Mishneh Torah, Admission into the Sanctu: Kal kohen hakkasher laavoda im shata yayin asur lo lehikkanes min hammizbeach ulfanim veim nichnas veavad avodato pesula vechayyav mita bide shamayim shenneemar velo tamutu vehu sheshshata reviit yayin chay bevat achat miyyayin sheavru alav arbaim yom aval im shata pachot merviit yayin o shata reviit vehifsik bah o mezagah bemayim o sheshshata yayin miggitto betoch arbaim afillu yeter merviit patur veeno mechallel avoda shata yeter merviit min hayyayin af al pi shehaya mazug veaf al pi shehifsik veshaha meat meat chayyav mita ufosel haavoda

Haya shikkor mishshear mashkin hamshakkerin asur lehikkanes lammikdash veim nichnas veavad vehu shikkor mishshear mashkin hamshakkerin afillu min hechalav o min haddevela hare ze loke vaavodato keshera sheen chayyavin mita ella al hayyayin bishat avoda veen mechallel avoda ella shikkor min hayyayin

Uchshem sheasur lakkohen lehikkanes lammikdash mippene hashshichrut kach asur lechal adam ben kohen ben yisrael lehorot keshehu shatuy afillu achal temarim o shata chalav venishtabbesha dato meat al yore shenneemar ulhorot et bene yisrael veim hora bedavar shehu meforash battora ad sheyedauhu hatztzedokim muttar kegon shehora shehashsheretz tame vehatztzefardea tahor vehaddam asur vechayyotze baze
Umuttar leshikkor lelammed tora vaafillu halachot umidrashot vehu shello yore veim haya chacham kavua lehoraa lo yelammed shellimmudo horaa hi

Shata kede reviit bilvad vehaya bah mayim kal shehu o yashan meat o halach kede mil kevar avar hayyayin umuttar laavod aval im shata yoter merviit afillu mazug shenat meat o hadderech mosifin beshichruto ella yishhe lefi hashshichrut ad shello yishshaer mishshichruto shum davar shebbaolam

Anshe mishmar muttarin lishtot yayin ballelot aval lo bime shabbatan vaafillu shear batte avot shel mishmar sheen avodatan hayyom shemma tichbad haavoda al anshe bet av shel yom veyitztarchu laacherim meanshe mishmartan lesayean veanshe bet av shel oto hayyom asurim lishtot ben bayyom ben ballayela shemma yishte ballayela veyashkim laavodato vaadayin lo sar yeno mealav

Kal kohen sheyyodea mee ze mishmar hu umee ze bet av hu veodea shebbatte avotav kevuim baavoda hayyom asur lo lishtot yayin kal oto hayyom haya yodea mee ze mishmar hu veeno makkir bet av shello asur lo lishtot kal otah shabbat shemmishmarto ovdin bah lo haya makkir mishmarto velo bet avotav haddin noten sheasur lishtot yayin leolam aval takkanato kalkalato vahare hu muttar lishtot tamid sheeno yachol laavod ad sheyyikkava bevet av shello uvmishmarto

Kohen sheggadal searo asur lo lehikkanes min hammizbeach velifnim veim nichnas veavad chayyav mita bide shamayim keshikkor sheavad shenneemar veyayin lo yishtu kal kohen verosham lo yegallechu ufera lo yeshallechu ma shetuye yayin bemita af meguddele pera bemita
Veen perue harosh mechallelin avoda af al pi shehu bemita avodato keshera

Keshem sheen hakkohanim muzharin al hayyayin ella bishat bia lammikdash kach en asurin legaddel pera ella bishat bia lammikdash bamme devarim amurim bechohen hedot aval kohen gadol asur legaddel pera velikroa begadav leolam shehare tamid hu bammikdash ulchach neemar bo et rosho lo yifra uvgadav lo yifrom
Kamma hu giddul pera sheloshim yom kenazir shenneemar bo gaddel pera sear rosho veen nezirut pechuta mishsheloshim yom lefichach kohen hedot haoved megalleach mishsheloshim yom lishloshim yom
Veanshe mishmar asurin lesapper ulchabbes beshabbattan kede shello yaalu lemishmartan keshehen menuvalin ella megallechin verochatzin umchabbesin kodem sheyyaalu
Mi sheshshalma mishmarto betoch haregel muttar legalleach baregel aval im shalma beerev haregel eno megalleach ella beerev haregel

Din kerue begadim vedin perue rosh echad hu shenneemar rashechem lo tifrau uvigdechem lo tifromu velo tamutu ha im avad vehu kerua begadim chayyav mita bide shamayim af al pi sheavodato keshera velo chillelah

Yerae li shekkal kohen hakkasher laavoda im nichnas min hammizbeach velifnim vehu shetuy yayin o shikkor mishshear hamshakkerin o perua rosh o kerua begadim kederech shekkorin al hammetim af al pi shello avad avoda hare ze loke hoil vehu rauy laavoda venichnas bishat haavoda menuval kacha vahare hu muzhar shello yikkanes

Vedin hannichnas kacha min hammizbeach velifnim vedin hayyotze mishsham echad hu ketzad kegon sheshshata reviit yayin ben haulam velammizbeach o kara begadav sham veyatza loke vechen im avad bitziato chayyav mita

Vechen asur lechal adam ben kohen ben yisrael lehikkanes lammikdash kullo mittechillat ezrat yisrael velifnim keshehu shetuy yayin o shikkor o perua rosh derech niuul o kerua begadim af al pi sheeno beazhara sheen ze kavod umora labbayit haggadol vehakkadosh sheyyikkanes bo menuval aval yisrael sheggiddel searo ad shennaasa machlefet velo haya derech niuul hare ze muttar lehikkanes leezrat yisrael
En kohen gadol nichnas lekodesh hakkadashim ella miyyom hakkippurim leom hakkippurim vechohen hedot nichnas lakkodesh laavoda bechal yom

Vehuzharu kal hakkohanim shello yikkansu lakkodesh o lekodesh hakkadashim shello bishat avoda shenneemar veal yavo vechal et el hakkodesh ze kodesh hakkadashim mibbet lapparochet lehazhir al kal habbayit

Kohen shennichnas lekodesh hakkadashim bishar yemot hashshana ben kohen hedot ben kohen gadol o kohen gadol shennichnas lo beom hakkippurim shello bishat haavoda chayyav mita bide shamayim shenneemar velo yamut vechamma peamim hu nichnas lesham beom hakkippurim arba kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo veim nichnas chamishit chayyav mita bide shamayim

Vehannichnas lakkodesh chutz lekodesh hakkadashim shello laavoda o lehishtachaot ben hedot ben gadol loke veeno chayyav mita shenneemar el pene hakkapporet velo yamut al kodesh hakkadashim bemita veal shear habbayit belav veloke

Kohen sheyyatza min hammikdash bishat haavoda bilvad chayyav mita ben kohen gadol ben kohen hedot shenneemar umippetach ohel moed lo tetzu pen tamutu kelomar lo tanichu avoda vetetzu mevohalim udchufim mippene gezera zo vechen ze shenneemar bechohen gadol umin hammikdash lo yetze eno ella bishat haavoda bilvad shello yaniach avodato veyetze

Im ken mippene ma nishnet azhara zo bechohen gadol shekkohen hedot shehaya bammikdash baavodato veshama shemmet lo met shehu chayyav lehitabbel alav af al pi sheeno yotze min hammikdash eno oved mippene shehu onen veim avad vehu onen shel tora chillel avodato ben bekarban yachid ben bekarban tzibbur aval kohen gadol oved keshehu onen shenneemar umin hammikdash lo yetze velo yechallel kelomar yeshev veyaavod avoda shehaya osek bah veenah mitchallelet
Uminnayin sheavodat haonen pesula mikkal vachomer im baal mum sheochel bekadashim im avad chillel onen shehu asur bekadashim shenneemar lo achalti veoni mimmennu din hu sheyechallel

Veaf al pi shekkohen gadol oved onen asur leechol bekadashim shenneemar veachalti chattat hayyom hayyitav beene Adonai vechen eno cholek leechol baerev onen sheavad eno loke umuttar ligga bekadashim af al pi shello taval shello asu maala ella baachila aval bingia hare ze tahor kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo
E zehu onen ze shemmet lo met min hakkerovim shehu chayyav lehitabbel alehen beom hammita bilvad hu hannikra onen din tora velayela hu onen middivre sofrim

Umet sheshshaha yamim veachar kach nikbar kal otam hayyamim sheachar yom hammita hu onen middivrehem vechen yom hakkevura veeno tofes lelo lefichach mi shemmet lo met ukvaro leachar yom hammita kal yom hakkevura eno makriv veeno ochel bekadashim middivrehem vetovel veochel laerev veom shemua kerova veom likkut atzamot hare hu keom kevura sheeno tofes lelo vaafillu middivrehem lefichach tovel veochel bekadashim laerev aval yom hammita keshem sheasur leechol bo kadashim min hattora kach asur leechol belelo middivrehem chutz min happesach bilvad shehu ochel laerev kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo

Haavel eno meshalleach karbenotav kal shiva afillu yayin o etzim o levona vechen metzora eno meshalleach karbenotav kal zeman sheeno rauy levia el hammachane eno rauy lehakrava aval hamnudde yesh bo safek im meshalleach im eno meshalleach lefichach im hikrivu alav nirtza

Teme sheretz vechayyotze bo vehearel meshallechin et karbenotehem umakrivin alehen chutz mippesach sheen shochatin oto al teme sheretz veen shochatin al hearel pesach kemo sheyyitbaer aval teme met en makrivin alav karban kelal ad sheyyittaher
Mitzvat ase leshalleach kal hattemeim min hammikdash shenneemar vishallechu min hammachane kal tzarua vechal zav vechol tame lanafesh

Ze hammachane haamur kan hu machane shechina shehu mippetach ezrat yisrael velifnim shomea ani shehamtzora vehazzav utme met shelashtan bemakom echad talmud lomar bimtzora badad yeshev michutz lammachane moshavo ze machane yisrael shehu mippetach yerushalayim ulfanim ma metzora shettumato chamura chamur shillucho mishshilluach chavero af kal shettumato chamura chamur shillucho mishshilluach chavero lefichach meshallechin et hamtzora chutz lishlosha machanot shehu chutz lirushalayim mippene shehu metamme bevia ma sheen hazzav metamme
Umshallechin zavin vezavot niddot veoldot chutz lishte machanot shehu chutz lehar habbayit mippene shehen metammein hammishkav vehammoshav afillu mittachat haeven ma sheen hammet metamme
Teme met afillu hammet atzmo muttar lehikkanes lehar habbayit shenneemar vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo immo bemachane halleviyya
Hachel meshallechin mimmennu akkum utmee met uvoale niddot aval tevul yom nichnas lesham shekkevar taval
Ezrat hannashim meshallechin mimmennu tevul yom aval lo mechussar kippurim shemmechussar kippurim heeriv shimsho veasur tevul yom bemachane leviyya middivre sofrim
Meezrat yisrael ulfanim afillu mechussar kippurim lo yikkanes lesham sheadayin lo tahar tahora gemura shenneemar vechipper aleha hakkohen vetahera mikkelal sheadayin lo gamra tahoratah

Hattame hamshullach mehar habbayit im nichnas over belo taase shenneemar veyatza michutz lammachane ze machane shechina velo yavo el toch hammachane ze machane leviyya vechen metzora shennichnas lirushalayim loke aval im nichnas lishar hearim hammukkafot choma af al pi sheeno rashshay lefi shenneemar badad yeshev eno loke
Nichnas hamtzora lehar habbayit loke shemonim aval teme met o tevul yom shennichnas leezrat nashim o mechussar kippurim shennichnas leezrat yisrael af al pi sheeno loke makkin oto makkat mardut
Uchshem sheshshilluach temeim min hammikdash baase kach im nichnesu ovrim belo taase shenneemar velo yetammeu et machanehem ze machane shechina
Uminnayin sheeno over ella im ken nichnas aval im naga baazara meachoreha patur shenneemar beoledet veel hammikdash lo tavo

Tame shennichnas lammikdash bemezid anush karet shenneemar veim lo yechabbes uvsaro lo yirchatz venasa aono beshogeg mevi karban ole veored shenneemar o nefesh asher tigga bechal davar tame veen chayyavin karet o karban ella meezrat yisrael ulfanim o al tosefet haazara shennitkaddesha kedushsha gemura kemo shebbearnu

Vee zehu hattame shechayyav karet al hammikdash kal shennitma betuma min hammet shehannazir megalleach aleha shekkevar nitparesh binzirut o sheyyigga baadam o bechelim shennitmeu beotan hattumot shehannazir megalleach alehem shehare hu sheni larishon shennaga bemet o shennitma bishar avot hattumot shel tora sheyyitparshu bimkoman

Kelalo shel davar kal hattaun biat mayim min hattora chayyav karet al biat hammikdash vaafillu achar shettaval ad sheyyaariv shimsho aval hammittamme betumot min hammet sheen hannazir megalleach alehen af al pi shehu tame tumat shiva hare ze patur al biat hammikdash

Vechen hannogea bechelim shennagu beadam shennaga bemet o shennaga beadam shennaga bechelim hannogim bemet af al pi shehu tame rishon leinyan teruma ultamme besar kadashim hare ze patur al biat hammikdash sheddevarim ellu halacha mippi hakkabbala veaf al pi shehu patur makkin oto makkat mardut

Hammachnis sheretz vechayyotze bo bammikdash o shehichnis adam tame lammikdash hare ze chayyav karet shehare timme mikdash Adonai aval hazzorek kelim temeim lammikdash afillu hau kelim shennagu bemet patur min hakkaret aval chayyav malkot shenneemar veim lo yechabbes vego mippi hashshemua lamdu al rechitzat gufo anush karet veal kibbus begadav loke arbaim

Yerae li sheeno loke ella al begadim shehen av tuma kegon begadim shennaga bahen ze hattame lemet shehen av hattuma kemo sheyyitbaer aval beged shehu rishon im hichniso lammikdash eno loke alav aval makkin oto makkat mardut

Vechen tame shehichnis yado lammikdash makkin oto makkat mardut vechen kal tame beav meavot hattumot shel divrehem o sheachal ochalin temeim veshata mashkin temein venichnas lammikdash bemezid kodem sheyyitbol makkin oto makkat mardut

Tame shennichnas lammikdash derech gaggot patur shenneemar veel hammikdash lo tavo derech bia chiyeva tora veaf al pi shehu patur mikkaret makkin oto makkat mardut vaafillu nichnas bemigdal happoreach baavir ben shennichnas lammikdash bemigdal derech gaggot ben shennichnas bo derech petachim

Kal makom shechayyavim al zedono karet veal shiggato karban im nimtzet sham tuma beshabbat motziin otah ushar hammekomot kofin alav keli ad achar shabbat uchshehen motziin en motziin otah ella bifshute kele etz sheen mekabbel tuma shello lerabbot et hattuma

Echad tame shennichnas lammikdash tahor o tahor shennichnas lammikdash sheyyesh bo tuma kegon shehaya met tachat ohel bammikdash venichnas hu tachat haohel hare ze chayyav karet shehare biato vetuma bain keachat nichnas lammikdash venitma sham achar shennichnas afillu timme atzmo sham bemezid yemaher veyibbahel veyetze bederech ketzara

Veasur lo lishhot o lehishtachaot o latzet bederech arukka veim shaha o sheyyatza baarukka af al pi shello shaha o shehechzir panav lahechal vehishtachava af al pi shello shaha chayyav karet veim haya shogeg mevi karban

Lo hechezir panav ella hishtachava derech yetziato kelappe chutz eno chayyav ella im ken shaha keshiur vechamma shiur shehiyyato kede likrot veyichreu appayim artza al haritzpa veyishtachau vehodot la ki tov ki leolam chasdo vezehu shiur hishtachavaya

Vee zo hi derech arukka kal sheefshar lo latzet min hammikdash bederech ketzara mimmenna yatza biktzara af al pi shello ratz ella halach akev betzad gudal afillu kal hayyom patur yatza baarukka af al pi sheratz vedachak atzmo bechal kocho venimtza shiur zeman shehalach bo haarukka pachot mishshiur hazzeman shemmehallech kal adam biktzara hoil veyatza baarukka chayyav yatza biktzara vehalach meat veamad veshaha meat ad shennitztaref mikkal hashshehiyyot kede hishtachavaya bemezid eno loke beshogeg eno mevi karban mippene shehaddavar safek aval makkin oto makkat mardut

Tame sheavad bammikdash chillel avodato vechayyav mita bide shamayim al avodato af al pi shello shaha sham shenneemar veyinnazru mikkadshe vene yisrael velo yechallelu et shem kadshi hare zo azhara leoved betuma ulhallan hu omer umetu vo ki yechalleluhu ma chillul haamur sham chayyav mita bide shamayim af kan mita bide shamayim vechal lav shechayyavin alav mita bide shamayim lokin alav
Af al pi sheim avad betuma eno chayyav bevet din ella malkot echav hakkohanim lo hau meviin oto levet din ella motziin oto lachutz ufotzin et mocho veen memachin alehen bechach

Veheach efshar lo laavod velo yishhe ad shello yitchayyev karet ella mita bide shamayim bilvad kegon shennitma baazara veyatza biktzara uvitziato haya tzinnor beyado vehafach bo evar al haesh bammizbeach vekerev serefato shekkal keruv avoda hare hu kaavoda

Vechen tame shettaval veavad kodem sheyyaariv shimsho avodato pesula vechayyav mita bide shamayim shenneemar velo yechallelu shem elohehem mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara litvul yom sheavad sheadayin tame hu shenneemar uva hashshemesh vetaher mikkelal sheadayin lo taher aval mechussar kippurim sheavad af al pi sheavodato pesula vechillel hare ze patur
Uminnayin sheavodato pesula shenneemar vechipper aleha hakkohen vetahera mikkelal sheadayin lo nigmera tahoratah vehu haddin lechal mechussere kippurim

Kohen sheavad veachar kach noda shehaya tame im hi tuma yedua kal hakkarbanot shehikriv pesulin shehare avodato chullin veim hi tumat hattehom hatztzitz meratztze vechal hakkarbanot shehikriv nirtzu vaafillu noda lo shehu tame kodem sheyyizrok haddam vezarak hurtza shehatztzitz meratztze al tumat hattehom af al pi shehu mezid uchvar bearnu tumat hattehom binzirut

Vechen hatztzitz meratztze al tumat devarim hakkerevin shenneemar vehaya al metzach aharon venasa aharon et aon hakodashim aval eno meratztze al tumat hanneechalin velo al tumat haadam shennitma betuma yedua ella im ken hayeta hattuma haddechuya batztzibbur shehatztzitz meratztze aleha
Veen hatztzitz meratztze ella bizman shehu al mitzcho shenneemar vehaya al mitzcho tamid leratzon lahem lifne Adonai

Kal karban sheen kavua lo zeman eno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et hattuma sheim lo yakriv hayyom yikkarev lemachar ulmachorat machar vechal karban shekkavua lo zeman ben karban tzibbur ben karban yachid doche et hashshabbat vedoche et hattuma velo kal hattumot hu doche ella tumat hammet levaddah
Kal karbenot hatztzibbur kavua zemannam lefichach kullan dochin et hashshabbat veet tumat hammet
Vechal karban mehen shekkarev betuma eno neechal ella maktirin mimmennu devarim haruyin lehaktara vehashshear harauy laachila nisraf kishar kadashim shennitmeu

Ketzad doche et hattuma higgia zemanno shel oto karban vehau rov hakkahal shemmakrivin oto temein lemet o shehau hakkahal tehorim vehau hakkohanim hammakrivin temeim lemet o shehau ellu veellu tehorin vehau kele hashsharet temeim lemet hare ze yease betuma veyitasseku bo hattemeim vehattehorim keechad veyikkansu kullan laazara aval hattemeim betuma acheret kegon zavin vezavot veniddot veoldot utmee sheretz unvela vechayyotze bahen lo yitasseku velo yikkansu laazara veaf al pi shennaasa betuma veim avru veasu o nichnesu laazara chayyavin karet al habbia umita al haavoda shello nidchet ella tumat hammet bilvad
Ufesach shebba betuma vedachaku temee met venichnesu lahechal peturin af al pi shello hutteru ella laazara hoil veen ani kore bahem el michutz lammachane teshallechum hare ellu peturin

Hau miktzat bet av temeim umiktzatam tehorim af al pi sherubban temee met lo yakrivu ella hattehorim haya kal bet haav temee met yaviu bet av acher hayeta kal hammishmara temee met machazirin al mishmara acheret im hau rov hakkohanim hannichnasin sham birushalayim bazzeman hakkavua temein yaasu betuma

Umippene ma machazirin al hattahor mibbet av acher mippene shehattuma lo huttera batztzibbur ella beissurah omedet udchuya hi atta mippene haddechak veen dochin kal davar hannidche ella bemakom shei efshar umippene ze tzericha tzitz leratztzot aleha

Uminnayin shettumat met dechuya batztzibbur shenneemar vayehi anashim asher hau temeim lenefesh adam kach lamdu mippi hashshemua sheanashim yechidim hem sheyyiddachu lefesach sheni im hau temeim aval tzibbur shehau temee met enan nidchin ella hattuma tiddache veyaasu pesach betuma vehu haddin lechal karban shekkavua lo zeman kefesach shehu doche et hattuma

Vahare haddavar meforash bakketuvim shenneemar sham ki rabbat bakkahal asher lo hitkaddashu vehalviyyim al shechitat happesachim lechol lo tahor lehakdish la ki marbit haam rabbat meefrayim umnashshe yissashchar uzvulun lo hitteharu umahu ze shenneemar ki achlu et happesach belo chakkatuv mippene sheibberu otah hashshana mippene hattuma shenneemar vayyivaatz hammelech vesarav vechal hakkahal birushalami laasot happesach bachodesh hashsheni ki lo yachlu laasoto baet hahi ki hakkohanim lo hitkaddeshu lemadday uchvar bearnu bekiddush hachodesh sheen meabberin et hashshana lechattechilla mippene hattuma

Veod acheret hayeta sham beotah hashshana sheibber chizkiyya hammelech et hashshana beom sheloshim shel adar sherauy lihot rosh chodesh nisan veasa oto hachodesh adar sheni velo hodu lo chachamim sheen meabberin beom ze kemo shebbearnu bekiddush hachodesh umippene devarim ellu sheasa shello kahalacha neemar ki achlu et happesach belo chakkatuv uvikkesh rachamim al atzmo veal hachachamim shehiskimu al maasav shenneemar ki hitpallel yechizkiyyahu alehem lemor Adonai hattov yechapper bead veneemar vayyishma Adonai el yechizkiyyahu vayyirpa et haam shennirtza karbanam

Mitzvat ase lekaddesh kohen haoved yadav veraglav veachar kach yaavod shenneemar verachatzu aharon uvanav mimmennu et yedehem veet raglehem vechohen sheavad velo kiddesh yadav veraglav shacharit chayyav mita bide shamayim shenneemar yirchatzu mayim velo yamutu vaavodato pesula ben kohen gadol ben kohen hedot

Uminnayin sheavodato pesula shenneemar chukkat olam lo ulzaro uvvigde kehunna hu omer chukkat olam ma mechussar begadim mechallel avoda kemo shebbearnu af mi shello rachatz yadav veraglav mechallel avoda

En hakkohen tzarich lekaddesh ben kal avoda vaavoda ella paam achat mekaddesh babboker veoved veholech kal hayyom kullo vechal hallayela vehu shello yetze min hammikdash velo yishan velo yatil mayim velo yassiach dato veim asa echad mearbatan tzarich lachzor ulkaddesh

Kal kohen sheavad avoda zara ben bemezid ben beshogeg af al pi shechazar bitshuva gemura hare ze lo yeshammesh bammikdash leolam shenneemar velo yiggeshu elay lechahen li echad haoved otah besherut kegon shennaasa komer laavoda zara o hammishtachave lah o hammode bah vekibbelah alav beeloha hare ze pasul leolam avar vehikriv en karbano reach nichoach af al pi shehaya shogeg beet sheshsheret o shehishtachava o shehoda aval hashshochet laavoda zara beshogeg im avar vehikriv karbano reach nichoach venitkabbel shehare lo sheret velo naasa komer ella shachat bilvad vehu shogeg veaf al pi chen lechattechilla lo yaavod

Mi sheavar veasa bayit chutz lammikdash lehakriv bo karbano lashshem eno kevet avoda zara veaf al pi chen kal kohen sheshshimmesh bevayit kaze lo yeshammesh bammikdash leolam vechen kelim shennishtammeshu bahen sham lo yishtammeshu bahen bammikdash leolam ella yigganzu veyerae li sheim avad kohen sheshshimmesh sham bammikdash lo pasal

Nimtzeu kal happesulin laavoda shemona asar veellu hen haoved avoda zara hazzar baal mum hearel hattame tevul yom mechussar kippurim haonen hashshikkor mechussar begadim yater begadim perum begadim perua rosh shello rachatz yadayim veraglayim hayyoshev mi sheyyesh ben yado uven hakkeli davar chotzetz mi sheyyesh ben raglo uven haaretz davar chotzetz mi sheavad bismolo kal ellu pesulin laavoda veim avdu chillelu chutz mipperua rosh ukrua begadim vehashshochet laavoda zara beshogeg sheim avdu avodatan keshera
Mishneh Torah, Daily Offerings and Addit: Mitzvat ase lehakriv shene kevasim olot bechal yom vehem hannikraim temidin echad babboker veechad ben haarbayim shenneemar shenayim layyom ola tamid vego

Veematay zeman shechitatan shel boker shochatin oto kodem shettaale hachamma mishsheyyeor pene kal mizrach vpaam achat dachaka hashshaa et hatztzibbur bevayit sheni vehikrivu tamid shel shachar bearba shaot bayyom

Tamid shel ben haarbayim shochatin oto mishsheyyaarich hatztzel veyerae lakkol sheheerich vehu mishshesh umechetza vamala ad sof hayyom velo hau shochatin oto bechal yom ella bishmone shaot umechetza vekarev betesha umechetza velamma meacharin oto shette shaot achar techillat zeman shechitato mippene hakkarbanot shel yechidim o shel tzibbur lefi sheasur lehakriv karban kelal kodem tamid shel shachar velo shochatin karban achar tamid shel ben haarbayim chutz mikkarban pesach levaddo shei efshar sheyyakrivu kal yisrael pischehen bishte shaot

En shochatin et happesach ella achar tamid shel ben haarbayim vechen mechussere kippurim makrivin kapparatan achar tamid shel ben haarbayim beom arbaa asar kede sheyyihu tehorin leechol pischehen laerev

Arve pesachim ben bechol ben beshabbat haya hattamid nishchat besheva umechetza vekarev bishmone umechetza kede sheyyihye lahem penay lishchot pischehem veim chal erev pesach lihot erev shabbat hau shochatin oto beshesh umechetza bitchillat zemanno vekarev besheva umechetza kede sheyyihye lahem revach litzlot kodem sheyyikkanes shabbat

Af al pi sheen shochatin achar tamid shel ben haarbayim maktirin kal davar harauy lehaktara kal hayyom umaktirin evre olot vehaemurin ad chatzi hallayela kemo shebbearnu bemaase hakkarbanot veevarin veemurin shello nitakkelu ben min hattamid ben mishshear hakkarbanot mehappechin bahen kal hallayela ad habboker shenneemar kal hallayela ad habboker

Evarim shel tamid dochin et hattuma veen dochin et hashshabbat ella beerev shabbat bilvad maktirin evre tamid shel erev shabbat shehattamid techillato doche shabbat vesofo eno doche chelve shabbat kerevin belele yom tov im chal yom tov lihot bemotzae shabbat aval en kerevin belele yom hakkippurim shenneemar lat shabbat beshabbatto velo olat shabbat zo beshabbat acheret velo olat chol beom tov
Arbaa asar shechal lihot beshabbat maktirin chelve happesachim belele yom tov mippene shehem kechelve shabbat

En pochatin mishshishsha telaim hamvukkarin belishkat hattelaim shebbammikdash veyihu muchanim kodem yom hakrava bearbaa yamim veaf al pi shehau mevakkerin oto mittechilla lo hau shochatin et hattamid ad shemmevakkerin oto sheniyya kodem shechita leor haavukot umashkin oto mayim bechos shel zahav kede sheyyihye noach lehefshet

Kemaase tamid shel shachar kach maase tamid shel ben haarbayim vehakkol kemaase haola shekkatavnu bemaase hakkarbanot velo hau koftin et hattale shello yechakku et hamminin ella ochazin yadav veraglav bidehen vechach hayeta akedato rosho laddarom ufanav lammaarav

Tamid shel shachar haya nishchat al keren tzefonit maaravit shel bet hammitbachayim al tabbaat sheniyya veshel ben haarbayim al keren tzefonit mizrachit mimmenna al tabbaat sheniyya kede sheyyihye keneged hashshemesh divre kabbala hen sheyyihu nishchatin keneged hashshemesh

Tau o shaggu afillu hezidu velo hikrivu tamid shel shachar yakrivu tamid shel ben haarbayim bamme devarim amurim beshennitchannech hammizbeach aval haya mizbeach chadash sheadayin lo karev alav kelum lo yakrivu alav techilla ben haarbayim sheen mechannechin mizbach haola ella betamid shel shachar

Mitzvat ase lihot esh yekuda al hammizbeach tamid shenneemar esh tamid tukad al hammizbeach af al pi shehaesh yarda min hashshamayim mitzva lehavi esh min hahedot shenneemar venatnu bene aharon hakkohanim esh al hammizbeach

Babboker orchin etzim veorchin berosh hammizbeach maaracha gedola shel esh shenneemar uvier aleha hakkohen etzim babboker babboker vechen mitzva lehaalot shene gezarim shel etz im tamid shel shachar yoter al atze hammaaracha shenneemar uvier aleha hakkohen etzim babboker vechen mosifin shene gezarim im tamid shel ben haarbayim shenneemar vearchu etzim al haesh mippi hashshemua lamdu shebbetamid shel ben haarbayim hakkatuv medabber
Shene gezarim shel ben haarbayim maalin otan shene kohanim kal echad veechad beetz yechidi beyado shenneemar vearchu hare kan shenayim aval shel shachar bechohen echad

Shalosh maarachot shel esh osin berosh hammizbeach bechal yom rishona maaracha gedola shealeha makrivin hattamid im shear hakkarbanot sheniyya betziddah ketanna shemmimmenna lokchin esh bemachta lehaktir ketoret bechal yom shelishit en aleha kelum ella lekayyem mitzvat haesh shenneemar esh tamid tukad

Mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar al mokda al hammizbeach zo maaracha gedola veesh hammizbeach tukad bo zo maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret vehaesh al hammizbeach tukad bo zo maaracha shelishit shel kiyyum haesh aval evarim ufdarim shello nitakkelu mibbaerev notnin otan betzidde maaracha gedola

Hamchabbe esh hammizbeach loke shenneemar lo tichbe afillu gachelet achat vaafillu horidah meal hammizbeach vechibba loke aval esh machta veesh menora shehechinah bammizbeach lehadlik mimmenna af al pi shekkibba otan berosh hammizbeach patur shehare nittekah lemitzva acheret veen ani kore bahen esh hammizbeach

Keshemmesadder atze maaracha gedola mesadderah bemizrach hammizbeach veyihye mare shehitchil lesadder min hammizrach verevach haya ben haggezarim verashe haggezarim happenimiyyim hau nogin baddeshen shebbeemtza hammizbeach vehu hannikra tappuach

Veachar shemmesadder maaracha gedola chozer uvorer atze teena yafim umsadder maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret mikkeneged keren maaravit deromit meshucha min hakkeren kelappe tzafon arba ammot uvah kemo chamesh sein gechalim uvshabbat osin bah kemo shemone sein gechalim mippene shealeha maktirin bechal shabbat shene beziche levona shel lechem happanim

Maaracha shelishit shel kiyyum haesh ose otah bechal makom sheyyirtze min hammizbeach umatztzit bah et haesh velo yatztzit haesh lematta veyaale otah lammizbeach ella bammizbeach atzmo matztzitin shenneemar veesh hammizbeach tukad bo mikkan lehatztzata shello tihye ella berosho shel mizbeach

Haramat haddeshen meal hammizbeach bechal yom mitzvat ase shenneemar veherim et haddeshen vehi avoda meavodot kehunna uvigde kehunna shettorem bahen haddeshen yihu pechutin min habbegadim shemmeshammesh bahem bishar avodot shenneemar ufashat et begadav velavash begadim acherim veherim et haddeshen eno omer acherim sheyyihu bigde chol ella sheyyihu pechutin min harishonim lefi sheeno derech eretz sheyyimzog kos lerabbo bivgadim shebbishshel bahem kedera lerabbo
Ematay tormin haddeshen bechal yom mishsheyyaale ammud hashshachar uvargalim mittechillat shelish emtzai shel layela uvom hakkippurim mechatzot hallayela

Ketzad tormin mi shezzacha litrom tovel velovesh bigde harama umkaddesh yadav veraglav veomrim lo hizzaher shemma tigga bichli ad shettekaddesh yadecha veraglecha veachar kach lokeach hammachta veshel kesef hayeta vehi hayeta netuna bemiktzoa ben kevesh lammizbeach bemaaravo shel kevesh venotel et hammachta veole lerosh hammizbeach umfanne et haggechalim elach veelach vechote min haggechalim shennitakkelu belev haesh veored lematta laaretz vehofech panav letzafon umhallech baaretz lemizrach hakkevesh kemo eser ammot kelappe hatztzafon vetzover et haggechalim shechata al gabbe haritzpa rachok min hakkevesh shelosha tefachim bemakom shennotnim murat haof vedishun hammizbeach happenimi vehammenora vachatiyya zo shechote bammachta umorid laritzpa etzel hammizbeach hi hammitzva shel kal yom

Achar sheyyarad ze shettaram ratzim echav hakkohanim umkaddeshin yedehem veraglehem bimhera venotlin et hammaggerefot veet hatztzinnorot veolin lerosh hammizbeach vechal evre haolot veemure hakkarbanot shello nitakkelu kal hallayela machazirin otam letzidde hammizbeach im en hatztzedadin machazikin sodrim otam bakkevesh keneged hassovev veachar kach gorfin et haddeshen bemagrefot mikkal tzidde hammizbeach umaalin oto arema al gabbe hattappuach vegorfin otah haarema bifsachter vehu keli gadol shemmachzik letech umoridin oto lematta uvargalim lo hau moridin oto ella mannichin haarema gevoha beemtza hammizbeach mippene shehu noy lammizbeach

Kal mi sheyyirtze min hakkohanim memalle min haddeshen shehoridu lematta umotzi chutz lair leshefech haddeshen veen lehotzaat haddeshen lachutz piyyus ella kal harotze umeolam lo nitatztzel kohen millehotzi et haddeshen

Veaf al pi sheen hotzaato lachutz avoda en baale mumin motziin oto uchshemmotziin oto lechutz lair mannichin oto bemakom sheen haruchot menashshevot bo bechazka velo chazirim gorfim oto velo yefazzerennu sham shenneemar vesamo sheyyannichennu benachat veasur lehanot bo

Mitzvat ase lehaktir hakketoret al mizbach hazzahav shebbahechal paamayim bechal yom babboker uven haarbayim shenneemar vehiktir alav aharon ketoret sammim lo hiktiru babboker yaktiru ben haarbayim afillu hau mezidin veen mechannechin mizbach hazzahav ella biktoret shel ben haarbayim

Kamma maktirin mimmenna bechal yom mishkal mea dinarin chamishshim babboker vachamishshim ben haarbayim mizbeach shenneekar maktirin hakketoret bimkomo uktoret sheppaka meal hammizbeach afillu keratin shebbah en machazirin otan

Beet shemmaktirin hakketoret bahechal bechal yom porshin kal haam min hahechal umibben haulam velammizbeach lo yihye sham adam ad sheyyetze ze shehiktir hakketoret vechen beshaa sheyyikkanes bedam chattaot hannaasot bifnim porshim hakkol mibben haulam velammizbeach ad sheyyetze shenneemar vechal adam lo yihye beohel moed bevoo lechapper bakkodesh vego binyan av lechal kappara shebbakkodesh shello yehe sham adam

Ketzad seder haktarat hakketoret bechal yom mi shezzacha bedishshun hammizbeach happenimi nichnas bichli kodesh veteni haya shemo veshel zahav haya umachazik kabbayim vachetzi manniach hatteni baaretz lefanav vechofen beyadav haefer vehappecham shebbetoch hammizbeach venoten letoch hatteni uvaacharona mechabbed et hashshear letocho umannicho sham bahechal veotze umi shezzacha bakketoret notel keli male ketoret gadush vechissuy haya lo uvazach haya shemo venoten habbazach betoch keli acher vechaf haya shemo umchasse et hakkaf beveged katan veochez hakkaf beyado venichnas immo echad bammachta shel esh beyado

Vechetzad chote ze shezzacha bemachta lokeach machta shel kesef veole lerosh hammizbeach umfanne et haggechalim elach veelach venotel min haggechalim shennitakkelu bemaaracha sheniyya veored umaran letoch machta shel zahav im nitpazzeru min haggechalim kemo kav o pachot mechabbedan laamma uvshabbat kofe alehen happesachter veim nitpazzer yeter al kav chozer vechote
Shelosha devarim haya happesachter meshammesh kofin oto al haggechalim veal hashsheretz beshabbat umoridin bo et haddeshen meal hammizbeach

Umakdim lifnehem ze sheddishshen hammizbeach happenimi venotel hatteni shebbo dishun hammizbeach umishtachave veotze veze shebbeyado hammachta tzover et haggechalim al gabbe hammizbeach happenimi umraddedan beshule hammachta umishtachave veotze veze shebbeyado hakkaf notel et habbazach mittoch hakkaf venotno leohavo o likrovo veroe im nitpazzer min hakketoret meat bechaf ohavo o kerovo noten lo letoch chafnav ze shennitpazzer im hakketoret shebbabbazach umishtachave veotze
Veomrin laze hammaktir hizzaher shello tatchil millefanecha shello tikkave umatchil umashlich hakketoret al haesh benachat kemi shemmerakked solet ad shettitradded al kal haesh
Veen hammaktir maktir ad shehammunne omer lo hakter veim kohen gadol hu omer lo hammunne ishi kohen gadol hakter veachar sheomer yifreshu kal haam veyaktir hammaktir veyishtachave veyetze

Dishun hammenora vahatavat hannerot babboker uven haarbayim mitzvat ase shenneemar yaaroch oto aharon uvanav vehadlakat hannerot docha et hashshabbat veet hattuma kekarbanot shekkavua lahen zeman shenneemar lehaalot ner tamid

Vechamma shemen hu noten lechal ner chatzi log shemen shenneemar meerev ad boker ten lo kammidda sheyyihye dolek meerev ad boker veen mechannechin et hammenora ella behadlakat shiva neroteha ben haarbayim

Mahu dishun hammenora kal ner shekkava mesir happetila vechal hashshemen shebbanner umkannecho venoten bo petila acheret veshemen acher bemidda vehu chatzi log veze shehesir mashlicho bimkom haddeshen etzel hammizbeach im dishun hammizbeach happenimi vehachitzon umadlik ner shekkava vehadlakat hannerot hi hatavatam vener shemmetzao shello kava metakkeno
Ner maaravi shekkava en madlikin oto achar dishshuno ella mimmizbach hachitzon aval shear hannerot kal ner shekkava mehen madliko minner chavero
Vechetzad madliko moshech happetila ad shemmadlikah umachazirah lefi shehannerot kevuim bammenora veeno yachol lehadlik bener acher mishshum bizzaon
Kal happetilot sheasur lehadlik bahen beshabbat asur lehadlik bahen bammikdash bammenora shenneemar lehaalot ner tamid shettehe shalhevet ola meeleha
Lo haya metiv kal hannerot befaam achat ella metiv chamishsha nerot umafsik veosin avoda acheret veachar kach nichnas umetiv hashshenayim kede lehargish et kal haazara

Kal ner shekkava madlikin oto minner acher mehen kemo shebbearnu vechetzad seder hahatava ze shezzacha bedishun hammenora nichnas uchli beyado vechuz shemo veshel zahav haya dome lekiton gadol medashshen bo et happetilot shekkavu veet hashshemen hannishar banner vemetiv chamishsha nerot umanniach hakkuz sham lifne hammenora al maala sheniyya mishshalosh maalot shellefaneha veotze veachar kach nichnas umetiv shene hannerot venotel hakkuz beyado umishtachave veotze

Chavite kohen gadol mitzvat ase lehakrivan bechal yom mechetza babboker im tamid shel shachar umechetza ben haarbayim im tamid shel ben haarbayim velishatan vaafiyyatan dochin et hashshabbat veet hattuma kechal karban shekkavua lo zeman shenneemar tufine shettehe naa velo teafe mibbaerev veod im teafe mibbaerev tippasel belina shehammarcheshet mikkele hakkodesh hi kemo shebbearnu
Techinat saltan veherkedan bachutz veenan dochin et hashshabbat

Kohen shehikriv mechetza beshacharit umet o nitma o nolad lo mum uminnu kohen acher tachtav lo yavi chatzi issaron mibbeto velo chatzi issaron shel rishon ella mevi issaron shalem vechotzehu umakriv mechetza umechetza aved

Nimtzeu shene chatzaim kerevin ushne chatzain ovdin veellu shene hachatzain haovdim mannichin otan ad shetteubbar tzuratan veotzin levet hasserefa vechen im avad o nitma hachetzi shel ben haarbayim vehechan sorfin otan baazara

Met kohen gadol beshacharit achar shehikriv chatzi haissaron velo minnu kohen acher meviin hayyorshin issaron shalem avur kapparato veosin oto chavitin ushlema hayeta kereva met kohen gadol kodem sheyyakrivo babboker velo minnu kohen acher makrivin oto issaron shalem babboker veissaron shalem ben haarbayim veen koflin shamnah ulvonatah af al pi shennichpela hassolet ella mafrishin lahem shelosha loge shemen vekometz levona log umechetza shemen vachatzi kometz levona leissaron shel boker velog umechetza shemen vachatzi kometz levona leissaron shel ben haarbayim

Kal haavodot haellu sheosin bechal yom befayis hau osin otan vechetzad hau osin kal kohane batte avot shel yom nichnasin lelishkat haggazit achar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar umlubbashin hen bevigde kehunna vehammunne sheal happeyasot immahen vehen omdin behakkafa vehammunne notel mitznefet meal rosho shel echad mehen umachazirah vehu haish shemmatchilin limnot mimmennu umfisin kemo sheyyitbaer

Veotzin laavoda anashim sheovdin bo ushar hakkohanim mosrin otan lechazzanin umafshitin otan et bigde hakkodesh velo hau mannichin alehen ella hammichnasayim bilvad ad shellovshin bigde chol vechozrin ufoshtin et hammichnasayim shel kodesh umachzirim hachazzanim et hakkelim lachallonot

Ketzad mefisin omdin behekkef umaskimin al minyan shemonim mea o elef o kal minyan sheyyaskimu alav vehammunne omer lahem hatzbiu vehen motziin etzbeotehen achat o shettayim veim hotzi shalosh monin lo shalosh veen motziin gudal bammikdash mippene harammaim shehaggudal katzar venoach lehotzio velichpoto vehammotzi gudal en monin oto lo umatchil hammunne limnot min haish hayyadua shehesir mitznafto techilla umone al etzbeotehen vechozer chalila ad sheyyashlim hamminyan shehiskimu alav vehaish sheshshalem hamminyan etzel etzbao hu sheyyetze befayis rishon laavoda
Velamma mone hamminyan shehiskimu alav al haetzbaot shehotziu velo haya mone al haanashim atzman lefi sheasur limnot yisrael ella al yede davar acher shenneemar vayyifkedem battelaim

Arbaa peyasot hau mefisin bechal yom beshacharit happayis harishon mi torem et hammizbeach hefisu vezacha mi shezzacha litrom vehu mesadder et hammaaracha vehu maale shene gizre etzim lammizbeach vehu machnis machta melea esh min hammizbeach hachitzon lemizbach hazzahav lehaktir aleha ketoret

Happayis hashsheni zochin bo shelosha asar al seder amidatan ketzad hammunne omer lahem hatzbiu umone kederech shebbearnu veze sheyyatza befayis rishon hu shochet tamid shel shachar vehashsheni sheomed betziddo hu mekabbel et dam hattamid vehu zorko vehashshelishi hassamuch lashsheni medashshen hammizbeach happenimi shehu mizbach hakketoret veharvii shebbetziddo medashshen et hammenora umetiv et hannerot vehachamishi maale rosh hattamid veraglo lakkevesh vehashshishshi maale shette hayyadayim vehashshevii maale haoketz veharegel vehashshemini maale hechaze vehaggera vehatteshii maale shette haddefanot vehaasiri maale hakkeravayim vehaachad asar maale solet hannesachim vehashshenem asar maale hachavitin vehashshelosha asar maale hayyayin shel nesachim

Happayis hashshelishi omer lahen hammunne lechal anshe bet av shel oto hayyom mi shello hiktir ketoret miyyamav yavo veyafis veyitkabbetzu etzel hammunne veyafisu umi sheyyetze befayis ze rishon hu sheyyizke lehaktir ketoret

Happayis harvii mitkabbetzin kullan umfisin leda mi maale evarim min hakkevesh lammizbeach hefisu vezacha mi shezzacha tamid shel ben haarbayim en mefisin lo payis acher ella kal kohen shezzacha baavoda min haavodot shacharit yizke ben haarbayim chutz min hakketoret shehen mefisin lah payis acher ben haarbayim veyavo kal mi shello hiktir ketoret meolam meanshe oto bet av veyafisu aleha veim kevar hiktiru kullan mimehen mefisin lahen kullan beshacharit befayis shelishi veze shezzacha bah shacharit maktirah ben haarbayim

Beshabbat sheyyesh sham temidin umusafin ushne beziche levona ketzad hem ovdin mefisin beshachar anshe oto bet av shel mishmar hayyotze umakrivin tamid shel shachar ushne kivse ola shel musafin vechal shezzacha baavoda meavodat hattamid shel shachar hu zoche bah bishne kivse musaf vehammishmar haacher shennichnas beshabbat mefisin peyasot acherot letamid shel ben haarbayim veellu veellu cholkin belechem happanim
Veen ochlin et hallechem ad sheyyaktiru shene beziche levona al haesh vehallevona teuna melach kishar hakkarbanot
Veachar karban hammusafin maktirin shene habbezichin ushne kohanim makrivin et shene habbezichin

Ellu hen hannisrafim besar kodesh shennitma o notar o nifsal vechen hammincha shennitmea o nifsela o notra veasham taluy shennoda lo shello chata kodem shennizrak damo vechattat haof habbaa al hassafek usar nazir tahor vehaarla vechile hakkerem vedavar sheen darko lehissaref kegon mashkin shel arla veshel kile hakkerem hare ellu yikkaveru

Veellu hem hannikbarim kadashim shemmetu ben kadshe mizbeach ben kadshe bedek habbayit vekadashim shehippilu nefel hippilu shilya tikkaver veshor hanniskal veegla arufa vetzippore metzora usar nazir tame ufeter chamor uvasar bechalav vechullin shennishchatu baazara
Haoreg melo hassit missear nazir umippeter chamor besak yiddalek
Kal hannikbarin efran asur vechal hannisrafin shel hekdesh efram muttar chutz middeshen hammizbeach hachitzon vehappenimi vedishun hammenora
Kal hannisrafin lo yikkavru vechen kal hannikbarim lo yissarfu sheaf al pi shehu machmir bisrefato hare hekel beefran sheefer hannikbarim asur

Haya makriv immo bizvachim veamar lo nitpaggelu ose immo betahorot veamar lo nitmeu neeman lo nechshedu yisrael al kach aval im amar lo zevachim shehikravti lecha beoto hayyom nitpaggelu veotan hattahorot nitmeu im haya neeman lo somech al devarav veim lav shurat haddin sheeno neeman veharotze lehachmir al atzmo hare ze meshubbach
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 1: Kal hakkarbanot shel mine nefesh chayya bain mechamishsha minin bilvad min habbakar umin hakkevasim umin haizzim umin hattorim umin bene hayyona
Vechal hakkarbanot ben shel tzibbur ben shel yachid arbaa minin ola vechattat veasham ushlamim
Veod yesh sham shelosha mine karban yachid vehem happesach vehabbechor vehammaaser

Kal karbanot hatztzibbur hen ola o chattat veen bekarbenot hatztzibbur shelamim chutz mishshene kevasim habbaim im lechem hattenufa baatzeret vehem hannikraim zivche shalme tzibbur veen hatztzibbur makrivin asham leolam velo of

Karbenot hatztzibbur hem shene temidin shel kal yom umusfe shabbatot verashe chodashim vehammoadot usir chattat shel yom hakkippurim vechen im shaggu bet din vehoru baavoda zara mevi kal shevet veshevet par vesair happar ola vehassair chattat veellu hasseirim hem hannikraim seire avoda zara veim shaggu vehoru bishar hammitzot meviin par lechattat vehu hannikra par helem davar shel tzibbur

Karbenot hayyachid hem habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach vehachagiga vehi shelamim vehariyya vehi olot vekarban hagger vehu ola min habbehema o shene bene yona o shette torim ushnehen ola o shette behemot achat ola veachat shelamim vehannoder o hammitnaddev ola o shelamim ushlamim habbain im hallechem hem hannikraim toda vechen karbenot hannazir vehen ola vechattat ushlamim vekarbenot metzora vehen chattat veasham veola vekarbenot zavim veoldot vehen chattat veola vekarban hashshogeg bemitzvat lo taase sheyyesh bah karet vehu chattat veim nistappek lo im asa o lo asa oto hachote mevi asham vehu hannikra asham taluy veyesh averot shemmevi alehen asham vehu hannikra asham vadday vechen el haola ufar hachattat shemmakriv kohen gadol mishshello beom hakkippurim hare hen karban yachid ufar ze hu hannikra par yom hakkippurim vechal ellu hakkarbanot meforashin hen battora vechal echad mehen yitbaaru dinav bimkomo

Kal karbenot hayyachid chayyav beacharautan uvacharaut niskehen chutz min hannedava vechal karbenot hatztzibbur enan chayyavin beacharautan velo beacharaut niskehen veim karav hazzevach chayyavin beacharaut niskehem vekarban yachid shekkavua lo zeman hare hu kekarban tzibbur veeno chayyav beacharauto
Kal olat behema enah baa ella min hazzecharim bilvad vehi baa min hakkevasim umin haizzim umin habbakar ben gedolim ben ketannim umin hattorim uvne yona veechad bahen hazzachar vehannekeva
Hachattat baa mechameshet hamminim haellu min hazzecharim umin hannekevot min haggedolim umin hakketannim
Haasham eno ba ella mizzichre kevasim bilvad yesh asham ba miggedole min ze veyesh asham ba min hakketannim

Hashshelamim baim min hakkevasim umin haizzim umin habbakar mizzecharim uminnekevot min haggedolim umin hakketannim veen haof ba shelamim hakketannim hem mibben shemonat yamim ad shana temima miyyom leom im nitabbera shana nitabbera lo vehaggedolim babbakar ad shalosh shanim shelemot miyyom leom uvatztzon ad shette shanim shelemot miyyom leom yoter al ze hare hu zaken veen makrivin oto

Af al pi shekkal hakkarbanot kesherin miyyom hashshemini vahala en makrivin lechattechilla ella miyyom sheloshim vahala chutz min habbechor umin happesach umin hammaaser sheim ratza lehakrivan bashshemini lechattechilla makriv

Shaot monin lekadashim veim hosifu shaa achat o pachatu shaa pesulin ketzad karban shemmitzvato lihot ben shana im hosif al hashshana shaa achat nifsal afillu haya ben shana bishat shechita vehosif al hashshana bishat zerika nifsal ad sheyyihye ben shana ad sheat zerika vechen bechal hazzevachim

Kal makom shenneemar battora keves o kavsa o kevasim hare ellu bene shana vechal makom shenneemar ayil o elim hem hazzecharim bene shenatayim umeematay yikkare ayil mishsheyyikkanes beshana sheniyya echad ushloshim yom aval beom sheloshim eno kasher lo lecheves velo laayil vehu hannikra pilgas vechal makom shenneemar bo egel hare ze ben shana par ben shettayim seir izzim ben shana sair ben shettayim kal shana sheniyya hu nikra sair

Kal karbenot hatztzibbur zecharim vechen chattaot shel tzibbur min haez o min habbakar veen bahen min hakkevasim vechal olot hatztzibbur min hakkevasim umin habbakar veen lahen ola min haez kal chattat yachid nekeva veteachel lakkohanim veenah baa min habbakar chutz mishshalosh chattaot chattat nasi shehi ez veneechelet vechattat kohen mashiach shehu par venisrefet vehu par habba al kal hammitzot vehashshelishi par shemmevi kohen gadol beom hakkippurim vehu chattat venisraf

Kal chattaot shel tzibbur neechalot chutz missair shel yom hakkippurim shechavero mishtalleach vechen seire avoda zara ufar helem nisrafin ufar habba al kal hammitzot ufar helem nikraim parim hannisrafin usire avoda zara nikraim seirim hannisrafin ha lamadta shechamesh chattaot hem hannisrafot shettayim layyachid veshalosh latztzibbur

Kal hakkarbanot haellu nikraim zevachim vechal haolot vehachattaot vehaashamot ushne kavse shelamim shel atzeret nikraim kadshe kadashim aval shelamim shel yachid vehabbechor vehammaaser vehappesach nikraim kadashim kallim

Haevarim shessorfin otan al gabbe hammizbeach min hachattaot hanneechalot umin haashamot umin hashshelamim hen hannikrain emurin veellu hen haemurin shel shor o shel ez hachelev asher al hakkerev uvichlalo chelev sheal gabbe hakkeva ushte hakkelaot vechelev shealehen im hachelev asher al hakkesalim veoteret hakkaved venotel min hakkaved meat im hayyoteret veim haya hakkarban mimmin hakkevasim mosif al ellu haalya temima im hachulot min hashshidra ad mekom hakkelaot shenneemar leemmat heatze yesirenna vechal haemurin nisrafin al mizbeach hachitzon
Hayeta habbehema meubberet af al pi shekkalu chodashav shel ubbar vaafillu nimtza chay eno maale chelbo im chelev immo ella chelev immo bilvad vahare haubbar keechad meevareha
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 2: Hayyayin vehassolet shemmeviin im hakkarban hem hannikrain nesachim vehassolet levaddah nikret minchat nesachim uminchat nesachim enah teuna lo tenufa velo haggasha velo levona aval teuna melach vechullah nisrefet al mizbeach hachitzon veyitnassech hayyayin al hammizbeach veen notnin oto al haesh ella magbiha yado veotzek al hayesod vehu yored lashshitin

En taun nesachin ella olat behema ushlamim bilvad ben hau karban tzibbur o karban yachid o keves yoledet veelo shel kohen gadol hoil vehen olot teunim nesachim aval haof vehaashamot vehachattaot en meviin immahem nesachim chutz mechattat metzora vaashamo shennitparshu niskehem battora

Uminnayin sheen meviin nesachim im hachattat vehaasham shenneemar lefalle neder o nedava davar habba beneder undava yatzu chattat veasham uvchor umaaser ufesach hoil veenan bain beneder undava en teunin nesachim uminnayin lehavi shalme chagiga veolat reiyya linsachim shenneemar o bemoadechem

Kamma hu shiur nesachim niske keves o kavsa issaron solet balul birviit hahin shemen veyayin lannesech reviit hahin vechen niske haez ben katan ben gadol ben zachar ben nekeva o niske rachel af al pi shehi gedola aval niske ayil hen shene esronim solet balul bishlishit hahin shemen veyayin lannesech shelishit hahin veniske happar o haegel ben zecharim ben nekevot shelosha esronim solet balul bachatzi hahin shemen veyayin lannesech chatzi hahin

Ellu hen hannesachim ben laola ben lashshelamim kashshiur hazze lechal echad veechad shenneemar kammispar asher taasu kacha taasu laechad kemisparam en mosifin al hashshiurin haellu veen gorin mehen veim gara o hosif kal shehu pasul chutz mikkeves haola shemmakrivin beom hanafat haomer shehannesachim shello shene esronim balul bishlishit hahin shemen af al pi shennichpela salto lo nichpelu yeno veshamno ella yayin lannesech reviit hahin

Hamtzora mevi im shelosha kevasim shello shehen chattat veasham veola shelosha esronim umippi hashshemua lamdu shehen bain bichlal hazzevachim shello issaron im kal keves balul birviit hahin shemen urviit yayin im kal issaron mishshelashtan kishar niske hakkevasim vehammakriv et happilgas mevi immo niske ayil velo ole lo zivcho
Hahin hu shenem asar log uchvar hodanu shiur hallog im middot acherot behilchot eruvin vehaissaron hu haomer shehu shiur challa uchvar bearnu shiuro beinyan challa

Keshemmoddin hannesachim o hammenachot ben minchat yachid ben minchat tzibbur en moddin oto bemidda shel shelosha esronim lappar o shel shenayim laayil ella moded hakkol beissaron echad shehaya bammikdash vechen hashshemen shel nesachim moddin oto bemiddato shebbammikdash veshemen shel minchot hayyachid belog shebbammikdash keminyan haesronot kach minyan hallogin

Berutze hammiddot shel solet chol sheen gav haissaron kodesh uverutze hayyayin vehashshemen kodesh lefi shehu yored al gav hakkeli uchle hallach nimshechu mibbifnim umibbachutz velamma yitkaddeshu habberutzin af al pi sheen kavanat hammoded ella lema shebbakkeli bilvad kede shello yomru motziin mikkele sharet lechol
Ma hau osin babberutzin im yesh sham zevach acher yakrivu immo veim lanu yippaslu belina veim lav mekayetzin bahen hammizbeach
Ketzad lokchin bahem olot habbasar lashshem vehaorot lakkohanim

Hassolet im hashshemen shel nesachim enan meakkevin et hayyayin velo hayyayin meakkevan velo hannesachim meakkevin et hazzevach ella mevi adam karbano hayyom unsachav achar asara yamim echad yachid veechad tzibbur vehu shello kadshu hannesachim bichli sharet aval im netanan lichli sharet im lanu yippaslu belina
En meviin nesachim ella min hachullin lo yeviem lo min hatteruma velo mimmaaser sheni velo min habbikkurim vaafillu toda shemmevi lachmah min hammaaser lo yevio nesachim ella min hachullin

Kal shiure hannesachim haemurin besefer yechezkel uminyan otan hakkarbanot vesidre haavoda hakketuvim sham kullam milluim hen veen nohagin ledorot ella hannavi tziva uferesh ketzad yihu makrivin hammilluin im chanukkat hammizbeach bime hammelech hammashiach kesheyyibbane bayit shelishi

Uchshem shehikrivu hannesiim bachanukkat hammizbeach devarim sheen kemotan ledorot vehikrivu beshabbat kach hannasi makriv chanukkato beshabbat leatid kaasher meforash sham vechen karbanot shehikrivu bime ezra habbaim mehashshevi milluim hau veenan nohagin ledorot aval devarim hannohagim ledorot hem divre tora shepperashnu kemo sheheetikum mippi moshe rabbenu en lehosif alehem veen ligroa
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 3: Shennayim sheratzu lehavi shelamim o ola beshuttafut meviin ben beneder ben bindava vaafillu of yavo beshuttafut

Veechad anashim veechad nashim o avadim meviin kal hakkarbanot aval haakkum en mekabbelin mehen ella olot bilvad shenneemar umiyyad ben nechar lo takrivu et lechem elohechem afillu olat haof mekabbelin min hannachri af al pi shehu oved avoda zara aval en mekabbelin mehen shelamim velo menachot velo chattaot vaashamot vechen olot sheenan baot beneder undava en mekabbelin otan min hannachri kegon olat yoledet vechayyotze bah meolot sheenan baot mishshum neder velo mishshum nedava

Nachri shehevi shelamim makrivin otan olot shehaakkum libbo lashshamayim nadar shelamim untanam leyisrael al menat sheyyitkapper bahen leyisrael ochlin otan hayyisreelim keshalme yisrael vechen im netanan lakkohen kohen ochlan

Yisrael shehu mumar laavoda zara o mechallel shabbat befarhesya en mekabbelin mimmennu karban kelal afillu haola shemmekabbelin otah min hannachrim en mekabbelin otah min hammumar hazze shenneemar adam ki yakriv mikkem mippi hashshemua lamdu mikkem velo kullechem lehotzi et hammumar aval im haya mumar lishar averot mekabbelin mimmennu kal hakkarbanot kede sheyyachazor bitshuva haya mumar laavera vehu mefursam veyadua laasotah vehurgal bah ben lehachis ben leteavon en mekabbelin mimmennu karban leotah avera ketzad kegon shehaya ragil leechol chelev ben lehachis ben leteavon veshagag veachal chelev vehevi chattat en mekabbelin otah mimmennu

Olot haakkum en meviin immahen nesachim shenneemar kal haezrach yaase kacha aval niskehem kerevin mishshel tzibbur shenneemar kacha taasu laechad kemisparam veenan teunot semicha sheen semicha ella beyisrael baanashim lo benashim

Kal karbenot behema sheyyakriv hayyachid ben chova ben nedava somech alehen keshehen chayyin chutz min habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach shenneemar vesamach yado al rosh karbano mippi hashshemua lamdu shekkal karban bemashma chutz mippesach uvchor umaaser

Haof eno taun semicha vechen kal hammaot sheddinan sheyyippelu lattevot shel nedava shekkevar bearnu behilchot shekalim shekkullan yavou olot en baal otan hammaot somech al otah haola veeno mevi aleha nesachim ella nesacheha mishshel tzibbur veaf al pi shehaya kohen avodatah veorah shel anshe mishmar
Hakkol somchin chutz mecheresh shote vekatan veeved veishsha vesuma venachri veen hashshaliach somech sheen semicha ella bivalim shenneemar vesamach yado lo yad ishto velo yad avdo velo shelucho
Chamishsha sheheviu zevach echad kullan somchin alav ze achar ze lo sheyyismechu kullan bevat achat mi shemmet vehinniach karbano ola o shelamim hare yorsho mevio vesomech alav umevi nesachav

En semicha bekarbenot hatztzibbur chutz mishshete semichot al sair hammishtalleach veal par helem davar ushlosha min hassanhedrin somchin alav vedavar ze halacha mippi moshe rabbenu sheen betzibbur ella shette semichot

En somchin ella baazara samach chutz laazara chozer vesomech mibbifnim veim haya baal hakkarban omed bachutz vehichnis yado lefanim vesamach semichato keshera vehu sheyyismoch bechal kocho veen somech ella tahor veim samach hattame samach

Uvmakom shessomchin shochatin vetechef lismicha shechita veim shachat bemakom acher o sheshshaha shechitato keshera vehassemicha sheyare mitzva hi lefichach im lo samach kipper veenah meakkevet veaf al pi chen maalin alav keillu lo kipper
Vetzarich hassomech lismoch bechal kocho bishte yadav al rosh habbehema shenneemar al rosh hala lo al hatztzavar velo al hatztzedadin velo yihye davar chotzetz ben yadav uven habbehema

Vechetzad somech im haya hakkarban kodesh kadashim maamido batztzafon ufanav lammaarav vehassomech omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav umanniach shette yadav ben shette karnav umitvadde al chattat aon chattat veal asham aon asham veal haola mitvadde aon ase vaaon lo taase shennittak laase

Ketzad mitvadde omer chatati aviti pashati veasiti kach vechach vechazarti bitshuva lefanecha vezo kapparati haya hakkarban shelamim somech bechal makom sheyyirtze min haazara bimkom shechita veyerae li sheeno mitvadde al hashshelamim aval omer divre shevach
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 4: Kal hakkarbanot en makrivin otan ella bayyom shenneemar beom tzaoto et bene yisrael lehakriv et karbenehem bayyom velo ballayela lefichach en shochatin zevachim ella bayyom veen zorkin damim ella beom hashshechita shenneemar beom hakrivo et zivcho beom hazzevicha tihye hahakrava vechevan sheshshaka hachamma nifsal haddam

Kal shekkarvu mattirav bayyom maalin oto al hammizbeach kal hallayela ketzad zevachim shennizrak damam bayyom maktirin emurehen ballayela ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar vechen evre haolot maktirin otan ballayela ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar uchde leharchik min happeshia amru chachamim sheen maktirin haemurin veevre haola ella ad chatzot hallayela

Af al pi shemmuttar lehaktir emurin veevarim ballayela en meacharin otan ledaat ella mishtaddelin lehaktir hakkol bayyom chaviva mitzva bishatah shehare hekter emurin veevarim af al pi shekkesherim ballayela dochin et hashshabbat bizmannan veen meacharin otan lemotzae shabbat
Kal davar sheeno karev ella bayyom kegon hakkometz vehallevona vehakketoret umnachot hannisrafot muttar lehakrivan im mevo hashshemesh vehem mitakkelin veholchin kal hallayela keevre ola

Hannesachim habbaim im hazzevach en kerevin ella bayyom shenneemar ulniskechem ulshalmechem makkish nesachim lishlamim ma shelamim bayyom af nesachim bayyom aval hannesachim habbaim bifne atzman mitkaddeshin ballayela ukrevin ballayela lefichach im nizdammenu lo nesachim habbain bifne atzman makdishan umakrivan ballayela vaalot hashshachar poselet bahen keevre haolot

Kal hayyom kasher lismicha velishchita velimlika lehekter lehaggasha ulhazzaya velitnufa velikmitza ulkarban hammusafin vechal hallayela kasher lehaktir emurin veevarim ze hakkelal davar shemmitzvato bayyom kasher kal hayyom vedavar shemmitzvato ballayela kasher kal hallayela veaf al pi chen zerizin makdimin lemitzot
Kal hazzevachim en shochatin otan lechattechilla ella besakkin mikkele sharet veim shachat bechal davar sheshshochatin bo hachullin afillu bikrumit shel kane kesherin

Vechal hazzevachim shekkibbel middamam pachot mikkede hazzaya lo nitkaddesh haddam vetzarich lehitkaven lekabbel kal haddam ketzad hu ose ochez hassimanim beyado umotzian im havveridin letoch hammizrak veshochet shenayim o rov shenayim kede sheyyitkabbel haddam kullo bichli umagbiha hassakkin lemala kede shello yered haddam mealeha ella min hatztzavar vedam shebbassakkin mekannecho bisfat hammizrak
Avir hakkeli hare hu kichli haya mekabbel haddam venifchatu shule hammizrak kodem sheyyaggia haddam laavir hammizrak hannifchat lo nitkaddesh haddam shehaavir sheen sofo lanuach eno kemunnach

Kal hazzevachim tzarich haoved shettihye machshavto leshem hazzevach ulshem bealav bishat zevicha uvishat kabbalat haddam uvishat holachat haddam uvishat zerikato al hammizbeach shenneemar uvsar zevach todat shelamav shettihye zevicha im shear arba haavodot leshem shelamav vechen shear hakkarbanot veim shachat veavad shear avodot setam velo chashav kelal beola uvishlamim hare hen kesherim vealu labbealim

Vetzarich shettihye machshavto bishat shechitat haola leshem shishsha devarim leshem hazzevach ulshem hazzoveach veshehazzevach lehashshem baruch hu vesheyyaktiro laishshim veshehaktarato lereach bilvad veshereach ze nachat ruach lifne hashshem veim shachat setam kasher kemo shebbearnu vehashshochet chattat veasham tzarich shettihye machshavto leshem oto hachet shebba alav
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 5: Kevar bearnu sheshshechitat hakkadashim keshera bezarim umikkabbalat haddam veelach mitzvat kehunna vechal hazzevachim kibbul daman bichli sharet beyad kohen aval mekom shechitatan umkom kibbul daman eno shave bechullan

Ketzad kadshe kadashim en shochatin otan veen mekabbelin et daman ella bitzfon hammizbeach bechal hammakom shebbearnu gevulotav bitchillat sefer ze vekadashim kallim shechitatan vekibbul daman bechal makom min haazara

Uminnayin sheen shochatin kadshe kadashim ella batztzafon shehare neemar beola veshachat oto al yerech hammizbeach tzafona uvchattat hu omer bimkom asher tishshachet haola tishshachet hachattat uchshem shehachattat nikret kodesh kadashim kach haola nikret kodesh kadashim uvasham hu omer bimkom asher yishchatu et haola yishchatu et haasham veshalme tzibbur hukkeshu lechattat shenneemar vaasitem seir izzim echad lechattat ushne chevasim bene shana lezevach shelamim lefichach hen kadshe kadashim kechattat venishchatin bimkom shechitatah umkom shechita hu mekom hakkabbala

Uminnayin sheshshochatim kadashim kallim bechal haazara afillu achore hahechal shehare neemar bishlamim ushchato petach ohel moed lehachshir kal haruchot shehare lo yiched lahem ruach vehu haddin lishar hakkadashim kallim veim shechatam bahechal kesherim aval im shechatan begaggo shel hechal pesulin sheen haggaggot reuot lishchita kelal ella bekarka haazara
Shelamim sheshshechatan kodem sheyyippatchu daltot hahechal pesulin shenneemar petach ohel moed bizman sheppatuach afillu hau daltotav muggafot hare ze kenaul aval happarochet shealav enah poselet

En bechal hakkarbanot karban shettaun hazzayat dam beetzbao ella chattat bilvad shenneemar bah vetaval etzbao baddam vetzarich sheyyihye sham dam kede tevila lo sheyyissafeg etzbao middam

Parim hannisrafin usirim hannisrafin zorek dam mikkal echad mehem sheva hazzaot al happarochet hammavdelet ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkadashim vearba hazzaot al arba karnot mizbach hazzahav

Par kohen mashiach habba al kal hammitzot kohen hammashiach atzmo mekabbel damo umazze mimmennu mibbifnim veim kibbel vehizza kohen hedot kasher

Seire avoda zara vehen seirin hannisrafin lo nitparesh bahen battora ketzad noten daman ulhechan hu noten ella lefi shehen chattat hakkahal dinan kedin par helem shehu chattat hakkahal lechal haamur bo lemattan damim velisrefa ultamme et hassoref

Kal kadshe hakkadashim sheera bahen pissul kodem hefshetan en orotehen lakkohanim leachar hefshetan oran lakkohanim vechal haorot mechallekin otan anshe mishmar benehen meerev shabbat leerev shabbat
