Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 6: Mitzvat ase laasot haola kemishpatah hakketuva battora vechetzad maase haola shochet vezorek haddam kemo shebbearnu umafshit umnatteach umaktir kal hannetachim al gabbe hammizbeach shenneemar vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha

Tzemer shebberashe kevasim vesear shebbizkan hatteyashim vehaatzamot vehaggidim vehakkarnayim vehattelafayim bizman shehen mechubbarin maktirin et hakkol veim parshu lo yaalu shenneemar olotecha habbasar vehaddam vechullan sheppaku meal hammizbeach lo yachzir vechen gachelet sheppaka meal hammizbeach lo yachzir

Evarim sheppaku meal hammizbeach im yesh bahen mammash afillu paku achar chatzot hallayela yachzir shenneemar al mokda al hammizbeach kal hallayela veim en bahem mammash afillu paku kodem chatzot lo yachzir nitcharech habbasar veyavash alehen keetz ufaku kodem chatzot yachzir achar chatzot lo yachzir

Keshemmenatteach evre haola molichin et kal hannetachim lakkevesh umolchin otam sham veachar kach maalin kal haevarim lerosh hammizbeach umesir gid hannashe berosh hammizbeach umashlicho al gabbe haddeshen shebbeemtza hammizbeach vezorek kal haevarim al haesh shenneemar habbasar vehaddam keshem shehaddam bizrika kach kal habbasar bizrika veachar shezzorkan chozer veorech otan al haesh shenneemar vearach hakkohen otam veevarim shetztzelaan veachar kach heelan lammizbeach en bahem mishshum reach nichoach

Ketzad menattechin et haola lo haya shover et haregel ella nokvo vetole bo umafshit veim haya shor mafshito beli teliyya umafshit ad shehu maggia lechaze higgia lechaze chotech et harosh venotno lakkohen vechotech et hakkeraayim venotnan leacher umashlim et hahefshet vekorea et hallev umotzi et damo vechotech et hayyadayim venotnan leacher ala leregel yemini chotcho venotno lemi shezzacha barosh ushte betzim immah veachar kach korea et habbehema ad sheyyiggalu et hammeayim venotel et happeder venotno al harosh millemala al bet hashshechita venotel et hakkeravayim venotnan leacher

Holech umdichan bammayim shenneemar vehakkerev vehakkeraayim yirchatz bammayim lo beyayin velo bemezeg velo bishar mashkin vechal hammemot kesherin kamma medichan hakkares medichin otah bevet hammedichin kal tzarkah hakkeravayim en pochatin mishshalosh peamim umdichin otan al shulchanot shel shayish shebben haammudim

Natal et hassakkin vehifrish et harea min hakkaved veetzba hakkaved min hakkaved veeno meziz hakkaved mimmekomo venokev et hechaze venotno leacher veole laddofen hayemanit vechotech veored ad hashshidra velo yigga bashshidra ad shehu maggia lishte tzelaot rakkot chotchah venotnah leacher vehakkaved teluya bah

Ba lo laggera manniach bah shette tzelaot mikkan ushte tzelaot mikkan chotchah venotnah leacher vehakkane vehallev veharea teluyin bah ba lo laddofen hassemalit umanniach bah shette tzelaot rakkot millemala ushte tzelaot rakkot millematta vechach haya manniach bachavertah nimtza manniach bishte haddefanot arba tzelaot bezo vearba tzelaot bezo chotchah venotnah leacher vehashshidra immah vehattechol taluy bah

Ba lo laoketz chotcho venotno leacher vehaalya veetzba hakkaved ushte kelaot immah notel et haregel hassemalit venotnah leacher uchseder ze mafshitin umnattechin olat behema veellu hen hannetachin haamurin battora venittach otah lintacheha
Bechamma molichin et haevarim lakkevesh im min hatztzon hi haola molichin otah shishsha
Harishon barosh uvaregel harosh bimino vechatmo kelappe zeroo vekarnav ben etzbeotav uvet shechita lemala vehappeder aleha veharegel shel yamin bismolo uvet orah lachutz
Hashsheni bishte hayyadayim shel yamin bimino veshel semol bismolo uvet oran lachutz
Hashshelishi baoketz uvaregel haoketz bimino vehaalya medeldelet ben etzbeotav veetzba hakkaved ushte hakkelaot immo veharegel shel semolo bismolo uvet oran lachutz
Harvii bechaze uvaggera hechaze bimino vehaggera bismolo vetzaloteha ben etzbeotav
Hachamishi bishte defanot shel yamin bimino veshel semol bismolo uvet oran lachutz

Hashshishshi bakkeravayim netunin bevazach uchraayim al gabbehen millemala im hayeta haola keves o ez aval im hayeta ayil molichin hakkeravayim shenayim vechen hassolet shel nesacheha beyad echad vehayyayin beyad acher veim haya ayil hassolet bishnayim vehayyayin bishnayim
Nimtzeta lamed shehakkeves o haez molichin oto shemona lammizbeach vehaayil molichin oto achad asar

Hashshor molichin oto arbaa veesrim harishon molich et harosh vehashsheni vehashshelishi molichin haregel shel yamin veharvii vehachamishi molichin et haoketz vehashshishshi vehashshevii molichin et haregel shel semol vehashshemini molich et hechaze vehaggera molichin otah shelosha teshii vaasiri veachad asar umolichin shette hayyadayim bishnayim ushte haddefanot bishnayim vehakkeravayim vehassolet vehayyayin bishlosha shelosha hare arbaa veesrim

Velamma lo yechalleku haevar haggadol shel shor lachalakim shenneemar venittach otah lintacheha velo netacheha lintachim bamme devarim amurim beolot hatztzibbur aval olot hayyachid im ratzu leholich netacheha befachot meellu o beoter molichin

Olat haof ketzad hayeta naaset ole lakkevesh ufana lassovev uva lo lekeren deromit mizrachit vehaya molek sham et roshah mimmul arpah umavdil veim lo hivdil pesula ummatztze dam harosh vedam hagguf al kir hammizbeach lemala min hachut shebbeemtza hammizbeach veim mitztza dam harosh velo mitztza dam hagguf pesula mitztza dam hagguf velo mitztza dam harosh keshera

Venotel et harosh umakkif bet melikato lammizbeach vesofgo bemelach vezorko al gabbe haishshim uva lo lagguf vehesir et hammura vehaor shealeha beyado im hannotza veet bene meayim hayyotzin immah umashlichan levet haddeshen

Veshissa oto vichnafav beyado belo sakkin veeno tzarich lehavdil shenneemar lo yavdil veim hivdil kasher vesofgo bemelach vezorko al gabbe haishshim lo hesir et hammura velo et hannotza velo et bene meayim velo sefagah bemelach kal sheshshinna bah meachar tamtzit haddam keshera

Ketzad molkin kotzetz veored batztzipporen mimmul oref im ratza leholich ulhavi molich umevi veim ratza lihot dores veored batztzipporen dores veim neekru hassimanim eno choshesh vechotech shidra umifreket belo rov basar sheim chatach rov basar hare zo kemeta kodem sheyyaggia lassimanin vetzarich lachtoch shene hassimanim baola keshehu yored vehammolek besakkin o min hatztzedadin enah melika ella kemi shechanak o nachar vechal haoref kasher limlika
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 7: Mitzvat ase laasot hachattaot kemitzvatan haamura battora vechetzad maase chattat hanneechelet shochet venoten haddam kemo shebbearnu umafshitah umafrish haemurim umolchan vezorkan al gabbe haishshim veim ratza litten et haemurin bichli keshemmolichan lammizbeach noten ushar besarah neechal lezichre kehunna baazara

Vechetzad maase chattaot hannisrafot shochet vezorek damam kemo shebbearnu veachar kach koram umotzi haemurim venotnan bichli umolchan vezorkan al gabbe haishshim umotzi sheeritan chutz lair umnattechin otan sham kenitche haola beoran vesorfin otan sham bevet haddeshen

Shelosha mekomot lisrefa echad betoch haazara uvo sorfin pesule hammukdashin veemure kadashim kallim shennifselu ufarim usirim shel chattaot hannisrafot im era bahem pasul ben lifne zerika ben leachar zerika kegon shennitmeu o sheyyatzu chutz laazara ad shello higgia zemannan latzet o shellan habbasar o lanu haemurin shellahen

Vehammakom hashsheni behar habbayit ushmo bira uvo sorfin chattaot hannisrafot im era bahen pesul achar tzetan min haazara vehammakom hashshelishi chutz lirushalayim vehu hannikra bet haddeshen vesham sorfin chattaot hannisrafot bizman shehen nisrafot kemitzvatan

Usrefat kal hannisrafin keshera bezar uvallayela vechal hannisrafin chutz laazara kal haetzim kesherin lisrefatan afillu bekash uvigvava shenneemar al etzim baesh esh mikkal makom velamma neemar etzim lehotzi et hassid veet haremetz

Chattat haof ketzad hayeta naaset molek otah bekeren deromit maaravit kemo shebbearnu veored betzipparno ad sheyyachtoch hassimanin o rov echad mehen veeno mavdil harosh min hagguf veim hivdil pasal veloke shenneemar umalak et rosho mimmul arpo velo yavdil umazze middamah al kir hammizbeach lematta meemtzao ushyare haddam mitmatztzim al hayesod shenneemar vehannishar baddam yimmatze al yesod hammizbeach mikkelal shehannetina al kir shehashsheyarin shello mitmatztzin el yesod vezehu kir hattachton
Umitztzuy dam chattat haof meakkev veen lammizbeach bah ella damah vehashshear neechal lezichre kehunna kivsar chattat habbehema

Ketzad ochez chattat haof bishat melika ochez shette ragleha ben shette etzbeotav ushte agappeha ben shette etzbeotav umoteach tzavarah el rochav shette etzbeotav umolek vezo meavodot kashot shebbammikdash veim shinna veachaz bechal makom keshera
Vechal makom min hammizbeach kasher limlikatah uvilvad sheyyazze damah lematta meemtza hammizbeach veim hizza bechal makom keshera vehu sheyyitten lematta meat middam hannefesh

Shelosha devarim hayeta keren deromit maaravit meshammeshet lemala ushlosha lematta millematta chattat haof vehaggashat hammenachot ushyare haddam shel olot vechattaot hanneechalot vaashamot ushlamim sheshshofchin aleha vehashshelosha shel mala nissuch hammayim shemmenassechin bechag venissuch hayyayin shel nesachim veolat haof bizman shehi rabba veim en keren deromit mizrachit mechila otah nifnin lekeren deromit maaravit veosin otah sham

Kal haolin lammizbeach olin derech yamin umakkifin veordin derech semol chutz min haole leechad mishshelosha devarim ellu shellemala bekeren zo shehen olin venifnin al hassemol lakkeren veosin melachtan vechozrin laakev umippene ma nifnin lismol kede sheyyifgeu bekeren maaravit deromit techilla sheim nifnin al yamin umakkifin et kal hammizbeach ad sheyyaggiu lekeren deromit maaravit shemma yitashshen hammayim vehayyayin o shemma yamut haof beeshen hammizbeach

Lefichach hamnassech mayim o yayin keshehu makkif et hammizbeach lo yihye beyado kelum umatchil umakkif mikkeren deromit mizrachit lemizrachit tzefonit litzfonit maaravit lemaaravit deromit velo yihye beyado kelum uchshemmaggia lemaaravit deromit notnin hammayim o hayyayin beyado umnassech veim lo hikkif ole ufone al semolo veose melachto veored
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 8: Chomer bechattat habbehema mishshear kadshe kadashim sheddam chattat habbehema shennittaz min hakkeli shekkibbel bo haddam kodem hazzaya al habbeged taun kibbus bemayim baazara shenneemar vaasher yizze middamah al habbeged asher yizze aleha techabbes bemakom kadsh

Echad habbeged veechad haor harach veechad hassak teunin kibbus aval haor hakkashe hare hu keetz vegored haddam mealav veechad dam chattat hanneechelet o dam chattat hannisrefet aval lo dam chattat haof shenneemar tishshachet hachattat benishchetet hakkatuv medabber lo benimleket

Chattat shennifsela en damah taun kibbus ben shehayeta lah sheat hakkosher ben shello hayeta lah sheat hakkosher e zo hi shehayeta lah sheat hakkosher shellana veshennitmet vesheyyatzat chutz laazara vee zo hi shello hayeta lah sheat hakkosher shennifsela bishchita o bizrikat haddam

En taun kibbus ella mekom haddam bilvad vehu sheyyihye al keli sherauy lekabbel tuma verauy lechibbus aval im nittaz al keli etz o keli mattechet eno taun kibbus lefi sheenan reuyin lechibbus ella gordan bilvad

Nittaz al or haddag eno taun kibbus lefi sheeno rauy lekabbel tuma aval im nittaz al or behema ad shello hufshat eno taun kibbus achar shehufshat taun kibbus sheaf al pi sheeno mekabbel tuma atta hare hu rauy lekabbel tuma leachar sheyyitabbed

Nittaz min hatztzavar al habbeged o meal keren hammizbeach o shennishpach haddam al haritzpa vaasafo venittaz mimmennu al habbeged eno taun kibbus shenneemar vaasher yizze middamah lo amarti ella bedam shennitkabbel bichli sharet verauy lehazzaya veyesh bo kede hazzaya
Natan arba hammattanot veachar kach nittaz min hakkos al habbeged mishsheyare haddam eno taun kibbus af al pi sheadayin lo zarak hashsheyarim al hayesod vechen bechattaot hannisrafot
Nittaz meetzbao achar sheyyatzat hazzaya miyyado eno taun kibbus sheshsheyare haddam shebbaetzba pesulin lehazzaya

Nittaz min habbeged leveged sheni en habbeged hashsheni taun kibbus nittaz al beged tame eno taun kibbus nittaz dam hachattat al habbeged venittaz al dam hachattat dam chullin taun kibbus aval im nittaz dam hachullin techilla o afillu dam ola venittaz alav dam hachattat eno taun kibbus shehare lo nivla bo

Keshemmechabbesin et mekom haddam mechabbesin oto bemayim yafe yafe ad shello yishshaer lo roshem vechal shivat hassammanim shemmaavirin al hakketem maavirin al dam chattat chutz mimme raglayim sheen machnisin me raglayim lammikdash

Keli cheres shennitbashshela bo hachattat hanneechelet taun shevira baazara uchli mattachot shennitbashshela bo taun merika ushtifa bemayim baazara shenneemar uchli cheres asher tevushshal bo yishshaver af al pi shello neemar kan bemakom kadosh hare dinan kedin hakkibbus ma kibbus habbeged bakkodesh af shevirat keli cheres ushtifat keli mattachot umrikato bakkodesh veechad keli shebbishshel bo o keli sheheera letocho roteach

Merika bechammin ushtifa betzonen bemayim lo beyayin velo bemezeg velo bishar mashkin vehammerika vehashshetifa kimrikat hakkos ushtifato vehashshippud vehaaskala magilan bemayim chammim al gabbe haesh veachar kach medichan

Bamme devarim amurim shebbishshel bahen achar shennizrak damah kehilchato aval im bishshel kodem zerika o shebbishshel bah besar chattat hannisrefet eno taun merika ushtifa bishshel bemiktzat hakkeli kullo taun merika ushtifa

Tzala habbasar baavir tannur shel cheres yesh baddavar safek im yishshaver hoil venitbashshela bo o lo yishshaver hoil velo naga bo velo bechattat bilvad ella kal hakkelim shemmishtammeshin bahen bekadashim al yede chammin ben kadshe kadashim ben kadashim kallim teunin merika ushtifa ekev achila vechen hashshippud vehaaskala magilan ekev achila veeno menichan ad zeman achila sheniyya ella kesheyyashlim leechol yagil hashshippud vehaaskala vimarek vayyishtof hakkeli ben kele mattachot ben kele cheres chutz min hachattat sheshshover bah kele cheres umvashshel veshone umshallesh miyyad ben bichle mattachot ben bichle cheres ummarek veshotef ad sof achila

Kele gelalim uchle avanim uchle adama enan teunin merika ushtifa afillu bechattat ella hadacha bilvad neemar bechattat kl asher yigga bivsarah yikdash lihot kamoha im pesula hi hannogea bah pasul veim keshera hannogea bah yeachel kamoha uvikdushshatah
Bamme devarim amurim keshennivlea bo aval negia belo havlaa enah mekuddeshet veechad hachattat veechad shear kadashim ben kadashim kallim ben chamurim shenneemar zot hattora laola velammincha
Naga besarah berakik venivla bemiktzato lo nitkaddesh kullo ella chotech mekom habbela

Keli shebbishshel bo kadashim vechullin o kadshe kadashim vekadashim kallim im yesh bahen benoten taam hare hakkol neechal kechamur shebbahen vetaun hakkeli merika ushtifa vehakkol kechamur shebbahen lechal davar veim lo natan taam ze baze en hakkallin neechalin kachamurim veenan kemotan lechal davar aval hakkeli taun merika ushtifa

Beged shennittaz alav dam hachattat veyatza chutz laazara machziro laazara umchabbeso sham nitma chutz laazara ketzad yaase koro kede sheyyithar umachniso umchabbeso bifnim vetzarich lehaniach bo shalem kede maaforet lefi shenneemar beged tzarich lechabbes beged veaf al pi shehu tame middivrehem mippene kede hammaaforet shennishara bo kevan shennikra rubbo tahor min hattora umuttar lehachniso lammikdash lechabbes haddam

Meil shennittaz alav dam chattat veyatza venitma lachutz ketzad hu ose vahare hakkorea oto loke kemo shebbearnu machniso pachot pachot mishshalosh etzbaot umchabbeso bifnim veachar sheyyitkabbes kal haddam meat meat matbilin oto bachutz

Keli cheres shebbishshel bo hachattat veyatza machniso veshovro bifnim nitma bachutz nokvo bichde shoresh katan kede sheyyithar umachniso veshovro bifnim veim nikkevo nekev gadol mizze eno shovro bifnim shehare eno keli veen shovrin bifnim ella kelim vechen keli mattachot shebbishshel bo veyatza chutz laazara machniso umorko veshotfo bifnim nitma kesheyyatza pochato ad sheyyithar umachniso bifnim vechozer umraddedo ad sheyyissatem happechat veyachzor ketavnit hakkelim veachar kach morko veshotfo baazara shenneemar veim bichli nechshet vego en morkin bifnim ella kelim
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 9: Mitzvat ase laasot kal haashamot kemitzvatan haamura battora vechetzad maase haashamot ben asham vadday ben asham taluy shochet vezorek haddam kemo shebbearnu umafshit umotzi haemurin umolchan vezorkan al gav haishshim veim ratza leholichan bichli molich ushar besaram neechal lezichre kehunna baazara kachattat
Asham metzora yesh bekabbalat damo shinnuy kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot mechussere kappara veaf al pi chen shear maasav uzrikat damo al hammizbeach vaachilato kishar haashamot lechal davar
Asiyyat kal shelamim kemitzvatan mitzvat ase vehen arbaa minin haechad shalme tzibbur vehashshelosha shalme yachid

Vechetzad maase shalme tzibbur shochet vezorek haddam kemo shebbearnu umafshit umotzi haemurim umolchan umaktiran vehashshear neechal lezichre kehunna baazara kachattat vechaasham mippene shehen kadshe kadashim kemo shebbearnu

Shalme yachid shelosha minin haechad hu habba shelamim belo lechem kegon shalme chagiga vesimcha vezehu hannikra shelamim vehashsheni shelamim habbaim im hallechem beneder o nedava vezehu hannikra toda veoto hallechem nikra lechem toda vehammin hashshelishi shelamim shemmakriv hannazir beom melot nizro vehem baim im lechem vezehu hannikra el nazir

Vechetzad maase shelashtan shochet vezorek haddam kemo shebbearnu umafshit umotzi haemurin veachar kach menatteach et habbasar umafrish hechaze veshok hayyamin venoten haemurin im hechaze vehashshok al yede habbealim vechohen manniach yado tachat yede habbealim umenif hakkol lifne Adonai bammizrach vechen kal hattaun tenufa bammizrach menifin oto

Vechetzad hu menif molich umevi maale umorid veim haya hakkarban toda lokeach min hallechem habba immah echad measara umannicho im hechaze vehashshok vehaemurim umenif hakkol al yede habbealim kemo shebbearnu
Vechetzad mannichan al yede habbealim noten et hachalavim al yede habbealim vechaze veshok lemala ushte hakkelaot veoteret hakkaved lemala mehem veim yesh sham lechem mannicho lemala umenif hakkol

Haya hakkarban el nazir motzi haemurin umafrish chaze veshok umvashshel shear haayil beezrat hannashim velokeach hakkohen hazzeroa beshela min haayil im echad measara min hallechem habba immo im hechaze vehashshok vehaemurin umanniach hakkol al yede hannazir vehakkohen manniach yadav tachat yede habbealim umenif hakkol kemo shebbearnu

E zehu chaze kal haroe et hakkarka lemala ad hatztzavar lematta ad hakkares vechotech immah shette tzelaot elach veelach vee zehu zeroa min happerek shel arkubba ad kaf shel yad shehem shene evarim meorin ze baze vehazzeroa haamura hi zeroa shel yamin veshekkenegdah baregel hu hashshok haamur bechal makom

Veachar shemmenifan moleach haemurin umaktiran al gabbe hammizbeach aval hechaze vehashshok neechal lakkohanim shenneemar ki et chaze hattenufa veet shok hatteruma ushar hashshelamim neechalim labbealim veen hakkohanim zochin bechaze veshok ella leachar hekter haemurin

Vechen hallechem shemmenif betoda uvel nazir vehazzeroa habbeshela neechalin lakkohanim ushar hallechem im shear habbasar neechal labbealim vehallechem shemmenif im hechaze vehashshok hem hannikrain muram mittoda vehazzeroa beshela im hechaze vehashshok im hallechem shemmenif hem hannikrain muram meel nazir
Hallechem hammuram min hattoda sefek teruma hu lefichach en chayyavin alav mita vechomesh kitruma veeno medammea kitruma
Haya baal hattoda kohen hare shear hallechem neechal labbealim ketodat yisrael sheen hallechem habba im hattoda o im el nazir karuy mincha
Shenayim sheheviu shelamim beshuttafut haechad menif birshut chavero afillu hem mea echad menif al yede kullan ma sheen ken bismicha

Hayeta ishsha baalat hakkarban enah menifa aval hakkohen menif shekkarbanah taun tenufa vehi pesula litnufa ulolam en ishsha menifa ella hassota vehannezira bilvad kemo shebbearnu utnufa kodemet lehaggasha bechal makom
Ketzad hu hallechem shemmevi im hattoda lokeach esrim issaron solet veose mehem asara esronim chametz vaasara matztza haasara shel chametz ose otam eser challot

Vechetzad mechammetzan mevi seor kede chimmutzan venotno letoch hammidda ummalle et hammidda af al pi shessofah lihot chasera o yetera mippene hasseor sheppeamim yihye ave vekashe ufamim rakka en mashgichin ella al middatah atta vahare hu moded issaron issaron shelamim vehaasara esronim shel matztza ose mehen sheloshim challot shaot eser challot mikkal min eser challot maafe tannur veeser challot rekikim veeser challot murbechet

Vechetzad hi hammurbechet choltah berotchin veofe otah meat veachar kach kole otah beshemen al hailpas vechayyotze bo kederech shekkolin hassufganin umarbin beshamnah vezehu haribbuch haamur bechal makom
Uvchamma shemen hu ose hashsheloshim challot bachatzi log shemen veshiur ze halacha lemoshe missinay reviit mimmennu lirvucha ushminit lechallot ushminit lirkikin

Hachallot lotet hassolet shellahen bishminit shel shemen veachar kach lash veofe otan veharkikin moshchan bashsheminit shellahen achar afiyyatan vehakkohen lokeach min hakkol arba challot achat mikkal min umin shenneemar echad mikkal karban

Velachme toda sheafa otan arba challot yatza lo neemar arbaim ella lemitzva vehu sheyyafrish hachalla shellahen achat mikkal karban keshehen batzek sheen mafrishin perusa shenneemar echad mikkal karban shello yittol parus

Vechetzad hu hallechem habba im el nazir lokeach shishsha esronot ushne shelishe issaron veose mehen esrim challot shaot vehakkol matztza asara rekikin meshuchin beshemen veeser challot lotet hassolet shellahen beshemen vehakkol maafe tannur veshemen shellahen reviit veshiur ze halacha lemoshe missinay vehakkohen lokeach mehen shette challot achat mikkal min
Shene mine lechem shebbenazir vearbaa mine lechem shebbetoda meakkevin ze et ze umaase hallechem shel shenehen chutz laazara

Ketzad maase habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach achar shezzorek daman kemo shebbearnu mafshit umotzi haemurim umolchan umaktiran ushar besar habbechor neechal lakkohanim ushar besar hammaaser neechal labbealim ushar happesach neechal limnuyav kehilchotav kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot happesach
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 10: Achilat hachattat vehaasham mitzvat ase shenneemar veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem hakkohanim ochlim uvalim mitkapperim vehu haddin lishar hakkadashim sheochlin otan hakkohanim sheachilatan mitzva
Vechen achilat sheyare menachot mitzvat ase shenneemar vehannoteret mimmenna yochlu aharon uvanav

Veen chattat veasham ushyare menachot neechalin ella lezichre kehunna baazara veim neechlu bahechal neechlu shenneemar lechal minchatam ulchal chattatam ulchal ashamam bekodesh hakodashim tochlennu kal zachar yochal oto vechen shalme tzibbur hare hen kachattat vechaasham kemo shebbearnu

Chaze veshok shel shelamim neechalin lechohanim zecharim unkevot shenneemar bahem lecha netattim ulvanecha velivnotecha vechen hammuram mittoda vehammuram meel nazir shenneemar kl terumot hakodashim asher yarimu vene yisrael la natatti lecha ulvanecha velivnotecha

Vechen habbechor shehare neemar bo uvsaram yihye lach kachaze hattenufa uchshok hayyamin vechal ellu hanneechalim lakkohanot neechalim leavde hakkohanim velinshehem kitruma vechullan neechalim bechal hair shenneemar et chaze hattenufa veet shok hatteruma tochlu bemakom tahor lo neemar bahen bemakom kadosh shehi haazara ella tahor shehu kal machane yisrael shekkenegdo ledorot yerushalayim vehu haddin lemaaser ufesach shehare hen kadashim kallim kishlamim vehachallonot vaovi hachoma kilfanim

Hashshelamim neechalim beom hazzevicha vechal hallayela vechal yom hammachorat ad shettishka hachamma shenneemar beom hakrivo et zivcho yeachel umimmachorat veim heachol yeachel mibbesar zevach shelamav bayyom hashshelishi vego nimtzeta lamed shehen neechalin lishne yamim velayela echad ben chelek hakkohanim ben chelek habbealim vehu haddin livchor umaaser shehare hen kadashim kallim kishlamim

Aval hattoda af al pi shehi kadashim kallim enah neechelet ella beom hazzevicha im hallayela shenneemar bah beom karbano yeachel lo yanniach mimmennu ad boker vechen el nazir vehallechem habba immahen vechayyotze bahen ben chelek hakkohanim ben chelek habbealim vehu haddin lechattat ulasham ulshalme tzibbur velishyare menachot shehakkol neechal leom velayela shenneemar beom karbano yeachel kal hakkarbanot bemashma chutz min hashshelamim shepperesh bahen hakkatuv uvchor umaaser haddomim lahem
Kal ellu hanneechalin leom velayela din tora shehen neechalin ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar uchde leharchik min haavera amru chachamim sheen neechalin ella ad chatzot hallayela

Kal hakkarbanot ben kadshe kadashim ben kadashim kallim en ochlin otam ella hattehorim bilvad hammulin afillu heeriv shimsho velo hevi kapparato eno ochel bekadashim vehattumtum asur leechol bekadashim lefi shehu sefek arel aval haanderoginus yerae li sheochel bekadashim kallim

Umuttar leechol et hakkadashim bechal maachal afillu hakkohanim muttarin leechol chelkam ben mikkadashim kallim ben mikkadshe kadashim bechal maachal ulshannot baachilatan ulachlam tzeluyim shelukim umvushshalim velatet letochan tavlin shel chullin aval lo tavlin shel teruma shello yaviu et hatteruma lide pissul vehaatzamot hannisharot muttarot veose adam mehem kal kelim sheyyirtze

Hayeta lahem achila muetet ochlin immah chullin utrumot kede shettihye neechelet im hassova hayeta lahen achila merubba en ochlin immah chullin utruma kede shello tihye neechelet achila gassa vechen bishyare hammenachot

En mevashshelin chattat o asham im muram mittoda o meel nazir mippene shemmemaet beochlehen uvimkom achilatan velo muram mittoda umeel nazir im bechor o im chaze veshok shel shelamim mippene shemmemaet zeman achilatan velo muram mishshelamim shel emesh im chattat veasham shel yom mippene shemmemaet beochlehen uvimkom achilatan uvizman achilatan aval chattat veasham mitbashshelin ze im ze vetoda veel nazir ze im ze vehabbechor vechaze veshok ze im ze chaticha shel kadshe kadashim o shel piggul o notar shennitbashshela im chatichot acherot otan hachatichot asurot lezarim umuttarot lakkohanim
Besar kadshe kadashim o besar kadashim kallim shennitbashshel im besar taava hare besar hattaava asur litmeim umuttar lithorim

Neemar beola or haola asher hikriv lakkohen lo yihye veneemar bechattat hakkohen hamchatte otah yochlenna veneemar beasham hakkohen asher yechapper bo lo yihye veneemar bishlamim lakkohen hazzorek et dam hashshelamim lo yihye veneemar bemincha hakkohen hammakriv otah lo yihye en hakkatuv medabber bechal ellu ella berauy shehakkohen harauy laavoda zehu sheyyesh lo chelek leechol umi sheeno rauy bishat hakkarban kegon shehaya tame en lo chelek leechol afillu kesheyyithar laerev aval leinyan chaluka hakkol leanshe bet av shemmakrivin beoto hayyom vechullam cholkim bechal kadshe hammikdash ish keachiv ben ze shehikriv ben achiv sheimmo bammikdash shello hikriv

Velamma chillek hakkatuv bimnachot ben menachot haafuot uminchat hassolet shehare baafuot hu omer kal hammincha asher teafe battannur lakkohen hammakriv otah lo tihye uvminchat hassolet hu omer vechal mincha velula vashshemen vachareva lechal bene aharon tihye ish keachiv shehaafuya keshecholkin otah anshe bet av kal sheyyaggia lo chelko afillu kezayit pat hare hu rauy lo shehare ochlo miyyad aval hassolet im yechallekuha benehen nimtza maggia laze melo kappo solet o pachot sheeno rauy lo lalush oto velo leefoto lefichach haya ole al haddaat sheyyachleku mincha keneged mincha velo yachleku mincha zo bifne atzmah al kal anshe bet av hutzrach hakkatuv lomar bah lechal bene aharon tihye ish keachiv lomar sheyechallekuha bifne atzmah mikkan amru chachamim en cholkin mincha keneged mincha afillu maase machavat keneged maase machavat o solet keneged solet ella kal achat veachat cholkin sheyareha bifne atzmah
Vechen en cholkin of keneged of velo chattat keneged chattat velo chaze veshok keneged chaze veshok ella kal chelek vechelek cholkin oto benehen beshave

En hakkatan cholek afillu bekadashim kallim af al pi shemmuttar lehaachilo kadshe kadashim vechen ishsha veanderoginus en cholkin lahem bekadshe hammikdash kelal shenneemar ish keachiv aval baal mum ben kavua ben over ben shennolad bemumo ben shehaya tamim venifsal cholek veochel shenneemar lechem elohav mikkadshe hakodashim vego vehu sheyyihye rauy laachila aval im haya tame eno cholek leechol laerev
Vechohen gadol ochel shello bachaluka ella notel kal ma sheyyirtze

Kal harauy laachilat hakkadashim bishat hakkarban cholek leechol vechal mi sheeno rauy leechol bishat haavoda af al pi shehu rauy laavoda vahare hu rauy leechol laerev eno cholek kede lehaniach chelko laerev ketzad tevul yom umchussar kippurim vehaonen beom hakkevura ben kohen gadol ben kohen hedot en cholkin leechol laerev
Kal sheeno rauy leechol eno rauy laavod chutz mikkohen gadol haonen shehu makriv veeno ochel kemo shebbearnu vechal sheeno rauy laavod eno rauy leechol chutz mibbaal mum shehare nitparesh battora

Kal sheen lo chelek babbasar en lo chelek baorot afillu tame bishat zerikat damim vetahor bishat hekter chalavim eno cholek babbasar shenneemar hammakriv et dam hashshelamim veet hachelev mibbene aharon lo tihye shok hayyamin lemana ad sheyyihye tahor verauy laavoda mishsheat zerika ad achar hekter chalavim
Nitma achar zerika vetaval vahare hu tahor af bishat hekter chalavim haddavar safek im cholek im eno cholek lefichach im tafas en motziin miyyado
Karban tzibbur habba betuma af al pi shehattemeim makrivin oto en cholkin im hattehorin leechol laerev mippene sheenam reuyim laachila
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 11: Kal haochel kezayit mibbesar haola ben lifni zerikat damah ben leachar zerikat damah loke shenneemar lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha vego vechal nedarecha asher tiddor mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara leochel besar haola
Vechelbah uvsarah vesaltah veshamnah veyayin shel nesacheha chamishshetan mitztarfin lichzayit

Vechen haochel kezayit mikkal haemurin ben lifne zerika ben leachar zerika ben kohen ben yisrael loke shehaemurin kalil lammizbeach kechal haola vahare neemar beminchat kohanim kalil tihye lo teachel kal shehu kalil lammizbeach achilato belo taase velokin alav bichzayit vechen haochel kezayit mibbesar chattaot hannisrafot loke shenneemar vechal chattat asher yuva middamah el ohel moed lo teachel baesh tissaref

Kal haochel kezayit mibbesar hakkadashim afillu kadashim kallim kodem zerikat damam loke shenneemar lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha venidvotecha kelomar lo tuchal leechol nidvotecha bisharecha kodem shezzorkin daman beshaare hammakom mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara leochel toda o shelamim kodem zerikat damim vehu haddin lishar kadashim ben kallim ben chamurim veshishsha devarim shebbetoda shehem hachelev vehabbasar vehassolet vehashshemen vehayyayin vehallechem kullan mitztarfin lichzayit

Kal haochel kezayit mibbesar kadshe kadashim chutz laazara loke shenneemar lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvchorot bekarcha vetzonecha mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara leochel mibbesar chattaot vaashamot chutz laazara vehu haddin leochel kadashim kallim chutz lirushalayim shehu loke shechomat yerushalayim lekadashim kallim kechomat haazara lekadshe kadashim veechad besar chattat veasham o sheyare menachot

Besar kadshe kadashim sheyyatza chutz lechomat haazara uvsar kadashim kallim sheyyatza chutz lechomat yerushalayim nifsal veneesar leolam veaf al pi shechazar limkomo asur leachlo vehaochel mimmennu kezayit loke shenneemar uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu kevan sheyyatza basar chutz limchitzato naasa kitrefa kemo shebbearnu behilchot maachalot asurot
Nichnas besar kadashim kallim lahechal hare ze kasher

Zar sheachal kezayit mibbesar kadshe kadashim baazara achar zerikat damim loke shenneemar veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem vego vezar lo yochal vego bemakom shehakkohen ochel uvet sherauy leechol im achalo sham hazzar loke aval im achal hazzar besar kadshe kadashim bachutz loke mishshum ochel bachutz lo mishshum zar sheachal kodesh shehare enam reuyin sham lakkohanim vechen im achalan baazara kodem zerika loke mishshum ochel kodem zerika bilvad lo mishshum zarut

Zar sheachal kezayit mechattat haof loke shettayim achat mishshum zar sheachal et hakkodesh veachat mishshum ochel nevela shekkal melika nevela hi uchshehuttera lakkohanim huttera lo lezarim vahare hen shene issurin habbain keechad kemo shebbearnu
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 12: Hammennachot hem min hakkarbanot vehammenachot habbaot bifne atzman vienan baot mishshum nesachim mehem minchat tzibbur umehem minchat yachid
Vechal hammenachot solet chittin chutz mimminchat sota veomer hattenufa shehem min hasseorim

Shalosh menachot latztzibbur omer hattenufa vehu karev lammizbeach kemo sheyyitbaer ushte hallechem shemmeviin beom atzeret veellu nikreu mincha veenan kerevin legabbe hammizbeach vehen chametz vaalehem neemar karban reshit takrivu otam la veel hammizbeach lo yaalu vehammincha hashshelishit hu lechem happanim sheosin bechal shabbat veeno karev legabbe hammizbeach ella kullo neechal lakkohanim kemo sheyyitbaer

Vetesha minchot hayyachid vechullan kerevin lammizbeach veellu hen minchat chote vehu hammincha shemmakriv heani kesheyyitchayyev chattat velo taggia yado minchat sota vehi minchat hakkenaot shekkevar nitparshu maaseha hammincha shemmakriv kal kohen techilla kesheyyikkanes laavoda shemmakriv otah beyado vehi hannikret minchat chinnuch hammincha shemmakriv kohen gadol bechal yom vehi hannikret chavitin minchat hassolet vehi baa beneder undava minchat hammachavat vehi baa beneder undava minchat hammarcheshet vehi baa beneder undava minchat maafe tannur vehi baa beneder undava minchat rekikin vehi baa beneder undava

Kal hammenachot hakkerevot legabbe hammizbeach en kal achat mehen pechuta meissaron umiuto meakkev et kullo vechamesh menachot habbaot beneder undava yesh lo lehitnaddev velindor mehen kal ma sheyyirtze afillu elef issaron aval minchat haomer uminchat chote uminchat kenaot uminchat chinnuch vehachavitin kal achat mehen issaron echad lo pachot velo yeter

Kal hammenachot hakkerevot legabbe hammizbeach teunot haggasha bamaarav keneged chuddah shel keren deromit maaravit veenan teunot tenufa chutz mimminchat sota veomer hattenufa sheshshenehen teunot tenufa vehaggasha

Kal hammenachot hakkerevot legabbe hammizbeach teunot shemen ulvona log shemen lechal issaron vekometz levona lechal mincha ben shehayeta issaron echad ben shehayeta shishshim esronim sheen meviin bichli echad yeter al shishshim issaron kemo sheyyitbaer chutz mimminchat kenaot uminchat chote shenneemar lo yasim aleha shemen velo yitten aleha levona

Natan vehikriv loke al hashshemen bifne atzmo veal hallevona bifne atzmah natan keli sheyyesh bo shemen o levona al gabbeha eno over velo pasal minchat chinnuch vehachavitin mosif lechal achat mehen shemen kemo sheyyitbaer

Kal hammenachot hakkerevot legabbe hammizbeach nikmatzot umaktir hakkometz kullo al gabbe hammizbeach vehashshear neechal lakkohanim chutz mimminchat zichre kehunna sheenah nikmetzet ella maktirin otah kullah shenneemar vechal minchat kohen vego ha lamadta shemminchat chinnuch vehachavitin vechohen shehevi minchat chote o minchat nedava kullan nisrafot al gabbe hammizbeach veenan nikmatzot
Hakkohenet minchatah nikmetzet keminchat yisrael ushyareha neechalin

Veladot shennitarvu vahare kal echad mehen safek minchatam nikmetzet keminchat yisrael veenah neechelet keminchat kohanim ketzad osim hakkometz karev bifne atzmo vehashsheyarim mitpazzerin al bet haddeshen

Kal hannesuot lakkohanim ben kohenet ben yisreelit en sheyare minchotehen neechalim mippene chelek habbaal sheeno ochel veenah kullah laishshim mippene chelek haishsha ella hakkometz karev leatzmo vehashsheyarim mitpazzerin al bet haddeshen hakkemitza bechal makom baazara veim kamatz bahechal keshera

Umkaddeshin mincha bichli sheal gabbe karka vekomtzin mikkeli sheal gabbe karka veen makdishin hakkometz bichli sheal gabbe karka umeematay yutteru hashsheyarim baachila mishsheyyatztzit haur berov hakkometz

Kal hammenachot hakkerevot legabbe hammizbeach matztza vechen sheyare hammenachot sheochlin hakkohanim af al pi shehen muttarin leachlan bechal maachal uvidvash en ochlin otan chametz shenneemar lo teafe chametz chelkam afillu chelkam lo yachmitzu veim hechmitz sheyareha loke vehamchammetz achar hamchammetz chayyav velokin al kal asiyya vaasiyya shebbah

Hinniach seor al gabbe haissa vehalach veyashav lo venitchammetza meeleha loke shehannachat hasseor hu hammaase
Tibbel hashsheyarim beketzach o beshumshemin o bechal mine tavlin ushmanim keshera matztza hi ella shennikret matztza metubbelet

Hamchammetz mincha pesula patur shenneemar asher takrivu la lo tease chametz hakkesherah lehashshem lo happesula chimmetzah keshehi keshera veyatzat lachutz vechazar vechimmetzah achar shennifsela bitziatah eno loke chimmetzah berosho shel mizbeach eno loke shenneemar asher takrivu uchvar karva zo vehi keshera

Hamchammetz lechem happanim loke shenneemar kal hammincha aval minchat nesachim en bah malkot sheim gibbelah bemayim hare nifsela kodem shettitchammetz veim gibbelah beyayin shel nesachim me perot hen veen machmitzin

Hachittim shel menachot en lottin otan shemma yachmitzu shehare bachutz lottin otan veen hakkol zerizin leshamran aval minchat haomer hoil vehi shel tzibbur lottin otah shehare hatztzibbur zerizin hen umshammerin otah
Kal hammenachot hanneefot nilloshot befoshrin umshammeran shello yachmitzu hoil velishatan vaafiyyatan bifnim baazara anshe penim zerizin hen
Uvmakom shemmevashshelin kadshe kadashim sham ofin et hammenachot shenneemar ze hammakom asher yevashshelu sham hakkohanim et haasham veet hachattat asher yofu et hammincha vego

Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 13: Mitzvat ase laasot kol mincha kemitzvatah haamura battora

Vechetzad asiyyat chavite kohen gadol mevi issaron shalem umakdisho vechotzehu bachatzi issaron shebbammikdash sheaf al pi shehi kereva chetzyan enah mitkaddeshet lechetzyan umevi immah sheloshet login shemen shenneemar bashshemen tease lehosif lah shemen keniske hakkeves uvolel hassolet beshemen vecholtah berotchin velash mikkal chatzi issaron shesh challot nimtzeu shettem esre challot

Veachat achat hau naasot vechetzad ose mechallek hashshelosha login birviit shebbammikdash reviit lechal challa veofah hachalla meat veachar kach kole otah al hammachavat bishar reviit hashshemen shellah veeno mevashshelah harbe shenneemar tufine ben bashel vena

Veachar kach cholek kal challa vechalla lishnayim beomed kede sheyyakriv hachetzi babboker vehachetzi baerev velokeach hachatzayim vechofel kal echad mehen lishnayim ufotet ad shettimmatze kal petita kefula lishnayim umakriv hachatzayin im chatzi kometz levona babboker vehachetzi hannishar im chatzi kometz levona baerev veim hayeta minchat chinnuch eno chotze ella makrivah kullah keachat im kometz levona ushtehen kalil laishshim

Minchat hassolet ketzad hayeta naaset mevi issaron solet o kamma esronot o kefi nidro veshemen harauy lah umoded beissaron shel mikdash venoten shemen bichli veachar kach noten alav et hassolet veachar kach noten shemen acher al hassolet uvolel hassolet bo veachar kach notnah bichli sharet vetzak letochah shemen veshemen shennatan techilla im hashshemen habbalul im shemen sheyyatzak hakkol log leissaron venoten aleha levonatah

Minchat hammachavat vehammarcheshet ketzad noten hashshemen bichli venoten alav hassolet venoten al hassolet shemen acher uvolel hassolet veachar kach lashah befoshrin veofe otah bemachavat o bammarcheshet kemo shennadar ufotet otah pittim venotnah bichli sharet veotzek aleha shear hashshemen venoten levonatah

Ma ben machavat lemarcheshet marcheshet yesh lah safa vehabbatzek sheofin oto aleha rach shehare yesh lah safa veeno yotze umachavat en lah safa vehabbatzek sheofin oto bah kashe kede shello yetze mikkan umikkan

Minchat maafe tannur ketzad im challot hi bolel hassolet beshemen velash befoshrin veofe ufotet venoten bichli sharet venoten aleha levonatah veen bah yetzikat shemen shenneemar challot matztzot belulot bashshemen veim rekikin hi lash et hassolet befoshrin umosheach et harkikin beshemen shenneemar urkike matztzot meshuchim bashshamen veyerae li sheachar afiyya mosheach otam
Vechetzad moshchan mevi log shemen lechal issaron umoshchan vechozer umoshchan ad sheyyichle kal hashshemen shabballog

Kal arba menachot ellu haafuot kesheofin otan ofin kal issaron eser challot veim ribba bechallot o chisser keshera vechetzad pottin otan kofel hachalla lishnayim vehashshenayim learbaa umavdil veim hayeta hammincha shel zichre kehunna eno mavdil ufotet vechullan petitin kezetim veim higdil happetitin o hiktin otan kesherim
Lo balal lo patat lo higgish lo mashach et harkikin keshera lo neemru kal haddevarim haellu ella lemitzva shekkach hi mitzvatah

Seder havaat hammincha ketzad mevi adam solet mittoch beto biklatot shel kesef o shel zahav o shel shear mine mattachot keli shehu rauy lichle sharet veim hayeta minchat hassolet notnah lichli sharet umkaddeshah bichli sharet veim hayeta min hammenachot hanneefot ofe otah sham bammikdash ufotet kemo shebbearnu venoten happetitin lichli sharet venoten aleha shamnah ulvonatah umolichah etzel kohen vehakkohen molichah etzel hammizbeach umaggishah bekeren deromit maaravit keneged chuddah shel keren vedayyo umsallek et kal levonatah letzad echad vekometz mimmakom shennitrabba shamnah shenneemar missaltah umishshamnah venoten hakkometz lichli sharet umkaddesho bichli sharet vekometz shechilleko bishne kelim eno kadosh vechozer umkaddesh umlakket et kal levonatah venotnah al hakkometz shebbakkeli umaalehu al hammizbeach umolcho venotno al gabbe haishshim mikkeli sharet veim minchat kohanim hi eno kometz ella noten melach al kullah umashlich hakkol al gabbe haishshim

Ketzad komtzin menachot hannikmatzot kederech shekkometz kal haadam poshet etzbeotav al pas yado vekometz kamatz berashe etzbeotav o min hatztzedadin lo yaktir veim hiktir hurtza veim hosif bakkometz kegon shehirchik etzbeotav vekamatz hare ze pasul

En kometz pachot mikkishne zetim umiktzat hakkometz meakkev et kullo vehakkometz vehallevona meakkevin ze et ze hassolet vehashshemen meakkevin ze et ze umiktzat hashshemen meakkev et kullo en pachot millog leissaron kemo shebbearnu
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 14: Mitnaddev adam venoder ola ushlamim vechal min sheyyirtze mechamishsha mine menachot habbain beneder undava umitnaddev o noder mincha mimminchat nesachim levaddah mee ze min mishshelosha mine menachot nesachim kemo shebbearnu umitnaddev o noder yayin bifne atzmo o levona bifne atzmah o shemen bifne atzmo o etzim lammaaracha mippene shehen kekarban shenneemar ulkurban haetzim
Shenayim mitnaddevin o nodrin karban echad ola o shelamim afillu pereda achat shel torim o bene yona meviin otah beshuttafut aval hammincha enah baa beshuttafut udvarim ellu hen divre kabbala
Heniach mincha lishne banav umet hare ellu meviin otah

E ze hu neder vee zo hi nedava haomer hare alay ola o hare alay shelamim o hare alay mincha o hare deme behema zo alay ola o shelamim zehu hanneder aval haomer hare behema zo o deme behema zo ola o shelamim o hare haissaron hazze mincha hare zo nedava
Ma ben nedarim lindavot shehannoder im hifrish karbano veavad o nignav chayyav beacharauto ad sheyyakriv kemo shennadar vehammitnaddev veomer zo im met o nignav eno chayyav beacharauto
Haomer deme shor ze alay ola udme bayit ze alay karban umet hashshor venafal habbayit chayyav leshallem amar hare alay ola al menat shello etchayyev beacharautah eno chayyav beacharautah

Kevar bearnu shehaose bayit chutz lammikdash lehakriv bo karbanot eno kevet avoda zara vehaomer hare alay ola sheakrivenna bammikdash vehikrivah bevayit ze lo yatza sheakrivenna bevayit ze vehikrivah bammikdash yatza veim hikrivah beoto habbayit yatza hare hu kemi shennadar ola al menat shello yitchayyev beacharautah veanush karet al haalayatah bachutz vechen im amar hareni nazir al menat sheagalleach bevayit ze im gilleach sham yatza hare hu kemi shennadar letzaer atzmo vahare tzier atzmo veenah nezirut

Chattat veasham enan bain ella al chet veenan bain beneder undava haomer hare alay chattat o asham o sheamar hare zo chattat o asham lo amar kelum haya mechuyyav chattat o asham veamar hare zo lechattati o laashami o hare hammaot haellu lechattati o laashami devarav kayyamim
Haomer karban metzora ze o yoledet zo alay im haya oto metzora o hayyoledet aniyyim mevi hannoder karban ani veim hau ashirim mevi hannoder karban ashir af al pi shehannoder ani

Haomer chattato veolato vaashamo ushlamav shel peloni alay im ratza oto peloni hare ze menicho lehakrivan al yado umitkapper lo ratza bishat hafrasha velo ratza bishat hakrava ella chazar bo beola uvishlamim makrivin umitkapper lo bahen af al pi sheeno rotze atta shehare ratza bishat hafrasha aval bechattat uvasham lo nitkapper lo ad sheyyirtze mittechilla vead sof

Haomer hare alay kenidre reshaim shemminnidrehen nazir vekarban ushvua chayyav bechullan kenidre kesherin lo nitchayyev kelum hare alay kindavot kesherin hare ze nadar benazir uvkarban vechal kinnuye karban kekarban

En hannoder velo hammitnaddev chayyav ad sheyehe piv velibbo shavin ketzad hammitkaven lomar hare alay ola veamar shelamim o shennitkaven lomar hare zo ola veamar shelamim lo amar kelum nitkaven lindor beola veamar karban lindor becherem veamar hekdesh devarav kayyamim shehaola karban vehacherem hekdesh vechen kal kayyotze baze bindarim undavot eno tzarich lehotzi bisfatav kelum ella im gamar belibbo velo hotzi bisfatav kelum chayyav ketzad gamar belibbo shezzo ola o sheyyavi ola hare ze chayyav lehavi shenneemar kl nediv lev yeviah bindivut lev yitchayyev lehavi vechen kal kayyotze baze minnidre kadashim venidvutan

Echad nedarim undavot im shear haddevarim sheadam chayyav bahen mearachin vedamim umaasrot umattenot aniyyim mitzvat ase min hattora sheyyavi hakkol baregel sheppaga bo techilla shenneemar uvata shamma vahavetem shamma vego kelomar beet shettavo lachog tavi kal ma sheatta chayyav bo vetitten kal chov shealecha lashshem higgia haregel velo hevi hare ze bittel mitzvat ase avru alav shelosha regalim velo hevi karbenotav shennadar o hitnaddev o shello natan haarachim vehacharamim vehaddamim hare ze avar belo taase shenneemar lo teacher leshallemo eno over belo taase ad sheyyaavru alav ragle hashshana kullah veen lokin al lav ze lefi sheen bo maase

Hikdish behema lammizbeach veavru alav shene regalim venafal bah mum ufdaah al gav behema acheret eno over belo taase ad sheyyaavru al haacheret shelosha regalim veechad haish veechad haishsha over beval teacher aval hayyoresh eno over beval teacher

Kal hakkarbanot sheavru alehen shelosha regalim lo nifselu ella makrivan uchsherim uvchal yom veom achar hashshelosha regalim hu over belo teacher uvet din metzuvin leassoto miyyad ad sheyyakriv karbenotav baregel sheppaga bo techilla
Af al pi shenneemar lirtzono kofin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani ben shennadar velo hifrish ben shehifrish velo hikriv kofin oto ad sheyyakriv

Kal chayyave olot ushlamim memashkenin otam af al pi sheen mitkapper lo ad sheyyirtze shenneemar lirtzono kofin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani aval chayyave chattaot vaashamot en memashkenin otan hoil vehem meukkeve kappara en choshshin lahem shemma yifsheu veyashhu karbenotehen chutz mechattat nazir hoil veenah meakkavto millishtot yayin shemma yeacher otah lefichach memashkenin oto aleha
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 15: Haomer veladah shel zo ola vihi shelamim devarav kayyamim hi shelamim uveladah ola im lechach nitkaven devarav kayyamim veim achar sheggamar belibbo vehotzi bisfatav shettihye shelamim chazar bo veamar uveladah ola af al pi shechazar bo betoch kede dibbur hare veladah shelamim sheen chazara behekdesh vaafillu betoch kede dibbur

Haomer yadah shel zo ola o raglah shel zo ola timmacher lechayyave olot vedameha chullin chutz middeme oto evar vehu sheyyihye ze hamchuyyav ola shekkana otah nadar ola bedamim ketzuvim haomer libbah o roshah shel zo ola hoil vedavar shehanneshama teluya bo hu kullah ola hikdish evar echad min haof hare ze safek im nitkaddesh kullo o lo nitkaddesh

Haomer behema zo chetzyah ola vechetzyah shelamim kadsha veenah kereva ella tire ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher veyavi bachatzi dameha ola uvachatzi dameha shelamim haya mechuyyav chattat veamar chetzyah chattat vechetzyah ola o shelamim o sheamar chetzyah ola o shelamim vechetzyah chattat hare hi tamut kemo sheyyitbaer bachattaot hammetot

Behemat hashshuttafin shehikdish echad mehen chetzyah shello vechazar velakach chetzyah haacher vehikdisho hare zo kedesha ukreva af al pi shemmittechillatah dechuya hayeta keshehikdish chetzyah en haddachuy meikkaro dachuy veaf al pi shehu kedushshat damim hoil vehi baale chayyim en baale chayyim niddachim vahare niret kullah lehakrava lefichach tikkarev veosa temura
Haomer deme behema zo ola o hare zo leola im hayeta reuya likkarev ola nitkaddesha kedushshat hagguf vehi atzmah tikkarev ola veim enah reuya timmacher veyavi bedameha ola

Amar al behema temea vechayyotze bah meissure karban sheen kedushsha chala alehen hare ellu ola lo amar kelum kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure mizbeach amar hare ellu leola yimmachru veyavi bidmehen ola

Haomer deme para zo leola kal sheloshim yom ulachar sheloshim yom lishlamim o sheamar dameha lishlamim kal sheloshim yom ulachar sheloshim yom leola devarav kayyamim veim hikriv dameha betoch sheloshim yom mevi bahen kemo shennadar veim hikrivo leachar sheloshim yom mevi kemo shennadar

Hayeta lo behema meubberet veamar im teled zachar hare hu ola veim hi nekeva zivche shelamim yalda zachar yikkarev ola yalda nekeva tikkarev zivche shelamim yalda zachar unkeva hazzachar yikkarev ola vehannekeva zivche shelamim yalda shene zecharim echad yikkarev ola vehashsheni yimmacher letzarche ola vedamav chullin vechen im yalda shette nekevot achat tikkarev shelamim ushniyya timmacher letzarche shelamim vedameha chullin yalda tumtum veanderoginus enan kadashim vahare hen chullin kemo shebbearnu vehammakdish ubbar bime baalat mum vechayyotze bah hare ze kadosh
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 16: Hannoder gadol vehevi katan lo yatza katan vehevi gadol yatza ketzad amar hare alay ola o shelamim keves vehevi ayil o shennadar egel vehevi shor gedi vehevi sair yatza

Nadar ola min hakkevasim o min haelim vehevi pilgas hare ze safek im yatza yede nidro o lo yatza vechen hannoder olat of min hattorim o min bene hayyona vehevi techillat hatztzihuv shebbaze veshebbaze hare ze safek nadar shachor vehevi lavan lavan vehevi shachor zachar vehevi nekeva nekeva vehevi zachar lo yatza

Hannoder setam mevi min haggedolim shebbammin shennadar veim oto hammakom regilin likrot bistam leechad min hamminin mevi keanshe hammakom ketzad nadar ola min habbakar yavi shor amar hare alay ola im derech anshe hammakom likrot ola setam afillu leolat haof mevi pereda achat tor o ben yona veim darkan sheen korin ola setam ella leolat bakar yavi shor vechen kal kayyotze baze

Mi shennadar shor o ayil o keves o egel vechayyotze bahem lo yavi kachush beoter shebbeoto hammin mippene sheddamav muatin veeno chayyav lehavi hayyafe hashshamen beoter sheen sham lemala mimmennu ella yavi habbenoni veim hevi hakkachush yatza yede nidro
Haomer hare alay shor sheve mane yavi shor sheshshave mane beoto makom chutz minnesachav hevi shenayim bemane lo yatza

Haomer shor ze ola venafal bo mum im ratza yavi bedamav shenayim vaafillu hevi bedamav ayil echad yatza amar shene shevarim ellu ola venafal bahem mum im ratza yavi bidmehem echad ayil ze ola venafal bo mum im ratza yavi bedamav keves vechen im nadar keves venifsal im ratza yavi bedamav ayil
Amar hare alay ola vehifrish shor venignav poter atzmo bese amar shor ze vedamav alay ola hukba veim nifsal lo yavi bedamav ella shor

Haomer echad mikkevasay hekdesh veechad mishshevaray hekdesh vehau lo shenayim haggadol shebbahen hekdesh hau shelosha haggadol shebbahen hekdesh vechoshshin labbenoni ketzad yaase yamtin labbenoni ad sheyyippol bo mum vetachul hakkedushsha al haggadol levaddo veim amar shor shebbishvaray hekdesh haggadol shebbahem hekdesh veen choshshin labbenoni

Perash echad mehen veshachach o sheamar lo aviv echad mehen hekdesh hare ze makdish gadol shebbahen veachar kach yetze yede chovato vechen hannoder ola min habbakar vekava nidro veshachach ma kava im shor im egel hare ze yavi shor vechen im kava bakkevasim veshachach ma kava yavi ayil kava baizzim veshachach yavi sair shachach beeze min min habbehema kava olato yavi shor veayil vesair veim nistappek lo shemma kava olato baof yosif tor uven yona

Nadar toda o shelamim vekava nidro babbakar veshachach bemi kevao yavi par ufara vechen im nistappek lo bakkevasim yavi ayil verachel nistappek lo baizzim yavi sair usira shachach bee ze min kava nidro mevi par ufara ayil verachel sair usira haomer hare alay olat of mevi tor o ben yona peresh veshachach bee ze min kava nidro mevi tor uven yona

Haomer hare alay lammizbeach yavi kometz levona sheen lecha davar shekkarev kullo lammizbeach kemot shehu ella levona peresh nidro veshachach ma peresh yavi mikkal davar shekkarev kullo lammizbeach lefichach mevi olat behema veolat haof uminchat nesachim ulvona veyayin bifne atzmo
Amar hare alay besela lammizbeach yavi keves sheen lecha davar shekkarev besela lammizbeach ella keves peresh veshachach ma shepperesh yavi besela mikkal davar vedavar shekkarev lammizbeach
Haomer hare alay levona lo yifchot mikkometz hare alay etzim lo yifchot mishshene gezarim avin kimchukot vearkan amma hare alay etz mevi gezer echad arko amma veim ratza lehavi deme haetzim yavi

Mi shennadar o hitnaddev shemen ketzad osin bo kometz mimmennu kometz venoten alav melach vezorko al gabbe haishshim vehashshear neechal lakkohanim kishyare menachot vechetzad osin beyayin habba bifne atzmo noten alav melach umnassecho kullo al gabbe hashshitin kechal hannesachim vehallevona habbaa bifne atzmah noten aleha melach vechullah laishshim
Mi shennadar neder lo yeviennu mimmeot maaser sheni shehare nitchayyev bekarban ze vechal hamchuyyav bekarban lo yavi karbano ella min hachullin
Amar hare alay toda min hachullin velachmah min hammaaser lo yavi lachmah ella min hachullin shehare nadar bekarban toda vehattoda enah baa ella im hallechem min hachullin

Peresh veamar hare alay lehavi toda mimmeot maaser sheni velachmah min hachullin yesh lo lehavi kemo shennadar veim hevi hakkol min hachullin yatza vechen im peresh veamar hare alay toda hi velachmah min hammaaser yavi velo yavi lachmah mechitte maaser sheni ella mimmeot maaser sheni kemo habbehema shehi mimmeot maaser sheni veaf al pi shepperesh sheyyavi lachmah min hammaaser lo yavi nesacheha mimmeot maaser sheni sheen hannesachim bain leolam ella min hachullin kemo shebbearnu lefi shenneemar bahen vehikriv hammakriv karbano ad sheyyihu mishshello velo yihye bahen tzad legavoha kelal
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 17: Hannoder mincha maafe tannur lo yavi moafe kuppach velo maafe reafim velo maafe yorot haarviyyim

Amar ellu lehavi bichli echad vehevi bishne kelim o lehavi bishne kelim vehevi bichli echad hare ellu pesulin lo kevaan bishat hanneder ella amar hare alay shene esronot uvishat hafrasha kevaan vehifrishan bishne kelim vechazar vehevian bichli echad hare ellu kesherim shenneemar kaasher nadarta velo kaasher hifrashta amar hare alay shene esronot lehavi bichli echad vehevian bishne kelim amru lo bichli echad nadarta hikrivam bishne kelim hare ellu pesulin hikrivam bichli echad hare ellu kesherim
Amar hare alay shene esronot lehavi bishne kelim vehevi bichli echad amru lo bishne kelim nadarta hikrivan bishne kelim hare ellu kesherim hikrivan bichli echad hare ellu kishte menachot shennitarvu

Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 18: Kal hakkarbanot kullan ben karbenot behema veof ben karbenot menachot mitzvat ase lehakrivan bevet habbechira shenneemar vesham taase kol asher anochi metzavekka vechen mitzvat ase lihot kal adam metappel umevi karbenot behema shennitchayyev lehakrivan michutza laaretz levet habbechira shenneemar kadashecha asher yihu lecha undarecha tissa vego mippi hashshemua lamdu sheeno medabber ella bekadshe chutza laaretz shehu metappel bahem ad sheyeviem levet habbechira

Hammakriv karban chutz laazara bittel mitzvat ase veavar al lo taase shenneemar hishshamer lecha pen taale olotecha bechal makom asher tire veim hikriv bemezid chayyav karet shenneemar asher yaale ola o zavach veel petach ohel moed lo hevio venichrat meammav beshogeg mevi chattat kevua

Vechen hashshochet kadashim chutz laazara af al pi shello heelam im haya mezid chayyav karet shenneemar asher yishchat shor o chesev o ez vego dam yechashev laish hahu dam shafach venichrat veim shachat beshogeg mevi chattat kevua

Eno chayyav ella al shechitat kadashim haruyin likkarev legabbe mizbeach aval hashshochet bachutz echad meissure mizbeach o mechattaot hammetot hare ze patur shenneemar lifne mishkan Adonai vechal sheeno rauy lavo el mishkan Adonai en chayyavin alav

E zehu mechussar zeman begufo behema betoch shivat yeme halleda vetorin shello higgia zemannan veoto veet beno shennishchat echad mehem hayyom sheen hashsheni rauy ad lemachar

Vee zehu mechussar zeman babbealim karban sheadayin lo higgia zeman bealav lehakrivo ketzad hazzav vehazzava vehayyoledet sheshshachatu chattatam bachutz betoch yeme sefira peturin vechen metzora sheshshachat chattato vaashamo bachutz betoch yeme hassefira patur sheadayin lo niru baale hakkarbanot haellu lechappara aval im shachatu olotehen bachutz betoch yeme hassefira chayyavin shehaola doron hi vehachattat vehaasham hi ikkar hakkappara vechen nazir sheshshachat chattato bachutz betoch yeme neziruto patur hikriv olato o shelamav bachutz chayyav shehachattat hi hammeakkavto vehi ikkar hannezirut

Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 1: Mitzvat ase laasot bayit la muchan lihot makrivim bo hakkarbanot vechoggin elav shalosh peamim bashshana shenneemar veasu li mikdash uchvar nitparesh battora mishkan sheasa moshe rabbenu vehaya lefi shaa shenneemar ki lo vatem ad atta vego

Kevan shennichnesu laaretz heemidu hammishkan baggilgal arba esre shana shekkavshu veshechilleku umishsham bau leshilo uvanu sham bayit shel avanim ufarsu yeriot hammishkan alav velo hayeta sham tikra veshst shana amad mishkan shilo uchshemmet eli charav uvau lenov uvanu sham mikdash uchshemmet shemuel charav uvau legivon uvanu sham mikdash umiggivon bau levet haolamim vime nov vegivon sheva vachamishshim shana

Kevan shennivna hammikdash birushalayim neesru kal hammekomot kullan livnot bahen bayit la ulhakriv bahen karban veen sham bayit ledore haddorot ella birushalayim bilvad uvhar hammoriyya shebbah neemar vayyomer david ze hu bet Adonai haelohim veze mizbeach leola leyisrael veomer zot menuchati ade ad

Binyan shebbana shelomo kevar meforash bimlachim vechen binyan heatid lehibbanot af al pi shehu katuv bichezkel eno meforash umvoar veanshe bayit sheni keshebbanu bime ezra banuhu kevinyan shelomo umeen devarim hamforashim bichezkel

Veellu hen haddevarim shehen ikkar bevinyan habbayit osin bo kodesh vekodesh hakkadashim veyihye lifne hakkodesh makom echad vehu hannikra ulam ushlashtan nikrain hechal veoshin mechitztza acheret saviv lahechal rechoka mimmennu keen kale hechatzer shehau bammidbar vechal hammukkaf bimchitza zo shehu keen chatzar ohel moed hu hannikra azara vehakkol nikra mikdash

Veosin bammikdash kelim mizbeach laola velishar hakkarbanot vechevesh sheolim bo lammizbeach umkomo lifne haulam mashuch ledarom vechiyyor vechanno lekaddesh mimmennu hakkohanim yedehem veraglehem laavoda umkomo ben haulam velammizbeach mashuch ledarom shehu semol hannichnas lammikdash umizbeach lakketoret umnora veshulchan ushlashtan betoch hakkodesh lifne kodesh hakkadashim

Hammenora baddarom missemol hannichnas veshulchan miyyamin shealav lechem happanim ushnehem betzad kodesh hakkadashim mibbachutz umizbach hakketoret mashuch mibben shenehem lachutz veosin betoch haazara gevulin ad kan leyisrael ad kan lakkohanim uvonim bah battim lishar tzarche hammikdash kal bayit mehem nikra lishka

Keshebbonin hahechal vehaazara bonin baavanim gedolot veim lo matzu avanim bonin bilvenim veen mefatztzelin et avne habbinyan behar habbayit ella mefatztzelin otan umsattetin otan mibbachutz veachar kach machnisin otan labbinyan shenneemar avanim gedolot avanim yekarot leyassed habbayit avne gazit veomer umakkavot vehaggarzen kal keli varzel lo nishma babbayit behibbanoto
Veen bonin bo etz bolet kelal ella o baavanim o bilvenim vesid veen osin achsadrot shel etz bechal haazara ella shel avanim o levenim
Umratztzefin et kal haazara baavanim yekarot veim neekra even af al pi shehi omedet bimkomah hoil venitkalkela pesula veasur lakkohen haoved laamod aleha bishat haavoda ad shettikkava baaretz

Umitzva min hammuvchar lechazzek et habbinyan ulhagbiho kefi koach hatztzibbur shenneemar ulromem et bet elohenu umfaarin oto umyappin kefi kochan im yecholin latuach oto bezahav ulhagdil bemaasav hare ze mitzva

En bonin et hammikdash ballayela shenneemar uvom hakim et hammishkan bayyom mekimin lo ballayela veoskin babbinyan mealot hashshachar ad tzet hakkochavim vehakkol chayyavin livnot ulsaed beatzman uvmamonam anashim venashim kemikdash hammidbar veen mevattelin tinokot shel bet rabban labbinyan veen binyan bet hammikdash doche yom tov

Hammizbeach en osin oto ella binyan avanim gazit veze shenneemar battora mizbach adama taase li sheyyihye mechubbar baadama shello yivnuhu lo al gabbe kefin velo al gabbe mechillot veze shenneemar veim mizbach avanim mippi hashshemua lamdu sheeno reshut ella chova

Kal even shennifgema kede shettachgor bah hatztzipporen kesakkin shel shechita hare zo pesula lakkevesh velammizbeach shenneemar avanim shelemot tivne et mizbach Adonai umehechan hau meviin avne mizbeach min betulat hakkarka chofrin ad shemmaggiin lemakom hannikkar sheeno mekom avoda uvinyan umotziin mimmennu haavanim o min hayyam haggadol uvonin mehen vechen avne hahechal vehaazarot shelemot hau

Avne hechal vaazarot shennifgemu o shennigmemu pesulin veen lahen pidon ella nignazim kal even shennaga bah habbarzel af al pi shello nifgema pesula levinyan hammizbeach uvinyan hakkevesh shenneemar ki charbecha henafta aleha vattechalleha vehabbone even shennaga bah barzel bammizbeach o bakkevesh loke shenneemar lo tivne ethen gazit vehabbone even pagum over baase

Even shennifgema o shennaga bah barzel achar shennivnet bammizbeach o bakkevesh otah haeven pesula vehashshear kesherot umlabbenin et hammizbeach paamayim beshana bappesach uvechag uchshemmelabbenin otan melabbenin bemappa aval lo bechafis shel barzel shemma yigga baeven veyifsol

En osin madregot lammizbeach shenneemar lo taale vemaalot al mizbechi ella bonin kemo tel bidromo shel mizbeach mitmaet veored merosh hammizbeach ad haaretz vehu hannikra kevesh vehaole bemaalot al hammizbeach loke vechen hannotetz even achat min hammizbeach o mikkal hahechal o mibben haulam velammizbeach derech hashchata loke shenneemar venittatztem et mizbechotam vego lo taasun ken la elohechem
Hammenora vecheleha vehashshulchan vechelav umizbach hakketoret vechal kele sharet en osin otan ella min hammattechet bilvad veim asaum shel etz o etzem o even o shel zechuchit pesulin

Hau hakkahal aniyyim osin otan afillu shel bedil veim heeshiru osin otan zahav afillu hammizrakot vehashshippudin vehammaggerefot shel mizbach haola vehammiddot im yesh koach batztzibbur osin otan shel zahav afillu shaare haazara mechappin otan zahav im matza yadam

En osin kal hakkelim mittechillatan ella leshem hakkodesh veim naasu mittechillatan lehedot en osin otan legavoha uchli gavoha ad shello nishtammesh bahen gavoha rashshay lehishtammesh bahen hedot umishshennishtammesh bahen gavoha asurin lehedot avanim vekorot shechatzavan mittechilla levet hakkeneset en bonin otan lehar habbayit
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 2: Hammizveach mekomo mechuvan beoter veen meshannin oto mimmekomo leolam shenneemar ze mizbach leola leyisrael uvammikdash neekad yitzchak avinu shenneemar velech lecha el eretz hammoriyya veneemar bedivre hayyamim vayyachel shelomo livnot et bet Adonai birushalayim behar hammoriyya asher nira ledavid avihu asher hechin bimkom david begoren arnan hayevusi

Umasoret beyad hakkol shehammakom shebbana bo david ushlomo hammizbeach begoren aravena hu hammakom shebbana bo avraham hammizbeach veakad alav yitzchak vehu hammakom shebbana bo noach kesheyyatza min hatteva vehu hammizbeach shehikriv alav kayin vehevel uvo hikriv adam harishon karban keshennivra umishsham nivra amru chachamim adam mimmekom kapparato nivra
Middot hammizbeach mechuvanot harbe vetzurato yedua ish meish umizbeach shebbanu bene haggola keen mizbeach sheatid lehibbanot asuhu veen lehosif al middato velo ligroa mimmenna

Ushlosha neviim alu immahem min haggola echad heid lahen al mekom hammizbeach veechad heid lahen al middotav veechad heid lahen shemmakrivin al hammizbeach hazze kal hakkarbanot af al pi sheen sham bayit

Mizbeach sheasa moshe vesheasa shelomo vesheasu bene haggola vesheatid leheasot kullan eser ammot govah kal echad mehen veze hakkatuv battora veshalosh ammot komato mekom hammaaracha bilvad umizbeach sheasu bene haggola vechen heatid lehibbanot middat arko verachbo ammot al ammot
Eser ammot shel govah hammizbeach mehen beamma bat chamishsha tefachim umehen beamma bat shishsha tefachim ushar kal ammot habbinyan beamma bat shishsha tefachim vegovah kal hammizbeach tefachim

Vechach hayeta middato vetzurato ala chamishsha tefachim vechanas chamishsha tefachim zehu yesod nimtza rochav sheloshim amma ushne tefachim al rochav sheloshim amma ushne tefachim ala sheloshim tefachim vechanas chamishsha tefachim zehu sovev ala tefachim zehu mekom hammaaracha nimtza rachbo shemone veesrim amma vearbaa tefachim al shemone veesrim amma vearbaa tefachim ala tefachim vechones lekeren zavit shel hach binyan chalul merubba lechal arba keranot umkom hakkeranot amma mizze veamma mizze saviv vechen mekom ragle hakkohanim amma saviv nimtza mekom hammaaracha rachbo esrim vearba ammot vearbaa tefachim al esrim vearba ammot vearbaa tefachim

Govah kal keren vekeren chamishsha tefachim veribbua kal keren amma al amma vearba hakkeranot chalulot hau mittochan vegovah mekom hammaaracha tefachim nimtza chatzi govah hammizbeach tefachim missof hassovev ulmatta

Vechut shel sikra haya choger beemtza hammizbeach keshishsha tefachim missof hassovev ulmatta lehavdil ben damim haelonim ledamim hattachtonim venimtza gavho min haaretz ad mekom hammaaracha tesha ammot pachot tefach

Yesod hammizbeach lo haya makkif mearba ruchotav kemo hassovev ella haya hayesod mashuch keneged kal ruach tzafon umaaravi veochel baddarom amma achat uvammizrach amma achat vekeren deromit mizrachit lo haya lah yesod
Uvkeren maaravit deromit hau shene nekavim kemin sheni chotamin dakkin vehen hannikrain shitin shehaddamim yordin bahen umitarvin beotah hakkeren baamma veotzin lannachal kidron
Ulmatta baritzpa beoto hakkeren haya mekom amma al amma vetavla shel shayish vetabbaat kevua bah shebbo yordin lashshitin umnakkin oto

Vechevesh haya banuy lidromo shel mizbeach arko sheloshim ushtayim amma al rochav amma vehaya ochel baaretz sheloshim amma mitztzad hammizbeach uforeach mimmenna amma al hayesod veamma al hassovev vaavir meat haya mafsik ben hakkevesh lammizbeach kede litten haevarim lammizbeach bizrika vegovah hakkevesh tesha ammot pachot shetut ad keneged hammaaracha

Ushne kevashim ketannim yotzim mimmennu shebbahem ponim layesod velassovev umuvdalin min hammizbeach kimlo nima vechallon hayeta bemaaravo shel kevesh amma al amma urvuva hayeta nikret shebbah notnin pesule chattat haof ad shettaavor tzuratah vetetze levet hasserefa
Ushne shulchanot hau bemaarav hakkevesh echad shel shayish shennotnin alav et haevarim veechad shel kesef shennotnin alav kele hashsharet

Keshebbonin hammizbeach bonin oto kullo atum kemin ammud veen osin bo chalal kelal ella mevi avanim shelemot gedolot uktannot umevi sid vezefet vekunya ummache veshofach letoch malben gadol kemiddato uvone veole venoten betoch habbinyan guf shel etz o even bekeren deromit mizrachit kemiddat hayesod vechen noten betoch kal keren vekeren ad sheyyashlim habbinyan veyasir haggufim shebbetoch habbinyan kede shettishshaer keren deromit mizrachit belo yesod veyishshaaru hakkeranot chalulin

Arba keranot shel mizbeach visodo veribbuo meakkevin vechal mizbeach sheen lo keren yesod vechevesh veribbua hare hu pasul shearbatan meakkevin aval middat arko umiddat rachbo umiddat komato enan meakkevin vehu shello yifchot meamma al amma berum shalosh ammot keshiur mekom hammaaracha shel mizbach midbar
Mizbeach shennifgam mibbinyano im nifgam mibbinyano tefach pasul pachot mittefach kasher vehu shello yihye bannishar even peguma
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 3: Hammennora meforeshet tzuratah battora vearbaa geviim ushne kaftorim ushne perachim hau bikne hammenora shenneemar uvammenora arbaa geviim meshukkadim kaftoreha ufracheha veod perach shelishi haya samuch lirechah shel menora shenneemar ad yerechah ad pirchah

Veshalosh raglayim hau lah ushlosha kaftorim acherim hau bikne hammenora shemmehen yotzim sheshet hakkanim shelosha mitztzad ze ushlosha mitztzad ze uvchal kane vekane mehen shelosha geviim vechaftor vaferach vehakkol meshukkadim kemo shekedim baasiyyatan
Nimtzeu kal haggeviim shenayim veesrim vehapperachim tisha vehakkaftorim achad asar vechullan meakkevin ze et ze vaafillu chaser echad min hashshenayim vearbaim meakkev et kullan

Bamme devarim amurim besheasauha zahav aval shear mine mattachot en osin bah geviim kaftorim ufrachim vechen menora habbaa zahav tihye kullah kikkar im neroteha vetihye kullah miksha min haashatot veshel shear mine mattachot en makpidin al mishkalah veim hayeta chalula keshera
Veen osin otah leolam min haggerutaot ben shehayeta shel zahav ben shehayeta shel shear mine mattachot

Hammelkachayim vehammachtot uchle hashshemen enan mikkelal hakkikkar shehare neemar bammenora zahav tahor vechazar veamar umalkacheha umachtoteha zahav tahor velo neemar neroteha zahav tahor mippene shehannerot kevuin bammenora vehem mikkelal hakkikkar
Shivat kene hammenora meakkevin ze et ze veshivat neroteha meakkevin ze et ze ben shehayeta shel zahav ben shehayeta shel shear mine mattachot vechal hannerot kevuim bakkanim

Sheshet hannerot hakkevuim besheshet hakkanim hayyotzim min hammenora kullan penehem lanner haemtzai sheal kene hammenora veze hanner haemtzai panav keneged kodesh hakkadashim vehu hannikra ner maaravi

Haggeviim domin lechosot alekkesanderia sheppihen rachav veshulehen katzar vehakkaftorim kemin tappuchim kerutiyyim shehen arukkin meat kevetza sheshshene rasheha kaddin vehapperachim kemo pirche haammudim shehen kemin keara usfatah kefula lachutz

Govah hammenora haya shemona asar tefach haraglayim vehapperach shelosha tefachim ushne tefachim chalak vetefach shebbo gavia kaftor vaferach utfachayim chalak vetefach kaftor ushne kanim yotzin mimmennu echad helach veechad helach venimshachim veolin keneged govah hammenora vetefach chalak vetefach kaftor ushne kanim yotzim mimmennu echad helach veechad helach venimshachin veolin keneged govah hammenora vetefach chalak vetefach kaftor ushne kanim yotzim mimmennu echad helach veechad helach venimshachin veolin keneged govah hammenora utfachayim chalak nishtayeru shelosha tefachim shebbahen shelosha geviim kaftor vaferach
Veeven hayeta lifne hammenora uvah shalosh maalot shealeha kohen omed umetiv et hannerot umanniach aleha kele shamnah umalkacheha umachtoteha bishat hatava

Hashshulchan haya arko shenem asar tefach verachbo shishsha tefachim vehaya munnach arko leorech habbayit verachbo lerochav habbayit vechen shear kal hakkelim shebbammikdash arkan learko shel bayit verachban lerochav habbayit chutz min haaron shehaya arko lerochav habbayit vechen nerot hammenora keneged rochav habbayit ben hatztzafon uven haddarom

Arbaa senifin shel zahav hau lashshulchan mefutztzalin berashehen shehau somchin bahen shette hammaarachot shel lechem happanim shenayim misseder ze ushnayim misseder ze vehem hanneemarim battora uksotav

Ushmona veesrim kanim shel zahav kal echad mehen kachatzi kane chalul hau lo arbaa asar leseder ze vearbaa asar leseder ze vehem hannikraim menakkiyyotav ushne habbezichin shemmannichin bahen hallevona al hashshulchan betzad hammaarachot hen hannikrain kappotav vehaddefusin sheosin bahem lechem happanim hem hannikraim kearotav

Ellu haarbaa asar kanim noten hachalla harishona al atzmo shel shulchan venoten ben rishona ushniyya shelosha kanim vechen ben kal challa vechalla shelosha kanim uven shishshit vachamishit shene kanim bilvad lefi sheen al hashshishshit acheret nimtzeu arbaa asar bechal maaracha umaaracha
Ushne shulchanot hau baulam mibbifnim al petach habbayit echad shel shayish notnin alav lechem happanim bichnisato veechad shel zahav notnin alav lechem bitziato shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin

Mizbach hakketoret haya merubba amma al amma vehu natun bahechal mechuvan ben hatztzafon laddarom mashuch ben hashshulchan vehammenora lachutz ushlashtan hau munnachin mishshelish hahechal velifnim keneged happarochet hammavdil ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkadashim

Hakkiyyor hau lo shenem asar dad kede sheyyihu kal hakkohanim haoskim battamid mekaddeshim mimmennu keechad umuchni asu lo sheyyihu bah hammayim tamid vehi chol kede shello yihu hammayim shebbah nifsalin belina shehakkiyyor mikkele hakkodesh umkaddesh vechal davar sheyyitkaddesh bichli kodesh im lan nifsal
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 4: Even hayeta bekodesh hakkadashim bemaaravo shealeha haya haaron munnach ulfanav tzintzenet hamman umatte aharon uvet shebbana shelomo et habbayit veyada shessofo lecharev bana bo makom lignoz bo haaron lematta bematmoniyyot amukot vaakalkallot veyoshiyyahu hammelech tziva ugnazo bammakom shebbana shelomo shenneemar vayyomer lalviyyim hammevinim lechal yisrael hakkedoshim la tenu et aron hakkodesh babbayit asher bana shelomo ven david melech yisrael en lachem massa bakkatef atta ivdu et Adonai elohechem vego venignaz immo matte aharon vehatztzintzenet veshemen hammishcha vechal ellu lo chazru bevayit sheni veaf urim vetummim shehau bevayit sheni lo hau meshivin beruach hakkodesh velo hau nishalin bahen shenneemar ad amod kohen leurim vetummim velo hau osin otan ella lehashlim shemona begadim lechohen gadol kede shello yehe mechussar begadim

Hahechal shebbanu bene gola haya mea amma al mea amma al rum mea vechen hayeta middat rumo banu govah shesh ammot atum satum kemo yesod lo verum katle habbayit arbaim amma verum hakkiyyur shebbattikra amma veal gabbav govah shette ammot panuy sheyyikkanes bo haddelef vehu hannikra bet dilfa vaovi hattikra sheal gabbe bet dilfa amma umaaziva govah amma vaaliyya benuya al gabbav govah ketaleha arbaim amma uvgaggah govah amma kiyyur veammatayim govah bet dilfa veamma tikra veamma maaziva vegovah hammaake shalosh ammot vetas shel barzel kemo sayif gavho amma al gabbe hammaake saviv kede shello yanuchu alav haofot vehu hannikra kale orev hare hakkol mea amma
