Kal ellu hammekomot happenuyim shebben hakketalim hem hannikraim taim nimtzeu hattaim hammukkafin lammikdash chamishsha min hatztzafon vachamishsha min haddarom ushlosha min hammaarav veshalosh deotot hau deota al gabbe deota nimtzeu taim baddarom chamishsha al gabbe chamishsha vachamishsha al gabbehen vechen batztzafon chamishsha asar ushmona taim hau bammaarav shelosha al gabbe shelosha ushnayim al gabbehen bidota achat hakkol taim

Shelosha petachim hau lechal echad veechad min hattaim echad latta min hayyamin veechad latta min hassemol veechad latta sheal gabbav uvkeren mizrachit tzefonit batta shebbaddeota haemtzait hau chamishsha petachim echad latta miyyamin veechad latta sheal gabbav veechad lammesibba veechad latta sheyyesh bo happishpash veechad lahechal

Umsibba hayeta ola mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit lekeren tzefonit maaravit shebbah hau olin legaggot hattaim haya ole bammesibba ufanav lammaarav halach et kal pene hatztzafon ad shehu maggia lammaarav higgia lammaarav hafach panav laddarom halach et kal pene hammaarav ad shehu maggia laddarom higgia laddarom hafach panav lammizrach vehaya mehallech laddarom ad shehu maggia lefitchah shel aliyya sheppitchah shel aliyya haya patuach laddarom

Uvfitchah shel aliyya hau shette kelunsot shel erez shebbahen olin legaggah shel aliyya verashe pispesin hau mavdilin baaliyya ben gag hakkodesh legag kodesh hakkadashim velulin hau petuchin baaliyya levet kodesh hakkadashim shebbahen meshalshelin et haummanin betevot kede shello yazunu enehem mibbet kodesh hakkadashim ufaam achat beshana mippesach lefesach melabbenin et hahechal
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 5: Har habbayit vehu har hammoriyya haya chamesh meot amma al chamesh meot amma vehaya mukkaf choma vechefin al gabbe kefin hau benuot mittachtav mippene ohel hattuma vechullo haya mekore setav lefanim missetav
Vachamishsha shearim hau lo echad min hammaarav veechad min hammizrach veechad min hatztzafon ushnayim min haddarom rochav kal shaar eser ammot vegavho esrim veyesh lahem daltot
Lefanim mimmennu soreg makkif seviv gavho asara tefachim ulfanim min hassoreg hachel gavho eser ammot vealav hu omer bakkinot vayyaavel chel vechoma zo chomat haazara

Lefanim min hachel haazara vechal haazara hayeta orech al rochav veshiva shearim hau lah shelosha min hatztzafon hassemuchin lammaarav ushlosha min haddarom semuchin lammaarav veechad bammizrach mechuvan keneged bet kodesh hakkadashim baemtza

Kal shaar mehen haya rachbo eser ammot vegavho esrim amma vehau lo delatot mechuppot zahav chutz mishshaar mizrachi shehaya metzuppe nechoshet doma lezahav veshaar ze hu hannikra shaar haelon vehu shaar nikanor

Haazara lo hayeta mechuvenet beemtza har habbayit ella rechoka midderom har habbayit yeter mikkal haruchot ukrova lammaarav yeter mikkal haruchot uvenah uven hatztzafon yeter mimma shebbenah uven hammaarav uvenah uven hammizrach yeter mimma shebbenah uven hatztzafon

Velifne haazara bammizrach hayeta ezrat hannashim vehi hayeta orech mea amma vachamishsha ushloshim al rochav vearba leshachot hau bearba miktzeoteha shel arbaim arbaim amma velo hau mekorot vechen atidin lihot

Uma hem meshammeshot deromit mizrachit lishkat hannezirim sheshsham mevashshelin et shalmehem umgallechin et saaram mizrachit tzefonit lishkat dir haetzim sheshsham kohanim baale mumin matliim baetzim shekkal etz shennimtza bo tolaat pasul tzefonit maaravit lishkat hamtzoraim maaravit deromit bah hau notnin yayin veshemen vehi hayeta nikret lishkat bet shamnayya

Ezrat hannashim hayeta mukkefet gezuztera kede sheyyihu hannashim root millemalan vehaanashim millemattan kede shello yihu meerbavin uvayit gadol haya betzad haazara bitzfonah mibbachutz ben haazara vehachel vehaya banuy kippa umukkaf revadin shel even vehu haya nikra bet hammoked ushne petachim hau lo echad patuach laazara veechad patuach lachel

Vearba leshachot hau bo shettayim kodesh ushtayim chol verashe pispesin mavdilin ben hakkodesh vehachol uma hau meshammeshot maaravit deromit lishkat hattelaim udromit mizrachit lishkat ose lechem happanim mizrachit tzefonit bah ganzu bet chashmonay avne mizbeach sheshshikketzum malche yavan tzefonit maaravit bah yordin levet hattevila

Hayyored levet hattevila millishka zo haya holech bammesibba haholechet tachat hammikdash kullo vehannerot dolkot mikkan umikkan ad shemmaggia levet hattevila umdura hayeta sham uvet hakkisse shel kavod vezehu kevodo metzao naul beyadua sheyyesh sham adam

Orech haazara min hammizrach lammaarav vezehu cheshbonan mikkotel maaravi shel azara ad kotel hahechal achat esre amma veorech hahechal kullo mea amma ben haulam velammizbeach shettayim veesrim hammizbeach shettayim ushloshim mekom derisat ragle hakkohanim vehu hannikra ezrat kohanim achat esre amma mekom derisat ragle yisrael vehu hannikra ezrat yisrael achat esre amma

Verochav haazara min hatztzafon laddarom mea ushloshim vechamesh vezehu cheshbonan mikkotel tzefoni ad bet hammitbachayim shemone ammot bet hammitbachayim ammot umechetza vesham tolin umafshitin et hakkadashim betziddo

Mekom hashshulchanot shemone ammot uvo shulchanot shel shayish shemmannichin alehen hannetachim umdichin et habbasar levashshelo ushmona shulchanot hau uvtzad mekom hashshulchanot mekom hattabbaot amma vesham shochatin et hakkadashim

Uven mekom hattabbaot vehammizbeach shemone ammot vehammizbeach vehakkevesh sheloshim uven hakkevesh ulchotel deromi amma umechetza mikkotel tzefoni shel azara ad kotel hammizbeach shehu rochav shishshim umechetza uchnegdo mikkotel haulam ad kotel mizrachi shel azara shehu orech shesh veshivim
Kal hamrubba hazze hu hannikra tzafon hu hammakom sheshshochatin bo kadshe kadashim

Shemone leshachot hau beezrat yisrael shalosh batztzafon veshalosh baddarom shebbaddarom lishkat hammelach lishkat happarva lishkat hammedichin lishkat hammelach sham notnin melach lakkarban lishkat happarva sham molchin orot hakkadashim veal gaggah hayeta bet tevila lechohen gadol beom hakkippurim lishkat hammedichin sham hau medichin kirve hakkadashim umishsham mesibba ola legag bet happarva vehashshalosh shebbitzfon lishkat haggazit lishkat haggula lishkat haetz lishkat haggazit shebbah sanhedri gedola yoshevet vechetzyah haya kodesh vechetzyah haya chol velah shene petachim echad lakkodesh veechad lechol uvachetzi shel chol hau hassanhedrin yoshvin lishkat haggula sham hayeta bor shemmemallein mimmennu baggula umishsham mesappekin mayim lechal haazara velishkat haetz hayeta achore shettehen vehi hayeta lishkat kohen gadol vehi hannikret lishkat parhedrin vegag shelashtan shave ushte leshachot acherot hau sham beezrat yisrael achat mimin shaar mizrachi vehu lishkat pinchas hammalbish veechad missemolo vehu lishkat ose chavitin
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 6: Hammikdash kullo lo haya bemishor ella bemaale hahar kesheadam nichnas mishshaar mizrachi shel har habbayit mehallech ad sof hachel beshave veole min hachel leezrat hannashim bishtem esre maalot rum kal maala chatzi amma veshilchah chatzi amma
Umhallech kal ezrat hannashim beshave veole mimmenna leezrat yisrael shehu techillat haazara bachamesh esre maalot rum kal maala chatzi amma veshilchah chatzi amma

Umhallech kal ezrat yisrael beshave veole mimmennu leezrat hakkohanim bemaala gevoha amma vealeha duchan yesh bo shalosh maalot rum kal mala chatzi amma veshilchah chatzi amma nimtzet ezrat hakkohanim gevoha al shel yisrael shette ammot umechetza

Umhallech kal ezrat hakkohanim vehammizbeach uven haulam velammizbeach beshave veole mishsham laulam bishtem esre maalot rum kal mala chatzi amma veshilchah chatzi amma vehaulam vehahechal kullo beshave

Nimtza govah karka hahechal al karka shaar hammizrach shel har habbayit shettayim veesrim ammot vegovah shaar har habbayit esrim amma lefichach haomed keneged shaar hammizrach eno roe petach hahechal umippene ze asu kotel sheal gabbe shaar ze namuch kede sheyehe kohen haomed behar hammishcha roe petach hahechal beshaa shemmazze middam happara nochach hahechal

Ulshachot hau sham tachat ezrat yisrael petuchot leezrat hannashim sheshsham halviyyim notnin hakkinnorot vehannevalim vehammetziltayim vechal kele hashshir veal hadduchan haole meezrat yisrael leezrat hakkohanim hau halviyyim omdim beshaa sheomrim shira al hakkarban

Halleshachot habbenuot bakkodesh uftuchot lachol im hau gaggotehen shavin im karka haazara tochan chol vegaggotehen kodesh veim enan shavin af gaggotehen chol shehaggaggot vehaaliyyot lo nitkaddeshu lefichach gaggim ellu en ochlin sham kadshe kadashim velo shochatin kadashim kallim
Hau benuot lachol uftuchot lakkodesh tochan kodesh laachilat kadshe kadashim aval en shochatin sham kadashim kallim vehannichnas lesham betuma patur vegaggotehen chol lechal davar
Hammechillot happetuchot laazara kodesh vehappetuchot lehar habbayit chol hachallonot vaovi hachoma kelifnim ben laachilat kadshe kadashim ben letuma
Bet din sheratzu lehosif al yerushalayim o lehosif al haazara mosifin veyesh lahem limshoch haazara ad hammakom sheyyirtzu mehar habbayit velimshoch chomat yerushalayim ad makom sheyyirtzu

En mosifin al hair o al haazarot ella al pi hammelech veal pi navi uvurim vetummim veal pi sanhedrin shel shivim veechad zekenim shenneemar kechl asher ani mare otcha vechen taasu ledorot umoshe rabbenu melech haya

Vechetzad mosifin al hair osin bet din shette todot velokchin lechem chametz shebbahem veholchim bet din achar shette hattodot ushte hattodot zo achar zo veomdin bechinnorot uvinvalim uvtziltzal al kal pinna ufinna veal kal even veeven shebbirushalayim veomer aromimcha Adonai ki dillitani vego ad shemmaggiin lesof hammakom shemmekaddeshin oto veomdin sham veochlim sham lechem toda achat mishshete hattodot vehashsheniyya nisrefet veal pi hannavi sorfin et zo veochlin et zo

Vechen im hosifu al haazara mekaddeshin otah bishyare hammincha ma yerushalayim hattoda shenneechelet bah mekaddashtah af haazara sheyare hammenachot sheen neechalin ella bah hen shemmekaddeshin otah bahen veochlin otan besof hammakom shekkiddeshu

Kal makom shello naasa bechal ellu vechasseder hazze en kadosh gamur veze sheasa ezra shette todot zikkaron hu sheasa lo bemaasav nitkaddesh hammakom shello haya sham lo melech velo urim vetummim uvma nitkaddesha bikdushsha rishona shekkiddeshah shelomo shehu kiddesh haazara virushalayim lishatan vekiddeshan leatid lavo

Lefichach makrivin hakkarbanot kullan af al pi sheen sham bayit banuy veochlin kadshe kadashim bechal haazara af al pi shehi chareva veenah mukkefet bimchitztza veochlin kadashim kallim umaaser sheni bechal yerushalayim af al pi sheen sham chomot shehakkedushsha rishona kadsha lishatah vekadsha leatid lavo

Velamma ani omer bammikdash virushalayim kedushsha rishona kadsha leatid lavo uvikdushshat shear eretz yisrael leinyan sheviit umaasrot vechayyotze bahen lo kadsha leatid lavo lefi shekkedushshat hammikdash virushalayim mippene hashshechina ushchina enah betela vahare hu omer vahashimmoti et mikdeshechem veamru chachamim af al pi sheshshommin bikdushshatan hen omdim aval chiyyuv haaretz bishviit uvmaasrot eno ella mippene shehu kibbush rabbim vechevan shennilkecha haaretz midehem batal hakkibbush veniftera min hattora mimmaasrot umishsheviit shehare enah min eretz yisrael vechevan sheala ezra vekiddeshah lo kiddeshah bechibbush ella bachazaka shehechziku bah ulfichach kal makom shehechziku bah ole bavel venitkaddesh bikdushshat ezra hashsheniyya hu mekuddash hayyom veaf al pi shennilkach haaretz mimmennu vechayyav bishviit uvmaasrot al hadderech shebbearnu behilchot teruma
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 7: Mitzvat ase leyira min hammikdash shenneemar umikdashi tirau velo min hammikdash atta yare ella mimmi shetztziva al yirato

Vee zo hi yirato lo yikkanes adam lehar habbayit bemaklo o beminal shebberaglav o baafundato o baavak sheal raglav o bemaot hatztzerurin lo bisdino veen tzarich lomar sheasur larok bechal har habbayit ella im nizdammen lo rok mavlio bichsuto velo yaase har habbayit derech sheyyikkanes mippetach zo veyetze mippetach shekkenegdah kede lekatztzer hadderech ella yakkifo mibbachutz velo yikkanes lo ella lidvar mitzva

Vechal hannichnasin lehar habbayit nichnasin derech yamin umakkifin veotzin derech semol chutz mimmi sheero davar shehu makkif al hassemol lefichach hau shoalin lo ma lecha makkif al hassemol sheani avel hashshochen babbayit hazze yenachemcha sheani menudde hashshochen babbayit hazze yitten bilvavcha vetishma ledivre chaverecha vikarvucha

Kal shehishlim avoda venistallek lo eno yotze vaachorav lahechal ella mehallech achorannit meat meat umhallech benachat al tziddo ad sheyyetze min haazara vechen anshe mishmar veanshe maamad ulviyyim midduchanan kach hem yotzin min hammikdash kemi shepposea achar tefilla laachorav kal ze leyira min hammikdash

Lo yakel adam et rosho keneged shaar mizrachi shel azara shehu shaar nikanor mippene shehu mechuvan keneged bet kodesh hakkadashim vechal hannichnas laazara yehallech benachat bemakom shemmuttar lo lehikkanes lesham veyire atzmo shehu omed lifne Adonai kemo shenneemar vehau enay velibbi sham kal hayyamim umhallech beema uvyira urada shenneemar bevet elohim nehallech beragesh

Veasur lechal adam leshev bechal haazara veen yeshiva baazara ella lemalche bet david bilvad shenneemar vayyavo hammelech david vayyeshev lifne Adonai vehassanhedrin shehau yoshvin belishkat haggazit lo hau yoshvin ella bechetzyah shel

Af al pi shehammikdash hayyom charev baaonotenu chayyav adam bemorao kemo shehaya noheg bo bevinyano lo yikkanes ella lemakom shemmuttar lehikkanes lesham velo yeshev baazara velo yakel rosho keneged shaar hammizrach shenneemar et shabbetotay tishmoru umikdashi tirau ma shemirat shabbat leolam af mora mikdash leolam sheaf al pi shecharev bikdushshato omed
Bizman shehammikdash banuy asur lo leadam lehakel et rosho min hatztzofim shehu chutz lirushalayim velifnim vehu sheyyihye roe et hammikdash velo yihye gader mafsik beno uven hammikdash

Asur leadam leolam sheyyippane o sheyyishan ben mizrach lammaarav veen tzarich lomar sheen kovin bet hakkisse ben mizrach lammaarav bechal makom mippene shehahechal bemaarav lefichach lo yippane lemaarav velo lemizrach mippene shehu keneged hammaarav ella ben tzafon ledarom nifnim vishenim vechal hammetil mayim min hatztzofim velifnim lo yeshev ufanav kelappe hakkodesh ella letzafon o ledarom o yesallek hakkodesh latztzedadin

Veasur leadam sheyyaase bayit tavnit hechal achsadra tavnit ulam chatzer keneged haazara shulchan betzurat shulchan umnora betzurat menora aval ose hu menora shel chamishsha kanim o shel shemona kanim o menora sheenah shel mattechet af al pi sheyyesh lah shiva kanim

Shelosha machanot hau bammidbar machane yisrael vehu arba machanot umachane leviyya shenneemar bah vesaviv lammishkan yachanu umachane shechina vehu mippetach chatzar ohel moed velifnim uchnegdan ledorot mippetach yerushalayim ad har habbayit kemachane yisrael umippetach har habbayit ad petach haazara shehu shaar nikanor kemachane leviyya umippetach haazara velifnim machane shechina vehachel veezrat hannashim maala yetera bevet olamim
Kal eretz yisrael mekuddeshet mikkal haaratzot uma hi kedushshatah shemmeviin mimmenna haomer ushte hallechem vehabbikkurim ma sheen meviin ken mishshear aratzot

Eser kedushshot hen beeretz yisrael vezo lemala mizzo ayarot hammukkafot choma mekuddashot mishshear haaretz shemmeshallechin mittochan et hamtzoraim veen kovrin betochan met ad sheyyirtzu shiva tove hair o kal anshe hair veim yatza hammet chutz lair en machazirin oto letochah af al pi sheratzu kullan lehachziro ratzu bene hair lehotzi hakkever min hammedina mefannin oto vechal hakkevarot mefannin chutz mikkever navi o melech kever shehikkifattu hair ben mearba ruchotav ben mishshete ruchot zo keneged zo im hayeta beno uven hair yeter mechamishshim amma lechan vachamishshim lechan en mefannin oto ad sheyyirtzu kullan pachot mikkan mefannin oto

Yerushalayim mekuddeshet mishshear haayarot hammukkafot choma sheochlin kadashim kallim umaaser sheni lefanim mechomatah veellu devarim shenneemru birushalayim en melinin bah et hammet veen maavirin betochah atzmot adam veen maskirin betochah battim veen notnin betochah makom leger toshav veen mekayemin bah kivrot chutz mikkivre bet david vekever chulda shehau bah mimot neviim harishonim veen notin bah gannot ufardesim veenah nizraat veenah nechereshet shemma tisrach veen mekayemin bah ilanot chutz migginnat veradim shehayeta sham mimot neviim harishonim veen mekayemin bah ashpa mippene hashsheratzim veen motziin hemenna zizin ugzuzteraot lirshut harabbim mippene ohel hattuma veen osin bah kivshonot mippene heashan veen megaddelin bah tarnegolot mippene hakkadashim vechen lo yegaddelu hakkohanim tarnegolim bechal eretz yisrael mippene hattahorot veen habbayit nechlat bah veeno mittamme bingaim veenah naaset ir hanniddachat veenah mevia egla arufa lefi shello nitchalleka lishvatim
Har habbayit mekuddash mimmenna sheen zavin vezavot niddot veoldot nichnasin lesham umuttar lehachnis hammet atzmo lehar habbayit veen tzarich lomar teme met shehu nichnas lesham
Hachel mekuddash mimmennu sheen akkum utme met uvoel nidda nichnasim lesham

Ezrat hannashim mekuddeshet min hachel sheen tevul yom nichnas lesham veissur ze middivrehem aval min hattora muttar litvul yom lehikkanes lemachane leviyya utme met shennichnas leezrat hannashim eno chayyav chattat
Ezrat yisrael mekuddeshet meezrat nashim sheen mechussar kippurim nichnas lesham vetame shennichnas lesham chayyav karet
Ezrat hakkohanim mekuddeshet mimmenna sheen yisrael nichnasin lesham ella bishat tzarchehem lismicha ulchappara velishchita velitnufa
Ben haulam velammizbeach mekuddash mimmenna sheen baale mumin ufrue rosh ukrue begadim nichnasin lesham
Hahechal mekuddash mibben haulam velammizbeach sheen nichnas lesham ella rechutz yadayim veraglayim
Bet kodesh hakkadashim mekuddash mimmennu sheen nichnas lesham ella kohen gadol beom hakkippurim bishat haavoda

Makom shehaya baaliyya mechuvan al kodesh hakkadashim en nichnasin lo ella paam achat beshavua leda ma hu tzarich lechazzek bidko beshaa shennichnasin habbannaim livnot ultakken bahechal o lehotzi mishsham et hattuma mitzva sheyyihu hannichnasin kohanim temimim lo matzu temimim yikkansu baale mumin veim en sham kohanim yikkansu leviyyim lo matzu leviyyim yikkansu yisrael mitzva bithorim lo matzu tehorim yikkansu temeim tame uvaal mum yikkanes baal mum veal yikkanes tame shehattuma dechuya betzibbur vechal hannichnasin lahechal letakken yikkansu betevot im en sham tevot o i efshar lahem sheyyaasu betevot yikkansu derech petachim
Mishneh Torah, The Chosen Temple 8: Shemirat hammikdash mitzvat ase veaf al pi sheen sham pachad meoyevim velo millistim sheen shemirato ella kavod lo eno dome palterin sheyyesh alav shomrin lefalterin sheen alav shomrin

Ushmira zo mitzvatah kal hallayela vehashshomrim hem hakkohanim vehalviyyim shenneemar veatta uvanecha ittach lifne ohel haedut kelomar attem tihu shomrim lo vahare neemar veshamru et mishmeret ohel moed veneemar vehachonim kedma lifne ohel moed mizracha moshe veaharon uvanav shomre mishmeret hakkodesh
Veim bittelu shemira avru belo taase shenneemar veshamru et mishmeret hakkodesh ulshon shemira azhara hi ha lamadta sheshshemirato mitzvat ase uvittul shemirato mitzvat lo taase
Mitzvat shemirato sheyyihu hakkohanim shomrim mibbifnim vehalviyyim mibbachutz vechd eda shomrin oto bechal layela tamid bechd makom hakkohanim bishlosha mekomot vehalviyyim bech makom

Vehechan hau shomrim kohanim hau shomrim bevet avtinas uvvet hannitzotz uvvet hammoked bet avtinas uvet hannitzotz hau aliyyot benuot betzad shaare haazara veharovin hau shomrim sham bet hammoked kippa uvayit gadol haya mukkaf revadin shel even vezikne bet av shel oto hayyom hau yeshenim sham umaftechot haazara beyadam

Lo hau hakkohanim hashshomrim yeshenim bevigde kehunna ella mekappelin otan umannichin otan keneged rashehen velovshin bigde atzman vishenim al haaretz kederech kal shomre chatzrot hammelachim shello yishnu al hammittot

Era keri laechad mehen holech bammesibba shettachat hakkarka shehammechillot happetuchot lehar habbayit lo nitkaddeshu vetovel vechozer veoshev etzel echav hakkohanim ad shenniftachin hashshearim babboker yotze veholech lo

Dishun hammizbeach happenimi vedishun hammenora lo nehenin velo moalin

Kal behemat kadshe kadashim shehi baalat mum ben shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshah ben shekkadam hekdeshah lemum kavua vaafillu hayeta mechussar zeman moalin bahem mishshehukdeshu ad sheyyippadu aval torin shello higgia zemannan uvne yona sheavar zemannan vehen kadshe mizbeach af al pi sheasur lehanot bahen hannehene lo maal hoil veenan reuyin lefidon hare hem kachattaot hammetot lefichach en moalin bahen
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 3: Kadshe mizbeach shemmetu yatzu mide meila devar tora aval moalin bahen middivre sofrim vechen im nifselu bidvarim sheyyippaslu bahen hakkarbanot shekkevar bearnum moalin bahen middivre sofrim bamme devarim amurim beshello haya lahen sheat hetter laachilat kohanim aval im haya lekadshe kadashim hanneechalim sheat hetter veachar kach nifselu veneesru baachila hoil vehutteru shaa achat en moalin beoto davar shehaya rauy laachila kemo shebbearnu ketzad kadshe kadashim shennifselu kodem sheyyaggia haddam lammizbeach kehilchatan kegon sheshshechatan baddarom af al pi shekkibbel batztzafon o sheshshechatan batztzafon vekibbel baddarom o sheshshachat bayyom vezarak ballayela o sheshshachat ballayela vezarak bayyom o sheasaan bemachshevet hazzeman o bemachshevet hammakom o shekkibbelu happesulin et daman af al pi shezzerakuhu kesherim o shezzerakuhu pesulin af al pi shekkibbeluhu kesherim o sheyyatza haddam vehabbasar kullo kodem zerikat haddam o shellan haddam bechal ellu moalin bechullan leolam shehare lo haya lahen sheat hetter aval im higgia haddam lammizbeach kemitzvato veachar kach lan habbasar o haemurin o shennitma habbasar o haemurin o sheyyatza habbasar o haemurin lachutz o sheyyatza miktzat habbasar kodem zerikat damim bechal ellu vechayyotze bahen en moalin bishar besaran shehare haya lo sheat hetter laachila kemo shebbearnu

Kibbelu happesulin et haddam uzrakuhu vechazru hakkesherim laavoda vekibbelu shear dam hannefesh uzrakuhu en moalin bivsaran sheen happesulin osin shear dam hannefesh sheyarim chutz min hattame hoil verauy laavodat tzibbur ose shear dam sheyarim

Ketzad kibbel hattame vezarak af al pi shechazar hakkasher vekibbel shear dam hannefesh uzrako hare ellu lo hayeta lahen sheat hetter umoalin bechullan shezze haddam sheyarim hu veen zerikat hashsheyarim moelet kevar bearnu sheen bekadashim kallim meila leolam chutz meemurehen achar zerikat haddam vehu shettihye zerika hammoelet aval kadashim kallim shennitpaggelu af al pi shennizrak haddam en moalin beemurehen vechen im yatza haddam af al pi shehechziru vezarku en moalin beemurehen
Kal chattaot hammetot kegon velad chattat utmuratah vechayyotze bahen asur lehanot bahen veim nehena lo maal
Vechal chattat shettire ad sheyyippol bah mum moalin bah ad shettippade

Hammafrish chattato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha veachar kach nimtzet harishona vahare shettehen omdot veshachat shettehen keachat vezarak dam achat mehen en moalin lo bivsar zo shennizrak damah velo bivsar chavertah veaf al pi sheeno rauy laachila hoil veim ratza mizze zorek veim ratza mizze zorek aval im shachat zo achar zo en damah moil livsar chavertah vaafillu leachar zerika shehare lo hayeta lah shaa haruya lehattir besarah

Kal chattat of o olat of shennifsela beshinnuy asiyyatah o beshinnuy mekom asiyyatah moalin bah chutz meolat haof shennimlak lematta kimlikat chattat lesham chattat sheaf al pi shello alta labbealim leshem chova en moalin bah hoil veshinna shemah umkom asiyyatah veshinna maaseha leshem davar sheen bo meila
Mincha shennitpaggela o shennaaset bemachshevet hammakom vechen shette hallechem velechem happanim shennitpaggelu o shennifselu bemachshevet hammakom moalin bahen shehare lo hayeta lahen sheat hetter

Vechen kometz sheyyatza lachutz o lan vechazar vehiktiro moalin bashsheyarim shehare lo haya sham sheat hetter aval im nitma hakkometz vehiktiro en moalin bashsheyarim shehatztzitz meratztze al hattame veeno meratztze lo al hallan velo al hayyotze yatzu hashsheyarim o nitmeu veachar kach hiktir hakkometz af al pi shehen asurin baachila en moalin bahen shehare karav hakkometz kemitzvato

Hannehene mikkadshe kadashim kullam lifne zerikat damim o meemure kadashim kallim leachar zerika o shennehene min haola kullah o min hakkometz vehallevona uminchat kohanim vehachavitin yippol ma shennehena lindava maal bekarbenot hatztzibbur yippol ma shennehena lallishka
Nehena kodem zerika mibbesar kadshe kadashim shennitma o shennehena meemure kadashim kallim af al pi sheheelan lerosh hammizbeach hare ze patur

Kadshe hammizbeach chalavan uvetzehen asur lehanot mehen vehannehene lo maal lefichach velad hakkadashim vechen velad hammaaser lo yinak meimmo ella mibbehema acheret chullin veyesh leadam lehitnaddev velomar chalev behema zo hachullin yihye hekdesh levaldot hakkadashim sheyyinkuhu kede shello yamutu
Hikdish behema veof lammizbeach kedushshat damim kegon sheamar deme behema zo linsachim udme ben yona ze lishlamim hare hen kekadshe bedek habbayit umoalin bachalavan uvvetzehen kemo sheyyitbaer
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 4: Hammafrish maot lechattato leolato ulaashamo ultorin uvne yona moalin bahen mishshaa shehifrish hifrish lishlamim en moalin bahem
Hikdish evar echad ledamav lammizbeach hare ze safek im pashta kedushsha bechullan o lo pashta lefichach tikkarev velo yippade veim nifda en moalin befidono

Hammafrish maot linziruto asur lehanot bahen veim nehena lo maal mippene shehen reuyin lavo kullam shelamim veen bishlamim meila ella beemurehen achar zerikat damim met yippelu lindava hau meforashim deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach velo nehenin velo moalin deme ola yaviu ola umoalin bahen amar ellu lechattati vehashshear linziruti im nehena bechal hashshear maal nehena bemiktzato lo maal vechen im amar ellu leolati vehashshear linziruti venehena bechullan maal nehena bemiktzatan lo maal sheen bidme shelamim meila hifrish maot veamar ellu leolati veellu lechattati veellu lishlamim venitarvu moalin bechullan umoalin bemiktzatan vechetzad yaase yikkach shalosh behemot umchallel deme chattat bechal makom shehu al hachattat udme ola al haola udme shelamim al shelamim
Echad mimmechuyeve kinin shehifrish maot veamar ellu lechovati moalin bechullan umoalin bemiktzatan veim met yippelu lindava kemo shebbearnu binzirut umoalin bahen

Hammafrish chattat al achilat chelev veheviah al achilat dam hare ze lo kipper lefichach lo maal hifrish maot lechattat chelev vekanah bahen chattat dam beshogeg kipper lefichach maal bemezid lo kipper lefichach lo maal

Hammafrish shette selaim leasham velakach bahen shene elim lechullin hoil vekanah chullin bidme asham maal vechayyav leshallem asara dinarim shehen shette selaim vechomesh veyavi bahen asham veyavi karban asham al meilato lefichach im haya echad mishshene haelim shekkana yafe shette selaim vehashsheni yafe asara dinarin yavi hashshave asara asham tachat hammeila im hachomesh veyavi hashshave shette selaim asham al meilato lakach echad leasham veechad lechullin im haya shel asham yafe shette selaim yavi oto laashamo harishon vechen im haya ze hachullin yafe shettayim yavi oto asham meilato shehare maal besela achat middeme haasham vishallem chamishsha dinarim veyippelu lindava

Hannehene middeme chattat ad shello karva chattato yosif chomesh al ma shennehena veyavi bedamav chattato veyavi karban asham al meilato vechen im nehena middeme asham ad shello karav ashamo yosif chomesh veyavi bedamav ashamo veyavi asham acher limilato shekkarbenot hammizbeach meilatan lekarbenot hammizbeach vekadshe bedek habbayit meilatan levedek habbayit noda lo shemmaal veachar kach karva chattato vaadayin lo hifrish meilato o shehifrishah velo kelalah bidme chattato yolich hammeila vechumshah leyam hammelach noda lo shemmaal achar shekkarva chattato yippelu meot hammeila vechumshah lindava sheen mafrishin battechilla leibbud uven kach uven kach yavi asham meilato uvasham ben shennoda lo shemmaal kodem shekkarav ashamo o achar shekkarav tippol meilato vechumshah lindava mippene shehu kemotar asham veyavi asham meilato

Hammocher olato ushlamav lo asa kelum vedin tora sheyyachzeru hammaot chullin kemo shehau vekansu oto chachamim sheyyippelu hammaot lindava afillu hayeta habbehema shava arbaa umcharah bachamishsha hachamishsha kullan yippelu lindava veen kan meila lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim

Yesh meila bindarim ketzad haomer kikkar zo alay karban o hekdesh vaachalah maal af al pi shehi mutteret laacherim lefichach en lah pidon shehare enah kodesh ella laze bilvad amar kikkar zo kodesh o karban vaachalah ben hu ben acher maal lefichach yesh lah pidon hayeta lefanav kikkar shel hefker veamar kikkar zo hekdesh netalah al menat leachlah maal lefi kullah al menat lehorishah maal lefi tovat hanaya shebbah

Haomer lachavero kikkari alecha hekdesh vechazar untanah lo hamkabbel mattana zo maal lichsheyyotzi shehare hannoten enah asura alav vechen kal kayyotze baze mishshear hakkonamot yesh bahen meila lanneesar bahen vechal devarim hanneesarin alav minneder kaze mitztarfin veim nehena mikkullam bishve peruta maal

Haomer hannetiot haellu karban im enan niktzatzot hayyom vetallit ze karban im lo tissaref hayyom veavar hayyom velo niktzetzu velo nisrefa hattallit hare hem hekdesh veyippadu kishar hahekdeshot veachar kach yehane bahen aval im amar hare hannetiot haellu karban ad sheyyikkatztzu eno yachol lifdotan shebbechal et sheyyippadu yachzeru hekdesh ad sheyyikkatztzu vechevan shenniktzetzu enan tzerichin pidon ella nehenin bahen miyyad bamme devarim amurim besheppedaan hammakdish aval im pedaan acher hare ellu yotzin lechullin af al pi sheadayin lo niktzetzu veyihu muttarin af lammakdish
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 5: Echad hammakdish levedek habbayit davar harauy lechazzek habbedek kegon even o kora o hammakdish levedek habbayit davar harauy lammizbeach kegon kevasim vetorim o hammakdish lammizbeach davar harauy levedek habbayit kegon even vekora o hammakdish laze velaze devarim sheenan reuyin lo laze velo laze kegon hammakdish tarnegolin vechometz vetzir o karka afillu hikdish ashpa melea zevel o afar o efer moalin bechullan mishshaa shehukdeshu ad sheyyippadu devarim haruyim lehippadot
Kal kadshe bedek habbayit im devarim shemmoalin bahen mikkadshe mizbeach mitztarfin ze im ze limila veim nehena bishve peruta mikkullam maal
Achal veheechil et chavero o nehena umhanne chavero achilato vahanayat chavero o achilat chavero vahanayato kullan mitztarfin lammeila veim naasa min hakkol hanaya bifruta maal
Hammeila mitztarefet lizman merubbe ketzad nehena hayyom min hahekdesh venehena leachar kamma shanim behelem echad hare ellu mitztarfin lifruta umaal

En meila ella betalush min hakkarka aval hannehene bakkarka atzmah o bamchubbar lah lo maal afillu pagam ketzad hachoresh sede hekdesh o hazzorea bah patur natal meavakah venehena bah ufgamah maal haddash bisde hekdesh maal sheheavak shellah moil lassade vahare nehena baavak ufagam hassade vechen im charash sede hekdesh kede lehaalot avak leesev shennatan bah venatal haesev maal haddar bimarat hekdesh o betzel ilan o shovach shel hekdesh af al pi shennehena lo maal vechen hammakdish bayit banuy haddar bo lo maal aval hammakdish etzim vaavanim uvana bahen bayit haddar sham maal kemo sheyyitbaer

Giddule hekdesh moalin bahen ketzad hikdish sade vehotzia asavim ilan veasa perot moalin bahen aval hammakdish et habbor rekan veachar kach nitmalle mayim hikdish ashpa veachar kach nitmallet zevel shovach venitmalle yonim hoil veenan giddule hekdesh en moalin bahen vechen hazzevel vehapperesh shebbachatzar hekdesh lo nehenin velo moalin uma yaasu bahen yimmachru veyippelu demehen lallishka mayan shehu yotze mittoch sede hekdesh asur lehanot bemayim sheyyotzin mimmennu betoch hassade vehannehene lo maal yatzu hammayim chutz lassade muttar lehanot bahen arava haggedela bisde hekdesh lo nehenin velo moalin ilan shel hedot hassamuch lisde hekdesh vesharashav yotzim betoch hassade im beno leven hassade shel hekdesh ad shesh esre amma hare otan hashsharashin shebbetoch hassade asurin vehannehene mehen lo maal haya hailan rachok yeter al shesh esre hannehene bahen maal ilan shel hekdesh hassamuch lisde hedot vesharashav yotzin betoch hassade im haya betoch shesh esre amma moalin bahen haya rachok yeter al shesh esre amma otan hashsharashin shebbetoch hassede hedot lo nehenin velo moalin
Ken shebbarosh hailan shel hekdesh shebbana otan haof meetzim vaasavim vechayyotze bahen kal hakken im habbetzim shebbo im haefrochim hatztzerichin leimman en nehenin bahen vehannehene lo maal
Hammakdish et hayyaar moalin bechullo ben bailanot ben bechal ken shebberosh hailanot o shebbenehen

Gizbarim sheshshafu atze hekdesh vekatztzu otan moalin beotan haetzim hakketannim shechatchu meet shekkatztzu aval en moalin lo bashshippuy velo bannesoret velo banneviyya shel etzim vehu hagguf hakkashe heagol shebbetoch haetz haddome leyabbelet shello yitzlach limlacha
Hammakdish avdo en moalin bo velo bisaro af al pi shehu omed lehiggazez mippene shehu mechubbar lo vechal zeman shehu mechubbar holech umashbiach
Hazzorea perot hekdesh pode otan bishat ziran veaf al pi shello pada hare haggiddulin chullin veen moalin bahen veen meshallemin mehen keren vechomesh vechayyavin bechalla

Shemarim shel hekdesh shennatan alehem mayim rishon vesheni ushlishi asur lehanot bo vehannehene lo maal revii muttar bamme devarim amurim bekadshe bedek habbayit aval kadshe mizbeach af mervii veelach leolam asur
Hammakdish tarnegolet lammizbeach moalin bah uvvetzatah hikdish chamor lammizbeach moalin bah uvachalavah hikdish torim levedek habbayit moalin bahen uvvetzatan kemo shebbearnu
Katnot kehunna shebbalu moalin bahen kishar kadashim vehachadashim hoil venittenu lehanot bahen en moalin bahen
Kadshe akkum im levedek habbayit hikdishu moalin bahen veim kadshe mizbeach hen en bahen meila min hattora shenneemar bakkarbanot dabber el bene yisrael aval asur lehanot bahen middivre sofrim
Kol umare vereach shel hekdesh lo nehenin velo moalin bamme devarim amurim kesheheriach bakketoret achar shealta hattimmoret aval im heriach bakketoret keshettaale timratah maal
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 6: Yesh devarim shehaadam nehene bahen velo yippagmu kegon hammishtammesh bichli zahav tahor veyesh devarim sheyyippagmu kegon begadim uchle kesef unchoshet uvarzel vechayyotze bahen vehannehene bishve peruta min hahekdesh sheeno mechubbar bakkarka im nehene bedavar sheen bo pegam kegon shennishtammesh bichli zahav shel hekdesh maal nehene bedavar shennifgam kegon shellavash bigde hekdesh o baka bekordom lo maal ad sheyyifgom bahekdesh bishve peruta beoto davar atzmo shennehena bo veyitkaven lehanot veyifgom veyehane keachat nehena bechachatzi peruta ufagam bechachatzi peruta o shennehena bishve peruta ufagam bishve peruta bedavar acher velo nehena bema sheppagam velo pagam bema shennehena hare ze lo maal ad sheyyehane bishve peruta veyifgom beotah hanaya bishve peruta baddavar atzmo ketzad hare shehittir matlit mibbeged hekdesh utfarah bevigdo ulvashah venehena bah bishve peruta vehifsid babbeged shehittirah mimmenna bishve peruta velo hifsid bammatlit kelum hare ze lo maal mippene shennehena bedavar echad ufagam bedavar acher uchvar bearnu shehannehene umhanne chavero mitztaref vaafillu lizman merubbe

Kadshe kadashim hattemimim shettalash mitztzimran kevan shennehena bifruta maal af al pi shello pagam shehare hen domim lechos shel zahav sheeno nifgam sheen telishat hatztzemer poselet otan millikkarev aval im nafal bahen mum hoil velimchira omdim vehaggizza pogemet demehen lo maal ad sheyyehane veyifgom bifruta talash mehen achar shemmetu kevan shennehena maal sheen pegam lemeta umila zo middivrehem kemo shebbearnu

Hammoel bekadshe bedek habbayit kevan shemmaal bishgaga nitchallel hekdesh veze shennehena acharav patur maal bezadon hoil veeno chayyav bekarban meila lo nitchallel hekdesh ella hare hu bahavayato veim ba acher venehena bo bishgaga maal bamme devarim amurim keshemmaal bakkodesh vehotzio betorat chullin vehiknahu leacher aval im nehena bo ufgamo velo hikna leacher yesh bo moel achar moel

Veen moel achar moel bemukdashim ella bivhema uchle tashmish bilvad ketzad baka bekordom shel hekdesh venehena bifruta ufagam uva chavero uvaka bo venehena ufagam kullam maalu natal hakkordom untano lachavero hu maal aval chavero lo maal shata bechos shel zahav venehena bifruta uva chavero veshata venehena uva chavero veshata venehena kullam maalu natal hakkos untano lachavero mattana o mecharo hu maal vachavero lo maal rachav al gabbe hachamor venehena bifruta ufagam uva chavero verachav alav venehena ufagam uva chavero verachav alav venehena ufagam kullam maalu natan hachamor lachavero mattana o mecharo o hiskiro hu maal vachavero lo maal vechen hammashil kardom shel hekdesh hu maal lefi tovat hanaa shebbo vachavero muttar livkoa bo lechattechilla vehu haddin livhema

Behemat kadshe mizbeach enah ken ella yesh bah moel achar moel ad kamma peamim ketzad talash min hachattat uva chavero vetalash uva chavero vetalash kullan maalu vechen im netanah lachavero vachavero lachavero kullan maalu veyerae li sheddin hammenachot vehaofot vehannesachim uchle sharet kedin habbehema shekkullan kedushshat hagguf hen
Behemat kadshe hakkadashim shennafal bah mum hoil vehi omedet lefidon hare hu kekadshe bedek habbayit shehi kedushshat damim veim netanah lachavero vachavero lachavero harishon bilvad maal

Amru chachamim shehannotel even o kora shel hekdesh untanah lachavero shenehem maalu veim netanah leze haggizbar shehayeta tachat yado hu maal vehaggizbar lo maal veyerae li sheen ellu haddevarim amurim ella bemoel bezadon shehare lo nitchallel hekdesh hannotel peruta shel hekdesh al daat shehi shello lo maal ad sheyyotzi otah bachafatzav o ad sheyyitten otah bemattana netanah lachavero hu maal vachavero lo maal sheen moel achar moel bishar hekdeshot kemo shebbearnu vechal kayyotze baze

Natal even o kora shel hekdesh lo maal shehare lo nehena adayin bana otah betoch beto maal netanah al gabbe challon shebbattikra velo chibberah lo maal ad sheyyadur tachteha bishve peruta sheen zo hanaya hannikkeret

Natal peruta shel hekdesh untanah levallan af al pi shello rachatz maal shehare nehena bihoto rochetz bechal et sheyyirtze vechen im netanah leechad mibbaale ummanuyyot maal af al pi sheadayin lo asu melachto
Kana bah chefetz velo mashach im min haakkum maal veim min yisrael lo maal

Hammotzi meot hekdesh bitzrachav al daat shehen chullin af al pi shello hotzian bedivre chol maal ketzad hammevi chattato vaashamo ufischo min hahekdesh vechen mechussar kappara shehevi kapparato min hahekdesh maal vechullam en moalin ad sheyyizzarek haddam lefichach hammevi menachot unsachim velechem toda min hahekdesh af al pi sheavar avera lo maal sheen kan zerikat dam lechapper alav
Natan shiklo mimmeot hekdesh kesheyyitremu hatteruma veyiknu mimmenna afillu behema achat veyizzarek damah yimol hashshokel shehare chalku beotah habbehema shennizrak damah

Hammafrish shiklo vehotzio bishar tzerachav ben hu ben chavero maal netano lachavero leshaklo al yado halach ushkalo al yede atzmo im kevar nitrema hatteruma maal hashshokel shehattorem torem al heatid lehiggavot kemo shebbearnu bishkalim uchillu higgia shekel ze lallishka ulfichach maal veim adayin lo nitrema teruma lo maal ulolam en moalin bishyare hallishka
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 7: Mi sheshshagag velakach hekdesh o meot hekdesh untano leshaliach lehotzio betorat chullin im asa hashshaliach shelichuto hamshalleach hu shemmaal veim lo asa shelichuto ella asa hashshaliach middaat atzmo hashshaliach hu shemmaal ketzad baal habbayit sheamar lishlucho ten li meoto basar laorchin halach venatan lahen kikkar o sheamar lo ten lahen kikkar venatan lahen basar amar lishlucho have li min hachallon vehevi lo min hammigdal o sheamar lo have min hammigdal vehevi lo min hachallon hashshaliach maal vechen kal kayyotze baze halach hashshaliach vehevi min hachallon kemo sheamar lo af al pi sheamar hashsholeach lo haya belibbi sheyyavi ella min hammigdal baal habbayit maal shehare asa shelichut maamaro udvarim shebballev enan devarim vaafillu haya hashshaliach cheresh o shote o katan sheen lahen shelichut im asa kemaamaro baal habbayit maal veim lo asa shelichuto baal habbayit patur amar lishlucho ten laorchin chaticha chaticha shel basar halach hashshaliach veamar lahen tolu shettayim shettayim baal habbayit maal shehare naasa devaro vehashshaliach patur mippene shehu mosif al shelichut baal habbayit velo akar hashshelichut aval im amar lahem hashshaliach tolu shettayim shettayim middati shenehen maalu natlu haorchim shalosh shalosh af haorchin maalu mippene shekkal echad mehen asa shelichut chavero vehosif middato nimtza chavero chayyav lefi shennaasu devarav velo neekra hashshelichut vehu chayyav al ze shehosif middato

Bamme devarim amurim keshehau hachatichot mikkadshe bedek habbayit aval im hau besar ola vechayyotze bo lo maal ella haochel bilvad shehare hu chayyav beissur acher yeter al hammeila uvchal hattora kullah en shaliach lidvar avera ella bimila levaddah shello yitarev immah issur acher

Hannoten perutat hekdesh lishlucho veamar lo have li bechetzyah nerot uvchetzyah petilot halach vehevi lo bechullah nerot o bechullah petilot o sheamar lo have li bechullah nerot o bechullah petilot halach vehevi bechetzyah nerot uvchetzyah petilot shenehem peturim baal habbayit lo maal shehare lo naasa shelichuto bifruta vehashshaliach lo maal shehare lo akar shelichuto bifruta aval im amar lo have li bechetzyah nerot mimmakom peloni uvchetzyah petilot mimmakom peloni vehalach vehevi nerot mimmekom petilot uftilot mimmekom nerot hashshaliach maal

Natan lo shette perutot veamar lo have li etrog vehalach vehevi lo bifruta etrog uvifruta rimmon hashshaliach maal uvaal habbayit patur shehare shelacho liknot lo etrog sheshshave shette perutot lefichach im haya haetrog shehevi lo bifruta achat shave shette perutot shenehem maalu

Hashsholeach peruta beyad shelucho liknot lo bah chefetz venizkar baal habbayit shehi hekdesh kodem shettaggia leyad hachenvani hashshaliach maal shehu shogeg uvaal habbayit kevar nizkar veen hammezid chayyav bekarban meila kemo shebbearnu nizkar af hashshaliach veyada shehi hekdesh kodem shettaggia lachenvani shenehem peturim mikkarban meila vehachenvani chayyav kesheyyotzi otah peruta shennitarva bimotav shehare hu shogeg hodiu lechenvani shepperuta shennatnu lo hekdesh shelashtan peturin venitpas hammikkach lahekdesh

Vechetzad yaase kede lehatztzil hachenvani min hachet ad sheyyihye muttar lehishtammesh bechal hammaot notel peruta shel chullin o keli kal shehu veomer peruta shel hekdesh bechal makom shehi mechullelet al ze vetease otah peruta o hakkeli hekdesh veyuttar hachenvani lehishtammesh bechal hammaot vechen peruta shel hekdesh shennitarva bechal hakkis o sheamar peruta bechis ze hekdesh mechallel otah veachar kach yishtammesh bakkis veim hotzi velo chillel lo maal ad sheyyotzi et kal hakkis

Amar kis mikkisay hekdesh veshor mishshevaray hekdesh moalin bechullan umoalin bemiktzatan ketzad ose mevi et haggadol shebbahem veomer im hekdesh hu hare hu hekdesh veim lav hahekdesh bechal makom shehu mechullal al ze vihanne bakkatan
Hammoel befachot mishsheve peruta ben bezadon ben bishgaga meshallem et hakkeren veeno chayyav chomesh velo karban veyerae li sheeno loke al pachot mishsheve peruta im haya mezid
Hammafkid maot etzel baal habbayit venishtammesh bahen vehotzi baal habbayit maal shehare en lo reshut lehishtammesh bahen uvaal happikkadon lo hirshahu

Hifkidan etzel shulchani o chenvani velo hau chatumin velo keshurin kesher meshunne hoil veyesh lo reshut min haddin lehishtammesh bahen im hotziu shenehen peturin baal happikkadon patur shehare lo amar lo hishtammesh bahen vehachenvani patur mippene sheenan keshurin kesher meshunne velo chatumin uchillu hishtammesh birshut
Haishsha shehichnisa maot shel hekdesh levalah o shehikdish morishah umet venaflu lah hekdeshot birushsha lichsheyyotzi habbaal hammaot bachafatzav yimol
Mishneh Torah, Trespass 8: Happoalim shehen osin behekdesh af al pi sheppasku immahen mezonot lo yochlu miggerogarot shel hekdesh veim achlu maalu ella hahekdesh noten lahem deme mezonot
Haddash karshine hekdesh hare ze chosem et happara shenneemar lo tachsom shor bedisho dayish harauy lo

En mechallelin et hahekdesh al hammelacha ella al hammaot ketzad umman sheasa melacha behekdesh bemane en notnin lo behemat hekdesh o tallit hekdesh bischaro ad shemmechallelin otan al hammaot veachar sheyyeasu chullin notnin otan laumman bischaro im ratzu vechozrin velokchin mimmennu behema mitterumat hallishka

Keshebbonin bammikdash en lokchin etzim vaavanim min hahekdesh velo bonin et habbinyan al daat shehu kodesh ella bonin hakkol min hachol gezera shemma yehane betzel habbinyan o yishshaen al even o kora bishat melacha veachar sheyyushlam habbinyan mechallelin meot hahekdesh al habbinyan veim tzarchu haggizbarin leetzim lakkodesh leoto hayyom bilvad lokchin otan mimmeot hahekdesh shehare enan mitacharin yamim kede shennachush lahen shemma yishshaen adam alehen veyimol

Keshepposkin im haummanin livnot bammikdash uvaazarot poskin immahen kach vechach amma bechach vechach sela beamma bat esrim etzba uchshemmoshchin lahen ma shebbanu moshchin umchashshevin lahen beamma gedola bat esrim vearba etzbaot kede shello yavou lide meila mippene sheen medakdekin bimshicha
Tenay bet din sheyyihu hakkohanim neotin bammelach uvaetzim baachilat karbanot sheochlin bechelkan aval lo yittenu melach hammikdash bechullin shellahen
Melach sheal gabbe haevar moalin bo sheal gabbe hakkevesh vesheal rosh hammizbeach en moalin bo

Rauy laadam lehitbonen bemishpete hattora hakkedosha veleda sof inyanam kefi kocho vedavar shello yimtza lo taam velo yeda lo illa al yehi kal beenav velo yaharos laalot el Adonai pen yifrotz bo velo tehe machashavto bo kemachshavto bishar divre hachol bo ure kamma hechmira tora bimila uma im etzim vaavanim veafar vaefer kevan shennikra shem adon haolam alehem bidvarim bilvad nitkaddeshu vechal hannoheg bahen minhag chol maal bah vaafillu haya shogeg tzarich kappara kal vachomer lemitzot shechakak lanu hakkadosh baruch hu shello yivat haadam bahen mippene shello yeda taman velo yechappe devarim asher lo ken al hashshem velo yachshov bahen machshavto kedivre hachol hare neemar battora ushmartem et kal chukkotay veet kal mishpatay vaasitem otam amru chachamim litten shemira vaasiyya lachukkim kammishpatim vehaasiyya yedua vehi sheyyaase hachukkim vehashshemira sheyyizzaher bahen velo yedamme shehen pechutin min hammishpatim vehammishpatim hen hammitzot shettaman galuy vetovat asiyyatan baolam hazze yedua kegon issur gezel ushfichut damim vechibbud av vaem vehachukkim hen hammitzot sheen taman yadua amru chachamim chukkim chakkoti lecha veen lecha reshut leharher bahen veyitzro shel adam nokfo bahen veummot haolam meshivin alehen kegon issur besar chazir uvasar bechalav veegla arufa ufara adumma vesair hammishtalleach vechamma haya david hammelech mitztaer min hamminim umin haakkum shehau meshivin al hachukkim vechal zeman shehau rodfin oto bitshuvot hashsheker sheorchin lefi kotzer daat haadam haya mosif devekut battora shenneemar taflu alay sheker zedim ani bechal lev etztzor pikkudecha veneemar sham bainyan kal mitzotecha emuna sheker redafuni azreni vechal hakkarbanot kullan mikkelal hachukkim hen amru chachamim shebbishvil avodat hakkarbanot haolam omed shebbaasiyyat hachukkim vehammishpatim zochin hayesharim lechayye haolam habba vehikdima tora tziuuy al hachukkim shenneemar ushmartem et chukkotay veet mishpatay asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem
Mishneh Torah, Vessels of the Sanctuary: Mitzvat ase laasot shemen hammishcha sheyyihye muchan lidvarim shetztzerichin meshicha bo shenneemar veasita oto shemen mishchat kodesh

Vechacha asahu moshe rabbenu bammidbar lakach min hammor vehakkinnamon vehakkidda mikkal echad mishshelashtan chamesh meot shekel beshekel hakkodesh umikkene habboshom chamishshim umatayim vezehu shenneemar battora vekinneman besem machatzito chamishshim umatayim sheshshoklim oto bishte peamim chamishshim umatayim bechal paam veshochek kal echad veechad levaddo veerev hakkol veshara otan bemayim zakkin umtukin ad sheyyetze kal kochan bammayim venatan al hammayim shemen zayit hin vehu log kal log arba reviiyyot uvishshel hakkol al haesh ad sheavdu hammayim venishar hashshemen vehinnicho bichli ledorot

Hammor hu haddam hatztzarur bechayya shebbehoddu hayyadua lakkol shemmitbassemin bah bene adam bechal makom vehakkinnamon hu haetz shebba meiyye hoddu sherecho tov umitgammerim bo bene adam vehakkidda hi hakkosht ukne boshom hem hakkanim haddakkim keteven haadummim habbaim meiyye hoddu verechan tov vehem mimmine habbesamim shennotnin otam harofim betzori

Haose shemen hammishcha kammaase hazze vechammishkal hazze velo hosif velo gara bemezid chayyav karet beshogeg mevi chattat kevua shenneemar asher yirkach kamohu venichrat meammav vehu sheyyaase oto lehimmashach bo aval im asahu lehitlammed o litteno laacherim patur

Hassach mishshemen hammishcha kezayit bemezid chayyav karet uvshogeg mevi chattat kevua shenneemar vaasher yitten mimmennu al zar venichrat meammav veen chayyavin ella al sichat shemen hammishcha sheasa moshe shenneemar mimmennu mizze shenneemar bo shemen mishchat kodesh yihye ze li umeolam lo naasa shemen acher chutz mimma sheasa moshe
Echad hassach et atzmo veechad hassach et acherim shenneemar vaasher yitten mimmennu al zar hassach kelim uvhema veakkum shehem kemotah o shessach metim bo patur shenneemar al besar adam lo yisach
En moshchin mimmennu ledorot ella kohanim gedolim umshuach milchama umalche bet david bilvad afillu kohen ben kohen moshchin oto shenneemar vehakkohen hammashiach tachtav mibbanav vego
Bevayit sheni shello haya sham shemen hammishcha haya kohen gadol mitrabbe bilvishat begadim bilvad shehaya lovesh bigde kehunna gedola

Ketzad moshchin et hakkohen tzak et hashshemen al rosho vesach mimmennu al gabbe enav kemin ki yevanit kaze shenneemar vayyitzok mishshemen hammishcha al rosh aharon vayyimshach oto lekaddesho umalche bet david moshchin otan kemin nezer al rosho velo yimshach bimkomot acherot velo yarbe beshemen

Hannoten mishshemen hammishcha al gabbe melech o kohen gadol shekkevar nimshechu patur shenneemar vaasher yitten mimmennu al zar veen ellu zarim etzlo aval hassach mimmennu afillu lemelech vechohen gadol chayyav shenneemar al besar adam lo yisach kal adam bemashma vechohen gadol shennatal shemen hammishcha merosho vesach bemeav chayyav karet vehu sheyyasuch mimmennu bichzayit

En moshchin et hammelech ella al gabbe hammayan veen moshchin melech ben melech shehammalchut yerushsha lammelech leolam shenneemar hu uvanav bekerev yisrael veim hayeta sham machloket moshchin oto kede lesallek hammachaloket ulhodia lakkol shezzehu melech levaddo kemo shemmashchu shelomo mippene machloket adoniyyahu veoash mippene atalya vihoachaz mippene yehoyakim achiv veze shemmashach elisha leyehu lo beshemen hammishcha meshacho ella beshemen afarsemon vedavar ze masoret beyad hachachamim

Kal kele hammikdash sheasa moshe bammidbar lo nitkaddeshu ella bimshichatan beshemen hammishcha shenneemar vayyimshachem vayekaddesh otam vedavar ze eno noheg ledorot ella hakkelim kullan kevan shennishtammeshu bahen bammikdash bimlachtan nitkaddeshu shenneemar asher yeshartu vam bakkodesh besherut hem mitkaddeshin

Hakkappot vehakkearot shemmekabbelin bahem hammenachot vechen hammizrakot shemmekabbelin bahen haddam ushar kele hashsharet kullan shel kesef veshel zahav hau umuttar laasotan mishshear mine mattachot kemo shebbearnu vechullan mitkaddeshin bimlachtan veim nishberu mattich otam veose otan keli acher veen kedushshatan mistalleket mehen leolam
Kele hakkodesh shennikkevu o shennisdeku en sotmin otan ella mattichin otan veosin otan chadashim
Sakkin shennishmat min hannitztzav o shennifgam en machazirin oto veen mashchizin oto ella gonzin oto betzad hahechal ben hakkodesh vehaulam laddarom veosin acherim sheen aniyyut bimkom ashirut
Shette middot shel yavesh hau bammikdash issaron vachatzi issaron haissaron limnachot vachatzi haissaron lechallek bo minchat kohen gadol shebbechal yom

Vesheva middot shel lach hau sham hin vachatzi hahin ushlishit hahin urviit hahin velog vachatzi log urviit velamma hau chatzi hahin ushlishit hahin urviit hahin limdidat hannesachim shel zevachim velog limdidat shemen hammenachot vachatzi log limdidat shemen lechal ner minnerot hammenora urviit lechallek bah hashshemen lachavitin

Veen lanu davar limdod bo hin velamma haya sham hoil vehaya bammikdash mime moshe shemmadad bo shemen leshemen hammishcha uvachatzi log sheyyihye bammikdash hau moddin mayim leme sota veshemen letoda uvarviit shehayeta sham hau moddin shemen lechem hannazir umayim letahorat metzora velo mippene maasim ellu nitkaddeshu ella mippene hammelachot shel mikdash sheamarnu

Kal hammiddot haellu kodesh umikkele hashsharet ella shemmiddot hallach nimshechu mibbifnim umibbachutz uchle hayyavesh lo nimshechu ella bifnim lefichach berutze middot hallach kodesh uverutze middot hayyavesh

Haktoret naaset bechal shana veshana vaasiyyato mitzvat ase shenneemar veatta kach lecha sammim vego venitparshu battora arbaa missammaneha vehen nataf ushchelet vechelbena ulvona ushar sammaneha halacha lemoshe missinay

Achad asar sammanim neemru lo lemoshe missinay vehem sheosin otan bemishkal mechuvan umosifin immahen belo mishkal melach sedomit vechippat hayyarden veesev echad shemmaale ashan velo hau yodim oto ella anashim yeduim vehu haya halacha beyadam ish mippi ish

Vezehu mishkal achad asar sammaneha nataf ushchelet vechelbena ulvona mikkal echad mishkal shivim mane vehammane mea dinarin umor uktzia veshibbolet nerde vecharkom mikkal echad shishsha asar mane koshte shenem asar mane kinnamon tisha manim killufa shelosha manim mishkal hakkol shelosh meot veshishshim ushmona mane shechukin hakkol hadek mosifin lah rova hakkav melach sedomit vechippat hayyarden umaale ashan kal shehu umaktir mimmenna bechal yom al mizbach hazzahav mane shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha mane keneged yemot hachamma vehashshelosha manim hannisharim shochek otam erev yom hakkippurim dakka min haddakka ad shemmotzi mimmenna male chafnav lehaktir beom hakkippurim vehashshear hu motar hakketoret sheamarnu bishkalim

Nataf haamur battora hu atze hakketaf sheyyotze mehen hatztzori vehashshechelet hi hatztzipporen shennotnin otah bene haadam bemugmarot vehachelbena kemo devash shachor verecho kashe vehu seraf ilanot beare yavan vezehu shemot hassammanim belashon aravi ud belasan veatzfar tiv umia ulchan umuski uktzia vesanbeli alnatorin vezaafran vekosht veud hayyardi vekassar selicha veinbar

Ketzad mefattemin et hakketoret mevi tisha kabbin borit karshina veshaf bah et hatztzipporen veachar kach shore et hatztzipporen beechad veesrim kav shel yen kafrisin o yayin lavan yashan chazak beoter veachar kach shochek kal echad min hassammanim bifne atzmo hadek uchshehu shochek omer hadek hetev hadek hetev kal zeman sheshshochek umarev hakkol
Vechal maaseha bakkodesh betoch haazara umishshel hakkodesh vehamfattem et hakketoret min hachullin o bichli shel chullin pesula
Paamayim bashshana hau machazirin oto lammachteshet bimot hachamma hau mefazzerim otah kede shello titappesh uvimot haggeshamim tzovrin otah kede shello yafug rechah
Natan letochah devash kal shehu pesalah chisser echad missammaneha chayyav mita shehare naaset ketoret zara pittemah meat meat bematkuntah keshera afillu pittem peras beshacharit ufras ben haarbayim

Haose ketoret meachad asar sammanin ellu lefi mishkalot ellu kede lehariach bah af al pi shello heriach chayyav karet al asiyyatah im asa mezid uvshogeg mevi chattat kevua af al pi shello asa hammishkal kullo ella chetzo o shelisho hoil veasa lefi mishkalot ellu chayyav karet shenneemar bematkuntah lo taasu lachem ish asher yaase chamoha lehariach bah venichrat meammav
Asaah lehitlammed bah o lemasrah latztzibbur patur heriach bah velo asaah eno chayyav karet ella dino kedin kal hannehene min hahekdesh lo chiyeva tora karet ella laose bematkuntah lehariach bah

Mizbach hazzahav shebbahechal alav maktirin hakketoret bechal yom veen makrivin alav davar acher veim hiktir alav ketoret acheret sheenah kazo o shehiktir alav ketoret kazo shehitnaddev otah yachid o rabbim o hikriv alav karban o hissich nesech loke shenneemar lo taalu alav ketoret zara veola umincha vego

Beet shemmolichin et haaron mimmakom lemakom en molichin oto lo al habbehema velo al haagalot ella mitzva lenatlo al hakkatef ulfi sheshshachach david unsao al haagala nifratz peretz beuzza ella mitzva lenaso al hakkatef shenneemar ki avodat hakkodesh alehem bakkatef yissau

Keshennosim oto al hakkatef nosin panim keneged panim vaachorehem lachutz ufnehem lefanim venizharim shello yishshamtu habbaddim min hattabbaot shehammesir echad min habbaddim min hattabbaot loke shenneemar betabbeot haaron yihu habbaddim lo yasuru mimmennu

Zera levi kullo muvdal laavodat hammikdash shenneemar baet hahi hivdil Adonai et shevet hallevi umitzvat ase lihot halviyyim penuyin umuchanin laavodat hammikdash ben ratzu ben shello ratzu shenneemar veavad hallevi hu et avodat ohel moed uven levi shekkibbel alav kal mitzot leviyya chutz middavar echad en mekabbelin oto ad sheyekabbel et kullan

Avoda shellahen hi sheyyihu shomrin et hammikdash veyihu mehen shoarin liftoach shaare hammikdash ulhagif daltotav veyihu mehen meshorrin leshorer al hakkarban bechal yom shenneemar vesheret beshem Adonai elohav kechal echav halviyyim e zehu sherut shehu beshem Adonai heve omer zo shira umatay omer shira al kal olot hatztzibbur hachova veal shalme atzeret beet nissuch hayyayin aval olot nedava shemmakrivin hatztzibbur lekayitz lammizbeach vechen hannesachin habbain bifne atzman en omrin alehen shira

Levi haonen muttar laavod ulshorer veen pochatin mishshenem asar leviyyim omdim al hadduchan bechal yom lomar shira al hakkarban umosifin ad leolam veen omrin shira ella bappe belo keli sheikkar hashshira shehi avodatam bappe vaacherim hau omdim sham menaggenin bichle shir mehen leviyyim umehen yisreelim meyuchasin hammassiin lichhunna sheen ole al hadduchan ella meyuchas veen ellu hamshorrim al pi hakkelim olin leminyan hashshenem asar

Uvamme hem menaggenin binvalim vachalilim vechinnorot vachatzotzrot vehatztziltzal veen pochatin mishshene nevalim velo mosifin al shishsha veen pochatin mishshene chalilim velo mosifin al shenem asar veen pochatin mishshete chatzotzrot velo mosifin al esrim umea veen pochatin mittisha kinnorot umosifin ad leolam vehatztziltzal echad bilvad

Bime hammoadot kullam uvrashe chodashim hau hakkohanim tokim bachatzotzrot bishat hakkarban vehalviyyim omrin shira shenneemar uvom simchatchem uvmoadechem uvrashe chadshechem utkatem bachatzotzrot hachatzotzra hayeta naaset min eshet shel kesef asa otah min haggerutaot shel kesef keshera mishshear mine mattachot pesula vehachalilin shehau menaggenin bahen haya abbuv shellahen shel kane mippene shekkolo arev velo haya mechallek ella beabbuv yechidi mippene shehu mechallek yafe

Bishnem asar yom bashshana hechalil makke lifne hammizbeach bishchitat pesach rishon uvishchitat pesach sheni uvom tov harishon shel pesach uvayyom harishon shel atzeret uvishmona yeme hechag vechalil ze doche shabbat mippene shehu chalil shel karban vechalil shel karban avoda hi vedocha et hashshabbat

En ben levi nichnas laazara laavodato ad sheyelammeduhu chamesh shanim techilla shenneemar zot asher lalviyyim mibben chamesh veesrim shana vechatuv echad omer mibben sheloshim shana ha ketzad chamesh lilmod veeno nichnas laavoda ad sheyyagdil veyihye ish shenneemar ish ish al avodato

Ze shenneemar battora balviyyim umibben chamishshim shana yashuv mitztzeva haavoda eno ella bizman shehau nosin hammikdash mimmakom lemakom veeno mitzva noheget ledorot aval ledorot en hallevi nifsal beshanim velo bemumin ella bekol sheyyitkalkel kolo merov hazzikna yippasel laavodato bammikdash veyerae li sheeno nifsal ella lomar shira aval yihye min hashshoarim

Shemuel haroe vedavid hammelech chilleku halviyyim learbaa veesrim mishmarot veoved mishmar bechal shabbat vechal anshe mishmar mechallek otam rosh hammishmar levatte avot vechal yom mime hashshabbat ovdim bo anashim yeduim verashe haavot mechallekin ellu haovdim bayyom shellahen ish ish al avodato vechal halviyyim muzharin al avodat hammizbeach shenneemar ach el kele hakkodesh veel hammizbeach lo yikravu velo yamutu lo yikravu laavoda aval ligga muttarin

Uchshem shehalviyyim muzharin shello laavod avodat hakkohanim kach hakkohanim muzharin shello laavod avodat halviyyim shenneemar gam hem gam attem vechen halviyyim atzmam muzharim shello yaase echad melechet chavero shello yesayyea hamshorer lashshoer velo hashshoer lamshorer shenneemar ish ish al avodato veel massao
Leviyyim sheavdu avodat hakkohanim o shessiyyea levi bimlacha sheenah melachto chayyavin mita bide shamayim shenneemar velo yamutu aval kohen sheavad avodat levi eno bemita ella belo taase

Hakkohannim huvdelu mikkelal halviyyim laavodat hakkarbanot shenneemar vayyibbadel aharon lehakdisho kodesh kadashim umitzvat ase hi lehavdil hakkohanim ulkaddesham velahachinam lekarban shenneemar vekiddashto ki et lechem elohecha hu makriv
Vetzarich kal adam miyyisrael linhog bahen kavod harbe ulhakdim otam lechal davar shebbikdushsha liftoach battora rishon ulvarech rishon velittol mana yafa rishon
