Ketzad hare shecharash vezara vekatzar beshabbat behealem echad chayyav shalosh chattaot vaafillu asa haarbaim chaser achat bishgaga kegon sheshshachach sheellu hammelachot asurot leasot beshabbat chayyav al kal melacha umlacha chattat achat aval im tachan vechatach hayyarak veshaf lashon shel mattechet behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat shehare lo asa ella av echad vetoldotav vechen kal kayyotze baze

Haose melachot harbe meen melacha achat behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat ketzad hare shezzara venata vehivrich vehirkiv vezamar behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat shekkullan av echad hen vechen kal kayyotze baze
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 8: Hachoresh kal shehu chayyav hamnakkesh beikkere hailanot vehamkarsem asavim o hamzared et hassarigim kede leyappot et hakkarka hare ze toledet choresh umishsheyyaase kal shehu chayyav vechen hammashve pene hassade kegon shehishpil hattel veriddedo o mille haggaye chayyav mishshum choresh veshiuro kal shehu vechen kal hammashve gummot shiuro kal shehu

Hazzorea kal shehu chayyav hazzomer et hailan kede sheyyitzmach hare ze meen zorea aval hammashke tzemachin veilanot beshabbat hare ze toledet zorea vechayyav bechal shehu vechen hashshore chittin usorin vechayyotze bahen bammayim hare ze toledet zorea vechayyav bechal shehu

Hakkotzer kigrogeret chayyav vetolesh toledet kotzer hu vechal haoker davar miggiddulo chayyav mishshum kotzer lefichach tzeror shealu bo asavim uchshut sheala bassene vaasavim shetztzamchu al gav hechavit hattolesh mehen chayyav shezze hu mekom giddulan aval hattolesh meatzitz sheeno nakuv patur mippene sheen ze mekom giddulo veatzitz nakuv bichde shoresh katan hare hu keeretz vehattolesh mimmennu chayyav

Kal zera shekketzirato matzmachat oto umgaddalto kegon aspasta vesilka hakkotzro bishgaga chayyav shette chattaot achat mippene shehu kotzer veachat mippene shehu notea vechen hazzomer vehu tzarich laetzim chayyav mishshum kotzer umishshum notea gavshushit shel afar shealu bah asavim higbihah meal haaretz vehinnichah al gabbe yetedot chayyav mishshum tolesh hayeta al gabbe yetedot vehinnichah al haaretz chayyav mishshum zorea teenim sheyyavshu beibbehen vechen ilan sheyyavshu perotav bo hattolesh mehen beshabbat chayyav af al pi shehen kaakurin leinyan tuma

Hattolesh ulshin hamzared zeradin im laachila shiuro kigrogeret veim livhema shiuro kimlo pi gedi veim lehassaka shiuro kede levashshel betza hamammer ochalin im laachila shiuro kigrogeret veim immer livhema shiuro kimlo pi gedi veim lehassaka shiuro kede levashshel betza uvetza haamura bechal makom hi betza benonit shel tarnegolin vechal makom shenneemar kede levashshel betza hu kede levashshel kigrogeret mibbetza ugrogeret echad mishshelosha bevetza veen immur ella begiddule karka
Hamkabbetz devela veasa mimmenna iggula o shennikkev teenim vehichnis hachevel bahen ad shennitkabbetzu guf echad hare ze toledet meammer vechayyav vechen kal kayyotze baze

Haddash kigrogeret chayyav veen disha ella begiddule karka vehamfarek hare hi toledet haddash vechayyav vechen kal kayyotze baze hacholev et habbehema chayyav mishshum mefarek vechen hachovel bechay sheyyesh lo or chayyav mishshum mefarek vehu sheyyihye tzarich laddam sheyyetze min hachabbura aval im nitkaven lehazzik bilvad patur mippene shehu mekalkel veeno chayyav ad sheyyihye baddam o bachalav shehotzi kigrogeret

Bamme devarim amurim bechovel bivhema vechayya veof vechayyotze bahem aval hachovel bachavero af al pi shennitkaven lehazzik chayyav mippene nachat rucho shehare nitkarra dato veshachcha chamato vahare hu kimtakken veaf al pi sheeno tzarich laddam shehotzi mimmennu chayyav

Shemona sheratzim haamurim battora hen sheyyesh lahen orot leinyan shabbat kemo chayya uvhema veof aval shear shekatzim urmasim en lahen or lefichach hachovel bahen patur veechad hachovel bivhema chayya veof o bishmona sheratzim veasa bahen chabbura veyatza mehem dam o shennitzrar haddam af al pi shello yatza chayyav

Hassochet et happerot lehotzi memehen chayyav mishshum mefarek veeno chayyav ad sheyyihye bammashkin shessachat kigrogeret veen chayyavim min hattora ella al derichat zetim vaanavim bilvad umuttar lischot eshkol shel anavim letoch haochel shemmashke habba leochel ochel hu venimtza kimfarek ochel meochel aval im sachat lichli sheen bo ochel hare ze dorech vechayyav vehacholev letoch haochel o hayyonek befiv patur veeno chayyav ad sheyyachalov letoch hakkeli

Hazzore o habborer kigrogeret chayyav vehamchabbetz hare hu toledet borer vechen habborer shemarim mittoch hammashkin hare ze toledet borer o toledet merakked vechayyav shehazzore vehabborer vehamrakked domin inyenehem ze laze umippene ma manu otan bishlosha mippene shekkal melacha shehayeta bammishkan monin otah bifne atzmah
Habborer ochel mittoch pesolet o shehau lefanav shene mine ochalin uverer min mimmin acher benafa uvichvara chayyav bekanon o betamchuy patur veim berer beyado leechol lealtar muttar

Vehabborer pesolet mittoch haochel vaafillu beyado achat chayyav vehabborer turmosin mittoch pesolet shellahen chayyav mippene shehappesolet shellahen mematteket otan kesheyyishleku otan immahem venimtza kevorer pesolet mittoch ochel vechayyav habborer ochel mittoch pesolet beyado lehannicho afillu levo bayyom naasa kevorer laotzar vechayyav hau lefanav shene mine ochalin meoravin borer echad meacher umanniach leechol miyyad veim berer vehinniach leachar zeman afillu levo bayyom kegon shebberer beshacharit leechol ben haarbayim chayyav

Hmshammer yayin o shemen o mayim vechen shear hammashkin bammeshammeret shellahen chayyav vehu sheyeshammer kigrogeret aval mesannenin yayin sheen bo shemarim o mayim tzelulin besudarin uvichfifa mitzrit kede sheyehe tzalul beoter venotnin mayim al gabbe shemarim bishvil sheyyitztzolu venotnin betza terufa limsannenet shel chardal kede sheyyitztzalel chardal shellasho meerev shabbat lemachar memache veshote ben bayyad ben bichli vechen yayin miggitto kal zeman shehu toses toref chavit bishmareha venoten letoch hassudarin sheadayin lo nifreshu hashshemarim min hayyayin yafe yafe vechal hayyayin keguf echad hu vechen hachardal vechal kayyotze bo

Hattochen kigrogeret chayyav vechal hashshochek tavlin vesammanin bemachteshet hare ze tochen vechayyav hamchattech yarak talush hare ze toledet tochen vechen hannoser etzim lehanot binsoret shellahen o hashshaf lashon shel mattechet chayyav mishsheyyashuf kal shehu aval hamchattech etzim eno chayyav ad sheyedakdek mehen kede levashshel kigrogeret mibbetza

Hamrakked kigrogeret chayyav hallash kigrogeret chayyav hamgabbel et heafar hare ze toledet lash vechamma shiuro kede laasot pi kur shel tzorfe zahav veen gibbul beefer velo bechol haggas velo bemursan velo bechayyotze bahen vehannoten zera shumshemin o zera pishtan vechayyotze bahen bemayim chayyav mishshum lash mippene shehen mitarvin venitlin ze baze
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 9: Haofe kigrogeret chayyav echad haofe et happat o hamvashshel et hammaachal o et hassammanin o hamchammem et hammayim hakkol inyan echad hu shiur hamchammem et hammayim kede lirchotz bahen evar katan veshiur mevashshel sammanin kede sheyyihu reuyin ledavar shemmevashshelin otan lo

Hannoten betza betzad hammecham bishvil shettitgalgel venitgalgela chayyav shehamvashshel betoledet haur kimvashshel baur atzmah vechen hammediach bechammin dag maliach hayyashan o kulyas haispanin vehu dag dak verach beoter hare ze chayyav shehadachatan bechammin ze hu gemar bishshulan vechen kal kayyotze bahen

Hammafkia et habbetza beveged cham o bechol uvaavak derachim shehen chammim mippene hashshemesh af al pi shennitzlet patur shettoldot chamma enam ketoldot haesh aval gazru alehen mippene toldot haur vechen hamvashshel bechamme teverya vechayyotze bahem patur hamvashshel al haur davar shehaya mevushshal kal tzarko o davar sheeno tzarich bishshul kelal patur

Echad natan et haur veechad natan et haetzim veechad natan et hakkedera veechad natan et hammayim veechad natan et habbasar veechad natan et hattavlin uva acher vehegis kullam chayyavim mishshum mevashshel shekkal haose davar mitztzarche habbishshul hare ze mevashshel aval im shafat echad et hakkedera techilla uva acher venatan et hammayim uva acher venatan et habbasar uva acher venatan et hattavlin uva acher venatan et haur uva acher venatan etzim al haur uva acher vehegis shenayim haacharonim bilvad chayyavin mishshum mevashshel

Hinniach basar al gabbe gechalim im nitzla bo kigrogeret afillu bishnayim ushlosha mekomot chayyav lo nitzla bo kigrogeret aval nitbashshel kullo chatzi bishshul chayyav nitbashshel chatzi bishshul mitztzad echad patur ad sheyyahafoch bo veyitbashshel chatzi bishshul mishshene tzedadin shachach vehidbik pat battannur beshabbat venizkar muttar lo lirdota kodem shetteafe veyavo lide melacha

Hammattich echad mimmine mattachot kal shehu o hamchammem et hammattachot ad shettease gachelet hare ze toledet mevashshel vechen hammasses et haddonag o et hachelev o et hazzefet vehakkofer vehaggafrit vechayyotze bahem hare ze toledet mevashshel vechayyav vechen hamvashshel kele adama ad sheyyeasu cheres chayyav mishshum mevashshel kelalo shel davar ben sherippa guf kashe baesh o shehiksha guf rach hare ze chayyav mishshum mevashshel

Haggozez tzemer o sear ben min habbehema ben min hachayya ben min hachay ben min hammet afillu min hashshelach shellahen chayyav kamma shiuro kede litot mimmennu chut shearko kerochav hassit kaful vechamma rochav hassit kede limtoach min bohen shel yad ad haetzba harishona kesheyyiftach benehen bechal kocho vehu karov lishne shelishe zeret hattolesh kanaf min haof hare ze toledet gozez hattove et hatztzemer min hachay patur sheen derech geziza bechach veen derech nipputz bechach veen derech teviyya bechach

Hannotel tzipparnav o searo o sefamo o zekano hare ze toledet gozez vechayyav vehu sheyyittol bichli aval im netalan beyado ben lo ben leacher patur vechen hachotech yabbelet miggufo ben beyad ben bichli patur ben lo ben leacher umuttar lachtoch yabbelet bammikdash beyad aval lo bichli veim hayeta yevesha chotchah af bichli veoved avoda

Hannotel searo bichli kamma yittol veyihye chayyav shette searot veim likket levanot mittoch shechorot afillu achat chayyav tzipporen sheppersha rubbah vetzitzin shel or sheppershu rubban im pershu kelappe mala umtzaarot oto muttar littol otan beyado aval lo bichli veim netalan bichli patur veim enan metzaarot oto afillu bayyad asur veim lo pershu rubban afillu metzaarot oto asur lenatlan beyado veim netalan bichli chayyav

Hamlabben et hatztzemer o et happishtan o et hashshani vechen kal kayyotze bahen mimma sheddarkan lehitlabben chayyav vechamma shiuro kede litot mimmennu chut echad arko kimlo rochav hassit kaful shehu orech arbaa tefachim

Hamchabbes begadim hare hu toledet melabben vechayyav vhassochet et habbeged ad sheyyotzi hammayim shebbo hare ze mechabbes vechayyav shehassechita mitztzarche kibbus hi kemo shehahagasa mitztzarche habbishshul veen sechita besear vehu haddin leor sheen chayyavin al sechitato

Hamnappetz et hatztzemer o et happishtan o et hashshani vechayyotze bahen chayyav vechamma shiuro kede litot mimmennu chut echad arko arbaa tefachim vehamnappetz et haggidim ad sheyyeasu ketzemer kede litot otan hare ze toledet menappetz vechayyav

Hatztzovea chut shearko arbaa tefachim o davar sheefshar litot mimmennu chut kaze chayyav veen hatztzovea chayyav ad sheyehe tzeva hammitkayyem aval tzeva sheeno mitkayyem kelal kegon sheheevir sarak o shashar al gabbe barzel o nechoshet utzvao patur shehare atta maaviro lishato veeno tzovea kelum vechal sheen melachto mitkayyemet beshabbat patur

Haose en hatztzeva hare ze toledet tzovea vechayyav ketzad kegon shennatan kankantom letoch me appetza shennaasa hakkol shachor o shennatan istis letoch me karkom shennaasa hakkol yarok vechen kal kayyotze baze vechamma shiuro kede litzboa bo chut shearko arbaa tefachim

Hattove orech arbaa tefachim mikkal davar hannitve chayyav echad hattove et hatztzemer o et happishtan o et hannotza o et hassear o et haggidin vechen kal kayyotze bahen haose et halleved hare ze toledet tove vechayyav vehu sheyelabbed davar sheefshar litot mimmennu chut orech arbaa tefachim beovi benoni

Haose shene batte nirin chayyav haose nafa o kevara o sal o sevacha o shessarag mitta bachavalim hare ze toledet ose nirin umishsheyyaase shene battim beechad mikkal ellu chayyav vechen kal haose shene batte nirin bedavar sheosin oto battim battim kegon ellu chayyav

Derech haorgin shemmotchin hachutin techilla beorech hayeria uvrachbah ushnayim ochazin ze mikkan veze mikkan veechad shovet beshevet al hachutin umtakken otan ze betzad ze ad shettease kullah sheti belo erev umtichat hachutin kederech haorgin hi hansachat hammassechet veze hammoteach nikra mesech uchshekkoflin otah umatchil lehachnis hashsheti baerev nikra oreg

Hammesech chayyav vehi melacha meavot melachot vehashshovet al hachutin ad sheyyipparku vitakkenem hare ze toledet mesech vechamma shiuro mishsheyetakken rochav shette etzbaot vechen haoreg shene chutin berochav shette etzbaot chayyav ben shearagan battechilla ben shehaya miktzat habbeged arug vearag al haarug shiuro shene chutin veim arag chut echad vehishlim bo habbeged chayyav arag bisfat hayeria shene chutin berochav shelosha batte nirin chayyav ha lema ze dome leoreg tziltzul katan berochav shelosha batte nirin
Hamdakdek et hachutin umafridan beet haariga hare ze toledet oreg vechen hakkolea et hannimin hare ze toledet oreg veshiuro mishsheyyaase kelia beorech shette etzbaot

Habbotzea shene chutin chayyav uvotzea hu hammafrish et haarug ben shehotzi haerev min hashsheti o sheheevir hashsheti meal haerev hare ze botzea vechayyav vehu shello yehe mekalkel ella yitkaven letakken kederech sheosin ellu shemmeachin et habbegadim hakkallim beoter shebbotzin veachar kach meachin vechozrin veorgin chutin shebbatzu ad sheyyeasu shene habbegadim o shene hakkeraim echad vehassoter et hakkelia letakken hare ze toledet botzea veshiuro keshiur habbotzea
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 10: Hakosher kesher shel kayyama vehu maase umman chayyav kegon kesher haggammalin vekesher hassappanin vekishre retzuot minal vesandal shekkoshrin haratzanin bishat asiyyatan vechen kal kayyotze baze aval hakkosher kesher shel kayyama veeno maase umman patur vekesher sheeno shel kayyama veeno maase umman muttar lekashro lechattechilla

Ketzad nifseka lo retzua uksharah nifsak hachevel uksharo o shekkashar chevel bidli o shekkashar resen behema hare ze patur vechen kal kayyotze beellu hakkesharim shehen maase hedot vechal adam kosher otan lekayyama vechal kesher sheeno shel kayyama im kesharo kesher umman hare ze asur

Kosheret ishsha mifteche hechaluk af al pi sheyyesh lo shene petachim vechute sevacha af al pi shehu rafuy beroshah urtzuot minal vesandal shekkoshrin otan al haregel bishat malbush venodot yayin veshemen af al pi sheyyesh lo shette aznayim ukdera shel basar af al pi sheyechola lehotzi habbasar velo tattir hakkesher vekoshrin deli bimshicha o beavnet vechayyotze bo aval lo bechevel vekoshrin lifne habbehema o beraglah bishvil shello tetze af al pi sheyyesh lah shene issarot vechevel shehaya kashur bappara koshro baevus haya kashur baevus koshro bappara aval lo yavi chevel mittoch beto veyikshor bappara uvaevus veim haya chevel gardi shemmuttar letaltelo hare ze mevi vekosher bappara uvaevus mippene shekkal ellu hakkesharim maase hedot hen veenan shel kayyama ella paam kosher ufaam mattir ulfichach muttar likshor otan lechattechilla chotalot shel temarim veshel gerogarot mattir umafkia vechotech venotel veochel

Kal sherauy lemaachal behema muttar likshor oto beshabbat lefichach im nifseka retzuat sandalo becharmelit notel gemi lach harauy lemaachal behema vechorech alav vekosher haggemi nishmeta lo retzuat minal vesandal o shennishmat rov haregel muttar lehachazir hartzuot limkoman uvilvad shello yikshor
Haaniva mutteret lefi sheenah mitchallefet bikshira lefichach hachevel shennifsak mekabbetz shene ketzotav vechorech alav meshicha veonev aniva

Muttar likshor kesher sheeno shel kayyama lidvar mitzva kegon sheyyikshor limdod shiur mishshiure hattora nimat kinnor shennifsak koshrin otah bammikdash aval lo bammedina velo yikshor nima lechattechilla afillu bammikdash
Kal kesher shechayyavin al kishshuro kach chayyavin al hettero vechal kesher shehakkosher oto patur kach hammattir oto patur vechal kesher shemmuttar lekashro kach muttar lehattiro

Happotel chavalim min hahutzin umin hachelef o michute tzemer o michute pishtan o chute sear vechayyotze bahen hare ze toledet kosher vechayyav veshiuro kede sheyyaamod hachevel biftilato belo keshira shennimtzet melachto mitkayyemet vechen hammafrid et happetil hare ze toledet mattir vechayyav vehu shello yitkaven lekalkel bilvad veshiuro keshiur happotel

Hattofer shette tefirot chayyav vehu shekkashar rashe hachut mikkan umikkan kede shettaamod hattefira velo tishshamet aval im tafar yeter al shette tefirot af al pi shello kashar chayyav shehare mitkayyemet hattefira vehammoteach chut shel tefira beshabbat chayyav mippene shehu mitztzarche hattefira

Hakkorea kede litpor shette tefirot al menat litpor shette tefirot chayyav aval hakkorea lehafsidah patur mippene shehu mekalkel hakkorea bachamato o al met shehu chayyav likroa alav chayyav mippene shemmeyashshev et dato bedavar ze veyanuach yitzro vehoil vachamato shochechet bedavar ze hare hu kimtakken vechayyav vehappoteach bet hatztzavar beshabbat chayyav

Hamdabbek neyarot o orot bekolan shel sofrim vechayyotze bo hare ze toledet tofer vechayyav vechen hamfarek neyarot devukin o orot devukin velo nitkaven lekalkel bilvad hare ze toledet korea vechayyav

Habbone kal shehu chayyav hammashve pene hakkarka bevayit kegon shehishpil tel o mille guma o gaye hare ze bone vechayyav echad natan et haeven veechad natan et hattit hannoten hattit chayyav uvannidbach haelon afillu heela et haeven vehinnichah al gabbe hattit chayyav shehare en mannichin aleha tit acher vehabbone al gabbe kelim patur

Haose ohel kavua hare ze toledet bone vechayyav vechen haose kele adama kegon tannur vechavit kodem sheyyissarfu hare ze toledet bone vechayyav vechen hamgabben et haggevina hare ze toledet bone veeno chayyav ad sheyegabben kigrogeret hammachnis yad hakkardom betoch haetz shello hare ze toledet bone vechen kal kayyotze bo vechen hattokea etz beetz ben shettaka bemasmer ben shettaka baetz atzmo ad shennitached hare ze toledet bone vechayyav
Haose nekev kal shehu belul shel tarnegolim kede sheyyikkanes lahen haora chayyav mishshum bone hammachazir delet shel bor veshel dut veshel yatzia chayyav mishshum bone
Hassoter kal shehu chayyav vehu sheyyistor al menat livnot aval im satar derech hashchata patur hassoter ohel kavua o shepperek etz takua hare ze toledet soter vechayyav vehu sheyyitkaven letakken

Hammakke befattish hakkaa achat chayyav vechal haose davar shehu gemar melacha hare ze toledet makke befattish vechayyav ketzad hamnappeach bichle zechuchit vehatztzar bakkeli tzura afillu miktzat hatztzura vehamgared kal shehu vehaose nekev kal shehu ben beetz ben bemattechet ben bevinyan ben bechelim hare ze toledet makke befattish vechayyav vechal petach sheeno asuy lehachnis ulhotzi en chayyavin al asiyyato

Hammefis shechin beshabbat kede leharchiv pi hammakka kederech sheharofin osin shehen mitkavvenin birfua leharchiv pi hammakka hare ze chayyav mishshum makke befattish shezzo hi melechet harofe veim hefisa lehotzi mimmenna hallecha shebbah hare ze muttar

Hamsattet et haeven kal shehu chayyav mishshum makke befattish hamtzadded et haeven bisod habbinyan vetikkenah beyado vehoshivah bammakom harauy lah chayyav mishshum makke befattish halloket yabbolet sheal gabbe begadim beyado kegon ellu hayyabbolot shebbichle tzemer chayyav mishshum makke befattish vehu sheyyakpid alehen aval im hesiran derech esek hare ze patur hamnaer tallit chadasha shechora kede lenaotah ulhasir hatztzemer hallavan hannitle bah kederech shehaummanin osin chayyav chattat veim eno makpid muttar

Hatztzad davar shedderech mino latzud oto chayyav kegon chayya veofot vedagim vehu sheyyatzud otan lemakom sheeno mechussar tzeda ketzad kegon sheradaf achare tzevi ad shehichniso levayit o leginna o lechatzer venaal befanav o shehifriach et haof ad shehichniso lemigdal venaal befanav o sheshshala dagim min hayyam betoch sefel shel mayim hare ze chayyav aval im hifriach tzippor levayit venaal befanav o shehivriach dag vaakaro min hayyam livrecha shel mayim o sheradaf achar tzevi ad shennichnas litraklin rachav venaal befanav hare ze patur sheen zo tzida gemura sheim yavo lekachto tzarich lirdof acharav velatzud oto mishsham lefichach hatztzad ari eno chayyav ad sheyyachnisennu lakkippa shello shehu neesar bah

Kal makom sheim yarutz bo yaggia lachayya bishchiyya achat o shehau hakketalim kerovin ze laze ad sheyyippol tzel shenehem laemtza keechad hare ze makom katan veim hivriach hatztzevi vechayyotze bo letocho chayyav umakom shehu gadol mizze hammavriach chayya vaof letocho patur

Echad shemona sheratzim haamurin battora veechad shear shekatzim urmasim sheyyesh leminan tzida hatztzad echad mikkullan ben letzorech ben shello letzorech o lesachek bahen chayyav hoil venitkaven latzud vetzad shemmelacha sheenah tzericha legufah chayyav aleha hatztzad et hayyashen veet hassuma chayyav

Hamshalleach kelavim kede sheyyatzudu tzevaim vearnavim vechayyotze bahen uvarach hatztzevi mippene hakkelev vehaya hu rodef achar hatztzevi o sheamad befanav vehivhilo ad shehiggia hakkelev utfaso hare ze toledet hatztzad vechayyav vechen haose kadderech hazzo beofot

Tzevi shennichnas levayit venaal echad befanav chayyav nealuhu shenayim peturin im en echad yachol linol unaluhu shenayim chayyavin yashav echad al happetach velo milleahu veyashav hashsheni umilleahu hashsheni chayyav yashav harishon umilleahu uva hashsheni veyashav betziddo af al pi sheamad harishon vehalach lo harishon chayyav vehashsheni lo asa kelum umuttar lo leshev bimkomo ad haerev velokeach hatztzevi lema ze dome lenoel beto leshamro venimtza tzevi shamur betocho shello asa kelum nichnesa lo tzippor tachat kenafav yoshev umshammerah ad shettechshach umuttar

Hatztzad tzevi zaken o chigger o chole o katan patur hamfarek behema chayya vaof min hammetzuda patur hatztzad chayya vaof shebbirshuto kegon avazin vetarnegolin veone aliyya patur hatztzad davar sheen bemino tzida kegon chagavim haggazin tzerain veyattushin ufaroshin vechayyotze baellu hare ze patur

Remasim hammazzikin kegon nechashim veakrabbim vechayyotze bahen af al pi sheenan memitin hoil venoshchin muttar latzud otam beshabbat vehu sheyyitkaven lehinnatzel minneshichatan ketzad hu ose kofe keli alehen o makkif alehen o koshran kede shello yazziku
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 11: Hashochet chayyav velo shochit bilvad ella kal hannotel neshama leechad mikkal mine chayya uvhema veof vedag vesheretz ben bishchita o binchira o behakkaa chayyav hachonek et hachay ad sheyyamut hare ze toledet shochet lefichach im heela dag missefel shel mayim vehinnicho ad shemmet chayyav mishshum chonek velo ad sheyyamut ella kevan sheyyavesh bo kesela ben senappirav chayyav sheod eno yachol lichot hoshit yado lime habbehema vedildel ebbar shebbemeeha chayyav

Remasim shehen parin veravin mizzachar unkeva o nehevin min heafar kemo happaroshin hahoreg otan chayyav kehoreg behema vechayya aval remasim shehavayatan min haggelalim umin happerot shehivishu vechayyotze bahen kegon tolaim shel basar vetolaim shebbetoch hakkitniyyot hahorgan patur
Hamfalle kelav beshabbat molel et hakkinnim vezorkan umuttar laharog et hakkinnim beshabbat mippene shehen min hazzea

Chayya veremes shehen noshchin ummitin vadday kegon zevuv shebbemitzrayim vetzira shebbeninve veakrav shebbachadayev venachash shebbeeretz yisrael vechelev shote bechal makom muttar lehargan beshabbat kesheyyerau ushar kal hammazzikin im hau ratzin acharav muttar lehargan veim hau yoshvin bimkoman o borchin millefanav asur lehargan veim dorsan lefi tummo bishat hillucho vehorgan muttar

Hammafshit min haor kede laasot kamea chayyav vechen hamabbed min haor kede laasot kamea chayyav veechad hammoleach veechad hamabbed shehammelicha min ibbud hu veen ibbud baochalin vechen hammochek min haor kede laasot kamea chayyav vee zehu mochek ze hammaavir sear o hatztzemer meal haor achar mita ad sheyyachalik pene haor

Hamfarek duchsustus meal hakkelaf hare ze toledet mafshit vechayyav hamfarek min haor kede laasot kamea chayyav haddores al haor beraglo ad sheyyitkashshe o hamrakkecho beyado umoshcho umashve oto kederech sheharatzanin osin hare ze toledet meabbed vechayyav hammoret notza min haevra hare ze toledet mochek vechayyav vechen hammareach retiyya kal shehu o shaava o zefet vechayyotze bahen middevarim hammitmarchin ad sheyyachalik penehem chayyav mishshum mochek vechen hashshaf beyado al haor hammatuach ben haammudim chayyav mishshum mochek

Hamchattech min haor kede laasot kamea chayyav vehu sheyyitkaven lemiddat arko umiddat rachbo veyachtoch bechavana shehi melacha aval im chatach derech hefsed o belo kavana lemiddato ella kemitassek o kimsachek hare ze patur hakkotem et hakkanaf hare ze toledet mechattech vechayyav vechen hamgared rashe kelunsot shel erez chayyav mishshum mechattech vechen kal chaticha sheyyachtoch charash etz min haetzim o charash mattechet min hammattachot chayyav mishshum mechattech hannotel kesam shel etz millefanav uktamo lachtzotz bo shinnav o liftoach bo et haddelet chayyav

Kal davar shehu rauy lemaachal behema kegon teven vaasavim lachim vehutzin vechayyotze bahen muttar liktom otan beshabbat mippene sheen bahen tikkun kelim umuttar liktom atze besamim lehariach bahen af al pi shehen kashim viveshin umfashsheach mehen kal ma sheyyirtze ben sheppashach etz gadol ben sheppashach etz katan

Hakkotev shette otiyyot chayyav hammochek ketav al menat lichtov bimkom hammachak shette otiyyot chayyav hkotev ot achat gedola kishtayim patur machak ot achat gedola veyesh bimkomah kede lichtov shettayim chayyav katav ot achat vehishlim bah et hassefer chayyav hakkotev al menat lekalkel haor chayyav sheen chiyyuvo al mekom hakketav ella al hakketav aval hammochek al menat lekalkel patur nafla deo al gabbe sefer umachak otah nafla shaava al gabbe happinkas umachak otah im yesh bimkomah kede lichtov shette otiyyot chayyav
Hakkotev ot kefula paamayim vehu shem echad kemo dad tet gag rar sas sas chach chayyav vehakkotev bechal ketav uvchal lashon chayyav vaafillu mishshene simaniyyot

Hakkotev ot achat samuch lakketav o ketav al gabbe ketav vehammitkaven lichtov chet vechatav shene zayinnin vechen kayyotze baze bishar otiyyot vehakkotev ot achat baaretz veot achat bakkora shehare en nehegin ze im ze o shekkatav shette otiyyot bishne dappe pinkas veenan nehegin ze im ze patur ketavan bishne katle zavit o bishne dappe pinkas vehen nehegin ze im ze chayyav

Lakach gevil vechayyotze bo vechatav alav ot achat bimdina zo vehalach beoto hayyom vechatav ot sheniyya bimdina acheret bimgilla acheret chayyav shebbizman shemmekarvan nehegin ze im ze veenan mechussarin maase likrivatan

Hakkotev ot achat af al pi shekkorim mimmenna teva shelema patur ketzad kegon shekkatav vehakkol korin otah maaser o shekketavah bemakom minyan shehare hi kemo shekkatav arbaim hare ze patur hammaggiha ot achat veasa otah shettayim kegon shechillek gag hachet venaaset shene zayinnin chayyav vechen kal kayyotze baze

Hakkotev bismolo o leachar yado beraglo befiv uvmarpeko patur itter shekkatav bimino shehi lo kismol kal adam patur veim katav bismolo chayyav vehashsholet bishte yadav beshave vechatav ben bimino ben bismolo chayyav katan ochez bekulmos vegadol ochez beyado vechotev chayyav gadol ochez bekulmos vekatan ochez beyado vechotev patur

En hakkotev chayyav ad sheyyichtov bedavar haroshem veomed kegon deo veshachor vesikra vekomos vekankantom vechayyotze bahem veyichtov al davar shemmitkayyem hakketav alav kegon or uklaf unyar veetz vechayyotze bahem aval hakkotev bedavar sheen rishshumo omed kegon mashkin ume perot o shekkatav bido vechayyotze bo al ale yerakot veal kal davar sheeno omed patur eno chayyav ad sheyyichtov bedavar haomed al davar haomed vechen en hammochek chayyav ad sheyyimchok ketav haomed meal davar haomed

Hakkotev al besaro chayyav mippene shehu or af al pi shechamimut besaro maaveret hakketav leachar zeman hare ze dome lichtav shennimchak aval hamsaret al besaro tzurat ketav patur hakkorea al haor ketavnit ketav chayyav mishshum kotev haroshem al haor ketavnit ketav patur hammaavir deo al gabbe sikra chayyav shettayim achat mishshum kotev veachat mishshum mochek heevir deo al gabbe deo vesikra al gabbe sikra o sikra al gabbe deo patur

Roshem toledet kotev hu ketzad haroshem reshamim vetzurot bechotel uvshashar vechayyotze bahen kederech shehatztzayyarin roshmim hare ze chayyav mishshum kotev vechen hammochek et harishshum letakken hare ze toledet mochek vechayyav hamsartet kede lichtov shette otiyyot tachat oto sirtut chayyav charashe haetzim shemmaavirin chut shel sikra al gabbe hakkora kede sheyyinsor beshave hare ze toledet mesartet vechen haggabbalim sheosim ken baavanim kede sheyefatztzel haeven beshave veechad hamsartet betzeva o belo tzeva hare ze chayyav
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 12: Hammavir kal shehu chayyav vehu sheyehe tzarich laefer aval im hivir derech hashchata patur mippene shehu mekalkel vehammavir gedisho shel chavero o hassoref dirato chayyav af al pi shehu mashchit mippene shekkavanato lehinnakem missono vahare nitkarra dato veshachcha chamato venaasa kekorea al meto o bachamato shehu chayyav uvchovel bachavero bishat meriva shekkal ellu metakkenim hen etzel yitzran hara vechen hammadlik et hanner o et haetzim ben lehitchammem ben lehair hare ze chayyav hamchammem et habbarzel kede letzarfo bemayim hare ze toledet mavir vechayyav

Hamchabbe kal shehu chayyav echad hamchabbe et hanner veechad hamchabbe et haggachelet shel etz aval hamchabbe gachelet shel mattechet patur veim nitkaven letzaref chayyav shekken lotshe habbarzel osim mechimmim et habbarzel ad sheyyease gachelet umchabbin oto bemayim kede lechassemo vezehu letzaref shehaose oto chayyav vehu toledet mechabbe umuttar lechabbot gachelet shel mattechet birshut harabbim kede shello yizzoku bah rabbim hannoten shemen letoch hanner haddolek chayyav mishshum mavir vehammistappek min hashshemen shebbanner chayyav mishshum mechabbe

Deleka shennafla beshabbat hamchabbe otah mippene ibbud mamon chayyav sheen ibbud mamon doche shabbat ella ibbud nefashot lefichach yetzu bene adam kede shello yamutu veyannichu haesh telahet vaafillu sorefet kal dirato kullah

Muttar laasot mechitztza bechal hakkelim ben meleim ben rekanim kede shello taavor haddeleka afillu keli cheres chadashim meleim mayim osin mehen mechitztza af al pi shevadday mitbakkein umchabbim sheggeram kibbuy muttar vechofin keara al gabbe hanner bishvil shello teachez bakkora
Teva shidda umigdal sheachaz bahen haur mevi or gedi vechayyotze bo middevarim sheen haur melahetet otan uforso al hakkatze sheadayin lo nisraf kede shello taavor sham haesh

Tallit sheachaz bah haur poshtah umitkasse bah veim kavta kavta vechen sefer tora sheachaz bo haur poshto vekore bo veim kava kava venoten mayim min hatztzad sheadayin lo nitla bo haur veim kavta kavta shachach ner daluk al gabbe tavla menaer et hattavla vehu nofel veim kava kava aval hinnicho mibbaerev af al pi shekkava asur letaltelo

Nachri shebba lechabbot en omrim lo kabbe veal techabbe mippene sheen shevitato alenu aval katan shebba lechabbot en shomin lo vehu sheyyihye ose al daat aviv aval middaat atzmo en bet din metzuvin lehafrisho uvidleka hittiru lomar kal hamchabbe eno mafsid

Hotzaa vehachnasa mershut lirshut melacha meavot melachot hi veaf al pi sheddavar ze im kal gufe tora mippi moshe missinay neemru hare hu omer battora ish veishsha al yaasu od melacha litrumat hakkodesh vayyikkale haam mehavi ha lamadta shehahavaa melacha kore otah vechen lamdu mippi hashshemua shehammaavir birshut harabbim mittechillat arba lesof arba hare hu kemotzi mershut lirshut vechayyav

En hammotzi mershut lirshut chayyav ad sheyyotzi kashshiur hammoil mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim o mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid veyaakor mershut zo veyanniach birshut sheniyya aval im akar velo hinniach o hinniach velo akar o shehotzi pachot mikkashshiur patur vechen hammaavir mittechillat arba lesof arba birshut harabbim eno chayyav ad sheyyaakor kashshiur mitztzad ze veyannichennu mitztzad acheret
Hazzorek mershut lirshut o hammoshit hare ze toledet motzi vechayyav vechen hazzorek o hammoshit beyado mittechillat arba lesof arba hare ze toledet motzi vechayyav vehazzorek kilachar yad patur

Hammotzi miktzat hachefetz mershut mishshette reshuot ellu lirshut sheniyya patur ad sheyyotzi et kal hachefetz kullo mershut zo lirshut zo kuppa shehi melea chafatzim afillu melea chardal vehotzi rubbah mershut zo lirshut zo patur ad sheyyotzi et kal hakkuppa vechen kal haddome laze shehakkeli mesim kal sheyyesh bo kechefetz echad

Hammotzi ben bimino ben bismolo ben betoch cheko o sheyyatza bemaot tzerurin lo bisdino chayyav mippene shehotzi kederech hammotziin vechen hammotzi al ketefo chayyav af al pi shehammassooy lemala measara tefachim birshut harabbim shekken haya massa bene kehat bammishkan lemala measara shenneemar bakkatef yissau vechal hammelachot mimmishkan lomdin otan
Aval hammotzi leachar yado beraglo befiv uvmarpeko beazno uvisaro uvchis shettafur bevigdo ufi hakkis lematta ben beged leveged befi bigdo beminalo uvsandalo patur shello hotzi kederech hammotziin

Hammotzi massooy al rosho im haya massooy kaved kegon sak male o teva umigdal vechayyotze bahen shehu mesim al rosho vetofes beyado chayyav shekken derech hammotziin venimtza kemotzi al ketefo o beyado aval im lakach chefetz kal kegon shehinniach beged o sefer o sakkin al rosho vehotzio vehu eno ochez beyado hare ze patur shello hotzi kederech hammotziin sheen derech rov haolam lehotzi hachafatzin munnachin al rashehem hammaavir chefetz mittechillat arba lesof arba birshut harabbim af al pi sheheeviro lemala merosho chayyav

Muttar leadam letaltel birshut harabbim betoch arba ammot al arba ammot shehu omed betziddan veyesh lo letaltel bechal hamrubba hazze uvamma shello moddin veim haya nannas beevarav notnin lo arba ammot kevenoniyyot shel kal adam umippi hakkabbala amru shezze shenneemar battora shevu ish tachtav shello yetaltel chutz limrubba ze ella bimrubba ze shehu kemiddat orech adam kesheyyifshot yadav veraglav bo bilvad yesh letaltel

Hau shenayim miktzat arba ammot shel ze letoch arba ammot shel ze meviin veochlin baemtza uvilvad shello yotzi ze mittoch shello letoch shel chavero veim hau shelosha vehaemtzai muvla bentayim hu muttar immahen vehen muttarin immo ushnayim hachitzonim asurim ze im ze

Lefichach muttar leadam laakor chefetz mershut harabbim velitteno lachavero sheimmo betoch arba ammot vechen chavero lachavero haacher shebbetziddo afillu hen mea veaf al pi shehachefetz holech kamma milin beshabbat muttar mippene shekkal echad mehen lo tiltel ella betoch arba ammot shello

Hoil veyesh lo leadam letaltel bechal hamrubba shehu arba ammot al arba ammot nimtza metaltel beorech alachsono shel merubba ze chamesh ammot ushlosha chumshe amma lefichach en hammaavir o hazzorek birshut harabbim chayyav ad sheyyaavir chutz lechamesh ammot ushlosha chumshe amma vechal makom sheamarnu mittechillat arba lesof arba o hammaavir arba ammot chayyav hu mittechillat haalachson shel arba ammot ad sofo veim heevir pachot mizze patur

Nimtza kan shalosh middot ketzad haoker chefetz mershut harabbim mimmakom ze vehinnicho bemakom acher birshut harabbim im haya ben shene hammekomot ad arba ammot hare ze muttar haya benehen yeter mearba ammot vaadayin hen betoch chamesh ammot ushlosha chumshe amma patur haya benehen chamesh ammot ushlosha chumshe amma beshave hare ze chayyav shehare heevir hachefetz chutz laalachsono shel merubba
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 13: En hammotzi mershut lirshut o hammaavir birshut harabbim chutz learba ammot chayyav ad sheyyaakor chefetz meal gabbe makom sheyyesh bo arbaa tefachim al arbaa tefachim o yater veyanniach al gabbe makom sheyyesh bo arbaa al arbaa tefachim

Yado shel adam chashuva lo kearbaa al arbaa lefichach im akar hachefetz miyyad adam haomed birshut zo vehinnicho beyad adam acher haomed birshut sheniyya chayyav vechen im haya omed beachat mishshette reshuot ellu ufashat yado lirshut sheniyya veakar hachefetz mimmenna o miyyad adam haomed bah vehechezir yado elav chayyav veaf al pi shello hinniach hachefetz bemakom shehu omed bo hoil vehu beyado hare hu kemunnach baaretz

Haya ochel veotze mershut lirshut vechishshev lehotzi haochel shebbefiv mershut lirshut chayyav mippene shemmachashavto mesima piv mekom arbaa af al pi shello hotzi kederech hammotziin vechen mi shehaya omed beachat mishshette reshuot ellu vehishtin mayim o rakak birshut sheniyya chayyav shehare akar mershut zo vehinniach birshut sheniyya umachashavto osa oto keillu akar meal gabbe mekom arbaa haya omed birshut zo ufi amma birshut sheniyya vehishtin bah patur

Haya omed beachat mishshette reshuot ufashat yado lirshut sheniyya venatal mishsham mayim meal gabbe guma melea mayim vehotzian chayyav shehammayim kullan keillu hen munnachin al haaretz aval im haya keli tzaf al gabbe mayim uferot betoch hakkeli ufashat yado velakach min happerot vehotzi patur shehare lo nachu happerot al gabbe haaretz venimtza shello akar meal gabbe mekom arbaa veen tzarich lomar im hau happerot tzafin al pene hammayim vehotziam shehu patur vechen im haya shemen tzaf al pene hammayim vekalat min hashshemen vehotzio patur

Kevar amarnu sheen hammotzi mershut lirshut chayyav ad sheyyaakor veyanniach aval im akar velo hinniach o hinniach velo akar patur lefichach mi shehaya omed beachat mishshette reshuot ufashat yado lirshut sheniyya vechefetz beyado untalo acher mimmennu o shennatan acher leyado chefetz vehechezir yado elav shenehem peturim shezze akar veze hinniach
Bamme devarim amurim keshehayeta yado lemala mishshelosha aval hayeta yado betoch shelosha samuch laaretz hare ze kemi shehinniach baaretz vechayyav

Haya omed beachat mishshette reshuot ellu ufashat chavero yad mershut sheniyya venatal chefetz miyyad ze haomed birshut zo vehichniso etzlo o shehotzi chefetz meetzlo vehinniach beyad ze haomed ze haomed lo asa kelum shehare chavero natan beyado o natal miyyado vachavero chayyav shehare akar vehinniach

Haya omed beachat mishshette reshuot ellu venatan chavero chefetz beyado o al gabbav veyatza beoto hachefetz lirshut sheniyya veamad sham chayyav mippene sheakirat gufo bachefetz shealav kaakirat chefetz meotah reshut vaamidato beoto hachefetz kehannachat hachefetz bakkarka sheamad bah lefichach im yatza bachefetz shebbeyado o al gabbav velo amad birshut sheniyya ella chazar venichnas vehu beyado afillu yatza venichnas kal hayyom kullo ad sheyyatza hayyom patur lefi sheakar velo hinniach vaafillu amad letakken hammassooy shealav adayin hu patur ad sheyyaamod lanuach

Vechen mi shehayeta chavilato al ketefo veratz bah afillu kal hayyom eno chayyav ad sheyyaamod vehu sheyyihye ratz bah aval im halach meat meat hare ze keoker umanniach veasur lefichach mi shekkadash alav hayyom vachavilato al ketefo ratz bah ad sheyyaggia leveto vezorkah sham kilachar yad

Akar hachefetz mershut harabbim vehalach bo pachot mearba ammot veamad vechazar vehalach pachot mearba ammot veamad afillu kal hayyom kullo patur bamme devarim amurim besheamad lanuach aval im amad letakken massao hare ze kimhallech uchsheyyaamod chutz learba ammot chayyav vehu sheyyaamod chutz learba ammot lanuach aval im yaamod letakken massao adayin hu kimhallech veeno chayyav ad sheyyaamod lanuach chutz learba ammot

Haya kane o romach vechayyotze bo munnach al haaretz vehigbiha hakkatze haechad vehaya hakkatze hashsheni munnach baaretz vehishlicho lefanav vechazar vehigbiha hakkatze hashsheni shehaya munnach baaretz vehishlicho lefanav al derech zo ad sheheevir hachefetz kamma milin patur lefi shello akar hachefetz kullo meal gabbe haaretz veim mashach hachefetz ugraro al haaretz mittechillat arba lesof arba chayyav shehamgalgel oker hu

Akar hachefetz mizzavit zo lehannicho bezavit acheret shennimtzet zo haakira akira hammutteret venimlach badderech vehotzio lirshut sheniyya patur mippene shello hayeta akira rishona lechach venimtzet kan hannacha belo akira vechen haoker chefetz vehinnicho al chavero keshehu mehallech uvet sheyyirtze chavero laamod netalo meal gabbe chavero hare ze patur shehare yesh kan akira belo hannacha

Hazzorek chefetz mershut lirshut o mittechillat arba lesof arba birshut harabbim vekodem sheyyanuach kelato acher beyado o kelato kelev o nisraf patur mippene sheen zo hannacha shennitkaven lah lefichach im nitkaven bishat zerika lechach chayyav
Hazzorek chefetz mershut lirshut vehaya kashur bechevel vaagado beyado im yachol limshoch hachefetz etzlo patur shehare en kan hanacha gemura venimtza kemi sheakar velo hinniach

Hazzorek venacha betoch yado shel chavero im amad chavero bimkomo vekibbelah hazzorek chayyav shehare akar vehinniach veim neekar chavero mimmekomo vekibbelah patur zarak veratz hazzorek atzmo achar hachefetz vekibbelo beyado birshut acheret o chutz learba ammot patur keillu neekar acher vekibbelo sheen hahannacha gemura ad sheyyanuach hachefetz bemakom shehaya lo lanuach bo bishat akira

Hazzorek mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid urshut harabbim baemtza af al pi sheavar hachefetz baavir reshut harabbim patur vehu sheyyaavor lemala mishshelosha tefachim aval im avar befachot mishshelosha samuch laaretz venach al gabbe mashshehu af al pi shenneekar o nitgalgel veyatza hachefetz mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid acheret hare hu kemi shennishar omed birshut harabbim ulfichach chayyav vechen hazzorek mershut harabbim lirshut harabbim urshut hayyachid baemtza patur veim avar hachefetz befachot mishshelosha samuch laaretz venach al gabbe mashshehu af al pi shechazar venitgalgel veyatza lirshut harabbim hashsheniyya hare hu kemi shennishar omed birshut hayyachid ulfichach chayyav
Hammaavir arba ammot birshut harabbim zo im reshut harabbim hashsheniyya chayyav mippene shearba ammot bishte reshuot harabbim mitztarfim mippene shello nach hachefetz barshut shebbenehen

Hammoshit mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid urshut harabbim baemtza chayyav vaafillu hoshit lemala meavir reshut harabbim shekken hayeta avodat halviyyim bammishkan moshitin et hakkerashim meagala laagala urshut harabbim ben shette haagalot vechal agala vaagala reshut hayyachid hi

Bamme devarim amurim keshehau shette reshut hayyachid beorech reshut harabbim kemo shehaagalot mehallechot birshut harabbim zo achar zo aval im hau shette harshuyyot bishne tzidde reshut harabbim af hammoshit mershut hayyachid zo lirshut hayyachid shekkenegdah patur

Shachach ufashat yado vehi melea perot vehotziah mechatzer zo lehachnisah lechatzer shebbetziddah venizkar kodem sheyyachnis vahare yado teluya baavir reshut harabbim muttar lehachazirah elav lachatzero aval lehachnisah leotah hechatzer hashsheniyya asur kede shello yaase machashavto shechashav bishat shegaga veim hotzi yado bemezid hare ze asur lehachazirah etzlo ella kansu oto shettehe yado teluya ad shettechshach

Hammitkaven lizrok shemone ammot birshut harabbim venach hachefetz besof arba chayyav shehare naasa keshiur hammelacha venaaset machashavto shehaddavar yadua sheen ze hachefetz maggia lesof shemone ad sheyyaavor al kal makom umakom mikkal hashshemone aval im nitkaven lizrok arba venach hachefetz besof shemone patur lefi shennach bemakom shello chashav shettaavor bo vechal shekken shettanuach lefichach im chashav beet zerika sheyyanuach hachefetz bechal makom sheyyirtze chayyav

Zarak letoch arba ammot venitgalgel chutz learba ammot patur zarak chutz learba ammot venitgalgel letoch arba ammot im nach al gabbe mashshehu chutz learba ammot veachar kach nitgalgel venichnas letoch arba ammot chayyav veim lo nach kelal hare ze patur
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 14: Arva reshuot leshabbat reshut hayyachid urshut harabbim vecharmelit umkom petor e zo hi reshut harabbim midbarot vaayarot ushvakim udrachim hamfullashin lahen uvilvad sheyyihye rochav hadderech shesh esre amma velo yihye alav tikra vee zo reshut hayyachid tel sheggavoha asara tefachim verachav arbaa tefachim al arbaa tefachim o yeter al ken vechen charitz shehu amok asara verachav arbaa al arbaa o yeter al ken vechen makom shehu mukkaf arba mechitztzot gavhan asara uvenehen arbaa al arbaa o yeter al ken afillu yesh bo kamma milin im hukkaf ledira kegon medina hammukkefet choma sheddaltoteha ninalot ballayela umvoot sheyyesh lahen shelosha ketalim velechi beruach reviit vechen chatzer vedir vesahar shehukkefu ledira kullan reshut hayyachid gemura hen
Afillu kelim kegon sefina o migdal shel etz vechaveret vechayyotze bahen im yesh bahen arbaa al arbaa begovah asara o yeter al ze hare hen reshut hayyachid gemura

Ovi hakketalim shel reshut hayyachid kirshut hayyachid laacherim ose mechitztza leatzmo lo kal shekken avir reshut hayyachid kirshut hayyachid ad larakia aval avir reshut harabbim eno kirshut harabbim ella ad asara tefachim ulmala measara baavir reshut harabbim mekom petor hu

E zo hi karmelit tel sheyyesh bo arbaa al arbaa o yeter al ken vegavho mishshelosha vead asara shehakkarmelit enah tofeset ella ad asara veenah rechava pachot mearbaa al arbaa vechen charitz sheyyesh bo arbaa al arbaa o yeter al ken veamok mishshelosha ad asara vechen makom shehukkaf bearba mechitztzot gavhan mishshelosha vead asara uvenehen arbaa al arbaa o yeter al ken vechen keren zavit hassemucha lirshut harabbim vehu hammakom shemmukkaf shalosh mechitztzot veharuach harviit reshut harabbim kegon mavoy sheen lo lechi o kora beruach reviit vechen hayyammim vehabbika ben bimot hachamma ben bimot haggeshamim kal ellu karmelit hen

Avir hakkarmelit hare hu kecharmelit ad asara tefachim ulmala measara tefachim baavir hakkarmelit hare hu mekom petor lefichach meal pene hammayim shebbayyammim veshebbanneharot ad asara tefachim kaavir karmelit ulmala measara mekom petor aval kal haomek hammelea mayim hare hu kekarka ava

Bor shebbecharmelit hare hu kecharmelit afillu amok mea amma im en bo arbaa reshut harabbim shehayeta aleha tikra o sheen berachbah amma hare hi kecharmelit itztabba shebben haammudim haomdim birshut harabbim hare hi kecharmelit vetzidde reshut harabbim kecharmelit aval ben haammudim hoil verabbim dorsin benehen hare hen reshut harabbim

E zehu mekom petor makom sheyyesh bo pachot mearbaa al arbaa vegavho shelosha ad larakia shekkal pachot mishshelosha hare hu kaaretz afillu kotzim uvarkanim o gelalim birshut harabbim gavhan shelosha veen rachban arbaa al arbaa hare hen mekom petor vechen charitz sheen bo arbaa al arbaa veamko mishshelosha ad hattehom vechen makom hammukkaf sheen bo arbaa al arbaa afillu haya arko elef mil verachbo arbaa pachot seora vegavho mishshelosha ulmala hare ze mekom petor vechen avir reshut harabbim o avir karmelit lemala measara hare hu mekom petor

Makom sheyyesh begavho tisha tefachim metzumtzamim lo pachot velo yeter birshut harabbim hare hu kirshut harabbim veen mashgichin al middat arko umiddat rachbo ben rachav ben katzar mippene sherabbim mechattefin alav aval im haya yeter al tisha o pachot im haya bo arbaa al arbaa o yeter hare hu karmelit veim en bo arbaa al arbaa hare hu mekom petor

Gag hassamuch lirshut harabbim betoch asara tefachim hoil verabbim mechattefin alav asur letaltel baggag ad sheyyaase lo sullam kavua lehattiro ammud birshut harabbim gavoha asara verachav arbaa hare ze reshut hayyachid naatz begavho yated kal shehu afillu enah gevoha shelosha hoil verauy litlot bayyated ulhishtammesh bo hare ze memaato venaasa karmelit veen moddin lo ella min hayyated ulmala vaafillu milleahu kullo yetedot hare ze memaet gavho shehare tolin beotan hayetedot umishtammeshim bahen

Chore reshut hayyachid hare hen kirshut hayyachid aval chore reshut harabbim enam kirshut harabbim ella hare hen kefi middatan ketzad chor betzad reshut harabbim im yesh bo arbaa al arbaa vegavoha asara hare hu reshut hayyachid veim en gavoha asara hare ze karmelit veim en bo arbaa al arbaa hare ze mekom petor vehu sheggavoha shelosha shekkal happachut mishshelosha hare hu kaaretz

Reshut hayyachid umkom petor muttar letaltel bechullan afillu haya orech kal achat mishshettehen kamma milin metaltel bechullah aval reshut harabbim vehakkarmelit en metaltelin bahen ella bearba ammot veim heevir o hoshit o zarak chutz learba ammot birshut harabbim chayyav uvcharmelit patur sheissur hakkarmelit middivrehem mippene shehi doma lirshut harabbim shemma titchallef birshut harabbim lefichach im lo haya tzarich leguf hahotzaa kegon sheheevir kotz becharmelit kede shello yizzoku bo rabbim hare ze muttar vaafillu heeviro kamma ammot vechen kal kayyotze baze

Keshem shemmuttar letaltel bechal mekom petor kach muttar lehachnis mimmennu lirshut hayyachid o lirshut harabbim veen tzarich lomar lecharmelit umotziin lo mershut hayyachid umershut harabbim veen tzarich lomar min hakkarmelit
Keshem sheasur letaltel bechal hakkarmelit kach asur lehotzi mimmenna lirshut hayyachid o lirshut harabbim o lehachnis lecharmelit mershut hayyachid o mershut harabbim veim hotzi o hichnis patur

Hammotzi mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid o mershut harabbim lirshut harabbim vecharmelit baemtza patur vechen hammoshit o hazzorek mizzo lezo vecharmelit baemtza patur hammotzi chefetz mershut harabbim lecharmelit vehinnicho sham vechazar vaakaro mikkarmelit vehichniso lirshut hayyachid o shehotzio mershut hayyachid lecharmelit vehinnicho sham vechazar vaakaro mikkarmelit vehotzio lirshut harabbim hare ze patur

Hammotzi mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim veavar al mekom petor shehaya benehen bahalichato chayyav shemmehallech eno keomed veen tzarich lomar bezorek sheavar hachefetz bimkom petor sheeno chashuv kemi shennach sham haya omed bimkom petor venatal chefetz mershut hayyachid o meadam haomed sham vehinnicho birshut harabbim o beyad adam haomed sham patur vechen im hichnis mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid veamad bimkom petor patur

Ammud birshut harabbim gavoha asara verachav arbaa veen beikkaro arbaa veyesh baggovah hakkatzar shello shelosha hare hu reshut hayyachid veim zarak mershut harabbim venach al gabbav chayyav tel hammitlakket gove asara tefachim mittoch orech arba ammot hare hu reshut hayyachid veim zarak mershut harabbim venach al gabbav chayyav

Naatz kane birshut hayyachid afillu gavoha mea amma vezarak mershut harabbim venach al gabbav chayyav shershut hayyachid ola ad larakia ilan shehu omed birshut hayyachid venofo note lirshut harabbim vezarak venach al nofo patur sheen hannof holech achar haikkar

Naatz kane birshut harabbim uvrosho teraskal vezarak venach al gabbav patur sheen reshut harabbim ella ad asara hazzorek arba ammot birshut harabbim venach hachefetz bakkotel kegon shezzarak chelev o batzek venidbak bakkotel im nidbak lemala measara tefachim kezorek baavir shellemala measara birshut harabbim mekom petor hu nidbak lematta measara tefachim kezorek baaretz vechayyav zarak lemala measara venach bechor kal shehu patur

Zarak kane o romach mershut hayyachid venitka birshut harabbim keshehu omed patur shehare miktzato bimkom petor zarak keli mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim vehaya oto keli gadol veyesh bo arbaa al arbaa begovah asara patur mippene shekkeli ze reshut hayyachid gemura venimtza kemotzi mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid

Bor tisha birshut harabbim veakar chulya mikkarkaito vehishlimo laasara af al pi sheakirat hachefetz vaasiyyat hammechitztza bain keachat patur mippene shello hayeta hammechitztza asara battechilla haya habbor asara vehishlich bo chulya umiato measara patur shehare hannachat hachefetz vesilluk hammechitztza bain keachat
Hazzorek daf venach al gabbe yetedot birshut harabbim venaasa reshut hayyachid afillu haya keli al gabbe haddaf patur shehare asiyyat hammechitztza im nuchat hakkeli bain keachat

Bor shehu amok asara verachav shemona birshut harabbim vezarak machtzelet mershut harabbim vechilleka habbor berachbo lishnayim patur shehare im hannachat hakkeli batlu hammechitztzot venaasa kal makom mehen pachot mearbaa al arbaa

Bor birshut harabbim amok asara verachav arbaa male mayim vezarak letocho chefetz venach al gabbe hammayim chayyav sheen hammayim mevattelin hammechitztzot haya male perot vezarak letocho patur shehare miatu happerot et shiuro

Rekak mayim shehu over birshut harabbim verabbim mehallechin bo im en beamko asara tefachim hare hu kirshut harabbim ben shehaya rachav afillu arba ammot ben shello haya berachbo arbaa tefachim shehare rov haam medallegin alav veen mehallechin betocho hoil veen beamko asara hare hu reshut harabbim veim yesh beamko asara o yeter hare hu kecharmelit kishar hayyamim vehu sheyyesh berachbo arbaa tefachim o yeter al ken sheen karmelit pechuta mearbaa
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 15: Omed adam birshut harabbim umtaltel birshut hayyachid kullah veomed birshut hayyachid umittaltel birshut harabbim uvilvad shello yotzi chutz learbaa ammot veim hotzi patur mippene shehu birshut acheret vechen omed adam birshut hayyachid ufoteach birshut harabbim birshut harabbim ufoteach birshut hayyachid behema shehayeta rubbah bachutz veroshah bifnim ovsin otah uvgamal ad sheyehe rosho verubbo bifnim hoil vetzavaro aroch

Lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid veyishte birshut harabbim birshut harabbim veyishte birshut hayyachid ella im ken hichnis rosho verubbo lemakom shehu shote bamme devarim amurim keshehaya shote bechelim naim shehu tzarich lahen gezera shemma yotziem aval im hau kelim sheenan naim sheeno tzarich lahen o shehaya habbor becharmelit af al pi shehakkelim naim machnis rosho bilvad veshote bimkomo veaf al pi shello hichnis rosho verubbo

Omed adam birshut harabbim vekolet min haavir min hammayim hamkallechin min hatztzinnor o min hakkotel veshote uvilvad shello yigga batztzinnor o bakkotel veyiklot meal gabban veim naga im haya makom shennaga bo lemala measara befachot mishshelosha samuch laggag hare ze asur shennimtza keoker meal haggag shehu reshut hayyachid vechen im haya batztzinnor arbaa al arbaa ben shehaya hatztzinnor betoch asara ben shehaya lemala measara vekalat mimmennu mayim hare ze asur velamma eno chayyav mippene shello nachu hammayim ella hare hen nizchalin veholchin

Ziz shellifne hachallon yotze baavir sheal reshut harabbim im haya lemala measara tefachim muttar lehishtammesh alav sheen reshut harabbim tofeset ella asara tefachim lefichach muttar lehishtammesh bechal hakkotel ad asara tefachim hattachtonim

Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya ziz echad yotze baavir aval im hau yotzim bakkotel shene zizin ze lematta mizze af al pi sheshshenehem lemala measara im yesh bazziz haelon shellifne hachallon rochav arbaa al arbaa asur lehishtammesh alav mippene shehu reshut bifne atzmo vehazziz shettachtav reshut acheret veasru ze al ze sheen shette reshuot mishtammeshot birshut achat

En baelon arbaa veen battachton arbaa mishtammesh bishnehen vechen bechal hakkotel ad asara tefachim hattachtonim haya battachton arbaa vehaelon en bo arbaa eno mishtammesh baelon ella keneged challono bilvad aval bishar hazziz shebbishne tzidde hachallon asur lehishtammesh mippene ze shettachtav shechalak reshut leatzmo

Kal ziz hayyotze al avir reshut harabbim shemmuttar lehishtammesh alav keshehu mishtammesh bo en notnin alav veen notlin mimmennu ella kele cheres uzchuchit vechayyotze bahen sheim yippelu lirshut harabbim yishshavru aval shear kelim vaochalin asurim shemma yippelu lirshut harabbim viviem

Shene battim bishne tzidde reshut harabbim zarak mizzo lazo lemala measara patur vehu sheyyihu shenehem shello o sheyyihye benehem eruv vaafillu begadim uchle mattachot muttar lizrok veim haya ze lemala mizze velo haya beshave asur lizrok beged vechayyotze bo shemma yippol viviennu aval kele cheres vechayyotze bahen zorek

Bor birshut harabbim vechallon al gabbav habbor vechulyato mitztarfim laasara ummallein mimmennu beshabbat bamme devarim amurim keshehaya samuch lakkotel betoch arbaa tefachim sheen adam yachol laavor sham aval im haya muflag en memallein mimmennu ella im ken hayeta chulyato gevoha asara shennimtza haddeli kesheyyetze min hachulya yetze limkom petor

Ashpa birshut harabbim gevoha asara tefachim vechallon al gabbah shofchin lah mayim beshabbat bamme devarim amurim beashpa shel rabbim sheen darkah lehippanot aval shel yachid en shofchin aleha shemma titpanne venimtzeu shofchin kedarkan birshut harabbim

Ammat hammayim shehi overet bechatzer im yesh begavhah asara tefachim uvrachbah arbaa o yoter al ken ad eser ammot en memallein mimmenna beshabbat ella im ken asu lah mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim bakkenisa uvayetzia veim en begavhah asara o sheen berachbah arbaa memallein mimmenna belo mechitztza

Haya berachbah yeter meeser ammot af al pi sheen begavhah asara en memallein mimmenna ad sheyyaase lah mechitztza shekkal yeter al eser pirtza hi umafsedet hammechitztzot umahu letaltel bechal hechatzer im nishar mitztzad happirtza pas mikkan ufas mikkan bechal shehu o pas rochav arbaa tefachim meruach achat muttar letaltel bechal hechatzer veen asur ella lemalleot min haamma bilvad aval im lo nishar pas kelal asur letaltel bechal hechatzer shehare nifretza chatzer layyam shehu karmelit

Veheach maamidin et hammechitztza bemayim im hayeta lemala min hammayim tzarich sheyyihye tefach min hammechitztza yored betoch hammayim veim hayeta hammechitztza kullah yoredet betoch hammayim tzarich sheyyihye tefach mimmenna yotze lemala min hammayim kede sheyyihu hammayim shebbechatzer muvdalin af al pi sheen hammechitztza maggaat ad hakkarka hoil veyesh bah asara tefachim hare zo mutteret velo hittiru mechitztza teluya ella bemayim bilvad sheissur tiltul bemayim middivrehem vehekelu bimchitztza sheenah ella kede laasot hekker

Ammat hammayim haoveret ben hachatzerot vechallonot petuchot eleha im en bah kashshiur meshalshelin deli min hachallonot ummalleim mimmenna beshabbat bamme devarim amurim besheenah mufleget min hakkotel shelosha tefachim aval im hayeta mufleget min hakkotel shelosha tefachim en memalleim mimmenna ella im ken hau passin yotzin min hakketalim mikkan umikkan shennimtza haamma keillu hi overet betoch hechatzer

Ketzotzra shehi lemala min hayyam vechallon betochah al gabbe hammayim en memalleim mimmenna beshabbat ella im ken asu mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim al gabbe hammayim keneged hachallon shebbakketzotzra o tihye hammechitztza yoredet min hakketzotzra keneged hammayim veroin otah keillu yarda venaga ad hammayim uchshem shemmemallein mizzo sheasu lah mechitztza kach shofchin mimmenna al hayyam shehare al hakkarmelit hen shofchin

Chatzer shehi pechuta mearba ammot al arba ammot en shofchin betochah mayim beshabbat mippene shehen yotzin lirshut harabbim bimhera lefichach tzarich laasot guma machzeket satayim betoch hechatzer o birshut harabbim betzad hechatzer kede sheyyihu hammayim nikbatzim betochah vetzarich livnot aleha kippa mibbachutz kede shello terae hauka hazzot birshut harabbim vehechatzer vehaachsadra mitztarfin learba ammot vechamma hu hammakom shemmachazik satayim chatzi amma al chatzi amma berum shelosha chumshe amma

Hayeta hauka pechuta missatayim shofchin lah bemilluah hayeta machzeket satayim shofchin lah afillu shishshim sea shel mayim veaf al pi shehammayim yitgabberu veyafutzu meal hagguma lachutz bamme devarim amurim bimot haggeshamim shehachatzerot mitkalkelot ustam tzinnorot mekallechin velo yavou haroim lomar shezze mishtammesh birshut harabbim vehammayim yotzim mikkocho birshut harabbim aval bimot hachamma im hayeta machzeket satayim en shofchin lah ella satayim hayeta pechuta missatayim en shofchin lah kal ikkar

Biv sheshshofchin lo mayim vehen nizchalin veholchin tachat hakkarka veotzin lirshut harabbim vechen tzinnor sheshshofchin al piv mayim vehen nizchalin al hakkotel veordin lirshut harabbim afillu haya orech hakkotel o orech hadderech shettachat haaretz mea amma asur lishpoch al pi habbiv o al pi hatztzinnor mippene shehammayim yotzin mikkocho lirshut harabbim ella shofech chutz labbiv vehen yordin labbiv

Bamme devarim amurim bimot hachamma aval bimot haggeshamim shofech veshone veeno nimna shessetam tzinnorot mekallechin hen veadam rotze sheyyibbalu hammayim bimkoman haya shofech al pi habbiv vehammayim yotzin lecharmelit hare ze muttar vaafillu bimot hachamma shello gazru al kocho becharmelit lefichach muttar lishpoch al katle hassefina vehem yordin layyam

Lo yemalle adam mayim min hayyam vehu betoch hassefina ella im ken asa mekom arbaa al arbaa yotze min hassefina al hayyam bamme devarim amurim keshehaya toch asara aval im haya lemala measara min hayyam motzi ziz kal shehu ummalle shehare derech mekom petor memalle veeno tzarich leziz ze ella mishshum hekker

Hakkore besefer becharmelit venitgalgel miktzat hassefer lirshut harabbim umiktzato beyado im nitgalgel lechutz learba ammot hofcho al hakketav umannicho gezera shemma yishshamet kullo miyyado veyaavirennu arba ammot nitgalgel letoch arba ammot gollo etzlo vechen im nitgalgel lirshut hayyachid gollo etzlo haya kore birshut hayyachid venitgalgel lirshut harabbim im nach bah hofcho al hakketav veim lo nach ella haya taluy baavir reshut harabbim velo higgia laaretz gollo etzlo

Hammaavir kotz kede shello yizzoku bo rabbim im haya birshut harabbim molicho pachot pachot mearba ammot veim haya becharmelit molicho kedarko afillu mea amma vechen met shehisriach venitbazza yeter midday velo yachlu shechenim laamod motziin oto mershut hayyachid lecharmelit hayyored lirchotz bayyam keshehu ole menaggev atzmo shemma yaavir mayim shealav arba ammot becharmelit
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 16: Makom shello hukkaf ledora ella sheyyihye tashmisho laavir kegon gannot ufardesim uchgon hammakkif makom min haaretz leshamro vechayyotze bahen im yesh begovah hammechitztzot asara tefachim o yeter hare hu kirshut hayyachid lechayyev hammotzi vehazzorek vehammoshit mimmennu lirshut harabbim o mershut harabbim letocho veen metaltelin bechullo ella im ken yesh bo bet satayim o pachot aval im haya bo yeter al bet satayim asur letaltel bo ella bearba ammot kecharmelit

Vechen ammud sheggavoha asara tefachim verachav ad bet satayim metaltelin al kullo haya rachav al bet satayim en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot sela shebbayyam haya gavoha pachot measara metaltelin mittocho layyam umin hayyam letocho shehakkol karmelit haya gavoha asara im haya rachbo mearbaa tefachim ad bet satayim hoil umuttar letaltel bechullo en metaltelin lo mittocho layyam velo min hayyam letocho haya yeter mibbet satayim af al pi shehu reshut hayyachid hoil veasur letaltel bo ella bearba ammot kecharmelit hare ze muttar letaltel mittocho layyam umin hayyam letocho shezze davar sheeno matzuy hu velo gazru bo

Kamma hi bet sea chamishshim amma al chamishshim amma nimtza bet satayim makom sheyyesh betishbarto chameshet alafim amma vechal makom sheyyesh bo kammidda hazzot ben shehaya merubba shehu shivim amma veshirayim al shivim amma veshirayim ben shehaya agol ben shear hatztzurot hare ze nikra bet satayim

Makom shello hukkaf ledira sheyyesh bo bet satayim im haya arko pi shenayim kerachbo kede sheyyihye mea al chamishshim kachatzar hammishkan muttar letaltel bechullo aval im haya arko yeter al shenayim kerachbo afillu amma en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot shello asu bet satayim shettashmisho laavir kishar hachatzerot ella mechatzar hammishkan

Makom shehukkaf shello leshem dira im paratz bo pirtza yeter al eser ammot begovah asara tefachim vegadar bah leshem dira ad asara muttar letaltel bechullah vaafillu paratz amma ugdarah leshem dira ufaratz amma ugdarah leshem dira ad shehishlimah leyeter meeser muttar letaltel bechullah af al pi sheyyesh bo kamma milin

Makom yater mibbet satayim shehukkaf ledira im nizra rubbo hare hu keginna veasur letaltel bechullo nizra miuto im nizra mimmennu bet satayim muttar letaltel bechullo veim haya hammakom hazzarua yeter mibbet satayim asur letaltel bechullo nata rubbo hare hu kechatzer umuttar letaltel bechullo nitmalle mayim afillu hau amukkim harbe im hau reuyin letashmish hare hen kintaim umuttar letaltel bechullo veim enan reuyin letashmish en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot

Makom shehukkaf shello leshem dira sheyyesh bo bet shalosh sein vekeru bo bet sea keruo mattiro sheppi tikra yored vesotem nifratz bimloo lechatzer venifretza chatzer kenegdo chatzer mutteret keshehayeta vehakkarpaf asur keshehaya sheen avir hechatzer mattiro

Haya yeter mibbet satayim uva lemaato bailanot eno miut bana bo ammud betzad hakkotel gavoha asara verachav shelosha o yeter hare ze miut pachot mishshelosha eno miut shekkal pachot mishshelosha kelavud dami vechen im hirchik min hakkotel shelosha veasa mechitztza hare ze miut pachot mishshelosha lo asa kelum

Tach et hakkotel betit af al pi sheeno yachol laamod bifne atzmo hare ze miut hirchik min hattel shelosha veasa mechitztza hoil asa mechitztza al sefat hattel eno moil shehaose mechitztza al gabbe mechitztza eno moil nivlea mechitztza hattachtona vahare haelona kayyemet hoil venaaset haelona leshem dira vahare en sham nire ella hi hare ze hoil umuttar letaltel bechullah

Rechava sheachore battim yetera al bet satayim en metaltelin bah ella bearba vaafillu haya petach habbayit patuach letochah veim patach happetach lesham veachar kach hikkifa hare zo kemukkefet ledira umuttar letaltel bechullah

Rechava happetucha lammedina mitztzad echad umitztzad acher petucha lashshevil hammaggia lannahar ose lah lechi mitztzad hammedina veyihye muttar letaltel bechullah umittochah lammedina umin hammedina letochah

Yachid sheshshavat bevika veasa mechitztza saviv lo im yesh bah ad bet satayim muttar letaltel bechullah veim hayeta yeter al bet satayim eno metaltel bah ella bearba ammot vechen im hau shenayim aval shelosha yisreelim o yeter alehen sheshshavtu bevika hare hen shayyara umuttar lahem letaltel bechal tzarkan afillu kamma milin vehu shello yishshaer min hammechitztza shehikkifu bet satayim panuy belo kelim aval im nishar bet satayim panuy belo kelim velo hau tzerichim lo asurim letaltel bechal hammechitztza ella bearba ammot veen hakkatan mashlim leshayyara

Shelosha shehikkifu kede tzarkan vekanu shevita veachar kach met echad mehen hare hem muttarin letaltel bechullah kanu shenayim shevita beyeter mibbet satayim veachar kach ba lahem shelishi asurin letaltel ella bearba ammot keshehau kodem sheyyavo ze shehashshevita hi haggoremet lo haddiyyurin

Shelosha mekomot hammukkafin shello leshem dira ze betzad ze uftuchim ze laze shenayim hachitzonim rechavim vehaemtzai katzar shennimtzeu lashshenayim hachitzonim passin mikkan umikkan vehaya yachid baze veyachid baze veyachid baze naasu keshayyara venotnin lahem kal tzarkan haya haemtzai rachav ushnayim hachitzonim ketzarim shennimtza haemtzai befassin mishshene ruchotav hare hu muvdal mishshenayim hachitzonim lefichach im shavat yachid baze veyachid baze veyachid baze en notnin lahen kal tzarkan ella kal echad veechad yesh lo bet satayim bimkomo haya yachid baze veyachid baze ushnayim baemtzai o shenayim baze ushnayim baze veechad baemtzai notnin lahen kal tzarkan

Kal mechitztza sheyyesh bah parutz merubbe al haomed enah mechitztza aval im haya parutz keomed hare zo mutteret uvilvad shello yihye beotan happeratzot pirtza shehi yeter al eser ammot aval eser ammot hare hi kefetach im haya lefirtza zo tzurat petach af al pi sheyyesh bah yoter meeser enah mafsedet hammechitztza vehu shello yehe happarutz merubbe al haomed

Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 17: Mavoy sheyyesh lo shelosha ketalim hu hannikra mavoy satum umavoy sheyyesh lo shene ketalim bilvad ze keneged ze vehaam nichnasin beruach zo veotzin beshekkenegdah hu hannikra mavoy hamfullash

Heach mattirin mavoy hassatum ose lo beruach reviit lechi echad o ose alav kora vedayyo vetechashev otah kora o oto lechi keillu satam ruach reviit veyease reshut hayyachid veyihye muttar letaltel bechullo sheddin tora beshalosh mechitztzot bilvad muttar letaltel umiddivre sofrim hi haruach harviit ulfichach day lah belechi o kora
Veheach mattirin mavoy mefullash ose lo tzurat petach mikkan velechi o kora mikkan umavoy akom torato kimfullash
Mavoy shehu shave mittocho umidron lirshut harabbim o shave lirshut harabbim umidron letocho eno tzarich lo lechi velo kora shehare hu muvdal mershut harabbim
Mavoy shetztziddo echad kale layyam vetziddo echad kale leashpa shel rabbim eno tzarich kelum sheashpa shel rabbim enah asuya lehitpannot veen choshshin shemma yaale hayyam sirton

Mavoy mefullash shehu kale leemtza rechava shel rabbim im lo haya mechuvan keneged petach harchava hare ze kesatum veeno tzarich mitztzad harchava kelum aval im haya kale letzidde harchava asur veim hayeta shel yachid af leemtzaah asur peamim bone mitztzad echad venimtza kale letziddah shel rechava

En hammavoy nittar belechi o kora ad sheyyihu battim vachatzerot petuchot letocho veyihye arko mearba ammot ulmala veyihye arko yater al rachbo aval mavoy shearko kerachbo hare hu kechatzer veeno nittar ella bishne lechayayim mishshene ruchotav kal lechi bemashshehu o befas rachav arbaa meruach achat

Chatzer shearkah yeter al rachbah hare hi kemavoy venitteret belechi o kora umavoy sheen battim vachatzerot petuchot letocho kegon shello haya bo ella bayit echad o chatzer achat vechen mavoy sheen bearko arba ammot eno nittar ella bishne lechayayim o befas arbaa umashshehu

Mavoy sheen berachbo shelosha tefachim eno tzarich lo lechi velo kora umuttar letaltel bechullo shekkal pachot mishshelosha hare hu kelavud mavoy shehechshero bekora af al pi shemmuttar letaltel bechullo kirshut hayyachid hazzorek mittocho lirshut harabbim o mershut harabbim letocho patur shehakkora mishshum hekker hi asuya aval im hechshero belechi hazzorek mittocho lirshut harabbim o mershut harabbim letocho chayyav shehallechi hare hu kimchitztza beruach reviit

Shene ketalim birshut harabbim vehaam ovrim benehem ketzad machshir benehem ose delatot mikkan udlatot mikkan veachar kach yaase benehem reshut hayyachid veeno tzarich linol haddelatot ballayela aval tzarich sheyyihu reuot lehinnael hau meshukkaot beafar mefanne otan umtakkenan lehinnael aval tzurat petach o lechi vekora enan moilin behechsher reshut harabbim

Muttar letaltel bemavoy tachat hakkora o ben hallechayayim bamme devarim amurim beshehaya samuch lirshut harabbim aval im haya samuch lecharmelit asur letaltel tachat hakkora o ben hallechayayim ad sheyyaase lechi acher lehattir toch happetach shehare matza min et mino veneor

Bakkol osin lechayayim afillu bedavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim vaafillu beissure hanaya avoda zara atzmah o ashera sheasa otah lechi kasher shehallechi avo kal shehu govah hallechi en pachot measara tefachim rachbo veavo kal shehu

Bakkol osin kora aval lo baashera lefi sheyyesh lerochav hakkora shiur vechal hashshiurin asurim min haashera vechen rochav hakkora en pachot mittefach veavyah kal shehu vehu shettihye beria lekabbel ariach shehu chatzi levena shel shelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim umaamide kora tzerichin sheyyihu beriin kede lekabbel kora vachatzi levena

Kamma yihye petach hammavoy veyihye day lehachshiro belechi o kora gavho en pachot measara tefachim velo yeter al esrim amma verachbo ad eser ammot bamme devarim amurim shello haya lo tzurat petach aval im haya lo tzurat petach afillu haya gavoha mea amma o pachot measara o rochav mea amma hare ze muttar

Vechen im haya bekora shel mavoy kiyyur vetziyyur ad sheyyihu hakkol mistakkelin bah af al pi shehi lemala meesrim amma keshera shehakkora mishshum hekker asuya veim hayeta lemala meesrim enah nikkeret veim yesh bah tziyyur vechiyyur mistakkelim bah venimtza sham hekker

Mavoy shehaya gavho min haaretz ad karkait kora esrim amma vaovi hakkora lemala meesrim kasher haya gavho yeter meesrim uva lemaato bakkora shemmanniach otah lematta tzarich lihot berachbah tefach kekora haya gavho pachot measara chokek bo meshech arba al arba ammot umaamik kede lehashlimo laasara

Hammotzi or shello nitabbed kelal ella adayin hu rach shiuro kede latzur mishkolet ketanna shemmishkalah shekel haya maluach vaadayin lo naasa bekemach velo beappetza shiuro kede laasot kamea haya asuy bekemach vaadayin lo nitabbed beappetza shiuro kede lichtov alav et hagget nigmar ibbudo shiuro chamishsha al chamishsha

Hammotzi kelaf meubbad kede lichtov alav parashat shema ad uvisharecha duchsustus kede lichtov alav mezuza neyar kede lichtov alav shette otiyyot shel kesher mochsin shehen gedolot meotiyyot shellanu hammotzi kesher mochsin chayyav af al pi shekkevar herahu lammoches veniftar bo shehare reaya hi leolam hammotzi shetar parua unyar machuk kede lichroch al pi tzelochit ketanna shel pelayyaton veim yesh balloven shello kede lichtov shette otiyyot shel kesher mochsin chayyav
Hammotzi behema chayya veof af al pi shehen chayyim chayyav aval adam chay eno massooy veim haya kafut o chole hammotzi oto chayyav vehaishsha medadda et benah bizman shennotel achat umanniach achat

Hammotzi tinok chay vechis taluy betzavaro chayyav mishshum hakkis sheen hakkis tefela lattinok aval im hotzi et haggadol af al pi shehu melubbash bechelav vetabbeotav beyado patur shehakkol tefela lo hau kelav mekuppalin al ketefo hannose oto chayyav

Hammotzi chagav chay kal shehu umet kigrogeret tzipporet keramim ben chayya ben meta kal shehu mippene shemmatzniin otah lirfua vechen kal kayyotze bah hammet vehannevela vehashsheretz keshiur tumatan kach shiur hotzaatan met unvela kezayit vesheretz kaadasha

Haya sham kezayit metzumtzam vehotzi mimmennu kachatzi zayit chayyav shehare hoil bemaasav shennitmaet hashshiur milletamme aval im hotzi kachatzi zayit mikkezayit umechetza patur vechen kal kayyotze baze bishar hattumot
Bamme devarim amurim sheeno chayyav ella al hahotzaa kashshiur keshehotzi setam aval hammotzi lezera o lirfua o leharot mimmennu dugma ulchal kayyotze baze chayyav bechal shehu

Hammatznia davar lizria o lirfua o ledugma veshachach lamma hitznio vehotzio setam chayyav alav bechal shehu sheal daat machashava rishona hotzi ushar haadam en chayyavin alav ella keshiuro zarak ze shehotzi kevar letoch haotzar af al pi shemmekomo nikkar kevar batla machashavto harishona lefichach im chazar vehichniso eno chayyav ad sheyyachnis kashshiur

Davar sheen derech bene adam lehatznio veeno rauy lehatznia kegon dam hannidda im hitznio echad vehotzio chayyav ushar haadam peturin alav sheen chayyavin ella al hotzaat davar hakkasher lehatznia umatzniin kamohu

Hammotzi chatzi shiur patur vechen kal haose melacha min hammelachot chatzi shiur patur hotzi chatzi shiur vehinnicho vechazar vehotzi hachetzi haacher chayyav veim kadam vehigbiha hachetzi harishon kodem hannachat hachetzi hashsheni naasa kemi shennisraf ufatur hotzi chatzi shiur vehinnicho vechazar vehotzi chetzi acher veheeviro al harishon betoch shelosha chayyav shehammaavir kemi shehinniach al gabbe mashshehu aval im zerako eno chayyav ad sheyyanuach sham al gabbe mashshehu

Hotzi chatzi shiur vechazar vehotzi chatzi shiur behealem achat lirshut achat chayyav lishte reshuot im yesh benehen reshut shechayyavin aleha patur hayeta benehen karmelit hare hen kirshut achat vechayyav chattat
Hammotzi pachot mikkashshiur vekodem sheyyannicho nitpach vechazar kashshiur vechen hammotzi kashshiur vekodem sheyyanniach tzamak vechazar pachot mikkashshiur patur

Hammotzi kigrogeret laachila vetzamka kodem hannacha vechashav aleha lizria o lirfua sheeno tzarich shiur hare ze chayyav kemachashavto shel et hannacha hotzi pachot mikkigrogeret lizria vekodem hannacha chazar vechashav aleha laachila patur veim tafcha kodem hannacha venaaset kigrogeret kodem sheyyimmalech aleha laachila chayyav sheafillu lo chishshev haya mitchayyev al machshevet hahotzaa

Hotzi kigrogeret laachila vetzamka vechazra vetafcha kodem hannacha hare ze safek im nidcha o lo nidcha zarak kezayit ochalin levayit tame vehishlim kezayit ze laochalim shehau sham venaasa hakkol kevetza hare ze safek im nitchayyev al kezayit mippene shehishlim hashshiur leinyan tuma o lo nitchayyev

Hammotzi pachot mikkashshiur af al pi shehotzio bichli patur shehakkeli tefela lo veen kavanato lehotzaat hakkeli ella lehotzaat ma shebbetocho vahare en bo kashshiur lefichach im hotzi adam chay sheeno kafut bemitta patur af al hammitta shehammitta tefela lo vechen kal kayyotze baze hammotzi kuppat harochlim af al pi sheyyesh bah minin harbe vaafillu hotzian betoch kappo eno chayyav ella achat shem hotzaa achat hi
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 19: Kal kele hammilchama yotzin bahen beshabbat veim yatza im hau kelim shehen derech malbush kegon shiron vechova umaggafayim sheal haraglayim hare ze patur veim yatza bechelim sheenan derech malbush kegon romach vesayif vekeshet vealla utris hare ze chayyav

En yotzin besandal mesummar shessemaro lechazzeko vaafillu beom tov gazru alav shello yetze bo umuttar latzet beavnet sheyyesh alav chatichot kevuot shel kesef veshel zahav kemo shehammelachim osin mippene shehu tachshit vechal shehu tachshit muttar vehu shello yehe rafuy shemma yippol birshut harabbim veyavo lahavio

Tabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam mittachshite haish hi veenah mittachshite haishsha vesheen aleha chotam mittachshite ishsha veenah mittachshite haish lefichach ishsha sheyyatzat betabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam veish sheyyatza betabbaat sheen aleha chotam chayyavin umippene ma hen chayyavin vahare hotziu otan shello kederech hammotziin sheen derech haish lehotzi beetzbao ella tabbaat haruya lo vechen haishsha en darkah lehotzi beetzbaah ella tabbaat haruya lah mippene sheppeamim noten haish tabbato leishto lehatzniah babbayit umannachat otah beetzbaah beet holacha vechen haishsha notenet tabbatah levalah letakkenah etzel haumman umanniach otah beetzbao beet holacha ad chanut haumman venimtzeu shehotziu otan kederech sheddarkan lehotzian ulfichach chayyavin

Lo tetze ishsha betabbaat sheen aleha chotam af al pi shehu mittachshiteha gezera shemma totziah birshut harabbim leharot lechavroteha kederech shehannashim osot tamid veim yatzat bah petura aval haish muttar latzet betabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam mippene shehu tachshit veen darko leheraot venahagu kal haam shello yetzu betabbaat kelal

Ishsha sheyyatza bemachat nekuva chayyevet vehaish patur veish sheyyatza bemachat sheenah nekuva chayyav vehaishsha petura mippene shehi mittachshiteha veenah asura ella gezera shemma tare lechavroteha ze hakkelal kal hayyotze bedavar sheeno mittachshitav veeno derech malbush vehotzio kederech shemmotziin oto davar chayyav vechal hayyotze bedavar shehu mittachshitav vehaya rafuy veefshar sheyyippol bimhera veyavo lahavio birshut harabbim vechen ishsha sheyyatzat betachshitin sheddarkan lishlof otan ulharotan hare ellu peturin vechal davar shehu tachshit veeno nofel veen darkah leharoto hare ze muttar latzet bo lefichach etzada shemmannichin otah bazzeroa o bashshok yotzin bah beshabbat vehu shettihye devuka labbasar velo tishshamet vechen kal kayyotze baze

Lo tetze ishsha bechute tzemer o bechute pishtan o birtzuot hakkeshurot lah al roshah shemma tachlotz otah bishat tevila vetaavirah birshut harabbim velo betzitz shemmannachat ben eneha velo bilchayayim shel zahav sheyyordin min hatztzitz al lechayeha bizman sheenan tefurin ze baze velo baatara shel zahav shemmunnachat beroshah velo bichvalim sheyyotzin bahen habbanot beraglehen kede shello yifseu pesia gassa shello yafsidu betulehen kal ellu asurin latzet bahen beshabbat shemma yippelu utvien beyadah

Lo tetze ishsha bekatla shebbetzavara velo benizme haaf velo bitzlochit shel pelayyaton hakkevua al zeroah velo bakkis hakkatan heagol shemmannichin bo shemen hattov vehu hannikra kovelet velo befea shel sear shemmannachat al roshah kede shetterae baalat sear harbe velo bechavul shel tzemer shemmakkefet oto saviv lefaneha velo beshen shemmannachat befiha bimkom shen shennafal velo beshen shel zahav shemmannachat al shen shachor o adom sheyyesh beshshinneha aval shen shel kesef muttar mippene sheeno nikkar kal ellu asurin latzet bahen shemma yippelu utviem beyadah o tachlotz vetare lechavroteha
