Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 28: Kal bet dira shehu yotze min hammedina im haya beno uven hammedina shivim amma ushne shelishe amma shehu tzela bet satayim hamrubbaat o pachot mizze hare ze mitztaref limdina venechshav mimmenna uchshemmoddin lah alpayim amma lechal ruach moddin chutz mibbet dira ze

Haya bayit ze karov lammedina beshivim amma uvayit sheni karov levayit rishon beshivim amma uvayit shelishi karov lashsheni beshivim amma vechen ad mahalach kamma yamim hare hakkol kimdina achat uchshemmoddin moddin michutz labbayit haacharon vehu sheyyihye bet dira ze arba ammot al arba ammot o yeter

Vechen bet hakkeneset sheyyesh bo bet dira lechazzanin uvet avodat kochavim umazzalot sheyyesh bo bet dira lechohanehem vehaotzarot sheyyesh bahen bet dira vehaggesher vehakkever sheyyesh bahen bet dira veshalosh mechitztzot sheen aleha tikra veyesh bahen arba al arba ammot vehabburganin vehabbayit habbanuy bayyam ushte mechitztzot sheyyesh alehen tikra umara sheyyesh binyan al piha veyesh bah bet dira kal ellu mitztarfin immah im hau betoch shivim amma veshirayim umeoto habbayit hayyotze roin keillu chut matuach al pene kal hammedina umoddin chutz leoto hachut alpayim amma

Veellu sheen mitztarfin immah shette mechitztzot sheen alehen tikra af al pi sheddarin benehen vehaggesher vehakkever uvet hakkeneset uvet avodat kochavim umazzalot vehaotzarot sheen bahen bet dira vehabbor vehashshiach vehammeara vehashshovach uvayit shebbassefina kal ellu vechayyotze bahen en mitztarfin immah

Hau shette ayarot zo semucha lazo im yesh benehen mea vearbaim veachat ushlish kede sheyyihye shivim amma veshirayim lazo veshivim amma veshirayim lazo choshvin shettehen keir achat venimtzet kal ir mehen mehallechet et kal hair hashsheniyya vachutza lah alpayim amma hau shelosha kefarim meshullashin im yesh ben haemtzai uven kal echad veechad min hachitzonim alpayim amma o pachot mikkan uven hashshenayim hachitzonim matayim shalosh ushmonim pachot shelish kede sheyyihye ben kal echad mehen uven haemtzai keshettire oto keillu hu benehen mea vearbaim veachat amma ushlish hare shelashtan kimdina achat umoddin alpayim amma lechal ruach michutz lishlashtan ir shehukkefa ulvassof yashva moddin lah mishivatah yashva ulvassof hukkefa moddin lah mechomoteha

Ir shehayeta arukka o merubbaat hoil veyesh lah arba zaviyyot shaot mannichin otah kemot shehi umoddin lah alpayim amma lechal ruach mearba ruchoteha hayeta agulla osin lah zaviyyot veroin otah keillu hu betoch hamrubba umoddin chutz mitztzalot oto merubba alpayim amma lechal ruach shennimtza mistakker hazzaviyyot

Vechen im hayeta hair meshulleshet o sheyyesh lah tzelaot rabbot merabbein otah veachar kach moddin chutz lamrubba alpayim amma lechal ruach uchshehu merabbeah merabbeah beribbua haolam kede shettehe kal ruach mimmenna meshucha keneged ruach meruchot haolam umchuvenet kenegdah

Hayeta rechava mitztzad echad uktzara mitztzad echad roin otah keillu hi kullah rechava hayeta asuya kemin gam o shehayeta asuya kekeshet im yesh ben shene rasheha pachot mearbaat alafim amma moddin lah min hayyeter veroin et kal harochav shebben hayyeter vehakkeshet keillu hu male battim veim haya ben shene rasheha arbaat alafim en moddin lah ella min hakkeshet

Ir sheyyoshevet al sefat hannachal im yesh lefaneha dakka rochav arba ammot al sefat hannachal kede sheyyaamdu aleha veyishtammeshu bannachal nimtza hannachal bichlal hair umoddin lah alpayim amma missefat hannachal hashsheniyya veyease hannachal kullo bichlal hammedina mippene haddakka habbenuya mitztziddo veim lo haya sham dakka en moddin lahen ella mippetach battehen venimtza hannachal nimdad min haalpayim shellahem
Yoshve tzerifin en moddin lahen ella mippetach battehen veim yesh sham shalosh chatzerot shel shene shene battim hukbeu kullam umrabbein otah venotnin lahem alpayim amma lechal ruach kishar haayarot

En moddin ella bechevel shel chamishshim amma lo pachot velo yeter uvchevel shel pishtan kede shello yimmashech yoter midday higgia legaye im haya rachbo chamishshim amma sheyyachol lehavlio bechevel hammidda mavlio vehu sheyyihye beamko pachot mearbaat alafim
Bamme devarim amurim shehaya chut hammishkolet yored kenegdo shei efshar lehishtammesh bo aval im en chut hammishkolet yored kenegdo eno mavlio ella im ken haya amko alpayim o pachot mikken
Haya gaye meukkam mekadder veole mekadder veored haya gaye rachav mechamishshim sheeno yachol lehavlio holech lemakom shehu yachol lehavlio umavlio vetzofe keneged middato vechozer
Higgia lechotel en omrim yikkov et hakkotel ella omed rachbo veholech lo veim efshar lehishtammesh bo moddo medida yafa veim haya chut hammishkolet yored kenegdo moded rachbo medida yafa

Higgia lehar im haya har mitlakket mimmennu gavoha asara tefachim beorech chamesh ammot mavlio vechozer lemiddato veim haya gavoha harbe ad sheyyitlakket mimmennu asara tefachim mittoch meshech arba ammot omdo veholech lo veim eno yachol lehavlio kegon shehaya rachbo yeter mechamishshim mekaddero meat meat veze hu sheamru mekadderin beharim

Ketzad mekadderin beharim o begeaot sheeno yachol lehavlian ochazin shenayim chevel shel arba ammot haelon ochez ketzato mikkeneged margelotav vehattachton ochez bakkatze hashsheni keneged libbo vechozer haelon laamod bimkom hattachton vehattachton yored umarchik mimmennu middat hachevel vechen mitgalgelim veholchin ad shemmoddin et kullo uchsheyyelech hammoded lehavlia hahar o haggaye lo yetze chutz lattechum shello yiru oto haovrim veyomru middat techumin baa lechan

En somchin ella al medidat adam mumche shehu yodea middat hakkarka hau lanu techume shabbat muchzakin uva mumche umadad ribba battechum mehen umiet battechum shomin lo battechum sheribba vechen im bau shenayim mumchin umaddu hattechum echad ribba veechad miet shomin lamrabbe uvilvad shello yerabbe yeter mimmiddat alachsonah shel ir

Ketzad beet sheyerabbe ze nomar shemma harishon mikkeren alachson shel ir madad haalpayim ulfichach miet middato venimtza tzela hattechum beno uven hammedina pachot mealpayim veze haacharon madad alpayim mitztzela hammedina veen machazikin al harishon shettaa beoter al ze lefichach im ribba ze haacharon yeter al harishon afillu bachamesh meot ushmonim amma bekeruv shomin lo beoter al ze en shomin lo

Afillu eved afillu shifcha neemanin lomar ad kan techum hashshabbat veneeman haggadol lomar zachur ani shead kan hayinu baim beshabbat keshehayiti katan vesomchin al eduto bedavar ze shello amru chachamim baddavar lehachamir ella lehakel mippene sheshshiur alpayim amma middivrehem
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 29: Mitzvat ase min hattora lekaddesh et yom hashshabbat bidvarim shenneemar zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho kelomar zachrehu zechirat shevach vekiddush vetzarich lezachrehu bichnisato uvitziato bichnisato bekiddush hayyom uvitziato behavdala

Veze hu nosach kiddush hayyom baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav veratza vanu veshabbat kadsho beahava veratzon hinchilanu zikkaron lemaase vereshit techilla lemikrae kodesh zecher litziat mitzrayim ki vanu vacharta veotanu kiddashta mikkal haammim veshabbat kadshecha beahava uvratzon hinchaltanu baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hashshabbat

Veze hu nosach hahavdala baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hammavdil ben kodesh lechol uven or lechoshech ben yisrael laammim uven yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase baruch atta Adonai hammavdil ben kodesh lechol

Ikkar hakkiddush ballayela im lo kiddesh ballayela ben beshogeg ben bemezid mekaddesh veholech kal hayyom kullo veim lo hivdil ballayela mavdil lemachar umavdil veholech ad sof yom shelishi aval eno mevarech al haur ella belel motzae shabbat bilvad

Asur leadam leechol o lishtot yayin mishshekkadash hayyom ad sheyekaddesh vechen mishsheyyatza hayyom asur lo lehatchil leechol velishtot velaasot melacha o litom kelum ad sheyyavdil velishtot mayim muttar shachach o avar veachal veshata kodem sheyekaddesh o kodem sheyyavdil hare ze mekaddesh umavdil achar sheachal

Middivre sofrim lekaddesh al hayyayin ulhavdil al hayyayin veaf al pi shehivdil battefilla tzarich lehavdil al hakkos umeachar sheyyavdil veyomar ben kodesh lechol muttar lo laasot melacha af al pi shello hivdil al hakkos umvarech al hayyayin techilla veachar kach mekaddesh veeno notel et yadav ad sheyekaddesh

Ketzad hu ose lokeach kos shehu machazik reviit o yeter umdicho mibbifnim veshotfo mibbachutz ummalleehu yayin veochazo bimino umagbiho min hakkarka tefach o yeter velo yesayyea bismol umvarech al haggefen veachar kach mekaddesh uminhag pashut bechal yisrael likrot battechilla parashat vayechullu veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mekaddesh veshote melo lugmav umashke lechal bene chavura veachar kach notel yadav umvarech hammotzi veochel

En kiddush ella bimkom seudda ketzad lo yekaddesh bevayit ze veyochal bevayit acher aval im kiddesh bezavit zo ochel bezavit sheniyya velamma mekaddeshin bevet hakkeneset mippene haorchin sheochlin veshotin sham
Haya mitave lappat yoter min hayyayin o shello haya lo yayin hare ze notel yadav techilla umvarech hammotzi umkaddesh veachar kach botzea veochel veen mavdilin al happat ella al hakkos

Mi shennitkaven lekaddesh al hayyayin belele shabbat veshachach venatal yadav kodem sheyekaddesh hare ze mekaddesh al happat veeno mekaddesh al hayyayin achar shennatal yadav lasseudda umitzva levarech al hayyayin beom hashshabbat kodem sheyyisod seudda sheniyya veze hu hannikra kiddusha rabba mevarech bore peri haggafen bilvad veshote veachar kach yittol yadav veyisod veasur lo leadam sheyyitom kelum kodem sheyekaddesh vegam kiddush ze lo yihye ella bimkom seudda

Yesh lo leadam lekaddesh al hakkos erev shabbat mibbeod yom af al pi shello nichnesa hashshabbat vechen mavdil al hakkos mibbeod yom af al pi sheadayin hi shabbat shemmitzvat zechira leamrah ben bishat kenisato vitziato ben kodem leshaa zo kimat

Mi shehaya ochel beerev shabbat vekadash alav hayyom vehu betoch hasseudda pores mappa al hashshulchan umkaddesh vegomer seuddato veachar kach mevarech birkat hammazon haya ochel beshabbat veyatza hashshabbat vehu betoch seuddato gomer seuddato venotel yadav umvarech birkat hammazon al hakkos veachar kach mavdil alav veim haya betoch hashshetiyya posek umavdil veachar kach chozer lishtiyyato

Haya ochel vegamar achilato im hachnasat shabbat mevarech birkat hammazon techilla veachar kach mekaddesh al kos sheni velo yevarech vayekaddesh al kos echad sheen osin shette mitzot bechos echad shemmitzvat kiddush umitzvat birkat hammazon shette mitzot shel tora hen

En mekaddeshin ella al hayyayin harauy lenassech al gabbe hammizbeach lefichach im nitarev bo devash o seor afillu ketippat hachardal bechavit gedola en mekaddeshin alav kach anu morin bechal hammaarav veyesh mi shemmattir lekaddesh alav veomer lo neemar hayyayin harauy lenassech al gabbe hammizbeach ella lehotzi yayin sherecho ra o megulle o mevushshal sheen mekaddeshin al echad mehen

Yayin shettaamo taam chometz af al pi sherecho reach yayin en mekaddeshin alav vechen shemarim shennatan alehen mayim af al pi sheyyesh bahen taam yayin en mekaddeshin alehen bamme devarim amurim beshennatan al hashshemarim shelosha mayim vehotzi pachot mearbaa aval im hotzi arbaa hare ze yayin mazug umkaddeshin alav
Keli shehaya male yayin afillu machazik kamma reviiyyot im shata mimmennu meat hare ze pegamo venifsal veen mekaddeshin al hashshear mippene shehu keshiyyure kosot

Yayin sherecho reach hachometz vetaamo taam yayin mekaddeshin alav vechen yayin mazug vechen yen tzimmukim mekaddeshin alav vehu sheyyihu tzimmukim sheyyesh bahen lachluchit sheim yidroch otan yetze mehen divshan vechen yayin chadash miggitto mekaddeshin alav vesochet adam eshkol shel anavim umkaddesh alav bishato medina sherov yenah shechar af al pi shehu pasul lekiddush muttar lehavdil alav hoil vehu chamar hammedina

Keshem shemmekaddeshin belele shabbat umavdilin bemotzae shabbat kach mekaddeshin belele yamim tovim umavdilin bemotzaehen uvmotzae yom hakkippurim shekkullam shabbetot Adonai hen umavdilin bemotzae yamim tovim lechullo shel moed uvmotzae shabbat leom tov aval en mavdilim bemotzae yom tov leshabbat

Nosach kiddush yom tov baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bachar banu mikkal am verommanu mikkal lashon bachar banu vayegaddelenu ratza banu vayefaarenu vattitten lanu Adonai elohenu beahava moadim lesimcha chaggim uzmannim lesason et yom tov mikra kodesh hazze et yom chag hammatztzot hazze o chag hashshavuot o chag hassukkot zeman cherutenu o zeman mattan toratenu o zeman simchatenu beahava zecher litziat mitzrayim ki vanu vacharta veotanu kiddashta mikkal haammim umoade kadshecha besimcha uvsason hinchaltanu baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim veim chal lihot beshabbat mazkir shabbat vechotem kederech shechotem battefilla mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael vehazzemannim

Berosh hashshana omer vattitten lanu Adonai elohenu beahava et yom tov mikra kodesh hazze zichron terua mikra kodesh beahava zecher litziat mitzrayim ki vanu vacharta veotanu kiddashta mikkal haammim udvarcha emet vekayyam laad baruch atta Adonai melech al kal haaretz mekaddesh yisrael veom hazzikkaron veim chal lihot beshabbat chotem mekaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael veom hazzikkaron kederech shechotem battefilla
Belele yom tov mekaddesh al hayyayin kivshabbat veim en lo yayin o shehaya mitave lefat mekaddesh al happat vechen beom tov mekaddesh kiddusha rabba kederech shemmekaddesh beshabbat

Ketzad mevarchin belele yom tov shechal lihot beechad beshabbat battechilla mevarech al haggefen veachar kach mekaddesh kiddush yom tov veachar kach mevarech al hanner veachar kach mavdil vechotem behavdala hammavdil ben kodesh lekodesh veachar kach mevarech shehecheyanu
Kal lele yom tov uvlel yom hakkippurim omrim shehecheyanu uvishvii shel pesach en mevarchin shehecheyanu mippene sheeno regel bifne atzmo uchvar berech al hazzeman bitchillat happesach
Seder havdala bemotzae shabbat mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach al habbesamim veachar kach al hanner vechetzad mevarech al hanner bore meore haesh veachar kach mavdil

En mevarchin al hanner ad sheyyeotu leoro kede sheyyakkir ben matbea medina zo lematbea medina acheret veen mevarchin al hanner shel ovde kochavim umazzalot shessetam mesibbatan laavodat kochavim umazzalot veen mevarchin lo al hanner shel avodat kochavim umazzalot velo al hanner shel metim

Yisrael shehidlik meoved kochavim umazzalot o oved kochavim umazzalot miyyisrael mevarchin alav oved kochavim umazzalot meovde kochavim umazzalot en mevarchin alav haya mehallech chutz lakkerach veraa or im rov anshe hakkerach ovde kochavim umazzalot eno mevarech veim rov yisrael mevarech ur shel kivshan shel tannur veshel kirayim lechattechilla lo yevarech alav haggechalim im kesheyyachnis kesam benehen dolek meelav mevarchin alehen ur shel bet hammidrash im yesh sham adam chashuv shemmadlikim bishvilo mevarchin alav shel bet hakkeneset im yesh sham chazzan shehu dar sham mevarchin alav vaavuka lehavdala mitzva min hammuvchar veen mechazzerin al haur kederech shemmechazzerin al kal hammitzot ella im yesh lo mevarchin alav

Ur shehudlak beshabbat lechole ulchayya mevarchin alav bemotzae shabbat ur shehukdach min haetzim umin haavanim mevarchin alav bemotzae shabbat shehi hayeta techillat beriyyato bide adam aval en mevarchin alav bemotzae yom hakkippurim sheen mevarchin bemotzae yom hakkippurim ella al ur sheshshavat af al pi shehudlak lechole o lechayya beom hakkippurim mevarchin alav shehare shavat meavera

Yom tov shechal lihot beemtza shabbat omer behavdala hammavdil ben kodesh lechol uven or lechoshech uven yisrael laammim uven yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase kederech sheomer bemotzae shabbat shesseder hahavdalot hu mone veeno tzarich levarech lo al habbesamim velo al hanner vechen eno tzarich levarech al habbesamim bemotzae yom hakkippurim
Velamma mevarchim al habbesamim bemotzae shabbat mippene shehannefesh doevet litziat shabbat mesammechin otah umyashshevin otah bereach tov
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 30: Arbaa devarim neemru beshabbat shenayim min hattora ushnayim middivre sofrim vehen meforashin al yede hanneviim shebbattora zachor ve shamor veshennitparshu al yede hanneviim kavod vaoneg shenneemar vekarata lashshabbat oneg velikdosh Adonai mechubbad

Ezehu kavod ze sheamru chachamim shemmitzva al adam lirchotz panav yadav veraglav bechammin beerev shabbat mippene kevod hashshabbat umitattef betzitzit veoshev bechoved rosh meyachel lehakbalat pene hashshabbat kemo shehu yotze likrat hammelech vachachamim harishonim hau mekabbetzin talmidehen beerev shabbat umitattefim veomrim bou venetze likrat shabbat hammelech

Umikkevod hashshabbat sheyyilbash kesut nekiyya velo yihye malbush hchol kemalbush hashshabbat veim en lo lehachalif meshalshel tallito kede shello yehe malbusho kemalbush hachol veezra tikken sheyehu haam mechabbesim bachamishi mippene kevod hashshabbat

Asur likboa seudda umishte beerev shabbat mippene kevod hashshabbat umuttar leechol velishtot ad shettechshach veaf al pi chen mikkevod hashshabbat sheyyimmana adam min hammincha ulmala millikboa seudda kede sheyyikkanes leshabbat keshehu mitave leechol

Mesadder adam shulchano beerev shabbat veaf al pi sheeno tzarich ella lichzayit vechen mesadder shulchano bemotzae shabbat veaf al pi sheeno tzarich ella lichzayit kede lechabbedo bichnisato uvitziato vetzarich letakken beto mibbeod yom mippene kevod hashshabbat veyihye ner daluk veshulchan aruch leechol umitta mutztzaat shekkal ellu lichvod shabbat hen

Af al pi shehaya adam chashuv beoter veen darko likkach devarim min hashshuk velo lehitassek bimlachot shebbabbayit chayyav laasot devarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat begufo shezze hu kevodo chachamim harishonim mehem mi shehaya mefatztzel haetzim levashshel bahen umehen mi shehaya mevashshel o moleach basar o godel petilot o madlik nerot umehen mi shehaya yotze vekone devarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat mimmaachal umashke af al pi sheen darko bechach vechal hammarbe bedavar ze hare ze meshubbach

Ezehu oneg zehu sheamru chachamim shetztzarich letakken tavshil shamen beoter umashke mevussam leshabbat hakkol lefi mamono shel adam vechal hammarbe behotzaat shabbat uvtikkun maachalim rabbim vetovim hare ze meshubbach veim en yado masseget afillu lo asa ella shelek vechayyotze bo mishshum kevod shabbat hare ze oneg shabbat veeno chayyav lehatzer leatzmo velishl meacherim kede leharbot bemaachal beshabbat amru chachamim harishonim ase shabbattecha chol veal titztarech labberiyyot

Mi shehaya anog veashir vahare kal yamav keshabbat tzarich leshannot maachal shabbat mimmaachal hachol veim i efshar leshannot meshanne zeman haachila im haya ragil lehakdim meacher veim haya ragil leacher makdim

Chayyav adam leechol shalosh seuddot beshabbat achat arvit veachat shacharit veachat bemincha vetzarich lehizzaher beshalosh seuddot ellu shello yifchot mehen kelal vaafillu ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaka soed shalosh seuddot veim haya chole merov haachila o shehaya mitanne tamid patur mishshalosh seuddot vetzarich likboa kal seudda mishshelashtan al hayyayin velivtzoa al shette kikkarot vechen beyamim tovim

Achilat basar ushtiyyat yayin beshabbat oneg hu lo vehu shehayeta yado masseget veasur likboa seudda al hayyayin beshabbat uvyamim tovim bishat bet hammidrash ella kach haya minhag hatztzaddikim harishonim mitpallel adam beshabbat shacharit umusaf bevet hakkeneset veyavo leveto veyisod seudda sheniyya veyelech levet hammidrash yikra veyishne ad hammincha veyitpallel mincha veachar kach yikba seudda shelishit al hayyayin veyochal veyishte ad motzae shabbat

Asur lo laadam sheyehallech bearve shabbatot yoter mishshalosh parsaot mittechillat hayyom kede sheyyaggia leveto veod hayyom rav veyachin seudda leshabbat shehare en anshe beto yodin shehayyom yavo kede lehachin lo veen tzarich lomar im haya mitareach etzel acherim shehare mevayeshan mippene shello hechinu lahen davar harauy leorchin

Asur lehitannot velizok ulhitchannen ulvakkesh rachamim beshabbat vaafillu betzara min hatztzarot shehatztzibbur mitannin umatriin alehen en mitannin velo matriin beshabbat velo beyamim tovim chutz meir shehikkifuha ovde kochavim umazzalot o nahar o sefina hammittarefet bayyam shemmatriin alehen beshabbat leazran umitchannenin umvakkeshin alehen rachamim

En tzarin al ayarot shel ovde kochavim umazzalot pachot mishshelosha yamim kodem hashshabbat kede shettityashshev daat anshe hammilchama alehen velo yihu mevohalim utrudim beshabbat en mafligin bisfina pachot mishshelosha yamim kodem hashshabbat kede shettityashshev dato alav kodem hashshabbat velo yitztaer yeter midday velidvar mitzva maflig bayyam afillu beerev shabbat ufosek immo lishbot veeno shovet umitztzor letzidon vechayyotze bahen afillu lidvar harshut muttar lehaflig beerev shabbat umakom shennahagu shello yaflig beerev shabbat kelal en mafligin

Tashmish hammitta meoneg shabbat hu lefichach onat talmide chachamim habberiim meshammeshin millele shabbat lelele shabbat umuttar livol betula lechattechilla beshabbat veen baze lo mishshum chovel velo mishshum tzaar lah

Hashshabbat vaavodat kochavim umazzalot kal achat mishshettehen shekula keneged shear kal mitzot hattora vehashshabbat hi haot shebben hakkadosh baruch hu uvenenu leolam lefichach kal haover al shear hammitzot hare hu bichlal rishe yisrael aval hamchallel shabbat befarhesya hare hu keoved avodat kochavim umazzalot ushnehem keovde kochavim umazzalot lechal divrehem lefichach meshabbeach hannavi veomer ashre enosh yaase zot uven adam yachazik bah shomer shabbat mechallelo vego vechal hashshomer et hashshabbat kehilchatah umchabbedah umannegah kefi kocho kevar meforash bakkabbala secharo baolam hazze yeter al hassachar hatztzafun laolam habba shenneemar az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bamote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha ki pi Adonai dibber
Mishneh Torah, Sanctification of the New: Chadshe hashshana hem chadshe hallevana shenneemar lat chodesh bechadsho veneemar hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim kach amru chachamim hera lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe bemare hannevua demut levana veamar lo kaze ree vekaddesh vehashshanim sheanu mechashshevin hem shene hachamma shenneemar shamor et chodesh haaviv

Vechamma yetera shenat hachamma al shenat hallevana karov meachad asar yom lefichach kesheyyitkabbetz min hattosefet hazzot kemo sheloshim yom o pachot meat o yoter meat mosifin chodesh echad veosin otah hashshana shelosha asar chodesh vehi hannikret shana meebberet shei efshar lihot hashshana shenem asar chodesh vechach vechach yamim shenneemar lechadshe hashshana chodashim atta mone leshana veen atta mone yamim

Hallevana nisteret bechal chodesh veenah niret kemo shene yamim o pachot o yoter meat kemo yom echad kodem shettidbak bashshemesh besof hachodesh uchmo yom echad achar shettidbak bashshemesh veterae bammaarav baerev uvallayil shetterae bammaarav achar shennistera hu techillat hachodesh umonin meoto hayyom tisha veesrim yom veim yerae hayyareach lel sheloshim yihye yom sheloshim rosh hachodesh veim lo yerae yihye rosh hachodesh yom echad ushloshim veyihye yom sheloshim mechodesh sheavar veen nizkakin layyareach belel echad ushloshim ben shennira ben shello nira sheen lecha chodesh levana yoter al sheloshim yom

Chodesh sheyyihye tisha veesrim veyerae yareach belel sheloshim nikra chodesh chaser veim lo yerae hayyareach veyihye hachodesh sheavar sheloshim yom nikra chodesh meubbar venikra chodesh male veyareach sheyyerae belel sheloshim hu hannikra yareach shennira bizmanno veim nira belel echad ushloshim velo nira belel sheloshim hu nikra yareach shennira belel ibburo

En reiyyat hayyareach mesura lechal adam kemo shabbat bereshit shekkal echad mone shishsha veshovet bashshevii ella levet din haddavar masur ad sheyekaddeshuhu bet din veyikbeu oto hayyom rosh chodesh hu sheyyihye rosh chodesh shenneemar hachodesh hazze lachem edut zo tihye mesura lachem

Bet din mechashshevin becheshbonot kederech shemmechashshevim haitztagninim sheyyodin mekomot hakkochavim umahalacham vechokrim umdakdekim ad sheyyedu im efshar sheyyerae hayyareach bizmanno shehu lel sheloshim o i efshar im yadu sheefshar sheyyerae yoshvin umtzappin laedim kal hayyom kullo shehu yom sheloshim im bau edim udrashum vachakarum kahalacha veneemnu divrehem mekaddeshin oto veim lo nira velo bau edim mashlimin sheloshim veyihye chodesh meebbar veim yadu becheshbon shei efshar sheyyerae en yoshvim yom sheloshim veen metzappin laedim veim bau edim yodin bevadday shehen ede sheker o shenniret lahem demut levana min heavim veenah hallevana havaddait

Mitzvat ase min hattora al bet din sheyechashshevu veyedu im yerae hayyareach o lo yerae vesheyyidreshu et haedim ad sheyekaddeshu et hachodesh veyishlechu veodiu shear haam bee ze yom hu rosh chodesh kede sheyyedu bee ze yom hen hammoadot shenneemar asher tikreu otam mikrae kodesh veneemar veshamarta et hachukka hazzot lemoadah

En mechashshevin vekovin chodashim umabberin shanim ella beeretz yisrael shenneemar ki mitztziyyon tetze tora udvar Adonai mirushalayim veim haya adam gadol bechachma venismach beeretz yisrael veyatza lechutza laaretz velo hinniach beeretz yisrael kemoto hare ze mechashshev vekovea chodashim umabber shanim bechutza laaretz veim noda lo shennaasa beeretz yisrael adam gadol kemoto veen tzarich lomar gadol mimmennu hare ze asur likboa ulabber bechutza laaretz veim avar vekava veibber lo asa kelum

En kasher leedut hachodesh ella shene anashim kesherim haruyin lehaid bechal davar vedavar aval nashim vaavadim hare hen kishar pesule edut veen meidin av uvno sherau et hayyareach yelchu levet din lehaid lo mippene sheedut hachodesh keshera bikrovim ella sheim yimmatze echad mehen pasul mippene shehu gazlan vechayyotze bo mishshear happaslanut yitztaref hashsheni im acher veyaidu vechal happasul leedut middivre sofrim af al pi shehu kasher min hattora pasul leedut hachodesh

Din tora sheen medakdekin beedut hachodesh sheafillu kiddeshu et hachodesh al pi edim venimtzeu zommin beedut zo hare ze mekuddash lefichach hau barishona mekabbelin edut hachodesh mikkal adam miyyisrael shekkal yisrael bechezkat kashrut ad sheyyivada lecha shezze pasul mishshekkilkelu habbayetosim vehau sochrin anashim lehaid sherau vehem lo rau hitkinu shello yekabbelu bet din edut hachodesh ella meedim shemmakkirin bet din otan shehem kesherim vesheyyihu dorshin vechokrim baedut

Lefichach im lo yihu bet din yodim et haedim sherau et hayyareach meshallechin anshe hair shennira bah im haedim sherau edim acherim shemmezakkin otan levet din umodiin otan sheellu kesherim hem veachar kach mekabbelin mehem

Bet din mechashshevin badderachim shehaitztagninin mechashshevin bahem veodin hallevana keshetterae bechodesh ze im tihye bitzfon hashshemesh o bidromah veim tihye rechava o ketzara ulhechan yihu rashe karneha notin uchsheyyavou haedim lehaid bodkin otam ketzad reitem otah betzafon o bedarom lehechan hau karneha notot kamma hayeta gevoha biriyyat enechem vechamma hayeta rechava im nimtzeu divrehem mechuvanin lema shennoda bacheshbon mekabbelin otam veim lo nimtzeu divrehem mechuvanin en mekabbelin otam

Amru haedim reinuhu bammayim o beavim o baashashit o sherau miktzato barakia umiktzato beavim o bammayim o baashashit en zo reiyya veen mekaddeshin al reiyya zot amar echad reitiv gavoha beenay kemo shette komot veamar hashsheni kemo shalosh komot haya gavoha mitztarfin amar haechad kemo shalosh komot vehashsheni omer kemo chamesh en mitztarfin umitztaref echad mehem im sheni sheyyaid kemoto o yihye benehen koma achat

Amru reinuhu belo kavana vechevan shehitbonannu bo venitkavannu liroto lehaid shuv lo reinuhu en zo edut veen mekaddeshin aleha shemma avim nitkashsheru veniru kallevana vechalu vehalchu lahem amru edim reinuhu beom tisha veesrim shacharit bammizrach kodem shettaale hashshemesh urinuhu arvit bammaarav belel sheloshim hare ellu neemanim umkaddeshin al reiyya zo shehare rauhu bizmanno aval hariyya sheamru sherauhu beshacharit en nizkakin lah sheen anu achrain liriyyat shacharit uvyadua sheheavim hem shennitkashsheru venira lahem kilvana vechen im rauhu bizmanno uvlel ibburo lo nira hare ellu neemanin sheen anu achrain ella liriyyat lel sheloshim bilvad

Ketzad mekabbelin edut hachodesh kal mi sherauy lehaid sheraa et hayyareach ba levet din uvet din machnisim otan kullan lemakom echad veosin lahen seuddot gedolot kede sheyyihu haam regilin lavo vezug shebba rishon bodkin otan rishon babbedikot sheamarnu machnisin et haggadol veshoalin oto nimtzeu devarav mechuvanim lacheshbon machnisim et chavero nimtzeu divrehem mechuvanin edutan kayyemet ushar kal hazzugot shoalin otam rashe devarim lo shetztzerichim lahem ella kede shello yetzu befache nefesh kede sheyyihu regilin lavo

Veachar kach achar shettitkayyem haedut rosh bet din omer mekuddash vechal haam onim acharav mekuddash mekuddash veen mekaddeshin et hachodesh ella bishlosha veen mechashshevin ella bishlosha veen mekaddeshin ella chodesh shennire bizmanno veen mekaddeshin ella bayyom veim kiddeshuhu ballayela eno mekuddash vafillu rauhu bet din vechal yisrael velo amru bet din mekuddash ad shechashcha lel echad ushloshim o shennechkeru haedim velo hispiku bet din lomar mekuddash ad shechashcha lel echad ushloshim en mekaddeshin oto veyihye hachodesh meubbar velo yihye rosh chodesh ella yom echad ushloshim af al pi shenniret belel sheloshim sheen hariyya kovaat ella bet din sheamru mekuddash hem shekkovin

Rauhu bet din atzman besof yom tisha veesrim im adayin lo yatza kochav lel sheloshim bet din omrim mekuddash sheadayin yom hu veim rauhu belel sheloshim achar sheyyatzu shene kochavim lemachar moshivin shene dayyanin etzel echad mehem veyaidu hashshenayim bifne hashshelosha vikaddeshuhu hashshelosha

Bet din shekkiddeshu et hachodesh ben shoggin ben mutin ben anusim hare ze mekuddash vechayyavin hakkol letakken hammoadot al hayyom shekkiddeshu bo af al pi shezze yodea shettau chayyav lismoch alehem sheen haddavar masur ella lahem umi shetztziva lishmor hammoadot hu tziva lismoch alehem shenneemar asher tikreu otam vego

Edim sherau et hachodesh im haya benehem uven makom sheyyesh bo bet din mahalach layela vaom o pachot holchin umidin veim haya benehen yeter al ken lo yelchu sheen edutan achar yom sheloshim moelet shekkevar nitabber hachodesh

Edim sherau et hachodesh hare ellu holchin levet din lehaid vaafillu haya shabbat shenneemar asher tikreu otam bemoadam vechal makom shenneemar moed doche et hashshabbat lefichach en mechallelin ella al rosh chodesh nisan veal rosh chodesh tishre bilvad mippene takkanat hammoadot uvizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam mechallelin al kullan mippene karban musaf shebbechal rosh chodesh vechodesh shehu doche et hashshabbat

Keshem shemmechallelin haedim sherau et hachodesh et hashshabbat kach mechallelin immahen haedim shemmezakkin otan bevet din im lo hau bet din makkirin et haroin vaafillu haya ze shemmodia otan levet din ed echad hare ze holech immahen umchallel missafek shemma yimmatze acher veyitztaref immo

Haya haed sheraa et hachodesh belel hashshabbat chole markivin oto al hachamor vaafillu bammitta veim yesh lahen orev badderech lokchin haedim beyadan kele zayin veim haya derech rechoka lokchim beyadam mezonot vaafillu rauhu gadol venire lakkol lo yomru keshem sherinuhu anachnu rauhu acherim veen anu tzerichin lechallel et hashshabbat ella kal mi sheyyire hachodesh veyihye rauy lehaid veyihye beno uven hammakom shekkavua bo bet din layela vaom o pachot mitzva alav lechallel et hashshabbat velelech ulhaid

Barishona hau mekabbelin edut hachodesh bechal yom sheloshim paam achat nishtahu haedim millavo ad ben haarbayim venitkalkelu bammikdash velo yadu ma yaasu im yaasu ola shel ben haarbayim shemma yavou haedim vei efshar sheyyakrivu musaf hayyom achar tamid shel ben haarbayim amdu bet din vehitkinu shello yihu mekabbelim edut hachodesh ella ad hammincha kede sheyehe shahut bayyom lehakriv musafin vetamid shel ben haarbayim veniskehem

Veim higgia mincha velo bau edim osin tamid shel ben haarbayim veim bau edim min hammincha ulmala nohagin oto hayyom kodesh ulmachar kodesh umakrivin musaf lemachar lefi shello hau mekaddeshin oto achar mincha mishshecharav bet hammikdash hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay uvet dino sheyyihu mekabbelin edut hachodesh kal hayyom kullo vaafillu bau edim yom sheloshim besof hayyom samuch lishkiat hachamma mekabbelin edutan umkaddeshin yom sheloshim bilvad

Keshemmeabberin bet din et hachodesh mippene shello bau edim kal yom sheloshim hau olin lemakom muchan veosin bo seudda beom echad ushloshim shehu rosh chodesh veen olin lesham ballayela ella banneshef kodem alot hashshemesh veen olin lisudda zo pachot measara veen olin lah ella befat dagan vekitnit veochlin beet hasseudda vezo hi seuddat mitzva shel ibbur hachodesh haamura bechal makom

Barishona keshehau bet din mekaddeshin et hachodesh hau massiin massuot berashe heharim kede sheyyedu harchokim mishshekkilkelu hakkutim shehau massiin massuot kede lehatot et haam hitkinu sheyehu sheluchim yotzin umodiin larabbim ushluchim ellu enan mechallelin et yom tov velo et yom hakkippurim veen tzarich lomar shabbat sheen mechallelin et hashshabbat lekayemo ella lekaddesho bilvad

Al shishsha chodashim hau sheluchim yotzin al nisan mippene happesach veal av mippene hattaanit veal elul mippene rosh hashshana kede sheyyeshvu metzappin beom sheloshim leelul im noda lahem shekkiddeshu bet din yom sheloshim nohagim oto hayyom kodesh bilvad veim lo noda lahem nohagim yom sheloshim kodesh veom echad ushloshim kodesh ad sheyyavou lahem sheluche tishre veal tishre mippene takkanat hammoadot veal kislev mippene chanukka veal adar mippene happurim uvizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam yotzin af al iyyar mippene pesach katan

Sheluche nisan ushluche tishre en yotzin ella beom rosh chodesh achar shettaale hashshemesh ad sheyyishmeu mippi bet din mekuddash veim kiddeshu bet din besof yom tisha veesrim kemo sheamarnu veshamu mippi bet din mekuddash yotzin mibbaerev ushluche shear hashshishsha chodashim yesh lahem latzet mibbaerev achar shennira hayyareach af al pi sheadayin lo kiddeshu bet din et hachodesh hoil venire hachodesh yatzu shehare lemachar bevadday mekaddeshin oto bet din

Kal makom shehau hashsheluchin maggiin hau osin et hammoadot yom tov echad kakkatuv battora umkomot harchokim sheen hashsheluchim maggiin alehem hau osin shene yamim mippene hassafek lefi sheenam yodim yom shekkavu bo bet din et hachodesh e ze yom hu

Yesh mekomot shehau maggiin alehem sheluche nisan velo hau maggiin lahen sheluche tishre umin haddin haya sheyyaasu pesach yom echad shehare higgiu lahen sheluchin veyadu bee ze yom nikba rosh chodesh veyaasu yom tov shel chag hassukkot shene yamim shehare lo higgiu alehen hashsheluchin uchde shello lachalok bammoadot hitkinu chachamim shekkal makom sheen sheluche tishre maggiin sham osin shene yamim afillu yom tov shel atzeret
Vechamma ben sheluche nisan lishluche tishre shene yamim sheshsheluche tishre enan mehallechin beechad betishre mippene shehu yom tov velo baasiri bo mippene shehu yom kippur

En hashsheluchin tzerichin lihotan shenayim ella afillu echad neeman velo shaliach bilvad ella afillu taggar mishshear haam shebba kedarko veamar ani shamati mippi bet din shekkiddeshu et hachodesh beom peloni neeman umtakkenin et hammoadot al piv sheddavar ze davar heasuy lehiggalot hu veed echad kasher neeman alav

Bet din sheyyashvu kal yom sheloshim velo bau edim vehishkimu banneshef veibberu et hachodesh kemo shebbearnu beferek ze veachar arbaa o chamishsha yamim bau edim rechokim veheidu sherau et hachodesh bizmanno shehu lel sheloshim vaafillu bau besof hachodesh meayemin alehen iyyum gadol umatrifim otam bishelot umatrichin alehen bivdikot umdakdekin beedut umishtaddelin bet din shello yekaddeshu chodesh ze hoil veyatza shemo meubbar

Veim amdu haedim beedutan venimtzet mechuvenet vahare haedim anashim yeduim unvonim venechkera haedut karauy mekaddeshin oto vechozrin umonin leoto hachodesh miyyom sheloshim hoil venire hayyareach belelo

Veim hutzrechu bet din lehanniach chodesh ze meubbar keshehaya kodem sheyyavou haedim ellu mannichin veze hu sheamru meabberin et hachodesh letzorech veyesh min hachachamim haggedolim mi shecholek bedavar ze veomer leolam en meabberin et hachodesh letzorech hoil uvau edim mekaddeshin veen meayemin alehen

Lefichach rauy levet din lasum shene devarim ellu belibbam shehen zeman hariyya umkomah veshoalin et haedim bee ze makom reitem sheim hayeta keshet hariyya ketzara veyitten hacheshbon sheyyerae betzimtzum kegon shehayeta keshet hariyya maalot ve chalakim vehaya haorech harishon maalot beshave uvau edim sherauhu im haya bimot hachamma o shehau bemakom namuch choshshin lahen uvodkin otan harbe veim haya bimot haggeshamim o bemakom gavoha beoter vadday yerae im lo yihu sham avim hammavdilin

Vehitchilu limnot yom min yom rosh hachodesh hashsheni velel sheloshim lo nira hayyareach im tomar shekkach meabberin et ze veosin oto sheloshim vekovin rosh hachodesh hashshelishi yom kach efshar shello yerae hayyareach belel sheloshim gam mechodesh ze venimtzeu meabberin veholchin veosin chodashim achar sheloshim kal hashshana kullah venimtza bechodesh acharon efshar sheyyerae hayyareach belel bo o belel veen lecha devar sechok vehefsed yoter mizze

Umitkavvenin leolam becheshbonam sheim yerae hayyareach bachodesh habba yerae bizmanno o belel ibburo lo sheyyerae kodem zemanno shehu lel uvcheshbonot hariyya haellu shebbearnu yitbaer lecha veteda matay efshar sheyyerae umatay i efshar shello yerae veal ze somchin umabberin chodesh achar chodesh o osin chodesh chaser achar chodesh chaser ulolam en pochatin mearbaa chodashim hamubbarin beshana velo mosifin al shemona chodashim hamubbarin vegam leibbur chodashim ellu shemmeabberin lefi cheshbon osin seuddat ibbur hachodesh kemo sheamarnu beferek shelishi

Vechal shettimtza baggemara middevariyim shemmarin shebbet din somchin al hacheshbon umippi moshe missinay shehaddavar masur lahem veharshut beyadam lechasser o leabber vechen ze shechaser tisha chodashim bashshana vechal kayyotze baze hakkol al ikkar ze hu banuy bizman shello nire hachodesh bizmanno

Vechen ze sheamru chachamim shemmeabberin et hachodesh letzorech hu bechodashim ellu shemmeabberin otan lefi cheshbon veosin echad male veechad chaser veyesh lahem leabber chodesh achar chodesh o lechasser baze hu shemmeabberin letzorech mippene shello nire hayyareach bizmanno ella beet sheyyerae hayyareach bizmanno shehu techillat heoto nire achar shennitkabbetz im hashshemesh mekaddeshin leolam

Vechal haddevarim haellu bizman sheyyesh sham bet din vesomchin al hariyya aval bizmannim ellu en somchin ella al hakkevia beze hacheshbon haemtzai happashut bechal yisrael kemo shebbearnu bahalachot ellu

Yitbaer besifre hacheshbon hattekufot vehaggimatriyyaot sheim yerae hayyareach beeretz yisrael yerae bechal medinot haolam shehen lemaarav eretz yisrael umchuvanot kenegdah veim yitten hacheshbon shello yerae beeretz yisrael efshar sheyyerae bimdinot acherot shehen lemaarav eretz yisrael umchuvanot kenegdah lefichach im yerae hayyareach bimdina shehi lemaarav eretz yisrael en baze reaya shello yerae beeretz yisrael ella efshar shennire hayyareach beeretz yisrael
Aval im lo yerae hayyareach berosh heharim bammedina hammaaravit hamchuvenet keneged eretz yisrael beyadua shello nire beeretz yisrael

Vechen im lo yerae hayyareach beeretz yisrael beyadua shello nire bechal medinot haolam shehen lemizrach eretz yisrael umchuvanot kenegdah veim yerae beeretz yisrael efshar sheyyerae bimdinot mizrachiyyot veefshar shello yerae lefichach im yerae bimdina shehi lemizrach eretz yisrael umchuvenet kenegdah beyadua shennire beeretz yisrael veim lo nire bammedina hammizrachit en baze reaya ella efshar sheyyerae beeretz yisrael

Vechal ellu haddevarim keshehau hammedinot shebbammaarav veshebbammizrach mechuvanot kegon shehau notot litzfon haolam mishsheloshim maalot ad maalot aval im hau notot latztzafon yoter mizze o pachot mishpatim acherim yesh lahen shehare enan mechuvanot keneged eretz yisrael udvarim ellu shebbearnu beare mizrach umaarav enan ella lehaggid kal mishpete hariyya lehagdil tora ulhadirah lo sheyyihu bene mizrach o bene maarav somchin al reiyyat hayyareach o toil lahem kelum ella leolam en somchin ella al kiddush bet din shebbeeretz yisrael kemo shebbearnu kamma peamim

Lefi sheamru chachamim shebbochlal divarim shehau bodkin bahen et haedim omrin lahen lehechan haya hayyareach note kasher beenay lehodia derech cheshbon davar ze veen ani medakdek bo lefi sheeno moil biriyya kelal utchillat cheshbon ze leda netiyyat hammazzalot techilla

Haagulla shehi overet bemachatzit hammazzalot shebbah mahalach hashshemesh enah overet beemtza haolam mechatzi hammizrach lachatzi hammaarav ella nota hi meal hakkav hashshave hamsabbev beemtza haolam keneged tzafon vedarom chetzyah note latztzafon vechetzyah note laddarom

Ushte nekuddot yesh bah sheppogaat bahen baagullat hakkav hashshave hamsabbev beemtza haolam hannekudda haachat rosh mazzal tale hannekudda hashsheniyya shekkenegdah rosh mazzal moznayim venimtzeu shishsha mazzalot notot latztzafon mittechillat tale ad sof betula veshishsha notot laddarom mittechillat mazzal moznayim ad sof mazzal dagim

Nimtza rosh tale verosh moznayim mesabbev al hakkav hashshave ulfichach keshettihye hashshemesh bishne rashim ellu lo tihye nota lo latztzafon velo laddarom vetizrach bachatzi mizrach vetishka bachatzi maarav veyihye hayyom vehallayela shavin bechal hayyishshuv
Hare nitbarer lecha shekkal maala umaala mimmaalot hammazzalot nota latztzafon o laddarom veyesh lintiyyatah shiur verov verochav hannetiyya lo tihye yoter al shalosh veesrim maalot vachatzi bekeruv

Veellu hem hashshiurim shel netiyyot lefi minyan hammaalot shel mazzalot vehatchala matchelet mazzal tale maalot netiyyatam maalot maalot netiyyatam maalot maalot netiyyatam maalot umechetza um maalot netiyyatam maalot maalot netiyyatam maalot maalot netiyyatam maalot maalot netiyyatam maalot maalot netiyyatam maalot maalot netiyyatam maalot vachatzi maala

Veim yihu achadim beminyan tikkach lahem menatam mibben shette hannetiyyot kemo shebbearnu bashshemesh uvayyareach ketzad chamesh maalot netiyyatam shette maalot veim haya minyan hammaalot netiyyatam maalot veal derech zo bechal haachadim shehen im haasarot

Umeachar shetteda hannetiyya shel maalot meachat ad teda netiyyatam kullan kederech shehodanucha berochav hayyareach sheim haya hamminyan yeter al ad tigra oto mikf veim haya yoter al ad tigra mimmennu veim haya yoter al ad tigra oto mishs vehannishar teda netiyyato vehu netiyyat oto hamminyan shebbeyadcha belo geraon velo tosefet

Im tirtze leda kamma maalot hu hayyareach note meal hakkav hashshave keneged tzefon haolam o keneged derom haolam teda techilla kamma netiyyat hammaala shehi mekom hayyareach haamitti ule ze ruach hi nota latztzafon o laddarom vetachazor vetachshov vetotzi rochav hayyareach harishon vetire im hu tzefoni o deromi im nimtzeu rochav hayyareach untiyyat maalato beruach achat kegon shehau shenehem tzefonim o deromiyyim tekabbetz shenehem veim nimtzeu bishte ruchot kegon shehaya haechad deromi vehaechad tzefoni tigra hammeat mishshenehem min harav vehannishar hu merchak hayyareach meal hakkav hashshave beotah haruach shehaya bah harav bishnehem

Ketzad banu leda kamma hayyareach note meal hakkav hashshave belel hariyya shehu sheni lechodesh iyyar mishshana zo uchvar yadata shemmaalat hayyareach hayeta mimmazzal shor netiyyatah batztzafon kemo maalot verochav hayyareach haya baddarom kemo maalot tigra hammeat min harav yishshaer maalot venimtza hayyareach rachok meal hakkav hashshave maalot leruach tzafon shehare hamminyan harav shehu shemone esre maalot haya tzefoni vechal cheshbon ze bekeruv belo dikduk lefi sheeno moil biriyya

Im tirtze leda lee zo ruach meruchot haolam yerae hayyareach note tachshov veteda merchakko meal hakkav hashshave im yihye al hakkav hashshave o karov mimmennu bishtayim o shalosh maalot batztzafon o baddarom yerae mechuvan keneged emtza maarav veterae pegimato mechuvenet keneged mizrach haolam beshave
Veim yihye rachok meal hakkav hashshave litzfon haolam yerae ben maarav haolam uven tzefono veterae pegimato nota mikkeneged mizrach haolam keneged derom haolam
Veim haya rachok meal hakkav hashshave lidrom haolam yerae ben maarav haolam uven deromo veterae pegimato nota mikkeneged mizrach haolam keneged tzefon haolam ulfi rov hammerchak ulfi rov hannetiyya

Umechakirat haedim sheomrin lahem kamma haya gavoha vedavar ze yivada mikkeshet hariyya shebbizman shettihye keshet hariyya ketzara yerae hayyareach keillu hu karov min haaretz uvizman shettihye arukka yerae gavoha meal haaretz ulfi orech keshet hariyya lefi gavho meal haaretz biriyyat haenayim

Hare bearnu cheshbonot kal hadderachim shetztzerichin lahem bidiat hariyya uvachakirat haedim kede sheyyihye hakkol yadua lammevinim velo yechseru derech middarche hattora velo yeshottu levakkesh achareha bisfarim acherim dirshu meal sefer Adonai vekiru achat mehenna lo nedara salik hilchot kiddush hachodesh
Mishneh Torah, Scroll of Esther and Hanu: Keriat hammegilla bizmannah mitzvat ase middivre sofrim vehaddevarim yeduim shehi takkanat hanneviim vehakkol chayyavim bikriatah anashim venashim vegerim vaavadim meshuchrarim umchannechin et hakketannim likrotah vaafillu kohanim baavodatan mevattelin avodatan uvain lishmoa mikra megilla vechen mevattelim talmud tora lishmoa mikra megilla kal vachomer lishar mitzot shel tora shekkullan nidchin mippene mikra megilla veen lecha davar shennidche mikra megilla mippanav chutz mimmet mitzva sheen lo kovrin shehappogea bo kovro techilla veachar kach kore
Echad hakkore veechad hashshomea min hakkore yatza yede chovato vehu sheyyishma mippi mi shehu chayyav bikriatah lefichach im haya hakkore katan o shote hashshomea mimmennu lo yatza

Mitzva likrot et kullah umitzva likrotah ballayela uvayyom vechal hallayela kasher likriat hallayela vechal hayyom kasher likriat hayyom umvarech kodem keriatah ballayela shalosh berachot veellu hen baruch atta Adonai elokenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al mikra megilla baruch atta Adonai elokenu melech haolam sheasa nissim laavotenu bayyamim hahem uvazzeman hazze baruch atta Adonai elokenu melech haolam shehecheyanu vekiyemanu vehiggianu lazzeman hazze uvayyom eno chozer umvarech shehecheyanu umakom shennahagu levarech achareha mevarech baruch atta Adonai elokenu melech haolam hael harav et rivenu vehaddan et dinenu vehannokem et nikmatenu vehannifra lanu mitztzarenu vehamshallem gemul lechal oyeve nafshenu baruch atta Adonai hannifra leyisrael mikkal tzarehem hael hammoshia

Ezehu zeman keriatah zemannim harbe tikkenu lah chachamim shenneemar bizmannehem veellu hen zemanne keriatah kal medina shehayeta mukkefet choma mime yehoshua bin nun ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz af al pi sheen lah achshav choma korin betv baadar umdina zo hi hannikret kerach vechal medina shello hayeta mukkefet choma bimot yehoshua veaf al pi shehi mukkefet atta korin bed umdina zo hi hannikret ir

Shushan habbira af al pi shello hayeta mukkefet choma bime yehoshua bin nun korin betv shebbah haya hannes shenneemar venoach bachamishsha asar bo velamma talu haddavar bime yehoshua kede lachalok kavod leeretz yisrael shehayeta chareva beoto hazzeman kede sheyyihu korin kivne shushan veyechashvu keillu hen kerakkin hammukkafin choma af al pi shehen atta charevin hoil vehau mukkafin bime yehoshua korin betv veyihye zikkaron leeretz yisrael benes ze

Bene hakkefarim sheenam mitkabbetzim bevatte kenesiyyot ella besheni uvachamishi tikkenu lahem sheyyihu makdimin vekorim beom hakkenisa ketzad im chal yom lihot besheni o bachamishi korin bo bayyom veim chal beom acher chutz mishsheni vachamishi makdimin vekorin besheni o bachamishi hassamuch led

Ketzad chal lihot beechad beshabbat makdimin vekorin bachamishi shehu yom chal lihot bishlishi korin besheni shehu yom chal lihot birvii korin besheni shehu yom vechal ellu shemmakdimin vekorin kodem en korin otah befachot measara

Kefar shemmakdimin vekorin beom hakkenisa bizman sheen nichnasin bo besheni uvachamishi en korin otah ella bed vechal ir sheen bah asara batlanin kevuin bevet hakkeneset letzarche hatztzibbur hare hi kichfar umakdimin vekorin beom hakkenisa veim en sham asara bene adam takkanato kalkalato vahare hem keanshe ir gedola veen korin ella bed

Bamme devarim amurim shemmakdimin vekorin beom hakkenisa bizman sheyyesh lahem leyisrael malchut aval bazzeman hazze en korin otah ella bizmannah shehu yom veom bene hakkefarim uvne ayarot korin bed uvne kerakkin korin betv

Ben ir shehalach lakkerach o ben kerach shehalach lair im haya dato lachazor limkomo bizman keria venitakkev velo chazar kore kimkomo veim lo haya bedato lachazor ella leachar zeman hakkeria kore im anshe hammakom shehu sham uchrach vechal hassamuch lo vechal hannire immo im en benehem yeter al alpayim amma hare ze kichrach vekorin bachamishsha asar

Ir shehi safek veen yadua im hayeta mukkefet choma bimot yehoshua bin nun o achar ken hukkefa korin bishne hayyamim shehen vetv uvlelehem umvarchin al keriatah bed bilvad hoil vehu zeman keriatah lerov haolam
Karu et hammegilla baadar rishon veachar kach ibberu bet din et hashshana chozrim vekorim otah baadar hashsheni bizmannah

En korin et hammegilla beshabbat gezera shemma yittol otah beyado veyelech etzel mi shehu baki likrotah veyaavirenna arba ammot birshut harabbim shehakkol chayyavim bikriatah veen hakkol bekiin bikriatah lefichach im chal zeman keriatah beshabbat makdimin vekorin otah kodem hashshabbat veshoalin vedorshin behilchot purim beotah shabbat kede lehazkir shehu purim

Ketzad yom arbaa asar shechal lihot beshabbat bene ayarot makdimin vekorin beerev shabbat uvne kerakkim korim bizmannam beechad beshabbat chal yom lihot beshabbat bene kerakkim makdimin vekorin beerev shabbat shehu yom arbaa asar uvne ayarot korin bo bayyom shehu zemannam venimtzeu hakkol korin bearbaa asar

Hakore et hammegilla lemafrea lo yatza kara veshachach pasuk echad vekara pasuk sheni lo vechazar vekara pasuk sheshshachach vechazar vekara pasuk shelishi lo yatza mippene shekkara pasuk echad lemafrea ella ketzad ose matchil mippasuk sheni sheshshachach vekore al hasseder

Matza tzibbur shekkaru chetzyah lo yomar ekra chetzyah haacharon im hatztzibbur veechezor veekra chetzyah rishon shezze kore lemafrea ella kore mittechilla vead sof al hasseder kara veshaha meat vechazar vekara af al pi sheshshaha kede ligmor et kullah hoil vekara al hasseder yatza

Hakkore et hammegilla al pe lo yatza yede chovato halloez sheshshama et hammegilla hakketuva bilshon hakkodesh uvichtav hakkodesh af al pi sheeno yodea ma hen omrin yatza yede chovato vechen im hayeta ketuva yevanit ushmaah yatza af al pi sheeno makkir vaafillu haya hashshomea ivri

Hayeta ketuva targum o belashon acheret milleshonot haggoyim lo yatza yede chovato bikriatah ella hammakkir otah hallashon bilvad vehu shettihye ketuva bichtav oto hallashon aval im hayeta ketuva bichtav ivri ukraah aramit laarami lo yatza shennimtza ze kore al pe vechevan shello yatza yede chovato hakkore lo yatza hashshomea mimmennu

Hakkore et hammegilla belo kavana lo yatza ketzad haya kotvah o dorshah o maggihah im kiven et libbo latzet bikria zo yatza veim lo kivin libbo lo yatza kara vehu mitnamnem hoil velo nirdam bashshena yatza

Bamme devarim amurim shehamchaven libbo bakketiva yatza beshennitkaven latzet bakkeria shekkore besefer shemmatik mimmennu beshaa shehu kotev aval im lo nitkaven latzet bikria zo shekkatav lo yatza sheeno yotze yede chovato ella bikriatah missefer shekkullah ketuva bo bishat keria

Hakkore et hammegilla vetaa bikriatah vekara keria meshubbeshet yatza lefi sheen medakdekin bikriatah keraah omed o yoshev yatza vaafillu betzibbur aval lo yikra betzibbur yoshev lechattechilla mippene kevod hatztzibbur kerauha shenayim afillu asara keechad yatzu hakkorin vehashshomim min hakkorin vekore otah gadol im hakkatan vaafillu betzibbur

En korin betzibbur bimgilla hakketuva ben hakketuvim veim kara lo yatza ella im ken hayeta yetera al shear hayeriot o chasera kede sheyehe lah hekker aval hayyachid kore bah vaafillu enah chasera velo yetera veotze bah yede chovato

En kotvin hammegilla ella bido al haggevil o al hakkelaf kesefer tora veim ketavah beme appetza vekankantom keshera ketavah bishar mine tzivonin pesula utzricha sirtut kattora atzmah veen haor shellah tzarich leabbed lishmah hayeta ketuva al hanneyar o al or sheeno meubbad o shekketavah akkum o eppikoros pesula

Hau bah otiyyot metushtashot o mekoraot im rishshuman nikkar afillu hau rubbah keshera veim en rishshuman nikkar im haya rubbah shalem keshera veim lav pesula vehakkore bah lo yatza hishmit bah hassofer otiyyot o pesukim ukraan hakkore et hammegilla al pe yatza

Hammegilla tzericha shettehe tefura kullah ad sheyyihu kal oroteha megilla achat veenah nitperet ella begidin kesefer tora veim tefarah shello begidin pesula veeno tzarich litpor et kal hayeria begidin kesefer tora ella afillu tafar begidin shalosh tefirot biktze hayeria veshalosh beemtzaah veshalosh bakkatze hashsheni keshera mippene shennikret iggeret

Vetzarich hakkore likrot aseret bene haman vaaseret binshima achat kede lehodia lechal haam shekkullam nitlu venehergu keechad uminhag kal yisrael shehakkore hammegilla kore ufoshet keiggeret leharot hannes uchsheyyigmor chozer vechorchah kullah umvarech

Shene hayyamim haellu shehen vetv asurin behesped vetaanit lechal adam bechal makom ben livne kerakkin shehen osin bilvad ben livne ayarot shehen osin bilvad ushne hayyamim asurin behesped vetaanit baadar harishon uvaadar hashsheni anshe kefarim shehikdimu vekaru besheni o bachamishi hassamuch lefurim muttarim behesped vetaanit beom keriatah vaasurin behesped vetaanit bishne hayyamim haellu af al pi sheen korin bahen

Veellu hen sheva berachot baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam yotzer haadam baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shehakkol bara lichvodo baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher yatzar et haadam betzalmo betzelem demut tavnito vehitkin lo mimmennu binyan ade ad baruch atta Adonai yotzer haadam sos tasis vetagel akara bekibbutz baneha letochah besimcha baruch atta Adonai mesammeach tziyyon bevaneha sammeach tesammach reim vaahuvim kesammechacha yetzircha began eden mikkedem baruch atta Adonai mesammeach chatan vechalla baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bara sason vesimcha chatan vechalla gila verinna ditza vechedva ahava achava shalom vereut mehera Adonai elohenu yishshama beare yehuda uvchutzot yerushalayim kol sason vekol simcha kol chatan vekol kalla kol mitzhalot chatanim mechuppatam unarim minneginatam baruch atta Adonai mesammeach chatan im hakkalla

Shachach velo hizkir beshabbat o beom tov kedushshat hayyom im nizkar kodem sheyyatchil bivracha reviit beshabbat omer baruch Adonai asher natan menucha leammo yisrael leot velivrit kodesh baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hashshabbat beom tov omer baruch asher natan yamim tovim leammo yisrael lesashon ulsimcha baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim umatchil bevirkat reviit vegomer veim nizkar achar shehitchil bivracha reviit posek vechozer larosh shehu birkat hazzan

Berashe chodashim shachach velo amar yaale veyavo im nizkar kodem sheyyatchil beracha reviit omer baruch asher natan rashe chodashim leammo yisrael lezikkaron veeno chotem bah umatchil bivracha reviit vegomer veim nizkar achar shehitchil bivracha reviit gomer otah veeno chozer vechen bechullo shel moed uvachanukka uvfurim shachach velo hizkir hainyan bevirkat hammazon eno chozer

Mi sheachal veshachach velo berech im nizkar kodem sheyyitakkel hammaachal shebbemeav chozer umvarech nitakkel hammazon shebbemeav eno chozer umvarech vechen im neelam mimmennu velo yada im berech o lo berech chozer umvarech vehu shello nitakkel hammazon shebbemeav
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 3: Chamishsha minin hen hachittin vehasseorin vehakkussemin veshibbolet shual veshipon hakkussemin mimmin hachittin veshibbolet shual veshipon mimmin hasseorim vachamishsha minin haellu keshehen shibbolim nikraim tevua bechal makom veachar sheddashin vezorin otan nikrain dagan uchshettochanin otan velashin et kimchan veofin otan nikrain pat vehappat hannaase meechad mehen hi hannikret pat bechal makom belo liuuy

Haochel pat chayyav levarech lefaneha baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hammotzi lechem min haaretz ulachareha arba berachot achal dagan shaluk kemo shehu mevarech lefanav bore peri haadama ulacharav bore nefashot rabbot achal kemach mevarech lefanav shehakkol ulacharav bore nefashot rabbot

Kemach shel echad mechameshet hamminin sheshshelakuhu veervu bemayim o bishar mashkim im haya ave kede sheyyihye rauy laachila ullaoso mevarech alav battechilla bore mine mezonot ulvassof al hammichya veal hakkalkala veim haya rach kede sheyyihye rauy lishtiyya mevarech alav battechilla shehakkol ulvassof bore nefashot rabbot

Kemach shel echad mechameshet hamminin shebbishshelo bikdera ben levaddo ben sheervo im devarim acherim kegon levivot vechayyotze bahen vechen haddagan shechilleko o ketasho uvishshelo bikdera kegon harifot vegeres hakkarmel vechayyotze bahen vechal ze hu hannikra maase kedera vechen kal tavshil sheerev bo mechameshet hamminin ben kemach ben pat battechilla mevarech alav bore mine mezonot

Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hammin hazze chashuv etzlo velo haya tefela aval im haya echad mechameshet hamminin sheerev tefela eno mevarech ella al haikkar ufoter et hattefela veze kelal bivrachot kal shehu ikkar veimmo tefela mevarech al haikkar ufoter et hattefela ben shehayeta hattefela meorevet im haikkar ben shello hayeta meorevet

Ketzad hi hattefela hamorevet kegon lefet o keruv shebbishshelo veerev bo kemach shel echad mechameshet hamminin kede ledabbeko eno mevarech alav bore mine mezonot shehallefet hu haikkar vekimcho tefela shekkal davar shemmearvin oto ledabbek o kede litten reach o kede litzboa et hattavshil hare zo tefela aval im erev kede litten taam battaarovot hare hu ikkar lefichach mine devash shemmevashshelin otan venotnin bahen chelev chitta kede ledabbek veosin mehen mine metika eno mevarech alav bore mine mezonot mippene shehaddevash hu haikkar

Ketzad hi hattefela sheenah meorevet hare shetztzarich leechol dag maliach veachal happat immo kede shello yazzik hammelach gerono ulshono hare ze mevarech al hammaliach ufoter et happat mippene shehappat tefela lo vechen kal kayyotze baze

Happat sheppatat otah pittim uvishlah bikdera o lashah bemarak im yesh bappetitin kezayit o shenikkar shehen pat velo nishtanna tzuratah mevarech aleha battechilla hammotzi veim en bahen kezayit o sheubbera tzurat happat babbishshul mevarech aleha battechilla bore mine mezonot

Issa shenneefet bakkarka kemo shehaarviyyim shochne hammidbarot ofim hoil veen aleha tzurat pat mevarech aleha battechilla bore mine mezonot veim kava mezono aleha mevarech hammotzi vechen issa shellashah bidvash o beshemen o bechalav o sheerev bah mine tavlin vaafaah vehi hannikret pat habbaa bechisnin af al pi shehu pat mevarech aleha bore mine mezonot veim kava seuddato aleha mevarech hammotzi

Orez shebbishshelo o sheasa mimmennu pat battechilla mevarech alav bore mine mezonot ulvassof bore nefashot uvilvad shello yehe meorav im davar acher ella orez levaddo aval pat dochan o pat shel shear mine kitnit battechilla mevarech shehakkol ulvassof bore nefashot rabbot

Kal shemmevarchin alav battechilla hammotzi mevarchin leacharav bassof birkat hammazon kesidrah arba berachot vechal shemmevarchin alav battechilla bore mine mezonot mevarchin bassof leacharav beracha achat meen shalosh chutz min haorez

Bamme devarim amurim sheachal mikkezayit ulmala aval achal pachot mikkezayit ben min happat ben mishshear ochlin vehashshote pachot merviit ben min hayyayin ben mishshear mashkin mevarech battechilla beracha haruya leoto hammin ulvassof eno mevarech kelal

Vezo hi beracha achat meen shalosh baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam al hammichya veal hakkalkala veal eretz chemda tova urchava sheratzita veshehinchalta et avotenu rachem Adonai elohenu alenu veal yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha veal tziyyon mishkan kevodecha vehaalenu letochah vesammechenu bevinyanah unvarechcha aleha bikdushsha uvtahora baruch atta Adonai al haaretz veal hammichya uvshabbatot veyamim tovim omer bivracha zo bichlalah meen kedushshat hayyom kederech shemmazkir bevirkat hammazon
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 4: Kal hamvarech birkat hammazon o beracha achat meen shalosh tzarich levarech otah bammakom sheachal achal keshehu mehallech yoshev bemakom sheppasak vivarech achal keshehu omed yoshev bimkomo vivarech shachach levarech birkat hammazon venizkar kodem sheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeav mevarech bammakom shennizkar veim haya mezid chozer limkomo umvarech veim berech bammakom shennizkar yatza yede chovato vechen im berech keshehu omed o keshehu mehallech yatza yede chovato ulchattechilla lo yevarech birkat hammazon velo beracha shemmeen shalosh ella keshehu yoshev uvammakom sheachal

Mi shennistappek lo im berech hammotzi o lo berech hammotzi eno chozer umvarech mippene sheeno min hattora shachach levarech hammotzi im nizkar ad shello gamar seuddato chozer umvarech veim nizkar leachar sheggamar eno chozer umvarech

Haya ochel bevayit ze ufasak seuddato vehalach levayit acher o shehaya ochel ukraahu chavero ledabber immo veyatza lo lefetach beto vechazar hoil veshinna mekomo tzarich levarech lemafrea al ma sheachal vechozer umvarech battechilla hammotzi veachar kach yigmor seuddato

Chaverim shehau yoshvim leechol veyatzu likrat chatan o likrat kalla im hinnichu sham zaken o chole chozrin limkoman vegomrin seuddatan veenan tzerichin levarech sheniyya veim lo hinnichu sham adam keshehen yotzin tzerichin beracha lemafrea uchshehen chozrin tzerichin beracha lechattechilla

Vechen im hau mesubbin bishtiyya o leechol perot shekkal hamshanne mekomo hare pasak achilato ulfichach mevarech lemafrea al ma sheachal vechozer umvarech sheniyya lechattechilla al ma shehu tzarich leechol vehamshanne mekomo mippinna lefinna bevayit echad eno tzarich lachazor ulvarech achal bemizrachah shel teena uva leechol bemaaravah tzarich lachazor ulvarech

Gamar belibbo milleechol o millishtot veachar kach nimlach leechol o lishtot af al pi shello shinna mekomo chozer umvarech veim lo gamar belibbo ella dato lachazor leechol velishtot afillu pasak kal hayyom kullo eno tzarich levarech shenit

Devarim habbaim betoch hasseudda vehen mechamat hasseudda enan tzerichin beracha lifnehem velo leacharehem ella birkat hammotzi shebbattechilla uvirkat hammazon shebbassof poteret hakkol shehakkol tefela lasseudda udvarim sheenan mechamat hasseudda shebbau betoch hasseudda teunin beracha lifnehem velo leacharehem udvarim habbaim leachar hasseudda ben mechamat hasseudda ben shello mechamat hasseudda teunin beracha lifnehen ulacharehem

Beshabbatot uvyamim tovim uvisudat hakkazat haddam uvshaa sheyyatza min hammerchatz vechayyotze bahen sheadam kovea seuddato al hayyayin im berech al hayyayin shellifne hammazon patar et hayyayin sheshshata leachar hammazon kodem sheyevarech birkat hammazon aval bishar hayyamim tzarich lachazor ulvarech battechilla al hayyayin shel achar hammazon ba lahen yayin betoch hammazon kal echad veechad mevarech leatzmo sheen bet habbelia panuy sheyyaanu amen veeno poter et hayyayin shelleachar hammazon
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 5: Nashim vaavadim chayyavin bevirkat hammazon vesafek yesh baddavar im hen chayyavin min hattora lefi sheen kavua lah zeman o enam chayyavin min hattora lefichach en motziin et haggedolim yede chovatan aval hakketannim chayyavin bevirkat hammazon middivre sofrim kede lechannechan bemitzot

Veachar kach omer baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hazzan et haolam kullo betuvo ad sheggomer arba berachot vehen onin amen achar kal beracha uvracha

Hau haochlin measara ulmala mezammenin beshem ketzad hamvarech omer nevarech lelohenu sheachalnu mishshello vehen onin baruch elohenu sheachalnu mishshello uvtuvo chayinu vehu chozer veomer baruch elohenu sheachalnu mishshello uvtuvo chayinu umatchil birkat hammazon

Hakkol chayyavin bevirkat hazzimmun kederech shechayyavin bevirkat hammazon afillu kohanim sheachlu kadshe hakkadashim baazara vechen kohanim veyisreelim sheachlu keechad veachlu hakkohanim teruma veyisrael chullin chayyavin bezimmun kechiyyuvan bevirkat hammazon

En mezammenin ella al mi sheachal kezayit pat ulmala shiva sheachlu pat ushlosha achlu immahen yarak o tzir vechayyotze bahen mitztarfin lezammen beshem vehu sheyyihye hamvarech meochle happat aval shishsha sheachlu pat vearbaa yarak en mitztarfin ad sheyyihu ochle happat rov hannikkar bamme devarim amurim baasara aval bishlosha tzarich sheyyochlu kal echad veechad mehen kezayit pat veachar kach mezammenin

Shenayim sheachlu vegamru milleechol uva shelishi veachal im yecholin leechol immo kal shehu vaafillu mishshear ochalin mitztaref immahen vechacham gadol shebbamsubbin hu shemmevarech lechullan af al pi shello ba ella baacharona

Shette chavurot shehau ochlin bevayit echad bizman shemmiktzatan roin ellu et ellu mitztarfin lezimmun echad veim lav ellu mezammenin leatzman veellu mezammenin leatzman veim yesh shammash echad benehem shehu holech umshammesh mechavura zo lachavura zo mitztarfin lezimmun echad af al pi sheen miktzat ellu roin et ellu vehu sheyyishmeu shettehen kal divre hamvarech beveur

Shelosha sheachlu veyatza echad mehen lashshuk korin lo kede sheyechaven lishmoa ma shehen omrim umzammenin alav vehu bashshuk veotze yede chovato velichsheyyachazor leveto yachazor vivarech birkat hammazon leatzmo aval asara sheachlu veyatza echad mehen lashshuk en mezammenin alav ad sheyyachazor limkomo veyeshev immahen
Shelosha sheachlu keechad vekadam echad mehen uverech leatzmo mezammenin alav veyatzu hashshenayim yede chovat zimmun vehu lo yatza bezimmun ze sheen zimmun lemafrea

Shenayim sheachlu keechad kal echad veechad mevarech leatzmo veim haya echad mehen yodea veechad eno yodea ze sheyyodea mevarech bekol ram vehashsheni one amen achar kal beracha uvracha veotze yede chovato uven mevarech leaviv veeved mevarech lerabbo veishsha mevarechet levalah veotzin yede chovatan aval amru chachamim tavo meera lemi sheishto uvanav mevarchin lo

Bamme devarim amurim sheyyatzu yede chovatan bizman sheachlu velo savu shehen chayyavim levarech middivre sofrim ulfichach motziin otan katan o eved o ishsha mide chovatan aval im achal vesava shehu chayyav bevirkat hammazon min hattora ben ishsha ben katan o eved en motziin otan shekkal hachayyav bedavar min hattora en motziin otan mide chovatan ella hachayyav beoto davar min hattora kemoto
Hannichnas etzel acherim umtzaan mevarchin bevirkat hazzimmun im matza hamvarech omer nevarech hu one baruch hu umvorach veim matza haochlim onin baruch sheachalnu mishshello hu one acharehen amen
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 6: Kal haochel happat shemmevarchin alav hammotzi tzarich netilat yadayim techilla vasof veaf al pi shehi pat chullin veaf al pi sheen yadav meluchlachot veeno yodea lahen tuma lo yochal ad sheyyittol shette yadav vechen kal davar shettibbulo bemashkin tzarich netilat yadayim techilla

Kal hannotel yadav ben laachila ben likriat shema ben litfilla mevarech techilla asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al netilat yadayim shezzo mitzvat chachamim shennitztavenu min hattora lishmoa mehen shenneemar al pi hattora asher yorucha vmayim acharonim en mevarchin alehen sheenam ella mippene hassakkana ulfichach chayyav adam lehizzaher bahen beoter

Netilat yadayim ben tavshil letavshil reshut ratza notel ratza eno notel uferot shel chullin enan tzerichin netilat yadayim ben battechilla ben bassof vechal hannotel yadav leferot hare ze miggasse haruach kal pat shehammelach bo tzarich netilat yadayim baacharona shemma yesh bo melach sedomit o melach shettivo kemelach sedomit veyaavir yadav al enav visamme mippene ze chayyavin littol yadayim besof kal seudda mippene hammelach uvmachane peturim minnetilat yadayim battechilla mippene shehen terudim bemilchama vechayyavin baacharona mippene hassakkana
