Ketzad mohalin chotchin et kal haor hamchappe et haatara ad shettitgalle kal haatara veachar kach porin et hakkerum harach shellematta min haor betzipporen umachaziro lechan ulchan ad sheyyerae besar haatara veachar kach motzetz et hammila ad sheyyetze haddam mimmekomot rechokim kede shello yavo lide sakkana vechal mi sheeno motzetz maavirin oto veachar shemmotzetz noten aleha ispelanit o retiyya vechayyotze bahen

Yesh tzitzin meakkevin et hammila veyesh tzitzin sheen meakkevin et hammila ketzad im nishar meor haarla or hachofe rov gavhah shel atara hare ze arel kemot shehaya veze haor hu tzitz hamakkev veim lo nishar mimmennu ella meat sheeno chofe rov gavhah shel atara zehu tzitz sheeno meakkev

Hammal kal zeman sheosek bammila chozer ben al hatztzitzin shemmeakkevin ben al tzitzin sheen meakkevin perash al tzitzin hamakkevin chozer al tzitzin sheenan meakkevin eno chozer mal velo para et hammila keillu lo mal

Katan shebbesaro rach umduldal beoter o shehaya baal basar ad sheyyerae keillu eno mahul roin oto beet sheyyitkashshe im nire shehu mahul eno tzarich kelum vetzarich letakken et habbasar mikkan umikkan mippene marit haayin veim beet sheyyitkashshe lo nire mahul chozrin vekotztzin et habbasar hamduldal mikkan umikkan ad shetterae haatara geluya beet kishshuy vedavar ze middivre sofrim aval min hattora af al pi shehu nire kearel hoil umal eno tzarich lamul paam sheniyya

Osin kal tzarche mila beshabbat malin uforin umotztzin vechozer al tzitzin hamakkevin af al pi shepperash veal tzitzin sheen meakkevin kal zeman shello perash venoten aleha ispelanit aval machshire mila enan dochin et hashshabbat ketzad hare shello matzu sakkin en osin sakkin beshabbat velo meviin oto mimmakom lemakom vaafillu mavoy sheeno meorav en meviin oto mechatzer lechatzer veen eruv middivrehem nidche mippene havaat hassakkin hoil veefshar lahavio meerev shabbat

Vechen en shochakin lah sammanin veen mechimmin lah chammin veen osin lah ispelanit veen torfin yayin veshemen veim lo shachak kammon meerev shabbat loes beshinnav venoten veim lo taraf yayin veshemen noten ze leatzmo veze leatzmo ze hakkelal kal sheefshar laasoto meerev shabbat eno doche et hashshabbat aval im shachach velo hechinu hammachshirin tiddache hammila litshii

Malu et hakkatan beshabbat veachar kach nishpechu hachammin o nitpazzeru hassammanin osin lo hakkol beshabbat mippene shessakkana hi lo makom sheddarkan leharchitz et hakkatan marchitzin oto beshabbat beom hammila ben lifne hammila ben leachar hammila o bashshelishi shel mila shechal lihot beshabbat ben rechitzat kal gufo ben rechitzat mila ben bechammin shehuchammu meerev shabbat ben bechammin shehuchammu beshabbat mippene shessakkana hi lo

Shachchu velo heviu sakkin meerev shabbat omer leakkum lehavi sakkin beshabbat uvilvad shello yavi oto derech reshut harabbim kelalo shel davar kal davar sheasiyyato beshabbat asura alenu mishshum shevut muttar lanu lomar leakkum laasot otan kede laasot mitzva bizmannah vedavar sheasiyyato asura alenu mishshum melacha asur lanu lomar leakkum laasoto beshabbat

Machshire mila afillu bizmannah enan dochin et yom tov hoil veefshar laasotan meerev yom tov vekal vachomer haddevarim im lo dachu machshire mila shevut shehu middivrehem heach yidchu lo taase shebbattora aval shochakin lah sammanin beom tov hoil verauy likdera vetorfin lah yayin veshemen
Mishneh Torah, Circumcision 3: Hammal mevarech kodem sheyyamul asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al hammila im mal ben chavero veim mal et beno mevarech vetzivanu lamul et habben vaavi habben mevarech beracha acheret baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu lehachniso bivrito shel avraham avinu mitzva al haav lamul et beno yater al mitzva shemmetzuvin yisrael sheyyamulu kal arel shebbenehen lefichach im en sham aviv en mevarchin achareha beracha zo veyesh mi shehora sheyevarchu otah bet din o echad min haam veen rauy laasot ken
Veim hau sham omdin omrim keshem shehichnasto labberit ken tachnisehu letora ulchuppa ulmaasim tovim

Veachar kach mevarech avi habben o hammal o echad min haomdin sham baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddash yedid mibbeten vechok bishero sam vetzeetzaav chatam beot berit kodesh al ken bischar zot el chay chelkenu tzurenu tzave lehatztzil yedidut sheerenu mishshachat lemaan berito asher sam bivsarenu baruch atta Adonai koret habberit vaavi habben mevarech shehecheyanu

Hammal et haggerim mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu lamul et haggerim ulhattif mimmennu dam berit sheilmale dam habberit lo nitkayemu shamayim vaaretz shenneemar im lo veriti yomam valayela chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti

Hammal et avdo mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu lamul et haavadim ulhattif mehen dam berit sheilmale dam berit lo nitkayemu shamayim vaaretz veim mal eved shel acherim mevarech al milat haavadim vehammal adam gadol tzarich lechassot ervato ad sheyevarech veachar kach megallehu umal oto
Ger shemmal kodem shennitgayyer vekatan shennolad keshehu mahul keshemmattifin mimmennu dam berit enan tzerichin beracha vechen anderoginus en mevarchin al millato mippene shehu eno zachar vadday

Akkum shetztzarich lachtoch arlato mippene makka o mippene shechin shennolad bo haya asur leyisrael lachtoch lo otah shehaakkum en maalim otam mide mita velo moridin otan eleha af al pi shennaaset mitzva birfua zo shehare lo nitkaven lemitzva lefichach im nitkaven haakkum lemila muttar leyisrael lamul oto

Meusa hi haarla shennitgannu bah haggoyim shenneemar ki kal haggoyim arelim ugdola hi hammila shello nikra avraham avinu shalem ad shemmal shenneemar hithallech lefanay vehye tamim veettena veriti beni uvenecha vego vechal hammefer berito shel avraham avinu vehinniach arlato o meshachah af al pi sheyyesh bo tora umaasim tovim en lo chelek laolam habba

Bo ure kamma chamura mila shello nitla lemoshe rabbenu aleha afillu shaa achat af al pi shehaya badderech vechal mitzot hattora nichretu alehen shalosh beritot shenneemar elle divre habberit asher tziva Adonai millevad habberit asher karat ittam bechorev vesham hu omer attem nitztzavim hayyom kullechem leavrecha bivrit Adonai elohecha hare shalosh beritot veal hammila nichretu shelosh esre beritot im avraham avinu veettena veriti beni uvenecha ani hinne veriti ittach vahakimoti et beriti beni uvenecha livrit olam veatta et beriti tishmor zot beriti asher tishmeru vehaya leot berit vehayeta veriti bivsarchem livrit olam et beriti hefar vahakimoti et beriti itto livrit olam veet beriti akim et yitzchak berich rachamana desayean
Mishneh Torah, Fringes 1: Anaf sheosin al kenaf habbeged mimmin habbeged hu hannikra tzitzit mippene shehu dome letzitzit shel rosh shenneemar vayyikkacheni betzitzit rashi veze heanaf hu hannikra lavan mippene sheen anu metzuvin letzavo veen lechute heanaf minyan min hattora
Velokchin chut tzemer shennitzba keen harakia vechorchin oto al heanaf vechut ze hu hannikra techelet veen leminyan hakkerichot shekkorech chut ze shiur min hattora
Nimtzeu bemitzva zo shene tzavim sheyyaase al hakkanaf anaf yotze mimmenna vesheyyichroch al heanaf chut techelet shenneemar veasu lahem tzitzit venatnu al tzitzit hakkanaf petil techelet

Vehattechelet eno meakkev et hallavan vehallavan eno meakkev et hattechelet ketzad hare sheen lo techelet ose lavan levaddo vechen im asa lavan utchelet venifsak hallavan venitmaet ad hakkanaf venishar hattechelet levaddo kasher

Af al pi sheen echad mehen meakkev et chavero enan shette mitzot ella mitzvat ase achat amru chachamim harishonim vehaya lachem letzitzit melammed sheshshenehem mitzva achat vearba tzitziyyot meakkevot zo et zo shearbatan mitzva achat vehallovesh tallit sheyyesh bah lavan o techelet o shenehem keechad hare kiyyem mitzvat ase achat

Ketzad osin et hatztzitzit matchil mizzavit shel tallit shehi sof haarug umarchik mimmenna lo yoter al shalosh etzbaot lemala velo pachot mikkesher gudal umachnis sham arbaa chutin vechoflan baemtza nimtzeu shemona chutim meshullashin teluyin min hakkeren veorech hachutim hashshemona en pachot mearba etzbaot veim hau yoter al ken afillu amma o shettayim kesherin vechal haetzbaot begudal veyihye echad mishshemona hachutim chut techelet vehashshiva levanim

Velokeach chut echad min hallavan vechorech bo kericha achat al shear hachutin betzad habbeged umannicho velokeach chut hattechelet vechorech bo shette kerichot betzad kericha shel lavan vekosher veellu hashshalosh kerichot hem hannikrain chulya umarchik meat veose chulya sheniyya bechut shel techelet levaddo umarchik meat veose chulya shelishit vechen ad chulya acharona shehu korech bah shette kerichot shel techelet uchricha acharona shel lavan mippene shehitchil belavan mesayyem bo shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin velamma yatchil belavan kede sheyehe samuch lichnaf minah veal derech ze hu ose bearba hakkenafot

Kamma chulot hu ose bechal kanaf lo pachot mishsheva velo yoter mishshelosh esre vezo hi mitzva min hammuvchar veim lo karach aleha ella chulya achat keshera veim karach hattechelet al rov hatztzitzit keshera venoy hattechelet sheyyihu kal hachulot bishlish hachutin hamshulshalin ushne shelishehen anaf vetzarich lefardo ad sheyyihye ketzitzit sear harosh

Haose lavan belo techelet lokeach echad mishshemona hachutin vechorech oto al shear hachutin ad shelishan umanniach shene shelishitan anaf uchricha zo im ratza lichroch otah chulot chulot keen shekkorech battechelet harshut beyado veze hu minhagenu veim ratza lichroch belo minyan chulot ose kelalo shel davar yitkaven lihot hakkaruch shelish veheanaf shene shelishim veyesh mi sheeno medakdek bedavar ze belavan veim karach hallavan al rov hachutin o shello karach ella chulya achat keshera
Echad chute lavan veechad chute techelet im ratza laasot shezurin ose afillu haya hachut kaful mishshemona chutin veshazur ad shennaase petil echad eno nechshav ella chut echad

Chute hatztzitzit ben lavan ben techelet tzerichin teviyya leshem tzitzit veen osin otan lo min hatztzemer hanneechaz bakkotzim keshehatztzon rovtzin benehem velo min hannimin hannitlashin min habbehema velo mishshiyyure sheti shehaoreg meshayyer besof habbeged ella min haggizza shel tzemer o min happishtan veen osin otan mitztzemer haggazul velo mishshel ir hanniddachat velo mishshel kadashim veim asa pasul hammishtachave livhema tzamrah pasul letzitzit aval hammishtachave lefishtan hannatua hare ze kasher shehare nishtanna
Tzitzit sheasa oto kuti pasul shenneemar dabber el bene yisrael veasu lahem tzitzit aval im asa otah yisrael belo kavana keshera vetzitzit shennaasa min heasuy mikkodem pasul

Ketzad hevi kanaf sheyyesh bah tzitzit utfarah al habbeged afillu yesh beotah hakkanaf amma al amma pasul shenneemar veasu lahem tzitzit lo min heasuy shehare ze dome lemi shennaaset meeleha umuttar lehattir tzitzit mibbeged ze velitlotam beveged acher ben lavan ben techelet

Tala hachutin ben shette kenafayim mizzo lezo vekashar kanaf zo kehilchatah vechanaf zo kehilchatah veachar kach chatachan baemtza venifredu ze mizze pasul shehare beet shekkesharan hau pesulin lefi sheshshette hakkenafayim meorot zo bazo bachutin shebbenehen uvshaa sheppesakan naasu shette tzitziyyot nimtza ose min heasuy

Hittil tzitzit al hatztzitzit im nitkaven levattel et harishonot mattir harishona o chotchah uchshera veim nitkaven lehosif af al pi shechatach achat mishshettehen hare zo pesula shehare keshehosif pasal et hakkol uchshehittir o chatach hattosefet nimtza hashshear naasa min heasuy sheasiyyato harishona pesula hayeta
Vechen hammattil levaalat shalosh veachar kach hishlimah learba vehittil larviit kullah pesula shenneemar taase velo min heasuy
En koflin et hattallit lishnayim umattilin tzitzit al arba kenafeha keshehi kefula ella im ken tefarah kullah vaafillu meruach achat

Nifsak hakkanaf sheyyesh bah tzitzit chutz leshalosh etzbaot tofrah bimkomah betoch shalosh lo yitpor nitmaata zavit shel beged shebben chute hatztzitzit uven sof haarug afillu lo nishar min haarug ella kal shehu kasher vechen im nitmaatu chute hatztzitzit afillu lo nishtayyer mehem ella kede aniva kasher veim nifsak hachut meikkaro afillu chut echad pesula
Mishneh Torah, Fringes 2: Techelet haamura battora bechal makom hi hatztzemer hatztzavua kefatuch shebbakkachol vezo hi demut harakia hanniret leen hashshemesh betahoro shel rakia vehattechelet haamura batztzitzit tzarich shettihye tzeviatah tzevia yedua sheomedet beyafyah velo tishtanne vechal shello nitzba beotah tzevia pasul letzitzit af al pi shehu keen harakia kegon shetztzevao beistis o beshachor o bishar hammashchirin hare ze pasul letzitzit rachel bat ez tzamrah pasul letzitzit

Ketzad tzovin techelet shel tzitzit lokchin hatztzemer veshorin oto besid veachar kach mechabbesin oto ad sheyyihye naki umartichim oto beahala vechayyotze bo kederech shehatztzabbain osin kede sheyyiklot et haayin veachar kach meviin dam chillazon vehu dag sheddome eno leen hattechelet vedamo shachor kido uvyam hammelach hu matzuy venotnin et haddam leora venotnin immo sammanin kemo hakkamonya vechayyotze bahen kederech shehatztzabbain osin umartichin oto venotnin bo hatztzemer ad sheyyease keen rakia vezo hi hattechelet shel tzitzit

Hattechelet shel tzitzit tzericha tzevia lishmah veim tzevaah shello lishmah pesula vehayyora sheyyesh bah hatztzeva im tzava bah meat tzemer levadko im hu yafe im lav nifsela hayyora kullah ella ketzad yaase lokeach hatztzeva min hayyora bichli katan umanniach bo tzemer shebbodek bo vesoref et shebbadak shehare nitzba livdika veshofech hatztzeva shebbakkeli shebbadak bo shehare taamo ufsalo vetzovea hattechelet bishar hatztzeva shello nifgam

Hattechelet enah nilkachat ella min hammumche choshshin shemma nitzbea shello lishmah af al pi shennilkecha min hammumche im nivdeka venoda shennitzbea beechad mishshear tzivonin hammashchirim sheenan omdin pesula

Ketzad bodkin otah ad sheyyodea im nitzbea kehilchatah im lav lokchin teven verir shel shabbelul ume raglayim shennitchammetzu arbaim yom veshorin hattechelet bechullan meet leet im amda beenah velo kahata keshera veim kahata lokchin batzek shel seorin shemmeappeshin oto lemuryas venotnin et zo hattechelet shennishtannet betocho veofe habbatzek betannur umotziim hattechelet min happat veroin otah im kahata mimma shehayeta pesula veim hosif enah vehushchara yoter mimma shehayeta kodem haafiyya keshera

Chatzer shemmochrin bah techelet vehau muchzakin bechashrut lokchin mimmenna setam veen tzarich bedika vahare hi bechezkatah ad shettechashed hammafkid techelet etzel hakkuti hare zo pesula shemma hechelifah veim hayeta bichli vehaya chatum bishne chotamot chotam betoch chotam keshera bechotam echad pesula

Hammotze techelet bashshuk afillu matza chutin pesukin pesula shezurin keshera hallokeach tallit metzuyyetzet min hashshuk miyyisrael hare hi bechezkatah min haggoy hattaggar keshera min hahedot pesula

Tallit shehi kullah adumma o yerukka o mishshear tzivonin ose chute lavan shellah keen tzivah im yerukka yerukkin im adumma adummin hayeta kullah techelet ose lavan shellah mishshear tzivonin chutz min hashshachor mippene shehu nire kitchelet vechorech al hakkol chut echad techelet kederech sheosin bishar tzitziyyot sheenan tzevuin
Kashe onesh mi sheeno manniach lavan yoter meonesh shello hinniach techelet lefi shehallavan matzuy lakkol vehattechelet eno metzuya bechal makom velo bechal zeman mippene hatztzeva sheamarnu
Mishneh Torah, Fringes 3: Kesut shechayyav adam laasot bah tzitzit min hattora hi kesut sheyyesh lah arba kenafayim o yoter al arba vetihye middatah kede sheyyitkasse bah rosho verubbo shel katan hammithallech levaddo bashshuk veeno tzarich acher leshamro velelech immo vetihye hakkesut shel tzemer o shel pishtan bilvad

Aval tallit shel shear minin kegon bigde meshi uvigde tzemer gefen uvigde tzemer gemallim vetzemer arnavim venotza shel izzim vechayyotze bahen en chayyavin bemitzvat tzitzit ella middivre chachamim kede lehizzaher bemitzvat tzitzit vehu shettihye merubbaat o yoter al arba veyihye shiurah kashshiur sheamarnu shekkal habbegadim haamurim battora setam enam ella tzemer ufishtim bilvad

Al arba kanfot kesutcha baalat arba velo baalat shalosh im ken baalat arba velo baalat chamesh talmud lomar asher techasse bah afillu baalat chamesh o yoter al ze velamma ani mechayyev baalat chamesh ufoter baalat shalosh ushtehen enan baale arba kenafot mippene sheyyesh bichlal hechamesh arba lefichach keshehu ose tzitzit levaalat chamesh o shesh eno ose ella learba kenafayim hamruchakot zo mizzo meotan hechamesh o hashshesh bilvad shenneemar al arba kanfot kesutcha

Kesut shel beged uchnafeha shel or chayyevet hi shel or uchnafeha shel beged petura sheen holchin ella achar ikkar hakkesut kesut shel shene shuttafin chayyevet shenneemar al kanfe vigdehem lo neemar kesutcha ella lemaet sheula shehattallit hashsheula petura min hatztzitzit sheloshim yom mikkan veelach chayyevet

Kesut shel tzemer osin lavan shellah chute tzemer uchsut shel pishtan osin lavan shellah chute pishtan mimmenna ushar begadim osin lavan shel kal min vamin mimmino kegon chute meshi lichsut meshi vechute notza lichsut notza veim ratza laasot lavan lechal shear minim mitztzemer o mippishtim ose mippene shehatztzemer vehappishtan potrin ben beminan ben shello beminan ushar minin beminan potrin shello beminan en potrin

Uma hu laasot chute tzemer bichsut shel pishtan o chute pishtan bichsut shel tzemer af al pi shehu lavan levaddo belo techelet bedin hu sheyehe muttar shehashshaatnez muttar leinyan tzitzit shehare hattechelet tzemer hu umattilin otah lefishtan umippene ma en osin ken mippene sheefshar laasot hallavan shellah mimminah vechal makom sheatta motze ase velo taase im yachol atta lekayyem et shettehen hare mutav veim lav yavo ase veyidche et lo taase vechan efshar lekayyem et shettehen

Kesut shel pishtan en mattilin bah techelet ella osin hallavan bilvad shel chute pishtan lo mippene shehatztzitzit nidchet mippene hashshaatnez ella gezera middivrehem shemma yitkasse bah ballayela sheenah zeman chiyyuv tzitzit venimtza over al lo taase beet sheen sham mitzvat ase shechovat hatztzitzit bayyom velo ballayela shenneemar uritem oto bishat reiyya vesuma chayyav betzitzit af al pi sheeno roe acherim roin oto

Muttar laadam lilbosh tzitzit ballayela ben bechol ben beshabbat veaf al pi sheeno zemannah uvilvad shello yevarech umeematay yevarech al hatztzitzit bashshachar mishsheyyakkir ben techelet shebbah lallavan shebbah vechetzad mevarech aleha baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu lehitattef betzitzit vechal zeman shemmitattef bah bayyom mevarech aleha kodem sheyyitattef veeno mevarech al hatztzitzit bishat asiyyatah mippene shessof hammitzva hu sheyyitattef bah

Umuttar lehikkanes betzitzit levet hakkisse ulvet hammerchatz nifseku lo chute lavan o techelet zorko baashpa mippene shehi mitzva sheen begufah kedushsha veasur limkor tallit metzuyyetzet legoy ad sheyyattir tzitziyyoteha lo mippene sheyyesh begufah kedushsha ella shemma yitattef bah veyitlave immo yisrael vidamme shehu yisrael veyahargennu nashim vaavadim uktannim peturin min hatztzitzit min hattora umiddivre sofrim shekkal katan sheyyodea lehitattef chayyav betzitzit kede lechannecho bemitzot venashim vaavadim sheratzu lehitattef betzitzit mitattefim belo beracha vechen shear mitzot ase shehannashim peturot mehen im ratzu laasot otan belo beracha en memachin beyadan tumtum veanderoginus chayyavin bechullan missafek lefichach en mevarchin ella osin belo beracha

Heach chiyyuv mitzvat hatztzitzit kal adam shechayyav laasot mitzva zo im yitkasse bichsut harauy letzitzit yattil lah tzitzit veachar kach yitkasse bah veim nitkassa bah belo tzitzit hare bittel mitzvat ase aval begadim haruyim letzitzit kal zeman shello yitkasse bahen adam ella mekuppalim umunnachim peturin min hatztzitzit sheenah chovat hattallit ella chovat haish sheyyesh lo tallit

Af al pi sheen adam mechuyyav liknot lo tallit ulhitattef bah kede sheyyaase bah tzitzit en rauy leadam chasid sheyyiftor atzmo mimmitzva zo ella leolam yishtaddel lihot atuf bichsut hamchuyyevet batztzitzit kede sheyekayyem mitzva zo uvishat hattefilla tzarich lehizzaher beoter genay gadol hu letalmide chachamim sheyyitpallelu vehem enam atufim

Veomer et hashshem kichtavo vehu hashshem hannehge miyyud he vav he veze hu hashshem hamforash haamur bechal makom uvammedina omrim oto bechinnuo vehu bealef dalet sheen mazkirin et hashshem kichtavo ella bammikdash bilvad umishshemmet shimon hatztzaddik pasku hakkohanim millevarech bashshem hamforash afillu bammikdash kede shello yilmod oto adam sheeno chashuv vesheeno hagun velo hau chachamim harishonim melammedin shem ze letalmidehem uvnehem hahagunim ella paam achat lesheva shanim kal ze gedulla lishmo hannichbad vehannora

En birkat kohanim neemeret bechal makom ella bilshon hakkodesh shenneemar ko tevarachu et bene yisrael kach lamdu mippi hashshemua mimmoshe rabbenu alav hashshalom ko tevarchu baamida ko tevarchu binsiat kappayim ko tevarchu bilshon hakkodesh ko tevarchu panim keneged panim ko tevarchu bekol ram ko tevarchu beshem hamforash vehu sheyyihye bammikdash kemo sheamarnu

En hakkohanim rashshain bechal makom lehosif beracha al sheloshet happesukim kegon Adonai elohe avotechem yosef alechem kachem elef peamim vechayyotze bah lo bekol ram velo belachash shenneemar lo tosifu al haddavar beshaa shekkal kohen ole ladduchan keshehu oker raglav laalot omer yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettihye beracha zo shetztzivitanu levarech et ammecha yisrael beracha shelema veal yehi bah michshol veaon meatta vead olam vekodem sheyyachazir panav levarech et haam mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bikdushshato shel aharon vetzivanu levarech et ammo yisrael beahava veachar kach machazir panav latztzibbur umatchil levarcham uchshemmachazir panav min hatztzibbur achar shemmashlim omer asinu ma sheggazarta alenu ase immanu ma shehivtachtanu hashkifa mimmeon kadshecha min hashshamayim uvarech et ammecha et yisrael

Keshemmachzirin hakkohanim et penehem latztzibbur levarcham uchshemmachzirin penehem min hatztzibbur achar shemmevarchin lo yachaziru ella al derech yamin bechal makom vechen kal pinnot sheyyihye adam pone lo yihu ella al derech yamin

Bammikdash mevarchin birkat kohanim paam achat beom achar tamid shel shachar bain veomdin al maalot haulam umvarchin kederech sheamarnu aval bammedina mevarchin otah achar kal tefilla chutz mimmincha kemo sheamarnu bechal makom mishtaddelin sheyyihye hammakre otan yisrael shenneemar amor lahem mikkelal sheen hammakre mehem

Shishsha devarim monin nesiat kappayim hallashon vehammumin vihaavera vehashshanim vehayyayin vetumat hayyadayim hallashon ketzad haillegim sheen motziin et haotiyyot ketikkunan kegon shekkorin laalefin ayenin ulayenin alefin o leshibbolet sibbolet vechayyotze bahen en nosin et kappehen vechen kevede pe uchvede lashon sheen divrehem nikkarim lakkol en nosin et kappehen

Hammumin ketzad kohen sheyyesh mumin befanav o beyadav o beraglav kegon shehau etzbeotav akummot o akkushshot o shehau yadav bohakaniyyot lo yissa et kappav lefi shehaam mistakkelin bo mi shehaya riro yored al zekano beshaa shehu medabber vechen hassuma beachat meenav lo yissa et kappav veim haya dash beiro vehakkol hau regilim beze hassuma beachat meenav o beze sheriro zav muttar lefi sheen mistakkelin bo vechen mi shehau yadav tzevuot istis ufua lo yissa et kappav veim rov anshe hair melachtan bechach muttar lefi sheen mistakkelin bo

Haavera ketzad kohen sheharag et hannefesh af al pi sheasa teshuva lo yissa et kappav shenneemar yedechem damim maleu uchtiv uvfarischem kappechem vego vechohen sheavad kochavim ben beones ben bishgaga af al pi sheasa teshuva eno nose et kappav leolam shenneemar ach lo yaalu kohane habbamot vego uvracha kaavoda hi shenneemar lesharto ulvarech bishmo vechen kohen shehemir leakkum af al pi shechazar bo eno nose et kappav leolam ushar haaverot en monin

Hashshanim ketzad kohen naar lo yissa et kappav ad sheyyitmalle zekano vehayyayin ketzad mi sheshshata reviit yayin bevat achat eno nose et kappav ad sheyyasir et yeno mealav lefi shehukkesha beracha laavoda shata reviit yayin bishte peamim o shennatan letocho meat mayim muttar veim shata yoter merviit af al pi shehaya mazug af al pi sheshshetao bechamma peamim lo yissa et kappav ad sheyyasir et yeno mealav vechamma hi reviit etzbaim al etzbaim berum etzbaim vachatzi etzba vechomesh etzba begudal veze haetzba shemmoshchin bo bechal hattora kullah hu haggudal vehu hannikra bohen yad

Tumat hayyadayim ketzad kohen shello natal et yadav lo yissa et kappav ella notel et yadav ad happerek kederech shemmekaddeshin laavoda veachar kach mevarech shenneemar seu yedechem kodesh uvarachu et Adonai vehechalal eno nose et kappav lefi sheeno bechihuno

Kohen shello haya lo davar mikkal ellu haddevarim hammonin nesiat kappayim af al pi sheeno chacham veeno medakdek bemitzot o shehau habberiyyot merannenim acharav o shello haya massao umattano betzedek hare ze nose et kappav veen monin oto lefi shezzo mitzvat ase al kal kohen vechohen sherauy linsiat kappayim veen omrim leadam rasha hosef resha vehimmana min hammitzot

Veal titmah vetomar uma toil birkat hedot ze sheen kibbul habberacha taluy bakkohanim ella behakkadosh baruch hu shenneemar vesamu et shemi al bene yisrael vaani avarachem hakkohanim osim mitzvatan shennitztauu bah vehakkadosh baruch hu verachamav mevarech et yisrael kecheftzo

Am shehem achore hakkohanim enam bichlal habberacha vehaomdim mitztziddehen hare hem bichlal habberacha veim hayeta mechitztza ben hakkohanim uven hammitbarchim afillu hi choma shel barzel hoil ufnehem mul pene hakkohanim hare hem bichlal habberacha

Nesiat kappayim baasara vechohanim min hamminyan bet hakkeneset shekkullan kohanim kullam nosim et kappehem ulmi hem mevarchim leachehem shebbatztzafon velaachehem shebbaddarom umi one acharehem amen hannashim vehattaf veim nisharu sham asara kohanim yoter al ellu shealu ladduchan haasara onin amen vehashshear mevarchin

Tzibbur shello haya bahen kohen ella sheliach tzibbur levaddo lo yissa et kappav veim hayeta havtachato shehu nose et kappav vechozer litfillato rashshay veim en lahem kohen kelal kesheyyaggia sheliach tzibbur lesim shalom omer elohenu velohe avotenu barchenu babberacha hamshulleshet battora hakketuva al yede moshe avdecha haamura mippi aharon uvanav kohanim am kedoshecha kaamur yevarechcha Adonai veyishmerecha yaer Adonai panav elecha vichunnekka yissa Adonai panav elecha veyasem lecha shalom vesamu et shemi al bene yisrael vaani avarachem veen haam onin amen umatchil veomer sim shalom

Kohen shennasa et kappav bevet hakkeneset vehalach levet hakkeneset acher umatza tzibbur shemmitpallelin velo higgiu levirkat kohanim nose yadav lahen umvarchan vaafillu kamma peamim beom kohen shello akar raglav mimmekomo laalot ladduchan beshaa sheamar sheliach tzibbur retze shuv eno ole beotah tefilla aval im akar raglav laalot af al pi shello higgia ladduchan ella achar avoda hare ze ole umvarech

Kal kohen sheeno ole ladduchan af al pi shebbittel mitzvat ase achat hare ze keover al shalosh ase shenneemar ko tevarachu et bene yisrael amor lahem vesamu et shemi vechal kohen sheeno mevarech eno mitbarech vechal kohen hamvarech mitbarech shenneemar vaavaracha mevarchecha seliku hilchot tefila besiyyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 1: Paamayim bechal yom korin keriat shema baerev uvabboker shenneemar uvshachbecha uvkumecha beshaa shedderech bene adam shochvin veze hu layela uvshaa shedderech bene adam omdin veze hu yom

Uma hu kore shelosha parashiyyot ellu hen shema vehaya im shamoa vayyomer umakdimin likrot parashat shema mippene sheyyesh bah yichud hashshem veahavato vetalmudo shehu haikkar haggadol shehakkol taluy bo veachareha vehaya im shamoa sheyyesh bah tziuuy al zechirat shear kal hammitzot veachar kach parashat tzitzit sheggam hi yesh bah tziuuy zechirat kal hammitzot

Af al pi sheen mitzvat tzitzit noheget ballayela korin otah ballayela mippene sheyyesh bah zichron yetziat mitzrayim umitzva lehazkir yetziat mitzrayim bayyom uvallayela shenneemar lemaan tizkor et yom tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim kol yeme chayyecha ukriat shalosh parashiyyot ellu al seder ze hi hannikret keriat shema

Hakkore keriat shema keshehu gomer pasuk rishon omer belachash baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed vechozer vekore kedarko veahavta et Adonai elohecha ad sofah velamma korin ken masoret hi beyadenu shebbeshaa shekkibbetz yaakov avinu et banav bemitzrayim bishat mitato tzivam vezerzam al yichud hashshem veal derech Adonai shehalach bah avraham veyitzchak aviv veshaal otam veamar lahem banay shemma yesh bachem paslut mi sheeno omed immi beyichud hashshem kainyan sheamar lanu moshe rabbenu pen yesh bachem ish o ishsha vego anu kullam veamru shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad kelomar shema mimmennu avinu yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad patach hazzaken veamar baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed lefichach nahagu kal yisrael lomar shevach sheshshibbeach bo yisrael hazzaken achar pasuk ze
Hakkore keriat shema mevarech lefaneha ulachareha bayyom mevarech shettayim lefaneha veachat leachareha uvallayela mevarech shettayim lefaneha ushtayim leachareha

Beracha rishona shellefaneha bayyom yotzer or uvore choshech vechu uvracha sheniyya ahavat olam ahavtanu veshel achareha emet veyatztziv uvracha rishona shellefaneha ballayela maariv aravim vechu sheniyya lah ahavat olam bet yisrael ammecha ahavta chu uvracha rishona shel achareha emet veemuna sheniyya lah hashkivenu

Beracha rishona shellefaneha ben bayyom ben ballayela poteach bah bevaruch vechotem bah bevaruch ushar birchoteha chotem bechal achat mehen bevaruch veen lahem peticha bevaruch berachot ellu im shear kal habberachot haaruchot befi kal yisrael ezra hassofer uvet dino tikkenum veen adam rashshay lifchot mehem velo lehosif alehem makom shehitkinu lachtom bevaruch eno rashshay shello lachtom umakom shehitkinu shello lachtom eno rashshay lachtom makom shehitkinu shello liftoach bevaruch eno rashshay liftoach makom shehitkinu liftoach eno rashshay shello liftoach kelalo shel davar kal hamshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim babberachot hare ze toe vechozer umvarech kammatbea vechal sheeno omer emet veyatztziv beshacharit veemet veemuna bearvit lo yatza yede chovato

Hikdim beracha sheniyya livracha rishona ben bayyom ben ballayela ben lefaneha ben leachareha yatza lefi sheen seder babberachot beshacharit patach yotzer or vesiyyem maariv aravim lo yatza patach bemaariv aravim vesiyyem beotzer or yatza uvaerev patach bemaariv aravim vesiyyem beotzer or lo yatza patach beotzer or vesiyyem bemaariv aravim yatza shekkal habberachot holchot achar chatimatan

Eze hu zeman keriat shema ballayela mitzvatah mishsheat yetziat hakkochavim ad chatzi hallayela veim avar veicher vekara ad shello ala ammud hashshachar yatza yede chovato shello amru ad chatzot ella kede leharchik adam min happeshia

Hakkore keriat shema shel arvit achar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar kodem hanetz hachamma lo yatza yede chovato ella im ken haya anus kegon shikkor o chole vechayyotze bahen veanus shekkara beet ze eno omer hashkivenu

Vee ze hu zemanna bayyom mitzvatah sheyyatchil likrot kodem hanetz hachamma kede sheyyigmor likrot ulvarech beracha acharona im hanetz hachamma veshiur ze kemo issur shaa kodem shettaale hashshemesh veim icher vekara keriat shema achar shettaale hashshemesh yatza yede chovato sheonatah ad sof shalosh shaot bayyom lemi sheavar veicher

Mi shehikdim vekara keriat shema shel shacharit achar sheyyaale ammud hashshachar af al pi shehishlim kodem shettanetz hachamma yatza yede chovato uvishat haddechak kegon shehaya mashkim latzet ladderech kore lechattechilla mishsheala ammud hashshachar

Hakkore achar shalosh shaot bayyom afillu haya anus lo yatza yede chovat keriat shema beonato ella hare hu kekore battora umvarech lefaneha ulachareha kal hayyom afillu icher vekara achar shalosh shaot
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 2: Hakkore et shema velo kiven libbo befasuk rishon shehu shema yisrael lo yatza yede chovato vehashshear im lo kiven libbo yatza afillu haya kore battora kedarko o maggiha et happarashiyyot haellu beonat keria yatza vehu shekkiven libbo befasuk rishon

Kal adam korin kedarkan ben omdin ben mehallechin ben shochvin ben rochvin al gabbe behema veasur likrot keriat shema vehu muttal ufanav tuchot bakkarka o mushlach al gabbo ufanav lemala aval kore hu vehu shochev al tziddo veim haya baal basar harbe veeno yachol lehithappech al tziddo o shehaya chole note meat letziddo vekore
Mi shehaya mehallech al raglav omed befasuk rishon vehashshear kore vehu mehallech haya yashen metzaarin oto umirin oto ad sheyyikra pasuk rishon umikkan veelach im anasattu shena en metzaarin oto

Mi shehaya osek bimlacha mafsik ad sheyyikra parasha rishona kullah vechen haummanin betelin mimmelachtan befarasha rishona kede shello tehe keriatan aray vehashshear kore hu kedarko veosek bimlachto afillu haya omed berosh hailan o berosh hakkotel kore bimkomo umvarech lefaneha ulachareha
Haya osek betalmud tora vehiggia zeman keriat shema posek vekore umvarech lefaneha ulachareha haya osek betzarche rabbim lo yifsok ella yigmor iskehen veyikra im nishar et likrot

Haya osek baachila o shehaya bammerchatz o shehaya osek betisporet o shehaya mehappech beorot o shehau oskin baddin gomer veachar kach kore keriat shema veim haya mityare shemma yaavor zeman keria ufasak vekara hare ze meshubbach

Mi sheyyarad litbol im yachol laalot ulhitkassot kodem shettanetz hachamma yaale veyitkasse veyikra veim haya mityare shemma tanetz hachamma kodem sheyyikra yitkasse bammayim shehu omed bahen veyikra velo yitkasse lo bammayim haraim sherechan ra velo beme hammishre velo bemayim tzelulin mippene sheervato niret bahen aval mitkasse hu bemayim achurin sheen rechan ra vekore bimkomo

Hakkore keriat shema lo yirmoz beenav velo yikrotz bisfatav velo yare beetzbeotav kede shello tihye keriato aray veim asa ken af al pi sheyyatza yede chovato hare ze megunne vetzarich lehashmia leazno keshehu kore veim lo hishmia leazno yatza vetzarich ledakdek beotiyyotav veim lo dikdek yatza

Ketzad yedakdek yishmor shello yarpe hechazak velo yachazik harafe velo yaniach hannad velo yanid hannach lefichach tzarich litten revach ben haddevakim ben kal shette otiyyot haddomot sheachat mehen sof teva vehaacheret techillat teva hassemucha lah kegon bechal levavcha kore bechal veshohe vechozer vekore levavcha vechen vaavadtem mehera hakkanaf petil vetzarich levaer zayin shel tizkeru vetzarich lehaarich bedalet shel echad kede sheyyamlichehu bashshamayim uvaaretz uvarba ruchot vetzarich shello yachtof bachet kede shello yehe keomer e chad
Kore adam et shema bechal lashon sheyyihye mevinah vehakkore bechal lashon tzarich lehizzaher middivre shibbush shebbeoto hallashon umdakdek beoto hallashon kemo shemmedakdek bilshon hakkodesh

Hakkore lemafrea lo yatza bamme devarim amurim beseder happesukim aval im hikdim parasha lefarasha af al pi sheeno rashshay ani omer sheyyatza lefi sheenah semucha lah battora kara pasuk vechazar ukrao paam sheniyya hare ze megunne kara milla achat uchfalah kegon shekkara shema shema meshattekin oto

Keraah serugin yatza afillu shaha ben serug leserug kede ligmor et kullah yatza vehu sheyyikra al hasseder keraah mitnamnem vehu mi sheeno er velo nirdam beshena yatza uvilvad sheyyihye er befasuk rishon

Safek kara keriat shema safek lo kara chozer vekore umvarech lefaneha ulachareha aval im yada shekkara venistappek lo im berech lefaneha ulachareha o lo berech eno chozer umvarech kara vetaa yachazor lammakom shettaa neelam mimmennu ben parasha lefarasha veeno yodea e zo parasha hishlim vee zo tzarich lehatchil chozer lefarasha rishona shehu veahavta et Adonai elohecha vego

Taa beemtza happerek veeno yodea lehechan pasak chozer lerosh happerek haya kore uchtavtam veeno yodea im hu beuchtavtam shel shema o beuchtavtam shebbivehaya im shamoa chozer leuchtavtam shel shema veim nistappek lo achar shekkara lemaan yirbu yemechem eno chozer sheal hergel leshono hu holech

Haya kore ufaga baacherim o pagu bo acherim im haya ben perek leferek posek umatchil veshoel shelom mi shehu chayyav bichvodo kegon sheppaga beaviv o rabbo o mi shehu gadol mimmennu bechachma umeshiv shalom lechal adam shennatan lo shalom

Haya kore beemtza happarasha eno posek umatchil lishl ella bishlom mi shehu mityare mimmennu kegon melech o annas vechayyotze bahen aval mi shehu chayyav bichvodo kegon aviv o rabbo im natan lo shalom techilla posek umeshiv lo shalom

Veellu hen ben happerakim ben beracha rishona lashsheniyya ben sheniyya lishma ben shema livehaya im shamoa ben vehaya im shamoa levayyomer ben happerakim haellu shoel mippene hakkavod umeshiv shalom lechal adam aval ben vayyomer leemet veyatztziv hare ze keemtza happerek velo yafsik ella lishl mippene hayyira ulhashiv mippene hakkavod
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 3: Hakore et shema rochetz yadav bammayim kodem sheyyikra higgia zeman keriatah velo matza mayim kodem sheyyikra lo yeacher keriatah veyelech levakkesh mayim ella mekanneach yadav beafar o bitzror o bekora vechayyotze bahen vekore

En korin lo bevet hammerchatz velo bevet hakkisse af al pi sheen bo tzoa velo bevet hakkevarot velo betzad hammet atzmo veim hirchik arba ammot min hakkever o min hammet muttar likrot vechal mi shekkara bemakom sheen korin bo chozer vekore

Bet hakkisse hechadash shehuchan vaadayin lo nishtammesh bo muttar likrot keriat shema lenegdo aval lo betocho merchatz hechadash muttar likrot betocho hau shene battim zimmen echad mehem levet hakkisse veamar al hashsheni veze hare hashsheni safek im hizmino lechach im lo lefichach en korin bo lechattechilla veim kara yatza amar gam ze hare shenehem mezummanin veen korin bahen chatzar hammerchatz vehu hammakom shebbene adam omdin bo levushin muttar likrot bo keriat shema

Velo keriat shema bilvad ella kal inyan shehu middivre hakkodesh asur leamro bevet hammerchatz uvvet hakkisse vaafillu amaro bilshon chol velo leamro bilvad ella afillu leharher belibbo bedivre tora bevet hakkisse uvvet hammerchatz uvimkom hattinofet vehu hammakom sheyyesh bo tzoa ume raglayim asur

Devarim shel chol muttar leamran bilshon kodesh bevet hakkisse vechen hakkinnuyim kegon rachum vechannun veneeman vechayyotze bahen muttar leamran bevet hakkisse aval hashshemot hamyuchadim vehen hashshemot sheenan nimchakin asur lehazkiran bevet hakkisse uvvet hammerchatz yashan veim nizdammen lo lehafrish min davar haasur bevet hammerchatz o bevet hakkisse mafrish vaafillu bilshon kodesh uvinyene kodesh

Tzoat haadam vetzoat kelavim vachazirin bizman sheyyesh betochan orot vechal tzoa sherechah ra kegon ellu asur likrot keriat shema kenegdan vechen keneged me raglayim shel adam aval me raglayim shel behema korin kenegdan katan sheeno yachol leechol kezayit dagan bichde sheyyochal haggadol kishlosha betze dagan en marchikin lo mitztzoato velo mimme raglav

Hayeta tzoa yevesha kecheres asur likrot kenegdah veim hayeta yevesha yoter mecheres ad sheim zerakah titparech hare hi keafar umuttar likrot kenegdah me raglayim shennivleu bakkarka im hau martivin hayyad asur likrot kenegdan veim lav muttar

Kamma yarchik adam mitztzoa umimme raglayim veachar kach yikra arba ammot bamme devarim amurim bizman shehem millaachorav o mitztziddav aval im hau keneged panav marchik mehen ad shello yire otan veachar kach yikra

Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya immahen babbayit bemakom shave aval im haya sham makom gavoha mehen asara tefachim o namuch mehem asara tefachim yoshev betzad hammakom vekore shehare nifsak benehem vehu shello yaggia lo reach ra vechen im kafa keli al hatztzoa o al meme raglayim af al pi shehen immo babbayit hare ellu kikvurin umuttar likrot kenegdan

Haya beno uven hatztzoa mechitztza shel zechuchit af al pi shehu roe otah meachare hazzechuchit muttar likrot betziddah natan reviit mayim letoch me raglayim shel paam achat muttar likrot immahen betoch arba ammot

Hayeta tzoa beguma omed besandalo al hagguma vekore vehu shello yihye sandalo nogea bah hayeta kenegdo tzoa meuta beoter kemo tippa rokek aleha rok ave ad shettitkasse vekore hayeta netishat tzoa al besaro o yadav metunnafot mibbet hakkisse velo haya lahen reach ra kelal mippene katnan o yavshutan muttar likrot lefi sheen lahen reach ra aval im hayeta bimkomah af al pi sheenah niret keshehu omed hoil veniret keshehu yoshev asur likrot ad sheyekanneach yafe yafe mippene shehatztzoa lacha hi veyesh lah reach ra vechamma geonim horu sheasur lo likrot im hau yadav metunnafot vechach rauy laasot

Reach ra sheyyesh lo ikkar marchik ammot vekore im pasak hareach veim lo pasak hareach marchik ad makom sheppasak hareach vesheen lo ikkar kegon mi sheyyatza mimmennu ruach millematta marchik ad makom shettichle hareach vekore geraf shel rei vaavit shel meme raglayim asur likrot keriat shema kenegdan veaf al pi sheen bahen kelum veen lahem reach ra mippene shehem kevet hakkisse
Tzoa overet kegon shehayeta shata al pene hammayim asur likrot kenegdah ufi chazir ketzoa overet dami veasur likrot kenegdo ad sheyyaavru mimmennu arba ammot

Haya kore vehiggia limkom hattinnofet lo yanniach yado al piv veyikra ella yafsik ad sheyyaavor meoto makom vechen hakkore sheyyatzta mimmennu ruach millematta yafsik ad shettichle baashah vechozer likriato vechen bedivre tora yatzta ruach mechavero af al pi shemmafsik likriat shema eno posek ledivre tora

Haya kore keriat shema bevayit venistappek lo im yesh sham tzoa o meme raglayim o en sham hare ze muttar likrot haya kore baashpa venistappek lo im yesh sham tzoa o en sham lo yikra ad sheyyivdok shechezkat haashpa shehi mekom hattinnofet aval sefek me raglayim afillu baashpa muttar likrot

Keshem sheasur likrot keneged tzoa ume raglayim ad sheyyarchik kach asur likrot keneged haerva ad sheyyachazir panav afillu kuti o katan lo yikra keneged ervatan afillu mechitztza shel zechuchit mafseket hoil vehu roe otah asur likrot ad sheyyachazir panav vechal guf haishsha erva lefichach lo yistakkel beguf haishsha keshehu kore vaafillu ishto veim haya megulle tefach miggufah lo yikra kenegdah

Uchshem shehu asur keneged ervat acherim kach hu asur likrot keneged ervato velo yikra keshehu arom ad sheyechasse ervato hayeta chagora shel beged o or o sak al matnav af al pi sheshshear gufo arom muttar lo likrot keriat shema vehu shello yihye akevo nogea beervato haya yashen betallito vehaya arom chotzetz betallito mittachat libbo vekore aval lo yachotz tzavaro veyikra mippene shellibbo roe et haerva venimtza kemi shekkore belo chagora

Shenayim shehau yeshenim betallit achat kal echad mehen asur likrot af al pi sheyechasse mittachat libbo ad shettehe tallit mafseket benehen ad shello yigga besar ze bivsar ze mimmatnav ulmatta veim haya yashen im ishto o banav uvne beto hakketannim hare gufan kegufo veeno margish mehen lefichach af al pi shebbesaro nogea bahem machazir panav vechotzetz mittachat libbo vekore

Ad ematay hem ketannim leinyan ze ad sheyehe hazzachar ben shettem esre shana veom echad vehannekeva bat achat esre shana veom echad vehu sheyehe tavnitam ketavnit gedolim shadayim nachonu usarech tzimmeach veachar kach lo yikra ad shettafsik tallit benehen aval im adayin lo hau shadayim nachonu usarech tzimmeach kore immahen bekeruv basar veeno tzarich hefsek ad sheyyihye hazzachar ben shana veom echad vehannekeva bat shettem esre shana veom echad
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 4: Nashim vaavadim uktannim peturim mikkeriat shema umlammedin et hakketannim likrotah beonatah umvarchin lefaneha ulachareha kede lechannechan bemitzot mi shehaya libbo tarud venechpaz lidvar mitzva patur mikkal hammitzot umikkeriat shema lefichach chatan shennasa betula patur mikkeriat shema ad sheyyavo aleha lefi sheen dato penuya shemma lo yimtza lah betulim veim shaha ad motzae shabbat velo baal chayyav likrot mimmotzae shabbat veelach shehare nitkarra dato velibbo gas bah af al pi shello baal
Aval hannose et habbeula af al pi sheosek bemitzva chayyav likrot hoil veen lo davar shemmevalbel dato vechen kal kayyotze baze

Mi shemmet lo met shehu chayyav lehitabbel alav patur mikkeriat shema ad sheyyikberennu mippene sheen dato penuya likrot veim haya meshammer et hammet af al pi sheeno meto patur mikkeriat shema veim hau hashshomrim shenayim haechad meshammer vehashsheni nishmat lemakom acher vekore vechozer umshammer venishmat haacher vekore vechen hachofer kever lemet patur mikkeriat shema

En motziin et hammet lekavro samuch lizman keriat shema ella im ken haya adam gadol veim hitchilu vehotziu vehiggia zeman hakkeria vehen melavin et hammet kal sheyyesh lammitta tzorech bahen kegon nose hammitta vechillufehen vechillufe chillufehen ben shehau lifne hammitta ben shehau leachar hammitta peturin ushar hamlavin sheen lammitta tzorech bahen chayyavin

Hau asukim behesped vehiggia zeman keriat shema bizman shehammet munnach lifnehen nishmatim echad echad vekorin vechozrin lahesped en hammet muttal lifnehem kal haam korin keriat shema vehaavel yoshev vedomem lefi sheeno chayyav likrot ad sheyyikbor et meto

Kavru et hammet vechazru haavelim lekabbel tanchumin vechal haam holchim acharehem mimmekom hakkever lammakom sheomdim bo haavelim laasot shura lekabbel tanchumin im yecholin haam lehatchil veligmor afillu pasuk echad kodem sheyyaggiu lashshura yatchilu veim lav lo yatchilu ella yenachamu et haavelim veachar sheyyippatru mehen yatchilu likrot bene adam haomdin bashshura happenimiyyim shehen roin pene haavelim peturin mikkeriat shema vehachitzonim hoil veenan roin et haavelim chayyavin bikriat shema bimkoman

Kal mi shehu patur millikrot keriat shema im ratza lehachamir al atzmo likrot kore vehu shettehe dato penuya alav aval im haya ze happatur millikrot mevohal eno rashshay likrot ad shettityashshev dato alav

Kal hattemein chayyavin bikriat shema umvarchin lefaneha ulachareha vehen betumatan af al pi sheefshar lahen laalot mittumatan bo bayyom kegon hannogin besheretz o benidda vezava umishkavah vechayyotze bahen veezra uvet dino tikkenu shello yikra bedivre tora baal keri levaddo vehotziuhu mikkelal shear hattemein ad sheyyitbol velo pashta takkana zo bechal yisrael velo haya koach berov hatztzibbur laamod bah lefichach batla uchvar nahagu kal yisrael likrot battora velikrot keriat shema vehen baale kerayin lefi sheen divre tora mekabbelin tuma ella omdin betahoratan leolam shenneemar halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai ma esh enah mekabbelet tuma af divre tora enam mekabbelin tuma
Mishneh Torah, Tefillin, Mezuzah and the: Arba parashiyyot ellu shehen kaddesh li vehaya chi yeviacha Adonai shebbesefer veelle shemot u shema vehaya im shamoa hen shennichtavot bifne atzman umchappin otan beor venikrain tefillin umannichin otan al harosh vekoshrin otan al hayyad vaafillu kotzo shel ot achat mearba parashiyyot ellu meakkev et kullan min hattora ad sheyyihu nichtavot shelemot ketikkunan

Vechen shette parashiyyot shebbammezuza shehen shema vehaya im shamoa afillu ot achat mishshette happarashiyyot im chaser kotzo meakkev min hattora ad sheyyihu shettehen nichtavot shelemot vechen sefer tora shechisser afillu ot achat pasul

Asara devarim yesh battefillin kullan halacha lemoshe missinay vechullan meakkevin lefichach im shinna beachat mehen hare hattefillin pesulot shenayim hen bichtivatan ushmona bechippuyan ukshirat retzuotehen veellu hen hashshenayim shebbichtivatan shekkotvin otan bido vesheyyihu nichtavin al hakkelaf

Ketzad maase haddeo mekabbetzin heashan shel shemanim o shel zefet veshel shaava vechayyotze bahen vegovlin otan bisraf hailan uvimat devash velottin oto harbe vedachin oto ad sheyyease rekikin umyabbeshin oto umatzniin oto uvishat ketiva shorehu beme afatzim vechayyotze bo vechotev bo sheim timchakennu yihye nimchak vezehu haddeo shemmitzva min hammuvchar lichtov bo sefarim tefillin umzuzot veim katav shelashtan beme aftza vekankantom shehu omed veeno nimchak kesheriyim

Im ken ma miata hahalacha shenneemar lemoshe missinay sheyyihu ketuvim bido lemaet shear mine tzivonin kegon haadom vehayyarok vechayyotze bahen sheim katav bassefarim o battefillin o bammezuzot afillu ot achat bishar mine tzivonin o bezahav hare ellu pesulin

Shalosh orot hen gevil uklaf veduchsustus ketzad lokchin or behema o chayya umaavirin hassear mimmennu techilla veachar kach molchin oto bemelach veachar kach meabbedin oto bekemach veachar kach baaftza vechayyotze bo middevarim shemmechavvetzin et haor umchazzekin oto veze hu hannikra gevil

Veim lakchu haor achar sheheeviru searo vechilleku oto beavo lishnayim kemo shehaabbedanin osin ad sheyyihu shene orot echad dak hu shemmimmul hassear veechad ave vehu shemmimmul habbasar veibbedu oto bemelach veachar kach bekemach veachar kach baaftza vechayyotze bo ze hachelek shemmimmul hassear nikra duchsustus veze shemmimmul habbasar nikra kelaf

Halacha lemoshe missinay sheyyihu kotvin sefer tora al haggevil vechotvin bimkom hassear vesheyyihu kotvin hattefillin al hakkelaf vechotvin bimkom habbasar vesheyyihu kotvin hammezuza al duchsustus vechotvin bimkom hassear vechal hakkotev al hakkelaf bimkom sear o shekkatav bigvil uvduchsustus bimkom basar pasul

Af al pi shekkach hi halacha lemoshe missinay im katav sefer tora al hakkelaf kasher velo neemar gevil ella lemaet duchsustus sheim katav alav hassefer pasul vechen im katav et hammezuza al hakkelaf o al haggevil kasher lo amru al duchsustus ella lemitzva

En kotvin sefarim tefillin umzuzot al gabbe or behema temea veof vechayya hattemeim aval kotvin al gabbe or behema vechayya vaof tehorim vaafillu nevelot utrefot shellahen veen kotvin al gabbe or haddag hattahor mippene hazzuhama sheen hazzuhama poseket beibbudah

Gevil shel sefer tora uklaf shel tefillin o shel sefer tora tzarich leabbed otan lishman veim ibbedan shello lishman pesulin lefichach im ibbedan hakkuti pesulin af al pi sheamarnu lo lakkuti leabbed or ze leshem hassefer o leshem hattefillin pesulin shehakkuti al daat atzmo hu ose lo al daat hassocher oto lefichach kal davar shetztzarich maase lishmo im asahu hakkuti pasul umzuza enah tzericha haavada lishmah

Halacha lemoshe missinay sheen kotvin sefer tora velo mezuza ella besirtut aval tefillin enan tzerichin sirtut lefi shehen mechuppin umuttar lichtov tefillin umzuza shello min hakketav shehakkol gorsin parashiyyot ellu aval sefer tora asur lichtov afillu ot achat shello min hakketav

Sefer tora tefillin umzuzot shekketavan eppikoros yissarfu ketavan kuti o yisrael mumar o moser beyad annas o eved o ishsha o katan hare ellu pesulin veyigganzu shenneemar ukshartam uchtavtam kal shemmuzhar al hakkeshira umaamin bah hu shekkotev nimtzeu beyad eppikoros veeno yodea mi ketavan yigganzu nimtzeu beyad kuti kesherim veen lokchin sefarim tefillin umzuzot min hakkutim beoter al demehem shello lehargil otan leganvan ulgazlan
Sefer tora tefillin umzuzot shekketavan al gabbe or behema chayya veof hattemein o al gabbe orot sheenam meubbadin o shekkatav sefer tora utfillin al or shello ibbedan lishman hare ellu pesulin

Hakkotev sefer tora o tefillin o mezuza uvishat ketiva lo hayeta lo kavana vechatav azkara min haazkarot shebbahen shello lishman pesulin lefichach hakkotev et hashshem afillu melech yisrael shoel bishlomo lo yeshivennu haya kotev shenayim o shelosha shemot hare ze mafsik benehem umeshiv

Hattovel et hakkulmos lichtov et hashshem lo yatchil meot hashshem aval matchil hu meot shellefanav shachach lichtov et hashshem kullo tole oto ben hashshittot aval miktzat hashshem bashshitta umiktzato taluy pasul uvishar hattevot im shachach kotev miktzat hatteva bashshitta umiktzatah lemala bamme devarim amurim besefer tora aval bimzuza utfillin en tolin bahen afillu ot achat ella im shachach afillu ot achat gonez ma shekkatav vechotev acheret umuttar lichtov et hashshem al mekom haggered veal mekom hammachak bechullan
Kotve sefarim tefillin umzuzot asur lahem lahafoch hayeria al paneha ella pores aleha beged o koflah

Sefer tora tefillin umzuza sheamar hassofer achar sheyyatzu mittachat yado lo katavti haazkarot shebbahen lishman eno neeman lefaslan aval neeman hu lehafsid kal secharo velamma eno neeman lefaslan shemma lo nitkaven ella lehafsid al hallokeach o al ze shessecharo vedome sheeno mafsid baamira zo ella sechar haazkarot lefichach im amar sefer tora ze o tefillin ellu orot shellahen enam meubbadot lishman mittoch shenneeman lehafsid secharo neeman lefaslan shehare hakkol yodim sheim en haorot meubbadim lishman en sachar lo kelal

En kotvin tefillin umzuza ella bichtav ashshurit vehittiru bassefarim lichtov af bivani bilvad uchvar nishka yevani min haolam venishtabbesh veavad lefichach en kotvin hayyom shelashtan ella ashshurit vetzarich lehizzaher bichtivatan kede shello tidbak ot beot shekkal ot sheen haor makkif lah mearba ruchoteha pasul vechal ot sheen hattinok sheeno lo chacham velo sachal yachol likrotah pasul lefichach tzarich lehizzaher betzurat haotiyyot shello tidme hayyud levav velo vav leud velo kaf levet velo bet lechaf velo dalet leresh velo resh ledalet vechen kal kayyotze baze ad sheyyarutz kal hakkore bahen

Or shehaya nakuv lo yichtov al gabbe hannekev vechal nekev shehaddeo overet alav eno nekev umuttar lichtov alav lefichach muttar lichtov al gabbe or haof shennitabbed nikkav haor achar shennichtav im nikkav betoch haot kegon toch he o toch mem vechen bishar otiyyot kasher nikkav bayyarech shel ot ad shennifseka im nishtayyer mimmenna melo ot ketanna kasher vehu shello tidme leot acheret veim lo nishtayyer mimmenna melo ot ketanna pesula

Ketzad kotvin et hattefillin shel rosh kotvin arba parashiyyot al arba kelafin vegollin kal echad veechad levaddo umannichin otan bearba battim shehen mechubbarin beor echad veshel yad kotvin otan haarba parashiyyot bearba dappin al kelaf echad vegollelo kemin sefer tora missofo litchillato umannicho bevayit echad
Vetzarich lehizzaher bapparashiyyot sheim asa hassetuma petucha o happetucha setuma pesalan ushloshet happarashiyyot harishonot kullan petuchot ufarasha acharona shehi vehaya im shamoa setuma

Vetzarich lehizzaher bemale vechaser ad sheyyihu arbatan ketuvot kemo shehen ketuvot besefer tora habbaduk sheim katav hechaser male pasul ad sheyyimchok hayyater veim katav hammale chaser pasul veen lo takkana veellu hen hachaserot vehammeleot sheyyesh bearba parashiyyot ellu

Parasha rishona kaddesh li chal bechor male zachor male bechozek chaser hotzi male yotzim chaser vav yeviacha male vehaemori chaser vehayevusi male laavotecha chaser vav haavoda chaser matztzot chaser hashshevii male matztzot male seor chaser gevulecha chaser baavur male leot male ulzikkaron male enecha male torat male hotziacha chaser yud hachukka chaser lemoadah male

Parasha sheniyya vehaya ki yeviacha chaser yud velaavotecha chaser vav chamor chaser bechor male bechozek chaser hotzianu male vayyaharog chaser bechor male mibbechor chaser vead bechor male zoveach chaser vav vechal bechor male leot male yadcha katuv behe ultotafot chaser vav tinyana enecha male bechozek chaser hotzianu male

Parasha shelishit shema ayin shel shema gedola dalet shel echad gedola meodecha chaser levanecha male bevetecha belo yud sheniyya uvkumecha male leot male yadecha chaser letotafot chaser shene vavin enecha male mezuzot chaser vav rishona betecha belo yud sheniyya uvisharecha male

Parasha reviit vehaya im shamoa chaser mitzotay bevav achat yore male umalkosh male vetiroshcha chaser vav vehishtachavitem male yevulah male hattova chaser noten chaser otam chaser leot male letotafot chaser vav sheniyya enechem male otam chaser bevetecha belo yud sheniyya uvkumecha male mezuzot male betecha belo yud sheniyya uvisharecha male laavotechem chaser vav
Vetzarich lehizzaher betagin shel otiyyot vehen kemo zayinnin zekufot sheyyesh lahen tag kemo shehen ketuvin besefer tora veellu hen haotiyyot hamtuyyagot shebbearba parashiyyot ellu

Parasha rishona yesh bah ot achat bilvad vehi mem setuma shel miyyamim aleha shalosh zayinnin parasha sheniyya yesh lah chamesh otiyyot vechal achat mehen he veal kal he mechamishtan arba zayinnin vehen he shel untanah vehe rishona vehe acharona shel hiksha vehe shel vayyaharog vehe shel yadcha parasha shelishit yesh bah chamesh otiyyot veellu hen kuf shel uvkumecha yesh aleha shalosh zayinnin vekuf shel ukshartam yesh aleha shalosh zayinnin vetet tet fe shel letotafot al kal ot mishshelashtan arba zayinnin parasha reviit yesh bah chamesh otiyyot fe shel veasafta yesh aleha shalosh zayinnin vetav shel veasafta yesh aleha zayin achat vetet tet fe shel letotafot al kal achat mishshelashtan arba zayinnin kal haotiyyot hamtuyyagot shesh esre veim lo asa hattagin o hosif vegara bahen lo pasal

Hallokeach tefillin mimmi sheeno mumche tzarich levadkan lakach mimmennu mea ketzitzot bodek mehen shalosh ketzitzot o shettayim shel rosh veachat shel yad o shettayim shel yad veachat shel rosh im metzaam kesherim huchzak ze haish vahare kullan kesherim veen hashshear tzarich bedika veim lekacham tzevatim tzevatim kullan tzerichot bedika shechezkat hatztzevatim meanashim harbe lekuchim

Hakkotev tefillin bichtav yado o shellekachan min hammumche o mishshear adam uvdakan vehecheziran leoran leolam eno tzarich levadkam paam acheret vaafillu leachar kamma shanim kal zeman shechippuyan shalem hare hen bechezkatan veen choshshin lahen shemma nimchaka ot mittochan o shennikkeva hillel hazzaken haya omer ellu mishshel avi ima

Shemone halachot yesh bemaase hattefillin kullan halacha lemoshe missinay ulfichach kullan meakkevot veim shinna beachat mehen pasal veellu hem sheyyihu merubbaot vechen tefiratan beribbua vaalachsonan beribbua ad sheyyihye lahen arba zaviyyot shaot vesheyyihye baor shel rosh tzurat shin miyyamin umissemol vesheyyichroch happarashiyyot bematlit vesheyyichroch otan besear meal hammatlit veachar kach machnisan bevattehen vesheyyihu tofrin otan begidin vesheosin lahen maboret meor hachippuy shettikkanes bah hartzua ad shettehe overet veholechet betoch tovar shellah vesheyyihu hartzuot shechorot vesheyyihye hakkesher shellahen kesher yadua ketzurat dalet

Ketzad osim tefillin shel rosh lokchin etz merubba arko kerachbo uchgavho veim haya gavho yoter al rachbo o pachot mimmennu en bechach kelum veen makpidin ella al arko sheyehe kerachbo vechofrin bo shelosha charitzin kede sheyyease lo arba rashim kegon ze velokchin or umartivin oto bemayim umsimin bo et haetz umachnisin et haor ben kal charitz vecharitz umchammeshim oto vehu ratov mikkan umikkan ad sheosin bo demut shin sheyyesh lah shelosha rashin miyyamin hammeniach tefillin udmut shin sheyyesh lah arbaa rashim missemol hammeniach

Umannichin et haor al haetz ad sheyyivash veachar kach choletz haor meal gabbe haimmum shel etz venimtza haor sheyyesh bo arbaa battim penuyin umachnisin parasha bechal bayit uvayit umachzirin miktzat haor millematta vetofrin oto mearba pinnotav umannichin min haor shellematta makom shettikkanes bo hartzua kemo tovar vehu hannikra maboret

Vechetzad osin tefillin shel yad lokchin etz merubba arko kerachbo veyihye gavho keetzba o yater al ze meat o pachot meat umchappin oto beor ratov umannichin et haor al haimmum ad sheyyivash vecholetz et haor umanniach et arba happarashiyyot bimkom haetz umachazir miktzat haor millematta vetofro mearba pinnotav umannichin min haor tovar mekom hartzuot

Ketzad siddur happarashiyyot bitfilla shel rosh machnis parasha acharona shehi vehaya im shamoa bevayit rishon shehu al yemin hammeniach u shema semucha lah vehaya chi yeviacha bevayit shelishi semucha lishma ve kaddesh li bevayit revii shehu lismol hammeniach tefillin kede sheyehe hakkore shellefanav keneged pene hammeniach kore al hasseder hazze kegon ze veim hechelif siddur ze pesulot
Tefilla shel yad kotvam bearbaa dappin beor echad aroch kesefer tora al sidduran battora kegon ze im ketavan al arba orot vehichnisan bevayit echad yatza veeno tzarich ledabbekam
Keshehu golel happarashiyyot ben shel rosh ben shel yad golel otan missofan litchillatan ad shettimtza keshettiftach happarasha tikra kal parasha ufarasha mittechillatah ad sofah

Uchshemmachnisin et happarashiyyot babbattim shellahem korchin otan bematlit veal hammatlit sear veachar kach machnisin otan bevattehen vesear ze tzarich lihot sear behema o shel chayya tehora vaafillu minnevelot utrefot shellahen uchvar nahagu kal haam levarchan lecharchan bisar zenav haagalim

Keshettofrin et hattefillin en tofrin ella begidin shel behema o shel chayya tehora vaafillu minnevelot utrefot shellahen lokchin haggidin sheyyesh baakev habbehema o hachayya tehorim vehem levanim veim hem kashim merakkechin otan baavanim vechayyotze bahen ad sheyyeasu kefishtan vetovin otan veshozrin otan uvahen tofrin hattefillin viriot sefer tora

Keshettofrin hattefillin tofrin otan beribbua vahalacha rovachat sheyyihu bechal tzad shalosh tefirot ad sheyyihu hakkol shettem esre tefirot ben shel yad ben shel rosh veim asa hattefirot eser o arba esre ose vechal hattefirot yihye hachut shellahen sovev mishshette ruchot

Vetzarich sheyyaggia hecharitz shel tefillin shel rosh ad mekom hattefer veim haya hecharitz nikkar kede sheyyihu arbaa rashin nirin lakkol veaf al pi sheen hecharitz maggia limkom hattefer kesherot veim en charitz nikkar pesulot vetzarich lehaavir betoch kal charitz vecharitz al gabbe haor chut o meshicha lehavdil ben bayit levayit uminhag pashut lehaavir gid miggide hattefira bechal charitz vecharitz mishshelashtan

Vechetzad osin hartzuot lokchin retzua shel or rechava keorech hasseora veim hayeta rechava mizzo hashshiur keshera veorech retzua shel rosh kede shettakkif et harosh veyikshor mimmenna hakkesher vetimtach shette hartzuot mikkan umikkan ad sheyyaggiu lattabbur o lemala mimmennu meat veorech retzua shel yad kede shettakkif et hazzeroa veyikshor mimmenna hakkesher vetimmatach retzua achat al etzba emtzait veyichroch mimmenna al etzbao shalosh kerichot veyikshor veim hau hartzuot arukkot yater al shiurim haellu kesherot

Lefichach anu chayyavin lehodot lecha ulshabbechacha ulfaercha velitten shevach vehodaa lishmecha vechayyavin anu lomar lefanecha bechal yom erev vavoker shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad ashrenu ma tov chelkenu ma naim goralenu ma yafa yerushshatenu ashrenu sheanu mashkimin umaarivin bechal yom tamid erev vavoker veomrim shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad atta hu kodem shennivra haolam atta hu achar shennivra haolam atta hu baolam hazze veatta hu laolam habba atta hu rishon veatta hu acharon kaddesh shimcha haggadol vehakkadosh beolamecha uvishuatcha tarum vetagbiha karnenu baruch hamkaddesh shemo barabbim atta hu Adonai elohenu bashshamayim mimmaal veal haaretz mittachat uvishme hashshamayim haelonim atta hu rishon veatta hu acharon umibbaladecha en elohim kabbetz kocha mearba kanfot haaretz yakkiru veyedu kal bae olam ki atta hu haelohim levaddecha lechol mamlechot haaretz atta asita et hashshamayim veet haaretz umi bechal maase yadecha baelonim o vattachtonim mi sheyyomar lecha ma taase avinu shebbashshamayim ase immanu kemo shehivtachtanu al yede chozecha baet hahi avi etchem uvaet kabbetzi etchem ki etten etchem leshem velithilla bechol amme haaretz beshuvi et shevutechem leenechem amar Adonai veneemar atta hu Adonai levaddecha atta asita et hashshamayim sheme hashshamayim vechal tzevaam haaretz vechal asher aleha hayyammim vechal asher bahem veatta mechayye et kullam utzva hashshamayim lecha mishtachavim atta hu Adonai haelohim asher bacharta beavram vehotzeto meur kasdim vesamta shemo avraham atta hu ushnotecha lo yittammu Adonai melech Adonai malach Adonai yimloch leolam vaed Adonai melech chu ad baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen

Beracha rishona shemmevarchin lifne pesuke hazzemirot zehu nuschah baruch sheamar vehaya haolam baruch hu baruch omer veose baruch gozer umkayyem baruch merachem al haaretz baruch merachem al habberiyyot baruch maavir afela umevi ora baruch meshallem sachar tov lireav baruch sheen lefanecha lo avela lo shichcha velo kazav velo mirma lo masso fanim velo mikkach shochad baruch el chay laad vekayyam lanetzach baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hael hamhullal befi ammo meshubbach umfoar bilshon kal chasidav vaavadav uvshire david avdecha meshichecha nehallelcha Adonai elohenu bishvachot uvizmirot nodecha unshabbechacha unfaercha venazkir shimcha malkenu elohenu yachid che haolamim meshubbach umfoar ade ad shemo baruch atta Adonai melech mehullal battishbachot vekorin pesukin ellu yehi chevod Adonai leolam yismach Adonai bemaasav chu ashre chu ad sof tillim veachar kach kore pesukim ellu baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen vayevarech david et Adonai leene kal hakkahal vayyomer david baruch atta Adonai elohe yisrael vechu

Beracha acharona shel achar pesuke hazzemirot zehu nuschah yishtabbach shimcha laad malkenu hael hammelech haggadol vehakkadosh bashshamayim uvaaretz ki lecha nae Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu vechu vekore hashshira ad sofah keminhag hammakom beshabbat nahagu kal haam lehosif lifne beracha zo nosach ze nishmat kal chay tevarech et shimcha Adonai elohenu veruach kal basar tefaer utromem zichrecha malkenu tamid ledor vador umeolam vead olam atta el umibbaladecha en elohim veen lanu melech goel umoshia pode umatztzil bechal et tzara vetzuka ella atta mefarnes umrachem eloha kal beriyyot adon hattoladot hamhullal battishbachot hamnaheg olamo bechesed uvriyyotav berachamim rabbim elohim emet lo yanum velo yishan hamorer yeshenim vehammekitz nirdamim somech noflim verofe cholim umattir asurim ulcha anachnu modim veillu finu male shira kayyam ulshonenu rinna kahamon gallav vesiftotenu shevach kemerchave rakia veenenu meirot kashshemesh vechayyareach veyadenu perusot kenishre shamayim veraglenu kallot kaayyalot en anu maspikin lehodot lecha Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu ulvarech et shemecha al achat meelef alfe alafim verov rubbe revavot peamim hattovot nissim ugvurot sheasita immanu veim avotenu millefanim mimmitzrayim gealtanu Adonai elohenu mibbet avadim peditanu baraav zantanu uvsava kilkaltanu mecherev hitztzaltanu umiddever millattanu umecholaim raim rabbim dillitanu vead henna azarunu rachamecha Adonai elohenu velo azavunu chasadecha al ken evarim sheppillagta banu veruach unshama shennafachta beappenu velashon asher samta befinu hen hem yodu vivarchu et shimcha Adonai elohenu vechu yishtabbach vechu vechen nahagu likrot kal mizmor shir leom hashshabbat kodem sheyyatchilu pesuke hazzemirot beom hashshabbat uvom hakkippurim veyesh mekomot shennahagu likrot hallel haggadol beshabbatot kodem pesuke hazzemirot veyesh mekomot shennahagu likrot shir hammaalot hakkol keminhagam

Beracha rishona shellifne keriat shema zo hi nuschah baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam yotzer or uvore choshech chu ad yotzer hammeorot beracha sheniyya ahavat olam ahavtanu Adonai elohenu chemla gedola vitera chamalta alenu avinu malkenu chu ad beammo yisrael beahava

Beracha acharona shelleachar keriat shema zo hi nuschah emet veyatztziv vechu ad baruch atta Adonai gaal yisrael uvarvit beracha rishona baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bidvaro maariv aravim ad baruch atta Adonai hammaariv aravim beracha sheniyya ahavat olam bet yisrael ammecha ahavta vechu ad baruch atta Adonai ohev ammo yisrael
Beracha rishona shelleachar keriat shema shel arvit zo hi nuschah emet veemuna kal zot kayyam alenu chu ad baruch atta Adonai gaal yisrael

Beracha acharona zo hi nuschah hashkivenu Adonai elohenu leshalom vechu ad baruch shomer ammo yisrael laad baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen chu ad padita oti Adonai el emet yiru enenu veyismach libbenu chu ad Adonai melech Adonai malach Adonai yimloch leolam vaed

Venahagu miktzat haam levarech pesukim beemtza beracha vekorin benosach ze vayyar kal haam vayyippelu al penehem vayyomru Adonai hu haelohim Adonai hu haelohim hoshienu elohe yishenu vekabbetzenu vehatztzilenu min haggoyim lehodot leshem kadshecha lehishtabbeach bithillatecha ki lo yittosh Adonai et ammo baavur shemo haggadol ki hoil Adonai laasot etchem lo leam vealu moshiim behar tziyyon lishpot et har esav vehayeta layeya hammelucha vehaya Adonai lemelech al kal haaretz bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushmo echad elohenu shebbashshamayim yached shimcha hakkaruy alenu kayyem et shemecha umalchutecha alenu tamid beyadcha nafshot hachayyim vehammetim asher beyado nefesh kal chay veruach kal besar ish beyadcha afkid ruchi padita oti Adonai el emet vaanachnu ammecha vetzon maritecha node lecha leolam ledor vador nesapper tehillatecha Adonai hatztzila nafshi missefat sheker millashon remiyya yisrael nosha bayeya teshuat olamim lo tevoshu velo tikkalmu ad olme ad yehi Adonai elohenu immanu kaasher haya im avotenu al yaazvenu veal yitteshenu lehattot levavenu elav lalechet bechal derachav lishmor mitzotav vechukkav umishpatav asher tziva et avotenu kal hanneshama tehallel yah halluyah baruch Adonai bayyom baruch Adonai ballayela baruch Adonai beshachvenu baruch Adonai bekumenu tamid nehallelcha sela venasiach bechukkecha uveemunatecha baruch atta Adonai hammolech bichvodo chay vekayyam tamid yimloch alenu vechu
Mishneh Torah, The Order of Prayer 2: Baruch atta Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu elohe avraham elohe yitzchak velohe yaakov hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora vechu
Atta gibbor leolam adonay mechayye metim atta rav lehoshia morid hattal mashshiv haruach umorid haggashem mechalkel chayyim bechesed mechayye metim berachamim rabbim somech noflim vechu
Atta kadosh veshimcha kadosh ukdoshim bechal yom yehallucha sela baruch atta Adonai hael hakkadosh
Atta chonen leadam daat umlammed leenosh bina vechannenu meittecha dea chachma uvina vehaskel baruch atta Adonai chonen haddaat
Hashivenu avinu letoratecha vedabbekenu bemitzotecha vekarvenu malkenu laavodatecha vehachazirenu bitshuva shelema lefanecha baruch atta Adonai harotze bitshuva
Selach lanu avinu ki chatanu mechol lanu malkenu ki pashanu lecha ki el tov vesallach atta baruch atta Adonai channun hammarbe lisloach
Ree na veanyenu veriva rivenu vedun dinenu umaher legaolenu ki el melech goel chazak atta baruch atta Adonai goel yisrael
Refaenu Adonai elohenu venerafe hoshienu venivashea ki tehillatenu atta vehaale refua shelema lechal tachaluenu ki el rofe verachaman atta baruch atta Adonai rofe chole ammo yisrael

Barchenu Adonai elohenu bechal maase yadenu uvarech et shenotenu veten tal umatar li beracha al kal pene haadama vesabba et haolam mibbirchotecha verave pene tevel baruch atta Adonai mevarech hashshanim
Teka beshofar gadol lecherutenu vesa nes lekabbetz et kal galuyyotenu mearba kanfot kal haaretz leartzenu baruch atta Adonai mekabbetz niddeche ammo yisrael

Hashiva shoftenu kevarishona veoatzenu kevattechilla vehaser mimmennu yagon vaanacha umloch alenu atta levaddecha bechesed uvrachamim betzedek uvmishpat baruch atta Adonai melech ohev tzedaka umishpat
Lammalshinim al tehi tikva vechal haeppikorosin kullam kerega yovedu umalchut zadon teakker utshabber bimhera veyamenu baruch atta Adonai shover reshaim umachnia zedim
Al hachasidim veal hatztzaddikim veal gere hatztzedek veal sheerit ammecha bet yisrael yehemu rachamecha Adonai elohenu veten sachar tov lechal habbotchim beshimcha beemet vechu
Tishkon betoch yerushalayim ircha kaasher dibbarta uvne otah binyan olam bimhera veyamenu baruch atta Adonai bone yerushalayim
Et tzemach david bimhera tatzmiach vekarno tarum bishuatecha baruch atta Adonai matzmiach keren yeshua
Shema kolenu Adonai elohenu vechus verachem alenu vekabbel berachamim uvratzon et tefillatenu malkenu rekam al teshivenu ki atta shomea vechu
Retze Adonai elohenu beammecha yisrael velitfillatam shee vehashev haavoda lidvir betecha veishshe yisrael utfillatam vechu baruch atta Adonai hammachazir shechinato letziyyon
Modim anachnu lach shaatta hu Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu tzur chayyenu umagen yishenu atta ledor vador node lecha unsapper tehillatecha al chayyenu vechu
Sim shalom tova uvracha chen vachesed verachamim alenu veal yisrael ammecha uvarchenu kullanu mimmeor panecha natatta lanu Adonai elohenu tora vechayyim ahava vechu

Bimot hachamma omer bivracha sheniyya rav lehoshia morid hattal mechalkel chayyim bechesed vechu umvarech beracha teshiit benosach ze barchenu Adonai elohenu bechal maase yadenu uvarech et shenatenu betalle ratzon beracha undava kashshanim hattovot baruch atta Adonai mevarech hashshanim

Belel motzae shabbat uvmotzae yom hakkippurim uvmotzae yamim tovim mevarech beracha reviit benosach ze atta chonen leadam daat umlammed leenosh bina atta hivdalta ben kodesh lechol ben or lechoshech ben yisrael laammim ben yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase keshem shehivdalta ben kodesh lechol ken pedenu vehatztzilenu mikkal mine mashchit umikkal mine furanuyyot hammitraggeshot lavo baolam veshamrenu min hakkol vechannenu meittecha vechu

Berashe chodashim uvchullo shel moed mosif bevirkat bearvit veshacharit umincha umvarech otah benosach ze retze Adonai elohenu vechu ad avodat yisrael ammecha elohenu velohe avotenu yaale veyavo vechu vetechezena enenu vechu
Uvchullo shel moed omer beom mikra kodesh hazze beom moed chag hammatztzot hazze o beom moed chag hashshavuot hazze o beom moed chag hassukkot hazze

Beom taanit mevarech hayyachid birkat benosach ze shema kolenu Adonai elohenu chus verachem alenu vekabbel berachamim uvratzon et tefillatenu millefanecha malkenu rekam al teshivenu anenu avinu anenu beom tzom taanitenu ki vetzara gedola anachnu al taster panecha mimmennu veal taalem aznecha mishshemoa bakkashatenu veheye karov leshaveenu terem nikra veatta taane nedabber veatta tishma kaddavar shenneemar vehaya terem yikrau vaani eene od hem medabberim vaani eshma ki atta shomea tefillat kal pe baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla ushliach tzibbur omer nosach ze beracha bifne atzmah achar beracha sheviit omer anenu vechu ad ki el one beet tzara pode umatztzil bechal et tzara vetzuka baruch atta Adonai haone beet tzara

Betisha beav mevarech birkat arba esre benosach ze rachem Adonai alenu al yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha hair haavela hachareva hashshomema hannetuna beyad zarim hayyoshevet verosh lah chafuy keishsha akara shello yalada vayevalleuha ligonot vayyirashuha ovde fesilim vayyittenu nivlat avadecha maachal leof hashshamayim ulvehemat haaretz al ken tziyyon bemerer bemar tivke virushalayim titten kolah libbi libbi al challehem meay meay al harugehem ree Adonai vehabbita ure shommoteha venachamenna ki vaesh hitztzattah uvaesh atta atid livnotah kakkatuv vaani ehye lah neum Adonai chomat esh saviv ulchavod ehye vetochah baruch atta Adonai bone yerushalayim

Befurim mevarech birkat shemone esre benosach ze modim anachnu lach shaatta hu Adonai elohenu al chayyenu hammesurim beyadecha al nishmotenu happekudot lach al nissecha shebbechal yom vaom veal nifleotecha shebbechal et chu al hannissim veal haggevurot veal hatteshuot vechu veal kullam Adonai elohenu anu modim lach hattov ki lo chalu vechu
Bachanukka mevarech beracha zo benosach ze modim anachnu lach chu ad veal nifleotecha shebbechal et erev vavoker vetzahorayim al hannissim chu ad veachar ken bau vanecha vechu

Sheliach tzibbur mevarech leolam beracha shelishit benosach ze nakdishcha venamlichcha unshallesh lecha kedushsha meshulleshet kaddavar haamur al yad neviecha vekara ze el ze veamar kadosh kadosh kadosh Adonai tzevaot melo chal haaretz kevodo kevodo vegadlo male olam umshartav shoalim ayye mekom kevodo lehaaritzo leummatam meshabbechim veomrim baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo mimmekomcha malkenu tofia vetimloch alenu ki mechakkim anachnu lach matay timloch betziyyon bechayyenu uvyamenu tishkon titgaddal vetitkaddash betoch yerushalayim ircha ledor vador lenetzach netzachim veenenu tirena bemalchut uzzecha kaddavar haamur bedivre kadshecha al yede david meshiach tzidkecha yimloch Adonai leolam elohayich tziyyon ledor vador halluyah ledor vador naggid gadlecha ulnetzach netzachim kedushshatcha nakdish veshivchacha elohenu mippinu lo yamush ki el melech gadol vekadosh atta baruch atta Adonai hael hakkadosh beet sheshsheliach tzibbur omer bivracha zo vekara ze el ze kal haam onin kadosh kadosh kadosh vechu uchshehu omer ayye mekom kevodo kal haam onin meshabbechim veomrim baruch chu uchshehu omer bechayyenu uvyamenu kal haam onin amen uchshehu omer al yede david meshiach tzidkecha kal haam omrim yimloch Adonai leolam vechal ellu haddevarim sheonin hatztzibbur hu kore immahen velo yagbiha kolo beet shehen onin immo veechad hayyachid veechad hashshatz baasara yamim shemmerosh hashshana ad yom hakkippurim omer besof beracha zo kaamur vayyigbah Adonai tzevaot bammishpat vehael hakkadosh nikdash bitzdaka baruch atta Adonai hammelech hakkadosh

Sheliach tzibbur omer kaddish leolam kodem kal tefilla veachar kal tefilla veachar sheomer seder hayyom bechal et sheyyomar seder hayyom yitchannen meat veyomar kaddish uchsheyyashlim likrot battora uvchal et sheyyitchannen bedivre tachanunim kesheyyigmor tachanunav yomar kaddish
