Af al pi shemmitzva lilmod bayyom uvallayela en adam lamed rov chachmato ella ballayela lefichach mi sheratza lizkot becheter hattora yizzaher bechal lelotav velo yeabbed afillu echad mehen beshena vaachila ushtiyya vesicha vechayyotze bahen ella betalmud tora vedivre chachma amru chachamim en rinna shel tora ella ballayela shenneemar kumi ronni vallayela vechal haosek battora ballayela chut shel chesed nimshach alav bayyom shenneemar yomam yetzave Adonai chasdo uvallayela shiro immi tefilla leel chayyay vechal bayit sheen nishmaim bo divre tora ballayela esh ochalto shenneemar kal choshech tamun litzpunav teachlehu esh lo nuppach ki devar Adonai baza ze shello hishgiach al divre tora kal ikkar vechen kal sheefshar lo laasok battora veeno osek o shekkara veshana uferash lehavle olam veheniach talmudo uznacho hare ze bichlal boze devar Adonai amru chachamim kal hamvattel et hattora meosher sofo levattelah meoni vechal hamkayyem et hattora meoni sofo lekayemah meosher veinyan ze meforash hu battora hare hu omer tachat asher lo avadta et Adonai elohecha besimcha uvtuv levav merov kl veavadta et oyevecha veomer lemaan annotcha lehetivcha beacharitecha
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 4: En melammedin tora ella letalmid hagun nae bemaasav o letam aval im haya holech bederech lo tova machzirin oto lammutav umanhigin oto bederech yeshara uvodkin oto veachar kach machnisin oto levet hammidrash umlammedin oto amru chachamim kal hashshone letalmid sheeno hagun keillu zarak even lemarkulis shenneemar kitzror even bemargema ken noten lichsil kavod veen kavod ella tora shenneemar kavod chachamim yinchalu vechen harav sheeno holech bederech tova af al pi shechacham gadol hu vechal haam tzerichin lo en mitlammedin mimmennu ad shuvo lammutav shenneemar ki sifte chohen yishmeru daat vetora yevakshu mippihu ki malach Adonai tzevaot hu amru chachamim im harav dome lemalach Adonai tzevaot tora yevakkeshu mippihu im lav al yevakkeshu tora mippihu

Ketzad melammedim harav yoshev barosh vehattalmidim mukkafim lefanav kaatara kede sheyehu kullam roim harav veshomim devarav velo yeshev harav al hakkisse vetalmidav al hakkarka ella o hakkol al haaretz o hakkol al hakkisot uvarishona haya harav yoshev vehattalmidim omdim umikkodem churban bayit sheni nahagu hakkol lelammed lattalmidim vehem yoshvim

Im haya melammed mippiv lattalmidim melammed veim haya melammed al pi metargem hamtargem omed beno uven hattalmidim veharav omer lamtargem vehamtargem mashmia lechal hattalmidim uchshehem shoalin lamtargem hu shoel larav veharav meshiv lamtargem vehamtargem meshiv lashshoel velo yagbiha harav kolo yoter mikkol hamtargem velo yagbiha hamtargem kolo beet sheshshoel et harav yoter mikkol harav en hamtargem rashshay lo lifchot velo lehosif velo leshannot ella im ken haya hamturgeman aviv shel chacham o rabbo omer harav lamturgeman kach amar li rabbi o kach amar li abba mari uchsheomer hamturgeman haddevarim laam omer beshem hechacham umazkir shemo shel avi harav o shel rabbo veomer kach amar rabbana peloni af al pi shello hizkir harav shemo shel chacham sheasur likrot lerabbo o leaviv bishmo

Harav shellimmed velo hevinu hattalmidim lo yichos alehem veyirgaz ella chozer veshone haddavar afillu kamma peamim ad sheyyavinu omek hahalacha vechen lo yomar hattalmid hevanti vehu lo hevin ella chozer veshoel afillu kamma peamim veim kaas alav rabbo veragaz yomar lo rabbi tora hi velilmod ani tzarich vedati ketzara

Lo yihye hattalmid bosh mechaverav shellamdu mippaam rishona o sheniyya vehu lo lamad ella achar kamma peamim sheim nitbayyesh middavar ze nimtza nichnas veotze levet hammidrash vehu eno lamed kelum lefichach amru chachamim harishonim en habbayeshan lamed velo hakkappedan melammed bamme devarim amurim bizman shello hevinu hattalmidim haddavar mippene amko o mippene datan shehi ketzara aval im nikkar larav shehem mitrashshelin bedivre tora umitrappin alehen ulfichach lo hevinu chayyav lirgoz alehen ulhachliman bidvarim kede lechaddedam uchinyan ze amru chachamim zerok mara battalmidim lefichach en rauy larav linhog kallut rosh lifne hattalmidim velo lischok bifnehem velo leechol velishtot immahem kede shettehe emato alehen veyilmedu mimmennu bimhera

En shoalin et harav kesheyyikkanes lammidrash ad shettityashshev dato alav veen hattalmid shoel kesheyyikkanes ad sheyyityashshev veyanuach veen shoalin shenayim keechad veen shoalin et harav meinyan acher ella meoto hainyan shehen asukin bo kede shello yitbayyesh veyesh larav lehatot et hattalmidim bishelotav uvammaasim sheose bifnehem kede lechaddedan uchde sheyyeda im zochrim hem ma shellimmedam o enam zochrim veen tzarich lomar sheyyesh lo reshut lishl otam beinyan acher sheen oskin bo kede lezarzam

En shoalin meummad veen meshivin meummad velo miggavoha velo merachok velo meachore hazzekenim veen shoalin harav ella beinyan shehen korin bo veen shoalin ella miyyira velo yishal bainyan yoter mishshalosh halachot

Shenayim sheshshaalu shaal echad kainyan veshaal echad shello kainyan nizkakin lainyan maase vesheeno maase nizkakin lammaase halacha umidrash nizkakin lahalacha midrash veaggada nizkakin lammidrash aggada vekal vachomer nizkakin lakkal vachomer kal vachomer ugzera shava nizkakin lakkal vachomer hau hashshoalin shenayim echad chacham veechad talmid nizkakin lechacham talmid veam haaretz nizkakin lattalmid shenehem chachamim shenehem talmidim shenehem amme haaretz shaalu shenehem bishte halachot o bishte teshuvot o bishte sheelot shene maasim harshut beyad hamtargem meatta

En yeshenim bevet hammidrash vechal hammitnamnem bevet hammidrash chachmato naaset keraim keraim vechen amar shelomo bechachmato ukraim talbish numa veen mesichin bevet hammidrash ella bedivre tora bilvad afillu mi shennitattesh en omrim lo refua bevet hammidrash veen tzarich lomar shear haddevarim ukdushshat bet hammidrash chamura mikkedushshat batte kenesiyyot
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 5: Keshem sheadam metzuve bichvod aviv veyirato kach hu chayyav bichvod rabbo veyirato yeter meaviv sheaviv mevio lechayye haolam hazze verabbo shellimmedo chachma mevio lechayye haolam habba raa avedat aviv vaavedat rabbo shel rabbo kodemet leshel aviv aviv verabbo nosim bemassa meniach et shel rabbo veachar kach shel aviv aviv verabbo shevuyim bashshivya pode et rabbo veachar kach pode et aviv veim haya aviv talmid chacham pode et aviv techilla vechen im haya aviv talmid chacham af al pi sheeno shakul keneged rabbo meshiv avedato veachar kach meshiv avedat rabbo veen lecha kavod gadol mikkevod harav velo mora mimmora harav amru chachamim mora rabbach kemora shamayim lefichach amru kal hacholek al rabbo kecholek al hashshechina shenneemar behatztzotam al Adonai vechal haose meriva im rabbo keose meriva im hashshechina shenneemar asher ravu vene yisrael et Adonai vayyikkadesh bam vechal hammitraem al rabbo kemitraem al Adonai shenneemar lo alenu telunotechem ki al Adonai vechal hamharher achar rabbo keillu meharher achar shechina shenneemar vayedabber haam belohim uvmshe

Ezehu cholek al rabbo ze shekkovea lo midrash veoshev vedoresh umlammed shello birshut rabbo verabbo kayyam veaf al pi sherabbo bimdina acheret veasur laadam lehorot bifne rabbo leolam vechal hammore halacha bifne rabbo chayyav mita

Haya beno uven rabbo shenem asar mil veshaal lo adam devar halacha muttar lehashiv ulhafrish min haissur afillu bifne rabbo muttar lehorot ketzad kegon sheraa adam ose davar haasur mippene shello yada beissuro o mippene risho yesh lo lehafrisho velomar lo davar ze asur vaafillu bifne rabbo veaf al pi shello natan lo rabbo reshut shekkal makom sheyyesh chillul hashshem en cholkin kavod larav bamme devarim amurim bedavar shennikra mikre aval likboa atzmo lehoraa veleshev ulhorot lechal shoel afillu hu besof haolam verabbo besof haolam asur lo lehorot ad sheyyamut rabbo ella im ken natal reshut merabbo velo kal mi shemmet rabbo muttar lo leshev ulhorot battora ella im ken haya talmid shehiggia lehoraa

Vechal talmid shello higgia lehoraa umore hare ze rasha shote vegas haruach vealav neemar ki rabbim chalalim hippila vego vechen chacham shehiggia lehoraa veeno more hare ze monea tora venoten michsholot lifne haivverim vealav neemar vaatzumim kal harugeha ellu hattalmidim hakketannim shello hirbu tora karauy vehem mevakkeshim lehitgaddel bifne amme haaretz uven anshe iram vekoftzin veoshvin barosh ledin ulhorot beyisrael hem hammarbim hammachaloket vehem hammacharivim et haolam vehamchabbin nerah shel tora vehamchabbelim kerem Adonai tzevaot alehem amar shelomo bechachmato echezu lanu shualim shualim ketannim mechabbelim keramim

Veasur lo letalmid likrot lerabbo bishmo vaafillu shello befanav vehu sheyyihye hashshem peli shekkal hashshomea yeda shehu peloni velo yazkir shemo befanav vaafillu likrot laacherim sheshshemam keshem rabbo kederech sheose beshem aviv ella yeshanne et shemam afillu leachar motam velo yitten shalom lerabbo o yachazir lo shalom kederech shennotnim lereim umachazirim ze laze ella shoche lefanav veomer lo beyira vechavod shalom alecha rabbi veim natan lo rabbo shalom yachazir lo shalom alecha rabbi umori

Vechen lo yachalotz tefillav lifne rabbo velo yasev ella yoshev keoshev lifne hammelech velo yitpallel lo lifne rabbo velo leachar rabbo velo betzad rabbo veen tzarich lomar sheasur lo lehallech betziddo ella yitrachek leachar rabbo velo yehe mechaven keneged achorav veachar kach yitpallel velo yikkanes im rabbo bammerchatz velo yeshev bimkom rabbo velo yachria devarav befanav velo yistor et devarav velo yeshev lefanav ad sheyyomar lo shev velo yaamod millefanav ad sheyyomar lo amod o ad sheyyittol reshut laamod uchsheyyippater merabbo lo yachazor lo laachorav ella nirta laachorav ufanav keneged panav
Vechayyav laamod mippene rabbo mishsheyyirennu merachok melo enav ad sheyyitkasse mimmennu velo yire komato veachar kach yeshev vechayyav adam lehakbil pene rabbo baregel

En cholkin kavod letalmid bifne rabbo ella im ken derech rabbo lachalok lo kavod vechal hammelachot shehaeved ose lerabbo talmid ose lerabbo veim haya bemakom sheen makkirin oto velo hau lo tefillin vechash shemma yomru eved hu eno noel lo minalo veeno choltzo vechal hammonea talmido milleshammesho monea mimmennu chesed uforek mimmennu yirat shamayim vechal talmid shemmezalzel davar mikkal kevod rabbo gorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael

Raa rabbo over al divre tora omer lo limmadtanu rabbenu kach vechach vechal zeman shemmazkir shemua befanav omer lo kach limmadtanu rabbenu veal yomar davar shello shama merabbo ad sheyyazkir shem omro uchsheyyamut rabbo korea kal begadav ad shehu megalle et libbo veeno meache leolam bamme devarim amurim berabbo muvhak shellamad mimmennu rov chachmato aval im lo lamad mimmennu rov chachmato hare ze talmid chaver veeno chayyav bichvodo bechal ellu haddevarim aval omed millefanav vekorea alav keshem shehu korea al kal hammetim shehu mitabbel alehem afillu lo lamad mimmennu ella davar echad ben katan ben gadol omed millefanav vekorea alav
Vechal talmid chacham sheddeotav mechuvanot eno medabber bifne mi shehu gadol mimmennu bechachma af al pi shello lamad mimmennu kelum

Harav hammuvhak sheratza limchol al kevodo bechal haddevarim haellu o beechad mehen lechal talmidav o leechad mehen harshut beyado veaf al pi shemmachal chayyav hattalmid lehaddero vaafillu beshaa shemmachal

Keshem shehattalmidim chayyavin bichvod harav kach harav tzarich lechabbed et talmidav ulkarvan kach amru chachamim yehi kevod talmidcha chaviv alecha keshellecha vetzarich adam lehizzaher betalmidav ulahovam shehem habbanim hamhannim laolam hazze velaolam habba

Hattalmidim mosifin chachmat harav umarchivin libbo amru chachamim harbe chachma lamadti merabbotay veoter mechaveray umittalmiday yoter mikkullam uchshem sheetz katan madlik et haggadol kach talmid katan mechadded harav ad sheyyotzi mimmennu bishelotav chachma mefoara
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 6: Kal talmid chacham mitzva lehaddero veaf al pi sheeno rabbo shenneemar mippene seva takum vehadarta pene zaken zaken ze shekkana chachma umeematay chayyavin laamod mippanav mishsheyyikrav mimmennu bearba ammot ad sheyyaavor mikkeneged panav

En omdin mippanav lo bevet hammerchatz velo bevet hakkisse shenneemar takum vehadarta kima sheyyesh bah hiddur veen baale ummanuyyot chayyavin laamod mippene talmide chachamim beshaa sheoskin bimlachtan shenneemar takum vehadarta ma hiddur sheen bah chesron kis af kima sheen bah chesron kis uminnayin shello yaatzim enav min hechacham kede shello yirehu ad shello yaamod mippanav shenneemar veyareta meelohecha ha kal davar shehu masur lallev neemar bo veyareta meelohecha

En rauy lechacham sheyyatriach et haam vichaven atzmo lahen kede sheyyaamdu mippanav ella yelech bederech ketzara umitkaven shello yiru oto kede shello yatrichen laamod vehachachamim hau makkifin veholchin bederech hachitzona sheen makkirehen metzuyin sham kede shello yatrichum
Rochev hare hu kimhallech uchshem sheomdim mippene hamhallech kach omdin mippene harochev
Shelosha shehau holchin badderech harav baemtza gadol mimino vekatan missemolo

Haroe chacham eno omed mippanav ad sheyyaggia lo learba ammot vechevan sheavar yoshev raa av bet din omed millefanav mishsheyyirennu merachok melo enav veeno yoshev ad sheyyaavor meacharav arba ammot raa et hannasi omed millefanav melo enav veeno yoshev ad sheyyeshev bimkomo o ad sheyyitkasse meenav vehannasi shemmachal al kevodo kevodo machul keshehannasi nichnas kal haam omdim veenan yoshvin ad sheyyomar lahem shevu kesheav bet din nichnas osin lo shette shurot veomdin mikkan umikkan ad shennichnas veoshev bimkomo ushar haam yoshvin bimkoman

Chacham shennichnas kal sheyyaggia lo bearba ammot omed millefanav echad omed veechad yoshev ad shennichnas veoshev bimkomo bene chachamim vetalmide chachamim bizman sheharabbim tzerichin lahem mekappetzin al rashe haam venichnasim limkomam veen shevach letalmide chachamim sheyyikkansu laacharona yatza letzorech chozer limkomo bene chachamim bizman sheyyesh bahen daat lishmoa hofchin penehen kelappe avihen en bahen daat lishmoa hofchin penehen kelappe haam
Talmid shehu yoshev lifne rabbo tamid eno rashshay laamod mippanav ella shacharit vearvit bilvad shello yehe kevodo merubbe mikkevod shamayim

Mi shehu zaken muflag bezikna af al pi sheeno chacham omdin lefanav vaafillu hechacham shehu yeled omed bifne hazzaken hammuflag bezikna veeno chayyav laamod melo komato ella kede lehaddero vaafillu zaken kuti mehadderin oto bidvarim venotnin lo yad lesamcho shenneemar mippene seva takum kal seva bemashma

Talmide chachamim enam yotzin beatzman laasot im kal hakkahal bevinyan vachafira shel medina vechayyotze bahen kede shello yitbazzu bifne amme haaretz veen govin mehen levinyan hachoma vetikkun hashshearim uschar hashshomrim vechayyotze bahen velo litshurat hammelech veen mechayevim otan litten hammas ben mas shehu katzuv al bene hair ben mas shehu katzuv al kal ish vaish shenneemar gam ki yitnu vaggoyim atta akabbetzem vayyachellu meat mimmassa melech vesarim vechen im hayeta sechora letalmid chacham menichim oto limkor techilla veen menichim echad mibbene hashshuk limkor ad sheyyimkor hu vechen im haya lo din vehaya omed bichlal baale dinim harbe makdimin oto umoshivin oto

Aon gadol hu levazzot et hachachamim o lisnotan lo charva yerushalayim ad shebbizzu bah talmide chachamim shenneemar vayyihu malivim bemalache haelohim uvozim devarav umittateim binviav kelomar bozim melammede devarav vechen ze sheamra tora im bechukkotay timasu melammede chukkotay timasu vechal hamvazze et hachachamim en lo chelek laolam habba vahare hu bichlal ki devar Adonai baza

Af al pi shehamvazze et hachachamim en lo chelek laolam habba im bau edim shebbizzahu afillu bidvarim chayyav nidduy umnaddin oto bet din barabbim vekonsin oto litra zahav bechal makom venotnin otah lechacham vehamvazze et hechacham bidvarim afillu leachar mita menaddin oto bet din vehem mattirim oto kesheyyachazor bitshuva aval im haya hechacham chay en mattirin oto ad sheyeratztze ze shennidduhu bishvilo vechen hechacham atzmo menadde lichvodo leam haaretz shehifkir bo veen tzarich lo edim velo hatraa veen mattirin lo ad sheyeratztze et hechacham veim met hechacham bain shelosha umattirin lo veim ratza hechacham limchol lo velo niddahu harshut beyado

Harav shennidda lichvodo kal talmidav chayyavin linhog nidduy bamnudde aval talmid shennidda lichvod atzmo en harav chayyav linhog bo nidduy aval kal haam chayyavin linhog bo nidduy vechen menudde lenasi menudde lechal yisrael menudde lechal yisrael eno menudde lannasi menudde leiro menudde leir acheret menudde leir acheret eno menudde leiro

Bamme devarim amurim bemi shennidduhu al shebbizza talmide chachamim aval mi shennidduhu al shear devarim shechayyavim alehem nidduy afillu niddahu katan shebbeyisrael chayyav hannasi vechal yisrael linhog bo nidduy ad sheyyachazor bitshuva middavar shennidduhu bishvilo veyattiru lo al esrim vearbaa devarim menaddin et haadam ben ish ben ishsha veellu hen hamvazze et hechacham vaafillu leachar moto hamvazze sheliach bet din hakkore lachavero eved mi sheshshalchu lo bet din vekavu lo zeman velo ba hamzalzel bedavar echad middivre sofrim veen tzarich lomar bedivre tora mi shello kibbel alav et haddin menaddin oto ad sheyyitten mi sheyyesh birshuto davar hammazzik kegon kelev ra o sullam raua menaddin oto ad sheyyasir hezzeko hammocher karka shello leoved kochavim menaddin oto ad sheyekabbel alav kal ones sheyyavo min haoved kochavim leyisrael chavero baal hammetzar hammeid al yisrael bearkaot shel ovde kochavim vehotzi mimmennu beeduto mamon shello kedin yisrael menaddin oto ad sheyeshallem tabbach kohen sheeno mafrish hammattanot venotnan lechohen acher menaddin oto ad sheyyitten hamchallel yom tov sheni shel galuyyot af al pi shehu minhag haose melacha beerev happesach achar chatzot hammazkir shem shamayim levattala o lishvua bedivre havay hammevi et harabbim lide chillul hashshem hammevi et harabbim lide achilat kadashim bachutz hamchashshev shanim vekovea chodashim bechutza laaretz hammachishil et haiver hamakkev harabbim millaasot mitzva tabbach sheyyatza terefa mittachat yado tabbach shello badak sakkino lifne chacham hammakshe atzmo ledaat mi sheggeresh et ishto veasa beno uvenah shuttafut o massa umattan hammeviin lahen lehizzakek ze laze kesheyyavou levet din menaddin otam chacham sheshshemuato raa hamnadde mi sheeno chayyav nidduy
Mishneh Torah, Torah Study 7: Chacham zaken bechachma vechen nasi o av bet din shessarach en menaddin oto befarhesya leolam ella im ken asa keyaravam ben nevat vachaverav aval keshechata shear chattaot malkin oto betzina shenneemar vechashalta hayyom vechashal gam navi immecha layela af al pi shekkashal kassehu kelayela veomrim lo hikkaved veshev bevetcha vechen kal talmid chacham shennitchayyev nidduy asur levet din likpotz ulnaddoto bimhera ella borchin middavar ze venishmatin mimmennu vachaside hachachamim hau mishtabbechim shello nimnu meolam lenaddot talmid chacham af al pi shennimnin lehalkoto im nitchayyev malkot vaafillu makkat mardut nimnin alav lehakkoto
Vechetzad hu hannidduy omer peloni yehe beshammata veim nidduhu befanav omer lo peloni ze beshammata vehacherem omer lo peloni muchram vearur bo ala bo shevua bo nidduy
Vechetzad mattirin hannidduy o hacherem omer lo sharuy lecha umachul lecha veim hittiruhu shello befanav omer lo peloni sharuy lo umachul lo

Mahu hamminhag sheyyinhog hamnudde beatzmo veshennohagin immo menudde asur lesapper ulchabbes keavel kal yeme nidduo veen mezammenin alav velo kollin oto baasara lechal davar shetztzarich asara velo yoshvin immo bearba ammot aval shone hu laacherim veshonin lo veniskar vesocher veim met benidduy bet din sholchin umannichin even al arono kelomar shehen rogmin oto lefi shehu muvdal min hatztzibbur veen tzarich lomar sheen maspidin oto veen melavin et mittato

Yoter alav hammuchram sheeno shone laacherim veen shonin lo aval shone hu leatzmo shello yishkach talmudo veeno niskar veen niskarin lo veen nosin venotnin immo veen mitassekin immo ella meat esek kede parnasato
Mi sheyyashav benidduy sheloshim yom velo bikkesh lehattiro menaddin oto sheniyya yashav sheloshim yom acherim velo bikkesh lehattiro machrimin oto
Bechamma mattirin hannidduy o hacherem bishlosha afillu hedotot veyachid mumche mattir hannidduy o hacherem levaddo veyesh letalmid lehattir hannidduy o hacherem vaafillu bimkom harav
Shelosha shenniddu vehalchu lahen vechazar ze middavar shennidduhu biglalo bain shelosha acherim umattirin lo
Mi shello yada mi shenniddahu yelech lo etzel hannasi veyattir lo nidduo
Nidduy al tenay afillu al pi atzmo tzarich hafara talmid chacham shennidda atzmo vaafillu nidda atzmo al daat peloni vaafillu al davar shechayyav alav nidduy hare ze mefer leatzmo

Mi shennidduhu bachalom afillu yada mi niddahu tzarich asara bene adam sheshshonin halachot lehattiro minnidduo veim lo matza toreach acharehem ad parsa lo matza mattirim lo afillu asara sheshshonim mishna lo matza mattirin lo asara sheyyodim likrot battora lo matza mattirin lo afillu asara sheenan yodin likrot lo matza bimkomo asara mattirin lo afillu shelosha

Mi shennidduhu befanav en mattirin lo ella befanav nidduhu shello befanav mattirin lo befanav veshello befanav veen ben nidduy lahafara kelum ella menaddin umattirin berega echad kesheyyachazor hamnudde lammutav veim rau bet din lehanniach ze benidduy kamma shanim mannichin kefi risho vechen im rau bet din lehacharim laze lechattechilla ulhacharim mi sheyyochal immo veshote immo o mi sheyyaamod immo bearba ammot machrimin kede leyassero uchde laasot seyag lattora ad shello yifretzu hachotim af al pi sheyyesh reshut lechacham lenaddot lichvodo eno shevach letalmid chacham lehanhig atzmo bedavar ze ella maalim aznav middivre am haaretz velo yashit libbo lahen kainyan sheamar shelomo bechachmato gam lechal haddevarim asher yedabberu al titten libbecha vechen haya derech chasidim harishonim shomim cherpatam veenan meshivin velo od ella shemmochalim lamcharef vesolchim lo vachachamim gedolim hau mishtabbechim bemaasehem hannaim veomrim shemmeolam lo niddu adam velo hechrimuhu lichvodan vezo hi darkam shel talmide chachamim sherauy lelech bah bamme devarim amurim keshebbizzahu o cherfahu basseter aval talmid chacham shebbizzahu o cherfo adam befarhesya asur lo limchol al kevodo veim machal neenash shezze bizon tora ella nokem venoter haddavar kenachash ad sheyevakkesh mimmennu mechila veyislach lo
Mishneh Torah, Festival Offering 1: Shalosh mitzot ase nitztauu yisrael bechal regel mishshalosh regalim veellu hen hariyya shenneemar yerae kal zechurcha vehachagiga shenneemar tachog la elohecha vehassimcha shenneemar vesamachta bechaggecha hariyya haamura battora hi shennira panav baazara beom tov harishon shel chag veyavi immo karban ola ben min haof ben min habbehema umi shebba laazara beom rishon velo hevi ola lo dayyo shello asa mitzvat ase ella over al lo taase shenneemar lo yerau fanay rekam veeno loke al lav ze shehare lo asa maase hachagiga haamura battora hi sheyyakriv shelamim beom tov harishon shel chag bevoo leheraot vehaddavar yadua sheen hashshelamim baim ella min habbehema ushte mitzot ellu shehen hariyya vehachagiga en hannashim chayyavot bahen vehassimcha haamura bargalim hi sheyyakriv shelamim yeter al shalme chagiga veellu hem hannikraim shalme simchat chagiga shenneemar vezavachta shelamim veachalta sham vesamachta lifne Adonai elohecha venashim chayyavot bemitzva zo

Hariyya vehachagiga en lahen shiur min hattora shenneemar ish kemattenat yado vego aval middivre sofrim shello yehe karban olat reiyya pachot mishsheve maa kesef velo shalme chagiga pachot mishsheve shette kesef umitzva lehavi kefi ashro shenneemar kemattenat yado

Shalme simcha lo natnu bahen chachamim shiur beet sheyyaale adam lirushalayim lachog im hau beyado karbenot hariyya yeviem o yaale immo kesef liknot bo hakkarban veim en beyado kesef lo yavi sheve kesef afillu haya beyado sheve kamma zehuvim asur lo laalot rekam belo kesef velo karban velamma asru sheyyaale beyado sheve kesef gezera shemma lo yimtza limkor o shemma yimmatzu hammaot sigim

Mi shello hikriv beom tov harishon olat reiyyato veshallemi chagigato hare ze makrivan bishar yemot haregel shenneemar shivat yamim tachog la elohecha melammed shekkullan reuyin lachagiga vechullan tashlume rishon hem
Umitzva lehakdim ulhakriv barishon lo hikriv barishon ben shogeg ben mezid yakriv bashsheni vechal hammeacher hare ze megunne vealav neemar nuge mimmoed asafti
Avar haregel velo chag eno chayyav beacharauto veal ze vechayyotze bo neemar meuvat lo yuchal litkon

Mi shello chag beom tov harishon shel chag hassukkot chogeg et kal haregel uvayyom tov haacharon shehu shemini veaf hashshemini tashlume rishon hu vechen mi shello chag beom chag hashshavuot chogeg kal shiva veyesh lo tashlumin kal sheshet yamim shelleachar chag hashshavuot vedavar ze mippi hashshemua neemar shechag hashshavuot kechag hammatztzot letashlumin

Olat reiyya veshalme chagiga enan dochin lo et hashshabbat velo et hattuma lefi sheen lahen zeman kavua kekarbenot hatztzibbur sheim eno chogeg hayyom chogeg lemachar kemo shebbearnu aval dochin et yom tov veaf al pi sheen makrivin beom tov nedarim undavot makrivin olat reiyya veshalme chagiga veshalme simcha sheen ellu nedarim undavot ella chovot

Keshemmakriv hammakriv olat reiyyato veshalme chagigato vesimchato beom tov somech alehen bechal kocho kederech sheose bishar hayyamim af al pi shessemicha enah meakkevet kemo shebbearnu bemaase hakkarbanot lo gazru aleha mishshum shevut

Hammafrish olat reiyyato umet hayyorshin chayyavin lahaviah muttar lehakriv bechullo shel moed nedarim undavot shenneemar elle taasu la bemoadechem levad minnidrechem venidvotechem mikkelal shekkerevin baregel leolotechem kemo olat metzora veolat yoledet ulminchotechem lehavi minchat chote uminchat kenaot ulshalmechem lerabbot shalme nazir hakkol kerevin bammoed veen kerevin beom tov

Mishneh Torah, Festival Offering 2: Nashim vaavadim peturin min hariyya vechal haanashim chayyavim biriyya chutz mecheresh veillem veshote vekatan vesuma vechigger vetame vearel vechen hazzaken vehachole veharach veheanog meod sheenam yecholim laalot al raglehen kal ellu haachad asar peturin ushar kal haanashim chayyavin biriyya hacheresh af al pi shehu medabber afillu cheresh beazno achat patur min hariyya vechen hassuma beeno achat o chigger beraglo achat patur haillem af al pi shehu shomea patur tumtum veanderoginus peturin mippene shehen sefek ishsha mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin patur mippene tzad avdut shebbo uminnayin shekkal ellu peturin min hariyya hare hu omer yerae kal zechurcha lehotzi et hannashim umitzvat ase sheen hannashim chayyavot bah en haavadim chayyavim bah veod hare neemar bevo chal yisrael lehotzi haavadim veneemar bevo chal yisrael leraot keshem shehen bain leheraot lifne Adonai kach hem baim lirot hadar kadsho uvet shechinato lehotzi suma sheeno roe afillu nismet eno achat shehare en reiyyato shelema vesham neemar lemaan yishmeu lehotzi mi sheen lo shemia gemura ulmaan yilmedu lehotzi mi sheeno medabber shekkal hamtzuve lilmod metzuve lelammed veneemar baalotcha leraot et pene Adonai mi sheyyachol laalot beraglav lehotzi chigger vechole vezaken veanog uchvar bearnu behilchot biat hammikdash sheen hattame rauy levia vechen hearel maus ketame

Hamkammetz vehu shemmelachto lekabbetz tzoat kelavim vechayyotze bahen leabbed haorot o lirfua vechen hamtzaref nechoshet bemachtzav shello vehaabbedanin af al pi shehen meusin mippene melachtan hare ellu metaharin gufan umalbushan veolin bichlal yisrael leraot

Kal katan sheyyachol leechoz beyado shel aviv velaalot miyerushalayim lehar habbayit aviv chayyav lehaaloto ulheraot bo kede lechannecho bemitzot shenneemar yerae kal zechurcha veim haya hakkatan chigger o suma o cheresh afillu beachat eno chayyav lechannecho af al pi shehu rauy lirfua sheillu haya gadol vehu kach haya patur kemo shebbearnu

Kal hachayyav biriyya chayyav bachagiga vechal happatur min hariyya patur min hachagiga vechullan chayyavin besimcha chutz mecheresh shote vekatan vearel vetame cheresh shote vekatan mippene sheenan bene chiyyuv hare hen peturin mikkal mitzot haamurot battora vearel vetame mippene sheenan ochlim bekadashim veenan reuyin levia kemo shebbearnu behilchot biat hammikdash uvhilchot maase hakkarbanot

Mi shehaya chigger o suma beom rishon venitrappe bashsheni patur min hariyya umin hachagiga shebbeom chovato haya patur shekkal yemot hechag tashlume rishon hen kemo shebbearnu vechen im nitma belele yom tov harishon af al pi shettahar lemachar patur aval im nitma beom rishon hare ze chayyav lehavi chagigato uriyyato betoch yeme haregel kesheyyithar

Mi shebba laazara betoch yeme hechag eno chayyav lehavi ola beyado bechal et sheyyikkanes shezze shenneemar velo yerau fanay rekam eno ella beikkar haregel bilvad shehu yom rishon o tashlume rishon veim hevi bechal et sheyyavi mekabbelin mimmennu umakrivin otah leshem olat reiyya shehariyya en lah shiur

Hifrish eser behemot lachagigato vehikriv mehen miktzatan barishon ufasak shuv eno chozer umakriv hashshear shehare shiyyer otam veim lo pasak ella dechako hayyom velo yachol lehakriv hayyom makriv hashshear lemachar

Olat reiyya enah baa ella min hachullin kishar hakkarbanot sheadam chayyav bahen aval shalme chagiga baot mimmeot maaser sheni hamoravot im meot chullin lokeach min hattaarovet behema umakrivah shalme chagiga vehu sheyyihye shiur achila rishona min hachullin mippene sheshshalme chagiga chova vechal shehu chova eno ba ella min hachullin
Veotze adam yede chovat shalme chagiga bemaasar behema veen meviin oto beom tov gezera shemma yeasser beom tov

Yotzin yisrael yede chovat shalme simcha bindarim undavot uvmaasar behema vehakkohanim bechattat uvasham uvivchor uvchaze veshok shemmitzva zo hi lismoach baachilat basar lifne Adonai vahare achlu aval en yotzin yede chovatan lo beofot velo bimnachot sheenan basar hamsammeach kevar bearnu bifsachim shechagigat arbaa asar reshut lefichach en adam yotze bah yede chovat chagiga ella yotze bah chovat simcha
Mi shehau lo shalme neder o nedava ushchatan meerev yom tov af al pi sheachalan beom tov eno yotze bah yede chovat chagiga sheenah baa ella min hachullin aval yatza bah yede chovat simcha
Af al pi sheshshechatan kodem haregel hoil veochel mehen baregel yatza yede chovato sheeno tzarich lishchot shalme simcha bishat simcha
Lo yavi adam toda beom arbaa asar mippene hechametz shebbah sheen meviin kadashim levet happesul veim hevi yotze bah yede chovat simcha kemo shebbearnu

Haomer hare alay toda sheetze bah yede chovati leshem chagiga chayyav lehavi toda veeno yotze bah yede chagiga sheen chagiga baa ella min hachullin kesheyyizbach adam shalme chagiga veshalme simcha lo yihye ochel hu uvanav veishto bilvad vidamme sheyyaase mitzva gemura ella chayyav lesammeach haaniyyim vehaumlalim shenneemar vehallevi vehagger vehayyatom vehaalmana maachil hakkol umashkan kefi ashro umi sheachal zevachav velo simmeach ellu immo alav neemar zivchehem kelechem onim lahem kal ochlav yittammau ki lachmam lenafsham umitzva belevi yoter min hakkol lefi sheen lo lo chelek velo nachala veen lo mattanot babbasar lefichach tzarich lezammen leviyyim al shulchano ulsammecham o yitten lahem mattenot basar im maaser shellahem kede sheyyimtzeu bo tzarchehem vechal haozev et hallevi millesammecho veshohe mimmennu maasrotav bargalim over belo taase shenneemar hishshamer lecha pen taazov et hallevi
Mishneh Torah, Festival Offering 3: Mitzvat ase lehakhil kal yisrael anashim venashim vetaf bechal motzae shemitta baalotam laregel velikrot beaznehem min hattora parashiyyot shehen mezarzot otan bemitzot umchazzekot yedehem bedat haemet shenneemar mikketz sheva shanim bemoed shenat hashshemitta bechag hassukkot bevo chal yisrael leraot vego hakhel et haam haanashim vehannashim vehattaf vegercha asher bisharecha vego

Kal happatur min hariyya patur mimmitzvat hakhel chutz min hannashim vehattaf vehearel aval hattame patur mimmitzvat hakhel shenneemar bevo chal yisrael veze eno rauy levia vehaddavar barur shehattumtum vehaanderoginus chayyavin shehare hannashim chayyavot

Ematay hau korin bemotzae yom tov harishon shel chag hassukkot shehu techillat yeme chullo shel moed shel shana sheminit vehammelech hu sheyyikra beaznehem uvezrat hannashim hau korin vekore keshehu yoshev veim kara meummad hare ze meshubbach mehechan hu kore mittechillat chummash elle haddevarim ad sof parashat shema umdalleg li vehaya im shamoa vego umdalleg leasser teasser vekore me asser teasser al hasseder ad sof berachot uklalot ad millevad habberit asher karat ittam bechorev ufosek

Ketzad hu kore tokin bachatzotzrot bechal yerushalayim kede lehakhil et haam umviin bima gedola veshel etz hayeta umaamidin otah beemtza ezrat nashim vehammelech ole veoshev aleha kede sheyyishmeu keriato vechal yisrael haolim lachog mitkabbetzin sevivav vechazzan hakkeneset notel sefer tora venotno lerosh hakkeneset verosh hakkeneset notno lassegan usgan lechohen gadol vechohen gadol lammelech kede lehaddero berov bene adam vehammelech mekabbelo keshehu omed veim ratza yeshev ufoteach veroe umvarech kederech shemmevarech kal kore battora bevet hakkeneset vekore happarashiyyot sheamarnu ad shehu gomer vegolel umvarech leachareha kederech shemmevarchin bevatte kenesiyyot umosif sheva berachot veellu hen retze Adonai elohenu beammecha yisrael vechu modim anachnu lach vechu atta bechartanu mikkal haammim vechu ad mekaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim kederech shemmevarchin battefilla hare shalosh berachot kematbean reviit mitpallel al hammikdash sheyyaamod vechotem bah baruch atta Adonai hashshochen betziyyon chamishit mitpallel al yisrael shettaamod malchutam vechotem bah habbocher beyisrael shishshit mitpallel al hakkohanim sheyyirtze hael avodatam vechotem bah baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh hakkohanim sheviit mitchannen umitpallel bah kefi ma shehu yachol vechotem bah hosha Adonai et ammecha yisrael sheammecha tzerichin lehivasha baruch atta Adonai shomea tefilla
Hakkeria vehabberachot bilshon hakkodesh shenneemar tikra et hattora hazzot bilshonah af al pi sheyyesh sham loazot

Vegerim sheenan makkirin chayyavin lehachin libbam ulhakshiv aznam lishmoa beema veyira vegila birada keom shennittena bo besinay afillu chachamim gedolim sheyyodim kal hattora kullah chayyavin lishmoa bechavana gedola yetera umi sheeno yachol lishmoa mechaven libbo likria zo shello kevaah hakkatuv ella lechazzek dat haemet veyire atzmo keillu atta nitztava bah umippi haggevura shomah shehammelech shaliach hu lehashmia divre hael
Yom hakhel shechal lihot beshabbat meacharin oto leachar hashshabbat mippene tekiat hachatzotzrot vehattechinnot sheenan dochin et hashshabbat
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 1: Mitzvat ase lehafrish kal peter rechem hazzecharim ben baadam ben bivhema tehora ben mimmin hachamor ben shehau shelemim ben shehau terefot shenneemar kaddesh li chal bechor peter kal rechem bivne yisrael baadam uvabbehema vechullan lakkohanim

Bechor adam uvchor chamor nifdim ufidonam lakkohanim uvchor behema tehora nishchat baazara kishar kadashim kallim zorkin damo umaktir emurav kemo shebbearnu bemaase hakkarbanot ushar habbasar neechal lakkohanim shenneemar ach pado tifde et bechor haadam veet bechor habbehema hattemea tifde ach bechor shor lo tifde kodesh hem uvsaram yihye lach

Bechor behema tehora shehu baal mum ben shennolad bemumo ben shennafal bo mum achar shehaya tamim hare hu lakkohen im ratza ochlo bechal makom o mochro o maachilo lemi sheyyirtze afillu lenachri mippene shehu chullin shenneemar vechi yihye vo mum pisseach o iver vego hattame vehattahor yachdav yochalennu katztzevi vechaayyal vahare hu nichse kohen
Mitzva lehakdish bechor behema tehora veyomar hare ze kodesh shenneemar takdish la elohecha veim lo hikdisho hare ze mitkaddesh meelav ukdushshato merechem hi

Mitzvat bechor behema tehora noheget baaretz uvchutza laaretz veen meviin bechorot michutza laaretz laaretz shenneemar veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvchorot bekarcha vetzonecha mimmakom sheatta mevi maasar dagan atta mevi bechor bakar vatzon umimmakom sheen atta mevi maasar dagan i atta mevi bechor bakar vatzon ella hare hu kechullin veyeachel bemumo veim hevi en mekabbelin mimmennu velo yikkarev ella yeachel bemumo
Mitzva zo noheget ben bifne habbayit ben shello bifne habbayit kemo maasar dagan veenah noheget bemukdashin keshehen bikdushshatan kodem sheyyippadu ben kadshe mizbeach ben kadshe bedek habbayit

Hakkol chayyavin bivchor behema tehora kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim veaf al pi shehabbechor lakkohen im nolad lo bechor makriv damo veemurav kemo shebbearnu veochel shear habbasar betorat bechor shenneemar kal habbechor asher yivaled bivkarcha uvtzoncha vego aval bechor adam uvchor behema temea kohanim ulviyyim peturin kemo shebbearnu behilchot mattenot kehunna

Habbechor neechal betoch shenato ben tamim ben baal mum shenneemar lifne Adonai elohecha tochalennu shana beshana vechi yihye bo mum bisharecha tochalennu umeematay mone lo im tam hu mone lo miyyom shemini shehu rauy lehakrava veim nolad baal mum mone lo miyyom shennolad vehu shekkalu lo chodashav shehare nire laachila beom ledato aval im lo yada bevadday shekkalu lo chodashav mone lo miyyom shemini

Nolad lo mum betoch shenato rashshay lekayemo kal shenem asar chodesh nolad lo mum besof shenato muttar lekayemo sheloshim yom miyyom shennafal bo hammum veaf al pi shehu mitacher leachar shenato ketzad kegon shennafal bo mum bachamishsha asar yom lifne gemar shenato mashlimin lo chamishsha asar achar shenato nolad lo mum achar shenato eno rashshay lekayemo ella ad sheloshim yom veyeachel
Habbechor bazzeman hazze mannicho ad sheyyippol bo mum veyeachel

Vead shello nire leharoto lechacham rashshay lekayemo shettayim veshalosh shanim umishshennire leharoto lechacham im nolad bo mum betoch shenato rashshay lekayemo kal shenem asar chodesh nolad achar shenato mekayemo sheloshim yom

Shana shel bechor hi shenat levana temima shenem asar chodesh miyyom leom veim hayeta shana meubberet nitabbera lo umone lo shelosha asar chodesh noldu lo shene telaim echad bachamishsha asar shel adar harishon veechad berosh chodesh adar sheni ze shennolad berosh chodesh adar sheni kevan shehiggia yom rishon baadar shel shana habbaa alta lo shana veze shennolad bachatzi adar rishon lo alta lo shana ad chatzi adar shel shana habbaa hoil venolad bechodesh haibbur monin oto lo

Avar veicher habbechor leachar shenato af al pi shehu over belo taase im haya tam hare ze lo nifsal ella makrivo veim haya baal mum shochato bechal makom shenneemar masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvchorot bekarcha vetzonecha makkish bechor lemaaser ma maaser eno nifsal mishshana lachavertah af bechor eno nifsal mishshana lachavertah

En notnin et habbechor lakkohen kesheyyivaled sheen zo gedulla lakkohen ella yetappel bo bealav ad sheyyagdil meat veyittenennu lakkohen vead kamma yisrael chayyavin lehittafel babbechor behema dakka sheloshim yom uvgassa chamishshim yom veim amar lo hakkohen tenehu li betoch zeman ze vaani atappel leatzmi eno rashshay litteno lo shezze kemo mesayyea al mattenotav uchvar bearnu bitrumot shehakkohanim hamsayein bevet haggoranot uvvet hammitbachayim uvtoch haroim en notnin lahem mattenotehen bischaran

Haya habbechor baal mum veamar lo betoch zeman ze tenehu li sheochalennu atta o shehaya tamim veamar lo tenehu li betoch zeman ze sheakrivennu atta hare ze notno lo veyerae li shehabbechor noten lechal kohen sheyyirtze

Kohen sheachal kezayit mibbechor tamim chutz lirushalayim loke min hattora shenneemar lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvchorot bekarcha vetzonecha vechen zar sheachal kezayit mibbechor ben lifne zerika ben leachar zerika loke mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara af lezar sheachal bechor ben lifne zerika ben leachar zerika

Habbechor en podin oto shenneemar ach bechor shor o vechor kesev o vechor ez lo tifde vechen en mochrin oto keshehu tam shekkevan shehu omed lekarban en lakkohen bo zechut kede lemachro uvazzeman hazze sheen bayit hoil vehu omed laachila hare hu muttar lemachro veaf al pi shehu tamim ben lechohen ben leyisrael

Bechor baal mum yesh lakkohen lemachro bechal zeman ben lifne habbayit ben shello lifne habbayit ben chay ben shachut uchshehu mocher besar bechor baal mum mochro babbayit aval lo bashshuk kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure mizbeach aval besar bechor tamim eno nimkar mippene shehu besar kodesh vechohanim shennimnu im habbechor muttarin lishkol mana keneged mana
Hammafshit bechor baal mum hare ze muttar lehafshito bee ze derech sheyyirtze im ratza lehargil margil vechen shear pesule hammukdashin im ratza lehafshit min haregel mafshit
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 2: Kal hammumim hakkevuim happoslin et hakodashim venifdim alehen im nafal echad mehen bivchor hare ze nishchat alav bechal makom uchvar bearnu otan hammumin behilchot issure mizbeach sheharauy mehen lihot bezachar shishshim veshiva

Vechal haddevarim shemmaninu sham sheen hakkarban min hammuvchar veen hakkadashim kerevin bahen velo nifdin alehen kach en habbechor nishchat alehen velo karev ella yihye omed ad sheyyivaled lo mum kavua vechen im nolad bivchor mum over hare ze eno nishchat bechal makom velo karev ella yihye roe ad sheyyippol bo mum kavua veyishshachet alav
Vechen im neevda bo avera o sheharag beed echad o al pi habbealim o shehuktza o neevad yire ad sheyyippol bo mum kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure mizbeach
Yotze dofen vehabba acharav shenehen enan bechor harishon mippene sheeno peter rechem vehaacharon mippene shekkedamo acher afillu yatza nekeva derech dofen vezachar derech rechem eno bechor

Bechor shehu anderoginus en bo kedushsha kelal vahare hu kinkeva sheen bo lakkohen kelum veovdim bo vegozzim oto kishar hachullin nolad tumtum hare ze sefek bechor veyeachel bemumo livalav ben shehetil mayim mimmekom zichrut ben shehetil mimmekom nakvut

Rachel sheyyalda kemin ez o ez sheyyalda kemin rachel patur min habbechora shenneemar ach bechor shor ad sheyyihye hu shor uvchoro shor veim haya bo miktzat simane immo hare ze bechor vehu baal mum kavua sheen lecha mum gadol mishshinnuy beriyyato afillu para sheyyalda kemin chamor veyesh bo miktzat simane para hare ze bechor lakkohen hoil umin hachamor yesh bo din bechor aval im yalda min sus o gamal af al pi sheyyesh bo miktzat simane para hare hu sefek bechor lefichach yeachel labbealim veim tefaso kohen en motziin miyyado
Hammattil mum bivchor hoil veasa avera konsin oto veeno nishchat al mum ze ad sheyyippol bo mum acher meelav veim met ze hachote muttar livno leshachoto al mum sheasa aviv shello kansu beno acharav

Hirgil labbechor sheyyippol bo mum kegon shennatan devela al azno ad shebba kelev untalah vechatach azno o shehalach ben barzel vaashashiyyot shel zechuchit kede shettikkata yado veniktea o sheamar lenachri lehattil bo mum hare ze lo yishchot alav ze hakkelal kal mum shennaasa ledato asur lo lishchot alav veim naasa shello ledato hare ze shochet alav
Amar illu nafal bivchor ze mum hayiti shochato veshama hannachri veasa bo mum hare ze shochet alav shehare lo naasa bedato

Reinuhu sheasa maase hammargil lehattil bo mum venafal bo mum veen anu yodin im nitkaven lemum ze o lo nitkaven hare ze lo yishchot alav ketzad kegon shennatan lo seorim bemakom dachuk mesorag bekotzim vechevan sheachal nechlak sefato afillu haya chaver hare ze lo yishchot alav vechen kal kayyotze baze
Haya bechor rodef et haadam uvaato kede letardo vaafillu baat bo mippene sherdafo mikkodem venaasa bo mum bivita zo hare ze yishchat alav
Ketannim shehittilu mum bivchor derech sechok vechen hannachri sheasa ledato hare ze yishchot alav veim asu kede lehattiro lo yishchot alav
Bechor sheachazo dam yakkiz uvilvad shello yitkaven laasot bo mum veim naasa bo mum behakkaza zo hare ze nishchat alav

Muttar lehattil mum bivchor kodem sheyyetze laavir haolam veyishchat alav bamme devarim amurim bazzeman hazze sheen sham bayit mippene shessofo leheachel bemumo aval bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam asur
Ed sheheid mippi ed achar shemmum ze nafal shello ledaat neeman afillu ishsha neemenet lomar befanay nafal mum ze meelav veyishchat alav

Kal hammumin haruyin lavo bide adam neeman haroe alehen lomar mealehen naflu velo naasu bechavana veyishchat alehen bamme devarim amurim keshehaya haroe yisrael vehabbechor beyad hakkohen aval im haya haroe kohen vehabbechor adayin hu beyad bealav hayyisreeli hare ze eno neeman vechoshdin oto shemma hu hittil bo mum kede sheyyittenennu lo

Kohen sheheid lechohen acher shemmum ze meelav nafal neeman veen choshshin lahen shemma hem gomlim ze et ze shekkal hakkohanim chashudin lehattil mum bivchor kede leachlo bachutz ulfichach en neemanin al yede atzman aval chavero meid lo sheen adam chote leacher afillu banav uvne beto shel kohen meidin lo al habbechor aval lo ishto mippene shehi kegufo

Bechor shehaya beyad kohen venafal bo mum veheid alav ed echad shezze hammum meelav nafal veen anu yodim im mum ze shochatin alav et habbechor o en shochatin alav uva hakkohen shehu beyado veamar hereti mum ze lemumche vehittiro lishchita hare ze neeman veen choshshin shemma lo herahu veshemma bechor tam hu shello nechshedu lishchot kadashim bachutz mippene shehu aon karet kemo shebbearnu

Vechen neeman hakkohen lomar al bechor baal mum bechor ze netano li yisrael bemumo velo nafal birshuti kede lachush lo shemma hu hittilo shehaddavar asuy lehiggalot vehu mityare shemma yishalu bealav veyomar tamim haya beet shennetanuhu lo
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 3: En shochatin et habbechor ella al pi mumche shennatan lo hannasi shebbeeretz yisrael reshut veamar lo hatter bechorot bemuman afillu haya mum gadol vegaluy lakkol lo yattiro ella mumche shennatal reshut vechal habbechorot adam roe chutz mibbechore atzmo

Im en sham mumche vehaya hammum min hammumin haggeluyin hammuvhakin kegon shennismet eno o niktea yado o nishbera raglo hare ze yishshachet al pi shelosha bene hakkeneset vechen bechor sheyyatza lechutza laaretz venafal bo mum muvhak hare ze yuttar al pi shelosha bene hakkeneset

En roin et habbechor leyisrael ad sheyyihye kohen immo shemma yomar lo hammumche mum hu umuttar lishchot alav veyelech veyishchatennu leatzmo velo yittenennu lakkohen sheaf al pi sheeno chashud leechol kadashim bachutz chashud hu ligzol mattenot kehunna lefichach im haya chacham veyadua shehu medakdek al atzmo roin lo haya hammum galuy lakkol kegon shenniktea yado o raglo hoil vehevio lechacham hammumche hare ze bechezkat medakdek al atzmo lefichach roin lo af al pi sheen immo kohen

Hashshochet et habbechor veachar kach hera et mumo af al pi shehu mum galuy sheeno mishtanne bishchita kegon shennechtecha yado o raglo hoil venishchat shello al pi mumche hare ze asur veyikkaver kivchor shemmet

Bechor shehayeta lo betza achat ushne kisim uvdako hammumche vehoshivuhu al hargozo umiachu velo yatzat betza sheniyya vehittiro hammumche venishchat venimtza hashsheniyya devuka bakkesalim hare ze muttar hoil umiachu aval im lo nimach af al pi shennishchat al pi mumche hare ze yikkaver

Mi sheeno mumche veraa et habbechor venishchat al piv hare ze yikkaver vishallem mibbeto vechamma meshallem revia ledakka umechetza legassa umippene ma lo yeshallem kal damav mippene shekkansu et baal habbehema kede shello yashhenna velo yegaddel behema dakka beeretz yisrael

Hannotel secharo lihot roe bechorot en shochatin al piv ella im ken haya mumche gadol veyadu bo chachamim sheen kemoto ufasku lo sachar al hariyya vehabbikkur ben shennimtza bo mum ben shennimtza tamim velo yittol sachar al behema zo chutz mippaam achat veroe otah leolam kal zeman shemmeviin otah kede shello yavo lide chashad

Hechashud al habbechorot lemachran leshem chullin en lokchin mimmennu afillu besar tzevaim mippene shehu dome livsar egel veen lokchim mimmennu orot sheenan avudim afillu shel nekeva shemma yachtoch zichruto veyomar or nekeva hu veen lokchin mimmennu tzemer afillu melubban veen tzarich lomar tzoi aval lokchin mimmennu tauuy ulvadin veorot avudim sheeno meabbed or bechor tamim mippene shehu mefached lashhoto etzlo shemma yishmeu haddayyanim veyiknesuhu kefi risho

Hashshochet et habbechor umcharo venoda shello herahu lemumche ma sheachlu achlu veyachzir lahem et haddamim uma shello neechal yikkaver veyachzir et haddamim vechen haddin bemaachil et hatterefa kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot mikkach umimkar

Bechor shennimtza terefa im tamim hu venimtza terefa achar shehufshat haor yissaref kemo shebbearnu behilchot pesule hammukdashin vehabbasar yikkaver veim bemumo nishchat habbasar yikkaver veyehanu hakkohanim beoro vehu shennishchat al pi mumche

Habbechor shenneechal besaro kahalacha ben tamim ben baal mum keshem shemmuttar lehanot beoro kach nehenin begizzotav aval kal tzemer shennigzaz mimmennu keshehu chay afillu nashar hare hu asur bahanaa vaafillu nashar mimmennu achar shennafal bo mum vaafillu achar shechitato veen tzarich lomar achar mitato shehare oto hatztzemer shennashar mimmennu mechayyim beissuro omed vechen bemaasar behema uchvar bearnu behilchot meila shello gazru gezera zo ella al habbechor veal hammaaser bilvad mippene sheenan bain lechappara shemma yashhem etzlo kede likkach kal hatztzemer sheyyinshor mehem uchvar bearnu shemmitzva leachlo toch shenato ben tamim ben baal mum
Bechor shehaya bo tzemer meduvlal ushchato et shehu nire immo min haggizza muttar bahanaa veet sheeno nire immo vehu hatztzemer sheikkaro hafuch kelappe rosho asur shezze kemo shennashar mechayyim

Gizzat bechor afillu baal mum shennitarva begizze chullin afillu achat bechamma alafim hakkol asurim hare hu davar chashuv umkaddesh bechal shehu haoreg melo hassit mitztzemer habbechor beveged yiddalek mitztzemer hammukdashin mekaddesh bechal shehu
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 4: Vehemat hashshuttafin chayyevet bivchora lo neemar bekarcha vetzonecha ella lemaet shuttafut hannachri sheim haya shuttaf bappara o baubbar afillu haya lannachri echad meelef baem o bavalad hare ze patur min habbechora haya lo beechad mishshenehem evar echad kegon yad o regel roin kal sheillu yechatech vehaya baal mum hare ze patur veim efshar sheyyechatech evar hannachri velo yippasel hare ze chayyav bivchora
Hallokeach ubbar parato shel nachri o hammocher ubbar parato lenachri af al pi sheeno rashshay hare ze patur min habbechora veen konsin oto al davar ze

Hamkabbel behema min hannachri lihot metappel bah vehavveladot benehem o nachri shekkibbel miyyisrael kaze hare ellu peturim min habbechora shenneemar peter kal rechem bivne yisrael ad sheyyihye hakkol miyyisrael

Hamkabbel tzon min hannachri bemamon katzuv ufasak immo sheyyihye hassachar benehem veim pichatu pichatu leyisrael af al pi shebbirshut yisrael hem vahare hem kekinyano hoil veim lo yimtza hannachri etzlo mamon acher ligbot mimmennu yigbe min habbehemot haellu umivaldotehen naasa kemo sheyyesh lo acharaut alehen veal valdotehen vahare yad hannachri beemtza ufturin min habbechora hem uvaldotehen aval valde veladot chayyavin shehare shel yisrael hem veen lannachri reshut alehen

Yisrael shennatan maot lenachri vekana lo bahen behema minnachri bedinehen af al pi shello mashach kana vechayyevet bivchora vechen im kana hannachri miyyisrael bedinehem venatan maot af al pi shello mashach kana uftura mibbechora
Ger shennitgayyer veen yadua im ad shello nitgayyer yalda parato o achar shennitgayyer hare ze bechor missafek
Hallokeach behema min hannachri veen yadua im bikkera o lo bikkera veyalda etzlo hare ze sefek bechor veyeachel bemumo labbealim veeno lakkohen shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya

Lakach behema menika min hannachri eno choshesh shemma benah shel acheret hi menika ella hare zo bechezkat sheyyalda vaafillu haya ze shemmenika kemo min acher vaafillu kemin chazir hare zo petura min habbechora vechen behema shehi cholevet petura min habbechora sherov habbehemot enan cholvot ella im ken kevar yaldu

Hallokeach behema miyyisrael hare zo bechezkat shebbikkera ad sheyyodio hammocher sheadayin lo yalda sheen hayyisrael shotek vegorem lo leechol kadashim bachutz vadday shebbikkera ulfichach mecharah setam

Behema dakka shehippila ubbar sheadayin lo nitbaer tzurato harbe venikkeret lakkol vezehu hannikra tinnuf im amru haroim ubbar hu ella shennifseda tzurato hare zo petura min habbechora vetzarich leharoto leroe chacham lefichach hallokeach behema min hannachri afillu hayeta ketanna veyalda etzlo betoch shenatah hare ze sefek bechor shemma tinnuf hippila birshut hannachri vechen behema gassa shehippila shilya hare zo siman valad sheen shilya belo valad veniftera min habbechora umuttar lehashlich otah hashshilya lakkelavim sheen mitkaddesh bivchora ella zachar vechezkat hannoladim mechetza zecharim umechetza nekevot uchvar bearnu shehazzachar sheen bo miktzat simane immo eno mitkaddesh bivchora venimtza miut hannoladim hen hammitkaddeshin bivchora veen choshshin lemiut aval behemat kadashim shehippila shilya tikkaver shehannekevot bah kizcharim

Behema gassa shehippila chararat dam hare zo niftera min habbechora shechezkatah shehavalad betochah verava alav haddam vehifsido uvittelo vekovrin charara zo kemo nefel mevakkeret af al pi sheen charara zo kedosha velamma kovrin otah kede lefarsem haddavar shenniftera min habbechora

Kevar bearnu beinyan nidda shehavalad baadam nigmar learbaim yom vehammappelet lefachot mearbaim eno valad aval velad behema lo amdu chachamim al minyan hayyamim sheyyiggamer bo aval amru shehammappelet tinnuf enah mitabberet acharav velo mekabbelet valad acher lefachot mishsheloshim yom
Behema sheyyatza melea uvaa rekanit habba achar ken bechor missafek shemma davar sheeno poter bivchora hippila veen lenifle behema petirat rechem ad sheyyaagilu rosh kefika shel erev

Mavkeret hammaksha leled mechattech evar umashlich lakkelavim vehabba acharav bechor yatza rubbo hare ze yikkaver veniftera min habbechora veim chatach evar vehinnicho evar vehinnicho ad shehishlim rubbo hare kal haevarim tzerichin kevura veniftera min habbechora kevan sheyyatza rubbo ben shalem ben mechuttach vahare hu lefanenu nitkaddesh lemafrea

Yatza shelish umcharo lenachri vechazar veyatza shelish acher nitkaddesh lemafrea veniftera min habbechora yatza shelish derech dofen ushne shelishim derech rechem eno kadosh sheharov harishon lo yatza derech rechem ulmafrea hu mitkaddesh

Yatza miut evar gadol vahare ze hayyotze rubbo shel ubbar niftar min habbechora veyikkaver hayyotze yatza chatzi haubbar vehu rubbo shel evar hayyotze hare ze safek im niftera min habbechora o lo niftera lefichach habba acharav sefek bechor
Bechor shekkeracho besiv vehotzio velo naga barechem o shekkeracho beshilyat behema acheret o shennichrecha alav achoto veyatza hoil velo naga barechem mikkal makom hare ze sefek bechor
Hidbik shene rechamim ze laze veyatza mizze venichnas laze hare ze safek im niftera min habbechora habbehema shennichnas bah habbechor shehare peter rechem o lo niftera ad sheyyiftor rachmah veladah
Niftechu katle bet harechem veyatza hare ze safek im negiat rechem mekaddeshet o aviro
Neekru katle bet harechem venitlu betzavaro hare ze safek im bimkomo mekaddesh o mekaddesh af chutz limkomo
Nigmemu katle bet harechem eno kadosh nifratz miktzato veomed merubbe al happarutz veyatza derech happarutz o shehaya happarutz merubbe al haomed veyatza derech haomed hare ze sefek bechor
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 5: Rachel shello bikkera veyalda shene zecharim afillu yatzu shene rashehen keechad i efshar shello kadam echad hoil veen yadua e ze mehem yatza rishon hakkohen notel et hakkachush vehashsheni sefek bechor met echad mehen en lakkohen kelum shezze hachay safek hu vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya vechen im yalda zachar unkeva hare hazzachar safek shemma hannekeva yatzat techilla lefichach en lakkohen kelum shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya

Shette rechelot shello bikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim shenehen lakkohen zachar unkeva hazzachar lakkohen shene zecharim unkeva hakkohen notel et hakkachush vehashsheni sefek bechor veim met echad mehen en lakkohen kelum shezze hazzachar hachay sefek bechor hu vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya yaldu shette nekevot vezachar o shene zecharim ushte nekevot hare hazzecharim sefek bechor sheani omer shemma hannekeva nolda techilla veachar kach hazzachar lefichach en kan lakkohen kelum shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya achat bikkera veachat shello bikkera veyaldu lo shene zecharim echad lo veechad lakkohen vechal echad mehen sefek bechor vehakkohen notel et hakkachush met echad mehen en kan lakkohen kelum shezze hachay safek hu vechen im yaldu zachar unkeva en kan lakkohen kelum shezze hazzachar sefek bechor hu

Kal bechor shehu safek dino sheyyire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyeachel livalav veim tefaso hakkohen en motziin oto miyyado veochel oto bemumo aval eno makrivo sheen makriv leolam ella bechor vadday shemma yishchot chullin baazara

Mi shehaya beedro mevakkerot vesheenan mevakkerot veyaldu veen sham adam venichnas umatza et hamvakkerot menikot nekevot veet sheenan mevakkerot menikot zecharim eno choshesh shemma benah shel zo ba lo etzel zo uvnah shel zo ba lo etzel zo ella hare haddavar bechezkato shekkal achat menika benah

Shenayim shehifkidu shene zecharim etzel haroe haechad bechor vehashsheni pashut umet echad mehen manniach haroe hashsheni benehen umistallek vahare hu sefek bechor ushnehen cholkin oto sheen echad mehen makkir et shello

Hifkid bechor etzel baal habbayit vehinnicho baal habbayit im pashut shello umet echad mehen veen yadua ezehu hammotzi mechavero alav haraya vahare hu sefek bechor vaafillu roe kohen shehinniach bechoro bachatzar baal habbayit im pashut shel baal habbayit umet echad mehen hammotzi mechavero alav haraya veen motziin mechatzar baal habbayit ella biraya shehare middaat baal habbechor hinnichu immo happashut shel baal habbayit
Lo nechshedu yisrael al habbechorot lefichach neeman hayyisrael lomar ze sefek bechor hu veroin lo mumo veochel oto bemumo

Kal hakkadashim shekkadam lahem mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu chayyavin bivchora veim kadam mum over lehekdeshan o shehikdishan temimim veachar kach nolad lahem mum kavua venifdu peturin min habbechora shehare lo yatzu lechullin lechal davar mippene shehen asurin begizza vaavoda kemo shebbearnu behilchot meila

Hallokeach behema mimmeot maaser sheni birushalayim chayyevet bivchora aval hallokeach behema mipperot sheviit hare zo petura min habbechora lefi sheeno rashshay laasot sechora beferot sheviit shehare neemar bah leachlah leachlah velo lischora veim tihye chayyevet bivchora hare ze mistakker bivchor shehare yatza mittorat perot sheviit uchvar bearnu behilchot maachalot asurot sheasur laasot sechora bidvarim haasurim baachila vechen bearnu bitrumot sheasur laasot sechora bitrumot vechen asur laasot sechora bivchorot af al pi shemmuttar lemachran al derech shebbearnu
Lakach bechor lemishte beno o laregel velo tzarich lo muttar lemachro

En shamin bechorot temimim leyisrael aval shamin lahen bechorot baale mumin veshamin bechorot temimim lakkohanim bazzeman hazze shehen omdin leheachel bemuman veen tzarich lomar sheshshamin lahen baale mumim
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 6: Mitzvat ase lehafrish echad measara mikkal behemot tehorot sheyyivaldu laadam bechal shana veshana veen mitzva zo noheget ella bevakar vetzon bilvad shenneemar vechal masar bakar vatzon vego

Maasar behema noheg bechullin aval lo bemukdashin venoheg baaretz uvchutza laaretz bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit aval chachamim asru leasser behema bazzeman hazze vetikkenu sheen measserin ella bifne habbayit gezera shemma yochlehu tamim venimtza ba lide issur karet shehu shechitat kadashim bachutz veim avar veasa bazzeman hazze hare ze maaser veyeachel bemumo
Hakkol chayyavin bemaasar behema kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim

Vedin maasar behema sheyyihye nishchat baazara vezorkin et damo zerika achat keneged hayesod umaktirin emurav ushar habbasar neechal labbealim birushalayim kishar kadashim kallim veen lakkohanim bo kelum ella kullo labbealim kappesach veim haya baal mum ben shennafal bo mum ben shehifrisho battechilla bemumo hare ze neechal bechal makom

Maasar behema asur lemachro keshehu tamim shenneemar bo lo yiggael mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar lo yiggael af issur mechira bemashma sheen nigal veeno nimkar kelal veyerae li shehammocher maaser lo asa kelum velo kana lokeach ulfichach eno loke kemocher cherme kohanim shello kana lokeach uchmocher yefat toar kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo
Middivre sofrim sheasur lemachro baal mum vaafillu shachut gezera shemma yimkerennu chay lefichach en shoklin mana keneged mana bemaaser kederech sheshshoklin bivchor mippene shehu nire kemocher
Umaasar behema shel yetomim shennishchat bemumo muttar lemachro kedarko mippene hashavat aveda litomim lo gazru alav

Maasar behema shennishchat bemumo muttar limkor chelbo vegidav veoro veatzmotav velo asru limkor ella besaro bilvad veim hivlia deme habbasar bidme haor vehachelev vehaggidin umachar hakkol behavlaa muttar veim hau deme haatzamot yekarim vehivlia deme habbasar bidme haatzamot muttar

Hakkol neemanim al mume maaser lomar mum ze meelav ba velo naasa ledaat vaafillu ellu sheenan neemanim al habbechor neemanim al hammaaser veroe adam mume maaser shello umattiro im haya mumche sheim yirtze yattil mum bechal edro veachar kach yeasser venimtza hammaaser baal mum mittechillato

Hallokeach telaim shennoldu beshana zo o shennittenu lo bemattana hare hem peturim min hammaaser ad sheyyivaldu birshuto lefichach hashshuttafin shennishtattefu bivhemot vehevi ze mea telaim veze mea telaim veervum venishtattefu bahen hare hammatayim peturim min hammaaser shekkal tale mehen kemachur vechen haachim sheyyarshu telaim meavihem hare hen peturin min hammaaser aval hannoladim lahem beshuttafut leachar mikkan meellu habbehemot ben lashshuttafin ben laachim chayyavin bemaaser vechen im hau shuttafin bemaot vekanu behemot mimmeot hashshuttafut vehaachim shekkanu behemot mimmeot hayerushsha hare hannoladim mehem leachar mikkan chayyavin bemaaser shehare birshutan noldu vahare hen keish echad chalku haachim vehashshuttafin achar shennoldu lahen habbehemot birshutan vechazru venishtattefu hare ellu peturin min hammaaser shebbeshaa shechalku naasu hakkol lekuchin vehallakuach patur uchshechazru venishtattefu hare nishtattefu babbehemot vaadayin lo yaldu lahen birshutan achar shittuf ze hashsheni veaf al pi shechalku gedayim keneged gedayim utlaim keneged telaim vaasara keneged asara hakkol peturin min hammaaser vahare hen kilkuchin

Haachin vehashshuttafin shechalku bichsafim velo chalku bivhema chayyavin bemaaser sheadayin lo naasu habbehemot lekuchin aval im chalku habbehemot af al pi sheadayin lo chalku hakkesafim hare ellu peturin
Hallokeach asara ubbarim bime imman kullan nichnasin laddir lehitasser shehare birshuto noldu
Kohen shennaflu lo eser behemot begezel hagger peturim min hammaaser shemmattenot kehunna mattanot hem uchvar bearnu shehannoten mattana patur min hammaaser

Hakkol nichnasin laddir lehitasser ben temimim ben baale mumin vechal issure mizbeach chutz min hakkilayim vehatterefa veotze dofen umchussar zeman shekkal ellu peturin min hammaaser vechen hayyatom shemmeta immo o nishchata im ledato eno mitasser udvarim ellu mippi hashshemua hem

En hallokeach patur ella im ken nilkach achar shennira lehitasser lefichach hallokeach telaim betoch shivat yeme halleda kesheyyaggia zemannam chayyav leasseran shekkevan sheen mechussar zeman rauy lehitasser hare ze kemi shellakach ubbarim venoldu birshuto

Kal behema shehi safek im bat maaser hi o enah bat maaser hare hi petura min hammaaser lefichach telaim shennitarev bahen yatom o lakuach vechayyotze bahen hare kullan peturin min hammaaser shekkal echad mehen safek hu
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 7: Mi shehau lo asara telaim vehifrish echad measara hau lo mea vehifrish asara lemaaser en ellu maaser ella ketzad ose kones kal hattelaim o kal haagalim laddir veose lo petach katan kede shello yetzu shenayim keechad veimmotehen maamid mibbachutz vehen goot sheyyishmeu hattelaim kolan veyetzu min haddir likratan shenneemar kl asher yaavor tachat hashshavet sheyyaavor meatzmo velo sheyyotzio beyado uchsheyyetzu min haddir ze achar ze matchil umone otan bashshevet Adonai vehayyotze asiri ben zachar ben nekeva ben tamim ben baal mum sokro besikra veomer hare ze maaser lo sekaro besikra velo menaan bashshevet o shemmenaan revutzim o omdim hare ellu maaser hoil umnaam asara asara vekiddesh asiri hare ze maaser

En tzarich letzaref kal behema shennolda birshuto ledir echad ella metzaref kal eder veeder levaddo hau lo chamishsha telaim birushalayim vachamishsha telaim beakko en mitztarfin vechullan peturin min hammaaser vechamma yihye ben ellu leellu veyitztarfu shishsha asar mil
Hau shelosha adarim ben kal echad veechad shishsha asar mil hare shelashtan mitztarfin ketzad haya tisha mikkan vetisha mikkan veechad beemtza hare shelashtan nichnasin laddir lehitasser

En measserin min hatztzon al habbakar velo min habbakar al hatztzon aval measserin min hakkevasim al haizzim umin haizzim al hakkevasim shenneemar vechal masar bakar vatzon mashma kal tzon echad sheshshenehem nikraim se vahare hem kemin echad

En measserim min hannoladim beshana zo al hannoladim beshana acheret keshem sheen measserin bezera haaretz min hechadash al hayyashan velo min hayyashan al hechadash shenneemar hayyotze hassade shana shana veyerae li sheim isser behema mishshana al shana hare ze maaser mippene chumrat hakodashim shehare lo hikpida tora al maasar behema beferush sheyyihye shana shana

Kal hannoladim beechad betishre ad esrim vetisha beelul mitztarfin umasserin meellu al ellu noldu chamishsha telaim beesrim vetisha beelul vachamishsha beechad betishre en mitztarfin yaldu toladot betoch shenatan hare hi uvittah nichnasim laddir lehitasser

En hattelaim hannoladim kemo hattevel sheasur leechol mimmennu ad sheyeasser kemo shebbearnu bimkomo ella muttar limkor velishchot kal ma sheyyirtze ad sheyeasser veyihye hammaaser kodesh veyeachel kehilchato kemo shebbearnu

Kavu chachamim shelosha zemannim beshana lemaasar behema umishsheyaggia zeman mehen asur lo limkor o lishchot ad sheyeasser veim shachat hare ze muttar veellu hen hashshelosha zemannim beom chamishsha asar kodem happesach uvayyom chamishsha asar kodem atzeret uvayyom chamishsha asar kodem hechag vechal zeman meellu nikra goren maasar behema nimtzeta omer shehaggoranot shel maasar behema beom acharon mechodesh adar uvayyom sheloshim vachamishsha missefirat haomer uvom acharon mechodesh elul velamma kavu haggoranot bayamim ellu kede shettihyena habbehemot metzuot leole regalim sheaf al pi shemmuttar limkor kodem sheyeasser kemo shebbearnu hau nimnaim limkor ad sheyeasseru veyaasu hammitzva

Hichnis kal hatztzon o habbakar laddir vehitchil limnot ulkaddesh asiri ad shennisharu betoch haddir pachot measara hare ze mannichan legoren acher vehen mitztarfin leellu sheyyivaldu veyitasseru hakkol begoren echad veaf al pi shehu yodea sheellu yishshaaru bamminyan chayyav lehachnis hakkol laddir vehannishar yishshaer
Mishneh Torah, Firstlings 8: Hammachnis tzon laddir vehitchilu latzet achat achat vehu mone kemo shebbearnu vetaa bamminyan vekara lashshemini o leshellematta mimmennu asiri o shekkara lashshenem asar o shellemala mimmennu asiri lo nitkaddeshu aval im kara latteshii o laachad asar asiri nitkaddeshu vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala nishma shehattaut mitkaddeshot lemaaser shellemala mimmennu veshellematta mimmennu aval lo shellifnehem veshelleacharehem afillu kara latteshii asiri velaasiri teshii velaachad asar asiri ben betaut ben bechavana shelashtan mukdashim

Veheach dinam hatteshii eno karev ella neechal bemumo vehaasiri maaser vehaachad asar yikkarev shelamim vetaun nesachim kishlamim veeno ose temura mippene shehu atzmo kitmura bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hammone hu baal habbehemot aval haose shaliach leasser lo vetaa ben batteshii ben baachad asar en mekaddesh ella haasiri havadday bilvad shello asaahu shaliach litot ulhafsid ella lekaddesh karauy

Ze sheamarnu sheim kara laachad asar asiri nitkaddesh keshekkara laasiri teshii aval im kara laasiri asiri vekara acharav laachad asar asiri lo nitkaddesh achad asar shehare haasiri havadday lo akar shem asiri mealav vaafillu yatza haasiri velo keraahu lo asiri velo achad asar ella shatak veachar kach yatza achad asar ukraahu asiri lo nitkaddesh shehaasiri meatzmo nitkaddesh veaf al pi shello keraahu asiri hoil velo akar shem asiri mealav en achad asar mekuddash

Yatzu teshii vaasiri keechad ben shekkara shenehem asiri ben shekkeraam teshii shenehem mukdashin veyeachlu bemuman veenan kerevin vechen im yatza asiri veachad asar keechad im keraan asiri hare asiri veachad asar meoravim ze baze vehem kemo maaser shennitarev bishlamim sheyyeachlu bemuman kemo shebbearnu behilchot pesule hammukdashin veim keraan achad asar hare haasiri vehachullin meoravin ze baze veyeachlu bemuman

Hitchil limnot veyatzu techilla shenayim shehen rishon vesheni hare ze mone hakkol zug zug umkaddesh zug asiri vechen im menaan shelosha shelosha bechal paam ufaam o chamishsha chamishsha mekaddesh hakkat haasirit

Yatzu battechilla shenayim umnaan echad vekara hashshelishi sheyyatza acharehen sheni umana kedarko echad echad hare hatteshii vehaasiri mukdashin veyeachlu bemuman hatteshii mippene shehu haasiri havadday shehare shenayim yatzu battechilla veze shekkerao asiri hu achad asar vehakkore leachad asar asiri nitkaddesh kemo shebbearnu
Menaan lemafrea kegon sheyyatza rishon veamar asiri veyatza sheni veamar teshii ad sheyyatza haasiri umana achat hare ze kadash shehaasiri meelav nitkaddesh

Kara latteshii asiri venishar haasiri baddir hatteshii yeachel bemumo veze shennishar baddir maaser af al pi shello yatza velo berro shehaasiri meelav nitkaddesh met haasiri baddir hatteshii yeachel bemumo vechal hashshemona sheyyatzu venimnu peturin veaf al pi shello nitkaddesh asiri shellahen likkarev ella met kodem sheyyatza shehamminyan harauy poter
