Bet din shehoru bishgaga veshachchu atzmo shel chet shehoru bo af al pi shehen yodim bevadday shechatu bishgaga veaf al pi shehaam modiin otan veomrim lahen bechach vechach horetem lanu hem peturin vehaosim al pihem chayyavin bifne atzman shenneemar venoda hachattat asher chatu aleha lo sheyyodiu oto hachotim ketzad shaggu vehittiru chelev sheal gabbe hakkeva vaachaluhu rov haam veachar sheyyadu sheshshagu behoraa veshehittiru davar shechayyavim al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat kevua nistappek lahem im miktzat hachalavim hittiru o miktzat haddamim hittiru hare ellu peturin vechal mi sheachal mevi chattat kevua

Bet din shehoru bishgaga venoda lahem shiggatan ben sheheviu kapparatan ben shello heviu kal haose kefi horaatan sheppashta berov hatztzibbur meachar sheyyadu hare ze mevi asham taluy hoil vehaya lo lishl bechal et al devarim shennitchaddeshu bevet din velo shaal hare ze kemi shennistappek lo im chata o lo chata bamme devarim amurim bemi shehaya im bet din bammedina aval mi sheraa hahoraa vehalach limdina acheret af al pi sheasa achar sheyyadu patur mippene shettala bahen vahare i efshar lo lishl velo od ella hannivhal latzet af al pi sheadayin lo yatza ladderech veasa al pihem meachar sheyyadu hare ze patur

Kevar bearnu shekkal shegaga shehahedot mevi aleha chattat hakkevua kisba o seira im shagag bah hannasi mevi sair veim shagag bah kohen mashiach mevi par bamme devarim amurim shekkohen mashiach mevi par al shiggato keshettaa behoraat atzmo veasa maase beshiggat horaato levaddah vehu sheyyihye chacham mufla shenneemar im hakkohen hammashiach yecheta leashmat haam hare mashiach ketzibbur ma hatztzibbur shehen bet din enan chayyavin bekarban ad sheyyihu chachamim reuyin lehoraa veyitu behoraa veyaasu haosim al pihem veoru levattel miktzat ulkayyem miktzat kach hammashiach bechal hadderachim haellu

Ketzad kohen mashiach shettaa behoraa leatzmo vedimma shehazzorek mershut lirshut beshabbat muttar vezarak mershut lirshut vehu tole behoraato leatzmo kesheyyivada lo cheto yavi par lechattat aval im lo tala behoraato ella shagag vezarak bishgaga o shettala behoraato velo haya chacham mufla o sheakar kal hagguf behoraato leatzmo o sheshshagag behoraato levattel miktzat velo asa vehu somech al horaato ella asa bishgaga acheret o shehaya mezid behoraa veshagag bemaase hare ze patur mikkarban kelal sheddino lehoraat atzmo kedin hakkahal lehoraat bet din lechal davar hora leatzmo veshachach mee ze taam hora uvishat maase amar hareni ose al daat horaati hare ze mevi par chattat

Hora leatzmo levattel miktzat ulkayyem miktzat baavoda zara veasa kefi horaato hare ze mevi seira kehedot vehu sheyyishgog behoraa kemo shebbearnu sheen hakkohen hammashiach chayyav karban ella behelem davar behoraa im shiggat hammaase betzibbur aval im shagag bemaase bilvad belo horaa ben baavoda zara ben bishar mitzot eno mevi karban kelal

Hora hakkohen hammashiach im bet din veshagag hu vehem behoraa af al pi sheasu al pi hahoraa hazzot shettau bah hoil velo samach bishat maase al horaato levaddah ella al horaato im horaat bet din hare ze patur veen tzarich lehavi kappara bifne atzmo ella im hau bet din meviin karban mitkapper lo bichlal hatztzibbur veim hau haosim hem hammeviim karban hu eno mevi karban shehare en tzarich kappara bifne atzmo
Hora im bet din bishgaga veshaggu hem bedam vehu bechelev eno mitkapper lo im hatztzibbur ella mevi par leatzmo

Kohen mashiach shennistappek lo im shagag shegaga zo shehi shiggat horaa im hammaase o lo shagag otah eno mevi asham taluy mippene shehu bah ketzibbur sheenan meviin asham taluy al lo hoda shel shiggat horaa aval hannasi im nistappek lo im chata o lo chata mevi asham taluy kishar hahedotot mippene sheen shiggato teluya behoraato e zehu nasi haamur battora ze melech sheen alav reshut meadam miyyisrael veen lemala mimmennu bemalchuto ella Adonai elohav ben shehaya mibbet david o mishshear shivte yisrael veim hau melachim rabbim veen echad mehen oved et chavero kal echad veechad mehen mevi seir izzim al shiggato vee zehu kohen mashiach ze kohen gadol shennimshach beshemen hammishcha lo hamrubbe bivgadim

Kohen gadol shennimshach beshemen hammishcha veavar meavodato mippene mum o zikna vechayyotze bahen vechata bishgaga zo mevi par al shiggato lefi sheen ben kohen mashiach hamshammesh lechohen mashiach sheavar ella par yom hakkippurim vaasirit haefa shel kal yom sheen makriv otan ella kohen hamshammesh bichhuna gedola aval par habba al kal hammitzot shavim hem bo

Nasi sheasa im hatztzibbur behoraat bet din hare ze mitkapper lo bichlal haam sheim hau bet din hem shehikrivu al shiggatan kal haam vehammelech peturin min hakkarban kemo shebbearnu veim hau haosim al pi bet din hem shechayyavin bekarban vehaya hammelech min haosim hare ze mevi sair shesseir nasi bimkom kisba o seira shel hedot hu omed
Nasi shennitztarea avar minnesiuto venasi sheavar minnesiuto hare hu kehedot chata keshehaya nasi veavar miggedullato hare ze mevi sair shenneemar al chattato asher chata kishat chattato hu mevi

Kohen mashiach o melech shechatu ad shello nitmannu af al pi shello noda lahem ella achar shennitmannu hare ellu kehedot shenneemar asher nasi yecheta im hakkohen hammashiach yecheta ad sheyyechta keshehu nasi uchshehu mashiach lefichach im achal sefek chelev keshehu hedot venoda lo al sefeko achar shennitmanna lihot kohen gadol hare ze mevi asham taluy achal chatzi zayit chelev keshehu hedot vachatzi zayit keshehu nasi behelem achat o sheachal chatzi zayit keshehu nasi vachatzi zayit achar sheavar eno mitztaref ufatur achal chatzi zayit keshehu hedot venitmanna veavar veachal chatzi zayit keshehu hedot hare ze safek im mitztaref o kevar hifsika hannesiut
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 1: Mitzvat ase lishchot et happesach bearbaa asar lechodesh nisan achar chatzot veen shochatin ella min hakkevasim o min haizzim bilvad zachar ben shana veechad haish veechad haishsha chayyavin bemitzva zo
Vmi shebbittel mitzva zo bezadon veavar yom arbaa asar velo hikriv vehu lo tame velo badderech rechoka hare ze chayyav karet veim bittelah bishgaga patur

En shochatin et happesach ella baazara kishar hakkadashim af bishat hetter habbamot lo hau makrivin et happesach bevamat yachid vechal hammakriv et happesach bevamat yachid loke shenneemar lo tuchal lizboach et happasach beachad shearecha mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara lashshochet bevamat yachid afillu bishat hetter habbamot

Shechitat happesach achar chatzot veim shechato kodem chatzot pasul veen shochatin oto ella achar tamid shel ben haarbayim achar shemmaktirin ketoret shel ben haarbayim veachar shemmetivin et hannerot matchilin lishchot et happesachim ad sof hayyom veim shechato achar chatzot kodem tamid shel ben haarbayim kasher veyihye echad memares bedam happesach ad sheyyizzarek dam hattamid veachar kach yizrok dam happesach acharav veim nizrak dam happesach kodem dam hattamid kasher

Hashshochet et happesach bizmanno vehaya lo kezayit chametz birshuto loke shenneemar lo tizbach al chametz dam zivchi shello yizbach happesach vehechametz kayyam echad hashshochet veechad hazzorek et haddam veechad hammaktir et haemurin im haya birshut echad mehem o birshut echad mibbene chavura sheochlin pesach ze kezayit chametz bishat hakravato hare ze loke vehappesach kasher

Dam happesach taun sheficha keneged hayesod veachar sheshshofchim damo mafshitim oto vekorin et bitno umotziin et emurav umaktirin otan chalavin kal zevach vezevach levaddo uvaal hazzevach notel pischo im haor shello umevi leveto lirushalayim vetzolehu veochel laerev
Hammanniach emurim velo hiktiran ad shellanu venifselu belina hare ze over belo taase shenneemar lo yalin chelev chaggi ad boker veaf al pi sheavar eno loke lefi sheen bo maase

Umaktirin chelve pesachim kal hallayela ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar bamme devarim amurim keshechal arbaa asar lihot beshabbat shehare chelve shabbat kerevin beom tov aval im chal arbaa asar lihot bechol en maktirin chelve chol beom tov
Happesach nishchat beshalosh kittot shenneemar veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael kahal veeda veyisrael veen pochatin mishsheloshim bene adam bechal kat vechat
Hau hakkol chamishshim nichnasim battechilla sheloshim veshochatin veotzim asara venichnasin asara vechozrin veotzin asara venichnasin asara

Hau pachot mechamishshim en shochatin et happesach lechattechilla veim shachatu kasher veim shachatu kullan bevat achat kasher ketzad nishchat nichnesa hakkat harishona ad shettitmalle haazara venoalin daltot haazara umatchilin lishchot et pischehen vechal zeman shehen shochatin umakrivin korim halleviyyim et hahallel im gamru hahallel vaadayin lo shalma hakkat millehakriv shonim veim shanu velo shalmu lehakriv meshalleshin umeolam lo shilleshu
Al kal keria ukria tokin shalosh tekiot bachatzotzrot tekia terua utkia hoil veen lo nesachim litkoa bishat nissuch tokin bishat shechita

Hakkohanim omdim shurot shurot uvidehen mizreke kesef umizreke zahav shura shekkullah kesef kesef shura shekkullah zahav zahav velo hau meoravim kede sheyyihye lahem noy velo hau lammizrakin shulayim kede shello yannichum veyikrash haddam

Shachat hashshochet vekibbel hakkohen notno lachavero vachavero lachavero kede sheyyitasseku rabbim bammitzva ad sheyyaggia haddam etzel kohen hakkarov lammizbeach shofcho sheficha achat keneged hayesod umkabbel mizrak echad male veachar kach machzir et harekan vetolin umafshitin et kullo vekoro ummache et keravav ad shemmesir mehen hatztzoa vehapperesh umotzi et haemurin venotnan bichli umolchan umaktiran hakkohen al gabbe hammizbeach vechetzad tolin umafshitin masmerot shel barzel hau kevuin bakketalim uvaammudim shebbahen tolin umafshitin vechal mi shello matza makom litlot maklot dakkim vachalakim hau sham manniach al ketefo veal ketef chavero vetole umafshit

Shalmu millehakriv potchin daltot haazara veotzet kat harishona venichnesa sheniyya yatzat sheniyya venichnesa shelishit kemaase rishona kach maase sheniyya ushlishit shalma kat shelishit veyatzat rochatzim et haazara

Chal arbaa asar lihot beshabbat kemaasehu bechol kach maasehu beshabbat verochatzin et haazara beshabbat sheen issur shevut bammikdash afillu bedavar sheeno tzorech avoda issur shevut bammikdash hetter hu

En kal echad veechad molich et pischo leveto beshabbat ella kat harishona yotzin befischehem veoshvin behar habbayit vehashsheniyya yotzin befischehen veoshvin bachel vehashshelishit omdin bimkoman baazara veshohim hakkol ad motzae shabbat veholech kal echad befischo leveto

Shechitat happesach uzrikat damo umichuy keravav vehekter chalavav dochin et hashshabbat shei efshar laasotan kodem hashshabbat shehare kavua lo zeman shenneemar bemoado aval harkavato vahavaato michutz lattechum vachatichat yabbalato bichli enan dochin et hashshabbat shehare efshar laasotan kodem hashshabbat veim yachol lachtoch yabbalto beyado beshabbat chotech veim hayeta yevesha chotchah afillu bichli sheen shevut bammikdash kelal vechen tzeliyyato vahadachat keravav enan dochin et hashshabbat shehare efshar laasotan leachar hashshabbat

Shachach velo hevi sakkin lo yevienna beshabbat ella notnah ben karne hakkeves o betzamro umakkisho ad shemmevio laazara umakdisho sham veaf al pi shehu mechammer beshabbat mechammer kilachar yad hu umippene hammitzva muttar bamme devarim amurim keshello hikdish pischo adayin velo amar ze pesach aval im hikdisho lo yavi sakkin alav mippene shehu oved bekadashim umippene ma hittiru lehakdish pischo beshabbat hoil vekavua lo zeman muttar lehakdisho beshabbat vechen makdish adam chagigato beom tov veeno choshesh

Hashshochet et happesach venimtza baal mum o terefa hare ze shochet acher ben bechol ben beshabbat afillu mea ze achar ze shochet veholech ad sheyyichshar echad o ad shettecheshach veyiddache lashsheni shehare anus hu
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 2: En shochatin et happesach ella limnuyav shenneemar tachossu al hasse melammed shemmitmannim alav keshehu chay veellu hammitmannim al happesach hem hannikraim bene chavura
Yachid sheshshachat et happesach leatzmo kasher vehu sheyyihye rauy leechol et kullo umishtaddelin shello yishchat lechattechilla al yachid shenneemar yaasu oto

En shochatin et happesach ella al mi sherauy leechol haya echad mibbene chavura katan o zaken o chole im yachol leechol kezayit shochatin alav veim lav en shochatin alav shenneemar ish lefi achlo ad sheyyihye rauy leechol afillu chavura shel mea veen kal echad mehen yachol leechol kezayit en shochatin alehen

En osin chavura nashim vaavadim o ketannim vaavadim mippene shello tihye kallut rosh benehen aval osim chavura kullam nashim afillu befesach sheni o kullah avadim veshochatin al hakketannim sheyyihu mikkelal bene hachavura lo shettihye chavura kullah ketannim sheenan bene daat vechen en osin chavura kullah cholim o zekenim o onnim af al pi shehen yecholin leechol hoil vaachilatam meuta shemma yashiru happesach viviuhu lide pesul veim avru veshachatu al chavura zo kasher vechen en osin chavura kullah gerim shemma yedakdeku bo viviuhu lide pissul veim shachatu alehen kasher

Shechato shello limnuyav o lemi sheen kal echad mehen yachol leechol kezayit o sheshshechato laarelim o litmeim pasul shechato lemi sheyyachol leechol ulmi sheeno yachol leechol kezayit limnuyav veshello limnuyav lemulim velaarelim lithorim velitmein kasher sheellu haruyin lo ochlin kahalacha vehaacherim keillu lo chashav alehem

Shechato lemulim vezarak haddam leshem mulim vaarelim pasul shehazzerika chamura shehi ikkar hakkarban shechato lemulim sheyyitkapperu bo arelim pasul shehare yesh machashevet arelim bizrika shechato leochlav lizrok damo shello leochlav happesach kasher veen adam yotze bo yede chovato lefi sheen machashevet ochlim bazzerika
Mi shehu bari bishat shechita vechole bishat zerika o chole bishat shechita uvari bishat zerika en shochatin vezorkin alav ad sheyyihye bari mishsheat shechita ad sheat zerika

Shochet adam al yede beno uvitto hakketannim veal yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim ben middatan ben shello middatan aval eno shochet al yede beno uvitto haggedolim velo al yede avdo veshifchato haivrim velo al yede ishto ella middatan veim shatku velo michu hare ze middatan
Shachat al yede beno uvitto hakketannim veal yede avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim vehalchu veshachatu hen leatzman yotzin beshel rabban
Shachat al yede ishto uvno uvitto haggedolim veal yede avdo veshifchato haivrim veshachatu hen leatzman en lecha michuy gadol mizze veenan yotzin ella beshel atzman

Haishsha shehi bevet balah shachat aleha aviha veshachat aleha balah tochal mishshel balah hayeta nechpezet lalechet levet aviha baregel harishon hassamuch lenissueha kederech kal habbanot veshachat aleha aviha veshachat aleha balah tochal mishshel aviha mikkan veelach tochal mimmakom shehi rotza vehu shettivror lah makom shettirtze bishat shechita vechen yatom sheshshachatu alav appotroppesin yochal mimmakom shehu rotze bamme devarim amurim beyatom katan aval gadol naase kimmanne atzmo al shene pesachim vehammanne atzmo al shene pesachim eno ochel ella min hannishchat rishon
Eved shel shene shuttafin bizman shemmakpidin ze al ze shello yignevennu lo yochal mishshel shenehen veim enan makpidin mimmakom sheyyirtze yochal
Mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin lo yochal lo mishshel rabbo velo mishshel atzmo ad sheyyease kullo ben chorin

Ad kamma nimnim al happesach ad sheyyihye bo kezayit lechal echad veechad venimnin alav umoshchin et yedehen mimmennu ad sheyyishshachet kevan shennishchat eno yachol limshoch et yado shehare nishchat alav nimnu alav vechazru acherim venimnu alav rishonim sheyyesh lahem kezayit ochlim ufturim measot pesach sheni veacharonim sheravu ad shello nimtza bo kezayit lechal echad enan ochlin vechayyavim laasot pesach sheni

Hammanne acherim immo al chelko velo yadu bahen bene hachavura hare bene hachavura rashshain litten lo chelko achar sheyyitztzale beet haachila uvne hachavura ochlin mishshellahen vehu ochel chelko im haacherim shemmana alav bachavura sheniyya vechen bene hachavura shehaya echad mehem gargeran rashshaim lehotzio mehen venotnin lo chelko veyochlehu bachavurato veim eno zolel enan rashshain lechallek
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 3: Haomer leavdo tze ushchot alay et happesach af al pi shedderech rabbo lishchot tale bechal shana vehalach veshachat alav gedi o shehaya darko lishchot gedi vehalach veshachat alav tale hare ze yochal mimmennu shehare lo peresh veamar lo shechot li mimmin peloni halach veshachat gedi vetale eno ochel mishshenehen ella yetzu levet hasserefa sheen nimnin al shene pesachim veim haya melech o malka veamar leavdo lishchot alav veshachat gedi vetale yochal min harishon mishshum shelom malchut

Haomer lishlucho tze ushchot alay et happesach vekava lo gedi o tale veshachach ma amar lo rabbo hare ze shochet gedi vetale veomer im gedi amar li gedi shello vetale shelli veim tale amar li tale shello ugdi shelli shachach hashsholeach ma amar lo shenehen yetzu levet hasserefa veim shachach hashsholeach kodem sheyyizzarek haddam chayyavin laasot pesach sheni shachach achar shennizrak haddam patur millaasot pesach sheni vechen haddin beomer leavdo tze ushchot alay vekava lo veshachach haeved ma amar lo rabbo vehu sheyyitten lo roe shel rabbo gedi vetale veyomar lo shechot shenehen kede shettishchot kemo sheamar lo rabbecha vahare echad mehen shellecha al menat shello yihye lerabbecha bo kelum im asa haroe kach achar kach yihye efshar laeved lehatnot kemo shebbearnu
Bene chavura sheamru laechad tze ushchot lanu et happesach veamar hu lahen veattem shachatu alay veshachatu hem veshachat hu kullam ochlin mizze shennishchat rishon vehaacharon yetze levet hasserefa

Chavura sheavad pischah veamru laechad tze uvakkesh ushchot alenu halach umatza pesach sheavad ushchato vehem lakchu pesach acher ushchatuhu im shello nishchat rishon hu ochel mishshello vehen ochlin immo vehashsheni yissaref veim shellahen nishchat rishon hen ochlin mishshellahen vehu ochel mishshello en yadua e ze mehen nishchat rishon o sheshshachatu shenehen keachat hu ochel mishshello vehen enan ochlin immo veshellahen yetze levet hasserefa ufturin millaasot pesach sheni

Amar lahem ze sheshshelachuhu levakkesh pesach sheavad ulshachoto im echarti shachatu attem alay halach umatza veshachat vehem lakchu veshachatu im shellahen nishchat rishon hem ochlin mishshellahem vehu ochel immahem vehashsheni yissaref veim shello nishchat rishon hu ochel mishshello vehen ochlin mishshellahen en yadua e ze mehen nishchat rishon o sheshshachatu shenehem keechad hen ochlin mishshellahen vehu eno ochel immahen veshello yetze levet hasserefa ufatur millaasot pesach sheni

Avad lahen pischam veavad lo pischo veamar lahen tzeu uvakkeshu veshachatu alay veamru lo tze uvakkesh ushchot alenu vehalach umatza veshachat umatzu hem veshachatu kullam ochlin min harishon vehashsheni yissaref veim en yadua e ze nishchat techilla o sheshshachatu shenehen keechad shenehen yissarfu ufturin millaasot pesach sheni halach hu levakkesh vehalchu hem levakkesh velo amru ze laze kelum af al pi shehaya belibbam sheyyishchot kal echad mehen al chavero o shehau sham remizot udvarim sheumdan haddaat bahen shekkal echad sheyyimtza yishchot al chavero hoil velo pershu velo amru ze laze kelum enan achrain ze laze

Shette chavurot shennitarvu pischehen kodem sheyyishshachatu chavura zo lokchin keves echad min hattaarovot vehashsheniyya lokchin hashsheni veechad mibbene chavura zo ba etzel ellu veechad mibbene sheniyya ba etzel harishona vechal chavura mehen omrot leze haechad shebba etzlam im shellanu hu happesach hazze yadecha meshuchot mishshellecha venimneta al shellanu veim shellecha hu happesach hazze yadenu meshuchot mishshellanu venimnenu al shellecha vechen chamesh chavurot shel chamishsha chamishsha bene adam o eser chavurot shel asara asara moshchin lahen echad mikkal chavura lachavura haacheret vechach hem matnim veomrim veachar kach shochatin

Shenayim shennitarvu pischehen ze lokeach pesach echad min hattaarovot veze lokeach lo echad veze memanne al pischo echad min hashshuk vehaacher memanne immo echad min hashshuk kede sheyyihu shette chavurot veachar kach yavo echad mishshenehem etzel ellu veyavo echad meellu etzel haacher umatne kal echad im chavero shebba etzlo mechavura sheniyya veomer im shelli hu pesach ze yadecha meshuchot mishshellecha venimneta al shelli veim shellecha hu yadi meshucha mippesach shelli venimneti al shellecha venimtza shello hifsidu kelum

Chamishsha shennitarvu orot pischehen nimtzet yabbelet beor echad mehen kullam yetzu levet hasserefa veim nitarvu kodem zerikat daman chayyavin befesach sheni nitarvu char zerika peturin millaasot pesach sheni sheim hikrivu pesach sheni nimtza ze shekkarav barishon karban kasher mevi chullin azara veim nimnu kullan al pesach echad nimtza nishchat shello limchuyyav veze kemi shennishchat shello limnuyav veim hitna kal chad mehen veamar im eno pesach yihye shelamim dam happesach bishficha vedam hashshelamim bizrika vehannittanin bizrika al yittenem bishficha lechattechilla lefichach peturin mippesach sheni
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 4: Kevar nitbaer behilchot pesule hammukdashin shehappesach eno nishchat ella leshem pesach ulshem bealav veim shechato bemachshevet shinnuy hashshem pasul hashshochet et happesach al bene chavura veamar lahem leachar zeman oto happesach sheshshachatti alechem shello lishmo shechattiv im haya neeman lahen somchin al devarav veim lav shurat haddin sheeno neeman veharotze lehachmir al atzmo hare ze meshubbach veyavi pesach sheni

Besar happesach shennitma venoda lo kodem zerika af al pi shehaemurin tehorin lo yizrok et haddam sheen happesach ba ella laachila veim zarak lo hurtza veim lo noda lo ad shennizrak haddam hurtza shehatztzitz meratztze al shiggat habbasar shennitma veeno meratztze al hazzadon nitmeu miktzat haevarim soref et hattemeim veochel et hattehorim nitmeu haemurim vehabbasar kayyam zorek et haddam vehabbasar neechal laerev nitmeu habbealim achar shennishchat lo yizrok et haddam veim zarak lo hurtza lefichach chayyavin befesach sheni sheen hatztzitz meratztze al tumat hagguf ella im nitmea betumat hattehom kemo shebbearnu behilchot biat hammikdash

Happesach sheyyatza mirushalayim o shennitma bearbaa asar yissaref miyyad nitmeu habbealim o metu o mashchu et yedehem afillu nitmeu o metu kodem zerikat haddam mannichin oto ad shetteubbar tzurato veachar kach yissaref ze hakkelal kal sheppesulo begufo yissaref miyyad baddam o babbealim teubbar tzurato veachar kach yissaref lefichach im shechato achar shennoda shemmashchu habbealim et yedehem o metu o nitmeu veniddechu lefesach sheni hare ze yissaref miyyad bamme devarim amurim sheyyissaref im nitmeu habbealim keshennitmeu kal bene hachavura aval im nitmeu miktzatan zachu tehorim bechelkam shel temeim af al pi shennitmeu miktzatan achar shehitchilu leechol zachu hattehorim sheadayin lo hitchilu aval im hitchilu kullan venitmeu miktzatan lo zachu tehorim bechelkan shel temeim ella hattehorim ochlin chelkam vechelek hattemeim yissaref vehu haddin im metu miktzatan nitma shalem o rubbo sorfim oto lifne habbira bifne hakkol kede levayeshan ad sheyyizaharu bo vesorfin oto meatze hammaaracha kede shello yachshedu otan veyomru meatze hammaaracha ganvu lefichach im yisrefuhu bekash uvkanim veratzu lisrof mishshel atzman sorfin nitma miuto vechen hannotar sorfin oto bechatzrotehen meatze atzman aval lo meatze hammaaracha shello yishshaaru mehen etzlam veyimalu bahen
Hammafrish nekeva lefischo o zachar ben shette shanim yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyimmacher veyavi bedamav pesach veim lo nafal bah mum ad shehikriv pischo yavi bedamav shelamim

Hifrish pischo umet lo yeviennu beno acharav leshem happesach ella leshem shelamim veim haya memunne im aviv alav yeviennu leshem pesach bamme devarim amurim keshemmet aviv achar chatzot arbaa asar aval kodem chatzot hare ze nidche lefesach sheni mippene shehu onen kemo sheyyitbaer veyavi pischo ze bashsheni

Mi sheavad pischo umtzao achar shehifrish pesach acher vahare shenehen omdin yakriv e ze mehen sheyyirtze leshem pesach vehashsheni yikrav shelamim metzao achar sheshshachat pischo hare ze yikrav shelamim vechen im hemir baze hannimtza achar shechita hare temura zo tikrav shelamim aval im metzao kodem shechitat ze shehifrish hoil veze hannimtza rauy lehakrivo pesach verauy lehakrivo shelamim kemo shebbearnu im hemir baze hannimtza ben kodem shechitat hammufrash tachtav ben achar shechita en temurato kereva ella tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veyavi bedameha shelamim
Pesach sheavra shenato ushlamim habbaim mechamat happesach hare hem kishlamim lechal davar teunin semicha unsachim utnufat chaze veshok ma sheen ken befesach

Pesach shennitarev bishlamim yikrevu kullan shelamim nitarev bizvachim acherim yiru ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyavi bidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin ze uvidme hayyafe shebbahen shelamim veyafsid hammotar mibbeto kemo shebbearnu bifsule hammukdashin nitarev bivchorot yiru hakkol ad sheyyippol bahen mum veyeachelu kivchor baal mum veyavi behema shehi yafa kayyafa shebbetaarovot veyomar kal makom shehu happesach kedushshato tachul al zo veyakrivenna shelamim im karev pischo

Hammafrish pischo ad shello nitgayyer venitgayyer ad shello nishtachrer venishtachrer ad shello hevi shette searot vehevi hare ze makrivo leshem pesach sheen baale chayyim nidchin kemo shebbearnu bifsule hammukdashin

Hammafrish maot lefischo vehotiru yavi hammotar shelamim hammanne acherim al pischo veal chagigato hare hammaot sheyyikkach mehen bechelkam chullin af al pi shezze hifrish tale lefischo veze hifrish maot lefischo velakach mimmennu hammaot uminnahu al pischo hare hammaot chullin sheal menat ken hikdishu yisrael et pischehen veet chagigatan veet meot pischehen vachagigatan

Etzim shel tzeliyyat happesach kefesach vechen matztza umaror hoil vehen machshire happesach hare hem kefesach veim lakach mimmeot happesach mimmi shemminna otan immo kede lemannotan immo bammatztza umaror o lihot lo chelek baetzim shetztzole bahen hare hammaot chullin
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 5: Mi shehaya tame bishat shechitat happesach sheen shochatin alav o shehaya bederech rechoka o neenas beones acher o sheshshagag velo hikriv barishon hare ze mevi pesach bearbaa asar lachodesh hashsheni ben haarbayim ushchitat pesach ze mitzvat ase bifne atzmo vedocha et hashshabbat sheen hashsheni tashlumin larishon ella regel bifne atzmo lefichach chayyavin alav karet

Ketzad mi sheshshagag o neenas velo hikriv barishon im hezid velo hikriv bashsheni chayyav karet veim shagag o neenas af bashsheni patur hezid velo hikriv barishon hare ze makriv bashsheni veim lo hikriv bashsheni af al pi sheshshagag hare ze chayyav karet shehare lo hikriv karban Adonai bemoado vehaya mezid aval mi shehaya tame o bederech rechoka velo asa et harishon af al pi shehezid bashsheni eno chayyav karet shekkevar niftar befesach rishon min hakkaret
Umi shehaya bederech rechoka veshachatu vezarku alav et haddam af al pi shebba laerev lo hurtza vechayyav befesach sheni

Tame sheyyachol littaher befesach rishon shello taval ella yashav betumato ad sheavar zeman hakkarban vechen arel shello mal ad sheavar zeman hakkarban hare ze mezid barishon lefichach im lo asa et hashsheni afillu bishgaga chayyav karet

Keshem shemmilat atzmo meakkavto millaasot pesach kach milat banav hakketannim umilat kal avadav ben gedolim ben ketannim meakkevet oto shenneemar himmol lo chal zachar veaz yikrav laasoto veim shachat kodem sheyyamul otam happesach pasul vechen tevilat amhotav leshem avdut meakkavto vedavar ze mippi hakkabbala shehattevila lishfachot kemila laavadim
Hakkatan en milat avadav utvilat shifchotav meakkavto millehimmanot al happesach shenneemar vechal eved ish lehotzi et hakkatan
Ger shennitgayyer ben pesach rishon lefesach sheni vechen katan shehigdil ben shene pesachim chayyavin laasot pesach sheni veim shachatu alav barishon patur

Nashim shenniddechu lashsheni ben mippene haones vehashshegaga ben mippene hattuma vederech rechoka hare pesach sheni lahem reshut ratzu shochatin ratzu en shochatin lefichach en shochatin alehen bifne atzman beshabbat befesach sheni aval im hayeta haishsha achat mibbene chavura muttar vee zo hi derech rechoka chamishsha asar mil chutz lechomat yerushalayim

Mi shehaya beno uven yerushalayim yom arbaa asar im aliyyat hashshamesh chamishsha asar mil o yeter hare ze derech rechoka haya beno uvenah pachot mizze eno bederech rechoka mippene shehu yachol lehaggia lirushalayim achar chatzot kesheyehallech beraglav benachat halach velo higgia mippene sheikkevuhu habbehemot bedachokam o shehaya birushalayim vehaya chole beraglav velo higgia laazara ad sheavar zeman hakkarban hare ze anus veeno bederech rechoka mi shehaya chavush chutz lechomat yerushalayim vehivtichuhu latzet laerev shochatin alav uchsheyyetze laerev yochal bamme devarim amurim keshehaya chavush beyad yisrael aval im haya chavush beyad akkum en shochatin alav ad sheyyetze veim shachatu alav veyatza hare ze ochel veim lo yatza patur millaasot pesach sheni shehare nishchat alav vechen haonen vehachole vehazzaken shehem yecholin leechol sheshshachatu alehen veachar shennizrak haddam nitmeu bemet vahare enan yecholin leechol hare ellu peturin millaasot pesach sheni
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 6: E zehu tame shennidche lefesach sheni kal mi sheeno yachol leechol et happesach belele benisan mippene tumato kegon zavim vezavot niddot veoldot uvoale niddot aval hannogea binvela vesheretz vechayyotze bahen beom arbaa asar hare ze tovel veshochatin alav achar sheyyitbol velaerev kesheyyaariv shimsho ochel et happesach

Teme met shechal shevii shello lihot bearbaa asar af al pi shettaval vehuzza alav vahare hu rauy leechol kadashim laerev en shochatin alav ella nidche lefesach sheni shenneemar vayehi anashim asher hau temeim lenefesh adam velo yachlu laasot happesach bayyom hahu mippi hashshemua lamdu sheshshevii shellahen haya veal ze shaalu im yishshachet alehen vehem yochlu laerev uferesh lahen sheen shochatin alehen bamme devarim amurim beshennitma betumot min hammet shehannazir megalleach alehen aval im haya tame bishar tumot min hammet sheen hannazir megalleach alehen shochatin alav bashshevii shello achar sheyyitbol veyazze alav uchsheyyaariv shimsho ochel pischo

Zav sheraa shette reiyyot vesafar shiva yamim vetaval bashshevii shochatin alav vehu ochel laerev veim raa zov achar shennizrak haddam hare ze patur millaasot pesach sheni vechen shomeret yom keneged yom tovelet beom hashshimmur kemo shebbearnu beviot asurot veshochatin aleha vehi ochelet laerev veim raata dam achar shennizrak dam happesach petura millaasot pesach sheni veen shochatin al hannidda bashshevii shellah shehare enah tovelet ad lel shemini veenah reuya leechol kadashim ad lel teshii

Mechussere kippurim shechal yom havaat karbenotehen bearbaa asar shochatin alehen umakrivin karbenotehen bearbaa asar benisan ben kodem shechitat happesach ben achar shechitato veochlin pischehen laerev veen shochatin alehen ad sheyyimseru karbenotehen beyad bet din shemma yifsheu velo yakrivu otam

Metzora shechal shemini shello lihot bearbaa asar veraa keri bo bayyom hare ze tovel venichnas leezrat nashim umevi karbenotav veaf al pi shettevul yom asur lehikkanes leezrat nashim hoil veissuro lehikkanes sham middivrehem kemo shebbearnu behilchot biat mikdash veom ze hu yom hakravat happesach bemoado yavo ase sheyyesh bo karet veyidche issur shel divrehem

Teme met shechal shevii shello lihot beshabbat en mazzin alav ella lemachar vaafillu chal shevii shello lihot bishlosha asar benisan vehu shabbat yiddache leom arbaa asar umazzin alav veen shochatin alav kemo shebbearnu ella yiddache lefesach sheni vahalo issur hazzaya beshabbat mishshum shevut vehappesach becharet veheach yaamidu divrehem bimkom karet mippene shebbeom shehu asur behazzaya mishshum shevut eno zeman hakkarban shechayyavin alav karet lefichach heemidu divrehen bimkoman af al pi shehaddavar gorem leatid lavo laamod bimkom karet

Yisrael arel shemmal beerev happesach shochatin alav achar shemmal aval ger shennitgayyer beom arbaa asar umal vetaval en shochatin alav sheeno ochel laerev vahare hu keforesh min hakkever shetztzarich shiva yamim veachar kach yithar gezera shemma yittame ger ze lemet leshana habbaa beom arbaa asar veyitbol veyochal laerev veyomar eshtakad kach asu li yisrael keshemmalti tavalti veachalti laerev vahalo gezera zo middivrehem ufesach becharet veheach heemidu divrehem bimkom karet beom hakkarban shehu yom arbaa asar mippene sheen hagger mitchayyev bemitzot ad sheyyamul veyitbol veeno tovel ad sheyyerafe min hammila kemo shebbearnu beinyan haggerut lefichach heemidu divrehem bemakom ze shehare ze hammal yesh lo shello litbol ad sheyyavri velo yavo lide chiyyuv kelal

Mi shebba bevet happeras hare ze menappeach veholech veim lo matza etzem velo nitma shochet veochel pischo veaf al pi shehalach bevet happeras shettumat bet happeras middivrehen kemo shebbearnu behilchot teme met velo heemidu divrehem bimkom karet kemo shebbearnu vechen bet happeras shenniddosh tahor laose pesach

Haonen rauy leechol happesach laerev mippene sheaninut layela middivrehem lo heemidu divrehem bimkom karet bedavar ze ella shochatin alav vetovel veachar kach ochel kede sheyyifrosh meaninuto velo yassiach dato bamme devarim amurim shemmet lo hammet achar chatzot shekkevar nitchayyev bekarban pesach aval im met lo hammet kodem chatzot en shochatin alav ella yiddache lashsheni veim shachatu alav vezarku haddam tovel veochel laerev met lo met bishlosha asar ukvaro bearbaa asar hare hu beom kevura onen middivrehem veeno tofes lelo middivrehem lefichach shochatin alav vetovel veochel laerev af bishar hakodashim veom shemua veom likkut atzamot hare hu keom kevura lefichach mi shellikket atzmot meto beom arbaa asar o sheshshama shemmet lo met shochatin alav vetovel veochel bekadashim laerev

Mi shechofer begal levakkesh al hammet en shochatin alav shemma yimmatze sham hammet baggal vahare hu tame bishat shechita shachatu alav velo nimtza sham met hare ze ochel laerev nimtza sham met achar shennizrak haddam im noda lo bevadday shehaya tame bishat zerikat haddam kegon shehaya gal agol hare ze chayyav befesach sheni veim safek haddavar veshemma lo haya omed al hattuma beet zerika velo nitma ella achar zerika hare ze patur mippesach sheni

Mi sheavar badderech umatza met mushkav lerachbah shel derech im haya hammet tumat hattehom af al pi shehu tame litruma hare ze tahor lefesach veshochet veochel pischo veaf al pi sheefshar shennaga hoil vehi tumat hattehom tahor lefesach veaf al pi shehammet shalem vehu min hakkatze el hakkatze hare ze ose pischo ad sheyyeda bevadday shennitma bo bamme devarim amurim keshehaya mehallech beraglav shehare efshar shello yigga aval im haya rochev o taun massa hare ze tame af al pi shehi tumat hattehom lefi shei efshar shello yigga veshello yasit veshello yaahil uchvar bearnu tumat hattehom behilchot nezirut

Mi sheasa pesach bechezkat shehu tahor veachar kach noda lo shehaya tame betumat hattehom eno chayyav befesach sheni vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala aval im noda lo shehaya tame betuma yedua chayyav befesach sheni

Mi shennitma bemet vehuzza alav shelishi ushvii uvashshevii shello nitma bekever hattehom velo yada veasa pesach bechezkat shehu tahor veachar kach noda lo shehu tame betumat hattehom eno chayyav befesach sheni shekkevan shettaval bashshevii paska tuma harishona aval im nitma betumat hattehom bashshishshi letumato velo yada ad sheasa happesach hare ze chayyav befesach sheni shechezkat hattame tame ad sheyyihye tahor vadday sheraglayim laddavar
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 7: Ravim shehau temee met befesach rishon im hau miut hakkahal hare ellu nidchin lefesach sheni kishar hattemeim aval im hau rov hakkahal temee met o shehau hakkohanim o kele sharet temeim tumat met enan nidchin ella yakrivu kullan happesach betuma hattemeim im tehorim shenneemar vayehi anashim asher hau temeim lenefesh adam yechidim nidchim veen hatztzibbur nidche vedavar ze betumat hammet bilvad kemo shebbearnu beviat hammikdash

Hau hakkahal mechetza tehorim umechetza temee met kullan osin barishon vehattehorim osin leatzman betahora vehattemeim osin leatzman betuma veochlin oto betuma veim hau temee hammet odfin al hattehorim afillu echad yaasu kullan betuma

Hau haanashim mechetza temee met umechetza tehorim uvizman sheatta mone hannashim bichlal haanashim yihu harov tehorim hattehorim osim et harishon vehattemein enan osin lo et harishon velo et hashsheni en osin rishon mippene shehen miut veen osin et hashsheni mippene shehannashim bashsheni reshut venimtzeu hattemeim mechetza veen mechetza osin et hashsheni

Hau rov hakkahal zavim umtzoraim uvoale niddot umiutan temee met otan temee met enan osin barishon lefi shehen miut veen osin hashsheni sheen hayechidim osin et hashsheni ella bizman sheasu rov hakkahal et harishon vechan hoil velo asa rov hakkahal barishon lo yaasu ellu hammiut hattemeim lemet et hashsheni

Hau rov hakkahal temee met umiutan zavim vechayyotze bahen temee met osin et harishon vehazzavin vechayyotze bahen enan osin lo et harishon velo et hashsheni enan osin barishon sheen nidchet betzibbur ella tumat hammet bilvad veenan osin bashsheni sheen osin pesach sheni ella im ba harishon betahora aval im naasa rishon betuma en sham pesach sheni

Hau shelish hakkahal tehorim ushlish zavim vechayyotze bahem ushlish temee met otan temee met en osin et harishon velo et hashsheni enan osin rishon shehare hen muatim legabbe tehorim im hazzavim uvashsheni lo yaasu shehare miut asu barishon kemo shebbearnu ketzad meshaarim happesach leda im rov hakkahal temeim o tehorim en meshaarin bechal haochlin sheefshar sheyyihu esrim nimnin al pesach echad umshallechin oto beyad echad lishchot alehen ella meshaarin bechal hannichnasim laazara vead shehen mibbachutz kodem shettikkanes kat harishona meshaarin otan
Yachid shennitma bisfek reshut hayyachid kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo hare ze yiddache lefesach sheni kishar temee met vetzibbur shennitma bisfek reshut hayyachid yaasu kullan betuma

Pesach shehikrivuhu betuma hare ze neechal betuma shemmittechillato lo ba ella laachila veeno neechal lechal tame ella litmee met shennidchet lahem hattuma hazzot ulchayyotze bahen mittemee magga tumot aval hattemeim shehattuma yotza alehen miggufan kegon zavim vezavot niddot veoldot umtzoraim lo yochlu mimmennu veim achlu peturin mippi hashshemua lamdu shehanneechal lithorin chayyavin alav mishshum tuma vehanneechal litmein en chayyavin alav mishshum tuma afillu achlu temee hammet mehaemurim shello peturin bamme devarim amurim shehappesach yeachel betuma keshennitmeu hatztzibbur kodem zerikat haddam aval im nitmeu leachar zerikat haddam lo yeachel

Shechatuhu betahora venitmeu rov hatztzibbur kodem zerika zorek et haddam vehappesach lo yeachel gezera shemma yittamu achar zerika beshana acheret veyochluhu betuma hau kele sharet temeim besheretz vechayyotze bo hoil veenan metammein et haadam kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo af al pi shemmetammein et habbasar lo yaasuhu ella hattehorim veyeachel af al pi shehu tame mutav sheyyeachel betumat basar shehi belav velo yochluhu temee hagguf shehem becharet kemo shebbearnu bifsule hammukdashin
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 8: Achilat besar happesach belel chamishsha asar mitzvat ase shenneemar veachlu et habbasar ballayela hazze tzeli esh umatztzot al merorim yochluhu
Veen matztza umaror meakkevin im lo matzu matztza umaror yotzin yede chovatan baachilat besar happesach levaddo aval maror belo pesach eno mitzva shenneemar al matztzot umrorim yochluhu

Mitzva min hammuvchar leechol besar happesach achilat sova lefichach im hikriv shalme chagiga bearbaa asar ochel mehen techilla veachar kach ochel besar happesach kede lisboa mimmennu veim lo achal ella kezayit yatza yede chovato vechen achilat besar pesach sheni belele chamishsha asar lechodesh iyyar mitzvat ase shenneemar bo al matztzot umrorim yochluhu

Ushnehen enan neechalin ella tzeli esh vehaochel mehen kezayit na o mevushshal belele pesachim loke shenneemar al tochlu mimmennu na uvashel mevushshal bammayim achal na umvushshal keachat eno loke ella achat lefi sheshshenehen nichlalot belav echad achal mimmennu na o mevushshal mibbeod yom eno loke shenneemar ki im tzeli esh beshaa shemmitzva leachlo tzali chayyav al achilat na umvushshal aval mibbeod yom patur
Achal mimmennu kezayit tzali mibbeod yom avar al mitzvat ase shenneemar veachlu et habbasar ballayela hazze ballayela velo bayyom velav habba mikkelal ase ase hu

Na shehizhira alav tora hu habbasar shehitchil bo maase haur venitzla meat veeno rauy laachilat adam adayin aval im achal mimmennu basar chay eno loke uvittel mitzvat ase shenneemar tzeli esh ha sheeno tzali asur tzalahu kal tzarko ad shennitcharech vaachalo patur
Mevushshal shehizhira alav tora ben shennitbashshel bemayim ben shennitbashshel bishar mashkin o beme perot shenneemar uvashel mevushshal ribba hakkol

Tzalahu veachar kach bishshelo o shebbishshelo veachar kach tzalahu o sheasahu tzeli kedera vaachalo chayyav aval muttar lasuch oto beyayin veshemen udvash uvishar mashkin ume perot chutz min hammayim umuttar letabbel habbasar achar shennitzla bemashkim uvme perot

En tzolin et happesach al gabbe kele even o kele mattachot shenneemar tzeli esh lo tzeli davar acher lefichach im haya keli menukkav kede shettishlot bo haur tzolin alav veen tzolin oto beshippud shel mattechet shehare hashshippud kullo cham vetzole mekomo

Hissik et hattannur vegaraf et kal haesh vetalahu battannur vetzalahu hare ze asur sheen ze tzeli esh chatacho vetalahu al gabbe gechalim hare ze tzeli esh tzalahu al gabbe sid o charsit o chamme teverya hare ze asur sheen ze tzeli esh ketzad tzolin oto tochavo mittoch piv ad bet nekuvato beshippud shel etz vetolehu letoch hattannur vehaesh lematto vetole keraav uvne meav betannur chutza lo velo yittenem betocho shezze kemin bishshul hu vshippud shel rimmon hau borrin litzliyyato kede shello yizrok et memav vivashshelehu
Naga habbasar becharso shel tannur yiklof et mekomo mippene shehu tzeli hacheres
Nataf meratbo al hacheres vechazar alav yittol et mekomo shekkal hammarak vehallecha shettifrosh mimmennu kesheyyitztzale asura shehare enah besar tzali
Nataf meratbo al hassolet yiklof et mekomo veyashlichennu

Sacho beshemen shel teruma im chavurat hakkohanim yochlu veim shel yisrael im chay hu yedichennu vinaggev veim tzali yiklof et hachitzon sacho beshemen shel maaser sheni lo yaasennu damim al bene chavura sheen podin maaser sheni birushalayim kemo shebbearnu bimkomo veen tzolin shene pesachim keachat mippene hattaarovot afillu gedi vetale

Kevar bearonu bechamma mekomot sheen happesach neechal ella ad chatzot kede leharchik min haavera vedin tora sheyyochal kal hallayela ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar uchvar bearnu behilchot chametz umatztza shehu taun hallel bishat achilato vesheen bene chavura chozrin veochlin achar shinnirdemu beshena afillu bitchillat hallayela
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 9: Kal haochel min happesach eno ochel ella bachavura achat veen motziin mimmennu min hachavura sheyyochal bah vehammotzi mimmennu kezayit basar mechavura lachavura belel chamishsha asar loke shenneemar lo totzi min habbayit min habbasar chutza vehu sheyyannichenu bachutz shehotzaa ketuva bo keshabbat lefichach tzarich akira vehannacha kehotzaat shabbat veen motzi achar motzi befesach shekkevan shehotzio harishon nifsal min haagaf ulfanim kilfanim min haagaf velachutz kelachutz vehaagaf atzmo shehu ovi happetach kelachutz hachallonot vaovi hakketalim kilfanim haggaggim vehaaliyyot enan bichlal habbayit

Besar happesach sheyyatza chutz lachavurato ben bezadon ben bishgaga neesar baachila vahare hu kivsar kadshe kadashim sheyyatza chutz laazara o besar kadashim kallim sheyyatza chutz lechomot yerushalayim shehakkol kitrefa velokin al achilato kemo shebbearnu bemaase hakkarbanot evar sheyyatza miktzato chotech habbasar veored ad shemmaggia laetzem vekolef et habbasar kal shebbifnim yochal vechal shebbachutz yissaref keshehu maggia laetzem chotech bekofitz im haya shear kadashim veim haya pesach sheasur lishbor bo etzem kolef ad happerek umfarek haevar sheyyatza miktzato min happerek umashlicho lachutz

Shette chavurot shehau ochlot bevayit echad tzericha kal chavura mehen laasot lah hekkef shenneemar min habbasar chutza mippi hashshemua lamdu shetztzarich litten lo chutza limkom achilato veellu hofchin et penehen elach veochlin veellu hofchin et penehen elach veochlin kede shello yerau meoravim

Hau hammayim shemmozgim bo yenam beemtza habbayit ben shette hachavurot keshehashshammash omed limzog kofetz et piv umachazir et panav ad shemmaggia etzel chavurato veachar kach ochel ma shebbefiv sheasur laochel leechol bishte chavurot umuttar lechalla lehachzir paneha mippene chavuratah veochelet mippene shehi bosha leechol bifnehem

Shette chavurot shennifretza mechitztza mibbenehen enan ochlin vechen im hayeta chavura achat venaaset mechitztza benehen enan ochlin ad shettistallek sheen happesach neechal bishte chavurot veenan neekarin mechavura lachavura

Bene chavura shennichnesu shelosha mehen o yeter leechol pischehen velo bau shear bene chavura im nichnesu beshaa shedderech bene adam leechol happesachim vechazar hamorer lechullan al hashshear velo bau hare ellu shennichnesu ochlin ad sheyyisbeu veen mamtinim lashshear vaafillu bau hammitacharin achar kach umatzu ellu hashshelosha sheachlu hakkol en meshallemim lahen kede chelkam aval im nichnesu shenayim bilvad hare ellu mamtinim bamme devarim amurim bishat kenisatan leechol aval beet shenniftarin en adam tzarich lehamtin lachavero afillu gamar echad bilvad milleechol yetze veeno tzarich lehamtin

Hammaachil kezayit min happesach ben mippesach rishon ben mippesach sheni lemumar laavoda zara o leger toshav o lesachir hare ze over belo taase veeno loke aval makkin oto makkat mardut u ven nechar haamur battora ze haoved el nechar veen maachilin mimmennu lenachri afillu ger toshav o sachir shenneemar toshav vesachir lo yochal bo
Arel sheachal kezayit mibbesar happesach loke shenneemar kal arel lo yochal bo bo hu sheeno ochel aval ochel hu matztza umaror vechen muttar lehaachil matztza umaror leger toshav ulsachir

Keshem shemmilat banav vaavadav meakkavto millishchot happesach kach meakkavto milleechol shenneemar umalta oto az yochal bo ketzad kana eved achar shennishchat happesach o shehaya lo ben shello higgia zemanno lehimmol ella achar shechitat happesach hare ze asur leechol ad sheyyamul otan vechetzad yihye habben rauy lemila achar shechitat happesach velo yihye rauy kodem shechita kegon shechalatzto chamma shetztzarich shivat yamim meet leet miyyom havraato uchgon shekkaava eno venirpet achar shechita o shehaya tumtum venikra achar shechitat happesach venimtza zachar
Mishneh Torah, Paschal Offering 10: Hashover etzem befesach tahor hare ze loke shenneemar veetzem lo tishberu vo vechen neemar befesach sheni veetzem lo tishberu vo aval pesach shebba betuma im shavar bo etzem eno loke mippi hashshemua lamdu lo tishberu vo betahor velo betame echad hashshover et haetzem belele chamishsha asar o sheshshavar bo etzem mibbeod yom o sheshshavar achar kamma yamim hare ze loke
Lefichach sorfin atzmot happesach bichlal hannotar mibbesaro kede shello yavou bahen lide takkala

En chayyavin ella al shevirat etzem sheyyesh alav kezayit basar o sheyyesh bo moach aval etzem sheen bo moach vesheen alav kezayit basar eno chayyav al shevirato haya alav kezayit basar veshavar haetzem shello bimkom habbasar chayyav af al pi shehammakom sheshshavar panuy mibbesaro
Hashshover achar hashshover beetzem echad loke
Hassoref atzamot vehamchattech gidim eno chayyav mishshum shevirat etzem

Pesach shehu na o mevushshal veshavar bo et haetzem loke afillu nifsal betuma vitzia vechayyotze bahem yesh bo issur shevirat haetzem bamme devarim amurim keshehayeta lo sheat hakkosher venifsal aval im lo hayeta lo sheat hakkosher kegon shennitpaggel o naasa machashevet zeman o machashevet shinnuy hashshem en bo mishshum shevirat haetzem
Shavar etzem haalya eno loke shehare eno rauy laachila
Hassechusim shehem kemo atzamim rakkim hare ellu muttarin leachlan

Haya gedi katan verach sheatzmotav rakkim lo yochal otan shezze shover etzem veim achal loke sheechad hashshover etzem kashe o etzem rach ze hakkelal kal shenneechal beshor haggadol achar sheyyitbashshel hu shemmuttar leechol kenegdo min haggedi harach achar tzeliyyato kegon rashe kenafayim vehassechusim

Gidin harakkin shessofan lehikkashot af al pi shehen reuyin laachila atta veneechalin befesach en nimnin alehen venimnin al moach shebbarosh mippene sheyyachol lehotzio belo shevirat etzem veen nimnin al moach shebbekulit vehu haetzem hassatum mishshene rashav shehare eno yachol lehotzio ella bishvirat etzem

Kesheadam ochel et happesach chotech habbasar veochel vechotech haatzamot min happerek umfarkan im ratza uchsheyyaggia legid hannashe motzio umannicho im shear haggidim vehaatzamot vehakkerumot sheyyotzin bishat achila sheen menakkin oto kishar habbasar veen mechattechin oto ella tzolin oto shalem veim chatacho chatichot chatichot kasher vehu shello yechsar evar tzarich adam lehishtaddel shello yashir mibbesar happesach ad boker shenneemar lo totiru mimmennu ad boker vechen bashsheni shenneemar lo yashiru mimmennu ad boker veim hishir mimmennu ben barishon ben bashsheni avar belo taase veeno loke al lav ze shehare nittak laase shenneemar vehannotar mimmennu baesh tisrofu

Chagigat arbaa asar reshut veenah chova veneechelet lishne yamim velayela echad kechal zivche shelamim veasur lehanniach mibbesar chagigat arbaa asar layyom hashshelishi shenneemar velo yalin min habbasar asher tizbach baerev bayyom harishon labboker mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze azhara lemanniach besar chagigat arbaa asar leom shishsha asar shenneemar labboker ad boker shel yom hashsheni vehammotir eno loke ella yisrof hannotar mimmenna kishar hannotarim
Besar chagiga sheala im happesach al hashshulchan vechal hattavshilin haolim immo al hashshulchan mitbaarin immo veenan neechalim ella ad chatzot kappesach atzmo gezera mippene hattaarovet

Ma ben pesach rishon lefesach sheni harishon asur bechametz beval yerae uval yimmatze veeno nishchat al chametz veen motziin mimmennu chutz lachavura vetaun hallel baachilato umviin immo chagiga veefshar sheyyavo betuma im nitma rov hakkahal tumat met kemo shebbearnu aval pesach sheni chametz umatztza immo babbayit veeno taun hallel baachilato umotziin oto chutz lachavurato veen meviin immo chagiga veeno ba betuma ushnehem dochin et hashshabbat utunin hallel baasiyyatan veneechalin tzali bevayit echad al matztza umaror veen motirin mehen veen shovrin bahen et haetzem velamma lo yishve hashsheni larishon lechal haddevarim meachar shenneemar kechal chukkat happesach yaasu lefi shepperesh bo miktzat chukkat happesach lelammed sheenah shava larishon ella bidvarim shennitparshu bo vehen hammitzot shebbegufo vehem chukkat happesach shekkelal ze shenneemar bemitzrayim sheyyillakach happesach mibbeasor veshehu taun haggaat dam baagudat ezov lammashkof velishte hammezuzot vesheyyeachel bechippazon en otan haddevarim nohagim ledorot velo naasu ella befesach mitzrayim bilvad
Mishneh Torah, Substitution 1: Kal hammemir loke al kal behema uvhema sheyyamir shenneemar lo yachalifennu velo yamir oto veaf al pi shello asa maase mippi hashshemua lamdu shekkal mitzvat lo taase sheen bah maase en lokin aleha chutz minnishba umemir umkallel et chavero beshem shelosha lavin ellu i efshar sheyyihye bahen maase kelal velokin alehen velamma lokin al hattemura vahare lav shebbah nittak laase shenneemar veim hamer yemirennu vehaya hu utmurato yihye kodesh mippene sheyyesh bah ase ushne lavin veod sheen lav shebbah shave laase shehatztzibbur vehashshuttafin en osin temura im hemiru af al pi shehen muzharin shello yamiru nimtzeta omer shehayyachid shehemir hare hattemura kodesh vaafillu hemir beshabbat loke arbaim veechad min hashshuttafin shehemir o mi shehemir bekarban mikkarbenot hatztzibbur hoil veyesh lo bahen shuttafut hare ze loke veen hattemura kodesh

Echad hammemir bezadon o shehemir bishgaga hare ze ose temura veloke ketzad hammitkavin lomar hare zo temurat ola sheyyesh li veamar hare zo temurat shelamim sheyyesh li hare zo temura veloke aval im dimma shemmuttar lehamir vehemir o sheamar ekkanes levayit ze veamir middati venichnas veshachach vehemir shello middato hare zo temura veeno loke aleha

En adam memir behemto bekarban sheeno shello veim amar baal hakkarban kal harotze lehamir bivhemti yavo veyamir hare ze memir bah hemir karbano bivhema sheenah shello enah temura sheen adam makdish davar sheeno shello

Hammitkapper hu sheose temura aval lo hammakdish ketzad hikdish behema sheyyitkapper bah chavero kegon shehikdish karbenot nazir sheyyitkapper bahem peloni hannazir oto hannazir hu sheose bahen temura aval lo ze shehikdish lefi sheenan shello
Hayyoresh memir hinniach behema lishne banav umet hare zo kereva veen memirin bah shehare hem bah shuttafin vehashshuttafin en osin temura kemo shebbearnu
En kadshe nachrim osin temura min hattora aval middivre sofrim shehannachri shehemir hare zo temura hikdish hannachri behema sheyyitkapper bah yisrael vehemir bah hannachri hare zo sefek temura
Echad anashim veechad nashim im hemiru osin temura
Katan shehiggia leonat nedarim shehemir af al pi sheeno loke yesh bo safek im ose temura o eno ose temura

En hakkohanim memirin bechattat uvasham sheaf al pi shehem shellahem enan zochin bahen mechayyim sheen lahem babbasar ad sheyyizzarek haddam veen hakkohanim memirin bivchor sheaf al pi shehu zoche bo mechayyim eno zoche bo mittechilla shehare techillato bevet yisrael hu aval habbealim shehemiru bivchor kal zeman shehu bevetam osim temura vechen kohen shehemir bivchor shennolad lo lo bivchor shellakach miyyisrael hare zo temura
Elo shel kohen gadol ose temura aval paro eno ose temura af al pi shehu mishshello hoil veechav hakkohanim mitkapperin bo hare hem bo keshuttafin
Haofot vehammenachot enan osin temura shello neemar ella behema

Karbenot bedek habbayit enan osin temura shenneemar bemaaser lo yevakker ben tov lara velo yemirennu vahalo hammaaser bichlal kal hakkadashim haya velamma yatza lelammed al hakkelal ma maaser karban yachid yatzu karbenot tzibbur vechen hashshuttafin ma maaser karban mizbeach yatzu kadshe bedek habbayit ma maasar behema hukkash lemaasar dagan sheen chayyavin bo ella yisrael velo nachrim yatzu karbenot nachrim sheen osin temura kemo shebbearnu

Hammakdish baalat mum kavua enah osa temura mippene shello nitkaddesh gufah kiddush gamur veenah ella kedushshat damim aval hammakdish baalat mum over o shehikdish temima veachar kach nolad lah mum kavua hare zo osa temura

Echad hammemir tamim bevaal mum o baal mum betamim o shehemir bakar betzon o tzon bevakar o kevasim beizzim o izzim bichvasim o nekevot bizcharim o zecharim binkevot o shehemir echad bemea o mea beechad ben bevat achat ben bazo achar zo hare zo temura veloke keminyan habbehemot shehemir

En hattemura osa temura velo velad behemot hahekdesh ose temura shenneemar vehaya hu utmurato hu velo velado utmurato velo temurat temurato aval hammemir bivhema vechazar vehemir bah vechazar vehemir afillu elef kullan temura veloke al kal echad veechad kemo shebbearnu

En memirin evarim o ubbarim bishlemim velo shelemim bahen ketzad haomer raglah shel behema zo o yadah tachat ola zo o sheamar ubbar behema zo tachat ola zo enah temura vechen haomer behema zo tachat yadah o raglah shel ola zo o sheamar behema zo tachat ubbarah shel chattat zo enah temura

Hammemir bechilayim o bitrefa veotze dofen o betumtum veanderoginus en hakkedushsha chala alehen vahare ze kemi shehemir begamal o bachamor lefi sheen beminan karban ulfichach eno loke ma ben ellu levaal mum baal mum yesh beminan karban ellu en beminam karban
Harovea vehannirba hare hem kevaal mum veosin temura vechen kal kayyotze bahen
Behema shechetzyah kodesh vechetzyah chol lo osa temura velo naaset temura
Kal hachattaot sheddinan sheyyamutu enan osin temura vechal chattat sheddinah shettire ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher osa temura

Hammafrish nekeva lefischo o leolato o laashamo osa temura af al pi sheenan reuyin likkarev hoil veyardu likdushshat damim vahare hem temimim yardu likdushshat hagguf aval hammafrish sair lechattato venasi shehifrish seira lechattato vechohen gadol shehifrish para lechattato enan osin temura shekkal hamshanne bechattaot lo nitkaddesha kelal vaafillu kedushshat damim kemo shebbearnu behilchot pesule hammukdashin
Mishneh Torah, Substitution 2: Hatmura hu sheyyomar baal hakkarban al behemat chullin sheyyesh lo hare zo tachat zo o hare zo chalifat zo veen tzarich lomar im amar hare zo tachat chattat zo o tachat ola zo shehi temura vechen im amar hare zo tachat chattat sheyyesh li betoch habbayit o tachat ola sheyyesh li bemakom peloni hare zo temura vehu sheyyesh lo aval im amar al behemat chullin hare zo tachat ola o hare zo tachat chattat lo amar kelum vechen im amar hare zo mechullelet al zo enah temura

Hau lefanav shette behemot achat chullin veachat hekdesh shennafal bah mum hinniach yado al behemat chullin veamar hare zo tachat zo hare zo temura veloke hinniach yado al behemat hekdesh veamar hare zo tachat zo hare ze chillelah al behemat hachullin veen zo temura ella kefode baalat mum bezo habbehema

Hau lefanav shalosh behemot kadshe mizbeach veachat mehen baalat mum shehare hi omedet lefidon veshalosh behemot temimot chullin veamar hare ellu tachat ellu hare shettayim min hachullin tachat shettayim hattemimot temuratan temura veloke alehem shettayim vehabbehema hashshelishit hi tachat baalat mum shennitchallela aleha ulchallelah nitkaven velo lehamir bah shekkevan sheyyesh lefanav derech issur vehi hattemura vederech hetter vehu hachillul chazaka hi sheen adam manniach hahetter veose haissur ulfichach eno loke shalosh malkiyyot vechen im amar eser behemot ellu tachat eser behemot ellu veachat mehen baalat mum eno loke ella tesha malkiyyot shehabbehema haasirit lechallelah nitkaven velo lehamir bah sheaf al pi shehuchzak ze bemalkiyyot harbe hoil veyesh sham derech hetter eno manniach devar hahetter veose haissur shette behemot shel hekdesh veachat mehen baalat mum ushte behemot shel chullin veachat mehen baalat mum veamar hare ellu tachat ellu hare hattemima temurat hattemima veloke achat uvaalat hammum mechullelet al baalat hammum sheeno meniach hahetter veose haissur

Haomer hare zo temurat ola ushlamim devarav kayyamim vetimmacher veyavi bachatzi dameha temurat ola uvachatzi dameha temurat shelamim amar hare zo temurat ola utmurat shelamim im nitkaven lechach mittechilla devarav kayyamim veim lo nitkaven battechilla ella litmurat ola vechazar veamar temurat shelamim af al pi shechazar betoch kede dibbur en tofsin ella lashon rishon vahare hi temurat ola bilvad
Mishneh Torah, Substitution 3: Ketzad din hattemurot likkarev temurat haola tikkarev ola veim hayeta temuratah nekeva o baalat mum tire hannekeva ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher veyavi bedameha ola temurat hachattat tamut kemo shebbearnu bifsule hammukdashin temurat haasham tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veyippelu dameha lindava temurat hashshelamim kishlamim lechal davar teuna semicha unsachim utnufat chaze veshok temurat hattoda ketoda ella sheenah teuna lechem kemo shebbearnu behilchot pesule hammukdashin temurat happesach im hemir bah kodem chatzot yom arbaa asar en temurato kereva ella tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veyavi bedameha shelamim veim hemir bah achar chatzot hare hattemura atzmah tikkarev shelamim temurat habbechor vehammaaser enam kerevin leolam shenneemar bivchor la hu mippi hashshemua lamdu hu karev veen temurato kereva vedin hammaaser bivchor temuratan tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veteachel
Temurat habbechor lakkohanim utmurat hammaaser labbealim uchshem sheen podin bechor umaaser shennafal bahen mum kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure mizbeach kach en podim temuratan

Behema shehikdishah chetzyah ola vechetzyah shelamim temuratah kamoha vechen kal behemat hekdesh sheenah kereva mippene techillat hekdeshah hare temuratah kamoha amar chatzi behema zo temura vechetzyah ola hare zo tikkarev ola chetzyah ola vechetzyah maaser tikkarev ola chetzyah temura vechetzyah maaser hare zo safek veenah kereva

En meviin bikkurim mashkin chutz mizzetim vaanavim bilvad shenneemar peri haadama velo mashke veim hevi mashkin en mekabbelin mimmennu
Hakkerovim lirushalayim meviin teenim vaanavim lachim veharchokin meviin otan gerogarot vetzimmukin

En meviin bikkurim kodem laatzeret shenneemar vechag hakkatzir bikkure maasecha veim hevi en mekabbelin mimmennu ella yannichem sham ad shettavo atzeret veyikra alehen vechen en meviin bikkurim achar chanukka shehabbikkurim shebbikkeru achar chanukka hen chashuvin mishshana habbaa veyannichem ad achar atzeret

Happerot shel shuttafin chayyavim bevikkurim shenneemar bikkure kal asher beartzecha asher yaviu
Haggadel beatzitz af al pi shehu nakuv vehaggadel bisfina eno mevi mimmennu kal ikkar shenneemar beartzam aval mevi min haggadel baggag o bachurba

Hannotea ilan betoch sadehu vehivricho letoch sede chavero o lirshut harabbim o shehaya notea bisde chavero o birshut harabbim vehivricho betoch sadehu o shehaya ikkaro betoch sadehu vehivrich ketzato betoch sadehu vederech harabbim o derech hayyachid mafseket baemtza ben haikkar vehatztzad hammuvrach eno mevi bikkurim lo mimma shehotzi birshut zo velo min hatztzad shebbirshut haacharon shenneemar bikkure admatcha ad sheyyihu kal haggiddulin meadmatcha

Natan lo chavero reshut lehavrich betoch shello afillu leshaa hare ze mevi bikkurim veim haya hailan samuch lemetzar chavero o note lisde chavero af al pi shechayyav leharchik hare ze mevi mimmennu vekore sheal menat ken hinchil yehoshua et haaretz
Haarisin vehachachirin uvaale zeroa sheonsin et habbealim velokchin mehen artzotam befachot vehaggazlanin enan meviin bikkurim vaafillu nityaashu habbealim shenneemar bikkure admatcha
Hakkone ilan betoch sede chavero eno mevi lefi sheen lo karka shelosha yesh lo karka veaf al pi sheen lo ella ilanot bilvad hare hu kemi shekkana karka kana ilan echad vekarkao hare ze mevi

Hallokeach perot telushin velakach hakkarka hare ze mevi bikkurim shehare yesh lo karka uferoteha machar lo perot chutz min hakkarka afillu mechubbarim mocher eno mevi shehare en lo perot velokeach eno mevi shehare en lo karka chazar hammocher velakach happerot min hallokeach hare ze mevi shehare yesh lo karka uferoteha
Hammocher sadehu leakkum vechazar ulkachah mimmennu hare ze mevi mimmenna bikkurim min hattora sheenah nifkaat min hammitzva bekinyan haakkum kemo shebbearnu
Ashera shebbittelah en meviin mimmenna bikkurim shehabbikkurim kekadshe mikdash hen
Habbikkurim en lahem shiur min hattora aval middivrehem tzarich lehafrish echad mishshishshim veharotze laasot kal sadehu bikkurim osehu

Hifrish bikkurav vechazar vehosif alehen o itteran hare hattosefet kevikkurim bamme devarim amurim keshehevi meeretz yisrael aval im hevi meever hayyarden o missurya enah kevikkurim veaf al pi sheenah kevikkurim enah neechelet ella betahora veen meatterin et habbikkurim bechal makom ella mishshivat hamminim

Ketzad mafrishin habbikkurim yored adam letoch sadehu veroe teena shebbikkera eshkol anavim shebbikkeru rimmon shebbikker koshran begemi veomer hare ellu bikkurim vehem naasim bikkurim bimchubbar mishshekkara lahen shem veaf al pi sheadayin lo bashlu kal tzarkan umishsheyyiggamru veyitleshem min hakkarka eno tzarich lachazor velikrot lahem shem lo hifrishan bimchubbar velo kara lahem shem utlasham hare ze mafrisham achar shennitleshu veim nitmeu happerot kullan eno mafrish bikkurim betuma ella mafrish min hattahor al hattame lechattechilla veim en lo perot acherot lehafrish mehen yerae li sheeno mafrish betuma sheen mafrishin leibbud vechen yerae li shehabbikkurim shennitmeu eno massik bahen hattannur kitruma temea mippene shehen kekadshe mikdash

Hammafrish bikkurav venamakku o nivzezu o avdu o shennignevu o shennitmeu chayyav lehafrish acherim tachtehem shenneemar tavi bet Adonai elohecha melammed shehu chayyav beachrautan ad sheyeviem lehar habbayit
Hammafrish bikkurav lehaalotan beyado lirushalayim lo yishlachem beyad shaliach veim likketan mittechilla al menat leshallecham beyad shaliach hare ze muttar leshallecham

Habbikkurim notnin otan leanshe mishmar vehen mechallekim otan benehen kekadshe hammikdash uchvar bearnu shehen keruyin teruma ulfichach zar sheachal bikkurim bechal makom chayyav mita bide shamayim vehu sheyyochlem meachar shennichnesu lechomat yerushalayim
Hau miktzatan bifnim umiktzatan bachutz ze shebbifnim chayyavin alav mita vahare hu hekdesh lechal devarav veze shebbachutz hare hu chullin lechal devarav

Kohen sheachal bikkurim chutz lirushalayim meachar shennichnesu lefanim min hachoma loke min hattora shenneemar lo tuchal leechol bisharecha vego utrumat yadecha vehem habbikkurim kemo shebbearnu behilchot teruma vechen im achalan hakkohen birushalayim kodem hannacha baazara loke min hattora kemi sheachalan bachutz lefi shehen teunin hannacha baazara shenneemar vehinnachto lifne mizbach Adonai elohecha
Umishsheyyanichem hammeviam baazara hutteru lakkohen veaf al pi sheadayin lo hitvadda alehen sheen hakkeria meakkevet achilatan vbikkurim sheyyatzu chutz limchitztzatan vechazru muttarin baachila

Achilat bikkurim kaachilat teruma lechal devarav yeter bevikkurim shehen asurin leonen utunin havaat makom vechohen tahor sheachal bikkurim temeim loke keshem shelloke yisrael tahor sheachal maaser sheni shennitma ma sheen ken bitruma
Uminnayin shehabbikkurim asurin leonen shehare neemar bahen vesamachta bechal hattov mikkelal shehu chayyav leachlan besimcha lo baaninut vehaochlan baaninut makkin oto makkat mardut

Habbikkurim teunin keli shenneemar vesamta vattene umitzva min hammuvchar lehavi kal min umin bichli bifne atzmo veim heviam bichli echad yatza velo yeviem beirbuv ella seorim millematta vechittim al gabbehen vezetim al gabbehen utmarim al gabbehen verimmonim al gabbehen utenim lemala min hakkeli veyihye davar echad mafsik ben min vamin kegon hutzin vechelef o alin vechayyotze bahen umakkif latteenim eshkolot shel anavim mibbachutz

Heviam bichle mattachot notel hakkohen habbikkurim vechozer hakkeli livalav veim heviam bichle arava vechelef vechayyotze bahen hare habbikkurim vehassallim lakkohanim veim nitmeu habbikkurim en hassallim lakkohanim

Keshehau meviin et habbikkurim hau meviin beyadam torin uvne yona vechen hau tolin mitztzidde hassallim torin uvne yona kede leatter et habbikkurim ellu sheim hassallim hau kerevim olot veellu shebbidehen hau nittanin lakkohanim

Mitzvat ase lehitvaddot bammikdash al habbikkurim beshaa shemmeviam matchil vekore higgadti hayyom la elohecha ki vati el haaretz vego arammi oved avi ad sheyyigmor kal happarasha ad asher natatta li Adonai veen korin otah ella bilshon hakkodesh shenneemar veanita veamarta ballashon hazzot

Barishona kal mi shehaya yodea likrot kore vechal mi sheeno yodea likrot makrin oto nimneu ellu sheen yodin likrot millehavi kede shello yikkalmu hitkinu bet din sheyyihu makrin et mi shehu yodea kemi sheeno yodea

Hammevi et habbikkurim yesh lo reshut littenem leavdo ukrovo bechal hadderech ad shemmaggia lehar habbayit higgia lehar habbayit notel hassal al ketefo hu beatzmo vaafillu haya melech gadol shebbeyisrael venichnas ad shemmaggia laazara vekore veodehu hassal al ketefo higgadti hayyom la elohecha vego umorid hassal meal ketefo veochazo bisfatav vehakkohen manniach yado tachtav umenif vekore arammi oved avi vayyered mitzrayema vego ad sheggomer kal happarasha umannicho betzad hammizbeach bekeren deromit maaravit bidromah shel keren veyishtachave veyetze uminnayin shehen teunin tenufa shenneemar velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha lerabbot et habbikkurim litnufa uchshem shetteunin tenufa kach teunin karban shelamim veshir shenneemar bahen vesamachta bechal hattov uvargalim omer vesamachta bechaggecha ma simchat hechag bishlamim af kan bishlamim veen hakkarban meakkevet
Veematay korin beshir alehen mishsheyyaggiu laazara halviyyim hau matchilin vekorin aromimcha Adonai ki dillitani

Habbikkurim tiunim lina ketzad hevi bikkurav lammikdash vekara vehikriv shelamav lo yetze beoto hayyom mirushalayim lachazor limkomo ella yalin sham veyachazor lemachar leiro shenneemar ufanita vabboker vehalachta leohalecha kal ponot sheatta pone min hammikdash lichshettavo lo lo yihu ella babboker nimtzeta omer shehabbikkurim teunin shiva devarim havaat makom uchli keria vekarban veshir utnufa velina
Kal hammevi bikkurim taun karban veshir utnufa velina aval havidduy eno shave bakkol lefi sheyyesh shechayyavin lehavi bikkurim veenan korin alehem

Veellu meviin velo korin haishsha vehattumtum vehaanderoginus lefi shehen sefek ishsha veenan yecholin lomar asher natatta li Adonai vechen haappotroppin vehaeved vehashshaliach lefi sheenan yecholin lomar asher natatta li Adonai

Hakkone shene ilanot betoch sade shel chavero mevi veeno kore lefi shehaddavar safek im yesh lo karka o en lo vechetzad ose makdish otam techilla levedek habbayit mippene shehen sefek chullin veen machnisin chullin laazara vehakkohen pode otan miyyad hahekdesh veachar kach ochlan umafrish mehen teruma umaaser mippene shehen sefek chullin venoten hammaasrot shellahen lakkohanim shemma bikkurim hem vaasurin lezarim veeno mevi otan beatzmo ella meshallechan beyad shaliach kede shello teakkev otan hakkeria milleachlan shekkal sheeno rauy likria mippene hassafek hakkeria meakkevet bo

Hifrish bikkurav umachar sadehu mevi veeno kore sheeno yachol lomar asher natatta li Adonai shehare en lo vehallokeach eno chayyav lehafrish bikkurim acherim meoto hammin shekkevar hifrish mimmennu hammocher veim hifrish mevi veeno kore aval mimmin acher mafrish umevi vekore

Hammocher sadehu leferot hallokeach mevi veeno kore shekkinyan perot eno kekinyan hagguf aval mevi adam minnichse ishto bikkurim vekore af al pi sheen lo guf hakkarka shenneemar asher natan lecha Adonai elohecha ulvetecha af al pi shemmeta ishto achar shehifrish vehu badderech mevi vekore

Hammocher sadehu o shemmachar ilanot vekarkaan bizman shehayyovel noheg hare ze mevi vekore beovel rishon bilvad sheadayin lo samcha dato shel mocher shettachazor lo hakkarka aval im chazar umcharah beovel sheni hare ze mevi veeno kore shehare samcha dato sheen lo ella happerot vekinyan perot eno kekinyan hagguf

Hevi bikkurav venitmeu baazara noftzam sham veeno kore
Hevi bikkurav meechad min hamminim vekara vechazar vehevi bikkurim mimmin acher eno kore alehen shenneemar higgadti hayyom paam achat beshana hu maggid velo shettayim
Hifrish bikkurav veyavash hammayan o shenniktzatz hailan mevi veeno kore lefi shezze kemi sheen lo karka shehare avda

Hammevi bikkurim meachar chag hassukkot vead chanukka af al pi shehifrishan kodem hechag mevi veeno kore shenneemar vesamachta vechal hattov veen keria ella bishat simcha mechag hashshavuot ad sof hechag ushar hammeviin chutz meellu meviin vekorin

Habbikkurim vehatterumot vehachalla vehakkeren vehachomesh umattenot behema hem nichse kohen yesh lo liknot mehen avadim vekarkaot uvhema temea uvaal chov notlan bechovo vehaishsha bichtubbatah vekone bahen sefer tora

Af al pi shehabbikkurim vehatterumot asur leheachel lezarim veaf al pi shehabbikkurim olin beechad umea kitruma im nitarvu bechullin birushalayim asurin bechal shehen beminam kemaaser sheni mippene shehu mekom achilatan asaum kedavar sheyyesh lo mattirin veaf al pi shehabbikkurim asurim lezarim af birushalayim hare hen osrin bechal shehen afillu zara habbikkurim achar shennichnesu lirushalayim hare haggiddulin asurin veosrin bechal shehen im nitarvu birushalayim aval hazzorea bikkurim kodem sheyyikkansu lirushalayim haggiddulin chullin

Ketzad maalin et habbikkurim kal haayarot shebbammaamad mitkannesot leiro shel maamad kede shello yaalu yechidim shenneemar berav am hadrat melech uvaim velanim birchovah shel ir velo yikkansu labbattim mippene ohel hattuma uvashshachar hammunne omer kumu venaale tziyyon el Adonai elohenu vehashshor holech lifnehem vekarnav metzuppin zahav vaatara shel zayit berosho lehodia shehabbikkurim mishshivat hamminin vehechalil makke lifnehem ad shehem maggiin karov lirushalayim vehem holchin bechal hadderech vekorin samachti beomrim li bet Adonai nelech velo hau mehallechin bayyom ella shette yadot bilvad higgiu karov lirushalayim shalchu lifnehem sheluchin lehodia leanshe yerushalayim veitteru et bikkurehem ufirkesu otan veim haya lahem lach veyavesh marin et hallach millemala vehappachot vehasseganim vehaggizbarim yotzin likratan mirushalayim lefi habbaim hem yotzin im bau anashim harbe yotzin likratan rabbim veim meat meat umishsheyyikkansu kullan beshaare yerushalayim yatchilu likrot omdot hau raglenu bisharayich yerushalayim
