Mitzvat ase lehafrish teruma min haissa lakkohen shenneemar reshit arisotechem challa tarimu teruma vereshit zo en lah shiur min hattora afillu hifrish kisora patar et haissa vehaose kal issato challa lo asa kelum ad sheyeshayyer miktzato

Umiddivre sofrim shemmafrishin echad mearbaa veesrim min haissa kede sheyyihye bah kede mattana lakkohen shenneemar titten lo ten lo davar harauy litteno mattana vehannachtom haose limkor bashshuk mafrish echad mishshemona vearbaim lefi sheissato merubba yesh beshiur ze kede mattana

Haose issa lemishte beno af al pi shehu merubbe mafrish echad meesrim vearbaa shello lechallek beissat baal habbayit vehannachtom sheasa issa ketanna echad mearbaim ushmone shello lechallek beissat hannachtom
Nitmet haissa beshogeg o beones mafrish echad mearbaim ushmona veim timmeah bezadon mafrish echad michd kede shello yihye chote niskar vechalla temea mutteret lakkohen lehassaka kitruma temea

En chayyavin bechalla min hattora ella beeretz yisrael bilvad shenneemar vehaya baachalchem millechem haaretz vego uvizman shekkal yisrael sham shenneemar bevoachem biat kullechem velo biat miktzatchem lefichach challa bazzeman hazze afillu bime ezra beeretz yisrael enah ella middivrehem kemo shebbearnu bitruma

Perot chutza laaretz shennichnesu laaretz chayyavin bechalla uferot haaretz sheyyatzu chutza laaretz peturin shenneemar asher ani mevi etchem shamma shamma attem chayyavin ben al perot haaretz ben al perot chutza laaretz

Mafrishin challa bechutza laaretz middivre sofrim kede shello tishtakkach torat challa miyyisrael veen meviin challot chutza laaretz laaretz keshem sheen meviin teruma uvikkurim mishsham veim hevi mannichah ad erev happesach vetissaref kitruma

Shelosha dinin lechalla beshalosh aratzot kal haaretz shehecheziku bah ole bavel ad keziv mafrishin bah challa achat kashshiur vehi neechelet lakkohanim ushar eretz yisrael shehecheziku bah ole mitzrayim velo ole bavel shehi mikkeziv vead amana mafrishin bah shette challot haachat nisrefet vehaachat neechelet umippene ma mafrishin bah shette challot mippene shehachalla harishona temea shehare lo nitkaddesha otah haaretz bime ezra ukdushsha rishona batla mishsheggalu vehoil vehi eretz yisrael mafrishin bah challa echad mearbaim ushmona vesorfin otah umafrishin challa sheniyya venotnin otah lakkohen leachlah kede shello yomru teruma tehora nisrefet shehare nisrefa harishona af al pi shello nitmea tuma yedua lakkol vezo sheniyya en lah shiur ella kal sherotze mafrish mippene shehi middivrehem vechal haaretz meamana velachutz ben besurya ben bishar haaratzot mafrishin shette challot achat lisrefa kede shello yomru rainu teruma temea neechelet veachat laachila kede shello tishtakkach torat challa miyyisrael vehoil vezo vezo middivrehem mutav lerabbot banneechelet lefichach shel serefa en lah shiur ella kal shehu veshel achila echad mimch umutteret lezavim ulzavot veen tzarich lomar lishar temeim

Bazzeman hazze sheen sham issa tehora mippene tumat hammet mafrishin challa achat bechal eretz yisrael echad mimch vesorfin otah mippene shehi temea veyesh lah shem min hattora umikkeziv ad amana mafrishin sheniyya lakkohen laachila veen lah shiur keshehaya haddavar mikkodem

Challat chutza laaretz af al pi shehi temea hoil veikkar chiyyuvah middivrehem enah asura baachila ella al kohen shettuma yotza alav miggufo vehem baale kerayin vezavim vezavot veniddot veoldot umtzorain aval shear hattemeim bemagga shear hattumot afillu temee met muttarim leachlah lefichach im haya sham kohen katan bechutza laaretz ben besurya ben bishar aratzot veratza lehafrish challa achat mafrish echad mimch veneechelet lekatan sheadayin lo raa keri o liktanna sheadayin lo raata nidda veeno tzarich lehafrish sheniyya

Vechen im haya sham kohen gadol shettaval mishshichvat zaro o mizzivato af al pi shello heeriv shimsho veaf al pi shehu teme met hare ze muttar leechol hachalla harishona veeno tzarich lehafrish sheniyya bechutza laaretz kal hammafrish challa mevarech techilla asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu lehafrish challa ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz uchshem shemmevarech al hattehora kach mevarech al hattemea lefichach en haish erom mafrish challa sheeno yachol levarech aval haishsha haaruma sheyyashva vechal paneha tuchot bakkarka mevarechet umafreshet challa

Hannidda vechayyotze bah mevarechet umafreshet challat chutza laaretz sheenah muzheret al maggaah ella al achilatah veim haya sham kohen katan o kohen shettaval shehi mutteret lo laachila kemo shebbearnu hare ze muttar leachlah im hazzar al shulchan echad lefi sheenah medammaat vaafillu nitarva shave beshave venotnin otah lechohen am haaretz mippene shehi temea baavir eretz haammim veen bah mishshum kohen hammesayyea bemattenotav shehu asur veim ratza leechol techilla veachar kach yafrish hachalla bechutz laaretz muttar sheen ikkarah ella middivrehem
Hachalla nikret teruma lefichach enah nittelet ella min hammukkaf kitruma veenah nittelet min hattahor al hattame lechattechilla

Vechal sheamarnu bitruma lo yitrom veim taram enah teruma kach bechalla vechal sheamarnu bitruma lo yitrom mizze al ze kach bechalla vechal sheeno ochel teruma eno ochel challa vechal haochel teruma ochel challa
Hassuma vehashshikkor mafrishin challa lechattechilla sheen beissa ra veyafe kede sheyechavvenu veyafrishu min hayyafe
Halokeach min hannachtom chayyav bechalla umafrish min hachamma al hatztzonenet umin hatztzonenet al hachamma afillu middefusin harbe

En chayyavin bechalla ella chamishsha mine tevua bilvad vehem hachittin vehasseorim vehakkussemin veshibbolet shual vehashshifon shenneemar baachalchem millechem haaretz veen karuy lechem ella pat hannaaset meellu aval haose pat orez o dochan vechayyotze bahen min hakkitniyyot enan chayyavin bechalla kelal

Halleket vehashshichcha vehappea vehahefker utvua shello hevia shelish af al pi shehen peturin min hatteruma chayyavin aleha bechalla vechen maaser rishon shehikdimo bashshibbolim shennittela terumato af al pi sheyyesh bo chelek teruma gedola umaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu umotar haomer ushte hallechem velechem happanim kesheyyippadu kal otan hammotarot hakkol chayyavin bechalla
Issa shel maaser sheni birushalayim veissat sheviit usfek medumma chayyavin bechalla aval hamdumma patur min hachalla
Challot toda urkike nazir asaan leatzmo peturin min hachalla mippene shehen kodesh lemachran bashshuk linzirim ulmakrive toda chayyavin bechalla lefi shebbedato sheim lo timmacher yochlenna
Issat hashshuttafin vehaose issa lerabbim chayyevet bechalla

Haose issa min hattevel ben shehikdim challa litruma ben shehikdim teruma lechalla ma sheasa asuy veim hifrish hachalla techilla lo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha teruma utrumat maaser veim hifrish techilla teruma lo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha challa
Haose issa lehaachil happat shellah livhema o lechayya petura issat hakkelavim bizman sheharoim ochlin mimmenna chayyevet bechalla issat haakkum petura
Hau yisrael veakkum shuttafin baissa im haya bechelek yisrael shiur issa hachayyevet bechalla hare zo chayyevet bechalla

Akkum shehifrish challa afillu beeretz yisrael enah challa ella modiin oto sheeno tzarich veteachel lezar velamma lo chashashnu lah shemma issa shel yisrael hi vetala otah beyad akkum uchde lefatrah sheim yirtze yisrael yiftor atzmo veyaase yisrael issato pachot mishshiur challa

Hamarev kemach chittin vekemach orez veasa mehen issa im yesh bah taam dagan chayyevet bechalla veim lav petura afillu haya hasseor chittim letoch issat orez im yesh bah taam dagan chayyevet bechalla veim lav petura

Issa shennillosha beyayin o shemen o devash o mayim rotchim o shennatan letochah tavlin o hirtiach hammayim vehishlich hakkemach letocho velasho im afaah ben betannur ben bekarka ben al hammachavat vehammarcheshet ben shehidbik et habbatzek bemachavat uvmarcheshet veachar kach hirtichan baesh millematta ad shenneefet happat ben shehirtichah veachar kach hidbik habbatzek kal ellu chayyavin bechalla aval haose issa leyabbeshah bachamma bilvad o levashshelah bikdera hare hi petura min hachalla sheen maase chamma lechem ben shellashah bemayim ben shellashah bishar mashkin vechen kali shellashin oto bemayim o bidvash veochlin oto belo afiyya patur sheen chayyevet ella issa shessofah leheafot lechem lemaachal adam
Issa shellashah techilla laasotah maase chamma vehishlimah laasotah pat o shehitchil bah leefot pat vehishlimah laasot maase chamma vechen kali shellasho leefoto pat chayyavin bechalla

Nachtom sheasa issa laasotah seor lechallekah chayyevet bechalla sheim lo timmacher yaasenna pat aval haose issa lechallekah batzek petura
Nashim shennatnu kemach lenachtom laasot lahem seor im en beshel achat mehen kashshiur af al pi sheyyesh bichlalan kashshiur petura

Hammafrish challato kemach enah challa vegezel beyad kohen ushar haissa chayyevet bechalla veoto hakkemach shehifrish leshem challa im yesh bo omer veosehu issa hare ze mafrish mimmennu challa kishar kal kemach chullin

Ematay mafrishin challa kesheyyitten et hammayim veyitarev hakkemach bemayim mafrish hachalla mittechillat davar shennillosh shenneemar reshit arisotechem vehu shello yishshaer sham baareva kemach shello nitarev bammayim shiur omer veim amar hare ze challa al haissa veal hasseor veal hakkemach shennishtayyer velichshettease kullah issa achat titkaddesh zo shebbeyado leshem challa hare ze muttar
Hinniach haissa ad shellash hakkol veervah veachar kach hifrish en bechach kelum veim lo hifrish hachalla batzek ella afa hakkol hare ze mafrish min happat kemo shebbearnu

Meematay titchayyev haissa bechalla mishshettiggalgel bechittim veyitarev hakkemach bemayim o shettittamtem bisorim vetease kullah guf echad veochlin aray min haissa ad shettitgalgel bechittim vetittamtem bisorim vehakkussemin kechittim veshibbolet shual vehashshifon kisorim

Ger shennitgayyer vehayeta lo behema shechuta im nishchata ad shello nitgayyer patur veim achar shennitgayyer chayyav veim safek patur vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya

Hau shene mine gizza kegon gizza levana vegizza shechuma o gizzat zecharim vegizzat nekevot umachar min ze vehinniach hammin haacher ze noten leatzmo veze noten leatzmo ze noten leatzmo al ma shellakach veze noten leatzmo al ma sheshshiyyer
Ger shennitgayyer vehau lo gizzot veen yadua im ad shello nitgayyer nigzezu o mishshennitgayyer hare ze patur vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya

Hashshuttafin chayyavin bereshit haggez vehu sheyyihye bechelek kal echad mehen kashshiur aval chamesh tzon bilvad shel shene shuttafin peturin

Reshit haggez chullin lechal davar lefichach ani omer shennotnim oto lechohenet af al pi shehi nesua leyisrael kemattenot behema veyerae li sheddin shenehen echad hu
Mitzvat ase lifdot kal ish miyyisrael beno shehu bechor leimmo hayyisreelit shenneemar kal peter rechem li veneemar ach pado tifde et bechor haadam
Veen haishsha chayyevet lifdot et benah shehachayyav lifdot et atzmo hu shechayyav lifdot et beno avar haav velo padahu kesheyyigdal yifde et atzmo
Haya hu lifdot uvno lifdot yifde atzmo techilla veachar kach beno veim en lo ella kede pidon echad yifde atzmo
Haya beno lifdot vehiggia et laalot laregel veen lo kede laze velaze pode et beno veachar kach ole laregel shenneemar kl bechor banecha tifde veachar kach velo yerau fanay rekam

Kohanim ulviyyim peturim mippidon habben mikkal vachomer im patru shel yisrael bammidbar din hu sheyyifteru atzman
Yisrael habba min hakkohenet umin halleviyya patur sheen haddavar taluy baav ella baem shenneemar peter rechem beyisrael
Leviyya hamubberet meakkum benah patur vechohenet hamubberet meakkum benah chayyav shehare nifsela immo min hakkehunna bivilat haakkum

Kohen shennolad lo ben chalal met haav betoch sheloshim yom habben chayyav lifdot et atzmo shello zacha haav befidono met achar sheloshim yom eno chayyav habben lifdot et atzmo shehare zacha haav befidono

Chatach haubbar bemeeha vehotzio evar evar habba acharav eno peter rechem ben shemona chodashim shehotzi rosho vehu chay vehecheziro vamet vechen ben tisha shemmet veyatza rosho vehecheziro veachar kach yatza achiv veyalda ze sheyyalda eno peter rechem shehare niftar berosho shel rishon umishshettetze paddachto poter habba acharav
Yotze dofen vehabba acharav kedarko shenehem peturim harishon lefi shello yatza min harechem vehashsheni mippene shekkedamo acher

Meematay yitchayyev befidon mishsheyyashlim sheloshim yom shenneemar ufduyav mibben chodesh tifde met habben betoch sheloshim vaafillu beom sheloshim vechen im naasa terefa eno chayyav bachamishsha selaim veim hikdim venatan lakkohen yachzir lo happidon veim met achar sheloshim yom chayyav befidon veim lo natan yitten
Mi sheppada beno betoch sheloshim yom im amar lo meachshav en beno paduy veim amar lo leachar sheloshim yom beno paduy veaf al pi sheen hammaot kayyamin leachar sheloshim yom

Mi shehu safek im chayyav befidon o lo hare ze patur shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya met haav betoch sheloshim yom hare habben bechezkat shello nifda ad sheyyavi reaya meaviv sheppadahu kodem sheyyamut met haav leachar sheloshim yom hare hu bechezkat paduy ad sheyyodiuhu shello nifda

Mi shello bikkera ishto veyalda zachar unkeva veen yadua e ze mehen yatza rishon en kan lakkohen kelum yalda shene zecharim af al pi sheen yadua e ze mehen habbechor noten chamishsha selaim lakkohen met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom patur shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya met haav ben betoch sheloshim yom ben achar sheloshim yom ben shello chalku haachim ben shechalku yinnaten min hannechasim chamishsha selaim lakkohen shekkevar nitchayevu hannechasim

Shette nashav shello bikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim noten asara selaim lakkohen met echad mehen betoch sheloshim yom im lechohen echad natan yachzir lo chamishsha selaim veim lishne kohanim natan eno yachol lehotzi mehen shehare lo tziyyen pidon ze al ben ze vechal echad mehen yachol lomar hachazir mechaveri
Shette nashav shello bikkeru sheyyaldu zachar unkeva o shene zecharim unkeva noten chamishsha selaim lakkohen shei efshar shello yihye zachar echad mehen peter rechem
Yaldu shette nekevot vezachar o shene zecharim ushte nekevot veen yadua e ze nolad rishon en kan lakkohen kelum sheani omer nekeva nolda techilla veachareha zachar

Shette nashav achat bikkera veachat lo bikkera veyaldu shene zecharim venitarvu noten chamishsha selaim lakkohen met echad mehem betoch sheloshim yom haav patur met haav yinnaten min hannechasim chamishsha selaim
Yaldu zachar unkeva o shene zecharim unkeva en kan lakkohen kelum sheani omer zo shello bikkera yalda nekeva techilla veachareha zachar vezo shebbikkera yalda zachar

Shette nashim shel shene anashim shello bikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim venitarvu ze noten chamishsha selaim veze noten chamishsha selaim natnu veachar kach met echad min habbanim betoch sheloshim yom im lishne kohanim natnu enan yecholin lehotzi miyyadan veim lechohen echad natnu kotev echad mehen lachavero harshaa veyelech ze beharshaa veyachzir min hakkohen chamishsha selaim

Yaldu zachar unkeva venitarvu haavot peturin vehabben chayyav lifdot et atzmo vechen mevakkeret shello shahata achar balah shelosha chodashim veyalda veen yadua im ben tisha larishon o ben shiva laacharon shenehen peturin vehabben chayyav lifdot et atzmo
Yaldu shette nekevot vezachar o shette nekevot ushne zecharim en kan lakkohen kelum
Shette nashim shel shene anashim achat bikkera veachat lo bikkera veyaldu shene zecharim ze shello bikkera ishto noten chamesh selaim lakkohen yaldu zachar unkeva en kan lakkohen kelum

Yaldu shene zecharim unkeva ze shello bikkera ishto noten chamishsha selaim shello niftar ella bishne sefekot im ishto yalda zachar bilvad chayyav veim hi yalda hazzachar vehannekeva chayyav ella im ken yalda nekeva techilla vehoil vehaddavar rachok yitten pidono

Mitzvat ase lifdot kal dam miyyisrael peter chamor bese veim lo ratza lifdoto mitzvat ase learfo shenneemar ufeter chamor tifde vese veim lo tifde vaarafto ushte mitzot ellu nohagot bechal makom uvchal zeman umitzvat pediyya kodemet lemitzvat arifa
Hasse sheppodin bo notno lakkohen shenneemar kal peter rechem vego
Veet bechor habbehema hattemea tifde behema temea haamura kan hi hachamor bilvad

Peter chamor asur bahanaa ad sheyyippade veim mecharo kodem pidon damav asurim veim met kodem pidon o shearafo yikkaver mippene shehu asur bahanaa af leachar arifa hoil velo nifda lefichach im lo padahu venatan peter hachamor beatzmo lakkohen asur lakkohen lehishtammesh bo ad sheyyifdehu bese veyikkach hasse leatzmo o yaarfennu veyikkaver vehakkohanim chashudim al davar ze lefichach asur leyisrael litten peter chamor lakkohen ella im ken padahu hakkohen befanav

Hifrish pidon peter chamor umet hasse kodem sheyyittenennu lakkohen eno chayyav beacharauto veyitten hannevela lakkohen lehanot bah met peter hachamor achar sheppadahu yitten hattale lakkohen umuttar behanayato shekkevar nifda
Meematay chayyav lifdoto mishsheyyivaled vead sheloshim yom umeachar sheloshim yom im ratza learfo orfo im ratza lifdoto pode veen kan ella mitzvat ikkuv bilvad

Lo ratza lifdoto orfo bekofitz meachorav shenneemar veim lo tifde vaarafto veen memitin oto lo bemakkel velo bekane velo bekordom velo bimgera ella bekofitz velo yachnisennu lecheder veyinol haddelet befanav ad sheyyamut shenneemar vaarafto
En podin lo beegel velo bechayya velo bese shachut velo bitrefa velo bechilayim velo bichvi shenneemar tifde bese veen karuy se ella kevasim veizzim chayyim bilvad

En podin bese haddome lemin leacher veim pada paduy ufodin beven pekua aval lo bifsule hammukdashin shehare neemar bahen katztzevi vechaayyal ma tzevi veayyal en podin bo af pesule hammukdashin en podin bahem
Podin bese ben zecharim ben nekevot ben temimim ben baale mumim ben ketannim ben gedolim

Se shellekacho middeme sheviit en podin bo et havadday aval podin bo et hassafek im en lo se lifdoto podehu beshaveo venoten damav lakkohen lo amra tora se lehachmir alav ella lehakel alav sheim haya lo peter chamor sheshshave eser selaim yesh lo lifdoto bese sheve dinar velo yihye ze chamur min hahekdesh shennifde bechesef beshaveo

Bamme devarim amurim keshehau deme peter chamor mishshelosha zuzim ulmala aval im hau damav pachot mishlosha zuzim en podin oto ella bese o bishlosha zuzim veayin yafa lo yifchot missela veayin raa bachatzi sela uvenonit bishlosha zuzim
Vhappode peter chamor shel chavero hare ze paduy vehachamor livalav

Ger shennitgayyer veen yadua im ad shello nitgayyer yalda chamoro o achar shennitgayyer hare ze chayyav laarof o lifdot veim pada bese hasse shel ger shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Akkum shehifrish peter chamor modiin oto sheeno chayyav vahare hu muttar begizza vaavoda

Para sheyyalda kemin chamor o chamor sheyyalda kemin sus patur shenneemar ufeter chamor tifde vese ufeter chamor shette peamim ad sheyyihye hayyoled chamor vehannolad chamor veim yesh bo miktzat simane chamor chayyav bivchora

Shette chamorav shello bikkeru veyaldu shene zecharim noten shene telaim lakkohen zachar unkeva o shene zecharim unkeva noten tale echad lakkohen

Yaldu shette nekevot vezachar o shene zecharim ushte nekevot en kan lakkohen kelum veeno tzarich lehafrish tale leatzmo lefi sheyyesh kan sefekot harbe shemma haachat yalda zachar vehashsheniyya yalda shette nekevot o shemma zo yalda nekeva vehaacheret zachar veacharav nekeva o nekeva veachareha zachar vechen sefekot harbe yesh bishne zecharim ushte nekevot achat bikkera veachat shello bikkera veyaldu shene zecharim venitarvu noten tale echad lakkohen zachar unkeva mafrish tale echad leatzmo veeno notno lakkohen mippene shehu safek vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya
Vechen hallokeach chamor min haakkum veen yadua im bikkera o lo bikkera veyalda zachar pode oto bese vehu labbealim mippene shehu safek
Mi shehau lo asara telaim kal echad mehen hifrisho al sefek peter chamor hare hen kechullin lechal davar umitasserin kishar habbehema umafresh echad mehen maaser vehashshear shello keshehau

Yisrael shehau lo asara pitre chamorim vaddain betoch beto shennaflu lo mibbet avi immo kohen veoto avi immo hakkohen naflo lo mibbet avi immo yisrael hare ze mafrish alehen asara seyin vehen shello vechayyavin bemaaser seliku lehu hilchot bikkurim besiyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Gifts to the Poor 1: Hakkotzer et sadehu lo yiktzor et kal hassade kullah ella yanniach meat kama laaniyyim besof hassade shenneemar lo techalle peat sadcha bekutzrecha echad hakkotzer veechad hattolesh veze shemmanniach hu hannikra pea

Uchshem shemmanniach bassade kach bailanot kesheosef et perotehen manniach meat laaniyyim avar vekatzar et kal hassade o asaf kal perot hailan lokeach meat mimma shekkatzar o mimma sheasaf venotno laaniyyim shennetinato mitzvat ase shenneemar leani velagger taazov otam vaafillu tachan hakkama velasho vaafao pat hare ze noten mimmennu pea laaniyyim
Avad kal hakkatzir shekkatzar o nisraf kodem shennatan happea hare ze loke shehare avar al mitzvat lo taase veeno yachol lekayyem ase shebbah shennittak lo

Vechen beleket keshekkotzer umallem lo yelakket hashshibbolim hannoflot bishat hakkatzir ella yannichem laaniyyim shenneemar veleket ketzircha lo telakket avar ulkatan afillu tachan veafa noten laaniyyim shenneemar leani velagger taazov otam avdu o nisrefu achar shellekatan kodem shennatan laaniyyim loke

Vechen beferet shennifrat min haanavim bishat habbetzira vechen beolelot shenneemar vecharmecha lo teolel uferet karmecha lo telakket leani velagger taazov otam vechen hamammer veshachach alumma achat bassade hare ze lo yikkachenna shenneemar veshachachta omer bassade lo tashuv lekachto avar ulkato afillu techano vaafao hare ze notno laaniyyim shenneemar lagger layyatom velaalmana yihye zo mitzvat ase ha lamadta shekkullan mitzot lo taase hannittak laase hen veim lo kiyyem ase shebbahen loke

Keshem shehashshichcha baomarim kach hi bakkama im shachach miktzat hakkama velo ketzarah hare zo laaniyyim uchshem shehashshichcha battevua vechayyotze bah kach yesh shichcha lailanot kullan shenneemar ki tachbot zetcha lo tefaer acharecha vehu haddin lishar hailanot
Nimtzeta lamed shearba mattanot laaniyyim bakkerem happeret vehaolelot vehappea vehashshichcha veshalosh mattanot battevua halleket vehashshichcha vehappea ushtayim bailanot hashshichcha vehappea
Kal mattenot aniyyim ellu en bahen tovat hanaya labbealim ella haaniyyim bain venotlin otan al karchan shel bealim vaafillu ani shebbeyisrael motziin otan miyyado

Kal ger haamur bemattenot aniyyim eno ella ger tzedek shehare hu omer bemaaser sheni uva hallevi vehagger ma hallevi ben berit af hagger ben berit veaf al pi chen en monin aniyye akkum mimmattanot ellu ella bain bichlal aniyye yisrael venotlin otan mippene darche shalom

Neemar bemattenot aniyyim leani velagger taazov otam kal zeman shehaaniyyim tovin otan pasku haaniyyim levakkesh ulchazzer alehem hare hannishar mehen muttar lechal adam sheen gufo kadosh kitrumot veeno chayyav litten lahen demehen shello neemar bahen venatan laaniyyim ella taazov otam veeno metzuve laazov otan lachayya velaofot ella laaniyyim vahare en aniyyim

Meematay muttarin kal adam beleket mishsheyyikkansu hamlakketim sheniyyim veyilketu achar melakketim harishonim veyetzu meematay muttarin kal adam beferet uvolelot mishshehalchu haaniyyim bakkerem veyavou hannishar achare chen muttar lechal adam meematay muttarin kal adam beshichcha shel zetim beeretz yisrael im shachach otah berosh hazzayit hare ze muttar bah merosh chodesh kislev shehu zeman revia sheniyya beshana afila aval tzibbure zetim sheshshechachan tachat hailan hare ze muttar bahen mishsheyyifseku haaniyyim millechazzer achareha

Kal zeman sheyyesh leani littol shichchat hazzetim hammunnachot baaretz tachat hailanot notel veaf al pi shekkevar huttar kal adam bashshichcha shebberosh hailan vechal zeman sheyyesh lo littol shichcha shebberosh hailan notel veaf al pi sheadayin en lo shichcha tachtav
Mattenot aniyyim shebbassade sheen haaniyyim makpidim alehen hare hen shel baal hassade veaf al pi sheadayin lo pasku haaniyyim millachazor al mattenotehem

Kal mattenot haaniyyim haellu enan nohagot min hattora ella beeretz yisrael kitrumot umaasrot hare hakkatuv omer uvkutzrechem et ketzir artzechem ki tiktzor ketzircha vesadecha uchvar nitparesh baggemara shehappea noheget bechutza laaretz middivrehem veyerae li shehu haddin lishar mattenot aniyyim ellu shekkullan nohagot bechutza laaretz middivrehem

Kamma hu shiur happea min hattora en lah shiur afillu hinniach shibbolet achat yatza yede chovato aval middivrehem en pachot meechad mishshishshim ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz umosif al haechad mishshishshim lefi godel hassade ulfi rov haaniyyim ulfi birkat hazzera ketzad sade shehi ketanna beoter sheim hinniach mimmenna echad mishshishshim eno moil leani hare ze mosif al hashshiur vechen im hau haaniyyim merubbin mosif veim zara meat veasaf harbe shehare nitbarech mosif lefi habberacha vechal hammosif al happea mosifin lo sachar veen letosefet zot shiur
Mishneh Torah, Gifts to the Poor 2: Kal ochel sheggiddulav min haaretz venishmar ulkitato kullo keachat umachnisin oto lekiyyum chayyav befea shenneemar uvkutzrechem et ketzir artzechem

Kal haddome lakkatzir bechamesh derachim ellu hu shechayyav befea kegon hattevua vehakkitniyyot vehecharuvin vehaegozin vehashshekedim veharimmonim vehaanavim vehazzetim vehattemarim ben yeveshim ben rakkim vechal kayyotze beellu aval istis ufua vechayyotze bahen peturin mippene sheenan ochel vechen kemehin ufitriyyot peturin mippene sheen giddulehen min haaretz kishar perot haaretz vechen hahefker patur sheen lo mi sheyyishmerennu shehare hu mufkar lakkol vechen hatteenim peturin mippene sheen lekitatan keachat ella yesh beilan ze ma sheyyiggamer hayyom veyesh bo ma sheyyiggamer leachar kamma yamim vechen yarak patur sheen machnisin oto lekiyyum hashshumim vehabbetzalim chayyavin befea shehare meyabbeshin otan umachnisin otan lekiyyum vechen haamahot shel betzalim shemmannichin otan baaretz likkach mehen hazzera chayyavot befea vechen kal kayyotze bahen

Mishneh Torah, Gifts to the Poor 6: Mattanna acheret shishshit yesh laaniyyim bezera haaretz vehu hammaaser shennotnin laaniyyim vehu hannikra maasar ani

Vezehu seder terumot umaasrot achar shekkotzer zera haaretz o osef peri haetz vetiggamer melachto mafrish mimmennu echad min hachamishshim vezehu hannikra teruma gedola venotnah lakkohen veal ze neemar battora reshit degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha veachar kach mafrish min hashshear echad measara vezehu hannikra maaser rishon venotno lallevi veal ze neemar battora ki et masar bene yisrael vego veneemar velivne levi hinne natatti et kal maaser beyisrael

Maaser rishon shellakach hallevi mafrish mimmennu echad measara venotno lakkohen vehu hannikra terumat maaser vealav neemar veel halviyyim tedabber
Baal hassade sheavru alav aniyyim vehaya lo sham maasar ani noten lechal ani sheyyaavor alav min hammaaser kede savo shenneemar veachlu visharecha vesaveu

Kede savo kamma im min hachittim noten lo yifchot mechatzi kav veim min hasseorim lo yifchot mikkav veim min hakkussemin lo yifchot mikkav umin haggerogarot lo yifchot mikkav veim min haddevela lo yifchot mimmishkal chamesh veesrim sela veim min hayyayin lo yifchot mechatzi log veim min hashshemen lo yifchot merviit veim min haorez rova hakkav natan lo yarak noten lo mishkal litra vehu mishkal chamishsha ushloshim dinar min hecharuvin shelosha kabbin min haegozim asara min haafarsekin chamishsha min harimmonim shenayim etrog echad veim natan lo mishshear happerot lo yifchot mikkede sheyyimkerem veyikkach bidmehen mezon shette seuddot
Haya lo davar muat vehaaniyyim merubbin veen bo kede litten lechal echad veechad kashshiur noten lifnehem vehen mechallekin benehem

Haya lo maaser baggoren veratza litteno leani kerovo o meyuddao yesh lehafrish mechetza litteno lo vehachetzi mechalleko lechal ani sheyyaavor kashshiur sheamarnu

Bamme devarim amurim sheeno noten leani ella kede savo bassade aval im haya hammaaser babbayit mechalleko lechal haaniyyim afillu kezayit kezayit sheeno metzuve litten kede savo ella bassade shehare eno motze sham likkach shenneemar veachlu visharecha vesaveu
Bau ish veishsha labbayit notnin laishsha techilla ufotrin otah veachar kach notnin laish av uvno ish ukrovo shene achin shene shuttafin shehaya echad mehen ani noten lo haacher maasar ani shello
Shette aniyyim shekkibbelu sade baarisut ze mafrish maasar ani mechelko venotno lachavero vechen chavero mafrish mechelko venoten lo

Hamkabbel sade liktzor asur beleket shichcha ufea umaasar ani ematay bizman shekkibbelah mimmennu likkach chelek bechal hassade kegon shennatan lo shelishah o reviah bischaro aval im amar lo baal hassade shelish ma sheatta kotzer bilvad hu shellecha o revia ma shettiktzor hare ze en lo kelum ad sheyyiktzor uvishat hakkatzir hu ani lefichach muttar beleket shichcha ufea veasur bemaasar ani sheen mafrishin maasar ani ella achar shekkatzar vahare zacha bechelko shekkatzar

Mishneh Torah, Gifts to the Poor 7: Mitzvat ase litten tzedaka laaniyyim kefi ma sherauy leani im hayeta yad hannoten masseget shenneemar fatoach tiftach et yadcha lo veneemar vehechezakta bo ger vetoshav vachay immach veneemar veche achicha immach
Vechal haroe ani mevakkesh veheelim enav mimmennu velo natan lo tzedaka avar belo taase shenneemar lo teammetz et levavcha velo tikpotz et yadcha meachicha haevon

Mishneh Torah, Gifts to the Poor 8: Hatzdaka hare hi bichlal hannedarim lefichach haomer hare alay sela litzdaka o hare sela zo tzedaka chayyav littenah laaniyyim miyyad veim icher avar be val teacher shehare beyado litten miyyad vaaniyyim metzuyin hen en sham aniyyim mafrish umanniach ad sheyyimtza aniyyim veim hitna shello yitten ad sheyyimtza ani eno tzarich lehafrish vechen im hitna beshaa shennadar bitzdaka o hitnaddev oto sheyyihu haggabbain rashshain leshannotah ultzarfah bezahav hare ellu muttarin

Bamme devarim amurim beshehaya hammitnaddev yisrael aval im haya akkum asur leshannotah afillu lidvar mitzva ad sheyyishtakkea shem bealeha mealeha shemma yomar haakkum hikdashti davar levet hakkeneset shel yehudim umcharuhu leatzman

Mi shemmachar atzmo uvanav leakkum o shellava mehen veshavu otan o asaruhu behalvaatan paam rishona ushniyya mitzva lifdotan shelishit en podin otan aval podin et habbanim leachar mitat avihen veim bikkeshuhu lehargo podin oto miyyadam afillu achar kamma peamim

Mishneh Torah, Gifts to the Poor 9: Kal ir sheyyesh bah yisrael chayyavin lehaamid mehem gabbae tzedaka anashim yeduim veneemanim sheyyihu machzirin al haam meerev shabbat leerev shabbat velokchin mikkal echad veechad ma shehu rauy litten vedavar hakkatzuv alav vehen mechallekin hammaot meerev shabbat leerev shabbat venotnin lechal ani veani mezonot hammaspikin leshiva yamim vezo hi hannikret kuppa

Rashshain bene hair laasot kuppa tamchuy vetamchuy kuppa ulshannotan lechal ma sheyyirtzu mitztzarche tzibbur veaf al pi shello hitnu ken beshaa sheggavu veim haya bammedina chacham gadol shehakkol govin al dato vehu yechallek laaniyyim kefi ma sheyyire hare ze rashshay leshannotan lechal ma sheyyerae lo mitztzarche tzibbur
Gabbae tzedaka en rashshain lifrosh ze mizze bashshuk ella kede sheyyihye ze poresh lashshaar veze poresh lachanut vegovin
Matza haggabbay maot bashshuk lo yittenem letoch kiso ella letoch arneki shel tzedaka uchsheyyaggia leveto yitlem

Haya haggabbay noshe bachavero mane ufrao bashshuk lo yittenem letoch kiso ella letoch arneki shel tzedaka uchsheyyaggia leveto yitlem velo yimne maot hakkuppa shenayim shenayim ella echad echad mippene hachashad shenneemar vihyitem nekiyyim me umiyyisrael

Gabbae tzedaka sheen lahem aniyyim lechallek metzarfin hammaot dinarin laacherim aval lo leatzman gabbae tamchuy sheen lahem aniyyim lechallek mochrim laacherim veen mochrim leatzmam veen mechashshevim bitzdaka im gabbae tzedaka velo bahekdesh im haggizbarin shenneemar ach lo yechashev ittam hakkesef hannittan al yadam ki beemuna hem osim

Mi sheyyashav bammedina sheloshim yom kofin oto litten tzedaka lakkuppa im bene hammedina yashav sham shelosha chodashim kofin oto litten hattamchuy yashav sham shishsha chodashim kofin oto litten tzedaka bichsut shemmechassim bah aniyye hair yashav sham tisha chodashim kofin oto litten tzedaka likvura shekkovrin bah et haaniyyim veosin lahem kal tzarche kevura

Mi sheyyesh lo mezon shette seuddot asur lo littol min hattamchuy hau lo mezon arba esre seuddot lo yittol min hakkuppa hau lo matayim zuz af al pi sheeno nose venoten bahem o sheyyesh lo chamishshim zuz venose venoten bahem hare ze lo yittol leket shichcha ufea umaaser ani hau lo matayim chaser dinar afillu elef notnin lo keechad hare ze muttar likkach hau beyado maot vahare hen alav chov o shehau memushkanim lichtubbat ishto hare ze muttar likkach

Ani shetztzarich veyesh lo chatzer uchle bayit afillu hau lo kele kesef uchle zahav en mechayevin oto limkor et beto veet kele tashmisho ella muttar likkach umitzva litten lo bamme devarim amurim bichle achila ushtiyya umalbush umatztzaot vechayyotze bahen aval im hau kele kesef uchle zahav kegon migredet o eli vechayyotze bahen mochran velokeach pachot mehen bamme devarim amurim kodem sheyyaggia ligbot min haam aval achar sheggava hatztzedaka mechayevim oto limkor kelav velikkach acherim pechutin mehem veachar kach yittol

Baal habbayit shehaya mehallech lair vetammu lo hammaot badderech veen lo atta ma yochal hare ze muttar likkach leket shichcha ufea umaasar ani velehanot min hatztzedaka velichsheyyaggia leveto eno chayyav leshallem shehare ani haya beotah shaa ha lema ze dome leani sheheeshir sheeno chayyav leshallem

Mi shehau lo battim sadot uchramim veim mochran bime haggeshamim mochran bezol veim hinnichan ad yemot hachamma mochran beshoyehen en mechayevin oto limkor ella maachilin oto maasar ani ad chatzi demehen velo yidchok atzmo veyimkor shello bizman mechira

Hau shear haadam lokchin beyoker vehu eno motze sheyyikkach mimmennu ella bezol mippene shehu dachuk vetarud en mechayevin oto limkor ella ochel maasar ani veholech ad sheyyimkor beshave veyedu hakkol sheeno dachuk limkor

Ani sheggavu lo kede lehashlim machasoro vehotiru al ma shehu tzarich hare hammotar shello umotar aniyyim laaniyyim umotar shevuyim lashshevuyim motar shavuy leoto shavuy motar metim lammetim motar hammet leorshav

Ani shennatan peruta lattamchuy o peruta lakkuppa mekabbelim mimmennu veim lo natan en mechayevin oto litten natnu lo begadim chadashim vehechezir lahen et hashshechakin mekabbelin mimmennu veim lo natan en mechayevin oto litten
Mishneh Torah, Gifts to the Poor 10: Chayyavin anu lehizzaher bemitzvat tzedaka yoter mikkal mitzot ase shehatztzedaka siman latztzaddik zera avraham avinu shenneemar ki yedativ lemaan asher yetzave et banav laasot tzedaka veen kisse yisrael mitkonen vedat haemet omedet ella bitzdaka shenneemar bitzdaka tikkonani veen yisrael nigalin ella bitzdaka shenneemar tziyyon bemishpat tippade veshaveha bitzdaka

Leolam en adam maani min hatztzedaka veen davar ra velo hezzek niglal bishvil hatztzedaka shenneemar vehaya maase hatztzedaka shalom kal hamrachem merachamin alav shenneemar venatan lecha rachamim verichamcha vehirbecha vechal mi shehu achzari veeno merachem yesh lachush leyachaso sheen haachzariyyut metzuya ella beakkum shenneemar achzari hemma velo yerachemu vechal yisrael vehannilve alehem keachim hem shenneemar banim attem la elohechem veim lo yerachem haach al haach mi yerachem alav ulmi aniyye yisrael nosin enehen halakkum shessonin otan verodfim acharehen ha en enehen teluot ella laachehen

Kal hammaalim enav min hatztzedaka hare ze nikra beliyyaal kemo shennikra oved akkum beliyyaal uvakkum hu omer yatzu anashim bene veliyyaal uvmaalim enav min hatztzedaka hu omer hishshamer lecha pen yihye davar im levavcha veliyyaal venikra rasha shenneemar verachame reshaim achzari venikra chote shenneemar vekara alecha el Adonai vehaya vecha chet vehakkadosh baruch hu karov leshaveat aniyyim shenneemar shaveat aniyyim atta tishma lefichach tzarich lehizzaher betzaakatam shehare berit keruta lahem shenneemar vehaya ki yitzak elay veshamati ki channun ani

Kal hannoten tzedaka leani besever panim raot ufanav kevushot bakkarka afillu natan lo elef zehuvim ibbed zechuto vehifsidah ella noten lo besever panim yafot uvsimcha umitonen immo al tzarato shenneemar im lo vachiti likshe yom agma nafshi laevon umdabber lo divre tachanunim venichumim shenneemar velev almana arnin

Shaal heani mimmecha veen beyadcha kelum litten lo payesehu bidvarim veasur ligor beani o lehagbiha kolo alav bitzaka mippene shellibbo nishbar venidke vahare hu omer lev nishbar venidke elohim lo tivze veomer lehachaot ruach shefalim ulhachaot lev nidkaim veoy lemi shehichlim et heani oy lo ella yihye lo keav ben berachamim ben bidvarim shenneemar av anochi laevonim
Hakkofe acherim litten tzedaka umasse otan secharo gadol missechar hannoten shenneemar vehaya maase hatztzedaka shalom veal gabbae tzedaka vechayyotze bahem omer umatzdike harabbim kakkochavim

Shemone maalot yesh batztzedaka zo lemala mizzo maala gedola sheen lemala mimmenna ze hammachazik beyad yisrael shemmach venoten lo mattana o halvaa o ose immo shuttafut o mamtzi lo melacha kede lechazzek et yado ad shello yitztarech labberiyyot lishl veal ze neemar vehechezakta bo ger vetoshav vachay immach kelomar hachazek bo ad shello yippol veyitztarech

Pachot mizze hannoten tzedaka laaniyyim velo yada lemi natan velo yada heani mimmi lakach shehare zo mitzva lishmah kegon lishkat chashaim shehayeta bammikdash shehau hatztzaddikim notnin bah bachashay vehaaniyyim bene tovim mitparnesin mimmenna bachashay vekarov laze hannoten letoch kuppa shel tzedaka velo yitten adam letoch kuppa shel tzedaka ella im ken yodea shehammunne neeman vechacham veodea lehanhig kashshura kerabbi chananya ben teradon

Pachot mizze sheyyeda hannoten lemi yitten velo yeda heani mimmi lakach kegon gedole hachachamim shehau holchin basseter umashlichin hammaot befitche haaniyyim vechaze rauy laasot umaala tova hi im en hammunnin bitzdaka nohagin kashshura
Pachot mizze sheyyeda heani mimmi natal velo yeda hannoten kegon gedole hachachamim shehau tzorrim hammaot bisdinehen umafshilin laachorehen uvain haaniyyim venotlin kede shello yihye lahen busha
Pachot mizze sheyyitten lo beyado kodem sheyyishal
Pachot mizze sheyyitten lo achar sheyyishal
Pachot mizze sheyyitten lo pachot min harauy besever panim yafot
Gedole hachachamim hau notnin peruta leani kodem kal tefilla veachar kach mitpallelin shenneemar ani betzedek echeze fanecha

Hannoten mezonot levanav velivnotav haggedolim sheeno chayyav bimzonotehen kede lelammed hazzecharim tora ulhanhig habbanot bederech yeshara velo yihu mevuzzot vechen hannoten mezonot leaviv ulimmo hare ze bichlal hatztzedaka utzdaka gedola hi shehakkarov kodem vechal hammaachil umashke aniyyim vitomim al shulchano hare ze kore el Adonai veyaanehu umitanneg shenneemar az tikra va yaane

Tziuu chachamim sheyyihu bene beto shel adam aniyyim vitomim bimkom haavadim mutav lo lehishtammesh beellu veyehanu bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov minnechasav velo yehanu bahem zera cham shekkal hammarbe avadim bechal yom vaom mosif chet veaon baolam veim yihu aniyyim bene beto bechal shaa veshaa mosif zechuyyot umitzot

Leolam yidchok adam atzmo veyitgalgel betzaar veal yitztarech labberiyyot veal yashlich atzmo al hatztzibbur vechen tziuu chachamim veamru ase shabbattecha chol veal titztarech labberiyyot vaafillu haya chacham umchubbad veheeni yaasok beummenut vaafillu beummenut menuvelet velo yitztarech labberiyyot mutav lifshot or behemot nevelot velo yomar laam chacham gadol ani kohen ani parnesuni uvchach tziuu chachamim gedole hachachamim hau mehem chotve etzim venose hakkorot veshoave mayim lagginnot veose habbarzel vehappechamim velo shaalu min hatztzibbur velo kibbelu mehem keshennatnu lahem

Kal mi sheeno tzarich littol umramme et haam venotel eno met min hazzikna ad sheyyitztarech labberiyyot vahare hu bichlal arur haggever asher yivtach baadam vechal mi shetztzarich littol veeno yachol lichot ella im ken notel kegon zaken o chole o baal yissurin umegis dato veeno notel hare ze shofech damim umitchayyev benafsho veen lo betzaaro ella chattaot vaashamot vechal mi shetztzarich littol vetzier vedachak et hashshaa vechaya chayye tzaar kede shello yatriach al hatztzibbur eno met min hazzikna ad sheyefarnes acherim mishshello vealav veal kal kayyotze baze neemar baruch haggever asher yivtach ba seliku lehu hilchot mattenot aniyyim besiyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 1: Hatterumot vehammaasrot enan nohagin min hattora ella beeretz yisrael ben bifne habbayit ben shello bifne habbayit unviim hitkinu sheyehu nohagot afillu beeretz shinar mippene shehi semucha leeretz yisrael verov yisrael holchin veshavin sham vehachachamim harishonim hitkinu sheyyihu nohagot af beeretz mitzrayim uveretz ammon umoav mippene shehem sevivot leeretz yisrael

Eretz yisrael haamura bechal makom hi baaratzot shekkibbeshan melech yisrael o navi middaat rov yisrael vezehu hannikra kibbush rabbim aval yachid miyyisrael o mishpacha o shevet shehalchu vechavshu leatzman makom afillu min haaretz shennittena leavraham eno nikra eretz yisrael kede sheyyinhagu bo kal hammitzot umippene ze chillek yehoshua uvet dino kal eretz yisrael lishvatim af al pi shello nichbesha kede shello yihye kibbush yachid kesheyyaale kal shevet veshevet veyichbosh chelko

Haaratzot shekkavash david chutz leeretz kenaan kegon aram naharayim vaaram tzova veachlav vechayyotze bahen af al pi shemmelech yisrael hu veal pi bet din haggadol hu ose eno keeretz yisrael lechal davar velo kechutza laaretz lechal davar kegon bavel umitzrayim ella yatzu mikkelal chutza laaretz velihotan keeretz yisrael lo higgiu umippene ma yardu mimmaalat eretz yisrael mippene shekkavash otam kodem sheyyichbosh kal eretz yisrael ella nishar bah mishshiva amamim veillu tafas kal eretz kenaan ligvuloteha veachar kach kavash aratzot acherot haya kibbusho kullo keeretz yisrael lechal davar vehaaratzot shekkavash david hen hannikrain surya
Surya yesh devarim shehi bahen keeretz yisrael veyesh devarim shehi bahen kechutza laaretz vehakkone bah karka kekone beeretz yisrael leinyan terumot umaasrot ushviit vehakkol besurya middivre sofrim

Kal shehecheziku ole mitzrayim venitkaddesh kedushsha rishona kevan sheggalu batla kedushshatan shekkedushsha rishona lefi shehayeta mippene hakkibbush bilvad kadsha lishatah velo kadsha leatid lavo kevan shealu bene haggola vehecheziku bemiktzat haaretz kiddeshuha kedushsha sheniyya haomedet leolam lishatah veleatid lavo vehinnichu otam hammekomot shehecheziku bahem ole mitzrayim velo hecheziku bahem ole bavel keshehau velo petarum min hatteruma vehammaasrot kede sheyyismechu alehem aniyyim bishviit verabbenu hakkadosh hittir bet shean meotam hammekomot shello hecheziku bahem ole bavel vehu nimna al ashkelon uftarah min hammaasrot

Nimtza kal haolam leinyan mitzot hatteluot baaretz nechleket leshalosh machalokot eretz yisrael vesurya vechutza laaretz veeretz yisrael nechleket lishnayim kal shehecheziku ole bavel chelek echad vechal shehecheziku ole mitzrayim bilvad chelek sheni vechutza laaretz nechleket lishnayim eretz mitzrayim veshinar veammon umoav hammitzot nohagot bahem middivre sofrim unviim ushar haaratzot en terumot umaasrot nohagot bahen

E zo hi eretz shehecheziku bah ole mitzrayim merekem shehu bemizrach eretz yisrael ad hayyam haggadol meashkelon shehi lidrom eretz yisrael ad akko shehi batztzafon haya mehallech meakko lichziv kal haaretz sheal yemino shehu mizrach hadderech hare hi bechezkat chutza laaretz utmea mishshum eretz haammim uftura min hammaaser umin hashsheviit ad sheyyivada lecha sheoto hammakom meeretz yisrael vechal haaretz sheal semolo shehu maarav hadderech hare hi bechezkat eretz yisrael uthora mishshum eretz haammim vechayyevet bemaaser uvishviit ad sheyyivada lecha sheoto makom chutza laaretz vechal sheshshofea veored mitture amanom velifnim eretz yisrael mitture amanom velachutz chutza laaretz vehanissim shebbayyam roin otan keillu chut matuach alehem mitture amanom vead nachal mitzrayim min hachut velifnim eretz yisrael min hachut velachutz chutza laaretz vezo hi tzuratah
Mehechan hecheziku ole bavel mikkeziv velifnim keneged hammizrach umikkeziv velachutz ad amana vehi amanom vead hannahar vehu nachal mitzrayim lo hecheziku bo uchziv atzmah lo hecheziku bah

E zo hi surya meeretz yisrael ulmatta keneged aram naharayim vaaram tzova kal yad perat ad bavel kegon dammesek veachlav vecharan umiggevat vechayyotze bahen ad shinar vetzohar hare hi kesurya aval akko chutza laaretz keashkelon vehem techume eretz yisrael

Akkum shekkana karka beeretz yisrael lo hifkiuha min hammitzot ella hare hi bikdushshatah lefichach im chazar yisrael ulkachah mimmennu enah kechibbush yachid ella mafrish terumot umaasrot umevi bikkurim vehakkol min hattora keillu lo nimkera leakkum meolam veyesh kinyan leakkum besurya lehafkia min hammaasrot umin hashsheviit kemo sheyyitbaer

Perot haakkum sheggadlu bekarka shekkana beeretz yisrael im nigmera melachtam beyad akkum umerchan haakkum peturin mikkelum shenneemar degancha velo degan akkum veim lekachan yisrael achar shennitleshu kodem shettiggamer melachtan ugmaran yisrael chayyavin bakkol min hattora umafrish teruma gedola venotnah lakkohen utrumat maaser umochrah lakkohen umaaser rishon hi shello mippene shehu omer lallevi bemaaser velakkohen bitrumat maaser ani bati mikkoach ish sheen attem yecholin littol mimmennu kelum umippene ma amru lo yitten terumat maaser lakkohen kitruma gedola lefi shenneemar bitrumat maaser ki tikchu meet bene yisrael et hammaaser tevel sheatta lokeach miyyisrael atta mafrish mimmennu terumat maaser venotnah lakkohen aval tevel sheatta lokeach min haakkum en atta noten lakkohen hatterumat maaser shehifrish mimmennu ella mochrah lakkohen velokeach dameha

Machar haakkum happerot shello leyisrael keshehen mechubbarin bakkarka im ad shello ba leonat hammaasrot venigmeru beyad yisrael chayyavin bakkol venoten hatterumot vehammaasrot labbealim veim mecharan achar shebbau leonat hammaasrot mafrish terumat maaser umaaser venoten mehen labbealim lefi cheshbon ketzad lakach tevua zerua min haakkum achar shehevia shelish venigmera beyad yisrael mafrish terumot umaasrot kemo shebbearnu venoten shene shelishe hammaaser lallevi ushne shelishe terumat maaser lakkohen umocher lo hashshelish

Yisrael shemmachar perotav leakkum kodem sheyyavou leonat hammaasrot ugmaran haakkum peturin min hatteruma umin hammaasrot veim achar shebbau leonat hammaasrot af al pi sheggemaran haakkum chayyav bakkol middivrehem vechen haakkum sheggamar perot yisrael hoil vediggunan beyad akkum enan chayyavin bitruma umaasrot ella middivrehen

Machar akkum leyisrael perot mechubbarin achar shebbau leonat hammaasrot umerchan haakkum birshut yisrael enan chayyavin bitruma umaasrot hoil uvau leonat hammaasrot birshut akkum umerchan haakkum af al pi shehen birshut yisrael

Hakkone sade besurya chayyav bitrumot umaasrot middivrehem kemo sheyyitchayyev min hattora hakkone birushalayim kemo shebbearnu aval hakkone perot min haakkum besurya ben telushin ben mechubbarim afillu kodem shebbau leonat hammaasrot af al pi shemerchan yisrael hoil veeno mikkarka shello patur
Kana karka min haakkum besurya uferot mechubbarin bah im higgiu leonat hammaasrot beyad haakkum peturin veim adayin lo higgiu leonat hammaasrot hoil vekana otam im hakkarka chayyav leasser

Yisrael shehaya aris leakkum besurya perotav peturin min hammaasrot lefi sheen lo beguf hakkarka kelum veyesh leakkum kinyan besurya lehafkia min hammaasrot kemo shebbearnu vechen hachocher vehamkabbel vehassocher sade min haakkum besurya patur min hatterumot umin hammaasrot

Yisrael shellakach besurya sade min haakkum ad shello hevia shelish vechazar umcharah leakkum meachar shehevia shelish im chazar yisrael ulkachah paam sheniyya hare ze chayyav bitrumot umaasrot shehare nitchayeva beyad yisrael
Yisrael shehaya lo karka besurya vehorid lah aris veshalach lo haaris perot hare ellu peturim sheani omer min hashshuk lekachan vehu sheyyihye oto hammin matzuy bashshuk

Shuttafut haakkum chayyevet bitrumot umaasrot ketzad yisrael veakkum shellakchu sade beshuttafut afillu chilleku sade bekamatah veen tzarich lomar im chilleku gadish hare tevel vechullin meoravin bechal kelach vekelach mechelko shel akkum af al pi shemerchan haakkum vechiyyuvam middivrehem kemo shebbearnu

Bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael shehammaasrot shel tora uvshel tora en berera aval im lakchu sade besurya hoil vehammaasrot sham middivrehem afillu chilleku haggadish chelko shel akkum patur mikkelum

Perot eretz yisrael sheyyatzu chutza laaretz peturin min hachalla umin hatterumot umin hammaasrot shenneemar asher ani mevi etchem shamma shamma attem chayyavin bechutza laaretz peturin veim yatzu lesurya chayyavin middivrehem vechen perot chutza laaretz shennichnesu laaretz chayyavin bechalla shenneemar shamma shamma attem chayyavin ben beferot haaretz ben beferot chutza laaretz veim nikbeu lemaaser beyad yisrael achar shennichnesu laaretz chayyavin bemaasrot middivrehem
Afar chutza laaretz shebba bisfina laaretz bizman shehassefina gosheshet laaretz hare hatztzomeach bo chayyav bitruma umaasrot ushviit katztzomeach beeretz yisrael atzmah

Ilan sheomed bechutza laaretz venofo note laaretz o omed baaretz venofo note lechutza laaretz hakkol holech achar haikkar hau miktzat sharashav baaretz umiktzatan chutza laaretz afillu haya tzechiach sela mavdil benehen hare tevel vechullin meoravin ze baze
Atzitz nakuv shehaya bo zera shello hishrish vehaya ikkaro baaretz venofo chutza laaretz holchim achar hannof

Hatteruma bazzeman hazze vaafillu bemakom shehecheziku ole bavel vaafillu bime ezra enah min hattora ella middivrehen sheen lecha teruma shel tora ella beeretz yisrael bilvad uvizman shekkal yisrael sham shenneemar ki tavou biat kullechem keshehau birushsha rishona uchmo shehen atidin lachazor birushsha shelishit lo keshehau birushsha sheniyya shehayeta bime ezra shehayeta biat miktzatan ulfichach lo chiyeva otan min hattora vechen yerae li shehu haddin bemaasrot sheen chayyavin bazzeman hazze ella middivrehem kitruma
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 2: Kal ochel adam hannishmar sheggiddulav min haaretz chayyav bitruma umitzvat ase lehafrish mimmennu reshit lakkohen shenneemar reshit degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha titten lo ma dagan tirosh veyitzhar maachal bene adam vegiddulav min haaretz veyesh lo bealim shenneemar degancha af kal kayyotze bahen chayyav bitrumot vechen bemaasrot

Hakkarshinin af al pi sheenam maachal adam hoil veochlin otan bishne reavon chayyavin bitruma umaasrot hassia vehaezov vehakkoranit shezzeraan mittechilla leadam chayyavin bemaaser vechen kal kayyotze bahen zeraan lemaachal behema af al pi shennimlach vechishshev alehen leadam keshehen mechubbarin peturin shemmachshevet chibbur enah kelum alu mealehen bechatzer im hi chatzer hamshammeret peroteha hare ellu chayyavin shessetaman leadam veim enah meshammeret peroteha petura

Zerone ginna sheenan neechalim kegon zera lefet vezera tzenon vezera betzalim vechayyotze bahen peturim min hatteruma umin hammaasrot mippene sheenan ochel adam aval hakketzach chayyav bitruma uvmaasrot

Temarot shel tiltan veshel chardal veshel pol hallavan veshel tzalaf vehakkafrisin shel tzalaf peturim mippene sheenan peri bamme devarim amurim beshezzeraan lezera aval zeraan leyarak hare ellu chayyavim vechen haevonot shel tzalaf chayyavim mippene shehen peri

Kusbar shezzeraah lezera yarkah patur min hatteruma umin hammaasrot zeraah leyarak mafrish terumot umaasrot min hayerakot umin hazzera vechen hashshevet shezzeraah lezera yarkah patur zeraah leyarak mitasseret zera veyarak veenah mitasseret zirin zeraah lezirin mafrish teruma umaasrot min hazzera umin hayyarak umin hazzirin vechen hashshichalayim vehaggarger shezzeraan lezera mitasserin zera veyarak ketzad mitasserin lezera ulyarak sheim likket hayyarak leachlo mafrish teruma umaasrot veachar kach yochal uchsheyyivash veyeesof hazzera shello mafrish min hazzera

Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 6: Teruma utrumat maaser neechelet lechohanim ben gedolim ben ketannim ben zecharim ben nekevot hem veavdehem hakkenaanim uvhemtan shenneemar vechohen ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo vego eved kohen shebbarach veeshet kohen shemmarda hare ellu ochlin

Teruma shel tora en ochel otah ella kohen meyuchas aval kohane chazaka ochlin bitruma shel divrehen bilvad utruma tehora ben teruma gedola ben terumat maaser ben shel tora ben shel divrehen enah nittenet ella lechohen talmid chacham mippene sheasur leechol teruma temea vechal amme haaretz bechezkat tuma lefichach notnin teruma temea lechal kohen sheyyirtze

Yisreelit shennisset lechohen afillu ketanna bat shalosh shanim veom echad tochal bitruma vechaze veshok vedin tora shettochal mishshennitarsa shehare hi kinyano aval asru chachamim shettochal ad shettikkanes lachuppa gezera shemma taachil teruma leaviha ulacheha keshehi arusa bevet aviha
Chereshet veshota shennisset lechohen enah ochelet bitruma afillu hissiah aviha gezera shemma yissa cheresh kohen chereshet veyaachilenna lefichach gazru shello tochal chereshet bat yisrael kelal

Hazzar asur leechol terumot shenneemar vechal zar lo yochal kodesh afillu haya toshav kohen o sechiro shenneemar toshav kohen vesachir lo yochal kodesh toshav ze sechir olam sachir ze sechir shanim veeved ivri hare hu ketoshav vesachir vechohenet eshet hazzar hare hi kezar shenneemar vechal zar ben hu ben ishto

Zar sheachal teruma bezadon ben shehaya tame ben shehaya tahor ben sheachal teruma tehora ben sheachal temea chayyav mita bide shamayim shenneemar umetu vo ki yechalleluhu veloke al achilatah veeno meshallem deme ma sheachal sheeno loke umshallem veim achal bishgaga mosif chomesh shenneemar veish ki yochal kodesh bishgaga veyasaf chamishito vego

Uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar hi bitrumat hakodashim lo tochel shene inyanim nichlelu belav ze sheim tibbael leasur lah vetease zona o chalala kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure bia hare hi asura leechol bitrumot leolam kedin kal chalal shehechalal kezar lechal davar veim tinnase leyisrael hare hi asura leechol bammuram min hakkadashim shehu chaze veshok leolam af al pi sheggershah o met
Aval hatteruma ochelet achar sheggershah hayyisrael o met im lo hinniach ben mimmenna shenneemar uvat kohen ki tihye almana ugrusha vezera en lah veshava el bet aviha kinureha millechem aviha tochel
Mippi hashshemua lamdu millechem velo kal lechem chozeret hi litruma velo lechaze veshok
Velo hakkohenet bilvad ella afillu leviyya veyisreelit shennivala leasur lah hoil venaaset zona asura leechol bitruma leolam veaf al pi sheyyesh lah zera mikkohen

Lefichach hashshevuya enah ochelet bitruma veaf al pi sheomeret tehora ani vechal shevuya shenneemenet lomar tehora ani o sheyyesh lah ed kede shettihye mutteret levalah hare zo ochelet bitruma vehannirbaat livhema lo nifsela min hakkehunna veochelet
Yisreelit sheyyesh lah zera mikkohen ochelet bishvil benah ben zachar ben nekeva vaafillu tumtum veanderoginus vaafillu zera hazzera ad sof kal haolam shenneemar vezera en lah

Keshem shezzera yisrael mikkohenet posel otah kach zera kohen miyyisreelit maachil otah veaf al pi shehu zera pasul ketzad bat yisrael shennisset lechohen o kohenet leyisrael veyalda mimmennu bat uva al habbat mi shehu erva aleha o shennisset lemamzer umeta habbat vahare hammamzer kayyam hayeta em immo bat yisrael lechohen tochal bitruma bat kohen leyisrael lo tochal

Ha lamadta shehi ochelet bishvil zarah veaf al pi sheoto hazzera pasul vaafillu eno yisrael veen tzarich lomar sheim hayeta lah bat mikkohen af al pi shehabbat nesua leyisrael vaafillu nitchallela hare immah ochelet bishvil habbat happesula

Kayyotze bo hakkohenet sheenah ochelet mippene zarah shemmiyyisrael af al pi sheoto hazzera kohanim ketzad bat kohen shennisset leyisrael veyalda mimmennu bat vehalcha habbat venisset lechohen veyalda mimmennu ben hare ze rauy lihot kohen gadol maachil et immo ufosel et em immo veaf al pi shemmeta immo vezot omeret lo keven bitti kohen gadol shehu poslani min hatteruma

Haeved eno posel mishshum zera veeno maachil ketzad kohenet shennisset leyisrael o yisreelit shennisset lechohen veyalda mimmennu ben vehalach habben venichbash al hashshifcha veyalda mimmennu eved umet habben vahare haeved kayyam hayeta em aviv shel eved ze bat yisrael lechohen lo tochal bitruma hayeta bat kohen leyisrael tochal sheen ze zera shehaavadim en lahem yichus

Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 7: Kohen tame asur leechol teruma ben temea ben tehora shenneemar ish ish mizzera aharon vehu tzarua o zav bakodashim lo yochal e zehu kodesh sheochlin oto kal zera aharon zecharim unkevot heve omer zo teruma ella shekkal tame haochel teruma tehora chayyav mita bide shamayim ulfichach loke shenneemar veshamru et mishmarti velo yisu alav chet vetame sheachal teruma temea af al pi shehu belav eno loke shehare enah kodesh

Mi shehaya ochel bitruma vehirgish shennizdazeu evarav lehotzi shichvat zera ochez baamma uvolea et hatteruma

Hacheresh vehashshote matbilin otan umaachilin otan teruma achar sheheeriv shimshan umshammerin otan shello yishnu achar hattevila sheim yishnu temeim ella im ken asu lahem kis shel nechoshet shemma yiru keri

Petzua dakka kohen shekkiddesh bat kohen enah ochelet seris chamma hu veishto vaavadav ochlin tumtum veanderoginus avdehen ochlin aval lo neshotehen
Cheresh shote vekatan shekkanu lahen avadim enan ochlin aval im kanu lahem bet din o appotroppos o shennaflu lahen birushsha hare ellu ochlin

Anderoginus shennival lefasul min hatteruma ben derech zichruto ben derech nekevuto nifsal milleechol bitruma kenashim veen avadav ochlin vechen im nival leanderoginus acher shehu posel beviato leishsha nifsal veeno ochel velo maachil avadav vehu sheyyivol oto derech nekevuto aval derech zichruto en zachar posel zachar min hakkehunna
Eved shel shene shuttafin shehaya echad mehen kohen eno maachil hare ze haeved asur leechol vechal hammaachil bitruma maachil bechaze veshok
