Bat kohen shennisset leyisrael vehichnisa lo ben avde melog ben avde tzon barzel hare ellu lo yochlu

Almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot ben kohenet ben yisreelit vechen shear chayyave lavin vehichnisa lo avde melog veavdi tzon barzel avde melog lo yochlu af al pi shehu chayyav bimzonotam veavde tzon barzel yochlu mippene shehem shel baal nasa sheniyya hi ochelet veavde melog shellah lo yochlu

Kohenet almana shennitarsa lechohen gadol o gerusha lechohen hedot hoil vehen meshammerot levia pesula shel tora hare ellu lo yochlu vechen im nichnesu lachuppa belo erusin enan ochlot shehachuppa posaltan milleechol nitalmenu o nitgarshu min haerusin chazru lehechsheran veochlot min hannissuin lo yochlu shekkevar nitchallelu
Kohenet shemmet balah kohen venafla lifne yevamim sheyyesh bahen chalal lo tochal mippene zikkat hechalal vaafillu asa bah echad min hakkesherim maamar sheen hammaamar kone bivama kinyan gamur

Kohen shennatan get livimto hakkohenet shehare neesra alav vaadayin zikkato aleha hare zo ochelet bitruma mippene shehi meshammeret levia pesula shel divrehen sheen hagget posel hayevama ella middivrehen vechen kohenet chalutza o sheniyya shennitarsa lechohen ochelet kohen hedot shennasa ayelonit hare zo ochelet bitruma
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 8: Haubbar vehayyavam vehaerusin vehacheresh uven tesha shanim veom echad poslin velo maachilin
Haubbar ketzad bat yisrael hamubberet mikkohen lo tochal bishvil haubbar uvat kohen hamubberet miyyisrael asura leechol mippene haubbar shenneemar veshava el bet aviha kinureha perat limubberet

Bat kohen shebba aleha yisrael en choshshin shemma nitabbera ella tovelet veochelet laerev hayeta nesua leyisrael umet balah tovelet veochelet bitruma laerev ad arbaim yom veim hukkar ubbarah hare zo mekulkelet lemafrea ad arbaim yom shekkal haarbaim yom eno ubbar ella mayim baolam hu chashuv

Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen umet vehinnichah meubberet lo yochlu avadeha bitruma bishvil haubbar shehayelud hu shemmaachil sheeno yelud eno maachil lefichach im haya haubbar chalal eno posel haavadim ella ochlin biglal echav hakkesherim ad sheyyivaled ze hechalal veyeasru haavadim milleechol

Hayyavam ketzad bat yisrael hazzekuka leyavam kohen lo tochal shenneemar vechohen ki yikne nefesh veze adayin lo kenaah uvat kohen hazzekuka leyisrael asura mippene yevamah shenneemar veshava el bet aviha kinureha perat leshomeret yavam

Yavam kohen shebba al yevimto beones o bishgaga o sheheera bah velo gamar af al pi shekkenaah kemo shebbearnu behilchot yibbum eno maachilah bitruma ad sheyyivol beila gemura beratzon bamme devarim amurim shennitalmena min haerusin aval min hannissuin hoil vehayeta ochelet tochal bevia zo

Haerusin ketzad bat kohen shennitarsa leyisrael asura leechol shehare yesh lo bah kinyan uvat yisrael shennitarsa lechohen lo tochal ad shettikkanes lachuppa shemma taachil livne bet aviha kemo shebbearnu

Yisrael sheamar lechohenet hare atte mekuddeshet li achar sheloshim yom hare zo ochelet bitruma kal hashsheloshim sheadayin lo nitarsa veim amar lah hare atte mekuddeshet li meachshav ulachar sheloshim yom hare zo asura leechol miyyad vechen shear hattenaim kayyotze baze

Hacheresh ketzad kohenet shennisset leyisrael cheresh lo tochal shehare kone betakkanat chachamim shettikkenu lo nissuin uvat yisrael shennisset lechohen cheresh lo tochal sheeno kone min hattora sheeno ben daat

Nitarsa lechohen pikkeach velo hispik lechansah ad shennitcharesh enah ochelet met venafla lifne yavam cheresh veyibbemah enah ochelet aval im nesaah keshehu pikkeach venitcharesh hare zo ochelet met venafla lifne yavam cheresh veyibbemah hare zo ochelet hoil vehayeta ochelet battechilla veeshet cheresh sheyyalda mimmennu hare zo ochelet bishvil benah

Ben tesha shanim veom echad ketzad mi shennivala leasur lah vehu ben tesha shanim veom echad hoil uviato bia nifsela min hakkehunna vaasura milleechol bitruma mippene shennaaset zona o chalala kemo shebbearnu afillu haya shachuf uvat yisrael shennisset lechohen ben tesha shanim veom echad af al pi shebbiato bia enah ochelet bishvil hakkatan lefi sheeno kone ad sheyyagdil safek shehu ben tesha shanim veom echad safek sheeno nisset leven shelosh esre shana veom echad safek shehevi shette searot safek shello hevi hare zo asura leechol
Kal ellu keshem sheen maachilin bitruma shel tora kach en maachilin bitruma shel divrehem gezera shemma yaachilu beshel tora
Veellu lo poslin velo maachilin haones vehamfatte vehashshote shennasa ishsha ella im ken hayeta asura lahen shehen poslin otah beviatam mippene shennaaset zona vachalala kemo shebbearnu

Mi shennisset lechohen shote o sheanas otah o sheppitta otah kohen veyalda ochelet bishvil benah veaf al pi shehaddavar safek hoil uvlo kiddushin hi shemma meacher nitabbera hare havalad bechezkat ze shebba aleha vehu shello yatza aleha kol im acher ella hakkol merannenin achareha beze hakkohen vechen kohenet shebba aleha yisrael shote o sheanasah o pitta otah venitabbera enah ochelet mippene haubbar nitchattech haubbar hare zo tochal

Eshet ish shebbau aleha ede kinnuy veede setira hare zo asura leechol bitruma ad shettishte me hammarim mippene shehi sefek zona met balah kodem sheyyashkenna o shehayeta min hannashim sheenan shotot velo notlot ketubba hare zo asura leechol bitruma leolam vechal eshet kohen sheamra temea ani hare zo asura leechol bitruma

Ketanna bat yisrael shennisset lechohen shello middaat aviha ben bifne aviha ben shello befanav af al pi shekkiddeshah aviha enah ochelet bitruma sheim micha tease zara lemafrea veze sheroe veshotek koes hu lefi shennisset shello ledato
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 9: Haisha ochelet bitruma ad sheyyaggia get leyadah o leyad sheluchah sheasta lekabbala vechal shehi sefek gerusha hare zo lo tochal haishsha sheasta shaliach lekabbel lah gittah asura leechol bitruma miyyad veim amra kabbel li gitti bemakom peloni enah asura ad sheyyaggia shaliach leoto makom shalcha shaliach lehavi lah gittah ochelet bitruma ad sheyyaggia get leyadah haomer leishto hare ze gittech shaa achat kodem lemitati asura leechol bitruma miyyad

Ir shehikkifuha karkom usfina hammittarefet bayyam vehayyotze liddon hare ellu bechezkat kayyamin veen tzarich lomar mefaresh veotze beshayyara aval ir shekkevashuha karkom usfina sheavda bayyam vehayyotze lehareg mibbatte dine akkum umi sheggerarattu chayya o nafla alav mappolet o shetafo nahar notnin lo chumre metim vechumre chayyim lefichach im hau neshotehen bat kohen leyisrael o bat yisrael lechohen hare ellu lo yochlu aval mi shennigmar dino bevet din vehinnichuhu bevet hassekila lehareg hare ze bechezkat met velo tochal ishto
Hinnicha balah goses bimdina acheret ben shehayeta kohenet eshet yisrael o yisreelit eshet kohen lo tochal sherov gossin lemita echad omer met veechad omer lo met hare zo lo tochal

Amra lah tzaratah o achat mehechamesh nashim sheenan neemanot lehaidah shemmet balah hoil veenah nisset al pihen hare zo ochelet bitruma bechezkat shebbalah kayyam ad sheyyaid lah mi shehu neeman lehassiah al piv

Hamshachrer et avdo mishsheyezakke lo beget shichrur pesalo milleechol bitruma vechal eved sheyyatza lecherut vaadayin hu meukkav get shichrur kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot avadim af al pi chen hare hu asur leechol bitruma

Hakkotev nechasav leacher vezikka lo al yede acher vehau bahen avadim veshatak ze shennatnu lo veachar kach tzavach hare ze safek im ze shetztzavach hochiach sofo al techillato vaadayin lo yatzu mershut rishon o ze shetztzavach achar sheshshatak chazar bo lefichach en ochlin bitruma ben shehaya rabbo sheni yisrael veharishon kohen ben shehaya rabbo rishon yisrael vehashsheni kohen
Yisrael shessachar behema mikkohen maachilah teruma vechohen shessachar behemat yisrael af al pi shehu chayyav bimzonoteha lo yaachilenna teruma mippene sheenah kinyan kaspo

Yisrael sheshsham para mikkohen lefattemah velihot hashshevach benehen lo yaachilenna bitruma af al pi sheyyesh lakkohen chelek beshivchah aval kohen sheshsham para miyyisrael lefattemah af al pi sheyyesh leyisrael chelek bashshevach hoil vegufah lakkohen shehare shamah al atzmo hare ze maachilah teruma
Parato shel yisrael sheyyalda bechor maachilo teruma shehabbechor lakkohanim veotzer adam karshine teruma letoch shovacho veeno choshesh shemma yavou hayyonim shello veyochlu otan

Yerae li sheim machar hakkohen parato leyisrael velakach haddamim af al pi sheadayin lo mashach hallokeach hare ze asur lehaachilah teruma sheddin tora maot konot kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot mikkach umimkar veim machar yisrael lakkohen af al pi shennatan haddamim lo tochal bitruma ad sheyyimshoch
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 10: Zar sheachal teruma bishgaga meshallem keren vechomesh af al pi sheyyodea shehi teruma veshehu muzhar aleha aval lo yada im chayyav aleha mita im lav hare zo shegaga umshallem keren vechomesh

Echad haochel davar sheddarko leechol veechad hashshote davar sheddarko lishtot veechad hassach davar sheddarko lasuch shenneemar velo yechallelu et kadshe bene yisrael lerabbot et hassach veechad haochel teruma tehora o temea bishgaga meshallem keren vechomesh veeno chayyav bechomesh ad sheyyochal kezayit shenneemar ki yochal kodesh bishgaga veen achila pechuta mikkezayit uchshem sheachilat teruma bichzayit kach shetiyya bichzayit

Achal vechazar veachal shata vechazar veshata im yesh mittechillat achila rishona ad sof achila acharona kede achilat peras umittechillat shetiyya rishona ad sof shetiyya acharona kede shetiyyat reviit hare ellu mitztarfin lichzayit

Hatteruma utrumat maaser ben shel demay ben shel vadday vehachalla vehabbikkurim kullan mitztarfin lichzayit lechayyev alehen mita vechomesh shekkullan nikreu teruma umin haddin haya sheen chayyavin chomesh al terumat maaser shel demay kemo sheen chayyavin al maaser sheni shello kemo sheyyitbaer aval amru chachamim im lo yitchayyev aleha chomesh yezalzelu bah

Achal teruma bemezid vehitru bo loke veeno meshallem lo hitru bo im hayeta tehora meshallem hakkeren veeno meshallem et hachomesh veim hayeta temea meshallem deme etzim mippene sheenah reuya ella lehassaka lefichach im achal terumat tutim verimmonim vechayyotze bahem shennitmeu patur min hattashlumin shehare enam reuyin lehassaka

Haochel terumat chametz befesach ben bezadon ben bishgaga ben temea ben tehora patur min hattashlumin afillu hifrishah matztza vehechmitza patur vaafillu deme etzim eno meshallem shehare enah reuya lehassaka mippene shehi asura bahanaa en lah damim

Aval hashshogeg sheachal teruma beom hakkippurim o sheachal teruma nekura vehashshote yen teruma shennitgalla vehassach yayin veshemen keechad o sheshshata shemen vechometz keechad o shekkasas et hachittim o gama et hachometz hare ze meshallem keren vechomesh

Haya savea vekatz bimzono vehosif al savo baachilat teruma eno meshallem et hachomesh shenneemar ki yochal lo sheyyazzik et atzmo vechen hakkoses et hasseorim patur min hachomesh mippene shehizzik atzmo
Zar shebbala shezafin shel teruma vehekian uva acher vaachalan gam hu bishgaga harishon meshallem keren vechomesh vehashsheni meshallem deme etzim larishon

Hammaachil happoalim veet haorchim teruma hem meshallemin keren vechomesh mippene shehen keshoggin vehu meshallem lahem deme seuddatan sheddeme hachullin yeterin middeme teruma sheachlu sheddavar haasur nafsho shel adam chota mimmennu

Hammaachil et banav hakketannim veet avadav ben gedolim ben ketannim vehaochel terumat chutza laaretz vehaochel o hashshote pachot mikkezayit venazir sheshshagag veshata yayin shel teruma vehashshote shemen vehassach et hayyayin kal ellu meshallemim et hakkeren velo et hachomesh

Bat kohen shehayeta nesua leyisrael o shennifsela veachar kach achla teruma meshallemet et hakkeren velo et hachomesh haishsha shehayeta ochelet bitruma veamru lah met balich o gershech vechen haeved shehaya ochel veamru lo met rabbecha vehinniach yoresh sheeno maachil o shemmecharcha leyisrael o netancha lo o shichrercha vechen kohen shehaya ochel venoda lo shehu ben gerusha o ben chalutza hare ellu meshallemin hakkeren bilvad veim hayeta terumat chametz vehaya erev happesach hare ellu peturin milleshallem mippene shezzemannah bahul nechpezu leechol velo badku vechullan shehayeta lahen teruma betoch pihen kesheyyadu shehen asurin leechol hare ellu yiflotu

Haya ochel veamru lo nitmeta o nitmet hatteruma tame hayita o temea hayeta hatteruma o noda shehu tevel o maaser rishon shello nittela terumato o maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu o shettaam taam pishpesh letoch piv hare ellu yiflotu

Shette kuppot achat shel teruma veachat shel chullin venafla teruma letoch achat mehen veen yadua lee zo nafla hareni omer letoch shel teruma nafla en yadua e zo hi shel teruma achal zar achat mehen hare ze patur min hattashlumin shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya vehashsheniyya noheg bah kitruma achal acher et hashsheniyya af hu patur achal echad et shettehen meshallem kakketanna shebbishtehen im mezid keren veim shogeg keren vechomesh

Haochel et hachomesh bishgaga hare ze mosif alav chumsho shehachomesh kekeren lechal davar vechen mosif chomesh al chomesh leolam kal hamshallem keren vechomesh hare hattashlumin kitruma lechal davar ella sheim nizreu giddulehen chullin veim ratza hakkohen limchol eno mochel vechal hamshallem et hakkeren bilvad hare hattashlumin chullin veim ratza hakkohen limchol mochel

Bat yisrael sheachla teruma veachar kach nisset lechohen im teruma shello zacha bah kohen achla meshallemet keren vechomesh leatzmah veim teruma shezzacha bah kohen achla meshallemet keren labbealim vechomesh leatzmah shekkal hamshallem keren vechomesh meshallem hakkeren labbealim vehachomesh lechal kohen sheyyirtze
Lo hispika leshallem ad shennitgarsha ben kach uven kach enah meshallemet leatzmah vahare hi kemi shello nisset lechohen meolam

Kal haochel teruma ben beshogeg ben bemezid eno meshallem ella min hachullin hamtukkanim shehotziu mehen terumot umaasrot umshallemin min halleket umin hashshichcha umin happea umin hahefker umimmaaser rishon shennittela terumato af al pi sheadayin lo nittela teruma gedola sheyyesh bo im hikdim hammaaser latteruma umshallemin mimmaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu veaf al pi shennifdu shello kahalacha umin hechadash al hayyashan aval lo mimmin al sheeno mino shenneemar venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh kakkodesh sheachal
Haochel kishshuin shel erev sheviit yamtin lakkishshuin shel motzae sheviit vishallem mehen sheeno yachol leshallem chovo mipperot sheviit kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo

Achal teruma temea meshallem chullin ben temein ben tehorin achal teruma tehora meshallem chullin tehorin veim shillem chullin temein ben beshogeg ben bemezid tashlumav tashlumin veyachazor vishallem min hattehorin
Achal terumat chaver meshallem lo achal terumat am haaretz meshallem lechaver venotel dameha mimmennu venoten leam haaretz sheachal terumato sheen mosrin tahorot leam haaretz

Gazal teruma meavi immo kohen vaachalah veachar kach met avi immo eno meshallem leatzmo ella leoresh acher mishshear hashshevet vechen im nafla lo teruma meavi immo vaachalah uvaal chov sheggava teruma bechovo vehaishsha bichtubbatah vaachaluha meshallemin keren vechomesh lechohen chaver vehechaver noten lahem damim shehau mochrin bah otah hatteruma kemo sheachlu

Haggonev teruma velo achalah meshallem tashlume kefel labbealim veyesh lo leshallem middeme teruma genavah vaachalah meshallem shene keranin vechomesh keren vechomesh min hachullin vekeren afillu middeme teruma

Hayeta hatteruma hekdesh levedek habbayit ugnavah vaachalah eno meshallem tashlume kefel sheen tashlume kefel behekdesh kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo aval meshallem keren ushne chomashim chomesh mishshum ochel teruma vechomesh mishshum shennehena min hahekdesh ulmi meshallem im haya bah kezayit veen bah sheve peruta meshallem lakkohanim veim yesh bah sheve peruta ben sheyyesh bah kezayit ben sheen bah kezayit meshallem lahekdesh

Umippene ma chal issur hekdesh al issur hatteruma mippene shehatteruma asura lezar umutteret lakkohen hikdishah neesra al hakkohen lefichach nosaf bah issur af al yisrael al derech shebbearnu behilchot biot asurot veissure maachalot

Haggozel teruma vaachalah meshallem keren vechomesh echad shehachomesh shechayyav bo mishshum teruma yatza bo yede gezelo shenneemar venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh eno chayyav ella bechomesh shel kodesh bilvad gezalah veheechilah leacher haochel meshallem keren vechomesh kal makom sheamarnu meshallem keren vechomesh im achal sheve arbaa meshallem sheve chamishsha mimmin sheachal vechal makom sheamarnu meshallem keren ushne chomashin achal sheve arbaa meshallem shishsha vechal makom sheamarnu meshallem shene keranin vechomesh echad achal sheve arbaa meshallem deme tisha ulolam eno meshallem ella lefi damim shehayeta shava bishat achila ben shehuzla bishat tashlumin ben shehukra
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 11: Hatteruma nittenet laachila velishtiyya ulsicha shehassicha hi kishtiyya shenneemar vattavo chammayim bekirbo vechashshemen beatzmotav vehashshetiyya bichlal achila leechol davar sheddarko leechol velishtot davar sheddarko lishtot velasuch davar sheddarko lasuch lo yasuch yayin vechometz aval sach hu et hashshemen hattahor umadlik et hattame vezehu hannikra shemen serefa bechal makom

Temarim shel teruma muttar lechavtzan ulkabbetzan keiggul haddevela veasur laasot mehem shechar vechen en osin temarim devash velo tappuchim yayin velo perot hassetav chometz vechen shear kal happerot en meshannin otan mibberiyyatan bitruma chutz mizzetim vaanavim bilvad avar veasa haochel mashke hare ze shotehu vezar sheachal devash temarim veyen tappuchim vechayyotze bahen bishgaga eno chayyav leshallem veim achal bemezid makkin oto makkat mardut

En notnin devela ugrogarot letoch hammuryas mippene shehu meabbedan aval notnin et hayyayin letoch hammuryas veen mefattemin et hashshemen mippene shehu motzio mikkelal maachalot veosehu shemen mishcha aval mearvin yayin udvash ufilpelin vechayyotze baellu leachlan

En mevashshelin yayin shel teruma mippene shehu memaato en kovshin betzalim shel teruma bechometz shel teruma mippene shemmafsid hachometz en mearvin tevua bekitniyyot vechal davar sheyyitparesh ze mizze keshekkovrin oto mearvin umishshecharva yehuda hitchilu learev tevua bitvua vekitnit bekitnit aval lo tevua bekitnit

Kederech shemmerakkedin et hakkemach bechullin kach noheg hakkohen bitruma merakked leechol umashlich et hammursan hare sheratza laasot solet menuppe benafaot harbe ad sheyyotzi kav o kabbayim min hassea lo yashlich et hashshear mippene shehu rauy laachila ella yannichehu bemakom mutzna

Shemen shel teruma en chosmin bo tannur vechirayim veen sachin bo minal vesandal velo yasuch raglo vehu betoch minal vesandal aval sach et raglo velovesh hamminal o hassandal vesach kal gufo umitaggel al gabbe katovliyya chadasha veaf al pi shehen nissochin eno choshesh aval lo yitten shemen al gabbe tavla shel shayish lehitaggel aleha mippene shemmeabbedo

Kal haochel teruma afillu perot tzarich netilat yadayim af al pi shehau yadav tehorot kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo veenah neechelet im hazzar al hashshulchan gezera shemma yochal mimmenna utrumat chutza laaretz neechelet im hazzar al hashshulchan veenah tzericha netilat yadayim kechullin veen sachin teruma beyadayim mesoavot nafal al besaro meshafshefo beyadayim mesoavot aval sachin et hakkatan beshemen teruma betoch shiva shehannolad kal shiva eno chashuv arel

Sach hu hakkohen atzmo beshemen shel teruma umevi ben bitto yisrael umaagilo al gabbav veim sach atzmo beshemen venichnas lammerchatz muttar lezar lemashcho bammerchatz af al pi shehu nissoch mimmennu

Kohenet shechaffa roshah betiltan shel teruma en hayyisreelit mutteret lachof achareha aval meaggelet searah bisarah umippene ma hutteru hakkohanim lachof searan betiltan shel teruma mippene sheeno rauy lemaachal adam

Uktze teenim ugrogarot vehakkelisim vehecharuvin umee avattiach uklippe avattiach veetrog umlaffon af al pi sheen bahen ochel uknivat yarak shemmashlichin baale battim hare ellu asurim lezarim aval kenivat yarak shemmekannevim haggannanin mutteret lezarim kelippe polin veshumshemin im yesh bahen ochel asurin en bahen ochel muttarin

Garine etrog muttarim garine zetim utmarim vecharuvin af al pi shello kenasan hakkohen hare ellu asurin lezarim ushar haggarinin bizman shekkenasan veyesh bahen lachluchit limtzotz otan asurin lezar veim hishlichan muttarot
Hassubbin shel chittim chadashot asurin mippene shehu rauy lemaachal adam veshel yeshanot muttar vead matay nikreu chadashot kal zeman shebbene adam regilin lachbot ben haggoranot

Hannetzolot veharakvaniyyot shel teruma asurot veim heelu avak muttarot shemarim shel teruma shennatan alehem mayim harishon vehashsheni asur lezarim vehashshelishi muttar veim lo natan alehem mayim ella mesannen hayyayin meal hashshemarim bilvad af hashshelishi asur lezarim

Megura sheppinna mimmenna chitte teruma en mechayevin oto lihot yoshev umlakket achat achat veachar kach yitten letochah chullin ella mechabbed kedarko venoten letochah chullin vechen chavit shel shemen teruma shennishpecha en mechayevin oto lihot yoshev umtappeach ella noheg bah kederech shennoheg bechullin

Hamare kad shel shemen teruma hare ze meare ad sheyyifsok haammud veyatchil hashshemen lintof meat meat vechevan shennatfu shalosh tippim zo achar zo dayyo umuttar litten bechad shemen chullin hare shello natan ella hinniach hakkad ad shennitmatztzet otah hattamtzit teruma
Memalle hakkohen ner shemen serefa venotno leyisrael laalot bo laaliyya ulhikkanes lacheder laasot tzarche hakkohen aval lo tzarche yisrael veim haya shuttaf immo muttar
Yisrael shehaya oreach etzel kohen vehidlik lo shemen serefa veamad hakkohen vehalach lo eno chayyav lechabboto ad shekkave meelav vetovel hayyisrael petila bener hakkohen umadlik lelech bah

Bekaro shel kohen shehaya omed etzel bekaro shel yisrael vechelav shel kohen shehaya neerag etzel kelav shel yisrael hare ze madlik alehen shemen serefa shello birshut hakkohen vechen madlikin shemen serefa bevatte kenesiyyot uvvatte midrashot uvammevoot haafelim shello birshut kohen umi sheen lo chullin lehadlik ner chanukka madlik shemen serefa shello birshut hakkohen madlikin shemen serefa al gabbe hachullin birshut kohen

Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen vehi lemuda etzel aviha madlik birshutah muttar lechohen lehadlik shemen serefa afillu bevet haavel o bevet hammishte sheyyesh sham irbuv veen choshshin shemma yesuppeku mimmenna bevet hammishte shemmippene nikon kelehem en nogin bo uvvet haavel mippene sheen lahem penay mippene haavel

Hazzorea et hatteruma beshogeg yehappech bemezid yekayyem hevia shelish ben bemezid ben beshogeg yekayyem veim haya pishtan afillu hevia shelish vaafillu bemezid yehappech kenas kansu bo shello yizra veyitkaven lehanot beetzav

Giddule teruma hare hen kechullin lechal davar ella sheasurim lezarim gazru chachamim alehen sheyyihu asurin lezarim kitruma mishshum teruma temea shebbeyad hakkohen shello yashhenna etzlo kede sheyyizraenna vetetze lechullin venimtza ba bah lide takkala lefichach muttar leechol haggiddulin beyadayim temeot umuttar litvul yom kechullin

Giddule giddulin chullin lechal davar vaafillu davar sheen zaro kale im rabbu haggiddulin al haikkar begiddule haggiddulin hare haggiddulin hashsheniyyim maalin et haikkar af al pi sheen zaro kale veyihye hakkol muttar lezarim vechen terumat chutza laaretz vehamdumma vetosefet teruma vezerone ginna sheenam neechalim kegon zera lefet utznon af al pi sheoto lefet utznon teruma giddulehen muttarin vahare hen chullin lechal davar vechen hazzorea pishtan shel teruma haggiddulin muttarin lezarim
Hazzorea teruma temea af al pi shehaggiddulim tehorin hare hen asurin baachila hoil vehatteruma shennizrea asura baachila hayeta kevar niddechu
Chatach et healin shetztzamchu veyatzu alin sheniyyin vachatachan hare ochel sheyyatza achar kach muttar baachila
Shetile chullin shennitmeu uzraan vaasaan teruma hare ellu muttarin shehare taharu bizria velo nitmeu keshehen teruma kede sheyyihu asurin

Shibbolet shehayeta betoch hakkeri umerach hakkeri kullo hare otah hashshibbolet tevel hoil venimrecha betoch hakkeri shetalah veachar kach kara aleha shem vaasaah teruma hare zo sefek teruma hoil uzraah shemma parach hattevel mimmenna venaaset keferot sheadayin lo nigmeru aval im asaah teruma kodem sheyyizraenna hare zo teruma lefichach im talash mimmenna veachal bemezid chayyav mita beshogeg meshallem et hachomesh veim gachan veachal befiv min haaretz betela dato etzel kal adam sheen derech bene adam bechach lefichach patur min hammita umin hachomesh im haya shogeg

Sade shel giddule teruma chayyevet beleket shichcha ufea uvitruma umaasrot uvmaasar ani vaaniyye yisrael vaaniyye kohanim notlim mimmenna mattanot ellu aniyye kohanim ochlin et shellahem vaaniyye yisrael mochrin et shellahem lakkohanim bidme teruma vehaddamim shel aniyyim vechen ben levi mocher hammaaser shello lakkohanim
Hachovet giddulin ellu meshubbach vehaddash bivhema ketzad yaase tole kefifot betzavvere behema venoten letochan meoto hammin nimtza lo zomem et habbehema velo maachil et hatteruma
Mishneh Torah, Heave Offerings 12: Asur letamme et hatteruma shel eretz yisrail kishar hakkadashim velo yevienna lide tuma velo yafsidenna ella ochel hattehora umadlik hattemea umuttar letamme terumat chutza laaretz betumot shel tora veaf al pi sheenah temea ella beeretz haammim shehi middivrehem mippene sheikkar chiyyuvah middivrehem lefichach nidda kotza lah challa bechutza laaretz sheenah muzheret ella leachlah lo ligga bah kemo shebbearnu
Teruma shennitmet besafek lo ochlim velo sorfin ella tihye munnachat ad shettitma tuma vaddait vetissaref veyesh sham sefekot shessorfin alehen et hatteruma kemo sheyyitbaer beinyan tuma vetahora
Chavit shel teruma shennolad lah sefek tuma hare ze lo yechaddesh bah davar lo yezizenna mimmekomah velo yegallenna ella yannichenna ad shettittame vadday vetissaref veen choshshin shemma teachel

Chavit shennishbera baggat haelona vehattachtona temea im yachol lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betahora yatztzil veim lav yatztzil beyadav belo netilat yadayim veaf al pi shehu metammeah kemo sheyyitbaer beinyan tahorot

Bamme devarim amurim bechavit shel yayin vehu sheyyihye baggat hattachtona pachot mimmea shehare yiddama hakkol veyippasel aval im haya battachtona mea bezo hechavit shehare hi ola beachat umea o shehayeta chavit shel shemen tered vetittame veal yetammeenna beyadav shehare hakkol rauy lehadlaka veen sham hefsed merubbe vechen chavit shemen shennishpecha im yachol lehatztzil reviit betahora yatztzil veim lav yatztzil betuma shekkevan shennishbera hechavit eno muzhar shello lehatztzil betuma mippene shehu bahul

Haya over mimmakom lemakom uvyado kikkarot shel teruma amar lo hannachri ten li achat mehen veim lav hareni nogea bechullan umtammean yanniach lefanav achat al hassela veal yittenenna letoch yado kede shello yetamme hatteruma beyadayim

Hattiltan vehakkarshinin shel teruma hoil veeno maachal adam hare ze muttar laasot kal maasehen betuma veeno nizhar ella beet sheriyyatan bemayim sheim shara otam betuma hare timme otam beyadayim aval achar hashsheriyya eno nizhar lo beet sheshshaf hakkarshinin velo beet shemmaachilan livhema lefichach notnin terumat tiltan vecharshinin lechohen am haaretz

En mafkidin teruma etzel kohen am haaretz mippene shellibbo gas bah leachlah aval mafkidin oto etzel yisrael am haaretz bichli cheres hammukkaf tzemid patil uvilvad shello yihu perot muchsharin gezera shello tesitem ishto nidda

Eno loke min hattora ella al hazzeria o al hazzemira veal hakketzira o al habbetzira veechad hakkerem veechad shear hailanot

En notin bashsheviit afillu ilan serak velo yachtoch hayyibbolet min hailanot velo yefarek healin vehabbaddim hayeveshim velo yeabbek et tzammarto baavak velo yeashshen tachtav kede sheyyamut hattolaat velo yasuch et hannetiot bedavar sheyyesh lo zohama kede shello yochal oto haof keshehu rach velo yasuch et happaggin velo yinkov otan velo yichroch et hannetiot velo yiktom otam velo yefasseg et hailanot vechen shear kal avodat hailan veim asa achat meellu bashsheviit makkin oto makkat mardut

En metzitin et haur beishat hakkanim mippene shehi avodat karka veen melammedin et happara lachrosh ella bechol veen bodkin et hazzeraim beatzitz male afar aval bodkin otan beatzitz male gelalim veshorin et hazzeraim bashsheviit kede lezaran bemotzae sheviit umkayemin hailuye berosh haggag aval en mashkin oto
Sokrin et hailan besikra vetoanin oto baavanim veodrin tachat haggefanim vehamkashkesh bezetim im lehavrot et hailan asur veim listom et happetzimim muttar

Mashkin bet hashshelachin bashsheviit vehi sede hazzeria shetztzemea beoter vechen sede hailanot im hau meruchakin ze mizze yeter meeser levet sea moshchin et hammayim meilan leilan aval lo yashku et kal hassade veim hau mekoravin ze laze eser levet sea mashkin kal hassade bishvilan vechen afar hallavan marbitzin oto bemayim bashsheviit bishvil hailanot shello yippasdu
Veosin ugiyyot laggefanim veosin et ammat hammayim kattechilla ummallein et hannekaim mayim

Umippene ma hittiru kal elle sheim lo yashke tease haaretz melecha veyamut kal etz shebbah vehoil veissur haddevarim haellu vechayyotze bahem middivrehem lo gazru al ellu sheen asur min hattora ella otan shene avot ushte toladot shellahem kemo shebbearnu

Mishsherabbu haannasin vehittilu malche akkum al yisrael laasot machanot lechelotehen hittiru lizroa bashsheviit devarim shetztzerichin lahem avde hammelech bilvad vechen mi shekkefao annas laasot bashsheviit bechinnam kemo avodat hammelech vechayyotze bahen hare ze ose
Hannotea bashsheviit ben beshogeg ben bemezid yaakor mippene sheyyisrael chashudin al hashsheviit im tomar beshogeg yekayyem yomar hammezid shogeg hayiti

Hachoresh et sadehu o narah o zibbelah bashsheviit kede shettihye yafa lizria bemotzae sheviit konsin oto velo yizraenna bemotzae sheviit veen chochrin otah mimmennu kede lezarah ella tehi bura lefanav veim met yizraenna beno
Hammaavir kotzim meartzo bashsheviit kede letakkenah lemotzae sheviit o shessikkel mimmenna avanim af al pi sheeno rashshay lo kansu oto umuttar lo lezarah bemotzae sheviit

Hattomen lefet utznonot vechayyotze bahen bashsheviit im hau miktzat healin megullin eno choshesh veim lav asur hattomen et halluf vechayyotze bahen lo yifchot mearba kabbim al govah tefach vetefach afar al gabbav vetomno bimkom derisat haadam kede shello yitzmach umuttar lemares beorez bashsheviit aval lo yechasseach

Barishona hau omrim melakket adam etzim vaavanim vaasavim mittoch sadehu vehu sheyyittol haggas haggas kede shello yitkaven lenakkot haaretz aval missede chavero notel ben dak ben gas mishsherabbu ovre avera shemmitkavvenin lenakkot veomrin haggas haggas anu notlin asru littol adam missadehu ella mittoch sede chavero vehu shello yelakket betova shello yomar lo ree kamma tov asiti lecha shehare nikketi sadcha
Hayeta behemto omedet betoch sadehu melakket umevi lefaneha shebbehemto mochachat alav vechen im hayeta sham kirato melakket hakkol umadlik shekkirato mochachat alav

Hakkotzetz ilan o shenayim leetzim hare ze muttar lesharshan katzatz shelosha o yeter ze betzad ze lo yesharesh shehare metakken et haaretz ella kotzetz meal haaretz umanniach sharashav baaretz bamme devarim amurim mittoch shello aval missede chavero muttar lesharesh
Hammavkia bezayit littol etzim lo yechappe mekom habbikkua beafar mippene shehi avoda aval mechasse baavanim o bekash
Hamzannev baggefanim vehakkotzetz kanim hare ze kotzetz kedarko bekardom uvmaggal uvimgera uvchal ma sheyyirtze

En kotztzin betulat shikma bashsheviit kederech shekkotztzin bishar hashshanim mippene shekketzitzatah avodat ilan shebbiktzitza zo tigdal vetosif veim tzarich leetzeha kotzetz otah shello kederech avodatah
Ketzad kotztzah meim haaretz o lemala measara tefachim ilan shennifshach koshrin oto bashsheviit lo sheyyaale ella shello yosif

Lo yotzi adam zevalim mechatzero veyitten betoch sadehu bashsheviit mippene shennire kimzabbel sadehu shettihye yafa lizria veim hotzi veheemid mimmennu ashpa muttar velo yaase ashpa betoch sadehu ad sheyyaavor zeman shemmezabbelin bo laavodat haaretz vehu mishsheyyikshor hammatok velo yaase ashpa pechuta mimmea vachamishshim sea shel zevel kede shettihye nikkeret shehi ashpa veim yirtze lehosif mosif haya lo davar muat mosif alav veholech velo yaase bechal bet sea yeter mishshalosh ashpattot
Veharotze laasot kal sadehu shalosh shalosh ashpattot letoch bet sea ose veharotze laasot zivlo otzar ose

Haya maamid hazzevel al hassela o sheheemik baaretz shelosha tefachim veheerim hazzevel o shebbana al haaretz govah shelosha veheemid alav hazzevel eno tzarich shiur afillu asa ken kamma ashpattot letoch bet sea ben gedolot ben ketannot muttar shehare haddavar nikkar sheenan laavodat haaretz ella lichnisat hazzevel

Muttar leadam lehotzi zevel min hassahar shel tzon venoten letoch sadehu kederech kal machnise zevel vehaose dir betoch sadehu bashsheviit lo yaasehu yeter al bet satayim veyachnis hatztzon letocho uchsheyezabbelu et kal haddir meniach dofen echad middafne haddir veose dir acher betziddo nimtza mezabbel betoch sadehu bet arbaat sein
Hayeta kal sadehu bet arbaat sein meshayyer mimmenna miktzat mippene marit haayin kede sheyyedu hakkol shehatztzon hetilu bah veniddayera velo yomru zibbel ze kal sadehu bashsheviit

Lo yiftach adam mechtzav battechilla letoch sadehu bashsheviit shemma yomru letakken sadehu nitkaven sheyyasir mimmenna hassela veim hitchil mikkodem sheviit ufitztzel mimmenna sheva veesrim avanim beribbua shalosh al shalosh al rum shalosh kal even mehen amma al amma berum amma o gedolot mizzo hare ze muttar lenakker mimmennu bashsheviit kal ma sheyyirtze

Gader shel avanim sheyyesh begavho asara tefachim o yeter veratza littol kal avanav im hau bo eser avanim o yeter kal achat mehen massoy shenayim o gedolot mizzo hare ze notel sheharoe yodea shelletzorech haavanim hu notel haya pachot measara o shehau pachot meeser avanim o shehau avanav ketannot mimmassoy shenayim notel ad sheyyanniach tefach samuch laaretz

Bamme devarim amurim beshennitkaven letakken sadehu o shehitchil littol bashsheviit aval im lo nitkaven letakken sadehu o shehitchil mikkodem sheviit notel bashsheviit kal ma sheyyirtze mikkal makom ugomem ad laaretz vechen im haya notel missede chavero af al pi shehu kibbelan gomem ad laaretz
Avanim sheruot shettezazea otan hammacharesha o shehau mechussot venitgallu im yesh bahen shettayim shel massoy shenayim shenayim hare ze muttar littol otan hau ketannot mizze lo yinnatlu

Hamsakkel sadehu bashsheviit mippene shehu tzarich laavanim notel et haelonot umanniach et hannogot baaretz vechen im haya lo besadehu garger shel tzerorot o gal shel avanim notel et haelonot umanniach et hannogot baaretz veim yesh tachtehen sela o kash yittol et kullan

Lo yemalle adam ga afar o yetakkenennu beafar mippene shemmetakken et haaretz aval ose hu chayitz al pene hagga vechal even sheyyachol lifshot et yado velittelah vehu omed al sefat hagga hare zo tinnatel

Avne katef vehem hannittalot shettayim shalosh al hakkatef muttar lahavian mikkal makom ben missede chavero ben missadehu vechen hakkabbelan mevi mikkal makom vaafillu avanim gedolot ben missade shekkibbelah ben missade shello kibbelah
Pirtza shehi suga beafar im enah machshelet et harabbim asur livnotah veim hayeta machshelet et harabbim o shello hayeta suga beafar ella petucha lirshut harabbim muttar livnotah

Asur lo livnot gader bashsheviit ben sadehu lisde chavero aval bone gader beno uven reshut harabbim umuttar lehaamik ad hassela umotzi et heafar vetzovro betoch sadehu kederech kal maamidin zevel vechen im chafar bor veshiach umara bashsheviit tzover heafar betoch sadehu kederech kal hachofrim

Avodat haaretz beshana shishshit sheloshim yom samuch lashsheviit asura halacha lemoshe missinay mippene shehu metakkenah lashsheviit vedavar ze bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam hu shenneesar mippi hashshemua vegazru chachamim shello yihu chorshim sede hailan erev sheviit bizman hammikdash ella ad haatzeret usde hallavan ad happasach uvazzeman sheen mikdash muttarin baavodat haaretz ad rosh hashshana kedin tora

Ilan shenniktzatz vehotzi chalifin im niktzatz mittefach ulmala hare hu keilan mittefach ulmatta hare hu kintia

Ha lamadta sheen ochlin mipperot sheviit ella perot hailanot vehaasavim sheen zorin otam rov haadam kegon happegam vehayyarbuzin hashshotim vechal kayyotze bahen aval hayerakot shedderech rov haadam lezaram bagginnot umine tevua vekitniyyot kal hatztzomeach mehen asur middivrehem vehamlakketan makkin oto makkat mardut

Sefichin shel sheviit sheyyatzu lemotzae sheviit asurin baachila veen tolshin otan bayyad ella choresh kedarko uvhema roa kedarkah
Vead matay asurin sefiche sheviit bemotzae sheviit merosh hashshana vead chanukka umechanukka veelach hen muttarin vehazzorea sefiche sheviit achar sheviit haggiddulin muttarin

Meematay motar adam likach luf bemotzae sheviit mesheyyirbe hechadash

Hattevua vehakkitniyyot asurin baachila mishshum sefichim uferot hailan ochlin otan bikdushshat sheviit

Haorez vehaddochan vehapperagim vehashshumshemin ufol hammitzri shezzerao lezera holchin bahen achar gemar peri im nigmar piryam kodem rosh hashshana hare ellu muttarin bashsheviit keferot shishshit veim nigmeru achar rosh hashshana af al pi shehishrishu kodem rosh hashshana hare ellu asurim mishshum sefichim

Hayyarak bishat lekitato vehaetrog afillu haya kefol kodem rosh hashshana venaasa kechikkar bashsheviit chayyav bemaasrot keferot shishshit vaafillu haya kechikkar bashshishshit hoil venilkat bashsheviit hare hu keferot sheviit umitasser keferot shishshit lehachamir

Vechen perot sheviit sheyyatzu lemotzae sheviit bitvua vekitniyyot veilanot holchin achar onat hammaasrot vhapperagin vehashshumshemin vehaorez vehaddochan ufol hammitzri shezzerao lezera achar gemar happeri vehayyarak achar lekitato

Pol hammitzri shezzerao lezera bashshishshit venigmar piro kodem rosh hashshana shel sheviit ben yarak shello ben zera shello muttar bashsheviit veim zara leyarak venichnesa alav sheviit ben yerako ben zaro asur kisfiche sheviit vechen im zerao lezera ulyarak asur

Avar uzrao bashsheviit veyatza lashsheminit im zerao lezera ben zaro ben yerako asur bemotzae sheviit kishar hassefichim veim zerao leyarak hoil venilkat bashsheminit ben yerako ben zaro muttar zerao lezera ulyarak zaro asur mishshum sefichim virako muttar
Benot shuach hoil vehen nigmarot leachar shalosh shanim im bau leonat hammaasrot kodem rosh hashshana shel sheminit hare hen neechalot beshana sheniyya min hashshavua betorat sheviit

Habbetzalim hassarisim ufol hammitzri shemmana mehem mayim sheloshim yom kodem rosh hashshana veshel baal shemmana mehem shalosh onot lifne rosh hashshana hare ellu mipperot shishshit pachot mikken hare hem kisfiche sheviit

Haddeluin shekkiyeman lezera im hukshu lifne rosh hashshana venifselu milleechol adam muttar lekayeman bashsheviit shehen mipperot shishshit veim lav asurin kisfiche sheviit vechen hayerakot kullan shehukshu lifne rosh hashshana muttar lekayeman bashsheviit veim hau rakkim asur lekayeman mishshum sefichim en mechayevin oto lesharesh et halluf ella mannicho baaretz kemot shehu im tzamach lemotzae sheviit muttar veen mechayevin oto lesharesh et hakkundas ella gozez bealin veim tzamach lemotzae sheviit muttar
Luf shel erev sheviit vechen betzalim shel erev sheviit hakkitzonim ufua shennigmeru lifne sheviit muttar leakran bashsheviit bekardummot shel mattechet veen baze mishshum avodat haaretz

Habbetzalim sheyyardu alehem geshamim bashsheviit vetzamchu kal zeman shehealin shellahen yerukkin hare ellu muttarin veim hishchiru hare hen kintuin baaretz veotan healin asurin mishshum sefichin uven kach uven kach habbetzalim atzman behetteran omdin
Batzal sheakaro bashsheviit untao bashsheminit verabbu giddulav al ikkaro heelu giddulav et ikkaro vehuttar hakkol hoil ushviit asura al yede karka kach netilatah al yede karka
Happerot sheyyotzi hailan bashsheviit lo yaasfem kederech sheosef bechal shana shenneemar veet inneve nezirecha lo tivtzor veim batzar laavodat hailan o shebbatzar kederech habbotzrim loke

Vechetzad ose teenim shel sheviit en kotzin otan bemuktze aval meyabbeshan becharava velo yidroch anavim baggat aval dorech hu baareva velo yaase zetim bevayit habbad aval kotesh hu umachnis letoch bad katan beoter vetochen bevet habbad uvakkotev umachnis levad ketanna vechen bishar haddevarim kal sheyyachol leshannot meshanne

Mitzvat ase lehashmit kal ma shettotzi haaretz bashsheviit shenneemar vehashsheviit tishmetenna untashtah vechal hannoel karmo o sag sadehu bashsheviit bittel mitzvat ase vechen im asaf kal perotav letoch beto ella yafkir hakkol veyad hakkol shavin bechal makom shenneemar veachlu evyone ammecha veyesh lo lehavi letoch beto meat kederech shemmeviin min hahefker chamesh kadde shemen chamishsha asar kadde yayin veim hevi yeter mizze muttar
En sheviit noheget ella beeretz yisrael bilvad shenneemar ki tavou el haaretz vego venoheget ben bifne habbayit ben shello bifne habbayit

Ir sheggaggoteha chomatah o shehayyam chomatah enah kemukkefet choma

En hammakom nikra are choma ad sheyyihye bo shalosh chatzerot o yeter uvchal chatzer mehen shene battim o yeter veyakkifuha choma techilla veachar kach yivnu hachatzerot betocho aval makom sheyyashav veachar kach hukkaf o shello hau bo shalosh chatzerot shel shene battim eno ir choma ella battim shebbo kevatte hachatzerim

En somchin ella al choma hammukkefet bishat kibbush haaretz ketzad ir shello hayeta mukkefet choma beshaa shekkavash yehoshua et haaretz af al pi shemmukkefet atta hare hi kevatte hachatzerim veir shehayeta mukkefet choma bime yehoshua af al pi sheenah mukkefet atta hare hi kemukkefet vechevan sheggalu bechurban rishon batla kedushshat are choma shehau bime yehoshua kevan sheala ezra babbia hashsheniyya nitkaddeshu kal hearim hammukkafot choma beoto haet mippene shebbiatan bime ezra shehi bia sheniyya keviatan bime yehoshua ma biatan bime yehoshua manu shemittin veovlot vekiddeshu batte are choma venitchayevu bemaaser af biatam bime ezra manu shemittin veovlot vekiddeshu batte are choma venitchayevu bemaaser

Vechen leatid lavo bevia shelishit beet sheyyikkansu laaretz yatchilu limnot shemittin veovlot vikaddeshu batte are choma veyitchayyev kal makom sheyyichbeshuhu bemaasrot shenneemar veheviacha Adonai elohecha el haaretz asher yarshu avotecha virishtah makkish yerushshatcha lirushshat avotecha ma yerushshat avotecha atta noheg bah bechiddush kal haddevarim haellu af yerushshatcha atta noheg bah bechiddush kal haddevarim haellu

Shevet levi af al pi sheen lahem chelek baaretz kevar nitztauu yisrael litten lahem arim lashevet umigreshehem vehearim hem shesh are miklat vaalehen shettayim vearbaim ir uchshemmosifin are miklat acherot bime hammashiach hakkol lalviyyim

Migreshe hearim kevar nitparshu battora shehem sheloshet alafim amma lechal ruach mikkir hair vechutza shenneemar mikkir hair vachutza elef amma saviv ulhallan hu omer umaddotem michutz lair et peat kedma alpayim baamma vego elef harishonim migrash vealpayim shemmoddin chutz lammigrash lesadot uchramim
Venotnin lechal ir bet hakkevarot chutz litchum ze sheen kovrin metehem litchum arehem shenneemar umigreshehem yihu livhemtam velirchusham ulchol chayyatam lechayyim nittenu velo likvura
En osin beare halviyyim ir migrash velo migrash ir velo migrash sade velo sade migrash shenneemar usde migrash arehem lo yimmacher
Vmippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar lo yimmacher lo yeshune ella hassade vehammigrash vehair kal echad mishshelashtan kemot shehu leolam vechen bishar are yisrael
Lo yistor adam et beto laasoto ginna velo yitta churbato ginna shello yacharivu eretz yisrael

Kohanim ulviyyim shemmachru sade missede arehem o bayit mibbatte are choma shellahen en goalin kasseder hazze ella mochrin hassadot vaafillu samuch layyovel vegoalin miyyad veim hikdishu sade goalim miyyad hahekdesh leachar hayyovel vegoalim batte are choma kal zeman sheyyirtzu afillu achar kamma shanim shenneemar geullat olam tihye lalviyyim
Yisrael sheyyarash et avi immo levi hare ze goel kilviyyim af al pi sheeno levi hoil vehearim o hassadot shel leviyyim goel leolam sheddin ze taluy bimkomot ellu velo babbealim
Velevi sheyyarash et avi immo yisrael goel keyisrael velo kilviyyim shello neemar geullat olam tihye lalviyyim ella beare halviyyim

Kal shevet levi muzharin shello yinchalu beeretz kenaan vechen hen muzharin shello yittelu chelek babbizzah beshaa shekkovshin et hearim shenneemar lo yihye lakkohanim halviyyim kal shevet levi chelek venachala im yisrael chelek babbizza venachala baaretz vechen hu omer beartzam lo tinchal vechelek lo yihye lecha betocham babbizza uven levi o kohen shennatal chelek babbizza loke veim natal nachala baaretz maavirin otah mimmennu

Yerae li sheen haddevarim amurim ella baaretz shennichreta aleha berit leavraham leyitzchak ulyaakov virashuha benehem venitchalleka lahem aval shear kal haaratzot shekkovesh melech mimmalche yisrael hare hakkohanim vehalviyyim beotan haaratzot uvvizzatan kechal yisrael

Velamma lo zacha levi benachalat eretz yisrael uvvizzatah im echav mippene shehuvdal laavod et Adonai lesharto ulhorot derachav hayesharim umishpatav hatztzaddikim larabbim shenneemar yoru mishpatecha leyaakov vetoratcha leyisrael lefichach huvdelu middarche haolam lo orchin milchama kishar yisrael velo nochalin velo zochin leatzman bechoach gufan ella hem chel hashshem shenneemar barech Adonai chelo vehu baruch hu zoche lahem shenneemar ani chelkecha venachalatcha

Velo shevet levi bilvad ella kal ish veish mikkal bae haolam asher nadva rucho oto vehevino maddao lehibbadel laamod lifne Adonai lesharto ulavdo ledea et Adonai vehalach yashar kemo sheasahu haelohim ufarak meal tzavaro ol hacheshbonot harabbim asher bikkeshu bene haadam hare ze nitkaddesh kodesh kadashim veyihye Adonai chelko venachalato leolam ulolme olamim veyizke lo baolam hazze davar hammaspik lo kemo shezzacha lakkohanim lalviyyim hare david alav hashshalom omer Adonai menat chelki vechosi atta tomich gorali
Mishneh Torah, Second Tithes and Fourth: Achar shemmafrishin maaser rishon bechal shana mafrishin maaser sheni shenneemar asser teasser et kal tevuat zarecha uvshana shelishit veshishshit mafrishin maasar ani chelef maaser sheni kemo shebbearnu

Beechad betishre hu rosh hashshana lemaasar tevuot vekitniyyot virakot vechal makom shenneemar rosh hashshana hu echad betishre uvtv bishvat hu rosh hashshana lemaasar hailanot ketzad tevua vekitniyyot shehiggiu leonat hammaasrot lifne rosh hashshana shel shelishit af al pi shennigmeru veneesfu bashshelishit mafrishin mehen maaser sheni veim lo bau leonat hammaasrot ella leachar rosh hashshana shel shelishit mafrishin mehen maasar ani vechen perot hailan shebbau leonat hammaasrot kodem bishvat shel shelishit af al pi shennigmeru veneesfu achar ken besof shana shelishit mitasserin lesheavar umafrishin mehen maaser sheni vechen im bau leonat hammaasrot kodem bishvat shel reviit af al pi shennigmeru veneesfu birviit mafrishin mehen maaser ani veim bau leonat hammaasrot achar bishvat mitasserin lehabba

Vehecharuvin af al pi shechantu perotehen kodem bishvat mitasserin lehabba hoil umitasserot middivre sofrim yerae li sheen haddevarim amurin ella becharuve tzalmona vechayyotze bahen sheen reuyin lemaachal rov haadam vehen hen shemmitasserot middivre sofrim aval shear hecharuvin yerae li shehen kishar perot hailan

Hayyarak bishat lekitato issuro ketzad im nilkat beom rosh hashshana shel shelishit af al pi shebba leonat hammaasrot venigmar bashsheniyya mafrishin mimmennu maasar ani veim nilkat barviit maaser sheni

Vechen haetrog bilvad mishshear perot hailan hare hu keyarak veholchin achar lekitato ben lemaaser ben lishviit ketzad im nilkat bashshelishit achar bishvat mafrishin mimmennu maasar ani af al pi shennigmera bashsheniyya vechen im nilkat barviit kodem bishvat mafrishin mimmennu maasar ani nilkat barviit achar bishvat mafrishin mimmennu maaser sheni
Veaf al pi sheholchin achar lekitato etrog bat shishshit shennichnesa lashsheviit afillu hayeta kezayit venaaset kechikkar chayyevet bemaasrot

Haevonot shel tzalaf notnin alehen chumre ilan vechumre zeraim sheim hau mishshana sheniyya shennichnesa lashshelishit venilketu kodem bishvat mafrishin maaser rishon veachar kach mafrish maaser acher ufodehu veachar sheppodehu notno laaniyyim veochel pidono betorat maaser sheni venimtza kemo shehifrish maaser sheni umaasar ani

Haorez vehaddochan vehapperagin vehashshumshemin af al pi shehishrishu kodem rosh hashshana en holchin bahen ella achar gemar happeri umitasserin lehabba vechen pol hammitzri af al pi shemmiktzato hishrish lifne rosh hashshana umiktzato leacharav tzover garno letocho vetorem umasser min hakkol keechad shehakkol holech achar gemar happeri

Habbetzalim hassarisim shemmana mehem mayim sheloshim yom lifne rosh hashshana veshel baal shemmana mehem shalosh onot lifne rosh hashshana mitasserin lesheavar mana mehem pachot mikkan af al pi shehitchilu livash kodem rosh hashshana mitasserin lehabba

Pol hammitzri shehevi shelish lifne rosh hashshana im zerao lezera mitasser lesheavar zerao leyarak mitasser lehabba zaro lezera ulyarak o shezzerao lezera vechishshev alav leyarak measser mizzaro al yerako umirako al zaro lo hevi shelish lifne rosh hashshana im zerao lezera zaro mitasser lesheavar virako bishat lekitato issuro vehu shellikket mimmennu lifne rosh hashshana aval im likket mimmennu achar rosh hashshana ben yerako ben zaro mitasser lehabba zerao lezera vechishshev alav leyarak holchin achar machashavto zerao leyarak vechishshev alav lezara en machashevet zera chala alav ella im ken mana mimmennu shalosh araot vehu shehevi shelish lifne rosh hashshana aval im lo hevi shelish ella leacharav af al pi shello nimna milleerot mimmennu shalosh araot zaro lezera veasa kullo katztzatzin gemurim lifne rosh hashshana zaro mitasser lesheavar virako bishat lekitato miktzato asa katztzatzin gemurin umiktzato lo asa ze sheamru tzover garno letocho venimtza measser mizzaro al yerako umirako al zaro

Perot shana sheniyya shennitarvu beferot shelishit o shel shelishit birviit holchin achar harov mechetza lemechetza mafrish maaser sheni min hakkol aval lo maasar ani shemmaaser sheni chamur shehare hu kodesh umaasar ani chol vechen perot shehen safek im perot sheniyya hem o perot shelishit mafrish mehen maaser sheni

Kal happetur mimmaaser rishon patur min hashsheni umin heani vechal shechayyav berishon chayyav bishnehem vechal hattorem motzi maaser vechal sheeno torem eno motzi maaser ze kal mi sheim taram terumato teruma kach im isser maaser ze hare hu maaser vechal mi sheen terumato teruma kach im hotzi maaser ze eno maaser

Perot shehotzi mehen maaser rishon kodem sheyyikkavu lammaaser hare ze ochel mehen aray kodem sheyyotzi maaser sheni sheen harishon kovea lashsheni aval mishshennikbeu lemaaser af al pi shehotzi et harishon asur leechol mehen aray ad sheyyotzi et hashsheni o et maasar ani

Maaser sheni hoil vetaun havaat makom en meviin oto michutza laaretz kivchor behema lefichach lo chiyevu lehafrish maaser sheni besurya veyerae li shemmaaser sheni shemmafrishim beeretz shinar uvmitzrayim podin oto umviin damav lirushalayim vechen yerae li shello chiyevu mekomot ellu bemaaser sheni ella kede likboa maaser ani kede sheyyihu aniyye yisrael somchim alehem

Maaser sheni neechal livalav lefanim mechomat yerushalayim shenneemar veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha bammakom asher yivchar leshakken shemo sham vego venoheg bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit aval eno neechal birushalayim ella bifne habbayit shenneemar masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvchorot bekarcha vetzoncha mippi hashshemua lamdu ma bechor eno neechal ella bifne habbayit af maaser sheni lo yeachel ella bifne habbayit

Middat chasidut sheppodin maaser sheni bazzeman hazze beshaveo kederech sheppodin oto bifne habbayit vehoru haggeonim sheim ratza lifdot sheve mane bifruta lechattechilla bazzeman hazze pode lo yihye ze chamur min hakkodesh umashlich happeruta layyam haggadol

Vechen im chillel maaser sheve mane al sheve peruta mipperot acherot hare ze mechullal vesoref et happerot shechillel alehem kede shello yihu takkala laacherim kefidon neta revai bazzeman hazze kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure maachalot

Keshem sheen ochlin maaser sheni bazzeman hazze birushalayim kach en podin oto sham veen mechallelin oto veen mochrin oto veim nichnas birushalayim af bazzeman hazze en motziin oto mishsham umannichim oto sham ad sheyyerakev vechen im avar vehotzio mishsham mannichin oto ad sheyyerakev lefichach en mafrishim maaser sheni birushalayim bazzeman hazze ella motziin et happerot betivlan chutz lair umafrishin oto sham ufodehu veim hifrishu sham bazzeman hazze yerakev

Kal haochel kezayit maaser sheni o sheshshata mimmennu reviit yayin chutz lechomat yerushalayim loke shenneemar lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha vego veloke al kal echad veechad bifne atzmo lefichach im achal shelashtan chutz lachoma loke shalosh malkiyyot shenneemar veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha veneemar lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha vego lamma peratan velo amar lo tochlem bisharecha lechayyev al kal echad veechad bifne atzmo

Eno loke min hattora ad sheyyochlennu achar shennichnas lechomat yerushalayim shenneemar lo tuchal leechol bisharecha vego veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha kevan shennichnas limkom achilato vaachalo bachutz loke aval im achalo kodem sheyyikkansu lirushalayim makkin oto makkat mardut middivrehem
Miktzat maaser bifnim umiktzato mibbachutz haochel mizze sheadayin lo nichnas makkin oto makkat mardut vehaochel bachutz mizze shennichnas loke

En podin maaser sheni birushalayim ella im ken nitma shenneemar ki yirchak mimmecha hammakom berichuk makom hu nifde veeno nifde bekeruv makom haya hu bifnim umassao bachutz afillu haya ochez oto bekane hoil velo nichnas hammaaser hare ze muttar lifdoto sham betzad hachoma

Maaser sheni shennichnas lirushalayim afillu shel demay asur lehotzio mishsham shekkevar kelatuhu mechitztzot vechen perot hannilkachin bechesef maaser shenneemar veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha avar vehotzian o sheyyatzu bishgaga yachzeru veyeachlu birushalayim uklitat mechitztzot middivrehem afillu maaser sheen bechumsho sheve peruta shehu middivrehem mechitztzot koltot oto veasur lehotzio aval meot maaser sheni nichnasin lirushalayim veotzin

Perot shennigmera melachtan veavru betoch yerushalayim veyatzu eno yachol lehotzi alehen maaser sheni mipperot acherot shello nichnesu lirushalayim ella yachazor maaser sheni shellahen veyeachel birushalayim veeno nifde bachutz afillu asa kal happerot haellu maaser sheni achar sheyyatzu al perot acherot shello nichnesu yachzeru veyeachlu birushalayim chomer hu bimchitztzot yerushalayim hoil vekaltu kaltu

Perot shello nigmera melachtan sheavru birushalayim veyatzu kegon salle anavim legat vesalle teenim bemuktze muttar lifdot maaser sheni shellahem bachutz vechen perot demay af al pi shennigmera melachtan veavru birushalayim veyatzu podin maaser sheni shellahen bachutz

Perot maaser sheni shennitmeu birushalayim ufdaan im nitmeu bivelad hattuma asur lehotzian ella yeachlu bifnim mippene shevvelad hattuma middivrehem veim nitmeu beav hattuma o shennitmeu bachutz vaafillu bivelad hattuma af al pi shennichnesu lirushalayim hare ellu nifdin veneechalin bechal makom

Bamme devarim amurim keshehichnisan al menat shello titpesem hammechitztzot aval im lo hitna hoil venichnas hare hu tahor min hattora sheen valad metamme sheni min hattora uchvar kelatuhu mechitztzot veeno yotze

Tiltan shel maaser sheni muttar leachlah tzimchonin shekkach hi reuya laachila vechen karshine maaser sheni yeachlu tzimchonin veim asa mehem issa hare zo mutteret lehikkanes lirushalayim ulhotziah sheenan bichlal happerot veim nitmeu birushalayim yippadu veyeachlu bachutz
Ilan sheomed lefanim min hachoma venofo note chutz lachoma en ochlin tachat nofo maaser sheni umaaser sheni shennichnas tachat nofo en podin oto shehare hu kemi shennichnas lirushalayim

Battim shebbetzad hachoma sheppitchehem lefanim min hachoma vachalalan lechutz mikkeneged hachoma ulfanim kilfanim lechal davar umikkeneged hachoma velachutz en ochlim sham veen podin sham lehachamir haya chalalan lefanim ufitchehem lachutz mikkeneged hachoma velachutz kelachutz podin bo veen ochlin umikkeneged hachoma velifnim en ochlin sham veen podin lehachamir vehachallonot vaovi hachoma kilfanim

Haochel maaser sheni betuma loke shenneemar velo viarti mimmennu betame ben shehammaaser tame vehaochel tahor ben shehammaaser tahor vehaochel tame vehu sheyyochlennu birushalayim kodem sheyyippade sheeno loke al achilato betuma ella bimkom achilato aval im achalo betuma chutz lirushalayim makkin oto makkat mardut
Vaafillu lehadlik bo et hanner achar shennitma asur ad sheyyippade shenneemar lo viarti mimmennu betame

Kevar bearnu shehammaaser shennitma afillu birushalayim podin veyeachel veochlin et damav betahora betorat perot maaser kemo sheyyitbaer afillu nitmeu happerot kullan keshehen tevel mafrish maaser sheni betuma ufodehu

Hearel ketame veim achal maaser sheni loke min hattora kederech shelloke al achilat teruma shehatteruma keruya kodesh umaaser sheni karuy kodesh shehare neemar bo kodesh la vetame shettaval ochel maaser sheni af al pi shello heeriv shimsho

Haochel maaser sheni baaninut shel tora loke shenneemar lo achalti veoni mimmennu vehu sheyyochlennu bemakom achilato birushalayim aval im achalo bachutz baaninut o sheachalo bifnim baaninut shel divrehem makkin oto makkat mardut

Ezehu onen ze hammitabbel al echad min hakkerovim shehu chayyav lehitabbel alehen uvom hammita hu onen min hattora uvallayela onen middivrehen shenneemar veachalti chattat hayyom hayyitav beene Adonai hayyom asur velayela muttar nishtaha hammet yamim rabbim veachar kach nikbar kal otan hayyamim sheachar yom hammita ad yom hakkevura hu onen middivrehen veen yom hakkevura tofes lelo
Velo maaser sheni bilvad ella kal hakkadashim kullan im achalan baaninut shel tora loke uvaaninut shel divrehen makkin oto makkat mardut

En notnin perot maaser sheni leam haaretz velo perot hannilkachot bimot maaser velo meot maaser mippene shehu bechezkat tuma umuttar leechol maaser sheni shel demay baaninut velitteno leam haaretz vehu sheyyochal kenegdo en mafkidin maaser sheni afillu etzel chaver shemma yamut venimtza hammaaser tachat yad beno am haaretz aval mafkidim maaser sheni shel demay etzel am haaretz

Maaser sheni asur leabbed afillu miuto badderachim ella molicho kal shehu o molich damav lirushalayim umuttar leabbed miut maaser sheni shel demay badderachim vechamma hi miut pachot mikkigrogeret ben beochel shalem ben befarus aval kigrogeret en meabbedin oto vehammafrish maaser sheni shel demay pachot mikkigrogeret hare ze notno leam haaretz veochel kenegdo aval lo yafrishennu lechattechilla leabbedo sheen mafrishin leabbed

Maaser sheni nittan laachila ushtiyya shenneemar veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha vesicha kishtiyya veasur lehotzio bishar tzerachav kegon likkach bo kelim uvgadim vaavadim shenneemar lo natatti mimmennu lemet kelomar lo hotzeti oto bedavar sheeno mekayyem et hagguf veim hotzi mimmennu bishar devarim afillu bidvar mitzva kegon shellakach mimmennu aron vetachrichin lemet mitzva hare ze ochel kenegdo betorat maaser

Maaser ochel davar sheddarko leheachel veshote davar sheddarko lishtot vesach davar sheddarko lasuch velo yasuch yayin vechometz aval sach hu et hashshemen velo yischot et happerot lehotzi mehen mashkin chutz mizzetim vaanavim bilvad veen mefattemin et hashshemen aval mefattemin et hayyayin veen mechayevin oto leechol pat sheippesha veshemen shennisrach ella kevan shennifsal meochel adam paka kedushsha mimmennu

Kal shemmuttar lezarim leachlo bitruma kach muttar bemaaser sheni leachlo betorat chullin shemarim shel maaser sheni shennatan alehem mayim rishon asur kemaaser vesheni muttar kechullin veshel demay afillu rishon muttar
Yayin shel maaser shennafal letocho devash vehattavlin vehishbichu hashshevach lefi cheshbon vechen dagim shennitbashshelu im kaflotot shel maaser sheni vehishbichu hashshevach lefi cheshbon

Issa shel maaser sheni sheafaah vehishbicha hashshevach lashsheni ze hakkelal kal sheshshivcho nikkar im hotir bemidda hashshevach lefi cheshbon veim lo hotir hammidda hashshevach lashsheni bilvad vechal sheen shivcho nikkar afillu hotir hammidda hashshevach lashsheni bilvad

Ketzad hashshevach lefi cheshbon yayin shel maaser sheshshave shelosha shennafal letocho devash vetavlin shave zuz echad vehosifa bemiddato vehishbichuhu vahare hakkol shave chamishsha choshvin hakkol bearbaa urvia vechen al derech ze bishar haddevarim
Maaser sheni af al pi shennittan lesicha en notnin oto lo al gabbe tzinit velo al gabbe chazazit veen osin mimmennu kamea vechayyotze bo shehare lo nittan lirfua

Maaser sheni mamon gavoha hu shenneemar la hu lefichach eno nikne bemattana ella im ken natan lo hattevel vehamkabbel mafrish hammaaser veen mekaddeshin bo et haishsha veen mochrin oto veen memashkenin oto veen machlifin oto veen marhinin oto

Ketzad en memashkenin oto lo yikkanes leveto vimashkenennu maaser sheni shello avar umishkeno motziin oto miyyado ketzad en marhinin oto lo yomar lo he lecha maaser ze veyihye beyadcha veten li alav maot ketzad en machlifin oto lo yomar lo he lecha yen maaser veten li shemen maaser aval omer lo he lecha yayin sheen li shemen veim ratza chavero litten lo shemen muttar shehare lo hechelif immo ella hodio sheen lo veim ratza halla litten yitten

Maaser sheni en shoklin kenegdo afillu dinre zahav vaafillu lechallel alehem maaser sheni acher gezera shemma lo yechaven mimmennu mishkalo venimtzeu happerot chaserim vehu shokel bahen maot lechallel alehem maaser acher nimtza motzi maaser lechullin befachot bedamav

Haachim shechalku maaser sheni en shoklin ze keneged ze vechen meot maaser sheni en shoklim kenegdan veen mochrin otam veen machlifin velo marhinin velo yittenem leshulchani lehitnaot bahen velo yalve otan lehitgaddel bahen veim hilvan shello yaale chaludda muttar

Veen porin mehem et hammilve en osin mehen shoshvinut veen meshallemin mehen haggemulin veen poskin mehem tzedaka bevet hakkeneset aval meshallemin mehen devarim shehen gemilut chasadim vetzarich lehodia

Lo yomar adam lachavero haal et happerot haellu lirushalayim vetol mehen chelkecha shennimtza ze kenotel sachar mimmaaser sheni al havaato lirushalayim aval omer lo halem shennochlem veshennishtem birushalayim
Omer adam lachavero birushalayim lasuch oto beshemen maaser sheni af al pi shennissocha yado veen ze bischar sichato
Kevar bearnu shehammaaser mamon gavoha hu lefichach anu omrim shehaggonev maaser sheni eno meshallem tashlume kefel vehaggozlo eno meshallem chomesh
Hammakdish maaser sheni shello levedek habbayit hare ze pode oto mi sheppodehu al menat litten lahekdesh et shello ulmaaser sheni et shello

Harotze lifdot perot maaser sheni pode otan bidmehen veomer hare hammaot haellu tachat happerot haellu o happerot haellu mechullalot al hammaot haellu veim lo peresh ella hifrish maot bilvad keneged happerot dayyo veeno tzarich lefaresh veyetzu happerot lechullin veyaalu hammaot lirushalayim veotziem sham shenneemar vechi yirbe mimmecha hadderech ki lo tuchal seeto

Vechen im ratza lechallel perot hammaaser al perot acherot yaalu happerot hashsheniyyot veyeachlu birushalayim velo yechallel mimmin al sheeno mino velo min hayyafe al hara vaafillu beoto hammin veim chillel hare hen mechullalot

Happode maaser sheni mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al pidon maaser sheni veim chillelan al perot acherot o shechillel maot al happerot mevarech al chillul maaser sheni vehappode o hamchallel maaser sheni shel demay eno tzarich beracha
Kesheppodin et hammaaser en podin oto leshem maaser ella leshem chullin veomrin kamma shavin perot chullin ellu veaf al pi shehakkol yodin shehen maaser kede shello yitbazze

En mechallelin meot maaser sheni al maot acherot ben shehau ellu veellu kesef o ellu veellu nechoshet o harishonot kesef vehashsheniyyot nechoshet o harishonot nechoshet vehashsheniyyot kesef veim avar vechillel hare ellu mechullalin

En mechallelin maot maaser al happerot veim chillel yaalu happerot veyeachlu birushalayim velo yechallelem al behema chayya veof chayyin veim chillel lo kana maaser shemma yegaddel mehem adarim adarim aval im chillel al shechutim hare hen kishar happerot veyaalu veyeachlu birushalayim veyetzu hammaot lechullin
Bishat haddechak muttar lechallel maot hakkesef al shel nechoshet lo sheyekayyem ken ella ad sheyyimtza revach veyachazor vichallel maot hannechoshet al maot hakkesef
Maaser sheni shel demay mechallelim oto lechattechilla kesef al kesef vechesef al nechoshet unchoshet al nechoshet unchoshet al happerot veyaalu otan happerot veyeachlu birushalayim

En podin perot maaser ella bechesef shenneemar vetzarta hakkesef vechen im pada leatzmo vehosif chomesh lo yihye hachomesh ella kesef kakkeren veen podin bechesef sheeno matbea ella bechesef mefuttach sheyyesh alav tzura o ketav shenneemar vetzarta hakkesef veim pada belashon shel kesef vechayyotze bo vehu hannikra asimon lo asa kelum veen podin befachot mipperuta mippene shehu kefode baasimon
En podin bematbea sheeno yotze beoto zeman uvoto makom shenneemar venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teave nafshecha ad sheyyihye rauy lehotzaa umatbea melachim harishonim im yotze mishshemam podin bo
Eno pode bemaot sheenan birshuto shenneemar vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha nafal kiso levor vehu yachol lehotzio pode bo mippene shehu birshuto

Haya ba badderech umaot beyado veannas ba kenegdo im yachol lehatztzil al yede haddechak pode bahen perot shebbeveto veim lav veamar perot sheyyesh li betoch beti mechullalin al hammaot hallalu lo amar kelum
Hammeniach maot lihot mechallel alehen maaser sheni hare ze pode bahen bechezkat shehen kayyamim metzaan sheavdu choshesh lechal ma sheppada bahen lemafrea
Mi shehaya omed bitverya veyesh lo maot bavel bevavel eno mechallel alehem hau lo maot mimmatbea teverya bevavel mechallel alehem vechen kal kayyotze baze
Haomer maaser sheni mechullal al sela shettaale beyadi mikkis ze al sela sheefrot middinar zahav ze al pundeon sheefrot missela ze hare ze chillel vesela shettaale beyado o sheyyifrot tehi maaser
Amar hare maaser mechullal al sela shehayeta beyad beni lo chillel shemma lo hayeta beyado beotah shaa

Happode maaser sheni kodem sheyyafrishennu kegon sheamar maaser sheni shel perot ellu paduy bemaot ellu lo amar kelum velo kava maaser aval im kava veamar maaser sheni shellahen batztzafon o baddarom mechullal al hammaot ellu hare ze paduy

Kesheppodin maaser sheni podin oto beshaveo veyesh lo lifdot bashshaar hazzol kemot shehachenvani lokeach velo kemot shehu mocher venoten hammaot kemot shehashshulchani poret lo kemot shehu metzaref veim avar ufada sheve mane bifruta o chillel sheve mane al sheve peruta hare ze mechullal
Hayeta hassela chasera shetut o pachot mishshetut im hayeta yotzet al yede haddechak mechallel aleha lechattechilla bishve sela veeno choshesh pada besela venimtzet raa yachalifenna

En podin maaser sheni achsara ella medakdek bemiddato o bemishkalo venoten damav im hau damav yeduim yippade al pi echad veim davar sheen damav yeduim kegon yayin shehitchil lehachamitz uferot shehirkivu o maot shehechelidu yippade al pi shelosha taggarim vaafillu haya echad mehen akkum o baal hammaaser afillu ish ushte nashav podin al pihem vechofin et habbealim liftoach rishon veze chomer bemaaser min hahekdesh

En molichin perot maaser mimmakom lemakom lifdotam sham vehammolich mimmekom hayyoker lammakom hazzol o mimmakom hazzol limkom hayyoker pode keshaar mekom happediyya veim hau demay podin oto kashshaar hazzol hoil veniru lehimmacher bezol
Hau lo perot maaser sheni baggoren vehotzi alehem yetziot mibbeto ad shehevian lair vehishbichu pode keshaar hair vehifsid yetziotav

Happode maasro leatzmo ben shehu shello ben shennafal lo birushsha ben shennittan lo betivlo mattana kemo shebbearnu hare ze mosif alav chomesh im haya shave arbaa noten chamishsha shenneemar veim gal yigal ish mimmaasro chamishito yosef alav
Veishsha sheppadat maaser sheni shellah leatzmah enah mosifa chomesh mippi hashshemua lamdu ish mimmaasro velo ishsha vechen im pada pidon perot hammaaser leatzmo mosif chomesh
Pada perot maasro vehosif chomesh vechazar ufada happidon leatzmo paam sheniyya mosif chomesh sheni al hakkeren bilvad veeno mosif chomesh al hachomesh

Maaser sheni sheen bechumsho sheve peruta eno mosif alav chomesh vechen maaser sheen damav yeduin dayyo sheyyomar hu vechumsho mechullal al hassela hazze vechal maaser shehu eno podehu mishshello eno mosif chomesh umaaser sheni shel demay eno mosif alav chomesh
Happode maaser sheni vehaya lo maaser sheni acher shello nifda im en bechumsho sheve peruta dayyo sheyyomar hu vechumsho mechullal al maot harishonot lefi shei efshar leadam letzamtzem et meotav
Happode maaser beoter al damav lo nitpesa hattosefet lamaaser
Baal habbayit omer besela veacher omer besela baal habbayit kodem mippene shehu mosif chomesh baal habbayit omer besela veacher omer besela ufruta haacher kodem mippene shemmosif al hakkeren

Muttar lehaarim al pidon maasro ketzad omer livno ulvitto haggedolim ulavdo haivri he lecha et hammaot haellu ufde lecha bahen hammaaser kede shello yosif chomesh aval lo yomar lo pede li bahen vechen im amar lo pede li mishshellecha eno mosif chomesh

Aval lo yitten hammaot lifdot livno ulvitto hakketannim ulavdo veshifchato hakkenaanim mippene sheyyadan keyado natan leshifchato haivriyya im maaser sheni ze middivrehem kegon shehaya meatzitz sheeno nakuv devarav kayyamin sheama haivriyya ketanna hi veen hakkatan zoche laacherim ella bedavar shehu middivrehem
Vechen maarim venoten hammaaser mattana keshehu betivlo veomer hannoten hare happerot haellu mechullalin al maot shebbabbayit

Shene achin o shene shuttafin av uvno podin ze laze maaser sheni kede shello yosif chomesh ishsha shehichnisa levalah maaser sheni hoil vehu mamon gavoha kemo shebbearnu lo kana baal lefichach im padahu eno mosif chomesh

Happode maaser sheni leatzmo venatan et hakkeren velo natan et hachomesh af al pi sheen hachomesh meakkev vahare nitchallel lo yochal ad sheyyitten hachomesh vaafillu beshabbat gezera shemma yifsha velo yitten
Maot maaser sheni im ratza letzarfam bedinre zahav kede lehakel massaan metzarfan veim tzerfan leatzmo eno mosif chomesh sheen ze derech pediyya
Happoret sela mimmeot maaser sheni ben birushalayim ben chutz lirushalayim lo yetzarfenna kullah bemaot nechoshet ella beshekel maot kesef uvshekel maot nechoshet

Muttar lechallel kesef maaser im perot maaser al hakkesef vehu sheyehu bapperot pachot mishsheve dinar aval im haya bahen sheve dinar lo yechallelem im hakkesef ella bifne atzman ketzad hau lo perot sheve dinar ushlosha dinarin shel maaser sheni eno mechallel hakkol al sela achat aval im haya lo chatzi dinar perot vachatzi dinar maot mechallel shenehem al dinar echad

Meot chullin umot maaser shennitpazzeru velikket mikan umikan ma shellikket likket lemaaser ad sheyyashlim vehashshear chullin veim balal vechafan o shellikket mitztzad echad umatza chaser hare ze lefi cheshbon ketzad hau matayim maaser sheni umea chullin nitpazzeru uvlalan vechafan hakkol nimtzeu matayim veshivim hare mea ushmonim mehen maaser vetishim chullin ze hakkelal hammitlakketin lemaaser sheni vehannivlalin lefi cheshbon matne veomer im ellu shebbeyadi hen hammaaser hashshear chullin veim hen chullin hare meot hammaaser bechal makom shehen mechullalin alehem

Sela shel maaser sheni veshel chulliyin shennitarvu mevi bassela maot vaafillu meot nechoshet veomer sela shel maaser sheni bechal makom shehi mechullelet al hammaot haellu veachar kach borer et hayyafe shebbishtehen umchallel hammaot shel nechoshet aleha vetachazor hassela hayyafa lemaaser

Haomer livno maaser sheni bezavit zo venimtza bezavit acheret hare ellu chullin amar lo hare sham mane venimtza matayim hashshear chullin hare sham matayim venimtza mane hare hu chullin hinniach mane maaser venimtza matayim matayim venimtza mane afillu hen bishne kisin hakkol chullin
Amar lo aviv kis maaser sheni li babbayit halach umatza sham shelosha kisim haggadol shebbechullan maaser vehashshear chullin veaf al pi chen lo yochal min hakketannim ad sheyechallelem al haggadol
Mi shennishtattek veamru lo maaser sheni shellecha bemakom peloni vehirkin berosho bodkin oto shalosh peamim kederech shebbodkin legittin vahare devarav kayyamin
Amru lo bachalom maaser sheni shel avicha sheatta mevakkesh hare hu bemakom peloni af al pi shemmatza sham ma shenneemar lo eno maaser divre chalomot lo maalin velo moridin

Haomer levanav afillu attem metim al tiggeu bezavit zo venimtzeu sham maot hare ellu chullin taman maot mippenehem veamar lahem shel peloni hen o shel maaser sheni hen im kemaarim en choshshin lidvarav veim kemitkaven devarav kayyamin
Hammotze keli vechatuv alav hare ma shebbetocho maaser sheni demay tevel teruma karban veim haya shel mattechet hu uma shebbetocho karban shekken hau kotvin ot achat min hashshem bishat hassakkana

Maot hannimtzaot birushalayim afillu dinre zahav im hakkesef veim hammaot hare ellu chullin hoil veshuke yerushalayim mitkabbedin bechal yom matza betochan cheres vechatuv bo maaser hare ellu maaser sheni bamme devarim amurim bishar yemot hashshana aval baregel hakkol maaser

Maot hannimtzaot lifne sochare behema birushalayim leolam maaser shechezkat rov haam meviin meot maaser vekonin bo behemot vehannimtzaot behar habbayit leolam chullin shechezkatan mitterumat hallishka shechillelum haggizbarin al behema
Teva shennishtammesh bah chullin umaaser sheni venimtza betochah maot im rov mannichin maaser hare hammaot maaser veim rov mannichin chullin chullin mechetza lemechetza chullin

Matza perot ben perot maaser leferot teruma yippelu lakkarov mechetza lemechetza yeachlu kechumre shenehen asurin lezarim utunin rechitzat yadayim vehaarev shemesh kitruma vaasurim leonen utunim havaat makom kemaaser vechen hammaot hannimtzaot ben chullin lemaaser
Maaser sheni shel demay veshel vadday shennitarvu yeachlu kechamur shebbahen

Perot maaser shennitarvu beferot chullin yochal hakkol betahora bammakom o yifde et hammaaser lefichach im nitarvu birushalayim asurin bechal shehen keminyan hoil vehu birushalayim hare hu kedavar sheyyesh lo mattirin veyeachel hakkol betahora
Hazzorea maaser sheni achar shennichnas lirushalayim haggiddulim maaser sheni zerao kodem sheyyikkanes haggiddulin chullin vaafillu bedavar sheen zaro kale ufodin oto bishat zeriato

Maaser sheni batel berov beeze maaser amru bemaaser shennichnas lirushalayim veyatza venaflu mechitztzot shehare en sham mechitztzot lehachaziro lesham vei efshar lifdoto meachar shennichnas veaf al pi sheen bo sheve peruta venimtza davar sheen lo mattirin uvatel berov kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure maachalot
Perot hannilkachot bechesef maaser sheni enan nifdin berichuk makom ella im ken nitmeu beav hattuma ella yaalu hen atzman veyeachlu birushalayim
Ze chomer belakuach bechesef maaser mipperot maaser atzman veim nitma bivelad hattuma middivrehem yippadu veyeachlu birushalayim
En nilkach bechesef maaser ella maachal adam sheggiddulav min haaretz o giddule giddulav min haaretz kegon happerat hamforash battora babbakar uvatztzon uvayyayin uvashshechar

Lefichach en lokchin bechesef maaser mayim umelach kemehin ufitriyyot lefi sheen giddulehem min haaretz velo perot mechubbarin lakkarka velo perot sheenan yecholim lehaggia lirushalayim lefi sheenan domin levakar vatzon
Haddevash vehabbetzim vehechalav hare hen kevakar vatzon sheaf al pi sheenan giddule karka hare hen giddule gidduleha
Hattemed ad shello hechmitz eno nilkach bechesef maaser mippene shehu kemayim umishshehechmitz nilkach kayyayin uchshechar lekacho ad shello hechmitz vehechemitz kana maaser
Bamme devarim amurim benatan shelosha mayim umatza pachot mearbaa aval im natan shelosha vehotzi arbaa hare ze keyayin mazug venilkach bechesef maaser

Lulve zeradin vehecharuvin ad shello yamtiku en nilkachin achar sheyyamtiku nilkachin aval halluf vehachardal vehatturmusin ushar kal hannichbashim ben mishsheyyamtiku ben ad shello himtiku nilkachin vehakkor nilkach bechesef maaser

Hakkarkom eno nilkach sheeno ella lemare vechen kal kayyotze bo minnotne reach umare vetaam hoil veenan laachilat gufan ella letaam shennotnin enan nilkachin bechesef maaser lefichach rashe besamim vehappilpelin vehakkoshte vehachiltit vechallot charia vechal kayyotze baellu enan nilkachin bechesef maaser

Hashshevet im litten taam bikdera enah nilkachat bechesef maaser veim lichmach vechayyotze bo shehu ochel gufah nilkachat bechesef maaser erev mayim umelach im natan letocho shemen hare hen kemuryas velokeach mehen bechesef maaser umavlia deme hammayim vehammelach bidme hashshemen

En lokchin terumot bechesef maaser mippene shehu memaet achilato vaachilatah sheen ochlin otah ella kohanim meorve shemesh umutteret leonen veneechelet bechal makom vehammaaser muttar lezarim velitvul yom veasur leonen veeno neechal ella birushalayim nimtza memaet achilat maaser vaachilat hatteruma

En lokchin perot sheviit bechesef maaser lefi shehu chayyav levaer kemo sheyyitbaer
Hallokeach mayim umelach o perot mechubbarin o perot sheenan yecholin lehaggia lirushalayim lo kana hammaaser af al pi sheyyatzu hammaot lechullin

Vechen en lokchin behema bechesef maaser chutz lirushalayim veim lakach beshogeg yachzeru haddamim limkoman bemezid taale veteachel birushalayim veim en mikdash tikkaver hi veorah

Lakach avadim vekarkaot uvhema temea ben bemezid ben beshogeg im barach hammocher hare ze yeachel keneged otan hammaot birushalayim betorat maaser ze hakkelal kal shehotzi chutz laachila ushtiyya vesicha middeme maaser uvarach hammocher o met yeachel kenegdo veim haya hammocher kayyam yachzeru haddamim limkoman vechen im hevi olot vechattaot vaashamot middeme maaser yochal kenegdan

Hammatpis meot maaser lishlamim lo kanu shelamim shekkedushshat shelamim enah chala al kedushshat maaser shehammaaser mamon gavoha hu veen tzarich lomar im hitpis hammaaser atzman lishlamim shello kanu shelamim

Vechen hallokeach kadde yayin setumot mimmakom sheddarkam lehimmacher setumot mimmi sheeno taggar yatza hakkankan lechullin lefichach tzarich hammocher liftoach rashe hakkaddim kede shello yetze hakkankan lechullin veim ratza lehachamir al atzmo velimkor bemidda yatza hakkankan lechullin

Lekachan petuchot o setumot bemakom sheddarkan lehimmacher petuchot o shellakach min hattaggar shemmedakdek bimchirato lo yatza hakkankan lechullin lakach salle teenim vaanavim im hakkeli lo yatzu deme hakkeli lechullin

Mi shehaya lo yayin shel maaser sheni vehishil kankannav leoto maaser af al pi shessatam et pihem lo kana maaser et hakkankannim kinnes hayyayin letocho setam im kara shem veasahu maaser ad shello satam et pihem lo kana maaser et hakkankannim veim mishshessatam pihen kara shem veasahu maaser kana maaser et hakkankan hifkid letoch hakkankan reviit chullin o shekkanas letochan shemen o chometz o tzir o devash shel maaser sheni setam ben mishshessatam ben ad shello satam lo kana maaser et hakkankannim

Tzevi shellekacho bechesef maaser umet yikkaver beoro lekacho chay ushchato venitma hare ze yippade kishar perot shennitmeu hammanniach dinar maaser sheni lihot ochel kenegdo ad sheyyetze lechullin vehaya haddinar yotze beesrim maa achal alav beeser maa vehuzzelu hammaot leachar zeman vahare haddinar yotze bearbaim maa tzarich leechol alav beesrim maa veachar kach yetze lechullin hukru hammaot vahare haddinar yotze beeser main ochel alav bechamesh main veachar kach yetze lechullin
