Natan lo selaim shettayim shel maaser velo hispik limshoch happerot ad shechazru lihot besela ma sheppada pada umiddat haddin benehem shehammaaser sheni pediyyato hi meshichato

Mi shehau lo perot chullin birushalayim vehau lo meot maaser sheni chutz lirushalayim omer hare hammaot hahem mechullalin al happerot haellu veyochlem sham betahora veyetzu otan hammaot lechullin bimkoman

Hau lo meot maaser sheni birushalayim veyesh lo perot chutz lirushalayim omer hare hammaot haellu mechullalin al perot hahem veyetzu hammaot lechullin veyaalu happerot veyeachlu birushalayim sheeno tzarich lihot hammaot vehapperot bemakom echad bishat hachillul

Mi shehau lo meot maaser birushalayim vetzarich lahem veyesh lachavero perot chullin sherotze leachlan omer lachavero hare hammaot haellu mechullalin al perotecha venimtzeu otam happerot lekuchot bechesef maaser veyochal otam chavero betahora velo hifsid kelum veyatzu hammaot lechullin

Hammanniach dinar shel maaser lihot ochel kenegdo veholech kevan sheachal alav ad shello nishar mimmennu ella pachot mipperuta yatza lechullin bamme devarim amurim beshel demay aval beshel vadday lo yetze lechullin ad sheyyishshaer mimmennu pachot mishsheve peruta achar shemmosifin et hachomesh kegon shennishar mimmennu pachot mearbaa chumshe sheve peruta

Temein uthorin shehau ochlin o shotin keechad birushalayim veratzu hattehorin lihot ochlin maaser sheni shellahem mannichin sela shel maaser sheni veomer kal shehattehorim ochlim veshotin sela zo mechullal alav vetetze hassela lechullin shehare achlu veshatu beshaveyah betahora uvilvad shello yiggeu hattemeim bamaachal shello yetammeuhu

Neta revai hare hu kodesh shenneemar uvashshana harviit yihye kal piro kodesh hillulim la vedino leheachel birushalayim livalav kemaaser sheni uchshem sheen maaser sheni besurya kach en neta revai besurya uvneta revai hu omer veish et kodashav lo yihu sheen lecha kodesh shello nitparesh dino battora lemi shehu chutz minneta revai

Harotze lifdot neta revai podehu kemaaser sheni veim padahu leatzmo mosif chomesh veen podin oto ad sheyyaggiu leonat hammaaser shenneemar lehosif lachem tevuato ad sheyyaase tevua veen podin oto bimchubbar kemaaser sheni vahare hu mamon gavoha kemaaser lefichach eno nikne bemattana ella im netano boser vedino bishar haddevarim leinyan achila ushtiyya ufdiyya kemaaser
Vehappode kerem revai ratza podehu anavim ratza podehu yayin vechen hazzetim aval shear happerot en meshannin otan mibberiyyatan

Kerem revai en lo lo shichcha velo pea velo peret velo olelot veen mafrishin mimmennu teruma umaasrot keshem sheen mafrishin mimmaaser sheni ella kullo ole lirushalayim o nifde veyaalu haddamim veyeachlu birushalayim kemaaser

Anavim shel kerem revai hitkinu bet din sheyyihu olin lirushalayim mahalach yom lechal tzad kede leatter shuke yerushalayim beferot umishecharav bet hammikdash nifde afillu samuch lachoma ushar kal happerot afillu bizman bet hammikdash nifdin samuch lachoma

Ketzad podin neta revai meniach et hassal al pi shelosha veomdin kamma adam rotze lifdot lo bassela al menat sheyyotzi yetziot hashshomrim vehachamarim vehappoalim mibbeto veachar shekkotzvin et hashshaar manniach et hammaot veomer kal hannilkat mizze mechullal al hammaot ellu mishshaar kach vechach sallim besela uvashsheviit podehu beshaveo sheen sham lo shomrim velo poalim veim haya hefker en lo ella sechar lekita bilvad

Mi shehaya lo neta revai bishnat hashshemitta sheyyad hakkol shava tzarich letzayeno bekozazot adama kede sheyyakkiru bo velo yochlu mimmennu ad sheyyippadu veim haya betoch shene arla metzayenin oto bacharasim kede sheyyifreshu mimmennu sheim tziyenu bekozazot adama shemma yitparru sheissur arla chamur hu shehi asura bahanaya vehatztzenuin hau mannichin et hammaot bishnat shemitta veomrin kal hannilkat mipperot revai ellu mechullal al hammaot haellu shehare i efshar lifdoto bimchubbar kemo shebbearnu

Beechad betishre rosh hashshana learla velirvai umeematay monin lahem mishsheat netia veeno mone merosh hashshana lerosh hashshana ella sheloshim yom beshana chashuvin shana vehu shettiklot hannetia kodem sheloshim yom vechamma hu setam hakkelita lechal hailanot shette shabbatot
Nimtzet lamed shehannotea yom kodem rosh hashshana alta lo shana veaf al pi chen en perot hannetia hazzot muttarot bearla ella birviit ad bishvat shehu rosh hashshana lailanot

Ketzad hannotea ilan maachal betv beav mishshana asirit bayyovel hare hu betoch shene arla ad bishvat mishshenat vechal ma sheyyotzi hailan betoch zeman ze hare hu arla af al pi shennigmeru leachar kamma yamim umitv bishvat mishshenat beovel ad bishvat mishshenat hu neta revai vechal ma sheyyotzi betoch zeman ze hare hu revai vetzarich pidon veim nitabbera hashshana nitabbera laarla o larvai
Nitan beshishsha asar beav mishshenat eser lo alta lo shenat eser ella hare hu arla shenat vev veg kullah vahare hu neta revai merosh hashshana shel shenat ad sofah

Nata hannetia merosh chodesh tishre ad bishvat mone lah shalosh shanim miyyom leom learla umiyyom leom lirvai veraiti laggeonim devarim becheshbon arla urvai en rauy lehaarich ulhashiv alehen uvvadday taut sofrim hem vehaemet kevar bearnu darkah

Healin vehallulavin ume gefanim vehassemadar muttarin bearla uvirvai vehaanavim shesserafam hakkadim vehifsidan vehachartzannim vehazzaggin vehattemed shellahen uklippe rimmon vehannetz shello uklippe egozim vehaggarinim asurin bearla umuttarin birvai vehannovlot kullan asurot
Kal shehu chayyav bearla yesh lo revai vechal sheppatur min haarla eno chayyav birvai shenneemar shalosh shanim yihye lachem arelim vego uvashshana harviit

Hannotea ilan maachal vedato alav sheyyihye seyag lagginna o shennetao lekorot lo leferot hare ze patur min haarla netao lisyag vechazar vechashav alav lemaachal o shennetao lemaachal vechazar vechashav alav lisyag kevan sheerev bo machshevet chiyyuv chayyav netao shalosh shanim lisyag umikkan veelach lemaachal en lo revai shekkal sheen lo arla en lo revai

Nata ilan vechashav sheyyihye hatztzad happenimi shello lemaachal vehachitzon lisyag o sheyyihye hatztzad hattachton lemaachal vehaelon lisyag ze shechashav alav lemaachal chayyav baarla veze shechashav alav lisyag o leetzim patur shehaddavar taluy bedato shel notea vehatztzalaf chayyav bearla haevonot bilvad aval hakkafrisin muttarot
Hannotea larabbim betoch sadehu chayyav bearla shenneemar untatem afillu larabbim bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael aval bechutza laaretz patur
Hannotea birshut harabbim o bisfina vehaole meelav birshut hayyachid veakkum shennata ben leyisrael ben leatzmo vehaggazlan shennata chayyavin baarla uvirvai

Haole meelav bimkom terashim patur afillu hannotea bemakom sheeno yishshuv patur vehu shello yihye ose kede tippul shemmetappel beferotav ad shemmevian layyishshuv aval im haya ose kede tippulo chayyav bearla
Hannotea lemitzva kegon shennata etrog lelulav o zayit lammenora chayyav baarla hikdish veachar kach nata patur min haarla nata veachar kach hikdish chayyav bearla
Hannotea beatzitz sheeno nakuv chayyav bearla af al pi sheeno keeretz lizraim hare hu keeretz leilanot

Ilan shennetao betoch habbayit chayyav bearla ze shennetao akkum ad shello bau avotenu laaretz patur aval mishshebbau laaretz af ma shennatu akkum chayyav shenneemar ki tavou el haaretz untatem mishsheat bia
Akkum shehirkiv ilan maachal al gabbe ilan serak chayyav bearla veyesh laakkum neta revai sheim ba linhog bemitzva zo hare hu kodesh keneta revai shel yisrael

Echad hannotea garina o yichur min hailan o sheakar et kal hailan mimmekomo untao bemakom acher hare ze chayyav bearla umone mishsheat netiato zizeo velo akaro veachar kach mille sevivotav beafar im yachol lichot illu lo mille sevivotav hare ze patur veim lav hare ze kemo sheakar venata vechayyav

Vechen ilan shenneekar venishar mimmennu shoresh echad afillu kemachat shemmelappefin alav harokmin et hashshani vehechziro limkomo venata patur mippene sheyyachol lichot neekar kullo veneekra hassela sheshsharashav bah immo vechazar untao kema shehu bechal haadama shessevivot sharashav im haya yachol lichot meotah adama illu lo nata hare hu kemi shello neekar veim lav chayyav
Ilan shekkitztzetzo meim haaretz vehechlif chayyav bearla umonin lo mishsheat ketzitza

Echad hannotea veechad hammavrich veechad hammarkiv chayyav bamme devarim amurim beshechatach bad echad min hailan vehivricho baaretz o hirkivo beilan acher aval im matach bad echad min hailan hazzaken vehivrich baaretz o hirkivo beilan acher veikkar habbad meore bailan hazzaken hare ze patur

Gadal ze hayyeled shehivrich veasa perot veachar kach pasak ikkaro shehu meore bailan hazzaken mone mishshaa shennifsak veotan happerot muttarin mippene sheggadlu behetter veim hinnichan achar shennifsak haikkar ad shehosifu bematayim hare ellu asurin
Yalda shessibbecha bizkena vehau perot bayyalda afillu hosifu matayim hare ellu happerot shel yalda asurin sheen giddule hetter maalin et haikkar haasur

Ilan shehivrich mimmennu bad baaretz veachar kach neekar hailan kullo vahare hu chay min habbad shehivrich baaretz naasa oto ilan keillu atta nitta vechayyav bearla umone lailan ulma shetztzamach min hahavracha mishshaa shenneekar

Hare shehivrich bad baaretz vetzamach vehivrich bad echad mimma shetztzamach baaretz vetzamach vechazar vehivrich min hashshelishi afillu hen mea meorin ze baze hoil velo nifseku min haikkar harishon hakkol muttar veim nifsak ikkar harishon mone lakkol mishshaa shennifsak

Ilan hayyotze min haggeza patur min haarla min hashsharashim chayyav yalda pechuta mittefach chayyevet bearla kal shenoteha mippene shenniret kintia bat shenatah bamme devarim amurim bintia achat o shettayim keneged shettayim veachat yotza zanav aval im haya hakkerem kullo pachot mittefach hare ze yesh lo kol umonin kederech shemmonin lishar hailanot

Notin yichur shel arla veen notin egoz shel arla mippene shehu peri uferot arla asurin bahanaa kemo shebbearnu behilchot issure maachalot veim avar venata egoz shel arla hare hatztzomeach muttar kishar hailanot

Vechen en markivin kafniyyot shel arla bidkalim mippene shehen kifri avar vehirkiv muttar shekkal davar sheyyesh lo shene gormin echad asur veechad muttar hare ze hannigram mishshenehem muttar lefichach hatztzomeach mipperot arla muttar shehare gorem litzmoach happeri haasur vehaaretz hammutteret
Mitzvat ase lehitvaddot lifnoy Adonai achar shemmotziin kal hammattanot shebbezera haaretz vezehu hannikra vidduy maaser
Veen mitvaddin vidduy ze ella achar hashshana shemmafrishin bah maasar ani shenneemar ki techalle laser veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha biarti hakkodesh min habbayit

Ematay mitvaddin bemincha beom tov haacharon shel pesach shel reviit veshel sheviit shenneemar ki techalle laser beregel shekkal hammaasrot kalim bo veen happesach maggia mishshana reviit ella kal perot shelishit nitasseru ben perot hailan ben perot haaretz
En mitvaddin ella bayyom vechal hayyom kasher levidduy hammaaser uven bifne habbayit uven shello bifne habbayit chayyav levaer ulhitvaddot
Vidduy ze neemar bechal lashon shenneemar veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha bechal lashon sheatta omer vechal echad veechad omro bifne atzmo veim ratzu rabbim lehitvaddot keechad mitvaddin
Umitzvato bammikdash shenneemar lifne Adonai veim hitvadda bechal makom yatza
Eno mitvadde ad shello yishshaer etzlo achat min hammattanot shekken hu omer bavidduy biarti hakkodesh min habbayit veerev yom tov haacharon haya habbiur ulmachar mitvaddin

Ketzad hu ose im nishar etzlo teruma utrumat maaser notnah lakkohen maaser rishon notno lelevi maasar ani notno laaniyyim nisharu etzlo perot maaser sheni shel vadday o neta revai o meot pediyyatan hare ze mevaaran umashlich layyam o soref nishar etzlo maaser sheni shel demay eno chayyav levaaro nishar etzlo bikkurim hare hen mitbaarin bechal makom

Bamme devarim amurim shessoref umvaer keshennisharu etzlo perot sheeno yachol leechol kullan kodem sheyyikkanes yom tov aval im nishar tavshil shel maaser sheni veneta revai eno tzarich levaaro shehattavshil kimvoar vechen yayin vetavlin hare hen kimvoarin
Perot shello higgiu leonat hammaasrot bishat habbiur en meakkevin oto lehitvaddot veeno chayyav levaaran

Mi shehau perotav rechokin mimmennu vehiggia yom habbiur hare ze kore shem lammattanot umzakke lahen levalehen al gav karka o lemi shezzoche lahen levaalehen umitvadde lemachar shennetinat hammittaltelin al gabbe karka enah ella mattana sheyyesh bah chizzuk aval eno yachol lehaknot lahem hammaaser bachalifin mippene shennire kimchira vehammaasrot vehatterumot vehammattanot neemar bahen netina lo mechira

Uminnayin sheeno yachol lehitvaddot ad sheyyotzi kal hammattanot shenneemar biarti hakkodesh min habbayit hakkodesh ze maaser sheni veneta revai hakkaruy kodesh min habbayit zo challa shehi hammattana shel kohanim babbayit netattiv lallevi ze maaser rishon vegam netattiv mikkelal shekkedamattu mattana acheret vehi teruma gedola utrumat maaser lagger layyatom velaalmana ze maasar ani veleket shichcha ufea af al pi sheen leket shichcha ufea meakkevin et havidduy

Vetzarich lehafrish hammattanot al hasseder veachar kach yitvadde shenneemar kechal mitzvatcha asher tzivitani ha im hikdim maaser sheni lerishon eno yachol lehitvaddot nisraf tivlo eno yachol lehitvaddot shehare lo hifrish mattanot velo netanan levaalehen uvizman shehau notnin maaser rishon lakkohanim lo hau mitvaddin shenneemar vegam netattiv lallevi

Mi sheen lo ella maaser sheni bilvad mitvadde sheikkar havidduy bammaaser hu vechen im lo haya lo ella bikkurim bilvad mitvadde shenneemar biarti hakkodesh hakkodesh harishon shehu habbikkurim aval mi sheen lo ella teruma bifne atzmah eno mitvadde sheen hatteruma teuna vidduy ella bichlal shear hammattanot

Lo avarti mimmitzotecha shello hifrish mimmin al sheeno mino velo min hattalush al hamchubbar velo min hamchubbar al hattalush velo min hechadash al hayyashan velo min hayyashan al hechadash velo shachachti shello shachach millevarcho umillehazkir shemo alav lo achalti veoni mimmennu ha im achalo baanino eno mitvadde velo viarti mimmennu betame ha im hifrisho betuma eno mitvadde velo natatti mimmennu lemet shello lakach mimmennu aron vetachrichin velo netano leonnim acherim shamati bekol Adonai elohay shehevio levet habbechira asiti kechal asher tzivitani shessamach vesimmeach bo shenneemar vesamachta vechal hattov
Hashkifa mimmeon kadshecha min hashshamayim ad kaasher nishbata laavotenu eretz zavat chalav udvash zo bakkasha sheyyitten taam bapperot

Yisrael umamzerim mitvaddim aval lo gerim vaavadim meshuchrarim mippene sheen lahem chelek baaretz vahare hu omer veet haadama asher natatta lanu kohanim ulviyyim mitvaddim sheaf al pi shello natlu chelek baaretz yesh lahem are migrash seliku lehu hilchot maaser sheni veneta revai besiyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 1: Achar shemmafrishin teruma gedola mafrish echad measara min hannishar vezehu hannikra maaser rishon uvo neemar ki et masar bene yisrael asher yarimu la vego vehammaaser hazze lilviyyim zecharim unkevot shenneemar velivne levi hinne natatti kal maaser beyisrael lenachala

Maaser rishon muttar baachila leyisrael umuttar leachlo betuma sheen bo kedushsha kelal vechal makom shenneemar bemaasrot kodesh o pediyya eno ella maaser sheni uminnayin shemmaaser rishon chullin shenneemar venechshav lachem terumatchem kaddagan min haggoren vechamlea min hayyakev ma goren veyekev chullin lechal davar af maaser rishon shennittela terumato chullin lechal davar lefichach bat levi shennishbet o shennivala beilat zenut notnin lah hammaaser veochelet aval mi sheshshama shemmet balah o heid lah ed echad venisset veachar kach ba balah kansu otah chachamim shettihye asura bemaaser

Leviyyim vechohanim mafrishin maaser rishon kede lehafrish mimmennu terumat maaser vechen hakkohanim mafrishin shear terumot umaasrot leatzman ulfi shehakkohanim notlin min hakkol yachol yochlu perotehen betivlan talmud lomar ken tarimu gam attem mippi hashshemua lamdu attem ellu halviyyim gam attem lerabbot et hakkohanim

En motziin hammaaser miyyad hakkohanim shenneemar ki tikchu meet bene yisrael vechen kal mattenot kehunna en motziin otan mikkohen lechohen veezra kanas et halviyyim bizmanno shello yittenu lahen maaser rishon ella yinnaten lakkohanim lefi shello alu immo lirushalayim

Haochel perotav tevalin vechen levi sheachal hammaaser betivlo af al pi shehen chayyavin mita lashshamayim en meshallemin hammattanot levaalehen shenneemar asher yarimu la en lecha bahen kelum ad sheyyarimu otan uvchutza laaretz muttar leadam lihot ochel veholech techilla veachar kach mafrish teruma umaasrot
Measserin mimmakom ze al makom acher veeno tzarich leasser min hammukkaf aval en measserin mimmin al sheeno mino velo min hachayyav al happatur velo min happatur al hachayyav veim isser eno meussar

Kal sheamarnu bitruma en tormin mizze al ze kach bemaaser en measserin mizze al ze vechal sheamarnu bitruma im taram terumato teruma kach bemaaser im hifrish maasrotav maasrot vechal shehu patur min hatteruma patur min hammaaser vechal hattorem measser kal sheamarnu bahen lo yitromu veim tarmu terumatan teruma kach im isseru maasrotehen maasrot vechal sheen terumato teruma kach en maasrotehen maasrot
Haomer lachavero hareni measser al yadecha eno tzarich laamod immo ad sheyyire im yeasser o lo yeasser veim amar hu lachavero asser al yadi tzarich laamod immo
Hecharuvin enan chayyavin bemaasrot ella middivrehem lefi sheenan maachal rov adam vehashshekedim hammarim ben begadlan ben biktannan peturin lefi sheenan ochel

Ilan shennetao betoch habbayit patur mimmaasrot shenneemar asser teasser et kal tevuat zarecha hayyotze hassade veyerae li shehu chayyav bemaasrot middivrehem shehare teena haomedet bechatzer chayyav leasser peroteha im asafan keachat
Betzalim shehishrishu ze betzad ze afillu hishrishu bekarka aliyya peturin min hammaasrot nafla alehen mappolet vahare hen megullin hare ellu kintuin bassade vechayyavin bemaasrot

Hamshammer sadehu mippene anavav uva acher veasaf et hatteenim hannisharot beotah sade o shehaya meshammer sadehu mippene hammikshaot vehamiddelaot uva echad veasaf et haanavim hannisharim sham hamfuzzarim bassade bizman shebbaal hassade makpid alehen asurin mishshum gezel ulfichach chayyavin bemaaser uvitruma en baal hassade makpid alehen muttarin mishshum gezel ufturin min hammaaser

En measserin ella min hammuvchar shenneemar baharimchem et chelbo mimmennu venechshav lachem kitvuat goren vechitvuat yakev keshem shemmaaser shemmafrishim halviyyim min hachelev shebbo kach maaser shemmafrishim yisrael min haggoren umin hayyekev min hachelev shebbo
En measserin beomed ella bemidda o bemishkal o beminyan vechal hamdakdek bashshiur meshubbach vehammarbe bemaasrot maasrotav mekulkalin shehare hattevel meorav bahen uferotav metukkanin

Hammafrish miktzat maaser eno measser ella kemi shechalak et haarema aval tzarich lehafrish mizze hachelek sheyyotzi maaser shello ketzad hau lo mea sea hifrish mehem chamishsha leshem maaser eno maaser veeno yachol lehafrish al hechamesh sein maaser bemakom acher ella mafrish mehen chatzi sea shehi hammaaser shellahen

Hammafrish maaser ze mevarech techilla kederech shemmevarchin al hammitzot vechen mevarech al maaser sheni veal maasar ani veal maaser min hammaaser mevarech al kal echad bifne atzmo veim hifrish hakkol ze achar ze miyyad velo sach benehen kollan bivracha achat umvarech lehafrish terumot umaasrot
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 2: Eno chayyav lehafrish min hattora ella haggomer perotav leachlan leatzmo aval haggomran lemachran patur min hattora vechayyav middivrehem shenneemar asser teasser vego veachalta eno chayyav ella haggomer tevuato leachlah

Vechen hallokeach patur min hattora shenneemar tevuat zarecha vechayyav middivrehem bamme devarim amurim beshellekachan achar shennigmeru melachtan beyad mocher aval im nigmeru beyad lokeach chayyav leasser min hattora

Perot sheenan reuyim laachila mikkatnan kegon habboser vechayyotze bo enan chayyavin bemaaser ad sheyyigdelu veyeasu ochel shenneemar mizzera haaretz mipperi haetz ad sheyyihye peri vechen hattevua vehakkitniyyot shenneemar et kal tevuat zarecha ad shettease tevua vezo hi onat hammaasrot vekodem shettaggia hattevua vehapperot leona zo muttar leechol mehen kal ma sheyyirtze uvchal derech sheyyirtze

Perot shehen reuyin laachila bekatnan kegon hakkishshuim vehammelaffonot sheen mannichin otan ella kede lehosif begufan bilvad aval reuyin hen mittechilla laachila hare ellu chayyavin bemaaser bekatnan shemmittechillat yetziatan bau leonat hammaasrot

E zo hi onat hammaasrot mishsheyyaggiu happerot lehazria velitzmoach hakkol lefi ma shehu happeri ketzad hatteenim mishsheyyeasu rakkim ad sheyehu reuyim laachila achar shaot mishsheat asifatan haanavim vehabbeushim vehem haanavim haddakkim hammidbariyyot mishsheyyerae hachartzan shellahem mibbachutz harimmonim mishsheyyimmas happerach shellahen ben haetzbaot veyetze mimmennu mayim hattemarim mishsheyyippatchu kisor haafarsekin mishsheyyattilu gidim adummim haegozim mishsheyyitparesh haochel mehakkelippa hachitzona hashshekedim hammetukim mishshettitparesh kelippatan hachitzona hammarim peturin leolam ushar kal baale kelippot kegon haitzterubbolin vehallot vehabbatnim mishsheyyaasu kelippa hattachtona hassemucha laochel hazzetim mishsheyyaasu shemen echad mittisha mimma shehen reuyin laasot kesheyyiggamru veze shelish shellahen hattappuchim vehaetrogim mishsheyyitaggelu mippene shehen reuyin laachila keshehem ketannim hattutim vehaog mishsheyyaadimu vechen kal sheddarkan lehaadim mishsheyyaadimu hecharuvin mishsheyyeasu nekuddot nekuddot shechorot vechen kal sheddarkan lehashchir mishsheyyinnakdu haagassim vehakrustemalin vehapperishim vehaozradin mishsheyyeasu karachot karachot levanot vechen kal sheddarkan lelabben mishsheyyikrechu karachot hattevua mishshettavi shelish hattiltan mishshettihye zarah rauy litzmicha im nizra uvyarak hakkishshuin vehaddeluin vehaavattichin vehammelaffonot vechal kayyotze bahen chayyavin bekatnan kemo shebbearnu ushar hayyarak sheeno rauy laachila ad sheyyagdil eno chayyav ad sheyehe rauy laachila eshkol shehiggia bo afillu gargir yechidi kullo chibbur lemaasrot uchillu higgia kullo velo oto eshkol bilvad ella kal haruach sheyyesh bah otah haggefen sheyyesh bah haeshkol vechen rimmon shehiggia bah afillu pereda achat kullah chibbur

Lo yimkor adam perotav mishshebbau leonat hammaasrot lemi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot veim bikkeru notel et habbikkurot umuttar limkor hashshear sheadayin lo higgia leonat hammaasrot vechen lo yimkor adam et gifto veet zaggav lemi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot lehotzi mehen mashkin shehammashkin hayyotzin mehem chayyavin bemaasrot velo et tivno lilkot mimmennu tevua lemi sheeno neeman shehattevua shettillaket min hatteven chayyevet bemaaser

Shimre yayin shennatan alehem mayim vesinnenan im natan shelosha umatza arbaa motzi maaser mizze hayyeter mimmakom acher veeno mafrish alav teruma shehattorem battechilla belibbo al hakkol kemo shebbearnu bitruma matza pachot mearbaa af al pi shemmatza yeter al middato veaf al pi sheyyesh bahen taam yayin patur
Hammakdish perotav keshehen mechubbarin ad shello bau leonat hammaaser ufdaan veachar sheppedaan higgiu chayyavin bemaaser veim bau leonat hammaasrot vehem beyad haggizbar veachar kach pedaan peturin
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 3: Perot shehiggiu leonat hammaasrot venitleshu vaadayin lo nigmera melachtan kegon tevua shekketzarah vedashah vaadayin lo zara otah velo merchah muttar leechol mehen achilat aray ad shettiggamer melachtan umishshettiggamer melachtan asur leechol mehen aray
Bamme devarim amurim begomer perotav lemachran bashshuk aval im hayeta kavanato leholichan babbayit hare ze muttar leechol mehen aray achar shennigmera melachtan ad sheyyikkavu lemaaser
Echad mishshishsha devarim kovea happerot lemaasrot hechatzer vehammikkach vehaesh vehammelach vehatteruma vehashshabbat vechullan en kovin ella bedavar shennigmera melachto

Ketzad perot sheddato leholichan labbayit af al pi shennigmera melachtan ochel mehen achilat aray ad shennichnesu labbayit nichnesu labbayit nikbeu lemaasrot veasur leechol mehen ad sheyeasser vechen im mecharan o bishshelan beur o kevashan bemelach o hifrish mehen teruma o nichnesa shabbat alehem lo yochal ad sheyeasser af al pi shello higgiu labbayit hichnisan labbayit kodem shettiggamer melachtan hare ze ochel mehen aray hitchil ligmor melachtan meachar shennichnesu labbayit chayyav leasser hakkol ketzad hichnis kishshuin vediluin labbayit kodem sheyeshafshef mishsheyyatchil leshafshef achat nikbeu hakkol lemaaser vechen kal kayyotze baze vechen hattorem perot shello nigmera melachtan muttar leechol mehen aray chutz mikkalkalat teenim sheim teramah kodem shettigmor melachtan nikbea lemaaser

Hammevi levayit sukke teena uvahem teenim michbede temara uvahem temarim im hichnisum tinokot o poalim lo nikbeu lemaaser veim hichnisan baal habbayit chayyav bemaaser hichnis shibbolim laasot mehen issa lo nikbeu leachlan melilot nikbeu lemaaser bamme devarim amurim bitvua aval bekitniyyot lo nikbeu lemaaser

Muttar lehaarim al hattevua lehachnisah bemotz kede shettihye behemto ochelet uftura min hammaaser vezore meat meat achar shehichnis leveto ufatur leolam min hatteruma umin hammaasrot shehare eno matchil ligmor hakkol
Haggomer perotav shel chavero shello middato vechen hakkovea perotav beechad min hashshishsha devarim shekkovim lemaaser shello middato hare ellu tavlu lemaaser

E zehu gemar melachtan shel perot hakkishshuin vehaddiluin vehaavattichin mishsheyeshafshef beyado veyasir hatztzihuv shealehen kemo sear dak veim eno meshafshef mishsheyyaamid arema uvaavattiach mishsheyyasdir oto bemuktze avattiach betzad avattiach haya meshafshef achat achat kevan sheggamar kal tzarko nigmera melachtan vetormin kishshuin vediluin af al pi shello hesir hatztzihuv mealehen
Hayyarak hanneegad mishsheyyeegod im eno oged mishsheyemalle et hakkeli im eno memalle hare ze ochel aray ad sheyelakket kal tzarko
Kalkala mishsheyechappe happerot shebbah bealim uvhutzin vechayyotze bahen im eno mechappe mishsheyemalle et hakkeli im eno memalle ad sheyelakket kal tzarko

Keli gadol sheddato lemalleot et chetzo kevan shemmille chetzo nitbal haya bedato lemalleot et kullo eno nitbal ad sheyemalle et kullo hau shenayim uvdato lemalleot et shenehem lo nitbelu ad sheyemalle shenehem

Agad hayyarak eged gadol bassade af al pi shebbedato leagdo aguddot ketannot lashshuk hare ze nitbal happered vehatztzimmukin vehecharuvin mishsheyyaamid arema berosh gaggo vehabbetzalim mishsheyyasir healim vehakkelippot sheddarko lehashlicham mealehen veim eno mesir ad sheyyaamid arema

Hattevua mishsheyemareach vee zehu memareach ze hamyappe pene hakkeri shel tevua berachat besof kal davar kederech sheosin kesheggomrin kal maaseha im eno memareach ad sheyyaamid arema hakkitniyyot mishsheyyichbor venotel mittachat hakkevara veochel im eno kover ad sheyemareach veaf al pi shemmereach muttar littol min hakkutim umin hatztzedadin umimma shebbetoch hatteven veochel

Hayyayin mishsheyyannichennu bechaviyyot veyishle hazzaggin vehachartzanin meal pi hechavit aval keshehu betoch habbor kesheyyagbihennu lehaamido bechavit shote aray vekolet min haggat haelona umin hatztzinnor umikkal makom veshote

Hashshemen mishsheyyered lauka af al pi sheyyarad notel min haekel umin hammemel umibben happassin venoten likara ketanna ultamchuy letoch hattavshil af al pi shehu cham mippene sheeno mitbashshel bichli sheni veim haya cham beoter kede sheyyichve et hayyad lo yitten letocho mippene shehu mitbashshel

Haiggul shel devela mishsheyachlikkennu haggerogarot mishsheyyadush veim hichnisam limgura mishsheyyaagil beyado al pi hammegura haya dash haggerogarot bechavit o haiggul al pi hammegura nishbera hechavit o shenniftecha hammegura hare ze lo yochal ad sheyeasser
Teenim vaanavim shebbammuktze muttar leechol mehen aray bimkoman aval im natal min hammuktze veholich lemakom acher lo yochal mehen aray shehare nigmera melachtan af al pi shello yavshu kal tzarkan
Hecharuvin ad shello kinnesan lerosh haggag morid mehen livhema ufatur mippene shehu machazir et hammotar leyabbesho venimtza maachil aray

Maaser rishon shehikdimu beshibbolim asur leechol mimmennu aray kodem sheyyafrish terumato veim achal makkin oto makkat mardut ketzad hi achilat aray kegon shehaya mekallef seorim veochel mekallef achat achat veim killef vechanas letoch yado chayyav leasser haya molel melilot shel chittim menappe miyyad leyad veochel veim nippa letoch cheko chayyav leasser veen tzarich lomar im nippa bichli sheen ze aray vechen notel min hayyayin venoten likara letoch tavshil tzonen veochel aval lo letoch hakkedera af al pi shehi tzonenet mippene shehi kevor katan vechen sochet zetim al besaro aval lo letoch yado vechen kal kayyotze baze

Uchshem shemmuttar leechol aray mipperot shello nigmera melachtan kach muttar lehaachil mehen lechayya velivhema velaofot kal ma sheyyirtze umafkir mehen kal ma sheyyirtze kodem sheyeasser veim gamru af al pi shello nikbeu lemaaser lo yafkir velo yaachil livhema ulchayya ulofot achilat keva ad sheyeasser umuttar lehaachil livhema aray min hattevel vaafillu betoch habbayit umaachil pekie amir ad sheyyaasem chavilot

Hammotze ketzitzot badderech afillu betzad sede ketzitzot hare ellu peturin min hammaaser matza gerogarot im darsu rov haggerogarot rov haadam chayyav leasser shechezkatan middavar shennigmera melachtan vechen im matza pilche devela sheyyadua shehem middavar haggamur

Matza kerichot birshut hayyachid chayyav leasser birshut harabbim peturot vehaalummot bechal makom chayyavot bemaaser matza tevua merucha ose terumot umaasrot al perot acherot veeno choshesh matza kalkala mechuppa chayyevet bemaasrot matza kalkala bemakom sheharov machnisin lashshuk asur leechol mimmenna aray umtakkenah demay uvmakom sheharov machnisin labbattim ochel mimmenna aray umtakkenah vadday mechetza lemechetza demay veim hichnisah labbayit metakkenah vadday bamme devarim amurim bedavar sheen lo gemar melacha aval bedavar sheyyesh lo gemar melacha af al pi shehu maaser vadday eno tzarich lehafrish teruma shechezkatan shehifrish mehen teruma beshaa shennigmera melachtan
Chadre hannemalim shellanu betzad haarema hachayyevet hare hannimtza bahen chayyav lemaasrot sheyyadua shemmiddavar gamur hau gorrin kal hallayela

Hammotze zetim tachat hazzayit vecharuvin tachat hecharuv chayyavin bemaaser shechezkatan shemmeilan ze naflu matza teenim tachat hatteena hare hem safek shehare mishtannot umitlachlechot beafar shemma mitteena zo naflu o mitteenim shennitasseru

Hammakdish perot telushin ufdaan kodem shettiggamer melachtan chayyav leasser veim nigmera melachtan beyad hahekdesh veachar kach pedaan peturin min hammaasrot shebbishat chovatan hau peturin min hammaasrot hammakdish kama limnachot petura min hammaasrot
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 4: En hattevel nikba lemaasrot min hattora ad sheyyachnisennu leveto shenneemar biarti hakkodesh min habbayit vehu sheyyachnisennu derech hashshaar shenneemar veachlu visharecha aval im hichnis tevuato derech gaggot vekarpifot patur min hatteruma umin hammaasrot

Yerae li sheen lokin min hattora al achilat hattevel ad sheyyikava bichnisato leveto kemo shebbearnu mippi hashshemua aval im nikba bishar hashshishsha devarim shemmaninu en lokin alav ella makkat mardut middivrehen vechen haochel mipperot sheddato leholichan lashshuk achar shennigmera melachtan eno loke ella makkat mardut kemo shebbearnu sheen haggomer limkor chayyav bemaaser ella middivrehem

Bayit sheen bo arba ammot al arba ammot eno kovea vechen haggaggim enan kovin af al pi shehabbayit shellematta kovea veim lo haya baggag arba ammot al arba ammot kegon shehaya habbayit meshuppa veole eno poter min hammaaser ella hare gag ze kemiktzat avir habbayit

Hatztzerifin vehabburganin uvatte hakkayitz vehu arbaa ammudim vetikra al gabbehen shennimtza belo ketalim vechen sukkot sheosin bene hakkeramim uvne hagginnot bime hakkayitz af al pi sheddarin bahen kal yeme hakkayitz veyesh bahem rechayim vetarnegolin enan kovin lemaaser vechen sukkat hayyotzrim hachitzona vesukkat hechag bechag enan kovin shekkal ellu en diratan keva
Hatztzerifin vehabburganin tovlin levalehen af al pi sheenan tovlin lechal adam vechen bet hassefer uvet hammidrash tovel leze sheyyoshev umlammed mippene shehem keveto veen tovlin laacherim
Bet hakkeneset uvet hammidrash im yesh bahen bet dira kovin veim lav en kovin haoriarot haotzarot shebbassadot haasuot limchunnas enan kovin veim hau ledira kovin
Keshem shehabbayit kovea lemaaser kach hechatzer kovaat lemaaser umishsheyyikkansu lechatzer derech hashshaar nikbeu af al pi shello hichnisan letoch habbayit

E zo hi chatzer hakkovaat kal shehakkelim nishmarin betochah o sheen adam bosh milleechol betochah o chatzer sheim yikkanes adam lah omrin lo ma atta mevakkesh vechen chatzer sheyyesh bah shene diyyurin o shehi lishne shuttafin sheechad potchah venichnas veechad ba venichnas o yotze venoel hoil vehen potchin venoalin hare zo kovaat
Bet shaar shel chatzer vehaachsadra vehammirpeset hare hen kechatzer im hayeta kovaat kovin veim lav enan kovin
Shette chatzerot zo lefanim mizzo shettehen kovot sukkat hayyotzrim zo lefanim mizzo happenimit kovaat vehachitzona enah kovaat vehachanut kovaat kevayit
Hammolich perotav mimmakom lemakom af al pi shehu nichnas bahen levattim velachatzerot badderech lo nikbeu ella ochel aray ad sheyyaggia lemakom shehu sof megammato vechen bachazara
Harochlin hammachzirin baayarot shehen nichnasin mechatzer lechatzer ochlin aray ad shemmaggiin levayit shellanin bo

Hammevi teenim min hassade leachlan bechatzer happetura min hammaasrot shachach vehichnisan letoch beto hare ze muttar lehotzian veleechol mehen aray vechen im shachach veheelan laggag ochel mehen baggag aray hevian leachlan berosh gaggo veshachach vehichnisan letoch chatzar chavero nikbeu velo yochal ad sheyeasser

Chatzer shehi nederet hare hi keginna veochlin betochah aray vehu sheyyeader rubbah veim zara rubbah en ochlin aray vechen im nata rubbah veim nata lenoy chatzer hoil vehi nederet hare ze ochel aray meotan ilanot

Teena haomedet bechatzer ochel mimmenna achat achat ufatur veim tzeref chayyav bemaaser bamme devarim amurim beshehaya omed bakkarka aval im ala lerosh hatteena memalle cheko veochel sham sheen avir chatzer kovea lemaaser

Hayeta omedet bechatzer venota leginna hare ze ochel mimmenna bagginna kedarko keillu hayeta netua bagginna hayeta netua bagginna venota lechatzer hare zo kintua bechatzer sheeno ochel sham ella achat achat

Gefen shennetua bechatzer lo yittol et kal haeshkol veyochal ella megarger echad echad vechen berimmon lo yittol et kal harimmon ella poret et harimmon bailan veochel happered mishsham vechen baavattiach kofto bakkarka veochlo sham haya ochel beeshkol bagginna venichnas min hagginna lechatzer af al pi sheyyatza min hechatzer lo yigmor ad sheyeasser
Kusbar hazzerua bechatzer mekarsem ale ale veochlo veim tzeref chayyav leasser vechen kal kayyotze baze
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 5: Halokeach perot telushin leachlan nikbeu lemaaser middivrehem kemo shebbearnu umeematay yikavu mishsheyyitten et haddamim af al pi shello mashach hare shello natan damim vehaya borer umanniach borer umanniach afillu kal hayyom kullo veaf al pi sheggamar belibbo likkach lo nitchayyev leasser veim haya yere shamayim mishsheggamar belibbo measser veachar kach yachazir lammocher im ratza lehachazir
Hallokeach bimchubbar lakkarka o shellakach talush lishloach lachavero lo nikbeu veyesh lo leechol mehen aray

Haomer lachavero he lecha isar ze veten li bo chamesh teenim hare ze ochel achat achat ufatur veim tzeref chayyav leasser he lecha isar ze beesrim teenim sheavor li borer achat achat veochel beeshkol sheavor li megarger mimmennu bailan veochel berimmon sheavor li porto bailan veochel baavattiach sheavor li kofet bakkarka veochel veim katzatz et hatteenim vetzerfam o shekkitztzetz haeshkol o haavattiach chayyav leasser shehare lo kana ella hannitlash aval im amar lo he lecha isar bishte teenim ellu bishne eshkolot ellu bishne rimmonim ellu bishne avattichim ellu kotzetz kedarko veochel aray ufatur shello nikbeu bemikkach shehare lekachan bimchubbar

Hammachalif im chavero ze leechol veze leechol shenehen nikbeu lemaasrot shehare lakchu betalush ze liktzot veze liktzot shenehen lo nikbeu sheen hammecher kovea davar shello nigmera melachto kemo shebbearnu lakach haechad perot shehechelif laachila velakach haacher chalifehen lehaktzotan ze shellakach laachila chayyav leasser veze shellakach lehaktzotan lo nikba lammaaser
Haomer lachavero tze velakket lecha esrim teenim mishshelli vaani amalle et keresi mishshellecha shenehem peturim sheen ze chalifin kede sheyyihye mecher veim tzeref veachal chayyav

Vehammattana enah kovaat kemecher am haaretz shehaya over bashshuk veamar telu lachem teenim ochlim ufturin sheen hammattana kovaat veim hichnisu levattehen im rov haam machnisim labbattim measserim vadday veim rov haam machnisim lashshuk en metakkenim ella demay shemma isser veachar kach hevi lashshuk veim amar telu lachem vehachnisu labbattim keshemmachnis labbayit measser demay natan lo davar merubbe afillu amar lo tol veechol hare ze kemi sheamar lo tol vehachnes sheeno ochel ad sheyetakken demay vechen im natan lo davar sheen darko leheachel chay o shehaya adam gadol sheen darko leechol bashshuk hare ze metakken demay
Hau shenayim amar leechad tol veechol veamar lesheni tol vehachnes ze ochel ufatur veze ochel vechayyav

Vechen anashim shehau yoshvim bashshaar o bachanut veamar lahem telu veichlu hare ellu ochlin ufturin uvaal hashshaar o baal hachanut lo yochal ad sheyeasseru demay shennimtza keomer leellu telu vehachnisu levattechem shehare hem kevattehem uchvar bearnu sheen habbayit sheeno shello kovea lo kesheyyaavru happerot betocho

Hassocher et happoalim laasot immo beferot ben bitlushin ben bimchubbarin hoil veyesh lahem leechol min hattora bema shehen osin hare ellu ochlin ufturim min hammaaser veim hitna immahen sheyyochlu ma shello zachta lahen tora kegon shehitna immahen happoel sheyyochlu banav immo o sheyyochal beno bischaro o sheyyochal achar gemar melachto betalush hare ze asur leechol ad sheyeasser hoil veochel mippene hattenay hare ze kelokeach
Secharo lenakkesh immo bezetim vehitna happoel sheyyochal bezetim hare ze ochel min hailan achat achat ufatur veim tzeref chayyav

Secharo lenakkesh bivtzalim vehitna leechol yarak mekarsem ale ale veochel veim tzeref chayyav katzatz happoel sheyyochal litra shel zetim ochel achat achat veim tzeref chayyav leasser hoil vehu ochel davar katzuv hare ze kelokeach sheim tzeref nikba lo kitztzetz ella haya ochel kedin tora metzaref veochel kal ma sheyyirtze vehu shello yispot bemelach aval im safat bemelach achat achat muttar shettayim shettayim asur shehare nikbeu bemelach
Poel shehaya ose bilvasin lo yochal bivnot sheva bivnot sheva lo yochal ballevasin ad sheyeasser aval yesh lo limnoa atzmo ad sheyyaggia limkom hayyafot

Hammotzi poalim laasot lo melacha bassade bizman sheen lahen alav mezonot ochlin mipperot shebbassade ufturin min hammaaser vehu shello nigmera melachtan aval im yesh lahen alav mezonot lo yochlu veaf al pi shello nigmera melachtan sheen porin chov min hattevel aval ochlin achat achat min hatteena aval lo min hassal velo min hkuppa velo min hammuktze
Echad hamvashshel veechad hashsholek veechad hakkovesh kovea lemaaser aval hamashshen et happerot ad shehichshiran hare ze safek
Hattomen perot baadama o batteven o bazzevel ad shehichshiran laachila lo nikbeu lemaaser

Hannoten yayin letavshil cham o shennatan shemen likdera beilfas keshehen meruttachin nikbeu lemaaser mazag yayin bemayim chammim nikba veen tzarich lomar im bishshel hayyayin vaafillu begat sheasur lishtot mimmennu ad sheyeasser
Hashshum vehashshachalim vehachardal sheshshechakan bassade beshemen nitbelu lemaaser vechen hassochet eshkol letoch hakkos nikba letoch hattamchuy eno nikba

Hammoleach perot bassade nikbeu taval hazzetim echad echad bemelach veachal patur happotzea zetim kede sheyyetze hassaraf mehem patur hannotel zetim min hammaatan tovel echad echad bemelach veochel veim malach venatan lefanav chayyav vechen kal kayyotze baze
Hattorem perotav teruma shetztzarich litrom achareha sheniyya nikbeu lemaaser velo yochal mehen aray ad sheyyotzi hatteruma hashsheniyya viasser
Perot shennigmera melachtan vechashcha alehen lele shabbat nikbeu velo yochal mehen afillu leachar hashshabbat ad sheyeasser
Tinokot shettamnu teenim leshabbat veshachchu leasseran lo yeachlu lemotzae shabbat ad sheyeasseru
Teena shehayeta meyuchedet lo leechol peroteha beshabbat velikket mimmenna kalkala lo yochal ad sheyeasser hoil uferot ellu meyuchadin leshabbat vehashshabbat kovaat
Haya ochel beeshkol vechashcha alav lele shabbat lo yigmor achilato beshabbat ad sheyeasser veim hinnichan leachar shabbat hare ze gomro
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 6: Machlikin bitenim vaanavim shel tevel veen baze mishshum hefsed vechal sheasur lezarim leachlo bitruma kegon haggarinin vechayyotze bahen kach asur leachlo min hattevel umin hammaaser shello nittela terumato umimmaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu vechal shemmuttar lezarim leachlo bitruma middevarim ellu kach muttar betevel uvmaaser shello nittela terumato umaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu

En madlikin betevel tame afillu bechol veen tzarich lomar beshabbat shenneemar et mishmeret terumotay ma teruma tehora en lecha bah ella mishsheat haramatah af teruma temea en lecha lehanot bah ella mishsheat haramatah veelach

En mechappin betevel veen zorin et hattevel vaafillu perot shello nigmera melachtan asur lizroa mehen ad sheyeasser bamme devarim amurim bitvua vekitniyyot vechayyotze bahen aval haoker shetilim sheyyesh bahen perot mimmakom lemakom betoch sadehu hare ze muttar veeno kezorea tevel shehare lo asaf happerot vechen haoker lefet utznonot ushtalam bemakom acher im nitkaven lehosif begufan muttar veim shetalan kede sheyekashshu veyikkach hazzera shellahen asur mippene shehu kezorea chittim o seorim shel tevel

Litra maaser tavul shezzeraah vehishbichah vahare hi eser litrin chayyevet bemaaser veotah litra measser aleha mimmakom acher lefi cheshbon litra betzalim shettikkenam uzraam eno measser lefi cheshbon hattosefet ella measser lefi kullo

Zeronim sheheviu shelish umrachan veisseran veachar kach zeraan vehosifu veen zaram kale hare ze safek im chayyavin bemaaser middivrehem hoil vehosifu o en chayyavin shehare hazzera sheadayin hu kayyam velo avad meussar hu veen ellu domim livtzalim shehabbetzalim en darkan lehizzara

Hazzorea et hattevel ben davar shezzaro kale ben davar sheen zaro kale im efshar lelakto konsin oto umlakketo veim tzamach en mechayevin oto laakor vehaggiddulin chullin veim haya davar sheen zaro kale afillu giddule giddulin asurin ad shalosh goranot veharvii muttar umippene ma haggiddulin asurin mippene terumat maaser utruma gedola shebbah vechen haddin bezorea maaser shello nittela terumato en mochrin et hattevel ella letzorech ulchaver veasur lishloach et hattevel vaafillu chaver lechaver shemma yismechu ze al ze veyeachel hattevel

Hammocher perot lachavero venizkar shehem tevel veratz acharav letakkeno velo metzao im yadua sheen kayyamin veshekkevar avdu o neechlu eno tzarich leasser alehem veim safek shehem kayyamin o en kayyamin tzarich lehotzi alehen maasrot mipperot acherot
Hammocher perot lachavero mocher omer al menat shehen tevel macharti velokeach omer lo lakachti mimmecha ella meessarin kofin et hammocher letakken kenas hu lo mippene shemmachar tevel
En porin chov min hattevel mippene shehu kemochro
Mi shellakchu bet hammelech et perotav vehem tevalim im mechamat shehu chayyav lahen tzarich lehotzi alehen maasrot veim lakchu beones eno tzarich leasser alehem

Hallokeach tevel mishshene mekomot measser mizze al ze hamkabbel sade miyyisrael o min hannachri cholek venoten levaal hassade befanav kede sheyyeda shettevel natal aval hachocher sade miyyisrael im natan lo mizzera otah sade torem veachar kach noten lo mizzo shekkatzatz litten lo uvaal hassade measser leatzmo veim natan lo mizzera sade acheret o mimmin acher motzi hammaaser veachar kach noten lo

Hachocher sade min haakkum measser veachar kach noten lo kenas kenasuhu baze kede shello yachkor min haakkum venimtzet hassade bura lefanav ad sheyyitztarech veyimkerenna leyisrael vechen hamkabbel sede avotav min haakkum kenasuhu sheyeasser veachar kach yitten chelko leakkum meussar kede shello yikpotz vikabbelah mimmennu mippene shehi sede avotav ad shettishshaer lefanav bura kede sheyyimkerenna leyisrael

E zehu chocher vee zehu mekabbel chocher shechocher hakkarka bedavar katzuv min hazzera bechach vechach sea ben asta harbe ben asta meat mekabbel hu sheyekabbel otah bechelek mimma shettease chetzo o shelisho o ma sheyyittenu benehen socher hu shessocher hakkarka bemaot

Shenayim shekkibbelu sade baarisut o yarshu o nishtattefu yachol haechad lomar lachavero tol atta chittim shebbemakom peloni vaani chittim shebbemakom peloni atta yayin shebbemakom peloni vaani yayin shebbemakom peloni aval lo yomar tol atta chittim vaani seorim atta yayin vaani shemen mippene shemmochrin et hattevel

Kohen o levi shellakchu perot miyyisrael achar shennigmera melachtan motziin et hatteruma vehammaasrot midehen venotnin otam lechohanim velilviyyim acherim kenas hu lahem kede shello yikpetzu lagoranot ulgittot veyiknu tevalim kede lehafkia mattenot achehem hakkohanim veim kanu kodem shettiggamer melachtan en motziim miyyadam

Kohen o levi shemmachru perot telushin leyisrael kodem shettiggamer melachtan veen tzarich lomar im machru bimchubbar hare hatteruma o hammaaser shellahem veim machru achar gemar melacha hare hatteruma vehammaaser shel lokeach umafrish venoten lechal kohen o levi sheyyirtze

Kohen velevi shekkibbelu sade miyyisrael keshem shecholkin bechullin kach cholkin bitruma uvmaasrot vehayyisrael notel chelko venoten lechal kohen o levi sheyyirtze aval yisrael shekkibbel sade mikkohen o millevi hatteruma o hammaaser levaal hassade ushar hammattanot cholkin
Hamkabbel zetim lehotzi mehen shemen ben yisrael mikkohen o levi ben kohen o levi miyyisrael keshem shecholkin bechullin kach cholkin bitruma umaasrot mippene shehashshemen chashuv hu

Kohen shemmachar sade leyisrael veamar lo al menat shehammaaser shellah shelli leolam hare hen shello kevan sheamar al menat naase kemi sheshshiyyer mekom hammaaser veim met hakkohen hare beno kishar hakkohanim veim amar lo al menat shehammaasrot li velivni met hu yitlem beno al menat shehammaasrot shelli kal zeman shehi lefanecha mecharah leacher af al pi shechazar ulkachah en lakkohen otam hammaasrot

Yisrael shekkibbel sade mikkohen velevi veamar lo al menat shehammaasrot shelli arba o chamesh shanim muttar al menat shehen shelli leolam asur sheen kohen ose kohen vechen ben levi shehaya alav chov leyisrael lo yihye yisrael ze gove meacherim umafrish ad sheyyifra keneged chovo sheen levi ze ose baal chov shello kelevi acher sheyyigbe maaser meacherim

Yisrael sheyyarash tevel memorach meavi immo kohen veoto avi immo yerasho meavi immo yisrael hare ze mafrish mimmennu maasrotav vehen shello shehammattanot haruot litarem kemo shehurmu hen af al pi shello hurmu

Hannoten sadehu bekabbala leakkum o lemi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot af al pi shello bau leonat maasrot tzarich leasser al yadam netanah leam haaretz ad shello bau leonat hammaasrot eno tzarich leasser al yadam umishshebbau leonat hammaasrot tzarich leasser al yadam ketzad hu ose omed al haggoren venotel veeno choshesh lema sheachlu sheen anu achrain lahem
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 7: Mi shehau lo mea log shel yayin tavul min hattora veamar shene login sheani atid lehafrish mehen hare hen teruma vaasara maaser rishon vetisha maaser sheni lo yatchil veyishte ad sheyyanniach besof shiur teruma umaasrot ella yafrish veachar kach yishte veen omrin ze shehinniach bassof keillu nivrar techilla mippene shechiyyuv teruma umaasrot min hattora veen omrin beshel tora nachshov keillu nivrar ad sheyyivror
Hakkovea maasrotav befi hechavit lo yishte mishshuleha beshuleha lo yishte mippiha mippene shehammashkin meoravin aval hakkovea befi hammegura ochel mishshuleha kava beshuleha ochel mippiha
Veyesh laadam likboa maaser sheni ufodehu veosehu maaser rishon al otan happerot o terumat maaser lemakom acher

Hammanniach perot lihot mafrish alehen maasrot mafrish alehen bechezkat shehen kayyamin veochel veshote ad sheyyeasu kal otan happerot shehinniach maaser venoten lallevi metzaan sheavdu hare ze choshesh lechal shehifrish veeno measser vadday
Hammalve maot et hakkohen veet hallevi veet heani lihot mafrish al otan hammaot mechelko mafrish alehen bechezkat shehen kayyamin veeno choshesh shemma metu hakkohen o hallevi o heeshir heani

Ketzad mafrish alehen mafrish teruma o maaser rishon o maaser sheni mipperotav umzakke bahen al yede acher leoto kohen o hallevi o heani shehilum veim hau regilin littol mimmennu vehu ragil shello yitten ella lahen eno tzarich lezakkot al yede acher veachar shemmafrish mechashshev kamma shave ze shehifrish umnakke min hammilve ad sheyyifra kal chovo umocher hatteruma lechal kohen sheyyirtze veochel hammaasrot

Keshehu mechashshev ma shavim happerot shehifrish yesh lo lechashshev kashshaar hazzol veeno choshesh mishshum ribbit veen hashsheviit meshammetet chov ze veim ba baal habbayit lachazor eno chozer aval im ratzu ellu shellakchu hammaot lachazor chozrin nityaashu mehen habbealim en mafrishin alehen sheen mafrishin al haavud met hakkohen o hallevi o heani shehilum eno yachol lehafrish alehen mechelkan kadderech hazzo ad sheyyittol reshut min hayyorshin vehu sheyyanniach lahen karka afillu melo machat aval im hinniach kesafim en reshut hayyoresh moelet veim hilvam bevet din al menat sheyyafrish al maot ellu mechelkam eno tzarich littol reshut min hayyorshin heeshir heani en mafrishin alav af al pi shehiluhu bevet din zoche halla bema shebbeyado
Yisrael sheamar leven levi kor maaser yesh lecha beyadi rashshay ben levi laasoto terumat maaser al makom acher af al pi shello mashach veim netano hayyisrael lelevi acher en lo alav ella taromet

Mi shehau lo perot bimgura venatan sea lelevi usa leani lo yafrish shemone sein min hammegura veyochlem ella im ken yodea sheshshette sein shel maasrot kayyamin aval im achlu mehen hallevi veheani eno mafrish alehen ella lefi cheshbon hannishar mishshette hassein

Aniyyim shehechlifu mattenotehen im baal habbayit kegon shennatnu lo sea shel leket o shichcha ufea umaaser ani venatlu sea min haggoren ze shennatal mehem patur min hammaaser af al pi shennaasa birshut baal habbayit veze shennatlu mimmennu chayyav af al pi shehu chelef mattenotehen happeturin

Mi shehau lefanav shette kalkalot shel tevel shennittela terumatan veamar maasrot zo bazo harishona meusseret amar maasrot zo bazo vezo bazo harishona meesseret shehare kava maasroteha bashsheniyya veen hashsheniyya meesseret sheen mafrishin maaser min harishona shekkevar niftera al hashsheniyya sheadayin hi chayyevet bemaasar shettehen
Amar maasrot shette kalkalot ellu maaser kal achat mehen kavua bachavertah kara shem uchvar kava maasrotehen bahen umotzi hammaasrot shellahen veeno yachol lehotzi alehen maasrot mimmakom acher

Vechetzad measseran motzi maasar shettehen meachat mehen o measser kal achat mehen mimmenna im hau shaot veim hayeta achat gedola mechavertah mafrish min hakketanna maasar haggedola umin haggedola maasar hakketanna
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 8: Happerot shehuram mehen teruma gedola utrumat maaser hen hannikrain chullin veim hifrish mehen shear maasrotehen hen hannikrain chullin metukkanin bechal makom

Tevel shennitarev bechullin metukkanin min bemino shei efshar lehallech achar hattaam im yesh lo perot acherot motzi al oto tevel teruma umaasrot lefi cheshbon veim en lo perot acherot lehotzi al oto tevel hare hakkol asur ad sheyyafrish uchshehu mafrish mafsid min hachullin hamtukkanin kede terumat maaser shebbattevel

Ketzad mea sea shel tevel shennitarev bemea sea shel chullin metukkanin mafrish min hakkol echad umea vechal shehifrish tevel veyishshaer chullin metukkanin nimtza mafsid sea achat vechen im haya oto tevel tavul litruma mafsid min hachullin hamtukkanin kede teruma utrumat maaser velamma mafsid sea zo kede shello yomar mea shehifrish hen mea shel chullin vehammea shennisharu hu hattevel vechen im haya hattevel pachot min hachullin o merubbe al hachullin magbiha hattevel uchde terumat maaser shebbattevel min hachullin o kede teruma utrumat maaser im haya hattevel tavul litruma

Vechen im nitarev maaser tavul bechullin metukkanin oser bechal shehu im yesh lo maaser acher motzi oto al maaser hattavul terumat maaser lefi cheshbon veim en lo maaser magbiha hammaaser shennitarev umafsid min hachullin hamtukkanin kede terumat maaser shebbamaaser hattavul

Ketzad mea maaser shennitarev bemea chullin metukkanin mafrish min hakkol mea veeser vechal shehifrish maaser vehattishim hannisharot hen chullin keshehau vechen im hau hachullin merubbin al hammaaser hattavul o pechutim mimmennu mafrish hammaaser uchde terumat maaser shebbamaaser hattavul min hachullin

Tevel shennitarev bemaaser tavul im haya hattevel kamaaser mafsid min hattevel kede terumat maaser shebbo ketzad mea sea tevel shennitarev bemea sea maaser mafrish echad umea veze shehifrish maaser vetishim vetesha hannisharot tevel haya hattevel merubbe al hammaaser mafrish hammaaser bilvad velo yafsid min hattevel kelum sheim yikra shem litrumat maaser shennitbal nimtza hammaaser medumma bitrumat maaser shel tevel shealta immo haya hammaaser merubbe al hattevel kore shem litrumat maaser shebbattevel umafrish hattevel uchde terumat maaser shel tivlo echad mimmea min hammaaser veyihye hattevel kullo medumma veyimkerenna lechohen chutz middeme shette terumot shebbo venimtza mafsid min hammaaser echad mimmea shebbo shehu kemo terumat maaser shebbattevel ketzad mea tevel im matayim maaser mafrish mea veshalosh vehashshalosh hen terumat maaser shel mea tevel veshiur terumat maaser mimmatayim kede shello yavo litot im nitarvu bichmoto veyishshaer vehem maaser keshehau

Mi shehau lo eser shurot shel eser eser kadde yayin vekava kad echad mishshura hachitzona maaser al makom acher veen yadua e zo shura hachitzona hi notel shette chaviyyot baalachson umarev shettehen umafrish mehen

Kevaah bachatzi shura hachitzona veen yadua e zo chatzi shura hi notel arba chaviyyot mearba zaviyyot kevaah beshura achat mehen veen yadua e zo shura hi notel shura achat baalachson kevaah bachatzi shura veen yadua e zo chatzi shura hi notel shette shurot baalachson shehare natal chavit mikkal chatzi shura umarev umafrish
Kava hammaaser bechad achat mehen veen yadua e zo hi notel mikkal kad vechad min hammea umarev umafrish kede kad achat umasser
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 9: Bime yochanan kohen gadol shehaya achar shimon hatztzaddik shalchu bet din haggadol uvadku bechal gevul yisrael umatzu shehakkol zehirim bitruma gedola umafrishin otah aval maaser rishon umaaser sheni umaasar ani hau amme haaretz miyyisrael mekillin al atzman velo hau mafrishin otan lefichach gazru shello yehe neeman al hammaasrot ella anashim neemanim aval amme haaretz perotehen safek veen neemanin lomar meessarin hen vezehu hannikra demay

Vehitkinu shello yehe adam mafrish min haddemay ella terumat maaser mippene shehu aon mita umaaser sheni sheen baze hefsed shehare bealav ochlin oto aval maaser rishon umaasar ani en mafrish min haddemay mippene shehu safek vehammotzi mechavero alav haraya lefichach omer lallevi o leani have reaya sheeno meessar vetol maasrot

Af al pi sheen mafrishin maasar ani min haddemay tzarich likrot lo shem veeno mafrish veomer issur ma sheyyesh kan maasar ani kede likboa maaser sheni shemmaasar ani bishlishit veshishshit bimkom maaser sheni shel shear shene hashshavua
Keshemmafrishin min haddemay terumat maaser umaaser sheni en mevarchin alehen lefi shehu safek lefichach muttar lehafrish keshehu erom

Ketzad measserin et haddemay mafrish kede terumat maaser shehu echad mimmea min hakkol umannichah betzad happerot veomer ze maaser ushar maaser samuch lo veachar kach omer ze sheamarti alav shehu maaser hare hu terumat maaser al shear hammaaser hassamuch lo venotel otah venotnah lakkohen sheeno rashshay lehafrish terumat maaser kodem hammaaser lechattechilla veachar kach mafrish maaser sheni

Umuttar lehafrish maaser sheni kodem harishon bidmay veim ratza omer maaser sheni shel perot ellu bitzfonam o bidromam vahare hu mechullal al hammaot vechen hallokeach kikkar min hannachtom mafrish mimmenna kede terumat maaser vechalla veomer echad mimmea mimma sheyyesh kan hare hu maaser ushar maaser samuch lo veze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser al hashshear hassamuch lo vehayyeter al echad mimmea sheyyesh baze shehifrashti hare hu challa umaaser sheni bitzfonah o bidromah vahare hu mechullal al hammaot veochel

Vechen hammazmin et chavero sheyyochal etzlo vehu eno maamino al hammaasrot omer meerev shabbat ma sheani atid lehafrish lemachar hare hu maaser ushar maaser samuch lo veze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser al shear hassamuch lo umaaser sheni bitzfono o bidromo vahare hu mechullal al hammaot mippene shemmuttar leadam lehatnot tenaim ellu al haddemay af al pi sheeno birshuto aval bevadday eno matne ella al davar shebbirshuto

Ketzad hau lo mea teenim shel tevel beveto vehu bevet hammidrash o bassade umityare shemma techshach veeno yachol leasser beshabbat omer shene teenim sheani atid lehafrish hare hen teruma veeser sheani mafrish acharehen maaser rishon tesha sheani mafrish acharehen maaser sheni ulmachar mafrish veochel

Vetzarich lirchosh bisfatav beshaa shemmafrish zo achar zo veeno kimtakken beshabbat shehare hikdim tenao vetevel sheyyesh alav tenay ze muttar letaltelo beshabbat kodem sheyyafrish venoten enav betzad ze veochel et hashshear

Natan lo am haaretz kos lishtoto omer ma sheani atid leshayyer beshule hakkos hare hu maaser ushar maaser samuch lo veze sheasiti maaser asuy terumat maaser al hashshear hassamuch lo umaaser sheni befi hakkos vahare hu mechullal al hammaot veshote umanniach kede terumat maaser beshule hakkos

Vechen im zimmeno chavero lishtot beshabbat matne kitnay ze meerev shabbat al kal ma sheyyirtze sheyyisod etzlo vechen poel sheeno maamin levaal habbayit notel gerogeret achat veomer zo vetesha habbaot achareha asuot maaser al hammea sheani atid leechol vezo haachat terumat maaser al haeser habbaot achareha umaaser sheni hu haeser haacharonot vahare hu mechullal al hammaot venoten haggerogeret shehifrish lakkohen vehappoel mafrish leatzmo deme maaser sheni shettenay bet din hu shettihye terumat maaser mishshel baal habbayit umaaser sheni mishshel poel

Hannachtomim lo chiyevum chachamim lehafrish maaser sheni min haddemay ella terumat maaser bilvad kede sheyyafrishenna betahora im hachalla vehallokeach mafrish maaser sheni bamme devarim amurim bemocher bachanuto o al petach chanuto aval hammocher lefalter o bachanut hassemucha lefalter chayyav lehafrish af maaser sheni

Shenayim shebbatzru karmehen betoch gat achat vehaechad mehem eno neeman al hammaasrot af al pi sheisser ze hanneeman al chelko keshehu notel chelko min hayyayin chayyav lehafrish mimmennu maaser demay al chelek am haaretz ketzad hau mechetza lemechetza venotel bechetzo matayim log yayin hare ze mafrish mimmennu log echad terumat maaser veeser maaser sheni keneged hammea log shehare hifrish hammaaser shel vadday techilla al chatzi kal shedderacho baggat vechen im haya shelish o revia mafrish lefi cheshbon
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 10: Hamkabbel alav lihot neeman al hammaasrot velo yihu perotav demay tzarich lihot measser et shehu ochel veet shehu mocher veet shehu lokeach veeno mitareach etzel am haaretz vetzarich sheyekabbel alav devarim ellu barabbim uchsheyyavou edim neemanin shekkibbel devarim ellu barabbim veshehu ragil bahem tamid hare ze neeman al perotav lomar meessarin hen

Kal talmid chacham leolam neeman veeno tzarich bedika acharav uvanav uvne beto vaavadav veishto hare hem kamohu talmid chacham shemmet vehinniach perot afillu kenasam beoto hayyom hare hen bechezkat metukkanin

Bat am haaretz o ishto shennisset lechaver veavdo shennimkar lechaver tzerichin lekabbel alehem battechilla uvat chaver o ishto shennisset leam haaretz veavdo shennimkar leam haaretz hare hen bechezkatan ad sheyyechashdu beno o avdo shel chaver shehau lemudin etzel am haaretz tzerichin lekabbel beno o avdo shel am haaretz shehau lemudim etzel chaver kal zeman shehen etzlo hare hen kechaver yatzu hare hen keam haaretz
Mi sheeno neeman vehaya echad mibbanav o meavadav neeman o echad mimmishpachto lokchin mimmennu veochlin al pihen veenan choshshin ledavar

Haya hu neeman veishto enah neemenet lokchim mimmennu veen mitarchin etzlo hayeta ishto neemenet vehu eno neeman mitarchin etzlo veen lokchin mimmennu vetavo meera lemi sheishto neemenet vehu eno neeman

Lo yeshammesh chaver lo bemishte am haaretz velo bisuddato ella im ken haya hakkol meussar umtukkan mittachat yado lefichach haroe chaver meshammesh bemishte am haaretz o bisuddato hare hakkol bechezkat metukkan umussar rauhu mesev im amme haaretz en hasseudda bechezkat meusseret shemma hechaver al hattenaim shebbelibbo hu somech

Keshem sheadam soed etzel am haaretz vesomech al tenao kach hu tzarich lihot matne al beno vaafillu haya beno bemakom acher aval eno tzarich lihot matne al acher chutz mibbeno vaafillu haya immo bemishte lefichach ben chaver shehaya mesev bemishte am haaretz en hasseudda bechezkat meusseret shemma aviv hitna alav

Am haaretz shennatan maa lechaver veamar lo kach li aguddat yarak achat o geluska achat lokeach lo setam ufatur milleasser veim hechelif et hammaa chayyav leasser veachar kach yavi lo veim peresh hechaver velo lekachan setam ella amar lachenvani agudda zo sheani lokeach mimmecha lachaveri ani kone otah vezo leatzmi ani kone otah zo shellakach leatzmo chayyav leasserah vezo shellakach lachavero eno tzarich leasserah veim nitarvu afillu nitarva achat shello bemea shel chavero metakken hakkol demay veachar kach yitten lachavero sheshshelacho likkach lo

Chamishsha sheamru leechad tze vehave lanu chamesh aguddot shel yarak vehevi lechal echad veechad bifne atzmo chaverim shebbahen en tzerichin leasser ella al chelkan bilvad hevi lahen beirbuv chaverim shebbahem tzerichin leasser hakkol

Am haaretz sheamar lechaver tze velakket li teenim mitteenati ochel mehen hechaver aray umasseran demay veim amar hechaver leam haaretz lilkot lo veshama chaver acher ze haacher ochel veeno tzarich leasser sheen hechaver motzi davar sheeno metukkan mittachat yado vechezkato shehifrish aleha mimmakom acher af al pi shello nechshedu chaverim litrom shello min hammukkaf kede lesallek hammichshol millifne am haaretz tormin
Muttar lehaachil et haaniyyim veet haorchim demay vetzarich lehodian veheani atzmo vehaoreach im ratzu letakken metakkenin
Gabbae tzedaka govin setam mikkal adam umchallekim setam veharotze letakken yetakken

Rofe chaver shehaya maachil lechole am haaretz mipperot am haaretz noten letoch yado aval lo letoch piv veim haya haddemay shel rofe afillu letoch yado lo yitten vechen im yada shehu tevel vadday afillu letoch yado asur
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 11: Asur limkor et haddemoy leam haaretz o lishloach lo demay mippene shehu mesayyea laze leechol davar haasur aval mochrin umshallechin oto letalmide chachamim sheen talmid chacham ochel ad sheyeasser o ad sheyyodio adam neeman shezze meussar

Kal hammashpiin bemidda gassa kegon hassitonot umochre tevua muttarin limkor et haddemay ulshallecho mippene shehen mosifin al hammidda hitkinu chachamim sheyyihye hallokeach o ze shennishtallechu lo hu hammafrish maaser demay aval hammoddin bemidda dakka hoil vehammocher mistakker hu mafrish velo yimkor velo yishlach ella metukkan
Vechamma hi midda gassa beyavesh chatzi sea uvlach midda shemmachzeket sheve dinar meoto davar hallach
Salle zetim vaanavim vekuppot shel yarak af al pi shehu mochran achsara asur lemachran demay
Amar echad mehen bo untakken happerot haellu ben shehaya mocher bedakka o begassa hammocher mafrish terumat maaser vehallokeach mafrish maaser sheni vedavar ze tenay bet din hu

Chaver veam haaretz sheyyarshu et avihen am haaretz yachol hu lomar tol atta chittim shebbemakom peloni vaani chittim shebbemakom peloni atta yayin shebbemakom peloni vaani yayin shebbemakom peloni aval lo yomar tol atta chittim vaani seorim tol atta hallach vaani hayyavesh mippene shezze mocher demay
Mi shehaya nose yarak vechaved alav massao veratza lehashlich mimmennu al hadderech kede lehakel mimmassao lo yashlich ad sheyeasser kede shello tehe takkala leamme haaretz sheochlin oto bidmay
Hallokeach yarak min hashshuk umashach af al pi shello shakal velo madad velo natan damim venimlach lehachazir levaal hachanut lo yachazir ad sheyeasser
Hammotze perot badderech im rov machnisin levattehen patur milleasser sheadayin lo nikba lemaaser veim rov machnisin limkor bashshuk hare ellu demay umechetza lemechetza demay

Netalan leachlan venimlach lehatznia lo yashhe otan ad sheyeasser kede shello yihye takkala laacherim veim netalam mittechilla shello yovdu hare ze muttar lashhotan etzlo ad sheyyirtze leachlan o leshalchan o lemachran viasser otan demay
Kenivat yarak hannimtzet bagginna hare zo petura min haddemay veshel baal habbayit hannimtzet babbayit chayyevet sheal gabbe haashpa bechal makom mutteret

Hannoten lefundakit levashshel lo veleefot lo measser et shehu noten lah kede shello yihye takkala laacherim umasser et shehu notel mimmenna mippene shehi chashuda lehachalif shel ze baze aval hannoten lachamoto ben shennasa bittah ben sheersah o lishchento pat leefot vetavshil levashshel eno choshesh lo mishshum maaser velo mishshum sheviit mippene sheenah chashuda lehachalif bamme devarim amurim bizman shennatan lah seor leisa vetavlin likdera aval im lo natan choshesh mishshum maasrot vechoshesh mishshum sheviit ulfichach im hayeta shenat shemitta asur shemma hasseor missefiche sheviit hu

Hammolich chittav letochen am haaretz hare hen bechezkatan sheeno chashud lehachalif holichan letochen akkum hare hem demay shemma hechelifan bechittim shel am haaretz vechen hammafkid etzel am haaretz hare hen bechezkatan sheeno chashud lehachalif happikkadon
Am haaretz shehaya mishtammesh bachanuto shel chaver af al pi shehechaver yotze venichnas hare ze muttar veeno choshesh shemma hechelif

Hammafkid perotav etzel haakkum hare hen keferotav shel akkum shechezkato lehachalif happikkadon veheach dinam im hau perot sheadayin lo nigmera melachtan venigmeru beyad yisrael achar shellakach happikkadon mafrish maasrotav kemo shebbearnu veim hau perot shehifkid tevalim venigmera melachtan chayyav lehafrish shemma lo hechelif haakkum ulfichach yerae li shehammaasrot sheyyafrish safek aval im hifkid chullin metukkanin eno tzarich lehafrish kelum sheafillu hechelif haakkum peturin kemo shebbearnu behilchot terumot degancha velo degan akkum
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 12: Halokeach perot mimmi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot veshachach leasseran venichnesa shabbat o yom tov sheeno yachol leasser hare ze shoalo veim amar lo meussarin hen ochel al piv beshabbat vechen im amar lo echad sheeno neeman meussarin hen ochel al piv beotah shabbat vaafillu hau lo perot acherot metukkanin meoto hammin mippene sheemat shabbat al amme haaretz veeno over bah avera

Af al pi shehu ochel al piv beshabbat hare ze lo yochal meotan happerot lemotzae shabbat ad sheyeasser demay al hakkol al sheachal beshabbat veal hannishar shello hekellu veheeminuhu ella letzorech otah shabbat hayeta shabbat veom tov samuch lah ushalo beechad mehen ochel af bashsheni mippene shello nire leasser bentayim vechen bishne yamim tovim shel galuyyot

Hannishba al chavero sheyyochal immo beshabbat vehu eno maamino al hammaasrot shoel veochel al piv bashshabbat harishona bilvad aval beshabbat sheniyya af al pi shennadar mimmennu hanaa im lo yochal etzlo lo yochal ad sheyeasser demay

Mi sheeno neeman sherinuhu shehifrish terumat maaser mipperotav shehen demay urinuhu shechazra venafla befanenu ben lemakom acher ben limkomah vechazar veamar hifrashtiha neeman afillu bechol veochel al piv keshem sheemat shabbat al amme haaretz kach emat dimmua alehem veenan chashudin lehaachil et hamdumma

Mi sheeno neeman sherinuhu shehifrish maaser rishon mipperot ellu veamar shehifrish mehen maaser sheni neeman hifrish maaser sheni befanenu veamar shehifrish maaser rishon eno neeman shehashsheni shello vehanneeman al hashsheni eno neeman al harishon vehanneeman al harishon neeman al hashsheni lefichach mi sheeno neeman shehotzi perot mibbeto veamar ellu maaser rishon neeman veen mafrishin mehen terumot umaasrot veim amar ellu maaser sheni eno neeman vahare hen demay umafrishin mehen terumat maaser veyerae li shehu pode et kullam

Haomer lemi sheeno neeman al hammaasrot kach li mimmi shehu measser vehalach velakach vehevi lo eno neeman veim amar lo kach li meish peloni hare ze neeman lomar mimmennu lakachti shehare mityare shemma yishalennu halach likkach lo meoto peloni veamar lo metzativ velakachti lecha meacher shehu neeman eno neeman

Hannichnas leir veeno makkir adam sham veamar mi kan neeman mi kan measser veamar lo echad ani eno neeman amar lo ish peloni hare ze neeman velokeach meoto peloni af al pi sheeno makkiro veholech veochel al piv halach velakach mimmennu veshaal lo mi kan mocher yayin yashan amar lo ze sheshshelachacha etzli af al pi shehen kegomlin ze et ze hare ellu neemanin
Bamme devarim amurim bizman sheeno makkir adam sham aval im makkir adam sham lo yikkach ella min hammumche veim shaha sham sheloshim yom af al pi sheeno makkir adam sham lo yikkach ella min hammumche
Velo hittiru devarim ellu ella bitrumot umaasrot aval leinyan perot sheviit o leinyan tahorot lo yikkach ella min hammumche
Hachammarin shennichnesu lair veamar echad mehen perot ellu enam metukkanim uferot chaveri metukkanin eno neeman shemma kenunya asu benehen

Hammocher perot besurya veamar mishshel eretz yisrael hem chayyav hallokeach leasser meussarin hen neeman shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir mishshelli hen chayyav leasser meussarin hen neeman shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir veim yadua sheyyesh lo karka besurya vehaya rov mimkaro missadehu chayyav hallokeach mimmennu leasser shechezkato shemmissadehu heviam

Aniyyim sheamru perot ellu shel leket shichcha ufea hare ellu neemanin kal zeman haggoranot shehalleket vehashshichcha vehappea metzuyim vehu sheyyihye karov min haggoren kede sheyyetze veyavo bo bayyom veim amru shel maasar ani hem hare ellu neemanin kal hashshana kullah veenan neemanin ella al davar shedderech bene adam litteno

Ketzad chittim ellu leket shichcha ufea hem hare ellu neemanim kemach ze shel leket shichcha ufea hu enam neemanin veen tzarich lomar sheen neemanin al happat lomar mimmattenot aniyyim hu ella mitasserin demay

Neemanin al hasseora shel orez veen neemanin alav ben chay ben mevushshal neemanin al happol veen neemanin al haggerisin ben chayyin ben mevushshalin neemanin al hashshemen lomar shel maasar ani hu veen neemanin lomar shel zete nikkuf hem neemanin al hayyarak chay velo mevushshal ella im ken haya davar muat shekken derech baale battim litten meat yarak mevushshal mikkederato leani umittoch sheyyachol lomar habbaal habbayit netano li yachol lomar ani bishshaltiv mimmattenotay

Vechen ben levi sheamar perot ellu mimmaaser rishon shennittela terumato hem hare ze neeman leolam al terumat maaser keshem sheyyisrael neeman al teruma gedola aval eno neeman alav lefatro mimmaaser sheni

En kal haddevarim haellu amurin ella beam haaretz sheeno lo chashud velo neeman aval mi shehu chashud limkor teruma leshem chullin asur likkach mimmennu kelal davar sheyyesh bo zikkat teruma umaaser afillu kirve dagim mippene shennotnin bahem shemen veen asur ella kal shellefanav aval atzaro muttar likkach mimmennu mippene shehu mityare learev teruma beotzaro shemma yivada haddavar veyafsid hakkol vechen hechashud lemaaser sheni lemachran leshem chullin en lokchin mimmennu davar sheyyesh alav zikkat maaser vechal ze kenas middivrehem

Chashud sheheid al shel acherim neeman chazaka en adam chote velo lo veen tzarich lomar am haaretz lefichach am haaretz sheamar ze tevel veze teruma ze vadday veze demay afillu beshello neeman amar ellu perot metukkanin beshel acherim neeman vehu shello yerau keose kenunya kemo shebbearnu

Hammocher perot lachavero veachar sheyyatzu mittachat yado amar lallokeach perot shemmacharti lecha tevalim hen habbasar besar bechor haya hayyayin yen nesech shurat haddin sheeno neeman afillu haya hammocher chaver vehazzariz machamir al atzmo veim heemino hare ze meshubbach afillu haya hammocher am haaretz
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 13: Perot shechezkatan min hahefikir kegon hashshitin veharimin vehaozradin uvnot shuach uvnot shikma vehaggufanin venovlot temara vehen sheadayin lo hittilu seor hannitzpa vehakkusbar vechayyotze bahen peturin min haddemay vehallokchan meam haaretz eno tzarich lehafrish mehen terumat maaser velo maaser sheni mippene shechezkatan min hahefker afillu amar lo am haaretz enam meussarin hare ellu peturin min hammaasrot ad sheyyivada lo shehen min hashshamur

Habbechorot vehasseyyafot shebbevika peturin min haddemay veshebbeginna chayyavin mippene shehen nishmarin veellu hen habbechorot kal happerot shebbikkeru ad shello hoshivu shomer al habbika lishmor peroteha vehasseyyafot hen happerot sheyyishshaaru achar sheyekappelu hammiktzoot shebbassadot veyannichum belo shomer vechen hachometz heasuy min hattemadim patur min haddemay

Kesheggazru al haddemay lo gazru ella al perot haaretz shehecheziku bah ole bavel bilvad shehu mikkeziv velifnim uchziv atzmah kelachutz vechal happerot hannimtzaot mikkeziv velachutz peturin min haddemay shechezkatan mipperot makom shennimtzeu bo

Perot sheyyadua shehen mipperot haaretz shehecheziku bah ole bavel af al pi shehen nimtzaot besurya veen tzarich lomar baaretz shehecheziku bah ole mitzrayim bilvad hare ellu chayyavin bidmay umafrishin mehen terumat maaser umaaser sheni lefichach haddevela hashshemena sheen kemotah ella baaretz shehecheziku ole bavel vechen hattemarim haggedolim vehecharuvin hashshavim vehaorez hallavan beoter vehakkammon haggadol mitasserin demay bechal eretz yisrael uvsurya vechen kal kayyotze beferot ellu

Hachammarim sheheviu perot letzor chayyavin bidmay shechezkatan mehaaretz shehecheziku ole bavel shehi hakkerova lah vehaorez en choshshin lo ella kal haorez hannimtza chutza laaretz shehi kerova laaretz shehecheziku ole bavel patur min haddemay ella im ken haya nikkar kemo shebbearnu
Hallokeach mibbaale otzarot betzor patur min haddemay veen omrin shemma mipperot haaretz atzaro vechen chamor yechidi shennichnas letzor vehu taun perot patur min haddemay shechezkatan missede hair

Hallokeach mibbaale otzar betzidon chayyav bidmay mippene shekkerova hi yoter mitztzor shechezkatah sheotzrin mipperot haaretz shehecheziku ole bavel aval hallokeach min hachammarim betzidon patur min haddemay mippene shechezkatan shemmeviin michutza laaretz

Hallokeach min haakkum baaretz shehecheziku ole bavel im haya taggar akkum shellokeach miyyisrael hare perotav demay lefichach barishona bizman shehaya rov eretz yisrael beyad yisrael hallokeach mikkal taggar akkum measser demay kelokeach meam haaretz
E zehu taggar ze shehevi shettayim veshalosh peamim aval im hevi paam achat afillu hevi shalosh massoot bevat achat o shehevi hu uvno ufoel adayin lo huchzak taggar
Kesheggazru al haddemay lo gazru al perot chutza laaretz shennichnesu laaretz

Perot haaretz sherabbu al shel chutza laaretz hare ellu chayyavin bidmay veshel chutza laaretz sherabbu al perot haaretz vechen devarim shechezkatan tadir michutza laaretz kegon egozim vedurmaskaot hare ellu peturin min haddemay

Lo halchu chachamim beferot chutza laaretz lo achar hammare velo achar hattaam vehareach ella achar harov kal sherabbu lo muttar veshello rabbu lo asur ketzad rabbu bair aval lo bammedina o sherabbu bammedina velo rabbu bair bahar velo rabbu babbika babbika velo bahar rabbu lachenvani velo levaal habbayit levaal habbayit velo lachenvani ze sherabbu bo muttar umakom shello rabbu bo chayyav bidmay
Rabbu perot chutza laaretz bashshuk venitmaatu chazar hashshuk leyashno vehallokeach mimmennu chayyav bidmay

Veellu devarim shello gazru alehen beshaa sheggazru al haddemay hallokeach perot lizria o lehaachil livhema kemach leorot o limlugma o lirtiyya shemen lehadlakat hanner o lasuch bo et hakkelim yayin lekilor vechallat am haaretz vehamdumma vehallakuach bechesef maaser sheni ushyare hammenachot vetosefet habbikkurim kal ellu peturim min haddemay vechevan sheamar lo am haaretz metukkanin hem eno tzarich leasser
Hallokeach perot laachila venimlach alehem livhema hare ze lo yimkerem leakkum velo yaachilem livhema afillu levehemat acherim ad sheyetakkenem demay

Shemen arev patur min haddemay sheen chezkato laachila shemen shellakach hassorek letitto betzemer patur min haddemay mippene shehu nivla batztzemer aval shemen shellokeach haoreg lasuch ben etzbeotav chayyav bidmay mippene shehu nivla begufo vesicha hi kishtiyya bechal makom
Akkum sheshshaal miyyisrael litten lo shemen al makkato asur bevadday umuttar bidmay natan haakkum shemen al gabbe tavla lehitaggel aleha mishsheamad muttar leyisrael leshev acharav

Mi shennafal shemen demay al besaro meshafshefo veeno choshesh hallokeach yayin lemuryas o laaluntit o kitniyyot laasot techinin chayyav bidmay aval hallokeach muryas sheyyesh bo yayin o aluntit o shellakach techinin hare ellu peturin min haddemay shello gazru al taarovet demay veim haya haddavar shechayyav bidmay shennitarev kegon tavlin usor hoil vetaamo nikkar enan betelim venimtzet kal hattaarovet chayyevet bidmay

Kal ellu happeturin min haddemay shello gazru alehem im hitkinan demay vehifrish mehem terumat maaser umaaser sheni ma sheasa asuy aval im tikken et haddemay bevadday vehifrish mimmennu teruma gedola umaasrot o shettikken et havadday bidmay lo asa kelum

Kal hair mochrin vadday veechad mocher demay velakach veen yadua mimmi lakach ketzad metakken mafrish teruma utrumat maaser venotnan lechohen umafrish maaser sheni bilvad vahare hu kemaaser sheni shel demay

Vechen im hau lefanav shette kuppot achat tevel veachat metukkan veavda achat mehem hare ze mafrish min hashsheniyya teruma gedola utrumat maaser venotnan lechal kohen sheyyirtze umafrish maaser sheni bilvad bidmay
Mishneh Torah, Tithes 14: Halokeach min hassiton vichazar velakach mimmennu paam sheniyya lo yeasser mizze al ze af al pi shehu min echad afillu mikkuppa achat af al pi shemmakkir et hechavit shehi hi mippene shehassiton lokeach meanashim harbe umocher veshemma lakach ze shemmachar techilla meam haaretz shepperotav demay veze shellakach bassof mechaver shepperotav metukkanin uchvar bearnu sheen measserin min hachayyav al happatur velo min happatur al hachayyav veim amar hassiton mishshel echad hen neeman
Haya mocher keshut o yarak vehen meviin vetzovrin lefanav hallokeach mimmennu measser mikkal keshut uchshut umikkal agudda vaagudda umikkal temara utmara
Hallokeach mibbaal habbayit vechazar velakach mimmennu sheniyya measser mizze al ze afillu mishshette kuppot afillu mishshette ayarot shechezkato sheeno mocher ella mishshello

Baal habbayit shehaya mocher yarak bashshuk bizman shemmeviin lo migginnotav measser meechad al hakkol uvizman shemmeviin lo migginnot acherot im lakach mimmennu vechazar velakach mimmennu paam sheniyya lo yeasser mizze al ze
Hallokeach pat min hannachtom lo yeasser min hachamma al hatztzonenet sheani omer chittim shel emesh hau mishshel echad veshel hayyom mishshel acher

Hallokeach min happalter af al pi shehen defusin harbe measser meechad al hakkol shehannachtom shemmocher lammanpol ose issato defusin harbe aval hallokeach min hammanpol measser mikkal defus udfus shehammanpol lokeach mishshene nachtomin
Tisha manpolin shellakchu measara nachtomin hoil veechad mehen lakach mishshenayim kal hallokeach meechad min hattisha measser mikkal defus udfus

Hallokeach min heani vechen heani shennatnu lo perusot pat o pilche devela measser mikkal achat veachat uvitmarim uvigrogarot bolel hakkol umasser ematay bizman shehammattana merubba aval bemuetet measser mikkal mattana umattana
