Shachak et happat vaasaah perurin veet haggerogarot vaasaan devela measser meechad al hakkol
Poalim o orchim shehau mesubbin veochlin vehotiru perusot measser mikkal achat veachat seliku lehu hilchot maoser besiyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 1: Shalosh mitzot nitztauu yisrael bishat kenisatan laaretz lemannot lahem melech shenneemar som tasim alecha melech ulhachrit zaro shel amalek shenneemar timche et zecher amalek velivnot bet habbechira shenneemar leshichno tidreshu uvata shamma

Minnuy melech kodem lemilchemet amalek shenneemar oti shalach Adonai limshachocha lemelech atta lech vehikkita et amalek vehachratat zera amalek kodemet levinyan habbayit shenneemar vayehi ki yashav hammelech beveto va heniach lo missaviv mikkal oyevav vayyomer hammelech el natan hannavi anochi yoshev bevet arazim vego meachar shehakamat melech mitzva lamma lo ratza hakkadosh baruch hu kesheshshaalu melech mishshemuel lefi sheshshaalu betaromet velo shaalu lekayyem hammitzva ella mippene shekkatzu bishmuel hannavi shenneemar ki lo otcha maasu ki oti maasu vego
En maamidin melech battechilla ella al pi bet din shel shivim zekenim veal pi navi kihoshua shemminnahu moshe rabbenu uvet dino uchshaul vedavid shemminnam shemuel haramati uvet dino

En maamidin melech mikkehal gerim afillu achar kamma dorot ad shettihye immo miyyisrael shenneemar lo tuchal latet alecha ish nachri asher lo achicha hu velo lemalchut bilvad ella lechal serarot shebbeyisrael lo sar tzava velo sar chamishshim o sar asara afillu memunne al ammat hammayim shemmechallek mimmenna lassadot veen tzarich lomar dayyan o nasi shello yehe ella miyyisrael shenneemar mikkerev achecha tasim alecha melech kal mesimot sheatta mesim lo yehu ella mikkerev achecha
En maamidin ishsha bemalchut shenneemar alecha melech velo malka vechen kal mesimot shebbeyisrael en memannim bahem ella ish

Veen maamidin melech velo kohen gadol lo katztzav velo sappar velo ballan velo bursi lo mippene shehen pesulin ella hoil veummanutan nikla haam mezalzelin bahen leolam umishsheyyaase bimlacha meellu yom echad nifsal

Keshemmaamidin hammelech moshchin oto beshemen hammishcha shenneemar vayyikkach shemuel et pach hashshemen vayyitzok al rosho vayyishshakehu umeachar shemmoshchin hammelech hare ze zoche lo ulvanav ad olam shehammalchut yerushsha shenneemar lemaan yaarich yamim al mamlachto hu uvanav bekerev yisrael heniach ben katan meshammerin lo hammelucha ad sheyyagdil kemo sheasa yehoyada leoash vechal hakkodem benachala kodem lirushshat hammelucha vehabben haggadol kodem lekatan mimmennu velo hammalchut bilvad ella kal hasserarot vechal hamminnuyin shebbeyisrael yerushsha livno ulven beno ad olam vehu sheyyihye habben memalle mekom avotav bechachma uvyira haya memalle beyira af al pi sheeno memalle bechachma maamidin oto bimkom aviv umlammedin oto vechal mi sheen bo yirat shamayim af al pi shechachmato merubba en memannin oto leminnuy min hamminnuyin shebbeyisrael kevan shennimshach david zacha becheter malchut vahare hammalchut lo ulvanav hazzecharim ad olam shenneemar kisacha yihye nachon ad olam velo zacha ella lichsherim shenneemar im yishmeru vanecha beriti af al pi shello zacha ella lichsherim lo tikkaret hammelucha mizzera david leolam hakkadosh baruch hu hivticho bechach shenneemar im yaazvu vanav torati uvmishpatay lo yelechun ufakadti veshevet pisham uvingaim aonam vechasdi lo afir meimmo

Navi sheheemid melech mishshear shivte yisrael vehaya oto hammelech holech bederech hattora vehammitzva venilcham milchamot Adonai hare ze melech vechal mitzot hammalchut nohagot bo af al pi sheikkar hammalchut ledavid veyihye mibbanav melech shehare achiyya hashshiloni heemid yaravam veamar lo vehaya im shamoa tishma et kal asher atzavecha uvaniti lecha vayit neeman kaasher baniti ledavid vego veamar lo achiyya velivno etten shevet echad lemaan heot nir ledavid avdi kal hayyamim lefanay birushalami
Malche bet david hem haomdim leolam shenneemar kisacha yihye nachon ad olam aval im yaamod melech mishshear yisrael tippasek hammalchut mibbeto shehare neemar leyaravam ach lo chal hayyamim
En moshchin malche yisrael beshemen hammishcha ella beshemen afarsemon veen memannin otan birushalayim leolam ella melech yisrael mizzera david veen moshchin ella zera david
Keshemmoshchin malche bet david en moshchin otan ella al hammayan

Veen moshchin melech ben melech ella im ken hayeta sham machloket o milchama moshchin oto kede lesallek hammachaloket lefichach mashchu shelomo mippene adoniyya veoash mippene atalya umashchu yehoachaz mippene yehoyakim achiv

Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 8: Chalutze tzava kesheyyikkansu bigvul haakkum veyichbeshum veyishbu mehen muttar lahen leechol nevelot utrefot uvsar chazir vechayyotze bo im yirav velo matza ma yochal ella maachalot ellu haasurim vechen shote yen nesech mippi hashshemua lamdu uvattim meleim kal tuv arpe chazirim vechayyotze bahen
Vechen boel ishsha begeutah im tekafo yitzro aval lo yivalenna veyelech lo ella machnisah letoch beto shenneemar veraita bashshivya eshet yefat toar veasur livol otah bia sheniyya ad sheyyissaenna

En eshet yefat toar mutteret ella bishat hashshivya shenneemar veraita bashshivya ben betula ben beula ben eshet ish sheen ishut leakkum vechashakta af al pi sheenah yafa vah velo bachavertah shello yivol shettayim velakachta lecha leishsha shello yikkach shettayim veyivol achat veyanniach achat leaviv o leachiv uminnayin shello yilchatzenna bammilchama shenneemar vahavetah el toch betecha yachnisah lemakom veachar kach yivol
Hakkohen muttar bifat toar bevia rishona shello dibbera tora ella keneged hayyetzer aval eno yachol lissaenna achar kach mippene shehi giyyoret

Vechetzad din yisrael bifat toar achare sheyyivalenna bia rishona vehi begeutah im kibbela aleha lehikkanes tachat kanfe hashshechina matbilah leshem gerut miyyad veim lo kibbela teshev beveto sheloshim yom shenneemar uvachta et aviha veet immah yerach yamim vechen bocha al datah veeno monah umgaddelet et tzipparneha umgallachat et roshah kede shettitganne beenav vetihye immo babbayit nichnas veroe otah yotze veroe otah kede sheyyakutz bah umgalgel immah kede shettekabbel im kibbela veratza bah hare zo mitgayyeret vetovelet kechal haggerim

Utzricha lehamtin shelosha chodashim chodesh shel bechiyya ushne chodashim acharav venosah bichtubba vekiddushin im lo chafetz bah meshallechah lenafshah veim mecharah over belo taase shenneemar umachor lo timkerenna bakkasef veim mecharah enah mechura umachazir haddamim vechen im kevashah achar shennivala leshem shifcha mishsheyyishtammesh bah over belo taase shenneemar lo titammer bah shello yishtammesh bah

Lo ratzta lehitgayyer megalgelin immah shenem asar chodesh lo ratzta mekabbelet sheva mitzot shennitztauu bene noach umshallechah lenafshah vahare hi kechal haggerim hattoshavim veeno nosah sheasur lissa ishsha shello nitgayera

Nitabbera mibbia rishona hare havalad ger veeno beno ledavar min haddevarim mippene shehu min haakkum ella bet din matbilin oto al datam vetamar mibbia rishona shel yefat toar hayeta aval avshalom nolad meachar hannissuin nimtzet tamar achot avshalom meimmo umutteret lehinnase leamnon vechen hu omer dabber na el hammelech ki lo yimnaeni mimmekka

Yefat toar shello ratzta lehaniach avoda zara achar hashshenem asar chodesh horgin otah vechen ir shehishlima en kortin lahen berit ad sheyyichperu baavoda zara viabbedu et kal mekomoteha vikabbelu shear hammitzot shennitztauu bene noach shekkal akkum shello kibbel mitzot shennitztauu bene noach horgin oto im yeshno tachat yadenu

Moshe rabbenu lo hinchil hattora vehammitzot ella leyisrael shenneemar morasha kehillat yaakov ulchal harotze lehitgayyer mishshear haummot shenneemar kachem kagger aval mi shello ratza en kofin oto lekabbel tora umitzot vechen tziva moshe rabbenu mippi haggevura lachof et kal bae haolam lekabbel mitzot shennitztauu bene noach vechal mi shello yekabbel yehareg vehamkabbel otam hu hannikra ger toshav bechal makom vetzarich lekabbel alav bifne shelosha chaverim vechal hamkabbel alav lamul veavru alav shenem asar chodesh velo mal hare ze kemin haummot

Kal hamkabbel sheva mitzot venizhar laasotan hare ze mechaside ummot haolam veyesh lo chelek laolam habba vehu sheyekabbel otan veyaase otan mippene shetztziva bahen hakkadosh baruch hu battora vehodianu al yede moshe rabbenu shebbene noach mikkodem nitztauu bahen aval im asaan mippene hechrea haddaat en ze ger toshav veeno mechaside ummot haolam velo mechachmehem
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 9: Al shishsha devarim nitztava adam harishon al avoda zara veal birkat hashshem veal shefichut damim veal gilluy araot veal haggezel veal haddinim af al pi shekkullan hen kabbala beyadenu mimmoshe rabbenu vehaddaat nota lahen mikkelal divre tora yerae sheal ellu nitztava hosif lenoach ever min hachay shenneemar ach basar benafsho damo lo tochelu nimtzeu sheva mitzot vechen haya haddavar bechal haolam ad avraham ba avraham venitztava yeter al ellu bemila vehu hitpallel shacharit veyyitzchak hifrish maaser vehosif tefilla acheret lifnot hayyom veyaakov hosif gid hannashe vehitpallel arvit uvmitzrayim nitztava amram bemitzot yeterot ad shebba moshe rabbenu venishlema tora al yado

Ben noach sheavad avoda zara hare ze chayyav vehu sheyyaavod kedarkah vechal avoda zara shebbet din shel yisrael memitin aleha ben noach neherag aleha vechal sheen bet din shel yisrael memitin aleha en ben noach neherag aleha veaf al pi sheeno neherag asur bakkol veen menichin oto lehakim matztzeva velo litta ashera velo laasot tzurot vechayyotze bahen lenoy
Ben noach shebberech et hashshem ben shebberech bashshem hamyuchad ben shebberech bechinnuy bechal lashon chayyav ma sheen ken beyisrael

Ben noach sheharag nefesh afillu ebbar bime immo neherag alav vechen im harag terefa o shekkefato untano lifne ari o shehinnicho baraav ad shemmet hoil vehemit mikkal makom neherag vechen im harag rodef sheyyachol lehatztzilo beechad meevarav neherag alav ma sheen ken beyisrael

Shesh araot asurot al bene noach haem veeshet haav veeshet ish vaachoto meimmo vezachur uvhema shenneemar al ken yaazav ish et aviv zo eshet aviv veet immo kemashmaah vedavak beishto velo beeshet chavero beishto velo bezachur vehau levasar echad lehotzi behema chayya veof sheen hu vehem basar echad veneemar achoti vat avi hi ach lo vat immi vattehi li leishsha

Ben noach chayyav al mefuttat aviv vaanusat aviv hare hi immo mikkal makom vechayyav al eshet aviv afillu leachar mitat aviv vechayyav al hazzachur ben katan ben gadol veal habbehema ben ketanna ben gedola vehu neherag levaddo veen horgin et habbehema shello nitztauu baharigat behema ella yisrael

En ben noach chayyav al eshet chavero ad sheyyavo aleha kedarkah achar shennivala levalah aval meorasa o shennichnesa lechuppa velo nivala en chayyavin aleha shenneemar vehi beulat baal bamme devarim amurim beven noach shebba al bat noach aval akkum habba al hayyisreelit ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah chayyav veim hayeta naara meorasa niskal aleha kedine yisrael ba aleha achar shennichnesa lachuppa velo nivala hare ze bechenek kedine yisrael aval im ba al eshet yisrael achar shennivala hare ze kemi shebba al eshet akkum chavero veyehareg besayif

Ben noach sheyyiched shifcha leavdo uva aleha hare ze neherag aleha mishshum eshet chavero veeno chayyav aleha ad sheyyifshot haddavar veyomru lah haam zo devet eved peloni umeematay tachzor lehetterah mishsheyyafrishenna meavdo veyifra roshah bashshuk umeematay tihye eshet chavero kigrusha shellanu mishsheyyotzienna mibbeto vishallechenna leatzmah o mishshettetze hi mittachat reshuto vattelech lah sheen lahem gerushin bichtav veen haddavar taluyi bo levad ella kal zeman sheyyirtze hu o hi lifrosh ze mizze porshin

Ben noach chayyav al haggezel ben sheggazal akkum ben sheggazal yisrael veechad haggozel o haggonev mamon o gonev nefesh o hakkovesh sechar sachir vechayyotze bo afillu poel sheachal shello bishat melacha al hakkol hu chayyav vahare hu bichlal gazlan ma sheen ken beyisrael vechen chayyav al pachot mishsheve peruta uven noach sheggazal pachot mishsheve peruta uva acher ugzalah mimmennu shenehen neheragin aleha
Vechen chayyav al ever min hachay veal basar min hachay bechal shehu shello nittenu hashshiurin ella leyisrael bilvad umuttar hu bedam min hachay
Echad haever o habbasar happoresh min habbehema o min hachayya aval haof yerae li sheen ben noach neherag al ever min hachay mimmennu
Hashshochet et habbehema afillu shachat bah shene hassimanin kal zeman shehi mefarkeset ever uvasar happorshin mimmenna asurin livne noach mishshum ever min hachay

Kal sheasur al yisrael mishshum ever min hachay asur al bene noach veyesh shebbene noach chayyavin velo yisrael shebbene noach echad behema vechayya ben temea ben tehora chayyavin aleha mishshum ever min hachay umishshum basar min hachay veever uvasar happorshin min hamfarkeset af al pi sheshshachat bah yisrael shene simanin hare ze asur livne noach mishshum ever min hachay

Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 10: Ben noach sheshshagag beachat mimmitzotav patur mikkelum chutz merotzeach bishgaga sheim harago goel haddam eno neherag alav veen lo ir miklat aval batte dinehen en memitin oto bamme devarim amurim beshagag beachat mimmitzot veavar belo kavana kegon shebbaal eshet chavero vedimma shehi ishto o penuya aval im yada shehi eshet chavero velo yada shehi asura alav ella ala al libbo sheddavar ze muttar lo vechen im harag vehu lo yada sheasur laharog hare ze karov lemezid veneherag velo techashev zo lahem shegaga mippene shehaya lo lilmod velo lamad

Ben noach shennitgayyer umal vetaval veachar kach ratza lachzor meachare Adonai velihot ger toshav bilvad keshehaya mikkodem en shomin lo ella yihye keyisrael lechal davar o yehareg veim haya katan keshehitbiluhu bet din yachol limchot beshaa sheyyagdil veyihye ger toshav bilvad vechevan shello micha bishato shuv eno moche ella hare hu ger tzedek lefichach im ba yisrael al ketanna shehitbiluha bet din kesef ketubbatah o kenas ones o mefatte yihye hakkol tachat yad bet din ad shettagdil velo timche baggerut shemma tittol vetagdil vetimche venimtzet zo ochelet begeutah maot sheen lah zechut bahen ella bedine yisrael

Ben noach shebberech et hashshem o sheavad avoda zara o shebba al eshet chavero o sheharag chavero venitgayyer patur harag ben yisrael o shebba al eshet yisrael venitgayyer chayyav vehorgin oto al ben yisrael vechonkin oto al eshet yisrael shebbaal shehare nishtanna dino
Kevar bearnu shekkal mitat bene noach besayif ella im baal eshet yisrael o naara meorasa yissakel veim bealah achar shennichnesa lachuppa kodem shettibbael yechanek
Mippi hakkabbala shebbene noach asurin beharbaat behema uvharkavat ilan bilvad veen neheragin alehen veakkum shehikka yisrael afillu chaval bo kal shehu af al pi shehu chayyav mita eno neherag

Hammila nitztava bah avraham vezaro bilvad shenneemar atta vezaracha acharecha yatza zaro shel yishmael shenneemar ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara veyatza esav shehare yitzchak amar leyaakov veyitten lecha et birkat avraham lecha ulzaracha michlal shehu levaddo zaro shel avraham hammachazik bedato uvdarko hayeshara vehem hamchuyyavin bemila

Chayyavin bet din shel yisrael laasot shoftim leellu haggerim hattoshavim ladun lahen al pi mishpatim ellu kede shello yishshachet haolam im rau bet din sheyyaamidu shoftehem mehen maamidin veim rau sheyyaamidu lahen miyyisrael maamidin

Shene akkum shebbau lefanecha ladun bedine yisrael veratzu shenehen ladun din tora danin haechad rotze vehaechad eno rotze en kofin oto ladun ella bedinehen haya yisrael veakkum im yesh zechut leyisrael bedinehen danin lo bedinehem veomrim lo kach dinechem veim yesh zechut leyisrael bedinenu danin lo din tora veomrim lo kach dinenu veyerae li sheen osin ken leger toshav ella leolam danin lo bedinehem vechen yerae li shennohagin im gere toshav bederech eretz ugmilut chasadim keyisrael shehare anu metzuvin lehachaotan shenneemar lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah veze sheamru chachamim en koflin lahen shalom beakkum lo beger toshav afillu haakkum tziuu chachamim levakker cholehem velikbor metehem im mete yisrael ulfarnes aniyyehem bichlal aniyye yisrael mippene darche shalom hare neemar tov Adonai lakkol verachamav al kal maasav veneemar deracheha darche noam vechal netivoteha shalom
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 11: Hammelech hammashiach atid laamod ulhachzir malochut david leyashnah lammemshala harishona uvone hammikdash umkabbetz nidche yisrael vechozrin kal hammishpatim beyamav keshehau mikkodem makrivin karbanot veosin shemittin veovlot kechal mitzvatan haamura battora vechal mi sheeno maamin bo o mi sheeno mechakke leviato lo bishar neviim bilvad hu kofer ella battora uvmoshe rabbenu shehare hattora heida alav shenneemar veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutcha verichamecha veshav vekibbetzcha vego im yihye niddachacha biktze hashshamayim vego veheviacha Adonai veellu haddevarim hamforashim battora hem kollim kal haddevarim shenneemru al yede kal hanneviim af befarashat bilam neemar vesham nibbe bishne hammeshichim bammashiach harishon shehu david shehoshia et yisrael miyyad tzarehem uvammashiach haacharon sheomed mibbanav shemmoshia et yisrael baacharona vesham hu omer erennu velo atta ze david ashurennu velo karov ze melech hammashiach darach kochav miyyaakov ze david vekam shevet miyyisrael ze melech hammashiach umachatz paate moav ze david vechen hu omer vayyach et moav vayemaddedem bachevel vekarkar kal bene shet ze hammelech hammashiach shenneemar bo umashlo miyyam ad yam vehaya edom yeresha ze david shenneemar vattehi edom ledavid laavadim vego vehaya yeresha vego ze hammelech hammashiach shenneemar vealu moshiim behar tziyyon vego

Af beare miklat hu omer im yarchiv Adonai elohecha et gevulcha veyasafta lecha od shalosh arim vego umeolam lo haya davar ze velo tziva hakkadosh baruch hu letohu aval bedivre hanneviim en haddavar tzarich reaya shekkal hassefarim meleim bedavar ze

Veal yaale al datecha shehammelech hammashiach tzarich laasot otot umoftim umchaddesh devarim baolam o mechayye metim vechayyotze bidvarim ellu en haddavar kach shehare rabbi akiva chacham gadol mechachme mishna haya vehu haya nose kelav shel ben koziva hammelech vehu haya omer alav shehu hammelech hammashiach vedimma hu vechal chachme doro shehu hammelech hammashiach ad shenneherag baaonot kevan shenneherag noda lahem sheeno velo shaalu mimmennu chachamim lo ot velo mofet veikkar haddevarim kacha hen shehattora hazzot chukkeha umishpateha leolam ulolme olamim veen mosifin alehen velo gorin mehen

Veim yaamod melech mibbet david hoge battora veosek bemitzot kedavid aviv kefi tora shebbichtav veshebbeal pe veyachof kal yisrael lelech bah ulchazzek bidkah veyillachem milchamot Adonai hare ze bechezkat shehu mashiach im asa vehitzliach uvana mikdash bimkomo vekibbetz nidche yisrael hare ze mashiach bevadday vitakken et haolam kullo laavod et Adonai beyachad shenneemar ki az ehpoch el ammim safa verura likro chullam beshem Adonai ulavdo shechem echad

Veim lo hitzliach ad ko o neherag beyadua sheeno ze shehivticha alav tora vahare hu kechal malche bet david hashshelemim hakkesherim shemmetu velo heemido hakkadosh baruch hu ella lenassot bo rabbim shenneemar umin hammaskilim yikkashlu litzrof bahen ulvarer velalben ad et ketz ki od lammoed

Af yeshua hannotzri sheddima sheyyihye mashiach veneherag bevet din kevar nitnabbe bo daniyyel shenneemar uvne paritze ammecha yinnasseu lehaamid chazon venichshalu vechi yesh michshol gadol mizze shekkal hanneviim dibberu shehammashiach goel yisrael umoshiam umkabbetz nidchehem umchazzek mitzvatan veze garam leabbed yisrael bacherev ulfazzer sheeritam ulhashpilam ulhachalif hattora ulhatot rov haolam laavod eloha mibbalade Adonai

Aval machshevot bore olam en koach baadam lehassigam ki lo derachenu derachav velo machshevotenu machshevotav vechal haddevarim haellu shel yeshua hannotzri veshel ze hayyishmeeli sheamad acharav enan ella leyashsher derech lammelech hammashiach ultakken et haolam kullu laavod et Adonai beyachad shenneemar ki az ehpoch el ammim safa verura likro kullam beshem Adonai ulovdo shechem echad

Ketzad kevar nitmalle haolam kullo middivre hammashiach umiddivre hattora umiddivre hammitzot ufashtu devarim ellu beiyyim rechokim uvammim rabbim arle lev vehem nosim venotnim bidvarim ellu uvmitzot hattora ellu omrim mitzot ellu emet hau uchvar batlu bazzeman hazze velo hau nohagot ledorot veellu omrim devarim nistarot yesh bahem veenan kifshutan uchvar ba mashiach vegilla nisterehem
Uchsheyyaamod hammelech hammashiach beemet veyatzliach veyarum veyinase miyyad hem kulan chozrin veodim sheshsheker nachalu avotehem veshenneviehem vaavotehem hitum
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 12: Al yaale al hallev shebbimot hammashiach yibbatel davar mimminhago shel olam o yihye sham chiddush bemaase bereshit ella olam keminhago noheg veze shenneemar bishaya vegar zeev im keves venamer im gedi yirbatz mashal vechida inyan haddavar sheyyihu yisrael yoshvin lavetach im rishe akkum hamshulim kizev venamer shenneemar zeev aravot yeshaddem venamer shoked al arehem veyachzeru kullam ledat haemet velo yigzelu velo yashchitu ella yochlu davar hammuttar benachat im yisrael shenneemar vearye kabbakar yochal teven vechen kal kayyotze beellu haddevarim beinyan hammashiach hem meshalim uvimot hammelech hammashiach yivada lakkol lee ze davar haya mashal uma inyan ramzu bahen

Amru chachamim en ben haolam hazze limot hammashiach ella shibud malchuyyot bilvad yerae mippeshutan shel divre hanneviim shebbitchillat yemot hammashiach tihye milchemet gog umagog veshekkodem milchemet gog umagog yaamod navi leyashsher yisrael ulhachin libbam shenneemar hinne anochi sholeach lachem et eliyya vego veeno ba lo letamme hattahor velo letaher hattame velo lifsol anashim shehem bechezkat kashrut velo lehachshir mi shehuchzeku pesulin ella lasum shalom baolam shenneemar veheshiv lev avot al banim veyesh min hachachamim sheomrim shekkodem biat hammashiach yavo eliyyahu vechal ellu haddevarim vechayyotze bahen lo yeda adam ech yihu ad sheyyihu sheddevarim setumin hen etzel hanneviim gam hachachamim en lahem kabbala bidvarim ellu ella lefi hechrea happesukim ulfichach yesh lahem machloket bidvarim ellu veal kal panim en siddur havayat devarim ellu velo dikdukehen ikkar baddat ulolam lo yitassek adam bedivre hahaggadot velo yaarich bammidrashot haamurim beinyanim ellu vechayyotze bahen velo yesimem ikkar sheen meviin lo lide yira velo lide ahava vechen lo yechashshev hakkitztzin amru chachamim tippach rucham shel mechashsheve hakkitztzim ella yechakke veyaamin bichlal haddavar kemo shebbearnu

Bime hammelech hammashiach keshettityashshev mamlachto veyitkabbetzu elav kal yisrael yityachasu kullam al piv beruach hakkodesh shettanuach alav shenneemar veyashav metzaref umtaher vego uvne levi metaher techilla veomer ze meyuchas kohen veze meyuchas levi vedoche et sheenan meyuchasin leyisrael hare hu omer vayyomer hattirshata lahem vego ad amod kohen leurim ultummim hinne lamadta shebberuach hakkodesh meyachasin hammuchzakin umodiin hamyuchas veeno meyaches yisrael ella leshivtehem shemmodia shezze mishshevet peloni veze mishshevet peloni aval eno omer al shehen bechezkat kashrut ze mamzer veze eved shehaddin hu shemmishpacha shennitmea nitmea

Lo nitauu hachachamim vehanneviim yemot hammashiach lo kede sheyyishletu al kal haolam velo kede sheyyirdu baakkum velo kede sheyenasseu otam haammim velo kede leechol velishtot velismoach ella kede sheyyihu penuyin battora vechachmatah velo yihye lahem noges umvattel kede sheyyizku lechayye haolam habba kemo shebbearnu behilchot teshuva

Uvoto hazzeman lo yihye sham lo raav velo milchama velo kina vetacharut shehattova tihye mushpaat harbe vechal hammaadannim metzuyin keafar velo yihye esek kal haolam ella ladaat et Adonai bilvad ulfichach yihu yisrael chachamim gedolim veodim devarim hassetumim veyassigu daat boram kefi koach haadam shenneemar ki mala haaretz dea et Adonai kammayim layyam mechassim
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 1: Mitzvat ase lehitabbel al hakkerovim shenneemar veachalti chattat hayyom hayyitav beene Adonai veen avelut min hattora ella beom rishon bilvad shehu yom hammita veom hakkevura aval shear hashshiva yamim eno din tora af al pi shenneemar battora vayyaas leaviv evel shivat yamim nittena tora venitchaddesha halacha umoshe rabbenu tikken lahem leyisrael shivat yeme avelut veshivat yeme hammishte

Meematay yitchayyev adam baevel mishsheyyissatem haggolel aval kal zeman shello nikbar hammet eno asur bedavar min haddevarim shehaavel asur bahen umippene taam ze rachatz david vesach keshemmet hayyeled terem sheyyikkaver
Haruge malchut sheen menichin otan lehikkaver meematay matchilin lehitabbel alehen velispor shiva ushloshim mishsheyyityaashu lishl lammelech lekavran af al pi shello nityaashu millignov otan
Mi shettava bannahar o mi sheachalattu chayya raa mishshennityaashu levakkesh metzauhu evarim evarim en monin lo ad sheyyimmatze rosho verubbo o yityaashu millevakkesh
Mi sheddarkan lishloach hammet limdina acheret lekavro veenam yodim matay yikkaver meet sheyyachzeru penehen millelauoto matchilin limnot shiva ushloshim umatchilin lehitabbel
Hannefalim en mitabbelin alehen vechal shello shaha sheloshim yom baadam hare ze nefel afillu met beom sheloshim en mitabbelin alav
Veim noda bevadday shennolad letisha chodashim gemurim afillu met bayyom shennolad mitabbelim alav

Ben tisha chodashim shennolad met uven shemona shemmet afillu leachar sheloshim umi sheyyatza mechuttach o merussas af al pi shekkalu lo chodashav hare ze nefel veen mitabbelin alehen velo mitassekin immahem

Kal haruge malchut af al pi shennehergu bedin hammelech vehattora natna lo reshut lehargan hare ellu mitabbelin alehen veen monin mehen kal davar umamonam lammelech venikbarin bekivre avotehen aval kal haruge bet din en mitabbelin alehen aval onnin sheen aninut ella ballev veen nikbarin im avotehen ad sheyyitakkel habbasar umamonam leorshehem

Kal happorshin middarche tzibbur vehem haanashim shepparku ol hammitzot meal tzavaran veen nichlalin bichlal yisrael baasiyyat hammitzot uvichvod hammoadot vishivat batte kenesiyyot uvatte midrashot ella hare hen kivne chorin leatzman kishar haummot vechen haeppikorosin vehammumarim vehammosrin kal ellu en mitabbelin alehen ella achehem ushar kerovehem lovshin levanim umitattefim levanim veochlim veshotim usmechim shehare avdu sonav shel hakkadosh baruch hu vaalehem hakkatuv omer halo mesanecha Adonai esna

Hamabbed atzmo ladaat en mitassekin immo lechal davar veen mitabbelin alav veen maspidin oto aval omdin alav beshura veomrin alav birkat avelim vechal davar shehu kavod lachayyim vee zehu hamabbed atzmo ladaat lo sheala laggag venafal umet ella haomer hareni ole lerosh haggag rauhu sheala miyyad derech kaas o shehaya metzer venafal umet hare ze bechezkat sheibbed atzmo ladaat aval im rauhu chanuk vetaluy bailan o harug umushlach al gav sefo hare ze bechezkat kal hammetim umitassekin immo veen monin mimmennu davar
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 2: Elu sheadam chayyav lehitabbel alehen din tora immo veaviv beno uvitto veachiv vaachoto meaviv umiddivrehem sheyyitabbel haish al ishto hannesua vechen haishsha al balah umitabbel al achiv veal achoto shehen meimmo
Afillu hakkohen sheeno mittamme leachiv vaachoto meimmo velaachoto hannesua af al pi shehi meaviv mitabbel hu alehen veim hayeta achoto zo hannesua meaviv hare hu mitabbel aleha din tora

Beno o achiv habba min hashshifcha umin hannachrit eno mitabbel alehen kelal vechen mi shennitgayyer hu uvanav o nishtachrer hu veimmo en mitabbelin ze al ze vechen ishto arusa eno mitabbel aleha velo onen vechen hi lo onenet velo mitabbelet alav

Kal kerovim shehu chayyav lehitabbel alehen hare ze mitabbel immahem bifnehem middivre sofrim ketzad hare shemmet ben beno o achi beno o em beno chayyav likroa bifne beno velinhog avelut befanav aval shello befanav eno chayyav vechen bishar hakkerovim

Ishto hannesua af al pi shehu mitabbel aleha eno mitabbel immah al shear kerovim ella al aviha veal immah mishshum kevod ishto noheg avelut alehen befaneha ketzad mi shemmet chamiv o chamoto kofe mittato venoheg avelut im ishto befaneha aval lo shello befaneha vechen haishsha shemmet chamiha o chamotah noheget avelut befanav aval shear kerovim kegon shemmet achi ishto o benah vehaishsha shemmet achi balah o beno en mitabbelin ze al ze vechen yerae li sheim meta eshet kerovo o baal kerovato kegon shemmeta eshet beno o baal bitto eno chayyav lehitabbel alehen vechen kal kayyotze baze

Kamma chamura mitzvat avelut shehare nidchet lo hattuma mippene kerovav kede sheyyitassek immahen veyitabbel alehen shenneemar ki im lishero hakkarov elav leimmo vego lah yittamma mitzvat ase sheim lo ratza lehittame metammein oto al karcho bamme devarim amurim bizcharim shehuzharu al hattuma aval hakkohanot hoil veenan muzharot al hattuma ken enan metzuuot lehittamme lakkerovim ella im ratzu mittammeot veim lav lo mittammeot

Ishto shel kohen mittamme lah al karcho veeno mittamme lah ella middivre sofrim asauha kemet mitzva kevan sheen lah yoresh ella hu lo timtza mi sheyyitassek bah veeno mittamme ella linsuah bilvad aval haarusa eno mittamme lah

Vechen kal otan sheamru sheen mitabbelin alehen kegon haruge bet din veshepparshu middarche tzibbur vehannefalim vehamabbed atzmo ladaat en hakkohen mittamme lahen vead matay metzuve lehittamme likrovav ad sheyyissatem haggolel aval meachar shennistam haggolel hare hen kishar kal hammetim sheim nitma bahen loke

Ishto happesula eno mittamme lah lefichach mi sheshshama shemua shemmet balah venisset uva balah shenehen en mittammein lah shehare hi pesula lishnehen aval mittamme hu leimmo af al pi shehi chalala vechen mittamme livno ulvitto ulachiv velaachoto af al pi shehen pesulin afillu hau mamzerim mittamme lahen

Achoto hannesua eno mittamme lah af al pi shehi nesua lechohen shenneemar habbetula hakkerova elav asher lo hayeta leish habbetula perat laanusa umfutta yachol sheani motzi et habbogeret umukkat etz talmud lomar asher lo hayeta leish mi shehavayatah bide ish asher lo hayeta leish perat laarusa sheeno mittamme lah af al pi shehi arusa lechohen
Nitgarsha achoto min haerusin mittamme lah shenneemar hakkerova elav lehavi et hamgoreshet min haerusin
Achiv vaachoto meimmo eno mittamme lahen shenneemar velivno ulvitto ulachiv velaachoto ma beno harauy lirushshato af achiv vaachoto haruyim lirushshato

Hassefekot eno mittamme lahen shenneemar lah yittamma mittamme hu al havadday veeno mittamme al hassafek lefichach havveladot shennitarvu vehabben shehu safek ben shiva laacharon o ben tisha larishon vechen kal kayyotze bahen eno mittamme lahen missafek vechen kal hammitgareshet sefek gerushin o beget pasul eno mittamme lah
En hakkohen mittamme leever min hachay meaviv velo leetzem meatzmot aviv vechen hamlakket atzmot aviv eno mittamme lahen af al pi shehashshidra kayyemet

Nikta rosho shel aviv eno mittamme lo shenneemar leaviv bizman shehu shalem velo bizman shehu chaser vechen shear hakkerovim hattuma lakkerovim dechuya hi velo huttera lakkol lefichach asur lechohen lehittamme lemet afillu beet shemmittamme likrovav shenneemar lah yittamma eno mittamme laacherim immah shello yomar hoil venitmeti al avi alakket atzmot peloni o egga bekever peloni lefichach kohen shemmet lo met tzarich lehizzaher ulkavro besof bet hakkevarot kede shello yikkanes levet hakkevarot velo yittamme bekivrot acherim kesheyyikbor meto
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 3: Kal kohen shennitma lemet chutz mishshishsha metim hamforashim battora o ishto beedim vehatraa hare ze loke shenneemar lenefesh lo yittamma beammav veechad hannogea bemet o hammaahil o hannose veechad hammet veechad shear hattumot happorshot min hammet shenneemar lenefesh lo yittamma beammav uchvar perashnu behilchot tumat met kal devarim hamtammein min hammet min hattora o middivrehem
Vechen im naga hakkohen bekever loke aval nogea hu bivgadim shennagu bemet af al pi shemmittamme bahen tumat shiva

Vechen im nichnas leohel tame shennichnesa lo hattuma loke af al pi sheatzmah shel tuma bevayit acher uchvar bearnu kal haohalim shettikkanes lahen hattuma o shettetze mehen vedin hassechachot vehapperaot vechal haddevarim hammeviin et hattuma vehachotztzin bifne hattuma vee ze mehen din tora vee ze mehen middivrehen hakkol behilchot tumat met vesham bearnu sheen akkum metammein beohel ulfichach kivrotehem tehorim umuttar lechohen likkanes lesham velidroch al kivrotehem veeno asur ella sheyyigga battuma o sheyyissaenna kemo shebbearnu sham

Kohen shennichnas leohel hammet o levet hakkevarot bishgaga veachar sheyyada hitru bo im kafatz veyatza patur veim yashav sham kede hishtachavaya kemo shebbearnu beinyan tumat mikdash hare ze loke nichnas veyatza vechazar venichnas veyatza im hitru bo al kal paam ufaam loke al kal kenisa uchnisa vechen im naga bemet vehitru bo uferash vechazar venaga vehitru bo afillu mea peamim loke al kal achat veachat haya nogea velo perash o shehaya omed bevet hakkevarot venaga bemetim acherim af al pi shehitru bo kamma peamim eno loke ella achat shehare mechullal veomed kal zeman shello perash
Hamtamme et hakkohen im hau shenehem mezidin hare hakkohen loke veze shettimmeo over al velifne iver lo titten michshol haya hakkohen shogeg veze shettimmeo mezid hare ze shettimmeo loke

Kohen gadol eno mittamme likrovim shenneemar leaviv ulimmo lo yittamma vechen eno nichnas im hammet beohel afillu kerovav shenneemar veal kal nafshot met lo yavo ha lamadta shehu chayyav belo yavo vechayyav belo yittamma ketzad naga o nasa loke achat nichnas leohel veyashav sham ad shemmet alav hammet o shennichnas leshidda teva umigdal uva chavero ufara alav gag hashshidda shehare tuma uvia bain keechad hare ze loke shettayim mishshum lo yavo umishshum lo yittamma
Nitma mikkodem veachar kach nichnas leohel im hitru bo loke af al habbia

Kohen sheppaga bemet mitzva badderech hare ze mittamme lo afillu kohen gadol chayyav lehittamme lo ulkavro veezehu met mitzva echad miyyisrael shehaya mushlach badderech veen lo kovrin davar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hakkohen levaddo veen immo acher vaafillu kara shem badderech veen lo one aval im kesheyyikra acherim onim oto en ze met mitzva ella yikra laacherim veyavou veyaasku bo

Hau kohen venazir mehallechin bederech ufagu bemet mitzva yitassek bo hannazir lefi sheen kedushshato kedushshat olam veal yittame bo hakkohen af al pi shehu kohen hedot haya kohen gadol vechohen hedot yittame hahedot vechal hakkodem et chavero bemaala mitacher betuma usgan im meshuach milchama sheppagu bemet mitzva yittame meshuach milchama veal yittame hassegan
Nasi shemmet hakkol mittammein lo afillu kohanim asauhu kemet mitzva lakkol mippene shehakkol chayyavin bichvodo vechen hakkol onnin alav
Benot aharon lo huzharu al tumat met shenneemar emor el hakkohanim bene aharon velo benot aharon vechen hachalalim muttarin lehittamme shenneemar bene aharon ad sheyyihu bechihunam
Kohen katan hare haggedolim muzharim shello yetammeuhu veim ba lehittamme meatzmo en bet din metzuvin alav lehafrisho aval aviv tzarich lechannecho bikdushsha

Met tofes arba ammot shello letuma vechal kohen shennichnas letoch arba ammot makkin oto makkat mardut vechen im nichnas levet happeras o yatza chutza laaretz o shennitma bedam tevusa o begolel uvdofek vechayyotze bahen makkin oto makkat mardut mippene shehen avot shel divrehem kemo shebbearnu behilchot tumat met aval im nichnas levet hakkevarot loke min hattora

Muttar lechohen lehittamme bevet happeras o bechutza laaretz lidvar mitzva bizman sheen sham derech ella hi kegon shehalach lissa ishsha o lilmod tora af al pi sheyyesh sham mi sheyelammedennu beeretz yisrael lo min hakkol adam zoche lilmod vechen mittamme betuma middivrehem lichvod habberiyyot ketzad avel shehalach bevet happeras hakkol holchin acharav sham lenachamo vechen medallegin al gabbe aronot shel metim likrat malche yisrael vaafillu malche akkum kede lehavchin benam leven malche yisrael kesheyyachzor kevodan limkoman vechen kal kayyotze baze vechen mittamme betuma shel divrehem ladun im haakkum ularer immahen mippene shehu matztzil miyyadam vechen kal kayyotze baze
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 4: Minnehag yisrael bemetim uvikvura kach hu meammetzin enav shel met veim niftach piv koshrin et lechayav ufokkin et nekavav achar shemmedichin oto vesachin oto bemine besamim vegozzin searo umalbishin oto tachrichin tefurin bechut shel pishtan levanim velo yihu demehen yekarim venahagu chachamim besudar sheve zuz shello levayyesh et mi sheen lo umchassin pene hammet shello levayyesh et haaniyyim sheppenehem mushcharin baraav
Veasur likbor betachrichin shel meshi uvgadim hammuzhavin harkumin afillu lenasi shebbeyisrael shezzehu gassut haruach vehashchata umaase akkum vesovlin et hammet al hakkatef ad bet hakkevarot
Venose hammitta asurin binilat hassandal shemma tippasek retzua missandalo shel echad mehen venimtza mitakkev min hammitzva

Vechofrin baafar mearot veosin kuch betzad hammeara vekovrin oto bo ufanav lemala umachzirin heafar vehaavanim alav veyesh lahen likbor bearon shel etz vehamlavin oto omrin lo lech beshalom shenneemar veatta tavo el avotecha beshalom umtzayenin et kal bet hakkevarot uvonin nefesh al hakkever vehatztzaddikim en bonim lahem nefesh al kivrotehem sheddivrehem hem zichronam velo yifne adam levakker hakkevarot

Haggoses hare hu kechay lechal davar en koshrin lechayav veen pokkin nekavav veen mannichin keli mattachot uchli meker al tabburo shello yitpach velo sachin oto velo medichin oto velo metilin oto al hachol velo al hammelach ad shaa sheyyamut vehannogea bo hare ze shofech damim lema ze dome lener shemmetaftef kevan sheyyigga bo adam yichbe vechal hamammetz enav im yetziat nefesh hare ze shofech damim ella yishhe meat shemma nitallef vechen en korin alav velo choltzin katef velo maspidin velo machnisin immo aron vetachrichin babbayit ad sheyyamut

Mi shemmeto muttal lefanav ochel bevayit acher en lo bayit acher ose mechitztza veochel en lo davar laasot mechitztza machzir panav veochel uven kach uven kach eno mesev veochel velo ochel basar velo shote yayin veeno mevarech veeno mezammen veen mevarchin alav veen mezammenin alav ufatur mikkeriat shema umin hattefilla umittefillin umikkal mitzot haamurot battora beshabbat mesev veochel basar veshote yayin umvarech umzammen umvarchin alav umzammenin alav vechayyav bechal mitzot haamurot battora chutz mittashmish hammitta nikbar hammet hare ze muttar leechol basar velishtot yayin meat kede lishrot achila shebbemeav aval lo lirot
En mashhin et hammet ella madchin mittato miyyad vechal hammadche mittato hare ze meshubbach veal aviv veal immo hare ze megunne

Haya erev shabbat o erev yom tov o shehau geshamim mezallefin al hammitta muttar shello miher ella lichvod aviv veimmo vechal hammelin et meto over belo taase ella im ken helino lichvodo ulhashlim tzerachav

Haavel beom rishon bilvad asur lehaniach tefillin uleechol mishshello vechayyav leshev al mitta kefuya uvishar yeme haevel muttar lo leechol mishshello veleshev al gabbe mappatz o karka umeniach tefillin uminnayin shehu asur beom rishon lehaniach tefillin shehare neemar lichezkel peercha chavosh alecha michlal shekkal haam asurin veneemar lo velechem anashim lo tochel michlal shekkal haam ochlin mishshel acherim beom rishon vaasurin leechol mishshel atzman
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 5: Elu devarim shehaavel asur bahen beom rishon min hattora uvishar yamim middivrehem asur lesapper ulchabbes velirchotz velasuch ulshammesh mittato velinol et hassandal velaasot melacha velikrot bedivre tora velizkof et hammitta velifroa et rosho velishl shalom hakkol achad asar davar

Uminnayin shehaavel asur betisporet shehare hizhir bene aharon rashechem al tifrau michlal shekkal hammitabbel asur lesapper searo ella megaddel pera uchshem sheasur legalleach sear rosho kach asur legalleach sear zekano vechal sear sheyyesh bo echad hamgalleach veechad hammitgalleach haya megalleach veshama shemmet aviv mashlim tiglachat searo echad hamgalleach veechad hammitgalleach vechen asur legalleach safa velittol tzipparnav bichli aval beshinnav o shennotel tzipporen betzipporen muttar

Uminnayin shehaavel asur lechabbes begadav velirchotz gufo velasuch shenneemar hitabbeli na velivshi vigde evel veal tasuchi shemen urchitza bichlal sicha sheharchitza kodemet lesicha shenneemar verachatzte vasachte uchshem sheavel asur bechibbus begadim kach asur lilbosh kelim levanim chadashim umgohatzin
Asur lasuch miktzat gufo kechal gufo veim lehaavir et hazzuhama muttar vechen asur birchitzat miktzat gufo bechammin aval betzonen rochetz panav yadav veraglav aval lo kal gufo

Minnayin leavel sheasur betashmish hammitta shenneemar vayenachem david et bat sheva ishto vayyavo eleha vayyishkav immah michlal shehaya asur mikkodem vechen lo yissa haavel ishsha velo tinnase ishsha af al pi sheen meshammeshin mittatan umuttar lehityached im ishto veaf al pi shehu asur betashmish hammitta
Minnayin shehaavel asur binilat hassandal shehare neemar lichezkel unalecha tasim beraglecha michlal shekkal haam asurin haya ba badderech noel veholech uchsheyyikkanes bammedina choletz minalav

Remez leavel sheasur baasiyyat melacha ze shenneemar vehafachti chaggechem leevel ma chag asur baasiyyat melacha af avel asur baasiyyat melacha uchshem shehu asur baasiyyat melacha kach hu asur lissa velitten bischora velelech mimmedina limdina bischora
Kal shelosha yamim harishonim asur baasiyyat melacha afillu haya ani hammitparnes min hatztzedaka mikkan veelach im haya ani ose betzina betoch beto vehaishsha to bappelech betoch beta
Shene achim o shene shuttafin shehau bachanut achat veera evel leechad mehen noalin et hachanut kal shiva

Afillu devarim shemmuttar laasotan bechullo shel moed asur leavel laasotan beyado bime evlo aval acherim osim lo ketzad hau zetav lahafoch vechaddav lagof ufishtano laalot min hammishra vetzamro min hayyora socher acherim laasot lo kede shello yovdu umrabbetzin lo sadehu mishshettaggia onat hammayim

Haarisin vehachachirin shello vehakkabbelanin hare ellu yaasu kedarkan aval hachammarim vehaggammalim babbehemot shello vehassappanim bassefina shello hare ellu lo yaasu veim hau muchkarim o muskarim mikkodem lizman katzuv hare ellu yaasu
Sechir yom afillu beir acheret lo yaase lo
Haavel shehayeta melechet acherim beyado ben bekabbelanut ben sheenah bekabbelanut lo yaase hayeta melachto beyad acherim beveto lo yaasu bevayit acher osin
Haya lo din im adam eno tovo kal shivat yeme haavelut veim haya davar aved ose shaliach kaze horu haggeonim
Minnayin shehaavel asur bedivre tora shehare neemar lichezkel heanek dom

Asur likrot battora banneviim uvakketuvim velishnot bammishna uvammidrash uvahalachot veim hau rabbim tzerichin lo muttar uvilvad shello yaamid turgeman ella yilchosh leacher betziddo veze shebbetziddo omer latturgeman vehatturgeman mashmia larabbim
Uminnayin sheen haavel yoshev al hammitta shenneemar vayyakam hammelech vayyikra et begadav vayyishkav artza

Vechayyav lichpot hammitta kal shiva velo mittato bilvad hu kofe ella kal hammittot sheyyesh lo betoch beto hu kofe afillu eser mittot baasara battim uveser ayarot chayyav lichpot et kullan vaafillu chamishsha achim umet echad mehen kullan kofin et mittotehen hammitta hamyuchedet lechelim o lemaot eno tzarich lichpotah dargash eno tzarich lichpoto ella mattir et karbitav vehu nofel meelav mitta shennakliteha yotzin mimmenna shehare i efshar lehafchah zokfah vedayyo hafach kal mittotav vehaya hu yashen al gabbe mittot acherim o al gabbe kisse o al gabbe aron o al gabbe karka lo yatza yede chovato ella yashen al gabbe hammitta hakkefuya

Minnayin leavel sheasur bifriat harosh shehare neemar lichezkel lo tate al safam michlal sheshshear haavelim chayyavin baatifat harosh vehassudar shemmechasse bo rosho ote mimmiktzato meat al piv shenneemar veal safam yate veunkelos tirgem kaavela yitattef

Uminnayin shehaavel asur bishelat shalom shenneemar heanek dom kal shelosha yamim harishonim mi shennatan lo shalom en machzir lo ella modio shehu avel umishshelosha vead shiva mi sheshshaal bishlomo machzir lo shalom umishshiva vead sheloshim shoel bishlom acherim aval acherim en shoalin bishlomo ad leachar sheloshim veal aviv veal immo en shoalin bishlomo ad leachar shenem asar chodesh im bishelat shalom neesar beavel kal vachomer shehu asur leharbot devarim velischok shenneemar dom velo yeechoz tinok beyado shello yeviennu lide sechok velo yikkanes limkom simcha kegon batte hammishtaot vechayyotze bahen
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 6: Midivre sofrim sheyyihye haavel noheg bemiktzat divre avelut kal sheloshim yom uminnayin samchu chachamim lishloshim yom shenneemar uvachta et aviha veet immah yerach yamim michlal shehaavel mitztaer kal sheloshim yom
Veellu devarim shehaavel asur bahen kal sheloshim yom asur betisporet uvgihutz uvnissuin uvsimchat mereut velelech bischora mimmedina limdina hakkol chamishsha devarim

Betisporet ketzad keshem sheasur lesapper kal sear gufo o legalleach sefamo o lakotz tzipparnav bichli kal shiva kach asur kal sheloshim yom bamme devarim amurim beish aval beishsha mutteret bintilat sear leachar shiva vehaish ad sheloshim yom veal aviv veal immo chayyav legaddel searo ad sheyyishlach pera o ad sheyyigaru bo chaverav

Vechen asur lilbosh kelim levanim chadashim umgohatzin kal sheloshim yom echad haish veechad haishsha hau tzevuin umgohatzin muttarin vechen im lo hau chadashim af al pi shehen levanim umgohatzin muttarin uchle pishtan en bahen mishshum gihutz ulachar sheloshim yom muttar begihutz afillu al aviv veal immo

Benissuin ketzad asur lissa ishsha kal sheloshim yom umuttar learsah afillu beom hammita umi shemmeta ishto im kevar kiyyem mitzvat periyya urviyya veyesh lo mi sheyeshammeshennu veen lo banim ketannim hare ze asur lissa ishsha acheret ad sheyyaavru alav shelosha regalim aval mi shello kiyyem mitzvat periyya urviyya o shekkiyyem veyesh lo banim ketannim o sheen lo mi sheyeshammeshennu hare ze muttar learsah velichnos miyyad veasur lo lavo aleha ad sheloshim yom vechen haishsha shehayeta avela lo tibbael ad sheloshim yom
Simchat mereut shehaya chayyav lifroa otah miyyad muttar laasotah miyyad leachar shiva aval im eno chayyav lefarah asur lehikkanes lah ad sheloshim yom
Bamme devarim amurim bishar kal metim aval al aviv veal immo ben kach uven kach lo yikkanes lesimchat mereut ad chodesh
Al kal hammetim kullan muttar lelech bischora leachar sheloshim al aviv veal immo ad sheyyigaru bo chaverav veyomru lo lech immanu
Al kal hammetim kullan ratza memaet beisko ratza eno memaet al aviv veal immo memaet beisko
Haholech mimmakom lemakom im yachol lemaet beisko yemaet veim lav yikne tzarche hadderech udvarim sheyyesh bahen chayye nefesh
Mi shehaya balah tzaluv bair o ishto tzeluva o aviv veimmo asur lo lishkon beotah hair ad sheyyichle habbasar veim hayeta ir gedola keantochya yesh lo lishkon batztzad haacher sheenan tzeluvin bo

Yom shevii miktzato kechullo vehu ole lechan ulchan ulfichach muttar lechabbes velirchotz velaasot shear haddevarim beom shevii vechen yom sheloshim miktzato kechullo umuttar lesapper ulgahetz beom sheloshim

Mi shettechafuhu avalav vehichbid searo mekel betaar lo bemisparayim umchabbes kesuto bemayim aval lo beneter velo bechol verochetz kal gufo betzonen aval lo bechammin vechen mi shettechafuhu avalav uva mimmedinat hayyam umibbet hashshivya o sheyyatza mibbet haasurim o shehaya menudde vehuttar o shehaya muddar venishal al nidro vehuttar vechal hayyotze mittuma letahora hare ellu megallechin bime evlam hoil utchafam evel achar evel velo matzu penay
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 7: Mi shebbaa lo shemua shemmet lo karov im betoch sheloshim yom higgia hashshemua afillu yom sheloshim atzmo hare zo shemua kerova vechayyav linhog shiva yeme avelut miyyom shehiggia hashshemua vekorea umone sheloshim leissur hattisporet im shear haddevarim kelalo shel davar yom shemuato hakkerova keom hakkevura aval im higgia lo hashshemua achar hashsheloshim yom hare zo shemua rechoka veenah noheget ella yom echad veeno korea uchillu yom hashshemua hu yom shevii veom sheloshim umiktzat hayyom kechullo
Ketzad miktzat hayyom kechullo kevan shennahag avelut shaa achat keillu nahag kal hayyom kullo umuttar linol velirchotz velasuch ulgalleach bishar hayyom vechen hu muttar bechal haddevarim

Mi shebbaa lo shemua kerova betoch haregel o beom shabbat ulachar shabbat o achar haregel naaset rechoka ole lo veeno noheg leachar haregel o leachar hashshabbat ella yom echad bilvad umiktzat hayyom kechullo kemo shebbearnu

Mi shemmet lo karov velo yada ad shebba im haya bemakom karov shehu mahalach asara parsaot sheefshar sheyyavo beom echad afillu ba bayyom hashshevii im matza menachamim etzel gedol habbayit af al pi shenninaru laamod hoil umatza menachamim ole lo umone immahen tashlum sheloshim yom veim lo matza menachamim mone leatzmo vechen im haya bemakom rachok afillu ba beom sheni mone leatzmo shiva ushloshim miyyom shebba

Avel bishlosha yamim harishonim eno holech afillu levet avel acher mikkan veelach holech veeno yoshev bimkom hamnachamin ella bimkom hammitnachamin velo yetze lemakom acher mippetach beto kal shabbat harishona sheniyya yotze veeno yoshev bimkomo shelishit yoshev bimkomo veeno medabber kedarko reviit hare hu kechal adam

Kohen gadol chayyav bechal divre avelut ella sheasur lo likroa begadav lemala ulgaddel pera velatzet achar hammitta vechal haam bain lenachamo leveto uchshemmavrin oto kal haam mesubbin al haaretz vehu mesev al hassafsal veomrin lo keshemmenachamin oto anu kapparatcha vehu omer lahem titbarchu min hashshamayim veim ratza lenachem acherim hammunne mematztzeo betoch haam veomer lahem tenuchamu

Vechen hammelech chayyav bechal divre avelut ella sheeno yotze mippetach palterin shello achar meto veen tzarich lomar achar metim acherim veeno menachem avelim velo yatza david achar avner ella lehodia laam shello neherag birtzono

En adam nichnas lammelech lenachamo ella avadav umi shennatan lo reshut lehikkanes veen lahen reshut ledabber lo divre tanchumin ella kefi ma sheyyarshe otam uchshemmavrin oto kal haam mesubbin al haaretz vehu mesev al haddargash
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 8: Avel chayyav likroa al meto shenneemar uvigdechem lo tifromu velo tamutu ha acher chayyav lifrom veen keria ella meummad shenneemar vayyakam hammelech vayyikra et begadav umehechan korea millefanav vehakkorea meacharav o min hatztzedadin o millematta lo yatza yede chovat keria ella kohen gadol shehu porem millematta

Kamma shiur hakkera tefach veen tzarich lehavdil sefat habbeged umuttar lo likroa bichli veyesh lo likroa bifnim shello bifne adam lefichach yesh lo lehachnis yado bifnim vekorea betzina veeno chayyav likroa ella beged haelon bilvad

Kal shivat yeme avelut hakkera lefanim veim ba lehachlif machlif veeno korea kera acher shekkal kera sheeno bishat chimmum eno kera bamme devarim amurim bishar hammetim chutz meaviv veimmo aval al aviv veal immo korea ad shemmegalle et libbo umavdil sefat habbeged veeno korea bichli ella beyado mibbachutz bifne kal haam vekorea kal habbegadim shealav uveged hazzea haddavuk livsaro eno meakkev veim hechlif beged acher chayyav likroa kal shiva vechen al aviv veal immo choletz ketefo umotzi zeroo min hechaluk ad sheyyitgalle ketefo uzroo veholech kach lifne hammitta veachar sheyyikkaver aviv veimmo eno chayyav lachlotz
Korin lekatan mippene agmat nefesh vechole shemmet lo met en mekarin lo velo modiin lo shello tittaref alav dato umshattekin et hannashim mippanav
Vekorea adam al chamiv veal chamoto mippene kevod ishto vechen haishsha koraat al chamiha veal chamotah mippene kevod balah

Mi sheen lo chaluk likroa venizdammen lo chaluk betoch shiva korea leachar shiva eno korea veal aviv veal immo afillu leachar shiva korea kal sheloshim yom vechal hayyotze beveged karua lifne metim kelomar shehu kara atta alehen hare ze gonev daat habberiyyot vezilzel bichvod hachayyim vehammetim

Haomer lachavero hashileni chalukcha vaavakker et avi shehu chole vehalach umtzao shemmet korea umache umachazir lo et chaluko venoten lo deme kiro veim lo hodio shehu mevakker lo chole hare ze lo yigga bo

Mi shehaya lo chole betoch beto venitallef vesavur shemmet vekara veachar kach met im betoch kede dibbur eno chozer vekorea veim leachar kede dibbur met chozer vekorea kera acher vechen mi sheamru lo met aviv vekara veachar kach nimtza shemmet beno amru lo met lo met vechassavur sheaviv vekara veachar kach nimtza beno im toch kede dibbur noda lo amittat haddavar yatza yede keria veim leachar kede dibbur lo yatza vechayyav likroa kera acher
Mi shemmetu lo metim harbe keechad korea kera echad lechullam haya bichlalan aviv o immo korea al kullan kera echad veal aviv veal immo kera acher

Mi shemmet lo met vekara alav veachar kach met lo met acher im betoch shiva korea kera acher veim leachar shiva mosif al hakkera harishon kal shehu met lo met shelishi achar shiva shel sheni mosif kal shehu vechen mosif veholech ad tabburo higgia letabburo marchik shalosh etzbaot vekorea nitmalle millefanav machziro laachorav nitmalle millemala hofcho lematta amru lo met aviv vekara veachar shiva met beno vehosif mitache hattachton velo haelon kemo sheyyitbaer amru lo met beno vekara veachar shiva met aviv eno mosif ella korea kera acher sheen aviv veimmo betosefet
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 9: Kal hakkeraim shekkorea adam al shear kerovav sholel hakkera leachar shiva umache leachar sheloshim al aviv veal immo sholel leachar sheloshim veeno meache leolam vehaishsha koraat vesholelet miyyad afillu al aviha veal immah mippene hatztzeniut

Kederech shekkorea adam al aviv veal immo kach chayyav likroa al rabbo shellimmedo tora veal hannasi veal av bet din veal rov hatztzibbur shenneherag veal birkat hashshem veal sefer tora shennisraf veal are yehuda veal yerushalayim veal hammikdash

Kal ellu hakkeraim korea ad shemmegalle et libbo veeno meache leolam veaf al pi sheen mitachin muttar leshollan lemallan ullakketan velaasotam kemin sullamot velo asru ella beichuy alekkesanderi bilvad vechal hakkorea mittoch hashshalal o hammelel o hallikkut lo asa kelum aval korea mittoch haichuy haalekkesanderi bilvad afillu hafach hakkeli venaasa sefato lematta lo yeache
Uchshem shehammocher asur leachoto kach hallokeach lefichach hammocher tzarich lehodia lallokeach shekkera ze eno mitache

Uminnayin shekkorea al rabbo kederech shekkorea al aviv shenneemar vehu metzaek avi avi rechev yisrael ufarashav velo raahu od vayyachazek bivgadav vayyikraem lishnayim keraim mikkan shechayyav lehavdil hassafa

Uminnayin shekkorin al hannasi veal av bet din veal shemua shebbaa shenneherag rov tzibbur shenneemar vayyachazek david bivgadav vayyikraem vegam kal haanashim asher itto vayyispedu vayyivku vayyatzumu ad haarev al shaul ze nasi veal yehonatan beno ze av bet din veal am Adonai veal bet yisrael ki naflu becharev zo shemua raa

Uminnayin shekkorin al birkat hashshem shenneemar vayyavo elyakim ben chilkiyyahu asher al habbayit veshevna hassofer veoach ben asaf hammazkir el chizkiyyahu kerue vegadim echad hashshomea veechad hashshomea mippi shomea chayyavin likroa
Vehaedim en chayyavin likroa kesheyyaidu bevet din shekkevar karu beshaa sheshshamu

Uminnayin shekkorin al sefer tora shennisraf shenneemar vayehi kikro yehudi shalosh delatot vearbaa vego ad tom kal hammegilla al haesh asher al haach velo fachadu velo karu et bigdehem hammelech vechal avadav michlal shechayyavin likroa veen chayyavin likroa ella al sefer tora shennisraf bizroa kemaase shehaya vechayyav likroa shette keriot achat al haggevil veachat al hakketav shenneemar achare serof hammelech et hammegilla veet haddevarim
Uminnayin shekkorin al are yehuda veal yerushalayim veal hammikdash shecharvu shenneemar vayyavou anashim mishshechem umishshilo umishshomron shemonim ish megulleche zakan ukrue vegadim

Kal mi sheamad im hammet bishat yetziat nishmato af al pi sheeno kerovo chayyav likroa vechen adam kasher shemmet hakkol chayyavin likroa alav af al pi sheeno chacham vekorin tefach kishar haavelim aval chacham shemmet hakkol kerovav vehakkol korin alav ad shemmegallin et libbam vecholtzin miyyamin uvet midrasho shel oto chacham batel kal shiva uchvar nahagu talmide chachamim bechal makom likroa ze al ze tefach af al pi shehen shavin veen echad mehem melammed et chavero

Kal hakkorim al hechacham shemmet kevan shehechziru penehen meachore hammitta shollin veyerae li shehakkorea al hechacham meache lemachar sheafillu rabbo shemmet en mitabbel alav ella yom echad bilvad o yom mita o yom shemua ken yerae li shehakkorea al hannasi vechayyotze bo sholel lemachar af al pi sheeno meache alehem leolam
Chacham shebbaa shemuato shemmet en korin alav ella bishat hespedo vezehu kevodo vesholel bo bayyom umache lemachar

Av bet din shemmet hakkol korin alav vecholtzin missemol vechal batte midrashot shebbeiro betelin uvne bet hakkeneset nichnasin levet hakkeneset umshannin et mekoman hayyoshvin baddarom yeshvu batztzafon vehayyoshvim batztzafon yeshvu baddarom

Nasi shemmet hakkol korin alav vecholtzin shette hayyadayim mikkan umikkan uvchal batte midrashot betelim uvne bet hakkeneset nichnasin beshabbat levet hakkeneset vekorin shiva velo yetayelu bashshuk ella yoshvin mishpachot mishpachot davim kal hayyom
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 10: Hashshabbat ola leminyan avelut veen avelut beshabbat ella bidvarim shebbetzina kegon atifat harosh vetashmish hammitta urchitza bechammin aval devarim shebbegaluy eno noheg bahen avelut ella lovesh minalav vezokef et hammitta venoten shalom lechal adam veim yesh lo beged machlif velo yilbash beged karua beshabbat afillu al aviv veal immo veim en lo lehachlif machzir et hakkera leacharav
Meematay zokfim et hammittot beerev shabbat min hammincha ulmala veaf al pi chen lo yeshev aleha ad shettecheshach veaf al pi shello nishtayyer lo ella yom echad chozer vechofe otan bemotzae shabbat

Hargalim vechen rosh hashshana veom hakkippurim en davar middivre avelut noheg bahen vechal hakkover et meto afillu shaa achat kodem haregel o kodem rosh hashshana veom hakkippurim batla mimmennu gezerat shiva nimtza mone leachar rosh hashshana veom hakkippurim shelosha veesrim yom ulachar happesach shishsha asar yom shehare batla mimmennu gezerat shiva veshivat yeme hechag hare arbaa asar vechen im kavar kodem atzeret mone achareha shishsha asar yom af al pi shehu yom echad hare hi regel veola leshiva yamim

Kavar et meto kodem chag hassukkot mone achar hechag tisha yamim bilvad shehare shemini atzeret regel bifne atzmo venimtza yom tov harishon mafsik shiva veshivat yeme hechag ushmini shel chag regel echad hare echad veesrim yom

Hakkover et meto shivat yamim kodem regel min hargalim o kodem rosh hashshana veom hakkippurim batla gezerat sheloshim umuttar lesapper ulchabbes beerev yom tov o beerev yom hakkippurim shemmiktzat hayyom kechullo veeno mone leacharehem kelum veim al aviv veal immo hu mitabbel afillu metu kodem haregel sheloshim yom eno megalleach ad sheyyishlach pera o ad sheyyigaru bo chaverav veen hargalim mafsikin davar ze

Chal shishshi shello beerev haregel veen tzarich lomar chamishi o shelishi eno megalleach velo batla mimmennu ella gezerat shiva bilvad veeno muttar lirchotz velasuch velaasot davar ad sheyyikkanes yom tov veom tov mafsik shear hashshiva ulachar yom tov mashlim kal sheloshim yom miyyom hammita veasur bahen bechal chamishsha devarim

Chal shevii shello lihot beerev haregel vahare hu shabbat batla mimmennu gezerat sheloshim umuttar legalleach betoch hammoed shehare anus haya vei efshar lo legalleach beshabbat vechen megalleach achar atzeret o achar rosh hashshana veom hakkippurim shehare batla gezerat sheloshim veyesh lo legalleach bechal et sheyyirtze

Hakkover et meto betoch haregel lo chala alav avelut kelal veeno noheg avelut baregel ella leachar haregel matchil limnot shiva venoheg bahen kal divre avelut umone sheloshim miyyom hakkevura venoheg bishar hashsheloshim bechal gezerot sheloshim

Hammekomot sheosin shene yamim tovim mone hashshiva miyyom tov sheni haacharon af al pi sheeno noheg avelut hoil umiddivrehem hu ole lo min hamminyan umone acharav shishsha yamim bilvad umone sheloshim yom miyyom hakkevura kemo sheamarnu

Hakkover et meto beom tov sheni shehu yom tov haacharon o beom tov sheni shel atzeret noheg bo avelut hoil veom tov sheni middivrehem vaavelut yom rishon shel tora yiddache ase shel divrehem mippene ase shel tora aval im kavar beom tov sheni shel rosh hashshana eno noheg bo avelut sheshshenehen keom aroch hen mittaam shebbearnu behilchot kiddush hachodesh
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 11: Af al pi sheen avelut bammoed korea al meto bammoed vecholetz ketefo umavrin et haavelim lechem bammoed kal ellu bechullo shel moed aval beom tov afillu beom tov sheni en korin velo choltzin velo mavrin

En korin bammoed velo choltzin ella hakkerovim shechayyavin baevel o hakkorea vehacholetz al hechacham o al adam kasher o mi shehaya omed bishat yetziat neshama umavrin hakkol al hechacham bammoed letoch harchava kederech shemmavrin et haavelim shehakkol avelim alav

Keshemmavrin et haavelim bammoed en mavrin ella al mittot zekufot veen omrin birkat avelim bammoed aval omdin beshura umnachamin ufotrin veen mannichin et hammitta barchov shello lehargil et hahesped shehammoed asur behesped uvtaanit vechen en melakketim atzmot aviv veimmo bammoed sheevel hu lo veen tzarich lomar shear kerovim vechen en maspidin et hammet bachanukka uvfurim velo berashe chodashim aval nohagin bahen kal divre avelut umuttar lispod lifne chanukka ufurim ulacharehen
Hannashim bammoed meannot aval lo metappechot uvrashe chodashim uvachanukka uvfurim meannot umtappechot aval en mekonnot lo baze velo baze nikbar hammet lo meannot velo metappechot

E zehu innuy shekkullan onot keachat kina sheachat omeret vechullan onot achareha shenneemar velammedna venotechem nehi veishsha reutah kina bamme devarim amurim bishar haam shemmetu aval talmid chacham shemmet sofdim oto bammoed veen tzarich lomar bachanukka uvfurim verashe chodashim aval lo beom tov sheni veen sofdin oto beyamim ellu ella befanav nikbar asurin behesped veom shemuato kivfanav hu vesofdin oto af al pi shehi rechoka

Lo teorer ishsha al met shellah sheloshim yom kodem lechag kede shello yavo hechag vehem davim sheen hammet mishtakkeach min hallev sheloshim yom bamme devarim amurim bemet yashan aval im met betoch sheloshim yom samuch lechag meoreret

Shivat yeme hachatnut hare hen keregel umi shemmet lo met betoch yeme hammishte afillu aviv veimmo mashlim shivat yeme hassimcha veachar kach noheg shivat yeme avelut umone hashsheloshim meachar yeme hassimcha

Hechin kal tzarche hasseuda veafa pitto vetavach tivcho kede sheyyikkansu lassimcha umet lo met kodem sheyyikkansu lassimcha im lo natan mayim al gabbe basar mocher habbasar vehappat venoheg shivat yeme avelut veachar kach noheg shivat yeme hammishte veim natan mayim al gabbe basar shehare i efshar lemachro machnisin et hammet lecheder veet hechatan veet hakkalla lachuppa uvoel beilat mitzva uforesh venoheg shivat yeme hammishte veachar kach noheg shivat yeme avelut vechal otan hayyamim noheg bidvarim shebbetzina keshabbat lefichach hu yashen ben haanashim veishto yeshena ben hannashim kede shello yeshammesh mittato veen monin tachshitin min hakkalla kal sheloshim yom hau bemakom sheefshar limkor habbasar af al pi shennatan alav mayim mocher venoheg avelut techilla hau bemakom shei efshar limkor habbasar af al pi shello natan alav mayim noheg shivat yeme hammishte techilla bamme devarim amurim keshemmet aviv shel chatan o immah shel kalla sheim yafsidu seuda zo en lahem mi sheyyitrach lahem aval im met aviha shel kalla o immo shel chatan o shear kerovehem nohagin shivat yeme haevel techilla veachar kach tikkanes lachuppa veyinhagu shivat yeme hammishte
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 12: Hahesped kevod hammet hu lefichach kofin et hayyorshin litten sechar mekonnim vehamkonnot vesofdin oto veim tziva shello yispeduhu en sofdin oto aval im tziva shello yikkaver en shomin lo shehakkevura mitzva shenneemar ki kavor tikberennu

Kal hammitatztzel behespedo shel chacham eno maarich yamim vechal hammitatztzel behesped adam kasher rauy likkaver bechayyav vechal hammorid demaot al adam kasher hare secharo shamur al kach etzel hakkadosh baruch hu
En mannichin sefer tora al mittato shel chacham veen meshannin oto mimmitta lemitta veen motziin mittato ella derech petachim lo sheyeshalsheluha derech gaggot uvishar haam muttar laasot

En pochatin mishshiva maamadot lemet veen osin maamad umoshav befachot measara veen osin ella bikrovim veen osin ella beom rishon uvvet hakkevarot uvmakom shennahagu ketzad osin bemakom shennahagu maamidin shear hakkerovim uvne mishpacha sheenan bene avel veomrin lifnehem divre kinot vechayyotze bahen veachar kach omer shevu yekarim shevu veomer lifnehem devarim acherim keshehen yoshvin veachar kach imdu yekarim amodu veomer keshehen omdin vechozer veomer kach ad sheva peamim

Kederech sheosin maamad umoshav laanashim bemakom shennahagu kach osin lenashim umaspidin hannashim kaanashim bechal makom aval en mannichin mittat haishsha barchov leolam shezze genay laishsha ella samuch lemitatah kevuratah
Hamlakket atzamot en omrim alehem kinim unhi velo birkat avelim velo tanchume avelim aval omrim alehen divre shevach lehakkadosh baruch hu vedivre kibbushim

Hamfanne arono shel met mimmakom lemakom im shidro kayyemet omdin alav beshura veomrim alav birkat avelim vetanchume avelim umaspidin oto af al pi sheheeviruhu leachar shenem asar chodesh veim en shidro kayyemet en maspidin oto veen omdin alav beshura veen omrin alav birkat avelim velo tanchume avelim veellu hen birkat avelim devarim sheomrim bevet haavel tanchume avelim sheomrim bashshura
Hamlakket atzmot aviv veimmo hare ze mitabbel alehen kal hayyom kullo velaerev en mitabbel afillu tzerurin lo bisdino veen omrin alehen kinot
En maspidin et hakketannim uven kamma shanim yihye rauy lehesped bene aniyyim o bene zekenim bene chamesh uvne ashirim bene shesh echad zecharim veechad nekevot

Tinok shemmet kal sheloshim yotze bechek venikbar beishsha achat uvishne anashim aval lo beish echad uvishte nashim mippene hayyichud veen omdin alav beshura veen omrin alav birkat avelim vetanchume avelim ben sheloshim yom gemurim yotze bigluskema ketanna hannittelet baagappayim veomdin alav beshura veomrin alav birkat avelim vetanchume avelim ben shenem asar chodesh yotze bemitta

Kal hayyotze bemitta rabbim matzhivin alav vechal sheeno yotze bemitta en rabbim matzhivin alav vkal hannikkar larabbim rabbim mitassekin bo vechal sheeno nikkar larabbim en rabbim chayyavin lehitassek bo umakom shennahagu nashim latzet lifne hammitta yotzot lifne hammitta leachar hammitta yotzot leachar hammitta

Haavadim vehashshefachot en maspidin otan veen omdin alehen beshura veen omrim alehen birkat avelim vetanchume avelim ella omrin lo keshem sheomrin lo al shoro veal chamoro hammakom yemalle chesroncha
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 13: Ketzad menachamin et haavelim achar shekkovrin et hammet mitkabbetzin haavelim veomdin betzad bet hakkevarot vechal hamlavin et hammet omdin saviv lahen shura lifne shura veen shura pechuta measara veen avelim min hamminyan

Haavelim omdin lismol hamnachamin vechal hamnachamin bain etzel haavelim echad echad veomrim lahen tenuchamu min hashshamayim veachar kach holech haavel leveto vechal yom veom mishshivat yeme avelut bain bene adam lenachamo ben shebbau panim chadashot ben shello bau

Haavel mesev barosh veen hamnachamin rashshain leshev ella al gabbe karka shenneemar vayyeshvu itto laaretz veen rashshain lomar davar ad sheyyiftach haavel et piv techilla shenneemar veen dover elav davar uchtiv achare chen patach iyyov et pihu vego vayyaan elifaz vechevan shenninea berosho shuv en hamnachamin rashshain leshev etzlo shello yatrichuhu yoter midday

Met sheen lo avelim lehitnachem baim asara bene adam kesherin veoshvin bimkomo kal shivat yeme haavelut ushar haam mitkabbetzin alehen veim lo hau sham asara kevuin bechal yom veom mitkabbetzin asara mishshear haam veoshvin bimkomo
Hakkol chayyavin laamod bifne nasi chutz meavel vechole ulchal haomed mippanav omer lo shev chutz meavel vechole shemmashma yeshev beevlo yeshev bechalo
Mechabbedin umrabbetzin bevet haavel umdichin kearot vechosot vekitonot utzlochiyyot umadlikin et hannerot aval en meviin sham lo et hammugmar velo et habbesamim

En molichin levet haavel hammaachal shemmavrin bo lo bichle kesef velo bichle shaam vechayyotze bahen ella bichle nesarim shel arava kelufa vechayyotze bahen shello levayyesh et mi sheen lo veen mashkin bizchuchit levana ella bitzvua shello levayyesh et haaniyyim sheen yenotehen tovot
En shotin bevet haavel yeter al asara kosot lechal echad veechad shelosha kodem achila ushlosha betoch achila vearbaa leachar achila velo yosif shemma yishtakker
En omrin shemua vehaggada bevet haavel ella yoshvin davin vechen en omrin bifne hammet ella devarim shel met aval laasok bedivre tora befanav o bevet hakkevarot asur

En bochin al hammet yeter mishshelosha yamim veen maspidin yeter mishshiva bamme devarim amurim bishar haam aval talmide chachamim hakkol lefi chachmatan veen bochiyin alehem yoter mishsheloshim yom sheen lanu gadol mimmoshe rabbenu uchtiv vayyittemu yeme vechi evel mshe vechen en maspidin yeter al shenem asar chodesh en lanu bechachma gadol merabbenu hakkadosh ushnem asar chodesh bilvad nispad vechen chacham shebbaa shemuato leachar shenem asar chodesh en sofdin oto

Al yitkashshe adam al meto yeter midday shenneemar al tivku lemet veal tanudu lo kelomar yeter midday shezzehu minhago shel olam vehamtzaer atzmo yoter al minhago shel olam hare ze tippesh ella ketzad yaase shelosha livchi shiva lehesped sheloshim yom letisporet velishar hachamishsha devarim

Kal mi sheeno mitabbel kemo shetztziuu chachamim hare ze achzari ella yifchad veyidag vifashpesh bemaasav veyachzor bitshuva veechad mibbene chavura shemmet tidag kal hachavura kullah kal shelosha yamim harishonim yire et atzmo keillu cherev munnachat lo al tzavaro umishshelosha vead shiva keillu hi munnachat bekeren zavit mikkan veelach keillu overet kenegdo bashshuk kal ze lehachin atzmo veyachzor veyeor mishshenato vahare hu omer hikkita otam velo chalu michlal shetztzarich lehakitz velachul
Mishneh Torah, Mourning 14: Mitzvat ase shel divrehem levakker cholim ulnachem avelim ulhotzi hammet ulhachnis hakkalla ullauot haorchim ulhitassek bechal tzarche hakkevura laset al hakkatef velelech lefanav velispod velachpor velikbor vechen lesammeach hakkalla vehechatan ulsaadam bechal tzarchehem veellu hen gemilut chasadim shebbegufo sheen lahem shiur af al pi shekkal mitzot ellu middivrehem hare hen bichlal veahavta lereacha kamocha kal haddevarim sheatta rotze sheyyaasu otam lecha acherim ase atta otan leachich betora uvmitzot

Sechar hallevaya merubbe min hakkol vehu hachok shechakako avraham avinu vederech hachesed shennahag bah maachil ovre derachim umashke otan umlave otan ugdola hachnasat orchim mehakbalat pene shechina shenneemar vayyar vehinne shelosha anashim veliuuyam yoter mehachnasatan amru chachamim kal sheeno melave keillu shofech damim

Kofin lilvaya kederech shekkofin litzdaka uvet din hau metakkenin sheluchin lelauot adam haover mimmakom lemakom veim nitatztzelu bedavar ze maale alehem keillu shafchu damim afillu hamlave et chavero arba ammot yesh lo sachar harbe vechamma shiur levaya shechayyav adam bah harav letalmid ad ibburah shel ir vehaish lachavero ad techum shabbat vehattalmid larav ad parsa veim haya rabbo muvhak ad shalosh parsaot

Bikkur cholim mitzva al hakkol afillu gadol mevakker et hakkatan umvakkerin harbe peamim bayyom vechal hammosif meshubbach uvilvad shello yatriach vechal hamvakker et hachole keillu natal chelek mechalo vehekel mealav vechal sheeno mevakker keillu shofech damim

En mevakkerin et hachole ella miyyom shelishi vahala veim kafatz alav hacholi vehichbid mevakkerin oto miyyad veen mevakkerin et hachole lo beshalosh shaot rishonot bayyom velo beshalosh acharonot mippene shehen mitassekin betzarche hachole veen mevakkerin lo chole meayim velo chole haayin velo mechoshe harosh mippene shehabbikkur kashe lahen

Hannichnas levakker et hachole lo yeshev lo al gabbe mitta velo al gabbe kisse velo al gabbe safsal velo al gabbe makom gavoha velo lemala mimmeraashotav ella mitattef veoshev lematta mimmeraashotav umvakkesh alav rachamim veotze
Yerae li shennechamat avelim kodem levikkur cholim shennichum avelim gemilut chesed im hachayyim veim hammetim

Mi shehaya lefanav met vechalla meniach et hakkalla umitassek im hammet vechen hu omer lev chachamim bevet evel vego met vechalla sheppagu ze baze badderech maavirin et hammet millifne hakkalla veze veze ovrin millifne hammelech
Mevattelin talmud tora lehotzaat hammet ulhachnasat hakkalla bamme devarim amurim besheen lo kal tzarko aval yesh lo kal tzarko en mevattelin vechal sheen mitassekin battora chayyavin lehitassek immo
Met echad bair kal bene hair asurin baasiyyat melacha ad sheyyikberuhu veim yesh lo mi sheyyitassek bitzrachav muttarin

Talmid chacham shemmet afillu hau immo ad shishshim ribbo mevattelin talmud tora lehotzaato hau shishshim ribbo en mevattelin veim haya melammed laacherim en lo shiur ella mevattelin hakkol lehotzaato
Kovrin mete akkum umnachamin avelehem umvakkerin cholehem mippene darche shalom

Batte hakkevarot asurin bahanaa ketzad en ochlin bahen veen shotin bahen veen osin bahen melacha velo korin bahen velo shonin bahen kelalo shel davar en neotin bahen velo nohagin bahen kallut rosh lo yelech adam betoch arba ammot shel kever utfillin beyado vesefer tora bizroo velo yitpallel sham uvrichuk arba ammot muttar

Hammolich atzamot mimmakom lemakom lo yittenem bediskiyya veyannichem al gabbe chamoro veyirkav alehem mippene shennoheg bahen minhag bizzaon veim haya mityare mippene haggannavim umippene hallistim muttar
En mefannin et hammet mikkever lekever afillu mibbazuy limchubbad veim haya betoch sadehu mefannehu afillu mimmechubbad levazuy
En kovrin met al gabbe met velo shene metim keechad shebbizzaon hu vekatan hayyashen im immo nikbar immah
Afar hakkever eno asur bahanaa sheen karka olam neeseret aval kever habbinyan asur bahanaa
Habbone kever lemet lo neesar ad sheyyikkanes bo hammet vaafillu hetil bo nefel neesar bahanaa

Nefesh shennaasa leshem chay vesam bo hammet vehosif bo dimos acher leshem hammet af al pi sheppinna hammet hakkol asur bahanaa veim hikkir et hattosefet choletz otah vehashshear muttar naasa leshem hammet kevan shehuttal bo hammet neesar af al pi sheppinnahu
Habbone kever leaviv vehalach ukvaro bekever acher hare ze lo yikkaver bo met acher olamit vehakkever hazze asur bahanaa mippene kevod aviv

Hammet asur bahanaa kullo chutz missearo shehu muttar bahanaa mippene sheeno gufo vechen arono vechal tachrichav asurin bahanaa aval kelim hammuchanim letachrich lo neesru bahanaa afillu arag beged lemet lo neesar ad sheyyaggia bammitta hannikberet immo sheen hahazmana oseret
Kal hakkelim shezzorkin al hammet al hammitta hannikberet immo asurin bahanaa shello yitchallefu battachrichin
Hau aviv veimmo mezarkin kelim bachamatan al hammet mitzva al acherim lehatztzilan veim higgiu lammitta hannikberet immo en matztzilin otan
Melammedin et haadam shello yehe chabbelan velo yafsid et hakkelim veyashlichem lechabbala mutav letittam laaniyyim veal yashlichem lerimma vetolea vechal hammarbe kelim al hammet over belo tashchit

Melech shemmet okrin sus shehaya rochev alav veegla shehayeta moshechet bakkaron shehaya yoshev bo menashsher parsoteha min haarkubba ulmatta makom sheen ose otah terefa umoshivin yeshiva al kivro shiva yamim shenneemar vechavod asu lo vemoto ze shehoshivu lo yeshiva al kivro venasi shemmet en mevattelin yeshivato yeter al sheloshim yom

Melech o nasi shemmet yesh lahen lisrof mittato vechal kele tashmisho veen baze derech haemori velo mishshum hashchata shenneemar beshalom tamut uvmisrefot avotecha harishonim yisrefu lach seliku lehu hilchot avel besad
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 1: Bet din haggadol shebbirushalayim hem ikkar tora shebbeal pe vehem ammude hahoraa umehem chok umishpat yotze lechal yisrael vaalehen hivticha tora shenneemar al pi hattora asher yorucha zo mitzvat ase vechal hammaamin bemoshe rabbenu uvtorato chayyav lismoch maase haddat alehen velishshaen alehen

Kal mi sheeno ose kehoraatan over belo taase shenneemar lo tasur mikkal haddavar asher yaggidu lecha yamin usmol veen lokin al lav ze mippene shennittan leazharat mitat bet din shekkal chacham shemmore al divrehem mitato bechenek shenneemar vehaish asher yaase vezadon vego echad devarim shellamdu otan mippi hashshemua vehem tora shebbeal pe veechad devarim shellemmadum mippi datam beachat min hammiddot shehattora nidreshet bahen venira beenehem sheddavar ze kach hu veechad devarim sheasaum seyag lattora ulfi ma shehashshaa tzericha vehen haggezerot vehattakkanot vehamminhagot kal echad veechad meellu hashshelosha devarim mitzvat ase lishmoa lahen vehaover al kal echad mehen over belo taase hare hu omer al pi hattora asher yorucha ellu hattakkanot vehaggezerot vehamminhagot sheyyoru bahem larabbim kede lechazzek haddat ultakken haolam veal hammishpat asher yomru ellu devarim sheyyilmedu otan min haddin beachat min hammiddot shehattora nidreshet bahen mikkal haddavar asher yaggidu lecha zo hakkabbala shekkibbelu ish mippi ish

Divre kabbala en bahen machloket leolam vechal davar shettimtza bo machloket beyadua sheeno kabbala mimmoshe rabbenu udvarim shellemedin min haddin im hiskimu alehen bet din haggadol kullan hare hiskimu veim nechleku bahen holchin achar harov umotziin haddin achar harabbim vechen haggezerot vehattakkanot vehamminhagot im rau miktzatan sherauy ligzor gezera o letakken takkana o sheyyanichu haam hamminhag hazze verau miktzatan sheen rauy ligzor gezera zo velo letakken takkana zo velo lehaniach minhag ze nosin venotnin ellu keneged ellu veholchin achar rubban umotziin haddavar achar harabbim

Keshehaya bet din haggadol kayyam lo hayeta machloket beyisrael ella kal din shennolad bo safek leechad miyyisrael shoel levet din shebbeiro im yadu amru lo im lav hare hashshoel im oto bet din o im sheluchav olin lirushalayim veshoalin levet din shebbehar habbayit im yadu amru lo im lav hakkol bain levet din sheal petach haazara im yadu amru lahen veim lav hakkol bain lelishkat haggazit levet din haggadol veshoalin im haya haddavar shennolad bo hassafek lakkol yadua etzel bet din haggadol ben mippi hakkabbala ben mippi hammidda sheddanu bah omrim miyyad im lo haya haddavar barur etzel bet din haggadol danin bo bishatan venosin venotnin baddavar ad sheyyaskimu kullan o yaamdu leminyan veyelchu achar harov veyomru lechal hashshoalim kach halacha veholchin lahen mishshebbatal bet din haggadol ravta machloket beyisrael ze metamme venoten taam lidvarav veze metaher venoten taam lidvarav ze oser veze mattir

Shene chachamim o shene batte dinin shennechleku shello bizman hassanhedrin o ad shello haya haddavar barur lahen ben bizman echad ben baze achar ze echad metaher veechad metamme echad oser veechad mattir im encha yodea lehechan haddin note beshel tora hallech achar hammachmir beshel sofrim hallech achar hammekel
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 2: Bet din haggadol sheddarshu beachat min hammiddot kefi ma shennira beenehem shehaddin kach vedanu din veamad acharehem bet din acher venire lo taam acher listor oto hare ze soter vedan kefi ma shennire beenav shenneemar el hashshofet asher yihye bayyamim hahem encha chayyav lalechet ella achar bet din shebbedorcha

Bet din sheggazru gezera o tikkenu takkana vehinhigu minhag ufashat haddavar bechal yisrael veamad acharehem bet din acher uvikkesh levattel devarim harishonim velaakor otah hattakkana veotah haggezera veoto hamminhag eno yachol ad sheyyihye gadol min harishonim bechachma uvminyan haya gadol bechachma aval lo beminyan beminyan aval lo bechachma eno yachol levattel et devarav afillu batal hattaam shebbiglalo gazru harishonim o hitkinu en haacharonim yecholin levattel ad sheyehu gedolim mehem veheach yihu gedolim mehem beminyan hoil vechal bet din uvet din shel shivim veechad hu ze minyan chachme haddor shehiskimu vekibbelu haddavar sheamru bet din haggadol velo chalku bo
