Bamme devarim amurim bidvarim shello asru otan kede laasot seyag lattora ella kishar dine tora aval devarim sherau bet din ligzor ulasran laasot seyag im pashat issuran bechal yisrael en bet din gadol acher yachol leakran ulhattiran afillu haya gadol min harishonim

Veyesh levet din laakor af devarim ellu lefi shaa af al pi shehu katan min harishonim shello yehu gezerot ellu chamurin middivre tora atzmah sheafillu divre tora yesh lechal bet din leakro horaat shaa ketzad bet din sherau lechazzek haddat velaasot seyag kede shello yaavru haam al divre tora makkin veonshin shello kaddin aval en kovin haddavar ledorot veomrim shehalacha kach hu vechen im rau lefi shaa levattel mitzvat ase o laavor al mitzvat lo taase kede lehachzir rabbim laddat o lehatztzil rabbim miyyisrael millehikkashel bidvarim acherim osin lefi ma shetztzericha hashshaa keshem sheharofe chotech yado o raglo shel ze kede sheyyichye kullo kach bet din morim bizman min hazzemannim laavor al ketzat mitzot lefi shaa kede sheyyitkayemu kullam kederech sheamru chachamim harishonim challel alav shabbat achat kede sheyyishmor shabbatot harbe

Bet din shennire lahen ligzor gezera o letakken takkana o lehanhig minhag tzerichin lehityashshev baddavar veleda techilla im rov hatztzibbur yecholin laamod bahen o im en yecholin laamod ulolam en gozrin gezera al hatztzibbur ella im ken rov hatztzibbur yecholin laamod bah
Hare sheggazru bet din gezera vedimmu sherov hakkahal yecholin laamod bah veachar sheggezaruha pikpeku haam bah velo pashta berov hakkahal hare zo betela veenan rashshain lachof et haam lalechet bah

Gazru vedimmu sheppashta bechal yisrael veamad haddavar ken shanim rabbot ulachar zeman merubbe amad bet din acher uvadak bechal yisrael veraa sheen otah haggezera poshetet bechal yisrael yesh lo reshut levattel vaafillu haya pachut mibbet din harishon bechachma uvminyan
Vechal bet din shehittir shene devarim al yemaher lehattir davar shelishi

Hoil veyesh levet din ligzor veleesor davar hammuttar veyaamod issuro ledorot vechen yesh lahen lehattir issure tora lefi shaa mahu ze shehizhira tora lo tosif alav velo tigra mimmennu shello lehosif al divre tora velo ligroa mehen velikboa haddavar leolam bedavar shehu min hattora ben battora shebbichtav ben battora shebbeal pe ketzad hare katuv battora lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze hakkatuv asar levashshel vleechol basar bechalav ben besar behema ben besar chayya aval besar haof muttar bechalav min hattora im yavo bet din veyattir besar chayya bechalav hare ze gorea veim yeesor besar haof veyomar shehu bichlal haggedi vehu asur min hattora hare ze mosif aval im amar besar haof muttar min hattora veanu neesor oto venodia laam shehu gezera shello yavo min haddavar chova veyomru haof muttar mippene shello nitparesh kach hachayya mutteret shehare lo nitparsha veyavo acher lomar af besar behema mutteret chutz min haez veyavo acher lomar af besar haez muttar bachalev para o hakkivsa shello neemar ella immo shehi mino veyavo acher lomar af bachalev haez sheenah immo muttar shello neemar ella immo lefichach neesor kal basar bechalav afillu besar of en ze mosif ella ose seyag lattora vechen kal kayyotze baze
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 3: Mi sheeno mode battora shebbeal pe eno zaken mamre haamur battora ella hare ze bichlal haeppikorosin umitato bechal adam

Meachar shennitparsem shehu kofer battora shebbeal pe moridin oto velo maalin vahare hu kishar kal haeppikorosin vehaomrin en tora min hashshamayim vehammosrin vehammumarin shekkal ellu enam bichlal yisrael veen tzarich lo leedim velo hatraa velo dayyanim ella kal hahoreg echad mehen asa mitzva gedola vehesir hammichshol

Bamme devarim amurim beish shekkafar battora shebbeal pe bemachashavto uvidvarim shenniru lo vehalach achar dato hakkalla veachar sherirut libbo vechofer battora shebbeal pe techilla ketzadok uvayettos vechen kal hattoim acharav aval bene hattoim haelle uvne benehem shehiddichu otam avotam venoldu ben hakkaraim vegiddelu otam al datam hare hu ketinok shennishba benehem vegiddeluhu veeno zariz leechoz bedarche hammitzot shehare hu keanus veaf al pi sheshshama achar kach shehu yehudi veraa hayehudim vedatam hare hu keanus shehare giddeluhu al tautam kach ellu sheamarnu haochazim bedarche avotam hakkaraim shettau lefichach rauy lehachziran bitshuva ulmashcham bedivre shalom ad sheyyachzeru leetan hattora

Aval zaken mamre haamur battora hu chacham echad mechachme yisrael sheyyesh beyado kabbala vedan umore bedivre tora kemo sheyyadunu veoru kal chachme yisrael shebbat lo machloket bedin min haddinim im bet din haggadol velo chazar ledivrehem ella chalak alehem vehora laasot shello kehoraatan gazra alav tora mita umitvadde veyesh lo chelek laolam habba af al pi shehu dan vehen danim hu kibbel vehem kibbelu hare hattora chalka lahem kavod veim ratzu bet din limchol al kevodan ulhannicho enan yecholin kede shello yarbu machloket beyisrael

En zaken mamre chayyav mita ad sheyehe chacham shehiggia lehoraa samuch bassanhedrin veyachlok al bet din bedavar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat o bitfillin veore laasot kehoraato o yaase hu al pi horaato veyachlok alehen vehen yoshvin belishkat haggazit aval im haya talmid shello higgia lehoraa vehora laasot patur shenneemar ki yippale mimmecha davar lammishpat mi shello yippale mimmennu ella davar mufla
Haya chacham mufla shel bet din vechalak veshana velimmed laacherim kidvarav aval lo hora laasot patur shenneemar vehaish asher yaase vezadon lo sheyyomar bezadon ella yore laasot o yaase hu beatzmo

Metzaan chutz limkoman vehimra alehen patur shenneemar vekamta vealita el hammakom melammed shehammakom gorem lo mita vechal ellu vechayyotze bahen shehen peturin min hammita yesh levet din haggadol lenaddotam ulhafrishan ulhakkotan ulmanan millelammed kefi ma sheyyerae lahen shehaddavar tzarich lechach

Vechetzad danin zaken mamre beet sheyyippale davar veore bo chacham hammaggia lehoraa ben bedavar sheyyerae beenav ben bedavar shekkibbel merabbotav hare hu vehacholkin immo olin lirushalayim uvain levet din sheal petach har habbayit omrim lahen bet din kach hu haddin im shama vekibbel mutav veim lav bain kullan levet din sheal petach haazara veomrim lahem gam hem kach hu haddin im kibbelu yelchu lahen veim lav kullan bain levet din haggadol lelishkat haggazit shemmishsham tora yotzet lechal yisrael shenneemar min hammakom hahu asher yivchar Adonai uvet din omer lahem kach hu haddin veotzin kullan chazar ze hechacham leiro veshana velimmed kederech shehu lamud hare ze patur hora laasot o sheasa kehoraato chayyav mita veeno tzarich hatraa afillu natan taam lidvarav en shomin lo ella kevan shebbau edim sheasa kehoraato o shehora laacherim laasot gomrin dino lemita bevet din shebbeiro vetofsin oto umaalin oto mishsham lirushalayim veen memitin oto bevet din shebbeiro velo bevet din haggadol sheyyatza chutz lirushalayim ella maalin oto levet din haggadol shebbirushalayim vead haregel meshammerin oto vechonkin oto baregel shenneemar vechal yisrael yishmeu veyirau mikkelal shetztzarich hachraza vearbaa tzerichin hachraza zaken mamre veedim zommin vehammesit uven sorer umore shehare bechullan neemar yishmeu veyirau
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 4: Ze shechalak al bet din haggadol bedavar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat ben shehau hen osrim vehu mattir ben shehau hen mattirin vehu oser hare ze chayyav mita afillu hu haya omer mippi hakkabbala veamar kach kibbalti merabbotay vehen omrim kach nire beenenu shehaddin noten hoil venasa venatan alehen baddavar veasa o shehora laasot hare ze chayyav veen tzarich lomar im hem morim mippi hakkabbala vechen im chalak alehem bigzera min haggezerot sheggazru bedavar sheyyesh beshiggato chattat uzdono karet kegon shehittir hechametz beom arbaa asar benisan beshaa shishshit o asaro bahanaa beshaa chamishit hare ze chayyav mita vechen kal kayyotze baze

Echad shennechleku bedavar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat o shennechleku bedavar hammevi lide davar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat ketzad nechleku beishsha zo im hi erva im lav im mare dam ze metamme beishsha o lo im zo temea leda o lo im zo zava o lo im chelev ze asur o muttar vechal kayyotze beellu hare ze cholek bedavar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat vechetzad davar hammevi lide davar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat kegon shennechleku beibbur shana im meabberim ad happurim o bechal adar hare ze chayyav shezze mevi lide chametz befesach vechen im nechleku bedin middine mamonot o beminyan haddayyanin sheddanin dine mamonot hare ze chayyav shehare lidvarav shel ze sheomer shezze chayyav laze kal shennatal mimmennu kedin natal veal pi bet din natal velidvarav shel ze sheomer patur o sheamar sheen ellu reuyin ladun kal shennatal gezel hu beyado veim kiddesh bo ishsha enah mekuddeshet uldivre haomer shello natal habba aleha bemezid anush karet beshogeg chayyav chattat venimtza haddavar mevi lide davar shechayyavin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat vechen im nechleku bedine makkot im ze chayyav malkot o eno o shechalak beminyan haddayyanim shellokin bifnehem hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer eno loke chovlin hem bo vechayyavin leshallem vechal sheyyittol mehen kedin notel uldivre haomer ben malkot hu kal sheyyittol mehen gezel hu beyado veim kiddesh bo ishsha enah mekuddeshet vechen im nechleku baarachin o bacharamin im ze chayyav litten o eno hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer eno chayyav litten im lakchu mimmennu hare ze gezel vehamkaddesh bo ishsha enah mekuddeshet vechen im chalak alehen befidon kadashim im nifdu o lo nifdu hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer en ze pidon im kiddesh bo ishsha enah mekuddeshet vechen im nechleku baarifat haegla im ellu chayyavin lehavi o lo hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer chayyavim lehavi hare hi asura bahanaa vehamkaddesh bo ishsha enah mekuddeshet vechen im nechleku bearla vechen im nechleku beleket shichcha ufea im ze laaniyyim o levaal habbayit hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer levaal habbayit hare ze gezel beyad heani veim kiddesh bo ishsha enah mekuddeshet vechen im chalak alehen beav meavot hattuma kegon nige basar o nige battim o nige begadim hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer tahor muttar lehikkanes bammikdash leechol kadashim uldivre haomer tame im nichnas o achal bemezid anush karet uvshogeg chayyav chattat vechen im nechleku betahorat metzora im yesh laze tahora o en lo vechen im nechleku behashkaat sota im zo tzericha lishtot o enah tzericha hare ze chayyav shehare ledivre haomer tzericha im met habbaal kodem shettishte hare zo asura livamah uldivre haomer enah tzericha mityabbemet vechen kal kayyotze baze tzerichin livdok velachkor im hayeta machloket zo mevia lide davar ze vedavar ze mevi lide davar sheni afillu achar mea devarim im yavo bassof ledavar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat ben shehaya hazzaken mekel vehen machamirin ben shehaya hu machmir vehen mekilin chayyav

Veim lo tavi hammachaloket lide kach hare ze patur chutz mimmitzvat tefillin bilvad ketzad hora lehosif totefet chamishit battefillin veyaasenna chamesh totafot hare ze chayyav vehu sheyyaase battechilla arbaa battim kehilchatan veyavi chamishit vidabbek bachitzon shehabbayit hachitzon sheeno roe et haavir tamid pasul vechiyyuv zaken mamre al davar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala aval im nechleku bishar mitzot kegon shechalak bedavar middivre lulav o tzitzit o shofar ze omer pasul veze omer kasher ze omer yatza yede chovato veze omer lo yatza ze omer tahor veze omer sheni letuma hare ze patur min hammita vechen kal kayyotze baze
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 5: Hamkalel aviv veimmo niskal shenneemar aviv veimmo killel damav bo veechad hamkallel bechayyehen o leachar mitatan hare ze niskal vetzarich edim vehatraa kishar kal mechuyyave mitot bet din veechad haish veechad haishsha vechen hattumtum vehaanderoginus vehu sheyyihu gedolim shehiggiu lichlal haonashin
Eno chayyav sekila ad sheyekallelem beshem min hashshemot hammeyuchadin aval im killelam bechinnuy patur min hassekila veloke kederech shelloke al killat kal adam kasher miyyisrael
Vechen hamkallel avi aviv vaavi immo hare ze kimkallel echad mishshear hakkahal
Azhara shel mekallel aviv veimmo minnayin onesh shamanu beferush aval haazhara hare hi bichlal lo tekallel cheresh hoil vehu muzhar shello lekallel adam miyyisrael hare aviv bichlal yisrael

Hammakke aviv veimmo mitato bechenek shenneemar makke aviv veimmo mot yumat vetzarich edim vehatraa kishar kal mechuyyave mitat bet din veechad haish veechad haishsha vechen hattumtum veanderoginus vehu sheyyaggiu lichlal onashin eno chayyav chenek ad sheyyaase bahen chabbura aval im lo asa bahen chabbura hare ze kemakke echad miyyisrael vehammakke otan leachar mita patur
Mi shehikka et aviv al azno vechersho chayyav veneherag shei efshar sheyyease cheresh belo chabbura ella yatzat tippat dam bifnim baozen venitcharesh

Hammakkiz dam leaviv o shehaya rofe vechatach lo basar o evar patur af al pi shehu patur lechattechilla lo yaase o lehotzi sillon mibbesar aviv o immo lo yotzi shemma yaase chabbura bamme devarim amurim kesheyyesh sham acher laasot aval im en sham mi sheyyaase ella hu vahare hen mitztaarin hare ze makkiz vechotech kefi ma sheyyarshehu laasot
Azhara shel makke aviv minnayin onesh shamanu azhara lo shamanu hoil vehu muzhar shello lehakkot adam miyyisrael hare aviv veimmo bichlal

Shetuki chayyav al immo veeno chayyav al aviv af al pi shennivdeka immo veamra ben peloni hu eno niskal o nechnak al piha aval beno min hashshifcha umin haakkum eno chayyav lo al aviv velo al immo vechen ger shehorato shello bikdushsha af al pi shelledato bikdushsha eno chayyav al makkat aviv vekillato
Keshem sheeno chayyav al aviv kach eno chayyav al immo shenneemar umkallel aviv veimmo et shehu chayyav al aviv chayyav al immo veze sheeno chayyav al aviv eno chayyav al immo

Hagger asur lekallel aviv haakkum ulhakkoto velo yevazzehu kede shello yomru bau mikkedushsha chamura likdushsha kalla shehare ze mevazze aviv ella noheg bo miktzat kavod aval haeved en lo yichus ella hare aviv kemi sheeno aviv lechal davar af al pi shennishtachreru

Mi shehau aviv veimmo reshaim gemurim veovre averot afillu nigmar dinan lahariga vehem yotzim lehareg asur lehakkotan ulkallelam veim killel o chaval bahen patur veim asu teshuva hare ze chayyav veneherag alehen af al pi shehare hen yotzin lemita bamme devarim amurim bivno aval acher shebba vehikkahu vekillel achar shennigmar dino af al pi sheasa teshuva hare ze patur hoil vehu holech lemita veim biyesho chayyav biknas hamvayyesh

Avar aviv veimmo al avera shellokin aleha vehaya hu chazzan lifne haddayyanim lo yakke otam vechen im nitchayyev nidduy lo yihye shaliach lenaddotam velo yidchof otam velo yevazze otam bishlichut bet din af al pi shehen reuyin lechach velo asu teshuva
Lakkol en habben naase shaliach lehakkoto ulkallelo chutz mimmesit umaddiach shehare amra tora lo tachmol velo techasse alav

Mi shennitchayyev shevua livno kach rainu bo tamid sheeno mashbio bishvuat haala shehare ze ba lekillat aviv ella mashbio shevua sheen bah ala uchvar bearnu shehaav sheharag et beno en echad meechav shel neherag naase goel haddam velo al hakkaa velo al hakkelala bilvad hikpida tora ella af al habbizzaon shekkal hamvazze aviv o immo afillu bidvarim vaafillu birmiza hare ze arur mippi haggevura shenneemar arur makle aviv veimmo vahare hu omer ayin tilag leav vetavuz likhat em vego veyesh levet din lehakkot al ze makkat mardut velaanosh kefi ma sheyyiru
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 6: Kibbud av vaem mitzvat ase gedola vechen mora av vaem shakal otan hakkatuv bichvodo uvmorao katuv kabbed et avicha veet immecha vechatuv kabbed et Adonai mehonecha uvaviv veimmo katuv ish immo veaviv tirau vechatuv et Adonai elohecha tira kederech shetztziva al kevod shemo haggadol umorao kach tziva al kevodam umoraam
Hamkallel aviv o immo biskila vehamgaddef biskila hinne hishva otan baonesh hikdim av leem lechavod vehikdim em leav lemora lelammed sheshshenehem shavim ben lammora ben lechavod

E zehu mora vee zehu kavod mora lo omed bimkomo velo yoshev bimkomo velo soter et devarav velo machria et devarav velo yikra lo bishmo lo bechayyav velo bemoto ella omer abba mari haya shem aviv o shem rabbo keshem acherim meshanne et shemam yerae li sheen nizhar bechach ella beshem shehu pele sheen hakkol dashin bo aval hashshemot shekkorim bahen et haam kegon avraham yitzchak veyaakov moshe vechayyotze bahen bechal lashon uvchal zeman kore bahen laacherim shello befanav veen bechach kelum e zehu kavod maachil umashke malbish umchasse mishshel haav veim en mamon laav veyesh mamon labben kofin oto vezan aviv veimmo kefi ma shehu yachol umotzi umachnis umshammesho bishar haddevarim shehashshammashim meshammeshim bahen et harav veomed mippanav kederech shehu omed mippene rabbo

Vehaav shehaya talmid beno en haav omed mippene habben aval habben omed mippene aviv af al pi shehu talmido vechayyav lechabbedo bishar derachav bishat asiyyat massao umattano vaasiyyat chafatzav ketzad hannishma bidvar aviv lemakom lo yomar maharuni bishvil atzmi pitruni bishvil atzmi ella maharuni bishvil abba pitruni bishvil abba vechen kal kayyotze baze leolam yichlol bichlal devarav shehu choshesh bichvod aviv veshemmityare mimmennu

Vechayyav lechabbedo afillu leachar moto ketzad haya omer devar shemua mippiv lo yomar kach amar abba ella omer kach amar abba mari ani kapparat mishkavo bamme devarim amurim betoch shenem asar chodesh shelleachar mitato aval leachar shenem asar chodesh omer zichrono lechayye haolam habba

Echad haish veechad haishsha chayyavin bemora vechavod ella shehaish yesh beyado laasot vehaishsha en beyadah laasot shehare reshut acherim aleha lefichach im nitgarsha o nitalmena hare shenehem shavim

Ad hechan hu kibbud av veem afillu natlu kis shel zehuvim shello vehishlichu befanav layyam lo yachlimem velo yetzaer bifnehem velo yichos kenegdam ella yekabbel gezerat hakkatuv veyishtok vead hechan moraan afillu haya lovesh begadim chamudot veoshev barosh bifne hakkahal uva aviv veimmo vekaru begadav vehikkuhu berosho veyarku befanav lo yachlimem ella yishtok veyira veyifchad mimmelech malche hammelachim shetztzivahu bechach sheillu melech basar vadam gazar alav davar shehu metzaer yeter mizze lo haya yachol lefarkes baddavar kal vachomer lemi sheamar vehaya haolam kirtzono
Af al pi shebbechach nitztavenu asur leadam lehachbid ello al banav uldakdek bichvodo immahem shello yeviem lide michshol ella yimchol veyitallem shehaav shemmachal al kevodo kevodo machul
Vehammakke beno gadol menaddin oto shehare hu over al velifne iver lo titten michshol

Mi shennitrefa dato shel aviv o shel immo mishtaddel linhog immahem kefi datam ad sheyerucham alehen veim i efshar lo laamod mippene shennishtattu beoter yenichem veyelech lo vitzave acherim lehanhigam karauy lahem

Hammamzer chayyav bichvod aviv umorao af al pi shehu patur al makkato vekillato ad sheyyaase teshuva afillu haya aviv rasha uvaal averot mechabbedo umityare mimmennu raahu over al divre tora lo yomar lo abba avarta al divre tora ella yomar lo abba katuv battora kach vechach keillu hu shoel mimmennu velo kemazhiro

Mi sheamar lo aviv laavor al divre tora ben sheamar lo laavor al mitzvat lo taase o levattel mitzvat ase afillu shel divrehem hare ze lo yishma lo shenneemar ish immo veaviv tirau veet shabbetotay tishmoru kullechem chayyavin bichvodi

Amar lo aviv hashkeni mayim veyesh beyado laasot mitzva im efshar lammitzva shettease al yede acherim tease veyitassek bichvod aviv sheen mevattelin mitzva mippene mitzva veim en sham acherim laasotah yitassek bammitzva veyaniach kavod aviv shehu veaviv chayyavim bidvar mitzva vetalmud tora gadol mikkevod av vaem
Amar lo aviv hashkeni mayim veamra lo immo hashkeni mayim meniach kevod immo veosek bichvod aviv techilla mippene shehu veimmo chayyavin bichvod aviv

Chayyav adam lechabbed et eshet aviv af al pi sheenah immo kal zeman sheaviv kayyam shezze bichlal kevod aviv vechen mechabbed baal immo kal zeman sheimmo kayyemet aval leachar mitatah eno chayyav umiddivre sofrim sheyyihye adam chayyav bichvod achiv haggadol kichvod aviv
Mishneh Torah, Rebels 7: Ben sorer umore haamur battora hare nitparsha bo sekila velo anash hakkatuv ella im ken hizhir vehechan hizhir lo tochlu al haddam lo tochal achila hammevia lide shefichut damim vezo achilat ben sorer umore sheeno neherag ella al achila mechoeret sheachal shenneemar zolel vesove mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzolel hu haochel basar beraavtanut vesove hashshote yayin beraavtanut

Achila zo shehu chayyav aleha devarim harbe yesh bahem vehen kullan halacha mippi hakkabbala eno chayyav sekila ad sheyyignov mishshel aviv veyikne basar bezol veyayin bezol veyochal veyishte chutz mershut aviv bachavura shekkullan rekanin ufchutin veyochal habbasar chay veeno chay mevushshal veeno mevushshal kederech shehaggannavim ochlim veyishte hayyayin mazug kederech shehaggargeranim shotim vehu sheyyochal mishkal chamishshim dinarin mibbasar ze bimlugma achat veyishte chatzi log miyyayin ze bevat achat ganav mishshel aviv veachal achila zo birshut aviv o shegganav mishshel acherim veachal achila zo hamchoeret ben birshut aviv ben birshut acherim hare ze patur vechen im ganav mishshel aviv veachal achila mechoeret kazo birshut acherim vehayeta achilat mitzva afillu middivrehem o achilat avera afillu middivrehem patur shenneemar enennu shomea beklenu sheeno over baachila zo ella al kolam yatza ze sheavar bah al divre tora o sheachalah bidvar mitzva ketzad achal achila zo hamchoeret im hachavura haraa sheochel immahem bidvar mitzva o sheachalo maaser sheni birushalayim afillu achalo betanchume avelim shehi mitzva middivrehem hare ze patur vechen im achalah minnevelot utrefot shekatzim urmasim afillu achal betaanit tzibbur shehi avera middivrehem hare ze patur min hammita

Achal kal maachal velo achal besar behema af al pi sheachal achila zo mibbesar haof patur veim achal achila zo mibbesar behema vehishlim hachamishshim dinarim mibbesar haof chayyav shata kal mashke velo shata yayin patur

Achal basar chay veshata yayin chay patur shezze keri hu veen adam yachol lehimmashech baze vechen im achal basar maliach bayyom hashshelishi limlichato o shata yayin miggitto patur sheen adam yachol lehimmashech baze

Lo anash hakkatuv katan shello ba lichlal hammitzot vechen ish sheggadal vahare hu birshut atzmo eno niskal mippene shegganav veachal veshata achila zo hamchoeret ha ketzad mippi hashshemua lamdu sheen din ze ella beven shelosh esre shana veom echad shehevi shette searot ad sheyyakkif kal haggid veachar sheyyakkif hassear kal haggid hare hu birshut atzmo veeno niskal

Kal yamav shel ben sorer umore enan ella shelosha chodashim meachar sheyyavi shette searot lefi sheefshar shettitabber ishto veyihye ubbarah nikkar bishlosha chodashim veneemar ki yihye leish ben sorer umore velo av sorer umore ha lamadta sheim hikkif hassear et kal haggid kodem sheyyashlim shelosha chodashim hare ze patur

Mishneh Torah, Testimony 7: Meid karov al ketav kerovo ketzad shetar sheedav reuven veshimon umetu o shehalchu limdinat hayyam uva beno shel reuven veamar ze ketav yado shel avi uva beno shel shimon veamar ze ketav yado shel avi hare ellu kishne edim kesherim sheenan kerovim veim yitztaref immahem shelishi veheid al ketav yadan shel shenehem hare nitkayyem hashshetar

Veellu middevarim shenneemanim haggedolim lehaid begadlam ma sherau bekatnam neeman adam lomar keshehu gadol zehu ketav yado shel avi zehu ketav yado shel rabbi zehu ketav yado shel achi shehayiti makkir bichtav yadam keshehayiti katan vehu sheyyitztaref immo acher shemmakkir ketav yadan keshehu gadol

Shetar sheedav reuven veshimon uvau shenayim veheidu shezze ketav yado shel reuven veze ketav yado shel shimon nitkayyem hashshetar aval im heid ze al ketav yado shel reuven vehashsheni heid al ketav yado shel shimon lo nitkayyem hashshetar lefi shetztzarich shene edim al ketav kal yad echad mishshenehem veim yesh shelishi meid al ketav reuven veshimon keechad nitkayyem

Amar harishon ze ketav yadi veheid hu veacher al ketav yede hashsheni lo nitkayyem lefi shennimtza sheloshet rive hammamon shebbashshetar taluy beedut haechad vechen im heid achiv o beno shel rishon im acher al ketav yede hashsheni lo nitkayyem shehare sheloshet rive hammamon taluy beedut hakkerovim

Shenayim shechatumin al hashshetar umet echad mehen tzarich shene edim lehaid al ketav yado shel met veim lo nimtza ella ed echad im ze haed hachay kotev chatimat yado bifne edim afillu al hacheres umashlicho bevet din ad shettuchzak ketav yado bevet din velo yihye tzarich lomar shezze ketav yado veyaid hu veacher al ketav yede hammet veyitkayyem ketav yado shello befanav

Shelosha sheyyashvu lekayyem et hashshetar shenayim mehen makkirin chatimat yede edim veechad eno makkir ad shello chatmu meidin befanav vechotem shehaedim naasim dayyanim bedavar shehu middivrehem kemo shebbearnu aval achar shechatmu en meidin befanav vechotem shehare beet shechatmu lo hau makkirin ella hashshenayim veen mekayemin ella ad sheyyihu shelashtan makkirin o yaidu haedim al hakketav bifne kal echad veechad

Shenayim shehau chatumin al hashshetar umetu uvau shenayim veamru ketav yadan hu ze aval anusim hau ketannim hau pesule edut hau af al pi sheyyesh sham edim acherim shezze ketav yadan o shehaya ketav yadan yotze mishshetar acher shekkara alav arar vehuchzak bevet din hare ze lo nitkayyem ella meidin hashshenayim shebbashshetar keneged hashshenayim sheheidu alehen shehen pesulin veen govin bo kelum
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 8: Mi shechatam al hashshetar uva lehaid al ketav yado bevet din vehikkir ketav yado shezzehu bevadday aval eno zocher haedut kelal velo yimmatze belibbo zikkaron kelal shezze lava mizze leolam hare ze asur lehaid al ketav yado shehu ze bevet din sheen adam meid al ketav yado shehu ze ella al hammamon shebbashshetar hu meid shezze chayyav laze uchtav yado hu kede lehazkiro haddavar aval im lo nizkar lo yaid

Echad hazzocher et haedut veechad sheraa ketav yado o shehizkiruhu acherim venizkar afillu hizkiro haed hashsheni sheheid im nizkar hare ze meid aval im hizkir oto hattovea atzmo af al pi shennizkar eno meid mippene shezze dome beene baal din keillu heid sheker bedavar shello yada

Lefichach im haya hattovea talmid chacham vehizkir hattovea hazze et haed venizkar hare ze yaid lo shettalmid chacham yodea sheillu lo zachar haddavar lo haya meid vekal hu shehekellu bedine mamonot sheaf al pi sheshshachach haddavar mikkamma shanim vehakketav hu shehizkiro hare ze meid

Hoil vehaddavar ken shetar sheyyatza levet din uvau edim veamru ketav yadenu hu ze aval meolam lo yadanu edut zo veen anu zochrim shezze lava mizze o machar lo lo nitkayyem hashshetar vahare hen kechershim ad sheyyizkeru edutan vechal mi sheeno dan ken lo yada bedine mamonot ben yemino lismolo aval im haya ketav yadan yotze mimmakom acher o shehau sham edim shezze ketav yadan mekayemin et hashshetar veen mashgichin al divrehen sheomrin en anu zochrin edut zo shemma chazru bahen veze sheamru en anu zochrin kede levattel hashshetar uchillu amru ketannim hayinu pesule edut hayinu sheenan neemanim hoil umitkayyem hashshetar shello al pihem umippene taam ze mekayemin kal hashshetarot veen anu tzerichin lehavi edim velishl otam im hem zochrim edut zo o enam zochrim otah sheafillu bau veamru en anu zochrim otah en shomin lahen hoil veefshar lekayemo shello mippihen

Echad hakkotev eduto al hashshetar o shennimtza etzlo katuv befinkaso bichtav yado peloni heid oti alav beom peloni bechach vechach im zachar meatzmo o hizkiruhu acherim venizkar meid veim lav asur lehaid sheen ze dome ella lemi sheamar lo adam neeman peloni yesh lo etzel peloni kach vechach veheid hu sheyyesh laze etzel ze vehu eno yodea min haddavar kelum ella mippi haacher shama veheid
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 9: Asara mine paslut hem kal mi shennimtza bo echad mehen hare hu pasul leedut veellu hen hannashim vehaavadim vehakketannim vehashshotim vehachershim vehassumim veharshaim vehabbezuyin vehakkerovin vehannogin beedutan hare ellu asara
Nashim pesulot leedut min hattora shenneemar al pi shenayim edim lashon zachar velo lashon nekeva

Vechen hattumtum vehaanderoginus pesulin mippene shehen safek ishsha vechal mi shehu safek kasher safek pasul hare hu pasul sheen haed ba ella lehotzi mamon al piv o lechayyev al piv veen motziin mamon missafek veen onshin missafek din tora

Haavadim pesulin leedut min hattora shenneemar vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv mikkelal sheachiv kamohu ma achiv ben berit af haed ben berit kal vachomer leakkum im avadim shehen bemiktzat mitzot pesulin haakkum lo kal shekken
Mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin pasul
Kal mi shennishtachrer vahare hu mechussar get shichrur pasul ad sheyyaggia get leyado veyease mikkelal bene berit veachar kach yaid

Hakketannim pesulin leedut min hattora shenneemar beedim veamdu shene haanashim anashim velo ketannim afillu haya hakkatan navon vechacham hare hu pasul ad sheyyavi shette searot achar shelosh esre shana gemurot veim higgia leesrim shana velo hevi shette searot venolad bo siman missimane serus hare ze saris veyaid veim lo nolad bo lo yaid ad rov shenotav kemo shebbearnu behilchot ishut

Katan shehiggia lichlal shenotav shenniru bo simane bagrut millemala eno tzarich bedika veim lav en mekabbelin eduto ad sheyyibbadek uven shelosh esre shana veom echad shehevi shette searot veeno yodea betiv massa umattan en eduto edut bekarkaot mippene sheeno medakdek bidvarim shehare eno yodea aval beedut mittaltelin mekabbelin eduto hoil vehu gadol

Hashshote pasul leedut min hattora lefi sheeno ben mitzot velo shote shehu mehallech arom umshabber kelim vezorek avanim bilvad ella kal mi shennitrefa dato venimtzet dato meshubbeshet tamid bedavar min haddevarim af al pi shehu medabber veshoel kainyan bishar devarim hare ze pasul uvichlal shotim yechashev hannichpe beet kefiyyato pasul uvet shehu bari kasher veechad hannichpe mizzeman lizman o hannichpe tamid belo et kavua vehu shello tihye dato meshubbeshet tamid shehare yesh sham nichpim sheggam beet beriutam datam mittarefet alehem vetzarich lehityashshev beedut hannichpin harbe

Happetaim beoter sheen makkirin devarim shessotrin ze et ze velo yavinu inyene haddavar kederech shemmevinin shear am haaretz vechen hamvohalim vehannechpazim bedatam vehammishtaggeim beoter hare ellu bichlal hashshotim vedavar ze lefi ma sheyyire haddayyan shei efshar lechaven haddaat bichtav

Hacheresh keshote sheen dato nechona veeno ben mitzot veechad cheresh medabber veeno shomea o shomea veeno medabber af al pi sheriyyato reiyya meulla vedato nechona tzarich lehaid bevet din befiv o sheyyihye rauy lehaid befiv veyihye rauy lishmoa haddayyanim vehaiyyum shemmeayemin alav vechen im nishtattek af al pi shennivdak bederech shebbodkin leinyan gittin venimtzet eduto mechuvenet veheid befanenu bichtav yado enah edut kelal chutz meedut ishsha lefi shebbeiggunah hekellu
Hassumim af al pi shemmakkirin hakkol veyadu haanashim hare ellu pesulin min hattora shenneemar vehu ed o raa mi shehu rauy lirot hu shemmeid vehassuma beachat meenav kasher lehaid
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 10: Harshaim pesulin leedut min hattora shenneemar al tashet yadcha im rasha lihyot ed chamas mippi hashshemua lamdu al tashet rasha ed vaafillu ed kasher sheyyodea bachavero shehu rasha veen haddayyanim makkirin risho asur lo lehaid immo af al pi shehu edut emet mippene shemmitztaref immo venimtza ze hakkasher heshit yado im harasha ad shennitkabbela eduto veen tzarich lomar ed kasher shehu yodea beedut lachavero veyada shehaed hashsheni immo ed sheker sheasur lo lehaid shenneemar al tashet yadcha im rasha

E zehu rasha kal sheavar avera shechayyavin aleha malkot zehu rasha ufasul shehare hattora kara lamchuyyav malkot rasha shenneemar vehaya im bin hakkot harasha veen tzarich lomar mechuyyav mitat bet din shehu pasul shenneemar asher hu rasha lamut

Avar avera shechayyavin aleha malkot min hattora hare ze pasul min hattora veim haya hachiyyuv shebbah middivrehem hare ze pasul middivrehem ketzad achal besar behema bechalav o sheachal nevelot ushkatzim vechayyotze bahen ben leteavon ben lehachis o shechillel et yom tov harishon o shellavash shaatnez shehu shua o tauy o nuz hare ze pasul leedut min hattora aval im achal besar of bechalav o shechillel yom tov sheni shel galuyyot o shellavash beged tzemer sheavad bo chut shel pishtan vechayyotze bo hare hu pasul middivrehem uchvar maninu kal avera shechayyavin aleha malkot uchvar nitbaer bechal mitzva umitzva devarim sheasurim min hattora udvarim sheasurin middivrehem

Veod yesh sham reshaim shehen pesulin leedut af al pi shehen bene tashlumin veenan bene malkot hoil velokchim mamon sheeno shellahem bechamas pesulin shenneemar ki yakum ed chamas beish kegon haggannavim vehachamsanim af al pi shehechzir pasul leedut meet shegganav o gazal vechen ed zomem af al pi shehuzam beedut mamon veshillem hare ze pasul min hattora lechal edut umeematay hu nifsal meet sheheid bevet din af al pi shello huzam al otah edut ella achar kamma yamim vechen hammalve beribbit echad hammalve veechad hallo shenehem pesulin leedut im ribbit ketzutza asu hare hen pesulin min hattora veim avak ribbit asu hare hen pesulin middivrehem vechen kal haover al gezel shel divrehem hare hu pasul middivrehem ketzad hachamsanim vehem hallokchim karka o mittaltelin shello birtzon habbealim af al pi shennotnin haddamim hare ellu pesulin middivrehem vechen haroim echad roe behema dakka veechad roe behema gassa shel atzman hare hen pesulin shechezkatan poshtin yedehen begezel umnichim behemtan lirot besadot ufardesim shel acherim ulfichach setam roe pasul umgaddele behema dakka beeretz yisrael pesulin aval bechutza laaretz kesherin umuttar legaddel behema gassa bechal makom vechen hammochsin setaman pesulin mippene shechezkatan likkach yoter middavar hakkatzuv lahem bedin hammalchut velokchin hetter leatzman aval gabbae menat hammelech setaman kesherin veim noda shellakchu afillu paam achat yeter min harauy lahem ligbot hare ellu pesulin vechen mafriche yonim bayyishshuv pesulin mippene shechezkatan sheggozlim yonim shel acherim bechinnam vechen sochare sheviit vehem bene adam sheyyoshvin betelim vechevan shebbaa sheviit poshtim yedehen umatchilin lissa velitten beferot shechezkat ellu shehen osfin perot sheviit veosin bahen sechora vechen mesachek bekubbiyya vehu shello tihye lo ummanut ella hu hoil veeno osek beyishshuvo shel olam hare ze bechezkat sheochel min hakkubbiyya shehu avak gezel velo bekubbiyya bilvad ella afillu mesachakim biklippe egozim uklippe rimmonim vechen lo yonim bilvad amru ella afillu hamsachakim bivhema chayya veof veomer kal hakkodem et chavero o kal hannotzeach et chavero yittol bealav et shenehen vechen kal kayyotze bischok ze vehu shello tihye lo ummanut ella sechok ze hare hu pasul vechal ellu pesulin middivrehem

Aris shellakach davar muat min happerot shebbikkeru bime nisan vime tishre kodem shettiggamer melachtan af al pi shellakach shello middaat baal hassade eno gannav vechasher leedut sheen baal hassade makpid alav vechen kal kayyotze baze
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 11: Mi sheeno lo bemikra velo bemishna velo bederech eretz hare ze bechezkat rasha ufasul leedut middivrehem shekkal mi sheyyarad ad kach chazaka shehu over al rov haaverot sheyyavou leyado

Lefichach en mosrin edut leam haaretz veen mekabbelin mimmennu edut ella im ken huchzak shehu osek bemitzot uvigmilut chasadim venoheg bedarche hayesharim veyesh bo derech eretz mekabbelin eduto af al pi shehu am haaretz veeno lo bemikra velo bemishna
Nimtzeta omer kal talmid chacham bechezkat kasher ad sheyyippasel kal am haaretz bechezkat shehu pasul ad sheyyuchzak shehu holech bedarche hayesharim

Vechal mi sheyekabbel edut am haaretz terem shettihye lo chazaka zo o kodem sheyyavou edim veyaidu shehu noheg bemitzot uvderech eretz hare ze hedot veatid litten et haddin shehare meabbed mamonan shel yisrael al pi reshaim

Vechen habbezuyin pesulin leedut middivrehem vehem haanashim sheholchin veochlin bashshuk bifne kal haam uchgon ellu sheholchin arumim bashshuk beet shehen oskin bimlacha menuvelet vechayyotze beellu sheen makpidin al habboshet shekkal ellu chashuvin kechelev veen makpidin al edut sheker umikkelal ellu haochlin tzedaka shel akkum befarhesya af al pi sheefshar lahen sheyyizzonu betzina mevazzim atzman veenan choshshin kal ellu pesulin middivrehem

Ma ben pasul leedut min hattora lefasul middivrehem shehappasul min hattora sheheid eduto betela af al pi shello hichrizu alav bevatte kenesiyyot uvvatte midrashot vehappasul middivrehem tzarich hachraza lefichach kal edut sheheid kodem shehichrizu alav mekabbelin ota kede shello leabbed zechut haam shehare lo yadu shehu pasul veen pesulo ella middivrehem

Ed echad neeman beissurin af al pi shehu pasul lishar eduot shehare rasha baavera sheshshachat shechitato keshera veneeman lomar kahalacha shachatti aval hechashud al davar eno neeman al shello aval neeman hu al acherim

Lefichach hechashud al davar yesh lo ladun bo ulhaid bo laacherim chazaka en adam chote kede sheyyehanu acherim ketzad neeman am haaretz lomar perot peloni metukkanim hem veneeman hannechshad limkor besar bechor lomar basar ze shemmocher peloni chullin hu vechen kal kayyotze baze mishshear haissurin lefi sheemat haissurim al harshaim veen emat hammamon alehen
Malche yisrael lo meidin velo meidin alehen mippene shehen allamim baale zeroa veenan nichnain tachat ol haddayyanim aval kohen gadol meidin alav umeid hu lammelech bevet din haggadol kemo shebbearnu

Hammosrin vehaeppikorosin vehammumarim lo hitzrichu chachamim limnotan bichlal pesule edut shello manu ella rishe yisrael aval ellu hammordin hakkofrin pechutin hen min haakkum shehaakkum lo maalin velo moridin veyesh lachasidehen chelek laolam habba veellu moridin velo maalin veen lahen chelek laolam habba
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 12: Kal hannifsal baavera im heidu alav shene edim sheasa avera pelonit af al pi shello hitru bo shehare eno loke hare ze pasul leedut bamme devarim amurim kesheavar al devarim sheppashat beyisrael shehen avera kegon shennishba lashsheker o lashshave o gazal o ganav o achal nevela vechayyotze bo aval im rauhu edim over al davar shekkarov haose lihot shogeg tzerichin lehazhiro veachar kach yippasel ketzad rauhu kosher o mattir beshabbat tzerichin lehodio shezze chillul shabbat mippene sherov haam enan yodin ze vechen im rauhu ose melacha beshabbat o bayyom tov tzerichin lehodio shehayyom shabbat shemma shocheach hu vechen hamsachek bekubbiyya tamid o mi shennaasa moches o gabbay shemmosif leatzmo tzerichin haedim lehodio shehaose davar ze pasul leedut sherov haam enan yodim devarim ellu vechen kal kayyotze baze kelalo shel davar kal avera shehaddevarim marim laedim shezze yada shehu rasha veavar bezadon af al pi shello hitru bo hare ze pasul leedut veeno loke

En adam nifsal baavera al pi atzmo ketzad hare shebba levet din veamar shegganav o gazal o hilva beribbit af al pi shemmeshallem al pi atzmo eno nifsal vechen im amar sheachal nevela o baal asura eno nifsal ad sheyyihu sham shene edim sheen adam mesim et atzmo rasha lefichach reuven sheheid alav shimon shehilva beribbit veheid levi veamar li hilva beribbit hare reuven nifsal beedut shimon velevi af al pi shehare hoda levi shellava beribbit eno mesim atzmo rasha veneeman al reuven veeno neeman al atzmo vechen mi sheheid sheppeloni revao ben beanso shel nirba ben birtzono hu veacher mitztarfin lehargo peloni ba al ishti hu veacher mitztarfin lehargo aval lo lehargah vechen kal kayyotze baze peloni rava et shori hu veacher mitztarfin lehargo sheen adam karov etzel mamono

Shenayim sheheidu al echad shehu pasul baavera meellu haaverot uvau shenayim veheidu sheasa teshuva vechazar bo o shellaka hare ze kasher aval im bau shenayim vehichchishum veamru lo asa avera zo velo nifsal hare ze safek pasul lefichach lo yaid veen motziin mamon beeduto velo yadun ad sheyyivada sheasa teshuva

Kal mi shennitchayyev malkot ben sheasa teshuva ben shellaka bevet din chozer lechashruto aval shear pesule edut shehen pesulin mishshum mamon shechamsu o sheggazlu af al pi sheshshillemu tzerichin teshuva vahare hen pesulin ad sheyyivada shechazru bahen middarkan hara
Meematay chazarat malvim beribbit mishsheyyikreu shitrotehen meatzman veyachzeru bahen chazara gemura shello yalu beribbit afillu leakkum
Meematay chazarat hamsachakin bekubbiyya mishsheyyishberu et pasifsehem veyachzeru bahen chazara gemura shello yaasu afillu bechinnam
Meematay chazarat mafriche yonim mishsheyyishberu et hakkelim shetztzadin bahen veyachzeru bahen chazara gemura sheafillu bammidbar lo yaasu

Meematay chazarat sochare sheviit mishshettaggia sheviit veyibbadku velo chazarat devarim bilvad ella kotev ani peloni ben peloni kanasti matayim zuz mipperot sheviit vahare hem netunim bemattana laaniyyim

Meematay chazarat hammoel bishvua mishsheyyavo levet din sheen makkirin oto veyomar lahem chashud ani o yitchayyev shevua bevet din sheen makkirin oto bemamon chashuv yeshallem velo yirtze lehishshava vechen tabbach shehaya bodek leatzmo umocher veyatzat terefa mittachat yado shehare hu bichlal ochle terefa shehen pesulin leedut hare ze pasul leedut ad sheyyerae mimmaasav shennicham al raato veyilbash shechorim vichasse shechorim veyelech lemakom sheen makkirin oto veyachzir aveda bemamon chashuv o yotzi terefa mittachat yado bedavar chashuv
Vechen ed zomem shehalach lemakom sheen makkirin oto venatnu lo mamon chashuv lehaid besheker velo ratza hare ze asa teshuva vechazar lechashruto vechen kal kayyotze baze
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 13: Hakkerovim pesulim leedut min hattora shenneemar lo yumtu avot al banim mippi hashshemua lamdu shebbichlal lav ze shello yumtu avot al pi banim velo banim al pi avot vehu haddin lishar kerovim en pesulin middin tora ella kerovim mimmishpachat av bilvad vehem haav im habben veim ben habben vehaachin min haav ze im ze uvnehen ze im ze veen tzarich lomar haddodim im ben achiv aval shear hakkerovim min haem o midderech haishut kullan pesulin middivrehem
Haggerim enan bedin hakkerovim afillu shene achim teomim shennitgayeru meidin ze laze shehagger shennitgayyer kekatan shennolad hu chashuv
Haachim ze im ze ben min haem ben min haav hare hen rishon berishon uvnehem ze im ze sheni besheni uvne benehem ze im ze shelishi bishlishi
Ulolam shelishi berishon kasher veen tzarich lomar shelishi besheni aval sheni besheni veen tzarich lomar sheni berishon shenehem pesulim

Haav im beno kerishon berishon hu lefichach haav im ben beno pasul veim ben ben beno shehu revii mimmennu kasher mippene shehu shelishi berishon vechen hadderech binkevot ketzad shette achaot o ach vaachoto ben min haav ben min haem hare hem rishon berishon benehem ben zecharim ben nekevot sheni besheni bene benehem o benot benotehen shelishi bishlishi kederech sheatta mone bizcharim rishon sheni ushlishi kach atta mone binkevot
Kal ishsha sheatta pasul lah kach atta pasul levalah shehabbaal keishto vechal baal sheatta pasul lo kach atta pasul leishto shehaishsha kevalah
Kal shette nashim shehen zo im zo sheni besheni balehen meidin ze laze aval im haya rishon berishon kegon shellakach ze ishsha veze bittah en meidin ze laze
Vechen bale achaot pesulin ze laze vahare hen rishon berishon
Vechen lo yaid leven achot ishto velo levaal bat achot ishto aval meid hu leven baal achot ishto sheyyesh lo meishsha acheret

Kal ish sheen atta meid lo mippene shehu baal kerovatcha hare atta meid lishar kerovav kegon beno veachiv vechen kal ishsha sheen atta meid lah mippene shehi eshet kerovcha hare atta meid lishar keroveha
Avi kalla vaavi chatan meidim ze laze

Ache haach min haem meidin ze laze shehare en benehen kurva kelal ketzad rachel shennisset leosef veyalda mimmenna reuven vehaya leosef ben meishsha acheret vehu menashshe umet yosef venisset leshimon veyalda mimmennu yehuda hare menashshe vihuda meidin ze laze
Haish im ishto rishon berishon lefichach eno meid lo livnah velo leeshet benah velo levittah velo levaal bittah velo leaviha velo leimmah velo levaal immah velo leeshet aviha

Ishto arusa af al pi shello nigmera haishut hare hi kinsua leinyan edut bamme devarim amurim baarusato atzmah sheeno meid lah aval im heid likrove arusato kegon baal achotah o benah uvittah vechayyotze bahen en poslin otah ad sheyyissaenna

Ze sheppasla tora edut hakkerovim lo mippene shehen bechezkat ohavin ze et ze shehare eno meid lo lo letovato velo leraato ella gezerat hakkatuv hu lefichach haohev vehassone kasher leedut af al pi shehu pasul ledayyanut shello gazra tora ella al hakkerovim
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 14: Kal mi sheen atta meod lo mippene shehu baal kerovatcha im meta ishto af al pi shehinnicha lo banim hare ze nitrachek vechasher

Mi shehaya yodea lachavero edut ad shello naasa chatano venaasa chatano o sheyyada haedut vehu pikkeach veachar kach nitcharesh patuach venistamme af al pi sheyyachol lechaven middat hakkarka shehu meid bah umsayyem metzareha shafuy venishtatta hare ze pasul aval im haya yodea lo edut ad shello naasa chatano venaasa chatano umeta bitto pikkeach venitcharesh vechazar venitpakkeach shafuy venishtatta vechazar venishtappa patuach venistamme vechazar venitpatteach kasher ze hakkelal kal shettechillato vesofo bechashrut af al pi shennifsal bentayim kasher techillato befaslut af al pi shessofo bechashrut pasul lefichach mi shehaya yodea beedut vehu katan uva veheid bah keshehu gadol enah kelum

Veyesh devarim shessomchin bahen al edut shemmeid keshehu gadol hoil vehem devarim shel divrehem veellu hen haddevarim sheadam neeman lehaid begadlo al ma sheraa bekatno neeman adam lomar ze ketav yado shel avi o shel rabbi o shel achi mippene shekkiyyum shetarot middivrehem zachur ani biflonit shennisset venaasa lah minhag habbetulot hoil verov nashim betulot nissaot uchtubba middivrehem shehammakom hazze bet happeras mippene shettumato middivrehem vead kan hayinu bain beshabbat shetztzimtzum hattechum ad alpayim amma bilvad middivrehem shehaya ish peloni yotze mibbet hassefer litbol veleechol bitrumato laerev veshehaya cholek immanu teruma veshehayinu molichim challa umattanot lifloni kohen al yede atzmo veamar li abba mishpacha zo keshera mishpacha zo pesula veachalnu bakotzatza shel peloni sheheechiluni echav kede lehodia sheachihem peloni nasa ishsha sheenah hogenet lo shekkal ellu haddevarim lehachazik ze hakkohen leechol bitruma shel divrehem o lidchoto mimmenna
Kal ellu shemmeid bahen haggadol bema sheyyada keshehaya katan im haya akkum o eved kesheraa devarim ellu veheid achar shennitgayyer venishtachrer eno neeman

Mi shehaya yodea lachavero beedut ad shello naasa gazlan venaasa gazlan hu eno meid al ketav yado aval im huchzak ketav yado shebbishtar ze bevet din kodem sheyyease gazlan hare ze shetar kasher vechen im naasa chatano hu eno meid al ketav yado aval acherim meidin af al pi shello huchzak bevet din ella achar shennaasa chatano hare ze kasher sheeno dome happasul baavera lefasul bikriva shehappasul baavera chashud lezayyef
Shetar sheyyesh bo shene edim bilvad ushnehem kerovim ze laze o echad mishshenehem pasul baavera af al pi shemmasar lo hashshetar bifne edim kesherim hare hu kecheres mippene shehu mezuyyaf mittocho

Hakkotev kal nechasav lishne bene adam beedut achat vehaedim kerovim leechad mimmekabbele hammattana urchokim min hashsheni hare hashshetar pasul mippene shehu edut achat aval im katav bishtar echad shennatatti liruven chatzer pelonit veshennatatti leshimon sade pelonit nimtzeu haedim kerovim laze urchokim mizze ze shehem rechokim mimmennu mattenato kayyemet sheellu shette eduot af al pi shehen bishtar echad lema ze dome leomer heu alay edim shennatatti liruven kach vechach veshennatatti leshimon kach vechach veshellaviti millevi kach vechach sheaf al pi shekkatav bishtar echad vehammakne ish echad hare ellu shalosh eduyyot sheenan teluot zo bazo
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 15: Kal edut shettavo hanaa leadam mimmenna eno meid bah shezze hu kemeid al atzmo lefichach bene hair shebba mearer learer alehem bammerchatz o birchov shel ir en echad mibbaale hair meid bedavar ze velo dan ad sheyesallek atzmo bekinyan gamur veachar kach yaid o yadin
Bene hair shennignav sefer tora shellahen hoil velishmia hu asuy shei efshar leadam lesallek atzmo mimmennu en danin bedayyane otah hair veen meviin reaya meanshe otah hair vechen kal kayyotze baze

Haomer tenu mane laaniyye iri en danin bedayyane otah hair veen meviin reaya meanshe otah hair bamme devarim amurim keshehau haaniyyim semuchim alehem ufoskin alehen tzedaka afillu amru shenayim meanshe otah hair anu nitten davar hakkatzuv alenu venaid en shomin lahem shehanaa hu lahem sheyyitashsheru aniyyim ellu hoil vehen semuchin al bene hair vechen kal kayyotze baze

Karka shebben shene shuttafin shebba mearer lehotziah mittachat yad hashuttaf eno meid leshuttafo aleha ella im sillek atzmo mimmenna vekanu miyyado shennetanah lashshuttaf vesheim ba baal chov shello utrafah miyyad hashuttaf meshallem lo dameha veachar kach meid lo aleha vechen kal kayyotze baze

Haorer al hassade im yesh bah perot en haaris meid lo aleha shehare rotze haaris lehaamidah beyad bealeha kede sheyyittol chelko bapperot veim en bah perot meid aval hassocher im lakach hassechirut beyado veamar kal mi shettitkayyem sade zo beyado yittol hare ze meid veim kevar natan hassechirut levaal hassade eno meid kevan sheim tetze hassade lamarer chayyav litten lo sechar kal hashshanim sheyyashav bah eno meid vechen kal kayyotze baze

Shimon shellava vehaya reuven arev uva yehuda learer al shimon hallo vehotzi karka mittachat yado im yesh leshimon sade acheret keneged hachov hare reuven hearev yesh lo lehaid al oto karka shehi shel shimon sheen lo hanaa baze sheim lekachah yehuda hare sade acheret sheyyippara mimmenna baal chovo vechen lokeach rishon meid lelokeach sheni shellakach acharav shezze hassade shello vehu sheyyesh lammocher sade ben chorin keneged deme sade shel lokeach rishon sheen lelokeach rishon hanaa baamidat ze hassade beyad lokeach sheni sheafillu nitraf lokeach harishon al hammocher hu chozer vahare yesh lo sade acheret sheyyigbe mimmenna
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 16: Reuven sheggazal sade o tallit mishshimon uva yehuda veirer al reuven veamar sade zo o tallit zo shelli hi en shimon yachol lehaid liruven sheen zo hassade shel yehuda velo zo hattallit shel yehuda shehare shimon rotze lehaamid sade zo o tallit zo beyad reuven shehu gezalah mimmennu kede sheyyachzeru lo miyyad haggazlan shehare efshar shettihye haraya shel shimon shemmotzi bah miyyad reuven efshar sheeno yachol lehotzi bah miyyad yehuda vechen im machar reuven hassade haggezula o horishah lelevi uva yehuda learer al levi en shimon meid sheenah shel yehuda shemma nachat ruach yesh lo lehotziah miyyad levi

Machar hattallit haggezula lelevi uva yehuda learer im met reuven shimon meid aleha sheenah shel yehuda shehare en tallit zo chozeret leshimon leolam shekkevar kenaah hallokeach beyeush veshinnuy reshut uchvar met reuven haggazlan veen lo mimmi yittol dameha aval im adayin reuven kayyam en shimon meid af al hattallit shehanaa hi lo shello taamod beyad yehuda kede sheyyavi reaya sheruven gezalah vishallem dameha vechen im hayeta hattallit beyad yorshe reuven en shimon meid aleha mippene shessofah sheim taamod beyad hayyoresh lachzor lo vechen kal kayyotze baze

Reuven shemmachar sade leshimon shello beacharaut uva yehuda learer al shimon ulhotziah mittachat yado en reuven meid lo aleha af al pi sheen aleha acharaut hare hu rotze shettaamod beyad shimon kede sheyyavo baal chov shel reuven veyitrefenna bechovo velo yihye lo rasha velo yeshallem

Reuven shemmachar para o tallit leshimon uva yehuda learer ulhotzi miyyad shimon reuven meid lo aleha shehi shel shimon sheafillu amda beyad shimon en baal chovo shel reuven toref min hammittaltelin vaafillu hau appoteke bamme devarim amurim keshehaya shimon mode shezzo happara vehattallit hem shel reuven hammocher bevadday vehu yodea shebbeemet hen shello aval im lo hoda shimon en reuven meid leabbed zechut yehuda sheim tetze mittachat yede shimon yachzor shimon veyitba damim veyomar lo macharta li davar sheeno shellecha shehare bau edim veamru shehen shel yehuda bamme devarim amurim sheyyaid reuven leabbed zechut yehuda veyaamid hammittaltelin beyad shimon keshebbau edim veheidu shehem yodim sheruven ze lo hayeta lo karka meolam aval im lo bau edim lechach af al happara vehattallit eno meid velamma eno meid alehen shemma hikna otam levaal chovo aggav karka vechatav deikne vehikna lo mittaltelin aggav karka shennimtza baal chovo toref af happara vehattallit lefichach lo yaid alehen shehare rotze lehaamidan beyad shimon kede sheyyavo baal chovo veyitrefem vechen kal kayyotze bidvarim ellu udvarim ellu enan teluyin ella bedaat haddayyan veotzem binato sheyyavin ikkar hammishpatim veyeda davar haggorem ledavar acher veyaamik lirot im yimmatze sheyyesh leze haed tzad hanaa beedut zo afillu bederech rechoka veniflaa hare ze lo yaid bah uchderech shello yaid bedavar ze shemma nogea beeduto hu kach lo yadun beoto davar vechen shear mine pesulin keshem shepposlin beedim kach poslin bedayyanim

Ulfichach en somchin besanhedrin shenayim hakkerovim ze laze ben besanhedri ketanna ben besanhedri gedola aval ellu shemmosifin ad shiva leabber hashshana kemo shebbearnu behilchot kiddush hachodesh yerae li sheim haya bahen kerovim en bechach kelum

Kal hakkasher ladun kasher lehaid veyesh kasher lehaid veeno kasher ladun haohev vehassone vehagger vehamshuchrar vechen hazzaken vehassaris vehammamzer vesuma beachat meenav kesherin lehaid veenan kesherim ladun dine nefashot kemo shebbearnu
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 17: Mi sheheidu lo anashim rabbim ugdolim bechachma uvyira shehem omrim sherau peloni sheavar avera pelonit o shellava mippeloni af al pi shehu maamin haddavar belibbo keillu raahu lo yaid ad sheyyire haddavar beenav o yode lo hallo mippiv veyomar lo heye alay ed sheppeloni hilva li mane shenneemar vehu ed o raa o yada veen lecha edut shemmitkayyemet biriyya o bidia ella edut mamon vechal hammeid mippi acherim hare ze ed sheker veover belo taase shenneemar lo taane vereacha ed shaker

Lefichach meayemin af al ede hammamon vechetzad meayemin alehen meayemin alehem bifne hakkol umodiin otan koach edut sheker uvoshet hammeid bah baolam hazze uvaolam habba veachar kach motziin et kal haadam lachutz umshayerin et haggadol shebbaedim veomer lo emor heach atta yodea shezze chayyav laze im amar shehu amar li chayyav ani lo o ish peloni amar li shehu chayyav lo lo amar kelum ad sheyyomar befanenu hoda lo shehu chayyav lo vehau machnisin et haed hashsheni uvodkin oto kach nimtzeu divrehen mechuvanin nosin venotnin baddavar vegomrin haddin

Hammatmin edim lachavero vehoda lo beno leven atzmo vehaedim roin veshomin shehu omer lo vadday yesh lecha etzli kach vechach aval mityare ani shemma techufeni bedin lemachar hare zo enah edut ad sheyyode bifne edim

Echad hammode bifne edim veamar derech hodaa ze yesh lo etzli kach vechach o sheamar attem eday o sheamar heu alay edim ben sheamar hallo ben sheamar hammalve veshatak hallo derech maamin lidvarav hare ellu edim veen tzarich lomar im kanu miyyado o sheamar lahem kitvu alay shetar sheyyesh laze etzli kach vechach vechal kayyotze bidvarim ellu hare hem hodaa umidin al piv
Talmid sheamar lo rabbo yodea atta sheim notnin li kal mamon haolam eni meshakker mane yesh li etzel peloni veyesh li alav ed echad lech vehitztaref immo im nitztaref hare ze ed sheker

Amar lo bo vaamod im haed velo taid kede sheyyire hallo vifached veyaale al dato sheattem shene edim veode meatzmo hare ze asur laamod ulharot shehu ed af al pi sheeno meid veal ze vechayyotze bo neemar middevar sheker tirchak
Hassocher ede sheker lehaid lachavero patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim vechen ed echad shekkavash eduto velo heid patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 18: Mi sheheid besheker venoda beedim sheheid besheker zehu shennikra ed zomem umitzvat ase laasot lo kema sheratza laasot beeduto lachavero im baavera shechayyavin aleha sekila heidu vehuzmu niskalin kullan veim bisrefa nisrafin vechen shear hammitot veim heidu bemalkot loke kal echad mehen kishar mechuyeve malkot veomdin kocho umalkin oto veim heidu lechayevo mamon meshalleshin hammamon benehen lefi minyan haedim kal echad veechad yitten chelek hammaggia lo veen lokin bimkom tashlumin

Bamme devarim amurim beedim shehuzmu aval shette kittot hammachchishot zo et zo veen kan edut en onshin et achat mehen lefi sheen anu yodim mi hi hakkat hashshakranit uma ben hachchasha lahazama hahachchasha baedut atzmah zot omeret haya haddavar hazze vezot omeret lo haya haddavar hazze o yavo mikkelal devareha shello haya vehahazama baedim atzman veellu haedim shehezimum enan yodim im nihya haddavar o lo haya ketzad edim shebbau veamru rainu ze sheharag et hannefesh o lava mane mippeloni beom peloni bemakom peloni veachar sheheidu venivdeku bau shenayim acherim veamru beom ze uvmakom ze hayinu immachem veim ellu kal hayyom velo hau devarim meolam lo ze harag et ze velo ze hilva et ze hare zo hachchasha vechen im amru lahem heach attem meidim kach veze hahoreg o hanneherag o hallo o hammalve haya immanu beom ze bimdina acheret hare zo edut muchcheshet shezze kemi sheamar lo harag ze et ze velo ze hilva et ze shehare immanu hau velo nihya davar ze vechen kal kayyotze bidvarim ellu aval im amru lahem anu en anu yodim im ze harag ze beom ze birushalayim kemo sheattem omrin o lo harago veanu meidim sheattem atzmechem heyitem immanu beom ze bevavel hare ellu zommim veneheragin o meshallemin hoil vehaedim shehezimum lo hishgichu al atzmah shel edut kelal im emet haya o sheker

Veze sheheemina tora edut haacharonim al haedim harishonim gezerat hakkatuv hi afillu hau haedim harishonim mea uvau shenayim vehezimum veamru lahem anu meidim sheattem hammea kullechem immanu heyitem beom peloni bemakom peloni hare ellu neenashin al pihem shehashshenayim kemea umea kishnayim vechen bishte kitte edim hammachchishot zo et zo en holchin achar harov ella dochin et shettehen
Edim zommin enan tzerichin hatraa veedim shehuchchashu ulvassof huzammu hare ellu neheragin o lokin o meshallemin mippene shehachchasha techillat hazama hi ella sheadayin lo nigmera

En mezimin et haedim ella bifnehem umachchishin et haedim shello bifnehem veedim shehuzammu shello bifnehen hare huchchashu lefichach im metu haedim shehezimum kodem sheyyazimu otam bifnehem en kan edut shehare hichchishu ze et ze

Ede nefashot shehuchchashu velo huzammu afillu ba hanneherag beraglav enam lokin mippene shehu lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din veen lokin alav aval bet din makkin otan makkat mardut kefi ma sheyyiru

Edim zommim tzerichin hachraza veheach hi hahachraza shellahen kotvin vesholchin bechal ir veir peloni ufloni heidu bechach vechach vehuzammu vaharagnum o laku befanenu o anashnu otan kach vechach dinarin shenneemar vehannisharim yishmeu veyirau

Chiyyuv haedim zommim leshallem bemakom shechayyavin leshallem kenas hu ulfichach en meshallemin al pi atzman ketzad hare sheheidu venechkera edutan bevet din veachar kach amru shenehem edut sheker headnu veen laze etzel ze kelum o sheamarnu headnu al ze bechach vechach vehuzamnu en meshallemin al pihen aval im amru headnu al ze vehuzamnu bevet dino shel peloni venitchayyavnu litten lo kach vechach hare ellu meshallemin shezzo hodaa bemamon shennigmar dino litteno veim amar haechad kach meshallem chelko
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 19: Shennayim sheheidu veamru bemizrach habbira harag ze et hannefesh beshaa pelonit uvau shenayim veamru lahen bemaarav habbira hazzot heyitem immanu baet hazzot im yachol haomed bemaarav lirot ma shebbammizrach enan zommin veim eno yachol lirot hare ellu zommin veen omrin shemma meor enehem shel rishonim rav veroin merachok yeter mikkal adam vechen im heidu shenayim veamru babboker harag ze et hannefesh birushalayim uvau shenayim veamru lahen beom ze baerev heyitem immanu belud im yachol adam lehallech afillu al hassus mirushalayim lelud mibboker ad erev enan zommin veim lav hare ellu zommin veen omrin shemma kar kal beoter nizdammen lahen vekippelu et hadderech ella bedavar hammatzuy hayyadua lakkol meshaarin leolam umzimin otan

Shenayim sheamru beechad beshabbat harag ze et hannefesh bemakom peloni uvau shenayim veamru beom ze immanu heyitem bemakom acher rachok aval bayyom shelleachar yom ze harago bevadday afillu heidu haacharonim shekkodem kamma yamim harago hare ze hahoreg im edav harishonim neheragin shehare huzmu shebbeet sheheidu sheharag adayin lo nigmar dino lehareg aval bau shene edim bishlishi beshabbat veamru beechad beshabbat nigmar dino shel peloni lahariga uvau shenayim veamru beechad beshabbat immanu heyitem bemakom peloni harachok ella meerev shabbat o besheni beshabbat nigmar dino en edim ellu shehuzammu neheragin shehare mikkal makom beet sheheidu alav kevar nigmar dino lahariga vechen leinyan tashlume kenas ketzad bau shenayim bishlishi beshabbat veamru beechad beshabbat ganav vetavach venigmar dino uvau shenayim veamru beechad beshabbat immanu heyitem bemakom rachok aval beerev shabbat nigmar dino afillu amru beechad beshabbat ganav vetavach umachar uvsheni beshabbat nigmar dino en edim ellu shehuzammu meshallemin shehare mikkal makom beet sheheidu alav chayyav haya leshallem vechen kal kayyotze baze

En ede hashshetar naasin zommin ad sheyyomru bevet din shetar ze bizmanno ketavnuhu velo icharnuhu aval im lo amru ken af al pi shezzemanno shel shetar beechad benisan birushalayim uvau edim veheidu sheede hashshetar hau immahem bevavel beom ze hashshetar kasher vehaedim kesherim sheefshar shekketavuhu veicharuhu uchshehau birushalayim beechad baadar katvu shetar ze sham veicharu zemanno vechatvu zemanno benisan amru bizmanno ketavnuhu vehuzammu im yesh sham edim sheyyodim hayyom shechatmu al hashshetar o edim sherau ze hashshetar vachatimat yadam bo beom peloni kevan shehuzammu hare nifselu lemafrea miyyom shennoda shechatmu al hashshetar shehaedim hachatumim al hashshetar hare hen kemi shennechkera edutan bevet din beet hachatima aval im en edim sherau edutan velo rau hashshetar mikkodem en nifsalin ella meet sheheidu bevet din shezze ketav yadan veamru bizmanno ketavnuhu veefshar shebbeom ze sheheidu bevet din bo bayyom chatmu al hashshetar sheyyesh lo kamma shanim vehem shikkeru veamru bizmanno katavnu
Mishneh Torah, Testimony 20: En edim zommin neheragin velo lokin velo meshallemin ad sheyyihu shenehem reuyin leedut veyizzomu shenehem achar shennigmar haddin aval im huzam echad mehen bilvad o shehuzammu shenehem kodem gemar din o achar gemar din venimtza echad mehen karov o pasul en neenashin af al pi shehuzammu venifselu lechal edut shebbattora

Neherag ze sheheidu alav veachar kach huzammu enan neheragin min haddin shenneemar kaasher zamam laasot vaadayin lo asa vedavar ze mippi hakkabbala aval im laka ze sheheidu alav lokin vechen im yatza hammamon miyyad ze leyad ze beedutan chozer livalav umshallemin lo

Hau haedim shelosha afillu mea im heidu bevet din ze achar ze veheid kal echad mehen achar chavero betoch kede dibbur vehuzammu miktzatan en neenashin ad sheyyuzammu kullan aval im haya hefsek ben ze laze yeter mikkede dibbur shehu kede sheelat shalom talmid lerav hare nechleka haedut vehashshenayim shehuzammu neenashin vehashshenayim haacherim shehaya ben divrehen vedivre harishonim hefsek en neenashin veaf al pi shebbatla haedut kullah mippene shehen kat achat hoil venifsela mikketzatah nifsela kullah

Heid haechad venechkera eduto veamar hashsheni af ani kamohu o sheamar hen kayyotze baze vehuzammu shenehen hare shenehen neheragin o lokin o meshallemin shekkal ed sheamar achar edut chavero hen hare ze kemi shennechkar veheid kemo sheheid chavero veen leedim zommin shegaga lefi sheen bah maase lefichach en tzerichim hatraa kemo shebbearnu

Keshem shehashshenayim mezimin et hammea im heidu hammea bevat achat kach hen mezimin otan afillu hau chamishshim kat uvau shenayim achar shenayim ketzad kat sheheida al reuven sheharag et shimon birushalayim uvau shene edim vehezimuha uvat kat sheniyya veheida otah edut atzmah sheruven harag shimon birushalayim veamdu otan hashshenayim vehezimuha gam zo hakkat hashsheniyya vechen hashshelishit vechen harviit afillu mea kullan hen neheragin al pi ellu hashshenayim

Mishneh Torah, Testimony 22: Shette kitte edim hammachchishot zo et zo shebba ed echad mikkat zo veed echad mikkat zo veheidu beedut acheret en kan edut shehare bevadday echad mehen sheker veen yadua mi hu mishshenehen baa kat zo bifne atzmah veheida edut uvaa kat zo veheida edut acheret bifne atzmah mekabbelin kal achat mehen bifne atzmah

Mi shehevi edim venechkera edutan vehuzammu vechazar vehevi edim acherim beotah hattaana atzmah vehuzammu afillu mea kat veachar kach hevi edim acherim beotah hattaana atzmah venimtzet edut ellu haacharonim mechuvenet danin al pihen sheaf al pi shehuchzak ze shettaan taana zo lehavi edim shakranim hare lo huchzeku ellu haedim haacharonim shehen meshakkerin aval shetar shekkara alav arar vehu sheyyavou shenayim veyomru mimmennu shaal lezayyef lo shetar ze af al pi shennitkayyem hashshetar mechotmav en govin bo leolam veyerae li sheim bau ede hashshetar veheidu hen beatzman al ketav yadan govin bo seliku lehu hilchot edut besad
Mishneh Torah, The Sanhedrin and the Pen: Mitzvat ase shel tora lemannot shoftim veshotrim bechal medina umdina uvchal pelech ufelech shenneemar shoftim veshotrim titten lecha bechal shearecha shoftim ellu haddayyanim hakkevuin bevet din uvaale dinin baim lifnehem shotrim ellu baale makkel urtzua vehem omdim lifne haddayyanin hamsabbevin bashshevakim uvarchovot veal hachanuyyot letakken hashshearim vehammiddot ulhakkot kal meavet vechal maasehem al pi haddayyanim vechal sheyyiru bo iuut davar meviin oto levet din vedanin oto kefi risho

En anu chayyavin lehaamid batte dinim bechal pelech ufelech uvchal ir vair ella beeretz yisrael bilvad aval bechutza laaretz enan chayyavin lehaamid bet din bechal pelech ufelech shenneemar titten lecha bechal shearecha asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha lishvatecha

Kamma batte dinin kevuin yihu beyisrael vechamma yihye minyanan kovin battechilla bet din haggadol bammikdash vehu hannikra sanhedri gedola uminyanam shivim veechad shenneemar esfa li shivim ish mizzikne yisrael umoshe al gabbehen shenneemar vehityatztzevu sham immach hare shivim veechad haggadol bechachma shebbechullan moshivin oto rosh alehen vehu rosh hayeshiva vehu shekkorin oto hachachamim nasi bechal makom vehu haomed tachat moshe rabbenu umoshivin haggadol shebbashshivim mishne larosh veoshev mimino vehu hannikra av bet din ushar hashshivim yoshvin lefanav kefi shenehem uchfi maalatam kal haggadol mechavero bechachma yihye karov lannasi missemolo yoter mechavero vehem yoshvin bichmo chatzi goren beiggul kede sheyyihye hannasi im av bet din roin kullan veod maamidin shene batte dinin shel esrim ushlosha esrim ushlosha echad al petach haazara veechad al petach har habbayit umaamidin bechal ir vair miyyisrael sheyyesh bah mea veesrim o yoter sanhedri ketanna veoshevet beshaar hair shenneemar vehatztzigu vashshaar mishpat vechamma yihye minyanam esrim ushlosha dayyanim vehaggadol bechachma shebbechullan rosh alehen vehashshear yoshvin beiggul kemo chatzi goren kede sheyehe harosh roe et kullan
Ir sheen bah mea veesrim maamidin bah shelosha dayyanim sheen bet din pachot mishshelosha kede sheyehe bahen rov umiut im hayeta benehen machloket bedin min haddinin

Umitzva lihot besanhedrin gedola kohanim ulviyyim shenneemar uvata el hakkohanim halviyyim veim lo matzu afillu hau kullam yisreelim hare ze muttar
En maamidin bechal hassanhedrin lo zaken muflag beshanim velo saris mippene sheyyesh bahen achzariyyut velo mi sheen lo banim kede sheyehe rachaman
Ven moshivin melech yisrael besanhedrin sheasur lachlok alav velamrot et devaro aval moshivin kohen gadol im haya rauy bechachma

Malche bet david af al pi sheen moshivin otam besanhedrin yoshvin vedanim hem et haam vedanim otam im yesh alehen din aval malche yisrael en danin veen danin otam lefi sheen nichnaim ledivre tora shemma tavo mehen takkala

Bet din shel shelosha af al pi sheen medakdekin bahen bechal ellu haddevarim tzarich sheyehe bechal echad mehen shiva devarim veellu hen chachma vaanava veyira vesinat mamon veahavat haemet veahavat habberiyyot lahen uvaale shem tov vechal ellu haddevarim meforashin hen battora hare hu omer anashim chachamim unvonim hare baale chachma amur viduim leshivtechem ellu sheruach habberiyyot nocha mehem uvamme yihu ahuvim labberiyyot bizman sheyyihu baale ayin tova venefesh shefala vechevratan tova vedibburan umassaan benachat im habberiyyot ulhallan hu omer anshe chayil ellu shehen gibborim bemitzot umdakdekim al atzmam vechovshin et yitzran ad shello yehe lahen shum genay velo shem ra vihe pirkan nae uvichlal anshe chayil sheyyihye lahen lev ammitz lehatztzil ashuk miyyad oshko kainyan shenneemar vayyakam moshe vayyoshian uma moshe rabbenu anav af kal dayyan tzarich lihot anav yire elohim kemashmao sone vatza af mamon shellahem enan nivhalin alav velo rodfin lekabbetz hammamon shekkal mi shehu nivhal lahon cheser yevoennu anshe emet sheyyihu rodfin achar hatztzedek mechamat atzman bedatan ohavin et haemet vesonin et hechamas uvorchin mikkal mine heavel

Amru chachamim shemmibbet din haggadol hau sholchim bechal eretz yisrael uvodkin kal mi sheyyimtzauhu chacham vire chata veanav veshafuy ufirko nae veruach habberiyyot nocha hemennu osin oto dayyan beiro umishsham maalin oto lefetach har habbayit umishsham maalin oto lefetach haazara umishsham maalin oto levet din haggadol

Bet din shel shelosha shehaya echad mehen ger hare ze pasul ad shettihye immo miyyisrael haya echad mamzer afillu shelashtan mamzerim hare ellu kesherin ladun vechen im haya kal echad mehem suma beechad meenav kasher ma sheen ken besanhedrin aval hassuma bishte enav pasul lakkol
Af al pi sheen bet din pachot mishshelosha muttar leechad ladun min hattora shenneemar betzedek tishpot amitecha umiddivre sofrim ad sheyyihu shelosha ushnayim sheddanu en dinehen din

Echad shehaya mumche larabbim o shennatal reshut mibbet din hare ze muttar lo ladun yechidi aval eno chashuv bet din veaf al pi shehu muttar mitzvat chachamim hu shemmoshiv immo acherim shehare amru al tehi dan yechidi sheen dan yechidi ella echad

Yesh leadam laasot din leatzmo im yesh beyado koach hoil vechaddat vechahalacha hu ose eno chayyav litroach velavo levet din af al pi shello haya sham hefsed binchasav illu nitacher uva levet din lefichach im kibbel alav baal dino vehevio levet din vedarshu umatzu sheasa kahalacha vedin emet dan leatzmo en sotrin et dino

Veasur leadam chacham sheyyeshev baddin ad sheyyeda im mi yeshev shemma yitztaref im anashim sheenan hagunim venimtza bichlal kesher bogdim lo bichlal bet din

Ad ematay yoshvin haddayyanim bedin sanhedri ketanna uvet din shel shelosha yoshvin meachar tefillat hashshachar ad sof shesh shaot bayyom aval bet din haggadol hau yoshvin mittamid shel shachar ad tamid shel ben haarbayim uvshabbatot veyamim tovim hau yoshvin bevet hammidrash shebbehar habbayit

En bet din shel shivim veechad tzerichin sheyyihu yoshvin kullan keechad bimkoman shebbammikdash ella beet sheyehu tzerichin lehitkabbetz mitkabbetzin kullan uvishar haittot kal mi shehaya lo esek yetze laasot cheftzo vechozer vehu shello yifchatu meesrim ushlosha yoshvin tamid kal zeman yeshivatan hutzrach echad mehen latzet hare ze mistakkel bachaverav hannisharim im yishshaaru sham esrim ushlosha yetze veim lav lo yetze ad sheyyavo acher
En matchilin et haddinin ballayela mippi hashshemua lamdu shehaddinin kingaim shenneemar kal riv vechal naga ma reiyyat negaim bayyom bilvad af haddinin bayyom bilvad
Vechen en mekabbelin edut veen mekayemin shetarot ballayela uvdine mamonot im hitchilu bayyom muttar ligmor haddin ballayela
Hannechalot kedinin shenneemar bahen lechukkat mishpat lefichach en mappilin nechalot ballayela
Shenayim shennichnesu levakker et hachole vetziva bifnehem kotvim veen osim din veim hau shelosha ratzu kotvin ratzu osin din bamme devarim amurim bayyom aval ballayela kotvin veen osin din

Kal dayyan shennatan mamon kede sheyyitmanne asur laamod mippanav vetziuu chachamim lehakel oto ulzalzel bo veamru chachamim shehattallit shemmitattef bah tehi beenecha kemirdaat shel chamor

Kach haya derech chachamim harishonim borchin millehitmannot vedochakin atzman harbe shello yeshvu baddin ad sheyyedu sheen sham rauy kemotam vesheim yimmanu min haddin tekalkel hashshura af al pi chen lo hau yoshvin baddin ella ad shemmachbidin alehem et haam vehazzekenim ufotzrim bahen

Al tomar shekkal ellu haddevarim bedin sheyyesh bo hotzaat mamon harbe mizze untinato laze leolam yehi din elef mane vedin peruta achat shavin beenecha lechal davar
En haddayyanin yoshvin ladin bedin pachot mishsheve peruta veim huzkeku lishve peruta gomrin et dino afillu lefachot mishsheve peruta

Kal hammatte mishpat echad miyyisrael over belav echad shenneemar lo taasu avel bammishpat veim haya ger over bishne lavin shenneemar lo tatte mishpat ger veim haya yatom over bishlosha lavin shenneemar mishpat ger yatom

Lo yihye echad yoshev veechad omed ella shenehem omdim veim ratzu bet din lehoshiv et shenehem moshivin velo yeshev echad lemala veechad lematta ella ze betzad ze bamme devarim amurim bishat massa umattan aval bishat gemar din shenehem baamida shenneemar vayyaamod haam al mshe vee zehu gemar din ish peloni atta zakkay ish peloni atta chayyav bamme devarim amurim bevaale dinin aval haedim leolam baamida shenneemar veamdu shene haanashim

Talmid chacham veam haaretz shebbau ledin moshivin et hechacham veomrim leam haaretz shev im lo yashav en makpidin al kach velo yakdim hattalmid kesheyyavo ledin veyeshev lifne rabbo kerotze ladun lefanav veim haya kovea lo zeman likrot uva zemanno muttar
Kevar nahagu kal batte dine yisrael meachar haggemara bechal hayeshivot shemmoshivin baale dinin umoshivin haedim kede lesallek hammachaloket sheen banu koach lehaamid mishpete haddat al tillam

Hau lifne haddayyanim baale din harbe makdimin et din hayyatom ledin haalmana shenneemar shiftu yatom rivu almana vedin almana kodem ledin talmid chacham vedin talmid chacham kodem ledin am haaretz vedin haishsha kodem ledin haish shebboshet haishsha merubba

Asur ledayyan lishmoa divre echad mibbaale dinin kodem sheyyavo chavero o shello bifne chavero vaafillu davar echad asur shenneemar shamoa ben achechem vechal hashshomea meechad over belo taase shenneemar lo tissa shema shave uvichlal lav ze azhara limkabbel lashon hara umsapper lashon hara umeid edut sheker vechen baal din muzhar shello yashmia devarav laddayyan kodem sheyyavo baal din chavero vegam al ze vechayyotze bo neemar middevar sheker tirchak
