Tzarich haddayyan lishmoa taanot baale dinin velishnot taanotehen shenneemar vayyomer hammelech zot omeret ze beni hachay uvnech hammet umtzaddek et haddin belibbo veachar kach chotcho

Minnayin laddayyan shello yease melitz lidvarav shel baal din shenneemar middevar sheker tirchak ella yomar ma shennire lo veyishtok velo yelammed echad mibbaale dinin taana kelal afillu hevi ed echad lo yomar lo en mekabbelin ed echad ella yomar lannitan hare ze heid alecha halvay sheyyode veyomar emet heid ad sheyyiton hu veyomar ed echad hu veeno neeman alay vechen kal kayyotze baze

Raa haddayyan zechut leechad mehen uvaal din mevakkesh leamrah veeno yodea lechabber haddevarim o sheraahu mitztaer lehatztzil atzmo betaanat emet umippene hachema vehakkaas nistallek mimmennu o nishtabbesh mippene hassichlut hare ze muttar lesaado meat lahavino techillat haddavar mishshum petach picha leillem vetzarich lehityashshev bedavar ze harbe shello yihye keorche haddayyanin

Shennayim shebbau lefanecha ledin echad rach veechad kashe ad shello tishma et divrehem o mishshettishma et divrehem vei atta yodea lehechan haddin note atta rashshay lomar lahem eni nizkak lachem shemma yitchayyev hakkashe venimtza rodef achar haddayyan aval mishshettishma et divrehem veteda lehechan haddin note i atta rashshay lomar eni nizkak lachem shenneemar lo taguru mippene ish shello tomar ish peloni rasha hu shemma yaharog et beni shemma yadlik et gedishi shemma yekatztzetz netiotay veim haya memunne larabbim chayyav lehizzakek lahem

Vechen talmid shehaya yoshev lifne rabbo veraa zechut leani vechova leashir im shatak hare ze over mishshum lo taguru mippene ish veal ze neemar middevar sheker tirchak uminnayin laddayyan shello yoshiv talmid bur lefanav talmud lomar middevar sheker tirchak
Uminnayin letalmid sheraa rabbo shettoe baddin shello yomar amtin lo ad sheyyiggamer haddin veesterenu vaavinennu kede sheyyikkare haddin al shemi talmud lomar middevar sheker tirchak

Mitzva lomar levaale dinim battechilla bedin attem rotzim o bifshara im ratzu bifshara osin benehen peshara vechal bet din sheosin peshara tamid hare ze meshubbach vealav neemar mishpat shalom shiftu beshaarechem e zehu mishpat sheyyesh immo shalom heve omer ze bitztzua vechen bedavid hu omer vayehi david osho mishpat utzdaka lechal ammo ezehu mishpat sheyyesh immo tzedaka heve omer zehu bitztzua vehi happeshara bamme devarim amurim kodem gemar din af al pi sheshshama divrehem veyada lehechan haddin note mitzva livtzoa aval achare sheggamar haddin veamar ish peloni atta zakkay ish peloni atta chayyav eno rashshay laasot peshara benehen ella yikkov haddin et hahar
Af al pi sheratzu baale haddin bifshara bevet din yesh lahem lachzor velitboa et haddin ad sheyyiknu miyyad shenehem
Yafe koach peshara mikkoach haddin sheshshene hedotot sheddanu en dinehen din veyesh levaale dinin lachzor bahen veim asu peshara vekanu miyyadan en yecholin lachzor bahen

Asur leechad min haddayyanim kesheyyetze mibbet din lomar ani hu hamzakke o hamchayyev vachaveray cholkin alay aval ma eese shehem rabbu alay veim amar ken hare hu bichlal holech rachil megalle sod umaase betalmid echad shehotzi devarim shenneemru bevet hammidrash leachar shettayim veesrim shana vehotziuhu bet din mibbet hammidrash vehichrizu alav ze megalle sod hu

Shaal echad mibbaale dinim lichtov lo pesak din kotvin lo kach ba peloni levet din shel peloni im peloni baal dino shetteano bechach veyatza zakkay o chayyav venotnin lo veen mazkirin shem hamzakkin velo shem hamchayevin ella bet din shel peloni middivrehem nizdakka peloni

Kach haya minhagam shel anshe yerushalayim machnisin baale dinin veshomim divrehem vetaanotehem umachnisim haedim veshomim divrehem umotziin kal adam lachutz vehaddayyanim nosim venotnim benehem baddavar vegomrin et haddavar veachar kach machnisin baale dinim vegadol shebbaddayyanim omer ish peloni atta zakkay ish peloni atta chayyav kede shello yeda echad mibbaale dinim e ze dayyan hu mi shezzikka oto velo e ze dayyan hu shechiyevo

Dayyan shehu yodea bachavero shehu gazlan o rasha asur lehitztaref immo shenneemar middevar sheker tirchak vechach hau nekiyye haddaat shebbirushalayim osin en yoshvin baddin ad sheyyedu im mi hem yoshvim velo chotmim et hashshetar ad sheyyedu mi chotem immahem velo nichnasim lisuda ad sheyyedu mi mesev immahen

Lo tikkach shochad en tzarich lomar leavet et haddin ella afillu lezakkot et hazzakkay ulchayyev et hachayyav asur veover belo taase vahare hu bichlal arur lokeach shochad vechayyav lehachzir hashshochad kesheyyitbaennu hannoten
Uchshem shehallokeach over belo taase kach hannoten shenneemar velifne iver lo titten michshl

Kal dayyan sheyyoshev umgaddel maalato kede leharbot sachar lechazzanav ulsofrav hare hu bichlal hannotim achare habbetza vechen asu bene shemuel ulchach neemar lahem vayyittu achare habbatza vayyikchu shochad velo shochad mamon bilvad ella afillu shochad devarim umaase bedayyan echad shehaya ole bedugit ketanna laavor bannahar ufashat echad yado vesiyeo baaliyyato vehaya lo din veamar lo haddayyan hareni pasul lecha ladin umaase beechad sheheevir evra notza shel of meal redid haddayyan veachar kissa rok millifne haddayyan veamar lo hareni pasul lecha ladin umaase beechad shehevi mattana achat mimmattenot kehunna ledayyan kohen veamar lo pasul ani lecha ladin umaase bearis echad shel dayyan shehaya mevi lo teenim mittoch sadehu meerev shabbat leerev shabbat paam achat hikdim vehevi bachamishi beshabbat mippene shehaya lo din veamar lo haddayyan hareni pasul lecha ladin af al pi shehatteenim mishshel dayyan hoil vehevian shello bizmannam nifsal lo ladin
Kal dayyan sheshshaal sheela pasul ladin laze shehishilo bamme devarim amurim beshello haya lo laddayyan lehashil aval haya lo lehashil kasher shehare gam ze shoel mimmennu

Kal dayyan shennotel secharo ladun dinav betelim vehu shello yihye sachar hannikkar aval im haya osek bimlachto uvau lefanav shenayim ledin veamar lahen tenu li mi sheyyaase tachtay ad sheadun lachem o tenu li sachar battalati hare ze muttar vehu sheyyihye haddavar nikkar shehu sechar habbattala bilvad velo yoter veyittol mishshenehem beshave ze bifne ze kegon ze muttar

Asur laddayyan ladun lemi shehu ohavo af al pi sheeno shoshvino velo reo asher kenafsho velo lemi shessono af al pi sheeno oyev lo velo mevakkesh raato ella tzarich sheyyihu shene baale dinim shavin beene haddayyanim uvlibbam veim lo haya makkir et echad mehem velo maasav en lecha dayyan tzedek kamohu
Kal shene talmide chachamim shessonim ze et ze asurin leshev baddin ze im ze sheddavar ze gorem litziat mishpat meukkal mippene hassina shebbenehen daat kal echad nota listor divre chavero

Leolam yire dayyan atzmo keillu cherev munnachat lo al tzavaro vegehinnom petucha lo mittachtav veyeda et mi hu dan velifne mi hu dan umi atid lehippara mimmennu im nata mikkav haemet shenneemar elohim nitztzav baadat el veomer reu ma attem osim ki lo leadam tishpetu ki la

Kal dayyan sheeno dan din emet laamitto gorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael vechal dayyan shennotel mizze venoten laze shello kaddin hakkadosh baruch hu gove mimmennu nefashot shenneemar vekava et kovehem nafesh vechal dayyan sheddan din emet laamitto afillu shaa achat keillu tikken et kal haolam kullo vegorem lashshechina shettishre beyisrael shenneemar elohim nitztzav baadat el veshemma yomar haddayyan ma li velatztzara hazzot talmud lomar veimmachem bidvar mishpat en laddayyan ella ma sheenav root

Vlolam yihu baale dinin lefanecha kirshaim uvchezkat shekkal echad mehen toen sheker vedun lefi ma shettire min haddevarim uchsheyyippatru millefanecha yihu beenecha ketzaddikim keshekkibbelu alehem et haddin vedun kal echad mehem lechaf zechut

Yesh laddayyan ladun bedine mamonot al pi haddevarim sheddato nota lahen shehen emet vehaddavar chazak belibbo shehu ken af al pi sheen sham reaya berura veen tzarich lomar im haya yodea bevadday shehaddavar ken hu shehu dan kefi ma sheyyodea ketzad hare shennitchayyev adam shevua bevet din veamar laddayyan adam shehu neeman etzlo vesheddato somechet al devarav shezze haish chashud al hashshevua yesh laddayyan lahafoch hashshevua al shekkenegdo veyishshava veyittol hoil vesamcha dato shel dayyan al divre ze afillu hayeta ishsha o eved neemanim etzlo hoil umatza haddavar chazak venachon belibbo somech alav vedan veen tzarich lomar im yada hu atzmo shezze chashud vechen im yatza shetar chov lefanav veamar lo adam shessamach alav afillu ishsha o karov ze parua hu im samcha dato al devarav yesh lo lomar laze lo tippara ella bishvua o im haya alav shetar chov leacher yitten leze shello nifgam shetaro kelal veyanniach ze shennifgam shetaro bedivre haechad o yashlich hashshetar befanav velo yadun bo kefi ma sheyyire vechen mi shebba vetaan sheyyesh lo pikkadon etzel peloni shemmet belo tzavaa venatan simanin muvhakin velo haya ze hattoen ragil lehikkanes bevet ze haish shemmet im yada haddayyan shezze hammet eno amud lihot lo chefetz ze vesamcha dato sheen ze hachefetz shel met motzio min hayyorshin venotno leze haamud bo venatan simanim vechen kal kayyotze baze sheen haddavar masur ella lelibbo shel dayyan lefi ma sheyyerae lo shehu din haemet im ken lamma hitzricha tora shene edim shebbizman sheyyavou lifne haddayyan shene edim yadun al pi edutan af al pi sheeno yodea im beemet heidu o besheker

Kal ellu haddevarim hen ikkar haddin aval mishsherabbu batte dinin sheenan hagunim vaafillu hau hagunim bemaasehem enan chachamim karauy uvaale bina hiskimu rov batte dine yisrael shello yehappechu shevua ella biraya berura velo yifgemu shetar veyafsidu chezkato beedut ishsha o pasul vechen bishar kal haddinin velo yadun haddayyan bismichat dato velo bidiato kede shello yomar kal hedot libbi maamin ledivre ze vedati somechet al ze vechen en motziin min hayetomim ella biraya berura lo bedaat haddayyan velo beumdan hammet o hattoen veaf al pi chen im heid adam neeman bedavar mikkal haddevarim venatta daat haddayyan sheemet hu omer mamtin baddin veeno doche eduto venose venoten im baale dinin ad sheyyodu ledivre haed o yaasu peshara o yistallek min haddin

Uminnayin ledayyan shehu yodea bedin shehu merumme shello yomar echtechennu veyihye hakkolar taluy betzavvere haedim talmud lomar middevar sheker tirchak ketzad yaase yidrosh bo veyachkor harbe bidrisha uvachakira shel dine nefashot im nire lo lefi dato sheen bo rammaut chotech et haddin al pi haedut aval im haya libbo nokfo sheyyesh bo rammaut o sheen dato somechet al divre haedim af al pi sheeno yachol lefaslan o sheddato nota shebbaal din ze rammay uvaal arma vehishshi et haedim af al pi shehem kesherim ulfi tummam heidu veze hattaam o shennire lo mikkelal haddevarim sheyyesh sham devarim acherim mesuttarin veenan rotzim legallotam kal ellu haddevarim vechayyotze bahen asur lo lachtoch oto haddin ella yesallek atzmo middin ze vidinennu mi shellibbo shalem baddavar vahare haddevarim mesurim lallev vehakkatuv omer ki hammishpat lelohim hu

Yesh levet din lehalkot mi sheeno mechuyyav malkot velaharog mi sheeno mechuyyav mita velo laavor al divre tora ella laasot seyag lattora vechevan sheroim bet din sheppartzu haam baddavar yesh lahen ligdor ulchazzek haddavar kefi ma sheyyerae lahem hakkol horaat shaa lo sheyyikba halacha ledorot maase vehilku adam shebbaal ishto tachat ilan umaase beechad sherachav al sus beshabbat bime yevanim veheviuhu levet din uskaluhu umaase vetala shimon ben shetach shemonim nashim beom echad beashkelon velo hau sham kal darche hadderisha vachakira vehahatraa velo beedut berura ella horaat shaa kefi ma sheraa

Vechen yesh levet din bechal makom uvchal zeman lehalkot adam sheshshemuato raa vehaam merannenim alav shehu over al haaraot vehu sheyyihye kol sheeno posek kemo shebbearnu velo yihu ellu oyevim yeduim shemmotziin alav shemua raa vechen mevazzin et ze sheshshemuato raa umcharfin et yoladto befanav

Vechen yesh lo lichpot yadayim veraglayim veleesor bevet haasurim velidchof velischov al haaretz shenneemar hen lemot hen lishroshi hen laanash nichsin veleesurin

Kal ellu haddevarim lefi ma sheyyire haddayyan shezze rauy lechach veshehashshaa tzericha uvakkol yihu maasav leshem shamayim veal yihye kevod habberiyyot kal beenav shehare hu doche et lo taase shel divrehem vechal shekken kevod bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov hammachazikin betorat haemet sheyyihye zahir shello yaharos kevodam ella lehosif bichvod hammakom bilvad shekkal hamvazze et hattora gufo mechullal al habberiyyot vehamchabbed et hattora gufo mechubbad al habberiyyot veen kevod hattora ella laasot al pi chukkeha umishpateha

Asur laadam linhog bisrara al hatztzibbur uvgassut haruach ella baanava veyira vechal parnas hammattil ema yetera al hatztzibbur shello leshem shamayim neenash veeno roe lo ben talmid chacham shenneemar lachen yereuhu anashim lo yire kal chachme lev

Vechen asur lo linhog bahen kallut rosh af al pi shehen amme haaretz velo yafsia al rashe am hakkodesh af al pi shehen hedotot ushfalim bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov hem vetzivot hashshem shehotzi meeretz mitzrayim bechoach gadol uvyad chazaka vesovel torach hatztzibbur umassaan kemoshe rabbenu shenneemar bo kaasher yissa haomen et hayyonek vahare hu omer vaatzave et shoftechem zo azhara laddayyan sheyyisbol et hatztzibbur kaasher yissa haomen et hayyonek tze ulmad mimmoshe rabban shel kal hanneviim kevan sheshshelacho hakkadosh baruch hu bemitzrayim veneemar vayetzavem el bene yisrael amru mippi hakkabbala sheamar lahem lemoshe ulaharon al menat sheyyihu mekallelim etchem vesoklin etchem baavanim

Kederech shennitztava haddayyan linhog bemitzva zo kach nitztauu hatztzibbur linhog kavod baddayyan shenneemar vaatzave etchem zo azhara latztzibbur shettihye emat haddayyan alehen velo yitbazze bifnehem velo yinhog kallut rosh beatzmo

Kevan shennitmanna adam parnas al hatztzibbur asur baasiyyat melacha bifne shelosha kede shello yitbazze bifnehem im hammelacha barabbim asura alav kal vachomer leechol velishtot ulhishtakker bifne rabbim uvichnisat amme haaretz uvisudat mereut oy lahem leotan haddayyanim shennahagu bechach meelbon torat moshe shebbizzu dineha vehishpiluha ad eretz vehiggiuha ad afar vegarmu raa lahen velivne benehem baolam hazze velaolam habba

Asur linhog kallut rosh beshaliach bet din vahare hashshaliach neeman kishnayim leinyan hannidduy sheim amar peloni hiklani o hikla haddayyan o lo ratza lavo ledin meshammetin oto al piv aval en kotvin pitcha alav ad sheyyavou shenayim veyaidu alav shennimna lavo levet din
En shaliach bet din chayyav baamirat devarim mishshum lashon hara vechal hamtzaer shaliach bet din yesh levet din reshut lehakkoto makkat mardut

Shaliach sheamar peloni shelachani beshem echad min haddayyanim velo ratza baal din lavo en kotvin alav pitcha shel shamta ad sheyyomar mishshem shelashtan bamme devarim amurim shehalach hashshaliach beom sheeno yadua lishivat haddayyanim aval bayyom hayyadua shehaddayyanim yoshvim bo ledin hakkol yodim shekkal haddayyanim mekubbatzin veaf al pi shebba hashshaliach beshem echad keillu ba beshem shelashtan

Mi sheshshalchu lo bet din lavo velo ba laddin menaddin oto vechotvin alav pitcha venoten sechar hassofer uvaet sheyyavo korin happitcha katvu lo pitcha mippene shello kibbel haddin kevan sheamar hareni mekabbel haddin korin nidduo kavu lo bet din zeman sheyyavo hayyom velo ba kal oto hayyom kotvin alav pitcha laerev bamme devarim amurim keshehaya bammedina umarad velo ba aval im haya bakkefarim veotze venichnas kovim lo zeman sheni vachamishi vesheni veim shalam yom sheni velo ba en kotvin alav pitcha ad lemachar

En kovin zeman lo bime nisan velo bime tishre mippene shehaam terudin bemoadot velo beerev shabbat velo beerev yom tov aval kovin benisan sheyyavo achar nisan uvtishre sheyyavo achar tishre aval lo kovin beerev shabbat sheyyavo achar shabbat mippene shehakkol terudin beerev shabbat

Mi shehu bammedina vehalach shaliach bet din velo metzao en kovin lo zeman ad sheyyimtza oto hashshaliach veyomar lo haya bichfar chutz lammedina im darko lavo beoto hayyom omer hashshaliach afillu leechad min hashshechenim afillu leishsha im yavo peloni hodiuhu shebbet din kavu lo zeman sheyyavo levet din veim lo ba menaddin oto laerev bamme devarim amurim kesheen hadderech sheddarko lelech bah al mekom bet din aval im darko alehen en menaddin oto ad sheyyodio hashshaliach beatzmo shemma lo amru lo hashshechenim shehare hem omrin darko al petach bet din uchvar halach alehem veniftar vechen im lo ba bammedina ad lemachar en somchin al hashshechenim shemma shachchu velo amru lo

Af al pi sheen bet din metzuvin lehafrish et hakkatan mitzva al aviv ligor bo ulhafrisho kede lechannecho bikdushsha shenneemar chanoch lannaar al pi darko vego

Vechen asru leechol beyadayim mesoavot mezohamot veal gabbe kelim meluchlachim shekkal devarim ellu bichlal al teshakketzu et nafshotechem vehaochel maachalot ellu makkin oto makkat mardut

Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 1: Hava al achat mikkal haaraot haamurot battora bemezid chayyav karet shenneemar ki kal asher yaase mikkol hattoevot haelle venichretu hannefashot vego shenehem habboel vehannivelet veim hau shoggin chayyavin chattat kevua veyesh min haaraot shehu bemitat bet din yeter al hakkaret hashshave bechullan

Shear haaraot kullan becharet bilvad veen bahem mitat bet din lefichach im hau sham edim vehatraa bet din malkin otan shekkal chayyave keretot lokin

Kal ishsha asura meellu im hayeta bat shalosh shanim veom echad vamala gadol habba aleha chayyav mita o karet o malkot vehi petura mikkelum ella im ken hayeta gedola veim hayeta pechuta mizze hare shenehen peturin sheen biatah bia vechen ishsha gedola shebba aleha katan im haya ben tesha shanim veom echad vamala hi chayyevet karet o mita o malkot vehu patur veim haya ben tesha shanim ulmatta shenehem peturin

Vechen hashshochev im habbehema bishgaga vehaishsha shehevia et habbehema aleha bishgaga en habbehema niskelet al yadan veaf al pi shehen gedolim kal haaraot kullan shehaya echad gadol veechad katan hakkatan patur vehaggadol chayyav kemo shebbearnu echad er veechad yashen hayyashen patur echad mezid veechad shogeg hammezid chayyav vehashshogeg mevi karban echad anus veechad beratzon haanus patur kemo shebbearnu

Vechen achot ishto erva alav ad shettamut ishto ben achotah meimmah ben achotah meaviha ben min hannissuin ben mizzenut hare zo erva alav

Vechal achad asar yom sheachar hashshiva hen hannikrain yeme zivatah ben raata bahen dam ben lo raata velamma nikrain yeme ziva mippene shehen reuyin leziva vechal dam shettire bahen dam ziva yechashev vehizzaher bishne shemot ellu shehen yeme niddatah vime zivatah

Kal yeme haishsha miyyom sheyyikkava lah veset ad shettamut o ad sheyyeaker haveset leom acher tispor leolam shiva mittechillat yom haveset veacharehen achad asar veacharehen shiva veacharehen achad asar vetizzaher bamminyan kede shetteda beet shettire dam im bime nidda raata o bime ziva shekkal yameha shel ishsha kach hen shiva yeme nidda veachad asar yeme ziva ella im ken hifsika halleda kemo sheyyitbaer

Ishsha sheraata dam bime zivatah yom echad bilvad o shene yamim ze achar ze nikret zava ketanna venikret shomeret yom keneged yom veim raata shelosha yamim ze achar ze hare zo zava gemura vehi hannikret zava gedola venikret zava setam shenneemar veishsha ki yazuv zov damah yamim rabbim miut yamim shenayim rabbim shelosha

En ben zava gedola lezava ketanna ella sefirat shiva vahavaat karban shezzava gedola tzericha lispor shiva yamim nekiyyim vezava ketanna enah soferet ella yom echad bilvad vezava gedola mevia karban keshettithar vezava ketanna enah mevia karban keshettithar aval leinyan tuma veissur bia shettehen shaot

Ketzad raata dam bime zivatah ben sheraata bitchillat hallayela ben sheraata besof hayyom hare oto hayyom kullo tame uchillu lo pasak haddam meet sheraata ad sheshshaka hachamma umshammeret kal hallayela veim lo raata kelum ballayela mashkemet lemachar vetovelet achar shettanetz hachamma umshammeret kal hayyom im lo raata kelum hare ze yom echad tahor keneged hayyom hattame vahare hi mutteret levalah laerev

Raata dam gam bayyom hashsheni ben belelo ben beomo achar shettavla hare hayyom hashsheni tame umshammeret kal lel shelishi im lo raata mashkemet lemachar vetovelet achar shettanetz hachamma umshammeret kal hayyom im lo raata kelum hare ze yom echad tahor keneged shene yamim hattemeim umutteret levalah laerev

Raata dam gam bashshelishi ben beomo ben belelo hare zo zava gedola utzricha lispor shiva yamim tehorim belo dam shenneemar vesafra lah shivat yamim vego vetovelet bayyom hashshevii achar hanetz hachamma vahare hi mutteret levalah laerev uvayyom hashshemini mevia karbanah shene torim o shene bene yona
Zava ketanna shettavla ballayela shel yom hashshimmur o zava gedola shettavla belel shevii keillu lo tavla vahare hi kenidda shettavla betoch shiva

Habba al zava gedola beom shevii shel sefira achar shettavla o al zava ketanna beom hashshimmur achar shettavla patur min hakkaret kevan shettavla bazzeman harauy litvilatah tehora ulishsha zo yihye lah tarbut raa shehare beilatah umaggaah teluyin

Ketzad hen teluyin im nishlam hayyom achar hattevila velo raata dam hare kal shennaga bo achar tevilatah tahor uvilatah achar hattevila en chayyavin aleha kelum veim raata dam beom ze achar shettavla nimtzet zava lemafrea vechal shennaga bo lemafrea tame vehi uvoalah chayyavin bekarban ulfichach hi asura levalah ad laerev shello tavi atzmah lide safek
Zava shessafra sheshet yamim nekiyyim uvashshevii raata dam afillu samuch lishkiat hachamma soteret hakkol vechozeret limnot meachar hayyom hattame shiva yamim nekiyyim

Palta shichvat zera betoch yeme hassefira soteret yom echad mippene shehu kezav sheraa keri shessoter yom echad raata dam baasiri mime zivatah uvachad asar uvishtem asar af al pi sheraata shelosha yamim ze achar ze enah zava gedola ella yatzat mizzivut ketanna lenidda sheyyom shenem asar matchelet niddatah veharoa bime niddatah enah zava kemo shebbearnu

Uma hu ze shekkatuv battora o ki tazuv al niddatah sheim raata shelosha yamim samuch leniddatah hare zo zava kegon sheraata bashshemini leniddatah uvatteshii uvaasiri shehen rishon vesheni ushlishi mehaachad asar yom shehen yeme zivatah raata dam ba mime zivatah vetavla laerev shehu lel veshimmesha mittatah af al pi shehi temea uvoalah tame veosin mishkav umoshav enam chayyavim karet mippene sheen yom mitztaref leom laasot zava hoila lah tevilat lel ze lehatztzilah min hakkarban

Tavla beom achar shettanetz hachamma hare zo asura levalah ad laerev kedin kal zava ketanna veim avar uvalah shenehen peturin mikkelum vaafillu raata dam achar shebba aleha beom en bechach kelum shezze dam nidda hu veeno mitztaref layyom shellefanav

Raata dam besof shevii leniddatah ben hashshemashot veraata batteshii uvaasiri hare zo sefek zava shemma reiyya rishona belel shemini hayeta venimtzet sheraata shelosha yamim ze achar ze mittechillat yeme zivatah vechen im raata dam batteshii uvaasiri mime zivatah veraata besof yom achad asar ben hashshemashot hare zo sefek zava shemma reiyya acharona beom achad asar hayeta vahare raata shelosha yamim ze achar ze bime zivatah

Nidda shebbadka atzmah betoch yeme niddatah umatza sheppasak haddam vaafillu pasak besheni leniddatah veshagga o hezida velo badka ad leachar niddatah yamim rabbim uchshebbadka matza tuma en omrim shemma kal otan hayyamim hayeta temea vetihye zava ella kal otan hayyamim shello badka bechezkat tahora badka atzmah umatza temea afillu badka bashshevii leniddatah uven hashshemashot lo badka atzmah kede lifrosh mittumat nidda ella himtina yamim veachar kach badka umatzat tehora hare zo sefek zava veim matza temea hare zo zava vaddait shekkevan shebbattechilla matza temea ulvassof temea hare zo bechezkat shello pasak veom rishon shel nidda af al pi shemmatza bo tehora hare zo kemi shemmatza temea sheyyom rishon kullo huchzak hammaayan patuach
Zava shebbadka atzmah barishon mime hassefira umatza tahor velo badka ad yom shevii umatza tahor hare zo bechezkat tahora uchillu badka kal shiva umatza tahor

Vechen im badka beom rishon mime hassefira umatza tahor uvayyom hashshemini umatza tahor hare zo bechezkat tahora badka beom shelishi lezivatah umatza sheppasak haddam velo badka beom rishon mime hassefira uvashshevii badka umatza tahor hare zo bechezkat tahora vehu haddin lezav bechal ellu habbedikot shehu tahor vealu lo yeme sefira

Kal ishsha shehi sefek nidda sefek zava tzericha leshev shivat yamim nekiyyim missafek vetovelet belel shemini veachar kach tihye mutteret levalah umvia karban zava veeno neechal kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 7: Meuveret shehitchila lehitztaer vaachazuha chevle leda vehitchil haddam latzet kodem shetteled oto haddam hu hannikra dam hakkoshi veheach dino im ba bime niddatah hare hu dam nidda vahare zo temea nidda veim ba bime zivatah hare zo tehora shenneemar bezava dam yihye zovah bivsarah mippi hashshemua lamdu zovah mechamat atzmah velo mechamat valad uvilvad shetteled valad chay aval im hippila en koshi linfalim afillu haya haddam shotet veored im hachavalim vehatztzaar yom kodem shetteled hare ze dam koshi vetahor aval im hitchil haddam kodem halleda betv yom o yeter hare ze dam ziva vahare hi yoledet bezov

Bamme devarim amurim beshello pasku hatztzirim vehachavalim vehatztzaar ella mitkashsha veholechet ad sheyyalda aval im raata dam shelosha yamim o yeter bime zivatah betzaar vachavalim ufasak lah hatztzaar veravach lah min hachavalim achar hashshelosha yamim veamda benachat shaot o yeter af al pi shello pasak haddam veaf al pi shechazar hatztzaar vehachavalim achar shaot hare zo zava sheillu haya haddam mechamat havalad lo pasak hatztzaar velo hachavalim veim yalda achare chen hare zo yoledet bezov

Raata yom echad belo tzaar ushnayim bekoshi veyalda o shenayim belo tzaar veom echad bekoshi veyalda o yom bekoshi veom belo tzaar veom bekoshi veyalda enah yoledet bezov aval im raata yom echad bekoshi ushnayim belo tzaar veyalda o shenayim bekoshi veechad belo tzaar veyalda o yom belo tzaar veom bekoshi veom belo tzaar veyalda hare zo yoledet bezov ze hakkelal koshi samuch lalleda en zo yoledet bezov shofi samuch lalleda hare zo yoledet bezov

Chal shelishi liriyyatah lihot beom halleda afillu kal hayyom kullo beshofi en zo yoledet bezov shehare yom halleda samuch lakkoshi raata shene yamim uvashshelishi hippila veen yadua ma hippila hare zo sefek yoledet usfek zava

Ketzad din yoledet bezov tzericha leshev shiva yamim nekiyyim vetovelet laerev veachar kach tihye mutteret levalah veachar kach yihye lah dam tohar umvia karban zava vekarban yoledet lefichach im yalda zachar afillu pasak haddam beom halleda soferet shivat yamim nekiyyim vetovelet veim yalda nekeva vesafra shiva nekiyyim veshalmu im shel leda o leacharehen hare zo tovelet umutteret levalah veim shalmu yeme hassefira betoch hare zo asura levalah ad lel

Ketzad hare sheraata dam shelosha vesafra shivat yamim nekiyyim hare asara vaadayin hi asura levalah ad lel shekkal hi kenidda velamma en matzrichin et hayyoledet bezov lisfirat shiva achar shiva shel zachar veachar shel nekeva mippene sheyeme ledatah vime niddatah sheenah roa bahen olin lah lisfirat shiva kemo sheyyitbaer

Yoledet bezov shello pasak damah en lah dam tohar ella kal dam shettire kedam ziva hu aval im safra shivat yamim nekiyyim veshalmu shel nekeva vetavla veachar kach raata dam betoch arbaim shel zachar ushmonim shel nekeva hare ze dam tohar

Safra shiva yamim nekiyyim velo tavla veachar kach raata dam hare zo tovelet umutteret levalah miyyad shekkal yeme tohar enan reuot lo lenidda velo leziva aval atzmo shel dam tame umtamme kedin dam hannidda ad shettitbol

Hayyoledet nekeva veachar shellah nitabbera vehitchil dam hakkoshi lavo lah betoch shemonim hare hu dam tohar af al pi sheen koshi linfalim shekkal damim shettire betoch yeme tohar tahor hu ad shettappil havalad uchshettappil tihye temea leda im hippila zachar tumat zachar veim hippila nekeva tumat nekeva umona yeme tuma vime melot mivalad sheni afillu hau teomim vehippila hayyom echad vehippila haacher afillu achar kamma yamim mona lashsheni yeme tuma vime melot

Zava sheppasak zovah vehitchila limnot shivat yamim nekiyyim uva lah dam koshi betoch yamim nekiyyim eno soter vime hakkoshi olim leminyan shiva vechen im yalda beshiva yamim nekiyyim en halleda soteret vime halleda olin lah leminyan shiva af al pi shehi temea bahen shenneemar veim tahara mizzovah kevan shettahara mizzovah af al pi shehi temea tuma acheret kegon tumat leda o tumat nidda o tumat tzaraat hare zo soferet bahen veen tumot ellu vechayyotze bahen sotrin hassefira

Yeme ledatah vime niddatah im lo raata bahen dam hare ellu olin lah lisfirat shivat yamim nekiyyim veim raata bahen dam en olin lah yeme hariyya velo sotrin kal hayyamim ella mashlemet al hayyamim shessafra kesheyyifsok haddam sheen soter hakkol ella reiyya shel zov aval ellu sotrin yoman bilvad

Meachar shettavin kal haikkarim shebbearnu yitbaer lecha ma sheamru chachamim sheefshar shettire haishsha dam min hammakor yom achar yom mea vearbaa asar yom velo tihye zava ketzad shenayim lifne niddatah veshiva yeme niddatah ushnayim leachar yeme niddatah vearbaa asar koshi ushmonim shel nekeva veshiva yeme nidda ushnayim achar yeme nidda ha lamadta shekkal dam shettire haishsha achar yom melot hu techillat niddatah veen mashgichin al vesatot shemmikkodem lefichach haroa dam besof yom melot ben hashshemashot hare zo sefek nidda shemma ballayela raata haddam shehu techillat yeme niddatah

Kevar bearnu shehannidda sheraata dam kal shiva mutteret leshammesh belel shemini achar shettitbol vezava ketanna meshammeret yom echad tahor vetovelet umutteret leshammesh laerev vezava gedola soferet shivat yamim nekiyyim vetovelet umutteret leshammesh belel shemini veen ben zeman nidda lenidda ella achad asar yom bilvad uvotan haachad asar tihye zava ketanna o gedola

Umeachar shettihye zocher kal ellu haikkarim yitbaer lecha ze sheamru chachamim haishsha shehuchzeka kal yameha yom tire dam veom lo tire battechilla meshammeshet belel shemini uvom shemini shehu yom echad achar yeme niddatah umshammeshet bechal yom arbaa lelot bilvad veenah yechola leshammesh bayyamim hattehorim shehayyom hattahor hu shomer layyom hattame lefichach im hayeta roa haddam bechal yom tame mittechillat hallayela enah meshammeshet ella bashshemini bilvad shehu yom echad achar yeme niddatah
Hayeta roa shene yamim temein ushne yamim tehorim meshammeshet bashshemini uvashshenem asar uvachamishsha asar uvaesrim

Hayeta roa shelosha yamim temein ushlosha tehorin meshammeshet shene yamim mehashshelosha hattehorin sheachar yeme niddatah shehaechad mehen shamur lashshenayim hattemein hassemuchin leniddatah veshuv enah meshammeshet leolam shehare huchzeka zava gedola veen lah shivat yamim nekiyyim
Hayeta roa arbaa yamim temeim vearbaa yamim tehorin meshammeshet yom echad sheachar niddatah veshuv enah meshammeshet leolam
Hayeta roa chamishsha yamim temeim vachamishsha yamim tehorim meshammeshet hashshelosha hassemuchim leniddatah veshuv enah meshammeshet leolam
Hayeta roa shishsha yamim temein veshishsha yamim tehorin meshammeshet bachamishsha yamim hassemuchim leniddatah techilla veshuv enah meshammeshet leolam

Hayeta roa shiva temein veshiva tehorin meshammeshet hashshavua harishon hattahor hassamuch leniddatah veyavo acharav shavua tame tikkava bo zava vehashshavua hattahor sheyyavo acharav lisfira vaasura leshammesh bo nimtzet shello shimmesha mittatah bearbaa shavuot ella shavua echad vechal yameha meshammeshet shemona asar yom bechal shemona asar shavuot ketzad shavua chamishi hare hi zava shavua shishshi shehi bo tehora lisfira shavua shevii zava shavua shemini lisfira shavua teshii shehi roa bo chamishsha yamim mimmennu mime nidda ushnayim mittechillat yeme ziva meshammeret yom echad min hashshavua haasiri hattahor umshammeshet shishsha shavua achad asar shehi roa bo shenayim missof yeme zovah vachamishsha mittechillat yeme nidda umshammeshet chamishsha yamim mishshavua shenem asar hattahor shavua zava veshavua lisfira vechen shavua zava shavua lisfira veshavua zava veshavua lisfira vesoferet al derech zo leolam nimtzeta omer shebbechal shavuot meshammeshet yom veillu lo era lah choli ze vehayeta shavua nidda ve yom tehora hayeta meshammeshet bechal hach shavuot shavuot shehen shiva veshivim yom
Uvizman shehi roa shavua tame veshavua tahor meshammeshet yom shehem kemo revia hayyamim vezo hi sheamru chachamim meshammeshet revia yameha

Hayeta roa shemona yamim tame ushmona yamim tahor hare zo meshammeshet yom mittoch yamim ketzad shemona tame shebbattechilla shiva mehen yeme niddatah veom echad zivut samuch leniddatah meshammeret lo yom echad min hashshemona hattehorin umshammeshet shiva veachar kach yavou lah shemona temein mehen shenayim tashlum yeme zivatah veshishsha mime niddatah veyavou shemona tehorin yom echad mehen tashlum yeme niddatah umshammeshet shiva sheniyyot veachar kach yavou lah shemona temeim mehen arbaa tashlum yeme zivatah vearbaa mime niddatah nimtzet zava gedola utzricha sefirat shiva yavou lah shemona tehorim soferet mehen shiva umshammeshet yom echad nimtzet meshammeshet yom bechal

Hayeta roa tisha yamim temeim vettisha yamim tehorin meshammeshet shemona yamim bechal yom leolam ketzad tisha hattemeim shiva mehen niddatah ushnayim zivut samuch leniddatah meshammeret lahen yom echad min hattisha hattehorin umshammeshet shemona vechen leolam

Hayeta roa asara yamim tame vaasara tahor umeasara ulmala afillu elef yom tame veelef yom tahor yihye yeme shimmushah keminyan zivatah ketzad asara hattemeim mehem shiva nidda ushlosha ziva asara hattehorim soferet mehen shiva umshammeshet shelosha nimtzeu yeme hashshimmush shelosha vime hazzavut shelosha vechen mea yom temein umea tehorin umea hattemein shiva mehen lenidda vetzg zivut hammea hattehorin shiva mehen lisfira leshimmush vechen elef vechen kal minyan uminyan al derech zo
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 8: Yesh ishsha sheyyesh lah veset veyesh ishsha sheen lah veset ella lo targish beatzmah ad sheyyetze haddam veen lah yom kavua liriyyatah vezehu sheyyesh lah veset hi sheyyesh lah yom kavua o meesrim yom leesrim yom o michd yom lechd yom o pachot o yoter

Vekodem sheyyavo haddam targish beatzmah mefaheket umitatteshet vechosheshet pi keresah veshippule meeha veyistammer saarat besarah o yecham besarah vechayyotze bimoraot ellu veyavou lah vesatot ellu o echad mehen beshaa hakkevua lah miyyom vestah

Kevar bearnu shekkal ishsha sheen lah veset asura leshammesh ad shettivdok atzmah techilla vesheyyesh lah veset asura leshammesh bechal onat haveset im vestah bayyom asura leshammesh kal oto hayyom veim vestah ballayela asura leshammesh kal oto hallayela umittechillat yom haveset tispor yeme niddatah vime zivatah leolam

Lefichach tzerichot hannashim lehizzaher bivesatot ad shetteda hayyom vehashshaa shennikbea bah vestah haya darkah lirot beom esrim uva yom esrim velo raata uva yom shelosha veesrim veraata hare yom esrim veom shelosha veesrim shenehen asurin vechen im raata paam sheniyya beom velo raata beom esrim adayin shenehen asurin raata paam shelishit beom shelosha veesrim velo raata beom esrim tahar yom esrim veneekar haveset leom shelosha veesrim sheen haishsha kovaat veset ad shettikbaennu shalosh peamim veenah mittaheret min haveset ad shetteaker mimmenna shalosh peamim

Kal veset shennikba mechamat ones afillu raata bo kamma peamim eno veset shemmippene haones raata kaftza veraata kaftza veraata kava lah veset leyamim belo kefitzot ketzad kaftza beechad beshabbat veraata dam ulachar esrim yom kaftza beechad beshabbat veraata dam ulachar kaftza beom hashshabbat velo raata dam ulachar shabbat raata belo kefitza hare nikba echad beshabbat achar esrim shehare noda shehayyom garam lah lirot velo hakkefitza uchvar nikba yom ze shalosh peamim vechen kal kayyotze baze

Raata yom bechodesh ze veom bechodesh shel acharav veom bechodesh shel acharav veom lechodesh shel acharav hare kava lah veset ledillug ba chodesh revii veraata beom adayin lo nikba lah veset vechal yom sheraata bo chosheshet lo lehabba kevan sheyyaggia oto hayyom velo tire tahar oto hayyom min haveset sheen tzarich akirat shalosh peamim ella yom shennikba shalosh peamim
Haya darkah lihot roa yom veshinneta letz shenehem asurin shinneta lez huttar veneesar vetv beissuro omed shinneta lech neesar vehutteru kullam

Haya darkah lirot yom esrim veshinneta leom shenehem asurin higgia esrim velo raata veraata adayin shenehen asurin higgia yom esrim veraata tahar yom shehare chazra levestah hakkavua veneekar mippene shello nikba shalosh peamim

En haishsha kovaat lah veset betoch yeme niddatah sheraata bahen kevan sheraata yom echad enah kovaat lah veset bechal hashshiva vechen en haishsha kovaat veset bime zivatah shehen achad asar yom aval kovaat hi veset bime niddatah sheenah roa bahen veim nikba lah veset bime zivatah hare zo chosheshet levestah vechal veset shekkava bime zivatah im neekra afillu paam achat neekra veenah tzericha leheaker shalosh peamim shechezkat damim mesullakin hen leyamim ellu

Ketzad chosheshet leveset im raata dam beveset zo afillu yom echad teshev leniddatah missafek vaasura leshammesh beoto hayyom vaafillu lo raata bishar yeme havvesatot veim raata shelosha yamim hare zo zava

Kal ishsha shemmarba livdok atzmah tamid hare zo meshubbachat veaf al pi sheyyesh lah veset kevua sheefshar sheyyavo dam belo sheat haveset vechal yom shel yeme zivatah hare hi bahen bechezkat tahora veenah tzericha bedika aval achar yeme zivatah tzericha livdok
Shachcha velo badka ben beones ben beratzon hare zo bechezkat tahora ad shettivdok vetimmatze temea

Haishsha shello badka atzmah bishat vestah ulachar yamim badka umatza tame af al pi shehi temea lemafrea ad sheat vestah kemo sheyyitbaer beinyan tuma vetahora hare zo enah metammea et boalah lemafrea veenah mona ella mishshaa sheraata dam veim matza atzmah tehora hare zo bechezkat tehora
Vechen ishsha sheraata dam mechamat makka sheyyesh lah bammakor af al pi sheraata bishat vestah hi tehora vehaddam tahor shehavvesatot middivrehem kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot metammee mishkav umoshav
Hassuma bodeket atzmah umara lachavertah aval hachereshet vehashshota tzerichot pikchot livdok otan velikboa lahen vesatot veachar kach yihu muttarot levalehen

Kal ishsha shettaata velo yada et vestah veraata dam chosheshet lezivut lefichach im raata yom echad o shenayim yoshevet tashlum shiva shemma dam ze bime niddatah hi veim raata shelosha yamim soferet shivat yamim nekiyyim shemma bime zivatah hi omedet

Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 11: Kal sheamarnu benidda vezava veoledet hu din tora uchmishpatim ellu hau osin keshehau bet din haggadol metzuyin vehau sham chachamim gedolim shemmakkirim haddamim veim nolad lahem safek biriyyot o bime nidda veziva yaalu levet din veyishalu kemo shehivticha tora alehen shenneemar ki yippale mimmecha davar lammishpat ben dam ledam ben din ledin ben dam nidda ledam ziva uvotan hayyamim hau benot yisrael nizharot middavar ze umshammerot vistotehen vesofrot tamid yeme hannidda vime hazziva

Vetorach gadol yesh beminyan hayyamim ufamim rabbot yavou lide safek sheafillu raata habbat dam beom halleda meoto hayyom matchilin limnot lah yeme nidda vime ziva kemo shebbearnu ulfichach lo tittame habbat beziva ella bat asara yamim sheim raata bayyom shennolda hare zo nidda shivat yamim ushloshet yamim samuch leniddatah hare asara yamim hinne lamadta shemmittechillat reiyya matchelet limnot yeme nidda vime ziva kal yameha vaafillu raata vehi ketanna

Uvime chachme haggemara nistappek haddavar harbe biriyyat haddamim venitkalkelu havvesatot lefi shello haya koach bechal hannashim limnot yeme nidda vime ziva lefichach hechmiru chachamim bedavar ze vegazru sheyehu kal yeme haishsha kime zivatah veyihye kal dam shettire sefek dam zivut

Veod hechemiru benot yisrael al atzman chumra yetera al ze venahagu kullam bechal makom sheyyesh yisrael shekkal bat yisrael sheroa dam afillu lo raata ella tippa kechardal bilvad ufasak haddam soferet lah shiva yamim nekiyyim vaafillu raata beet niddatah ben sheraata yom echad o shenayim o hashshiva kullan o yeter mishsheyyifsok haddam soferet shivat yamim nekiyyim kezava gedola vetovelet belel shemini af al pi shehi sefek zava o beom shemini im haya sham dochak kemo sheamarnu veachar kach tihye mutteret levalah

Vechen kal hayyoledet bazzeman hazze hare hi keoledet bezov utzricha shivat yamim nekiyyim kemo shebbearnu uminhag pashut beshinar uveretz hatztzevi uvisfarad uvammaarav sheim raata dam betoch yeme melot af al pi sheraata achar shessafra shivat yamim nekiyyim vetavla hare zo soferet shivat yamim nekiyyim achar sheyyifsok haddam veen notnin lah yeme tohar kelal ella kal dam shettire haishsha ben dam koshi ben dam tohar hakkol tame vesoferet shivat yamim nekiyyim achar sheyyifsok haddam

Vedin ze bime haggeonim nitchaddesh vehem gazru shello yihye sham dam tohar kelal shezze shehechmiru al atzman bime chachme haggemara eno ella beroa dam shehu tame sheyyoshevet alav shiva nekiyyim aval dam shettire bime tohar achar sefira utvila en lachush lo sheen yeme tohar reuyin lo lenidda velo leziva kemo shebbearnu
Veshamanu shebbetzarfat boalim al dam tohar kedin haggemara ad hayyom achar sefira utvila mittumat yoledet bezov vedavar ze taluy bamminhag

Vechen din dam betulim bazzeman hazze sheafillu hayeta ketanna shello higgia zemanna lirot velo raata dam miyyameha boel beilat mitzva uforesh vechal zeman shettire haddam mechamat hammakka hare hi temea veachar sheyyifsok haddam soferet shiva yamim nekiyyim

Yeter al ze kal bat shettevauha lehinnase veratzta shoha shivat yamim nekiyyim meachar sheratzta veachar kach tihye mutteret lehibbael shemma mechimmudah leish raata dam tippa achat velo hirgisha bah ben shehayeta haishsha gedola ben shehayeta ketanna tzericha leshev shiva nekiyyim meachar sheratzta veachar kach titbol vetibbael

Vechal haddevarim haellu chumra yetera shennahagu bah benot yisrael mime chachme haggemara veen lasur mimmenna leolam lefichach kal ishsha sheratzta keshettevauha lehinnase lo tinnase ad shettispor vetitbol veim nisset letalmid chacham mutteret lehinnase miyyad vetispor meachar shennesaattu vetitbol shettalmid chacham yodea shehi asura venizhar mizze velo yikrav lah ad shettitbol

Din hakketamim bazzeman hazze kemo shebbearnu veen baddavar chiddush velo minhag ella kal ketem sheamarnu shehi tehora hare hi tehora vechal ketem sheamarnu temea im en bakketem shiur kede lachush lezivut soferet shivat yamim miyyom shennimtza bo hakketem veim haya shiur hakketem kede lachush lezivut soferet shivat yamim meachar yom shennimtza bo hakketem sheen haroa dam keroa ketem

Vechen kal ma sheamarnu beoledet sheimmo tehora hare hi tehora bazzeman hazze vechen haishsha sheraata loven o dam yarok o shehishlicha chaticha adumma sheen immah dam hare hi tehora af bazzeman hazze shello hechmiru ella beroa dam tame veen ze dam tame

Vechen im hayeta bah makka vehaya haddam shotet mimmenna o shebba haddam im meme raglayim hare zo tehora velo nitchaddesh davar ella sefirat shivat yamim nekiyyim lechal roa dam tame kemo sheamarnu vesheyyihu kal mare damim temeim

Ze shettimtza bemiktzat hammekomot shehannidda yoshevet shivat yamim beniddatah af al pi shello raata dam ella yom echad veachar hashshiva teshev shivat yamim nekiyyim en ze minhag ella taut hu mimmi shehora lahem kach veen rauy lifnot ledavar ze kelal ella im raata yom echad soferet acharav shiva nekiyyim vetovelet belel shemini shehu layil sheni shelleachar niddatah umutteret levalah

Vechen ze shettimtza bemiktzat mekomot vetimtza teshuvot lemiktzat haggeonim sheyyoledet zachar lo teshammesh mittatah ad sof arbaim veoledet nekeva achar shemonim veaf al pi shello raata dam ella betoch hashshiva en ze minhag ella taut hu beotan hatteshuvot vederech eppikorosut beotan hammekomot umin hatztzedokin lamdu davar ze umitzva lechofan kede lehotzi millibban ulhachaziran ledivre chachamim shettispor shiva yamim nekiyyim bilvad kemo shebbearnu

En haishsha ola mittumatah veotzet mide erva ad shettitbol beme mikve kasher velo yihye davar chotzetz ben besarah uven hammayim uvhilchot mikvaot yitbaer hammikve hakkasher vehappasul vederech hattevila umishpete hachatzitza aval im rachatza bammerchatz afillu naflu aleha kal memot shebbaolam hare hi achar harchitza kemot shehayeta kodem harchitza becharet sheen lecha davar shemmaale mittuma letahora ella tevila beme mikve o bemaayan o bayyammim shehem kemaayan kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot mikvaot

Kal shiva yamim nekiyyim shebbazzeman hazze af al pi shehen safek im tavla bahen keillu lo tavla veim tavla bashshevii af al pi sheasur laasot ken lechattechilla shemma yavo livol bashshevii achar hattevila hoil vetavla bizmannah afillu hayeta zava vaddait hare zo alta lah tevila

Veasur leadam sheyyidbak beishto beshivat yamim nekiyyim ellu veaf al pi shehi bichsutah vehu bichsuto velo yikrav lah velo yigga bah afillu beetzba ketanna velo yochal immah bikara achat kelalo shel davar yinhog immah bime sefira kemo sheyyinhog bime nidda sheadayin hi becharet ad shettitbol kemo shebbearnu

Kal melachot shehaishsha osa levalah nidda osa levalah chutz meharchatzat panav yadav veraglav umzigat hakkos vehatztzaat hammitta befanav gezera shemma yavo lidvar avera umippene ze lo tochal immo bikara achat velo yigga bivsarah mippene hergel avera vechen beshivat yamim nekiyyim lo taase lo shalosh melachot ellu umuttar leishsha lehitkashshet bime niddatah kede shello titganne al balah
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 12: Yisrael shebbaal akkum mishshear haummot derech ishut o yisreelit shennivala leakkum derech ishut hare ellu lokin min hattora shenneemar lo titchatten bam bittecha lo titten livno uvitto lo tikkach livnecha echad shiva amamin veechad kal ummot beissur ze vechen meforash al yede ezra vaasher lo nitten benotenu leamme haaretz veet benotehem lo nikkach levanenu

Velo asra tora ella derech chatnut aval habba al hakkutit derech zenut makkin oto makkat mardut middivre sofrim gezera shemma yavo lehitchatten veim yichadah lo biznut chayyav aleha mishshum nidda umishshum shifcha umishshum kutit umishshum zona veim lo yichadah lo ella nikret mikre eno chayyav ella mishshum kutit vechal chiyyuvin ellu middivrehen
Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya habboel yisrael aval kohen habba al hakkutit loke min hattora mishshum zona veechad zona kutit veechad zona yisreelit uvivila bilvad loke shehare enah bat kiddushin

Kal habboel kutit ben derech chatnut ben derech zenut im bealah befarhesya vehu sheyyivol leene asara miyyisrael o yeter im pagu bo kannain vaharaguhu hare ellu meshubbachin uzrizin vedavar ze halacha lemoshe missinay hu reaya ledavar ze maase pinchas bezimri

Veen hakkannay rashshay lifgoa bahen ella bishat maase kezimri shenneemar veet haishsha el kovatah aval im perash en horgin oto veim harago neherag alav veim ba hakkannay littol reshut mibbet din lehargo en morin lo veaf al pi shehu bishat maase velo od ella im ba hakkannay laharog et habboel venishmat habboel veharag hakkannay kede lehatztzil atzmo miyyado en habboel neherag alav vehabba al bat ger toshav en hakkannain pogim bo aval makkin oto makkat mardut

Lo pagu bo kannaim velo hilkuhu bayit din hare ansho meforash bedivre kabbala shehu becharet shenneemar ki chillel yehuda kodesh Adonai asher ahev uvaal bat el nechar yachret Adonai laish asher yaasenna er veone im yisrael hu lo yihye lo er bachachamim velo one battalmidim veim kohen hu lo yihye lo maggish mincha la tzevaot hinne lamadta shehabboel kutit keillu nitchatten leakkum shenneemar vaal bat el nechar venikra mechallel kodesh Adonai

Aon ze af al pi sheen bo mitat bet din al yehi kal beenecha ella yesh bo hefsed sheen bechal haaraot kemoto shehabben min haerva beno hu lechal davar uvichlal yisrael nechshav af al pi shehu mamzer vehabben min hakkutit eno beno shenneemar ki yasir et bincha meacharay mesir oto millihot achare Adonai
Vedavar ze gorem lehiddavek beakkum shehivdilanu hakkadosh baruch hu mehem velashuv meachare Adonai velimol bo
Akkum habba al bat yisrael im eshet ish hi neherag aleha veim penuya hi eno neherag

Aval yisrael habba al hakkutit ben ketanna bat shalosh shanim veom echad ben gedola ben penuya ben eshet ish vaafillu haya katan ben tesha shanim veom echad kevan shebba al hakkutit bezadon hare zo nehereget mippene shebba leyisrael takkala al yadeha kivhema vedavar ze meforash battora shenneemar hen henna hau livne yisrael bidvar bilam vechal ishsha yodaat ish lemishkav zachar harogu

Haavadim shehitbilu otam leshem avdut vekibbelu alehem mitzot shehaavadim chayyavim bahem yatzu mikkelal haakkum velichlal yisrael lo bau lefichach hashshifcha asura leven chorin echad shifchato veechad shifchat chavero vehabba al hashshifcha makkin oto makkat mardut middivre sofrim shehare meforash battora shehaadon noten shifcha kenaanit leavdo haivri vehi mutteret lo shenneemar im adonav yitten lo ishsha
Velo gazru chachamim bedavar ze velo chiyeva tora malkot beshifcha ella im ken hayeta necherefet leish kemo shebbearnu

Al yehi aon ze kal beenecha mippene sheen bo malkot min hattora sheggam ze gorem labben lasur meachare Adonai shehabben min hashshifcha hu eved veeno miyyisrael venimtza gorem lezera hakkodesh lehitchallel velihotam avadim hare unkelos hamtargem kalal beilat eved veshifcha bichlal lo yihye kadesh velo tihye kedesha
Habba al shifcha vaafillu befarhesya uvishat avera en hakkannain pogin bo vechen im lakach shifcha derech chatnut eno loke min hattora shemmeet shettavla vekibbela mitzot yatzta mikkelal haakkum

Nitarev velad yisreelit bivelad shifcha hare shenehen safek vechal echad mehen sefek eved vechofin baal hashshifcha umshachrer et shenehem veim haya habben hahu ben haadon shel eved kesheyyigdelu yeshachreru ze et ze veyihu muttarin lavo bakkahal

Hau hattaarovot banot hare shettehen sefek shefachot vehabba al kal achat mehen havalad sefek eved vechen im nitarev velad akkum bivelad yisreelit matbilim et shenehen leshem gerut vechal achat mehen sefek giyyoret

Kal haakkum kullam kesheyyitgayeru vikabbelu alehen kal hammitzot shebbattora vehaavadim kesheyyishtachreru hare hen keyisrael lechal davar shenneemar hakkahal chukka achat yihye lachem umuttarin lehikkanes bikhal Adonai miyyad vehu sheyyissa hagger o hamshuchrar bat yisrael veyissa hayyisreeli giyyoret umshuchreret chutz mearbaa amamin bilvad vehem ammon umoav umitzrayim veedom shehaummot haellu kesheyyitgayyer echad mehen hare hu keyisrael lechal davar ella leinyan bia bakkahal

Vechetzad dinan ammon umoav issuran issur olam zecharim velo nekevot shenneemar lo yavo ammoni umoavi bikhal Adonai vego halacha lemoshe missinay shehaammoni hazzachar vehammoavi hazzachar hu sheasur leolam lissa bat yisrael afillu ben beno ad sof haolam aval ammonit umoavit mutteret miyyad kishar haummot
Mitzri veedomi echad zecharim veechad nekevot dor rishon vedor sheni asurin lavo beyisrael vedor shelishi muttar shenneemar banim asher yivaldu lahem vego
Mitzrit meubberet shennitgayera benah sheni mitzri sheni shennasa mitzrit rishona o mitzri rishon shennasa mitzrit sheniyya havalad sheni shenneemar banim asher yivaldu lahem hakkatuv telaan beleda
Ger ammoni shennasa mitzrit havalad ammoni ger mitzri shennasa ammonit havalad mitzri ze hakkelal baummot hallech achar hazzachar nitgayeru hallech achar happachut

Mi shennitgayyer mishshiva amamin enan asurin min hattora lavo bakkahal vehaddavar yadua shello nitgayeru mehen ella haggivonim vihoshua gazar alehem sheyyihu asurim lavo bakkahal echad zecharim veechad nekevot velo asar otam ella bizman sheyyesh mikdash shenneemar vechotve etzim veshoave mayim levet elohay tala harchakatam bammikdash

Vehem hannikraim netinim lefi shennetanam laavodat hammikdash ba david vegazar alehem shello yikkansu bakkahal leolam vaafillu bizman sheen mikdash vechen meforash beezra umin hannetinim shennatan david vehassarim laavodat halviyyim ha lamadta shello tala otam bammikdash
Velamma gazar alehem hu uvet dino lefi sheraa azzut veachzariyyut shehayeta bahem beet shebbikkeshu shivat bene shaul bechir Adonai litlotam vaharagum velo richamu alehem

Kesheala sancheriv melech ashshur bilbel kal haummot veervam ze baze vehigla otam mimmekomam veellu hammitzrim shebbeeretz mitzrayim atta anashim acherim hem vechen haedomim shebbisde edom vehoil venitarvu arba ummot haasurim bechal ummot haolam shehen muttarim huttar hakkol shekkal happoresh mehen lehitgayyer chezkato shepperash min harov lefichach kesheyyitgayyer hagger bazzeman hazze bechal makom ben edomi ben mitzri ben ammoni ben moavi ben kushi ben shear haummot echad hazzecharim veechad hannekevot muttarin lavo bakkahal miyyad
