Mila hayeta bemitzrayim shenneemar vechal arel lo yochal bo mal otam moshe rabbenu shekkullam bittelu berit mila bemitzrayim chutz mishshevet levi veal ze neemar uvritcha yintzoru
Utvila hayeta bammidbar kodem mattan tora shenneemar vekiddashtam hayyom umachar vechibbesu simlotam vekarban shenneemar vayyishlach et naare bene yisrael vayyaalu olot al yede kal yisrael hikrivum

Vechen ledorot kesheyyirtze haakkum lehikkanes livrit ulhistofef tachat kanfe hashshechina vikabbel alav ol tora tzarich mila utvila vehartzaat karban veim nekeva hi tevila vekarban shenneemar kachem kagger ma attem bemila utvila vehartzaat karban af hagger ledorot bemila utvila vehartzaat karban
Umahu karban hagger olat behema o shette torim o shene bene yona ushnehem ola uvazzeman hazze sheen sham karban tzarich mila utvila uchsheyyibbane bet hammikdash yavi karban

Ger shemmal velo taval o taval velo mal eno ger ad sheyyamul veyitbol vetzarich litbol bifne shelosha vehoil vehaddavar tzarich bet din en matbilin oto beshabbat velo beom tov velo ballayela veim hitbiluhu hare ze ger

Ger katan matbilin oto al daat bet din shezzechut hi lo meubberet shennitgayera vetavla en benah tzarich tevila taval beno leven atzmo venitgayyer beno leven atzmo vaafillu bifne shenayim eno ger ba veamar nitgayyarti bevet dino shel peloni vehitbiluni eno neeman lavo bakkahal ad sheyyavi edim
Haya nasuy leyisreelit o legiyyoret veyesh lo banim veamar nitgayyarti beni leven atzmi neeman lifsol et atzmo veeno neeman lifsol et habbanim vechozer vetovel bevet din

Giyyoret sherinuha noheget bedarche yisrael tamid kegon shettitbol leniddatah vetafrish teruma meissatah vechayyotze baze vechen ger shennoheg bedarche yisrael shettovel lekiro veose kal hammitzot hare ellu bechezkat gere tzedek veaf al pi sheen sham edim shemmeidin lifne mi shennitgayeru veaf al pi chen im bau lehitarev beyisrael en massiin otam ad sheyyaviu edim o ad sheyyitbelu befanenu hoil vehuchzeku akkum

Aval mi shebba veamar shehaya akkum venitgayyer bevet din neeman shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael uvotan hayyamim shechezkat hakkol sham bechezkat yisrael aval bechutza laaretz tzarich lehavi reaya veachar kach yissa yisreelit vaani omer shezzo maala beuchasin

Keshem shemmalin umatbilin et haggerim kach malin umatbilin et haavadim hannilkachim min haakkum leshem avdut hallokeach eved min haakkum vekadam haeved vetaval leshem ben chorin kana atzmo vehu sheyyomar beet tevila hareni tovel bifnechem leshem gerut veim taval bifne rabbo eno tzarich lefaresh ella kevan shettaval nishtachrer lefichach tzarich rabbo letakpo bammayim ad sheyyaale vehu tachat shibudo umodio bifne haddayyanin shelleshem avdut matbilo veen haeved tovel ella bifne shelosha uvayyom keger shemmiktzat gerut hu

Kesheyyishtachrer haeved tzarich tevila acheret bifne shelosha bayyom shebbo tiggamer geruto veyihye keyisrael veen tzarich lekabbel alav mitzot ulhodio ikkere haddat shekkevar hodiuhu keshettaval leshem avdut
Uvmikve hakkasher litvilat nidda sham matbilin et haggerim veet haavadim veet hamshuchrarim vechal davar shechotzetz benidda chotzetz begerim uvaavadim uvimshuchrarim

Al yaale al datecha sheshshimshon hammoshia et yisrael o shelomo melech yisrael shennikra yedid Adonai nasu nashim nachriyyot begeutan ella sod haddavar kach hu shehammitzva hannechona kesheyyavo hagger o haggiyyoret lehitgayyer bodkin acharav shemma biglal mamon sheyyittol o bishvil serara sheyyizke lah o mippene happachad ba lehikkanes laddat veim ish hu bodkin acharav shemma enav natan beishsha yehudit veim ishsha hi bodkin shemma eneha natna bevachur mibbachure yisrael im lo nimtza lahem illa modiin otan koved ol hattora vetorach sheyyesh baasiyyatah al amme haaratzot kede sheyyifroshu im kibbelu velo pershu verau otan shechazru meahava mekabbelim otan shenneemar vattere ki mitammetzet hi lalechet ittah vattechdal ledabber eleha

Lefichach lo kibbelu bet din gerim kal yeme david ushlomo bime david shemma min happachad chazru uvime shelomo shemma bishvil hammalchut vehattova vehaggedulla shehau bah yisrael chazru shekkal hachozer min haakkum bishvil davar mehavle haolam eno miggere hatztzedek veaf al pi chen hau gerim harbe mitgayerim bime david ushlomo bifne hedotot vehau bet din haggadol choshshin lahem lo dochin otan achar shettavlu mikkal makom velo mekarvin otan ad shetterae acharitam

Ulfi sheggiyyer shelomo nashim unsaan vechen shimshon giyyer venasa vehaddavar yadua shello chazru ellu ella bishvil davar velo al pi bet din giyerum chashavan hakkatuv keillu hen akkum uvissuran omdin veod shehochiach sofan al techillatan shehen ovdot kochavim umazzalot shellahen uvanu lahen bamot veheela alav hakkatuv keillu hu benaan shenneemar az yivne shelomo bama

Ger shello badku acharav o shello hodiuhu hammitzot veanshan umal vetaval bifne shelosha hedotot hare ze ger afillu noda shebbishvil davar hu mitgayyer hoil umal vetaval yatza mikkelal haakkum vechoshshin lo ad sheyyitbaer tzidkuto vaafillu chazar veavad avoda zara hare hu keyisrael mumar shekkiddushav kiddushin umitzva lehachazir avedato meachar shettaval naasa keyisrael ulfichach kiyemu shimshon ushlomo neshotehen veaf al pi shennigla sodan

Umippene ze amru chachamim kashim lahem gerim leyisrael kenega tzaraat sherubban chozrin bishvil davar umatin et yisrael vekashe haddavar lifrosh mehem achar shennitgayeru tze ulmad ma era bammidbar bemaase haegel uvkivrot hattaava vechen rov hannisonot haasafsuf hau bahen techilla
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 14: Ketzad mekabbelin gere hatztzedek kesheyyavo echad lihitgayyer min haakkum veyivdeku acharav velo yimtzeu illa omrim lo ma raita shebbata lehitgayyer i atta yodea sheyyisrael bazzeman hazze deuyim udchufim umsuchafin umtorafin veyissurin bain alehen im amar ani yodea veeni keday mekabbelin oto miyyad

Umodiin oto ikkere haddat shehu yichud hashshem veissur akkum umaarichin baddavar hazze umodiin oto miktzat mitzot kallot umiktzat mitzot chamurot veen maarichin bedavar ze umodiin oto aon leket shichcha ufea umaaser sheni umodiin oto anshan shel mitzot ketzad omrim lo heve yodea shead shello bata ledat zo im achalta chelev i atta anush karet im chillalta shabbat i atta anush sekila veachshav achar shettitgayyer im achalta chelev atta anush karet im chillalta shabbat atta anush sekila veen marbin alav veen medakdekin alav shemma yigrom letardo ulhattoto midderech tova lederech raa shebbattechilla en moshchin et haadam ella bedivre ratzon verakkim vechen hu omer bechavle adam emshechem veachar kach baavotot ahava

Uchshem shemmodiin oto anshan shel mitzot kach modiin oto secharan shel mitzot umodiin oto shebbaasiyyat mitzot ellu yizke lechayye haolam habba vesheen shum tzaddik gamur ella baal hachachma sheose mitzot ellu veodan

Veomrim lo heve yodea shehaolam habba eno tzafun ella latztzaddikim vehem yisrael veze shettire yisrael betzaar baolam hazze tova hi tzefuna lahem sheenan yecholin lekabbel rov tova baolam hazze kaummot shemma yarum libbam veyitu veyafsidu sechar haolam habba kainyan shenneemar vayyishman yeshurun vayyivat

Veen hakkadosh baruch hu mevi alehen rov puranut kede shello yovdu ella kal haakkum kalin vehen omdin umaarichin baddavar hazze kede lechabbevan im chazar bo velo ratza lekabbel holech ledarko veim kibbel en mashhin oto ella malin oto miyyad veim haya mahul mattifin mimmennu dam berit umashhim oto ad sheyyitrappe refua shelema veachar kach matbilin oto

Ushlosha omdin al gabbav umodiin oto miktzat mitzot kallot umiktzat mitzot chamurot paam sheniyya vehu omed bammayim veim hayeta ishsha nashim moshivot otah bammayim ad tzavarah vehaddayyanin mibbachutz umodiin otah miktzat mitzot kallot vachamurot vehi yoshevet bammayim veachar kach tovelet bifnehem vehen machzirin penehen veotzin kede shello yiru otah keshettaale min hammayim

E ze hu ger toshav ze akkum shekkibbel alav shello yaavod avoda zara im shear hammitzot shennitztauu bene noach velo mal velo taval hare ze mekabbelin oto vehu mechaside ummot haolam velamma nikra shemo toshav lefi shemmuttar lanu lehoshivo benenu beeretz yisrael kemo shebbearnu behilchot akkum
Veen mekabbelin ger toshav ella bizman shehayyovel noheg aval bazzeman hazze afillu kibbel alav kal hattora kullah chutz middikduk echad en mekabbelin oto

Haeved hannilkach min haakkum en omrin lo ma raita shebbata ella omrim lo retzoncha shettikkanes lichlal avde yisrael vetihye min hakkesherim o lo im ratza modiin lo ikkere haddat umiktzat mitzot kallot vachamurot veanshan uscharan kemo shemmodiin et hagger umatbilin oto keger umodiin oto keshehu bammayim veim lo ratza lekabbel megalgelin alav kal shenem asar chodesh umochro leakkum veasur lekayemo yoter al ken veim hitna alav mittechilla shello yamul velo yitbol ella yihye ger toshav muttar lekayemo baavodato keshehu ger toshav veen mekayemin eved kaze ella bizman hayyovel
Haakkum en asurim alehem mishshum erva ella immo veeshet aviv vaachoto meimmo veeshet ish vezachar uvhema kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot melachim umilchamotehen aval shear araot muttarin lahen

Akkum shennitgayyer veeved shennishtachrer hare hu kekatan shennolad vechal sheer basar shehau lo keshehu akkum o keshehu eved enan sheer basar veim nitgayyer hu vehem eno chayyav al achat mehem mishshum erva kelal

Din tora shemmuttar leakkum sheyyissa immo o achoto meimmo shennitgayeru aval chachamim asru davar ze kede shello yomru banu mikkedushsha chamura likdushsha kalla sheemesh hayeta lo zo asura vehayyom mutteret vechen ger shebba al immo o achoto vehi begeutah hare ze keva al hannachrit

Ketzad din haggerim baaraot shel sheer basar im haya nasuy keshehu akkum leimmo o laachoto venitgayeru mafrishin otan kemo shebbearnu veim haya nasuy lishar araot venitgayyer hu veishto en mafrishin otan ger asur bisher haem achar shennitgayyer middivre sofrim umuttar bisher haav af al pi sheyyodea bevadday shezze sheero meaviv kegon teomim sheddavar barur sheaviv shel ze hu aviv shel ze af al pi chen lo gazru al sheer aviv lefichach nose hagger eshet achiv meaviv veeshet achi aviv veeshet aviv veeshet beno af al pi shennisset leachiv o leaviv o laachi aviv o livno achar shennitgayeru vechen achot immo meaviha vaachoto meaviv uvitto shennitgayera mutteret lo aval eno nose lo achoto meimmo velo achot immo meimmah velo eshet achiv meimmo shennesaah achiv meimmo achar shennitgayyer aval im nesaah achiv keshehu akkum hare zo mutteret lo
Shene achim teomim shehayeta horatan shello bikdushsha veledatan bikdushsha chayyavin mishshum eshet ach

Hannose giyyoret uvittah haggiyyoret o shette achaot min haem yoshev im achat mehen umgaresh hashsheniyya nasa giyyoret umeta hare ze muttar lissa immah o bittah shello gazru ella bechayyehen umuttar leadam lissa shette achaot giyyorot min haav shello gazru bisher haav kemo shebbearnu
Hashsheniyyot kullan lo gazru alehen begerim lefichach muttar hagger lissa em immo venose adam giyyoret veem immah o bat bat bittah vechen bishar hashsheniyyot

Haeved muttar lissa immo keshehu eved veen tzarich lomar bitto vaachoto vechayyotze bahen shekkevar yatza mikkelal akkum veen haaraot haasurot al haakkum asurot alav velo ba lichlal yisrael kede sheyyeasru alav araot haasurot al haggerim
Veyerae li sheim ba haeved al hazzachur uvhema yeharegu sheissur shette araot ellu shave bechal haadam

Avadim shennishtachreru hare hen kegerim kal sheasur legerim asur lahen vechal hammuttar legerim muttar lahen noten adam shifchato leavdo o leeved chavero umoser shifcha achat lishne avadim lechattechilla veenan tzerichin shum davar ella hare hen kivhemot veshifcha shehi meyuchedet leeved o sheenah meyuchedet achat hi lefi sheen ishut ella leyisrael o leakkum al haakkum aval lo laavadim al haavadim velo laavadim al yisrael
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 15: E zehu mamzer haamur battora ze habba meerva min haaraot chutz min hannidda shehabben mimmenna pagum veeno mamzer aval habba al shear haaraot ben beones ben beratzon ben bezadon ben bishgaga havalad mamzer veechad zecharim veechad nekevot asurin leolam shenneemar gam dor asiri kelomar leolam

Echad mamzer shennasa yisreelit o yisreeli shennasa mamzeret kevan shebbaalu achar hakkiddushin lokin kiddesh velo baal eno loke baal velo kiddesh enan lokin mishshum mamzerut sheen lecha bechal chayyave lavin mi shelloke al beila belo kiddushin ella kohen gadol bealmana kemo sheyyitbaer hammachazir gerushato mishshennisset havalad kasher shehare enah erva

Akkum veeved habba al bat yisrael havalad kasher ben penuya ben beeshet ish ben beones ben beratzon akkum veeved habbaim al hammamzeret havalad mamzer umamzer habba al haakkum havalad akkum nitgayyer hare hu kasher kishar gerim veim ba al hashshifcha havalad eved shichrero havalad kasher kishar avadim meshuchrarin umuttar bevat yisrael

Ze hakkelal ben habba min haeved o min haakkum o min hashshifcha o min bat akkum hare hu keimmo veen mashgichin al haav lefi davar ze hittiru lemamzer lissa shifcha kede letaher et banav shehare hu meshachrer otam venimtzeu bene chorin velo gazru al hashshifcha lemamzer mippene takkanat habbanim
Mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin habba al eshet ish oto habben en lo takkana mippene shetztzad mamzerut vetzad kashrut meoravin bo lefichach asur beshifcha venimtzeu banav kemoto leolam

Akkum habba al hashshifcha shettavla hare ze eved veeved shettaval shebba al akkum havalad akkum hallech achar haem aval akkum habba al shifcha akkum o eved akkum shebba al akkum bat chorin hallech achar hazzachar
Mamzer muttar lissa giyyoret vechen hammamzeret mutteret leger vehabbanim mishshenehem mamzerim shehavalad holech achar happagum shenneemar bikhal Adonai ukhal gerim eno karuy kehal Adonai

Giyyoret shennisset leger veholidu ben af al pi shehorato veledato bikdushsha hare ze muttar bemamzeret vechen ben ben beno ad sheyyishtakka shem geruto mimmennu velo yivada shehu ger veachar kach yeaser bemamzeret veechad haggerim veechad haavadim meshuchrarin din echad lechullan
Ger shennasa bat yisrael o yisrael shennasa giyyoret havalad yisrael lechal davar veasur bemamzeret

Shelosha mamzerim hem mamzer vadday umamzer safek umamzer middivre sofrim e zehu mamzer vadday ze shebba min haerva havaddait kemo shebbearnu umamzer safek ze shebba missefek erva kegon habba al haishsha shennitkaddesha sefek kiddushin o nitgarsha sefek gerushin vechayyotze bahen middivre sofrim kegon haishsha sheshshama shemmet balah venisset vahare balah kayyam uva balah harishon aleha vehi tachat hashsheni hare habben mamzer middivre sofrim
Penuya shennitabbera mizzenut amru lah mahu haubbar hazze o hayyalud hazze im amra ben kasher hu ulyisrael nivalti hare zo neemenet vehabben kasher veaf al pi sherov hair shezzinneta bah pesulim

Veim lo nivdeka immo ad shemmeta o shehayeta chereshet o illemet o shota o sheamra lifloni hammamzer nivalti o lifloni hannatin afillu oto peloni mode shehu mimmennu hare ze hayyalud sefek mamzer keshem shezzinneta im ze shehoda lah kach zinneta im acher veze hu hannikra shetuki shemmakkir et immo veeno makkir et aviv vadday
Vechen habben hannimtza bashshuk vehu hannikra asufi hare hu sefek mamzer sheen anu yodim ma hu

Penuya shezzinneta veamra ben ze ben peloni hu im oto peloni kasher hare habben kasher veenah neemenet lihot ze beno shel peloni veyerae li shechoshshin lidvareha veyihye habben asur bikrovot oto peloni missafek veim oto peloni mamzer enah neemenet lihot habben mamzer vadday al piha kemo shebbearnu ella yihye sefek mamzer

Aval haav shehuchzak shezze beno veamar beni ze mamzer hu neeman veim yesh labben banim eno neeman shello heemina oto tora ella al beno shenneemar ki et habbechor ben hassenua yakkir yakkirennu laacherim

Uchshem shenneeman lomar beni ze bechor kach neeman lomar beni ze mamzer o ben gerusha o ben chalutza vechen im hayeta ishto meubberet neeman lomar ubbar ze eno beni umamzer hu veyihye mamzer vadday vehaomer al atzmo shehu mamzer neeman leesor atzmo bevat yisrael veasur bemamzeret ad sheyyivada vadday shehu mamzer uvno kamohu veim yesh lo bene banim eno neeman lifsol bene banav velo yifsol ella atzmo

Arusa shennitabbera vehi bevet aviha hare havalad bechezkat mamzer veasur bevat yisrael veasur bemamzeret veim nivdeka immo veamra mearusi nitabbarti neemenet vehavalad kasher veim hichchishah haarus veamar meolam lo bati aleha hare havalad mamzer sheafillu haya bechezkat beno veamar beni ze mamzer neeman vehaishsha enah bechezkat zona ella neemenet lomar laarus nivalti veenah zona veim nisset lechohen lo tetze uveladah mimmennu kasher

Hau haam merannenim achareha vehi arusa im arusah veim anashim acherim af al pi shebba aleha arusah bevet chamiv hare ze sefek mamzer keshem shehifkira atzmah laarusah hifkira laacherim veim nivdeka veamra ubbar ze mearusi hare ze kasher kemo shebbearnu

Eshet ish shehayeta meubberet veamra ubbar ze eno mibbaali enah neemenet lefaslo vahare habben bechezkat kashrut shello heemina tora ella haav amar haav eno beni o shehaya balah bimdinat hayyam hare ze bechezkat mamzer veim amra meakkum veeved nitabbarti hare havalad kasher sheen habbaal yachol lehachchishah bidvareha veen haubbar mishtahe bime immo yeter al shenem asar chodesh

Eshet ish sheyyatza aleha kol shehayeta zona tachat balah vehakkol merannenin achareha en choshshin levaneha shemma mamzerim hem sherov beilot etzel habbaal umuttar lissa bittah lechattechilla aval hi atzmah choshshin lah mishshum zona veim hayeta perutza yoter midday af levaneha choshshin

Din tora shessefek mamzer muttar lavo bakkahal shenneemar lo yavo mamzer bikhal Adonai mamzer vadday asur lavo bakkahal velo safek aval chachamim asu maala beuchasin veasru gam hassefekot lavo bakkahal lefichach mamzer vadday muttar lissa mamzeret vaddait aval mamzer safek o shetuki o asufi asur lissa bat yisrael

Veasur lissa mamzeret vaafillu mamzeret missafek asura lo shemma echad mehen eno mamzer vehashsheni mamzer vadday umamzer shel divrehem muttar lissa mamzeret shel divrehem vechen shear hassefekot asurin lissa ze mizze

Ketzad shetukim vaasufim usfek mamzerim asurim lavo ze im ze veim nasu lo yekayemu ella yotziu beget vehavalad safek kaavotav veen lisfekot ellu takkana ella sheyyisseu min haggerim vehavalad holech achar happagum
Ketzad shetuki o asufi shennasa giyyoret o meshuchreret o ger umshuchrar shennasa shetukit o asufit havalad shetuki o asufi
Haasufi shennimtza beir sheyyesh bah akkum ben shehaya rov akkum o rov yisrael hare ze sefek akkum leinyan yuchasin kiddesh ishsha tzericha get missafek mi sheharago lo haya neherag alav

Hitbiluhu bet din leshem gerut o shettaval mishshehigdil hare hu kishar asufim hannimtzaim beare yisrael haya rov hair akkum muttar lehaachilo nevelot haya rubban yisrael machzirin lo avedato keyisrael mechetza al mechetza mitzva lehachaoto keyisrael umfakkechin alav et haggal beshabbat vahare hu leinyan nezakin kechal sefek mamon hammotzi mechavero alav haraya

Yerae li shekkal medina sheyyesh bah shifcha o akkum haruya leled hoil vehaasufi hannimtza sham sefek akkum o sefek eved kesheyyissa haggiyyoret kemo shebbearnu hare zo sefek eshet ish vehabba aleha patur sheen horgin al safek vechen yerae li shehashshetuki shennasa ishsha sheefshar shehi erva alav vahare hi sefek eshet ish sheen kiddushin tofsin baaraot
Vee zo hi haishsha sheefshar shettihye erva alav kal ishsha shehaya aviha o achiha kayyam keshennitabbera bo immo vechal ishsha shennitgarsha o nitalmena shemma eshet aviv hi o eshet achi aviv

Uminnayin ani omer sheen hashshetuki vehaasufi asur bechal ishsha sheefshar shettihye erva alav shehare hakkasher shennivdeka immo eno asur bechal ishsha sheefshar shettihye erva alav vahare neemar battora al techallel et bittecha lehaznotah veamru chachamim sheim yaase ze nimtza av nose bitto veach nose achoto veillu haya haddin shekkal mi sheeno yodea aviv bevadday asur bechal ishsha sheefshar shettihye erva alav lo hayinu baim lammidda hazzot leolam velo tihye haaretz melea zimma ha lamadta sheen osrin araot umachazikin otan bisher basar besafek ad sheyyivada bevadday shezzo erva alav sheim atta omer ken kal hayetomim shebbaolam shello hikkiru avotehem hau asurin lehinnase bechal makom shemma yifgeu beerva

Havalad shehaya mushlach badderech uva echad veamar beni hu vaani hishlachtiv neeman vechen immo neemenet neesaf min hashshuk uvau aviv veimmo achar ken veamru benenu hu en neemanin hoil veyatza alav shem asufi uvishne reavon neemanin shemmippene raav hishlichuhu vehen rotzin sheyyazunu oto acherim ulfichach shatku ad shenneesaf

Nimtza havalad mahul o shehuchtal o shehumlach o shehaya hakkochal beenav o hakkemein betzavaro o shennimtza tachat ilan mesubbach sheen chayya nichneset lo vehaya samuch lair o shennimtza bevet hakkeneset hassamuch lirshut harabbim o betzidde reshut harabbim en kan mishshum asufi meacher shehen meshammerin oto shello yamut bechezkat kasher hu aval im nimtza mushlach beemtza hadderech o rachok min hair afillu tachat ilan o bevet hakkeneset o shennimtza taluy bailan makom shechayya maggaat lo hare ze asufi

Neemenet chayya lomar ze habben kohen hu o levi o natin o mamzer mippene shello huchzak veen anu yodin yichusan bamme devarim amurim beshehuchzeka beneemanut velo irer aleha adam aval im irer aleha afillu echad veamar besheker meida enah neemenet vahare habben bechezkat kasher veen lo yichus

Davar barur shehashshetuki asur lissa shetukit vaasufi asur baasufit mippene shehen sefekot aval mamzerim vaddaim untinim muttarim lavo ze baze vehavalad mamzer ushtuki vaasufi muttarin bintinim uvishar haggerim vehavalad safek
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 16: Petzua dakka uchrut shafcha shennasu bat yisirael uvaalu lokin shenneemar lo yavo fetzua dakka uchrut shafcha bikhal Adonai umuttarin lissa giyyoret umshuchreret vaafillu kohen shehu petzua dakka muttar lissa giyyoret umshuchreret lefi sheeno bikdushshato vaafillu netina o echad min hassefekot mutteret lo
Hoil uftzua dakka asur lavo bakkahal lo gazru bo al hannetinim velo al hassefekot aval petzua dakka uchrut shafcha asur bemamzeret vaddait shehare asura min hattora

Ve zehu petzua dakka kal shenniftzeu habbetzim shello uchrut shafcha kal shennichrat haggid shello uvishlosha evarin efshar sheyyippasel hazzachar baggid uvabbetzim uvashshevilin shebbahen titbashshel shichvat zera vehen hannikrain chute betzim vechevan shenniftza echad mishshelosha evarin ellu o niddach hare ze pasul

Ketzad niftza haggid o niddach o shennichrat haatara o lemala meatara pasul veim nichrat merosh haatara venishtayyer mimmenna afillu kechut hassaara mukkaf lechal haggid kasher nichrat haggid lemala meatara kekulmos o kemarzev kasher

Nikkav lematta meatara kasher nikkeva haatara atzmah im kesheyyire keri tetze shichvat zera min hannekev pasul nistam hannekev chazar lehechshero nikkav lematta meatara shekkenegdo lemala betoch haatara pasul shehaatara kullah meakkevet
Nistam shevil shichvat zera vechazar lirot shichvat zera mishshevil shemmashtin bo hare ze pasul
Nichretu habbetzim o achat mehen o shenniftzea achat mehen o shenniddocha achat mehen o shechasra o shennikkeva hare ze pasul nichretu chute betzim o achat o shenniddach o niftza hare ze pasul
Nikkav chut michute habbetzim lishvil me raglayim vahare hu mattil mayim mishshene mekomot mishshevil hammayim umishshevil shichvat zera hare ze kasher

Kal pasul sheamarnu beinyan ze keshello hau bide shamayim kegon shekkerato adam o kelev o hikkahu kotz vechayyotze bidvarim ellu aval im nolad kerut shafcha o petzua dakka o shennolad belo betzim o shechala mechamat gufo uvatlu mimmennu evarim ellu o shennolad bahem shechin vehemessa otan o keratan hare ze kasher lavo bakkahal shekkal ellu bide shamayim

Asur lehafsid evre zera ben beadam ben bivhema chayya veof echad temeim veechad tehorim ben beeretz yisrael ben bechutza laaretz af al pi shenneemar uvartzechem lo taasu mippi hashshemua lamdu sheddavar ze noheg bechal makom veinyan hakkatuv lo yease zot beyisrael ben begufan ben beguf acherim vechal hamsares loke min hattora bechal makom vaafillu mesares achar mesares loke

Ketzad hare shebba echad vecharat et haggid uva acher vecharat et habbetzim o nittekan uva acher vecharat chute betzim o shebba echad umaach et haggid uva acher venitteko uva acher uchrato kullan lokin veaf al pi shello seres haacharon ella mesoras ben baadam ben bivhema chayya vaof vehamsares et hannekeva ben beadam ben bishar minim patur

Hammashke ikkarin leadam o lishar minim kede lesarso hare ze asur veen lokin alav veishsha mutteret lishtot ikkarin kede lesarsah ad shello teled hare shekkafa et haadam veshissa bo kelev o shear chayyot ad sheasauhu kerut shafcha o shehoshivo bammayim o bashsheleg ad shebbittel mimmennu evre tashmish eno loke ad sheyesares beyado verauy lehakkoto makkat mardut

Asur lomar leakkum lesares behema shellanu veim lekachah hu meatzmo vesersah muttar veim heerim yisrael bedavar ze konsin oto umochrah leyisrael acher vaafillu livno haggadol muttar lemachrah aval livno hakkatan eno mochrah lo velo notna lo
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 17: Shalosh nashim neesru al kal hakkohanim gerusha zona vachlola vial kohen gadol arba ellu hashshalosh vehaalmana echad kohen gadol mashuach beshemen hammishcha o hamrubbe begadim veechad kohen haoved veechad kohen gadol shemminnuhu veavar vechen kohen meshuach milchama kullan metzuvin al habbetula vaasurin bealmana
Kal kohen shennasa achat mehashshalosh nashim ellu ben gadol ben hedot uvaal loke veim ba aleha derech zenut eno loke mishshum zona o gerusha o chalala shenneemar lo yikkachu ad sheyyikkach veyivol

Aval kohen gadol shebba al almana loke achat af al pi shello kiddesh shenneemar lo yechallel kevan shebbealah chillelah ufsalah lichhunna aval zona vachalala ugrusha hare hen mechullalot veomdot kodem beilato ulfichach loke kohen gadol levaddo al beilat almana levaddah af al pi sheen sham kiddushin shehare chillelah vehu muzhar shello yechallel kesherim lo ishsha velo zaro
Kiddesh kohen gadol almana uvalah loke shettayim achat mishshum almana lo yikkach veachat mishshum lo yechallel uven kohen gadol uven kohen hedot shennasa ishsha min haarba velo baal eno loke
Vechal makom shehu loke hi loka vechal makom shehu eno loke hi enah loka sheen hefresh ben ish leishsha laonashin zulati beshifcha charufa bilvad kemo shebbearnu
Kal kohen habba al hakkutit ben gadol ben hedot loke mishshum zona shehare enah bat kiddushin vehu asur bivilat zona ben yisreelit ben kutit

Hachalutza asura lechohen middivre sofrim mippene shehi kigrusha umakkin oto makkat mardut middivrehem kohen shennasa sefek chalutza en motziin otah mittachtav vehi keshera uveladah kasher mippene shello gazru al sefek chalutza ella al chalutza vaddait vechen mi shehayeta sefek gerusha o sefek almana o sefek zona usfek chalala makkin oto makkat mardut umotzi beget

Kelal gadol hu bechal issurim shebbattora sheen issur chal al issur ella im ken hau shene issurin bain keachat o shehaya haissur haechad mosif devarim acherim al oto haissur o im haya kolel devarim acherim im issur ze

Lefichach ishsha shehayeta almana venaaset gerusha venaaset chalala venaaset zona uva aleha kohen gadol achar kach loke arba malkiyyot al bia achat lefi shehaalmana asura lechohen gadol umutteret lehedot

Chazra lihot gerusha nosaf bah issur veneeseret lechohen hedot lefichach nosaf bah issur acher al issur haalmana vaadayin hi mutteret leechol bitruma naaset chalala nosaf bah issur shehare neeseret bitruma vaadayin hi mutteret leyisrael naaset zona hoil veyesh shem zenut sheosrah al yisrael im zinneta ishto beratzon nosaf bah issur acher vehu haddin lechohen hedot shebba al haggerusha shennaaset chalala veachar kach zona shehu loke shalosh al bia achat aval im nishtanna seder ze eno loke ella achat
Mi shennitalmena meanashim harbe o nitgarsha meanashim harbe en lokin aleha ella achat al kal bia almana ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin asura

Kohen gadol shemmet achiv af al pi shehu min haerusin hare ze lo yeyabbem ella choletz nafla lo yevama vehu kohen hedot venitmanna lihot kohen gadol af al pi sheasa bah maamar keshehu kohen hedot hare ze lo yeyabbem achar shennitmanna aval im eres et haalmana venitmanna lihot kohen gadol hare ze yichnos achar shennitmanna hayeta mekuddeshet sefek kiddushin umet arusah hare zo sefek almana

Mitzvat ase al kohen gadol sheyyissa naara betula umishshettivgor teaser alav shenneemar vehu ishsha vivtuleha yikkach ishsha lo ketanna bivtuleha velo bogeret ha ketzad yatzat mikkelal katnut velichlal bagrut lo baa zo naara veeno nose shette nashim leolam keachat shenneemar ishsha achat velo shettayim
Kohen gadol lo yissa mukkat etz af al pi shello nivala nivala shello kedarkah hare zo kenivala kedarkah nivala livhema hare zo mutteret
Kohen gadol shennasa beula eno loke aval motzi beget nasa bogeret o mukkat etz hare ze yekayyem eres beula venitmanna kohen gadol hare ze yichnos achar shennitmanna
Anas naara betula o pitta otah afillu anasah o pitta otah keshehu kohen hedot venitmanna kohen gadol kodem sheyyichnos hare ze lo yichnos veim kanas motzi
Eres et hakketanna uvagra tachtav kodem nissuin hare ze lo yichnos mippene shennishtanna gufah veim kanas lo yotzi

Achat gerusha min haerusin o min hannissuin aval hammaenet afillu gershah beget vehechezirah umeana bo hare zo mutteret lechohen kemo shebbearnu behilchot gerushin vechal mi sheenah reuya lachalitza im nechletza lo nifsela lichhunna
Yatza aleha kol ish peloni kohen katav get leishto o natan get leishto vahare hi yoshevet tachtav umshammashto en motziin otah mittachat balah veim nisset lechohen acher tetze min hashsheni
Yatza shemah bair shennitkaddesha venitgarsha min hakkiddushin choshshin lah kemo shebbearnu behilchot gerushin aval im yatza aleha kol shehi chalutza en choshshin lah

Yatza kol al habbetula shehi beula en choshshin lah vetinnase lechohen gadol yatza aleha kol shehi shifcha en choshshin lah vetinnase afillu lechohen yatza lah shem mezanna bair en choshshin lah vaafillu hotziah balah mishshum sheavra al dat yehudit o beede davar mechoar umet kodem sheyyitten lah get hare zo mutteret lechohen sheen osrin ishsha meellu ella beedut berura o bihodaat piha
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 18: Mippi hashshemua lamadnu sheha zona haamura battora hi kal sheenah bat yisrael o bat yisrael shennivala leadam shehi asura lehinnase lo issur hashshave lakkol o shennivala lechalal af al pi shehi mutteret lehinnase lo lefichach hannirbaat livhema af al pi shehi biskila lo naaset zona velo nifsela lichhunna shehare lo nivala leadam vehabba al hannidda af al pi shehi becharet lo naaset zona velo nifsela lichhunna shehare enah asura lehinnase lo

Vechen habba al happenuya afillu hayeta kedesha shehifkira atzmah lakkol af al pi shehi bemalkot lo naaset zona velo nifsela min hakkehunna shehare enah asura lehinnase lo aval hannivelet leechad meissure lavin hashshavin bakkol veen meyuchadin bechohanim o meissure ase veen tzarich lomar lemi shehi asura lo mishshum erva o leakkum veeved hoil vehi asura lehinnase lo hare zo zona

Vechen haggiyyoret vehamshuchreret afillu nitgayera venishtachrera pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim hoil veenah bat yisrael hare zo zona vaasura lechohen mikkan amru akkum o natin o mamzer o ger ammoni umoavi o mitzri veedomi rishon vesheni o petzua dakka uchrut shafcha o chalal shebbau al hayehudit asu otah zona venifsela lichhunna veim hayeta kohenet pesaluha min hatteruma vechen yevama shebba aleha zar asaah zona vehaayelonit mutteret lechohen veenah zona
Habba al achat mehashsheniyyot vechayyotze bahen kegon habba al kerovat chalutzato o al chalutzato lo asa otah zona shehare enah asura lehinnase lo min hattora kemo shebbearnu behilchot yibbum

Ha lamadta sheen heotah zona tole bivila shel issur shehare habba al hannidda veal hakkedesha vehannirbaat labbehema nivala beila shel issur velo naaset zona umi shennisset lechalal nivala beila shel hetter kemo sheyyitbaer venaaset zona veen haddavar taluy ella bifgima umippi hashshemua lamdu sheenah peguma ella meadam haasur lah o mechalal kemo sheamarnu

Kal hannivelet leadam sheose otah zona ben beones ben beratzon ben bezadon ben bishgaga ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah mishsheheera bah nifsela mishshum zona uvilvad shettihye bat shalosh shanim veom echad veyihye habboel ben tesha shanim veom echad vamala lefichach eshet ish shennivala leacher ben beones ben beratzon nifsela lichhunna

Eshet kohen shenneensa balah loke aleha mishshum tuma shenneemar lo yuchal balah harishon asher shillechah lashuv lekachtah lihot lo leishsha achare asher hutammaa hakkol bichlal sheim nivalu asurin al baalehen peret lecha hakkatuv beeshet yisrael shenneensa shehi mutteret levalah shenneemar vehi lo nitpasa aval eshet kohen beissurah omedet shehare hi zona

Eshet yisrael shenneensa af al pi shehi mutteret levalah asura lichhunna eshet kohen sheamra levalah neenasti o shagagti uva alay echad o shebba ed echad veheid lo aleha shezzinneta ben beones ben beratzon hare zo enah asura alav shemma eneha natna beacher veim hi neemenet lo o haed neeman lo vesamach dato ledivrehem hare ze yotzi kede latzet yede safek

Eshet kohen sheamra levalah neenasti af al pi shehi mutteret levalah kemo shebbearnu hare hi asura lechal kohen shebbaolam achar sheyyamut balah shehare hodet shehi zona veasra atzmah venaaset kachaticha haasura

Kohen shekkiddesh gedola o ketanna veachar zeman ba aleha vetaan shemmetzaah derusat ish neesra alav missafek shemma kodem kiddushin nivala o achar kiddushin aval yisrael shettaan taana zo lo neesra alav sheyyesh kan shene sefekot shemma kodem kiddushin veshemma achar kiddushin vaafillu nomar leachar kiddushin shemma beones shemma beratzon shehaanusa mutteret leyisrael kemo shebbearnu

Lefichach im kiddeshah aviha leyisrael vehi pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veom echad vetaan shemmetzaah derusat ish neesra alav missafek sheen kan ella safek echad shemma beones shemma beratzon vesafek issur shel tora lechumra

Kal ishsha shekkinne lah balah venistera velo shatat me sota asura lechohen mippene shehi sefek zona ben shello ratzat hi lishtot ben shello ratza lehashkotah ben shehayeta sham edut shemmonah millishtot ben shekkinneu lah bet din ben shehayeta min hannashim sheen reuot lishtot hoil velo shatat mikkal makom hare zo asura lichhunna missafek

Penuya sherauha shennivala leechad vehalach lo veamru lah mi hu ze shebba alayich veamra adam kasher hare zo neemenet velo od ella afillu rauha meubberet veamru lah mimmi nitabbarte veamra meadam kasher hare zo neemenet vetihye mutteret lechohen

Bamme devarim amurim besheyyihye hammakom shennivala bo parashat derachim o bikranot shebbassadot shehakkol ovrin sham vehau rov haovrim sham kesherim verov hair shepparshu ellu haovrin mimmenna kesherim shehachachamim asu maala beuchasin vehitzrichu shene rubbot aval im hau rov haovrim poslim otah kegon akkum o mamzerim vechayyotze bahem af al pi sherov hammakom shebbau mimmenna kesherim o shehau rov anshe hammakom pesulin af al pi sherov haovrin sham kesherim choshshin lah shemma lemi shepposel otah nivala velo tinnase lechohen lechattechilla veim nisset lo tetze

Rauha shennivala bair o nitabbera bair afillu lo haya shochen sham ella akkum echad o chalal echad veeved vechayyotze bahen hare zo lo tinnase lechattechilla lechohen shekkal hakkavua kemechetza al mechetza hu veim nisset lo tetze hoil vehi omeret lechasher nivalti

Hayeta illemet o chereshet o sheamra eni yodaat lemi nivalti o shehayeta ketanna sheenah makkeret ben kasher lefasul hare zo sefek zona veim nisset lechohen tetze ella im ken hau shene harubbin hammetzuyin etzlah kesherim

Hashshevuya shennifdet vehi bat shalosh shanim veom echad o yeter asura lechohen mippene shehi sefek zona shemma nivala leakkum veim yesh lah ed shello nityached haakkum immah hare zo keshera lichhunna vaafillu eved o shifcha o karov neeman leedut zo ushte shevuot sheheida kal achat mehen lachavertah hare ellu neemanot hoil veissur kal hassefekot kullan middivre sofrim lefichach hekellu bishvuya

Vechen katan shehaya mesiach lefi tummo neeman maase beechad shennishba hu veimmo uvnah mesiach lefi tummo veamar nishbenu leven haakkum ani veimmi yatzati lishov mayim vedati al immi lilkot etzim vedati al immi vehissiu otah chachamim lechohen al piv
En habbaal neeman lehaid beishto hashshevuya shello nitmea sheen adam meid leatzmo vechen shifchatah lo taid lah aval shifchat balah meida lah veshifchatah shehayeta mesicha lefi tummah neemenet
Kohen sheheid lishvuya shehi tehora hare ze lo yissaenna shemma enav natan bah veim pedaah veheid bah hare ze yissaenna sheillu lo yada shehi tehora lo natan bah meotav

Haishsha sheamra nishbeti uthora ani neemenet shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir afillu haya sham ed echad shemmeid shehi shevuya aval im yesh sham shene edim shennishbet enah neemenet ad sheyyaid lah echad shehi tehora hau sham shene edim shennishbet veed echad meid shennitmet veechad machchish oto umeid lah shehi tehora velo nityached immah akkum ad shennifdet afillu ze shemmeid shehi tehora ishsha o shifcha hare zo mutteret

Mi sheamra nishbeti uthora ani vehittiruha bet din lehinnase veachar kach bau shene edim shennishbet hare zo tinnase lechattechilla velo tetze mehetterah vaafillu nichnas achareha shabbay vahare hi shevuya lefanenu beyad adoneha hare zo lo tetze mehetterah shehittiruha umshammerin otah meatta ad shettippade

Bau lah shene edim achar kach shennitmet afillu nisset vaafillu hau lah banim hare zo tetze veim ba ed echad eno kelum amra nishbeti uthora ani veyesh li edim sheani tehora en omrin namtin ad sheyyavou haedim ella mattirin otah miyyad velo od ella afillu yatza aleha kol sheyyesh aleha ede tuma mattirin otah ad sheyyavou shebbishvuya hekellu

Haav sheamar kiddashti et bitti vegerashtiha vahare hi ketanna neeman kiddashtiha vegerashtiha keshehayeta ketanna vahare hi gedola eno neeman lehachazikah gerusha nishbet ufditiha ben shehi gedola ben shehi ketanna eno neeman shello heemina oto tora ella leasrah mishshum ishut shenneemar et bitti natatti laish hazze aval lo lefaslah mishshum zenut
Eshet kohen shenneesra alav mishshum shevuya hoil vehaddavar safek hare zo mutteret ladur immo bechatzer echad uvilvad sheyyihu immo banav uvne beto tamid leshamro

Ir shebbaa bematzor venichbesha im hau haakkum makkifin et hair mikkal ruchoteha kede shello timmalet ishsha achat ad sheyyiru otah vetease birshutan hare kal hannashim shebbetochah pesulot lichhunna kishvuot shemma nivalu leakkum ella mi shehayeta mibbat shalosh shanim ulmatta kemo shebbearnu
Veim haya efshar shettimmalet ishsha achat velo yedu bah o shettihye bair machavoa achat afillu enah machzeket ella ishsha achat hare zo matztzelet al hakkol

Ketzad matztzelet shekkal ishsha sheamra tehora ani neemenet veaf al pi sheen lah ed mittoch sheyechola lomar nimlatti keshennichbesha hair o bemachavoa hayiti venitztzalti neemenet lomar lo nimlatti velo nechbeti velo nitmeti

Bamme devarim amurim bigdud shel otah malchut shehem mityashshevin bair veen yerein lefichach choshshin lahem shemma baalu aval gedud shel malchut acheret sheppashat veshataf veavar lo neesru hannashim mippene sheen lahem penay livol shehen oskim bashshalal uvorchin lahem veim shavu nashim venaasu birshutan af al pi sheradfu acharehem yisrael vehitztzilu otan miyyadam hare hen asurot

Haishsha shenechbesha beyad akkum al yede mamon mutteret al yede nefashot asura lichhunna ulfichach im haya balah kohen neesra alav bamme devarim amurim bizman sheyyad yisrael takkifa al haakkum vehem yerein mehem aval bizman sheyyad haakkum takkifa afillu al yede mamon kevan shennaaset birshut haakkum neesra ella im ken heid lah echad kishvuya kemo shebbearnu
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 19: E zo hi chalala zo shennolida meissur kehunna vechen achat min hannashim haasurot lichhunna shennivala lechohen nitchallela aval hakkohen atzmo sheavar haavera lo nitchallel

Uven shennivala beones o bishgaga ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah mishsheheera bah nitchallela vehu sheyyihye kohen ben tesha shanim veom echad vamala vetihye zo haasura lo bat shalosh shanim veom echad vamala

Ketzad kohen ben tesha shanim veom echad shebba al haggerusha o al hazzona vechohen gadol shebba alehen o al haalmana o shennasa beula uva aleha hare ellu nitchallelu leolam veim holid mimmenna ben ben ze shechillelah ben kohen achar havalad chalal aval kohen shekkiddesh ishsha meissure kehunna venitalmena o nitgarsha min haerusin lo nitchallela veim nisset af al pi shello nivala nitchallela shekkal nesua bechezkat beula hi af al pi shennimtzet betula
Kohen gadol shennasa bogeret o mukkat etz lo chillelah vechen im baal beula belo nissuin lo chillelah

Kohen habba al erva min haaraot chutz minnidda o al achat mechayyave lavin hashshavin bakkol asa otah zona kemo shebbearnu chazar uva aleha bia sheniyya ben hu ben kohen acher naaset chalala vezaro mimmenna chalalim lefichach kohen shebba al zekuka leyavam venitabbera mibbia rishona havalad kasher lefi sheenah meissure kehunna venaaset zona chazar uva aleha bia sheniyya venitabbera veyalda hi chalala uveladah chalal lefi shehu meissure kehunna
Vechen kohen habba al haggiyyoret vehamshuchreret chillelah vezaro mimmenna chalalim kohen habba al hannidda havalad kasher veeno chalal sheen issur hannidda meyuchad bechohanim ella shave bakkol
Kohen shennasa gerusha meubberet ben mimmennu ben meacher veyalda keshehi chalala havalad kasher shehare lo ba mittippat avera

Kevar bearnu shehachalutza asura lechohen middivrehem lefichach kohen shebba al hachalutza hare zo chalala vezarah mikkohen chalalim vehakkol middivrehen aval kohen shebba al achat mehashsheniyyot hi keshera vezaro mimmenna kesherim sheissur hashsheniyyot issur hashshave bakkol hu veeno meyuchad bechohanim
Kohen shebba al sefek zona kegon sefek giyyoret o meshuchreret o shebba al sefek gerusha vechen kohen gadol shebba al sefek almana hare zo sefek chalala uveladah sefek chalal

Nimtzeu hachalalim shelosha chalal min hattora vechalal middivrehem usfek chalal vechal sefek chalal notnin alav chumre kohanim vechumre yisrael eno ochel bitruma velo mittamme lammetim venose ishsha haruya lechohen veim achal o nitma o nasa gerusha makkin oto makkat mardut vehu haddin bechalal shel divrehem aval chalal shel tora havadday hare hu kezar venose gerusha umittamme lammetim shenneemar emor el hakkohanim bene aharon af al pi shehem bene aharon ad sheyyihu bechihunam

Kohen zachar shehu asur lissa zona vachalala asur begiyyoret umshuchreret shehi kezona kemo shebbearnu aval hakkohenet mutteret lehinnase lechalal ulger velimshuchrar shello huzharu kesherot lehinnase lifsulin shenneemar bene aharon velo benot aharon nimtza hagger muttar lissa mamzeret velissa kohenet

Gerim umshuchrarim shennasu ellu meellu veholidu bat afillu leachar kamma dorot hoil velo nitarev bahen zera yisrael hare otah habbat asura lechohen veim nisset lo tetze hoil vehoratah veledatah bikdushsha aval ger o meshuchrar shennasa bat yisrael o yisrael shennasa giyyoret o meshuchreret bitto keshera lichhunna lechattechilla
Ger ammoni shennasa bat yisrael vechen mitzri sheni shennasa bat yisrael af al pi shebbiatam baavera vahare neshotehen zonot kemo shebbearnu benotehem kesherot lichhunna lechattechilla

Chalal shennasa keshera zaro mimmenna chalalim vechen ben ben beno vaafillu achar elef dor shebben hechalal hazzachar hu chalal leolam veim hayeta bat asura hi lichhunna shehare hi chalala aval yisrael shennasa chalala havalad kasher lefichach im hayeta bat hare zo tinnase lichhunna lechattechilla

Kohanim ulviyyim veyisreelim muttarin lavo ze baze vehavalad holech achar hazzachar leviyyim veyisreelim vachalalim muttarim lavo ze baze vehavalad holech achar hazzachar shenneemar vayyityaldu al mishpechotam levet avotam bet aviv hi mishpachto veen bet immo mishpachto

Leviyyim veyisreelim vachalalim gerim vaavadim meshuchrarim muttarim lavo ze baze vehagger vehamshuchrar shennasa leviyya o yisreelit o chalala hare habben yisreeli veyisreeli o levi o chalal shennasu giyyoret o meshuchreret havalad holech achar hazzachar

Kal mishpachot bechezkat kesherot umuttar lissa mehen lechattechilla veaf al pi chen im raita shette mishpachot shemmitgarot zo bazo tamid o raita mishpacha shehi baalat matztza umriva tamid o raita ish shehu marbe meriva im hakkol veaz panim beoter choshshin lahen verauy lehitrachek mehen sheellu simane paslut hem vechen happosel et acherim tamid kegon shennoten shemetz bemishpachot o bichidim veomer alehen shehen mamzerim choshshin lo shemma mamzer hu veim amar lahen shehem avadim choshshin lo shemma eved hu shekkal happosel bemumo posel vechen kal mi sheyyesh bo azzut panim o achzariyyut vesone et habberiyyot veeno gomel lahem chesed choshshin lo beoter shemma givoni hu shessimane yisrael haumma hakkedosha bayeshanin rachamanim vegomle chasadim uvaggivonim hu omer vehaggivonim lo mibbene yisrael hemma lefi sheheezzu penehem velo nitpayesu velo richamu al bene shaul velo gamlu leyisrael chesed limchol livne malkam vehem asu immahem chesed vehecheum battechilla

Mishpacha shekkara aleha arar vehu sheyyaidu shenayim shennitarev bahen mamzer o chalal o sheyyesh bahen avdut hare ze safek veim mishpachat kohanim hi lo yissa mimmenna ishsha ad sheyyivdok aleha arba immahot shehen shemone immah veem immah veem avi immah veem em avi immah vechen hu bodek al em aviha veem em aviha veem avi aviha veem em avi aviha
Veim hayeta mishpacha zo shekkara aleha arar leviyyim o yisreelim mosif livdok lahem zug echad venimtza bodek eser immahot shehaeruv balviyyim veyisreelim yeter min hakkohanim
Velamma bodek bannashim bilvad mippene shehaanashim kal et sheyyarivu ze im ze yecharef et chavero bifsul sheyyesh beyichuso veillu haya sham pasul haya nishma aval hannashim en mecharfot beuchasin
Velamma yivdok haish kesheyyirtze lissa mimmishpacha zo shehura chezkatah velo tivdok ishsha shettinnase lahen mippene shello huzharu kesherot lehinnase lifsulin
Kal shekkorin lo mamzer veshotek o natin veshotek o chalal veshotek o eved veshotek choshshin lo ulmishpachto veen nosin mehen ella im ken bodkin kemo shebbearnu

Mishpacha shennitarev bah sefek chalal kal almana meotah mishpacha asura lechohen lechattechilla veim nisset lo tetze mippene shehen shette sefekot shemma zo almenat oto chalal shemma enah almenato veim nomar shehi almenato shemma chalal hu shemma eno chalal aval im nitarev bah chalal vadday kal ishsha mehen asura lechohen ad sheyyivdok veim nisset tetze vehu haddin im nitarev bah sefek mamzer o mamzer vadday sheeshet mamzer veeshet chalal lichhunna issur echad hu kemo shebbearnu
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 20: Kal kohanim bazzeman hazze bachazaka hem kohanim veen ochlin ella bekadshe haggevul vehu shettihye teruma shel divrehem aval teruma shel tora vechalla shel tora en ochel otah ella kohen meyuchas

E zehu kohen meyuchas kal sheheidu lo shene edim shehu kohen ben peloni hakkohen ufloni ben peloni hakkohen ad ish sheeno tzarich bedika vehu hakkohen sheshshimmesh al gabbe hammizbeach sheillu lo badku bet din haggadol acharav lo hau menichin oto laavod lefichach en bodkin mehammizbeach vamala velo min hassanhedrin vamala sheen memannin bassanhedrin ella kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim meyuchasin

Challa bazzeman hazze vaafillu beeretz yisrael enah shel tora shenneemar bevoachem el haaretz biat kullechem velo biat miktzatchem uchshealu bime ezra lo alu kullam vechen teruma bazzeman hazze shel divre sofrim ulfichach ochlim otah hakkohanim shebbizmannenu shehen bachazaka

Mi sheheidu alav shene edim sherauhu shehaya ochel bitruma shel tora hare ze meyuchas veen maalin leuchasin lo minnesiat kappayim velo mikkeria battora rishon velo mechilluk teruma bevet haggeranot velo al pi ed echad
Kohen meyuchas sheamar beni ze kohen hu en maalin oto leuchasin al piv ad sheyyavi edim shehu beno

Kohen meyuchas sheyyatza hu veishto sheyyadanu shehi keshera limdina acheret uva hu vehi uvanim keruchin acharehen veamar ishsha sheyyatzat immi hi zo veellu baneha eno tzarich lehavi edim lo al haishsha velo al habbanim meta veellu baneha tzarich lehavi edim sheellu banav veeno tzarich lehavi edim al imman shehi keshera mippene shekkevar huchzak sheyyatza meimmanu keishsha keshera

Yatza kohen meyuchas limdina acheret uva hu veishto uvanav veamar ishsha zo nasati veellu baneha tzarich lehavi reaya sheishsha zo keshera veeno mevi edim sheellu baneha vehu sheyyihu keruchin achareha veim ba bishte nashim vehevi reaya al haachat af al pi shehabbanim ketannim uchruchin achareha tzarich lehavi reaya alehem shemma banav min haacheret hem venichrechu achar zo hamyucheset

Ba hu uvanav veamar ishsha nasati vameta veellu baneha mevi edim sheotah haishsha keshera hayeta veellu baneha vechaddin hazze danin beyisrael meyuchas uvlevi meyuchas veachar kach naid al beno ze shehu meyuchas kede sheyyihye rauy lesanhedrin

En maalin mishshetarot lichhunna ketzad hare shehaya katuv bishtar peloni kohen lava mippeloni vehilvahu kach vechach vehaedim millematta en machazikin bahem kohen ze shehu meyuchas shemma lo heidu ella al hammilve bamme devarim amurim leinyan yichus aval lachazaka sheyyihye kohen kechohane zeman ze veyochal teruma vechalla shel divre sofrim uvishar kadshe haggevul maalin min hashshetarot veal pi ed echad uminnesiut kappayim umikkeria battora rishon
Vechen kal kohen sheamar beni ze kohen neeman lehaachilo bitruma velihoto bechezkat kohen veeno tzarich lehavi reaya lo al habbanim velo al haishsha

Shenayim shebbau limdina ze omer ani vachaveri kohen veze omer ani vachaveri kohen af al pi shennirin kegomlin ze et ze hare ellu neemanin ushnehem bechezkat kohanim vechen ed sheamar raiti ze shennasa kappav o sheachal bitruma o shechalak al haggoren o shekkara battora rishon vekara acharav levi machazikin oto bichhunna al piv vechen im heid shezze kara sheni battora achar kohen machazikin oto bilviyya
Heid sheraa ze shechalak im achiv bevet din teruma shehinniach lahen avihen hakkohen en maalin oto lichhunna beedut zo shemma chalal hu velakach chelek yerushshato mitteruma lemachrah

Mi shebba bazzeman hazze veamar kohen ani eno neeman veen maalin oto lichhunna al pi atzmo velo yikra battora rishon velo yissa et kappav velo yochal bekadshe haggevul ad sheyyihye lo ed echad aval oser atzmo bigrusha vezona vachalala veeno mittamme lemetim veim nasa o nitma loke vehannivelet lo sefek chalala

Veim haya mesiach lefi tummo neeman ketzad maase beechad shehaya mesiach lefi tummo veamar zachur ani keshehayiti tinok vehayiti murkav al ketefo shel avi hotziuni mibbet hassefer vehifshituni kuttanti vehitbiluni leechol teruma laerev vachaveray bodlin mimmenni vehau korin oti yochanan ochel challot veheelahu rabbenu hakkadosh lichhunna al pi atzmo

Neeman gadol lomar zachur ani keshehayiti tinok veraiti peloni tovel veochel bitruma laerev umachazikin oto bichhunna beeduto mi shebba bazzeman hazze veamar kohen ani veed echad meid lo sheani yodea sheaviv shel ze kohen en maalin oto lichhunna beedut ze shemma chalal hu ad sheyyaid shezze kohen hu aval im huchzak aviv kohen o shebbau shenayim veheidu sheaviv shel ze kohen hare hu bechezkat aviv

Mi shehuchzak aviv kohen veyatza alav kol shehu ben gerusha o chalutza choshshin lo umoridin oto ba ed echad achar kach veheid shehu kasher maalin oto lichhunna al piv bau shenayim edim achar kach vehaidu shehu chalal moridin oto min hakkehunna ba ed echad veheid shehu kasher maalin oto lichhunna shezze haacharon mitztaref leed rishon vahare shenayim meidin shehu kasher ushnayim meidim shehu pasul yiddachu ellu veellu veyiddache hakkol shehashshenayim kemea veyishshaer kohen bechezkat aviv

Ishsha shello shahata shelosha chodashim achar balah veyalda veen yadua im ben tisha lerishon o ben shiva leacharon vehaya echad mehen kohen vehashsheni yisrael hare ze sefek kohen vechach im nitarev velad kohen bivelad yisrael vehigdilu hattaarovot kal echad mehen sefek kohen venotnin alehen chumre yisrael vechumre kohanim nosin nashim haruot lichhunna veen mittammeim lemetim velo ochlin bitruma veim nasu gerusha motziin veenan lokin

Shene kohanim shennitarvu valdotehem o eshet kohen shello shahata achar balah shelosha chodashim venisset lechohen acher veen yadua im ben tisha larishon o ben shiva laacharon notnin lo al havalad chumre shenehem hu onen alehem vehen onnin alav hu en metamme lahem vehem enan metammein lo veole bemishmaro shel ze veshel ze veen cholek veim hau shenehem bemishmar echad uvet av echad notel chelek echad

Bamme devarim amurim bizman shehen bain mikkoach nissuin aval biznut gazru chachamim shemmeshattekin oto middin kehunna kelal hoil veeno yodea aviv havadday shenneemar vehayeta lo ulzaro acharav ad sheyyihye zaro meyuchas acharav

Ketzad asara kohanim shepperash echad mehem uvaal shehare havalad kohen vadday veaf al pi chen hoil veeno yodea aviv sheyyityaches lo meshattekin oto middin kehunna veeno oved velo ochel velo cholek veim nitma lemetim o nasa gerusha loke sheen kan sefek hetter
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 21: Kal habba al erva min haaraot derech evarim o shechibbek venishshek derech taava venehena bekeruv basar hare ze loke min hattora shenneemar levilti asot mechukkot hattoevot vego veneemar lo tikrevu legallot erva kelomar lo tikrevu lidvarim hammeviin lide gilluy erva

Haose davar mechukkot ellu hare hu chashud al haaraot veasur laadam likrotz beyadav uvraglav o lirmoz beenav leachat min haaraot o lischok immah o lehakel rosh vaafillu lehariach besamim shealeha o lehabbit beyafyah asur umakkin lammitkaven ledavar ze makkat mardut vehammistakkel afillu beetzba ketanna shel ishsha venitkaven lehanot kemi shennistakkel bimkom hattoref vaafillu lishmoa kol haerva o lirot searah asur

Vehaddevarim haellu asurin bechayyave lavin umuttar lehistakkel bifne happenuya ulvadkah ben betula ben beula kede sheyyire im hi naa beenav yissaenna veen baze tzad issur velo od ella sherauy laasot ken aval lo yistakkel derech zenut hare hu omer berit karatti leenay uma etbonen al betula

Umuttar laadam lehabbit beishto keshehi nidda veaf al pi shehi erva veaf al pi sheyyesh lo hanaat lev mimmenna biriyya hoil vehi mutteret lo leachar zeman eno ba baze lidvar michshol aval lo yischok velo yakel rosh immah shemma yargil laavera

Asur lehishtamesh beishsha kelal ben gedola ben ketanna ben shifcha ben meshuchreret shemma yavo lide hirhur bee ze shimmush amru rechitzat panav yadav veraglav vehatztzaat mitta lefanav umzigat hakkos sheen osa leish devarim ellu ella ishto bilvad veen shoalin bishlom ishsha kelal vaafillu al yede shaliach

Hamchabbek achat min haaraot sheen libbo shel adam nokfo alehen o shennishshek leachat mehen kegon achoto haggedola vaachot immo vechayyotze bahen af al pi sheen sham taava velo hanaa kelal hare ze megunne beoter vedavar asur hu umaase tippeshim hu sheen kerevin leerva kelal ben gedola ben ketanna chutz mehaem livnah vehaav levitto

Ketzad muttar haav lechabbek bitto ulnashshekah vetishan immo bekeruv basar vechen haem im benah kal zeman shehem ketannim higdilu venaasa habben gadol vehabbat gedola ad sheyyihu shadayim nachonu usarech tzamach ze yashen bichsuto vehi yeshena bichsutah veim hayeta habbat bosha laamod lifne aviha arumma o shennisset vechen im haem bosha laamod bifne benah arumma veaf al pi shehen ketannim mishshehiggiu lehikkalem mehen en yeshenim immahem ella bichsutan

Nashim hamsolalot zo bazo asur umimmaase mitzrayim hu shehuzharnu alav shenneemar kemaase eretz mitzrayim lo taasu amru chachamim me hau osim ish nose ish veishsha nose ishsha veishsha nisset lishne anashim af al pi shemmaase ze asur en malkin alav sheen lo lav meyuchad vahare en sham bia kelal lefichach en neesarot lichhunna mishshum zenut velo teaser ishsha al balah baze sheen kan zenut verauy lehakkotan makkat mardut hoil veasu issur veyesh laish lehakpid al ishto middavar ze umonea hannashim hayeduot bechach millehikkanes lah umillatzet hi alehen

Ishto shel adam mutteret hi lo lefichach kal ma sheadam rotze laasot beishto ose boel bechal et sheyyirtze umnashshek bechal evar veevar sheyyirtze uva aleha kedarkah veshello kedarkah uvilvad shello yotzi shichvat zera levattala veaf al pi chen middat chasidut shello yakel adam et rosho lechach vesheyekaddesh atzmo bishat tashmish kemo shebbearnu behilchot deot velo yasur midderech haolam uminhago sheen davar ze ella kede lifrot velirbot

Asur laadam leshammesh mittato leor hanner hare shehayeta shabbat velo haya lo bayit acher vehaya hanner daluk hare ze lo yeshammesh kelal vechen asur leyisreeli leshammesh mittato bayyom sheazzut panim hi lo veim haya talmid chacham sheeno ba lehimmashech bechach hare ze maafil betallito umshammesh veen nizkakin ledavar ze ella mippene tzorech gadol vederech kedushsha leshammesh beemtza hallayela

En daat chachamim nocha lemi shehu marbe battashmish hammitta veyihye matzuy etzel ishto ketarnegol ufagum hu ad meod umaase burim hu ella kal hammaet battashmish hare ze meshubbach vehu shello yevattel ona ella middaat ishto velo tikkenu barishona levaale kerayin shello yikreu battora ad sheyyitbelu ella kede lemaet battashmish hammitta

Vechen asru chachamim shello yeshammesh adam mittato velibbo mechashshev beishsha acheret velo yivol mittoch shichrut velo mittoch meriva velo mittoch sina velo yavo aleha al karchah vehi yerea mimmennu velo kesheyyihye echad mehen menudde velo yavo aleha achar sheggamar belibbo legarshah veim asa ken habbanim enan hagunim ella mehen azze panim umehen mordim ufoshim

Vechen amru chachamim shekkal ishsha chatzufa shehi tovaat tashmish hammitta befiha o hamfatte ishshah leshem nissuin o hammitkaven lavo al rachel ishto uva al lea ishto umi shello shahata achar mitat balah shelosha chodashim vahare habben safek kal ellu habbanim hayyillodim mehem hem hammordim vehapposhim sheyyissure haggalut borrin otan

Veasur leadam lavo al ishto bashshevakim uvarchovot o baggannot uvappardesin ella bevet dira shello yerae kiznut veyargilu atzmam lide zenut vehabboel et ishto bimkomot ellu makkin oto makkat mardut vechen hamkaddesh bevia vehamkaddesh bashshuk vehamkaddesh belo shidduch makkin oto makkat mardut
Veachsenay asur battashmish hammitta ad sheyyachzor leveto vechen asru chachamim al haish sheyyadur bevet chamiv shezzo azzut panim hi velo yikkanes immo lemerchatz
Velo yikkanes adam im aviv lammerchatz velo im baal achoto velo im talmido veim haya tzarich letalmido muttar veyesh mekomot shennahagu shello yikkansu shene achim keechad lammerchatz

Lo yehallechu benot yisrael perue rosh bashshuk achat penuya veachat eshet ish velo telech ishsha bashshuk uvnah achareha gezera shemma yitpesu benah vetelech acharav lehachaziro veyitallelu bah harshaim shettefasuhu derech sechok

Asur lehotzi shichvat zera levattala lefichach lo yihye adam dash mibbifnim vezore mibbachutz velo yissa ketanna sheenah reuya leled aval ellu shemmenaafin bayyad umotziin shichvat zera lo day lahem sheissur gadol hu ella shehaose ze benidduy hu yoshev vaalehem neemar yedechem damim maleu uchillu harag hannefesh

Vechen asur leadam sheyyakshe atzmo ledaat o yavi atzmo lide hirhur ella im yavo lo hirhur yassia libbo middivre havay vehashchata ledivre tora shehi ayyelet ahavim veyaalat chen lefichach asur leadam lishon al arpo ufanav lemala ad sheyyitte meat kede shello yavo lide kishshuy
Velo yistakkel bivhema uvchayya veof beshaa shemmizdakkin zachar linkeva vmuttar lemarbie behema lehachnis kemichchol bishfoferet mippene shehen asukin bimlachtan lo yavou lide hirhur
Vechen asur leadam lehistakkel benashim beshaa shehen omdot al hakkevisa afillu lehistakkel bevigde tzemer shel ishsha shehu makkirah asur shello yavo lide hirhur

Mi sheppaga beishsha bashshuk asur lo lehallech achareha ella ratz umsallekah latztzedadin o leacharav vechal hamhallech bashshuk achare ishsha hare ze mikkalle amme haaretz veasur laavor al petach ishsha zona ad sheyyarchik arba ammot shenneemar veal tikrav el petach betah

Veasur leadam sheeno nasuy lishloach yado bimvushav shello yavo lide hirhur vaafillu mittachat tibburo lo yachnis yado shemma yavo lide hirhur veim hishtin mayim lo yeechoz baamma veyashtin veim haya nasuy muttar uven nasuy uven sheeno nasuy lo yoshit yado laamma kelal ella beshaa shehu tzarich linkavav

Chasidim harishonim ugdole hachachamim hitpaer echad mehem shemmeolam lo nistakkel bammila shello umehen mi shehitpaer shello hitbonen meolam betzurat ishto mippene shellibbo pone middivre havay ledivre haemet shehen ochazot levav hakkedoshim

Mitzvat chachamim sheyyassi adam banav uvnotav samuch lefirkan sheim yannichan yavou lide zenut o lide hirhur veal ze neemar ufakadta navecha velo techeta veasur lehassi ishsha lekatan shezze kemo zenut hi

Veen haish rashshay leshev belo ishsha velo yissa akara uzkena sheenah reuya leled urshut laishsha shello tinnase leolam o tinnase lesaris velo yissa bachur zekena velo yissa zaken yalda sheddavar ze gorem liznut

Vechen mi sheggeresh et ishto min hannissuin lo tadur immo bechatzer shemma yavou lide zenut veim haya kohen lo tadur immo bemavoy uchfar katan niddon kemavoy haya lah milve etzlo osa shaliach letavo ugrusha shebbaa im hamgaresh laddin menaddin otan o makkin otan makkat mardut veim nitgarsha min haerusin mutteret letavo baddin veladur immo veim haya libbo gas bah af min haerusin asur umi nidche mippene mi hi niddechet mippanav veim hayeta hechatzer shellah hu yiddache mippaneha
Asur leadam lissa ishsha vedato legarshah shenneemar al tacharosh al reacha raa vehu yoshev lavetach ittach veim hodia battechilla shehu nose otah leyamim muttar

Velo yissa adam ishsha bimdina zo veishsha bimdina acheret shemma yaarichu hayyamim venimtza ach nose achoto vaachot immo vaachot aviv vechayyotze bahen veeno yadua veim haya adam gadol sheshshemo yadua vahare zaro mefursamin viduin hare ze muttar
Lo yissa adam ishsha mimmishpachat metzoraim velo mimmishpachat nichpin vehu shehuchzeku shelosha peamim sheyyavou benehem kach

Ishsha shennisset lishne anashim vametu lishlishi lo tinnase veim nisset lo tetze vaafillu nitkaddesha yichnos velo yissa yisrael am haaretz kohenet shezze kemo chillul lezaro shel aharon veim nasa amru chachamim en ziuugan ole yafe ella met belo banim o met hu o hi bimhera o ketata tihye benehem aval talmid chacham shennasa kohenet hare ze nae umshubbach hare tora uchhunna keechad

Lo yissa adam bat amme haaretz sheim met o gole banav amme haaretz yihu sheen imman yodaat keter hattora velo yassi bitto leam haaretz shekkal hannoten bitto leam haaretz kemiyi shekkefatah untanah lifne haari makke uvoel veen lo boshet panim ulolam yimkor adam kal ma sheyyesh lo veyissa bat talmid chacham sheim met o gole banav talmide chachamim vechen yassi bitto letalmid chacham sheen davar megunne velo meriva beveto shel talmid chacham
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 22: Asur lehityached im erva min haaraot ben zekena ben yalda sheddavar ze gorem legallot erva chutz mehaem im benah vehaav im bitto vehabbaal im ishto nidda vechatan sheppersa ishto nidda kodem sheyyivol asur lehityached immah ella hi yeshena ben hannashim vehu yashen ben haanashim veim ba aleha bia rishona veachar kach nitmet muttar lehityached immah

Lo nechshedu yisrael al mishkav zachur veal habbehema lefichach en asur lehityached immahen veim nitrachek afillu miyyichud zachur uvhema hare ze meshubbach ugdole hachachamim hau marchikin habbehema kede shello yityachadu immah veissur yichud haaraot mippi hakkabbala

Kesheera maase amnon vetamar gazar david uvet dino al yichud penuya veaf al pi sheenah erva bichlal yichud araot hi veshammay vehillel gazru al yichud kutit nimtza kal hammityached im ishsha sheasur lehityached immah ben yisreelit ben kutit makkin et shenehen makkat mardut haish vehaishsha umachrizin alehen chutz meeshet ish sheaf al pi sheasur lehityached immah im nityached en lokin shello lehotzi laaz aleha shezzinneta venimtzeu motziin laaz al habbanim shehen mamzerim

Kal ishsha sheasur lehityached immah im hayeta ishto immo hare zo mutteret lehityached mippene sheishto meshammarto aval lo tityached yisreelit im hakkuti veaf al pi sheishto immo sheen ishto shel kuti meshammarto veen lahen busha

Vechen en mosrin tinok yisrael lechuti lelammedo sefer ullammedo ammanut mippene shekkullan chashudin al mishkav zachur veen maamidin behema befundakiyyot shel kutim vaafillu zecharim etzel zecharim unkevot etzel nekevot

Veen mosrin behema chayya veof leroe kuti afillu zecharim lechutim unkevot lechutit mippene shekkullan chashudin al harbaat behema uchvar bearnu shehen asurin bezachur uvivhema veneemar velifne iver lo titten michshl

Umippene ma en mosrin behema nekeva lechutit mippene shekkullan bechezkat noafim uchsheyyavo hannoef lishkav im hakkutit zo efshar shello yimtzaenna veyishkav im habbehema o afillu yimtzaenna yishkav im habbehema

Lo tityached ishsha achat afillu im anashim harbe ad shettihye ishto shel echad mehem sham vechen lo yityached ish echad afillu im nashim harbe nashim harbe im anashim harbe en choshshin leyichud hau haanashim mibbachutz vehannashim mibbifnim o haanashim mibbifnim vehannashim mibbachutz ufersha ishsha achat leven haanashim o ish leven hannashim asurin mishshum yichud afillu ish sheisko umlachto im hannashim asur lo lehityached im hannashim ketzad yaase yitassek immahen veishto immo o yifne limlacha acheret

Muttar lehityached im shette yevamot o im shette tzarot o im ishsha vachamotah o im ishsha uvat balah o im ishsha uvat chamotah mippene shessonot zo et zo veen mechappot zo al zo vechen muttar lehityached im ishsha sheyyesh immah tinoket ketanna sheyyodaat taam bia veenah moseret atzmah levia sheenah mezanna befaneha shehare zo megalla et sodah
Tinoket mibbat shalosh ulmatta vetinok ben tesha ulmatta muttar lehityached immahen shello gazru ella al yichud ishsha haruya levia veish harauy levia
Anderoginus eno mityached im hannashim veim nityached en makkin oto mippene shehu safek aval haish mityached im haanderoginus veim hattumtum

Eshet ish shehaya balah bair enah chosheshet leyichud mippene sheemat balah aleha veim haya ze gas bah kegon sheggadla immo o shehayeta kerovato lo yityached immah veaf al pi shebbalah bair vechen kal hammityached im ishsha vehaya happetach patuach lirshut harabbim en choshshin mishshum yichud

Mi sheen lo ishsha lo yelammed tinokot mippene sheimmot habbanim baot levet hassefer livnehem venimtza mitgare benashim vechen ishsha lo telammed ketannim mippene avotehen shehen bain biglal benehem venimtzeu mityachadim immah veen hamlammed tzarich shettihye ishto sheruya immo bevet hassefer ella hi bevetah vehu melammed bimkomo
Tikkenu chachamim shettihyena hannashim mesapperot zo im zo bevet hakkisse kede shello yikkanes sham ish mishshum yichud

En memannin afillu adam neeman vechasher lihot shomer chatzer sheyyesh sham nashim af al pi shehu omed bachutz sheen appotroppos laaraot veasur leadam lemannot appotroppos al beto shello yanhig ishto lidvar avera
