Tolaat shehayeta barea venikkeva veyatza vahare harea nekuva betolaat hare zo mutteret chezkatah sheachar shechita tikkov vetetze yesh sham marot sheim nishtanna mare haevar leoto hammare hara hare hu kenakuv sheoto habbasar shennishtannu marav lemare ze kemet hu chashuv uchillu hu habbasar shennehefach eno eno matzuy vechen hu omer umichyat basar chay baset uvom heraot bo basar chay mikkelal sheshshear habbasar shennishtanna eno chay

Rea shennishtannu mareha ben mare kulla ben mare miktzatah im nishtannet lemare hammuttar afillu nishtannet kullah mutteret veim nishtanna lemare haasur afillu kal shehu terefa shehammare haasur kenekev hu chashuv kemo shebbearnu

Vechamesh marot asurot yesh barea veellu hen shechora kido o yerukka keen keshut o keen chelmon betza o keen charia o kemare habbasar vacharia hu hatztzeva shetztzovim bo habbegadim vehu dome lisarot adummot meat venotot lirukka

Nimtzet keen charaot shel dekel osrin otah missafek shezze karov lemare haasur vechal hammarot haellu en osrin bahem ad shennofchim otah ummares bah beyado im nishtannet lammare hammuttar mutteret veim amda beenah asura

Arba marot muttarot yesh bah veellu hen shechora kichchol o yerukka kechatzir o adumma o kemare hakkaved vaafillu hayeta harea kullah telaim telaim nekuddot nekuddot mearba marot ellu hare zo mutteret

Of shennafal laur vehorik libbo o kevedo o kurkevano o shehedimu hammeayim shello bechal shehu hare zo terefa shekkal hayerukkim shehedimu o haadummim shehoriku mechamat haur baof hare hen kemi shennittelu utrefa vehu sheyyaamdu bemare ze achar sheshshalku otan meat ummarsin bahen

Kal of shennimtzet hakkaved shello kemare bene meayim o shennishtannu shear bene meayim veamdu beshinnuyan achar shelika umrisa kemo shebbearnu beyadua shennafal laur venechmeru bene meav utrefa velo od ella bene meayim shel of shello nimtza bahem shinnuy uchshennishleku nishtannu vehedimu hayerukkim vehoriku haadummim beyadua shennafal laur venechmeru bene meav utrefa vechen haveshet shennimtza haor hachitzon shello lavan vehappenimi adom ben baof ben babbehema hare hu keillu eno utrefa
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 8: Chasera ketzad shene evarim hen sheim chaser mimminyanam terefa veellu hen harea veharaglayim vechamesh unnot yesh larea kesheyyitle otah adam beyado ufne rea keneged panav shalosh min hayyamin ushtayim min hassemol uvtzad yamin mimmenna kemo ozen ketanna veenah betzad haunnot veyesh lah kemo kis bifne atzmah vehi betoch hakkis veozen zo ketanna hi hannikra varda mippene shehi doma levered veenah min hamminyan lefichach im lo nimtzet havarda mutteret shekkach hi darkah yesh behemot timmatze bahem veyesh behemot lo timmatze bahem veim nimtzet nekuva af al pi shehakkis shellah sotem et hannekev hare zo terefa
Chaser minyan haunnot venimtzet achat min hassemol o shettayim min hayyamin terefa veim nimtzeu shettayim beyamin vezot havarda hare zo mutteret
Nitchallefu haunnot venimtzeu shalosh min semol ushtayim min hayyamin belo vered o shehaya havered im hashshalosh betzad semol hare zo terefa shehi chasera mitztzad hayyamin

Nitvassefu haunnot beminyanam im hayeta haozen hayetera betzad haunnot o millifne harea shehu leummat hallev mutteret veim hayeta al gabbah shehu leummat hatztzelaot hare zo terefa shehayyater kechaser vehu shettihye kemo ale shel hadas aval pachot mizze enah ozen umutteret
Ozen shennimtzet devuka bachavertah hassemucha lah mutteret veim nismechu shello al hasseder kegon shennismecha rishona lashshelishit terefa

Nimtzeu shette haunnot keunna achat veenan nirot kishtayim devukot im haya benehen kemo ale hahadas ben beikkaran ben beemtzaan ben besofan kede sheyyukkar shehen shettayim devukot mutteret veim lav hare zo chasera utrefa

Nimtzet kullah shette arugot veen lah chittuch aznayim terefa vechen im chaser guf harea af al pi shello nikkeva hare zo kemi shechaser minyan haunnot utrefa lefichach im nimtza mimmenna makom yavesh ad sheyyipparech betzipporen hare zo kechaser utrefa vaafillu haya kal shehu
Rea shennimtzet nefucha kemo ikkar charaot shel dekel osrin otah missafek shezzo tosefet meshunna begufah veshemma hattosefet bagguf kechissaron kemo sheamar beminyan

Habbehema sheppachada veyara ad shetztzamka harea shellah vekarva lihot yevesha im pachada bide shamayim kegon sheshshama kol raam o raata zikkim vechayyotze baze mutteret veim pachada bide adam kegon sheshshachatu lefaneha behema acheret vechayyotze baze hare zo kachasera utrefa

Ketzad bodkin otah moshivin et harea bemayim meet leet veim haya zeman hakkor moshivin otah bemayim poshrin uvichli sheen hammayim mitmatztzin miggabbo venozlim kede shello yitztzonnu bimhera veim haya zeman hachom moshivin otah bemayim tzonen bichli shehammayim mitmatztzin miggabbo kede sheyyishshaaru karim im chazra livriyyatah hare zo bide shamayim umutteret veim lo chazra bide adam hi utrefa

Behema shehayeta chasera regel bitchillat beriyyatah terefa vechen im hayeta yetera regel shekkal hayyater kechaser hu aval im hau lah shalosh yadayim o yad achat mutteret lefichach im nechtach hayyad shellah mutteret nechtach haregel min haarkubba ulmala terefa min haarkubba ulmatta mutteret bee zo arkubba amru bearkubba shehu sof hayyarech hassamuch lagguf

Nishbar haetzem lemala min haarkubba im yatza kullo o rubbo lachutz hare ze kema shennechtach venafal utrefa veim haya habbasar o haor chofe rov avo verov hekkefo shel etzem shennishbar hare zo mutteret vaafillu nafal miktzat haetzem shennishbar vehalach lo vegidim harakkim enan chashuvin kevasar

Tzomet haggidin hen bivhema uvchayya lemala min heakev bemakom shettolin bo hattabbachim habbehema vehen shelosha gidin levanim echad ave ushnayim dakkim umimmakom sheyyatchil vehen kashim ulvanim ad sheyyasur halloven mehen veyatchilu lehitaddem ulhitrakkech hu tzomet haggidim vehu keorech shesh esre etzbaot beshor
Uminyan gidim ellu baof shishsha asar gidin techillatan min haetzem shel matta meetzba yetera ad sof haregel shehu asuy kaskassim kaskassim

Behema shennechtechu ragleha bimkom tzomet haggidin terefa veal titmah vetomar ketzad tachtoch lemala mitztzomet haggidim vehi mutteret ad shettachtoch lemala min haarkubba haelona kemo shebbearnu veim nechtach lematta mitztzomet haggidim asura shebbitrefot tachtoch mikkan vetichye umikkan vetamut velo neesra behema zo mippene shehi chatuchat regel mimmakom ze ella mippene shennechtechu haggidin shechatichatan mikkelal hatterefot kemo sheyyitbaer
Netula ketzad shelosha evarim hen sheim nittelu terefa veaf al pi sheen bahen din nekev velo din chesron veellu hen tzomet haggidim vehakkaved ulchi haelon

Uchvar bearnu shehabbehema shennechtach raglah vechen haof bimkom tzomet haggidim lo naasu terefa ella mippene shennechtechu haggidin lefichach im nechtechu haggidim levaddam veharegel kayyemet terefa shehare nittela tzomet haggidim

Nechtach bivhema haechad heave levaddo mutteret shehare nisharu shenayim nechtechu hashshenayim haddakkin mutteret shehare haechad heave gedol shenehen vahare lo nittal kal hatztzomet ella miutah nechtach rubbo shel kal echad mehen terefa veen tzarich lomar shennechtechu kullan o nittelu kullan
Uvaof afillu nechtach rubbo shel kal echad min hashshishsha asar terefa
Veof shennishtabberu agappav muttar kivhema shennechtechu yadeha

Kaved shennittela kullah terefa veim nishtayyer mimmenna kezayit bemakom shehi teluya bo uchzayit bimkom mara hare zo mutteret niddaldela hakkaved vahare hi meora battarpash shellah mutteret nittal mimmenna makom shehi teluya bo umkom hammara veaf al pi shehashshear kayyam kemo shehu terefa
Nishar bah kezayit bimkom mara uchzayit bemakom shehi teluya bo keshera aval haya mefuzzar meat bechan umat bechan o shehaya meruddad o shehaya aroch kirtzua hare zo safek veyerae li shehi asura
Lechi haelon shennittal terefa aval im nittal hattachton kegon shennigmam ad mekom hassimanin velo neekru hare zo mutteret

Kal evar shenneemar bo sheim haya chaser terefa kach im nittal terefa aval evar shenneemar bo im nittal terefa enah neeseret ella im nechtach oto evar aval im nivret chasera oto evar hare zo mutteret sheim lo tomar ken nimtzet hachasera vehannetula achat vechal evar shenneemar bo sheim nittal mutteret kal vachomer im chaser mittechillat beriyyatah velo nivra shehi mutteret
Behema shennittela haem shellah vehu bet harechem o shennittelu hakkelaot hare zo mutteret lefichach im nivret bechulya achat o beshalosh kelaot mutteret vechen im nikkeva hakkulya mutteret

Af al pi shehakkulya shennittela o chasera mutteret im nimtzet ketanna beoter vehakketanna bedaka ad kefol uvgassa ad keenav terefa vechen im lakta hakkulya vehu sheyyease besarah kivsar hammet shehivish achar yamim sheim teechoz bemiktzato yitmasmes veyippol vehiggia choli ze ad hallavan shebbetoch hakkulya hare zo terefa vechen im nimtzet bakkulya lecha af al pi sheenah serucha o shennimtza bah mayim achurin o seruchim hare zo terefa aval im nimtzeu bah mayim zakkim hare zo mutteret
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 9: Pesuka ketzad chut hashshidra shennifsak haor hachofe et hammoach terefa uvilvad sheyyippasek rov hekkefo aval im nisdak haor learko o nikkav mutteret vechen im nishbera hashshidra velo nifsak hachut shellah o shennitmaech hammoach shebbetoch hachut venitnadned hoil veoro kayyam hare zo mutteret
Humrach hammoach venishpach kammayim o kedonag shennames ad sheyyimmatze hachut keshemmaamido eno omed hare zo terefa veim eno yachol laamod mippene kavdo hare zo safek
Ad hechan chut hashshidra techillato mibbachutz lappolin shebbitchillat haoref ad sof parasha sheniyya shello yishshaer achareha ella parasha shelishit hassemucha litchillat haalya

Veshalosh parashiyyot hen veellu hen shelosha atzamot devukin ze baze lematta mechulot shel shidra vechut hashshidra baof ad ben agappayim aval lematta mimmekomot ellu en mashgichin al hachut hannimshach lesham ben shennifsak oro ben shennimrach hammoach

Kerua ketzad basar hachofe et rov hakkeres vehu hammakom min habbeten sheim yikkara yetze hakkeres im nikra basar ze terefa af al pi shello higgia hakkera lakkeres ad shenniret ella kevan shennikra rov ovi habbasar hazze o nittal terefa vechamma shiur hakkera bearko orech tefach veim hayeta behema ketanna venikra rov orech habbasar hachofe et hakkeres af al pi sheen beorech hakkera tefach terefa hoil venikra rubbah
Nikdar habbasar hazze beiggul o beorech im haya yater mikkesela vehu kede sheyyikkanes bo shalosh garine temara zo betzad zo bedochak hare zo terefa sheim yimmatach kera ze yaamod al tefach

Behema shennifshat haor shealeha kullo ben shennikra bayyad o becholi venimtza basar belo or hare zo terefa vezo hi shennikret geluda veim nishar min haor rochav sela al pene kal hashshidra verochav sela al hattabbur verochav sela al rashe evareha hare zo mutteret veim nittal kerochav sela meal kal pene hashshidra o meal hattabbur o meal rashe evareha ushar kal haor kayyam hare zo safek veyerae li shemmattirin otah

Nefula ketzad hare shennafla habbehema mimmakom gavoha sheggavho asara tefachim o yeter venitrassek evar meevareha hare zo terefa vechetzad hu harissuk sheyyitrotzetz haevar veyechele mechamat hannefila ad shettippased tzurato vetaoro af al pi shello nikkav velo nisdak velo nishbar hare zo terefa vechen im hikka otah beeven o bematte veritztzetz evar meevareha terefa bee ze evarim amru beevarim shebbachalal hagguf
Behema shennafla min haggag im halcha en choshshin lah veim amda velo halcha choshshin lah kaftza mechamat atzmah en choshshin lah hinnichah lemala umtzaah lematta en choshshin lah shemma nafla
Zecharim hamnaggechin ze et ze en choshshin lahen naflu laaretz choshshin lahen vechen behema shehayeta megareret ragleha en choshshin lah shemma nitrasseku evareha o shemma nifsak hachut shel shidra

Gannavim sheggonvin hattelaim umashlichin otan laachore haddir en choshshin lahen mishshum rissuk evarim mippene sheen mashlichin otan ella bechavana shello yishtabberu veim hechezirum vehishlichum laddir mechamat yira choshshin lahen mechamat teshuva en choshshin lahen mippene shemmitkaven lehachaziram shelemim veyizzaharu behashlachatan
Shor shehirbitzuhu lishchita af al pi shennafal nefila gedola sheyyesh lah kol beet shemmappilin oto en choshshin lo mippene shennoetz tzipparnav umitchazzek ad shemmaggia laaretz

Hikka habbehema al roshah vehalcha lah hammakka kelappe zenavah o al zenavah vehalcha lah kelappe roshah vaafillu hikka otah bammatte al kal hashshidra en choshshin lah veim yesh bammatte chulot chulot choshshin lah veim higgia rosh hammatte lemiktzat hashshidra choshshin lah vechen im hikka lerochav hashshidra choshshin lah

Of shennechbat al davar kashe kegon keri shel chittim o kuppa shel shekedim vechayyotze bahen choshshin lerissuk evarim veim nechbat al davar rach kegon kesut kefula vehatteven vehaefer vechayyotze bahen en choshshin lo
Nidbeku kenafav bedevek bishat tzida venitchabbet im bechanaf achat neechaz en choshshin lo veim neechaz bishte kenafav venitchabbet begufo choshshin lo

Nechbat al pene hammayim im shat melo komato mimmatta lemala leemmat hammayim en choshshin lo aval im shat mimmala lematta im hilluch hammayim choshshin lo shemma hammayim hem hammolichin oto veim kadam leteven o kash shemmehallechin al gabbe hammayim hare zo shat mechamat atzmo veen choshshin lo

Kal makom sheamarnu en choshshin lah muttar lishchot miyyad veeno tzarich livdok shemma nitrassek evar vechal makom sheamarnu choshshin lah im shechatah tzarich livdok keneged kal hechalal kullo mikkadkod harosh ad hayyarech im matza bah terefa min hatterefot shemmaninu o shennitrassek evar min haevarim shebbifnim venifseda tzurato hare zo terefa afillu nitrassek evar min haevarim sheim nittelu keshera kegon techol uchlaot hare zo terefa chutz mibbet harechem sheim nitrassek hare zo mutteret
Vehassimanin enan tzerichin bedika bechan sheen hannefila memaechet otan
Nafla min haggag velo amda asur lishchot otah ad shettishhe meet leet veim shachat betoch zeman ze hare zo terefa uchsheshshochet otah achar meet leet tzericha bedika kemo shebbearnu
Vechen mi sheddaras beraglo al haof o shedderasattu behema o shetterafo lakkotel vahare hu mefarkes mashhin oto meet leet veachar kach shochatin oto uvodkin oto kederech shebbearnu

Simanim shenniddaldelu rubban terefa vaafillu shello mechamat nefila vechen im nitkappelu shehare enan reuyin lishchita aval im nitparek rov tarbatz haveshet min hallechi hare zo mutteret sheen hattarbatz rauy lishchita kemo shebbearnu
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 10: Shevura ketzad hu shennishtabberu rov tzaloteha vetzalot habbehema hen achat esre mikan veachat esre mikan nishtabberu shesh mikan veshesh mikkan o achat esre mikkan veachat mikkan terefa vehu shennishberu mechetzyan shel mul hashshidra

Nishberu shesh mikkan veshesh mikkan im hau tzelaot gedolot sheyyesh bahen moach terefa veim lav af al pi shehen rov veaf al pi shennishberu kelappe hashshidra mutteret vechen im neekru rov tzaloteha terefa veim neekra afillu tzela achat vachatzi chulyatah immah shehatztzela tekua bah hare zo terefa vechen im neekra min hashshidra chulya achat afillu hayeta min hachulot shellematta min hakkesalim sheen bahen tzelaot hare zo terefa

Behema shennishmat hayyarech shellah meikkaro veyatza min hakkaf shello im nitakkelu nivav vehen hayetedot shebbeetzem hakkaf sheyyotzet al haetzem hazzachar veochezet oto hare zo terefa veim lo nitakkelu mutteret

Vechen baof im nishmat yerecho terefa nishmat kenafo meikkaro choshshin shemma nikkeva harea shello ulfichach bodkin otah veachar kach yeachel uvhema shennishmeta yadah meikkarah mutteret veen choshshin lah
Gulgolet behema o chayya shennittal mimmenna kesela af al pi shello nikkav hakkerum terefa veim nikkevu nekavim sheyyesh bahen chesron kullan mitztarfin lichsela

Vechen gulgolet shennechbas rov gavhah verov hekkefah terefa af al pi shehakkerum shalem velo chaser mimmenna kelum nechbas rov gavhah vahare rov hekkefah kayyam o shennechbas rov hekkefah vahare rov gavhah kayyam hare zo sefek terefa veyerae li sheosrin otah

Of shel mayim kegon avazim im nikkav etzem gulgalto af al pi shello nikkav kerum shel moach terefa mippene shekkerumo rach of hayyabbasha shehikkattu chulda al rosho o shenniggaf beeven o beetz manniach yado betzad hannekev venoetz o machnis yado letoch piv vedochek lemala im yatza hammoach min hannekev beyadua shennikkav hakkerum utrefa veim lav muttar

Behema sheachazah dam o shehayeta meushshenet o metzunnenet o sheachla sam shehoreg habbehema o shatta mayim haraim hare zo mutteret achla sam shehoreg et haadam o shenneshachah nachash vechayyotze bo mutteret mishshum terefa vaasura mippene sakkanat nefashot

Nimtzeu kal hatterefot hammenuot kesheyyippartu veefshar sheyyimmatzu bivhema vechayya shivim veellu hen al hasseder shennitbaaru bechibbur ze derusa nikkav tarbatz haveshet nikkav kerum shel moach nitmasmes hammoach atzmo nikkav hallev atzmo levet chalalo nikkav kene hallev nikkeva hammara nikkevu kene hakkaved nikkeva hakkeva nikkav hakkeres nikkav hemses nikkav bet hakkosot nikkevu meeha yatzu hammeayim lachutz venehefchu nikkav hattechol beavo chasera hammara nimtzeu shette merarot chasera hakkeva nimtzeu shette kevot chaser hakkeres nimtzeu shene keresim chaser hemses nimtzeu shene mesasim chaser bet hakkosot nimtzeu shene batte hakkosot chaser echad min hammeayim nimtzeu shene meayim nikkeva harea nikkav hakkane lematta bemakom sheeno rauy lishchita nikkav simpon missimpone rea afillu lachavero lo neetam makom min harea nimmok simpon missimpone harea nimtzea lecha serucha barea nimtzeu bah mayim seruchim nimtzeu bah mayim achurin af al pi shello hisrichu nitmasmesa harea nishtannu mareha nehefach haveshet bemarav chasera harea mimminyan haunnot nitchallefu haunnot hotiru haunnot miggabbah nisrecha unna leunna shello kesidran nimtzea harea belo chittuch aznayim chaser miktzat harea yavesh miktzat gufah nimtzea harea nefucha veomedet tzamka harea mippachad adam chaser haregel ben mittechillat beriyyato ben shennechtach o shehayeta yetera regel nittela tzomet haggidim nittela hakkaved nittal lechi haelon kulya shehiktina beoter kulya shellakta kulya shennimtzet bah lecha kulya shennimtzeu bah mayim achurin af al pi sheenan seruchin kulya shennimtzeu bah mayim seruchin nifsak chut hashshidra nimrach moach chut hashshidra venitmasmes nikra rov habbasar hachofe et hakkeres niglad haor shealeha nitrasseku evareha minnefila niddaldelu hassimanin nishtabberu rov tzaloteha neekru rov tzaloteha neekra tzela achat bechulyatah neekra chulya achat nishmat hayyarech meikkaro chasera haggulgolet kesela nechbas rov haggulgolet venitrotzetz

Ellu hashshivim cholayim sheosrin et habbehema veet hachayya mishshum terefa kevar nitbaer kal echad mehen umishpatav vechal sheefshar mehen sheyyimmatze baof baevarin hammetzuyin laof velabbehema dino bivhema uvof echad hu chutz mitterefot shebbechulya veshebbattechol veshebbeunnot harea mippene shehaof en lo chittuch unnot kivhema veim yimmatze en lo minyan yadua utchol haof agol kemo enav veeno kitchol behema utrefot shebbakkulya veshebbattechol lo manu otan bivhema kede sheyyihye kenegdan baof ulfichach lo natnu lechulya shehiktina shiur baof vechen kal kayyotze baze
Ushte terefot yesh baof yeter al habbehema veaf al pi sheyyesh lah otan haevarim veellu hen of shennishtannu mare bene meav mechamat haur veof hammayim shennikkav etzem rosho

Veen lehosif al terefot ellu kelal shekkal sheera livhema o lechayya o leof chutz meellu shemmanu chachme dorot harishonim vehiskimu alehen bevatte dine yisrael efshar shettichye vaafillu noda lanu midderech harfua sheen sofah lichot

Vechen ellu shemmanu veamru shehen terefa af al pi sheyyerae bedarche harfua shebbeyadenu shemmiktzatan enan memitin veefshar shettichye mehen en lecha ella ma shemmanu chachamim shenneemar al pi hattora asher yorucha

Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 11: Kal behema o of shennolod bahen sefek terefot mitterefot ellu kegon behema shennafla velo halcha o shennidresa bide chayya veen yadua im heedim basar keneged bene meayim o lo heedim o shennechbesa gulgaltah veen yadua im rubbah o miutah vechayyotze bidvarim ellu im haya zachar veshaha shenem asar chodesh hare zo bechezkat shelema kishar kal habbehemot veim hayeta nekeva ad shetteled uvof bezachar shenem asar chodesh uvinkeva ad shetteled kal habbetzim shel teina harishona vetiton teina sheniyya veteled
Veasur limkor sefek terefa zo lenachri betoch zeman ze shemma yimkerenna leyisrael

Kal behema chayya veof bechezkat beriim hem veen choshshin lahem shemma yesh bahen terefa lefichach kesheyyishachatu shechita keshera enan tzerichin bedika shemma yesh bahen achat min hatterefot ella hare hen bechezkat hetter ad sheyyivaled lahen davar shechoshshin lo veachar kach bodkin al oto davar bilvad

Ketzad kegon shennishmat haggaf shel of bodkin et harea shemma nikkeva nafla habbehema bodkin otah shemma nitrasseku evareha nitratztzetz etzem harosh bodkin kerum shel moach shemma nikkav hikka otah kotz o nizrak bah chetz o romach vechayyotze bahen venichnas lachalalah choshshin lah utzricha bedika keneged kal hechalal shemma nikkav echad min haevarin shettittaref binkivatan vechen kal kayyotze baze

Lefichach rea sheheelta tzemachin o shennimtzeu sirchot kemo chutin teluyin mimmenna veladdofen o lallev o letarpash hakkaved choshshin lah shemma nikkeva utzricha bedika vechen im nimtza bah avabua male lecha choshshin shemma nikkav simpon shettachtav utzricha bedika

Min haddin haya al derech zo sheim nimtzet harea teluya besirchot kemo chutin im hau min haom shel rea veladdofen o shehau lallev o letarpash hakkaved shechotchim et hassircha umotziin et harea venofchin otah befoshrin im nimtzet nekuva terefa veim lo nitbabea hammayim hare hi shelema mikkal nekev umutteret vesircha zo lo hayeta bimkom nekev o shemma nikkav kerum haelon bilvad umeolam lo rainu mi shehora kach velo shamanu makom sheosin bo kach

Veaf al pi sheellu hen haddevarim hannirin middivre chachme haggemara hamminhag happashut beyisrael kach hu kesheshshochatin et habbehema o et hachayya korin et hattarpash shel kaved uvodkin et harea bimkomah im lo nimtzea teluya besircha o shennimtzea sircha ben ozen meazne harea velabbasar shebbimkom revitzatah ben basar shebben hatztzelaot ben basar shebbechaze o shennimtzea sircha meozen leozen al hasseder o min haom laozen hassemucha lah hare ellu mattirin otah
Veim nimtza chut yotze min haom shel rea leeze makom sheyyimmashech vaafillu haya kechut hassaara osrin otah

Vechen im haya min harea chut mashuch lallev o letarpash hakkaved o lechis hallev o lavarda ben shehaya hachut min haom shel rea ben shehaya min haozen vaafillu haya kechut hassaara osrin otah vechen varda shennimtzet devuka bechisah o chut yotze mimmenna lechisah osrin otah vechut hayyotze meozen leozen shello al hasseder osrin otah

Yesh mekomot shemminhagan im matzu sircha min haozen labbasar velaetzem shebbatztzelaot vehassircha devuka bishtehen osrin otah veabba mari min haosrin vaani min hammattirin umiut mekomot mattirin afillu nidbeka baetzem levaddo vaani oser

Veyesh mekomot shennofchin harea shemma yesh bah nekev verov hammekomot en nofchin shehare lo nolad davar sheggorem lachashash umeolam lo nafachnu rea bisfarad uvammaarav ella im nolad lanu davar shechoshshim lo
Udvarim haellu kullan enan al pi haddin ella al pi hamminhag kemo shebbearnu umeolam lo shamanu bemi shebbadak of ella im nolad lo chashash

Mi sheshshachat et habbehema vekara et habbeten vekodem sheyyivdok et harea ba kelev o akkum venatal et harea vehalach lo hare zo mutteret veen omrim shemma nekuva hayeta o shemma devuka hayeta sheen machazikin issur ella hare zo bechezkat hetter ad sheyyivada bamme nitrefa uchshem sheen choshshin likrum moach velashshidra vechayyotze bahen kach lo nachush larea sheavda veen baze minhag sheddavar sheeno matzuy en bo minhag
Ba haakkum o hayyisrael vehotzi harea kodem shettibbadek vahare hi kayyemet nofchin otah veaf al pi sheen anu yodin im hau sham tzemachin o lo hau mippene pishshut hamminhag

Yesh mekomot sheim nimtzeu sirchot meduldalot min harea af al pi sheenan devukot lo laddofen velo lemakom acher osrin otah vedavar ze hefsed gadol hu veibbud mamon leyisrael umeolam lo nahagu ze lo betzarfat velo bisfarad velo nishma ze bammaarav veen rauy linhog beminhag ze ella nofchin otah bilvad im nimtzet shelema min hannekev hare zo mutteret
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 12: Hashochet oto veet beno beom echad habbasar muttar baachila vehashshochet loke shenneemar oto veet beno lo tishchatu beom echad veeno loke ella al shechitat haacharon lefichach im shachat echad mishshenehen uva chavero veshachat et hashsheni chavero loke

Issur oto veet beno noheg bechal zeman uvchal makom bechullin uvmukdashin ben kadashim hanneechalin ben kadashim sheenan neechalin lefichach harishon sheshshachat baazara vehashsheni bachutz o harishon bachutz vehashsheni baazara ben shehau shenehen chullin o shenehen kadashim ben shehaya echad mehen chullin veechad kadashim ze sheshshachat acharon loke mishshum oto veet beno

En issur oto veet beno noheg ella bishchita bilvad shenneemar lo tishchatu bishchitat shenehen hu haissur aval im nachar harishon o nitnabbel beyado muttar lishchot vechen im shachat harishon venichar hashsheni o nitnabbel beyado patur
Cheresh shote vekatan sheshshachatu benam leven atzman et harishon muttar lishchot sheni acharehem lefi sheen shechitatan shechita kelal
Hashshochet et harishon vahare hu sefek nevela asur lishchot hashsheni veim shechato eno loke

Shechato leakkum patur mishshum oto veet beno shehare nitchayyev benafsho veim hitru bo mishshum oto veet beno velo hitru bo mishshum akkum loke

En issur oto veet beno noheg ella bivhema tehora bilvad shenneemar veshor o se oto veet beno lo tishchatu beom echad venoheg bechilayim ketzad tzevi shebba al haez veshachat haez veet benah loke aval haez shebba al hatztzivya asur lishchot otah veet benah veim shachat eno loke para uvnah asra tora lo tzivya uvnah

Hayeta bat hatztzivya hazzot nekeva veyalda ben veshachat et hannekeva bat hatztzivya veet benah loke vechen kilayim habba mimmin keves umimmin ez ben mikkeves im haez ben meez im hakkivsa loke mishshum oto veet beno
Muttar lishchot et hamubberet ubbar yerech immo hu veim yatza haubbar chay achar shechita vehifris al gabbe karka en shochatin oto beom echad veim shachat eno loke
Issur oto veet beno noheg binkevot shezze benah vadday veim noda vadday shezze hu aviv en shochatin shenehen beom echad veim shachat eno loke shehaddavar safek im noheg bizcharim o eno noheg

Shenayim shellakchu shette behemot ze haem veze habbat uvau ledin ze shellakach rishon yishchot rishon vehashsheni yamtin lemachar veim kadam hashsheni veshachat zacha veyamtin harishon ad lemachar

Bamme devarim amurim kesheraa ze shellakach baacharona nechpaz liknot vehaya besof hayyom shechezkato shehu shochet atta aval im haya revach bayyom eno tzarich lehodio shemma lo yishchot ella lemachar
Vehammocher et haem lechatan vehabbat lakkalla tzarich lehodian shevadday beom echad shochatin vechen kal kayyotze baze

Yom echad haamur beoto veet beno hayyom holech achar hallayela ketzad hare sheshshachat rishon bitchillat lel revii lo yishchot hashsheni ad techillat lel chamishi vechen im shachat harishon besof yom revii kodem ben hashshemashot shochet hashsheni bitchillat lel chamishi shachat rishon ben hashshemashot shel lel chamishi lo yishchot hashsheni ad lel shishshi veim shachat beom chamishi eno loke
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 13: Halokeach em al habbanim ushichatah habbasar muttar baachila veloke al shechitat haem shenneemar lo tikkach haem al habbanim vechen im meta kodem sheyeshallechenna loke veim shillechah achar shellekachah patur
Vechen kal mitzvat lo taase shennitteka laase chayyav lekayyem ase shebbah veim lo kiyemo loke
Ba echad vechataf haem miyyado veshillechah o shebbarcha mittachat yado shello middato loke shenneemar shalleach teshallach ad sheyeshalleach meatzmo vahare lo kiyyem ase shebbah

Natal em al habbanim vekitztzetz agappeha kede shello tauf veshillechah makkin oto makkat mardut umashhe otah etzlo ad sheyyigdelu kenafeha umshallechah veim meta kodem laze o barcha veavda loke shehare lo kiyyem ase shebbah
Vechetzad meshalleach haem ochez bichnafeha umafrichah shillechah vechazra veshillechah vechazra afillu arba vechamesh peamim chayyav leshalleach shenneemar shalleach teshallach
Haomer hareni notel et haem umshalleach et habbanim chayyav leshalleach et haem shenneemar shalleach teshallach et haem

Lakach et habbanim vehecheziran lakken veachar kach chazra haem alehen patur milleshalleach shilleach et haem vechazar vetzad otah hare ze muttar lo asra tora ella latzud otah vehi enah yechola lifroach bishvil habbanim shehi merachefet alehen shello yillakchu shenneemar vehaem rovetzet al haefrochim aval im hotziah mittachat yado vechazar vetzad otah muttar

Shilluach haem eno noheg ella beof tahor sheeno mezumman kegon yone shovach vaaliyya veofot shekkinnenu bappardes shenneemar ki yikkare aval hamzumman kegon avazin vetarnegolin veonim shekkinnenu babbayit eno chayyav leshalleach
Hau haefrochin mafrichin sheenan tzerichin leimman o betzim muzarot eno chayyav leshalleach hau efrochin terefot hare ellu kevetzim muzarot ufatur milleshalleach
Zachar shemmetzao rovetz al hakken patur milleshalleach of tame rovetz al betze of tahor o of tahor rovetz al betze of tame patur milleshalleach
Hayeta rovetzet al betzim sheenan minah vehen tehorin hare ze meshalleach veim lo shilleach eno loke hayeta haem terefa chayyav leshallechah
Shachat miktzat simanin betoch hakken kodem sheyyikkachenna chayyav leshalleach veim lo shilleach eno loke
Hayeta meofefet im kenafeha nogot bakken chayyav leshalleach veim lav patur milleshalleach hayeta matlit o kenafayim chotztzot ben kenafeha uven hakken hare ze meshalleach veim lo shilleach eno loke

Hau shene sidre betzim uchnafeha nogot basseder haelon o shehayeta rovetzet al betzim muzarot vetachtehen betzim yafot o shehayeta em al gabbe em o shehaya hazzachar al hakken vehaem al hazzachar hare ze lo yikkach veim lakach yeshalleach veim lo shilleach eno loke
Hayeta yoshevet ben haefrochim o ben habbetzim veenah nogaat bahen patur milleshalleach vechen im hayeta betzad hakken uchnafeha nogot bakken mitztziddo patur milleshalleach
Hayeta al shene badde ilan vehakken benehen roin kal sheillu yinnatlu habbaddin tippol al hakken chayyav leshalleach

Hayeta rovetzet al efroach echad o al betza achat chayyav leshalleach hammotze ken al pene hammayim o al gabbe baale chayyim chayyav leshalleach lo neemar efrochim o betzim velo neemar bechal etz o al haaretz ella sheddibber hakkatuv behove

Asur lizkot babbetzim kal zeman shehaem rovetzet alehen lefichach afillu hayeta rovetzet al habbetzim o al haefrochim baaliyyato ushovacho enan mezummanin velo kana lo chatzero keshem sheeno yachol lizkot bahen laacherim kach lo tizke lo chatzero bahen ulfichach chayyav leshalleach
Asur littol em al habbanim vaafillu letaher bahen et hamtzora shehi mitzva veim lakach chayyav leshalleach veim lo shilleach loke sheen ase doche lo taase vaase vaase velo ase doche ase

Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 14: Mitzvat ase lechassot dam shichitat chayya tehora o of tahor shenneemar asher yatzud tzed chayya o of asher yeachel veshafach et damo vechissahu beafar lefichach chayyav levarech kodem sheyechasse baruch atta Adonai elokenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vetzivanu al kissuy haddam

Kissuy haddam noheg bimzumman uvsheeno mezumman lo neemar asher yatzud ella bahove venoheg bechullin velo bemukdashin ben kadshe hammizbeach ben kadshe bedek habbayit veim avar ushchatan eno chayyav lechassot et daman
Shachat chayya veof veachar kach hikdishan o hikdish et haddam chayyav lechassot

Hashshochet ofot umine chayya bemakom echad mevarech beracha achat lechullan vechissuy echad lechullan

Dam shennitarev bammayim im yesh bo mare dam chayyav lechassot veim lav patur nitarev beyayin o bedam behema roin otan keillu hem mayim im efshar sheyerae mare haddam shechayyav lechassoto keshiur ze illu haya mayim chayyav lechassot hakkol veim lav patur
Kissahu venitgalla eno chayyav lechassoto paam acheret kissathu haruach eno chayyav lechassot chazar venitgalla achar shekkissathu haruach chayyav lechassot
Dam hannittaz vesheal hassakkin im en sham dam ella hu chayyav lechassot
Shachat venivla haddam bakkarka im rishshumo nikkar chayyav lechassot veim lav hare ze kemi shekkissathu haruach ufatur millechassot

En chayyav bechissuy ella dam shechita haruya laachila shenneemar asher yeachel lefichach hashshochet venimtzet terefa o hashshochet chullin baazara o hashshochet chayya veof shennigmar dinan liskila vehashshochet venitnabbela beyado patur millechassot vechen cheres shote vekatan sheshshachatu benan leven atzman peturin millechassot dam shechitatan

Bamme mechassin besid uvgafsit bezevel dak uvchol dak sheen hayyotzer tzarich lechatsho uvishchikat avanim vacharasim uvinoret shel pishtan dakka uvinsoret charasim dakka uvilvena vecharsit umgufa shekketashah shekkal ellu min afar hen aval im kafa alav keli o kissahu baavanim en ze kissuy shenneemar beafar

Lefichach en mechassim bezevel gas vechol gas vekemach vesubbin umorsan ushchikat kele mattachot lefi sheen ellu min afar chutz mishshechikat hazzahav bilvad shemmechassin bahem mippene shennikra afar shenneemar veafrot zahav lo veomer ad asher dak leafar

Mechassin beshichor vehu piach hakkivshan uvchochal uvnikrat pesilim uvefer ben efer etzim ben efer begadim afillu efer basar shennisraf shehare katuv meafar serefat hachattat umuttar lechassot beafar ir hanniddachat
Hashshochet tzarich litten afar lematta veachar kach yishchot bo veachar kach yechasse beafar aval lo yishchot bichli vichasse beafar
Umi sheshshachat hu yechasse shenneemar vechissahu beafar veim lo kissahu veraahu acher chayyav lechassot shezzo mitzva bifne atzmah veenah teluya bashshochet levad

Mishneh Torah, Borrowing and Deposit 1: Hashshoel kelim o behema vechayyotze bahen mishshear mittaltelin mechavero veavad o nignav afillu neenas ones gadol kegon shennishbera habbehema o nishbet o meta chayyav leshallem hakkol shenneemar vechi yishal ish meim reehu vego venishbar o met bealav en immo shallem yeshallem bamme devarim amurim keshenneenas shello bishat melacha aval im shaal behema mechavero lachrosh bah umeta keshehi choreshet hare ze patur aval im meta kodem sheyyacharosh bah o achar shecharash bah o sherachav aleha o dash bah umeta keshehi dasha o bishat rechiva hare ze chayyav leshallem vechen kal kayyotze baze vechen hashshoel behema mechavero lelech bah lemakom peloni umeta tachtav beotah hadderech o sheshshaal deli lemalleot bo venikra babbor bishat milluy o sheshshaal kardom lefatztzel bo etzim venishbar beet sheppitztzel bo mechamat habbikkua vechal kayyotze baze hare ze patur shello shaal ella laasot bo melacha zo vahare lo shinna

Hashshoel behema mechavero umeta vetaan hashshoel shebbishat melacha meta im haya hammakom sheshshaala lelech bo makom shebbene adam metzuyin sham yavi reaya shemmeta o neensa bishat melacha veshello shinna bah veyippater veim lo hevi reaya meshallem sheala mimmennu lemalleot bah afar shebbechurbato sheen haedim metzuyin sham o sheshshaal mimmennu deli lemalleot bo habbor betoch beto venikra babbor im hevi reaya yippater af mishshevua veim lav yishshava hashshoel shevuat hashshomrim shemmeta bishat melacha veyippater vechen kal kayyotze baze

Echad hammashken et chavero bevet din o shemmishkeno beyado bizroa o middaat hallo im ish ani hu umishkeno davar shehu tzarich lo hare ze metzuve lehachzir lo haavot beet shehu tzarich lo machzir lo et hakkar ballayela kede lishon alav veet hammachresha bayyom kede laasot bah melachto shenneemar hashev tashiv lo et haavot avar velo heshiv lo keli hayyom bayyom uchli hallayela ballayela over belo taase shenneemar lo tishkav baavoto lo tishkav vaavoto etzlecha zo kesut layela uvchelim shehu ose bahen melachto bayyom o lovshan hu omer ad bo hashshemesh teshivennu lo melammed sheyyachaziro kal hayyom im ken hu shemmachzir lo hammashkon beet shehu tzarich lo velokeach otah beet sheeno tzarich lo ma yoil hammashkon kede shello yishshamet hachov bishviit velo yease mittaltelin etzel banav ella yippara min hammashkon achar shemmet hallo ha lamadta shehammashken et heani davar shehu tzarich lo velo hecheziro lo bizmanno over mishshum shelosha shemot mishshum lo tavo el beto umishshum hashev tashiv lo et haavot umishshum lo tishkav baavoto bamme devarim amurim shemmishkeno shello bishat halvaato aval im mishkeno bishat halvaato eno chayyav lehachzir kelal veeno over beshem min hashshemot haellu

Sheliach bet din shebba lemashken lo yemashken devarim shei efshar laadam litten otam mashkon kegon beged shealav uchli sheochel bo vechayyotze beellu umanniach mitta umatztza leashir umitta umappatz leani vechal hannimtza beyado chutz meellu yesh lo lemashkeno veyachzir lo keli hayyom bayyom uchli hallayela ballayela hau lefanav shene kelim notel echad umachazir echad ad matay hu chayyav lehachzir velikkach ad leolam veim haya hammashkon middevarim sheeno tzarich lahem veen mannichin otan lallo hare ze mannicho etzlo ad sheloshim yom umishsheloshim yom veelach mocher hammashkon bevet din met hallo eno machzir levanav met hallo achar sheheshiv lo hammashkon shomto hammalve meal banav veeno machzir

Hearev muttar lemashken bizroa ulhikkanes leveto velittol hammashkon shenneemar lekach bigdo ki arav zar vechen mi sheyyesh lo sachar etzel chavero ben sechar melachto ben sechar behemto vechelav ben sechar beto hare ze muttar lemashkeno shello al pi bet din venichnas leveto venotel hammashkon bischaro veim zakaf alav hassachar bemilve asur shenneemar ki tashshe vereacha mashshat meuma vego

Mi shehaya beyado mashkono shel ani im haya secharo yater al pechato kegon kardom umassar haggadol vechayyotze bahen hare ze muttar lehaskiro umnakke secharo tamid bechovo mippene shezze kemeshiv aveda veen tzarich reshut bealim
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 4: Neshech umarbit echad hu shenneemar et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech uvmarbit lo titten achlecha ulhallan hu omer neshech kesef neshech ochel neshech kal davar asher yishshach velamma nikra shemo neshech mippene shehu noshech shemmetzaer et chavero veochel et besaro velamma chillekan hakkatuv laavor alav bishne lavin

Kederech sheasur lehalot kach asur lilot beribbit shenneemar lo tashshich leachicha mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo azhara lallo kelomar lo tinshoch leachich vechen asur lehitassek ben lo umalve beribbit vechal mi shehaya arev o sofer o ed benehen hare ze over belo taase shenneemar lo tesimun alav neshech zo azhara af laedim velaarev velassofer ha lamadta shehammalve beribbit over al shishsha lavin lo tihye lo kenshe et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech uvmarbit lo titten achlecha al tikkach meitto neshech vetarbit lo tesimun alav neshech velifne iver lo titten michshl vehallo over bishnayim lo tashshich leachicha velifne iver lo titten michshol arev veedim vechayyotze bahen en ovrin ella mishshum lo tesimun alav neshech vechal mi shehaya sarsur ben shenehem o shessiyyea echad mehen o horahu over mishshum lifne iver lo titten michshol

Af al pi shehammalve vehallo ovrin al kal ellu hallavin enan lokin alav mippene shennittan lehishshavon shekkal hammalve beribbit im hayeta ribbit ketzutza shehi asura min hattora hare zo yotza bedayyanin umotziin otah min hammalve umachzirin lallo veim met hammalve en motziin miyyad habbanim

Hinniach lahem avihem maot shel ribbit af al pi shehen yodin shehen shel ribbit enan chayyavim lehachzir hinniach lahem para vetallit shel ribbit vechal davar hamsuyyam chayyavim lehachzir mippene kevod avihen bamme devarim amurim kesheasa teshuva velo hispik lehachzir ad shemmet aval im lo asa teshuva en choshshin lichvodo vaafillu davar hamsuyyam en machazirin

Haggazlanin umalve beribbit shehechziru en mekabbelin mehen kede liftoach lahen derech litshuva vechal hamkabbel mehen en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu im hayeta gezela kayyemet veharibbit davar hamsuyyam vahare hu beatzmo mekabbelin mehen

Shetar shekkatuv bo ribbit ben ketzutza ben shel divrehem gove et hakkeren veeno gove et haribbit kadam vegava hakkol motziin mimmennu haribbit ketzutza aval avak ribbit shehu middivrehem eno gove min hallo lammalve veen machazirin oto min hammalve lallo

Kal hakkotev shetar ribbit hare ze kechotev umeid alav edim shekkafar ba elohe yisrael vechen kal hallo umalve beribbit benan leven atzman hare hen kechofrim ba elohe yisrael vechafru bitziat mitzrayim shenneemar et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech vego ani Adonai elohechem asher hotzeti etchem meeretz mitzrayim
Asur leadam lehalot banav uvne beto beribbit af al pi sheeno makpid umattana hu shennoten lahen hare ze asur shemma yargilem bedavar ze
Talmide chachamim shehilu ze et ze venatan lo yeter al ma shehilva mimmennu hare ze muttar shehaddavar yadua shello natan lo ella mattana shehare hen yodin chomer issur haribbit

Hammalve et chavero umatza hallo yoter o shehechzir lo chovo umatza hammalve yoter im bichde shehaddaat toa chayyav lehachzir veim lav mattana hu shennatan lo o gezela hayeta lo beyado vehivlia lo becheshbon o acher tziva lehavlia lo bechamma haddaat toa beechad uvishnayim o bachamishsha o baasara shemma mana chamishsha chamishsha o asara asara vechen im matza yater minyan hachamishiyyot o minyan haasiriyyot echad echad chayyav lehachzir lo shemma haachadim shehaya mone bahen hachamishiyyot o haasiriyyot nitarvu immahem

Hammalve et chavero al hammatbea vechen hakkotev leishto bichtubbatah matbea yadua uferesh mishkalo vehosifu al mishkalo im huzlu happerot mechamat hattosefet menakke lo shiur hattosefet vaafillu hosifu alav kal shehu veim lo huzlu mechamat hattosefet eno menakke lo ella noten lo mimmatbea hayyotze beotah shaa bamme devarim amurim beshehosifu alav ad chamishito kegon shehaya mishkalo arbaa vaasao chamishsha aval im hosifu lo yoter al chamishito menakke lo kal hattosefet af al pi shello huzlu happerot vehu haddin lemalve al hammatbea ufachatu mimmennu

Hammalve et chavero al hammatbea venifsal im yachol lehotzio bimdina acheret veyesh lo derech leotah medina noten lo mimmatbea shehilvahu veomer lo lech vehotzio bemakom peloni veim en lo derech lesham noten lo mimmatbea hayyotze beotah shaa vechen bichtubba

Horu miktzat haggeonim shehallo shemmachal lammalve beribbit shellakach mimmennu o sheatid likkach af al pi shekkanu miyyado shemmachal o natan mattana eno moil kelum shekkal ribbit shebbaolam mechila hi aval hattora lo machala veasra mechila zo ulfichach en hammechila moelet beribbit afillu beribbit shel divrehem yerae li sheen horaa zo nechona ella meachar sheomrim lammalve lehachzir lo veyada hammalve sheddevar issur asa veyesh lo littol mimmennu im ratza limchol mochel kederech shemmochel haggezel uvferush amru chachamim shehaggazlanin umalve beribbit shehechziru en mekabbelin mehen mikkelal shehammechila moelet

Nichse yetomim muttar litten otam leadam neeman sheyyesh lo nechasim tovim karov lesachar verachok lehefsed ketzad omer lo tihye nose venoten bahen im yesh sham revach ten lahem chelkan min harevach veim yesh sham hefsed tafsid atta levaddecha shezze avak ribbit hu vechal avak ribbit enah asura ella middivrehem uvnichse yetomim lo gazru
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 5: Haakkum veger toshav lon mehen umalvin otan beribbit shenneemar lo tashshich leachicha leachich asur velishar haolam muttar umitzvat ase lehashshich leakkum shenneemar lannachri tashshich mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo mitzvat ase vezehu din tora

Asru chachamim sheyyihye yisrael malve et haakkum beribbit ketzutza ella bichde chayyav gazru shemma yilmod mimmaasav berov yeshivato immo lefichach muttar lilot min haakkum beribbit shehare hu boreach millefanav veeno ragil etzlo vetalmid chacham sheeno ragil bo lilmod mimmaasav muttar lehalot laakkum beribbit afillu leharviach vechal avak ribbit im haakkum mutteret lakkol

Yisrael shellava maot min haakkum beribbit uvikkesh lehachziram lo metzao yisrael acher veamar lo tenem li vaani maale lecha kederech sheatta maale laakkum hare zo ribbit ketzutza afillu heemido etzel haakkum ad sheyyittol haakkum meotav veyachzor veyittenem beyad yisrael haacher

Akkum shellava maot miyyisrael beribbit uvikkesh lehachziram lo metzao yisrael acher veamar lo tenem li vaani maale lecha kederech sheatta maale leyisrael hare ze muttar veim heemido etzel yisrael af al pi shennatan haakkum hammaot beyado hoil umiddaat yisrael natan hare zo ribbit ketzutza

Asur leyisrael litlot meotav beyad akkum kede lehalotan beribbit leyisrael veakkum shehilva et yisrael beribbit asur leyisrael acher lihot lo arev shekkevan shebbedinehem shettovea hearev techilla nimtza hearev tovea et yisrael beribbit shehearev chayyav bah laakkum lefichach im kibbel alav haakkum shello yitba et hearev techilla hare ze muttar

Yisrael shellava maot min haakkum beribbit uzkafan alav bemilve venitgayyer im ad shello nitgayyer zekafan alav bemilve gove et hakkeren veharibbit veim mishshennitgayyer zekafan alav bemilve gove et hakkeren velo et haribbit aval akkum shellava miyyisrael beribbit vezakaf alav et haribbit bemilve af al pi shezzekafan alav acher shennitgayyer gove et hakkeren veet haribbit shello yomru bishvil meotav nitgayyer ze vegove hayyisrael mimmennu achar shennitgayyer kal meot haribbit shennitchayyev bahen keshehaya akkum
Mitzva lehakdim halvaat yisrael bechinnam lehalvaat akkum beribbit

Hammishtattef im chavero bemaot o bekarka o hannoten lo esek lo yetzaref hassachar im hakkeren shemma lo yihye sham sachar venimtzeu bain lide ribbit vechen lo yitten lo maot betorat esek o shuttafut veyichtov otan milve shemma yamut venimtza hashshetar beyad hayyoresh vegove bo et haribbit

Asur lehakdim haribbit o leacher oto ketzad natan enav lilot mimmennu vehaya meshalleach lo sivlonot bishvil sheyyalvehu zo hi ribbit mukdemet lava mimmennu vehechzir lo meotav vehaya meshalleach lo sivlonot bishvil meotav shehau betelin etzlo zo hi ribbit meucheret veim avar veose chen hare ze avak ribbit

Mi shellava mechavero velo haya ragil mikkodem lehakdim lo shalom asur lehakdim lo shalom veen tzarich lomar sheyekalleso bidvarim o yashkim lefitcho shenneemar neshech kal davar afillu devarim asurim vechen asur lo lelammed et hammalve mikra o gemara kal zeman shemmeotav beyado im lo haya ragil baze mikkodem shenneemar neshech kal davar
Hammalve et chavero lo yomar lo da im ba ish peloni mimmakom peloni kelomar shettechabbedo vetaachilo vetashkehu karauy vechen kal kayyotze baze

Yesh devarim shehen kemo ribbit umuttarin ketzad lokeach adam shitrotav shel chavero befachot veeno choshesh umuttar leadam litten lachavero dinar kede sheyyalve lifloni mea dinarin shello asra tora ella ribbit habbaa min hallo lammalve vechen omer adam lachavero he lecha dinar ze veemor lifloni sheyyalveni shello natan ella sechar amira

Yesh devarim shehen muttarin veasur laasotan mippene haaramat ribbit ketzad amar lo halveni mane amar lo mane en li chittim yesh li bemane venatan lo chittim bemane vechazar ulkachan mimmennu betishim hare ze muttar aval asaruhu mippene haaramat ribbit shehare natan lo tishim velokeach mane veim avar veasa kaze hare hu motzi mimmennu mea bedin sheafillu avak ribbit en kan vechen mi shehayeta sade memushkenet beyado lo yachzor veyaskir otah levaal hassade mippene haaramat ribbit shehare ze omed besadehu keshehaya venoten laze sachar bechal chodesh bishvil meotav shehilvahu
Asur lehaskir haddinarin sheen ze dome lemaskir et hakkeli shehakkeli chozer beatzmo veze motzi ellu umevi dinarin acherot venimtza ze avak ribbit

Melech shehau dinav shekkal mi sheyyitten hammas hakkatzuv al kal ish veish al yede ze shello natan yishtabed bo venatan al yado dinar af al pi shemmeshabed bo yeter middinar hare ze muttar vechen kal kayyotze baze

Hammalve et chavero lo yimshoch et avdo kede sheyyaase bo melacha af al pi shehaeved yoshev uvatel velo yadur bachatzero bechinnam af al pi sheen hechatzer asuya lesachar veen derech baal hechatzer lehaskir veim dar tzarich lehaalot lo sachar veim lo heela lo hare ze avak ribbit lefi shello hitna immo sheyyalvehu veyadur bachatzero lefichach im adayin lo hechzir lo chovo uva lenakkot sechar hechatzer sheddar bah min hachov im haya hassachar keneged hachov eno menakke lo hakkol ella kemo sheyyiru haddayyanim sheim tesallek oto belo kelum hare ze kemo shehotzi oto bedayyanin vaavak ribbit enah yotza bedayyanin

Horu rabbotay shehammalve et chavero ulachar zeman tava chovo veamar lo hallo dur bachatzeri ad sheachzir lecha chovcha hare ze avak ribbit lefi shello katzatz bishat halvaa shenneemar lo titten lo beneshech

Hammalve et chavero al hassade veamar lo im lo tachzir li mikkan ad shalosh shanim hare hi shelli hare ze lo kana mippene shehi asmachta lefichach menakke kal happerot sheachal mippene shehu ribbit shel tora aval im amar lo hammocher im lo achzir lecha ad shalosh shanim kene otah meachshav vehevi lo betoch shalosh en lo perot hevi lo leachar shalosh hare kal happerot lallokeach

Hammocher bayit o sade veamar hammocher lallokeach lichsheyyihu li maot tachzir li karkai lo kana vechal happerot sheachal ribbit ketzutza umotziin otam bedayyanin aval im amar lo hallokeach middato kesheyyihu lecha maot ani achzir lecha karka ze muttar vehallokeach ochel perot ad sheyyachzir lo meotav

Machar lo et hassade venatan lo miktzat haddamim im amar lo hammocher lallokeach kene keshiur meotecha kal echad mishshenehem ochel perot keshiur meotav amar hammocher lallokeach lichshettavi shear hammaot tikne meachshav shenehem asurim leechol happerot miyyad hammocher asur shemma yavi hallokeach shear hammaot venimtzet hassade shello venimtza hammocher ochel perot bishvil hammaot shennisharu lo etzel hallokeach vechen hallokeach asur shemma lo yavi venimtza sheachal bishvil miktzat hammaot sheyyesh lo etzel hammocher lefichach mannichin et happerot al yede shalish ad sheyyinnatnu leechad mehen amar lo hammocher lichshettavi shear hammaot tikne hare hammocher ochel perot ad sheyyavi hallokeach veim achal hallokeach motziin mimmennu amar lo hammocher kene meachshav ushar hammaot hare hen chov etzlecha hare hallokeach ochel perot veim achal hammocher motziin mimmennu kal ma sheachal

Horu rabbotay shehammalve et chavero umishken lo sadehu al menat sheyyochal peroteha kal yeme hammashkona af al pi sheeno menakke lo kelum hare zo avak ribbit veenah yotza bedayyanin sheen hammashken et hassade dome limmashken bayit shehare en bassade perot metzuyin beet hahalvaa veefshar sheyyarviach veyihu sham perot veefshar sheyyafsid bizriatah vaavodatah ulfichach hi avak ribbit vechen en hammashkona doma lemi shemmachar beasmachta shehammocher beasmachta lo gamar vehiknahu vehammashken gamar vehiknahu guf ze leferotav vechaze yerae min haggemara shehammashkona avak ribbit veen lecha lehaamidah ella bimmashken sadehu kemo shehoru rabbotay nimtzeta lamed sheshshalosh mashkonot hen mashkona shehi ribbit ketzutza umashkona shehi avak ribbit umashkona shehi mutteret ketzad mishken lo makom shepperotav metzuyin tadir kegon chatzer o merchatz o chanut veachal perotehen hare zo ribbit ketzutza mishken lo sade vechayyotze bah uvau sham perot vaachalan hare zo avak ribbit vechen im mishken chatzero vechayyotze bah benikkuy hare ze avak ribbit mishken sadehu benikkuy hare ze muttar ketzad hu hannikkuy kegon shehilvahu mea dinarin umishken lo bahen chatzero o sadehu veamar lo hammalve hareni menakke lecha maa kesef bechal shana bischar karka zo kede sheyyihu kal perotav shelli bechatzer vechayyotze bah asur uvsade vechayyotze bah muttar

Horu miktzat geonim shekkal mashkona sheen bah nikkuy kelal hare hi ribbit ketzutza velo yardu leomek haddavar lehafrish ben sade lechatzer ulfichach nitkashshu lahen divre chachme haggemara vechen horu shekkal mashkona afillu benikkuy asur ben bechatzer ben besade veen lahem mashkona mutteret ella badderech hazzot ketzad kegon shehilvahu mea dinarin umishken lo bahen bayit o sade vehitna immo sheachar eser shanim tachzor karka zo livaleha chinnam hare ze muttar leechol peroteha kal eser shanim afillu haya secharah shave elef dinarim bechal shana sheen ze ella kemi shessachar befachot vechen im hitna baal hassade immo kal zeman sheyyavi lo maot yechashev lo eser bechal shana visalleko mimmenna hare ze muttar vechen im hitna hallo shekkal zeman sheyyirtze mechashshev lo ma sheddar bo veyachzir lo shear haddamim veyistallek hare ze muttar sheen ze ella kischirut vechal tenay shebbischirut muttar kemo shebbearnu
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 7: Hammalve et chavero umishken lo et hassade ad zeman katzuv o ad sheyyavi lo maot veyistallek vehaya hammalve ochel kal peroteha afillu achal keshiur chovo en mesallekin oto belo kelum sheim tesallek oto belo maot hare ze kemi shehotzi mimmennu bedayyanin veen tzarich lomar sheim achal yeter al meotav en motziin mimmennu vechen en mechashshevin mishshetar lishtar bemashkona hayeta hakkarka hammushkenet beyado shel yetomim veachal shiur chovo mesallekin oto belo kelum aval yeter al chovo en motziin mimmennu hayyeter umchashshevin lo mishshetar lishtar ketzad mechashshevin mishshetar lishtar hare shehayeta sade zo memushkenet lo bemea dinar vesade acheret memushkenet lo bishtar acher bemea dinar ushte hassadot leadam echad veachal mipperot hassade haachat bachamishshim umipperot hashsheniyya bemea vachamishshim omrim lo hare achalta min happerot bematayim veen lecha kelum uchillu hashshene shetarot shetar echad umashkona achat

Makom shennahagu lesallek hammalve kal zeman sheyyavi lo maot hare ze kemo shepperesh veen tzarich lefaresh davar ze vechen makom shennahagu shello yistallek hammalve ad sof zeman hammashkona hare ze kemo shepperesh vechal hammashken setam eno yachol lesalleko ad shenem asar chodesh

Makom sheddarkan lesallek hammalve kal zeman sheyyirtze hallo vehitna immo hammalve shello yistallek ad sof zeman hammashkona hare ze eno yachol lesalleko haya hamminhag sheen hammalve mistallek ad sof zemanno vekibbel hammalve alav sheyyistallek bechal et sheyyavi lo meotav hare ze tzarich liknot miyyado al kach

Hammashkona bemakom shemminhagam lesallek hammalve bechal et sheyyavi meotav en baal chov shel malve gove mimmenna kederech sheggove min hakkarka veen habbechor notel bah pi shenayim ushviit meshammattah uchshemmesallek oto eno notel afillu perot shebbashlu venaflu laaretz veim higbiha otan kodem sheyesalleku kana otan umakom sheeno yachol lesalleko ad sof zemanno baal chov gove hemennu vehabbechor notel pi shenayim veen hashsheviit meshammatta

Af al pi shemmashkona zo asura hi vaavak ribbit kemo shebbearnu efshar sheyyihye minhag ze betaut o laakkum o derech kal mi shechote umishken beotah medina hoil vaavak ribbit holchin achar hamminhag veyesh mi shehora shezzot hammashkona benikkuy

Akkum shemmishken chatzero leyisrael vechazar haakkum umcharah leyisrael acher en hammashken chayyav lehaalot sachar leyisrael meet shekkana hayyisrael ella dar bechatzer belo sachar ad sheyyachzir lo haakkum et hammaot sheyyesh lo al chatzer zo shehare hu birshut hammashken bedinehem ad sheyyitten lo meotav veyistallek

Hammashken bayit o sade beyad chavero vehaya baal hakkarka ochel peroteha veamar lo hammalve lichshettimkor karka zo lo timkerenna ella li bedamim ellu hare ze asur veim amar lo al timkerenna ella li beshaveyah veal menat ken ani malve otcha hare ze muttar

Muttar leharbot bischar hakkarka ketzad hiskir lo et hechatzer veamar lo im meachshav atta noten li hare hi lecha beeser selaim bechal shana veim titten sechar chodesh bechodesh hare hi besela bechal chodesh hare ze muttar

Hammaskir sade lachavero baasara korim leshana veamar lo ten li matayim zuz sheafarnes bahen et hassade vaani etten lecha shenem asar kor bechal shana hare ze muttar mippene sheim yefarnes et hassade bedinarin ellu yihye secharah yoter vechen im hiskir lo chanut o sefina baasara dinarin beshana veamar lo ten li matayim zuz sheevne bahen chanut vaatzayerenna vaachayerenna o atakken bahen sefina zo uchle tashmisheha vaani aale lecha shenem asar dinar bechal shana hare ze muttar aval im amar lo ten li matayim zuz kede lehitassek bahen bachanut o otziem bischora shel sefina o eskor bahen mallachin vaani aale lecha besachar hare ze asur
Asur leharbot bischar haadam ketzad lo yomar lo ase immi hayyom melacha zo shehi shava kesef vaani eese immecha beshavua acher melacha shehi shava shettayim

Muttar laadam lomar lachavero nakkesh immi hayyom vaanakkesh immecha lemachar ador immi hayyom veeedor immecha lemachar aval lo yomar lo nakkesh immi veeedor immecha ador immi vaanakkesh immecha kal yeme garid echad vechal yeme revia achat velo yomar lo charosh immi begarid vaani echerosh immecha birvia shehare torach hacharisha bimot haggeshamim yater vechen kal kayyotze baze

Hassocher et happoel bime hachoref laasot immo bime hakkor bedinar bechal yom venatan lo hassachar vahare secharo shave bime hachoref sela bechal yom hare ze asur mippene shennire kemalve oto hayyom kede sheyyozil lo bischaro aval im amar lo ase immi mehayyom vead zeman peloni bedinar bechal yom af al pi sheshshave secharo sela bechal yom hare ze muttar hoil vehu matchil laasot meatta eno nire kenotel sechar meotav shehikdim untanan lo bischaro
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 8: Asur leharbot al hammecher ketzad hammocher lachavero karka o mittaltelin veamar lo im meachshav titten li haddamim hare hen shellecha bemea veim ad zeman peloni hare hem shellecha beesrim umea hare ze avak ribbit shezze dome kemi shennotel esrim bishvil shennatan lo mea lehishtammesh bah ad zeman peloni uchsheyyitbaennu baddin eno chayyav litten ella ma shehaya shave bishat hammecher o yachzir mimkaro miyyado im haya kayyam vechen im machar lo mittaltelin ad zeman peloni bemea vehau shavin bashshuk lemi shekkone bimotav miyyad tishim hare ze asur veeno noten lo ella tishim o machzir miyyado sechorato im hayeta kayyemet
Hallokeach mechavero chefetz beshavehu al menat sheyyitten lo mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh hare ze rashshay lomar lo ten li miyyad befachot veeno choshesh mishshum ribbit

Chavit shel yayin shehi shava atta dinar umcharah lo bishnayim ad hakkayitz al menat sheim teera bah takkala hare hi birshut hammocher ad sheyyimkerenna hallokeach hare ze muttar sheim avda o nishbera eno meshallem kelum veim lo matza lemachrah ulharviach bah haya lo lehachzirah labbealim vechen im mecharah lo bishnayim veamar lo hayyater al shenayim yihye secharcha bishvil sheatta metappel lemachrah veim lo timtza lemachrah kemo shettirtze hachazirah li hare ze muttar af al pi sheim avda o nigneva o hechmitza tihye birshut hallokeach

Hau lo perot sheim yirtze lemachran bashshuk velikkach demehen miyyad mochran baasara veim tava otan hallokeach liknotan veyitten hammaot miyyad yikne otan bishnem asar hare ze muttar lemachran bishnem asar ad shenem asar chodesh sheafillu hevi ze meotav atta bishnem asar haya kone otan vechen kal kayyotze baze

Asur liknot peri happardes kodem sheyyiggamer veyitbashshel mippene shezze shemmocher bezol atta beeser hu peri sheshshave esrim kesheyyiggamer nimtzet hattosefet bishvil hahakkafa aval im kana egel bezol vehaya etzel habbealim ad sheyyagdil hare ze muttar shehare im met o kachash birshut hallokeach hu vehakkachash vehammita davar matzuy tamid

Hannoten maot levaal hakkerem al hassarigim veal hazzemorot lichsheyyikkartu shehem beyoker vehu kone otan bezol ad sheyyivshu veyikkartu hare ze tzarich lehappech bahen keshehem mechubbarim shennimtza kekone ilan lizmorotav veim lo hafach nimtzeu hammaot halvaa vehen lokchin bezol mippene hahakkafa veasur

Shomre hassadot shennotnin lahem chittim bischaran bezol min haggoren kesheyyavou laggoren tzerichin lehitassek immahen bimlacha baggoren kede sheyyihu hachittim haellu shennatlu besof zeman hassechirut veim lo asu kach nimtzet hassechirut etzel habbealim kemilve veze shellakchu bezol mippene sheicharu secharan ad haggoren

Arisin shehau baale hassadot mesallekin otan min hassade benisan venotnin lahem haarisin bechal zera chomer arba sein vehinniach ze arisin betoch sadehu ad iyyar venatal mehen shesh sein hare ze muttar veen sham ribbit

Hallokeach chittim arba sein besela vechen hashshaar venatan lo et hammaot uchshebba ligbot et hachittim leachar zeman hosif lo bammidda venatan lo yeter hare ze muttar shehare birtzono hosif lo veillu ratza lo hosif shehare lo haya sham tenay

Muttar leadam litten deme chavit shel yayin lachavero velomar lo im hechmitza mikkan ad yom peloni birshutcha aval im hozila o hokira hare hi shelli shekkevan shekkibbel alav hazzol hare ze karov lesachar ulhefsed vechen kal kayyotze baze vechen muttar leadam liknot mechavero betishre mea kaddin shel yayin bedinar veeno notlan ad tevet uchshennotlan bodek umachazir hachometz velokeach hayyayin hattov shello kana mimmennu ella yayin tov veellu shehechmitzu mittechilla hau reuyin lehachmitz aval lo noda haddavar ad achar hazzeman

Makom shennahagu liskor hassefina velittol secharah veim nishbera shamin lo ma sheppachata umshallem yeter al secharah hare ze muttar vechen muttar lehaskir sir shel nechoshet vechayyotze bo venotel hassachar udme ma sheppachat mimmishkalo vechen kal kayyotze baze

En mekabbelin tzon barzel miyyisrael mippene shehu avak ribbit vechetzad hen tzon barzel hare shehaya lo mea tzon vekibbelam mimmennu lehittappel bahen veyihu haggizzot vehavveladot vehechalav laemtza lishlish o lirvia ad shana o ad shenatayim kemo shehitnu benehem veim metu hatztzon hare hamkabbel meshallem demehem hare ze asur shehare baal hatztzon karov lesachar verachok lehefsed lefichach im kibbel alav baal hatztzon sheim hukru o huzlu o im nitrefu hare hen birshuto hare ze muttar vechen kal kayyotze baze
Hashsham para mechavero veamar lo im meta hare hi atta alay bishloshim dinarim vaani aale lecha sela bechal chodesh muttar lefi shello asaah mechayyim damim ella leachar mita
Maskeret ishsha lachavertah tarnegolet leshev al habbetzim bishne efrochim veen choshshin mishshum ribbit

Mi shehaya noshe bachavero arbaa dinarim shel ribbit venatan lo bahen chefetz sheshshave chamishsha keshemmotziin mimmennu motziin mimmennu chamishsha hoil uvtorat ribbit ba leyado vechen im natan lo bahen kesut o keli motziin mimmennu et hakkeli atzmo veoto hakkesut atzmo hiskir lo bahen makom sheshshave secharo shelosha dinarin keshemmotziin mimmennu motziin mimmennu arbaa shehare bearbaa sachar mimmennu makom ze shekkibbel alav
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 9: En poskin al happerot ad sheyyetze hashshaar yatza hashshaar poskin af al pi sheen laze yesh laze ketzad haya hashshaar lachittim kavua lashshuk arba sein besela hare ze posek immo al mea sein venoten lo chamesh veesrim selaim veim yitten lo mea sea shel chittim achar zeman beet sheyyihu hachittim sea besela en baze ribbit kelal af al pi shello haya lammocher chittim kelal beet sheppasak bamme devarim amurim beshello haya lo kelum meoto hammin beet sheppasak alav aval im haya lammocher meoto hammin kelum af al pi sheadayin lo nigmera melachto hare ze muttar lifsok alav af al pi sheadayin lo yatza hashshaar ketzad haya hu techilla lakkotzrim hare ze posek al hachittim af al pi sheadayin hen gadish ufosek al hayyayin mishsheyyivtzor haanavim veyittenem beavit veal hashshemen mishshennatan zetim bammaatan veal hassid mishsheyeshakkeenna bakkivshan vechen posek al kele cheres mishsheyyaase hayyotzer betzim shellahen bamme devarim amurim beshehaya afaran lavan aval afaran shachor posek al hakkelim hannaasin mimmennu af al pi shello naasu mippene shehu matzuy lakkol veaf al pi sheen laze yesh laze vechen posek immo al hazzevel kal yemot hashshana af al pi sheen lo zevel mippene shehu matzuy tamid

Kal davar shehu mechussar melacha achat o shettayim posek immo alav haya mechussar shalosh melachot eno posek ella im ken yatza hashshaar shekkevan shehu mechussar shalosh melachot hare ze kemi sheen lo meoto hammin kelum uchmo lo ba laolam adayin ketzad gadish shehaya mechussar hannacha bashshemesh sheyyivash vedisha uzriyya eno posek alav ella im ken yatza hashshaar haya yavesh veeno mechussar ella disha uzriyya posek alav betzim shel yotzer shehau mechussarin lefifa veyibbush veholacha lakkivshan usrefa vehotzaa eno posek alehen hau yeveshin veenan mechussarin ella holacha lakkivshan usrefa posek alehen vehu sheyyihye derech hallokeach lehotzi oto min hakkivshan aval im haya hammocher hu shemmotzi hare ellu mechussarin shalosh veeno posek alehen ad sheyyetze hashshaar vechen kal kayyotze baze

Haholech lachalov et izzav veligzoz et rechelav velirdot et kavarto umtzao chavero veamar lo ma sheizzay cholvot machur lecha ma sherchelay gozzot machur lecha ma shekkavarti roda machur lecha hare ze muttar aval amar lo ma sheizzay cholvot kach vechach machur lecha bechach vechach ma sherchelay gozzot kach vechach machur lecha bechach vechach ma shekkavarti roda kach vechach machur lecha bechach vechach asur ella im ken pasak immo kashshaar shebbashshuk vechen kal kayyotze baze

En poskin al shaar shel ayarot mippene sheen hashshaar kavua ella al shaar shebbammedina hau hachittim hachadashot bammedina arba sein besela vishanot shalosh besela en poskin ad sheyyetze hashshaar lechadash velayyashan hau chittin shel lekutot arba sein besela veshel baal habbayit shalosh posek lallekutot keshaar lekutot velo yifsok levaal habbayit ad sheyyikba hashshaar levaal habbayit

Kevan shennikba hashshaar muttar lifsok al hashshaar haggavoha ketzad hau hachittim nimkarot arba sein besela ufasak immo sheyyitten lo hachittim kashshaar hazzol im amdu achar ken eser sein besela noten lo eser sein kashshaar shehaya bashshuk shehare pasak immo beshaar gavoha natan lo hammaot setam velo pasak immo bashshaar haggavoha vehuzlu noten kashshaar shehau shavin keshennatan lo hammaot umi shechazar mekabbel mi sheppara bamme devarim amurim befosek al daat atzmo aval im haya shaliach laacherim ben hammocher ben hallokeach eno notel ella kashshaar hazzol o machzir et haddamim veeno mekabbel mi sheppara beshaliach shehare hamshalleach omer letakken shelachticha velo leavet kemo shebbearnu

Hau hachittim nimkarot arba sein besela venatal et haddamim venatan lo chamesh besela im yesh lo chittim muttar hau lo chittim chov etzel acherim venatal hammaot ad sheyyigbe chittav veyitten lo asur shehare hen mechussarin geviyya uchillu enam vahare ze kekovea lo zeman vehozil lo mippene shemmakkifo

Hau hachittim bammedina arba sein besela uvakkefarim shesh bassela hare ze muttar litten sela letaggar kede sheyyavi shesh sein min hakkefar vehu sheyyihu birshut hallokeach im avdu badderech o nignevu avdu lo veadam chashuv asur laasot ze vbmine sechora asur lechal adam lefi sheen mine sechora metzuyin keferot

Hachammarin shennichnesu lair vahare hachittim arba sein besela hozilu umachru lemakkirehen o lesafsarehen chamesh besela bammaot shennatnu lahen techilla kesheyyikkansu lair ad sheyyiftechu sakkehen veyimkeru lechal adam hare ze muttar sheen ellu mochrin lahem bezol mippene shennatnu maot atta velo yikchu ella leachar zeman ella mippene shemmodiin lahem et hashshaar umsaadin otam

Hammolich perotav mimmakom lemakom metzao chavero veamar lo tenem li vaani aale lecha perot sheyyesh li bemakom peloni beoto makom im yesh lo sham muttar veim lav asur haya molich sechora mimmakom lemakom amar lo tenem li vaani aale lecha dameha kemo sheshshave beoto makom im hayeta birshut hammocher ad shehiggia lesham muttar veim hayeta birshut lokeach asur

Hannoten levaal hagginna deme asara kishshuin ellu deme asara avattichim ellu vahare hen ketannim vehitna immo sheyyittenem lo lichsheyyagdilu hare ze muttar shehare hu mannichan vehem gedelim mealehen veillu kitztzetzan atta keshehen ketannim lo hau baim acherim tachtehen vechen kal kayyotze baze middavar sheen bo hefsed velo chissaron al hammocher
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 10: Keshem shemmuttar lammocher lifsok al shaar shebbashshuk kach muttar lilot happerot setam uforin setam belo keviat zeman al hashshaar shebbashshuk ketzad haya hashshaar kavua veyadua lishnehem velava mechavero eser sein chayyav lehachzir lo eser sein af al pi shehukru hachittim shehare keshellava mimmennu haya hashshaar yadua veillu ratza haya kone umachazir lo shehare lo kava lo zeman

Haya lo meoto hammin shellava hare ze muttar lilot setam belo keviat zeman uforea setam af al pi sheadayin lo yatza hashshaar vaafillu hayeta lo sea bilvad lo aleha kamma sein hayeta lo tippa achat shel shemen o shel yayin lo aleha kamma garbe yayin veshemen lo hayeta lo meoto hammin kelum velo nikba shaar hashshuk adayin o shello yadu shaar hashshuk hare ze asur lilot sea bisa vechen bishar happerot lo yalve otan ad sheyyaase otan damim veim lava velo asa otan damim vehuzlu machzir lo perot kammidda shellava o kammishkal veim hukar notel damim shehau shavin bishat halvaa af al pi sheyyesh lo meoto hammin o shehaya hashshaar kavua bashshuk hare ze asur lilot perot beferot ad zeman kavua ella lo setam uforea beeze zeman sheyyifra
Lo yomar adam lachavero halveni kor chittim vaani achzir lecha kor laggoren ella omer lo halveni ad sheyyavo beni o ad sheemtza hammafteach
Lava perot ad zeman kavua im huzlu machzir lo perot bazzeman shekkava veim hukru noten lo damim shehau shavin bishat hahalvaa

Malve adam et arisav chittim bechittim lezera ben kodem sheyyarad haaris lassade ben achar sheyyarad bamme devarim amurim bemakom shennahagu sheyyitten haaris et hazzera shehare beyad baal hakkarka lesalleko kal zeman shello natan aval bemakom shedderech baal hakkarka litten et hazzera im adayin lo yarad haaris hare ze muttar lehalot chittim bechittim sheadayin yesh lo lesalleko nimtza beet sheyyarad lassade yarad al daat sheyyachzir lo chittim shehilvahu aval achar sheyyarad lassade hoil veeno yachol lesalleko hare hu kechal adam veasur lehaloto chittim bachittim lezera aval malvehu setam al shaar shebbashshuk

Mi shehaya noshe bachavero maot veamar lo ten li meotay sheani rotze likkach bahen chittim amar lo tze vaase otan alay keshaar shel achshav veyihye lecha etzli chittim behalvaa im yesh lo chittim keshiur meotav muttar veim en lo oto hammin hare ze asur shello amru chachamim shemmuttar lifsok al shaar shebbashshuk af al pi sheen lo kelum meoto hammin ella benoten meotav liknot bahen perot aval harotze lehaamid halvaato al gav happerot asur ad sheyyihu lo perot haya lallo chittim veasa halvaato alav chittim uva achar zeman veamar lo ten li chittim sheani rotze lemachran velikkach bidmehen yayin amar lo tze vaase otan alay yayin kashshaar shebbashshuk atta im yesh lo yayin hare ze muttar venaaset halvaato etzlo yayin veim en lo yayin asur hare shello haya lo veavar vehechzir hahalvaa perot af al pi shekkana perot achar kach eno chayyav litten lo perot ella noten lo maot shehilvahu
Mishneh Torah, Creditor and Debtor 11: Hammalve et chavero bifonoy edim o sheamar leedim heu alay edim sheani chayyav laze mane o attem eday sheani chayyav laze mane zo nikret milve al pe veen tzarich lefaro beedim lefichach im taan veamar achar kach parati nishba hesset veniftar aval hammalve et chavero bishtar tzarich lefaro beedim lefichach im taan veamar parati shetar ze eno neeman ella omrim lo o have edim o amod veshallem lo chovo lefichach haomer leedim heu alay edim sheani chayyav laze mane en kotvin edutan venotnin lammalve shello yachaziro lammalve al pi edut bishtar ad sheyyomar lahen hallo kitvu shetar vechitmu utnu lo af al pi sheamar lahen kach tzerichin lehimmalech bo achar shechatmu bashshetar veachar kach notnin hashshetar beyad hammalve kanu miyyado shehu chayyav lo mane hare ellu kotvin venotnin af al pi shello amar lahen ketovu shessetam kinyan lichtiva omed veenan tzerichin lehimmalech bo

Lo shekkatav shetar bichtav yado veheid bo edim untano lammalve hare ze shetar kasher vechen im katav shetar af al pi sheen bo edim untano lammalve bifne edim hare zo milve bishtar vehu sheyyihye ketav sheeno yachol lehizdayyef veyikreu oto haedim shennimsar bifnehem veyesh min haggeonim shehora shetztzarich lomar laedim shemmasru bifnehem chitmu vehaidu shennimsar bifnechem

Hotzi alav ketav yado shehu chayyav lo veen sham edim af al pi shehuchzak ketav yado bevet din hare ze kemilve al pe lechal davar veim taan sheppara nishba hesset veniftar veeno gove bichtav ze lo min hayyorshin velo min hallakochot

Kal milve bishtar gove otah min hayyorshin umin hallakochot kemo sheyyitbaer umilve al pe gove otah min hayyorshin veeno gove otah min hallakochot lefi sheen lah kol lefichach lo yitrof bah aval milve shebbishtar kol yesh lah vehallokeach hifsid al atzmo shello shaal ad sheyyada shennechasav shel ze meshubadin bammilve shealav shekkal nichse hallo tachat shibud hammalve min hattora

Hammocher sadehu beedim veyatzat mittachat yede hallokeach af al pi sheen sham shetar beyad hallokeach hare ze chozer vetoref minnechasim meshubadim kemo sheyyitbaer shekkal hammocher befarhesya mocher vekol yesh lo

En hahalvaa sheal pe nigbet min hayyorshin ella beechad mishshelosha devarim ellu keshechayyav mode bah vetziva bechalo sheyyesh lifloni alav chov adayin o shehayeta hahalvaa lizman velo higgia zeman lefarah vachazaka hi sheen adam porea betoch zemanno o shennidduhu ad sheyyitten umet benidduo kal ellu govin min hayyorshin belo shevua aval im bau edim shehaya chayyav laze mane o befanenu hilvahu eno gove min hayyoresh kelum shemma perao shehammalve et chavero beedim en tzarich lefaro beedim vechen im motzi ketav yad avihen shehu chayyav lo eno gove bo kelum kemo shebbearnu

Lo sheen lo mittaltelin veyesh lo karka im noda levet din shettole meotav beyad acherim kofin oto limkor velitten levaal chovo veim lo noda lahem davar ze machrimin al mi sheyyeda lo mittaltelin velo yeviem veachar kach yordin levenonit shebbinchasav umagbin levaal chovo kemo sheyyitbaer bamme devarim amurim bizman shennifrain min hallo atzmo aval habba lippara min hayyoresh ben katan ben gadol lo yippara min hammittaltelin afillu hau mufkadin o milve etzel acherim shehammittaltelin enan tachat shibud baal chov min hattora

Mitzva al hayetomin lifroa chov avihen min hammittaltelin shehinniach veim lo ratza hayyoresh litten en kofin oto veim tafas baal chov mechayyim gove mehen taan shemmechayyim tefasan vehayyoresh taan sheachar mita tafas al hayyoresh lehavi reaya o yishshava hammalve shekkach vechach hu chayyav lo veyachol liton ad kede demehen vecholel bishvuato shemmechayyim tafas hau haddevarim shettafas shetarot vetaan shehen mashkon beyado al chovo veshemmechayyim tafas al hammalve lehavi reaya shemmechayyim tafas veim lo hevi reaya yachzir layyorshim mippene sheeno toen liknot gufam ella laraya shebbahen
