Bechor shennikra venimtza zachar eno notel pi shenayim ufashut shennikra venimtza zachar eno memaet bechelek bechorah shenneemar veyaldu lo vanim ad sheyyihye ben mishsheat leda

Ketzad eno memaet bechelek bechora hare shehaya lo ben bechor ushne peshutim veze hattumtum shennikra venimtza zachar habbechor notel revia hammamon bechelek habbechora uchillu en immo ella shene happeshutim bilvad vachatzi urvia hannishar cholkin oto shene happeshutin im hannikra veim habbechor beshave
Katan ben yom echad memaet bechelek bechora aval lo haubbar uven shennolad achar mitat aviv eno memaet bechelek bechora

Ben shennistappek lanu im hu bechor o pashut kegon shennitarev im acher eno notel pi shenayim vechetzad osin im hukkeru ulvassof nitarvu kotvin harshaa ze laze venotlin chelek bechora im achehem veim lo hukkeru kegon sheyelado bemachavoa achat en kotvin harshaa veen kan chelek bechora

Mi shehau lo shene banim bechor ufashut umetu shenehem bechayyav vehinnichu banim habbechor heniach bat vehappashut hinniach ben hare ben happashut yoresh benichse hazzaken shelish shehu chelek aviv uvat habbechor yoreshet shene shelishim shehu chelek aviha vechen haddin bivne haachin uvne ache haav uvchal hayyorshin im haya avi echad min hayyorshim bechor notel chelek bechora shello ze hayyoresh mechamato
En habbechor notel pi shenayim benichse haem ketzad bechor ufashut sheyyarshu imman cholkin beshave ben shehaya bechor lenachala ben shehaya peter rechem
Bechor lenachala hu hannolad laav rishon shenneemar ki hu reshit ono veen mashgichin al haem afillu yalda kamma banim hoil veze rishon leaviv yoresh pi shenayim

Habba achar nefalim af al pi sheyyatza rosh hannefel keshehu chay habba acharav bechor lenachala vechen ben tisha sheyyatza rosho met habba acharav bechor lenachala shezze shenneemar reshit ono hu shello nolad lo kodem laze valad sheyyatza chay laavir haolam lefichach ben tisha shehotzi rov rosho chay habba acharav eno bechor
Yotze dofen vehabba acharav shenehen enan bechorim harishon lefi shello nolad veneemar veyaldu lo vanim vehashsheni shehare kedamo acher

Hau lo banim keshehaya akkum venitgayyer en lo bechor lenachala aval yisrael shehaya lo ben min hashshifcha umin haakkum hoil veeno karuy beno habba lo acharav min hayyisreelit bechor lenachala venotel pi shenayim
Haya habbechor mamzer notel pi shenayim shenneemar ki et habbechor ben hassenua yakkir zo shessenua benissueha veen tzarich lomar im haya ben gerusha o ben chalutza

Shelosha neemanin al habbechor chayya veimmo veaviv chayya miyyad sheim amra ze yatza rishon neemenet immo kal shivat yeme halleda neemenet lomar zehu habbechor aviv leolam afillu amar haav al mi shello huchzak beno kelal hu beni uvchori hu neeman vechen im amar al hammuchzak lanu shehu bechoro eno bechor neeman
Haav shennishtattek bodkin oto kederech shebbodkin legittin im ramaz o katav shezze beno bechoro hare ze notel pi shenayim

Heidu edim shehen shamu aviv shel ze omer devarim kach vechach shehare otan haddevarim yodea mikkelalan shezze beno bechoro hare ze notel pi shenayim af al pi shello amar haav beferush ze beni bechori
Shamu min haav sheamar ze beni bechor eno notel pi shenayim beedut zo shemma bechor leimmo hu velaze nitkaven haav ad sheyyomar beni bechori
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 3: En habbechor notel pi shenayim binchasim haruyin lavo leachar mitat aviv ella binchasim hammuchzakin leaviv shebbau lirshuto shenneemar bechl asher yimmatze lo ketzad echad mimmorishe aviv shemmet leachar mitat aviv habbechor vehappashut yorshin keechad vechen im hayeta leaviv milve o hayeta lo sefina bayyam yorshin keechad
Hinniach lahem para muskeret o muchkeret o shehayeta roa baafar veyalda habbechor notel bah uviveladah pi shenayim
Shachat echad mimmakkire aviv behema veachar kach met aviv notel pi shenayim bammattanot shel otah behema

En habbechor notel pi shenayim bashshevach sheshshavchu nechasim leachar mitat aviv ella maale oto hashshevach bedamim venoten hayyeter lappashut vehu sheyyishtannu hannechasim kegon karmel shennaasu shibbolim vechifniyyot shennaasu temarim aval shavchu mechamat atzman velo nishtannu kegon ilan katan sheggadal veava veeretz sheheelta sirton hare ze notel bashshevach pi shenayim veim mechamat hotzaa hishbiach eno notel

En habbechor notel pi shenayim bemilve af al pi shehu bishtar af al gav sheggavu karka bechov avihem haya leav milve beyad habbechor hare ze safek im notel bah pi shenayim hoil veyeshnah tachat yado o lo yittol hoil umechamat aviv yirashenna vaadayin lo baa leyado shel aviv lefichach yittol mimmenna chatzi chelek bechora

Bechor shemmachar chelek bechora kodem chaluka mimkaro kayyam mippene sheyyesh labbechor chelek bechora kodem chaluka lefichach im chalak im echav kodem bemiktzat nechasim ben bakkarka ben bemittaltelin venatal chelek kefashut vitter bechal hannechasim veeno notel bisheran ella kefashut bamme devarim amurim beshello micha aval im micha beechav veamar bifne shenayim anavim ellu sheani cholek im echay beshave lo mippene shemmachalti bechelek bechora hare ze mechaa velo vitter bishar nechasim vaafillu micha baanavim keshehen mechubbarim uvtzarum vechillekum beshave lo vitter bishar nechasim aval im derachum vechalak immahen beshave beyayin velo micha bahen mishshennaasa yayin vitter bishar hannechasim ha lema ze dome lemi shemmicha baanavim vechalak immahem beshave bazetim shehare vitter bakkol vechen kal kayyotze baze

Mi sheyyibbem eshet achiv hu yoresh kal nichse echav hammuchzakim vechal haruyin lavo leachar mikkan hare hu bahen kechal haachim shehare bechor kara oto hakkatuv shenneemar vehaya habbechor asher teled yakum al shem achiv hammet velo yimmache shemo miyyisrael uchshem sheeno notel mimmennu berauy kivmuchzak kach eno notel bashshevach sheshshavchu nechasim achare mot aviv mishsheat mita ad sheat chalukato im echav benichse aviv vaafillu hishbichu nechasim achar sheyyibbem vekodem sheyyachleku hare hu bashshevach keechad min haachin af al pi shennotel min hannechasim ellu shene chalakim chelko vechelek achiv sheyyibbem ishto hoil umet haav bechayye kullan

Kevar bearnu behilchot shechenim shehabbechor notel shene chalakim shello keechad bemetzar echad aval hayyavam shechalak im echav benichse aviv notel chelko vechelek achiv begoral veim ala goralo bishne mekomot notel bishne mekomot

Shomeret yavam shemmeta afillu asa bah echad min haachim maamar mishpachat bet aviha yorshin benichse melog vachatzi nichse tzon barzel veorshe habbaal yorshin ketubbatah im chatzi nichse tzon barzel veorshe habbaal chayyavin bikvuratah hoil vehen yirshu ketubbatah kemo shebbearnu bimkomo
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 4: Haomer ze beni o ze achi o ze achi avi o shear hayyorshin oto af al pi shehoda baanashim sheenan muchzakin shehen kerovav hare ze neeman veyirashennu ben sheamar keshehu bari ben sheamar keshehu shechiv mera afillu nishtattek vechatav bichtav yado shezze yorsho bodkin oto kederech shebbodkin legittin

Hayinu muchzakin baze shehu achiv o ben dodo veamar eno achi veeno ben dodi eno neeman aval neeman hu al mi shehuchzak shehu beno lomar eno beni velo yirashennu veyerae li sheafillu hau labben banim af al pi sheeno neeman alav lomar eno beni leinyan yichus veen machazikin oto mamzer al piv neeman hu leinyan yerushsha velo yirashennu

Haomer ze beni vechazar veamar avdi hu eno neeman amar avdi vechazar veamar beni af al pi shehu meshammesho keeved neeman shezze sheamar avdi kelomar shehu li keeved veim hau korin lo eved ben mea zuz vechayyotze bidvarim ellu sheen omrin otan beyichud ella laavadim hare ze eno neeman
Haya over al bet hammeches veamar beni hu ze vechazar achar kach veamar avdi neeman shello amar beni ella lehavriach min hammeches amar bevet hammoches avdi hu vechazar veamar beni hu eno neeman

Haavadim vehashshefachot en korin lahen abba peloni veimma pelonit shello yavo min haddavar takkala venimtza ze habben nifgam lefichach im hau haavadim vehashshefachot chashuvin beoter veyesh lahen kol vechal hakkahal makkirin otan veet bene veavde adonehem kegon avde hannasi hare ellu muttar likrot lahen abba veimma

Mi shehayeta lo shifcha veholid mimmenna ben vehaya noheg bo minhag banim o sheamar beni hu umshuchreret hi immo im talmid chacham hu o adam kasher shehu baduk bedikduke mitzot hare ze yirashennu veaf al pi chen eno nose bat yisrael ad sheyyavi reaya shennishtachrera immo veachar kach yalda shehare huchzeka shifcha befanenu veim mishshear hedotot hu veen tzarich lomar im haya min hammafkirin atzman lechach hare ze bechezkat eved lechal davar veechav meaviv mochrin oto veim en leaviv ben chutz mimmennu eshet aviv mityabbemet veze hu haddin sheyyerae li shehu holech al ikkere hakkabbala veyesh mi shello chillek ben kesherim lishar haam ella leinyan shello yimkeruhu echav bilvad veyesh mi shehora sheafillu leyarsho lo nachlok beyisrael veen rauy lismoch al davar ze
Kal hayyorshin yorshin bachazaka ketzad edim sheheidu shezze muchzak lanu shehu beno shel peloni o achiv af al pi sheenan ede yichus velo yadu amittat hayyuchasin hare ellu yorshin beedut zo

Yaakov shemmet vehinniach reuven veshimon velo huchzak lo ben ella shenehem tafas reuven levi min hashshuk veamar gam ze achinu hu veshimon omer eni yodea hare shimon notel chatzi hammamon uruven shelish shehare hoda shehem shelosha achin velevi notel shetut met levi yachzor hashshetut liruven naflu lelevi nechasim acherim yachleku otan reuven veshimon shehare reuven mode leshimon shellevi ze achihen hishbiach hashshetut meelav veachar kach met levi im shevach maggia lakketefayim hu kegon anavim shehiggiu lehibbatzer hare hashshevach hazze kinchasim shennaflu lo meacherim veyachleku bahen veim adayin lo higgiu lehibbatzer hare hen shel reuven levaddo amar shimon en levi ze achi venatal levi bechelek reuven kemo shebbearnu veachar kach met levi lo yirash shimon mimmennu kelum ella reuven levaddo yirash hashshetut im shear nechasim acherim shehinniach levi vehu haddin bechal hayyorshin sheyyodu miktzatan beorshin acherim shello yodu miktzatan
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 5: Ze hakkelal beorshin kal shene yorshin sheechad mehen yoresh vadday vehashsheni safek en lassafek kelum veim hau shenehem safek shemma zehu hayyoresh o shemma ze hayyoresh cholkin beshave lefichach mi shemmet vehinniach ben vetumtum o anderoginus hare habben yoresh et hakkol shehattumtum vehaanderoginus safek hinniach banot vetumtum veanderoginus yorshot beshave vahare hu keachat min habbanot

Kevar bearnu behilchot ishut din habbanot im habbanim bimzonotehen uvfarnasatan vesham bearnu shehammezonot mittenae ketubba bizman shehannechasim merubbin en labbanot ella mezonotehen vehabbanim yirshu hakkol veyitparnesu habbanot beissur nechasim kede sheyyinnasu bo levalehen uvizman shehannechasim muatin en labbanim kelum ella hakkol limzon habbanot lefichach mi shemmet vehinniach banim uvanot vetumtum o anderoginus bizman shehannechasim merubbin habbanim yorshin vedochin hattumtum etzel habbanot venizzon kemotan uvizman shehannechasin muatin habbanot dochot et hattumtum etzel habbanim veomrot lo zachar atta veen lecha immanu mezonot

Mi shello shahata achar balah shelosha chodashim venisset veyalda ben veen yadua im ben tisha lerishon o ben shiva leacharon en ze habben yoresh et echad mishshenehem mippene shehu safek veim met habben shenehen yorshin oto vecholkin beshave mippene sheshshenehem safek shemma ze aviv o ze aviv

Yevama shello shahata shelosha chodashim venityabbema betoch shelosha chodashim veyalda ben veen yadua im ben tisha larishon o ben shiva laacharon ze hassafek omer shemma ben hammet ani veirash et nichse avi kullan veen atta rauy leyabbem otah sheen immi bat yibbum vehayyavam omer shemma beni atta veimmecha reuya leyabbem veen lecha benichse achi kelum hoil vegam ze hayyavam safek shemma yavam hu o eno yavam cholkin beshave vechen din ze hassafek im bene hayyavam benichse hammet shennityabbema ishto cholkin beshave hassafek notel mechetza uvne hayyavam mechetza met hayyavam achar shechalak im ze hassafek uvau bene hayyavam haruyim lirash avihem af al pi sheyyesh leze hassafek lomar im achichem ani tenu li chelek birushsha zo veim eni achichem hachziru li hachetzi shellakach avichem en leze hassafek benichse avihen immahen kelum veen motzi miyyadan

Safek vehayyavam shebbau lachlok benichse haav hare hayyavam yoresh vadday veze hassafek im hu ben hammet yesh lo chatzi hammamon ulze hayyavam chatzi veim hu ben hayyavam en lo kelum lefichach hayyavam yoresh veyiddache hassafek hinniach hayyavam shene banim vaddain veachar kach met hayyavam hare hassafek omer ani ben hammet veyesh li mechetza velishnechem mechetza vehashshenayim omrim atta achinu uven hayyavam atta veen lecha ella shelish benichse hazzaken hachetzi shemmode lahem bo notlin vehishlish shemmodin hen lo notel vehashshetut hannishar cholkim oto beshave hu notel chetzo ushnehem chetzo met hassafek hare hayyavam omer shemma beni hu vaani irashennu vaavi hayyavam omer shemma ben beni hammet hu vaani irashennu cholkin beshave met hayyavam hassafek omer beno ani veirashennu vaavi hayyavam omer shemma ben beni haacher atta veze achi avicha hu vaani irashennu cholkin beshave

Mi shennafal habbayit alav veal ishto veen yadua im haishsha meta techilla venimtzeu yorshe habbaal yorshin kal nechaseha o habbaal met techilla venimtzeu yorshe haishsha yorshin kal nechaseha ketzad dinam maamidin nichse melog bechezkat yorshe haishsha vehakketubba ikkar vehattosefet bechezkat yorshe habbaal vecholkin benichse tzon barzel yorshe haishsha notlin chetzyan veorshe habbaal chetzyan aval im nafal habbayit alav veal immo maamidin nichse haem bechezkat yorshe haem shehem yorshin vaddain aval yorshe habben safek hem sheim met habben techilla en leechav meaviv benichse imman kelum kemo shebbearnu

Nafal habbayit alav veal ben bitto im haav met techilla ben bitto yirashennu venimtzeu hannechasim shel yorshe habben veim ben bitto met techilla en habben yoresh et immo bakkever kemo shebbearnu venimtzeu hannechasim shel yorshe haav lefichach yachleku yorshe haav im yorshe ben habbat vechen im nishba haav umet ben bitto bammedina o shennishba habben umet avi immo bammedina yachleku yorshe haav im yorshe ben habbat

Nafal alav habbayit veal aviv o shear morishin vealav ketubbat ishsha uvaale chov yorshe haav omrin met habben techilla velo hinniach kelum veavad hachov uvaale chovot omrim haav met techilla vezacha habben birushshato veyesh lanu ligbot mechelko hare hannechasim bechezkat hayyorshin veal haishsha uvaale chovot lehavi reaya o yelchu lahem belo kelum

Din ellu shemmetu tachat hammappolet o shettavu bayyam o shennaflu laesh o shemmetu beom echad veze bimdina zo vehaacher bimdina acheret din echad hu shebbechal ellu vechayyotze bahen en yodin mi hu shemmet techilla
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 6: En adam yachol lehorish lemi sheeno rauy leyarsho velo laakor hayerushsha min hayyoresh af al pi shezze mamon hu lefi shenneemar befarashat nechalot vehayeta livne yisrael lechukkat mishpat lomar shechukka zo lo nishtanna veen hattenay moil bah ben shetztziva vehu bari ben shehaya shechiv mera ben al pe ben bichtav eno moil

Lefichach haomer ish peloni beni bechori lo yittol pi shenayim ish peloni beni lo yirash im echav lo amar kelum ish peloni yirasheni bemakom sheyyesh lo bat bitti tirasheni bemakom sheyyesh lo ben lo amar kelum vechen kal kayyotze baze aval hau lo yorshin rabbim kegon banim rabbim o achim o banot veamar keshehu shechiv mera peloni achi yirasheni mikkelal echay o bitti pelonit tirasheni mikkelal benotay devarav kayyamin ben sheamar al pe ben shekkatav bichtav aval im amar peloni beni yirasheni levaddo im amar al pe devarav kayyamin aval im katav kal nechasav livno lo asahu ella appotroppos kemo shebbearnu

Amar peloni beni yirash chatzi nechasay ushar banay hachetzi devarav kayyamin aval im amar habbechor yirash kappashut o sheamar lo yirash pi shenayim im echav lo amar kelum shenneemar lo yuchal levakker et ben haahuva al pene ven hassenua habbechor ki et habbechor ben hassenua yakkir
Veim haya bari eno yachol lehosif velo ligroa lo labbechor velo leechad mishshear hayyorshin

Bamme devarim amurim kesheamar bilshon yerushsha aval im natan mattana devarav kayyamin lefichach hamchallek nechasav al piv levanav keshehu shechiv mera ribba leechad umiet leechad vehishva lahen habbechor devarav kayyamin veim amar mishshum yerushsha lo amar kelum

Katav ben battechilla ben baemtza ben bassof mishshum mattana af al pi shehizkir leshon yerushsha battechilla uvassof devarav kayyamin ketzad tinnaten sade peloni lifloni beni veyirashenna o sheamar yirashenna vetinnaten lo veyirashenna o yirashenna vetinnaten lo hoil veyesh sham leshon mattana af al pi shehizkir leshon yerushsha battechilla uvassof devarav kayyamin vechen im hau shalosh sadot lishlosha yorshin veamar yirash peloni sade pelonit vetinnaten lifloni sade pelonit veyirash peloni sade pelonit kanu af al pi shezze sheamar lo bilshon yerushsha eno ze sheamar lo bilshon mattana vehu shello yishhe ben amira laamira kede dibbur aval im shaha tzarich sheyehe leshon hammattana meorav bishlashtan

Ketzad im haya leshon hammattana baemtza yomar peloni ufloni ufloni yirshu sade peloni ufloni ufloni shennetattim lahen bemattana veyirashum veim haya leshon hammattana battechilla yomar tinnaten sade peloni ufloni ufloni lifloni ufloni ufloni veyirashum veim haya leshon hammattana bassof yomar yirash peloni ufloni ufloni sade peloni ufloni ufloni shennetattim lahen bemattana
Yerushshat habbaal af al pi shehi middivrehem asu chizzuk ledivrehem keshel tora veen hattenay moil bah ella im ken hitna immah keshehi arusa kemo shebbearnu behilchot ishut
Haakkum yoresh et aviv devar tora aval shear yerushshotehen mannichin oto lefi minhagam

Vehagger eno yoresh et aviv haakkum ella middivrehem tikkenu lo sheyyirash keshehaya shemma yachzor lemirdo veyerae li shettenay moil birushsha zo hoil veen haakkum mechuyyav laamod betakkanat chachamim veen haakkum yoresh et aviv hagger velo ger yoresh et ger lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim

Kal hannoten nechasav laacherim vehinniach hayyorshin af al pi sheen hayyorshin nohagin bo kashshura en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu vezachu haacherim bechal ma shennatan lahen middat chasidut hi shello yaid adam chasid betzavaa shemmaavirin bo hayerushsha min hayyoresh afillu mibben sheeno noheg kashshura leachiv chacham venoheg kashshura

Yisrael shehemir yoresh et kerovav hayyisreelim keshehaya veim rau bet din leabbed et mamono ulkanso shello yirash kede shello lechazzek et yedehem harshut beyadan veim yesh lo banim beyisrael tinnaten yerushshat avihen hammumar lahen vechen hamminhag tamid bammaarav
Tziuu chachamim shello yeshanne adam ben habbanim bechayyav afillu bedavar muat shello yavou lide tacharut vekina kaache yosef im yosef
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 7: En hayyorshin nochalin ad sheyyaviu reaya berura shemmet morishan aval im shamu bo shemmet o shebbau akkum mesichin lefi tumman af al pi shemmassiin et ishto al pihem venotel ketubbatah en hayyorshin nochalin al pihem

Haishsha shebbat veamra met bali af al pi shehi neemenet vetinnase vetittol ketubbatah en hayyorshin nichnasin lannachala al piha amra met bali venityabbema hare yevamah nichnas lannachala al piha shenneemar yakum al shem achiv hammet vahare kam

Mi shettava bemayim sheen lahem sof uvau edim shettava bifnehem veavad zichro af al pi sheen massiin et ishto lechattechilla hare hayyorshin nochalin al pihem vechen im bau edim sherauhu shennafal legov araot unmerim o sherauhu tzaluv vehaof ochel bo o shennidkar bammilchama umet o shenneherag velo hikkiru panav aval hau lo simanim muvhakin begufo vehikkiru otam bechal ellu haddevarim vechayyotze bahen im avad zichro achar kach yordin lannachala beedut zo af al pi sheen massiin et ishto sheani omer shello hechmiru bidvarim ellu ella mippene issur karet aval leinyan mamon im heidu haedim bidvarim shechezkatan lemita veheidu sherau otan haddevarim veavad zichro veachar kach nishma shemmet hare ellu nochalin al pihen vechaze maasim bechal yom bechal batte dinin velo shamanu mi shechalak bedavar ze

Shavuy shennishba veshamu shemmet veyardu yorshav lannachala vechalku otah benehem en motziin otah miyyadan vechen habboreach mechamat sakkana aval hayyotze ledaat sheshshamu bo shemmet veyardu yorshav linchasav vechillekum motziin miyyadan ad sheyyaviu reaya shemmet morishan

Shavuy shennishba uvarach mechamat sakkanat nefashot chayyavin bet din lehitassek benichsehen ketzad osin kal hammittaltelin yihu mufkadin beyad neeman al pi bet din umoridin letoch hakkarkaot kerovin haruyin lirushsha kede laavod et hakkarkaot ulhitassek bahen ad sheyyivada shemmetu o ad sheyyavou velichsheyyavo hashshavuy vehabboreach shamin ellu hakkerovim shehurdu ma sheasu uma sheachlu keminhag kal haarisin shel otah hammedina velamma lo yaamidu bet din appotroppos leolam ben bemittaltelim ben bekarkaot ad sheyyavou habbealim o ad sheyyivada bevadday shemmetu lefi sheen bet din chayyavin lehaamid appotroppos ligdolim shehen bene daat

Nishba hashshavuy uvarach hamsukkan vehinniach kama liktzor vaanavim livtzor temarim ligdor vezetim limsok bet din yordim linchasav umaamidin lahen appotroppos vekotzer uvotzer vegoder umosek umocher happerot umannichin demehen im shear hammittaltelin bevet din veachar kach moridin hakkarov linchasav sheim yered techilla shemma yitlosh ellu happerot shehen kitlushin veyochal otan vehu haddin bachatzerot ufundakiyyot vachanuyyot haasuot lesachar veenan tzerichin avoda velo torach veen adam noten otan baarisut en moridin lahem yoresh shehare gove hassachar veochel ella ketzad osin bet din maamidin lahen gabbay veyihye hassachar munnach bevet din ad sheyyavi reaya shemmet o ad sheyyavo veyittol shello

Sear tzahov haamur battora hu sheyyihye ketavnit hazzahav veze shenneemar dak hu sheyyihye katzar aval im haya aroch af al pi shehu tzahov ketavnit hazzahav eno siman tuma

Netek shehaya chut yotze mimmennu vechen shene netakin shechut yotze mizze laze im yesh berochav hachut hannatuk kede tzemichat shette searot zokkin littamme besear tzahov dak ufison umatztzilin batztzomeach bo aval sear shachor hannishar beoto hachut eno matztzil ad sheyyihye rochav hachut kigris

Mi shehaya berosho netek kigris ufasa hannetek al kal rosho velo nishar sham sear kelal ella pachot mishshete searot hare ze tahor ben shennittak kullo mittoch hesger o mittoch hechlet o achar happittur shenneemar kereach hu tahor hu vechen im haya hannetek bizkano venittak kal zekano hare ze tahor veaf al pi sheen ze meforash battora shebbichtav kabbala hi sheim halach kal sear hazzakan tahor hu veyittamme or hazzakan shekkarach benige or habbasar kemo shebbearnu

Habba battechilla vechal rosho natuk o kal zekano natuk yasgir shavua echad im lo nolad lo sear tzahov yasgir shavua sheni im nolad lo sear tzahov dak tame lo nolad lo yippater nolad lo achar happittur sear tzahov hare ze muchlat nolad lo sear shachor hare ze tahor habba kullo natuk rosh o zakan venolad lo sear shachor tahor kemo shebbearnu halach hassear hashshachor tame mishshum pison

Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 9: Hakkol mittammein bingaim afillu katan ben yomo vehaavadim aval lo akkum velo ger toshav vehakkol kesherin lirot et hannegaim vechal hannegaim adam roe otan chutz minnige atzmo

Af al pi shehakkol kesherin lirot negaim hattuma vehattahora teluya bechohen ketzad kohen sheeno yodea lirot hechacham roehu veomer lo emor tame vehakkohen omer tame emor tahor vehakkohen omer tahor hasgiro vehu masgiro shenneemar veal pihem yihye kal riv vechal nega vaafillu haya hakkohen katan o shote hechacham omer lo vehu machlit o poter o soger bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hakkohen somech al divre hechacham aval im haya hakkohen roe vesomech al atzmo asur lo lirot nega mikkal negaim ad sheyyorennu rabbo veyihye baki bechal hannegaim uvishmotehen benige adam kullam uvnige begadim uvnige battim

Kohen shettimme et hattahor o tiher et hattame lo asa kelum shenneemar tame hu vetimmeo hakkohen tahor hu vetiharo hakkohen umtzora shennirpa ben mittoch hesger ben mittoch hechlet afillu achar kamma shanim hare ze betumato ad sheyyomar lo kohen tahor atta

En hakkohen rashshay letamme et hattame ad sheyyihu enav bimkom hannega beor habbasar shechutza lo vechohen sheraa hannega battechilla hu sheroehu besof shavua rishon uvsof shavua sheni vehu shemmasgiro o machlito o potro met hakkohen sheraahu techilla o shechala roehu kohen acher veen hashsheni yachol letammeo befison sheen yodea im pasa im lo pasa ella rishon veneeman kohen lomar nega ze pasa venega ze lo pasa vesear lavan ze kadam et habbaheret o baheret zo kadma et sear lavan

Chalal pasul liriyyat negaim shenneemar echad mibbanav hakkohanim bichhunnatam aval baale mumin kesherim liriyyat negaim uvilvad shello yihye suma vaafillu beachat meenav vaafillu kohen shekkaha meor enav lo yire et hannegaim shenneemar lechal mare ene hakkohen

En roin et hannegaim ella bayyom ben lehasgir ben lehachlit ben liftor shehare bechal hainyan hu omer bayyom uvayyom veen roin lo beshacharit velo ben haarbayim velo betoch habbayit velo bayyom hamunnan lefi shekkeha niret azza velo batztzahorayim lefi sheazza niret keha ematay roin otan beshaa reviit uvachamishit uvashsheminit uvatteshiit ben nige adam ben nige begadim uvattim

Nagua shebba lakkohen laroto lo yomar lo lech veshuv ella nizkak lo miyyad bau lefanav shenayim roe et harishon masgiro o potro o machlito vechozer veroe et hashsheni

Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 10: Hattolesh simane tuma ben kullan ben miktzatan o hichva et hammichya kullah o mikketzatah o hakkotzetz hannega kullo mibbesaro o min habbeged o min habbayit ben kodem sheyyavo lakkohen ben betoch hesger o betoch hechlet o achar happittur hare ze over belo taase shenneemar hishshamer benega hatztzaraat lishmor meod velaasot kechol asher yoru etchem hakkohanim halviyyim kaasher tzivitim tishmeru shello yitlosh o sheyyakotz aval eno loke ad sheyyoilu maasav veim lo hoilu eno loke ketzad hayeta bo baheret uvah shalosh searot levanot vetalash achat kava miktzat hammichya venishar mimmenna kaadasha eno loke shehare hu tame keshehaya vechen kal kayyotze baze umakkin oto makkat mardut vechen hamgalleach et hannetek loke shenneemar veet hannetek lo yegalleach veeno chayyav ad sheyegalleach kal hannetek betaar umuttar limtzora lissa bemot al ketefo sheyyesh bah hatztzaraat velikshor hassiv al raglo veim halchu simane tuma yelchu vehu shello nitkaven lechach

Hattolesh simane tuma o shekkava et hammichya ad shello ba etzel kohen hare ze tahor vechen im asa ken bime hesger hare ze tahor leachar yeme hesger veim telashan achar shehuchlat bahen hare ze muchlat keshehaya veen lo tahora ad shettifrach hatztzaraat bechullo o ad shettitmaet baharto mikkigris

Mi shehayeta baheret bearlato yamul veaf al pi shehi mila shello bizmannah shemmitzvat ase docha et lo taase bechal makom veim mal vehalach beor haarla siman shehaya muchlat bo hare ze chayyav bekarban metzora

Etz erez veezov ushni tolaat shettahar bahen metzora ze metaher bahen metzoraim acherim vechen tzippor hammishtallachat muttar letaher bah metzoraim acherim meachar shennishtallecha umutteret baachila aval hatztzippor hashshechuta asura bahanaa umeematay teaser mishsheat shechitatah shechatah veen sham ezov velo etz erez velo sheni tolaat hare zo asura bahanaa sheshshechita sheenah reuya shemah shechita vehaochel kezayit mitztzippor hashshechuta avar al ase veal lo taase shenneemar veze asher lo tochlu mehem mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze lerabbot hatztzippor hashshechuta veneemar tehora tochelu ha acheret lo tochlu velav habba mikkelal ase ase

Shachat achat mehen venimtzet shello hayeta deror yikkach zug lashsheniyya veharishona mutteret baachila shachat haachat venimtzet terefa yikkach zug lashsheniyya veharishona mutteret bahanaa
Nishpach haddam mannichin et hammishtallachat ad shettamut meta hammishtallachat yishshafech haddam veyikkach shettayim acherot
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 12: Tzaraat begadim kigris ketzaraat adam aval pachot mikkigris tahor ushlosha simane tuma yesh bahen yerakrak adamdam vehappison ushlashtan meforashin battora yerakrak hu hayyarok shebbayerukkin shehu yarok harbe kichnaf hattavas uchhutze haddekel vaadamdam hu adom shebbaadummim shehu adom harbe kizhorit yafa ushne marot ellu mitztarfin ze im ze bemare yerakrak o adamdam masgirin et habbeged veim amad bemare ze shene shavuot machlitin vesorfin vechen im pasa machlitin vesorfin ketzad beged shennire bo nega yerakrak o adamdam masgiro shivat yamim uvashshevii roe im pasa machlito vesoref et kal habbeged veim amad bemarehu velo pasa o sheppasa vecheha mishshene hammarot shehusgar bahen o shehosif hammare lehaadim ulhorik velo pasa yechabbes mekom hannega veyasgir shivat yamim shenit uvsof shavua sheni shehu yom shelosha asar roe im keha lemare shelishit hare ze taun kibbus vetahor veim nishtanna hannega mimma shehaya kegon shehaya yerakrak venaasa adamdam o adamdam venaasa yerakrak korea mekom hannega vesoref ma shekkara vetofer matlit bammakom shekkara ufoter shear habbeged umchabbeso kullo kibbus sheni umatbilo vetaher veim amad bammare shehusgar bo battechilla yachlito veyisrof et kullo
Nega shehaya yerakrak ufasa adamdam o shehaya adamdam ufasa yerakrak hare ze pison
Nega shehaya beemtzao makom naki belo nega ufasa lo hannega eno pison ad sheyyifse lachutz sheen pison hannega letocho pison ben beadam ben bivgadim uvattim

Happison hassamuch babbegadim kal shehu veharachok o hachozer kigris ketzad beged shehusgar venolad bo nega acher kigris rachok min hannega shehusgar bo hare ze pison veyissaref veim haya pachot mikkigris en mashgichin bo vechen beged shekkara mimmennu hannega besof shavua sheni kemo shebbearnu vechazar bo nega kigris yissaref vechen beged sheppasa bo hannega achar shenniftar yissaref

Mi shemmechabbes et hannega beshavua rishon kemo shebbearnu tzarich lechabbes meat min habbeged shechutza lo shenneemar et asher bo hannaga vechal nige begadim shemmechabbesin otan maavirin alehen shiva sammanin shemmaavirin al hakketem kederech shemmaavirin al hakketamim kemo shebbearnu beinyan nidda

Beged shekkara mimmennu mekom hannega vetafar matlit kemo shebbearnu vechazar nega kigris al habbeged mattir et hammatlit umatztzilah vesoref shear habbeged chazar hannega al hammatlit soref et hakkol

Hattole min hammusgar betahor vechazar nega al habbeged soref et hammatlit chazar al hammatlit habbeged harishon hammusgar yissaref vehammatlit teshammesh et habbeged shehi tefura bo besimanin im amad beenav shene shavuot o pasa sorfin hakkol

Beged shebba kullo battechilla yerakrak o adamdam masgiro shavua achar shavua im amad bo shene shavuot yissaref aval beged shehisgiro ufasa hannega bechullo venaasa yerakrak o adamdam o sheppetaro veachar sheppetaro ba kullo yerakrak o adamdam hare ze tahor kibbes ufasa yissaref

Beged shemmochin yotzin al panav min haarig kegon sagos shel tzemer venira bo nega eno mittamme ad sheyyerae hannega bammochin uvaarig atzmo veze shenneemar babbegadim bekarachto o vegabbachto karachto ellu hashshechakim gabbachto ellu hachadashim

Habbegadim hatztzevuim enan mittammein bingaim ben shetztzevuin bide adam ben shetztzevuin bide shamayim ad sheyehu levanim beged sheshshito tzavua veervo lavan ervo tzavua veshito lavan hakkol holech achar hannire pachot mishshalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot min haarig eno mittamme bingaim
Beged shearag bo pachot mishshalosh al shalosh venira bo nega veachar kach hishlimo leshalosh al shalosh tahor
Hattofer matliyyot sheen bechal achat mehen shalosh al shalosh veasa mehen beged hare ze mittamme bingaim shehattafur kearug vechullo beged echad hu

Beged shehu matliyyot matliyyot mehen tzevuin umehen levanim venira nega ballavan shebbo masgirin oto im amad shene shavuot nitma kullo veyissaref vechen im pasa hannega bematlit levana acheret hare ze pison af al pi sheyyesh benehem tzavua haya kullo tzavua uvo pas echad lavan afillu kigris venira bo nega yasgir sheim amad beenav velo hosif velo keha shene shavuot yissaref
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 13: En mittamme bingaim ella bigde tzemer ufishtim bilvad o hashsheti o haerev shel tzemer ufishtim vechal kele haor ben kashe ben rach af haor hatztzavua bide shamayim mittamme bingaim vehallevadim kivgadim umittammein bingaim vehaohalim mittammein bingaim ben shehau shel tzemer ufishtim ben shehau shel or
Kal habbegadim shel tzemer ufishtim mittammein bingaim chutz mibbigde akkum hallokeach begadim min haakkum yerau battechilla beged shehu kilayim min hatztzemer umin happishtim mittamme bingaim

Tzemer gemallim vetzemer rechelim shettevaan ze im ze im rov min haggemallim eno mittamme bingaim veim rov min harchelim mittamme bingaim mechetza lemechetza mittamme bingaim vehu haddin befishtan vekanbos shetterafan ze baze verachel bat ez en hatztzemer shellah mittamme bingaim beged shehaya shito pishtan veervo kanbos o shito kanbos veervo pishtan eno mittamme bingaim vechen im haya shito o ervo pishtan o tzemer vehashshear notza shel izzim vechayyotze bah eno mittamme bingaim

Haor sheeno meubbad eno mittamme bingaim vechen haor shehu golem kodem sheasa mimmennu kelim eno mittamme bingaim shenneemar keli haor vechal kele haor ben peshutehen ben mekabbelehen kal shehen mittammein bingaim

Orot chayya shebbayyam en mittammein bingaim chibber lahen min haggadel baaretz afillu chut o meshicha shel tzemer o pishtim o or behema vechayya hamubbadin kal shehu veasa mehen kelim mittammein bingaim vehu sheyechabberennu lo kederech chibbure begadim letuma

Kal keli harauy lehittamme bishar hattumot af al pi sheeno mittamme bemidras hazzav mippene shello naasa lemishkav o lemoshav hare ze mittamme bingaim kegon kela shel sefina vehapparochet veshavis shel sevacha umitpechot sefarim vehaavnet urtzuot minal vesandal sheyyesh bahen rochav kigris hare ellu vechal kayyotze bahen mittamme bingaim veen tzarich lomar shear hakkelim kegon karim uchsatot hachemet vehatturmal nirin kedarkan ufose hannega mittochan laachorehen umeachorehen letochan vechen kal kayyotze bahen mikkele haor hakkefulin
Sadin hamkummat mafshitin et kematav veroin et nigo

Hashsheti vehaerev ben shel tzemer ben shel pishtan mittammein bingain miyyad mishsheyyittau af al pi shello libben happishtan velo shalak hatztzemer vechamma yihye bifkaat shel tauy vetittame bingaim kede leerog mimmennu shalosh al shalosh sheti vaerev ben shehayeta kullah sheti ben shehayeta kullah erev hayeta happekaat mekubbetzet mechutim pesukin enah mittammea bingaim

Shette pekaiyyot hamurot zo lazo bechut vechen hashsheti shemmiktzato lafuf al hakkoved haelona umiktzato lafuf al hakkoved hattachtona vechen shene dappe chaluk shemmeerot bechut echad venira hannega beechad mehen hashsheni tahor af al pi shechut echad mechabber benehen nira hannega benefesh hammassechet uvashsheti haomed af al pi shemmiktzat hannega babbeged umiktzato bashsheti hare ze tame nira hannega bashsheti haomed levaddo haarug tahor nira baarug levaddo hashsheti haomed tahor nira besadin soref et hannimin nira bannimin hassadin tahor pasa min hannimin lassadin hassadin tame
Chaluk shennira bo nega matztzil et haimriot shebbo afillu hayeta haimeret tzemer o pishtim matztzilah veenah nisrefet

Beged musgar shetztzevao o mecharo leakkum tahor vechen im nitarev baacherim kullan tehorim ketzatzo veasahu mochin pachot mishshalosh al shalosh tahor umuttar bahanayato hayeta bahen achat shalosh al shalosh venira bah nega hi levaddah temea
Beged muchlat shennitarev baacherim kullan temein veyissarfu afillu echad bechamma alafim vechen im ketzatzan vaasaahu mochin hare hen temein veasur bahanayatan

Echad beged o keli or o sheti o erev hammusgar o hammuchlat leinyan tuma hare hu av meavot hattumot keadam metzora lechal davar metamme bemagga uvmassa uvvia veose mishkav umoshav afillu mittachat haeven ketzad beged menugga o sheti o erev o kele or hamnuggain shehichnis mehen afillu kezayit levayit tahor nitma kal asher babbayit ben adam ben kelim venaasu kullan rishon letuma vechen mishkav umoshav hammunnach tachat haeven vehinniach kezayit mehen lemala min haeven nitma hammishkav o hammoshav

Matlit sheyyesh bah shalosh al shalosh af al pi sheen bah kezayit kevan shennichnas rubbah levayit tahor timmeattu hau bah kamma zetim kevan shennichnas mimmenna kezayet levayit tahor nitma af al pi shekkal hashshiurin halacha lemoshe missinay hare hu omer lechal nega hatztzaraat velannatek ultzaraat habbeged velabbayit hikkish nige adam lenige begadim uvattim vehishva hamtzora lemet shenneemar al na tehi kammet ma hammet bichzayit af ellu bichzayit
Begadim hamnuggaim meshallechin otan chutz lair ben shehayeta mukkefet choma ben sheenah mukkefet veze chomer bivgadim mibbeadam
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 14: Tzaraat battim kishne gerisin ze betzad ze nimtza rochov hannega kemo mekom tzemichat shesh searot bagguf vearko kishtem esre searot beribbua vehappachot mishshiur ze bevattim tahor vechal hashshiurin halacha lemoshe missinay

Shelosha simane tuma yesh bevattim mare yerakrak vaadamdam vehappison vechullan meforashin battora ushne hammarot mitztarfin ze im ze ufison hassamuch kal shehu veharachok kigris aval hachozer achar hittoach kishne gerisin

En nige battim metammein ad sheyyihye mare hannega shafal min hakkir shenneemar shekaarurot sheyyihu shokin bakkirot uvishne hammarot masgirin o machlitin uvfison nottzin veim pasa achare hittoach notetz et kal habbayit kemo sheyyitbaer

Kesheyyerae nega babbayit afillu chacham sheyyodea vadday shezze nega lo yigzor veyomar nega nire li babbayit ella omer lakkohen kenega nire li babbayit vetziva hakkohen ufinnu et habbayit afillu chavile etzim vachavile kanim veachar kach yavo hakkohen veyikkanes veyire hannega

Bayit afel en potchin bo challonot lirot et nigo ella im en hannega nire bo tahor veachar sheyyire hakkohen et hannega yetze veyaamod al petach habbayit betzad hammashkof veyasgir o yachlit o yiftor shenneemar veyatza hakkohen min habbayit vehisgir et habbayit lo sheyyasgir vehu betoch beto o betoch bayit hamnugga o tachat hammashkof ella betzad pitcho veim amad tachat hammashkof o shehalach leveto vehisgir hare ze musgar

En habbayit mittamme bingaim ad sheyyihye bo arba ammot al arba ammot o yeter vihe lo arbaa ketalim vehu banuy baaretz baavanim veafar veetzim shenneemar et avanav veet etzav veet afaro aval im haya bo pachot mearba ammot al arba ammot o shehaya agol o shehaya baal shelosha ketalim o baal chamishsha o shehaya banuy bisfina o taluy al arba korot eno mittamme bingaim haya banuy al arbaa ammudim mittamme bingaim

Kamma avanim yihu bo en pachot mishshemone shette avanim bechal kotel kede sheyyihye kal kotel rauy lenega sheen habbayit mittamme bingaim ad sheyyerae bo kishne gerisin al shette avanim shenneemar et haavanim asher bahen hannega vechamma etzim yihu bo kede litten tachat hammashkof veafar kede latet ben patztzim lachavero aval im haya bo pachot mishshiurim ellu eno mittamme bingaim
Hallevenim vehashshayish enan chashuvin kaavanim bayit sheechad mitztziddav mechuppe beshayish veechad besela veechad bilvenim veechad beafar eno mittamme bingaim
Bayit shello hau bo avanim veetzim kashshiur venira bo nega veachar kach hevi lo avanim veetzim veafar tahor
Bayit shessikkecho bizraim bittelan hoil umshammeshin tashmish etz hare hen keetz veim nitma habbayit nitmeu immo tuma chamura kemo sheyyitbaer
Yerushalayim vechutza laaretz en mittammein bingaim shenneemar bevet eretz achuzzatchem virushalayim lo nitchalleka lishvatim uvatte haakkum shebbeeretz yisrael en mittammein bingaim
Hallokeach battim min haakkum yerae battechilla

Bayit shetztziddo echad akkum vetziddo echad yisrael tziddo echad baaretz vetziddo echad bechutza laaretz eno mittamme bingaim ushar kal habbattim shebbeeretz yisrael mittammein bingaim ben tzevuim bide adam ben tzevuim bide shamayim
Bet haishsha bet hashshuttafin bet hakkeneset o bet hammidrash sheyyesh bahen dira lechazzanin o letalmidim mittammein bingaim
Kirot haevus vekirot hammechitztza shebbabbayit en mittammein bingaim
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 15: Nige battim yesh bahen hesger shelosha shavuot shehen tisha asar yom sheyyom shevii ole lechan ulchan veom shelosha asar ole lechan ulchan nimtzeta atta lamed sheim tzarich lishlosha shavuot roehu bashshevii uvom shelosha asar uvom tisha asar vehesger battim shelosha shavuot eno meforash battora vechen rov dine nige battim divre kabbala hen

Vechal haddinin hamforashin bahen battora uvdivre kabbala kach hem kesheyyavo hakkohen veyire hannega shokea yerakrak o adamdam kemo shebbearnu yasgir shivat yamim vaafillu metzao kullo battechilla yerakrak o adamdam yasgir uvashshevii roehu im keha hannega veen tzarich lomar im halach kolef mekom hannega bilvad vehabbayit tahor metzao sheamad beenav velo pasa masgir shavua sheni veroehu beom shelosha asar im keha hannega o halach lo kolef mekom hannega umtaher et habbayit betzipporim veim matza hannega sheppasa besof shavua sheni o sheamad beeno choletz et haavanim shebbahen hannega umaktze heafar el michutz lair vetach et kal habbayit umasgiro shavua shelishi uvom tisha asar roehu im chazar bo nega kishne gerisin hare ze pison achare hittoach venotetz et kal habbayit veim lo chazar bo nega metaharo betzipporim vechal zeman sheyyachzor bo hannega kodem sheyetaharo betzipporim hare ze yinnatetz veim nira bo nega achar shettiharo betzipporim yerae battechilla vechen im pasa hannega besof shavua rishon choletz et haavanim shebbahen hannega vekotze heafar chutz lair vetach et kal habbayit umasgiro shavua sheni veroe im matza bo nega kishne gerisin hare ze pison achare hittoach venotetz et kal habbayit veim lo chazar bo nega metaharo betzipporim vechal zeman sheyyire bo nega kodem tahora betzipporim yinnatetz veim nira bo achar shettiharo betzipporim yerae battechilla

Keshehu choletz et haavanim shebbahen hannega eno choletz pachot mishshete avanim veeno notel avanim mitztzad ze umvian letzad ze shenneemar velakchu avanim acherot velo afar mitztzad ze umevi letzad ze shenneemar veafar acher yikkach vetach et habbayit veeno tach besid ella beafar shenneemar veafar acher yikkach vego eno mevi even achat tachat shettayim shechalatz velo shette avanim tachat even achat chalutza ella mevi shettayim tachat shettayim veyesh lo lehavi shettayim tachat shalosh

Haya hakkotel beno leven chavero shenehen choltzin ushnehen kotzim et heafar ushnehem meviin avanim acherot aval baal habbayit mevi levaddo et heafar shenneemar veafar acher yikkach vetach en chavero metappel immo beticha
Even shebbazzavit bizman shehu choletz choletz et kullah uvizman shehu notetz notetz et shello umanniach et shel chavero veyesh baddavar safek im tihye zo shel chavero kemo yad laeven shello

Bayit shennira bo nega vehayeta aliyya al gabbav noten et hakkorot laaliyya nira baaliyya noten et hakkorot labbayit lo hayeta aliyya al gabbav avanav veetzav vaafaro kullan nittatzin immo umatztzil et hammalbenin veet serige hachallonot

Hallokeach avanim mibbayit musgar uvnaan bevayit tahor chazar hannega lammusgar choletz et haavanim shebbattahor nira nega al haavanim shebbana hammusgar yinnatetz vehabbayit hashsheni masgirin oto benega ze kedin kal bayit shennira bo nega battechilla

Ketzad metaharin et habbayit hamnugga achar hachalitza vehatticha mevi mayim chayyim bichli cheres ushte tzipporim veetz erez veezov ushni tolaat ketahorat adam shebbearnu lechal davar ella shebbeadam mazze sheva peamim leachar yado shel metzora uvvayit mazze sheva peamim al hammashkof shel bayit mibbachutz ushar kal maasehen shavin
Mishneh Torah, Defilement by Leprosy 16: Bayit hamnugga av meavot hattumot kal hannogea bo nitma vechen avanim shecholtzin mimmennu achar hesger o avanim veetzim veafar shel bayit keshennottzin oto kullan avot tumot vechal kezayit mehem metamme adam vechelim bemagga uvmassa uvvia ketzad im nichnas kezayit mehen levayit tahor nitma kal asher babbayit meadam vechelim shekkullan metammein bevia keadam metzora vechullan asurin bahanaa veim serafan veasa mehen sid hare ze asur bahanaa shenneemar tzaraat mameret ten bo meera veal tehane bo vechullan meshallechin otan chutz lair af al pi sheenah mukkefet choma

Bayit musgar eno metamme ella mittocho shenneemar vehabba el habbayit kal yeme hisgir oto yitma ad haarev aval hammuchlat metamme mittocho umeachorav shehannogea bo meachorav tame shenneemar tzaraat mameret babbayit tame hu vechi tahor haya ella lehosif lo tuma al tumato sheyyihye kullo tame vitamme meachorav vechen avanim sheyyesh bahen hannega bemusgar metammein meachorehen

Echad hammusgar vehammuchlat metamme bevia ketzad bayit shehaya mesech al gabbe bayit menugga ben muchlat ben musgar o ilan shehu mesech alav haomed tachat hailan o hannichnas labbayit hachitzon tame shehare hu vehabbayit hattame tachat ohel echad vechen even menuggaat hannichneset leohel vehuncha sham nitma kal asher baohel hayeta munnachat tachat hailan vehattahor over nitma haya hattahor omed tachat hailan veavar adam beeven menuggaat lo timmeahu veim hinnichah sham timmeahu shemmoshav hamnugga kamohu ben adam ben kelim ben avanim veetzav vaafaro
Hammaahil beyado al even menuggaat o sheheehila alav tahor ad sheyyigga
Tahor shennichnas levayit menugga derech achorav afillu nichnas kullo chutz mechatmo tahor shenneemar vehabba el habbayit derech bia timmea tora

Tahor shehichnis rosho verubbo levayit tame nitma vechen tallit tehora shehichnis mimmenna shalosh al shalosh levayit tame nitmet vechen keli cheres shehichnis aviro levayit tame nitma aval shear kelim ad sheyyachnis rov hakkelim mishsheyyachnis rubbo nitma miyyad bamme devarim amurim bechelim shennichnesu chalutzin aval adam miyyisrael shennichnas levayit menugga vehu lavush bivgadav vesandalav beraglav vetabbeotav beyadav hare haadam tame miyyad uvgadav tehorim ad sheyyashhe sham kede sheyyasev adam veyochal keshalosh betzim pat chittim beliftan shenneemar vehashshochev babbayit yechabbes et begadav vehaochel babbayit yechabbes et begadav vechi taale al datecha sheen begadav mittammein ad sheyyochal sham ella litten shiur lashshochev keochel veachad hashshochev o hayyoshev o haomed im shaha kede leechol shiur achila haamura nitmeu begadav

Mi shennichnas levayit menugga vechelav al ketefav vesandalo vetabbato bechappav hu vehen temein miyyad sheeno matztzil milletamme miyyad ella kelim shehu lavush bahen vechen haakkum vehabbehema shehau levushin bechelim venichnesu labbayit hamnugga nitmeu hakkelim miyyad aval haakkum eno mekabbel tuma kivhema

Mi shehaya omed bevayit menugga ufashat yadav chutz labbayit vetabbeotav beyadav im shaha kede achilat hashshiur nitmeu hattabbaot af al pi shehem bachutz vechen haomed bachutz ufashat yado levayit menugga nitmeu yadav bilvad miyyad veim nishtahu sham kede achilat hashshiur nitmeu tabbeotav veim lav tehorot

Kal hammatztzil betzamid patil beohel hammet matztzil mechusse bevayit menugga vechal hammatztzil mechusse beohel hammet afillu haya megulle bevayit hamnugga hare ze tahor ketzad kele cheres o kele avanim uchle adama vechayyotze bahen shehau ochalin umashkin vechelim betochan vehau mechussin bevayit hamnugga af al pi sheenan mukkafin tzamid patil hen vechal ma shebbetochan tahor habbor vehaddut shebbevayit hamnugga af al pi shehen megullin kelim shebbetochan tehorin

Hatztzaraat hu shem haamur beshuttafut kolel inyanim harbe sheen domin ze laze shehare loven or haadam karuy tzaraat unfilat ketzat sear harosh o hazzakan karuy tzaraat veshinnuy en habbegadim o habbattim karuy tzaraat veze hashshinnuy haamur babbegadim uvabbattim shekkeraattu tora tzaraat beshuttafut hashshem eno mimminhago shel olam ella ot ufele haya beyisrael kede lehazhiran millashon Haya zav rochev al chamoro veze rochev al chamoro umhallechin badderech safek naga bazzav safek lo naga tinok tame murkav al ketefo shel aviv vetinok tahor murkav al ketefo shel aviv vehalchu ze betzad ze safek naga safek lo naga chavila al ketefo veharok mudbak bakkotel safek naga safek lo naga kelim shetuchin birshut harabbim lemala measara vehattame over safek hesit safek lo hesit hakkol tahor berich rachamana desayean
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 1: Mitzvat para adumma shettihye bat shalosh shanim o bat arba veim hayeta zekena keshera ella sheen mamtinin lah shemma tashchir vetippasel veen lokchin egla umgaddelin otah shenneemar veyikchu elecha fara velo egla lo matzu ella egla poskin aleha damim vetihye etzel bealeha ad shettagdil vetease para velokchin otah mitterumat hallishka

Ze shenneemar battora temima temimat admimut lo temimat koma ella im hayeta nannasa keshera kishar hakkadashim hau bah shette searot levanot o shechorot betoch gumma achat o betoch shene kosot vehen munnachot zo al zo pesula

Hau bah shette searot ikkaran maadim veroshan mashchir ikkaran mashchir veroshan maadim hakkol holech achar haikkar vegozez bemisparayim et roshan hammashchir veeno choshesh mishshum gizza bekadashim sheen kavanato lagoz

Vetzarich sheyyishshaer min hammaadim kede sheyyinnatel bezug shekkal seara sheenah nittelet bezug hare hi keillu enah lefichach im hau bah shette searot levanot o shechorot sheenan nilkatin bezug hare zo keshera
Hau karneha o telafeha shechorim yagod galgal haayin vehashshinnayim vehallashon en marehen poslim befara
Hayeta bah yabbelet vachatachah af al pi shetztzamach bimkomah sear adom pesula

Kal hammumin happoslin bekadashim poslin befara shenneemar asher en bah mum hayeta yotze dofen o mechir o etnan o terefa o shennirbea pesula shekkal happoslin et hakkadashim lammizbeach poslin et happara veaf al pi shehi kekadshe bedek habbayit hoil ukraah hakkatuv chattat umuttar likkach otah min haakkum veen choshshin shemma revaah haakkum sheeno mafsid behemto yetera para al hakkadashim shehaavoda poselet bah shenneemar asher lo ala aleha ol uvegla arufa omer asher lo ubbad bah asher lo mashcha beol ma ol haamur beegla asa shear avodot keol af ol haamur befara yifsol bah shear avodot keol ella shehaol posel ben bishat avoda ben shello bishat avoda ushar avodot en poslot ella bishat avoda ketzad kashar aleha haol af al pi shello charash bah pesula hichnisah ladush enah nifselet ad sheyyadush bah vechen kal kayyotze baze rachav aleha nishan aleha nitla biznavah veavar bah et hannahar kippel aleha et hammosera natan tallito aleha natan aleha kesut shel sakkim pesula kesharah bemosera im hayeta moredet utzricha shemira keshera veim lav pesula shekkal shemira sheenah tzericha massoy hu asa bah sandal shello tachlek peras tallito aleha mippene hazzevuvin keshera ze hakkelal kal shehu letzarkah keshera letzorech acher pesula naaset bah melacha meeleha o sheala aleha ol meelav im lirtzono pesula shenneemar asher lo ubbad bah sheim ubbad bah lirtzono hare ze kemi sheavad bah lefichach im shachan aleha haof keshera ala aleha zachar pesula veen tzarich lomar shehamubberet pesula hichnisah lirvaka vedasha meeleha keshera hichnisah kede shettinak vetadush pesula shehare asa lirtzono vechen kal kayyotze baze
Para shennolad bah pesul tippade vechen im meta tippade mippene orah aval lo lehaachil besarah lichlavim
Nishchata leshem chullin tippade veenah mechapperet nishchata al gav maarachtah en lah pidon olamit
Lakchu para umatzu acheret naa mimmenna hare zo tippade shello bemum

Af kohen hedot kasher lisrefat happara shenneemar untattem otah el elazar hakkohen vaadayin aharon haya kayyam umippi hashshemua lamdu zo naaset beelazar ushar kal happarot ben bechohen gadol ben bechohen hedot
Vehaose otah lovesh arbaa kelim shel kohen hedot ben sheasaah kohen hedot ben sheasaah kohen gadol

Kal haoskin bappara mittechilla vead sof shehau tevule yom kesherim lemaase happara ulkaddesh ulhazzot meefrah veaf al pi sheadayin lo heeriv shimshan shezze shenneemar bechal happarasha ish tahor hu hattahor lemaaser sheni af al pi sheeno tahor litruma ad sheyyaariv shimsho hare ze tahor lefara

Hatztzedokin hau omrim sheen maase happara kasher ella bimorave shemesh lefichach hau bet din bevayit sheni metammein et hakkohen hassoref et happara besheretz vechayyotze bo vetovel veachar kach osek bah kede levattel divre ellu hazzedim shemmorim mehaole al rucham lo min hakkabbala vechen kal hakkelim shemmachnisin letocham efer happara kullam tevule yom

Hachotech shefoferet shel kane lehanniach bah efer chattat yetamme otah veyitbelenna veachar kach yanniach bah vehachotchah vehammatbilah taun tevila mippene sheasauha kitme met bashshevii shello ulfichach enah tzericha hazzaa shelishi ushvii ella metammeah kede leharot latztzedokin umatbilah venoten bah
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 2: Maalot yeterot asu betahorat para adumma veharchakot gedolot hirchiku mittumat hammet bechal maaseha mippene shehi keshera bitvule yom chashu shemma yavou lezalzel bah umippene ze keshemmafrishin hakkohen hassoref otah mafrishin oto lelishka muchenet baazara uvet even hayeta nikret mippene shekkal keleha kele avanim sheen mekabbelin tuma uvichle haeven haya mishtammesh kal shivat yeme hahafrasha velo hau nogin bo echav hakkohanim kede leharbot betahorato

Shivat yamim kodem serefat happara mafrishin kohen hassoref otah mibbeto keshem shemmafrishin kohen gadol laavodat yom hakkippurim vedavar ze kabbala mimmoshe rabbenu vechen mafrishin oto meishto shemma timmatze nidda veyihye tame shivat yamim
Hallishka shehaya yoshev bah kal shiva tzefonit mizrachit hayeta kede lehazkiro shehi kechattat hannishchetet batztzafon af al pi shehi nishchetet bachutz

Kal yom veom mishshivat yeme hahafrasha mazzin alav me chattat shemma nitma lemet vehu lo yada chutz miyyom revii lehafrasha sheen tzarich hazzaa lefi shei efshar shello yihye lo shelishi letumato velo shevii sheen hazzaa bashshevii ola mishshum hazzaat shevii ad sheyyazze bashshelishi millefaneha umin haddin haya sheen tzarich hazzaa ella bishlishi ushvii lehafrasha bilvad veze shemmazzin yom achar yom maala yetera asu befara
Birvii beshabbat hau mafrishin oto kede sheyyachul revii shello lihot beshabbat shehahazzaya enah docha shabbat veharvii en tzarich hazzaya
Bechal yom veom mime hahafrasha shemmazzin alav bahem mazzin meefer para min happarot shennisrefu kevar veim lo haya sham ella efer para achat bilvad mazzin mimmennu alav kal hashshishsha

Keshemmazzin alav bime hahafrasha en mazze alav ella adam shello nitma bemet meolam shehammaze tzarich sheyyihye tahor veim tomar yazze alav ish shennitma vehuzza alav shemma ze shehizza alav lo haya tahor mittumat met vechen hakkelim shemmemallein bahen umkaddeshin lehazzot al hakkohen hassoref kullam kele avanim hau sheen mekabbelin tuma vechal ellu haddevarim maalot yeterot hen sheasu bah vechetzad yimmatze ish shello nitma bemet meolam chatzerot hau birushalayim benuot al gabbe hassela vetachtehen chalul mippene kever hattehom umviin hau nashim ubbarot veoldot sham umgaddelot sham et benehem uchsheyyirtzu lehazzot al hakkohen hassoref meviin shevarim mippene shekkeresehen nefuchot umannichim al gabbehen delatot veoshvin hattinokot al gabbe haddelatot kede sheyyihye haohel mavdil benam leven haaretz mippene kever hattehom vechosot shel even beyadam veholchin lashshiloach higgiu lashshiloach yordin sham ummallein sheen lachush sham mippene kever hattehom sheen derech bene adam likbor banneharot veolin veoshvin al gabbe haddelatot veholchin ad shemmaggiin lehar habbayit higgiu lehar habbayit yordin umhallechin al raglehen mippene shekkal har habbayit vehaazarot tachtehen haya chalul mippene kever hattehom umhallechin ad petach haazara uvfetach haazara haya kalal shel efer notlin haefer venotnin bammayim shebbakkosot umazzin al hakkohen hassoref umatbilin hau hattinokot shemmemallein umkaddeshin umazzin al hassoref af al pi shehen tehorin mittumat hammet shemma nitmeu betuma acheret

Tinok shettaval lemalleot ulhazzot lo yemalle bechelav tinok acher af al pi shettaval vetinok shettaval lehazzot al kohen ze eno mazze al kohen acher ad sheyyitbol leshem maase ze hakkohen vechen kelim shettiharum lechattat zo uvne adam shettiharum lechattat zo lo yitassek bahem befara acheret ad sheyyitbelu lishmah vechal haddevarim haellu maalot yeterot befara
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 3: En sorfin et happara ella chutz lehar habbayit shenneemar vehotzi otah el michutz lammachane uvhar hammishcha hau sorfin otah vechevesh hau osin mehar habbayit lehar hammishcha vetachtav banuy kippin kippin vechippa al kal shene kippin kede sheyyihu shene ragle hakkippa al gag shene kippin shettachteha kede shettihye tachat hakkol chalul mippene kever hattehom af mekom serefatah umkom hattevila shehau behar hammishcha tachtehen chalul mippene kever hattehom vehappara vehassoref vechal hamsaadin bisrefatah yotzin mehar habbayit lehar hammishcha al gabbe kevesh ze

Ketzad sorfin otah zikne yisrael hau makdimin beraglehen lehar hammishcha uvet tevila haya sham vechohen vehamsaadin bisrefatah vehappara yotzin al hakkevesh uvain lehar hammishcha umtammein et hakkohen vesomchin hazzekenim et yedehem al hakkohen veomrim lo tevol achat veim haya kohen gadol omrim lo ishi kohen gadol tevol achat yarad vetaval veala venistappeg veetzim mesuddarim hau sham arazim allonim uvroshim vaatze teena chalaka veosin maaracha kemin migdal umfattechin bah challonot kede shettihye haur melabbevet bahen umare hammaaracha bemaarav vechoftin et happara bechevel shel megeg venotnin otah al gabbe hammaaracha roshah ledarom ufaneha lemaarav hakkohen omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav shochet bimino umkabbel haddam bismolo umazze beetzbao hayemanit min haddam shebbechappo hassemalit sheva peamim keneged bet kadshe hakkadashim al kal hazzaa tevilat etzba bedam ushyare haddam shebbaetzba pesulim lehazzaya lefichach al kal hazzaa mekanneach etzbao begufah shel para gamar millehazzot mekanneach et yadav begufah shel para veored min hammaaracha vehitztzit et haesh beetzim ketannim vehichnisan tachat atze hammaaracha vehitchil haesh bah vehakkohen omed berachok umshammer lah ad sheyyitztzat et haur berubbah vetikkara bitnah veachar kach notel etz erez veezov en pachot mittefach vetzemer tzavua betolaat mishkal chamishsha selaim veomer laomdim sham etz erez ze etz erez ze etz erez ze ezov ze ezov ze ezov ze sheni tolaat ze sheni tolaat ze sheni tolaat ze shalosh peamim al kal echad veechad vehen omrin lo hen hen hen shalosh peamim al kal echad veechad vechal kach lamma lefi shemmine arazim shiva hen umine ezov arbaa vehatztzavua adom yesh shetztzovin oto befua veyesh shetztzovin oto belakka veyesh shetztzovin oto betolaat vehattolaat hi haggargerim haadummim beoter haddomim legarine hecharuvim vehen kemo haog vetolaat kemo yattush yesh bechal gargir mehen ulfichach modia lakkol umgalle lahen sheellu hen hamminim haamurim battora vehaezov haamur battora hu haezov sheochlin oto baale battim umtabbelin bo hakkederot haezov vehaerez vehattolaat shelashtan meakkevin ze et ze vechorech haezov im haerez belashon shel shani umashlich el toch bitnah shenneemar vehishlich el toch serefat happara veeno mashlich kodem sheyyatztzit haur berubbah velo achar shettease efer veim hishlich pesula shenneemar el toch serefat lo kodem sheyyitztzat haur berubbah velo achar shettease efer ben shehishlich shelashtan keachat ben shehishlich ze achar ze ben shehishlich letoch gufah o letoch serefatah ben shennikrea meeleha veachar kach hishlich ben shekkeraah beyado o bichli keshera

Nigmera serefatah chovtin otah bemaklot hi vechal atze hammaaracha shennisrefa bahen vechovrin et hakkol bichvarot vechal shachor sheefshar sheyyikkatesh veyihye efer ben mibbesarah ben min haetzim kotshin oto ad sheyyease efer vesheen bo efer mannichin oto vechal etzem shennishar meatzameha belo serefa ben kach uven kach haya nichtash

En machnisin kelum meefrah lehannicho baazara shenneemar vehinniach michutz lammachane ushlosha chalakim hau cholkin et kal efrah echad nittan bachel veechad behar hammishcha veechad mitchallek lechal hammishmarot ze shemmitchallek lechal hammishmarot hau hakkohanim mekaddeshin mimmennu veze shennittan behar hammishcha hau yisrael mazzin mimmennu veze shennittan bachel haya muchan umutzna shenneemar vehayeta laadat bene yisrael lemishmeret melammed shemmatzniin mimmennu vechen hau matzniin meefer kal para ufara shessorfin bachel vetesha parot adummot naasu mishshennitztauu bemitzva zo ad shecharav habbayit bashsheniyya rishona asa moshe rabbenu sheniyya asa ezra vesheva meezra ad churban habbayit vehaasirit yaase hammelech hammashiach mehera yiggale amen ken yehi ratzon
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 4: En shochatin shette parot adummot keachat shenneemar veshachat otah
Lo ratzta para latzet en motziin immah shechora shello yomru shechora shachatu velo adumma shello yomru shettayim shachatu

Para shennishchata shello lishmah o shekkibbel o shehizza shello lishmah o lishmah veshello lishmah o shello lishmah velishmah o shennaaset shello bechohen o bimchussar begadim o sheasaah bevigde zahav o bevigde chol pesula shechatah al menat leechol mibbesarah o lishtot middamah keshera lefi shello neemar bah reach nichoach
Kibbel damah bichli pesula shenneemar velakach elazar hakkohen middamah beetzbao mitzvatah mitzvat yad velo mitzvat keli

Hizza bichli afillu achat mehen hazzaato pesula hizza achat mehen bismolo pesula hizzu shiva kohanim hazzayatan keechad hazzayatan pesula ze achar ze keshera hizza velo kiven keneged hahechal pesula shenneemar el nochach pene ohel moed ad sheyechaven keneged hahechal veyihye roehu vechen im shechatah o serafah shello keneged hahechal pesula shenneemar veshachat otah lefanav

Bamme devarim amurim shehizza o saraf o shachat keneged haddarom o keneged tzafon o shehaya achorav lammikdash aval im amad ben mizrach umaarav ufanav keneged hahechal af al pi shello kiven keneged hahechal bedikduk keshera

Chisser achat min hammattanot pesula taval shettayim vehizza achat hazzaato pesula taval achat vehizza shettayim af al pi shello chashav hazzaa sheniyya ella taval vehizza acheret hazzayato pesula ketzad taval etzbao tevila shishshit vehizza shesh vesheva af al pi shechazar vetaval etzbao vehizza sheva hazzayato pesula hizza mittevila sheviit sheviit ushminit afillu chazar vetaval tevila sheminit vehizza sheminit keshera shekkal shemmosif al hashsheva eno kelum vehu sheyyihye ze shehosif kohen acher aval hakkohen hassoref otah im hosif pesula mippene shennitassek bedavar sheeno tzarich bishat serefatah
Hotzi et haddam chutz mimmaarachtah vehizza pesula
Hizza middamah ballayela afillu hizza shesh hazzaot bayyom veachat ballayela pesula
Shechatah chutz mimmekom serefatah afillu shechatah lefanim min hachoma pesula

Serafah chutz mimmaaracha shennishchata aleha o shechillekah lishnayim usrafah bishte maarachot o shessaraf shettayim bemaaracha achat pesula veim achar shennaaset efer mevi acheret soref al gabbah veeno choshesh

Hifshitah untachah veachar kach saraf kullah keshera veim chisser mimmenna kelum afillu mippirshah pesula paka meorah o mibbesarah afillu missearah kezayit yachzir veim lo hechzir pesula paka chutz lemaarachtah marbe alav vesorfo bimkomo paka mikkarneha mittelafeha o mippirshah eno tzarich lehachzir
Happara enah nifselet belina lefichach im nishchata hayyom vehizza damah kehilchato venisrefa lemachar keshera
Serafah onen o mechussar kappara keshera

Serafah shello bekiddush yadayim veraglayim pesula mippene shemmaaseha keen avoda vehechan mekaddesh yadav veraglav bichli sharet bifnim veim kiddesh bachutz umikkeli chol afillu bimkeda shel cheres kasher hoil vechal maaseha bachutz vechen keshemmatbilin et hakkohen hassoref achar shemmetammein oto kemo shebbearnu eno tzarich lachzor ulkaddesh hoil vechal maaseha bitvule yom

Serafah shello beetzim o bechal etzim afillu bekash o bigvava keshera umitzvatah shello yemaet lah etzim min harauy lah aval marbe hu lah chavile ezov veezov yon bizman serefa kede leharbot et haefer veyesh lo leharbot etzim bisrefatah ad shettease efer aval mishshettease efer im hosif bah afillu etz echad hare ze kimarev efer makle beefer happara

Kal maase happara mittechilla vead sof eno ella bayyom uvzichre kehunna vehammelacha poselet bah ad shettease efer aval mishshettease efer im kanas efrah ballayela o shekkenasattu ishsha o sheasa melacha acheret bishat kenisato hare zo keshera uminnayin sheasifat haefer bechal adam miyyisrael chutz mecheresh shote vekatan shenneemar veasaf ish tahor mikkelal sheenah tzericha kohen uchillu amar adam tahor ben ish ben ishsha uminnayin shehammelacha poselet bah shenneemar veshachat otah mippi hashshemua lamdu shello ba hakkatuv ella lelammed sheim nitassek bedavar acher bishat shechitatah pesalah veneemar vesaraf et happara leenav sheyyihu enav bah lelammed shehammelacha poselet bah mishsheat shechita ad shettease efer vechal haosek bisrefatah veasa melacha acheret pesalah ad shettease efer

Shachat et happara venishchata behema acheret immah o nechtecha delaat immah keshera shehare lo nitkaven limlacha af al pi shehabbehema shennishchata immah keshera laachila sheen shechitat hachullin tzericha kavana aval im nitkaven lachtoch haddelaat venechtecha bishat shechita pesula shehare asa immah melacha
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 5: Kal haoskin bappara mittechilla vead sof metammein begadim kal zeman asiyyatan shenneemar beshochet umashlich etz erez vechibbes begadav verachatz besaro veneemar besoref vehassoref otah yechabbes begadav veneemar vechibbes haosef et efer happara melammed shekkal haoskin bah mittechilla vead sof metammeim begadim utunin tevila vehaarev shemesh din tora aval hamshammerah bishat asiyyatah metamme begadim middivrehem gezera shemma yaziz bah evar

Kal makom shenneemar battora betumot yechabbes begadav lo ba lelammedenu shehabbegadim shealav bilvad hem temeim ella lelammed shekkal beged o keli sheyyigga bo hattame hazze bishat chibburo bimtammeav hare hen temeim aval achar sheyyifrosh mimmetammeav eno metamme begadim ketzad hannose et hannevela echad beged shealav o keli sheyyigga bo kal zeman shehu nosah hare hen temein vahare hen rishon letuma vechen ze hannose hare hu rishon perash mimmetammeav vehishlich et hannevela hare hu rishon kemot shehaya veim yigga bichli o beged eno metamme oto sheen velad tuma metamme kelim kemo shebbearnu bitchillat sefer ze vechen kal kayyotze binvela vechen kal haoskin bappara im naga beveged o bichli bishat shechita o bishat serefa hare hen temein aval achar sheyyifrosh mimmaaseha af al pi sheadayin lo taval im naga bichli eno metammeo mippene shehu velad hattuma vehappara atzmah enah metammea lo adam velo kelim shennagu bo ella hammitassek bah bilvad hu hattame vetaun tevila umtamme begadim kal zeman sheosek bah

Bamme devarim amurim bizman shennisrefet kemitzvatah aval im nifsela hammitassek bah tahor era pissul bishchitatah enah metammea begadim era pissul behazzayatah kal haosek bah lifne pissulah metamme begadim leachar pissulah eno metamme begadim

Hishlim lichnos et efrah hammitassek bah achar ken bechilluk heafar o behatznaato vechen hannogea bo tahor velo happara bilvad ella kal hachattaot hannisrafot min happarim umin hasseirim hassorfam metamme begadim bishat serefato ad sheyyeasu efer shehare hu omer befar vesair shel yom hakkippurim vehassoref otam yechabbes mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze binyan av lechal hannisrafim sheyehu metammein begadim ad sheyyeasu efer bamme devarim amurim beshello era lahen pissul venisrefu kemitzvatan bevet haddeshen aval im nifselu baazara nisrafin sham kifsule hammukdashin vesorfan tahor vechen hammitassek bahen mishsheyyeasu efer eno metamme begadim vee zehu soref ze hammassia bisrefa kegon hamhappech babbasar vehammashlich etzim vehamhappech baesh vehachote gechalim kede shettivar haesh vechayyotze bahen aval hammatztzit haur vehamsadder et hammaaracha tahor kach lamdu mippi hashshemua shehannose parim usirim hannisrafin lehotzian levet haddeshen lesarfan tame umtamme begadim din tora kal zeman shehu osek beholachatan vetaun tevila vehaarev shemesh kemo hamshalleach et hassair laazazel shehu metamme kal beged vechal keli sheyyigga bo bechelim shealav kal zeman shemmitassek bishlucho shenneemar vehamshalleach et hassair laazazel yechabbes begadav

Meematay metammein begadim hannosin parim usirim hannisrafim mishsheyyetzu bahen chutz lechomat haazara nesaum bemotot veyatzu miktzat hannosim chutz lechomat haazara vehaacharonim lo yatzu ellu sheyyatzu metammein begadim veellu sheadayin lo yatzu enan metammein begadim ad sheyyetzu yatzu vechazru laazara hannose otan baazara tahor ad sheyyetze bahen haya omed chutz laazara umoshech otam mishsham meachar shechazru hoil uchvar yatzu lachutz vahare ze hammoshcham bachutz hare hu sefek tame
Umeematay metamme begadim hamshalleach et hassair mishsheyyetze chutz lechomat yerushalayim ad sheat dechiyyato laazazel aval achar sheddachahu im naga bechelim uvivgadim tehorim

Hannogea befarim uvisirin hannisrafin atzman afillu achar sheyyatzu ben adam ben kelim ben ochalin ben mashkin hakkol tahor vechen im nagu bassair hammishtalleach atzmo bizman holachato tehorin sheen ellu metammein ella lammitassek bahen bilvad shenneemar vehassoref otah yechabbes begadav aval hannogea tahor
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 6: Hammayim shennotnin alav efer happara en memallein otan ella bichli umin hammayanot o min hanneharot hammoshchin shenneemar venatan alav mayim chayyim el keli untinat efer happara al hammayim shennitmalleu hu hannikra kiddush vehammayim haellu shennittan alehen haefer hen hannikrain me chattat umayim mekuddashin vehem shekkeraan hakkatuv me nidda

Hakkol kesherim lemalleot hammayim chutz mecheresh shote vekatan vehakkol kesherin lekaddesh chutz mecheresh shote vekatan veen memallein veen mekaddeshin ella bichli veen mazzin ella mikkeli vehammilluy vehakkiddush kesherin ballayela aval en mazzin veen tovlin ella bayyom vechal hayyom kasher lehazzaa velitvila

Bechal hakkelim memallein umazzin umkaddeshin afillu bichle gelalim uchle avanim uchle adama uvisfina veechad kele cheres veechad kal hakkelim aval en memallein veen mekaddeshin velo mazzin bedafnot hakkelim velo beshule hammachatz velo bimgufat hechavit velo bechafnav velo bevetzat hattarnegolet velo beshoket shebbassela aval betzat hayyotzrim keshera mippene shehi keli adama

Shule kele etz uchle zechuchit uchle etzem en mekaddeshin bahen ad sheyyashuf otan vitakkenem veyaasem kelim bifne atzman vechen megufa shehitkinah lihot keli mekaddeshin bah uvetzat hannaamit keshera lekaddesh bah veen tzarich lomar shekkeshera lemalleot bah ulhazzot mimmenna

Keli shechibbero baaretz o bassela afillu chibbero besid mekaddeshin bo umazzin mimmennu asa atara shel tit saviv lakkeli vehammayim shebbakkeli tzafin ad shehalchu laatara im nittelet haatara im hakkeli hare hammayim shebbetochah kesherim shehare hen bichli adama veim lav hare hen kemi shehikkif atara shel tit bassela o al haaretz umille otah mayim shehen pesulin mippene sheenan bichli
Keli cheres shennikkav bechones mashke en memallein umkaddeshin bo aval im nikkav bemotzi mashke mekaddeshin bo
Keli shennikkav millematta ustamo bismartutin pasul shehammayim shebbo enan al iggul hakkeli ella al happekak haya nakuv min hatztzad ufkako hare ze kasher lemalleot ulkaddesh ulhazzot mimmennu

Hazzolef mayim min hammayan beyadav uvraglav uvacharasim venatan letoch hechavit pesulin mippene shello nitmalleu bichli natan et hechavit bemayim vedachak hammayim beyadav o beraglav o baale yerakot kede sheyyaavru lechavit hare ellu pesulin vechen im shikkeo bemayim kede sheyyigberu hammayim veyaalu veyishshafchu lechavit pesulin veim asa ken baale kanim o baale egoz hare hammayim kesherim ze hakkelal davar shehu mekabbel tuma im siyyea bo hammayim kede sheyemalleu hakkeli hammayim pesulin veim siyyea bedavar sheeno mekabbel tuma kesherim
Hamfanne hammayan letoch haggat o letoch haggeve vechazar umille bichli meoto haggeve o haggat pesulim shehare tzarich shettihye lekichat hammayim min hammayan bichli battechilla
Hayyam haggadol kemikve veeno kemayan lefichach en memallein mimmennu lekiddush vechal hanneharot pesulin lekaddesh mehen me chattat ushar hayyammim kemayan
Vehammayim hannigrarin mishshear hayyammim vehen hannikrain zochalin pesulin vehazzochalin min hammayan hare hem kemayan uchsherim

Mayim hammukkin vehamchazzevin pesulin veellu hen hammukkin hammeluchim o happoshrim vehamchazzevim hem hammayanot sheppeamim mekerin ufamim charevin viveshin afillu hau charevin paam achat lesheva shanim pesulin aval im hau charevin bishne batztzoret o leshanim rabbot yeter mishsheva o shehau memehen peamim merubbin ufamim muatin veenan charevin hare ellu kesherim umayan hayyotze battechilla kasher veeno tzarich livdok shemma yechazzev

Me bitztzim ume hayyarden ume hayyarmuch pesulin mippene shehen me hattaarovot veellu hen me hattaarovot mayim kesherim lekiddush shennitarvu bemayim pesulin en memallein mittaarovet shenehem aval mayim kesherim shennitarvu bemayim kesherim kegon meme shette hammayanot shennitarvu venimshechu memallein mehen
Hammayim shennishtannu shinnuyan mechamat atzman kesherin
Beer shennafal letochah charsit o adama venaasu memeha achurin memalle mimmenna veen tzarich lehamtin nafal letochah shetef shel meme geshamim yamtin ad shettitzal

Ammat hammayim habbaa merachok hoil utchillatah min hammayan keshera lemalleot mimmenna uvilvad sheyyishmerenna shello yifsekenna adam venimtza memalle min hammayim sheppasku techillatan min hammayan shehen pesulin
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 7: Hammelacha poselet bemayim kodem sheyyitkaddeshu veenah poselet behazzaa udvarim ellu hen divre kabbala ketzad hammalle mayim lekiddush venitassek bimlacha acheret bishat hammilluy o bishat holachat hammayim shemmemalle o beet shemmeare otan mikkeli el keli pesalan leolam hammelacha poselet bemayim ad sheyyatil lahen et haefer hetil et haefer venitkaddeshu venaasu me nidda en hammelacha poselet bahen ella hammolich hammayim hammukdashin o meare otan mikkeli lichli vehu osek bimlacha acheret en bechach kelum vechen mazze mehen beyado achat vehu ose melacha beyado haacheret

Hassachar pasul bekiddush uvahazzaya veeno posel bemilluy ketzad hannotel secharo lekaddesh me chattat o lehazzot mehen hare otan hammayim keme hammeara vehaefer keefer makle sheeno kelum aval notel hu sachar lemalleot hammayim o leholichan umkaddeshin otan bechinnam umazze mehen hammazze bechinnam haya hamkaddesh o hammazze zaken sheeno yachol lehallech al raglav uva hattame uvikkesh mimmennu lahaloch immo bemakom rachok lekaddesh o lehazzot hare ze markivo al hachamor venoten secharo kefoel batel shebbatel meotah melacha shebbittelo mimmenna vechen im haya kohen vehaya tame betuma hammonato milleechol terumato beet sheyyelech immo lehazzot o lekaddesh hare ze maachilo umashkehu vesacho veim bittelo mimmelacha noten lo secharo kefoel batel shel otah melacha shekkal ellu haddevarim enan sachar shennistakker bekiddush o behazzaa shehare lo hirviach kelum velo natal ella keneged ma shehifsid

Hammalle beachat yado veose melacha beyado haacheret o hammalle lo ulacher o shemmille lishnayim keachat shenehen pesulin shehammilluy melacha venimtza kal milluy mishshenehem keillu asa immo melacha acheret uchvar hodanu shehammelacha poselet bemilluy ben shemmille leatzmo ben shemmille laacherim

Hammalle laacherim afillu mille elef chaviyyot zo achar zo leelef bene adam kullan kesherim vechal echad mehen notel hammayim shello umkaddeshan mille leatzmo chavit achar chavit im nitkaven lekabbetz kal hechaviyyot lichli echad ulhashlich alehen et haefer umkaddeshan kiddush echad kullan kesherim shehakkol milluy echad hu aval im nitkaven lekaddesh kal chavit vechavit bifne atzmah kullan pesulin chutz min haacharona sheharishona nifselet bammelacha sheasa kodem sheyekaddesh vehu milluy hashsheniyya vechen hashsheniyya nifselet bemilluy hashshelishit veen keshera ella acharona

Chamishsha shemmilleu chamesh chaviyyot lekaddesham chamishsha kiddushim kegon sheyyashlich haefer al kal achat veachat bifne atzmo venimlechu learvan ulkaddeshan kullan kiddush echad o shemmilleum lekaddeshan kiddush echad venimlechu lekaddeshan chamishsha kiddushin kullan kesherin shehare lo nitassek hammalle bemilluy acher aval hayyachid shemmille chamesh chaviyyot lekaddesham chamishsha kiddushin af al pi shechazar venimlach lekaddeshan kiddush echad en kasher ella acharon millean lekaddeshan kiddush echad venimlach lekaddeshan chamishsha kiddushin en kasher ella ze shekkiddesh battechilla vechen im amar leacher kaddesh lecha et ellu en kasher ella zo shennitkaddesha mehen battechilla aval im amar lo kaddesh li et ellu hare kullan kesherin shehare lekiddush echad millean veaf al pi shennimlach aleha lekaddeshah chamishsha kiddushin hare lo kiddesh hu ella acher kiddesh lo

Harotze lemalleot mayim lekaddeshan umayim acherim litzrachav memalle et shel tzerachav techilla vekoshran vetoanan laachorav veachar kach memalle et shel chattat kede shello yitassek bimlacha achar hammilluy venotnam lefanav veholech

Shenayim shehau memallein kal echad veechad leatzmo vehigbihu ze al ze venatal ze laze kotz miyyado o miggufo bishat milluo im milleu shenehem lekiddush echad hammayim kesherim veim milleu lekaddesh kal echad leatzmo ze shehigbiha o hotzi et hakkotz pasal memav

Hashshoel chevel lemalleot bo umille venatal hachevel beyadav umemav al ketefo ufaga babbealim bedarko venatan lahen et hachevel keshehu mehallech kesherin veim yatza min hadderech kede leholich hachevel labbealim pasal et hammayim
Mi shehaya memalle umashlich hachevel shemmille bo al haaretz veachar shemmille chazar vekibbetz al yado pesalan veim haya dole umkabbetz letoch yado hammayim kesherim

Hammalle venoten lechavit ad sheyemalleenna mayim vehitznia et hechavit shello tishshaver beshaa shehaya memalle o shekkefaah al piha al menat lenaggevah lemalleot bah kasher shezze mitztzorech hammilluy hu aval im hitzniah o niggevah kede leholich bah et hakkiddush pasal shehare asa melacha sheenah letzorech hammilluy vechen hammalle venoten leshoket ufinna charsit min hashshoket bishat milluy im bishvil shettachzik mayim rabbim kesherim shehare zo tzorech hammilluy veim bishvil shello yihu hacharasin meakkevin oto beshaa shehu zolef et hammayim shemmille bashshoket hare ellu pesulin

Hammalle deli lishtot venimlach vechishshev alav leme chattat im ad shello higgia haddeli lammayim chishshev meare veen tzarich lenaggev veim mishshehiggia haddeli lammayim chishshev meare vetzarich lenaggev veachar kach yemalle bo lechattat shilshel haddeli venifsak hachevel miyyado im ad shello higgia haddeli lammayim chishshev alav meare veen tzarich lenaggev nimlach vehu odehu betoch hammayim vechishshev alav leme chattat meare veeno tzarich lenaggev mayim shemmillean leme chattat veachar shennitmalle chishshev alehen lishtotan kesheyyatte et hakkeli lishtot pasal hammayim af al pi shello shata mehen kelum
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 8: Mi shehau memav al ketefo veamad vehora horaa laacherim o sheddan din o shechaltza befanav o meana o shehera laacherim et hadderech o sheharag et nachash o akrav o natal ochalin min hashshuk lehatzniam hare hammayim pesulin shehare nitassek bedavar acher kodem sheyyitten haefer al hammayim aval im natal haochalin leachlan vaachalan keshehu mehallech o sheharag nachash o akrav hamakkevin oto hare hammayim kesherim shezze mitztzorech holachat hammayim ze hakkelal kal davar shehu mishshum melacha sheasahu kodem mattan haefer ben amad ben lo amad pasal vedavar sheeno mishshum melacha im lo amad kesherim veim amad pasal haya mehallech bemayim ufaratz bishat hillucho makom sheyyelech bo af al pi shepparatz al menat ligdor kesherim veim gadar kodem sheyyitten haefer pesulin vechen im katza perot leechol af al pi shekkavanato lehaktzot et hashshear kesherin veim hiktza kodem mattan haefer pasul
