Haya ochel bishat holachat hammayim vehotir vezarak ma shehotir letachat hatteena o letachat hammuktze im nitkaven shello yovdu happerot hare hammayim pesulin shehare asa melacha veim zerakan lefi sheen lo tzorech bahen hare hammayim kesherin hammalle mayim lekaddeshan umsaran leacher leshamran veasu habbealim melacha lo nifselu hammayim shehare mesaran leshomer veim asa hashshomer melacha pesalan shehare hen birshuto vehu nichnas tachat habbealim hau shenayim shomrin et hammayim veasa echad mehen melacha hammayim kesherim shehare hashsheni meshammer chazar harishon lishmor veamad hashsheni veasa melacha hammayim kesherim ad sheyyaasu kal hashshomrin melacha keachat

Hamkaddesh beachat yado veasa melacha bashsheniyya im leatzmo kiddesh pasal shehare asa melacha kodem mattan efer bemayim veim lachavero kiddesh hammayim kesherim sheen ze posel memav shel chavero bammelacha sheasa sheen hammelacha poselet bekiddush ella bemayim vehu sheyyihye haose hashshomer o habbealim

Hamkaddesh leatzmo ulacher keachat shello pasul shehare nifselu hammayim shel atzmo beesek shennitassek bekiddush chavero aval im kiddesh lishnayim keachat shenehem kesherin sheen melachto poselet me acherim

Hammalle leatzmo bishte yadav keachat bekiddush echad pasul bishne kiddushim kasher kiddesh leatzmo bishte yadav keachat bekiddush echad kesherim bishne kiddushin pesulin mille vekiddesh bishte yadav keachat leatzmo shenehen pesulin mille leacher bishte yadav keachat bekiddush echad kasher bishne kiddushin pesulin kiddesh leacher bishte yadav keachat ben bekiddush echad ben bishne kiddushin shenehen kesherim mille vekiddesh bishte yadav keachat leacher hammilluy pasul vehakkiddush kasher ze hakkelal kal milluy sheasa immo melacha ben shemmille leatzmo ben shemmille leacher pasul vechal mayim shennitmalleu kehilchatan veasa melacha kodem sheyyitten et haefer im hau hammayim shello hare hen pesulin veim hau shel acher kesherin vechal davar shebbeyado veasa melacha ben sheyyesh sham shomer sheeno ose melacha ben sheen sham shomer pasul vedavar sheeno beyado veasa melacha im yesh sham shomer lo pasal im en sham shomer pasal

Haomer lachavero kaddesh li vaakaddesh lecha vekiddeshu ze laze harishon kasher vehashsheni pasul shehare kiddesh besachar amar lo malle li vaamalle lecha umilleu ze laze harishon pasul hoil vechavanato sheyemalle lo chavero chelef milluy ze hare ze kimmalle lo ulacher shehen pesulin vehashsheni kasher shehammilluy besachar muttar vahare lo asa melacha achar shemmille veen bechavanato milluy acher

Haomer lachavero kaddesh li vaamalle lecha shenehen kesherin shehammelacha enah poselet hakkiddush vehammilluy besachar muttar malle li vaakaddesh lecha shenehen pesulin ze shemmille battechilla pasul shehare hu kimmalle umkaddesh keachat ufasal hammayim bammelacha veze shekkiddesh baacharona pasul shehare kiddesh besachar uchillu hechzir chov shealav

Haholech lekaddesh hare ze notel et hammafteach ufoteach lehotzi haefer venotel kardom im tzarich lachpor bo efer happara venotel sullam umolich mimmakom lemakom lehavi haefer vechasher veim mishshennatal haefer lekaddesh bo kissa hakkeli shehaya bo haefer o shehegif et haddalet o shezzakaf et hakkeli baaretz kodem sheyyashlich haefer lammayim pasal hammayim aval haefer kasher lekaddesh bo mayim acherim zakaf et hakkeli sheyyesh bo haefer beyado kede shello yitpazzer kesherim mippene shei efshar shehare im hinnicho baaretz pasal veim kissahu pasal natal et haefer veraa shehu merubbe vehechzir mimmennu kasher natan haefer al hammayim veraa shehu merubbe venatal mimmennu lekaddesh mayim acherim kasher kirsem ale zayit lachtot bo haefer im bishvil shello yachazik efer harbe pasal veim bishvil sheyyikkanes haefer bakkeli kasher
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 9: Ketzad mekaddeshin et hammayim beefer happara noten et hammayim shennitmalleu leshem me chattat bakkeli venoten efer al pene hammayim kede sheyyerae al pene hammayim af al pi shehi chavit gedola melea mayim umarev hakkol veim natan haefer techilla veachar kach natan alav hammayim pasal umahu ze shenneemar battora venatan alav mayim chayyim kede learev et haefer bammayim

Hamkaddesh tzarich sheyyitkaven veyitten haefer beyado al hammayim shenneemar velakchu lattame ad sheyyihye mitkaven lekiddush ulmilluy ulhazzaya aval im nafal haefer min hakkeli sheyyesh bo haefer letoch hammayim o shennatal haefer beyado udchafo chavero o haruach venafal haefer miyyado al hammayim o shennafal haefer miyyado al tzad hakkeli o al yado veachar kach nafal lammayim hare ze pasul

Kiddesh pachot mikkede hazzaa bichli ze ufachot mikkede hazzaa bichli acher lo nitkaddeshu haya haefer tzaf al pene hammayim vechanas mimmennu millemala vekiddesh bo mayim acherim hare ellu mekuddashin vechal shennaga bammayim en mekaddeshin bo paam sheniyya veaf al pi shenniggevo vaafillu nashva haruach venatna et haefer al gabbe hammayim eno menaggevo umkaddesh bo

Keli katan shehaya betoch keli gadol vehen melein mayim vehammayim meoravin kevan shennatan haefer bammayim shebbakkeli haggadol nitkaddeshu kal hammayim shebbetoch hakkeli hakkatan veaf al pi shehaya piv tzar beoter velo nichnas lo efer shehare hammayim kullan meoravin

Haya sefog betoch hammayim beet shennatan haefer hare hammayim shebbassefog pesulin mippene sheenan bakkeli ketzad yaase zolef et kal hammayim ad shemmaggia lassefog velo yigga bassefog veim naga bassefog af al pi shehammayim tzafin al gabbav kal shehen pesulin mippene shehammayim shebbassefog yotzin umitarvin bammayim hakkesherin nafal sefog letoch hammayim hamkuddashin notlo vesochato chutz lakkeli vehammayim shebbakkeli kesherin

Shette shekatot shebbeeven achat shennatan et haefer letoch achat mehen en hammayim shebbashsheniyya mekuddashin veim hau nekuvot zo lezo kishfoferet hannod o shehau hammayim tzafin al gabbehen afillu kiklippat hashshum venatan efer leachat mehen hare hammayim shebbashsheniyya mekuddashin

Shette avanim shehikkifan zo lezo vaasaan shoket vechen shette arevot vechen shoket shennechleka venatan efer bechelek echad mehen hammayim shebbenehen enan mekuddashin veim chibberan besid o begafsis vehem yecholot lehinnatel keachat hammayim shebbenehen mekuddashin

Mayim mekuddashin shennitarvu bahen mayim acherim kal shehu afillu mayim shennitmalleu lekiddush hare ellu pesulin vechen im yarad letochan tal hare ellu pesulin nafal letochan mashkin ume perot yeare hakkol vetzarich lenaggev hakkeli veachar ken yitten letocho mayim mekuddashin acherim nafal letochan deo komos vekankantom vechal davar shehu roshem yeare veen tzarich lenaggev sheim yishshaer sham davar haroshem hare hu nire

Hammatbil keli lechattat bemayim sheenan reuyin lekaddesh tzarich lenaggev veachar kach yekaddesh bo hitbilo bemayim haruyin lekaddesh eno tzarich lenaggev veim hitbilo leesof bo mayim mekuddashin ben kach uven kach tzarich lenaggev

Keruya shehitbilah bemayim haruyin lekaddesh mekaddeshin bah aval en osfin letochah me chattat mippene shehammayim shehutbela bahen nivlaim betochah veotzin umitarvin beme chattat ufoslin otan nitmet vehitbiluha en mekaddeshin bah shehammashkin hattemein hannivlain begufah yetzu veyitarvu bammayim shemmekaddeshin otan betochah

Mayim mekuddashin shennafal letochan shekatzim urmasim venitbakkeu o shennishtannu marehen pesulin afilu hau yeveshim beoter kegon hannemala veharira vehakkinna shebbattevua natan letochah chippushin af al pi shello nitbakkeu velo nishtannu marehen hare hammayim pesulin mippene shehi kishfoferet vehammayim nichnasin betochah veotzin mittochah im hallecha shebbah

Mayim mekuddashin sheshshata mehen behema o chayya pesulin vechen kal haofot pesulin chutz min hayyona mippene shehi motzetzet veen rir yotze mippiha umitarev bammayim vechen kal hashsheratzim sheshshatu enan poslin chutz min hachulda mippene shehi melakkeket bilshonah venimtzet hallecha yotza mippiha lammayim
Me chattat shennishtannu marehen mechamat atzman kesherim nishtannu mechamat ashan pesulin higlidu vechazru venimmochu kesherim afillu nimmochu bachamma aval im himchan baur pesulin
Efer chattat shennishtannu marav mechamat atzmo o mechamat ashan kasher nishtannu mechamat avak o shennafal letocho sid o gafsis o shennitarev bo efer makle kal shehu hare ze pasul
Hachoshev al me chattat lishtotan lo pesalan ad sheyyishte mehen veim shafach min hakkeli letoch gerono velo naga sefato bammayim shebbakkeli lo pasal

Keli sheyyesh bo mayim mekuddashin shehinnicho megulle uva umtzao mechusse hare ellu pesulin shemma adam sheeno tahor lechattat naga bahen shehare adam kissahu bevadday hinnicho mechusse uva umtzao megulle im yechola hachulda lishtot mimmennu o sheyyarad lo tal ballayela pesulin veim lav kesherin mippene sheyyesh kan shette sefekot safek adam gilla o behema chayya varemes veim timtze lomar adam gillahu shemma haya tahor lechattat o lo
Hammoser mayim mekuddashin o mayim shennitmalleu lekiddush letame leshamran hare ellu pesulin

Shenayim shehau shomrin et hammayim venitma echad mehen kesherim mippene shehen birshuto shel sheni tahar vechazar lishmor venitma hashsheni kesherim mippene shehen birshuto shel rishon nitmeu shenehen keachat hammayim pesulin
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 10: Hammale mayim lekiddush eno tzarich sheyyihye hu atzmo hamkaddesh vehammazze ella mekaddesh echad umazze echad vechen memalle adam bichli umare mikkeli lichli umkaddesh bichli acher umare hammayim hamkuddashin mikkeli lichli umazze mikkeli acher

Memalle adam mayim umannichan etzlo belo kiddush kal zeman sheyyirtze veen bechach kelum umolichan mimmakom lemakom umeir leir venoten alehen efer umkaddeshan bechal et sheyyirtze vechen hammayim hamkuddashin mannichan adam etzlo yamim veshanim umazze mehen bechal yom shehu tzarich ad sheyyittammu umolichan mimmakom lemakom umeir leir umshammer adam efer para etzlo umolichah mimmakom lemakom umeir leir paam achat holichu keli shehaya bo me chattat bisfina bayyarden venimtza kezayit min hammet bekarka hassefina venitmeu hammayim beotah shaa gazru bet din haggadol sheen maavirin me chattat velo efer chattat benahar uvisfina velo yeshitem al pene hammayim velo yaamod betzad hannahar mikkan veyizrekem latztzad hashsheni aval over hu adam bemayim ad tzavaro uvyado efer para o mayim mekuddashin vechen adam vechelim harekanim shehen tehorin lechattat umayim shennitmalleu lechattat vaadayin lo nitkaddeshu maavirin otam benahar bisfina
Maavirin mayim mekuddashin bisfina bayyam haggadol veshatin bahem al pene hammayim shello gazru ella al hammayim hamkuddashin veal haefer benahar

Hammolich mayim lekaddeshan veen tzarich lomar mayim shennitkaddeshu lo yafshil hakkeli laachorav ella lefanav shenneemar lemishmeret leme nidda bizman shehen shemurin hen me nidda veim lav pesulin mille shette chaviyyot noten achat lefanav veachat laachorav mippene shei efshar

Me chattat sheshshekalan bemishkal im hissiach dato pesulin veim lav kesherin aval im shakal devarim acherim beme chattat hoil vaasaan mishkolet pesalan sheen zo mishmeret kal ellu hattehorim shemmemallein o shemmekaddeshin o shemmazzin vechen kal hakkelim shemmemallein umkaddeshin mehem veshemmazzin mehen im hau tevule yom af al pi shello heeriv shimshan hare ellu kesherim shekkal maase happara vehammilluy vehakkiddush vehahazzaya kasher bitvul yom kemo shebbearnu umippene hatztzedokin metammein et kal kele shetef umatbilin otan veachar kach mishtammeshin bahen beme chattat

Hakkol kesherin lehazzot chutz meishsha vetumtum veanderoginus vecheresh shote vekatan sheen bo daat aval katan sheyyesh bo daat kasher lehazzot vehearel kasher lehazzot sheen hearel tame katan sheyyesh bo daat shehizza vehaishsha mesaaddato kegon sheachaza lo hammayim beyado hazzaato keshera uvilvad shello teechoz beyado bishat hazzaa veim achaza beyado bishat hazzayato pesula

Hammazze tzarich lechaven ulhazzot al hattame letaharo veim hizza shello bechavana hazzaato pesula aval ze shemmazzin alav eno tzarich kavana ella mazzin al haadam ledato veshello ledato hammitkaven lehazzot lefanav vehizza laachorav laachorav vehizza lefanav hazzayato pesula nitkaven lehazzot lefanav vehizza latztzedadin shel panav hazzayato keshera

Hammazze eno tzarich tevila lechal hazzaya ella tovel et haezov umazze hazzaya achar hazzaya ad sheyyiggamru hammayim umazze hazzaya achat al kamma bene adam o al kamma kelim keachat afillu mea kal shennaga bo min hammayim kal shehu tahor vehu sheyyitkaven hammazze lehazzot alav taval et haezov venitkaven lehazzot al davar shemmekabbel tuma o al haadam vehizza meotah tevila al davar sheeno mekabbel tuma o al habbehema im nisharu mayim baezov eno tzarich lachzor ulhatbil ella mazze min hashshear al haadam o al hakkelim hattemeim shehare techillat tevilato keshera hayeta aval im taval et haezov lehazzot al davar sheeno mekabbel tuma o al habbehema vehizza al haadam o al hakkeli hattame hazzayato pesula ad sheyyachzor veyitbol paam sheniyya veyitkaven lehazzot al haadam o al davar hamkabbel tuma

Hitbil et haezov venitkaven lehazzot al davar sheeno mekabbel tuma hammayim hamnattefim kesherin lefichach im natfu bichli vechazar vehitbil bahen et haezov bechavana lehazzot al davar hamkabbel tuma hazzayato keshera

Me chattat shennitmaatu tovel bahen afillu rashe givolin umazze uvilvad shello yesappeg tzelochit sheppiha tzar tovel umaale kedarko umazze veeno tzarich lehizzaher shemma yigga betzidde hakkeli befaam sheniyya
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 11: Ketzad metaharim teme met beme nidda lokeach adam tahor shelosha kelachin shel ezov veogdan aguda achat uvchal bad uvad givol echad vetovel rashe givolin beme nidda shebbakkeli umitkaven umazze al haadam o al hakkelim bayyom hashshelishi uvayyom hashshevii achar shettanetz hachamma veim hizza mishsheala ammud hashshachar kasher veachar sheyyazze alav bayyom hashshevii tovel bayyom umaariv shimsho vahare hu tahor laerev taval et haezov ballayela vehizza bayyom o shettaval et haezov bayyom vehizza ballayela hazzaato pesula vehammayim metammein mishshum me chattat kemo sheyyitbaer ad shettihye tevilat haezov bammayim vehazzaato mimmennu bayyom hashshelishi uvayyom hashshevii achar shettanetz hachamma veim avar veasa mishsheala ammud hashshachar kasher kemo shebbearnu

Mi shennitma bemet veshaha kamma yamim belo hazzaa kesheyyavo lehazzot mone befanenu shelosha yamim umazzin alav bashshelishi uvashshevii vetovel bashshevii umaariv shimsho bamme devarim amurim beam haaretz shebba lehazzot sheafillu amar hayyom shelishi shelli eno neeman shemma hayyom nitma lefichach tzarich limnot befanenu aval chaver shebba lehazzot mazzin alav o al kelav miyyad mi shehuzza alav bashshelishi velo huzza alav bashshevii veshaha kamma yamim tovel bechal et sheyyirtze achar hashshevii ben bayyom ben ballayela umazzin alav bayyom ben kodem tevila ben achar tevila afillu taval belel teshii o belel asiri mazzin alav lemachar achar hanetz hachamma

Kal hamtammein mekabbelin hazzaa ketzad zavim vezavot niddot veoldot shennitmeu bemet mazzin alehen bashshelishi ushvii vahare hem tehorin mittumat met af al pi shehen temein tuma acheret shenneemar vehizza hattahor al hattame bayyom hashshelishi ha lamadta shehazzaya moelet lo af al pi shehu tame vechen hearel mekabbel hazzaa ketzad arel shennitma bemet vehizza alav shelishi ushvii hare ze tahor mittumat met uchsheyyamul tovel veochel bekadashim laerev

Mitzvat ezov shelosha kelachin vechal kelach vekelach givol echad nimtzeu shelosha givolin ushyarav shenayim o im lakach shenayim battechilla vaagadan kasher nitpardu haggivolin venashru healin afillu lo nishar mikkal givol mehem ella kal shehu kasher sheshsheyare haezov bechal shehu kelach sheyyesh bo shelosha baddin mefasseko veachar kach oged shelashtan shemmitzvato lihot agudda af al pi shello nitparesh battora sheyyihye agudda pesako velo agado o sheagado velo pesako o shello pesako velo agado vehizza bo kasher haezov hakkatzar ogdo bechut al hakkush vechayyotze bo vetovel bemayim umaale veochez baezov umazze nistappek lo im min hachut hizza o min hakkush o min haggivol hazzaato pesula

En mazzin lo beonkot haezov velo battemarot ella baggivolin ellu hen hayyonkot givolin shello gamlu umi shehuzza alav beonkot venichnas lammikdash patur umeematay mazzin baezov mishsheyyanetz veezov shehuzza bo me nidda kasher letaher bo et hamtzora kal ezov sheyyesh lo shem levay pasul vehaezov shekkorin oto ezov beyichud hu hakkasher vehu haezov sheochlin oto baale battim aval ze shekkorin oto ezov yon veezov kachlit veezov midbari pasul
Ezov shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat veshel avoda zara veshel teruma temea pesula shel teruma tehora lo yazze veim hizza kasher

Ezov shellikketo leetzim venaflu alav mashkin menaggevo vehu kasher lehazzaya likketo laochalin venaflu alav mashkin af al pi shenniggevo pasul shehare nitma lehazzaya shekkal hammashkin vechal haochalin vechal hakkelim hare hen kitmeim leinyan chattat kemo shebbearnu likketo lechattat hare ze kenilkat leetzim veim naflu alav mashkin menaggevo umazze bo
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 12: Adam shennitma bemet vehizza alav kevan shennaga kal shehu mimme hannidda bechal makom meor besaro shel tame alta lo hazzaya afillu nafla hahazzaa al rosh etzbao o al rosh sefato aval im naga bilshono enah kelum af al pi shehallashon keevarim shebbegaluy leinyan tuma kemo shebbearnu enan keevarim shebbegaluy leinyan hazzaa utvila vechen keli shennitma bemet vehizza alav kevan shehiggia legufo shel keli kal shehu mimme hannidda alta lo hazzaa

Shene kelim o shene bene adam shennitkaven lehazzot al shenehen keachat vehizza al echad mehen venatfu hammayim meal harishon al hashsheni hare hashsheni betumato ad sheyyippelu alav hammayim mehazzayat hammazze lo min hattamtzit hizza al shene kelim venistappek lo im hizza al shenehen keachad o mechavero nimtza alav hazzayato pesula
Machat shennetuna al hacheres vehizza aleha safek al hammachat hizza safek min hacheres nimtza aleha hazzayato pesula

Kelim hamfutztzalin shemmechubbarin ze laze bemasmerim kegon misporet shel perakim veizmel shel rehitni vechayyotze bahen bishat melacha chibbur letuma ulhazzaya shello bishat melacha eno chibbur lo laze velo laze ketzad hen chibbur letuma ulhazzaya sheim nitma echad mehen bishat melacha nitma hashsheni veim hizza al echad mehen bishat melacha alta hazzaya lishnehen uchillu hen guf echad vechetzad eno chibbur lo letuma velo lehazzaya sheim nitma echad mehen shello bishat melacha lo nitma chavero veim nitmeu shenehen vehizza al echad mehen shello bishat melacha lo tiher chavero af al pi shehen mechubbarin vezehu din tora aval middivre sofrim gazru sheyyihu chibbur letuma afillu shello bishat melacha gezera mishshum sheat melacha ulolam im naga beechad mehen tuma nitma chavero vechen gazru alehen shello yihu chibbur lehazzaya afillu bishat melacha gezera mishshum shello bishat melacha ulolam im hizza al echad mehen lo tiher chavero ad sheyyazze gam alav hinne lamadta shekkal makom shaatta shomea chibbur letuma veeno chibbur lehazzaya en ze ella gezera middivrehem al hadderech shebbearnu
Shene kelim shechibberan ad shennaasu keguf echad kegon shettafar shene begadim o shette yeriot hare ellu chibbur letuma ulhazzaa mippene shehen kichli echad

Shelal hakkovsin vehabbeged shehu tafur bechilayim vehen omdin lehattiran eno chibbur lehazzaya vahare hen chibbur letuma vechen hasselaim shebbakkantal vehammitta shel tarbal vekeren shel keliva vekarnayim shel yotze derachim veshalshelet hammaftechot chibbur letuma velo lehazzaa ella tzarich sheyyiggeu hammayim min hammazze bechal sal vesal uvchal mafteach umafteach uvchal keren vekeren uvchal kora vekora mimmitta zo hamfutztzelet

Hamchabber shalosh kesatot shel tzemer veshesh shel pishtan o shelosha sedinim o shettem esre mitpachot hare ellu chibbur letuma ulhazzaa yeter mikkan chibbur letuma velo lehazzaa chaluk echad vetallit achat ukluvkarin echad hare hen chibbur letuma ulhazzaya afillu hau arukkin beoter o rechavin beoter kal shehen vee zehu keluvkarin ze shene begadim shemmannichin tzemer gefen benehen vetofrin otan keachat veosin mehen chaluk limot haggeshamim
Kissuy hammecham shemmechubbar beshalshelet hizza al hammecham tiher hakkol hizza al hakkissuy lo tiher hammecham ad sheyyazze alav
Hazzog vehainbal chibbur letuma ulhazzaa veim hizza al echad mehen tiharu shenehen

Hatteviy shettovim bo happishtim o shozrin bo hachavalim shelosha gufin yesh bo haetz shemmelappefin alav hattauyi vehu hannikra kush vehannechoshet o habbarzel shebberosh haetz vehu hannikra tzinnora shebbah potlin vetovin veharechayim shebbeemtza hakkush vehi hannikret pika hakkush sheppotlin bo hachavalim shennitma lo yazze al happika shello velo al hakkush ella al hatztzinnora veim hizza al echad mishshelashtan tiher hakkol veshel pishtan mazze al echad mishshelashtan lechattechilla sheshshelashtan chibbur
Or shel arisa shehu mechubbar lefikot chibbur letuma ulhazzaa hammalben shel mittot eno chibbur lo letuma velo lehazzaa

Kal yedot hakkelim hakkeduchot kegon nitztzav hassakkin vechayyotze bo shehannitztzav nakuv vehabbarzel nichnas bo chibbur letuma ulhazzaa aval hayyadot hacharukot kegon etz hachanit shehaetz nichnas babbarzel eno chibbur lehazzaa
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 13: Maalot yeterot asu betahorat hachattat shehaadam hattahor afillu taval lekodesh veomed umshammesh al gabbe hammizbeach eno tahor lechattat velo lisrefat happara velo lemilluy hammayim velo lekaddeshan velo lehazzot ad sheyyitbol leshem chattat veachar kach yihye tahor lechattat vechen hakkelim afillu mizrak shebbaazara eno tahor lechattat ad sheyyatbiluhu leshem chattat vechen kal haochalin vechal hammashkin af al pi shehen tehorin hare hen leinyan chattat kaochalin umashkin hamtammein

Kal keli harauy lemishkav o lemoshav af al pi shehu tahor legabbe hakkodesh hare hu legabbe chattat kemidras hazzav ad sheyyatbiluhu leshem chattat yochanan ben gudgeda haya ochel betahorat hakkodesh kal yamav vehaya mitpachto kemidras hazzav leinyan hachattat

Kal velad hattumot af al pi sheeno metamme adam velo chelim afillu lekodesh kemo shebbearnu hare hu metamme adam vechelim lechattat lefichach amru hamkaddesh et me chattat lo yinol et hassandal shemma yippelu mashkin al hassandal venimtza hassandal tame shekkal hammashkin temein hen ligobbe hchottat vititomme ze hamkaddesh bingiato besandal venimtzeu me chattat temeim

Mi shennitmeu yadav bilvad baddevarim hamtammein et hayyadayim kegon shennaga baochalin o bemashkin vechayyotze bahen af al pi shehu tahor lakkodesh veeno tzarich ella tevilat yadav bilvad kemo sheyyitbaer hare nitma kal gufo leinyan hachattat vetzarich tevila afillu lo nitmet ella yado achat nitma kullo vahare hu rishon letuma

Kal hattaun tevila ben min hattora ben middivrehem metamme et me chattat veet efer hachattat veet hammazze me chattat bemagga uvmassa vechen metamme et haezov hammuchshar veet hammayim shennitmalleu vaadayin lo nitkaddeshu veet hakkeli harekan hattahor lechattat metamme kal echad meellu bemagga aval lo bemassa vetame shennaga bemiktzat efer chattat pasal et kullo

En monin lechattat rishon vesheni ushlishi kederech shemmonin litruma ulkodesh ketzad asara shettavlu leshem chattat venitma echad mehen afillu lo nitma ella legabbe chattat bilvad kegon shennitmet yado bilvad venaga bachavero vachavero bachavero afillu hen mea kullan temein lechattat vechen chelim hattehorim lechattat shennitma keli mehen afillu lo nitmeu ella achorav bilvad legabbe chattat kegon shennagu mashkin baachorav venaga keli ze bichli sheni vesheni bishlishi nitmeu hakkelim kullan legabbe hachattat vaafillu hen mea

Kal harauy lehittamme bemidras hazzav af al pi shehu tahor lekodesh im henido hattahor lechattat nitma af al pi shello naga bo vechen hattahor lechattat shehenid et haadam sheeno tahor lechattat o shehenid et rukko o et meme raglav shel adam ze nitma af al pi shello naga bo aval keli sheeno rauy lemidras eno metamme et hattahor lechattat ella im ken naga bo

Keli hattame bitme met im henido hattahor lechattat nitma veaf al pi shello naga bo veaf al pi sheen teme met metamme bemassa kemo shebbearnu ketzad mafteach shehu teme met shehaya taluy baddelet vesagar hattahor lechattat et haddelet hoil vehenid et hammafteach hattame nitma vechen im hesit et hashsheretz veet shichvat zera hare ze tame lechattat af al pi sheen ellu metammein bemassa kemo sheyyitbaer

Hattahor lechattat shennaga bechelim shehau lemala min hazzav vechayyotze bo vehen hannikrain maddaf af al pi shehu tahor lekodesh nitma lechattat vechen keli hattahor lechattat shennaga bemaddaf nitma lechattat

Hattahor lechattat shennaga baochalin umashkin ben tehorin ben temeim shekkal ochalin umashkin legabbe chattat enan tehorin im naga bahen beyado nitma kal gufo kemo shebbearnu naga bahen beraglo o bishar gufo o shehesitan beyado velo naga bahen tahor vechen im naga betannur vechayyotze bo mishar kelim sheenam tehorin lechattat nitma kullo aval im naga beraglo bahen hare hu tahor lechattat kemo shehaya
Hattahor lechattat shehichnis rosho verubbo letoch mayim shennitmalleu lechattat nitma mippene shehen sheuvin umiddivre sofrim shehabba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvin nitma kemo sheyyitbaer

Hakkol neemanin al tahorat hachattat vaafillu amme haaretz mippene chumratah umaalot ellu sheasu bah hakkol nizharin bah vahare neemar battora vehayeta laadat bene yisrael lemishmeret kal yisrael reuyin lishmira lefichach am haaretz shehevi keli mibbeto afillu keli cheres veamar keli ze tahor lechattat hare ze tahor umkaddeshin bo umazzin mimmennu veaf al pi sheoto keli tame lekodesh velitruma vechen am haaretz sheamar tahor ani lechattat o shehau me chattat etzlo veamar tehorin hen neeman sheen adam miyyisrael mezalzel bah
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 14: Keli cheres shehaya bo efor chattat venaga bo sheretz mitztziddo tahor sheen keli cheres mittamme miggabbo afillu legabbe chattat hinniach hakkeli al gabbe hashsheretz af al pi shello nitma hakkeli hare haefer tame shenneemar vehinniach michutz lammachane bemakom tahor veen ze makom tahor velo al gabbe hashsheretz bilvad ella afillu hinnicho al gabbe ochel sheni vechayyotze bo middevarim shettumatan tuma kalla vehem middivre sofrim hare nitma haefer shenneemar bemakom tahor shello yihye al gabbe shum tuma baolam vechen keli cheres shehaya bo efer chattat venatun al arubba shebbabbayit tame im haya hakkeli meshulshal labbayit nitma haefer veaf al pi sheen baarubba poteach tefach veim lo haya meshulshal im haya baarubba poteach tefach tame
Haya hakkeli shel even ben sheyyesh bah poteach tefach ben sheen bah haefer tahor

Vechen keli sheyyesh bo efer o mayim mekuddashim umukkaf tzamid patil venatun beohel hammet hare haefer vehammayim temeim sheen efer hachattat nitztzelet betzamid patil shenneemar bemakom tahor veen ze makom tahor

Vechen ochalin umashkin shel kodesh enan nitztzalin betzamid patil aval mayim sheenan mekuddashin uchli rekan hattahor lechattat nitztzal betzamid patil bamme devarim amurim keshehau habbealim tehorim aval im nitmeu habbealim nifselu hammayim bechal makom shehen ketzad hau memav mukkafin tzamid patil vehu vehem beohel hammet shenehen temeim haya hu mibbachutz vehammayim sheenan mekuddashin mibbifnim shenehen tehorin hu bifnim vehammayim bachutz keshem shehu tame kach memav pesulin

Hattahor lechattat shehaya omed al gabbe hattannur vechayyotze bo mikkelim sheenam tehorim lechattat ufashat yado chutz lattannur uchli sheyyesh bo me chattat beyado vechen kane hammuttal al gabbe hattannur ushne kelim sheyyesh bahen me chattat teluyin bo echad mikkan veachad mikkan hare ellu temein lefi sheenan bemakom hattahor lechattat vehoil vehem nishanin al hattannur hare hen keillu munnachin al gabbav aval im haya omed al hattannur uvyado keli rekan hattahor lechattat o mayim sheenan mekuddashin hare ellu tehorin kemot shehau haya omed chutz lattannur ufashat yado lachallon venatal keli sheyyesh bo chattat veheeviro al gabbe hattannur hare ze tahor vechen hazzaya sheavra al gabbe tuma kegon mishkav umoshav vechayyotze bahen hare zo tehora

Keli sheyyesh bo me chattat uchli sheyyesh bo kodesh shennagu ze baze hare nitma keli shel chattat vechal sheyyesh bo aval keli hakkodesh tahor keshehaya vechen im naga hattahor lachattat bishnehen bishte yadav keshehen munnachin al haaretz hare nitma shel chattat shehare hattahor lechattat nitma bingiat hakkeli sheeno tahor lechattat kemo shebbearnu vechazar vetimme et me chattat

Higbiha shene hakkelim bishte yadav shenehen temein ze shel chattat nitma mippene shennaga bo adam shennaga bichli sheeno tahor lechattat veshel kodesh nitma mippene ze shehigbiho vehu tame binsiat me nidda shehen metammein bemassa mippene shennitmeu mechamat hakkeli shel kodesh lefichach im haya hakkeli shel kodesh karuch binyar vehigbiha banneyar velo naga bo vehigbiha hachattat beyado sheniyya shenehen tehorin shehare lo naga bakkeli velo nitma lechattat aval im haya nogea bichli hakkodesh beyado afillu haya shel chattat binyar shenehem temein
Hesit et shene hakkelim beyado velo naga bahen shenehen tehorin sheen hakkeli sheeno tahor lechattat metamme et hattahor lechattat ad sheyyaga bo beyado ella im ken haya rauy lemidras kemo shebbearnu

Kal sefek hattumot shehu tahor legabbe teruma kemo sheyyitbaer hare hu tahor lechattat vechal hassefekot shettolin bahen et hatteruma im noldu bechattat hare ellu nishpachin veim naasu tahorot al gabbe otan kelim veadam shennoldu lahen sefekot ellu shehachattaot nishpachin alehen hare otan hattahorot teluot veharfafot enan kechelim vahare hen tehorot litruma ulkodesh ulchattat

Devela shel teruma shennafla letoch me chattat untalah vaachalah im yesh bah kevetza hammayim temein ben shehayeta haddevela temea ben shehayeta tehora shekkal haochalin afillu ochel kodesh eno tahor lechattat vehaochlah chayyav mita mippene sheachal teruma temea veim en bah kevetza hammayim betahoratan sheen haochel metamme acherim ad sheyyihye bo kevetza ben litruma ben lekodesh ben lechattat
Mishneh Torah, Red Heifer 15: Hannogea beme chattat shello letzorech hazzaa ben adam ben kelim tame veeno metamme begadim bishat maggao shenneemar vehannogea beme hannidda yitma ad haarev hinne lamadta shemme hannidda av meavot hattumot shel tora vetumat maggaan bechal shehu veim haya bahen kede hazzaa metammein bemagga uvmassa vehannogea bahen o shennosan shello letzorech metamme begadim bishat maggao o bishat massao ad sheyyifrosh mimmetammeav shenneemar umazze me hannidda yechabbes begadav eno medabber bemazze al hattame im tiher et hattame kal vachomer sheyyihye hu tahor mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar battora umazze me hannidda lo neemar ella leshiur shehannogea o hannose me nidda sheyyesh bahen kede hazzaya shello letzorech hazzaa tame umtamme begadim din tora vechamma hu shiur hazzaa kede sheyyitbol rashe givolin shel ezov bemayim bamme devarim amurim shemme chattat metammein bizman shennaga bahen o nesaan shello letzorech kodem sheyyaasu mitzvatan aval achar sheasu mitzvatan enan metammein kelal ketzad hare shettaval et haezov vehizza al haadam hattame o al hakkelim vehau hammayim shottin veordin meal hattame laaretz vechen hammayim hannittazin bishat hazzaa al haaretz o al hattahor hare otan hammayim tehorim vehannogea bahen vehannosan tahor hitbil et haezov lehazzot al davar sheeno mekabbel tuma hare hammayim hamnattefin kesherin lehazzot mehen kemo shebbearnu lefichach metammein tumat me chattat lefi shello asu mitzvatan shehare hattevila hayeta leshem davar sheeno mekabbel tuma

En me chattat metammein et hakkol kodem sheyyaasu mitzvatan ad sheyyihu tehorin uchsherin lehazzaa aval me chattat shennifselu kegon shennitarev bahen mayim o sheshshatta mehen behema vechayyotze bahen meellu haddevarim happoslin otan im naga bahen hattahor litruma nitma ben shennaga beyadav ben shennaga bishar gufo naga bahen adam hattahor lechattat vaafillu beyadav hare hu tahor kemot shehau
Me chattat shennitmeu venaga bahen achar shennitmeu adam hattahor litruma ben beyadav ben begufo nitma veim naga bahen hattahor lechattat beyadav nitma naga bishar gufo hare hu tahor kemot shehaya

Me chattat shennaflu letochan me mayan o me mikve o me perot im rov me chattat metammein bemassa veim rov me perot en metammein mechetza lemechetza metammein efer para shennitarev beefer makle vekiddesh bechullan im haya harov efer para metammein beme nidda veim haya harov efer makle en metammein bemagga aval metammein bemassa
Efer kasher shennetano al gabbe hammayim sheenan reuyin lekaddeshan venaga bahen hattahor litruma ben beyadav ben begufo nitma naga bahen hattahor lechattat afillu beyadav hare ze tahor kemot shehaya
Me chattat shennifselu lo yegabbelem betit shello yaasem takkala laacherim shemma yigga battit vitamme shemme chattat enam betelin betit shenneemar chattat hi

Para sheshshatat me chattat af al pi shennishchata betoch shaot besarah tahor shenneemar lemishmeret leme nidda bizman shehen shemurin enan betelin aval bizman sheshshetaatan para batlu shehare enam shemurin

Hammazze mechallon shemmazzin mimmennu al harabbim vehuzza alav venichnas lammikdash veachar kach nimtzeu hammayim pesulin hare ze patur shechezkat hammayim shemmazzin mehen al harabbim shehen kesherin vahare ze keanus aval im huzza alav mechallon shel yachid venichnas lammikdash venimtzeu hammayim pesulin chayyav bekarban ole veored mippene shehaya lo livdok al hammayim veachar kach yikkanes lammikdash machalikim hau haam bammayim sheshshottim baaretz mechallon shel rabbim vedorsim otan venichnasim lammikdash velo hau choshshin lahen shemma pesulin hen

Hammazze beezov hattame lechattat im yesh bo kevetza hammayim pesulin vehazzayato pesula en bo kevetza hammayim kesherim vehazzaato pesula veezov ze metamme chavero vachavero lachavero afillu hen mea sheen monin lechattat
Hammagbiha keli shehuzza alav vahare alav hammayim kede hazzaa tahor shehammayim sheasu mitzvatan enan metammein kemo shebbearnu berich rachamana desayean
Mishneh Torah, Those Who Defile Bed or S: Hazzav vehazzava vehannidda vehayyoledet kal echad mearbatan av meavot hattumot metammein kelim bemagga umtamme adam bemagga uvmassa umtamme mishkav umoshav umerkav mittachtav veose otan av tuma umtamme maddaf al gabbo
Echad zava ketanna veechad zava gedola veechad zava mechamat atzmah o mechamat ones veechad zav baal shette reiot o baal shalosh tumat kullan shava letamme acherim
Ketanna bat yom echad mittammea benidda bat asara yamim beziva bat shalosh shanim veom echad metammea et boalah kemo sheyyitbaer
Katan ben yom echad mittamme beziva veechad gerim vaavadim veechad yisrael mittammein benidda uvziva
Seris adam seris chamma mittammein beziva kishar habberiin
En haishsha mittammea beloven velo haish beodem ella haishsha beodem vehaish beloven

Tumtum veanderoginus notnin alehem chumre haish vechumre haishsha mittammein beloven keish uvodem keishsha vetumatan besafek lefichach en sorfin alehen teruma vekadashim veen chayyavin alehen al tumat mikdash vekadashav raa loven veodem keachad sorfin alehen et hatteruma veet hakkadashim aval en chayyavin alehen al biat mikdash vekadashav shenneemar mizzachar ad nekeva teshallechu ad sheyyihye hattuma tumat zachar vadday o tumat nekeva vaddait vechen hannogea balloven veodem shello keachat eno chayyav al tumat mikdash vekadashav naga hu beatzmo beloven veodem sheraa hare ze chayyav al biat hammikdash

Dam hannidda o dam hazzava o dam hayyoledet metamme bechal shehu bemagga uvmassa shenneemar vehaddava beniddatah vehazzav mippi hashshemua lamdu shemmadve kamoha uchvar bearnu beinyan issur nidda shechamishsha damim temeim baishsha aval im raata dam yarok hare hu tahor veeno kemo rukkah ushar mashkin hayyotzin mimmenna sheharok mitaggel veotze veze shotet veored

Ishsha sheyyatza havalad middafnah veotze immo dam min haddofen hare oto dam av meavot hattumot kedam hannidda vehalleda vehazziva shehammakor mekomo tame vehaishsha tehora ad sheyyetze mimmenna dam derech harechem

Mekor haishsha shenneekar venafal laaretz haishsha temea tumat erev vechen makor shehizzia kishne tippe margaliyyot haishsha temea tumat erev aval enah nidda ad shettire echad mechamishsha damim hamtammein otah
Hezia tippa achat hare haishsha tehora sheenah ella michutz lammakor

Zovo shel zav av meavot hattumot kezav shenneemar zovo tame hu umtamme bemagga uvmassa bechal shehu reiyya rishona shel zav enah metammea bemassa vahare hi keshichvat zera ben meish gadol ben meish katan vechen hammishkavot vehammoshavot sheyyashav alehem mishsheraa reiyya rishona ad sheraa hashsheniyya tehorim sheeno karuy zav ella achar reiyya sheniyya kemo shebbearnu behilchot mechussere kappara raa achat merubba kishtayim en tame ella hammesit tippa acharona

Reiyya rishona shel metzora metamme bemassa shenneemar kal tzarua vechal zav vechol tame lanafesh hare hatztzarua kezav gamur ma zav gamur zovo metamme bemassa af metzora reiyyato harishona metamme bemassa

Rok hazzav veshichvat zaro umeme raglav kal echad mishshelashtan av tuma din tora umtamme bechal shehu bemagga uvmassa hare hu omer berok vechi yarok hazzav battahor umeme raglav veshichvat zaro i efshar shello yihye bahem tzichtzuche ziva kal shehu
Echad zav veechad nidda veoledet vezava kal echad mehen rukko umeme raglav av tuma kezav vechen kal makom shenneemar bahalachot ellu hazzav echad hazzav veechad shear haarbaa

Tisha mashkin bezav shelosha mehen av tuma vehen rukko veshichvat zaro umeme raglav kal echad meellu metamme adam vechelim bechal shehu kemo shebbearnu shelosha mehen kivelad hattuma veellu hen dimat eno vedam maggafto vachalev haishsha kal echad meellu kemashkin temein sheen metammein adam aval metammein kelim middivre sofrim kemo shebbearnu ushlosha mehen tehorin veellu hen zeato velecha serucha hayyotzim mimmennu veharei hare ellu shelosha min hazzav vachaverav kemotan mishshear haadam kicho venio veriro ume haaf shello hare hen kerukko lechal davar uvichlal harok hen chashuvin dam hayyotze mippi amma vedam hashshotet mippiv hare hen bichlal dam maggafto haya motzetz verokek dam hare ze metamme kerok shehaddam shemmotzetz i efshar lo belo tzichtzuche rok

Dam nidda vezava veoledet metamme lach veyavesh aval zovo shel zav verukko veshichvat zaro eno metamme ella kal zeman shehu lach aval yavesh yoter midday eno metamme vead kamma im shorin oto befoshrin meet leet vechozer lichmot shehaya hare ze metamme kelach im hau hammayim poshrin bitchillatan af al pi sheenan poshrin besofan vechal haddevarim haellu divre kabbala hen
Pishtan shettevaattu nidda hammesito tahor veim haya lach metamme mippene rok piha
Zav shehinniach piv al pi hakkos venimlach shello lishtoto hammesit et hakkos tahor shata mimmennu hazzav kal shehu hammesito tame mippene mashke pi hazzav
Zav shennashach et happat veet habbatzal hammesitan tahor nashach et hakkishshut vehammelaffon hammesitan tame mippene mashke pi hazzav hammitarev bahen
Kelippe polin uklippe tormosin shekketzatzan haakkum hammesitan tame shekkal akkum kezavim lechal divrehen kemo sheyyitbaer hakkelippin shebbashshevakin holchin bahen achar harov

Dam tame shennitarev bemayim im batlu marav hakkol tahor nitarev bedam tahor uvyayin roin oto keillu hu mayim vechen rok tame shennitarev bemayim im haya karush kivriyyato hare ze tame veim nimcha bemayim im batlu marav hakkol tahor nitarev berok acher roin oto keillu hu mayim vechen me raglav shel tame shennitarvu bemayim im batlu marehen hakkol tahor veim lav tame nitarev beyayin o beme raglayim tehorin roin oto keillu hu mayim nitarvu beme raglayim shel akkum holchin achar harov ketzad keli shehau yisrael veakkum metilin sham me raglehen im rov akkum hakkol tame veim rov yisrael hakkol tahor mechetza lemechetza hakkol tame vechen im nitarev me ragle akkum ze beme ragle yisrael ze holchin achar harov
Shoalin kele me raglayim mikkal makom veen choshshin shemma shel niddot hen shello nechshedu benot yisrael lechannes et me raglehen keshehen niddot

Cheres shehaya hazzav o hazzava metilin bo me raglehen vechibbesu paam rishona ushniyya hare hammashkin shekkibbesu bahen temein ufaam shelishit tehorin ben shekkibbesu bemayim ben shekkibbesu beme raglayim shehare lo nishar bah lachluchit meme raglayim

Zava shenneekru meme ragleha besof shivat yeme hassefira veyarda vetavla vehetila mayim achar hattevila hare hen safek im achar akira holchin vezava hayeta o achar hayetzia shehi tehora vechen akkum shenneekru meme ragleha venitgayera vetavla vehetila mayim achar shettavla hare ze safek im achar akira holchin vahare hen keme ragle haakkum hattemeim o achar yetzia vahare hem kememe ragle yisrael hattehorim

Haavadim metammein beziva uvnidda uvleda keyisrael aval haakkum en metammein lo beziva velo beniddut velo beledot din tora shenneemar dabberu el bene yisrael vaamartem alehem ish ish ki yihye zav bene yisrael metammein beziva velo haakkum vachachamim gazru al kal haakkum sheyetammeu kezavim lechal divrehen zecharim unkevot vehu sheyyihye hazzachar ben tesha shanim veom echad ulmala vehannekeva bat shalosh shanim veom echad vamala aval hakketannim lematta mizzeman ze lo gazru alehen tuma sheikkar haggezera hi kede shello yehe tinok yisrael ragil etzel haakkum bemishkav zachur ufachot mizzeman ze en biatan bia beet sheggazru alehen lo gazru al shichvat zera shellahen ella shichvat zaro shel akkum tehora kedin tora umippene ma lo gazru aleha tuma kede lehodia shettumatan middivre sofrim shehare hakkol yodin sheillu hau zavin din tora hayeta shichvat zaram av hattuma keshichvat zera hazzav umeachar sheyyodin betumatan shehayeta middivre sofrim lo yavou lisrof aleha teruma vekadashim nimtzeta lamed shezzovo shel akkum vedam nidda o dam ziva veledah shel bat akkum uvat akkum veakkum atzman af al pi shehem nekiyyim min hattora middam hazzav verok haakkum umeme raglehen umishkavan umerkavan uvoel akkum kal echad meellu av tuma middivre sofrim lefichach en chayyavin alehen al biat mikdash vekadashav veen sorfin alehen et hatteruma vechullan metammein adam vechelim bemagga umtammein adam bemassa kezav lechal davar ella shehattuma middivrehen kemo shebbearnu vedam hannachrit kerukkah uchmeme ragleha metamme lach veeno metamme yavesh
Boel nidda kenidda shehu av meavot hattuma shel tora metamme kelim bemagga umtamme adam bemassa uvmagga umtamme behesset umtamme mishkav umerkav kenidda

En mishkav boel nidda umerkavo kemishkav nidda umerkavah shehammishkav o hammerkav sheddarsa alav nidda av meavot hattuma umishkav boel nidda umerkavo velad tuma kechelim shennogea bahen sheenan metammein adam velo kelim ella ochalin umashkin bilvad velamma nigrea tumat mishkavo mittumat mishkavah mippene shenneemar bevoel nidda uthi niddatah alav vetame shivat yamim veneemar bo kal hammishkav asher yishkav alav yitma meachar shenneemar uthi niddatah alav eni yodea shehu metamme mishkav velamma neemar mippi hashshemua lamdu shehakkatuv nitteko mittuma chamura milletamme adam vechelim utlao betuma kalla sheyyihye mishkavo valad velo yetamme adam vechelim ella ochalin umashkin bilvad kishar valdot hattumot

Echad habba al hannidda o al shomeret yom keneged yom o al hayyoledet ben kedarkan ben shello kedarkan echad hamare veechad haggomer ben gadol shebba al hakketanna ben katan shebba al haggedola mittamme mishshum boel nidda bamme devarim amurim keshehaya habboel ben tesha shanim veom echad vehannivelet hayeta bat shalosh shanim veom echad aval pachot mikkan eno mittamme mishshum boel nidda ella mishshum nogea benidda bilvad shehu valad veeno av vechen boel hazzav hare hu kenogea bo veechad hannogea bezav o hannivelet min hazzav

Hannidda vehazzava veshomeret yom keneged yom vehayyoledet af al pi shello raata dam kullam metammeot lemafrea meet leet o mippekida lifkida vezehu hannikra meet leet shebbenidda ketzad ishsha shehayeta tehora veen lah veset uvadka atzmah beshacharit umatza tehora uvachatzi hayyom badka atzma umatza dam hare kal hattahorot sheasta mishsheat pekida rishona ad sheat pekida sheniyya temeot lemafrea vechen im badka hayyom umatza tehora ulachar shenayim o shelosha yamim badka umatza dam kal hattahorot sheasta meet shebbadka umatza dam ad shaot temeot lemafrea veed shelleachar hattashmish hare hu kifkida veshellifne hattashmish eno kifkida mippene sheenah bodeket bo yafe

Ishsha sheyyesh lah veset veraata dam bishat vestah dayyah sheatah veenah temea lemafrea higgia sheat vestah velo badka atzmah ulachar yamim badka atzmah umatza dam hare zo temea lemafrea vahare hi bechezkat nidda mishsheat vestah vezo hi tumat vestot haamura bechal makom veim matza atzmah tehora keshebbadka achar haveset hare zo tehora

Kal ishsha sheyyesh lah veset targish beatzmah mefaheket o mitatteshet o chosheshet pi keresah veshippule meeha o achazah tzamrurit o roshah kaved aleha o evareha kevedin vechayyotze beellu veyesh ishsha sheddarkah lirot beet sheyyatchil bah mikre echad meellu miyyad bitchillato veyesh ishsha shettamtin bemikre ze shaa o shettayim veachar kach tire haddam besof haveset hayeta lemuda lihot roa bitchillat haveset kal hattahorot sheasta betoch haveset temeot hayeta lemuda lihot roa besof haveset kal hattahorot sheasta betoch haveset tehorot veenah chosheshet ella mishshaa sheddarkah lirot ad et shemmatza dam

Haroa ketem temea lemafrea ad et happekida vechen habbeged shennimtza alav hakketem tame lemafrea vead kamma ad shettomar badakti hechaluk hazze velo haya alav ketem afillu kibbesattu velo bedakattu tame mikkodem hakkibbus lemafrea ad sheat bedika vaafillu nimtza hakketem lach hare ze metamme lemafrea ad sheat habbedika sheani omer miyyamim haya sham veatta naflu alav mayim venaasa lach

Vechal hannashim sheddayyan sheatan kitman kiriyyatan veeno metamme otan lemafrea kal ellu hannashim hattemeot lemafrea ben raata dam ben matzata ketem metammeot mishkav umerkav lemafrea letamme adam uvgadim vechen rukkan umeme raglehen temein lemafrea vaafillu keli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil metammeot otan lemafrea aval enan metammeot et habboel lemafrea mishshum boel nidda ella mishshum nogea bilvad aval haroa ketem habboel otah meachar shennimtzet hakketem tame mishshum boel nidda

Meubberet shehotzi haubbar et yado vehechezirah immo temea ledah vetumat yoledet vetumat meet leet o mippekida lifkida lemafrea kemo shebbearnu vetumat vesatot vetumat ketamim hakkol middivre sofrim vetumatan missafek lefichach en sorfin alehen teruma vekadashim ella tolin vechen chullin shennaasu al tahorat hakkodesh shennitmeu beellu tolin aval hannaasim al tahorat hatteruma vechullin hattevulin lechalla en mittammein bechal ellu hattumot shehen middivrehen nimtzeta omer shekkal achat meellu hannashim umishkavan umerkavan verukkan umeme raglehen uvoel roa ketem meachar shennimtza hakketem uvoel yoledet meachar sheyyatza haevar vechazar kullan avot tumot middivre sofrim

Arba nashim dayyan sheatan veenan mittammeot lemafrea veellu hen meubberet umenika uvtula uzkena e zo hi meubberet mishsheyyukkar ubbarah hayeta bechezkat meubberet veraata dam veachar kach hippila ruach o davar sheeno valad hare zo bechezkatah vedayyah sheatah raata dam veachar kach hukkar ubbarah hare zo mittammea lemafrea kechal hannashim e zo hi menika kal arbaa veesrim chodesh miyyom halleda afillu met benah betoch zeman ze o sheggemalathu o netanathu lemenika dayyah sheatah aval achar arbaa veesrim chodesh af al pi shehi menika veholechet hare zo temea lemafrea kechal hannashim e zo hi betula kal shello raata dam miyyameha betulat damim amru lo betulat betulim ketzad afillu nisset veraata dam mechamat nissuin o yalda veraata dam mechamat leda adayin hi betula leinyan tuma vedayya sheatah e zo hi zekena kal sheavru aleha shelosha chodashim samuch leziknutah velo raata dam vee zo hi samuch leziknutah kal shechavroteha korot lah zekena befaneha veenah makpedet avru aleha shalosh onot veraata vechazru veavru aleha shalosh onot acherot o pachot o yeter veraata hare hi kechal hannashim umittammea lemafrea
Betula sheraata dam afillu shofaat kal shiva o dolefet hare ze paam achat raata dam ufaska vechazra veraata hare ze shette peamim

Tinoket shello higgia zemannah lirot veraata dam paam rishona ushniyya dayyah sheatah raata paam shelishit mittammea lemafrea avru aleha shelosha chodashim veachar kach raata dayyah sheatah avru aleha shelosha chodashim acherim veachar kach raata dayyah sheatah avru aleha shelosha chodashim acherim veraata mittammea lemafrea

Tinoket shehiggia zemannah lirot veraata paam rishona dayyah sheatah sheniyya mittammea lemafrea avru aleha shelosha chodashim veachar kach raata dayyah sheatah avru aleha shelosha chodashim acherim veachar kach raata mittammea lemafrea

Meubberet umenika uzkena uvtula shehiggia zemannam lirot sherau reiyya rishona dayyan sheatan rau paam sheniyya mittammeot lemafrea kechal hannashim kemo shebbearnu veim rau harishona beones af bashsheniyya dayyan sheatan

Chezkat benot yisrael shello higgiu lefirkan bechezkat tahora veen hannashim bodkot otan aval mishshehiggiu lefirkan tzerichot bedika venashim bodkot otan
Hachereshet vehashshota umi shennitrefa datah becholi im yesh lahen pikchot metakkenot otan hare ellu ochlot bitruma

Pil shebbala hutzin vehekian derech hari haose mehen kelim hare hen safek im hem kichle gelalim o kele etz keshehau aval kefifa shennitmet uvlaah pil vehekiah derech bet hari hare hi betumatah

Peshute kele cheres kegon menora vechisse veshulchan shel cheres vechayyotze bahen en mekabbelin tuma min hattumot velo tumat midras lo min hattora velo middivre sofrim shenneemar asher yippol mehem el tocho yitma kal sheyyesh lo toch bichli cheres mekabbel tuma vesheen lo toch tahor

Kele mattachot echad peshutehen kegon hassakkinim vehammisparayim o mekabbelehen kegon hayyorot vehakkumkumosin hakkol mekabbelin tuma shenneemar kal davar asher yavo vaesh ben mekabbel ben pashut afillu teva o migdal vechayyotze bahen shel mattechet shehen mekabbelin arbaim sea belach o yeter mekabbelin tuma shenneemar kal davar asher yavo vaesh

Kele etz uchle or uchle etzem mekabbelehen kegon haareva vehachemet vechayyotze bahen mekabbelin tuma middivre tora aval peshutehen kegon halluchot vehakkisse vehaor sheochlin alav vechayyotze bahen enan mekabbelin tuma ella middivre sofrim shenneemar mikkal keli etz mippi hashshemua lamdu ma sak sheyyesh lo bet kibbul af kal sheyyesh lo bet kibbul uchle etzem kichle etz lechal davar bamme devarim amurim shettumat peshutehen middivre sofrim bishar tumot chutz mittumat midras aval bemidras hazzav vachaverav mittammein min hattora shenneemar kal hammishkav asher yishkav kal heasuy lemishkav o lemerkav kemo shebbearnu vechen keli zechuchit heasuy lemishkav mittamme bemidras middivrehen
Kal shehu arug ben mitztzemer ufishtim ben mikkanbos o mimmeshi o mishshear devarim haggedelim bayyabbasha hu hannikra beged leinyan tuma vehallevadim kivgadim lechal davar

Hassak hu chute sear haggedulin keshalshelet o haarugin kivgadim echad heasuy min haizzim o mitztzemer gemallim o mizzenav hassus vehappara vechayyotze bahen veechad haarig mehen kemo hammartzufin o haggadul kemo chevek shel chamor vechayyotze bo aval hachavalim vehammeshichot hashshezurin ben min hassear ben mitztzemer ufishtim enan mekabbelin tuma bifne atzman

Kal hakkelim haasuyin min haggome umin haarava umin hakkanim umikkappot temarim umin healim vehassarigin uklippe ilanot umin hachelef kegon hakkefifot vehatteraskelin vehammachalatzot vehammappatzot hakkol bichlal kele haetz shehakkol gadel min haaretz keetz echad keli cheres veechad keli neter lechal davar kal keli heasuy meheafar min haafarot veachar kach sorfin otan bechivshan hare ze keli cheres vehattannur vehakkirayim vehakkuppach vechayyotze bahen mishshear habbinyanot sheofin bahen o mevashshelin bahen hakkol mekabbelin tuma din tora vetumatan vetumat keli cheres shava
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 2: Haose keli kibbul mikkal makom hare ze mekabbel tuma bechal shehu min hattora veen lichli kibbul shiur vehu sheyyaase davar shel kayyama sheefshar sheyyaamod ketzad haose keli min haor hammatztza shello nitabbed kelal o min hanneyar af al pi sheen hanneyar mekabbel tuma o mikkelippat harimmon vehaegoz vehaallon afillu chakakum hattinokot lamod bahen et heafar o shehitkinum lechaf moznayim hare ellu mekabbelin tuma shettinok cheresh shote vekatan yesh lahen maase af al pi sheen lahen machashava aval haose kelim min hallefet vehaetrog vehaddelaat hayeveshim shechakakan lamod bahen vechal kayyotze bahen hare hen tehorin lefi shei efshar sheyyaamdu ella zeman muat

Kene moznayim vehammachak sheyyesh bahen bet kibbul mattechet vehaesel sheyyesh bo bet kibbul maot vekane shel etz sheyyesh bo bet kibbul mayim umakkel sheyyesh bo bet kibbul mezuza o mekom margalit umashchezet shel etz sheyyesh bo bet kibbul shemen veluach pinkas sheyyesh bo bet kibbul shaava kal ellu vechayyotze bahen af al pi shehen peshute kele etz hoil veyesh bahen bet kibbul kal shehu mekabbelin tuma din tora veen tame min hattora ella bet kibbul levaddo sheyyesh bahen vehamshammesh et bet hakkibbul mishshear hakkeli shebbet hakkibbul tzarich lo aval hayyater al hatztzorech mishshear hakkeli happashut tahor min hattora vetame middivrehen kemo shebbearnu

Bet kibbul heasuy lemalleoto eno bet kibbul ketzad bekaat shel etz shechokkin bah bet kibbul vetokin bo hassaddan shel barzel im shel nappachim hi enah mekabbelet tuma sheaf al pi sheyyesh bah bet kibbul lo naasa ella lemalleoto vechen kal kayyotze baze veim hayeta shel tzorfin hare zo mekabbelet tuma mippene shehen magbihin et habbarzel bechal et sheyyirtze umkabbetzin et sefot hazzahav vehakkesef hammitkabbetzet sham tachat hassaddan vahare naasa lekabbala vechen kal kayyotze bo

Hakkaf hechakuk shettachat ragle hammittot vehammigdalot vechayyotze bahen af al pi shehu mekabbel tahor veen bo mishshum keli kibbul lefi sheeno asuy lekibbul ella lismoch bo bilvad shefoferet hakkash mekabbelet tuma kechal kele haetz shemmekabbelin tuma afillu enah yechola lekabbel ella tippa achat ushfoferet hakkane shechatachah lekabbala enah mekabbelet tuma ad sheyyotzi et kal hallavan shebbetochah veim lo nechtecha lekabbala hare hi kifshute kele etz aval shefoferet shel pakuot vechayyotze bahen enan kelim ella kaochalin hen chashuvin

Shefoferet shechatachah venatan bah et hammezuza veachar kach netanah bechotel afillu natna shello kederech kabbalatah mekabbelet tuma kevaah bakkotel im kevaah kederech kabbalatah hare zo mekabbelet tuma shello kederech kabbalatah tehora natan hashshefoferet bakkotel veachar kach natan bah hammezuza im hayeta kederech kabbalatah hare zo mekabbelet tuma shello kederech kabbalatah tehora kevaah bakkotel afillu kederech kabbalatah tehora

Keli sheorgin oto min hannesarim o min hashshaam kede sheyyishtechu alav habbegadim vehammugmar millematta kede sheyyitbassemu im haya asuy kechaveret sheen lo karka tahor veim haya bo bet kabbalat kesut hare ze mekabbel tuma
Sandal shel behema shel mattechet tame veshel shaam tahor sheen ze chashuv mikkele hakkabbala

Hatztzorer margalit baor vehotziah venishar mekomah amok hare ze mekabbel tuma ad sheyyifshot shekkal kele kibbul mekabbelin bechal shehen vahare mekoman kemo kis katan aval tzeror hammaot eno mekabbel tuma sheen alav tzurat keli
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 3: Kal keli etz heasuy lenachat afillu eno mekabbel ella davar muat eno mekabbel tuma lo min hattora velo middivre sofrim vechal keli etz heasuy lehittaltel male verekan kesak afillu haya machazik mea sea veaf al pi sheyyesh lo shulayim hoil veeno asuy lenachat hare ze mekabbel tuma din tora kishar kele kibbul vechal keli etz shehu setam im hau lo shulayim leshev alehem al hakkarka kede shello yehe noach lehitgalgel vehaya machazik arbaim sea belach shehen korayim beyavesh eno mekabbel tuma kelal lo min hattora velo middivre sofrim mippene shechezkato sheasuy lenachat udvarim ellu divre kabbala hen mippi hashshemua lamdu ma sak shehu mittaltel male verekan af keli etz lo yitma ella im ken haya mittaltel male verekan lehotzi keli etz heasuy lenachat

Hakkelim shechezkatan shehen asuyin lenachat kegon shidda teva umigdal vechaveret hakkash vechaveret hakkanim uvor sefina gedola vechayyotze beellu im hen machazikin arbaim sea en mekabbelin tuma veellu hen hakkelim shel etz shehen asuyin lehittaltel bimloan dirdur shemmannichin oto al haagala vekostot hammelachim vaarevat haabbedan uvor sefina ketanna sheenah yechola lehallech beemtza hayyam haggadol vehaaron kal echad mechameshet kele etz ellu af al pi shehen mekabbelin yoter mearbaim sea hare ellu mekabbelin tuma shello naasu mittechillatan ella lehittaltel melein ushar kal kele etz im hau mekabbelin arbaim sea veyesh lahem shulayim chezkatan sheenan asuyin lehittaltel bimloan ulfichach en mekabbelin tuma vechen kele etzem uchle haor hamkabbelin arbaim sea belach en mekabbelin tuma ella im ken naasu mittechillatan keshehen melein
Hashshidda vehatteva vehammigdal shel zechuchit habbaim bemidda tehorin ushar kele zechuchit af al pi shemmekabbelin arbaim sea hare hen mekabbelin tuma veze chomer bichle zechuchit mibbichle etz

Kal keli sheyyesh beshibburo amma al amma berum shalosh hare hu machazik arbaim sea belach uchshemmoddin et hakkeli moddin oto mibbachutz im haya bo amma al amma berum shalosh af al pi sheen tocho ella pachot mizze hare hu tahor sheen ovi haddefanot memaet aval ovi haraglayim vaovi hazzer im haya lo zer en nimdadin immo

Haya betoch hakkeli teva ketanna kegon muchni shebbetoch hashshidda bizman shehi nishmetet enah nimdedet immah veenah chibbur lah veenah matztzelet immah beohel hammet veim enah nishmetet nimdedet immah vahare hen kichli echad
Haya lakkeli kissuy kamur bizman shehu kavua nimdad immo eno kavua eno nimdad immo hau bo megurot mibbifnim nimdedet immo veim hau mibbachutz enan nimdadot immo
Keli etz sheeno mekabbel arbaim sea kedarko ella im ken hittahu al tziddo o semacho bedavar acher hoil umkabbel arbaim sea mikkal makom tahor
Hashshidda vehatteva shennittela achat meraglehen af al pi shello nikkevu ella hare hen mekabbelin hare ellu tehorin vaadayin yesh lahem shulayim vechezkatan shehen lenachat keshehau
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 4: Shalosh middot bichle etz sheenan asuyin lekabbala kal keli etz heasuy letashmish adam bilvad kegon hassullam tahor veeno mekabbel tuma kelal velo ribbuhu chachamim letuma vechal keli etz heasuy letashmish hakkelim vehaadam kegon hashshulchan vehattavla vehammitta vechayyotze bahen mekabbelin tuma uminnayin shehen letashmish adam vetashmish meshammeshav shehare manniach hakkearot al hashshulchan vehakkosot al hattavla vehammatztzaot al hammitta vechal keli etz heasuy letashmish hakkelim bilvad shehare hu meshammesh meshammeshe adam im lo haya meshammesh et hakkelim ella bishat melacha bilvad hare ze tahor mikkelum kegon menora shel etz shemmeshammeshet hanner bishat hadlaka vechan vehu keli shemmannichin tachat hakkelim bishat melacha vehaddefusin kullan veim haya meshammesh et hakkelim bishat melacha veshello bishat melacha hare ze mekabbel tuma kegon kissuy hakkafatza vechayyotze bo vetik hassayif vehassakkin veharomach vehammisparim vehattaar vehammichchol vehammichtav uvet hakkochal vetik tavla uskurtiya uvet hachitztzim uvet happagozot vetik chalalim kal ellu vechayyotze bahen af al pi sheenan ella meshammeshe kelim mekabbelin tuma shehare hakkeli tzarich lahen bishat melacha veshello bishat melacha aval kissuy kamatra vechissuy teva vechissuy teni vehammachbesh shel charash vehakkisse shettachat hatteva vehakkematin shellah vehakkelev shebbonin alav tik hassappar uvet hanneger vehammanul vehammezuza vetik nevalim vehakkinnorot vehakkelev shel godle mitznefet udfus shel tefillin vesus shel etz shel zemer shemmesachakin bo urviit hammekonenet ugnonat heani vesamochot hammitta venaklite hammitta vachamor shettachat hammitta kal ellu vechayyotze bahen tehorin mippene shehen meshammeshe hakkelim bishat melacha bilvad

Malben hammitta im haya melubbash befikot veyesh lo raglayim shemmechabberan im hammitta hare ze mittamme im hammitta shehare notnin oto bifne hammitta vahare hu keechad meevareha netano al shette leshonot vahare hu gavoha al hammitta af al pi shemmesorag bachavalim hoil veen lo raglayim tahor mippene shehu mimmeshammeshe hakkelim bishat melacha bilvad kemalbene bene levi shettolin bahem kinnorotehen uchle hashsher shehen tehorin

Machbesh shel shekkaf shemmoteach alav et haor tahor mippene shemmanniach alav et haeven bammakom hechakuk sheyyesh bo umshammesh alav venimtza asuy leshammesh et hakkelim bishat melacha veeno mittamme mishshum kibbul shehare hechakak shebbo asuy lehitmalleot beeven

Chippuye hammitta tehorin vechen kal hachippuyin ben shehau shel etz o shel etzem o shel or o shel mattechet tehorin shenneemar asher yease melacha bahen perat lechippuye hakkelim vechen kele etz o etzem sheyyesh bahen bet kibbul shetztzippam bemattechet tehorim veen mekabbelin tuma meachar shetztzippam bittelan vehatztzippuy atzmo tahor kemo shebbearnu

Haose keli miktzato min haetz umiktzato min hammattechet im haya haetz meshammesh hammattechet mekabbel tuma veim hayeta hammattechet meshammeshet et haetz hakkol tahor ketzad mafteach shel etz veshinnav mimmattechet afillu shen echad hare ze mekabbel tuma hayeta hi mimmattechet veshinnayim shello meetz hakkol tahor
Tabbaat shel mattechet vechotamah shel almog temea hayeta shel almog vechotamo shel mattechet hare zo enah mekabbelet tuma

Hashshen shel mattechet o hachotam mekabbel tuma bifne atzmo im lo haya mechubbar laetz vechen hamabbed vehammazre vehammagov vehammasrek shel rosh shennittela echad mishshinnehen vaasaah shel mattechet hare ellu mekabbelin tuma
Makkel sheasa berosho masmer kemin rimmon kede sheyyihye ochez bo eno mekabbel tuma asaahu shello tihye haaretz ochelet et haetz mekabbel tuma
Vechen makkel shekkava bo masmerim kede lehakkot bo mekabbel tuma shennimtza haetz meshammesh et hammattechet asaan lenoy eno mekabbel tuma shehare hammattechet meshammeshet et haetz
Vechen menakkiyyot shel mattechet shekkevaan bammakkel o baddelet lenoy tehorot vechen kal kayyotze baze mishshear hakkelim
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 5: Kal hakkelim en mekabbelin tuma ad shettiggamer melachtan uchle etz meematay mekabbelin tuma hammitta vehaarisa mishsheyeshufem beor haddag gamar shello lashuf mekabbelin tuma hassallim shel etz mishsheyyachsom siftotehen veyichrot ektze hassarigim vehaetzim hakketannim hayyotzim al gabbe hassal hau hassallim shel temara af al pi shello karat hahutzin mibbifnim mekabbelin tuma shekkach mekayemin otan hakkalkala mishsheyyachsom piha veyichrot hahutzim veyigmor et hatteluot bet hakkosot vehallaginin af al pi shello karat mibbifnim mekabbelin tuma shekkach mekayemin otam hakkenonim hakketannim vehakkelatot mishsheyyachsom siftotehen veyichrot hahutzin hayyotzim hakkenonim haggedolim vehasseogim haggedolim mishsheyyaase shene dorim larochav shellahen hannafa vehakkevara vechaf moznayim mishsheyyaase dor echad larochav shellahen hakuppa mishsheyyaase shette tzefirot larochav shellah vehaarak mishsheyyaase bo tzefira achat af al pi shello gamar gabbehen mekabbelin tuma shehare niru lema shennaasu vetzurat hakkeli alehen ha lema ze dome leveged shenneerag miktzato hammachtzelet mishsheyyichrot hahutzin vezehu gemar melacha vechal kele hannesarim enan mekabbelin tuma ad sheyyitchassemu siftotehen galme kele etz mekabbelin tuma mishshennaasa hakkeli betzurato af al pi sheatid letaaro bisrad o lehashoto bimchoga o leyappoto bammaatzad vechayyotze bemaasim ellu vaadayin hu golem hoil veeno mechussar chakika vahare hishlim chafirato hare ze mekabbel tuma vechal galme kele etz mekabbelin tuma chutz mishshel eshkeroa sheen hakkeli mimmennu chashuv keli ad sheyyityappe vekarov beenay shekkele etzem kichle eshkeroa veen galmehen mekabbelin tuma keli etz sheen alav tzurat keli af al pi shemmishtammeshin bo eno mekabbel tuma arubbot shel nachtomin shessodrim alehen hachallot keshehen batzek mittammeot shehare tzurat hakkeli alehen veshel baale battim enan mekabbelin tuma veim tzevaan besikra o becharkom vechayyotze bahen mittammeot shehare naaset lahen tzurat keli serod shel nachtomin shennotnin bo hammayim shemmekattefin bo tame veshel baale battim tahor veim gippefo mearba ruchotav mittamme nifratz meruach achat tahor vehalluach sheorchin alav mittamme keli etz shehassallatim merakkedin alav et hassolet mittamme veshel baale battim tahor rachat haggarosot mittammea shel otzarot tehora shel gittot mittammea veshel goranot tehora ze hakkelal heasuy lekabbala mekabbel tuma veheasuy lechannes bo tahor

Kal hatteloyin tehorin chutz mitteloye nafa shel sallatin utloy kevarah shel goranot utloy maggal yad utloy makkel habballashin mippene shehen mesayein bishat melacha ze hakkelal heasuy lesayeo bishat melacha mittamme litlot bo hakkeli bilvad tahor
Nivle hamshorrim mittammein nivle bene levi shemmezammerin bahen bammikdash tehorin habbitnon vehanniktemon vehairus mittammein
Metzudat hachulda mittamme veshel achbarim tehora lefi sheen lah bet kibbul veen aleha tzurat keli
Kotzin sheorgin bahen kemo kefifa shemmannichin bah hatteenim vechayyotze bahen mittammein vesheorgin bahen ketavnit menora gedola sheotzrin bahen hachittin tehora sheen torat keli aleha
Alin shemmesargin otan kemin seyag saviv lapperot tahor veim asu seyag shel nesarin mittammein

Chotel shel hutzin shemmannichin bo harotev vechayyotze bo im hu noten letocho venotel mittocho mittamme veim eno yachol littol ma shebbetocho ad sheyyikraennu o yattirennu o shechashav leechol ma shebbetocho ulzarko tahor vechen hakkeren shehu mishtammesh bah umashlichah enah mekabbelet tuma veim chashav aleha mekabbelet tuma
Hashshofar eno mekabbel tuma chatacho lihot keren tashmish mekabbel tuma
Keara shekkevaah beshidda teva umigdal im hi kederech kabbalatah mekabbelet tuma veim kevaah baddofen shehare enah mekabbelet ad shemmattim shidda al tzidda hare zo mikkelal hashshidda uthora
Haakkon veharatov vehakkeluv shel etz tehorin
Hammaddaf vehappaltzur umtzudat secharim mittammein shehare tzurat keli alehem

Hassafsalin shebbappundekaot veshel melammede tinokot af al pi shehen nekuvin umachnisin bahen et haraglayim tehorim kavu bahen raglayim bemasmer mekabbelin tuma ze hakkelal kal shennittal veen raglav nittalot immo tahor vechal shennittal veraglav nittalot immo tame veim hau kullan shel etz o etzem mekabbel tuma hayeta achat meraglav shel even eno mekabbel tuma
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 6: Kal keli shennitma venishbar achar shennitma venifseda tzurato vetashmisho tahor bishvirato vechen kelim shennishberu keshehen tehorin shivrehen enan mekabbelin tuma

Kamma shiur hashshever sheyyishshaver bichli etz o keli etzem veyihye tahor kal kele baale battim shiuran berimmonim ketzad mishsheyyinnakev hakkeli bemotzi rimmon tahor veharimmon sheamru benoni lo gadol velo katan lefi daat haroe veyihu bakkeli shelosha rimmonim achuzim ze baze nikkav hakkeli bemotzi zayit ustamo vechazar venikkav bemotzi zayit ustamo ad shehishlimo lemotzi rimmon af al pi shehu satum tahor shehare naasu lo panim chadashot
Kelim sheasaan mittechilla nekuvin bemotzi rimmon kegon hassal vehappuchlatz shel gemallim vehaappifyarot mekabbelin tuma ad sheyyikkara rubban
Appifyarot sheasa lahen kanim lemala ulmatta lechazzek tehorot asa lahen gappayim kal shehen af al pi shekkullah nekuva kemotzi rimmon mekabbelet tuma
Kal hakkelim sheenan yecholin lekabbel rimmonim kegon harova vachatzi rova vehakkenonim hakketannim shiuran bemotzi zayit nigmemu siftotehen im nishar bahen kede lekabbel kal shehu temein
Hassallin shel pat shiuran kechikkarot shel pat
Kuppat haggannanim mishshettotzi aguddot shel yarak tehora veshel baale battim bemotzi teven shel ballanin bigvava
Bet kearot sheeno mekabbel kearot hoil umkabbel hattamchuyin hare ze mekabbel tuma vechen bet hari sheeno mekabbel mashkin hoil umkabbel et hari hare ze mekabbel tuma

Kal keli etz shennechlak lishnayim tahor veaf al pi shemmekabbelin al dafnotehen beilpasin chutz mikkelim shel etz shechetzyan o miktzatan keli bifne atzmo mittechillat asiyyatan kegon hashshulchan hakkaful shemmitchilla naasa shene chalakim vahare hu nichpal venifshat uchgon hattamchuy hammiznon shehu kearot kearot vahare bechal chelek mechalakav kearot shelemot uchgon hakkisse hakkaful vechal kayyotze beellu vechen bet laginin uvet hakkosot shel etz shennifchat echad mehen ze shennifchat tahor veeno chibbur lishar habbattim nifchat hashsheni tahor veeno chibbur lo nifchatu shelashtan kullan tehorin vechen kal kayyotze bechelim kaellu

Mashpelet sheemtzaitah gevoha vezaviyyoteha yordot venifchata mitztzad echad temea mippene shehi mekabbelet mitztzad hashsheni nifchata mitztzad hashsheni tehora hashshulchan vehaddulpeki shennifchatu mekabbelin tuma ad sheyyechalku veyibbadel kal chelek mechavero nittela achat meraglehen tehora vechen im nittela hashsheniyya nittela hashshelishit im chishshev alehem sheyyochal al shulchan ze o al dulpeki zo kemo ochel betavla mekabbelin tuma veim lav tehorin
Kele nesarim shennaflu siftotehen tehorin veim nishar machsom siftotehen kal shehu mekabbelin tuma
Tavla shemmilleah etzim utkaah tehora chippah binsarim mekabbelet tuma
Safsal shennitparek tahor sirgelo bimshichot o bachavalim mekabbel tuma
Hassallim shel gemallim hittiran tehorin chazar uksharan mekabbelin tuma nimtzeu mittammein umittaharin afillu eser peamim beom

Hashshulchan o haddulpeki shechippan beshayish veshiyyer bahem mekom hannachat hakkosot mekabbelin tuma veim chippa hakkol tahor ben betzippuy omed ben betzippuy sheeno omed ben shechippa et levazbezav ben shello chippan ben shehau shel etzim chashuvim kegon eshkeroa vechayyotze bo ben shehau shel shear etzim hoil vechippan kullan tehorin kemo shebbearnu
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 7: Kele or meematay mekabbelin tuma hatturmal vechayyotze bo mishsheyyachsom siftotav veyichrot hakkofin hakketannim hayyotzin al gabbe haor veyaase kichotav sekurtiya mishsheyyachsom veyichrot veyaase tzitzatah katavulya mishsheyyachsom veyichrot hakkar vehakkeset shel or mishsheyyachsom siftotehen veyichrot hakkofin hayyotzin vechen kal kayyotze bahen hattefillin mishsheyyigmor hakketzitza af al pi shehu atid latet bah et hartzua mekabbelet tuma or haarisa shehu atid laasot lo tabbur ad sheyyaasennu lo hassandal mishsheyyakmia hamminal misheyyiggov al haimmum veim atid locharkem ulsartet ad sheyyicharkem visartet

Or sheen alav tzurat keli eno mekabbel tuma lefichach kaf shel or shekkoshrin lokte kotzim al kappotehen kede shello yakkem kotz eno mekabbel tuma mippene shehu or pashut veen alav tzurat keli vechen haor shemmelakketin bo gelale habbakar veor shechosmin bo pi habbehema veor shemmoshivin bo haddevorim beshaa shellokchin haddevash veor shemmenifin bo et haruach mippene hachom tehorin veen mekabbelin tuma
Kal bet haetzbaot shel or tehorot chutz mishshel kayatzin mippene shehi mekabbelet et haog temea nikrea im enah mekabbelet et rov haog tehora

Haavnet shel orot veorot shettofrin hakkitteim al arkubbotehen kede sheyyitgalgelu bahen al hakkarka mekabbelin tuma shehare tzurat keli alehen vechen haorot haasuot keen tabbaot shemmachnisin otan haummanin bizrootehen kede lehagbiha bigdehen mealehen bishat melacha mittammein kishar kele or happeshutim

Or shettofrin mimmennu kissuy leyad velizroa shel zore ginnot veshel holche derachim veshel ose pishtan mekabbelin tuma veim haya shel tzabbaim veshel nappachim eno mekabbel tuma ze hakkelal kal heasuy lekabbala kede shello yakkehu kotz uchde sheyyochaz yafe yafe mekabbel tuma veheasuy mippene hazzea kede shello yippased haddavar shemmitassek bo bezeat yado eno mekabbel tuma

Kamma shiur hannekev sheyyinnakev keli haor veyithar hachemet mishshettinnakev kemotzi pekaiyyot shel sheti veim enah yechola lekabbel shel sheti hoil umkabbelet shel erev mekabbelet tuma ad shettinnakev rubbah
Hatturmil shennifchat hakkis shebbetocho adayin hatturmil mekabbel tuma veeno chibbur lo
Hachemet shehabbetzim shellah mekabbelot immah venifchatu tehorot sheenan mekabbelot kedarkan

Keli or sheyyesh lo lulaot ushnatzot kegon sandal imki vechis shel shenatzot af al pi shekkeshehen muttarin en alehen tzurat keli hare ellu mekabbelin tuma keshehen muttarin hoil vehahedot yachol bimhera lehachnis hashshenatzot ballulaot veyachzor keli kibbul keshehaya vechen im nitmeu vehesir hashshenatzot mehen venifseda tzuratan hare hen tehorin af al pi sheefshar lehachziran shello beumman

Kis shel shenatzot shennittelu shenatzav adayin hu mekabbel tuma shehare hu mekabbel nifshat vechazar or pashut tahor tala alav et hammatlet millematta mekabbelet tuma af al pi shehu pashut shehare yesh alav tzurat keli

Or shekkarach bo et hakkamea mekabbel tuma peshato tahor chazar vecharach bo mekabbel tuma mittamme umittaher afillu eser peamim beom veor shekkatav alav et hakkamea tahor veim karat mimmennu veasa chulya letachshit mekabbel tuma

Hattefilla shel rosh arbaa kelim hi hare shennitmet bemet vehittir ketzitza harishona vetikkenah hare hi av tuma keshehayeta vechen im hittir hashsheniyya vetikkenah veim hittir af hashshelishit vetikkenah vehittir af harviit vetikkenah naaset kullah rishon letuma shehare hittir kal achat veachat vechazar vetikkenam kullam uchillu zo tefillin acharonot shennagu barishonot chazar vehittir et harishona paam sheniyya vetikkenah hare hi rishon keshehayeta vechen im hittir et hashsheniyya veet hashshelishit chazar vehittir af harviit vetikkenah hare kullah tehora sheen harishon metamme kelim mippene shehu valad kemo shebbearnu vechen sandal shehu teme midras venifseka achat meaznav vetikkenah tame midras nifseka sheniyya vetikkenah hare hu tahor min hammidras shehare naasu lo aznayim chadashot aval teme magga midras lo hispik letakken et harishona ad shennifseka hashsheniyya o shennifsak akevo o nittal chatmo o nechlak lishnayim tahor
Minal shennifchat im eno mekabbel rov haregel tahor
Tefilla shennitmet meematay tahoratah shel yad mishsheyyattir otah mishshalosh ruchot veshel rosh mishsheyyattir mishshalosh ruchot uven ketzitza lachavertah

Hakkaddur vehaimmum vehakkame vehattefillin shennikreu achar shennitmeu hannogea bahen tame uvma shebbetochan tahor haikkuf shennikra hannogea bema shebbetocho tame mippene shehattefer mechabbero venaasa kullo keguf echad
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 8: Kal kele mattachot enan mekabbelin tuma ad shettiggamer melachtan kullah velo yihye hakkeli mechussar maase kelal aval galme kele mattachot enan mekabbelin tuma

Veellu hen galme kele mattachot kal sheatid lashuf oto o leshabbetz o ligror o lecharkev o lehakkish bekurnas o shehaya mechussar ozen o ogen hare ze eno mekabbel tuma ad sheyetakkenennu viyappehu velo tishshaer bo melacha kelal ketzad hassayif eno mekabbel tuma ad sheyeshufennu vehassakkin ad sheyyashchizenna vechen kal kayyotze bemaasim ellu lefichach haose kelim min haeshet shel barzel o min hacharara shel mattechet umin hassovev shel galgal umin hattassin umin hatztzippuyin umikkanne hakkelim umeogne hakkelim umeazne hakkelim umin hashshechula umin haggerodet hare ellu tehorim mippene shekkal ellu shennaasu galme kele mattachot hen aval haose keli mishshivre kele mattachot umin hakkelim shennishchaku merov hazzeman umin hammasmerot sheyyadua shennaasu min hakkelim hare ellu mekabbelin tuma lefi sheenam golamim aval masmerot sheen yadua im naasu min hakkelim o min haeshet hare hen tehorin afillu hitkin otam lichli enam mekabbelin tuma
Keli mattachot sheeno mechussar ella kissuy mekabbel tuma sheen hakkissuy chashuv migguf hakkeli

Machat shello nikkevah ella shafah vetikkenah lechach mittechillatah mekabbelet tuma mippene shemmotziin bah et hakkotz aval im atid lenakkevah hare hi kishar galme kele mattachot veenah mekabbelet tuma

Meachar shebbearnu sheggalme kele mattachot tehorim vegalme kele etz temeim ufshute kele mattachot temeim ufshute kele etz tehorim din tora nimtza hattame bichle etz tahor bichle mattachot tame bichle mattachot tahor bichle etz

Kal kele hammilchama kegon hassayif veharomach vehakkova vehashshiron vehammaggafayim vechayyotze bahen mekabbelin tuma vechal tachshite haadam kegon hakkatala vehannezamim vehattabbaot ben sheyyesh alehen chotam ben sheen alehem chotam vechayyotze bahen mekabbelin tuma afillu dinar shennifsal vehitkino litloto betzavar ketanna mekabbel tuma vechen kamea shel mattechet mittamme kechal tachshit adam

Kal tachshite habbehema vehakkelim kegon hattabbaot sheosin letzavar habbehema ulazne hakkelim tehorin veenan mekabbelin tuma bifne atzman chutz mizzog shel behema vechelim hammashmia kol laadam ketzad haose zogin lemachteshet velaarisa lemitpechot sefarim vetinokot tehorim asa lahen inbolin mekabbelim tuma hoil venaasu lehashmia kol laadam hare hen ketachshite adam vaafillu nittelu inbolehen mekabbelin tuma shehare hu rauy lehakkisho al hacheres
Zog heasuy leadam im naasa lekatan eno mekabbel tuma ella bainbol shello shehare lekol naasa naasa legadol hare ze tachshit umkabbel tuma af al pi sheen lo inbol

Kal happartzufot mekabbelot tuma vechal hachotamot tehorin chutz mechotam shel mattechet shebbo chotmin bilvad vechal hattabbaot tehorot chutz mittabbaat etzba aval tabbaat shechoger bo et matnav shekkoshrah ben ketefav tehora tabbaat hashsher shel behema hoil vehaadam moshech bah et habbehema mekabbelet tuma vechen makkel shel behema shel mattechet hoil veadam rode otah bo mekabbelet tuma

Kal hakkelim yordim letuma bemachshava veen olin mide tuma ella beshinnuy maase vehammaase mevattel miyyad hammaase umiyyad hammachshava vehammachshava enah mevattelet lo miyyad hammaase velo miyyad hammachshava ketzad tabbaat behema o kelim shechashav aleha lehachzirah tabbaat adam hare zo mekabbelet tuma bemachshava zo uchillu naaset leadam mittechillat asiyyatah chazar vechishshev aleha lehannichah tabbaat behema keshehaya af al pi shello nitkashshet bah haadam hare zo mekabbelet tuma sheen hammachshava mevattelet miyyad hammachshava ad sheyyaase maase bagguf kegon sheyyashuf otah o yitkaah bemaase shel behema hayeta hattabbaat laadam vechishshev aleha livhema adayin hi mekabbelet tuma keshehayeta sheen hakkelim olin mide tumatan bemachshava asa bah maase veshinna livhema enah mekabbelet tuma shehammaase mevattel miyyad hammaase
Cheresh shote vekatan yesh lahen maase veen lahen machashava kemo shebbearnu lemala beinyan hechsher ochalin
Zog shel delet shechishshev aleha livhema mekabbel tuma veshel behema sheasauhu laddelet afillu chibbero bakkarka vaafillu kevao bemasmer mekabbel tuma keshehaya ad sheyeshanne bo maase begufo

Umman sheose umanniach zogin livhema velidlatot im rov heasuy ledavar shemmekabbel tuma hare hakkol mekabbel tuma ad sheyyafrish miktzatan ledavar sheeno mekabbel tuma veim rov heasuy ledavar sheen mekabbel tuma hare hakkol tahor ad sheyyafrish miktzatan ledavar hamkabbel tuma
Zogin hannimtzain bechal makom mekabbelin tuma chutz mehannimtzaim bakkerakkim mippene sherubban lidlatot

Amar leumman ase li shene zogim echad ledelet veechad livhema ase li shette machtzelaot achat lishchiva veachat leohalim ase li shene sedinim echad letzurot veechad leohalim shenehen mekabbelin tuma ad sheyefaresh veyomar ze lechach veze lechach
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 9: Kal kele mattachot sheyyesh lahen shem bifne atzman mekabbelin tuma chutz min haddelet vehanneger vehammanul vehappotat shettachat hatztzir vehatztzir vehakkora vehatztzinnor mippene sheellu asuyin lekarka o leshammesh et haetz enan mekabbelin tuma vaafillu kodem sheyyikkavu vechal keli mattachot sheyyesh lo shem levay eno mittamme bifne atzmo mippene shehu kemiktzat keli ketzad akrav shel perumbeya tame ulchayayim shellah sheal lechaye habbehema mikkan umikkan tehorin veen mekabbelin tuma bifne atzman mippene sheen lahem shem bifne atzman uvishat chibburan hakkol mekabbel tuma
Tassin shel barzel shemmannichin al lechaye haadam bishat milchama enan mekabbelin tuma mippene sheen lahem shem bifne atzman veim yesh bahen bet kibbul mayim mittammein kechal keli kibbul

Nezem heasuy kikdera millematta vechaadasha millemala venifsak hakkedera shello mekabbelet tuma bifne atzmah shehare yesh lah bet kibbul vehaadasha mekabbelet tuma bifne atzmah mippene sheyyesh lah shem bifne atzmah vehatztzenira shellah shehi nichneset baozen o baaf enah mekabbelet tuma bifne atzmah haya hannezem asuy kemin eshkol venifrak tahor mippene sheen bo bet kibbul veen lechal gargir mimmennu shem bifne atzmo vahare eno rauy letachshit mishshennifrak
