Tabbaat achat shemmannichin habbanot beregel achat hi hannikret birit veenah mekabbelet tuma mippene sheen aleha tzurat keli tachshit ella kemo tabbaat hakkelim o tabbaat shekkosher bah ben ketefav aval shette tabbaot shemmesimot habbanot beraglehen veshalshelet muttelet benehen mizzo lezo mekabbelin tuma mippene shehen tachshite habbanot vehen hannikrain kevalim

Katla shel chulot shel mattechet vehem bechut shel tzemer o shel pishtan venifsak hachut hachulot mekabbelot tuma shekkal echad veechad keli bifne atzmo haya hachut shellah shel mattechet vehachulot shel avanim tovot veshel margaliyyot o shel zechuchit venishberu hachulot vehachut kayyam hare ze mittamme bifne atzmo sheyare katla kimlo tzavar ketanna

Kal hakkissuyin shel mattechet tehorin veen mekabbelin tuma mippene sheen lahem shem bifne atzman chutz mikkissuy hammecham umikkissuy teni shel rofin mippene shemmannichin bo et haispelanit naase keli kibbul
Kissuy shel mattechet sheshshafo velittesho veasahu mara hare ze mekabbel tuma

Kal hammishkolot shel mattachot mekabbelot tuma vehen hannikrain onkiot kene moznayim shel etz shehau onkiyyot shel barzel teluot bo mekabbelet tuma mippene haonkiyyot hatteluot bo bamme devarim amurim bemoznayim shel mochre pishtan umochre tzemer aval shel baale battim eno mekabbel tuma ad sheyyihu haonkiyyot kevuot bo
Mishkalot shennishtabberu af al pi shehechziran veshokel bahen enan mekabbelin tuma yiched mehen chatzae litrin shelishe litrin revie litrin hare ellu mekabbelin tuma
Sela shennifsela vehitkinah lihot shokel bah mekabbelet tuma

Unkeli shel kattafim tehora veshel rochlim mittammea unkeli shel naklite hammitta tehora veshel dargish mittammea unkeli shel kaveret hatztzayyadim shetztzadin bahen haddagim tahor veshel shidda mittammea unkeli shel menorot haetz tahor veshel shulchan mittammea ze hakkelal kal keli shemmekabbel tuma bifne atzmo min hattora hare haunkeli shel mattechet shello veshalshelet shello mekabbelet tuma uchli sheeno mekabbel tuma kegon peshute kele etz uchle etz habbaim bemidda vechayyotze bahen unkeli shel mattechet vehashshalshelet shello enan mekabbelin tuma vechal achat veachat bifne atzmah tehora sheen haunkeli o hashshalshelet keli bifne atzmo ella hare hen kemiktzat keli vaafillu unkeli shebbakketalim shettolin bah hakkelim vehabbegadim vechayyotze bahen tehora
Shalshelet sheyyesh bah bet neila mittammea vehaasuya lichfita tehora
Shalshelet shel sitonot mittammea mippene shehen noalin bah et hachanuyyot veshel baale battim tehora sheenah asuya ella lenoy
Shalshelet shel moshche karka vitedotehen shettokin bakkarka beshaa shemmoshchin mekabbelin tuma veshel mekoshshe etzim tehora lefi shehi meshammeshet et haetz
Shalshelet deli gadol arbaa tefachim mimmenna samuch laddeli mittammea im haddeli mippene shehi tzorech haddeli vehashshear tahor lefi sheen lo shem bifne atzmo veshalshelet deli katan asara tefachim

Hakkaddur shel mattechet vehassaddan vehakkantar shel bannay vehaddakkar shel charash vachamor shel nappach vehamtultelet vehammishkolot shel bannaim vehakkirayim shel barzel shechovtin bahem hazzetim vehaafarkes shel mattechet vehaolar shekkortin bo hassofrim rosh hakkulmos shel kane vehakkulmos shel mattechet vehakkan vehakkana shemmesartetin bo hassofrim kal ellu mekabbelin tuma shekkal echad mehen yesh lo shem bifne atzmo
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 10: Masmerot shemmachazikin bahen hattikra haasuyin litkoa oto beetzim enan mekabbelin tuma vechen hammasmerot shettokin otan bakketalim litlot bahen veim hitkino lihot keli bifne atzmo mekabbel tuma ketzad masmer shehitkino lihot poteach venoel bah o lehotzi et happetila o shennetano berechayim shel yad o shel chamor hare ze mekabbel tuma hitkino liftoach bo et hechavit tahor ad sheyyitzrefennu

Masmer heasuy kesiman lishmirat happetach eno mekabbel tuma vechen masmer shel shulchani shettole bo hammoznayim vehakkis tahor vechen teloye hammigradot tehorot af al pi shemmasmerin ellu meshunnin betzuratan mishshear masmerot hattekia
Masmer haggara vehu hakkeli shemmakkizin mekabbel tuma umasmer shel even hashshaot tahor
Masmer haggardi vehu hammasmer haaroch keen shippud shemmachnis bo haoreg shefoferet hakkane o haetz velofef aleha chutim mekabbel tuma

Ellu kele mattachot hammittammeot baagala haol shel mattechet vehakkatrav vehakkenafayim hamkabbelot et hartzuot uvarzel shettachat tzavvere habbehema vehassomech vehammachger vehattamchuyyot vehainbol vehatztzenira umasmer hamchabber et kullam veellu tehorim baagala haol shel etz hamtzuppe uchnafayim haasuyin lenoy vehashshefofarot hammashmiot et hakkol vehaavar shebbetzad tzavvere behema vehassovev shel galgal vehattassin vehatztzippuyin ushar kal hammasmerot shebbah tehorin
Akrav bet habbad mekabbel tuma aron shel garosot af al pi shehu tahor im hayeta tachtav agala shel mattechet hare zo mekabbelet tuma
Rechayim shel pilpelin mekabbelet tuma mishshum shelosha kelim mishshum keli mattachot umishshum keli kibbul umishshum kevara
Haddelet shel mattechet shebbemigdal shel baale battim enah mekabbelet tuma veshel rofim mekabbelet tuma mippene shemmannichim bah et haispelanit vetole bah et hammisparayim
Tassin shel mattechet shemmenaarin bahen et hakkedera mekabbelin tuma vehakkevuin bakkira tehorin
Hammelkachayim shemmemaech bahen et happetila mekabbelin tuma vehatztzinnorot shettofsot et harechayim millemala enan mekabbelot tuma mippene sheenan asuot ella lechazzek
Kelostera shennoalin bah haddelatot im hayeta shel mattechet mittammea hayeta shel etz umtzuppa mattechet tahor
Pika shel mattechet tehora lefi shehi meshammeshet et haetz

Hakkush vehappima vehammakkel vesimponya vechalil shel mattechet mekabbelin tuma hau shel etz umtzuppin mattechet tahor chutz min hassimponya sheim haya bah bet kibbul kenafayim af al pi shehi metzuppa temea
Hachatzotzeret shemmefutztzelet chulot chulot im en yodea lehachzirah ella umman hare zo mekabbelet tuma keshehi mechubberet veim yecholin hakkol lefarkah ulhachazirah enah mekabbelet tuma

Hakkatze shemmannichin happe alav bishat tekia mekabbel tuma bifne atzmo vehakkatze haacher harachav eno mekabbel tuma bifne atzmo uvishat chibbur hakkol tame kayyotze bo kene menora bifne atzman enan mekabbelin tuma mippene sheyyesh lahen shem levay happerach shellah vehabbasis mittammein bifne atzman uvishat chibbur hakkol tame

Korat hachitztzim shehi hammattara sheyyesh bah leshonot shel mattechet mekabbelet tuma veshemmannichim otah beragle haasurim tehora vehakkolar mekabbel tuma megera sheasa shinneha lechor haddelet af al pi shemmishtammesh bah enah mekabbelet tuma veim mishshennitmet asaah lechor haddelet hare zo betumatah ad sheyyikbaenna bemasmer hafachah ben millemala ben millematta ben min hatztzedadim tehora
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 11: Kamma shiur hashshever sheyyishshaver keli mattechet velo yekabbel tuma o yithar mittumato hakkol lefi ma shehu

Kal zeman shehakkeli yachol laasot meen melachto adayin hu keli vechashuv keli shalem ketzad keli shel mattechet shennishbar vahare hu yachol lemalleot bo hare hu keli keshehaya hakkumkum kede lachom bo chammin hammecham kede lekabbel selaim hallefas kede lekabbel kitonot shel mattechet hakkiton kede lekabbel perutot middot hayyayin kede lamod bahen hayyayin vechen middot hashshemen kede lamod bahen hashshemen mesannenet shel chardal shennifretzu bah shelosha nekavim millematta ze letoch ze tehora lefi sheenah meshammeshet meen melachtah magrefa shennittela kappah af al pi shehi kekurnas tehora sheenah osa meen melachtah ella meen hakkurnas vehi lo naaset litkoa bah kekurnas vechen kal kayyotze baze

Masrek shel tzemer shennittelu shinnav im nishtayyer bo shelosha bemakom echad tame hayeta hachitzona achat min hashshelosha tahor lefi sheeno yachol lisrok bo pishtan shehachitzona enah moelet lisrok vechal sheeno ose meen melachto bichli mattechet tahor nittelu min hammasrek shettayim vaasaan limlakketet temeot achat vehitkinah lener o lilpof aleha hachut lerikkum mekabbelet tuma veim hayeta hashshen ava ugdola af al pi shello hitkinah hare zo mittammet bifne atzmah
Masrek shel pishtan shennittelu shinnav venishtayyer bo shettayim tame nishtayyer bo achat tahor
Hakkerumim shennishberu veunkeli shellahen kayyemet temein shehare efshar lehotzi bahen haddeli min habbeer keshehau mikkodem
Megera shennittela shen achat mibbentayim tehora nishtayyer bah melo hassit bemakom echad temea shehare efshar lagor bannishar

Hammaatzad vehaizmel vehammafselet vehammakdeach shennifgemu adayin mekabbelin tuma nittal chissuman tehorin vechullan shennechleku lishnayim temein chutz min hammakdeach shehare eno yachol linkov bo veharunki bifne atzmah enah mekabbelet tuma mippene shehi miktzat keli

Hassayif vehassakkin vehassakkin heakom kemo maggal veharomach umaggal yad umaggal katzir vezug misparayim ketannim shel baale battim vezug misparayim gedolim shel sapparim shennechleku kal chelek mehen mekabbel tuma mippene shehu ose meen melachto
Misparayim shennechleka lishnayim tehora lefi sheenah maaveret et hassear ella bedochak

Shiron shennechlak learko tahor lerachbo im meshammesh meen melachto rishona tame meematay tahorato mishsheyyivle veeno meshammesh meen melachto bala venishtayyer bo rubbo im millemala tame veim millematta tahor kitztzetz mimmennu veasa chulya letachshit hare zo mekabbelet tuma
Shefoferet shel zehavim veshel zogin veshel nappachim veshel ose zechuchit shennechleka learkah tehora lerachbah im meshammeshet meen melachtah rishona temea veim lav tehora
Kalviya shel sapparim veshel rofim veshel ose zechuchit shennechleka lishnayim tehora veshel nappachim temea mippene shehu battechilla chote bah et haggechalim veachshav chote bah et haggechalim
Mara shel mattechet shennishbera o shennittashtesha im enah mara rov happanim tehora hayeta mara rov happanim adayin hi keli keshehayeta

Machat shennittal ketzatah hannakuv o ektzah tehora veim hitkinah lilpof aleha hachut lirkom bah temea aval machat shel sakkin shennittal ketzatah hannakuv temea mippene shehu roshem bakkatze hashsheni
Hammachat shelloffin aleha hashshani o hazzahav vechayyotze bahen kederech sheosin harokmin ben shennittal hannakuv shellah ben shennittal ektzah temea sheen melachtah hattefira
Machat sheheelta chaluda im meakkevet hattefira tehora veim lav temea
Hassayif vehassakkin sheheelu chaluda tehorin shefaan vehishchizan chazru letumatan hayeshana vechen tzinora sheppeshatah tehora kefafah chazra letumatah hayeshana

Mafteach akom kemo arkubba shennishbar mittoch arkubbotav tahor vechen mafteach heasuy kemin gam shennishbar mittoch gammo tahor shehare eno yachol liftoach bahen vahare enan meshammeshin meen melachtan hau bah shinnayim unkavim tame sheadayin hu mafteach nittelu hashshinnayim tame mippene hannekavim nistemu hannekavim tame mippene hashshinnayim nittelu hashshinnayim venistemu hannekavim o shennifretzu hannekavim ze letoch ze tahor

Keli sheyyesh berosho haechad kaf leharim bo haddeshen uvrosho hashsheni mazleg litzlot bo habbasar nittela kappo tame mippene shinnav nittelu shinnav tame mippene kappo vechen michchol shennittela kappo sheggorfin bah hakkechol tame mippene hazzachar shekkochalim bo haayin nittal hazzachar tame mippene hakkaf

Keli shebberosho kaf echad kisvacha litzlot alav uvakkatze hashsheni shinnayim lehotzi mehen habbasar min hakkedera o meal haesh nittela kappo tame mippene shinnav nittelu shinnav tame mippene kappo vechen et shel mattechet shekkotvin berosho haechad uvrosho hashsheni mochakin nittal hakkotev tame mippene hammochek nittal hammochek tame mippene hakkotev vechen kayyotze beellu vehu sheyyihye hannishar yachol laasot meen melachtan ketzad et shennittal hammochek shello venishar hakkotev im nishar mearko kede sheyyaga lekishre etzbeotav tame shehare efshar sheyyochaz bo veyichtov bo nittal hakkotev venishar hammochek im nishar mearko melo pas yado tame shehare efshar lo limchok bo nishar pachot mizze tahor vechen kal kayyotze baze
Kordom shennittal eshpo vehu hatztzad shehecharash menagger bo tame mippene bet bikkuo nittal bet bikkuo tame mippene bet ushpo nishbar makkifo tahor
Charchur shennifgam adayin hu keli ad sheyyinnatel rubbo nishbar makkifo tahor

Hammardea hu hammalmad vehu etz aroch av uchmo masmer chad takua biktzato millemala veze habbarzel nikra darvan uvakkatze hashsheni millematta mimmennu barzel kemo romach vehaetz nichnas veze habbarzel nikra charchur

Menikat shel mattechet shehi kemo shefoferet shennitmea mishsheyyikbaenna bammakkel o baddelet vichabberenna im haetz tithar lo nitmea ukvaah bammakkel o baddelet hare zo mekabbelet tuma bimkomah shekkal kele mattachot shekkevaam bekora o bakkotel mekabbelin tuma keshehau ad sheyeshanne et maasehem lefichach daf shel nachtomin shel mattechet shekkevao bakkotel tame vechen kal kayyotze baze mishshear kele mattachot shennikbeu ben mekabbelehen ben peshutehen mekabbelim tuma keshehau
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 12: Kele etz uchle or uchle etzem shennishberu tiharu mittumatan chazar veasa keli mishshivrehem o shekkibbetz et shivrehen veasa mehen kelim acherim hare ellu kishar hakkelim hattehorim shello nitmeu mikkodem shehen mekabbelin tuma mikkan ulhabba vechen kele mattachot shennishberu achar shennitmeu tiharu hittichan vechazar veasa mehen kelim acherim chazru lattuma hayeshana veen lichle mattachot tahora gemura ad sheyyatbilem bemikve keshehem shelemim o yishshaaru shevurim

Vachazarat kele mattachot letumatan hayeshana middivre sofrim umippene ma gazru al kele mattachot sheyyachzeru letumatan hayeshana gezera shemma yetamme lo keli veyattichennu veyaase mimmennu keli acher bo beom im yomar shehu tahor kedin tora yavo lomar hashshevira metaheret vehattevila metaheret keshem sheim nishbar vehitticho veasa mimmennu keli keshehaya hare hu tahor bo bayyom kach im hitbilo af al pi shehu keshehaya hare hu tahor bo bayyom veyavou lomar sheen hakkelim tzerichin haarev shemesh mippene ze hachashash gazru tuma alehem

Echad keli shennitma bemet o bishar hattumot im hitticho chazar letumato hayeshana ad sheyyatbil nitma bemet vehizza alav bashshelishi veachar kach hitticho vaasaahu keli acher vehizza alav bashshevii vehitbilo hare ze tame veen hazzaya shekkodem hittuch mitztarefet lehazzaa sheachar hittuch veen lo tahora ad sheyyazze alav shelishi ushvii veyatbil keshehu keli kodem shevira o yazze alav shelishi ushvii veyatbil achar sheyyattichennu

Barzel tame shebbelalo im barzel tahor im rov min hattame tame veim rov min hattahor tahor mechetza lemechetza tame vechen tit shebbelalo biglalim vesaraf hakkol bechivshan vaasaahu keli im rov min hattit hare ze mekabbel tuma mippene shehu keli cheres veim rov min haggelalim eno mekabbel tuma
Kele mattachot hattehorin sheanachan baanach tame temeim aval haose kelim min haanach hattame hare hen tehorin
Kordom sheasaahu min habbarzel hattahor veasa ushpo min hattame hare ze tame asa ushpo min hattahor vehakkordom min hattame hare ze tahor shehakkol holech achar ose hammelacha
Kordom tahor shechasamo bevarzel tame tahor
Kiton sheasaahu min hattame veshulav min hattahor tahor asaahu min hattahor veshulav min hattame tame shehakkol holech achar hamkabbel haose melacha

Keli mattachot shennitma betuma shehi middivre sofrim kegon shennitma baavoda zara vechayyotze bah venishbar vehitticho vechazar veasa mimmennu keli acher hare ze safek im chazar letumato hayeshana o lo chazar

Kele zechuchit shennitmeu venishberu taharu kechal hakkelim vaafillu hittichan veasa mehen kelim acherim enam chozrim lattuma hayeshana lefi sheikkar tumatah middivre sofrim kemo shebbearnu lo gazru alehen betuma yeshana vechen kele zechuchit shennishberu af al pi sheshshivrehen kelim uruyin letashmish hoil vehem shivre kelim enan mekabbelin tuma lefi sheenan domin lichle cheres ketzad keara shel zechuchit shennishbera vehitkin shulayim letashmish en hashshulayim mekabbelin tuma af al pi shehen bakkeara veim kirsem et mekom hashshever veshafo beshufin hare zo mekabbelet tuma

Tzelochit ketanna hannittelet beyad achat shennittal piha mekabbelet tuma mippene sheen machnisin hayyad letochah ella yotzek mimmenna aval gedola hannittelet bishte yadayim shennittal piha tehora mippene shehi chovelet bayyad beshaa shemmachnis yado letochah vechen tzelochit shel palyaton af al pi shehi ketanna im nittelet piha tehora mippene shechovelet beetzbao beshaa shemmotzi habboshom mittochah
Laginim haggedolin shennittal pihen adayin hen kelim mippene shemmatkinam hu lechivshanim
Kos shennifgam rubbo tahor nifgam bo shelish hekkefo berov gavho tahor nikkav ustamo ben bevaatz ben bezefet tahor vehakkos vehatztzelochit shennikkevu ben millemala ben millematta tehorin
Hattamchuy vehakkeara shennikkevu millemala temein millematta tehorin nisdeku im yecholin lekabbel et hachammin ketzonnin temein veim lav tehorin
Hakkosot hachatuchin af al pi shessiftotehem sorchin et happe mekabbelim tuma
Haafarkes shel zechuchit tahor shehare hu kemo machatz sheeno mekabbel

Zechuchit sheosin otah lemara tehora af al pi shehi mekabbelet lefi shello naaset lekabbala hattarvad shel zechuchit shehu mekabbel af al pi shekkeshemmannicho al hashshulchan nehpach al tziddo veeno mekabbel hare ze mekabbel tuma

Tamchuy shel zechuchit sheasao mara mekabbel tuma veim mittechilla asauhu lemara kede sheyyihu devarim shemmannichin bo nirin meachorav hare ze tahor vechal kele zechuchit en mekabbelin tuma ad shettiggamer melachtan kechal hakkelim
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 13: Kevar bearnu bechamma mekomot sheen keli cheres mittamme ella meaviro o behesset hazzav ushar kal hakkelim shennaga bahen hattuma nitmeu veim nichnesa tuma laaviro velo naga bahen hare hem tehorin nimtza hattame bichli cheres tahor bechal hakkelim vehattame bechal hakkelim tahor bichli cheres uminnayin sheen keli cheres mittamme ella meaviro shenneemar uchli cheres asher yippol mehem el tocho vego mittocho hu mittamme lo meachorav

Uchshem shemmittamme meaviro kach metamme ochalin umashkin meaviro ketzad keli cheres shennitma venichnesu ochalin umashkin laaviro af al pi shello nagu bo hare ellu temein shenneemar kl asher betocho yitma aval shear hakkelim hattemein enan metammein ochalin umashkin ad sheyyiggeu bahen

En keli cheres metamme kelim meaviro ben kele cheres ben shear kelim ketzad keli cheres gadol shehau betocho kelim venichnesa tuma baaviro hu tame vechal hakkelim shebbetocho tehorin hau mashkin bakkelim shebbetocho nitmeu hammashkin meaviro vechozrin umtammein et hakkelim vahare ze omer metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani

Keli cheres shennagu mashkin temein baachorav bilvad nitmeu achorav kishar kal hakkelim bamme devarim amurim beshehaya lo toch aval im en lo toch venagu bo mashkin temein hare ze tahor shekkal sheen lo toch bichli cheres en achorav mittammein bemashkin nagu ochalin o mashkin baachore keli cheres hattame hare ellu temein veechad keli cheres veechad shear kal hakkelim bedavar ze shekkal hakkelim hattemein shennagu ochalin o mashkin bahen ben mittochan ben meachorehen nitmeu

Echad keli cheres shennichnesa tuma laaviro o shekkafahu al hattuma hammunnachat al haaretz venaasa ohel aleha shehare hattuma betocho mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar el tocho lerabbot et haohalim

Guma shehaya hashsheretz munnach betochah vechafa keli cheres al hagguma lo nitma shenneemar el tocho ad shettikkanes atzmah shel tuma betocho lefichach hashsheretz shennimtza lematta minnechushto shel tannur shehi karkait hattannur tahor sheani omer chay nafal veachshav met betoch guma zo vechen im nimtzet machat o tabbaat lematta minnechushto af al pi shekkal hakkelim hannimtzaim temeim kemo shebbearnu hare hattannur tahor sheani omer sham hau ad shello ba hattannur vehattannur nivna alehen velo naflu betocho nimtzeu baddeshen hare hattannur tame sheen lo bema yitle nimtzeu binchushto shel tannur nirin aval enan yotzin laaviro im ofe et habbatzek vehu nogea bahen nitma hattannur keillu hau betoch aviro veim lav hattannur tahor keillu hau lematta minnechushto bee ze batzek amru bevatzek habbenoni sheeno rach beoter velo kashe

Hashsheretz shennimtza beayin shel tannur beayin shel kira beayin shel kuppach im nimtza min hassafa happenimit velachutz tahor vechen im nimtza baavir haayin tahor shehare lo nichnas laavir hattannur o hakkira o hakkuppach ella tachat ovi dafnotehen hu taluy vaafillu haya sham kezayit min hammet tehorin ella im ken haya baovi haayin poteach tefach shehare mevi et hattuma laavir hattannur kemo shennitbaer beinyan tumat met
Nimtza hashsheretz bimkom hannachat haetzim min hassafa happenimit velachutz tahor nimtza bimkom yeshivat habballan bimkom yeshivat hatztzabba bimkom yeshivat sholke hazzetim hakkol tahor
En hattannur velo hakkira velo shear mekomot hayekod mittammein ella im ken nimtzet hattuma min hassetima ulfanim

Keli cheres sheshshotin bo baale battim hammayim shebbeemtzao kemo reshet shel cheres usfato shellemala min hareshet kemo masrek vezehu hannikra tzartzur im nichnesa hattuma laavir hammasrek lemala min hareshet nitma kullo shezzehu tocho shel keli ze

Keli cheres shehaya lo shalosh sefaot zo lefanim mizzo hayeta happenimit odefet venichnesa tuma laavir happenimit kal haochalin vehammashkin shebbaavir shebben hassafa happenimit uven haemtzait vehachitzona tehorin hayeta haemtzait odefet venitma avirah mimmenna velifnim tame mimmenna velachutz tahor hayeta hachitzona odefet venitma avirah hakkol tame hau shaot kal shennitma avirah temea vehashshear tahor

Ilpasim zo betoch zo vesiftotehen shaot vehashsheretz baelona o battachtona zo sheyyesh bah hashsheretz temea ushar hailpasin tehorin hen vechal haochalin shebbahen haya kal ilpas mehen nekuva bechones mashke vehashsheretz baelona kal haochalin vehammashkin shebbechal hailpasim temeim shehattuma baavir kullan kemo sheyyitbaer haya hashsheretz battachtona hi temea vechullan tehorot shehare lo nichnas sheretz laavir haelona veen sefat hattachtona odefet kede letamme kal haochalin vehammashkin shebbetochah haya hashsheretz baelona vehayeta sefat hattachtona odefet haelona temea shehashsheretz betochah vechen hattachtona mippene shessefatah odefet hare hashsheretz baavirah ushar hailpasin shebbetoch hattachtona tehorin sheen keli cheres metamme kelim shebbetocho veim haya benehen mashke tofeach kal sheyyesh bah mashke tofeach temea shehammashke mittamme meavir hattachtona haodefet vechozer umtamme et hailpas

Tavla shel cheres shehau kearot devukot bah bitchillat maaseha vahare hakkol keli echad venitmet achat mehen lo nitmeu kullan veim haya lattavla dofen odef shennimtzeu kal hakkearot betocho venitmet achat mehen nitmeu kullan vechen haddin bevet hattavlin shel cheres vekalmirin hammatimot kayyotze bo

Bet hattavlin shel etz shennitma echad mibbattav bemashkin lo nitmeu shear habbattim veim yesh lo dofen odef shennimtzeu kal habbattim betocho venitma echad mibbattav bemashkin nitmeu kullan shehakkol kichli echad uchli shennitma tocho bemashkin nitma kullo hau battav kevuin bemasmer hare ellu chibbur ze laze letuma ulhazzaya hau tekuin bilvad hare ellu chibbur letuma velo lehazzaya veim hau battav nittalin venittanin enan chibbur lo letuma velo lehazzaya
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 14: Kal hammatztzil betzamid patil beohel hammet matztzil betzamid potil boavir keli cheres im hitztzil bemet hechamur din hu sheyyatztzil bichli cheres hakkal vechal sheeno matztzil beohel hammet eno matztzil baavir keli cheres

Uchshem sheen tzamid patil letuma beohel hammet kach en tzamid patil letuma baavir keli cheres ketzad kedera shehi melea ochalin umashkin umukkefet tzamid patil untuna betoch hattannur hattame hare hakkedera vechal ma shebbetochah tehorin haya hashsheretz o mashkin temein betochah umukkefet tzamid patil untuna baavir hattannur nitma hattannur vechen kal kayyotze baze

Tabbaat temea shemmuvlaat betoch hallevena o machat temea shemmuvlaat betoch haetz venaflu laavir keli cheres nitma af al pi sheim naga kikkar teruma beetz ze o bilvena zo tahor hare hen metammein keli cheres meaviro

Tarnegol shebbala sheretz o besar met venafal laavir hattannur hare ze tahor veim met sham hattarnegol nitma hattannur shehabbeluin bechay matztzilin miyyad keli cheres kederech shemmatztzilin beohel hammet

Devarim shebbetoch happe o betoch hakkematin enan kivluin ketzad adam shehau mashkin temein betoch piv vekafatz piv vehichnis rosho laavir keli cheres timmeahu vechen tahor shehau ochalin umashkin letoch piv vehichnis rosho laavir tannur tame nitmeu ochalim shebbefiv haya lo betoch kumto kaadasha min hashsheretz vehichniso laavir hattannur nitma hattannur af al pi shehattuma betoch hakkemet

Sefog shebbala mashkin temein af al pi shehu naguv mibbachutz im nafal laavir keli cheres timmeahu shessof mashke latzet vechen chaticha shel lefet veshel gemi charasim shennishtammeshu bahen mashkin temein veniggevu venaflu laavir keli cheres lo timmeuhu naflu letannur vehussak nitma shessof mashke latzet bamme devarim amurim bemashkin kallin aval bachamurin kegon dam hannidda umeme ragleha im hau yecholin latzet vehikpid alav sheyyetze hare ze metamme hattannur af al pi shello hussak veim eno makpid alav eno metamme ad sheyyussak veyetze hammashke vechen begefet chadasha habbaa mimmashkin temein shehussak bah hattannur nitma shessof mashke latzet aval bishana tahor ezo hi yeshana leachar shenem asar chodesh veim yadua sheyyatza mimmenna mashke bishat hessek afillu leachar shalosh shanim nitma hattannur kesheyyussak

Keli cheres shechilleko bimchitztza missefato ad karkaito venichnesa tuma baavir echad mishshene hachalakim nitma hakkeli kullo lefi sheen derech bene adam lechallek kele cheres kederech shecholkin haohalim lefichach tannur shechatzatzo binsarim o biriot venimtza hashsheretz bemakom echad hakkol tame

Keli shehayeta hattuma betocho vehichnis hakkeli laavir keli cheres usfat hakkeli hattame chutz lichli cheres af al pi shehattuma mechuvenet betoch keli cheres hare ze tahor shenneemar el tocho lo el toch tocho

Vechen im haya keli cheres tame vehichnis laaviro keli acher sheyyesh bo ochalim umashkin usfat hakkeli haacher chutz lichli cheres af al pi shehaochalin vehammashkin mechuvanin betoch keli cheres hattame hare ellu tehorin shenneemar kl asher betocho yitma velo shebbetoch tocho ketzad kaveret o kuppa o kedera o chemet vechayyotze bahen shehaya hashsheretz betochah veshilshel hakkuppa laavir hechavit o laavir hattannur af al pi shehashsheretz mechuvan betoch avir hechavit hoil usfat hakkuppa o hachemet lemala missefat hechavit o missefat hattannur hare ellu tehorin veim haya betoch hachemet o betoch hakkedera vechayyotze bahen ochalin o mashkin veshilshelan laavir hattannur o laavir hechavit hattemein hare hen tehorin hayeta hakkaveret o hakkuppa o hachemet vechayyotze bahen nekuvin enan matztzilin ella im haya hashsheretz letochan veshilshelan laavir keli cheres hattahor nitma veim hau ochalin o mashkin letochan veshilshelan laavir keli cheres hattame nitmeu vechamma yihye bannekev im haya bichli shetef bemotzi zetim veim haya bichli cheres heasuy laochalin shiuro kezetim veheasuy lemashkin shiuro bechones mashke veheasuy lechach vechach metilin oto lechumro uchsheyyinnakev keli cheres ze bechones mashke eno matztzil miyyad keli cheres

Satam nekev keli cheres bezefet im haya hashsheretz bichli ze veshilshelo laavir hattannur hattahor nitma sheen hatztzamid matztzil al hattuma milletamme kemo shebbearnu aval im haya bichli ze ochalin o mashkin veshilshelo laavir hattannur hattame hare hen tehorin shehare hannekev satum ushar kal hakkelim shessetaman bezefet vechayyotze bo eno matztzil miyyad keli cheres
Kaveret pechuta af al pi shessatam happechat bekash enah matztzelet miyyad keli cheres shehare enah keli

Hachemet vehakkefisha shennifchatu bemotzi rimmon af al pi shebbittelo mittorat keli hare ellu matztzilin miyyad keli cheres vehu sheyyihye happechat lemala missefat keli cheres mibbachutz veyihye bet kibbul shellahen meshulshal letoch keli cheres

Or pashut vechayyotze bo shehaya shakua laavir keli cheres o laavir hattannur vehashsheretz betoch haor hare hattannur tame veim haya hashsheretz battannur ochalin umashkin shebbetoch haor temein sheen matztzil miyyad keli cheres ella kelim sheyyesh lahen toch kegon hassal vehakkuppa vehachemet

Keli cheres shehayeta tuma betocho vehaya keli cheres tahor kafuy al pi hakkeli hattame o shehaya hakkeli shehattuma devuka betocho kafuy al pi hakkeli hattahor af al pi sheavir shenehen meorav hattame betumato vehattahor betahorato shehare lo nichnesa hattuma atzmah laavir keli cheres hattahor lefichach chavit shehayeta melea mashkin tehorin untuna lematta minnechushto shel tannur venafal sheretz letoch hattannur hare hechavit vehammashkin tehorin af al pi sheavir hattannur meorav im avir hechavit vechen im hayeta hechavit kefuya al pi hattannur ufiha laavir hattannur afillu hammashke shebbeshule hechavit tahor
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 15: En keli cheres mekabbel tuma ad shettiggamer melachto umeemotay hu gemar melachto mishsheyyitzrefo bechivshan hattannur mishsheyyassikennu leefot sufganin hakkira mishsheyyassikenna kede levashshel aleha betzat hattarnegolin terufa untuna beilpas hakkuppach im asaahu laafiyya shiuro ketannur asaahu levishshul shiuro kechira

Tannur shehitchil livnoto im haya gadol mishsheyyatchil bo arbaa tefachim veyassikennu mekabbel tuma veim haya katan mishsheyyatchil bo tefach veyassikennu hakkira mishsheyyatchil bah shalosh etzbaot veyassikenna hakkuppach im asaahu laafiyya hare hu ketannur veim levashshel hare hu kechira

Tannur shehussak meachorav o shehussak mibbet haumman o shehussak shello ledaat hoil vehussak mikkal makom hare ze mekabbel tuma maase shennafla deleka betannur bichfar min hakkefarim uva maase lifne bet din veamru mekabbel tuma
Tannur shehissiko lihot tzole bo hare ze mekabbel tuma lelabben bo unin shel pishtan tahor sheen ze ose melacha beguf hattannur

Tannur shechatzatzo lishnayim vehissik echad mechalakav venitma bemashkin hu tame vachavero tahor nitma besheretz vechayyotze bo mittumot shel tora hakkol tame veovi shebbenehen tame husseku shenehen venitma echad mehen bemashkin baavir cholkin et avo hamshammesh letame tame letahor tahor bamme devarim amurim bizman shechatzatzo veachar kach hissiko aval hissiko veachar kach chatzatzo venitma echad mehen afillu bemashkin nitma hakkol

Tannur o kira shel even tehorin leolam veshel mattechet tehorin mishshum tannur vechirayim shenneemar yuttatz et sheyyesh lo netitza umtammein mishshum kele mattachot ketzad en mittammein meaviran velo bimchubbar lakkarka ketannur vechirayim veim naga bahen tuma afillu meachorehen mittammein kishar kele mattachot veim nitmeu bemet naasin av tuma kishar kele mattachot veyesh lahen tahora bemikve

Tannur shel mattechet shennikkav o nifgam o nisdak ustamo betit o sheasa lo tefela shel tit o musaf shel tit hare ze mittamme mishshum tannur vechamma yihye bannekev kede sheyyetze bo haur vechen bechira veim asa lakkira pitputim shel tit mittammea mishshum kira merchah betit ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz adayin enah mekabbelet tuma
Tannur sheeno mechubbar baaretz afillu taluy betzavar haggamal hare ze tame mishshum tannur shenneemar temeim hem bechal makom
Kur shel tzorfe mattachot sheyyesh bo bet shefita mittamme kechira vechen kirat shel ose zechuchit im yesh bo bet shefita mekabbelet tuma
Kivshan shel sayyadin veshel zoggin veshel yotzrin tehorin happurna im yesh lah dofen mittammea

Avanim shechibberan zo lazo vaasaan tannur im asa lo tefela mibbifnim umibbachutz hare ze ketannur lechal davar umittamme meaviro veim tefalo mibbachutz bilvad mittamme bemagga velo baavir chibber avanim lattannur velo chibberan zo lazo mittammeot im hattannur chibberan zo lazo velo chibberan lattannur hare hen ketira chafar baaretz veasa tira tahor vetirat hakkira tahor
Shette chaviyyot ushne ilpasin sheasaan kira mittammein baavir uvmagga vetochan shel chaviyyot tahor vaovi hechaviyyot cholkin oto hamshammesh et hakkira tame vehamshammesh et toch hechavit tahor

Haose shelosha pitputin baaretz vechibberan betit lihot shofet alehen et hakkedera hare zo temea mishshum kira kava shelosha masmerin baaretz lihot shofet alehen et hakkedera af al pi sheasa beroshah makom betit shetteshev hakkedera hare zo tehora kechira shel mattechet vechen avanim shello mercham betit shehu shofet alehen enan mekabbelot tuma keillu hi kira shel even
Haose shette avanim kira vechibberan betit mittammea chibber et haachat betit vehashsheniyya lo chibberah enah mekabbelet tuma
Haeven shehu shofet aleha veal hattannur aleha veal hakkira aleha veal hakkuppach temea aleha veal hakkotel aleha veal hassela enah mekabbelet tuma
Kirat hattabbachim shehu noten even betzad even vechullan mechubbarot betit nitmet achat mehen lo nitmeu kullan

Shalosh avanim shechibberan betit vaasaan shette kirot ben shechibberan zo lazo velo chibberan lakkarka ben shechibberan bakkarka velo chibberan zo lazo im nitmet achat mishshete hakkirot haeven haemtzait hamshammesh mimmenna lakkira hattemea tame vehamshammesh mimmenna lakkira hattehora tahor nittela haeven hachitzona shel kira hattehora huchleta haemtzait kullah letuma nittela hachitzona shel kira hattemea tahara haeven haemtzait kullah nitmeu shette hachitzonot im hayeta haeven haemtzait gedola noten mimmenna lechira zo kede shefita mitztziddah velakkira hashsheniyya kede shefita mikkan vehashshear tahor veim hayeta ketanna hakkol tame nittela haemtzait im yachol lishpot al shettayim chitzonot yora gedola hare hi temea hau meruchakin yeter mizze tehora hechezir et haemtzait hare hakkol tahor keshehaya merchah betit mekabbel tuma mikkan ulhabba vehu sheyyassikenna lechal achat mehen kede levashshel aleha et habbetza

Shette avanim sheasaan kira venitmet vesamach leeven zo mimmenna even achat mikkan velazo even achat mikkan hare chatzi kal even mishshete avne hakkira harishona tame vachatzi haeven tahor nittelu hashshettayim hattehorot shessamach chazru hashshettayim shel kira letumatan

Duchan shel cheres sheyyesh lo bet kibbul hakkederot veharemetz natun betocho tahor mishshum kira vetame mishshum keli kibbul lefichach im haya mechubbar baaretz tahor kishar hakkelim veim nikkav eno mekabbel tuma kichli kibbul ma sheen ken bechira hatztzedadin shello hannogea bahen eno tame mishshum kira harachav shello sheyyoshvin alav bishat bishshul mittamme im nitma hadduchan vechen hakkofe et hassal uvana kira al gabbah hare zo temea mishshum keli etz lo mishshum kira lefichach enah mekabbelet tuma meavirah kechira
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 16: Tannur gadol sheyarav arbaa tefachim vehakkatan sheyarav rubbo ketzad im nishbar baggadol arbaa uvakkatan rubbo mekabbel tuma pachot mikkan eno mekabbel tuma vechen im nitma venittetzo ad sheshshiyyer bo pachot mearbaa baggadol o befachot merov bakkatan tahor nishar bo arbaa o rov bakkatan adayin hu betumato vehakkira sheyareha shalosh etzbaot hakkuppach sheasaahu laafiyya shiuro ketannur levishshul shiuro kechira

Tannur shennitma velo ratza lechatteto ketzad metaharin oto cholko lishlosha chalakim vegorer et hattefela sheal hacharasim ad shennimtza kal cheres mehen omed al haaretz belo tit al gabbav chilleko lishnayim echad gadol veechad katan haggadol tame vehakkatan tahor chilleko lishnayim beshave kal echad mehen tame lefi shei efshar lechaven aval tavla shel cheres sheyyesh lah dofen shennechleka lishnayim tehora veim haya echad gadol veechad katan haggadol tame

Tannur shechilleko lishlosha veechad gadol kishnayim haggadol tame vehashshenayim hakketannim tehorin chatacho chulot lerachbo im haya govah kal chulya vechulya pachot mearbaa tefachim tahor chazar vesidder hachulot zo al gabbe zo vehimriach alehem betit vehecheziro tannur keshehaya hare zo kemo sheasa tannur acher veeno mekabbel tuma ella mikkan ulhabba vehu sheyyassikennu kede leefot bo sufganin achar shemmercho hirchik mimmennu et hattefela venatan chol o tzerorot ben hachulot uven hattefela eno mekabbel tuma leolam vezehu sheamru hannidda vehattehora ofot bo vehu tahor hayeta bo chulya achat sheyyesh bah arbaa tefachim hi mittammea bemagga velo mittammet baavir ushar hachulot tehorot

Tannur shebba mechuttach mibbet haumman veasa lo semochin shemmekabbetzin oto lihot keechad untanam alav vehu tahor venitma kesheyyasir et hassomchin oto yithar vaafillu hechziran hare hu tahor mercho betit mekabbel tuma lehabba veeno tzarich lehassiko shekkevar hussak
Tannur shechatacho chulot venatan chol ben chulya lechulya vetach betit al hakkol mibbachutz hare ze mekabbel tuma
Yorat haarviyyim shehu chofer baaretz vetach betit im yuchal hattit laamod bifne atzmo mekabbelet tuma veim lav tahor
Hammevi shivre cheres vedibbekan ze baze vaasaan tannur veasa lo tefela mibbayit umibbachutz vehissiko hare ze mekabbel tuma af al pi sheen bechal echad mehen kashshiur

Pittam shekkirzelo vaasaahu tannur veasa lo tefela michutz af al pi shemmekabbel al dafnotav kashshiur hare ze tahor shekkeli cheres shettahar en lo tuma leolam ella im ken asaahu tannur veasa lo tefela mibbayit umibbachutz

Tannur shel sedakin sheasa tefela lechal echad veechad umkom hassedakin megulle eno mekabbel tuma natan tit o sid o gafsis al gabbe hassedakin hare ze mittamme natan alehen charsit o zefet vegafrit shaava ushmarim batzek o gelalim tahor ze hakkelal davar sheen osin mimmennu tannur eno mechabber et hassedakin
Sedek tannur shennetano kelappe zavit umereach betit min hatztzedadin tahor
Daf shel tannur shennetano bezavit lihot ofe bo tahor veim yesh bo rov tannur mekabbel tuma
Tannur shennatan bo afar ad chetzo im nitma meaviro bilvad eno mittamme ella meafar ulmala veim nitma bemagga venaga tuma bo mittocho nitma kullo af meafar ulmatta

Hakkira mekom shefitat shette kederot vehakkuppach mekom shefitat kedera achat lefichach kira shennechleka learkah tehora lerachbah adayin mekabbelet tuma hakkuppach shennechlak ben learko ben lerachbo tahor

Hakkelatot shel baale battim shennifchata karkaitah im haya omek happechat pachot mishshelosha tefachim hare zo mekabbelet tuma sheim yassik bappechat millematta titbashshel hakkedera millemala haya happechat amok shelosha o yeter enah mekabbelet tuma shehare haesh rechoka min hakkedera veenah beshela natan even o tzeror al pi happechat adayin hi betahoratah mercho betit naaset haeven karka hakkira umkabbelet tuma mikkan ulhabba
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 17: Kal yedot hakkelim hare hen kechelim veim nitma hakkeli nitoma yado hatztzarich lah betashmisho vesheen tzarich lah tahor kemo sheyyitbaer lefichach haeven hayyotzet min hattannur tefach umin hakkira shalosh etzbaot chibbur veim nitma hattannur vehakkira nitmeu avanim ellu vaochalin umashkin hannogin baavanim ellu nitmeu veim nagu bechutz letefach shel tannur o bechutz leshalosh etzbaot shel kira tehorin
Hakkuppach asaahu laafiyya shiuro ketannur asaahu levishshul shiuro kechira
Musaf hattannur shel baale battim tahor veshel nachtomin tame betumat hattannur mippene shessomech alav et hashshippud kayyotze bo musaf yora shel sholke zetim tame veshel tzabbaim tahor

Ateret hakkira tehora vetirat hattannur vehu hammakom habbanuy betziddo shemmannichin bo et happat beet rediyyatah bizman shehi gevoha arbaa tefachim temea betumat hattannur pachot mearbaa tefachim tehora lefi sheenah chibbur lo veim chibberah lattannur afillu al shalosh avanim temea

Bet happach uvet hattavlin uvet hanner shebbakkira im nitmet hakkira bemagga nitmeu kullan veim nitmet baavir lo nitmeu lefi sheenan chibbur lah ella middivre sofrim ulfichach asu lah hekker kede shello yissarfu al maggaan teruma vekadashim vechen kal sheanu omrin beinyan ze shehu mittamme bemagga veeno mittamme baavir eno chibbur ella middivrehem veasu lo hekker ze kede shello yissarfu alav kadashim ella tolin

Chatzar hakkira bizman shehi gevoha shalosh etzbaot hare zo chibbur veim nitmet hakkira o chatzerah ben baavir ben bemagga nitmet hashsheniyya hayeta hechatzer pechuta mikkan venitmet achat mehen bemagga nitmet hashsheniyya aval im nitmet achat mehen meavirah bilvad en chavertah temea lefi sheenah chibbur lah ella middivrehem hayeta chatzar hakkira mufreshet mimmenna bizman shehi gevoha shalosh etzbaot hare zo chibbur lah ben letumat magga ben letumat avir hayeta pachot mikkan o shehayeta hechatzer chalaka veen lah safa en chibbur lah veim nitmet hakkira ben meavirah ben bemagga hechatzer tehora vechen im nitmet hechatzer hakkira tehora

Pitpute kira shelosha haya govah kal echad mehen shalosh etzbaot o pachot im nitmet hakkira ben bemagga ben baavir nitmeu shelashtan vechen im hau arbaa nittal echad mehen im nitmet hakkira bemagga nitmeu shene happitputim shennisharu veim nitmet baavir lo nitmeu immah asa lah shene happitputim ze keneged ze im nitmet hakkira bemagga nitmeu veim nitmet baavir lo nitmeu hau happitputim gevohin mishshalosh etzbaot ulmatta mittammein immah ben shennitmet bemagga ben shennitmet baavir umishshalosh ulmala mittammein immah im nitmet bemagga aval im nitmet meavirah bilvad en mittammein immah hau meshuchin min hassafa betoch shalosh etzbaot mittammein immah ben shennitmet bemagga ben shennitmeta baavir hau chutz leshalosh etzbaot mittammein immah im nitmet bemagga veim nitmet baavir bilvad en mittammein immah veen medakdekin bechal hashshiurin haellu shekkullan hen middivre sofrim
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 18: Keli cheres eno mekabbel tuma ad sheyyihye mekabbel veasuy lekabbalo aval im lo haya lo bet kibbul o shehaya mekabbel velo naasa lekabbala eno mekabbel tuma kelal lo min hattora velo middivre sofrim lefichach hakkisse vehammitta vehassafsal vehammenora vehashshulchan shel cheres vechen kal kayyotze bahen mikkelim sheen lahem toch enan mekabbelin tuma vechen hassilonot shehammayim mehallechin bahen af al pi shehen kefufin veaf al pi shehen mekabbelin hare hen tehorin mippene shello naasu lekabbala ella kede sheyyetzu mehen hammayim vechen chavit shel shayyatim vechavit haddefuna beshule hammachatz hoil venaaset kemo bet yad shennosin bah hammachatz velo naaset lekabbala enah mekabbelet tuma
Panas shehaya bo bet kibbul shemen mekabbel tuma vesheen bo tahor vechen megufat hayyotzrim sheyyesh lah toch temea
Mashpech shel baale battim tahor veshel rochlin mittamme mippene shemmattehu al tziddo umeriach bo lallokeach
Kissuy kadde yayin vechadde shemen vehechaviyyot tehorot shello naasu lekabbala veim hitkinan letashmish mittammein

Kissuy hailpas bizman shehu nakuv veyesh lo chiddud tahor veim eno nakuv veen lo chiddud mittamme mippene shehaishsha mesannenet letocho et hayyarak ze hakkelal kal hamshammesh bichli cheres keshehu kafuy tahor
Titros af al pi shehu nakuv umotzi perutot mittamme shehare hammayim mitkannesin batztzedadin vehen asuyin lekabbala
Hallappid shel cheres shemmannichin matliyyot habbegadim vehashshemen betocho vehu dolek mittamme vechen keli shemmannichin tachat hannerot lekabbel hashshemen mittamme
Gistera shemmannichin tachat hakkelim lekabbel mashkin hannozlin min hakkeli mekabbelin tuma
Sefina shel cheres af al pi shehi mekabbelet enah mekabbelet tuma sheen hassefina bichlal hakkelim haamurin battora ben hi shel cheres ben hi shel etz ben gedola ben ketanna

Kal hakkelim shennishberu venifseda tzuratan en shivrehen mekabbelin tuma af al pi sheotan hashshevarim reuyin letashmish chutz mishshivre kele cheres sheim haya bahen cheres harauy lekabbel hare hu mekabbel tuma shenneemar vechal keli cheres mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze lo ba lerabbot ella shivre kele cheres bamme devarim amurim keshehaya lecheres ze toch lekabbel bo hammashkin keshehaya hacheres yoshev lo samuch aval im eno yachol lekabbel ella im ken somchin oto eno mekabbel tuma

Hacheres sheeno yachol leshev kede sheyekabbel mippene azno o shehaya bo chiddud vehachiddud machrio letzad acher hare ze tahor af al pi shennittela haozen o nishbar hachiddud shekkal keli cheres shettahar shaa achat en lo tuma leolam

Kele cheres sheshshulehen chaddin kemizrakot shennishberu veshulehen mekabbelin af al pi sheenan mekabbelin ella im ken nismechu kegon shule hakkurfiot vehakkosot hare ellu mekabbelin tuma shellechach naasu mittechillatan sheyyihu shulehen mekabbelin bismicha o baachiza

Kamma yekabbel hacheres veyihye mekabbel tuma im haya hakkeli keshehaya shalem umechil kede sikkat adam katan ad chaviyyot shehen mekabbelot kisah o karov venishberu venishar bacharasim ben mikkarkeehen ben middafnehen cheres shehu mekabbel keshehu yoshev reviit hare ze mekabbel tuma

Haya hakkeli mechavit hammechila kisa ad chavit hamchila satayim o yeter venishbera im haya bacheres hannishar kede lekabbel chatzi log hare ze mekabbel tuma haya hakkeli mechavit hamchila satayim ad chatzavim gedolim venishberu im nishar mehen cheres hamkabbel log hare ze mekabbel tuma hau hacharasim mekabbelin pachot mishshiurin ellu en mekabbelin tuma

Keli cheres katan kegon happach vechayyotze bo shennishbar venishar mikkarkaito cheres hamkabbel kal shehu keshehu yoshev vehaya chad beoter shennimtza kichli katan hare ze mekabbel tuma veim nishar middafnotehen cheres hamkabbel eno mekabbel tuma lefi sheddafnot kelim ellu vechayyotze bahen keshavin hen veen lahen toch hannikkar venimtzeu kifshute kele cheres
Chezkat charasim hannimtzaim bechal makom tehorim chutz mehannimtzaim bevet hayyotzer mippene sherubban gisteraot hen lakkelim vehaggistera mekabbelet tuma af al pi shehi mishshivre kelim
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 19: Kamma shiur hashshever sheyyishshaver keli cheres veyithar mittumato im haya tame o lo yekabbel tuma im haya tahor heasuy laochalin mishsheyyinnakev bemotzi zetim veheasuy lemashkin mishsheyyinnakev bemachnis mashkin keshemmannichin oto al hammashke yikkanes hammashke lakkeli bannekev heasuy lechach ulchach metilin oto lechumro vahare hu mekabbel tuma ad sheyyinnakev bemotzi zayit velo amru bemotzi mashke ella begistera bilvad lefi shehi asuya lekabbel hammashkin hannozlim min hakkelim veim hotzia mashkin hare ze batel tashmishah

Chamesh middot bichli cheres nikkav bemotzi mashke tahor millehittamme mishshum gistera vaadayin hu chashuv keli lekaddesh bo me chattat nikkav bechones mashke eno rauy lekaddesh bo me chattat vaadayin keli hu chashuv lehachshir hazzeraim bemashkin hattelushin bo kemo shebbearnu nikkav keshoresh katan en hammayim shebbetocho machshirin et hazzeraim vahare hen kemo sheenan bakkeli vaadayin keli hu chashuv lekabbel bo zetim umkabbel tuma nikkav bemotzi zetim tahor vahare hu kichle gelalim vaavanim sheen mekabbelin tuma vaadayin keli hu chashuv lehatztzil betzamid patil ad sheyyippachet rubbo kemo shebbearnu betumat met beferek shenem asar

Hechavit shiurah keegozim hailpas vehakkedera shiuran kezetim vechen areva shel cheres afillu hayeta gedola umachzeket arbaim sea belach venifchata bemotzi zetim af al pi shehu mattah al tzidda velash bah tehora shemmittechillatah lo naaset lechach
Happach vehatteni shiuran beshemen vehatztzartzur shiuro bemayim
Ner shennittal piv tahor veshel adama shehussak piv biftila eno mekabbel tuma veeno bichlal kele cheres ad sheyyussak kullo bakkivshan kichle cheres
Chavit shennifchata uchshemmattin otah al dafnah mekabbelet o shennechleka kemin shette arevot adayin hi mekabbelet tuma nitraa veenah yechola lehittaltel bachatzi kav gerogarot tehora
Chavit shennittelu azneha hare hi kegistera afillu ozen achat nisdeka lematta meazneha af al pi sheazneha kayyamot hare zo kegistera veim asaah mittechilla shello beaznayim niddonet kechavit

Chavit shennisdeka bakkivshan venimtza shehi kishte gisteraot im mishshennigmera melachtah nisdeka kal gistera mehen mekabbelet tuma veim nisdeka kodem shettiggamer melachtah veachar kach nisrefa bakkivshan tehora veheach yivada davar ze im hau shevareha shavin vetochah maadim ad shello nigmera melachtah nisdeka en shevareha shavin veen tochah maadim beyadua sheachar shennigmera melachtah nishbera umkabbelet tuma kishar shivre kele cheres haruyin letashmish

Gistera shennitraa veenah mekabbelet mashkin af al pi shemmekabbelet ochalin hare zo tehora sheenah asuya ella lekabbel mashkin haddolfin kemo shebbearnu veim hayeta dolefet en osin gistera legistera vechen gistera shennifchata o shennechleka lishtayim tehora shello amru sheyarim shel sheyarim mittammein ella sheyare kele cheres bilvad hen shemmittammein

Gistera shechiddudin yotzin mimmenna ben shehayeta yoshevet ben shehayeta mutta al tziddah kal hamkabbel min hachiddudin zetim kesheyyitmalle haggistera zetim metamme bemagga uchnegdo mittamme baavir vechal sheen mekabbel immah bezetim mittamme bemagga veen kenegdo mittamme baavir
Ketzad mittamme bemagga veen kenegdo mittamme baavir sheim naga hattuma baggistera mittochah mittamme hachiddud nichnesa hattuma baavir haggistera afillu hayeta keneged hachiddud lo nitma hachiddud

Vechetzad kenegdo mittamme baavir sheim hayeta hattuma baavir haggistera keneged hachiddud nitma hachiddud im haggistera veal derech ze hu bechal makom shenneemar bichli cheres uvtannur vechirayim mittamme bemagga uchnegdo baavir o en mittamme kenegdo baavir vechen kal tumat magga haamura beinyan keli cheres o tannur vechirayim hu shettigga hattuma bahen mittochan vechal tumat avir hu shello tigga hattuma kelal ella tikkanes laavir bilvad

Chavit shennitraa utfalah biglalim af al pi shehu notel et haggelalim vehacharasim noflim hare zo mekabbelet tuma mippene shello batal shem keli mealeha nishbera vedibbek charaseha achar sheppershu o shehevi charasim mimmakom acher utfalam biglalim af al pi shennotel et haggelalim vacharaseha omdin hare zo tehora mippene shebbatal mealeha shem keli haya bahen cheres machazik reviit keneged oto hacheres bilvad mittamme baavir mippene shehu keli bifne atzmo ushar hechavit eno mittamme ad shettigga bah hattuma mittochah mippene sheenah keli shalem

Chavit shennikkeva vesatam hannekev bezefet veachar kach nishbera im yesh bacheres hassatum bezefet kede lehachazik reviit hare ze mekabbel tuma mippene shehu mishshivre hechavit velo batal shem keli mealeha aval cheres shennikkav achar shepperash min hakkeli vesatam hannekev bezefet af al pi shehu machazik reviit tahor shehacheres shennikkav batal shem keli mealav vetahar vechal shettahar bichli cheres shaa achat en lo tuma leolam
Kumkumos shennikkav vaasaahu bezefet tahor sheeno yachol lekabbel hachammin ketzonen vechen kele hazzefet vehashshaava vechayyotze bahen tehorin veenan bichlal hakkelim
Mashpech shel cheres sheppekako bezefet eno mekabbel tuma sheen hazzefet mesimo keli kibbul aval mashpech shel etz shessetamo hare ze kichli kibbul umittamme
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 20: Kevar bearnu shekkal yad hakkelim shehakkeli tzarich lah bishat tashmisho hare hi chashuva keguf hakkeli lehittamme ultamme lefichach hattofel keli cheres habbari im nitma hakkeli hare ochlin umashkin hannogin battefela tehorin sheen hakkeli tzarich litfela zo aval hattofel et keli cheres haraua hare hattefela chashuva keguf hakkeli vechen hamhaddek et hakkeruya shel cheres haddolin bah hammayim im chippa otah beor o biklaf vechayyotze bahen im hayeta reua hare hen kegufah
Hattofel keli cheres lihot mevashshel bo eno chibbur tafal kelim lihot zofet bahen chibbur
Chavit shennikkeva vaasaah bezefet bevaatz vegafrit besid uvigfasim enan chibbur ushar kal haddevarim chibbur

Devarim hallachin hammeshuchin shettoflin bahen happitasin shel mayim kede shello yidlof hakkeli hare hen kegufo shel keli sheafillu nitma hakkeli meaviro ochalin umashkin hannogin battefela temein vechen tefelo shel tannur hare hu kecheres hattannur vehu sheyyihye baovi hattefela ad tefach shehu tzarko shel tannur aval yeter al tefach eno mitztzorech hattannur vehannogin beyeter al tefach meavo tehorim tefelat hakkira avo shalosh etzbaot
Chavit shennikkeva ustamah bezefet yoter mitztzarkah hannogea betzarkah tame uvyeter mitztzarkah tahor zefet shennatfa al chavit hannogea bah tahor
Mecham shettefalo bechemar uvcharsit venitma hannogea bachemar tame vehannogea bacharsit tahor sheen hacharsit mitchabber lakkeli
Megufat hechavit shettafal betit aleha veal hechavit enah chibbur lah veim nagu mashkin temein bachavit lo nitmet hammegufa veim nagu bammegufa lo nitmeu achore hechavit
Kele nechoshet shezzefatan en hazzefet chibbur veim leyayin hare ze keguf hakkeli

Batzek shebbesidke haareva shennaga bo sheretz im befesach hoil veissuro chashuv chotzetz velo nitmet haareva veim bishar yemot hashshana im haya makpid alav haareva tehora veim rotze bekiyyumo hare hu kaareva venitmet haareva

Hammeshichot vehartzuot shebbemitpechot hassefarim veshebbemitpechot hattinokot tefurot chibbur ukshurot enan chibbur vechen retzuot shebbammader veshebbassak veshebbakuppa aval shebbeazne kele cheres afillu tefurot enan chibbur sheen chibburin lichle cheres
Yad kordom hayyotze meacharav shalosh etzbaot chibbur vehayyeter al shalosh hannogea bo tahor yad kordom millefanav tefach hassamuch labbarzel chibbur yeter al ken hannogea bo tahor

Sheyare happargal tefach veyad makkevet shel mefatteche avanim tefach yad kurnas shel zehavim tefachayim veshel charashim shelosha sheyare malmad habbakar arbaa tefachim samuch laddarvan yad kordom shechofrin bo bedidin shel mayim arbaa tefachim veyad kordom shel nikkush chamishsha veyad ben pattish chamishsha veshel pattish shishsha vechen yad kordom shel bikkua veshel adir shishsha yad makkevet shel sattatin shishsha sheyare hammardea hassamuch lecharchur shel mattechet shebberosh hammardea shiva tefachim yad hammagrefa shel baale battim shemona tefachim veshel sayyadin asara vechal hayyeter al ze im ratza lekayemo tame yad kal meshammeshe haur kegon hashshippudin vehaaskelaot afillu arukkin kal shehen temein

Makkel sheasaahu yad lekordom hare hu chibbur lattuma bishat melacha veim naga tuma bammakkel keshehu choresh o mevakkea bo nitma hakkordom veim naga bakkordom nitma hammakkel vechen haddeustar shehen kishne kelim vehammasmer mechabberan lihot mesech alehen hare hen chibbur bishat melacha kevao bekora hare ze mekabbel tuma veen hakkora chibbur lo asa ketzat hakkora deustar kal shehu min hakkora letzorech haddeustar chibbur laddeustar vehannogea bishar hakkora tahor sheen kal hakkora chibbur

Agala shennitmet hannogea baol uvakkatrav uvaetz uveavot afillu bishat melacha tahor vehannogea bacherev uvabborech uvayetzul uvaayin shel mattechet uvallechayayim uvairain tame vechen megera shennitmet hannogea beyadah mikkan umikkan tame vehannogea bachut uvammeshicha uvaamma uvassenifin shellah tahor sheen ellu chibbur lah aval hannogea bammalben shel massar haggadol tame

Machbesh shel charash shennitma haromach shebbo hannogea bammachbesh tahor megera shennitma hannogea bakkashtanit shehi lefufa alav tahor sheenah chibbur keshet shehayeta metucha vehachetz mashuch immah venitma hachetz hannogea bayyeter uvakkeshet tahor vaafillu keshehi metucha vechen metzudat haishut shennitma hachetz shellah lo nitmet hammetzuda afillu keshehi metucha vechen massechet nesucha shennitmet bishat haarig hannogea bakkoved haelon vehattachton uvannirim uvakkeros uvachut sheheeviro al gabbe argaman uvaira sheenah atid lehachzirah tahor shekkal ellu enan chibbur leveged aval hannogea benefesh hammassechet uvashsheti haomed uvakkefel sheheeviro al gabbe argaman uvaira shehu lehachzirah tame shekkal ellu chibburin leveged
Hannogea batztzemer sheal haima uvaashvaya tahor hannogea bappika ad shello peraah tame mishshepperaah tahor

Hachut shehishshilo lemachat afillu kashur mishshene tzedadin eno chibbur hichniso leveged hachut chibbur labbeged veen hammachat chibbur labbeged veen hachut kullo chibbur labbeged ella kal shehu letzorech hattefira chibbur sheeno letzorech hattefira eno chibbur hachut shepperesh min habbeged afillu mea amma kullo chibbur chevel shekkashur becheres afillu mea amma kullo chibbur kashar bo chevel echad min hakkesher ulfanim chibbur min hakkesher velachutz eno chibbur hachevel shehu kashur bekuppa eno chibbur ella im ken tafar
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 21: Hachutin hayyotzin min haarig veshebbitchillat hayeria veshebbesofah vehen hannikrain nimin kamma shiuran shel sadin veshel sudarin veshel tzaif veshel pilon shel rosh shesh etzbaot veshel chaluk shehu karua mittechillato vead sofo veachar shellovshin oto mekabbetzin oto belulaot shiur chutav eser etzbaot hassagis vehardid vehattallit shalosh etzbaot vechal hayyeter al hashshiurin haellu hannogea bo tahor af al pi shehabbeged tame bemidras o bishar tumot veen tzarich lomar sheim naga tuma bayyeter shehabbeged tahor

Nime hakkippa shel rosh vehammasve shemmannichin haarviyyim al penehem vehakkilkalin hashshezurin min hassear vehappunda shellovesh haadam al besaro vehassimla vehappargod shemmannichin al happetachim kemo parochet nimehen kal shehen

Mishkolet shennitmet hare shenem asar tefach min hachut shellah chibbur lah vechal hannogea bechutz lishnem asar tefach tahor umishkolet shel charashim shemona asar tefach veshel bannain chamishshim amma vehayyeter al middot ellu af al pi shehu rotze bekiyyumo tahor
Mishkolot shel sayyadin veshel tzayyarin afillu arukkin kal shehen temein

Chut moznayim shel zehavim shel peles veshel shokle argaman tov sheochez hashshokel bo vetole hammoznayim miyyado shalosh etzbaot kane shellah vechuteha kal shehen chute moznayim shel mochre ashashiyyot shel mattachot vechayyotze bahen shelosha tefachim kane shellah vechuteha shenem asar tefachim chut moznayim shel chenvanim veshel baale battim tefach kene hammoznayim vechuteha shishsha tefachim chut moznayim shel tzammarim veshel shokle zechuchit tefachayim kene moznayim vechuteha tisha tefachim vehayyeter al hashshiurin ellu enan chibbur

Hachevel shemmesargin hammittot meematay hu chibbur lattuma mishsheyesareg bo shelosha battim vehannogea bachevel min hakkesher ulfanim tame min hakkesher velachutz ad shalosh etzbaot tame mippene shehen tzerachav shel kesher hare hen mikkelal hammitta vechutz leshalosh etzbaot tahor sheeno letzorech hakkeli sheafillu pesako en hakkesher nittar

Chevel hayyotze min hammitta shehi temea ad sof arbaa tefachim hannogea bo tahor sheeno mitztzarche hammitta lefi sheeno rauy lichlum mittechillat chamishsha vead sof asara tame mippene shettolin bo et hammittot measara velachutz tahor mippene shehu yeter al tzorech hammitta

Avnet shel arig shemmakkifin oto al hammitta kede lekabbetz evareha vehu hannikra mizran shemmiktzato yotza min hammitta ad asara tefachim hare hu mitztzarche hammitta yeter al ken eno mitztzarche hammitta umizran shebbala im nishar mimmennu shiva tefachim kede laasot mimmennu chevek lachamor hare ze mekabbel tuma

Mitta shehayeta temea midras umizran yotze mimmenna ad asara tefachim hare hu av tuma kammitta atzmah vehakkol midras measara velachutz hare hu kemagga midras daras hazzav al hammizran hayyotze measara ulfanim hare hammitta kullah midras measara velachutz tehora bamme devarim amurim lemidras aval lishar tumot afillu mea amma kullo chibbur ketzad mizran shehu karuch al hammitta vehichnis ketzato leohel hammet o shennaga sheretz biktzato o shennaflu mashkin temein al miktzato nitmet hammitta vaafillu haya hakkatze shennitma yotze min hammitta mea amma

Mitta hattemea midras vecharach lah mizran hakkol tame midras hifrisho hammitta midras keshehayeta vehammizran magga midras hayeta temea tumat shiva vecharach lah mizran kullah temea tumat shiva hifrisho hi temea keshehayeta vehammizran tame tumat erev hayeta temea tumat erev vecharach lah mizran hakkol tame tumat erev hifrisho hi temea tumat erev vehammizran tahor
Mitta shekkarach aleha mizran venaga bahen hammet hakkol tame tumat shiva pershu tame tumat shiva naga bah sheretz vechayyotze bahen temein tumat erev pershu temein tumat erev

Kera shehayeta temea midras vechibberah lemitta hammitta kullah midras persha hakkera temea midras keshehayeta vehammitta magga midras vechen im hayeta hakkera temea tumat shiva vechibberah lemitta hammitta kullah temea shiva keillu naga hammet bechera shellah veim hizza al hammitta tihara vehakkera bichlalah veim persha kodem hazzaya hakkera temea tumat shiva keshehayeta vehammitta temea tumat erev haya hakkera temea tumat erev vechibberah lammitta hakkol tame tumat erev persha hi temea tumat erev vehammitta tehora sheen hattame tumat erev min hammet metamme lo adam velo kelim mippene shehu valad kemo shebbearnu vechen haddin beshen shel mader shennitma bemet veachar kach chibbero lammader
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 22: Kamma shiur habbeged lehittamme shelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim lemidras veshalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot mechuvanot im hammelel letumat hammet o lishar tumot bamme devarim amurim bevigde tzemer ufishtim aval begadim shel shear minin en mekabbelin tuma mikkal hattumot ella im ken haya bahen shelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim o yeter shenneemar o veged mippi hashshemua lamdu shebba hakkatuv lerabbot shelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim kishar begadim lattuma bamme devarim amurim bikraim min habbegadim aval haoreg beged bifne atzmo kal shehu hare ze mekabbel shear tumot chutz mittumat midras sheen mekabbel otah ella harauy lemidras

Habbegadim heavim beoter kegon hallevadin vehannimtin hakkashin o habbegadim harakkin beoter kegon bigde pishtan shel mitzrayim shehabbasar nire mittachtan enan mekabbelin tuma ad sheyyihye bakkera shelosha al shelosha tefachim ben lemidras ben lishar tumot

Kal hakkeliot mekabbelot tuma bivgadim echad hakkolea chutim vaasaan pif o haorgan vaasaan avnet vechayyotze bo chutz mikkelia sheosin hatztzammarim likshor bah hatztzemer shehi tehora hakkela shebbet kibbul even shebbah arug o or mekabbelet tuma nifsak bet etzba shellah tehora nifsak bet happakia shellah bilvad adayin hi betumatah hammichmorot veharshatot mekabbelin tuma vehacherem mekabbel tuma mippene zuto mippene sheene otah hassevacha dakkin beoter vahare hi keveged haose beged min hacherem tahor min zuto mittamme
Asa chaluk min hammeshammeret im yesh bo shelosha al shelosha mekabbel tuma
Meshammeret shel yayin shebbalta im meshammeshet meen melacha rishona temea veim lav tehora

Mitpechot sefarim hamtzuyyarot en mekabbelin tuma mippene sheenan meshammeshin adam shehare tziyyuran meid alehen shebbishvil sefer naasu vesheenan metzuyyarot mittammeot bishar tumot chutz mittumat midras mippene sheomrin lo amod venaasa melachtenu kemo shebbearnu beinyan mishkav umoshav
Keset hassabbalim shemmannichin al kitfehen mippene hammot mittammea bemidras umshammeret shel yayin enah mittammea bemidras
Beged shechishshev alav letzurot eno mekabbel tuma bittel machshavto mekabbel tuma baal habbayit sheasa mitpachot lechappot bahen ketalim o ammudim enam mekabbelot tuma
Chaluk heasuy kisvacha kede lesachek bo shote shechar eno mekabbel tuma
Kuppach shennetano al hassefer tahor millekabbel tumat midras aval mittamme bemet uvishar tumot

Haose ispelanit ben al haor ben al habbeged af al pi sheyyesh bahen shiur tehorin asa alehen melugma al habbeged eno mekabbel tuma shehare nitlachlech veeno rauy veal haor mekabbel tuma mippene shehu mitkanneach verauy lemishkav
Meematay yekabbel habbeged tuma mishsheyyeerog bo shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot vechal hakkelim hanneeragin bemachat kegon hakkis veanpeliya en mekabbelin tuma ad shettiggamer melachtan
Kal hakkelim hannaasin al gabbe machat kegon metzuda kevan shennaasa bahen bet kibbul melachtan mekabbelin tuma

Sevacha shemmannichot habbanot berashehen im hitchilu laasot otah mippiha enah mekabbelet tuma ad sheyyiggamer karkaitah veim hitchila mikkarkaitah enah mekabbelet tuma ad sheyyigmor et piha ushvisa mekabbelet tuma bifne atzmah vechuteha chibbur lah letamme ulhittamme
Sevacha shennikrea im enah mekabbelet rov sear harosh tehora

Chaluk shel beged o shel leved o shel neyar meematay hu gemar melachto mishsheyyiftach et piv haggadol lefi gadlo vehakkaton lefi katno veim nitma hechaluk meematay hu tahorato mishsheyyivle veeno meshammesh meen melachto rishona nishtayyer bo rubbo millemala adayin hu betumato rubbo millematta tahor veim nikra mibbet piv tahor
Haose chagor mitztzavar shel beged umitztziddo shel sadin eno mekabbel tuma ad sheyyimlol siftotav asaahu meemtza habbeged umeemtza hassadin eno mekabbel tuma ad sheyyimlol mitztzad hashsheni
Chagor shebbalu tzedadav veemtzaito kayyemet tame
Safa sheppersha min habbeged vehitkinah lachagor bah et matnav mekabbelet tuma mippene shehi keavnet

Tallit shel ani shebbalta im hau rov siftoteha kayyamot af al pi sheen bah shalosh al shalosh bari hare zo mekabbelet tuma en siftoteha kayyamot im yesh bah shalosh al shalosh chazak uvari mekabbelet tuma veim lav enah mekabbelet tuma vechen shear bigde aniyyim

Matliyyot sheen bahen shelosha al shelosha enan mekabbelot tuma veim chishshev alehen vehechinan mekabbelot tuma ad sheyyihu pachot mishshalosh al shalosh shekkal pachot mishshalosh al shalosh eno mekabbel tuma kelal veaf al pi shehechino

Pachot mishshelosha al shelosha shehitkino lifkok bo et hammerchatz ulnaer bo et hakkedera ulkanneach bo et harechayim vechayyotze beellu im hishlicho baashpa eno mekabbel tuma telao bemagod o hinnicho achore haddelet hare ze kemi shehinnicho betoch begadav vaadayin hu chashuv etzlo umkabbel shear tumot chutz mittumat midras shehare hu pachot mishshelosha tefachim

Shelosha al shelosha shehaya mushlach baashpa im haya bari kede litzror bo rova hakkav melach gas velo yikkara hare ze mittamme bemidras veim lav eno mittamme aval im haya babbayit im haya bari af al pi sheeno yachol litzror bo melach o shehaya tzorer bo melach velo haya bari hare ze tame midras
Shelosha al shelosha shennikra velo huvdelu hakkeraim im notno al hakkisse uchsheyyeshev alav yigga besaro bakkisse hare ze tahor veim lav hare ze mittamme bemidras
Shalosh al shalosh shennimcha mimmennu afillu chut echad o shennimtza bah kesher o shene chutin matimin hare zo tehora

Shalosh al shalosh shehishlichah baashpa tehora hechezirah mekabbelet tuma leolam hashlachatah metahartah vehachzaratah metammetah chutz mishshel argaman veshel zehorit tova sheafilu hayeta al haashpa mekabbelet tuma mippene shehi chashuva

Shalosh al shalosh shennetanah bechaddur o sheasaah kaddur bifne atzmah tehora aval shelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim shennetano bechaddur hare hu kemot shehaya umittamme bemidras asahu kaddur bifne atzmo eno mittamme bemidras shehare hattefer memaato mishshelosha al shelosha
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 23: Hammappatz hu hammachtzelet sheorgin otah min hachavalim umin hassuf umin haggome vechayyotze bahen veen hammappatz bichlal kelim haamurin battora veaf al pi chen mittamme hu bemidras din tora shehare ribba hakkatuv kal hammishkav veze rauy lemishkav veasuy lo vechen mittamme bemet uvishar tumot middivrehen kechal peshute kele etz kemo shebbearnu veze kelal gadol shekkal hammittamme bemidras mittamme bishar tumot
Kevar bearnu shehabbeged mittamme beshalosh al shalosh kemo shebbearnu bishar tumot uvishlosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim lemidras

Hassak shiuro arbaa tefachim al arbaa tefachim haor chamishsha al chamishsha hammappatz shishsha al shishsha ben lemidras ben lishar hattumot ufachot min hashshiurin haellu tehorin mikkelum bamme devarim amurim bekera echad mehen shennikra belo kavana aval hakkotzetz bechavana vekitztzetz afillu tefach al tefach lemoshav o shelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim lemishkav hare ze mittamme bemidras ben shehaya hattefach al tefach shekkitztzetz o hashshelosha beged o sak o or o mappatz vechen hamkatztzea meechad mehen laachiza kede sheyyochaz bo beyado kederech sheosin kotztze teenim shello yizzoku etzbeotehen hare ze tame bechal shehu vehu shello yihye pachot mishshalosh al shalosh shekkal pachot mishshalosh etzbaot tahor mikkelum

Hamchabber shene tefachim min habbeged umin hassak tefach shelosha min hassak veechad min haor arbaa min haor veechad min hammappatz hare ze tahor min hammidras aval im chibber chamishsha tefachim min hammappatz veechad min haor arbaa min haor veechad min hassak shelosha min hassak veechad min habbeged hare ze teme midras ze hakkelal kal shehishlim shiuro bechamur mimmennu tame min hakkal tahor
Beloye nafa uchvara shehitkinan lishiva tehorin veenan mekabbelin tuma ad sheyekatztzetzem veachar kach yihu kemappatz

Chaluk shel katan eno mittamme bemidras ad sheyyihye bo keshiur shelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim venimdad kaful kivriyyato veellu nimdadin kefulin begadim shemmalbishin otan al haraglayim veal hashshokayim veet harosh vehammichnasayim vehakkova vehakkis shel punda umatlit shettelaah al hassafa im peshuta nimdedet peshuta veim kefula nimdedet kefula

Habbeged shearag shelosha al shelosha nitma bemidras veachar kach hishlim et kal habbeged kullo midras natal chut echad mittechillato tahar min hammidras aval tame magga midras vahare hu rishon kichli shennaga bemidras natal chut echad mittechillato veachar kach hishlim et kal habbeged kal habbeged tame magga midras vechen beged shenneerag bo shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot venitma bemet veachar kach hishlim alav et kal habbeged habbeged kullo teme met natal chut echad mittechillato tahar mitteme met aval teme magga teme met natal chut echad mittechillato veachar kach hishlim et kal habbeged hakkol tahor velamma yihye hakkol tahor mippene sheamru shalosh al shalosh shennitmaata tehora mikkelum aval shelosha al shelosha shennitmaata af al pi shettahara min hammidras hare hi temea bechal hattumot

Matlit shehi midras utlaah al hakkuppa o al haor naasa hakkol rishon letuma hifrish et hammatlit hare hakkuppa o haor rishon mippene shennagu bammidras vehammatlit tehora shekkevan shettelaah vehifrishah batla telaah al habbeged o al hassak naasa hakkol midras vahare hakkol av tuma hifrishah hare habbeged o hassak rishon shehare naga bammidras vehammatlit av tuma keshehayeta sheenah betela al haarig tafar hammatlit al habbeged keshettelaah meruach achat o mishshete ruchot kemin gam eno chibbur velo naasa hakkol av ella magga midras bilvad tefarah mishshete ruchot zo betzad zo hare hi chibbur venaasa hakkol av

Shelosha al shelosha shennitma bemidras veachar kach nechlak tahar min hammidras veen bikraim ellu tuma kelal vehinnam keshivre keli shennitma aval beged shennitma bemidras vekara mimmennu shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot oto hakkera tahar min hammidras aval teme magga midras shebbeet perishato min habbeged haggadol nitma bemagga
Sadin shennitma bemidras veachar kach asaahu parochet tahar min hammidras umeematay hu tahorato min hammidras mishsheyyikshor bo hallulaot shehu nitle bahen kishar happarochot

Tallit shehi midras vehitbilah vekodem sheyyaariv shimshah hitchil likroa mimmenna kera kevan shennikra bah rubbah shuv enah chibbur vetahara kullah af al pi sheadayin nishtayyer bah kede maaforet shello nikra shehare hu korea veholech bamme devarim amurim bitvulat yom shekkevan shello chas aleha lehatbilah kach lo yachus likroa et kullah ulfichach tahara kullah
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 24: Elu orot mittammein bemidras or shechashav alav lishticha veor shemmannichin al hammittot millemala lishon alav veor shemmannichin al hachamor tachat hammassooy veor shemmannichin baeres tachat hakkatan veor hakkar veor hakkeset veor shemmannichin tachat hashshulchan beet haachila kede sheyyippelu alav happerurin mippene shehu nishan alav beraglo veor shechoger nofetz happishtan alav beet shennofetz veor shechoger hachammar alav veor shemmanniach hassabbal al ketefo beet shessovel veor shemmanniach harofe al birkav beet shemmefis hashshechinin mippene shekkal haorot haellu yoshev alehen veor hallev shel katan sheriro yored alav kede shello yippasdu begadav veor sheasaahu lenotno al libbo bishat hakkatzir mippene hashsharav veor shelloffin hakkesut bo veor hattafur beteva shemmannichin bo habbegadim shekkal ellu mithappechin alehen venishanin alehen

Kal haorot hammittammeot bemidras enan mittammein ad sheyyihye bahen keshiur chamishsha tefachim al chamishsha tefachim veellu orot sheen mittammein bemidras or shechoger sorek hatztzemer beet shessorek veor shellofef bo hatztzemer hassaruk veor shellofef bo haargaman veor hattofer shemmannichin bo haargaman vechullan mittammein bishar tumot
Or sheasao chippuy lechelim tahor mikkelum asao chippuy lemishkolet mekabbel shear tumot shehare naasa lekabbala veeno mittamme bemidras
Or sheasaahu laakevo ulfarsato im chofe et rov haregel mittamme veim lav tahor
Minal sheal haimmum af al pi sheadayin lo levasho adam hare ze mittamme bemidras shekkevar nigmera melachto

Kal or harauy lehittamme bemidras veeno chaser melacha hammachshava metammeto veim chishshev alav lihot or shulchan vechayyotze bo hare ze mittamme bemidras veim chaser melacha en hammachshava moelet bo ad shettiggamer melachto chutz min haor shemmechappin bo hammerkav mippene haavak shehammachshava moelet bo af al pi shello nigmera melachto bamme devarim amurim beorot baal habbayit aval orot haabbedan shessetaman limchira en hammachshava metammetan ad sheyyaase bahen maase vichinem lemidras

En adam metamme bemidras mishkav o merkav sheenan shello shenneemar vehannogea bemishkavo gazal mishkav vedaras alav belo negia tahor veim nityaashu habbealim tame ganav mishkav veyashav alav tame shechezkato shennityaashu habbealim sheenan yodim mi genavo veim noda sheadayin lo nityaashu habbealim tahor lefichach gannav shegganav or vechishshev alav lishchiva machashava moelet lo umittamme bemidras aval haggazlan en machshavto moelet ella im ken nityaashu habbealim
Or shennitma bemidras vehitchil lekaro retzuot hare hu betumato ad sheyemaatennu pachot pachot mechamishsha tefachim

Kal keli or shennitma bemidras hazzav veshinnahu lichli acher im shinnahu mippashut lefashut hare hu betumato shinnahu mippashut limkabbel umimmekabbel lefashut tahor uvveged hakkol tame ketzad chemet sheasaah shatiach veshatiach sheasaah chemet tahor aval chemet shennitmea midras vaasaah turmil o turmil sheasaahu chemet hare hen midras keshehau
Kar shel beged shennitma bemidras vaasaahu sadin o sadin sheasaahu kar o keset beged sheasaahu mitpachat o mitpachat sheasaahu keset hare hen midras keshehau

Teraskal shel gemi vechayyotze bo hamchuppe beor mittamme bemidras uvishar tumot hifrish haor mealav haor mittamme bemidras aval hatteraskal tahor mikkelum shehare naasa keshivre kelim
Safsalin shebbammerchatz sheshshette raglav shel etz mittamme bemidras hayeta achat shel etz veachat shel shayish eno mekabbel tuma
Nesarim shebbammerchatz sheshshigman enan mekabbelin tuma sheenan asuyin lishiva ella kede sheyehallechu hammayim tachtehen
Hakkalkala vehassal shemmillean teven o mochin af al pi shehitkinan lishiva enan mekabbelin tumat midras sheenan reuyin lishiva veim sergan begemi o bimshicha al pihen mittammein bemidras

Korat bet habbad sheasa roshah haechad kisse eno mittamme bemidras mippene sheomrin lo amod venaase melachtenu aval im kava et hakkisse bekorat bet habbad hakkisse mittamme bemidras veim daras hazzav al hakkora lo nitma hakkisse vechen im kava hakkisse bekora gedola o asa rosh hakkora haggedola kisse en tame ella mekom hakkisse bilvad ushar hakkora tahor vechen haddin bechisse shekkevao baareva shehu tahor
Ketzat hakkora shemmetakken hamsattet et haeven leshev alav hare mekom yeshivato mittamme bemidras umkom yeshiva sheachore hakkaron tahor sheenah ella yeshivat tzaar

Makkel shel zekenim tahor mikkelum sheeno ella lesayyea
Sandal shel sayyadin vehu sandal shel etz mittamme bemidras mippene shehassayyad peamim metayyel bo ad shemmaggia leveto
Kav shel kittea sheyyesh bo bet kibbul ketitin mittamme bishar tumot mippene bet kibbulo umittamme bemidras shehare nishan alav

Veellu temein mishshum merkav mirdaat shel chamor vetappitan shel sus vechar haggamal veukkaf shel naka vechal kayyotze bahen halluchot shemmannichin al gabbe hachamor veachar kach notnin alav hammassooy tehorot veim hayeta reuya lemerkav temea
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 26: Keli etz harauy lemidras shekkevao bechotel betoch habbinyan kevao bakkotel velo bana al gabbav o bana al gabbav velo kevao adayin mittamme bemidras keshehaya kevao bemasmerim uvana alav tahor vechen mappatz shennetano al gabbe hakkorot kevao velo natan alav et hammaaziva o shennatan alav et hammaaziva velo kevao mittamme bemidras kevao venatan alav et hammaaziva tahor
Safsal shennittal echad merashav adayin hu rauy lemidras nittal hashsheni tahor veim yesh bo govah tefach mittamme bemidras
Kisse shel kalla shennittelu chippuyav tahor veim lo hau chippuyav yotzim venittelu adayin hu rauy lemidras shekken darko lihot mattehu al tziddo veoshev alav
Kisse shennittelu chippuyav vaadayin hu rauy lishiva mittamme nittelu shenayim mechippuyav ze betzad ze tahor
Shidda shennittal haelon shellah temea mippene hattachton shehu rauy lemidras nittal hattachton temea mippene haelon nittelu shettehen hare haddappin tehorin

Teva shennifchata mitztziddah mittammea bemidras uvishar tumot mippene sheruya af lishiva vehakkol yoshvin aleha nifchata millemala tehora min hammidras shehare enah reuya lishiva umittammea bishar tumot sheadayin hi mekabbelet nifchata millematta tehora mikkal tumot af al pi sheefshar leshev aleha bechisse mippene sheikkar maaseha lekabbala uchvar batal haikkar vehammegurot shellah mittammeot veenan chibbur lah vechen mashpelet shennifchata millekabbel rimmonim af al pi sheruya lemidras hare hi tehora mikkelum mippene sheikkar maaseha lekabbala vehoil uvatal haikkar batla hattefela

Areva shel etz shemmegabbelin bah habbinyan o et haggefasim af al pi shemmekabbelet shear tumot enah mittammea bemidras veshellashin bah et habbatzek shemmechazzeket mishshene login vead tisha kabbin shennisdeka ad sheeno yachol lirchotz bah raglo achat mippene hassedek hare zo mittammea bemidras shessetamah shekkoftah veoshev aleha lefi gadlah vesedek shellah hinnichah baggeshamim ad shennitpecha venistam hassedek enah mittammea bemidras shehare hi reuya lalush bah utchillat maaseha lalush bah umkabbelet shear tumot chazar vehinnichah bakkadim veniftach hassedek chazra lekabbel tumat midras uthora mishshear tumot

Areva gedola shehi yeter al tisha kabbin shennifchata millekabbel rimmonim vehechinah lishiva hare zo tehora af mittumat midras ad sheyyaktzia sheen hammachshava moelet baareva gedola shennifchata ad sheyyaase bah maase asaah evus livhema af al pi shekkevaah bakkotel temea bechal hattumot

Mitta shehayeta temea midras venittela ketzara ushte keraayim adayin hi betumatah sheadayin tzurat hammitta omedet nittela arukka ushte keraayim tehora

Mitta shehayeta temea midras o bishar tumot venignav chetzyah o avad chetzyah o shechillekuha achin o shuttafin hare zo tehora shehare ze kichli shennishbar hechziruha mekabbelet tuma mikkan ulhabba hare ze dome lemi sheasa keli echad mishshivre kelim shennitma shehu tahor umkabbel tuma lehabba
Mitta shennifreku evareha im nishbera arukka ushte keraayim o ketzara ushte keraayim hare ellu mittammein mippene sheruyin lesamchan bakkotel velishon alehen
Mitta shennitmet kullah im hitbilah evarim evarim tehora
Hamfarek et hammitta lehatbilah hannogea bachavalim shellah tahor
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 27: Shalosh tevot hen teva shennifchata mitztziddah temea midras millemala temea teme met vehabbaa bemidda tehora mikkelum
Shalosh arevot hen areva mishshene login vead tisha kabbin shennisdeka temea midras shelema temea teme met vehabbaa bemidda tehora mikkelum

Shelosha tarbusin shel or hen shel sefarim tame midras vesheochlin alav tame teme met vesheshshotchim alav et hazzetim tahor mikkelum lefi sheeno mimmeshammeshe adam
Shelosha besisaot hen shellifne hammitta veshellifne hassofrim tame midras shel shulchan tame teme met veshel migdal tahor mikkelum lefi shehu miktzat migdal vetzurato mochachat alav
