Shalosh chamatot hen ushlosha turmelin hen hamkabbelin keshiur temein midras vechamma shiuran hachemet arbaa kabbin vehatturmil chamishsha vesheenan mekabbelin keshiur temeim teme met veshel orot haddag tahor mikkelum
Shelosha orot hen heasuy leshatiach teme midras veheasuy letachrich kelim tame teme met veshel retzuot veshel sandalin tahor mikkelum lefi sheen alav tzurat keli
Shelosha sedinin hen heasuy lishchiva tame midras veheasuy lefarochet tame teme met veshel tzurot sheosin oto kede sheyyitlammed mimmennu harokem tahor mikkelum lefi sheeno mimmeshammeshe adam
Shalosh mitpachot hen shel yadayim temea midras veshel sefarim temea teme met veshel tachriche hammet veshel nivle bene levi tehora mikkelum lefi sheenan mimmeshammeshe adam

Or heasuy kemo yad shemmachnisin bo hayyad vehaetzbaot mippene hatztzinna vechayyotze bahen hu hannikra peraklinin ushlosha peraklinin hen shel tzayyade chayya veof tame midras shehare nishan alav veshel chagavim tame teme met shennotnin bo hachagavim veshel kayatzim shebbo mekayetzin perot tahor mikkelum lefi sheeno mimmeshammeshe adam
Shalosh sevachot hen shel yalda temea midras veshel zekena temea teme met vesheosin lesachek bah leshote shechar tehora mikkelum lefi sheenah mimmeshammeshe adam

Shelosha sandalin hen shel adam tame midras shel mattachot shel behema tame teme met shel shaam veshel tzefira tehora mikkelum kelalo shel davar kal keli sheeno rauy lemishkav o lemerkav o shehu rauy velo naasa lechach ella limlacha acheret hare hu tahor min hammidras naasa limlacha acheret umshammesh immah et hayeshiva kegon hattallit vehardid mittamme bemidras vechal hammittamme bemidras mittamme bemet veyesh mittamme bemet veeno mittamme bemidras kemo shebbearnu vechal hammittamme bemet mittamme bishar avot hattumot ben avot shel tora ben shel divrehem umittammein bemashkin

Shelosha pinkasot hen haappiforin shemmannichin alav hassefarim teme midras vesheyyesh bo bet kibbul shaava tame teme met chillekah tehora mikkelum lefi sheen alav tzurat keli veeno rauy lemidras
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 28: Kal hakkelim sheyyesh lahen bet kibbul shennitmeu achorehen bemashkin lo nitma tochan litruma velo agnehen velo aznehen velo mekom etzba hashshokea bisfat hakkeli nitma toch hakkeli nitmeu kullan naflu mashkin temein al kanne hakkelim o al agnehen o al aznehen o al yedot hakkelim hamkabbelin hare ze menaggevan vehen tehorin vaafillu achore hakkeli kullo lo nitmeu
Echad kele hassak kegon hassakkin vehammartzufin o kele haor kegon hakkarim vehakkesatot veechad kele etz afillu kuppot umishpalot im nitmeu achorehen bemashkin lo nitma tochan

Peshute kele shetef sheen reuyin lemidras kegon hashshulchan vetavla sheen lah dofen hoil veen mekabbelin tuma min hattora im nitmeu achorehen bemashkin lo nitma tochan aval peshute kele shetef haruyim lemidras kegon hammitta vehaor sheyeshenim alav vehakkisse vechayyotze bahen en lahem achorayim vetoch ella ben shennagu mashkin bahen mittochan o meachorehen nitma hakkeli kullo vechen middot yayin veshemen vezoma listerot umsannenet shel chardal umshammeret shel yayin en lahen achorayim vetoch ella im nafal mashkin al miktzatan nitmeu kullan kemo habbegadim

Hammardea vehammalmad yesh lahen achorayim vetoch ketzad naflu mashkin al hacharchur lo nitma min haetz hassamuch lacharchur ella shiva tefachim bilvad ushar haetz tahor vechen im naflu mashkin al haddarvan lo nitma ella arbaa tefachim hassemuchin laddarvan naflu chutz leshiva vechutz learbaa hare ze kichli kibbul shennagu mashkin baachorav velo nitmeu ella mimmekom maggao velachutz

Mishneh Torah, Agents and Partners 1: Haomer lishlucho tze umchor li karka o mittaltelin o kene li hare ze mocher velokeach veose shelichuto vechal maasav kayyamin veen haose shaliach tzarich kinyan velo edim ella baamira bilvad beno leven chavero veen tzerichin edim ella legallot haddavar im kafar echad mehem kishar kal hatteanot

Taan shimon sheyyesh lelevi alav chov bezo hashshuttafut mane im haya beyado kede hachov vehaya yachol litteno lelevi neeman venotnin hachov veachar kach mechashshevin veim en beyado litten eno neeman lehotzi miyyad reuven o min hassechora hayedua leshuttafut shemma kenunya hem osin shimon velevi al nichse reuven afillu hayeta hammilve bishtar en reuven chayyav leshallem mimmenna kelum aval im taan shimon sheruven yodea bevadday shezze hachov shealay mechamat hashshuttafut hu vehachov etzlenu hu yishshava reuven hesset o al yede gilgul sheeno yodea shechov ze etzlenu vishallem shimon hachov mishshello vechen im yatza shetar chov al levi beshem shimon bemea dinarin mimmamon hashshuttafut veamar shimon nifrati vehechzarti lakkis o sheamar shimon kavati lo zeman leshana o lishtayim eno neeman shemma kenunya hu ose al nichse reuven vketzad danin bedin ze levi kevar niftar behodaat shimon veim lo hevi shimon reaya yeshallem mibbeto veyitba et levi besof zeman sheamar vechen kal kayyotze baze seliku lehu hilchot sheluchin veshuttappin
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 1: Echad hakkone mechavero chatzi sadehu o shenayim shekkanu meechad sade o sheyyarshu o shennittena lahen bemattana o shehechziku bah min hahefker o nichse ger kelalo shel davar kal sheyyesh benehem shuttafut bakkarka uvikkesh echad min hashshuttafin lachalok velittol chelko levaddo im yesh beotah karka din chaluka kofe et shear hashshuttafin vecholkin immo veim en bah din chaluka en echad mehen yachol lachof et chavero lachalok vechen haddin bemittaltelin bamme devarim amurim besheen echad mehen makkir et chelko bammakom shehen shuttafin bo ella yad kullan mishtammesh bechal hammakom aval im haya echad mehen makkir chelko af al pi sheen bah din chaluka kofe kal echad mehen et chavero lehavdil ben chelko lechelek chavero

Echad min hashshuttafin sheamar lachavero bemakom sheen bo din chaluka o bedavar shei efshar sheyyachleku kegon shifcha o keli mechor li chelkecha bechach vechach o kene mimmenni kashshaar hazze haddin immo vechofin et hannitba limkor lachavero o liknot mimmennu aval im en hattovea rotze liknot o lo yimtza bema yikne eno yachol lachof et chavero liknot mimmennu afillu kashshaar hazzol shehare chavero yachol lomar lo en retzoni sheekne ella sheemkor lefichach shene achin echad ani veechad ashir shehinniach lahem avihem merchatz o bet habbad im asaan haav lesachar hassachar laemtza kal zeman sheyyirtzu laamod beshuttafut asaan haav leatzmo eno yachol lachof achiv lehaskir otam ella mishtammeshin bahem kederech shehishtammesh avihem vahare ashir omer leani kach lecha zetim uvo vaase otam bevet habbad kene lecha avadim veyavou veyirchatzu bammerchatz veen heani kofe et heashir liknot chelko ella im ken amar lo kene mimmenni o mechor li vahareni love vekone o mocher laacherim vekonin haddin immo amar kal echad mehen eni kone ella hareni mocher chelki mochrin otah laacherim amar kal echad mehem eni mocher ella kal echad mehen rotze sheyyikne chelek chavero o sheen echad mehen rotze lo liknot chelek chavero velo limkor chelko ella yishshaaru shuttafin bagguf heach hen osin im haya hammakom asuy lesachar maskirin oto vecholkin secharo veim eno asuy lesachar im chatzer hu shochnin bah shana shana shei efshar sheyyishkenu shenehem keachat mippene hezzek reiyya shehare en bah din chaluka veen adam asuy litroach kal sheloshim yom lifnot mechatzer lechatzer ella mishshana leshana veim merchatz hu nichnasin lah shenehem tamid bechal yom vechen kal davar sherauy lehishtammesh bo tamid veeno asuy lesachar kegon merchatz o matztza o sefer tora eno yachol lomar lo hishtammesh atta yom vaani yom shehare omer lo bechal yom ani rotze lehishtammesh bo

Echad hassocher mechavero miktzat chatzer o sade sheen bah din chaluka o shenayim shessachru makom echad beshuttafut kal echad mehen yachol lachof et chavero velomar lo o sechor mimmenni chelki o haskir li chelkecha veim yesh bah din chaluka cholkin

E zehu din chaluka kal sheillu yechallek lefi hashshuttafin yaggia lappachut shebbahem chelek sheshshem hakkol karuy alav aval im en shem hakkol nikra al hachelek en bah din chaluka ketzad kal chatzer sheen bah arba ammot al arba ammot enah keruya chatzer vechal sade sheen bah kede zeriat tisha kabbin enah keruya sade vechal ginna sheen bah kede zeriat chatzi kav enah keruya ginna vechal pardes sheen bo kede zeriat shelosha kabbin eno karuy pardes lefichach en cholkin et hechatzer ad sheyyihye arba ammot lechal echad veechad min hashshuttafin velo et hassade ad sheyyihye bah kede zeriat tisha kabbin lechal echad veechad velo et hagginna ad sheyehe bah chatzi kav lechal echad veechad velo et happardes ad sheyehe bo bet shelosha kabbin lechal echad veechad bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael vechayyotze bah aval bevavel vechayyotze bah en cholkin et hassade ad sheyyihye bah kede charishat yom laze vacharishat yom laze velo et happardes ad sheyyihye bo sheloshim veshishsha ilanot laze ushloshim veshishsha ilanot laze kede avodat adam echad bayyom echad vesade shemmashkin otah bichli ad sheyehe bah kede sheyemalle happoel yom echad laze veom echad laze

En cholkin et hatteraklin velo et hammoran velo et hashshovach velo et bet habbad velo et hammerchatz velo et hattallit ad sheyehe bechal chelek mehen kede laze uchde laze im merchatz chalku ad sheyehe bechal chelek mehen kede merchatz veim shovach ad sheyehe kal chelek shovach bifne atzmo vechen betallit uvishar kal haddevarim en bahen kede laze uchde laze maalin oto bedamim veyesh lo lomar lachavero o mechor li o kene mimmenni amar echad mehen chalok ze af al pi sheen hachalakin shavim ani ettol et happachut vetol atta et hayyeter en shomin lo shehare omer lo en retzoni likkach mattana ella hoil veen bah din chaluka beshave hare anu maalin bedamim
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 2: Chatzrot hakkefarim shekkal echad veechad bone lo bayit venimtzet hechatzer shebben shene habbattim meshuttefet lechal bene habbattim hare yesh lechal petach ufetach arba ammot lefanav berochav kal happetach vehannishar min hechatzer im yesh bo arba ammot al arba ammot lechal shuttaf veshuttaf cholkin otah veim lav en cholkin otah shekkal chatzer sheen lah arba ammot al arba ammot enah keruya chatzer kemo shebbearnu ketzad hau shene shuttafin laze shene battim velaze bayit echad ze sheyyesh lo shene battim moddin lo min hechatzer arba ammot lechal bayit uvayit al kal rochav happetach afillu haya eser ammot veze sheyyesh lo bayit echad notnin lo arba ammot berochav pitcho lifne pitcho vehannishar min hechatzer im yesh bah shemone ammot kede sheyehe laze arba ammot al arba ammot velaze arba ammot al arba ammot chutz min happetachim yesh bah din chaluka vecholkin pachot mizze en bah din chaluka
Bayit sheyyesh lo petachim rabbim mikkal ruchotav yesh lo arba ammot lechal ruach veim yiched lo petach en lo ella arba ammot keneged pitcho
Achsadra im efshar lo lehikkanes letochah bemassao en lah arba ammot veim lav yesh lah arba ammot shello amru sheyyesh lechal petach ufetach arba ammot ella lifrok sham massao
Bet shaar o mirpeset yesh lahem arba ammot hau chamishsha battim petuchim lemirpeset vehammirpeset petucha lechatzer en lah ella arba ammot
Lul shel tarnegolim en lo arba ammot
Bayit chetzo mekore vechetzo sheeno mekore ben shekkeruo kelappe penim ben shekkeruo kelappe chutz en lo arba ammot
Bayit satum yesh lo arba ammot paratz et petzimav en lo arba ammot

Bayit sheen bo arba ammot al arba ammot en lo arba ammot bechatzer ella im yesh bechatzer arba ammot laze vearba ammot laze ad petach habbayit hazze cholkin vehazzevel shel chatzer mitchallek lefi happetachim aval achsanya shel melech lefi bene adam

Hashshuttafin sheratzu lachalok davar sheen bo din chaluka af al pi shehen mafsidin et shemo cholkin uvchitve hakkodesh af al pi sheratzu lo yachaloku bamme devarim amurim becherech echad aval bishte kerichot cholkin

Makom sheen bo din chaluka sheratzu shuttafin lechalleko af al pi shekkanu miyyadam kal echad mehen yachol lachzor bo shezze kinyan devarim hu kemo shebbearnu aval im kanu miyyadam shezze ratza beruach peloni veze ratza beruach peloni enan yecholim lachzor bahem vechen im halach ze beatzmo vehechezik bechelko veze beatzmo vehechezik bechelko af al pi shello kanu miyyadam en echad mehem yachol lachzor bachavero
Haachin shechalku veasu benehem goral kevan sheala goral leechad mehen kanu kullan bahanaya shennaaset lahem sheshshamu ze mizze ledavar shehiskimu alav gamar kal echad mehen umakne lachavero

Haachin shechalku hare hen kelakochot ze mizze veen lahem derech ze al ze velo sullamot ze al ze velo challonot ze al ze velo ammat hammayim ze al ze shekkevan shechalku lo nishar leechad mehen zechut bechelek chavero lefichach yesh lomar laachin keshehayeta hassade kullah leechad haya maavir bah ammat hammayim hazzot mimmakom lemakom aval atta shennaaset ze chelki yesh li lehasir ammat hammayim mealay vechen sotem hachallon hammashkif al chelko uvone betzad hassullam af al pi shehu mevattel tashmisho vehu haddin bishnayim shekkanu sade meechad vechalku lo nishar leechad mehem zechut bechelek chavero umafsik ammat hammayim mechelko vesotem hachallonot
Aval shenayim shekkanu sade mishshene anashim o mishshene achin en leechad mehen lehafsik ammat hammayim velo leshannot davar min hannezakim shehechziku bahen hammochrin

Chatzar hashshuttafin sheyyesh bah din chaluka o shechillekuha birtzonam af al pi sheen bah din chaluka yesh lechal echad mehen lachof et chavero livnot hakkotel baemtza kede shello yirehu chavero beshaa shemmishtammesh bechelko shehezzek reiyya hezzek hu veen lo chazaka bechatzer ella af al pi sheamdu kach shanim rabbot belo mechitztza kofehu laasot mechitztza bechal et sheyyirtze

Rochav mekom hakkotel mishshel shenehem vechamma yihye rachbo hakkol keminhag hammedina vaafillu nahagu laasot mechitztza benehem bekanim uvhutzin uvilvad shello yihye avir sheyyistakkel bo veyire et chavero

Kamma govah hakkotel en pachot mearba ammot vechen beginna kofehu lehavdil ginnato migginnat chavero bimchitztza gevoha asara tefachim aval bevika en tzarich lehavdil bikato mibbikat chavero ella bemakom shennahagu ratza lehavdil bikato mibbikat chavero kones letoch shello uvone veose chazit kemo amma besid mibbachutz kede lehodia shehakkotel shello lefichach im nafal hakkotel hammakom vehaavanim shello veim asu middaat shenehem bonim hakkotel baemtza veosin chazit mikkan umikkan lefichach im nafal hakkotel hammakom vehaavanim shel shenehen

Hammocher ginna lachavero setam vehayeta meorevet im ginnot acherot kofin et hallokeach livnot et hakkotel benehem vaafillu bemakom shennahagu shello ligdor bagginnot aval im machar bika setam en mechayevim oto ligdor ella bemakom shennahagu

Makom shennahagu livnot ketalim hammavdilin bachatzerot o bagginnot baavanim sheenan gazit ze noten shelosha tefachim veze noten shelosha tefachim begazit ze noten tefachayim umechetza veze noten tefachayim umechetza bichfisin ze noten tefachayim veze noten tefachayim bilvenim ze noten tefach umechetza veze noten tefach umechetza vechal hashshiurin haellu ovi hakkotel im hassid vehoil umkom hakkotel mishshel shenehem im nafal hakkotel hare hammakom vehaavanim shel shenehem vaafillu nafal lirshut echad mehen o sheppinna echad mehen et kal haavanim lirshuto vetaan shemmachar lo chavero chelko o netano lo bemattana eno neeman ella hare hen birshut shel shenehem ad sheyyavi reaya
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 3: Kotel chatzer hammavdil ben shene shuttafin shennafal yesh lechal echad mishshenehem lachof al chavero livnoto ad govah arba ammot kede shello yiru ze et ze aval yeter al arba ammot en mechayevin oto ratza haechad vehigbiha hakkotel yoter al arba ammot im ba chavero uvana kotel acher gavoha keneged hakkotel shebbenehen mechayevin oto litten chelko baggovah shekkeneged katlo ketzad bana echad kotel shebbenehen vehigbiho eser ammot uva chavero uvana kotel acher kenegdo o betziddo laasot lo bayit vehigbiha hakkotel haacher shesh ammot mechayevin oto litten chelko bishte ammot shemmosif al arba ammot shehare nire mimmaasav shehu rotze bahen vechen im chakak berosh hakkotel shebbenehen makom lehanniach bo hakkorot o shebbana alav kora gedola shehakkorot nishanin aleha mechayevin oto litten chelko beshesh haammot kullan shehosif chavero al haarba ammot af al pi shello bana kal hakkotel shehare gilla dato shehu rotze bechal haggovah hazze

Echad min hashshuttafin shebbana hakkotel shemmavdil beno uven chavero ad arba ammot vetava chavero litten chelko bahotzaa veamar natatti chelki hare ze bechezkat shennatan venishba hesset shennatan veniftar ad sheyyavi reaya hattovea shello natan aval im ba litboa oto litten chelko behotzaat shear haggovah shehosif al arba ammot mippene shessamach lo o kenegdo veamar natatti eno neeman ella chavero nishba binkitat chefetz shello natan lo venotel mimmennu kedin kal hannishbain venotlin ad sheyyavi reaya ze shennatan lo

Mi shehaya lo churba ben churbot chavero veamad chavero vegadar ruach rishona ushniyya ushlishit ad shennimtzet churba zo mishshelosh ruchoteha gedura en mechayevin oto litten lo hahotzaa kelum shehare lo hoil lo vahare churbato petucha lirshut harabbim keshehayeta lefichach im gadar lo ruach reviit ad shennimtzet churbato mukkefet gader megalgelin alav et hakkol venoten chatzi hahotzaa shehotzi ze bearba ruchot ad arba ammot uvilvad sheyyihye mekom hakkotel shel shenehem

Aval im haya hakkotel shel ze shebbana uvchelko bana yerae li sheen megalgelin alav ella davar muat kemo sheyyiru haddayyanin shehare eno yachol lehishtammesh bakketalim vechen im hannikkaf atzmo hu sheggadar ruach reviit hare gilla dato venoten chatzi hahotzaa shel shalosh ruchot im hau hakketalim shel shenehem vechen kal kayyotze baze

Vechen shene battim ze betzad ze vehau gaggehen asuyin ledira afillu hau bishne tzidde reshut harabbim ze ose maake lachatzi gaggo shehu dar bo veze ose maake lachatzi gaggo veze shello keneged ze umaadif kede shello yiru ze et ze veaf al pi shebbene reshut harabbim roin oto yachol kal echad lomar lachavero ellu en roin oti ella bayyom beet sheeemod al gaggi veatta roe oti tamid

Gag hassamuch lachatzar chavero ose lo maake gavoha arba ammot aval ben gag legag mishshear haggaggin eno zakuk learba ammot sheen bene adam darin baggaggot lefichach en baggaggot hezzek reiyya aval tzarich laasot mechitztza ben shene haggaggin gevoha asara tefachim kede sheyyitpos oto kegannav im nichnas lirshuto

Shette chatzerot zo lemala mizzo lo yomar haelon hareni bone mikkenegdi veole ella bonim shenehem millematta veole uvone haelon levaddo mikkenegdo vamala veim hayeta chatzero lemala miggaggo shel chavero en haelon zakuk lattachton kelal

Mi shehaya katlo samuch leginnat chavero venafal kofin oto lefannot avanav amar lo higgiucha vahare hen shellecha en shomin lo veim ratza bahen baal hagginna veamar lo hen im pinna otam kana veeno yachol lachzor bo vaafillu amar helach yetziotecha veettol avanay en shomin lo aval im lo pinna lo kana shello amar lo ella lidchoto

Chamesh ginnot hamsappekot mayim mimmayan echad venitkalkel hammayan kullan metakkenot im haelona nimtzet hattachtona metakkenet im kullan umtakkenet leatzmah veharishona enah metakkenet im hashsheniyya velo mehashsheniyya ulmatta vechen chamesh chatzerot sheshshofchin mayim leviv echad venitkalkel habbiv kullan metakkenot im hattachtona nimtzet haelona metakkenet im kullan umtakkenet leatzmah vehattachtona enah metakkenet im hashsheniyya velo mishsheniyya ulmala

Bene hannahar mashkin al hasseder ratza echad mehen liskor kede sheyyachazor lo hammayim veyashke techilla veachar kach yiftach veacher rotze lehashkot techilla kal hammitgabber zacha uvor hakkarov laamma mitmalle rishon mippene darche shalom
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 4: Mi shehayeta lo aliyya lemala mibbeto shel chavero venafal kotel mikkatle habbayit en baal haaliyya noten lo kelum bitziotav vechofe et baal habbayit livnoto keshehaya aval en baal habbayit kofe levaal haaliyya livnot kotel aliyya shennafal vehattikra shel bayit hare hi shel baal habbayit vehammaaziva sheal hattikra hare hi shel baal haaliyya

Naflu shenehem habbayit vehaaliyya hare shenehem cholkin baetzim uvaavanim uveafar veim nishtabberu miktzat haavanim roin e zo reuya lehishtabber im avne habbayit o avne haaliyya vedavar ze yadua midderech hannefila im nafal haelon al hattachton vaharaso o nishmat hattachton venafal haelon veneheras veim enan yodin ketzad nafal cholkin haavanim hashshelemot vehashshevurot

Amar baal haaliyya levaal habbayit livnot kede sheyyivne aliyyato al gabbav vehu eno rotze hare baal haaliyya bone et habbayit keshehaya veoshev vedar betocho ad asher yitten kal yetziotav veachar kach yetze veyivne aliyyato im rotze
Veim en echad mehen yachol livnot baal haaliyya notel shelish hakkarka uvaal habbayit shene shelishim

Ratza baal habbayit livnot beto bone keshehaya veim ba leshannot bakketalim im chizzek otan vehirba berachban yoter mimma shehau shomin lo ratza lemaet berachban o lifchot mechazkan kegon shehau avanim uvikkesh lehachzir levenim vechayyotze bahen en shomin lo ba leshannot et hattikra lekorot kevedin vachazakin shomin lo lifchot berachban pachot mimma shehau en shomin lo hirba bechallonot o shehosif begovah habbayit en shomin lo miet bechallonot o shemmiet begovah habbayit shomin lo vechen baal haaliyya bone otah im ratza keshehayeta veim ba leshannot hakketalim leharchiv ulhachzik en shomin lo mippene shehu machbid al kotel hattachton aval lemaet shomin lo vechen bekorot tikra haelona im shinna otam lekallim mimma shehau shomin lo lichvedim mehen en shomin lo hirba bechallonot o shemmiet begovah haaliyya shomin lo aval im miet bechallonot o hirba begavhah en shomin lo

Nitdaldelu korot habbayit veyardu laavir habbayit im higgiu letoch asara tefachim soter uvone veim lo higgiu yachol baal haaliyya leakkev alav vaafillu amar lo baal habbayit ani eskor lecha makom kede shettadur bo ad sheatakken hattikra en shomin lo shehare omer lo eni rotze sheetrach mimmakom lemakom kede shettetakken et betcha

Hitnu benehem al davar ze im nishar begovah habbayit kede sheyyikkach adam chavila benonit al rosho veyikkanes bah tachat korot ellu shenneekmu eno soter veim eno yachol lehikkanes bah ad sheyyachof et rosho soter umtakken uvone veen baal haaliyya yachol leakkev shehare hitnu benehem techilla

Bet habbad shehu banuy baovi hahar veginna achat al gabbav venifchatu sheme bet habbad kearbaa tefachim o yoter hare baal hagginna yored vezorea lematta ad sheyyaase ze labbayit bado kefin vitakken haelon karka ginnato veyizra kal ginnato

Shette ginnot zo al gav zo vehayyarak bentayim begovah ovi haaretz shebbenehem kal shehaelon yachol lifshot et yado velittol oto meikkaro hare hu shello uvilvad shello yeenos et atzmo vehashshear shel tachton haya maggia lenofo veeno maggia leikkaro lo yittol haelon veim natal en motziin oto miyyado aval hailan haomed al hammetzar af al pi shehu note letoch sade achat mehen hare shenehem cholkin beferotav

Shataf nahar et zetav ushtalam betoch sede chavero veamar halla zetay ani notel en shomin lo mishshum yishshuv haaretz ella yaamdu bimkoman veim akaran hannahar begushehen kesheshshetalan yachleku happerot baal hassade im baal hazzetim kal shalosh shanim ulachar shalosh hakkol levaal hassade veim lo neekru begushehen hakkol levaal hakkarka miyyad

Kayyotze bo hammocher zetav leetzim im pasak immo lakotz miyyad kal happerot sheyyaasu hare hen levaal hakkarka veim hitna immo lakotz kal zeman sheyyirtze kal happerot sheyyotziu levaal haetzim machar setam im asu pachot merviit lisa chutz min hahotzaa hare ellu shel baal hazzetim asu reviit lisa chutz min hahotzaa hare ellu yachaloku
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 5: Chatzar hashshuttafin kal echad mehen kofe et chavero laasot bah bet shaar vedelet vechen kal haddevarim shehechatzer tzericha lahem tzorech gadol o devarim shennahagu bene hammedina laasotam aval shear haddevarim kegon tziyyur vechiyyur vechayyotze bo eno kofehu asa echad mehen meatzmo im gilla hashsheni dato shennoach lo bema sheasa chavero megalgelin alav et hakkol venoten chelko bahotzaa

Mi sheyyesh lo bayit bechatzer acheret bene hechatzer meshabedin oto laasot immahem delet veneger umanul aval bishar haddevarim en meshabedin oto veim haya sharuy immahem beotah chatzer meshabedin oto al hakkol

Echad min hashshuttafin bechatzer shebbikkesh lehaamid bah behema o rechayim o legaddel bah tarnegolin chavero meakkev alav vechen shear haddevarim sheen derech anshe hammakom laasotan bechatzrotehen bechullan hashshuttafin meakkevin ze al ze chutz min hakkevisa lefi sheen darkan shel benot yisrael lehitbazzot al gav hannahar

Mi shebba lachpor bor besof sadehu lismoch lemetzar chavero im sede chavero eno asuy levorot somech veeno yachol limchot beyado veim yimmalech chavero lachpor bor betziddo tzarich leharchik min kotel habbor shelosha tefachim ad sheyehe ben chalal shette habborot shishsha tefachim veim hayeta sede chavero asuya levorot eno somech ad sheyyarchik min hammetzar shelosha tefachim veyachpor uchsheyyavo chavero lachpor yarchik gam hu shelosha tefachim betoch sadehu veyachpor

Habbayit vehaaliyya shel shenayim lo yaase baal habbayit tannur betoch beto ella im ken yesh lo al gabbav govah arba ammot vechen lo yaamid baal haaliyya tannur ad sheyyihu tachtav maaziva shelosha tefachim uvchira tefach veim tannur shel nachtomim hu tzarich sheyehe tachtav arbaa tefachim uvchira shel nachtomin shelosha tefachim veaf al pi shehirchik hashshiur im yatzat haesh vehizzika meshallem ma shehizzik kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo

Mi shehayeta lo chanut tachat otzar chavero lo yaase bah lo nachtom velo tzabba velo refet bakar velo yachnis sham aspasta vechayyotze bahen middevarim sheole mehem hevel cham harbe mippene shehachom mafsid perot haotzar lefichach im haya otzar yayin beeretz yisrael sheen hachom mafsido hare ze ose bachanuto kal melechet esh sheyyirtze aval lo yaase refet bakar mippene shemmafsid reach hayyayin veim huchzeka hachanut battechilla lerefet o lenachtom vechayyotze bo veachar kach ratza baal haaliyya laasot aliyyato otzar eno yachol limchot beyado

Kibbed baal habbayit veribbetz aliyyato o sheribba bah challonot kede laasot bo otzar vekadam ze veasa tannur kodem sheyyachnis perot laotzar o shehitchil leetzor shumshemin o rimmonim o temarim vechayyotze bahen vekadam ze veasa hattannur kodem sheatzar hachittin o sheasa baal hachanut mechila al gabbah lehavdil ben hachanut uven haotzar bechal ellu baal haotzar meakkev alav veim avar veasa tannur vechayyotze bo en baal haotzar yachol lehasir hattannur bechal ellu
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 10: Marchikin et hailan min hair esrim vechamesh amma uvecharuv uvashshikma chamishshim amma mippene noye hair vechal ilan hannimtza karov lair pachot mizze kotztzin oto veim hailan kadam notnin lo bene hair damav veim haya haddavar safek velo noda e ze mehem kadam en levaal hailan damim ella notel etzav veholech

Marchikin goren kavua min hair chamishshim amma kede shello yolich haruach hatteven beet shezzore veyazzik livne hair vechen lo yaase adam goren kavua betoch shello ella im ken haya lo chamishshim amma lechal ruach kede shello yazzik hatteven lintiat chavero o leniro
Marchikin et hannevelot veet hakkevarot veet habburseki min hair chamishshim amma
Veen osin burseki ella lemizrach hair mippene sheruach mizrachit chamma ummaetet hezzek reach ibbud haorot

Mi shebba laasot mishra shel pishtan betzad yarak shel chavero shehare me hammishra nivlain baaretz veholchin umafsidin et hayyarak o shennata kereshin karov min habbetzalim shel chavero shehen mefigin taman o shennata chardal betzad kaveret devorim shehare haddevorim ochlin healin umafsidin et haddevash vechal ellu vechayyotze bahen en tzarich leharchik bichde shello yazzik veal hannizzak leharchik et atzmo im yirtze ad shello yaggia lo hannezek shezze betoch shello hu ose vehannezek ba lachavero meelav bamme devarim amurim sheeno marchik keshehaya hannezek ba meelav achar sheyyippasku maasav shel mazzik aval im hau maasav shel ze sheose birshuto mazzikin et chavero bishat asiyyato hare ze kemi shemmazzik beyado ha lema ze dome lemi sheomed birshuto veore chitztzim lachatzar chavero veamar birshuti ani ose shemmonin oto vechen kal harchakot haamurot lemala beinyan ze im lo hirchiko hare ze kemi shehizzik bechitztzav lefichach tzarich sheyyarchik mishra min hayyarak uchreshin min habbetzalim vechardal min haddevorim shelosha tefachim o yeter meat kede shello yihye hezzek bayyadayim aval leharchik ad shello yavo hannezek meelav en tzarich

Baal haaliyya shehaya shofech mayim vehen yordin al cheder lematta im hayeta sham maaziva shehammayim kalim bah beet sheficha veachar sheyyafsik elon millishpoch yitballa hammayim veyerdu veyintefu al hattachton tzarich hattachton letakken ulharchik min atzmo hannezek veim en sham maaziva ella kesheyyishpoch yerdu hammayim miyyad hare ze kemazzik bechitztzav vehaelon metakken o yimmana millishpoch vechen kal kayyotze baze

Mi shehaya lo ilan betoch sadehu karov levor chavero en baal habbor yachol leakkev alav velomar lo hare sharshe hailan nichnasim labbor shelli umafsidin oto shezze nezek habba meelav hu leachar zeman uvet shennata eno mazziko uchshem shezze chofer betoch shello kach ze notea betoch shello vechen reuven shechafar bor veyarad umatza sharshe ilan shel shimon betoch sadehu kotzetz vechofer vehaetzim shello veim haya karov leilan shimon betoch shesh esre amma hashsharashim shel shimon vekotztzan venotnan lo veim en tzarich lachpor bor veyatzu hashsharashim shel shimon betoch sadehu hare hu maamik shelosha tefachim kede shello yeakkev hammacharesha vechal shoresh shemmatza betoch shelosha tefachim kotztzo veeno choshesh shemma yivash hailan shel chavero shezze betoch shello hu chofer

Mi shehayeta sede chavero netua gefanim o shear ilanot uva hu lintoa betoch sadehu gefanim betzad gefanim o ilanot betzad ilanot tzarich leharchik arba ammot bamme devarim amurim beeretz yisrael aval bechutza laaretz marchik ben gefanim ligfanim shette ammot uven gefanim lishar ilanot o ben ilanot leilanot arba ammot bechal makom haya gader bentayim ze somech laggader veze somech laggader bechal makom mi shehaya ilan chavero note letoch sadehu kotzetz kimlo mardea al gabbe hammacharesha uvcharuv uvshikma kotzetz kal hannote ad sheyyihye shakul keneged hammetzar vechen im haya note al bet hashshelachin shel chavero o al bet hailan kotzetz et kal hannote ad sheyyihye shakul keneged hammetzar
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 11: Mi sheasa goren betoch shello o kava bet hakkisse o melacha sheyyesh bah avak veafar vechayyotze bahen tzarich leharchik kede shello yaggia heafar o reach bet hakkisse o haavak lachavero kede shello yazziko afillu hayeta haruach hu shemmesayyea oto beet sheose melachto umolicha et heafar o neoret happishtan vehammotz vechayyotze bahen umaggiatan lachavero hare ze chayyav leharchik kede shello yaggiu velo yazziku vaafillu al yede haruach metzuya shekkal ellu kemi shehizziku bechitztzav hen
Af al pi shehu chayyav leharchik kal kach im holicha haruach hamtzuya hammotz veet heafar vehizzika bahen patur milleshallem sheharuach hu shessiyyea oto veen nezek ze ba mikkoach mazzik atzmo

Hakkotesh et harifot vechayyotze bahen betoch shello uvet shemmakke menadned lachatzar chavero ad shennidneda kissuy hechavit al pi hechavit hare ze mazzik bechitztzav vechayyav leharchik kede shello yindod o yevattel melachto shemmazzeket veim hizzik beet hannidnud chayyav leshallem shehare mikkocho ba hannezek

Kal haharchakot haamurot bapperakim shel mala im lo hirchik veraa chavero veshatak hare ze machal veeno yachol lachzor ulhatzricho ulharchiko vehu sheyyerae mimmennu shemmachal kegon shessiyyea immo miyyad o sheamar lo laasot o sheraahu sheasa betziddo belo harchaka veshatak velo hikpid al ze zacha shekkal hammachazik benezek zacha bo kemo shebbearnu bamme devarim amurim beshehechzik bishar nezakin chutz mearbaa mine nezakin ellu haamurim beferek ze shehen heashan vereach bet hakkisse veheavak vechayyotze bo venidnud hakkarka shekkal echad meellu en lo chazaka vaafillu shatak hannizzak kamma shanim hare ze chozer vechofehu leharchik vechen hezzek reiyya bemakom shetztzarich mechitztza kofehu laasot mechitztza bechal et sheyyirtze kemo shebbearnu velamma shinnu nezakim ellu mishshear nezakin lefi sheen dato shel adam sovelet nezek meellu vechezkato sheeno mochel shehezzeko hezzek kavua veim kanu miyyado shemmachal binzakim ellu eno yachol lachzor bo

Mi shehechzik laasot melechet dam o nevelot vechayyotze bahen bimkoman veyavou haorvim vechayyotze bahen biglal haddam veyochlu vahare hen metzerin lachavero bekolam vetziftzufam o baddam shebberaglehem shehen yoshvin al hailanot umlachlechin perotehem im haya chavero kappedan o chole shetztziftzuf hazze mazziko o shepperot shello nifsadin lo baddam chayyav levattel otah hammelacha o yarchik ad shello yavo lo hezzek mechamato shehezzek ze dome lereach bet hakkisse vechayyotze bo sheen lo chazaka vechen bene mavoy o bene chatzer shennaasa echad mehen umman velo michu bo shehare huchzak vehau haam nichnasin veotzin liknot veshatku lo hechezik bedavar ze veyesh lahem bechal et leakkev velomar en anu yecholin lishon mikkol hannichnasin vehayyotzin shezze hezzek kavua hu kemo heashan veheavak vechaze horu haggeonim

Mi shehechzik benezek sheyyesh lo chazaka kegon sheppatach challon o heevir ammat hammayim o shello hirchik ma sherauy leharchik vahare hammachazik toen atta amarta li laasot o machalta li achar sheraita o hukkar hannezek veshatakta velo machita bi vehannizzak omer achshav hu sheraiti velo yadati mikkodem o sheamar kesheraiti machiti becha veatta amarta atta archik o estom veatta madche oti miyyom el yom kede shettikba hezzekcha bechal ellu vechayyotze bahen al hannizzak lehavi reaya veim lo hevi yishshava hammazzik hesset veyippater

Hechezik benezek sheen lo chazaka kegon ashan uvet hakkisse vechayyotze bahen vetaan hammazzik shekkana miyyado shel nizzak al hammazzik lehavi reaya shekkanu miyyado veim lo hevi yishshava hannizzak hesset shello kanu miyyado al kach visallek ze hezzeko
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 12: Haachin o hashshuttafin shebbau lachalok et hassade velittol kal echad chelko im hayeta kullah shava veen sham makom tov umakom ra ella hakkol echad cholkin lefi hammidda bilvad veim amar echad mehem tenu li chelki mitztzad ze kede sheyehe samuch lesade acher shelli veyihye hakkol sade achat shomin lo vechofe oto al ze sheikkuv bedavar ze middat sedom hi aval im haya chelek echad mimmenna tov o karov lannahar yoter o karov ladderech veshamu otah hayyafe keneged hara veamar tenu li beshuma shelli mitztzad ze en shomin lo ella notel begoral amar lahem tenu li beshuma shelli mitztzad ze chatzi middatah min hatztzad hara belo shuma vetol atta min hatztzad hattov kede sheyyihye chelki samuch lassade shelli horu miktzat haggeonim sheshshomin lo velaze dati nota vechen rauy ladun
Habbechor shechalak notel shene chalakim shello keechad aval hayyavam shechalak im echav benichse haav notel chelko vechelek echav begoral im alu bemakom echad alu veim alu bishte mekomot alu

Eretz merubbaat shehaya hannahar makkif lah mizrach vetzafon vehadderech darom umaarav cholkin otah baalachson kede sheyyaggia laze nahar vederech velaze nahar vederech veim amar tenu li hachetzi shemmitztzad ze shehu betzad sadi shomin lo kelalo shel davar kal davar shehu tov laze veen al chavero hefsed kelal kofin oto laasot
Echad min haachin o min hashshuttafin shemmachar chelko leacher mesallekin et hallokeach venotnin lo shear haachin o shear hashshuttafin damim shennatan veholech kede shello yikkanes zar benehen

Velo od ella hammocher karka shello leacher yesh lachavero shehu betzad hammetzar shello litten damim lallokeach ulsallek oto veze hallokeach harachok keillu hu shaliach shel ben hammetzar ben shemmachar hu ben shemmachar shelucho ben shemmachru bet din yesh bo din ben hammetzar afillu haya hallokeach talmid chacham veshachen vekarov lammocher uven hammetzar am haaretz rachok ben hammetzar kodem umsallek et hallokeach vedavar ze mishshum shenneemar veasita hayyashar vehattov amru chachamim hoil vehammecher echad hu tov veyashar hu sheyyikne makom ze ben hammetzar yoter min harachok hau bene hammetzar rabbim kullam zochim bezo hassade hannimkeret vehi benehem lefi minyanam venotnin min haddamim lallokeach vehu shebbau kullam befaam achat aval im kadam echad mehen vesillek et hallokeach zacha bah levaddo hoil vehu ben hammetzar vechen im bau miktzatan umiktzatan bimdina acheret mesallekin oto ellu haomdim kan bilvad vehi lahen vechen hammocher leechad mibbene hammetzar o leechad min hashshuttafin shello bemassa umattan af al pi sheeno shuttafo bakkarka zacha bah veen shear hashshuttafin o shear bene hammetzar notlin immo

Hammocher kal nechasav leechad en baal hammetzar shel sade achat mesallek et hallokeach meotah hassade shehare hi vehaacheret kana keechad vechen hammocher labbealim harishonim o hallokeach min haakkum en bo din ben hammetzar

Hammocher laakkum meshammetin oto ad sheyekabbel alav kal ones sheyyavo min haakkum ad sheyyinhog haakkum im ben hammetzar shello bedine yisrael bakkol veim anaso shello kedin yisrael meshallem hammocher
Hassechirut en bah mishshum din ben hammetzar

Hammashken makom veachar kach mecharo laze shehu memushkan beyado en bo mishshum din ben hammetzar vechen hammocher makom rachok kede ligl makom karov o shemmachar ra kede ligl yafe bedamav o shemmachar kede litten menat hammelech o shemmachar likvura o limzon haishsha o habbanot en beechad meellu din ben hammetzar ella zacha hallokeach

Velamma en bahen din ben hammetzar shekkal ellu terudin hen limkor umishshum tzorech gadol mochrin veim tomar yesh bahen din ben hammetzar lo yimtzeu lokeach shehare omer lamma etrach veekkach kede sheyyavo ze visallek oti veen habbealim yecholin lehamtin ad sheyyavi baal hammetzar maot veyikne

Hare shettaan hallokeach veamar mippene hammas vechayyotze bo machar lo hammocher uvaal hammetzar omer sheker atta toen levattel zechuti al baal hammetzar lehavi reaya veachar kach yotzi miyyad hallokeach veim lo hevi reaya yishshava hallokeach hesset

Afillu haya sham baddavar safek en hallokeach mistallek ella biraya berura shehevi baal hammetzar lefichach im taan hallokeach veamar gazlan atta lesade zo aris atta lesade zo o socher o memashken tzarich baal hammetzar lehavi reaya shehu baal hammetzar veshehakkarka zo bechezkato vechen kal kayyotze baze
Hammocher litomim ketannim en bo din baal hammetzar hattov vehayyashar sheosin chesed im ellu yater mibbaal hammetzar
Vechen hammocher leishsha en bo din baal hammetzar mippene sheen darkah litroach tamid veliknot hoil velakcha chesed hu shettaamod hakkarka beyadah
Machar letumtum veanderoginus baal hammetzar yachol lesallekan mippene shehen safek ishsha

Hayeta hakkarka shel echad mehen vehabbinyan o hailanot shel echad im yesh levaal habbinyan o levaal hailanot zechut bakkarka kal echad mehen ben hammetzar shel chavero lefichach im machar echad mehen chelko chavero mesallek hallokeach aval im en levaal hailanot o levaal habbinyan zechut bakkarka ella kal zeman sheyyirtze omer lo akor ilancha o haros binyancha umachar baal hassade zacha hallokeach veen baal hailanot o baal habbinyan mesallek oto veim machar baal habbinyan o baal hailan hare baal hakkarka mesallek oto

Haya mafsik beno uven metzar shel chavero rechav dekalim o binyan gavoha vechazak o guma vechayyotze bahen roin im yachol lehachnis afillu telem echad betoch haddavar hammafsik ad sheyyitarvu shette hassadot hare ze ben metzar shello umsallek hallokeach veim lav eno mesallek hallokeach
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 13: Hannoten mattana en bah din ben hammetzar haya katuv bishtar mottana sheacharaut mattana zo al hannoten yesh bah din ben hammetzar hoil veyesh bah acharaut mechira hi velo katav mattana ella levattel zechut ben hammetzar vechamma noten lo ma shehi shava

Amar hallokeach ken hu vehaarama asinu umchira hi bechach vechach kenitiha nishba binkitat chefetz venotel kedin hashsheluchin veyerae li shetztzarich liton damim shehen reuyin o yeter meat aval im amar al sheve mea bematayim kaniti eno neeman
Haya katuv bishtar mattana vekibbalti alay acharaut mattana zo sheim tetze miyyado etten lo matayim noten lo ben hammetzar matayim veachar kach mesalleko veaf al pi sheeno shave ella mane

Hechlif chatzer bechatzer en bah din baal hammetzar hechlif chatzer bivhema o bemittaltelin roin deme otah habbehema o deme otam hammittaltelin venoten lo ben hammetzar umsalleko veeno yachol lomar lo ten li kamma shellakachti bo shezze haarama hi veenah moelet kelum

Machar lo karka meat beemtza sadehu veachar kach machar lo karka betzad otah sade shebbaemtza roin im oto hammeat shemmachar lo techilla hi idit o zibburit legabbe zot hakkarka shemmachar lo baacharona zacha hallokeach veen ben hammetzar yachol lesalleko shehare hu atzmo ben metzar hu mippene oto meat shekkana baemtza veim oto meat shekkana baemtza kemo zot shemmachar lo bassof mitztziddo hare ze maarim uven hammetzar mesallek oto min hassade shekkana bassof

Hammocher al tenay ben shehitna mocher ben shehitna lokeach en baal hammetzar yachol lesalleko ad sheyyitkayemu hattenain veyizke hallokeach bakkarka velo tishshaer bah illa immo kelal veachar kach yesallek oto

Hallokeach shebbana vehishbiach o satar vehifsid ben hammetzar mesalleko venoten lo damim haruyin lo vahare hu bechal maasav kemo hashshaliach vechen im lava hallokeach kodem sheyesallek oto ben hammetzar vesilleko ben hammetzar en baal chov shello toref miyyad ben hammetzar zehu haikkar bechal ellu haddinin shekkal hallokeach betzad metzar chavero hu kemo shaliach lachavero ultakken shelacho velo leavet lefichach im hishbiach notel hotzaa veim hifsid vechafar veharas o achal happerot menakkin oto min haddamim bamme devarim amurim shemmechashshevin lo happerot besheachalan achar shebba ben hammetzar vehevi maot lesalleko aval kal happerot sheachal mikkodem shello hu ochel veen mechashshevin otan

Echad shellakach sade achat mishshenayim uva baal hammetzar lesalleko machatzit bilvad shellakach min haechad eno yachol lesalleko o mesalleko mikkullah o manniach kullah aval hammocher karka lishnayim yesh levaal hammetzar lesallek shenehem o lesallek echad ulhanniach echad
Ben hammetzar shebba lesallek et hallokeach vekodem sheyesalleko machar lo et hassade sheyyesh lo al hammetzar ibbed et zechuto
Shaliach shemmachar vahare hu baal hammetzar eno mesallek et hallokeach shehare hu machar lo veen lecha mechila gedola mizzo
Baal chov shel mocher shettaraf hassade miyyad baal hammetzar hare baal hammetzar chozer vetoref min hallokeach shessilleko vehallokeach chozer venotel min hammocher

Kal baal chov shettaraf bechovo yesh levaal hammetzar lesalleko lo yehe koach hattoref gadol mikkoach hallokeach veim yirtze hannitraf litten haddamim shehau alav bechovo tachzor lo sadehu leolam kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo
Katan shehaya ben hammetzar veraa bet din shezzechut hu lo mesallekin lo et hallokeach o yittol lo chelko im shear baale hammetzar kemo sheyyiru

Baal shehayeta ishto ben hammetzar hare ze mesallek et hallokeach shekkal nichse ishto birshuto vechal zechut shettavo leyadah zechut hu lo afillu kanu miyyad ishto shemmachala bizchut zo lallokeach eno moil ella habbaal mesalleko amda haishsha middatah vesilleka et hallokeach vechen haeved shehaya nose venoten benichse adonav shessillek et hallokeach im ratza habbaal o haadon mekayyem al yedehen veim ratza lo yekayyem vetachzor lallokeach veyachzir haddamim
Mishneh Torah, Neighbors 14: Harotze limkor sadehu vehevi ben hammetzor shello veze sherotze likkach mimmennu levet din veamar leven hammetzar im tirtze liknot bechach vechach ase veim lav sallek et atzmecha vahare ze lokeach hare ze lo nishara lo taana ella o mevi maot miyyad veyikne o batla zechuto amar etrach veavi en shomin lo elech vaavi im hu amud sheyyesh lo mamtinin lo ad sheyyelech veyavi veim eno amud en shomin lo sheeno rotze ella lehishshamet lefichach omrim lo o totzi atta zuzim o betela zechutcha sheen kovin zeman levaal hammetzar hotzi ben hammetzar hammaot vehotzi hallokeach maot im hau shel lokeach tovim mizzuzav o memaharim latzet yoter mizzuzav batla zechuto veen lo din ben hammetzar haya rotze hallokeach liknotah livnot bah battim uven hammetzar rotze lezarah hallokeach zoche mishshum yishshuv haaretz veen bah din ben hammetzar

Ba lokeach venimlach beven hammetzar veamar lo hare peloni ben hammetzar shellecha rotze limkor li sade zo elech veekkach mimmennu veamar lo lech vekach lo bittel zechuto veyesh lesallek oto achar sheyyikne ella im ken kanu miyyado bamme devarim amurim shetztzarich kinyan keshemmachal lo kodem sheyyikne aval im machal lo zechuto achar shellakach kegon shebba ben hammetzar vesiyyea immo o sachar mimmennu o sheraa oto bone vesoter kal shehu umishtammesh velo micha bo velo irer hare ze machal veshuv eno yachol lesalleko

Haya ben hammetzar bimdina acheret o chole o katan veachar zeman hivri hachole vehigdil hakkatan uva haholech eno yachol lesalleko sheim atta omer ken en adam yachol limkor karkaito shehare hallokeach omer leachar kamma shanim tetze miyyadi vechaze horu haggeonim

Hammocher sheve matayim bemane im lechal haam mozil umocher noten lo ben hammetzar mea umsalleko veim eno mozil lechal haam noten lo matayim shehu shave shehammocher natan laze mattana lakach sheve mane bematayim eno yachol lesalleko ad sheyyitten hammatayim taan ben hammetzar sheasu kenunya benehem nishba hallokeach binkitat chefetz venotel matayim zuz veim haya sham edim shennatan matayim uven hammetzar toen sheamana hayeta beno uven hammocher veeno yodea bevadday shello lakach mimmennu ella mea hare ze noten damim kemo sheheidu haedim veachar kach mesalleko umashbio hesset shellakach bematayim veniftar
