Echad hammocher atzmo o shemmecharuhu bet din uvarach chayyav lehashlim shesh veim paga bo yovel yotze lecherut

Chala ben shechala shana achar shana o shechala cholaim mekuttaim im hakkol pachot mearba shanim olin leminyan shesh aval im chala arba shanim chayyav lehashlim kal yeme hacholi shenneemar kesachir ketoshav veim paga bo yovel yetze bamme devarim amurim shemmechashshevin yeme hacholi keshehaya chalo kaved sheeno yachol laasot melacha aval im lo haya chalo kaved ella yachol laasot maase machat afillu chala kal shesh olin lo
Hammocher atzmo leakkum im lo nifda eno yotze ella bayyovel shenneemar veim lo yiggael beelle veyatza bishnat hayyovel hu uvanav immo

Hannimkar leakkum im lo hissiga yado ligl kerovav podin oto vekarov karov kodem shenneemar o dodo o ven dodo yigalennu uvet din kofin et kerovav lifdoto shello yittama baakkum lo pedauhu kerovav o sheen yadam masseget mitzva al kal adam miyyisrael lifdoto uven sheppedauhu kerovim ben sheppedaahu shear adam yetze lecherut veyesh lo lilot veligl et atzmo min haakkum vegoel lachatzain aval hannimkar leyisrael en hakkerovim podin oto veen lo vegoel veeno goel lachatzain ella ketzad dino im hissiga yado litten kefi hashshanim hannotarot noten veotze veim lav lo yetze

Echad hammocher atzmo ben leyisrael ben leakkum veechad shemmecharuhu bet din hare ze megarea mippidono veotze ketzad hare shemmecharuhu beshishshim dinarim veavad arba shanim umatza yado hare ze noten esrim dinarim veyetze lecherut vechen im machar atzmo bearbaim dinarin leeser shanim hare ze megarea arbaa dinarin lechal shana sheavad venoten hannishar kesef o sheve kesef veotze vechen hannimkar leakkum mechashshev haddamim lefi hashshanim hannisharot ad shenat hayyovel shenneemar vechishshav im konehu mishshenat himmachro lo ad shenat hayyovel ketzad machar atzmo bemea venishar layyovel mishshenat mechira eser shanim mechashshev asara lechal shana sheavad vegorea haddamim umeshiv hashshear kesef lo tevua velo kelim shenneemar kesef mimkaro bechesef hu nigal miyyad haakkum veeno nigal bishve kesef

Kal eved ivri o ivriyya sheyyatza begiron kesef vehivri vehosifu damav o nishchaf ufachatu damav mechashshevin lo lehakel alav ketzad hare shennimkar bemea vahare hu atta shave matayim eno mechashshev im adonav ella lefi mea nimkar bematayim vahare hu shave mea mechashshev immo al pi hashshanim hannotarot lefi mea

Hannimkar leakkum hoil veyesh ligl atzmo lachatzain kemo shebbearnu peamim yihye lehakel ufamim lehachmir ketzad lehakel kana oto bematayim venishchaf vahare hu atta shave mea venatan lo chamishshim chatzi damav vehivri vahare hu shave matayim noten lo mea shehen chatzi damav hannishar veyatza ketzad lehachmir kana oto bematayim venatan lo chatzi damav shehen mea venishchaf vahare atta shave mea noten lo chamishshim shehen deme chetzo hannishar venimtza shennatan mea vachamishshim af al pi shehu atta shave mea

Harav shemmachal laeved al hakkesef shennishar lo laavod kenegdo eno machul lo ad sheyyichtov lo shetar shichrur ketzad hare shekkanahu beshishshim veavad shana o shenatayim veamar lo shear haddamim mechulin lecha lech ledarkecha lo niftar mishshibudo ad sheyyichtov lo shetar

Adon shemmet im hinniach ben zachar hare haeved oved habben ad sof hashshesh o ad sof hashshanim shemmachar atzmo lahen o ad sheyyifga bo yovel o ad sheyegarea pidono veyitten hashshear aval im lo hinniach ben zachar hare ze yetze lecherut veeno oved lo et habbat velo et haach veen tzarich lomar sheeno oved shear hayyorshin vehannimkar leger tzedek o leakkum afillu habben eno oved ella kevan shemmet haadon yetze lecherut nimtzeta omer sheeved ivri nikne bechesef o bishtar vekone et atzmo bachamishsha devarim beshanim o beovel o begiron kesef o bishtar shichrur o bemitat adon belo ben uvakkum o beger afillu hinniach ben mitzva lomar lo tze bishat yetziato af al pi shello amar lo hare hu yotze bechinnam veeno tzarich shetar afillu chala vehotzi rabbo alav hotzaot harbe eno chayyav lo kelum shenneemar yetze lachafshi chinnam
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 3: Kal eved ivri hare haadon chayyav bimzonot ishto hannesua lo velo arusa veshomeret yavam vehu shettihye mutteret lo aval im hayeta meissure lavin afillu sheniyya eno chayyav bimzonoteha shenneemar ishto immo ishsha haruya laamod immo vechen chayyav bimzonot banav uvnotav bimcharuhu bet din neemar im baal ishsha hu veyatza ishto immo vechi taale al datecha shekkevan shennikna ze nishtabeda ishto aval lo ba lelammed ella shehaadon chayyav bimzonoteha uvmocher atzmo neemar veyatza meimmach hu uvanav immo uvnimkar leakkum neemar veyatza bishnat hayyovel hu uvanav immo echad ishsha uvanim shehau lo bishat mechira o ishsha uvanim shehau lo achar mechirato vehu sheyyikkachenna middaat haadon aval im lekachah shello middaat rabbo eno chayyav bimzonoteha
Af al pi shehaadon chayyav bimzonot ishto uvanav en lo bemaase yedehem kelum ella hare maase haishsha umtziatah levaalah vechal shezzoche habbaal beishto zoche ze af al pi shehu eved ivri

Mi shemmecharuhu bet din yesh lerabbo litten lo shifcha kenaanit ben haadon ben beno shel adon im met aviv hare ze noten lo shifcha vechofehu al ze kede sheyyolid mimmenna avadim vahare hi mutteret lo kal yeme avduto shenneemar im adonav yitten lo ishsha vego vehammocher atzmo asur beshifcha kenaanit kishar kal yisrael

En eved ivri muttar beshifcha kenaanit ad shettihye lo ishsha yisreelit uvanim aval im en lo ishsha uvanim en rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit vedavar ze kabbala hu afillu haya hannimkar kohen hare ze muttar beshifcha kenaanit kal yeme avduto

Im hau lo ishsha uvanim af al pi shemmoser lo rabbo shifcha kenaanit eno yachol lehafrisho meishto uvanav shenneemar ishto immo veeno yachol litten lo shette shefachot velo litten shifcha achat lishne avadav haivrim kederech shennoten lakkenaaniyyim shenneemar yitten lo ishsha nirtza shemmasar lo rabbo shifcha kenaanit vehiggia yovel vehaya rabbo mesarev bo latzet veeno rotze latzet vechaval bo patur shehare neesar beshifcha
Hammocher atzmo eno nirtza aval mecharuhu bet din veavad shesh velo ratza latzet hare ze nirtza veoved ad shenat hayyovel o ad sheyyamut haadon
Af al pi shehinniach ben en hannirtza oved et habben mippi hashshemua lamdu vaavado lo velo livno leolam leolamo shel yovel nimtzeta lamed shehannirtza eno kone et atzmo ella bayyovel uvmitat haadon
Eved ivri kohen eno nirtza mippene shennaasa baal mum vahare hu omer veshav el mishpachto lachazaka shehaya bah veeno shav lasserara shehaya bah

Ketzad rotzin mevio levet din shel shelosha veomer devarav lifnehem umaggisho lesof shesh el haddelet o el hammezuza keshehen omdin bevinyan ben delet umzuza shel adon ben shel kal adam venokev et azno hayemanit begufah shel ozen bemartzea shel mattechet ad sheyyaggia laddelet shenneemar venatatta veazno uvaddelet velo neemar mezuza ella sheyyihye omed ben etzel delet ben etzel mezuza uma mezuza keshehi omedet af delet keshehi omedet aval hartzia baddelet af al pi sheen sham mezuza haadon hu sherotzea beatzmo shenneemar veratza adonav lo beno velo shelucho velo sheliach bet din veen rotzin shene avadim keechad sheen osin mitzot chavilot chavilot

Veim amor yomar haeved ad sheyyomar veyishne haeved ad sheyyomar keshehu eved aval im amar achar shesh eno nirtza ad sheyyomar veyishne besof shesh bitchillat peruta acharona ketzad kegon shennishar min hayyom sheve peruta middeme mechirato o yeter meat aval im nishar pachot mishsheve peruta hare ze keomer achar shesh

Hayeta laeved shifcha kenaanit velo mimmenna banim ulrabbo en ishsha uvanim eno nirtza shenneemar ki ahevcha veet betecha lerabbo ishsha uvanim velo en ishsha uvanim eno nirtza shenneemar ahavti et adoni et ishti veet banay hu ohev et rabbo verabbo eno ohavo eno nirtza shenneemar ki tov lo immach rabbo ohavo vehu eno ohev et rabbo eno nirtza shenneemar ki ahevcha hu chole verabbo eno chole eno nirtza shenneemar ki tov lo immach rabbo chole vehu eno chole o shehau shenehem cholim eno nirtza shenneemar ki tov lo immach ad sheyyihu shenehem betova

Ma ben mocher atzmo limcharuhu bet din mocher atzmo eno nirtza umcharuhu bet din nirtza mocher atzmo asur beshifcha kenaanit umcharuhu bet din rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit mocher atzmo nimkar leakkum umcharuhu bet din eno nimkar ella leyisrael shenneemar ki yimmacher lecha achicha en bet din mochrin oto ella lecha mocher atzmo nimkar leshesh veyeter al shesh mecharuhu bet din eno nimkar ella leshesh mocher atzmo en maanikin lo mecharuhu bet din maanikin lo

Mippi hashshemua lamdu sheen haishsha nirtzaat vechen yerae meinyan hakkatuv shehare omer benirtza ahavti et adoni et ishti veet banay umahu shenneemar veaf laamatcha taase ken lehaanik shekkeshem shemmitzvat ase lehaanik eved ivri kach maanik ama haivriyya

Kal hamshalleach avdo vaamato rekam over belo taase shenneemar lo teshallechennu rekam vahare hakkatuv nitteko laase shenneemar haanek taanik lo echad hayyotze besof shesh o sheyyatza beovel o bemitat haadon vechen haama haivriyya sheyyatzat beechad mikkal ellu o besimanin hare ellu maanikin lahem aval hayyotze begiron kesef en maanikin lahem shenneemar vechi teshallechennu chafshi meimmach veze lo shillecho chafshi ella haeved natan shear haddamim shennishar lo laavod bahen veachar kach yatza haanek taanik lo mitztzoncha miggarnecha umiyyikvecha beinyan tzon goren veyekev devarim sheyyesh bahem beracha mechamat atzman hu shechayyav lehaanik lo mehem aval hakkesafim vehabbegadim eno chayyav litten lo mehem vechamma noten lo en pachot mishsheve sheloshim sela ben mimmin echad ben mimminin harbe kishloshim shel kenas haeved shenneemar bo yitten ladonav ben shennitbarech habbayit biglalo ben shello nitbarech shenneemar haanek taanik lo mikkal makom im ken lamma neemar asher berachcha hakkol lefi habberacha ten lo

Im barach ufaga bo yovel keshehu boreach veyatza lecherut eno chayyav lehaaniko shenneemar vechi teshallechennu vego enek eved ivri leatzmo veen baal chov gove hemennu veenek ama haivriyya vechen metziatah leaviha veim met aviha kodem sheyyavo leyado hare hen shel atzmah veen leacheha bahem kelum sheen adam morish zechut sheyyesh lo bevitto livno
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 4: Ama haivriyya hi hakketanna shemmecharah aviha umishshettavi shette searot achar shettem esre shana vetease naara eno yachol lemachrah af al pi sheadayin yesh lo reshut bah veyesh lo lekaddeshah lechal mi sheyyirtze af hakketanna shehi ayelonit besimaneha veenah reuya lahavaat shette searot yesh leaviha lemachrah kal zeman shehi ketanna aval hattumtum vehaanderoginus eno nimkar lo keeved ivri velo kedin haama haivriyya

En haav rashshay limkor et bitto ella im ken heeni velo nishar lo kelum lo karka velo mittaltelin vaafillu kesut shealav veaf al pi chen kofin et haav lifdotah achar shemmecharah mishshum pegam mishpacha barach haav o shemmet o shello haya lo lifdotah hare zo ovedet ad shettetze

Ama haivriyya niknet bechesef o bishve kesef uvishtar veenah niknet bifruta mippene shetztzarich liknotah bedamim sheruyin legeraon kede shettigra pidonah vetetze ketzad bishtar kotev al hanneyar o al hacheres bitti mechura lecha bitti kenuya lecha venoten beyad haadon ushtar ama haivriyya haav kotvo

Ama haivriyya ovedet shesh shanim keeved shemmecharuhu bet din shenneemar ki yimmacher lecha achicha haivri o haivriyya veotzet bitchillat sheva veim paga bah yovel betoch shesh yotza chinnam keeved met haadon af al pi shehinniach ben yotza chinnam kenirtza shenneemar veaf laamatcha taase ken vechen megaraat mippidonah veotza veim katav lah shetar shichrur umachal al hashshear yotza chinnam keeved

Yetera ama haivriyya shehi yotza besimanin ketzad kegon shehevia simanin venaaset naara yotza lecherut belo kesef afillu hevia simanin meachar yom shellekachah hare zo yotzet lecherut shenneemar veyatza chinnam ribba lah hakkatuv yetzia acheret bechinnam yeter al haeved mippi hashshemua lamdu shehi havaat simane naarut vetachzor lirshut aviha ad shettivgor vetetze mershut aviha hayeta habbat ayelonit sheen lah yeme naarut ella yotzet mikkatnutah leveger kevan shebbagra tetze lecherut

En ama haivriyya yotza berashe evarim shenneemar lo tetze ketzet haavadim vechen eved ivri im hippil lo shinno o simme lo eno meshallem lo kedin hachovel bachavero kemo shebbearnu behilchot chovel nimtzeta lamed sheama haivriyya niknet bishne devarim bechesef o bishtar vekona atzmah beshishsha devarim beshanim uvovel uvgiron kesef uvishtar shichrur uvmitat haadon uvsimanin

Yied otah haadon leatzmo o livno hare hi kishar arusot veenah yotza beechad mikkal ellu ella bemitat habbaal o beget umitzvat yiud kodemet lemitzvat pediyya ketzad mitzvat yiud omer lah bifne shenayim hare atte mekuddeshet li hare atte meoreset li hare atte li leishsha afillu besof shesh samuch lishkiat hachamma veeno tzarich litten lah kelum shemmaot harishonot lekiddushin nittenu venoheg bah minhag ishut veeno noheg bah minhag shefachot veeno meyaed shettayim keachat shenneemar yeadah vechetzad meyaadah livno im haya beno gadol venatan reshut leaviv leyaadah lo hare haav omer lah bifne shenayim hare atte mekuddeshet livni

En haadon meyaed ama haivriyya lo lo velo livno ella middatah af al pi shekkevar kibbel aviha meoteha shehare hu omer yeadah middatah veim met haadon en beno yuchal leyaadah lo shehare yotza lecherut bemitat haadon

Hayyiud keerusin veeno kenissuin lefichach eno mittamme lah velo yirashenna velo mefer nedareha ad shettikkanes lechuppa veim shelash elle lo yaase lah lo yiadah lo velo yiadah livno velo nifdet begiron kesef veyatza chinnam bahavaat simanin kemo shebbearnu

Yeter al otan hadderachim shekkona bahen atzmah keeved ivri en haadon yachol limkor ama haivriyya velo littenah leish acher ben rachok ben karov veim machar o natan lo asa kelum shenneemar leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah bevigdo vah vechen eved ivri lo yachol lemachro leacher velo litteno veyerae li shello hutzrach hakkatuv leesor davar ze beama ella mippene sheyyesh lo leyaadah livno lechach neemar leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah

En ama haivriyya nimkeret ella lemi sheyyesh lah alav o livno kiddushin kede shettehe reuya leyiud ketzad mocher adam et bitto leaviv sheaf al pi sheen haadon yachol leyaadah lo reuya hi livno shehare haama bat achiv aval eno yachol limkor et bitto livno mippene sheenah reuya leadon shehare hi achoto velo livno mippene shehi achot aviv
Yesh leadam limkor bitto lifsulin kegon almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedot sheaf al pi shehen belav kiddushin tofsin bahen

Hamkaddesh et bitto keshehi ketanna venitarmela o nitgarsha eno yachol lemachrah sheen adam yachol limkor et bitto leshifchut achar ishut aval mochrah leshifcha achar shifchut ketzad mecharah leshifchut techilla veyied otah haadon umet haadon o gershah vechazra lirshut haav keshehi ketanna hare haav mochrah paam sheniyya afillu lechohen vechen im nafla lifne yavam min hayyiud vechalatz lah af al pi shehi chalitza pesula mippene shehi ketanna hare nifsela min hakkehunna veyesh lo lemachrah lechohen hoil vekiddushin tofsin bah kemo shennitbaer
Hammocher et bitto veyatza beshanim o beovel o begiron kesef vaadayin hi ketanna yesh lo lachzor ulmachrah paam sheniyya kemo shebbearnu
Hammocher et bitto veachar kach halach vekiddeshah leacher im ratza haadon leyaed meyaed veim lo yied haadon lo lo velo livno keshettetze mershut haadon yiggamru kiddusheha vetease eshet ish
Hammocher et bitto ufasak al haadon al menat shello leyaed otah im ratza haadon leyaed meyaed shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora shettenao batel
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 5: Eved kenaani nikne bachamishsha devarim vekone et atzmo bishlosha nikne bechesef o bishtar o bachazaka o bachalifin o bimshicha vekone et atzmo bechesef o bishtar o berashe evarim veeved katan hare hu kivhema venikne bimshicha kimshichat habbehema uchvar bearnu bitchillat sefer ze kal hadderachim shehaavadim niknin bahen

Ketzad kone et atzmo bechesef kegon shennatan echad lerabbo maot veamar lo al menat sheyyetze avdecha bahem lecherut kevan shekkibbel harav et hakkesef o sheve kesef yatza haeved lecherut veen tzarich daat haeved shezzechut hi lo vezachin leadam shello befanav vechen im natan echad leeved maot veamar al menat shettetze bahem lecherut im ratza haadon lekabbel hammaot yatza haeved lecherut veim lo ratza lo kana haeved hammaot shello natan lo ella al menat sheyyetze bahem lecherut veechad hakkesef o sheve kesef ben liknoto ben lehaknot atzmo lo

Ketzad bishtar kotev lo al hanneyar o al hacheres hare atte ben chorin o hare atte shel atzmecha o en li esek becha vechen kal kayyotze baze beinyan ze shezze hu gufo shel get shichrur umoser lo et hashshetar bifne shene edim o shehau haedim chatumim bo umsaro lo beno leveno hare ze yatza lecherut shehare gitto veyado bain keechad amar lo shello bichtav hare atte ben chorin hare atte shel atzmecha af al pi sheheidu alav edim bevet din veaf al pi shekkanu miyyado adayin lo nishtachrer sheen haeved yotze lecherut ella bechesef o bishtar o berashe evarim vhakkotev leshifchato hare atte mutteret lechal adam lo amar kelum

Ketzad berashe evarim hammakke et avdo bechavana vchisro echad meesrim vearbaa rashe evarim sheenan chozrin yatza lecherut vetzarich get shichrur im ken lamma neemar battora shen ve ayin liddon mehen ma shen veayin mumin shebbegaluy veenan chozrin af kal mumin shebbegaluy veenan chozrin yetze haeved bo lecherut aval hamsares avdo babbetzim o hachotech leshono eno yotze lecherut sheenan mumin shebbegaluy vechen hammappil shen hakkatan eno yotze lecherut shehare sofo lachzor

En yotze berashe evarim ella avadim shemmalu vetavlu shehare yeshnan bemiktzat mitzot aval haeved shehu begeuto eno yotze berashe evarim ellu hen rashe evarim sheenan chozrin etzbeot yadayim veraglayim esrim rashe haaznayim verosh hachotem verosh haggeviyya verashe haddadin shebbaishsha aval haenayim vehashshinnayim hare hen meforashin battora

Hayeta lo etzba yetera vachatachah im nisperet al gav hayyad eved yotze bah lecherut hayeta eno semuya vechittah eved yotze bah lecherut shehare chissero evar vehu haddin leechad merashe evarim shehu batel veeno ose bo melacha sheim chatacho hare chissero evar veyatza lecherut
Hikkahu al eno vesimmeah al azno vechershah eved yotze bahen lecherut hikkahu keneged eno veeno roe keneged azno veeno shomea en eved yotze bahen lecherut
Hikkahu al eno vechasra meorah al shinno veniddedah im yachol lehishtammesh bahem eno yotze lecherut veim lav yetze lecherut
Hayeta eno keha vechisser meorah o shinno nodedet vehikkahu haadon vehippil hashshen hannodedet o simme haayin hakkeha im haya mishtammesh bahen kal shehu yetze lecherut veim lav lo yetze lecherut
Hikkahu al yado vetzavta yado vesofah lachzor eno yotze lecherut talash bizkano vedildel bo etzem min hallechi yetze lecherut shehare bittel maase hashshinnayim hakkevuot beoto haetzem

Hippil et shinno o simme et eno belo kavana kegon shezzarak even livhema venafla baeved vehippila et shinno vechatcha etzbao lo yetze lecherut shenneemar im shen avdo o shen amato yappil ad sheyyitkaven
Hoshit yado lime shifchato vesimme en haubbar shebbemeeha lo yetze lecherut shehare lo yada davar sheyyitkaven lo

Hare shehaya rabbo rofe veamar lo kechol li eni vesimmeah chator li shinni vehippilah sachak baadon veyetze lecherut sheaf al pi shello nitkaven lehazzik hare nitkaven lingoa beevre haeved venistakken bahen veen tzarich lomar im hayeta en haeved koevet vehaya rabbo umman vaakarah lo shehare yetze lecherut
Hammappil shen avdo vesimme et eno hare yetze lecherut beshinno venoten lo deme eno vechen kal kayyotze baze
Mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin veeved shel shene shuttafin eno yotze berashe evarim lefi sheeno meyuchad lerabbo shechaval bo

Avde tzon barzel yotzin berashe evarim im chisseran habbaal aval lo haishsha veavde melog enan yotzin berashe evarim lo im hippil habbaal shehare en lo bahem ella perot velo im hippila otan haishsha mippene sheenan meyuchadin lah

Yetziat haeved berashe evarim noheg bechal makom uvchal zeman veen danin bo ella bevet din semuchin mippene shehu kenas lefichach haeved sheamar lerabbo hippalta et shinni vesimmeta et eni vehaadon omer lo asiti ze patur sheim yode meatzmo eno chayyav lehotzio lecherut belo edim shehammode biknas patur kemo shebbearnu behilchot geneva shekkal mode biknas patur milleshallemo
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 6: Hakkotev get shichrur leavdo vezikka lo bo al yede acher veamar zeche beget ze lifloni avdi yatza lecherut af al pi shello higgia get leyado shezzachin leadam shello befanav aval im amar tenu get ze leavdi eno yachol lachzor bo velo yetze haeved lecherut ad sheyyaggia hagget leyado lefichach haomer tenu get ze leavdi umet lo yittenu leachar mita
Hakkotev bishtar asiti peloni avdi ben chorin o naasa peloni avdi ben chorin o hare hu ben chorin hare ze yetze lecherut katav bashshetar eesennu ben chorin lo yetze lecherut

Haomer asiti peloni avdi ben chorin vehu omer lo asaani choshshin shemma zikka lo al yede acher amar katavti get shichrur venatatti lo vehu amar lo katav velo natan hodaat baal din kemea edim vahare ze eved ad sheyeshachrerenu befanenu

Mi shetztziva bishat mitato pelonit shifchati al yishtabedu bah yorshay hare zo shifcha keshehayeta veasur layyorshim lehishtabed bah mippene shemmitzva lekayyem divre hammet vechen im amar asu lah korat ruach kofin et hayyorshin veen mishtabedin bah ella bimlacha shehi rotza bah tziva veamar shachreruha kofin et hayyorshin leshachrer otah

Beshishsha devarim shavin shichrure avadim legitte nashim uvishar devarim hare hen kishar kal hashshetarot veellu hen hashshishsha pesulim bearkaot shel akkum uchsherin beed kuti utzrichin ketiva leshem hammeshuchrar atzmo veen nichtavin bimchubbar veen chotmin edehem ella ze bifne ze echad gitte nashim veechad shichrure avadim shavin lammolich velammevi ketzad kal hashshetarot haolim bearkaot shel akkum kesherim bechal hattenaim sheanu mevaarim behilchot halvaa chutz miggitte nashim veshichrure avadim

Kal shetar sheyyesh alav afillu ed echad kuti pasul chutz miggitte nashim veshichrure avadim shehen kesherin beed echad yisrael veed echad kuti vehu sheyyihye kuti chaver uvazzeman hazze shehakkutim keakkum lechal divrehem anu lemedin mehen litzdokin shehatztzedokin bazzeman hazze kemo kuti beoto hazzeman kodem sheggazru alehem sheyyihu keakkum lechal divrehem beget ishsha hu omer vechatav lah lishmah uvget shichrur hu omer o chufsha lo nittan lah ad sheyyichtov lishmah beget ishsha hu omer vechatav venatan mi sheeno mechussar ella netina yatza hakkotev bimchubbar veachar kach kitztzetz shehare mechussar ketzitza untina uvget shichrur hu omer venatan lah lo yihye mechussar ella netina echad gitte nashim veshichrure avadim enan chotmin edehem ella ze bifne ze uchvar bearnu taam haddavar behilchot gerushin

Vechetzad shavin bemolich umevi shehammevi get shichrur beeretz yisrael en tzarich lomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam uvchutza laaretz im en edim metzuyin lekayemo veamar hashshaliach befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam zehu kiyyumo veim ba haadon veirer achar kach en mashgichin bo kemo shebbearnu begitte nashim keshem shehaishsha atzmah mevia gittah veenah tzericha lekayemo hoil vehagget yotze mittachat yadah kach haeved sheshshetar shichrur yotze mittachat yado eno tzarich lekayemo uchshem shehaishsha omeret befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam im hitna aleha kemo shebbearnu bimkomo kach haeved shehevi get veamar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam neeman al oto hadderech veen tzarich kiyyum

Kal hakkasher lehavi get haishsha kasher lehavi get haeved vehaeved mekabbel get lachavero miyyad rabbo shel chavero aval lo miyyad rabbo shel mekabbel hakkotev shetar erusin leshifchato af al pi sheamar lah tzei bo lecherut vehitkaddeshi bo en ballashon hazze leshon shichrur veenah mekuddeshet velo meshuchreret
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 7: Get shichrur tzarich sheyyihye inyano davar hakkoret beno leven adonav velo yishshaer laadon bo zechut lefichach hakkotev leavdo atzmecha vechal nechasay kenuyin lecha chutz mimmakom peloni o chutz mittallit pelonit en ze koret vehagget batel umittoch sheeno get en haeved meshuchrar velo kana min hannechasim kelum vechen kal kayyotze baze

Eved shehevi get vechatuv bo atzmecha unchasay kenuyin lecha atzmo kana vahare hu ben chorin aval hannechasim lo kana ad sheyyitkayyem hagget bechotmav kishar hashshetarot vechen im haya katuv bo kal nechasay kenuyin lecha kana atzmo velo kana hannechasim ad sheyyitkayyem hagget bechotmav shecholkim haddibbur veomrim atzmo kana mippene shehu neeman lehavi get shichruro veeno tzarich lekayemo aval hannechasim sheen adam kone otam ella biraya berura lo yikne otam ad sheyyitkayyem hashshetar

Hamshachrer shene avadim bishtar echad lo kanu atzman ella kotvin shetar lechal echad veechad lefichach hakkotev kal nechasav lishne avadav bishtar echad af atzman lo kanu veim katav bishne shetarot kanu umshachrerin ze et ze bamme devarim amurim beshekkatav bechal shetar mishshenehem kal nechasay netunim lifloni ufloni avdi aval im katav chatzi nechasay lifloni avdi vachatzi nechasay lifloni avdi af bishne shetarot lo kanu kelum shehaeved mikkelal nechasim vahare shiyyer bo chetzo veen ze shichrur vechevan shello nishtachrer lo kana min hannechasim kelum

Hamshachrer chatzi avdo bishtar lo kana haeved chetzo vahare hu eved keshehaya aval im shichrer chetzo bechesef kegon shellakach chatzi damav al menat leshachrer chetzo kana venimtza chetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin bamme devarim amurim besheshshichrer chetzo bishtar vehinniach chetzo aval im shichrer chetzo umachar chetzo o sheshshichrer chetzo venatan chetzo bemattana hoil veyatza haeved kullo mershuto kana haeved chetzo vahare ze chetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin vechen eved shel shene shuttafin veshichrer echad mehen chelko ben bechesef ben bishtar kana haeved chetzo vahare hu chetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin
Hakkotev leshifchato meubberet hare atte bat chorin uveladech eved devarav kayyamin hare atte shifcha uveladech ben chorin lo amar velo kelum shezze kemi shemmeshachrer chetzyah
Shifcha charufa im ratza leshachrer chetzyah hannishar vetease eshet ish gemura hare ze meshachrer ben bechesef ben bishtar sheaf hakkesef gomer shichrurah

Mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin hoil veeno muttar lo beshifcha velo bevat chorin kofin et rabbo veose oto ben chorin vechotev shetar alav bachatzi damav bamme devarim amurim beeved mippene shehaish metzuve al periyya urviyya aval hashshifcha tishshaer kemot shehi veovedet et rabba yom echad veet atzmah yom echad veim nahagu bah hachotim minhag hefker kofin et rabba leshachrer vechotev aleha shetar bachatzi dameha

Mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin sheamad rabbo vehikna chetzo livno hakkatan kede shello yachofu oto bet din leshachrero maamidin bet din lakkatan appotroppos vechotev lo haappotroppos get shichrur vechotev lo shetar chov bachatzi damav veim nitztarech hakkatan beeved veyesh lo gaguin alav mafligin oto mimmennu bemaot sheddato shel katan karov etzel maot
Shechiv mera shekkatav kal nechasav leavdo veamad chozer bannechasim veeno chozer baeved shehare yatza alav shem ben chorin
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 8: Hammocher et avdo leakkum yetze ben chorin vechofin et rabbo lachzor veliknoto min haakkum ad asara bedamav vechotev lo get shichrur veotze veim lo ratza haakkum lemachro afillu baasara bedamav en mechayevin oto yeter uknas ze en govin oto vedanin oto ella bevet din mumchin veim met hammocher en konsin et hayyoresh lehachzir et haeved leshichrur

Lava al avdo min haakkum im kava lo zeman veamar lo im higgia zeman peloni velo ashallem lecha tikne guf eved ze hare ze yetze lecherut miyyad veim amar lo tikne maase yadav lo yetze lecherut gevao akkum bechovo o shebbau al haadon metzerim uvikkeshu lehargo ufada atzmo miyyadan beavdo lo yatza lecherut mippene shennilkach mimmennu shello birtzono
Machar avdo leechad meavde hammelech o miggedolav af al pi shehu mityare mehem yatza haeved lecherut mippene shehaya yachol lefayeso bemamon acher

Mecharo leakkum lishloshim yom mecharo chutz mimmelachto chutz min hammitzot chutz mishshabbatot veyamim tovim hare ze safek im nishtachrer o lo nishtachrer lefichach im tafas haeved kede damav lerabbo kede sheyyetze bahen lecherut miyyad akkum en motziin miyyado

Echad mocher avdo leakkum oved avoda zara o shemmecharo leger toshav afillu lechuti hare ze yetze lecherut mecharo leyisrael mumar hare ze safek lefichach im tafas kede damav merabbo rishon kede latzet bahen miyyad hammumar en motziin miyyado

Hammocher avdo lechutza laaretz yatza ben chorin vechofin et rabbo hashsheni lichtov lo get shichrur veavdu haddamim umippene ma kansu kan hallokeach levaddo sheillu lo lakach ze lo yatza haeved lechutza laaretz hammocher avdo lesurya vaafillu leakko kemocher lechutza laaretz

Ben bavel shennasa ishsha beeretz yisrael vedato lachzor vehichnisa lo ishto avadim ushfachot hare ellu safek im hem kemi shemmachra otam lechutza laaretz hoil veyesh lo happerot o enan kimchurin lo shehare hagguf shellah

Eved sheyyatza achar rabbo lesurya umcharo sham ibbed et zechuto bamme devarim amurim kesheyyatza rabbo al menat shello lachzor leeretz yisrael aval im daat rabbo lachzor veyatza acharav umcharo sham yatza lecherut vechofin et hallokeach leshachrero

Eved sheamar laalot leeretz yisrael kofin et rabbo laalot immo o yimkor oto lemi sheyyaaluhu lesham ratza haadon latzet lechutza laaretz eno yachol lehotzi et avdo ad sheyyirtze vedin ze bechal zeman afillu bazzeman hazze shehaaretz beyad akkum

Eved shebbarach michutza laaretz laaretz en machazirin lo leavdut vealav neemar lo tasgir eved el adonav veomer lerabbo sheyyichtov lo get shichrur veyichtov lo shetar chov bedamav ad shettassig yado veyitten lo veim lo ratza haadon leshachrero mafkiin bet din shibudo mealav veyelech lo

Eved ze shebbarach laaretz hare hu ger tzedek vehosif lo hakkatuv azhara acheret lemi shemmeanne oto mippene shehu shefal ruach yoter min hagger vetziva alav hakkatuv shenneemar immecha yeshev bekirbecha beachad shearecha battov lo lo tonennu zo af honayat devarim nimtzeta lamed shehamanne et hagger hazze over bishlosha lavin mishshum velo tonu ish et amito umishshum veger lo tone umishshum lo tonennu vechen over mishshum velo tilchatzennu kemo shebbearnu beinyan honaya

Hakkone eved min haakkum setam velo ratza lamul ulkabbel mitzot haavadim megalgelin immo kal shenem asar chodesh veim lo ratza chozer umochro leakkum o lechutza laaretz veim hitna haeved alav techilla shello yamul hare ze muttar lekayemo kal zeman sheyyirtze begeuto umochro leakkum o lechutza laaretz vechen eved shemmal vetaval leshem avdut veachar kach hippil atzmo ligyasot veen rabbo yachol lehotzio lo bedine yisrael velo bedine ummot haolam hare ze muttar lo littol damav min haakkum vechotev umaale bearkaot shel akkum mippene shehu kematztzil miyyadam
Hammafkir avdo yatza lecherut vetzarich get shichrur veim met haadon shehifkiro hayyoresh kotev lo get shichrur
Eved shebbarach mibbet haasurin im nityaesh mimmennu rabbo yatza lecherut vechofin et rabbo vechotev lo get shichrur

Eved shennishba im nityaesh mimmennu rabbo rishon kal happode oto leshem eved yishtabed bo vahare hu shello veim padahu leshem ben chorin hare ze ben chorin veim lo nityaesh mimmennu rabbo rishon happode oto leshem eved notel pidono merabbo vechozer lerabbo veim padahu leshem ben chorin chozer lerabbo harishon belo kelum
Eved sheasao rabbo appoteke levaal chovo veshichrero hare ze meshuchrar vechofin et baal chovo leshachrero gam ze mippene tikkun haolam shello yifga bo leachar zeman veyomar lo avdi atta

Eved shehissio rabbo bat chorin o shehinniach lo rabbo tefillin berosho o sheamar lo rabbo likrot shelosha pesukin besefer tora bifne tzibbur vechen kal kayyotze beellu haddevarim sheeno chayyav bahen ella ben chorin yetze lecherut vechofin et rabbo lichtov lo get shichrur vechen im nadar neder shekkofin alav et haavadim kemo shebbearnu bindarim veamar lo rabbo mufar lecha yetze lecherut shekkevan shello kafa oto bemakom sheyyesh lo lichpoto gilla dato shehifkia shibudo mikkan ani omer shehamshachrer avdo bechal lashon vehotzi devarim mippiv shemmashmaan shello nishar lo alav shibud kelal vesheggamar belibbo ledavar ze sheeno yachol lachzor bo kofin oto lichtov lo get shichrur af al pi sheadayin lo katav aval im lava meavdo o sheasahu appotroppos o shehinniach tefillin bifne rabbo o shekkara shelosha pesukim bevet hakkeneset bifne rabbo velo micha bo lo yetze lecherut
Veasur leadam lelammed et avdo tora veim limmedo lo yatza lecherut
Hallokeach eved min haakkum vekadam haeved vetaval bifne rabbo leshem ben chorin yatza lecherut shello bifne rabbo tzarich lefaresh lefichach tzarich rabbo letakpo bammayim
Yisrael shettakaf akkum katan o matza tinok akkum vehitbilo leshem ger hare ze ger leshem eved hare ze eved leshem ben chorin hare ze ben chorin
Ger shekkadmu avadav veshifchotav vetavlu lefanav kanu atzman bene chorin
Mishneh Torah, Slaves 9: Yisrael shebba al shifcha kenaanit af al pi shehi shifchato hare ze havalad kenaani lechal davar venimkar venikne umishtammeshim bo leolam kishar haavadim

Echad hakkone eved kenaani miyyisrael o min ger toshav o min akkum shehu kavush tachat yadenu o meechad mishshear haummot yesh lo limkor et atzmo leyisrael leeved vahare hu eved kenaani lechal davar vechen mocher banav uvnotav shenneemar mehem tiknu umimmishpachtam asher immachem asher holidu beartzechem vechal echad meellu hare hu keeved kenaani lechal davar

Echad min haummot shebba al shifcha kenaanit shellanu hare habben eved kenaani shenneemar asher holidu beartzechem aval haeved shellanu shebba al achat min haummot en habben eved shenneemar asher holidu beartzechem veeved en lo yachas

Melech akkum sheasa milchama vehevi shivya umcharah vechen im hirsha lechal mi sheyyirtze sheyyelech veyignov meumma shehi osa immo milchama sheyyavi veyimkor leatzmo vechen im hau dinav shekkal mi shello yitten hammas yimkor o mi sheasa kach vechach o lo yaase yimkor hare dinav din veeved hannilkach bedinin ellu hare hu keeved kenaani lechal davar
Akkum shekkana akkum leavdut lo kana gufo veen lo bo ella maase yadav af al pi chen im mecharo leyisrael hare gufo kanuy leyisrael

Haishsha kona shefachot veenah kona avadim afillu ketannim mippene hachashad veim kanta otam hare zo kanta gufam keish veyerae li sheenah asura liknot ella eved ben tesha shanim umittesha ulmala vechen asur leadam leshachrer eved kenaani vechal hamshachrero over baase shenneemar lelam bahem taavodu veim shichrero meshuchrar kemo shebbearnu vechofin oto lichtov get shichrur bechal hadderachim shebbearnu umuttar leshachrero lidvar mitzva afillu lemitzva shel divrehem kegon shello hau asara bevet hakkeneset hare ze meshachrer avdo umashlim bo hamminyan vechen kal kayyotze baze vechen shifcha shennohagin bah haam minhag hefker vahare hi michshol lachotim kofin et rabba umshachrerah kede shettinnase veyasur hammichshol vechen kal kayyotze baze

Yachol harav lomar leavdo kenaani asa immi veeni zancha ella yelech veyishal al happetachim veyitparnes min hatztzedaka sheyyisrael metzuvin lehachaot haavadim shebbenehem bamme devarim amurim baavadav sheen bet din nizkakin ligdolim lishmor mamonam veim lo yaachil laavadav veyashkem karauy hem yivrechu o yamutu veadam chas al mamon atzmo yeter mikkal adam aval avadim shehichnisa lo ishto betorat nichse melog chayyav bimzonotehen sheal menat ken hichnis otam sheim lo yazun otam yamutu veyivrechu vahare eno chayyav beacharautan

Muttar laavod beeved kenaani befarech veaf al pi shehaddin kach middat chasidut vedarche chachma sheyyihye adam rachman verodef tzedek velo yachbid ello al avdo velo yatzer lo veyaachilehu veyashkehu mikkal maachal umikkal mishte chachamim harishonim hau notnin laeved mikkal tavshil vetavshil shehau ochlin umakdimin mezon habbehemot vehaavadim lisudat atzman hare hu omer cheene avadim el yad adonehem keene shifcha el yad gevirtah vechen lo yevazzehu bayyad velo bidvarim leavdut mesaran hakkatuv lo levusha velo yarbe alav tzeaka vechaas ella yedabber immo benachat veyishma taanotav vechen meforash bedarche iyyov hattovim shehishtabbeach bahen im emas mishpat avdi vaamati berivam immadi halo vabbeten oshoni asahu vayechunennu barechem echad veen haachzariyyut vehaazzut metzuya ella beakkum ovde avoda zara aval zaro shel avraham avinu vehem yisrael shehishpia lahem hakkadosh baruch hu tovat hattora vetziva otam bechukkim umishpatim tzaddikim rachmanim hem al hakkol vechen bemiddotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu shetztzivanu lehiddamot bahem hu omer verachamav al kal maasav vechal hamrachem merachamin alav shenneemar venatan lecha rachamim verichamcha vehirbecha
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 1: En haishsha mitgareshet ella bichtav sheyyaggia lah uchtav ze hu hannikra get vaasara devarim hen ikkar haggerushin min hattora veellu hen shello yegaresh haish ella birtzono vesheyegaresh bichtav velo bedavar acher vesheyyihye inyan hakketav sheggershah vehesirah mikkinyano vesheyyihye inyano davar hakkoret beno levenah vesheyyihye nichtav lishmah veshello yihye mechussar maase achar ketivato ella netinato lah bilvad vesheyyittenehu lah vesheyyittenehu lah bifne edim vesheyyittenehu lah betorat gerushin vesheyyihye habbaal o shelucho hu shennotno lah ushar haddevarim shebbagget kegon hazzeman vachatimat haedim vechayyotze bahen hakkol middivre sofrim

Uminnayin sheasara devarim ellu min hattora shenneemar vehaya im lo timtza chen beenav vechatav lah sefer keritut venatan beyadah veshillechah mibbeto im lo timtza chen beenav melammed sheeno megaresh ella birtzono veim nitgarsha shello birtzono enah megoreshet aval haishsha mitgareshet birtzonah veshello birtzonah

Vechatav melammed sheenah mitgareshet ella bichtav lah lishmah sefer keritut davar hakkoret beno levenah shello yishshaer lo aleha reshut veim adayin lo nichrat beno levenah enah megoreshet kemo sheyyitbaer venatan beyadah melammed sheenah mitgareshet ad sheyyinnaten hagget beyadah o beyad shelucha shehu keyadah o lachatzerah shehakkol keyadah kemo sheyyitbaer veshillechah sheyyihye inyan hagget shehu hamshalleach otah lo sheyyishlach atzmo mimmenna

Ketzad katav lah hare atte meshullachat hare atte megoreshet hare atte leatzmech hare atte mutteret lechal adam vechayyotze beze hainyan hare zo megoreshet vegufo shel get hare atte mutteret lechal adam aval im katav lah eni balech eni arusech eni ishech en ze get shenneemar veshillechah velo sheyyishlach et atzmo vechen hakkotev leishto hare atte bat chorin eno get

Ze shenneemar battora veshillechah mibbeto en inyano shello yiggamru gerusheha ad shettetze mibbeto ella keshemmaggia get leyadah gamru gerusheha veaf al pi sheadayin hi beveto kemo sheyyitbaer shello neemar veshillechah ella sheim geresh velo hotziah mibbeto hare ze kemi sheggeresh vehechezir gerushato lefichach tzericha mimmennu get kemo sheyyitbaer

Uminnayin shello yihye mechussar maase achar ketivato shenneemar vechatav venatan mi sheeno mechussar ella ketiva untina hu hagget hakkasher yatza davar shemmechussar ketzitza achar hakketiva lefichach im katav get al keren happara noten lah happara veim chatach hakkeren achar shekketavo untano lah eno get vechen im katav bimchubbar af al pi shechatmu bo haedim achar shettelasho untano lah eno get
En kotvin bimchubbar afillu tofes hagget katav hattofes bimchubbar utlasho veachar kach katav shem haish veshem haishsha vehazzeman vahare atte mutteret lechal adam vachatamo untano lah kasher
Katav kal hagget al heale hazzarua beatzitz nakuv af al pi shennatan lah heatzitz kullo hagget pasul gezera shemma yiktom aval kotev hu al charso shel atzitz venoten lah

Uminnayin sheeno notno lah ella betorat gerushin shenneemar sefer keritut venatan beyadah sheyyitten oto betorat sefer keritut aval im netano lah betorat shehu shetar chov o mezuza o shennetano beyadah vehi yeshena veneora vahare hu beyadah eno get veim amar lah achar kach hare hu gittech hare ze get

Amar leedim reu get sheani noten lah vechazar veamar lah kinsi shetar chov ze hare ze kasher shehare hodia et haedim shennetano betorat gerushin veze sheamar lah shetar chov mippene shennichlam mimmenna

Hamgaresh tzarich sheyyomar lah kesheyyitten lah hagget hare ze gittech o hu gittech vechayyotze baze veim natan beyadah velo amar kelum hare ze get pasul bamme devarim amurim beshello haya medabber immah al iske gittah aval im haya medabber al iske gittah venatal hagget venatan beyadah velo amar kelum hare ze get kasher

Get shehaya munnach al haaretz veamar lah teli gittech meal gabbe karka untalattu o shehaya kashur al yado o al yerecho ushlafattu mimmennu af al pi sheamar lah achar shebba leyadah hare ze gittech eno get shenneemar venatan beyadah lo shettikkach hi meatzmah vahare lo natan lah lo hu velo shelucho aval im hirkin lah begufo o hitta yado ad sheshshalfa hagget mealav veamar lah hare ze gittech hare ze get

Uminnayin sheyyittenennu lah bifne edim hare hu omer al pi shenayim edim o shelosha edim yakum davar vei efshar shettihye zo hayyom erva vehabba aleha bemitat bet din ulmachar tihye mutteret belo edim lefichach im natan lah get beno levenah vaafillu beed echad eno get kelal
Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hagget bichtav yad sofer aval im katav habbaal hagget bichtav yado vechatam alav ed echad untano lah hare ze get pasul ufosel lichhunna

Takkanat chachamim hu sheyyihu haedim chotmin al hagget shemma yitten lah get bifne shenayim veyamutu venimtza hagget shebbeyadah kecheres mecharse adama shehare en bo edim lefichach tikkenu sheyyaidu mittocho veaf al pi shehaedim betocho notno lah bifne shenayim ben bifne otan haedim hachatumin alav ben bifne shenayim acherim sheikkar haggerushin beede mesira

Chatmu bo shenayim veavar untano lah beno levenah o shennimtzeu ede mesira pesulin hare ze kasher hoil veedim shebbo kesherin vahare hagget yotze mittachat yadeha veyesh shehora min haggeonim shehu pasul
Hau edav mittocho pesulin afillu echad pasul veechad kasher untano lah bifne shene edim kesherin hare ze pasul shennimtza kimzuyyaf mittocho

Hirchik et haedim min hakketav melo shene shitin pasul vechamma yarchik et haedim min hakketav pachot mikkede shene shitin kede sheyyihu nikrain immo bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hagget yotze mittachat yadeha velo hau sham ede mesira aval im mesaro lah beedim af al pi shehen meruchakin harbe veen nikrain immo veaf al pi sheen chatum alav ed kelal hare ze kasher sheikkar haggerushin beede mesira

Haedim shennoten et hagget bifnehem tzerichin likroto veachar kach yittenennu lah veim netano lah bifnehem techilla chozrin vekorin oto achar shennetano lah kerauhu vehu beyad habbaal o beyad shelucho vehechziruhu lo vechazar hu vehichniso letoch yado untano lah chozrin vekorin oto

Lo kerauhu ella natlato uzrakattu layyam o laesh hare zo megoreshet hoil ukrauhu techilla en choshshim lo shehechelifo velo od ella afillu amar habbaal shetar acher haya velo haya hagget shekkeratem eno neeman vahare hi megoreshet
Hare shello karu hagget battechilla venatan lah hagget bifnehem uzrakattu laur o layyam af al pi shehabbaal omer get kasher haya hare zo safek megoreshet

Zarak lah hagget lachatzerah leven hechaviyyot bifne edim uvikkeshu umatzu mezuza o shetar acher en choshshin lah shezze shennimtza hu shezzarak nimtzeu sham shettayim shalosh mezuzot o shetarot choshshin shemma get shezzarak geraruhu achbarim vahare zo safek megoreshet

Haedim shechotmin al hagget tzerichim lihotam yodim likrot velachtom veim enam yodim likrot korim bifnehem vechotmim vehu sheyyakkiru leshon hagget veim enam yodim lachtom roshmin lahem hanneyar berok vechayyotze bo middavar sheen rishshumo mitkayyem vehen kotvin al haroshem veen osin kach bishar shetarot kal hu shehekellu begitte nashim kede shello yihu benot yisrael agunot hoil vachatimat haedim beget middivrehem kemo shebbearnu

Af al pi shechatimat haedim beget middivrehem hitkinu sheyyihu haedim mefarshin shemotehen bagget vechen hitkinu beede hagget sheen chotmin ella ze bifne ze veim chatmu ze shello bifne ze hare ze get pasul vechen hitkinu chachamim sheyyichtov zeman bagget umkom ketivato kishar hashshetarot shemma tihye ishto kerovato vetizne keshehi tachtav veyichtov lah get achar hazzenut veyitten lah veim lo yihye bo zeman yechola lomar kodem hazzenut nitgarashti ulfichach tikkenu zeman begittin

Get sheyyesh alav edim veen bo zeman o shehaya mukdam o meuchar o shennichtav bayyom venechtam ballayela shelleacharav af al pi sheasukin beoto hainyan o katav et hagget birushalayim vetaa vechatav belud kal ellu pesulin ad sheyyachtemu bo bizman ketivato uvimkom ketivato

Chatach mimmennu hazzeman untano lah o shello katav shem hayyom ella beshabbat rishona o sheniyya mechodesh peloni o bechodesh peloni o beshana pelonit velo hizkir hachodesh afillu katav beshavua peloni kasher vechen im katav bo hayyom gerashtiha kasher shemmashmao hayyom hazze sheyyatza bo hagget

Vechen tikkenu sheyehu monin begittin lemalchut oto hazzeman mishshum shelom malchut katav leshem malchut sheenah malchut otah hammedina o levinyan habbayit o lechurban habbayit im derech anshe oto makom limnot bo hare ze kasher veim en darkan limnot bo hare ze pasul uchvar nahagu kal yisrael limnot begittin o litzira o lammalchut alekkesanderos makdon shehu minyan shetarot veim katav leshem malchut oto zeman bimdina sheyyesh bah reshut otah malchut hare ze kasher

Haomer lishnayim kitvu vechitmu utnu get leishti venitacher haddavar yamim o shanim o shennimtza hagget batel vehutzrechu lichtov lah get acher kasher achar kamma shanim kemo sheyyitbaer hare ellu kotvin zeman hakketiva umkom hakketiva lo hazzeman sheamar lahen habbaal bo kitvu velo oto hammakom ketzad hau birushalayim kesheamar lahen vehau omdin betishre venitacharu ad nisan vahare hen belud kotvin zeman hagget minnisan uvlud sheshsham nichtav hagget kishar shetarot
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 2: Ze shenneemar battora vechatav lah sefer keritut venatan beyadah echad hakkotev beyado o sheamar leacher lichtov lo veechad hannoten beyado o sheamar leacher litten lah lo neemar vechatav ella lehodia sheen mitgareshet ella bichtav venatan shello tikkach meatzmah

Amar lishnayim kitvu get vechitmu utnu leishti hare ellu kotvin vechotmin venotnin lah vehen hen sheluchav vehen hen edav vechen im amar lassofer ketov li get leishti veamar laedim lachtom kotvim vechotmim venotnin lo vehu megaresh bo bechal et sheyyirtze

Vechotvin get laish af al pi sheen ishto immo vehu sheyyihu haedim vehassofer shekkatvu vechatmu bo makkirin veodim shezze hu peloni veishto hi pelonit veim hau beoto makom shenayim sheshshemotehem shavim ushmot neshotehem shavim en megaresh echad mehem ella bemaamad chavero shemma yichtov get veolicho leeshet chavero veyaasrenna alav
Uvishat hassakkana kotvin venotnin af al pi sheen makkirim vehaishsha notenet sechar hassofer bechal makom

Vetzarich sheyyomar habbaal atzmo lassofer ketov velaedim chatomu hare sheamru lo bet din o shenayim nichtov get leishtecha veamar lahem kitvu vechatvu hen atzman vechatmu bo hare ze kasher aval im amru hem lassofer vechatav velaedim vechatmu af al pi shechazru untanuhu labbaal vechazar venatan get ze leishto bifne edim hare ze get batel shehare ketavo mi shello amar lo habbaal lechatvo

Amar lishnayim o lishlosha imru lassofer veyichtov get leishti veimru laedim veyachtomu veamru lassofer vechatav velaedim vechatmu o sheamar lishnayim imru lassofer veyichtov get leishti veattem chatomu hare ze get pasul umityashshevin bedavar ze harbe mippene shehu karov lihot get batel
Uma ben pasul levatel shekkal makom shenneemar bechibbur ze beget shehu batel hu batel min hattora uvchal makom shenneemar pasul hu pasul middivre sofrim

Habbaal shehevi get beyado chatum veamar tenu get ze leishti hare ellu yittenu lah amar laacherim lichtov get velachtom bo velitteno leishto vechatvu vechatmu venatnu lah venimtza hagget batel o pasul hare ellu kotvin get acher afillu mea ad sheyyaggia leyadah get kasher

Amar lahem habbaal kitvu vechitmu utnu lashshaliach leholich lah vechatvu vechatmu venatnu lashshaliach venimtza hagget batel o pasul en kotvim acher ad sheyyimmalchu babbaal shehare lo asa otan sheluchim legerushin veshemma lo ratza ella sheyyichtevu veyittenu lashshaliach bilvad velo yishshaer lahem bo maase acher vahare katvu venatnu lefichach lo yichtevu acher veim katvu get acher kasher untanuhu lashshaliach venatnu lah hare zo safek megoreshet

Haomer lishnayim o leyeter mishshenayim kitvu get utnu leishti garshuha shallechuha shivkuha tarchuha kitvu iggeret utnu lah hare ellu yichtevu get kasher veyittenu lah amar lahem pitruha parnesuha asu lah kaddat asu lah kannimus asu lah karauy lo amar kelum veim katvu get venatnu lah hare ze get batel
Amar lahem hotziuha izvuha hattiruha hannichuha hoiluha hare ze safek im mashma millot ellu gerushin o inyan acher lefichach en kotvin lah veim katvu get venatnu lah hare zo safek megoreshet

Haomer kitvu get leishti hare ellu kotvin vechotmin venotnin labbaal beyado veen notnin leishto ad sheyyomar lahem litten lah veim natnu lah eno get bamme devarim amurim bevari aval bimsukkan vehu adam shekkafatz alav hacholi bimhera vehichbid alav chalo miyyad vehayyotze bekolar afillu al iske mamon vehamfaresh bayyam vehayyotze beshayyara veamar kitvu get leishti hare ellu yichtevu veyachtemu veyittenu lah shehaddavar yadua shello nitkaven ze ella lichtov velitten lah

Bari sheamar kitvu get leishti vechatvu vechatmu venatnu lah veharag atzmo miyyad kegon shehishlich atzmo min haggag o hippil atzmo layyam hare ze get kasher ala laggag udchafattu haruach venafal umet eno get safek hippil atzmo safek dechafattu haruach hare ze get ad sheyyivada lecha bevadday sheharuach dechafattu vechen mi shehaya mushlach babbor veamar kal hashshomea koli yichtov get leishti hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu lah vehu sheyyadu oto veaf al pi sheheeluhu velo hikkiruhu hare ze kasher shezze kishat hassakkana hu shekkotvim venotnin af al pi sheen makkirin vechen mi shennaflu bo makkot raot shei efshar sheyyichye mehen afillu nishchatu bo rov simanin veramaz veamar kitvu get leishti hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu shehare atta chay hu af al pi shessofo lamut

Mi shehayeta ruach raa mevaetet oto veamar keshehitchil bo hacholi kitvu get leishti lo amar kelum mippene sheen dato nechona umyushshevet vechen shikkor shehiggia leshichruto shel lot veim lo higgia hare ze safek

Amar keshehu bari kitvu utnu get leishti veachar kach nivat mamtinin ad sheyyavri vechotvin venotnin lah veen tzarich lachazor ulhimmalech bo achar shehivri veim katvu venatnu kodem sheyyibbare hare ze pasul

Mi shennishtattek vahare dato nechona veamru lo nichtov get leishtecha vehirkin berosho bodkin oto shalosh peamim beserugin im amar lahem al lav lav veal hen hen hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu utzrichin levadko yafe yafe shemma nitrefa dato vechen im katav beyado kitvu utnu get leishti hare ellu kotvin venotnin lah im hayeta dato meyushshevet alav sheen din mi shennishtattek kedin hacheresh

Mi shennasa keshehu pikkeach venitcharesh veen tzarich lomar nishtatta eno motzi leolam ad sheyyavri veen somchin al remizat hacheresh velo al ketavo af al pi sheddato nechona umyushshevet alav aval im nasa ishsha keshehu cheresh megaresh birmiza sheen kiddushav kiddushin min hattora kemo shebbearnu uchshem shekkones birmiza kach motzi birmiza

Hamkaddesh ketanna al yede aviha vegershah keshehi ketanna aviha mekabbel gittah umishsheyaggia get leyad haav nitgarsha gershah keshehi naara im higgia hagget leyadah o leyad aviha nitgarsha veen osa naara hamorasa shaliach lekabbel gittah miyyad balah bechayye aviha aval haav ose shaliach lekabbel hagget levitto hamorasa ben ketanna ben naara
Kiddeshah aviha keshehi ketanna umet im mavchenet ben gittah ledavar acher hare zo mitgareshet mishsheyaggia hagget leyadah veim lav enah mitgareshet ad shettavchin veim gershah enah megoreshet

Mi shehaddin noten shekkofin oto legaresh et ishto velo ratza legaresh bet din shel yisrael bechal makom uvchal zeman makkin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani veyichtov hagget vehu get kasher vechen im hikkuhu akkum veamru lo ase ma sheyyisrael omrin lecha velachatzu oto yisrael beyad haakkum ad sheyegaresh hare ze kasher veim haakkum meatzman anasuhu ad shekkatav hoil vehaddin noten sheyyichtov hare ze get pasul velamma lo bittel get ze shehare hu anus ben beyad akkum ben beyad yisrael sheen omrin anus ella lemi shennilchatz venidchak laasot davar sheeno mechuyyav bo min hattora laasoto kegon mi shehukka ad shemmachar o ad shennatan aval mi shettekafo yitzro hara levattel mitzva o laasot avera vehukka ad sheasa davar shechayyav laasoto o ad shennitrachek middavar haasur laasoto en ze anus mimmennu ella hu anas atzmo bedato haraa lefichach ze sheeno rotze legaresh meachar shehu rotze lihot miyyisrael verotze hu laasot kal hammitzot ulhitrachek min haaverot veyitzro hu shettekafo vechevan shehukka ad shettashash yitzro veamar rotze ani kevar geresh lirtzono lo haya haddin noten shekkofin oto legaresh vetau bet din shel yisrael o shehau hedotot vaanasuhu ad sheggeresh hare ze get pasul hoil veyisrael anasuhu yigmor vigaresh veim haakkum anasuhu legaresh shello kaddin eno get af al pi sheamar beakkum rotze ani veamar leyisrael kitvu vechitmu hoil veen haddin mechayevo lehotzi vehaakkum anasuhu eno get
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 3: Kal get shello nichtav leshem haish hamgaresh ulshem haishsha hammitgareshet eno get ketzad sofer shekkatav get lelammed o lehitlammed uva habbaal umatza shem shennichtav beget ze kishmo veshem haishsha keshem ishto veshem hair keshem iro untalo vegeresh bo eno get
Yeter al ze katav legaresh et ishto venimlach umatza ben iro veamar lo shemi keshimcha veshem ishti keshem ishtecha untalo mimmennu vegeresh bo af al pi shennichtav leshem gerushin eno get

Yeter al ze mi sheyyesh lo shette nashim sheshshemotehen shaot vechatav legaresh et haggedola venimlach vegeresh bo et hakketanna eno get af al pi shennichtav leshem haish hamgaresh lo nichtav leshem zo shennitgarsha bo

Yeter al ken amar lesofer ketov vee zo sheertze agaresh bo vechatav hassofer al daat zo vegeresh bo achat mehen hare ze safek gerushin vechal get shekketavo shello lishmah af al pi sheheevir alav kulmos lishmah eno get

Mi shekkatav get legaresh et ishto venimlach velo gershah venityached immah achar shekketavo lo yegarshenah beoto hagget paam acheret kesheyyirtze legarshah veim gershah beoto hagget hayyashan hare zo megoreshet vetinnase bo lechattechilla shehare nichtav lishmah vahare natan lah atta beedim kehilchato velamma lo yegarshenah bo lechattechilla gezera shemma yomru gittah kodem livnah

Amar lesofer ketov get liflonit veyihye immi lichsheessaenna agarshenna bo venichtav unsaah vegershah bo eno get mippene shello hayeta bat gerushin mimmennu keshennichtav get ze venimtza shennichtav shello leshem gerushin aval im amar lo ketov oto laarusati lichsheessaenna agarshenna uchnasah vegershah bo kasher ketavo livimto veachar sheyyibbemah gershah bo hare ze sefek gerushin hoil veenah ishto gemura keshekketavo

Mippene takkanat sofer hittiru chachamim lesofer sheyyichtov tafse gittin veyanniach mekom haish umkom haishsha umkom hazzeman umkom hare atte mutteret lechal adam kede sheyyichtevem leshem haish hamgaresh ulshem haishsha hammitgareshet veachar kach yachtemu haedim lishmo velishmah

Sofer shekkatav hagget lishmo velishmah kehilchato vechatmu haedim shello lishmah hoil umsaru lah beedim hare ze get ella shehu pasul velamma eno batel lefi sheen haedim chotmin al hagget ella mippene tikkun haolam veyesh mi sheomer sheim chatmu haedim shello lishmah hoil vehu kimzuyyaf mittocho hare ze get batel vechen im haya echad meedav pasul o shehaya bo ed echad bilvad kasher af al pi shennimsar beedim hare ze get batel velo yerae li davar ze ella kimzuyyaf lo mezuyyaf vadday vehoil venimsar beede mesira kesherin hare ze pasul middivrehem

Hammevi get veavad mimmennu umtzao im avad mimmennu bemakom sheen hashshayyarot metzuot afillu metzao leachar zeman merubbe hare ze bechezkat shehagget sheavad mimmennu hu hagget shennimtza vetitgaresh bo avad bemakom shehashshayyarot metzuot im metzao miyyad vaadayin lo shaha adam sham min haovrim o shemmetzao bakkeli shehinnicho bo veyesh lo teviut ayin bearko verachbo shel get shehaya karuch hare hu bechezkato vetitgaresh bo

Huchzak beoto hammakom ish echad sheshshemo kishmo shebbagget choshshim shemma get ze hannimtza shel oto haish haacher hu hoil veavar adam sham veaf al pi shello shaha veim nitgarsha bo hare zo safek megoreshet aval im lo avar adam sham hare ze bechezkato af al pi shehuchzeku sham shenayim sheshshemotehen shavin

Haya laedim bagget siman muvhak kegon sheamru nekev yesh bo betzad ot pelonit o sheamru meolam lo chatamnu ella al get echad sheyyesh bo shemot keshemot ellu hare ze bechezkato vetitgaresh bo veaf al pi shemmetzao achar zeman merubbe uvmakom shehashshayyarot metzuot vehuchzeku sham shenayim sheshshemotehen shavin
Shenayim sheshshalchu shene gittin venitarvu notnin shenehen lazo ushnehen lazo beede mesira lefichach im avad echad mehen hare hashsheni batel

Mi shehau lo shene shemot vechen ishsha sheyyesh lah shene shemot keshemmegaresh kotev shemo ushmah shehen regilin bo viduin bo beoter veomer ish peloni vechal shem sheyyesh lo geresh ishsha pelonit vechal shem sheyyesh lah veim katav chanichato vachanichatah kasher

Katav hashshem sheenam yeduim bo beoter vechatav kal shem sheyyesh lo hare ze pasul shinna shemo o shemah veshem iro o shem irah af al pi shekkatav kal shem sheyyesh lo vechal shem sheyyesh lah eno get

Hakkol kesherin lichtov et hagget chutz mechamishsha akkum veeved vecheresh veshote vekatan afillu ishsha atzmah kotevet et gittah yisrael shehemir leakkum o shehu mechallel shabbatot befarhesya hare hu keakkum lechal devarav

Velamma en kotvin ellu hachamishsha mippene shetztzarich hakkotev lichtov leshem haish hamgaresh ulshem haishsha hammitgareshet vehaakkum al daat atzmo hu kotev vecheresh shote vekatan enan bene dea vehaeved eno betorat gittin vekiddushin lefichach hu pasul keakkum lechal devarav veim katav hagget echad mechamishsha ellu eno get af al pi shechatmu bo edim kesherim venimsar lah bichsherim

Katav echad mechamishsha ellu tofes hagget vehinniach makom hattoref shehu mekom haish umkom haishsha umkom hazzeman umkom hare atte mutteret lechal adam uchtavan happikkeach haggadol hayyisreeli lishmo hare ze get kasher

Muttar lehaniach cheresh shote vekatan lichtov tofes hagget lechattechilla vehu sheyyihye gadol happikkeach omed al gabban aval haakkum vehaeved en kotvin hattofes lechattechilla vaafillu yisrael omed al gabban shello hittiru lichtov tafse gittin shello lishmah lechattechilla ella mippene takkanat sofer kemo shebbearnu

Hakkotev get beshabbat o beom hakkippurim bishgaga untano lah hare zo megoreshet ketavo vachatamo bo bayyom bezadon untano lah enah megoreshet shehare haedim pesulin min hattora ketavo beom tov bezadon venimsar lah bifne edim kesherim beom tov hare ze get pasul
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 4: En kotvin et hagget ella bedavar sherishshumo omed kegon deo vesikra vekomos vekankantom vechayyotze bahen aval im ketavo bedavar sheeno omed kegon mashkin ume perot vechayyotze bahen eno get ketavo baavar beshachor uvshichor kasher veen kotvin bahen lechattechilla

Kotvin beme appetza lechattechilla al gav hanneyar vehaor vechayyotze bahen aval lo al gabbe megilla afutza mippene sheeno nikkar veim katav eno get vechen kal kayyotze bo al hakkol kotvin et hagget vaafillu al issure hanaa vechotvin al davar sheyyachol lehizdayyef vehu sheyyitteno lah beede mesira

Ketzad kotev oto al hanneyar hammachuk veal haddiftera veal hacheres veal healin veal yado shel eved veal keren shel para umoser lah haeved vehappara o hanneyar hammachuk vehaddiftera vechayyotze bo bifne edim

Haya hagget chakuk al yado shel eved bichtovet kaaka vehaya yotze mittachat yadah vehau haedim chakukim al yado hare zo megoreshet af al pi sheen lah ede mesira shehare en yachol lehizdayyef afillu hau muchzakin beeved shehu shello veget chakuk al yado vehu yotze mittachat yadah vehi omeret beedim nimsar li hare zo safek megoreshet shemma meatzmo nichnas lah shehaggodrot en lahen chazaka

Haya hagget chakuk al hattavla vehaedim alav vehu yotze mittachat yadah af al pi shehen muchzakin betavla shehu shellah hare zo megoreshet shehaishsha atzmah kotevet et gittah sheen kiyyum hagget ella bechotmav im en sham ede mesira

Chakak hagget al halluach o al haeven o al tas shel mattechet im chafar yarche haotiyyot kasher shezze ketav hu hare hu omer ketuva beet barzel kelomar shehu chafaro vechen im chakak hayerechot meachore hattas ad shebbaltu bifne hattas aval im chafar toch haot ad sheyyerau hayerechot gevohot mikkan umikkan kichtav dinar zahav shehakketav bolet eno get sheen ze ketav

Hamkarea al haor tavnit ketav o sherasham al haor tavnit ketav hare ze kasher kotvin et hagget bechal ketav uvchal lashon get shennichtav bichtav min halleshonot veedav chatumin bichtav acher kasher vehu sheyehu haedim makkirin leshon hakketav vehakketiva
Echad min haedim chatam bichtav lashon achat vehaed hashsheni bichtav lashon acheret kasher aval im haya miktzat hagget katuv belashon achat umiktzato belashon acheret pasul

Kal lashon sheyyikkatev bah hagget tzarich sheyyizaher hassofer bedivre hagget shello yehe mashmaan shene inyanim ad shennimtza hakkore omer shemma lechach ulchach nitkaven sheen mashmao leshon gerushin o shemma leinyan ze nitkaven shemmashmao leshon gerushin ella yihu haddevarim sheen bahen safek beoto hallashon ella mashmaan inyan echad sheggeresh veshalach peloni et pelonit

Vechen tzarich sheyyihye oto hakketav mevoar hetev beoto hakketav sheyyichtov bo ad sheyyedu hakketannim likroto shemmakkirim oto ketav sheenan lo nevonim velo sechalim velo biktannim ella benonim velo yihye ketav meukkam umvulbal shemma tidme ot leot venimtza hainyan mishtanne
