Mishneh Torah, Divorce 7: Shaliach shehevi get mimmakom lemakom beeretz yisrael af al pi shello raa ketivat hagget velo yada mi hem edav ella natan lo habbaal get veamar lo ten get ze leishti hare ze notno lah bifne edim veaf al pi sheen edav yeduin etzlenu vetihye megoreshet vetinnase bo

Ba habbaal veirer veamar lo gerashtiha meolam veget shehuva lah mezuyyaf hu yitkayyem bechotmav veim lo nitkayyem velo nodu edav kelal tetze vehavalad mamzer shehare enah megoreshet avad hagget hare zo sefek megoreshet lefichach nashim shechezkatan shehen sonot zo et zo en neemanot lehavi get beeretz yisrael zo lazo shemma mezuyyaf hu vetitkaven lekalkel otah kede shettinnase veteaser al balah
Veellu hen hannashim shechezkatan sonot zo et zo chamotah uvat chamotah vetzaratah afillu hayeta hatztzara nesua leacher vivimtah afillu hayeta achotah uvat balah aval shear kal hannashim kesherot

Hammevi get mimmakom lemakom beeretz yisrael vechala o neenas meshallecho beyad acher vechen hashsheni im chala meshallecho beyad acher vaafillu mea veen tzarich edim lachazor velaasot shaliach bifnehem vehaacharon shehiggia hagget leyado notno lah bifne shenayim vetitgaresh bo af al pi shemmet harishon

Shaliach shehevi get mimmakom lemakom bechutza laaretz o meeretz yisrael lechutza laaretz o mechutza laaretz laaretz im haya hashshaliach omed bishat ketivat hagget vachatimato hare ze omer bifne shenayim befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam veachar kach yitten lah bifnehem vetitgaresh bo veaf al pi sheen edav yeduin etzlenu vaafillu hau shemot edav kishmot haakkum en choshshin lahen
Ba habbaal veamad veirer en mashgichin bo lefichach af hannashim shessonot zo et zo neemanot lehavi get ze velomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam

Vechen shaliach shehevi get beeretz yisrael veamar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam af al pi sheeno tzarich im yavo habbaal viarer en mashgichin bo veim en hashshaliach omed bishat ketiva vachatima lo yinnaten lah ella im ken nitkayyem bechotmav veyesh lashshaliach lihot mikkelal hashshelosha shekkiyemu otan bechotmav veim lo nitkayyem venatan lah hare ze pasul ad sheyyitkayyem veim ba habbaal veirer velo nitkayyem enah megoreshet avad hagget hare zo safek megoreshet

Umippene ma hitzrichu lomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam bechutz laaretz kede shello tihye haishsha tzericha lekayemo im yavo habbaal viarer mippene sheen haedim metzuyin lekayemo mimmakom lemakom bechutza laaretz

Baal shehevi reaya berura shegget ze shenneemar bo befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam mezuyyaf hu hare ze batel shello heeminu devarav shel echad sheamar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam ella lidchot irur habbaal sheen immo reaya aval bimkom edim shemmachchishin oto lo heeminuhu

Hanneharot shebbeeretz yisrael vehannissin shebbayyam haggadol shebbetoch hattechum shel eretz yisrael hare hen keeretz yisrael veshechutz lattechum kechutza laaretz uvhilchot terumot yitbaaru techume eretz yisrael uvavel keeretz yisrael legittin

Get shekketavo beeretz yisrael vachatamo bechutza laaretz tzarich sheyyomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam ketavo bechutza laaretz vachatamo beeretz yisrael eno tzarich lomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam

Nichtav miktzat hagget befanav venechtam kullo befanav im miktzato harishon hu hare ze omer befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam afillu lo nichtav bo ella shita achat befanav vaafillu shama kol hakkulmos kotev vechatmu haedim befanav hare ze omer befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam vechen im yatza hassofer lashshuk vechazar vehishlim et hagget eno choshesh shemma acher metzao veamar lo ulshem ishsha acheret ketavo ella omer befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam

Amar befanay nichtav aval lo befanay nechtam befanay nechtam aval lo befanay nichtav befanay nichtav kullo vechatam ed echad aval lo haed hashsheni afillu haya hu haed hashsheni hare ze yitkayyem bechotmav veachar kach yinnaten lah veim heid hu veacher al haed hashsheni shello chatam befanav hare ze kasher veyinnaten lah veen tzarich lomar im heidu shenayim acherim al ketav haed hashsheni shezze kasher

Shenayim sheheviu get bechutza laaretz af al pi shello nichtav venechtam bifnehem hoil untano lahem habbaal litteno leishto hare ellu notnin lah vetihye megoreshet shehare en habbaal yachol learer beget ze af al pi sheeno mekuyyam shehare sheluchav hem edav sheillu amru hashshenayim befanenu nitgarsha hare zo megoreshet af al pi sheen sham get

Bamme devarim amurim bizman shehagget yotze mittachat yede shenehem aval im en hagget yotze mittachat yede shenehem tzerichin lomar befanenu nichtav uvfanenu nechtam lefichach im amar echad befanay nichtav vehaacher omer befanay nechtam vaafillu shenayim omrim befanenu nichtav veechad omer befanay nechtam hoil veeno yotze mittachat yede shenehem lo yinnaten lah ad sheyyitkayyem bechotmav
Amar echad befanay nichtav ushnayim omrim befanenu nechtam kasher af al pi sheeno yotze mittachat yadam shehare nitkayyem bechotmav

Shaliach shehevi get bechutza laaretz untano lah beno levenah o shennetano lah bifne shenayim velo amar lah befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam af al pi shennisset notlo mimmenna vechozer venotno lah bifne shenayim veomer bifnehem befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam veim lo netalo mimmenna hare ze pasul ad sheyyitkayyem bechotmav
Netano lah velo hispik lomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam ad shennishtattek hare ze yitkayyem bechotmav veachar kach yinnaten lah

Hassuma eno yachol lehavi get ze shel chutza laaretz mippene sheeno yachol lomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam lefichach im nichtav venechtam befanav keshehu patuach venistama hare ze omer bifne shelosha befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam venotno lah vechen haishsha shehevia get ze shel chutza laaretz tzericha shelosha lomar bifnehem befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam shello amru bifne shenayim ella bizman shehashshaliach kasher leedut shehare hu mitztaref im hashshenayim venimtza mikkelal hashshelosha shekkiyemu get ze bidvarav shehaed naasa dayyan bedavar shehu middivrehem

Chala hashshaliach o neenas ba levet din veomer lahem get ze befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam vehen meshallechin oto beyad shaliach acher veen hashshaliach haacharon tzarich lomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam ella omer sheliach bet din ani venotno lah bifne edim

Chala hashsheni o neenas ose shaliach acher bevet din afillu mea vehaacharon omer sheliach bet din ani venotno lah af al pi shemmet hashshaliach harishon umippene ma tzarich bet din mippene shehu tzarich lomar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam aval im nitkayyem hagget bechotmav af al pi shennetano shaliach leshaliach afillu mea benam leven atzmam ad shehiggia hagget leyadah hare ze kasher veaf al pi shello peresh habbaal velo amar lo shallecho beyad acher im teanes im chala o neenas hare ze meshallecho
Kal haose shaliach eno tzarich sheyehe hashshaliach immo bevet din ella omer lahem hare peloni sheluchi vaafillu shello befanav vechen hashshaliach ose shaliach acher shello befanav afillu hen mea

Haish shennatan get leishto venichtav venechtam befaneha veamar lah hare atte sheluchati leholacha ad bet din peloni vehem yaamidu shaliach veyittenu lich get ze vetitgarshi bo hare zo neemenet lomar bifnehem befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam vehem notlin oto venotnin oto leshaliach litteno lah kemaamar habbaal

Bamme devarim amurim keshehitna aleha habbaal tenay ze aval im lo hitna aleha ella natan lah gittah vahare hagget yotze mittachat yadah enah tzericha lomar kelum vahare hi bechezkat megoreshet hoil veget shebbeyadah katuv kehilchato vehaedim chatumim alav veaf al pi sheen anu makkirin ketav otan haedim velo nitkayyem en choshshin lah shemma ziyefa oto shehare enah mekalkelet al atzmah veod shehaedim hachatumim al hagget hare hen kemi shennechkera edutan bevet din ad sheyehe sham mearer lefichach naamid hagget bechezkato vetinnase veen choshshin shemma yimmatze mezuyyaf kemo shennaamid hagget bechezkat kasher kesheyyavi oto hashshaliach ad sheyearer habbaal o ad sheyyavi reaya shehu mezuyyaf o batel sheim nachush lidvarim ellu vechayyotze bahen kach haya lanu lachush leget sheyyitten habbaal befanenu shemma bittelo veachar kach netano o shemma edim pesulin chatmu bo vahare hu kimzuyyaf mittocho o shemma shello lishmah nichtav uchshem sheen choshshin laze vechayyotze bo ella naamidennu al chezkato ad sheyyivada shehu batel kach lo nachush lo lashshaliach velo laishsha atzmah shehagget yotze mittachat yadah sheen dine haissurin kedine hammamonot
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 8: Hamgaresh al tenay im nitkayyem hattenay hare zo megoreshet veim lo nitkayyem hattenay enah megoreshet uchvar bearnu beferek shishshi mehilchot ishut mishpete hattenain kullam vesham nitbaer shehamgaresh al tenay kesheyyitkayyem hattenay tihye megoreshet beshaa sheyyitkayyem lo bishat netinat hagget leyadah lefichach yesh labbaal levattel hagget o lehosif al tenao o lehatnot al tenay acher kal zeman shello nitkayyem hattenay harishon af al pi shehiggia get leyadah veim met habbaal o avad hagget o nisraf kodem sheyyitkayyem hattenay enah megoreshet ulchattechilla lo tinnase ad sheyyitkayyem hattenay veim nisset lo tetze ella im ken lo nishar beyadah lekayemo shehare batal hattenay vesham nitbaer sheim amar lah hare atte megoreshet meachshav o mehayyom al tenay kach vechach o sheamar lah hare atte megoreshet al menat kach vechach kesheyyitkayyem hattenay tihye megoreshet mishsheat netinat hagget leyadah lefichach eno yachol levattel hagget velo lehosif al tenao mishshehiggia get leyadah veim avad o nisraf afillu met habbaal kodem sheyyitkayyem hattenay hare zo mekayyemet hattenay achar moto uchvar nitgarsha mishsheat netinat hagget leyadah veyesh lah lehinnase lechattechilla af al pi sheadayin lo nitkayyem hattenay veen choshshin shemma lo yitkayyem hoil vehaya hattenay bimachshav o beal menat

Kal hamgaresh al tenay ben sheamar meachshav ben sheamar im yihye veim lo yihye hare ze lo yityached im ishto kal zeman shello nitkayyem hattenay ella bifne ed vaafillu eved vaafillu shifcha chutz mishshifchatah o benah katan mippene sheenah bosha milleshammesh bifnehem vehaddavar yadua sheim nityached immah bifne shene edim keechad afillu nitkayyem hattenay achar kach hare zo sefek megoreshet shemma bealah uvatel hagget kemo sheyyitbaer bahalachot ellu

Ketzad megaresh adam al tenay lo sheyyomar kitvu get leishti al tenay ze o kitvu utnu lah al tenay veen tzarich lomar shello yichtov betoch hagget al tenay ze geresh peloni et pelonit ella ketzad ose omer lassofer lichtov velaedim lachtom vechotvin get kasher belo shum tenay baolam veachar kach noten lah hagget veomer lah hare ze gittech o hare atte megoreshet baze al menat kach vechach o yomar lahem o lashshaliach tenu lah get ze al menat kach vechach

Katav hattenay bagget achar sheggamar lichtov toref hagget hare ze get kasher ben shekketavo kodem chatimat haedim ben shekketavo leachar chatimat haedim aval im ketavo kodem toref hagget afillu katav al menat kach vechach hare ze sefek gerushin shehare nishar lo zechut begufo shel get vechen im hitna al pe kodem ketivat hattoref hare ze sefek gerushin

Hamgaresh et ishto vehitna aleha ben bichtav achar hattoref ben al pe achar hattoref veamar lah hare atte mutteret lechal adam chutz meish peloni o ella leish peloni venatan lah hagget al tenay ze im haya oto haish akkum o eved o asur aleha mishshum erva kegon aviha veachiha o aviv o achiv hare ze get kasher veim haya oto haish sheyyesh lo bah kiddushin af al pi shehu mechayyave lavin veaf al pi shehu katan eno get shehare shiyyer bagget veen ze keritut haya baal achotah sheaf al pi shehu hayyom asur aleha mishshum erva im tamut achotah yihye muttar lah hare zo sefek megoreshet

Amar lah hare atte mutteret lechal adam chutz mimmi sheyyivaled sheeno atta baolam o chutz mizzenutich kelomar tihye mutteret lehinnase lechal adam aval liznot hare atte beissur eshet ish o hare atte mutteret lechal mi sheyyavo alecha kederech kal haaretz aval shello kedarkech hare atte beissurich o hare atte mutteret lechal adam chutz mimmekaddesh bishtar kelomar shehi mutteret lehitkaddesh bechesef uvvia aval bishtar hare atte beissur eshet ish o hare atte mutteret lechal adam chutz mehafarat nedarayich kelomar lo nishar li alayich shum ishut chutz mehafarat nedarayich sheatte ishti leinyan hafarat nedarim o leinyan achilat teruma o leinyan yerushsha sheim meta yirashenna bechal echad meellu hare zo sefek megoreshet

Amar lah hare atte mutteret lechal adam chutz meruven veshimon vechazar veamar lah hare atte mutteret liruven veshimon hare zo megoreshet shehare batel hattenay shehaanashim shehitna bahen hittiran lah

Amar lah hare atte mutteret liruven hare zo enah megoreshet shehare lo bittel tenao shel shimon amar lah hare atte mutteret leshimon o hare atte mutteret af leshimon hare ze sefek gerushin shemma lo hittira ella leshimon uruven beissuro omed veze sheamar af leshimon kelomar lechal adam af leshimon o shemma hittirah lakkol veze sheamar af leshimon vehu haddin liruven sheshshimon samuch haya liruven bitnao
Hitna aleha veamar hayyom en atte ishti ulmachar atte ishti enah megoreshet veaf al pi shekkarat beno levenah hayyom lefichach kotvin begittin min hayyom hazze ulolam

Hare ze gittech al menat shello tishti yayin kal yeme chayyayechi eno get sheen ze keritut kal yeme chayyay o kal yeme chayye peloni hare ze get shehare karat beno levenah velo tishshaer lo aleha reshut kesheyyamut oto peloni

Hare ze gittech al menat shello telchi levet avicha ad sheloshim yom hare ze get shello telchi levet avicha leolam eno get shehare en ze keritut lefichach haomer hare ze gittech al menat shello tochli basar ze leolam shello tishti yayin ze leolam eno get sheen ze keritut ad sheloshim yom hare ze get

Hare ze gittech al menat shello tinnasi lifloni eno get ha lema ze dome leomer lah hare ze gittech al menat shello tishti yayin leolam o shello telchi levet avich leolam o kal yeme chayyayechi aval im amar lah al menat shello tinnasi lifloni ad chamishshim shana hare ze get velo tinnase lo kal zeman shehitna veim nisset batel hagget lemafrea zanta immo havalad kasher vehagget kasher shello hitna ella al hannissuin

Hare ze gittech al menat shettinnasi lifloni im nisset lo hare ze get kishar kal hattenaim aval amru chachamim lo tinnase lo leoto peloni velo leacher leoto peloni lo tinnase shemma yomru neshehen notnin bemattana ze laze ulacher lo tinnase sheeno get ella bekiyyum hattenay avra venisset leoto peloni lo tetze nisset leacher kodem shettinnase leoto peloni batel hagget vetetze vehavalad mamzer utzricha get mishsheni
Hare ze gittech vehanneyar shelli enah megoreshet sheen ze keritut al menat shettitteni li et hanneyar hare ze get vetitten
Chakak hagget al tas shel zahav untano lah veamar lah hare ze gittech uchtubbatech kasher venitkabbela ketubbatah im yesh battas kede ketubbatah veim lav yashlim ketubbatah

Kal hamgaresh al tenay shemmevuttal hagget kegon shehitna lah shello tochal basar velo tishte yayin kal yeme chayyeha o shettihye mutteret lechal adam chutz mippeloni o shehitna aleha shear tenaim kodem ketivat hattoref im haya tenao katuv bagget vechazar umchako untano lah hare zo safek megoreshet veim haya hattenay al pe hare ze notel hagget mimmenna vechozer venotno lah belo tenay kelal o bitnay kasher

Ketzad hare shennatan get leishto veamar lah hare atte megoreshet baze umutteret lechal adam chutz mippeloni im netalo mimmenna vechazar untano lah veamar lah hare atte mutteret lechal adam o hare ze gittech hare zo megoreshet vechen kal kayyotze bo

Hannoten get leishto al tenay shettitten lo matayim zuz vechazar vehitna aleha tenay acher bifne edim shetteshammesh aviv shette shanim lo bittelu devarav haacharonim et harishonim ella hare ze keomer lah asi echad mishshene hattenaim ratzat meshammeshet ratzat notenet veen echad min harishonim veechad min haacharonim mitztarfin aval im hitna aleha shettitten lo matayim zuz vechazar vehitna bifne shenayim shettitten lo shelosh meot zuz kevar bittel hattenay shel matayim utzricha litten shelosh meot zuz vechen kal kayyotze baze

Hitna aleha shettaase davar ze setam hare ze kimfaresh yom echad hoil velo peresh kamma zeman taase ketzad amar lah hare ze gittech al menat shettaasi immi melacha al menat shetteshammeshi et abba al menat shetteniki et beni im asta immo melacha o im shimmesha et aviv yom echad o shehenika beno yom echad betoch hazzeman shehabben yonek bo vehu betoch arbaa veesrim chodesh hare ze get met habben o met aviv kodem shettenik o shetteshammesh eno get

Amar lah al menat shetteniki et beni o teshammeshi et avi shette shanim hare zo mashlemet hazzeman shepperesh met habben o haav betoch hazzeman o sheamar haav en retzoni shetteshammesheni eno get shehare lo nitkayyem hattenay vechen kal kayyotze baze

Hare ze gittech al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz mikkan vead sheloshim yom natna betoch sheloshim yom middato hare zo megoreshet leachar sheloshim enah megoreshet netanah lo beal karcho vehu eno rotze lekabbel hare ze get pasul ad shettitten middato chazar veamar lah betoch hashsheloshim yom hare hen mechulin lach enah megoreshet shehare lo naasa hattenay met betoch sheloshim yom hoil veshalmu hashsheloshim yom velo natna enah megoreshet

Amar lah hare ze gittech al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz velo kava zeman umet kodem shettitten enah yechola litten leorshav shello hitna aleha ella shettitten lo velo batal hagget shehare lo kava zeman lefichach af al pi sheavad hagget o nikra kodem sheyyamut hare zo lo tinnase lezar ad shettachalotz

Hare ze gittech al menat shettitteni li keli peloni o beged peloni veavad oto keli o oto beged o nignav af al pi shennatna lo elef zuz bedamav eno get ad shettitten oto keli o oto beged atzmo o ad sheyevattel hattenay

Mi shennitgarsha al tenay vekiddeshah acher kodem sheyyitkayyem hattenay im nitkayyem hattenay hare zo mekuddeshet veim lo nitkayyem hattenay uvatal hagget enah tzericha get mishsheni shehare en kiddushin tofsin bah aval im nisset velo nitkayyem hattenay uvatal hagget tzericha get mishsheni kemo shebbearnu
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 9: Hamgaresh et ishto leachar zeman kavua hare zo megoreshet kesheyyaggia hazzeman shekkava vahare ze dome litnay veeno tenay dome litnay shehi mitgareshet kesheyyaggia hazzeman shekkava veeno tenay shehamgaresh al tenay hare geresh veze adayin lo geresh ad sheyyaggia oto hazzeman lefichach hamgaresh al tenay tzarich lichpol tenao veze eno tzarich lichpol devaro velo lishar mishpete hattenain shebbearnu
Ketzad haomer leishto hare ze gittech velo titgarshi bo ella leachar sheloshim yom enah megoreshet ella leachar sheloshim yom veim met habbaal o avad hagget o nisraf betoch sheloshim enah megoreshet

Halcha vehinnichato betzidde reshut harabbim venignav o avad mishsham leachar sheloshim yom hare zo megoreshet hoil vehaya hagget kayyam bayyom shemmitgareshet bo veyichada oto bemakom sheeno reshut harabbim shetztzidde reshut harabbim enan kirshut harabbim

Vechen im tala haggerushin bemaase dino kedin megaresh achar zeman ketzad kegon sheamar leishsha hare ze gittech velo titgarshi bo ad shettitteni li matayim zuz hare zo mitgareshet achar shettitten veen tzarich lichpol tenao velo lishar mishpete hattenain shebbearnu shehare lo geresh al tenay ella adayin lo geresh ze ella tala haggerushin baasiyyat kach vechach veachar kach titgaresh

Uma ben hamgaresh al tenay leze shekkava zeman legerushin o telaan bemaase shehamgaresh al tenay yesh sham gerushin veenan gomrin ad sheyyitkayyem hattenay lefichach kesheyyitkayyem hattenay nitgarsha im haya hagget kayyam af al pi sheeno birshutah veenah tzericha lachazor velittelo o lihoto birshutah achar shennitkayyem hattenay shehare higgia leyadah techilla betorat gerushin veim nisset kodem sheyyitkayyem hattenay lo tetze kemo shebbearnu aval hattole gerushin bizman o bemaase lo higgia get leyadah betorat gerushin ella betorat pikkadon ad hazmen shekkava o ad shettaase hammaase lefichach keshehiggia hazzeman tzericha lihot hagget birshutah o tachazor vetittelennu o sheyyihye bammakom sheyyichada oto bo af al pi sheeno reshutah kemo shebbearnu veachar kach titgaresh bo veim nisset kodem sheyyaggia hazzeman shekkava o kodem shettaase hammaase shettala bo haggerushin tetze vehavalad mamzer sheadayin hi eshet ish gemura veen kan shem gerushin
Hannoten get beyad ishto veamar lah im lo titteni li matayim zuz en ze get o en atte megoreshet hare ze lo geresh kelal veen kan get lo al tenay velo taluy bemaase vechen kal kayyotze baze

Harotze legaresh al tenay veyihye inyan tenao shello titgaresh ad zeman peloni hare ze motzi inyan ze bilshon tenay veyitle hattenay beviato bizman kavua o bahalichato ketzad kegon sheyyomar lah im lo bati mikkan vead sheloshim yom hare ze get veim bati betoch sheloshim yom lo yihye get venoten hagget beyadah o yomar lah hare ze gittech al menat shello avo limdina zo ad sheloshim yom vechen kal kayyotze baze

Hitna aleha sheyyihye get im lo ba ad sheloshim yom limdina zo vehaya ba badderech betoch sheloshim yom vechala o ikkevo nahar velo ba ad achar sheloshim yom hare ze get afillu omed vetzoveach hare ani anus sheen ones begittin veaf al pi sheggilla dato sheen retzono legaresh

Hitna aleha shettitgaresh kesheyyaavor minneged paneha sheloshim yom vehaya holech uva holech uva velo nityached immah kesheyyelech veyishhe sheloshim yom tihye megoreshet veaf al pi shehaya holech uva betoch sheloshim yom hoil velo nityached immah hare ze get kasher bamme devarim amurim beshehitna veamar hare hi neemenet alay lomar shello piyyastiha aval im lo heeminah choshshin shemma piyesah keshehaya holech uva umachala lo vechazar uvatal hagget kesheppiyesah umippene chashash ze yihye hagget pasul achar sheloshim yom vechen haomer leishsha hare ze gittech leachar shenem asar chodesh vehaya immah bammedina choshshin shemma piyesah ad sheyyomar neemenet alay shello piyyasti

Vechen kal hattenain shehen teluyin birtzonah veim ratzat umachala otan levalah batel hagget choshshin lah shemma piyyes ad sheyyomar neemenet alay bamme devarim amurim bemitgareshet min hannissuin shellibbo gas bah aval bemitgareshet min haerusin en choshshin lo shemma piyyes

Bari shehitna sheyyihye ze get im matti o chole shehitna sheyyihye ze get im matti mecholi ze lo amar kelum shemmashmaut im matti leachar mita umashmao meatta lefichach im amar im matti hare ze keomer leachar moti veen get leachar mita
Amar lah hare ze gittech meachshav im matti o mehayyom im matti hare ze get uchsheyyamut tihye megoreshet

Amar lah hare ze gittech meachshav o mehayyom leachar mitati umet hare zo safek megoreshet shemma achar sheamar meachshav chazar bo milleshon meachshav vesamcha dato al leachar mita veen get leachar mita

Hare ze gittech lichshettetze chamma minnartekah umet ballayela eno get al menat shettizrach chamma umet ballayela hare zo megoreshet uchshettizrach chamma yitkayyem hattenay hitna aleha sheim zarcha chamma yihye get veim lo zarcha lo yihye get umet ballayela eno get shehare lo nitkayyem hattenay ad shemmet veen get leachar mita

Hare ze gittech mehayyom im matti mecholi ze venafal alav bayit o neshacho nachash o terafo ari vechayyotze baze umet eno get

Amar lah im lo yaamod mecholi ze venafal alav bayit o neshacho nachash o terafo ari hare zo safek megoreshet hare ze gittech meachshav im matti mecholi ze veamad vehalach bashshuk vechala umet omdin oto im mechamat hacholi harishon met hare ze get veim lav eno get veim nittak mecholi lecholi velo amad bashshuk hare ze get veeno tzarich omed
Uvchal ellu hattenain kal hayyamim shemminnetinat hagget ad sheyyamut veyitkayyem hattenay hare hi megoreshet lechal davar uvilvad shello tityached immo kemo shebbearnu

Chole sheratza legaresh ishto al tenay kesheyyamut kede shello tippol lifne yavam veim amad lo tihye megoreshet velo ratza legarshah meachshav kede shello tittaref dato kach hu kotev bagget achar shekkotev hattoref o omer lah keshennoten hagget im lo matti lo yihye get veim matti yihye get veim lo matti lo yihye get kede shettihye tenay kaful vehen kodem lelav velo yiftach piv techilla lefuranut veim met tihye megoreshet kesheyyamut vehu sheyyaggia hagget leyadah kodem mita

Baal sheamar leechad zeche beget ze leishti kede shello tippol lifne yavam venatan hagget leyado umet habbaal kodem sheyyaggia hagget leyadah hare zo safek megoreshet sherov hannashim zechut hu lahen shello yippelu lifne yavam ulfichach tihye sefek megoreshet af al pi shello higgia get leyadah hoil vezacha lah bo acher

Amar laedim leachar shenem asar chodesh kitvu get leishti o sheamar lahem kitvu utnu get leishti leachar chodesh hare ellu kotvin venotnin lah achar hazzeman shekkava veim ketavuhu betoch hazzeman af al pi shennetanuhu lah leachar zeman sheamar eno get ketavuhu achar zeman sheamar umet kodem sheyyinnaten lah eno get veim lo noda im mita kadma lintinat hagget o netinat hagget kadma lemita hare zo safek megoreshet

Amar lahen kitvu utnu leishti get achar hashshavua en kotvin ella ad shana achar hashshavua amar lahen leachar shana en kotvin ella ad leachar chodesh mishshana sheniyya amar lahen leachar hachodesh en kotvin ad leachar hashshabbat mechodesh sheni amar leachar shabbat en kotvin leachar hashshabbat ad sof yom shelishi amar lahen kitvu utnu lah kodem hashshabbat kotvin miyyom revii vead sof yom shishshi venotnin lah
Hare sheecharu achar hazzeman sheamar veachar kach katvu venatnu lah kegon sheamar lahen leachar hachodesh vechatvu venatnu lah leachar shette shabbatot mechodesh sheni hare ze pasul

Nityached immah achar sheamar lahen lichtov velachtom velitten lah hare ellu lo yichtevu vekal vachomer haddevarim im hagget shennatan lah leyadah keshennityached immah nifsal hagget shemma baal kal vachomer laze shello nichtav veim ketavo untano lah achar shennityached immah eno get

Amar laasara kitvu get leishti echad kotev al yede kullam kullechem kitvu kotev echad mehem bemaamad kullam holichu get ze leishti molicho echad mehen al yede kullam kullechem holichu get ze leishti molicho echad mehen bemaamad kullam

Amar laasara kitvu get vechitmu utnu leishti echad mehen kotev ushnayim mehen chotmin veechad mehen notno lah vaafillu haya hakkotev echad mishshene haedim shechatmu bo vehu hashshaliach shennetano lah hare ze kasher amar lahen kullechem chatomu kullam chotmin veim menaan ben shemmana kullam ben shemmana miktzatan veamar lahen chatomu hare ze keomer lahen kullechem chatomu ushnayim shechotmin battechilla hen mishshum edim vehashshear mishshum tenay lefichach im hau hashshear pesulin o chatmu ze hayyom veze lemachar afillu leyamim harbe hare ze get kasher met echad mehen kodem chatima hare ze get batel haya echad mishshenayim harishonim pasul hare ze get pasul shemma yomru ed pasul kasher beedut shear shetarot beet sheyyihu haedim rabbim velo hichshiruhu beget sheedav rabbim ella mippene sheede mesira hen haikkar

Tikkenu chachamim shehaomer lerabbim lichtov get o lachtom o leholich get leishto im lichtiva omer lahen kal echad mikkem yichtov get leishti vechen leholacha kal echad mikkem yolich veim lachatima yomar lahen kal shenayim mikkem yachtemu beget ze veyittenu leishti

Velamma amru chachamim ede hagget en chotmin ella ze bifne ze gezera shemma yomar lerabbim kullechem chatomu im tomar chotmin ze shello bifne ze shemma yaidu shenayim vetittol hagget beyadah vetachshov shekkevar heidu bo vaadayin lo nitkayyem hattenay

Amar lishlosha shenayim mikkem yichtevu get leishti veyachtemu veyittenu lah vehaya bahen av uvno ben shechatam habben im haechad ben shechatam haav im haechad hare ze get kasher shehaadam ose habben shaliach bimkom haav

Amar lishnayim kitvu vechitmu utnu lifloni sheyyolich leishti o tenu leshaliach sheyyolich lah echad mehen kotev ushnehem chotmin venotnin lashshaliach veim holichu hen beatzman venatnu lah eno get shello asa otan sheluchin legerushin ketzad yaasu yittelu oto mimmenna veyittenuhu lashshaliach vechozer venotno lah bifnehen o bifne acherim verabbotay horu beget ze davar sheeno nire mippene shibbush shehaya bannuschaot shellahen

Amar lesofer ketov li get leishti ketavo untano labbaal belo edim untalo habbaal untano leshaliach veamar lo ten get ze leishti bifne edim vehalach hashshaliach untano lah bifne edim hare zo sefek megoreshet sheen hashshaliach neeman lehattir haerva af al pi shehu ed echad ella mippene ketav haedim shechatmu al hagget shehen kemi shennechkera edutan bevet din ad sheyyihye sham mearer kemo shebbearnu sham veim hau sham shene edim sheyyaidu shegget ze habbaal netano lashshaliach legarshah bo hare zo megoreshet

Haomer leshaliach ten get ze leishti bemakom peloni untano lah bemakom acher eno get hare hi bemakom peloni untano lah bemakom acher kasher mippene shemmare makom hu lo amar al tittenehu lah ella babbayit untano lah baaliyya al tittenehu lah ella beyamin untano lah bismol tenehu lah beom peloni untano lah betoch hazzeman eno get al tittenehu lah ella beom peloni untano lah millefanav o meacharav eno get shehare hikpid al atzmo shel yom vechen kal kayyotze baze
Vechen haishsha sheamra lishluchah hitkabbel li gitti bemakom peloni vekibbelo lah bemakom acher eno get have li gitti bemakom peloni vehevio lah bemakom acher kasher

Haomer lishlucho holech get ze leishti ben sheamar lo holech ben sheamar lo atte holech vechala o neenas meshallecho beyad acher veim amar lo tol mimmenna chefetz peloni veten lah get ze hare ze lo yeshallechennu beyad acher veim shillecho beyad acher veyatzat haishsha likrat hashshaliach venatna hachefetz techilla veachar kach natan lah hagget hare zo megoreshet

Natan lah hagget techilla veachar kach natna hachefetz afillu miyyad shaliach rishon eno get shehare avar al divre habbaal bedavar shessetam bene adam makpidin alav shehare habbaal amar lo tol hachefetz techilla veten lah hagget vehu natan veachar kach natal

Amar lo ten lah hagget vetol mimmenna chefetz peloni hare ze lo yeshallechennu beyad acher sheen retzono sheyyihye pikdono beyad acher veim shillecho beyad acher hare ze get ben shennatna hachefetz techilla ben shello natna ella bassof

Natan leshaliach hagget veamar lo lo tittenehu lah ella atta untano leacher untano lah eno get vechen im amar lo al tittenehu lah atta tenehu lifloni vehu yittenehu lah untano lah hashshaliach harishon eno get lefi shello asahu shaliach legerushin

Natan lo hagget veamar lo holech get ze leishti amar lo hashshaliach eni makkirah amar lo habbaal tenehu lifloni hu makkirah hare ze shaliach shello nittan legerushin veeno noten hagget ella lifloni sheamar habbaal veoto happeloni hu shaliach legerushin hu shemmolicho lah o meshallecho beyad acher im chala o neenas

Natan hagget leshaliach veamar lo lo tittenehu lah ad sheloshim yom vechala o neenas betoch hashsheloshim meshallecho beyad acher sheaf al pi sheeno achshav shaliach legerushin hoil ulachar sheloshim yom yihye sheliach gerushin ose shaliach acher betoch sheloshim yom

Bamme devarim amurim beshello haya balah immah bammedina o shehayeta mitgareshet min haerusin aval im mitgareshet min hannissuin uvalah immah bammedina choshshin lo shemma piyyes veeno ose shaliach betoch hashsheloshim ella im ken amar neemenet alay shello piyyasti aval noten lah hagget leachar sheloshim vechoshshin lah kemo shebbearnu ad sheyyomar neemenet alay shello piyyasti
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 10: Kal makom sheamarnu bechibbur ze shehagget batel o eno get o enah megoreshet hare ze get batel min hattora vaadayin hi eshet ish gemura veim nisset tetze vehavalad mamzer veim haya balah kohen lo neesra alav mishshum gerusha chutz min hamgaresh et ishto veamar lah hare atte megoreshet mimmenni veen atte mutteret lakkol sheaf al pi sheen ze get hare zo pesula lichhunna middivrehen shenneemar veishsha gerusha meishah amru chachamim afillu lo nitgarsha ella meishah velo huttera lakkol neesra lichhunna vezehu reach hagget shepposel bichhunna middivrehem

Vechal makom sheamarnu bechibbur ze shehagget pasul hare ze pasul middivre sofrim bilvad venifsela bo min hakkehunna middivre tora velo tinnase lechattechilla veim nisset lo tetze vehavalad kasher vechotvin lah get acher kasher venotnin lah vehi tachat balah veim i efshar lichtov acher vehaya habbaal vatik vegeresh meatzmo hare ze meshubbach im en lah banim aval im yesh lah banim lo yotzi mippene pesul hagget shemma yotzi laaz al banav

Vechal makom sheamarnu bechibbur zo hare ze sefek gerushin o shehi safek megoreshet lo tinnase veim nisset tetze vehavalad sefek mamzer mippene shehi sefek erva vechen im geresh et ishto beget pasul o shehayeta safek megoreshet veratza lehachazirah hare zo mutteret levalah veeno tzarich lechaddesh hannissuin ulvarech sheva berachot velichtov ketubba ad shettitgaresh gerushin gemurin

Kal mi shennisset beget batel hare zo tzericha get mibbaal sheni middivrehen kede shello yomru eshet ish yotza belo get utzricha get min harishon lehattirah lishar haam veneesra al shenehem leolam af al pi shennivala bishgaga kede shello yomru hechezir ze gerushato achar shennisset veim avar echad mishshenehen vehechezirah yotzi

Vechen haddin beishsha shebbau edim shemmet balah venisset veachar kach ba balah ben shehaya balah pikkeach ben shehaya cheresh ben shennisset lefikkeach ben shennisset lecheresh sheen kiddushav kiddushin gemurim tetze mishshenehem utzricha get mizze umizze veneesra al shenehem olamit

Hare shennitkaddesha veachar kach ba balah o nimtza hagget batel hare zo mutteret levalah veenah tzericha get mishsheni sheen kiddushin tofsin baaraot veen choshshin shemma yomru eshet ish yotza belo get kevan shello nisset yomru tenay haya bakkiddushin velo nitkayyem

Haishsha shennisset venimtza hagget batel o ba balah achar sheshshama shemmet en habbaal harishon vehashsheni zakkain lo bimtziatah velo bemaase yadeha velo bahafarat nedareha vechal perot sheachlu shenehen achar shennisset en motziin mehen veen lah ketubba velo tenay mittenae ketubba velo mezonot lo al ze velo al ze veim natla mizze o mizze tachazir vechal ma shebbala o avad minnechaseha vaafillu minnichse tzon barzel en motziin otan lo mizze velo mizze vehavalad min hashsheni mamzer veim ba aleha harishon kodem sheggeresh hashsheni hare havalad mamzer middivrehem gershah hashsheni venatla mimmennu ketubba veachar kach ba balah o nimtza hagget batel en motziin miyyadah ma shennatla lo min hammezonot velo min hakketubba

Vechen haddin beachin shekkiddesh echad ishsha vehalach achiv veshama bo shemmet veyibbem et ishto veachar kach ba tetze mizze umizze utzricha get mizze umizze vechal haddevarim haellu bah vechen im kiddesh ishsha vehalcha limdina acheret veshama shemmeta venasa achotah veachar kach noda shello meta tzerichot shettehen mimmennu get vechal hadderachim haellu bahen

Aval im halcha ishto hannesua limdina acheret veshama bah shemmeta venasa achotah venimtzet ishto kayyemet en achotah tzericha mimmennu get veishto mutteret vechen shear haaraot shennesaan bechezkat hetter venimtzeu erva enan tzerichot get sheen kiddushin tofsin baaraot

Umippene ma hitzrichu achot arusato get shemma yomru tenay haya baerusin vechaddat nasa achotah vehoil veyatza achotah beget achotah shehi arusato harishona asura kede shello yomru nasa achot gerushato

Katav hassofer vetaa venatan get laish veshover laishsha o shettau hen venatal habbaal hagget venatla hi hashshover vechimdumme lahen shennitgarsha ulachar zeman hare hagget yotze mittachat yede haish im lo nisset hare zo enah megoreshet venitgalla haddavar sheadayin lo nitgarsha veyitten lah hagget befanenu vetihye megoreshet mishsheat netinato veim nisset veachar kach hotzi habbaal et hagget veamar adayin lo nitgarsha shehare hagget beyadi velo higgia leyadah en shomin lo leasrah al balah ella hare zo bechezkat gerusha venafal hagget miyyadah umtzao ze vahare ba leasrah al habbaal hashsheni

Hammotzi et ishto mishshum shem ra o mishshum shehi perutza bindarim omrin lo hodiah shemmippene ze atta motziah kede leyasserah veda sheen atta machazirah leolam umippene ma hammotzi et zo lo yachazirah leolam gezera shemma tinnase leacher vetaase teshuva vetihye tzenua tachtav veyomar harishon illu hayiti yodea shekken hu lo hayiti megarshah venimtza kimgaresh al tenay velo nitkayyem shennimtza hagget batel lemafrea lefichach omrim lo gemor belibbecha legarshah sheen zo chozeret lecha leolam veim avar vehechezir kodem shennitkaddesha leacher lo yotzi

Vechen hammotzi et ishto mishshum ayelonit o mishshum sheroa dam bechal et tashmish hare ze lo yachazir leolam shemma tinnase leacher veteled haayelonit vetitrappe hannidda veyomar illu hayiti yodea shekken hu lo hayiti megarshah venimtza hagget batel vehabbanim mamzerim veim avar vehechezir lo yotzi

Shaliach shehevi get chutza laaretz veamar befanay nichtav uvfanay nechtam hare ze lo yissaenna sheanu choshshin shemma enav natan bah ulfichach heid lah vechen haed haechad sheheid leishsha shemmet balah venisset al piv hare ze lo yissaenna vechen hechacham sheasar et haishsha al balah beneder hare ze lo yissaenna vechen hannitan al hashshifcha venishtachrera al hannachrit venitgayera hare ze lo yissaenna vechen akkum veeved habba al bat yisrael af al pi shechazar haakkum venitgayyer haeved venishtachrer hare ze lo yissaenna vechullan im avru venasu en motziin miyyadam

Vechullan shehau lahem nashim umetu neshotehen o shennitgarshu vehau hannashim hen shehirgilu et baalehen legarsham hare ellu muttarot lehinnase lahen lechattechilla vechen im halchu nashim ellu venisseu laacherim venitalmenu o nitgarshu hare ellu muttarot lehinnase lahen lechattechilla

Vechal achat mehen mutteret lehinnase leven haed sheheid lah o leven hechacham sheasarah al balah o leven hannitan aleha o lishar kerovin sheen adam chote kede sheyyehane acher umutteret haishsha lehinnase leechad meede gerusheha o meede meuneha o leechad min haddayyanim shechaltza bifnehem sheen choshshin ella leedut echad ulolam yitrachek adam meedut meun veyitkarev lachalitza

Hamgaresh et ishto vechazar uvalah bifne edim kodem shettinnase leacher ben sheggershah min hannissuin ben min haerusin hoil veishto hayeta hare zo bechezkat shehechezirah ulshem kiddushin baal velo leshem zenut vaafillu rau oto shennatan lah maot shechazaka hi sheen adam ose beilato beishto beilat zenut vahare beyado laasotah beilat mitzva lefichach hare zo bechezkat mekuddeshet kiddushe vadday utzricha mimmennu get sheni

Nityached immah bifne edim vehu sheyyihu shene haedim keechad im hayeta megoreshet min hannissuin choshshin lah shemma nivala vehen hen ede yichud hen hen ede bia shekkal hamkaddesh bevia eno tzarich livol bifne edim ella yityached bifnehen veyivol kemo shebbearnu lefichach tzericha get missafek vahare hi safek mekuddeshet veim hayeta megoreshet min haerusin en choshshin lah shehare en libbo gas bah

Horu miktzat haggeonim shekkal ishsha shettibbael bifne edim tzericha get chazaka sheen adam ose beilato beilat zenut vehigdilu vehosifu bedavar ze sheala al datam ad shehoru shemmi sheyyesh lo ben mishshifchato choshshin lo velo tityabbem ishto shemma shichrer shifchato veachar kach ba aleha veyesh mi shehora shevadday shichrerah sheen adam ose beilato beilat zenut vechal haddevarim haelle rechokim hem beenay ad meod middarche hahoraa veen rauy lismoch alehen shello amru chachamim chazaka zo ella beishto sheggershah bilvad o bimkaddesh al tenay uvaal setam shehare ishto hi uvishto hi shechezkato sheeno ose beilat zenut ad sheyefaresh shehi beilat zenut o yefaresh sheal tenay hu boel aval bishar hannashim hare kal zona bechezkat shebbaal leshem zenut ad sheyefaresh ki hu leshem kiddushin veen tzarich lomar beshifcha o kutit sheenah bat kiddushin sheen choshshin lahen kelal vahare habben mehen bechezkat kuti veeved ad sheyyivada bevadday shennishtachrera immo o nitgayera

Mi shehuchzeka eshet ish ben min hannissuin ben min haerusin veyatza shemah bair megoreshet afillu rov hair o kullah maavirin hakkol shennitgarsha en choshshin lah vahare hi bechezkatah aval im yatza shemah bair mekuddeshet vehuchzak hakkol bevet din shehare hi mekuddeshet besafek kemo shebbearnu veachar kach yatza aleha kol shennitgarsha meotan hakkiddushin hakkol asarah vehakkol hittirah vahare zo megoreshet

Lo yissa adam ishsha vedato legarshah velo tihye yoshevet tachtav umshammashto vedato legarshah velo yegaresh adam ishto rishona ella im ken matza bah ervat davar shenneemar ki matza vah ervat davar vego veen rauy lo lemaher leshalleach ishto rishona aval sheniyya im seneah yeshallechenna

Ishsha raa bedeoteha vesheenah tzenua kivnot yisrael hakkesherot mitzva legarshah shenneemar garesh letz veyetze madon veishsha shennitgarsha mishshum peritzut en rauy leadam kasher sheyyissaenna shello yomru ze hotzi reshaa mibbeto veze machnisah

Mi shennitcharsha ishto hare ze megarshah beget vetihye megoreshet aval im nishtattet eno motziah ad shettavri vedavar ze takkanat chachamim hu kede shello tehe hefker lifrutzin shehare enah yechola lishmor atzmah lefichach mannichah venose acheret umaachilah umashkah mishshellah veen mechayevin oto bisher kesut veona sheen koach beven daat ladur im hashshotim bevayit echad veeno chayyav lerappeotah velo lifdotah veim gershah hare zo megoreshet umotziah mibbeto veeno chayyav lachazor ulhittafel bah
Mishneh Torah, Divorce 11: En nosin et hakketonna vehannose ketanna yetoma velo ratzta babbaal hare zo memaenet veholechet veenah tzericha mimmennu get sheen kiddushin shel ketanna kiddushin gemurin kemo shebbearnu vechen ketanna shehissiah aviha venitalmena o nitgarsha keshehi ketanna hare hi kitoma bechayye aviha veim nisset keshehi ketanna hare zo memaenet
Hachereshet af al pi shennissueha middivre sofrim kenissue ketanna lo tikkenu lah shettemaen kede shello yimmanu millenasah

Memaenet hi hakketanna ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin ben bifne balah ben shello befanav uchshem shemmemaenet bevaal kach memaenet beyavam ummaenet bevaal ze ummaenet besheni im nisset leacher vechen bishlishi afillu kamma peamim kal zeman shehi ketanna yesh lah lemaen uktanna shello meana af al pi shehi nesua vehalcha venitkaddesha leacher keshehi ketanna kiddusheha hem hem meuneha

Ad matay habbat memaenet kal zeman shehi ketanna ad shettihye naara o ad sheyyivada shehi ayelonit bamme devarim amurim beshello ba aleha habbaal achar shennaaset bat shana veom echad aval im higgia lazzeman hazze venivala hoil vehabbeila kona min hattora kemo shebbearnu hare zo enah memaenet veenah tzericha bedika lemeun shechezkatah shehevia simanin

Mishneh Torah, Divorce 12: Haishsha shebbaa veamra eshet ish hayiti ugrusha ani neemenet shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir huchzeka eshet ish uvaa veamra gershani bali enah neemenet lehattir atzmah lashshuk aval pasla atzmah lichhunna leolam veim met balah choshshin lidvareha vecholetzet velo mityabbemet

Hau lah shene edim shehi gerusha af al pi sheen sham get hare zo tinnase lechattechilla hotzia get mittachat yadah veamra gershani bali baze hare zo neemenet vetinnase bo af al pi sheeno mekuyyam kemo shebbearnu

Ba habbaal veirer im amar lo netattiv lah ella nafal mimmenni umatza oto eno neeman shehare hoda shekketavo lah vahare hu yotze mittachat yadah aval im amar habbaal al tenay haya pikkadon haya meolam lo ketavtiv mezuyyaf hu yitkayyem bechotmav o beede mesira kemo shebbearnu veim lo nitkayyem enah megoreshet lihot mutteret laacherim aval pasla nafshah mikkehunna kemo shebbearnu shehare pasla atzmah behodaat piha veasta atzmah kachaticha shel issur
Baa hi uvalah hi omeret gerashtani veavad gitti vehu omer lo gerashtich af al pi shehuchzeka ishto hare zo neemenet chazaka en ishsha meizza paneha bifne balah

Amar habbaal gerashti et ishti eno neeman vechoshshim lidvarav vetihye safek megoreshet vaafillu hodet lo sheggershah eno neeman shemma yitkaven lekalkelah o beget batel gershah vehi enah yodaat o shemma taez paneha bo mippene shehu maaminah vehi enah yodaat koved haissur shellah lefichach omrim lo im emet haddavar hare attem kayyamim garesh otah atta befanenu

Amra naflu alenu akkum o listim hu neherag vaani nitztzalti neemenet sheen darkan laharog et hannashim kede shennomar keshem shennitztzela hi kach nitztzal hu

Yisrael sheamar haragti et peloni hare zo tinnase al piv sheen adam mesim atzmo rasha vahare heid shemmet

Akkum shehesiach lefi tummo techilla af al pi sheshshaalu oto achar kach uvdakuhu ad sheyefaresh kal hamora hare ze neeman umassiin al piv

Kevar hodanu shehaed sheamar shamati shemmet peloni afillu shama meishsha sheshshama meeved hare ze kasher leedut ishsha umassiin al piv aval im amar haed o haishsha o haeved met peloni vaani reitiv shemmet shoalin oto heach raita uvma yadata shemmet im heid bedavar barur neeman veim heid bidvarim sherubban lemita en massiin et ishto sheen meidin al haadam shemmet ella kesherauhu shemmet vadday veen bo safek

Ketzad rauhu shennafal layyam afillu tava bayyam haggadol en meidin alav shemmet shemma yatza bemakom acher veim nafal lemayim mekubbatzim kegon bor o meara sheomed veroe kal sevivav veshaha kede shettetze nafsho velo ala meidin alav shemmet umassiin et ishto vechen im hishlichuhu bayyam vehishlichu metzuda acharav veheelu mimmennu evar shei efshar sheyyinnatel min hachay veyichye hare ze meidin alav shemmet umassiin et ishto

Rauhu shennafal legov araot unmerim vechayyotze bahen en meidin alav efshar shello yochluhu nafal lachafirat nechashim veakrabbim o letoch kivshan haesh o letoch yora rotachat melea yayin o shemen o sheshshachatu bo shene simanin o rubban afillu amad uvarach meidin alav shemmet shevadday sofo lamut vechen kal kayyotze baze middevarim shei efshar sheyyichye ella yamut miyyad bizman karov hare ellu meidin alav

Rauhu tzaluv vehaof ochel bo af al pi sheddekaruhu o yaru bo chitztzim eno meid alav shemmet veim rau haof ochel bemakom shehannefesh yotza bintilato kegon mocho o libbo o bene meav hare ze meid alav shemmet

Hakkones et yevimto vegershah im ratza lehachazir yachazir mippene shehi ishto lechal davar velo nishar aleha shem issur mippene achiv kelal lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim

Shene achin echad pikkeach veechad cheresh hacheresh nasuy shette nashim pikchot haachat mehen erva al happikkeach umet hacheresh shettehen peturot al kal panim im nissue haerva nissuin hare hashsheniyya tzaratah uftura veim en nissue haerva nissuin kach lo yihu nissue tzaratah nissuin
Hayeta bitto vechayyotze bah chereshet unsua leachiv happikkeach tzaratah choletzet velo mityabbemet sheen nissue hachereshet nissuin gemurin

Kal makom sheamarnu bahalachot ellu shette achaot achat shette achaot o ishsha uvittah o ishsha uvat bittah vechayyotze bahen inyan haddevarim shehen shette nashim shehaachat mehen erva im haacheret vei efshar lissa shettehen mishshum erva vechen kal makom sheamarnu achot ishto o achot yevimto echad achotah o immah o bittah inyan haddevarim achat mikkerovoteha shehen erva immah

Mi shekkiddesh achat mishshette achaot veen yadua e ze mehen kiddesh umet velo ach echad choletz lishtehen kede lehattiran laacherim hau lo shene achin echad choletz leachat mehen battechilla vehashsheni meyabbem lashsheniyya al kal panim im zo hi shekkiddesh achiv hare yibbem otah veim enah eshet achiv hare nasa ishsha mishshear hannashim vaachotah shehayeta eshet achiv kevar nechletza aval lo yeyabbem haachat techilla shemma haacheret hi eshet achiv venimtza shennasa kerovat zekukato kadmu shene haachim vechansu shette hayevamot en motziin otan miyyadan

Shenayim shekkiddeshu shette achaot ze eno yodea e zo kiddesh veze eno yodea e zo kiddesh umetu shenehen laze ach velaze ach ze choletz lishtehen veze choletz lishtehen laze ach echad velaze shenayim hayechidi choletz lishtehen battechilla vehashshenayim echad choletz rishona vehashsheni meyabbem veim kadmu vechansu en motziin miyyadan vaafillu hau kohanim shehachalitza shechalatz hayechidi missafek chalatz vehachalutza asura lechohen middivre sofrim uvisfek chalutza lo gazru

Hau laze shene achin velaze shene achin achiv shel ze choletz leachat veachiv shel ze choletz laacheret veachar kach haach hashsheni shel ze meyabbem chalutzato shel ze vehaach hashsheni shel ze meyabbem chalutzato shel ze kadmu shenehen vechaltzu lishtehen lo yeyabbemu shene haachin haacherim ella echad choletz battechilla veachiv meyabbem lashsheniyya veim kadmu vechansu en motziin miyyadan

Mi shello shahata achar mitat balah shelosha chodashim venisset veyalda veen yadua im ben tisha larishon im ben shiva laacharon vehau lah banim min harishon umin hashsheni im met ze habben hassafek bene harishon uvne hashsheni choltzin leishto velo meyabbemin shekkal echad mehen sheyyavo leyabbem shemma eno achiv meaviv vahare hu achiv meimmo bevadday veeshet achiv meimmo asura alav leolam mishshum erva vechen ze habben hassafek choletz linshotehen velo meyabbem

Haya ben larishon uven lashsheni shello meishsha zo shennisset betoch zeman umet echad mehen hare habben hassafek choletz leeshet ze shemmet o meyabbem sheim achiv meaviv hu hare yibbem et ishto veim eno achiv meaviv hare en benehen achava kelal lefichach muttar lo lissa et ishto

Met habben hassafek echad mishshene habbanim havaddain choletz leishto techilla vehashsheni meyabbem al kal panim im achiv hu hare yibbem et ishto veim eno achiv vehu ben haav haacher hare nechletza meachi balah
Mi shehalach balah limdina acheret veshama shemmet venisset veachar kach ba habbaal harishon umetu shenehen velaze achin velaze achin echav shel ze veechav shel ze choltzin velo meyabbemin

Ketzad im eshet achiv hi hare yibbem otah veim enah eshet achiv hare hi eshet ach echad mearbaa vahare chaltzu lah arbatan techilla vechen hashsheniyya choltzin lah arbaa vehaechad min haarbaa yihye ze shennasa harishona vehachamishi yissaenna ad shennimtzeu habbanim hachamishsha nasu hechamesh nashim achar shennechletza kal achat mehen arba chalitzot

Ulolam hizzaher bechal hassefekot hallalu beikkarim ellu shekkal mi shennistappek lecha shemma bat chalitza hi leish ze o enah tzericha lachalitza mimmennu enah nitteret lehinnase lezar ad sheyyachalotz lah oto haish vechal mi sheyyistappek lecha shemma biatah asura al ish ze ben middivre tora ben middivre sofrim enah mityabbemet lo vechal shennechletza chalitza meulla o nivala beila keshera huttera tzaratah lezar

Mishneh Torah, Marriage 1: Kodem mattan tora haya adam pogea ishsha bashshuk im ratza hu vehi lissa otah machnisah letoch beto uvoalah beno leven atzmo vetihye lo leishsha kevan shennittena tora nitztauu yisrael sheim yirtze haish lissa ishsha yikne otah techilla bifne edim veachar kach tihye lo leishsha shenneemar ki yikkach ish ishsha uva eleha

Velikkuchin ellu mitzvat ase shel tora hem uvechad mishshelosha devarim ellu haishsha niknet bechesef o bishtar o bevia bevia uvishtar mehattora uvchesef middivre sofrim velikkuchin ellu hen hannikrain kiddushin o erusin bechal makom veishsha shenniknet beechad mishshelosha devarim ellu hi hannikret mekuddeshet o meoreset

Vechevan shenniknet haishsha venaaset mekuddeshet af al pi shello nivala velo nichnesa levet balah hare hi eshet ish vehabba aleha chutz mibbalah chayyav mitat bet din veim ratza legaresh tzericha get

Kodem mattan tora haya adam pogea ishsha bashshuk im ratza hu vehi noten lah secharah uvoel otah al em hadderech veholech vezo hi hannikret kedesha mishshennittena hattora neesra hakkedesha shenneemar lo tihye kedesha mibbenot yisrael lefichach kal habboel ishsha leshem zenut belo kiddushin loke min hattora lefi shebbaal kedesha
Kal sheasar biato battora vechayyav al biato karet vehem haamurot befarashat achare mot hen hannikraot araot vechal achat mehen nikret erva kegon em veachot uvat vechayyotze bahen
