Mishneh Torah, Marriage 2: Habbat miyyom ledatah ad shettihye bat shana gemurot hi hannikret ketanna venikret tinoket vaafillu hevia kamma searot betoch hazzeman hazze enam ella keshuma aval im hevia shette searot lematta bagguf bammekomot hayeduot lahavaat sear vehi mibbat shana veom echad vamala nikret naara

Vahavaat shette searot bazzeman hazze nikra siman hattachton umeachar shettavi siman hattachton tikkare naara ad shishsha chodashim gemurim umittechillat yom tashlum hashshishsha chodashim vamala tikkare bogeret veen ben naarut levagrut ella shishsha chodashim bilvad

Higgia lev shana veom echad velo hevia shette searot af al pi shenniru bah simane ayelonit adayin ketanna hi ad esrim shana uchshettavi shette searot afillu bishnat esrim tihye naara shishsha chodashim veachar kach tikkare bogeret

Hayeta bat esrim shana pachot sheloshim yom velo hevia shette searot veniru bah kal simane ayelonit hare hi ayelonit veim lo niru bah kal simane ayelonit adayin ketanna hi ad shettavi shette searot o ad shettihye bat shana veom echad

Higgia lazzeman hazze velo hevia shette searot hare zo nikret ayelonit af al pi shello nire bah siman missimane ayelonit nimtzeta atta lamed shehaayelonit en lah yeme naarut ella mikkatnutah tetze levagrut

Veellu hen simane ayelonit kal sheen lah dadin umitkashsha bishat tashmish veen lah shippule meayim kenashim vekolah ave veenah nikkeret ben ish leishsha vehannaara vehabbogeret vehaayelonit kal achat mishshelashtan nikret gedola

Veyesh bevat simanin millemala vehen hannikrain siman haelon veellu hen mishshettachazir yadeha leachorah veyease kemet bimkom haddadin umishsheyyashchir rosh haddad umishsheyyitten adam yado al oketz haddad vehu shokea veshohe lachazor umishsheyyippatzel rosh chotem haddad veyease berosho kaddur katan verabbotay pershu mishsheyyippatzel hachotem atzmo vechen mishsheyyittu haddadin umishsheyyitkashkeshu haddadin umishshettakkif haatara shehu mekom habbasar hattafuach shellemala min haerva leemmat habbeten umishsheyyitmaech habbasar hazze velo yihye kashe

Kal ellu hassimanin shemona nire babbat siman echad mikkal ellu o kullan vehi bat shana o pachot en mashgichin bo vahare hi ketanna naaset bat shana veom echad venire bah siman hattachton en mashgichin beechad mikkal ellu veim lo nire hattachton venire bah echad mikkal ellu hare hi safek ben naara liktanna vedanim bah lehachamir veim niru kullan velo nire siman hattachton hare zo gedola vaddait shei efshar sheyyavou kullan ella kevar ba siman hattachton venashar
Habbat sheyyalda achar shettem esre shana af al pi shello hevia simanim lo tachton velo elon hare zo gedola banim hare hem kesimanin

Habben mishsheyyivaled ad sheyyihye ben shelosh esre shana nikra katan venikra tinok vaafillu hevi kamma searot betoch hazzeman hazze eno siman ella shuma hevi shette searot lematta bammekomot hayeduot lesear vehu mibben shelosh esre shana veom echad vamala nikra gadol venikra ish

Higgia lazzeman hazze velo hevi shette searot af al pi shenniru bo simane saris hare hu katan ad sheyyihye ben esrim shana pachot sheloshim yom higgia lazzeman hazze velo hevi shette searot lematta velo hevi shette searot bazzakan im nire bo echad missimane saris hare hu saris vedino din haggadol lechal davar veim lo nire bo siman missimane saris adayin katan hu ad sheyyavi shette searot lematta bammakom harauy lahen o ad sheyyihye ben shana veom echad

Higgia lazzeman hazze velo hevi hare ze saris af al pi shello nire bo echad missimane saris higgia lishnat esrim pachot sheloshim yom velo hevi shette searot lematta vehevi shette searot bazzakan af al pi shennolad lo echad missimane saris eno saris ella hare hu bekatnuto ad sheyyivaldu lo kal simane saris o ad sheyyihye ben shana veom echad

Veellu hen simane saris kal sheen lo zakan usaro lakuy uvsaro machalik veen meme raglav maalim reticha uchshemmetil mayim eno ose kippa veshichvat zaro diha veen meme raglav machmitzin verochetz bimot haggeshamim veeno maale besaro hevel vekolo lakuy veeno nikkar ben ish leishsha

Vesaris ze hu hannikra seris chamma bechal makom aval habben shechatchu o nitteku o miachu gidav o betzav kemo shehaakkum osin hu hannikra seris adam uchsheyyihye ben shana veom echad nikra gadol sheen ze mevi siman leolam

Ben shana veom echad shello hevi siman shellematta veniru bo kal hassimanin shel mala hare ze safek ben gadol lekatan veim lo nivdak millematta kevan shennire bo simane bagrut millemala hare ze bechezkat gadol

Shette searot haamurot beven uvvat bechal makom shiuran kede lachof roshan leikkaran umishsheyyitzmechu veyihu yecholot lehinnatel befi hazzug ad sheyyaggiu lachof roshan leikkaran danin bahen lehachamir bechal makom lefichach beven uvvat nachshov otam gedolim lehachamir hoil vetzamchu kede lehinnatel befi hazzug venachshov otam ketannim lehachamir hoil velo higgiu lachof roshan leikkaran

Shette searot ellu tzerichot sheyyihu bimkom haerva uvet haerva kullo mekom simanin ben lemala ben lematta ben al evre hazzera atzman utzrichot lihot bemakom echad vesheyyihye beikkaran gummot vaafillu shettehen begumma achat hare ellu siman nimtzeu shette gummot zo betzad zo veen bahen sear hare ellu siman chazaka en gumma belo sear usarot hau bahen venashru
Habbat shehevia shette searot betoch shana vehabben shehevi betoch shenehem shuma kemo shebbearnu af al pi sheotan searot bimkoman hem omdot achar lezachar veachar linkeva enan siman

Bamme devarim amurim keshennivdeku betoch hazzeman venoda shehen shuma aval im lo nivdeku ella achar zeman venimtzeu sham shette searot hare hen bechezkat simanin veen omrin shemma kodem zeman tzamchu kede sheyyihu shuma

Keshebbodkin habbat ben betoch hazzeman shehu kal shenat ben kodem zeman ze ben leachar hazzeman bodkin al pi nashim kesherot veneemanot vaafillu ishsha achat bodeket veshomin lah im hevia veim lo hevia

Kal hashshanim haamurot beven uvvat uverchin uvchal makom enan lo shene hallevana velo shene hachamma ella shanim shel seder haibbur shehen peshutot umebbarot al pi bet din kemo shehem kovin otan kemo shebbearnu behilchot kiddush hachodesh uvotan hashshanim monin lechal divre haddat
En somchin al hannashim beminyan hashshanim velo al hakkerovim ella al pi shenayim anashim kesherim lehaid

Haav sheamar beni ze ben tesha shanim veom echad bitti zo bat shalosh shanim veom echad neeman lekarban aval lo lemakkot velo laonashim beni ze ben shana veom echad bitti zo bat shana veom echad neeman lindarim ulerchin velacharamot ulhekdeshot aval lo lemakkot velo laonashim
Mi sheyyesh lo evar zichrut veevar nekevut hu hannikra anderoginus vehu safek im zachar safek im nekeva veen lo siman sheyyivada bo im hu zachar vadday im hi nekeva vaddait leolam

Vechal mi sheen lo lo zichrut velo nekevut ella atum hu hannikra tumtum vegam hu safek veim nikra hattumtum venimtza zachar hare hu kezachar vadday veim nimtza nekeva hare hu nekeva vetumtum veanderoginus shehau ben shettem esre shana veom echad hare hen bechezkat gedolim vehem shennedabber bahen bechal makom

Cheresh vechereshet haamurim bechal makom hen haillemim sheen shomin velo medabberim aval mi shemmedabber veeno shomea o shomea veeno medabber hare hu kechal adam veish veishsha shehen shelemim bedatan veenan lo chershim velo shotim nikrain pikkeach ufikkachat

Nimtzeu kal hashshemot shebbearnu inyanam bishne perakim ellu esrim shemot veillu hen kiddushin erva sheniyya issure lavin issure ase ketanna naara bogeret ayelonit gedola siman hattachton siman haelon katan seris chamma seris adam gadol anderoginus tumtum chershim pikchim sim kal hashshemot haellu leummatcha tamid veal yalozu meenecha kal inyenehem kede shello nihye tzerichin levaer kal shem mehen bechal makom shennazkir oto
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 3: Ketzad haishsha mitkaddeshet im bechesef hu mekaddesh en pachot mipperuta kesef o sheve peruta omer lah hare atte mekuddeshet li o hare atte meoreset li o hare atte li leishsha baze venoten lah bifne edim vehaish hu sheomer devarim shemmashmaan shekkone otah lo leishsha vehu sheyyitten lah hakkesef

Natna hi veamra lo hare ani mekuddeshet lecha hareni meoreset lecha hareni lecha leintu o bechal leshon haknaa enah mekuddeshet vechen im natna hi lo veamar hu enah mekuddeshet veim natan hu veamra hi hare zo mekuddeshet missafek
Veim kiddesh bishtar kotev al hanneyar o al hacheres o al heale o al kal davar sheyyirtze hare atte mekuddeshet li o hare atte meoreset li vechal kayyotze bidvarim ellu venotno lah bifne edim
Vetzarich sheyyichtov oto leshem haishsha hammitkaddeshet keget veeno kotvo ella middatah ketavo shello lishmah o lishmah shello middatah af al pi shennetano lah ledatah bifne edim enah mekuddeshet

Veim kiddesh bevia omer lah hare atte mekuddeshet li o hare atte meoreset li o hare atte li leishsha bivila zo vechal kayyotze baze umityached immah bifne shene edim uvoalah vehamkaddesh bevia missetama dato al gemar bia uchsheyyigmor biato tihye mekuddeshet uven shebba aleha kedarkah uven shebba aleha shello kedarkah hare zo mekuddeshet

Haddevarim sheyyomar haish kesheyekaddesh tzarich sheyyihye mashmaam shehu kone haishsha velo sheyehe mashma shehikna atzmo lah ketzad hare sheamar lah o shekkatav bashshetar shennetano lah hareni balech hareni arusech hareni ishech vechal kayyotze baze en kan kiddushin kelal amar lah o katav lah hare atte ishti hare atte arusati o hare atte kenuya li hare atte shelli hare atte lekuchati hare et charufati hare atte birshuti hare atte zekuka li vechal kayyotze bahen hare zo mekuddeshet

Amar lah o katav lah hare atte meyuchedet li hare atte meyoedet li hare atte ezrati hare atte negdati hare atte tzalati hare atte segurati hare atte tachtay hare atte atzurati hare atte tefusati hare zo mekuddeshet besafek vehu sheyyihye medabber immah techilla al iske kiddushin aval im eno medabber immah techilla al isike kiddushin en choshishin limillot ellu

Veyesh laish lekaddesh haishsha bechal lashon shehi makkeret bo veyihye mashma haddevarim beotah hallashon shekkenaah kemo shebbearnu haya medabber im haishsha al iske hakkiddushin veratzta veamad vekiddesh velo peresh velo amar lah kelum ella natan beyadah o baal hoil vehen asukin bainyan dayyo veeno tzarich lefaresh vechen ede hakkiddushin vehaggerushin eno tzarich lomar lahem attem eday ella kevan sheggeresh o kiddesh bifinehem hare zo mekuddeshet o migoreshet

Haomer leishsha hitkaddeshi lechetzyi hare zo mekuddeshet ha lema ze dome leomer lah tehi ishti atte veacheret shennimtza sheen lah ella chatzi ish aval im amar chetzyech mekuddeshet li enah mekuddeshet sheen ishsha achat reuya lishnayim vechen im omer hare atte mekuddeshet li velaze enah mekuddeshet

Amar lah hare chetzyech mekuddeshet li bifruta vechetzyech bifruta o sheamar lah chetzyech mekuddeshet li bachatzi peruta vechetzyech haacheret mekuddeshet bachatzi peruta hare zo mekuddeshet amar lah chetzyech mekuddeshet li bifruta hayyom vechetzyech bifruta lemachar shette chatzayayich bifruta shette benotecha lishne banay bifruta bittecha mekuddeshet li ufaratcha mechura li bifruta o bittecha vekarkaatcha li bifruta bechal ellu mekuddeshet besafek

Haav mekaddesh et bitto shello ledatah kal zeman shehi ketanna vechen keshehi naara reshutah beyado shenneemar et bitti natatti laish hazze leishsha vekiddusheha leaviha vechen hu zakkay bimtziatah uvmaase yadeha uvichtubbatah im nitgarsha o nitalmena min haerusin hu zakkay bakkol ad shettibbager lefichach mekabbel haav kiddushe bitto miyyom shettivaled ad shettibbager vaafillu hayeta chereshet o shota vekiddeshah haav hare hi eshet ish gemura veim hayeta bat shalosh shanim veom echad mitkaddeshet bevia middaat aviha pachot mikken im kiddeshah aviha bevia enah mekuddeshet

Bagra habbat en leaviha bah reshut vahare hi kishar kal hannashim sheenam mitkaddeshot ella ledatan vechen im hissiah aviha venitalmena o nitgarsha bechayye aviha hare hi birshut atzmah veaf al pi sheadayin hi ketanna kevan shennisset en leaviha bah reshut leolam

Nitkaddesha kodem shettivgor shello ledaat aviha enah mekuddeshet vaafillu im nitratztza haav achar shennitkaddesha vaafillu im nitalmena o nitgarsha min otan hakkiddushin enah asura lechohen uven hi uven aviha yecholin leakkev ben im nitkaddesha befanav ben shennitkaddesha shello befanav enah mekuddeshet

Hayeta habbat safek bogeret ben shekkiddeshah aviha shello ledatah ben shekkiddesha hi atzmah shello ledaat aviha hare zo mekuddeshet besafek lefichach tzericha get missafek yesh laish laasot shaliach lekaddesh lo ishsha ben ishsha pelonit ben ishsha mishshear hannashim vechen haishsha haggedola osa shaliach lekabbel kiddusheha ben meish peloni ben meish mishshear anashim vechen haav ose shaliach lekabbel kiddushe bitto keshehi birshuto veomer haav levitto hakketanna tzei vekabbeli kiddushayich

Kal haose shaliach lekabbel hakkiddushin tzarich laasoto bifne edim aval haish sheasa shaliach lekaddesh lo ishsha eno tzarich laasoto beedim sheen makom leedim bishlichut haish ella lehodia amittat haddavar lefichach im hodu hashshaliach vehamshalleach enan tzerichin edim kemo sheliach hagget uchmo shaliach shehirshahu lehafrish lo teruma vechayyotze bahen bechal makom sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto veeno tzarich edim
Hashshaliach naase ed lefichach im asa shene sheluchin lekaddesh lo ishsha vehalchu vekiddeshu otah hen hen sheluchav vehen hen ede hakkiddushin veenan tzerichin lekaddeshah lo bifne shenayim acherim

Hakkol kesherin lishlichut chutz mecheresh shote vekatan lefi sheenan bene daat vehaakkum lefi sheeno bene berit veneemar ken tarimu gam attem lerabbot hashshaliach uma attem bene berit af sheluchachem bene berit lehotzi et haakkum aval haeved af al pi shehu naase shaliach ledavar shebbemamon hare hu pasul lishlichut hakkiddushin vehaggittin lefi sheeno betorat gittin vekiddushin

Sheliach haish shemmekaddesh omer lah hare atte mekuddeshet lifloni bechesef ze o bishtar ze im sheliach haishsha hu shemmekabbel hakkiddushin omer lo hare pelonit sheshshalcha otcha mekuddeshet li vehu omer lo kiddashtiha lecha o erastiha lecha o netattiha lecha leishsha vechal kayyotze baze vechen hamkaddesh al yede haav omer lo hare bittecha pelonit mekuddeshet li vehu omer lo kiddashtiha lecha im amar haav o hashshaliach hen dayyo vaafillu shatak veim hau asukin beoto inyan venatan laav o lashshaliach velo peresh velo amar davar dayyo vehi mekuddeshet veim kiddesh bishtar eno kotvo ella middaat haav o middaat hashshaliach vechen bechal haddevarim kullan shel kiddushin din haish im haishsha kedin shaliach im shaliach o im haav

Mitzva sheyekaddesh adam et ishto beatzmo yoter meal yede shelucho vechen mitzva laishsha shettekaddesh atzmah beyadah yoter meal yede sheluchah veaf al pi sheyyesh reshut laav lekaddesh bitto keshehi ketanna uchshehi naara lechal mi sheyyirtze en rauy laasot ken ella mitzvat chachamim shello yekaddesh adam bitto keshehi ketanna ad shettagdil vetomar lifloni ani rotza vechen haish en rauy lekaddesh ketanna velo yekaddesh ishsha ad sheyyirenna vetihye keshera beenav shemma lo timtza chen beenav venimtza megarshah o shochev immah vehu sonah

Hamkaddesh bevia hare ellu kiddushe tora vechen mitkaddeshet bishtar min hattora keshem sheggomer umgaresh shenneemar vechatav lah sefer keritut kach gomer umachnis aval hakkesef middivre sofrim vechen din hakkesef din tora uferusho middivre sofrim shenneemar ki yikkach ish ishsha veamru chachamim likkuchim ellu yihu bechesef shenneemar natatti kesef hassade kach mimmenni

Af al pi sheikkar haddavar kach hu kevar nahagu kal yisrael lekaddesh bechesef o bishve kesef vechen im ratza lekaddesh bishtar mekaddesh aval en mekaddeshin bevia lechattechilla veim kiddesh bevia makkin oto makkat mardut kede shello yihu yisrael perutzim bedavar ze af al pi shekkiddushav kiddushin gemurin

Vechen hamkaddesh belo shidduchin o hamkaddesh bashshuk af al pi shekkiddushav kiddushin gemurin makkin oto makkat mardut kede shello yehe davar ze hergel liznut veyidme likdesha shehayeta kodem mattan tora

Kal hamkaddesh ishsha ben al yede atzmo ben al yede shaliach tzarich levarech kodem hakkiddushin o hu o shelucho kederech shemmevarchin al kal hammitzot veachar kach mekaddesh veim kiddesh velo berech lo yevarech achar hakkiddushin shezzo beracha levattala ma shennaasa kevar naasa

Ketzad mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzotav vehivdilanu min haaraot veasar lanu et haarusot vehittir lanu et hannesuot al yede chuppa vekiddushin baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh yisrael zo hi birkat erusin venahagu haam lehasdir beracha zo al kos shel yayin o shel shechar veim yesh sham yayin mevarech al hayyayin techilla veachar kach mevarech birkat erusin veachar kach mekaddeshah veim en lo yayin o shechar mevarech otah bifne atzmah
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 4: En haishsha mitkaddeshet ella lirtzonah vehamkaddesh ishsha beal karchah enah mekuddeshet aval haish sheanasuhu ad shekkiddesh beal karcho hare zo mekuddeshet veyesh laish lekaddesh nashim rabbot keachat vehu sheyyihye bechesef im kiddesh bechesef peruta lechal achat veachat veyesh leachat mehen o leacher lekabbel hakkiddushin al yede kullan middatan

Hamkaddesh et haishsha venatan hakkiddushin middatah beyad chavertah veamar lachavertah keshennatan hakkiddushin beyadah veatte nammi o vechen gam atte vechayyotze baze hare shettehen mekuddashot aval im natan beyadah veamar lah veatte hare zo shekkibbela hakkiddushin mekuddeshet besafek shemma lo nitkavin ella lirot ma belibbah uchillu amar lah veatte ma tomri bedavar ze ulfichach kibbela hakkiddushin hi shehare ze adayin shoalah lirot ma belibbah umippene ze hi safek mekuddeshet

Amar lah hitkaddeshi li bedinar ze netalattu uzrakattu lefanav o layyam o laur o ledavar haaved enah mekuddeshet amra lo tenehu leabba o leavicha o leish peloni venatan enah mekuddeshet veim amra lo tenehu lo sheyekabbelehu li venatan hare zo mekuddeshet

Amra hannichehu al hassela enah mekuddeshet veim haya sela shellah mekuddeshet haya sela shel shenehem hare zo mekuddeshet besafek amar lah hitkaddeshi li bechikkar ze amra lo tenehu leani afillu haya ani hassamuch aleha enah mekuddeshet tenehu lakkelev hare zo enah mekuddeshet veim haya hakkelev shellah mekuddeshet veim haya ratz achareha lenashchah veamra lo tenehu lechelev ze hare zo safek mekuddeshet

Haya mocher perot o kelim vechayyotze bahen baa ishsha veamra lo ten li meat meellu veamar lah im etten lach tehi mekuddeshet li im amra hen venatan lah hare zo mekuddeshet aval im amra lo ten li mehen o hashlech li o devarim sheinyanam lo tischak immi bidvarim ellu ella ten li bilvad venatan enah mekuddeshet vechen im haya shote yayin veamra lo ten li kos echad veamar lah im etten lach hare atte mekuddeshet li bo veamra hashkeni hashkot o ten hashke hashlech enah me ke deshet sheen haddevarim nirin ella hashkeni bilvad velo tischak immi bedavar acher

Hamkaddesh beed echad en choshshin lekiddushav veaf al pi sheshshenehem modin kal vachomer limkaddesh belo edim hamkaddesh bifsule edut shel tora enah mekuddeshet bifsule edut shel divre sofrim o beedim shehen safek pesule tora im ratza lichnos chozer umkaddesh bichsherim veim lo ratza lichnos tzericha get mimmennu missafek vaafillu kafra haishsha vehichchisha et haedim veamra lo kiddashtani kofin otah likkach get vechen din kal kiddushe safek im ratza lichnos chozer umkaddesh vadday veim lo ratza lichnos tzericha get mimmennu missafek

Katan shekkiddesh en kiddushav kiddushin aval gadol shekkiddesh et hakketanna hayetoma o ketanna sheyyatza mershut aviha im hayeta pechuta mibbat shesh af al pi shehi nevonat lachash beoter umakkeret umavchenet en kan shem kiddushin veenah tzericha lemaen veim hayeta mibbat eser shanim ulmala af al pi shehi sechala beoter hoil venitkaddesha ledatah hare zo mekuddeshet lemeun hayeta mibbat shesh vead sof eser bodkin et yefi datah im makkeret umavchenet iske hannissuin vehakkiddushin tzericha lemaen veim lav enah mekuddeshet lemeun veenah tzericha lemaen

Ketzad mekuddeshet lemeun sheim nitkaddesha velo ratzta leshev im balah tzericha lemaen bifne shenayim velomar eni rotza bo veotza belo get kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot gerushin vezo hi hannikret memaenet velamma yotza belo get mippene sheen kiddusheha kiddushin gemurin min hattora ella middivre sofrim vehen teluyin sheim yashva im balah ad sheggadla gamru kiddusheha venaaset eshet ish gemura veeno tzarich lachazor ulkaddeshah achar sheggadla veim lo ratzta leshev tzericha lemaen vetetze belo get

Cheresh shennasa pikkachat vechen chereshet shennisset lefikkeach en kiddushehen gemurin min hattora ella middivre sofrim lefichach im ba pikkeach vekiddesh eshet cheresh happikkachat hare zo mekuddeshet lashsheni kiddushin gemurin venoten get vehi mutteret levalah hacheresh aval hashshote shekkiddesh pikkachat o pikkeach shekkiddesh shota en kan kiddushin kelal lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim
Saris shekkiddesh ben seris chamma ben seris adam vechen ayelonit shennitkaddesha hare ellu kiddushin gemurin
Tumtum veanderoginus shekkiddeshu ishsha o shekkiddeshan ish hare ellu kiddushe safek utzrichin get missafek
Hamkaddesh achat min haaraot lo asa kelum sheen kiddushin tofsin laerva chutz min hannidda shehamkaddesh et hannidda hare zo mekuddeshet kiddushin gemurin veen rauy laasot ken

Eshet ish sheppashta yadah vekibbela kiddushin meacher bifne balah hare zo mekuddeshet lashsheni shehaishsha sheamra levalah befanav gerashtani neemenet chazaka en ishsha meizza paneha bifne balah aval im kiddeshah acher shello bifne balah en kiddushin tofsin bah ad shettavi reaya shennitgarsha kodem shettekabbel hakkiddushin kal shello befanav meizza

Hamkaddesh achat min hashsheniyyot o meissure lavin o meissure ase vechen yavam shekkiddesh tzarat yevama hare zo mekuddeshet kiddushin gemurin chutz mivama shennitkaddesha lezar shehi mekuddeshet besafek nistappek lachachamim im hakkiddushin tofsin bivama kishar chiyyuve lavin o en kiddushin tofsin bah keerva veaf al pi sheasur lo lichnos achat mikkal ellu hare ze megaresh beget

Hamkaddesh kutit o shifcha enan kiddushin ella hare hi achar hakkiddushin kemo shehayeta kodem hakkiddushin vechen akkum veeved shekkiddeshu bat yisrael en kiddushehen kiddushin yisrael mumar shekkiddesh af al pi shehu oved akkum birtzono hare ellu kiddushin gemurin utzricha get mimmennu

Hamkaddesh ishsha shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin enah mekuddeshet kiddushin gemurin ad shettishtachrer vechevan shennishtachrera gamru kiddusheha kekiddushe ketanna sheggadla veeno tzarich lekaddeshah kiddushin acherim ba acher vekiddeshah achar shennishtachrera hare ze safek kiddushin lishnehem
Vee zo hi shifcha charufa haamura battora zo mi shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin shekkiddeshah eved ivri umi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin shekkiddesh bat chorin hare zo safek kiddushin
Shikkor shekkiddesh kiddushav kiddushin veaf al pi shennishtakker harbe veim higgia leshichruto shel lot en kiddushav kiddushin umityashshevin bedavar ze

Hamkaddesh befachot mipperuta enah mekuddeshet kiddeshah beochel o bichli vechayyotze bo sheshshave pachot mipperuta hare zo mekuddeshet besafek utzricha get missafek shemma davar ze shave peruta bemakom acher ha lamadta shekkal hamkaddesh bishve kesef im haya beotah hammedina sheve peruta hare ellu kiddushe vadday veim eno sheve peruta hare ellu kiddushe safek yerae li sheim kiddesh betavshil o beyarak sheeno mitkayyem vechayyotze bahem im lo hau sheve peruta beoto hammakom enah mekuddeshet kelal shehare davar ze eno maggia lemakom acher ad sheyyippased veyovad velo yihu sheve peruta vedavar shel taam hu ze verauy lismoch alav

Hamkaddesh ishsha befachot mipperuta o shekkiddesh shette nashim bifruta af al pi sheshshalach sivlonot leachar mikken enah mekuddeshet vechen katan shekkiddesh af al pi sheshshalach sivlonot leachar shehigdil enah mekuddeshet shemmechamat kiddushin harishonim shelachan shehau kiddushin pesulin

Hamkaddesh et haishsha bechesef o bishtar eno tzarich sheyyitten hakkiddushin letoch yadah ella kevan sheratzta lizrok lah kiddusheha uzrakan ben letoch yadah ben letoch chekah o letoch chatzerah o letoch sade shellah hare zo mekuddeshet hayeta omedet birshut habbaal tzarich sheyyitten letoch yadah o letoch chekah hayeta omedet birshut shehi shel shenehen vezarak lah kiddusheha middatah velo higgiu leyadah o lechekah hare zo mekuddeshet kiddushe safek vaafillu amra lo hannach kiddushin al makom ze veoto hammakom shel shenehem hare ellu kiddushe safek

Hau omdim birshut harabbim o birshut sheeno shel shenehem vezarak lah kiddusheha karov lo enah mekuddeshet karov lah hare zo mekuddeshet mechetza al mechetza o shehau safek karov lo safek karov lah veavdu kodem sheyyaggiu leyadah hare zo safek mekuddeshet ketzad hu karov lo vekarov lah kal shehu yachol lishmor otan vehi enah yechola ze hu karov lo hi yechola lishmor otan vehu eno yachol zehu karov lah shenehen yecholin lishmor otan o shenehen en yecholim lishmor otan ze hu mechetza al mechetza
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 5: Hamkadesh bedavar shehu asur bahanaa kegon chametz befesach o basar bechalav vechayyotze bahen mishshear issure hanaa enah mekuddeshet vaafillu haya asur bahanaa middivrehem kegon chametz beshaa shishshit miyyom arbaa asar enah mekuddeshet

Avar umachar davar haasur bahanaa vekiddesh bedamav hare zo mekuddeshet chutz meakkum sheim kiddesh bedameha enah mekuddeshet mippene sheddeme akkum asurin bahanaa kamoha hamkaddesh beferesh egle akkum enah mekuddeshet shehakkol meakkum asur bahanaa shenneemar velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem aval hamkaddesh beferesh shor hanniskal hare zo mekuddeshet af al pi sheshshor hanniskal asur bahanaa pirsho eno asur bahanaa sheeno davar chashuv legabbe hashshor

Hamkaddesh beferot sheviit o beefer para adumma o bemayim shemmillean laasotan me nidda hare zo mekuddeshet hamkaddesh behekdesh shel bedek habbayit beshogeg hare zo mekuddeshet vehu yeshallem keren vechomesh lehekdesh veyavi ashamo kedin kal moel bishgaga veim kiddesh bo ishsha bemezid enah mekuddeshet
Kiddeshah bemaaser sheni ben beshogeg ben bemezid enah mekuddeshet lefi sheen lo laasot bo shear chafatzav ad sheyyitchallel shenneemar bemaaser la hu

Kohen shekkiddesh bechelko mikkadshe kadashim o mikkadashim kallim enah mekuddeshet mippene shello hutteru ella laachila bilvad aval kohen shekkiddesh bitruma gedola uvitrumat maaser uvvikkurim vechen levi shekkiddesh bemaaser rishon veyisrael shekkiddesh bemaasar ani hare zo mekuddeshet

Mattanot shello hurmu hare hem kemo shehurmu lefichach yisrael shennaflu lo tevalim mibbet avi immo kohen vehifrish mehen teruma umaasrot hare hen kitrumot umaasrot shennaflu lo birushsha meavi immo veim kiddesh bahen ishsha hare zo mekuddeshet sheaf al pi sheenan reuyin lo laachila yesh lo lemachran lemi shehen reuyin lo aval yisrael shekkiddesh bitruma shehifrish miggarno enah mekuddeshet shehare en lo lemachrah veen lo bah ella tovat hanaa lefi shennotnah lechal kohen sheyyirtze vetovat hanaa enah mamon
Hamkaddesh et haishsha begezel o bigneva o bechamas im nityaashu habbealim venoda shekkana oto davar beyeush hare zo mekuddeshet veim lav enah mekuddeshet

Hannichnas levet chavero velakach lo keli o ochel vechayyotze bahen vekiddesh bo ishsha uva baal habbayit af al pi sheamar lo lamma lo natatta lah davar ze shehu tov mimma shennatatta lah enah mekuddeshet shello amar lo davar ze ella kede shello lehitbayyesh immo vehoil vekiddesh bemamon chavero shello middaat chavero hare ze gezel veenah mekuddeshet veim kiddeshah bedavar sheen baal habbayit makpid alav kegon temara o egoz hare zo mekuddeshet missafek
Hayeta sechora beno uven chavero vechillekah shello middaat chavero vekiddesh bechelko hoil utzricha shumat bet din enah mekuddeshet sheen ze notel leatzmo ma sheyyirtze veyanniach ma sheyyirtze

Gazal et haishsha o ganav mimmenna o chamasah vechazar vekiddeshah baggezel uvaggeneva uvechamas shellah veamar lah hare atte mekuddeshet bo im kadam benehen shidduchin venatla veshatka hare zo mekuddeshet veim lo shiddech otah meolam af al pi sheshshatka keshennatan lah devarim ellu betorat kiddushin enah mekuddeshet veim amra hen hare zo mekuddeshet

Vechen im natan lah pikkadon veamar lah kinsi pikkadon ze vechazar veamar lah hare atte mekuddeshet li bo im amar lah kodem shennetalattu untalattu veshatka hare zo mekuddeshet veim achar shennetalattu betorat pikkadon amar lah hare atte mekuddeshet bo veshatka en ze kelum shekkal shetika shelleachar mattan maot enah moelet aval im amra hen achar shennatla hare zo mekuddeshet

Hechezir lah chov shehaya lah etzlo veamar lah hare atte mekuddeshet bo kodem shettittelennu untalattu veshatka im haya benehen shidduchin hare zo mekuddeshet veim lo shiddech enah mekuddeshet ad shettomar hen veim amar lah achar shennatla hachov shellah hare atte mekuddeshet bo afillu amra hen enah mekuddeshet shehare lo higgia leyadah mimmennu kelum ella shellah natla uchvar nifra chovo mishshaa shennatla veenah yechola lachazor ultavo bachov paam acheret

Hamkaddesh bemilve afillu hayeta bishtar enah mekuddeshet ketzad kegon shehaya lo etzlah chov dinar veamar lah hare atte mekuddeshet li baddinar sheyyesh li beyadech enah mekuddeshet mippene shehammilve lehotzaa nittena veen kan shum davar kayyam lehanot bo meatta shekkevar hotzia oto dinar veavra hanaato
Haya lo etzlah milve al hammashkon vekiddeshah beotah hammilve vehechezir lah hammashkon hare zo mekuddeshet shehare hi nehenet bammashkon meatta vahare higgia hanaa leyadah

Hamkaddesh bahanaat milve hare zo mekuddeshet ketzad kegon shehilva otah atta matayim zuz veamar lah hare atte mekuddeshet li bahanaat zeman shearviach lach bemilve zo shettihye beyadech kach vechach yom veeni tovah mimmech ad zeman peloni hare zo mekuddeshet shehare yesh lah hanaa meatta lehishtammesh bemilve zo ad sof zeman shekkava veasur laasot ken mippene shehi keribbit ufershu rabbotay bahanaat milve devarim sheen rauy leshaman

Uvchullam af al pi sheamra belibbi haya lehitkaddesh lo af al pi shehitani veen haddavar kemo sheamar vechen im amar hu belibbi haya lekaddeshah af al pi shehitatni enah mekuddeshet lefi shehaddevarim shebballev enam devarim

Hare atte mekuddeshet li al menat sheani bassam venimtza bassam uvursay al menat sheani ben ir venimtza ben ir uven kerach al menat sheshshemi yosef venimtza shemo yosef veshimon hare zo mekuddeshet aval im amar lah al menat sheen shemi ella yosef venimtza shemo yosef veshimon sheeni ella bassam venimtza bassam uvursay sheeni ella ben ir venimtza ben kerach uven ir enah mekuddeshet

Haomer leishsha hare atte mekuddeshet li al menat sheani yodea likrot tzarich sheyyikra hattora vitargem otah targum unkelus hagger veim amar lah al menat sheani kore tzarich lihot yodea likrot tora neviim uchtuvim bedikduk yafe al menat sheani yodea lishnot tzarich lihot yodea likrot hammishna veim amar al menat sheani tannaa tzarich lihot yodea likrot hammishna vesafra vesifri vetosefta shel rabbi chiyya

Al menat sheani talmid en omrin keven azay uven zoma ella kal sheshshoalin oto davar echad betalmudo veomro vaafillu behilchot hechag shemmelammedin otan barabbim middevarim hakkallim samuch lechag kede sheyyihu kal haam bekiin bahen al menat sheani chacham en omrin kerabbi akiva vachaverav ella kal sheshshoalin oto bechal makom devar chachma veomer al menat sheani gibbor en omrin keavner ben ner uchoav ella kal shechaverav mityarim mimmennu mippene gevurato al menat sheani ashir en omrin kerabbi elazar ben charsom uchrabbi elazar ben azarya ella kal shebbene iro mechabbedin oto mippene ashro al menat sheani tzaddik afillu rasha gamur hare zo mekuddeshet missafek shemma hirher teshuva belibbo al menat sheani rasha afillu tzaddik gamur hare zo mekuddeshet missafek shemma hirher beakkum belibbo sheaon akkum gadol hu umishsheyeharher laavod belibbo naase rasha shenneemar pen yifte levavchem vechatuv lemaan tefosho et bet yisrael belibbam

Hamkaddesh et haishsha veamar hayiti savur shehi kohenet vahare hi leviyya leviyya vahare hi kohenet aniyya vahare hi ashira ashira vahare hi aniyya hare zo mekuddeshet mippene shello hitattu vechen hi sheamra sevura hayiti shehu kohen vahare hu levi levi vahare hu kohen ashir vahare hu ani ani vahare hu ashir hare zo mekuddeshet mippene shello hita otah
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 9: Ham ka desh shette nashim sheasur lissa shettehen mishshum erva keachat enan mekuddashot ketzad kegon shekkiddesh ishsha uvittah o shette achaot keachat en achat mehen mekuddeshet

Kiddesh nashim rabbot keachat veamar hare kullechem mekuddashot li vehau bahen shette achaot o ishsha uvittah vechayyotze bahen en achat mikkullan mekuddeshet veim amar lahen haruya mikkem li levia mekuddeshet li hare kullan mekuddashot lo chutz meachaot o ishsha uvittah vechayyotze bahen vechen im amar lahen hare kullechem mekuddashot li vehayeta bahen shifcha o akkum o ishsha achat erva kegon eshet ish o bitto o achoto vechayyotze bahen en achat mikkullam mekuddeshet veim amar haruya mikkem li levia tihye mekuddeshet li hare kullan mekuddashot lo chutz meotah ishsha sheen kiddushin tofsin bah

Amar lishte achaot hare achat mikkem mekuddeshet li baze venatan lahen peruta o shekkibbaltah achat al yad chavertah vechen haomer laav achat mibbenotecha mekuddeshet li vekibbel haav kiddusheha kullan tzerichot get mimmennu veasur lo lavo al achat mehen mippene shehakkiddushin tofsin bahen af al pi shei efshar lavo al achat mehen

Haose shaliach lekaddesh lo ishsha pelonit vehalach vekiddeshah lo vekiddesh hamshalleach beatzmo leimmah o levittah o laachotah veen yadua e zo mehen nitkaddesha rishona shettehen tzerichot get vaasurot alav vechen ishsha sheasta shaliach lekaddeshah vehalach vekiddeshah vehalcha vekiddesha hi atzmah leacher veen yadua e zo mehen kodem shenehen notnin lah get veim ratzu echad noten get veechad kones
Bamme devarim amurim birchokin aval bikrovim im kiddeshah hashshaliach laav vekiddesha hi atzmah labben o laach vechayyotze bahen shenehem notnin get vehi asura lishnehem

Haomer lishlucho tze vekaddesh li ishsha umet hashshaliach veeno yodea im kiddesh im lo kiddesh lo ishsha hare ze bechezkat shekkiddesh shechezkat shaliach laasot shelichuto vehoil veen yadua e zo ishsha kiddesh lo hare ze asur bechal ishsha sheyyesh lah kerovot shehen erva immah kegon ishsha sheyyesh lah bat o em o achot vechayyotze bahen sheim tomar yissa zo shemma immah kiddesh lo shelucho o achotah o bittah umuttar beishsha sheen lah kerovot kegon ellu hayeta lah kerova kegon em o achot vechayyotze bahen vehayeta hakkerova eshet ish beshaa sheasa hu shaliach af al pi shennitgarsha kodem sheyyamut hashshaliach hare ze muttar bah veen omrim shemma kiddesh hashshaliach atte kerovatah achar shennitgarsha mippene shello hayeta reuya beshaa sheasa hashshaliach veen adam ose shaliach lekaddesh lo ella ishsha sheyyachol hu lekaddeshah bishat hashshelichut

Mi shehau lo chamishsha banim veasu kullan shaliach et avihem lekaddesh lahem ishsha veamar avi habbanim leish sheyyesh lo chamesh banot achat mibbenotecha mekuddeshet leechad mibbanay vekibbel haav hakkiddushin kal achat mehen tzericha chamishsha gittin mikkal haachin hoil vechullan natnu reshut laav lekaddesh lahen ishsha met echad mehem kal achat mehen tzericha arbaa gittin vachalitza meechad mehem

Haav shehayeta lo bat ketanna o naara shehi birshuto uvat bogeret venatna lo habbogeret reshut lekaddeshah vekiddesh bitto setam leechad en habbogeret bichlal ad sheyefaresh veyomar bitti habbogeret sheasat oti shaliach lefichach en habbogeret mekuddeshet vaachotah mekuddeshet

Mi sheyyesh lo shette kitte banot mishshette nashim vechullan birshuto vekiddesh achat mehen uvishat hakkiddushin amar labbaal kiddashti lecha et bitti haggedola af al pi sheyyesh lomar shemma gedola shebbaggedolot kiddesh lo o gedola shebbakketannot o ketanna shebbaggedolot shehi gedola min haggedola shebbakketannot hare kullan muttarot chutz min haggedola shebbaggedolot shehi levaddah hamkuddeshet vechen im kiddesh bitto hakketanna af al pi sheyyesh lomar shemma ketanna shebbakketannot o ketanna shebbaggedolot o gedola shebbakketannot shehi ketanna min hakketanna shebbaggedolot hare kullan muttarot chutz min hakketanna shebbakketannot vehi levaddah hamkuddeshet shemmashma bitto haggedola sheen bivnotav gedola mimmenna umashma bitto hakketanna sheen bahen ketanna mimmenna
Neeman haav lomar al bitto kodem shettivgor shehi mekuddeshet veosrah al hakkol

Haav sheamar kiddashti et bitti veeni yodea lemi kiddashtiha hare zo asura leolam al kal adam ad sheyyomar haav noda li shellifloni kiddashtiha vetihye tzericha mimmennu get bilvad veaf al pi shennoda lo achar shebbagra
Amar haav eni yodea lemi kiddashtiha uva echad veamar ani hu shekkiddashtiha neeman af lichnos veeno tzarich kiddushin acherim

Bau shenayim ze omer ani kiddashtiha veze omer ani kiddashtiha shenehen notnin get veim ratzu echad noten get veechad kones kenasah veachar kach ba acher veamar ani hu shekkiddashtiha eno neeman veeno osrah al balah

Haishsha sheamra nitkaddashti veeni yodaat lemi nitkaddashti uva echad veamar ani hu shekkiddashtich neeman litten get vetihye mutteret lechal adam chutz mimmennu aval eno neeman lichnos shemma yitzro tokfo vehi targil lo kede lehattirah

Haomer leishsha kiddashtich vehi omeret lo kiddashtani hu asur bikrovoteha vehi mutteret bikrovav kiddashtani vehu omer lo kiddashtich hu muttar bikrovoteha vehi asura bikrovav kiddashtich vehi omeret lo kiddashta ella bitti hu asur bikrovot gedola ugdola mutteret bikrovav umuttar bikrovot habbat vehabbat mutteret bikrovav kiddashti et bittech vehi omeret lo kiddashta ella oti hu asur bikrovot habbat vehabbat mutteret bikrovav umuttar bikrovot haem vehaem asura al kerovav

Vechal ellu shettoanin hakkiddushin beshettaan hattoen shehau sham kiddushin bifne edim vehalchu limdina acheret o metu aval im hodu shehau hakkiddushin belo edim en kan kiddushin kemo shebbearnu vechal makom shettomar ishsha leish kiddashtani vehu omer lo kiddashtich mevakkeshim mimmennu sheyyichtov lah get lehattirah lishar haam sheen lo baze hefsed veim natan lah get meatzmo kofin oto litten ketubba
Haose shaliach lekaddesh lo ishsha vehalach vekiddeshah leatzmo hare zo mekuddeshet lashshaliach veasur laasot ken vechal haose davar ze vechayyotze bo bishar divre mikkach umimkar nikra rasha

Haose shaliach lekaddesh lo ishsha vehalach vekiddeshah hashshaliach omer leatzmi kiddashtiha vehaishsha omeret larishon sheshshelacho nitkaddashti im lo asa hashshaliach beedim hare hashshaliach asur bikrovoteha vehi mutteret bikrovav vehaishsha asura bikrove hamshalleach vehamshalleach muttar bikrovoteha veim huchzak hashshaliach beedim hare zo mekuddeshet larishon

Amra eni yodaat lemi nitkaddashti im lashsholeach o lishlucho im lo huchzak hashshaliach beedim hare zo mekuddeshet lashsheni veim huchzak shehu shelucho shenehen notnin get veim ratzu echad noten get veechad kones

Haishsha sheasta shaliach lekaddeshah vehalach vekiddeshah uvet halichato bittela hashshelichut vechazra bah veen yadua im kodem shekkibbel lah hakkiddushin chazra o achar hakkiddushin hare zo mekuddeshet missafek vechen haish sheasa shaliach vechazar bo

Hamkaddesh achat mechamesh nashim veeno yodea e zo mehen kiddesh vechal achat veachat omeret oti kiddesh asur bikrovot kullan venoten get lechal achat veachat umanniach ketubba achat benehen umistallek veim kiddesh bevia kansu oto chachamim sheyyitten ketubba lechal achat veachat vehaddavar yadua shehakketubba shekkatav leachat mehen avda vechal achat veachat omeret ani hi shekkiddashtani vechatavta li ketubba veavda ketubbati

Haishsha sheyyatza aleha kol shehi mekuddeshet lifloni hare zo bechezkat mekuddeshet af al pi sheen sham reaya berura vechal kol shello huchzak bevet din en choshshin lo vechetzad hu hakkol shettuchzak zo bo shehi mekuddeshet kegon shebbau shenayim veheidu sherau hannerot dolkot umittot mutzaot uvne adam nichnasin veotzin venashim semechot lah veomrot nitkaddesha pelonit hayyom shamu otan omrot pelonit titkaddesh hayyom en choshshin lah shemma nizdammenu lekaddesh velo nitkaddesha ad sheyyishmeu shennitkaddesha vechen im bau shenayim veamru rainu kemo simchat erusin veshamanu kol havara veshamanu mippeloni sheshshama mippeloni shennitkaddesha pelonit bifne peloni ufloni vehalchu lahem haedim limdina acheret o metu hare ze kol shemmachazik otah mekuddeshet

Bamme devarim amurim shello hayeta sham amatla aval im hayeta sham amatla veshamu haamatla kesheshshamu shennitkaddesha lo huchzeka mekuddeshet ketzad hi haamatla pelonit nitkaddesha al tenay o kiddushe safek lo huchzeka ella shoalin otah vesomchin al devareha hoil veen sham reaya berura velo kol chazak

Yatza aleha kol shennitkaddesha lifloni ulachar yamim amru amatla im nirin haddevarim levet din shehu ken somchin al haamatla velo tuchzak mekuddeshet veim lav hoil velo nishmea haamatla beet shennishmeu hakkiddushin en choshshin laamatla

Maase beachat sheyyatza aleha kol shennitkaddesha livno shel peloni ulachar zeman shaalu leaviv veamar al tenay kach nitkaddesha lo velo nitkayyem hattenay velo samchu chachamim al devarav ella amru hare zo safek mekuddeshet uchillu en sham amatla

Yatza aleha kol shehi mekuddeshet lifloni uva sheni vekiddeshah befanenu bodkin al kiddushe rishon shehen bekol im bau edim biraya berura shehi mekuddeshet larishon en kiddushe sheni kelum veim lav megaresh rishon shekkiddushav bekol venose hashsheni shekkiddushav vadday veim geresh hashsheni lo yichnos harishon shemma yomru hechezir gerushato min haerusin achar shennitarsa leacher
Yatza aleha kol shehi mekuddeshet lifloni veyatza kol acher kemoto shehi mekuddeshet leacher echad kotev get veechad kones ben rishon ben acharon

Makom shennahagu lishloach sivlonot laarusa achar shettitares uvau edim sherau sivlonot shehuvlu lah choshshin lah shemma nitkaddesha utzricha get missafek af al pi sherov anshe hair en meshallechin sivlonot ella kodem haerusin umakom shennahagu kullan lishloach sivlonot battechilla veachar kach mekaddeshin verau sivlonot en choshshin lah

Huchzak shetar ketubbatah im derech miktzat anshe hammakom shemmekaddeshin veachar kach kotvin choshshin lah veaf al pi sheen sham sofer en omrin shemma mippene hassofer shemmatza hikdim vechatav veim derech kal anshe hammakom shekkotvin hakketubba kodem hakkiddushin en choshshin lah

Shenayim omrin reinuha shennitkaddesha beom peloni ushnayim omrin lo reinuha af al pi shekkullam shechenim bechatzer achat hare zo mekuddeshet sheen taanat lo reinuha reaya shedderech haam lekaddesh betzina

Amar ed echad mekuddeshet hi zo vehi omeret lo nitkaddashti hare zo mutteret echad omer mekuddeshet veechad omer enah mekuddeshet lo tinnase veim nisset lo tetze shehare hi omeret lo nitkaddashti amra mekuddeshet ani ulachar zeman amda vekiddesha atzmah im natna amatla lidvareha veamra mippene kach vechach amarti battechilla sheani mekuddeshet verainu bidvareha mammash hare zo mutteret lashsheni veim lo natna amatla o shennatna veen bahen mammash hare zo asura vekiddushe sheni kiddushe safek lefichach noten lah get vetihye asura alav veal hakkol ad sheyyavo arusah vechen haishsha shebbat veamra eshet ish ani vechazra veamra penuya ani im natna amatla lidvareha veyesh bidvareha mammash hare zo neemenet
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 10: Haarusa asura levalah middivre sofrim kal zeman shehi bevet aviha vehabba al arusato bevet chamiv makkin oto makkat mardut vaafillu im kiddeshah bevia asur lo lavo aleha bia sheniyya bevet aviha ad sheyyavi otah letoch beto veyityached immah veyafrishennah lo veyichud ze hu hannikra kenisa lachuppa vehu hannikra nissuin bechal makom vehabba al arusato leshem nissuin achar shekkiddeshah mishsheyeare bah kenaah venaaset nesua vahare hi ishto lechal davar

Kevan shennichnesa haarusa lachuppa hare zo mutteret lavo aleha bechal et sheyyirtze vahare hi ishto gemura lechal davar umishshettikkanes lachuppa nikret nesua af al pi shello nivala vehu shettihye reuya livila aval im hayeta nidda af al pi shennichnesa lachuppa venityached immah lo gamru hannissuin vahare hi kaarusa adayin

Vetzarich levarech birkat chatanim bevet hechatan kodem hannissuin vehen shesh berachot veellu hen baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shehakkol bara lichvodo baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam yotzer haadam baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher yatzar et haadam betzalmo betzelem demut tavnito vehitkin lo mimmennu binyan ade ad baruch atta Adonai yotzer haadam sos tasis vetagel akara bekibbutz baneha letochah besimcha baruch atta Adonai mesammeach tziyyon bevaneha sammeach tesammach reim haahuvim kesammechacha yetzircha began eden mikkedem baruch atta Adonai mesammeach chatan vechalla baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bara sason vesimcha chatan vechalla gila rinna ditza vechedva ahava achava shalom vereut mehera Adonai elohenu yishshama beare yehuda uvchutzot yerushalayim kol sason kol simcha kol chatan kol kalla kol mitzhalot chatanim mechuppatam unarim mimmishte manginatam baruch atta Adonai mesammeach hechatan im hakkalla

Veim haya sham yayin mevi kos shel yayin umvarech al hayyayin techilla umsadder et kullan al hakkos venimtza mevarech sheva berachot veyesh mekomot shennahagu lehavi hadas im hayyayin umvarech al hahadas achar hayyayin veachar kach mevarech hashshesh
Veen mevarchin birkat chatanim ella baasara gedolim uvne chorin vechatan min hamminyan

Hamares et haishsha uverech birkat chatanim velo nityached immah beveto adayin arusa hi sheen birkat chatanim osa hannissuin ella kenisa lachuppa eres vechanas lachuppa velo berech birkat chatanim hare zo nesua gemura vechozer umvarech afillu achar kamma yamim velo tinnase nidda ad shettithar veen mevarchin lah birkat chatanim ad shettithar veim avar venasa uverech eno chozer umvarech

Vetzarich lichtov ketubba kodem kenisa lachuppa veachar kach yihye muttar beishto vehechatan noten sechar hassofer vechamma hu kotev lah im hayeta betula en kotvin lah pachot mimmatayim dinarim veim beula en kotvin lah pachot mimmea dinarim veze hu hannikra ikkar ketubba veim ratza lehosif lah afillu kikkar zahav mosif vedin hattosefet vedin haikkar echad hu lerov haddevarim lefichach kal makom shenneemar bo ketubba setam hu haikkar vehattosefet keechad vachachamim hem shettikkenu ketubba laishsha kede shello tihye kalla beenav lehotziah

Dinarim ellu lo tikkenu otam min hakkesef hattahor ella mimmatbea shehaya beotan hayyamim shehaya shiva chalakim nechoshet veechad kesef ad sheyyihye bassela chatzi zuz kesef venimtza matayim dinarim shel betula chamishsha veesrim zuzin shel kesef tahor umea dinarim shel beula shenem asar zuzim umechetza umishkal kal zuz shesh vetishim seorot kemo shebbearnu bitchillat eruvin vehaddinar hu hannikra zuz bechal makom ben sheyyihye min hakkesef hattahor ben sheyyihye mimmatbea otan hayyamim

En pochatin livtula mimmatayim velivula mimmea vechal happochet beilato beilat zenut echad hakkotev et hakketubba bishtar veechad sheheidu alav edim vekanu miyyado shehu chayyav lah mea o matayim hare ze muttar vechen im natan lah mittaltelin keneged ketubbatah hare ze muttar livol ad sheyyihye lo penay lichtov

Hakkones et haishsha velo katav lah ketubba o shekkatav veavad shetar hakketubba o shemmachala ketubbatah levalah o shemmachra lo ketubbatah chozer vechotev lah ikkar ketubba im ratza lekayemah lefi sheasur lo leadam lishhot im ishto afillu shaa achat belo ketubba aval hammocheret ketubbatah laacherim betovat hanaa eno tzarich lichtov lah ketubba acheret shello tikkenu ketubba ella kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah veim hotzi ze meshallem ketubbatah lallokeach kederech shehaya meshallem lah im lo machra

Hamares et haishsha vechatav lah ketubba velo nichnesa lachuppa adayin arusa hi veenah nesua sheen hakketubba osa nissuin veim met o gershah gova ikkar ketubbatah mibbene chorin veenah gova tosefet kelal hoil velo kenasah aval im eres ishsha velo katav lah ketubba vamet o gershah vehi arusa en lah kelum vaafillu haikkar shello tikkenu lah ikkar ketubba ad shettinnase o ad sheyyichtov vehamares et bitto vechatav lah ketubba vamet o gershah keshehayeta naara ketubbatah leaviha kemo shebbearnu lemala beferek shelishi

Vechen tikkenu chachamim shekkal hannose betula yihye sameach immah shivat yamim eno osek bimlachto velo nose venoten bashshuk ella ochel veshote vesameach ben shehaya bachur ben shehaya almon veim hayeta beula en pachot mishshelosha yamim shettakkanat chachamim hi livnot yisrael sheyyihye sameach im habbeula shelosha yamim ben bachur ben almon

Yesh lo leadam lissa nashim rabbot keachat beom echad umvarech birkat chatanim lechullan keachat aval lesimcha tzarich lismoach im kal achat simcha haruya lah im betula shiva im beula shelosha veen mearvin simcha besimcha

Muttar leares bechal yom chol afillu betisha beav ben bayyom ben ballayela aval en nosin nashim lo beerev shabbat velo beechad beshabbat gezera shemma yavo lide chillul shabbat betikkun hasseedda shehechatan tarud basseudda veen tzarich lomar sheasur lissa ishsha beshabbat vaafillu bechullo shel moed en nosin nashim kemo shebbearnu lefi sheen mearvin simcha besimcha shenneemar malle shevua zot venittena lecha gam et zot ushar hayyamim muttar lissa ishsha bechal yom sheyyirtze vehu sheyyitrach bisuddat nissuin shelosha yamim kodem hannissuin

Makom sheen bet din yoshvin bo ella besheni uvachamishi bilvad betula nisset beom revii sheim hayeta lo taanat betulim yashkim levet din uminhag chachamim shehannose et habbeula yissaenna bachamishi kede sheyyihye sameach immah chamishi veerev shabbat veshabbat veotze limlachto yom rishon
Hamares et bitto ketanna utvaah habbaal lenissuin ben hi ben aviha yecholin leakkev shello tinnase ad shettagdil vetease naara veim ratza lechansah kones veen rauy laasot ken

Ersah veshaha kamma shanim utvaah lenissuin vahare hi naara notnin lah chodesh miyyom hattevia lefarnes et atzmah ultakken ma shehi tzericha lah veachar kach tinnase tevaah achar shebbagra notnin lah chodesh miyyom habbeger vechen im kiddeshah beom habbeger notnin lah chodesh miyyom hakkiddushin shehu yom habbeger kiddeshah achar shebbagra im avru aleha chodesh bevagrutah ulachar kach nitkaddesha en notnin lah ella sheloshim yom miyyom hattevia vechen hamares et habbeula notnin lah sheloshim yom miyyom hattevia

Keshem shennotnin zeman laishsha mishshettevaah habbaal lefarnes et atzmah veachar kach tinnase kach notnin zeman laish lefarnes et atzmo mishshettava haishsha oto vechamma notnin lo kemo shennotnin lah im chodesh chodesh veim sheloshim yom sheloshim yom

Higgia zeman shennatnu laish velo nesaah nitchayyev bimzonoteha af al pi shello kanas veim higgia hazzeman beechad beshabbat o beerev shabbat eno maale lah mezonot beoto hayyom mippene sheeno yachol lichnos vechen im chala hu o hi o sheppersa nidda keshehiggia hazzeman eno maale lah mezonot shehare enah reuya lehinnase ad shettithar o ad shettavri vechen hu eno yachol lissa ishsha ad sheyyavri
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 11: Hannose betula shennitalmina o shennitgarsha o nechletza im min haerusin nitalmena o nitgarsha o nechletza ketubbatah matayim veim min hannissuin ketubbatah mea shemmishshennisset hare hi kivula vechen hannose betula meshuchreret o giyyoret o shevuya im nishtachrera hashshifcha venitgayera hakkutit venifdet hashshevuya vehen pechutot mibbat shalosh shanim veom echad ketubbatan matayim veim hau benot shalosh shanim veom echad vamala ketubbatan mea

Umippene ma tikkenu chachamim leellu ketubba mea veaf al pi shehen betulot hoil vechezkat hannesua shettibbael vechezkat hashshifcha vehakkutit vehashshevuya shettibbael tikkenu leellu mea ben nivalu ben lo nivalu vahare hen kivulot lechal davar

Mukkat etz ketubbatah mea afillu nisset al menat shehi betula shelema venimtzet mukkat etz ketubbatah mea ketanna mibbat shalosh shanim ulmatta shennivala afillu ba aleha adam gadol ketubbatah matayim sofah shettachazor betula kishar habbetulot vechen gedola shebba aleha katan mibben tesha shanim ulmatta ketubbatah matayim keillu lo nivala kelal shebbiat ben tesha shanim veom echad biato bia pachot mizze en biato bia

Betula shehi bogeret o suma o ayelonit ketubbatan matayim aval hachereshet vehashshota lo tikkenu lahen ketubba hashshota lo tikkenu lah nissuin kelal vehachereshet af al pi sheyyesh lah nissuin middivrehem lo tikkenu lah ketubba kede shello yimmanu millaset otah uchshem sheen lah ketubba kach en lah mezonot velo tenay mittenae ketubba veim kanas hachereshet venitpakkecha yesh lah ketubba utnay ketubba uchtubbatah mea
Nasa chereshet o shota vechatav lahen mea mane ketubbatan kayyemet mippene sheratza lehazzik nechasav

Cheresh o shote shennasu nashim pikchot af al pi shennitpakkeach hacheresh venishtappa hashshote en linshehem alehem kelum ratzu lekayeman achar shehivriu yesh lahen ketubba uchtubbatan mea veim bet din hem shehissiu hacheresh vechatvu lah ketubbatah al nechasav notelet kal ma shekkatvu lah bet din aval hashshote en bet din massiin oto bechal makom umippene sheen takkanat chachamim omedet bo lo tikkenu lo nissuin vechen hakkatan lo tikkenu lo chachamim nissuin hoil vesofo lavo lide nissuin gemurin umippene ma tikkenu nissuin liktanna veaf al pi shehi baa lide nissuin gemurin kede shello yinhagu bah minhag hefker veen massiin et hakkatan ad shebbodkin oto veodim shehevi simanin

Katan afillu ben tesha shanim veom echad shennasa ishsha en lah ketubba veim higdil vekiyemah achar shehigdil yesh lah ikkar ketubba vechen ger shennitgayyer hu veishto ketubbatah mane sheal menat ken kiyemah

Kal betula shekketubbatah matayim yesh lah taanat betulim vechal shekketubbatah mea o shello tikkenu lah chachamim ketubba en lah taanat betulim vehammityached im arusato kodem nissuin en lah taanat betulim

Uma hi taanat betulim ze shennasa ishsha shechezkatah shehi betula vetoen veomer lo metzatiha betula ushne simanin hen livtula haechad damim sheshottin mimmenna besof bia rishona vehashsheni haddochak sheyyimmatze bah bevia rishona bishat tashmish

Hannose et habbetula shekketubbatah matayim vetaan veamar lo metzatiha betula shoalin otah im amra emet hu lo metzaani betula mippene shennafalti vehikkani etz o karka vehalchu betulay hare zo neemenet vetachazor ketubbatah lemane af al pi shehu toen omer shemma ish ba alayich veen lach kelum en mashgichin betaanato veyesh lo lehacharim setam shello ba aleha ish sheen haddavar vadday lo

Amra hi emet amar shello metzaani betula veish ba alay beones achar shennitarasti lo hare zo neemenet uchtubbatah matayim kemo shehayeta veim taan veamar shemma ad shello erastich neenaste umikkachi mikkach taut o achar sheerastich nivalte birtzonech hare ze macharim setam al mi shettoen sheker kede lechayeveni mamon sheeni chayyav bo

Taan veamar lo metzatiha betula vehi omeret lo ba alay vaadayin ani betula bodkin otah o chozer uvoel bifne edim amra ba alay uvtula metzaani kechal habbetulot vesheker hu toen shoalin oto veomrin lo me haya haddavar ad sheamarta sheenah betula im amar mippene shello matzati lah dam bodkin bemishpachtah shemma en lahem dam kelal lo dam nidda velo dam betulim im nimtzeu kullan ken hare zo bechezkatah lo nimtzeu benot mishpachtah ken bodkin otah shemma choli gadol yesh bah sheyyavash lachluchit haevarim o shehayeta mitannet baraav martivin otah umaachilin otah umashkin otah ad shettavri vetibbael shenit venire im totzi dam im lav veim en sham choli velo raav velo kayyotze bo hare zo taanat betulim veaf al pi shemmatza dochak beet tashmish hoil velo yatza dam en kan betulim shekkal betula yesh lah dam ben ketanna ben gedola ben naara ben bogeret ella mippene hacholi kemo shebbearnu veim amar mippene shello matzati dochak ella petach patuach matzati shoalin al shenoteha shemma bogeret hi sherov habbogrot en lahen dochak shemmargishin bo harbe shehare gadla venitrappu evareha vechalu betuleha veim lo bagra adayin omrin lo shemma hitteta o baalta benachat ulfichach lo hirgashta baddochak im amar lo ki ella vadday petach patuach haya hare zo taanat betulim lechal betula shello bagra ben ketanna ben naara ben beria ben chola shekkal naara betula pitchah satum hu veaf al pi sheyyatza haddam hoil umatza petach patuach en kan betulim

Yesh geonim shehoru shehabbogeret en lah taanat damim veyesh lah taanat petach patuach veen derech haggemara mara davar ze vetaut haya bannuschaot shellahem uchvar badakti al sefarim rabbim vekadmonim umatzati shehaddavar kemo shebbearnu sheen levogeret ella taanat damim bilvad

Chachamim hem shettikkenu ikkar ketubba leishsha vehem hitkinu veamru shekkal hattoen taanat betulim vehaishsha machcheshet oto neeman vealeha lehavi reaya lo al haish shechazaka hi sheen adam toreach bisudda umafsidah vehofech simchato evel
Vead matay yesh lo liton taanat betulim im nistera miyyad veim lo nistera afillu leachar sheloshim yom

Horu kal haggeonim shezze sheamru chachamim shehu neeman im hichchishato ishto lehafsidah ikkar hakketubba aval hattosefet yesh lah ella im ken noda biraya berura shehayeta beula o shehodta lo shehi beula kodem shettitares vehitattu lefichach yesh lo lehashbiah binkitat chefetz kedin kal hannishbain venotlin veachar kach tigbe hattosefet veen lah lehashbio shello metzaah betula veachar kach tafsid ikkar ketubba shechazaka hi sheen adam toreach bisudda umafsidah veyesh lah lehacharim setam al mi shettaan aleha sheker
Hare sheratza lekayemah achar shehifsida ikkar hakketubba chozer vechotev lah mea lefi sheasur laadam lishhot im ishto shaa achat belo ketubba kemo shebbearnu
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 12: Keshennose adam ishsha ben betula ben beula ben gedola ben ketanna achat bat yisrael veachat haggiyyoret o hamshuchreret yitchayyev lah baasara devarim veyizke bearbaa devarim

Vehaasara shelosha mehen min hattora veellu hen sheerah kesutah veonatah sheerah ellu mezonoteha kesutah kemashmao onatah lavo aleha kederech kal haaretz vehashshiva middivre sofrim vechullan tenay bet din hem haechad mehem ikkar ketubba vehashshear hem hannikrain tenae ketubba veellu hen lerappotah im chalta velifdotah im nishbet lekavrah im meta velihot nizzonet min nechasav veoshevet beveto achar moto kal zeman almenutah velihot benoteha mimmennu nizzonot minnechasav achare moto ad shettitaresna velihot baneha hazzecharim mimmennu yorshin ketubbatah yoter al chelkam bayerushsha sheim achehem

Vehaarbaa shezzocha bahen kullam middivre sofrim veellu hen lihot maase yadeha shello velihot metziatah shello vesheyyihye ochel kal perot nechaseha bechayyeha veim meta bechayyav yirashenna vehu kodem lechal adam bayerushsha

Veod tikkenu chachamim sheyyihu maase yede haishsha keneged mezonoteha ufidonah keneged achilat perot nechaseha ukvuratah keneged yerushshato lichtubbatah lefichach im amra haishsha eni nizzonit veeni osa shomin lah veen kofin otah aval im amar habbaal eni zanech veeni notel kelum mimmaase yadayich en shomin lo shemma lo yesappeku lah maase yadeha bimzonoteha umippene takkana zo yechashvu hammezonot mittenae hakketubba

Kal haddevarim haellu af al pi shello nichtevu bishtar hakketubba vaafillu lo katvu ketubba ella nasa setam kevan shennesaah zacha bearbaa devarim shello vezachta haishsha baasara devarim shellah veenan tzerichin lefaresh

Hitna habbaal shello yitchayyev beechad min haddevarim shehu chayyav bahen o shehitnat haishsha shello yizke habbaal beechad min haddevarim shehu zoche bahem hattenay kayyam chutz mishshelosha devarim sheen hattenay moil bahen vechal hammatne alehen tenao batel veellu hen onatah veikkar ketubbatah virushshatah
Ketzad hitna im haishsha sheen lah alav ona tenao batel vechayyav beonatah shehare hitna al ma shekkatuv battora veeno tenay mamon

Hitna immah lifchot meikkar ketubba o shekkatav lah matayim o mea ikkar ketubba vechatva lo shennitkabbela mehen kach vechach vehi lo nitkabbela tenao batel shekkal happochet livtula mimmatayim ulalmana mimmea hare beilato beilat zenut

Hitna immah achar shennesaah shello yirashenna tenao batel veaf al pi sheyerushshat habbaal middivre sofrim asu chizzuk ledivrehem keshel tora vechal tenay shebbayerushsha batel veaf al pi shehu mamon shenneemar bah lechukkat mishpat uvishar haddevarim tenao kayyam kegon shehitna immah sheen lah sheer uchsut al menat shello yochal perot nechaseha vechal kayyotze baze tenao kayyam

Kamma mezonot poskin laishsha poskin lah lechem shette seuddot bechal yom seudda benonit shel kal adam beotah hair keadam sheeno lo chole velo gargeran umeoto maachal shel anshe otah hair im chittim chittim veim seorim seorim vechen orez vedochan o mishshear minin shennahagu bahen ufoskin lah parperet leechol bah et happat kegon kitnit o yerakot vechayyotze bahen veshemen laachila veshemen lehadlakat hanner uferot umat yayin lishtot im haya minhag hammakom sheyyishtu hannashim yayin ufoskin lah shalosh seuddot beshabbat uvasar o dagim keminhag hammakom venoten lah bechal shabbat veshabbat maa kesef litzracheha kegon peruta lechibbus o lemerchatz vechayyotze bahen

Bamme devarim amurim beani shebbeyisrael aval im haya ashir hakkol lefi ashro afillu haya mamono rauy laasot lah kamma tavshile basar bechal yom kofin oto ufoskin lah mezonot kefi mamono veim haya ani beoter veeno yachol litten lah afillu lechem shehi tzericha lo kofin oto lehotzi vetihye ketubbatah chov alav ad shettimtza yado veyitten
Baal sheratza litten leishto mezonoteha haruot lah vetihye ochelet veshota leatzmah vehu shote veochel leatzmo harshut beyado uvilvad sheyyochal immah millele shabbat lelele shabbat

Haishsha sheppasku lah mezonot vehotiru hammotar labbaal haya balah kohen eno noten lah kal mezonoteha teruma mippene shettorach gadol hu lah leshamran middevarim hamtammein ulachlan betahora ella noten lah mechetza chullin umechetza teruma

Keshem sheadam chayyav bimzonot ishto kach hu chayyav bimzonot banav uvnotav hakketannim ad sheyyihu bene shesh shanim mikkan veelach maachilan ad sheyyigdelu ketakkanat chachamim veim lo ratza goarin bo umachlimin oto ufotzrin bo veim lo ratza machrizin alav batztzibbur veomrim peloni achzari hu veeno rotze lazun banav vahare pachut hu meof tame shehu zan et efrochav veen kofin oto lezunam achar shesh

Bamme devarim amurim beish sheeno amud veen yadua im rauy litten tzedaka o eno rauy aval im haya amud sheyyesh lo mamon harauy litten mimmennu tzedaka hammaspeket lahen motziin mimmennu baal karcho mishshum tzedaka vezanin otan ad sheyyigdelu

Mi shehalach limdina acheret uvaa ishto levet din litboa mezonot shelosha chodashim harishonim miyyom halichato en poskin lah bahen mezonot shechazaka sheen adam manniach beto rekan mikkan veelach poskin lah mezonot veim hau lo nechasim bet din yordin linchasav umochrin limzonoteha veen mechashshevin immah al maase yadeha ad sheyyavo balah im matza sheasta hare ellu shello vechen im lo amda baddin ella machra leatzmah limzonot michrah kayyam veenah tzericha hachraza velo shevua ad sheyyavo balah veyiton o ad shettavo ligbot ketubbatah achar moto megalgelin aleha shello machra ella limzonot shehi tzericha lahen

Uchshem shebbet din mochrin limzon haishsha shehalach balah kach mochrin limzon banav uvnotav keshehen bene shesh shanim o pachot aval yeter al shesh enan zanin otan minnechasav shello befanav af al pi shehu amud vechen mi shennishtatta bet din yordin linchasav umochrim vezanin ishto uvanav uvnotav shehen bene shesh shanim o pachot umfarnesin otan

Yesh min haggeonim shehora sheen poskin mezonot leishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam o shemmet balah ad sheyehe shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadah veim lo totzi shetar ketubba en lah mezonot shemma natla ketubbatah mibbalah o machala lo ketubbatah sheen lah mezonot kemo sheyyitbaer veyesh mi shehora shepposkin lah mezonot bechezkat shello natla velo machala veen matzrichin otah lehavi ketubba vedati nota laze bemi shehalach balah hoil veyesh lah mezonot min hattora aval im met balah en lah mezonot ad shettavi ketubba mippene shehi ochelet betakkanat chachamim veod shennizzonet minnichse yorshim ulolam toanin leoresh

Halach balah velaveta veachla kesheyyavo chayyav leshallem amad echad middaat atzmo vezanah mishshello im yavo habbaal eno chayyav leshallem lo vahare ze ibbed et meotav mippene shello tzivahu lezunah vehi lo laveta mimmennu
Habbaal sheamar leishto beshaa shehalach teli maase yadayich bimzonotayich en lah mezonot sheillu lo ratzta bedavar ze velo samcha datah haya lah letavo o lomar lo en maase yaday maspikin li

Hare sheamda baddin ufasku lah mezonot umachru ben din venatnu lah o shemmachra hi leatzmah uva habbaal veamar hinnachti lah mezonot hare zo nishbaat binkitat chefetz shello hinniach lah lo tava velo machra ella shahata ad shebba hu omer hinnachti vehi omeret lo hinnachta ella laviti mizze venitparnasti nishba shevuat hesset shehinniach lah veniftar veyishshaer hachov aleha

Machra mittaltelin veamra limzonot macharti vehu toen veomer mezonotayich hinnachti nishbaat shevuat hesset shello hinniach hare shello tava velo laveta velo machra ella dachaka atzmah bayyom uvallayela veasta veachla en lah kelum

Hammaddir et ishto millehanot lo ben shepperesh ad zeman peloni ben shello peresh ella setam mamtinin lo sheloshim yom im tammu yeme nidro o shello tammu vehittir nidro hare ze mutav veim lav yotzi veyitten ketubba uvotan hashsheloshim yom tihye hi osa veochelet veyihye echad mechaverav mefarnes otah devarim shehi tzericha lahen yeter al maase yadeha im en maase yadeha maspikin lakkol

Hammaddir et ishto shello titom echad mikkal happerot mamtinin lo ad sheloshim yom yeter al ken yotzi veyitten ketubba afillu hiddirah shello tochal maachal ra afillu hiddirah mimmin shello achla oto miyyameha yotzi achar sheloshim yom veyitten ketubba nadra hi shello tochal echad mikkal happerot vekiyyem lah hu et nidrah o nadra benazir velo hefer lah im ratza shetteshev tachtav velo tochal perot o tihye nezira teshev veim amar eni rotze beishsha nadranit yotzi veyitten ketubba shehare haya beyado lehafer vehu kiyyem lah birtzono
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 13: Kamma hakkesut shehu chayyav litten lah begadom shel chamishshim zuz mishshana leshana mimmatbea otan hayyamim shennimtzeu hachamishshim shishsha dinarin urvia dinar kesef notnin lah chadashim bimot haggeshamim veloveshet belaotehen bimot hachamma vehashshechakim vehem motar hakkesut hare hen shellah kede shettitkasse bahem bime niddatah venotnin lah chagora lematneha vechippa leroshah uminal mimmoed lemoed

Bamme devarim amurim beotan hayyamim uveretz yisrael aval bishar zemannim ushar hammekomot en haddamim ikkar yesh mekomot sheyyihu sham habbegadim beyoker harbe o bezol harbe ella haikkar shessomchin alav shemmechayevin oto litten lah begadim haruyim bimot haggeshamim uvimot hachamma befachot shelloveshet kal ishsha baalat bayit shebbeotah hammedina

Uvichlal hakkesut shehu chayyav litten lah kele bayit umador sheyyoshevet bo uma hen kele bayit mitta mutztzaat umappatz o machtzelet leshev aleha uchle achila ushtiyya kegon kedera ukara vechos uvakbuk vechayyotze bahen vehammador shessocher lah bayit shel arba ammot al arba ammot vetihye rechava chutza lo kede lehishtammesh bah veyihye lo bet hakkisse chutz mimmennu
Vechen mechayevin oto litten lah tachshitim kegon bigde tzivonin lehakkif al roshah ufaddachtah ufuch vesarak vechayyotze bah kede shello titganne alav

Bamme devarim amurim beani shebbeyisrael aval beashir hakkol lefi ashro vaafillu haya rauy liknot lah kele meshi verikma uchle zahav kofin oto venoten vechen hammador lefi ashro vehattachshit uchle habbayit hakkol lefi ashro veim katzra yado litten lah afillu keani shebbeyisrael kofin oto lehotzi vetihye hakketubba alav chov ad sheyyaashir

Velo haishsha bilvad ella banav uvnotav hakketannim bene shesh o pachot chayyav litten lahem kesut hammaspeket lahem uchle tashmish umador lishkon bo veeno noten lahem lefi ashro ella kefi tzarkan bilvad ze hakkelal kal mi sheyyesh lo alav mezonot ben bechayyav ben achar moto yesh lo kesut uchle bet umador vechal shebbet din mochrin limzonotav kach mochrin lichsuto uchle beto umdoro

Haishsha shehalach balah ufasku lah bet din mezonot uchsut uchle bayit uschar mador en poskin lah tachshit shehare en lah baal shettitkashshet lo aval mi shennishtatta balah o shennitcharesh poskin lah tachshit vedin habbaal im ishto betaanat hakkesut vehakkelim uschar hammador kedinam betaanat hammezonot im amar hu natatti vehi omeret lo natatta din echad lakkol

Hammaddir et ishto shello titkashshet beechad mikkal hamminin baaniyyot shana achat yekayyem yeter al ken o yattir et nidro o yotzi veyitten ketubba uvaashirot sheloshim yom yekayyem yeter al ken yattir et nidro o yotzi veyitten chetuva

Hiddirah shello telech lemerchatz bichrakkim shabbat achat bichfarim shette shabbatot shello tinol minal bichfarim shelosha yamim uvichrakkim meet leet yeter al ze yattir et nidro o yotzi veyitten ketubba

Hiddirah shello tishal velo tashil mikkele habbayit shedderech kal hashshechenot lishl otan ulhashilan kegon nafa uchvara rechayim vetannur vechayyotze bahem yattir et nidro o yotzi veyitten ketubba mippene shemmashshiah shem ra bishchenoteha vechen hi shennadra shello tishal velo tashil nafa uchvara verechayim vetannur vechayyotze bahem veshello teerog begadim naim levanim bemakom sheddarkan leerog otam levanim tetze belo ketubba mippene shemmashshiato shem ra bishchunato shehu kilay

Makom sheddarkan shello tetze ishsha lashshuk bechippa sheal roshah bilvad ad sheyyihye aleha redid hachofe et kal gufah kemo tallit noten lah bichlal hakkesut redid happachut mikkal hardidin veim haya ashir noten lah lefi ashro kede shettetze bo levet aviha o levayit haavel o levet hammishte lefi shekkal ishsha yesh lah latzet velelech levet aviha levakkero ulvet haavel ulvet hammishte ligmol chesed lereoteha o likrovoteha kede sheyyavou hem lah sheenah bevet hassohar ad shello tetze velo tavo aval genay hu leishsha shettihye yotza tamid paam bachutz paam barchovot veyesh labbaal limnoa ishto mizze velo yenichennah latzet ella kemo paam achat bechodesh o kemo paamayim bechodesh lefi hatztzorech sheen yofi laishsha ella leshev bezavit betah shekkach katuv kal kevudda vat melech penima

Hammaddir et ishto shello telech levet aviha bizman shehu immah bair chodesh echad mamtinin lo shenayim yotzi veyitten ketubba uvizman shehu beir acheret regel echad mamtinin lo shenayim yotzi veyitten ketubba

Hammaddir et ishto shello telech levayit haavel o levet hammishte o yattir et nidro o yotzi veyitten ketubba shezze kemi sheasarah bevet hassohar venaal befaneha veim haya toen mippene bene adam perutzim sheyyesh beoto bet haavel o bevet hammishte vehuchzeku sham perutzim shomin lo

Haomer leishto en retzoni sheyyavou leveti avich veimmech achayich veachotayich shomin lo vetihye hi holechet lahem kesheyyeera lahem davar vetelech levet aviha paam bechodesh uvchal regel veregel velo yikkansu hem lah ella im era lah davar kegon choli o leda sheen kofin et haadam sheyyikkansu acherim birshuto vechen hi sheamra en retzoni sheyyikkansu etzli immecha veachotecha veeni shochenet immahem bechatzer achat mippene shemmerein li umtzerin li shomin lah sheen kofin et haadam sheyyeshvu acherim immo birshuto

Haish sheamar eni dar bemador ze mippene shebbene adam raim o perutzim o akkum bishchunati vaani mityare mehem shomim lo veaf al pi shello huchzeku bifritzut shekkach tziuu chachamim harchek mishshachen ra vaafillu haya hammador shellah motziin otah mimmennu veshochen ben bene adam kesherim vechach hi sheamra ken af al pi shehu omer ani eni makpid alehem shomin lah mippene shehi omeret en retzoni sheyyetze alay shum ra bishchenut ellu

Kal hayyishshuv aratzot aratzot hu kegon eretz kenaan veeretz mitzrayim veeretz teman veeretz kush veeretz shinar vechayyotze bahen vechal eretz veeretz mimmedinot uchfarim veare yisrael leinyan nissuin shalosh aratzot hau yehuda veever hayyarden vehaggalil

Ish shehaya meeretz min haaratzot venasa ishsha beeretz acheret kofin otah veotza immo leartzo o tetze belo ketubba sheal menat ken nissea af al pi shello peresh aval hannose ishsha beachat min haaratzot vehi meanshe otah haaretz eno yachol lehotziah leeretz acheret aval motziah mimmedina limdina umikkefar lichfar beotah haaretz veeno yachol lehotziah mimmedina lichfar velo mikkefar limdina sheyyesh devarim sheyeshivat hammedina tova lahem veyesh devarim sheyeshivat hakkefarim tova lahem

Uchshemmotziah mimmedina limdina umikkefar lichfar beotah haaretz eno yachol lehotziah minnave hayyafe lannave hara velo mera leyafe mippene shehi tzericha lehittafel velivdok atzmah bannave hayyafe kede shello tihye bo kalla uchura vechen lo yotziah mimmakom sherubbo yisrael lemakom sherubbo akkum uvchal makom motziin mimmakom sherubbo akkum lemakom sherubbo yisrael

Bamme devarim amurim michutza laaretz lechutza laaretz o meeretz yisrael leeretz yisrael aval michutza laaretz leeretz yisrael kofin otah laalot afillu minnave hayyafe lannave hara vaafillu mimmakom sherubbo yisrael lemakom sherubbo akkum maalin veen motziin meeretz yisrael lechutza laaretz vaafillu minnave hara lannave hayyafe vaafillu mimmakom sherubbo akkum lemakom sherubbo yisrael

Amar haish laalot leeretz yisrael vehi enah rotza tetze belo ketubba amra hi laalot vehu eno rotze yotzi veyitten ketubba vehu haddin lechal makom meeretz yisrael im yerushalayim shehakkol maalin leeretz yisrael veen hakkol motziin mishsham hakkol maalin lirushalayim veen hakkol motziin mishsham
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 14: Onna haamura battora lechal ish veish kefi kocho uchfi melachto ketzad bene adam habberiim veharakkim vehaanuggim sheen lahem melacha shemmachshelet kochan ella ochlin veshotin veoshvin bevattehen onatan bechal layela happoalin kegon hachayyatin vehaorgin vehabbonim vechayyotze bahen im hayeta melachtan bair onatan paamayim beshabbat veim hayeta melachtan beir acheret onatan paam achat beshabbat hachammarim paam achat beshabbat vehaggammalim achat lishloshim yom vehammallachin achat leshishsha chodashim talmide chachamim onatan paam achat beshabbat mippene shettalmud tora mattish kochan vederech talmide chachamim leshammesh mittatan millele shabbat lelele shabbat

Yesh leishsha leakkev al balah shello yetze lischora ella lemakom karov shello yimmana meonatah velo yetze ella birshutah vechen yesh lah lemano latzet mimmelacha sheonatah kerova limlacha sheonatah rechoka kegon chammar shebbikkesh leheasot gammal o gammal leheasot mallach vetalmide chachamim yotzin letalmud tora shello birshut neshotehen shettayim veshalosh shanim vechen rach veanog shennaasa talmid chacham en ishto yechola leakkev

Nose adam kamma nashim afillu mea ben bevat achat ben bazo achar zo veen ishto yechola leakkev vehu sheyyihye yachol litten sheer kesut veona karauy lechal achat veachat veeno yachol lachof otan lishkon bechatzer achat ella kal achat veachat leatzmah

Vechamma hi onatan lefi minyan ketzad poel shehau lo shette nashim yesh lazo ona achat beshabbat veyesh lazo ona achat beshabbat hau lo arba nashim nimtza onat kal achat mehen paam achat bishte shabbatot vechen im haya mallach veyesh lo arba nashim tihye onat kal achat mehen paam achat bishte shanim lefichach tziuu chachamim shello yissa adam yoter al arba nashim af al pi sheyyesh lo mamon harbe kede shettaggia lahen ona paam achat bechodesh

Hammaddir et ishto shettomar laacherim ma sheamar lah o ma sheamra lo middivre sechok vekallut rosh shemmedabber adam im ishto al iske tashmish hare ze yotzi veyitten ketubba sheen zo yechola lehaez paneha velomar laacherim divre kalon vechen im hiddirah shettihye poelet beet tashmish shello titabber o shehiddirah shettaase maase shotim udvarim sheen bahen mammash ella kishtut hare ze yotzi veyitten ketubba

Hammaddir et ishto mittashmish hammitta shabbat achat mamtinin lo yeter al ken yotzi veyitten ketubba o yafer nidro afillu haya mallach sheonato leshishsha chodashim shekkevan shennadar hare tziarah venityaasha vechetzad maddirah im amar lah tashmishi asur alayich o shennishba shello yeshammesh mittato lo nadar kelum veim nishba nishba lashshave mippene shehu meshubad lah amar lah hanaat tashmishech asura alay hare ze neder veasur leshammesh sheen maachilin laadam davar haasur lo

Asur laadam limnoa ishto meonatah veim avar umana kede letzaarah avar belo taase shebbattora shenneemar sheerah kesutah veonatah lo yigra veim chala o tashash kocho veeno yachol livol yamtin shishsha chodashim shemma yavri sheen lecha ona gedola mizzo veachar kach o yittol mimmenna reshut o yotzi veyitten ketubba

Haishsha shemmana balah mittashmish hammitta hi hannikret moredet veshoalin otah mippene ma marda im amra meastihu veeni yechola lehibbael lo middati kofin oto lishato legarshah lefi sheenah kishvuya shettibbael lesanu lah vetetze belo ketubba kelal vetittol belaoteha hakkayyamin ben minnechasim shehichnisa levalah venitchayyev beachrautan ben minnichse melog shello nitchayyev beachrautan veenah notelet beshel baal kelum vaafillu minal shebberagleha umitpachat shebberoshah shellekachan lah poshetet venotenet lo vechal ma shennatan lah mattana mechazzeret oto shello natan lah al menat shettittol vetetze

Veim marda mittachat balah kede letzaaro veamra hareni metzaeret oto bechach mippene sheasa li kach vechach o mippene shekkillelani o mippene sheasa immi meriva vechayyotze bidvarim ellu sholchim lah mibbet din veomrin lah heve yodaat sheim atte omedet bemirdech afillu ketubbatech mea mane hifsadte otah veachar kach machrizin aleha bevatte kenesiyyot uvvatte midrashot bechal yom arba shabbatot zo achar zo veomrim pelonit marda al balah

Veachar hahachraza sholchin lah bet din paam sheniyya veomrim lah im atte omedet bemirdech hifsadte ketubbatech im amda bemirdah velo chazra nimlachin bah utabbed ketubbatah velo yihye lah ketubba kelal veen notnin lah get ad chodesh veen lah mezonot kal chodesh veim meta kodem hagget balah yorshah
Kasseder hazze osin lah im marda kede letzaaro vaafillu hayeta nidda o chola sheenah reuya letashmish vaafillu haya balah mallach sheonato leshishsha chodashim vaafillu yesh lo ishsha acheret
Vechen arusa shehiggia zemanna lehinnase umarda kede letzaaro velo nisset hare zo moredet mittashmish vechen yevama shello ratzta lehityabbem kede letzaaro kasseder hazze osin lah

Hammoredet hazzot keshehi yotzet achar chodesh belo ketubba tachazir kal davar shehu shel baal aval nechasim shehichnisa lo uvlaotehen kayyamim im tafsa en motziim miyyadah veim tefasan habbaal en motziin miyyado vechen kal ma sheavad minnechaseha shekkibbel habbaal acharautan alav eno meshallem lah kelum ze hu din haggemara bemoredet
Veamru haggeonim sheyyesh lahem bevavel minhagot acherot bemoredet velo pashtu otan hamminhagot berov yisrael verabbim ugdolim cholkin alehem berov hammekomot uchdin haggemara rauy litpos veladun

Hammored al ishto veamar hareni zan umfarnes otah aval eni ba aleha mippene shessenetiha mosifin lah al ketubbatah mishkal shesh ushloshim seorot shel kesef bechal shabbat veshabbat veyeshev velo yeshammesh kal zeman shettirtze hi leshev veaf al pi shekketubbatah holechet venosefet hare hu over belo taase shenneemar lo yigra sheim seneah yeshallechah aval leannot asur velamma lo yilke al lav ze mippene sheen bo maase

Ish veishto shebbau levet din hu omer zo moredet mittashmish vehi omeret lo ki ella kederech kal haaretz ani immo vechen im taana hi veamra shehu mored mittashmish vehu omer lo ki ella kederech kal haaretz ani immah machrimin battechilla al mi shehu mored velo yode bevet din veachar kach im lo hodu omrin lahem hityachadu bifne edim nityachadu vaadayin hem toanin mevakkeshin min hannitan veosin peshara kefi koach haddayyan aval livol bifne bene adam i efshar lefi sheasur livol bifne kal beriyya

Haishsha shechalta chayyav lerappeot otah ad shettavri raa shehacholi aroch veyafsid mamon harbe lirfua veamar lah hare ketubbatech munnachat o rappei atzmech mikketubbatech o hareni megarshech venoten ketubba veholech shomin lo veen rauy laasot ken mippene derech eretz

Nishbet chayyav lifdotah veim haya kohen shekkevar neesra alav pode otah umachazirah levet aviha afillu haya beir acheret metappel lah ad shemmachazirah limdinatah umgarshah venoten lah kal ketubbatah haya balah yisrael shehashshevuya mutteret lo machazirah lo leishsha kemo shehayeta veim ratza achar kach megarshah venoten lah ketubbatah
