En mechayevin et habbaal lifdot et ishto yoter al dameha ella kamma shehi shava kishar hashshevuot hau dameha yoter al kede ketubbatah veamar hareni megarshah vezo ketubbatah vetelech vetifde et atzmah en shomin lo ella kofin oto ufode otah afillu hau dameha ad asara bichtubbatah vaafillu en lo ella kede pidonah bamme devarim amurim befaam rishona aval im pedaah venishbet paam sheniyya veratza legarshah hare ze megarshah venoten ketubba vehi tifde et atzmah
Mi shennishbet ishto vehu bimdinat hayyam bet din yordin linchasav umochrin behachraza ufodin otah kederech shehabbaal pode
Hammaddir et ishto neder shehu chayyav biglalo legarshah velitten ketubba venishbet achar shehiddirah eno chayyav lifdotah shemmishshaa shehiddirah nitchayyev legarshah velitten lah ketubba

Haishsha shehayeta asura al balah meissure lavin venishbet eno chayyav lifdotah ella noten lah ketubbatah vehi tifde et atzmah vahalo hashshevuya asura lechohen vahare hu pode otah mippene shello hayeta asura mikkodem veissur hashsheviyya hu sheggaram lah

Meta ishto chayyav bikvuratah velaasot lah misped vekinim kederech kal hammedina vaafillu ani shebbeyisrael lo yifchatu lo mishshene chalilin umkonenet im haya ashir hakkol lefi kevodo veim haya kevodah yoter mikkevodo kovrin otah lefi kevodah shehaishsha ola im balah veenah yoredet afillu leachar mita

Lo ratza likbor et ishto veamad echad middaat atzmo ukvarah motziin mibbalah al karcho venotnin laze kede shello tihye zo mushlechet lakkelavim haya bimdina acheret keshemmeta ishto bet din yordin linchasav umochrin belo hachraza vekovrin otah lefi mamon habbaal ulfi kevodo o lefi kevodah
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 15: Haisha shehirshat et bailah achar hannissuin sheyyimna onatah hare ze muttar bamme devarim amurim beshehau lo banim shekkevar kiyyem mitzvat periyya urviyya aval lo kiyyem chayyav livol bechal ona ad sheyyihu lo banim mippene shehi mitzvat ase shel tora shenneemar peru urvu

Haish metzuve al periyya urviyya aval lo haishsha veematay haish nitchayyev bemitzva zo mibben sheva esre vechevan sheavru esrim shana velo nasa ishsha hare ze over umvattel mitzvat ase veim haya osek battora vetarud bah vehaya mityare millissa ishsha kede shello yitrach bimzonot baavur ishto veyibbatel min hattora hare ze muttar lehitacher shehaosek bemitzva patur min hammitzva vechal shekken betalmud tora

Mi shechashka nafsho battora tamid veshoge bah keven azay vedavek bah kal yamav velo nasa ishsha en beyado aon vehu shello yihye yitzro mitgabber alav aval im haya yitzro mitgabber alav chayyav lissa ishsha vaafillu hau lo banim shemma yavo lide hirhur
Kamma banim yihu leish vetitkayyem mitzva zo beyado zachar unkeva shenneemar zachar unkeva beraam haya habben saris o shehayeta habbat ayelonit lo kiyyem mitzva zo

Noldu lo umetu vehinnichu banim hare ze kiyyem mitzvat periyya urviyya bene banim hare hem kevanim bamme devarim amurim beshehau bene habbanim zachar unkeva vehau baim mizzachar unkeva af al pi shehazzachar ben bitto vehannekeva bat beno hoil vehem mishshene banav hen baim hare kiyyem mitzvat periyya urviyya aval im hau lo ben uvat umetu vehinniach echad mehen zachar unkeva adayin lo kiyyem hammitzva

Hau lo banim begeuto venitgayyer hu vehem hare ze kiyyem mitzva zo hau lo banim vehu eved venishtachrer hu vehem lo kiyyem mitzvat periyya urviyya ad sheyyivaled achar shennishtachrer shehaeved en lo yichus

Lo yissa adam akara uzkena veayelonit uktanna sheenah reuya leled ella im ken kiyyem mitzvat periyya urviyya o shehayeta lo ishsha acheret lifrot velirbot mimmenna nasa ishsha veshahata immo eser shanim velo yalda hare ze yotzi veyitten ketubba o yissa ishsha haruya leled veim lo ratza lehotzi kofin oto umakkin oto beshot ad sheyyotzi veim amar eni boalah vahareni shochen immah bifne edim kede shello etyached immah ben sheamra hi ben sheamar hu en shomin ella yotzi o yissa ishsha haruya leled

Shahata eser shanim velo yalda vahare hu yore kechetz shichvat zera chezkat hacholi mimmenna vetetze shello bichtubba veyesh lah tosefet lo tihye zo pechuta meayelonit shello hikkir bah sheyyesh lah tosefet kemo sheyyitbaer veim eno yore kechetz chezkat hacholi mimmennu bilvad veotzi veyitten hakketubba kullah ikkar vetosefet

Hu omer mimmenna nimna holada vehi omeret mimmennu nimna mippene sheeno yore kechetz neemenet veyesh lo lehacharim setam al mi shettoenet davar sheenah yodaat bo bevadday veachar kach yitten ketubba veim amra eni yodaat im mimmenni im mimmennu en lah ikkar ketubba kemo sheamarnu haamed mamon bechezkat bealav ad shettiton bevadday sheeno yore kechetz velamma neemenet hi betaana zo mippene shehi margeshet im yore kechetz im lo yore kechetz vehu eno margish

Haishsha shebbaa litboa mibbalah legarshah achar eser shanim mippene shello yalda vehi omeret sheeno yore kechetz shomin lah af al pi sheenah metzuva al periyya urviyya tzericha hi levanim leziknutah vechofin oto lehotzi veyitten ikkar ketubba bilvad shello katav lah hattosefet al menat shettetze lirtzonah vetittol
Halach bischora betoch eser shanim o shehaya habbaal chole o shehayeta hi chola o shehau chavushin bevet haasurin en ole lahen oto zeman min hamminyan
Hippila mona miyyom shehippila im hippila vechazra vehippila shalosh peamim huchzeka linfalim veshemma lo zacha lehibbanot mimmenna veotzi veyitten ketubba

Hu omer hippila betoch eser kede sheyyishhe immah vehi omeret lo hippalti neemenet sheenah machzeket atzmah baakarut hu omer hippila shenayim vehi omeret hippalti shelosha neemenet sheenah machzeket atzmah bemappelet veotzi veyitten ketubba uvchal ze mashbiah shevuat hesset shello hippila o shehippila shelosha shebbetaana zo yitchayyev litten ketubba

Nisset larishon veshahata immo eser shanim velo yalda vehotziah mutteret lehinnase lesheni shahata im hashsheni eser shanim velo yalda lo tinnase lishlishi veim nisset lishlishi tetze shello bichtubba ella im ken yesh lo ishsha acheret o shekkiyyem mitzvat periyya urviyya

Haishsha shebbaa levet din veamra bali eno yachol leshammesh kederech kal haaretz shimmush shemmolid o sheeno yore kechetz yaasu haddayyanin peshara veomrim lah rauy lich shettinhagi im balech ad shettishhi eser shanim velo tolidi veachar kach titbei umgalgelin immah bedavar ze veen kofin otah leshev velo danin otah kedin hammoredet ella maarichin bedavar ze ad sheyyaasu peshara

Af al pi shekkiyyem adam mitzvat periyya urviyya hare hu metzuve middivre sofrim shello yibbatel millifrot velirbot kal zeman sheyyesh bo koach shekkal hammosif nefesh achat beyisrael keillu bana olam vechen mitzvat chachamim hi shello yeshev adam belo ishsha shello yavo lide hirhur velo teshev ishsha belo ish shello techashed

Vechova al kal ish lekanneot leishto amru chachamim en adam mekanne leishto ella im ken nichnesa bo ruach tahora velo yekanne lah beoter midday velo yeenos otah veyivol beal karchah ella bedatah umittoch sicha vesimcha

Vechen tziuu chachamim al haishsha shettihye tzenua betoch betah velo tarbe sechok vekallut rosh bifne balah velo titba tashmish hammitta befiha velo tihye medabberet beesek ze velo timna mibbalah kede letzaaro ad sheyyosif beahavatah ella nishmaat lo bechal et sheyyirtze vetizzaher mikkerovav uvne beto kede shello yaavor alav ruach kina vetitrachek min hakkiur umin haddome lechiur

Vechen tziuu chachamim sheyyihye adam mechabbed et ishto yoter miggufo veohavah kegufo veim yesh lo mamon marbe betovatah kefi mamono velo yattil aleha ema yetera veyihye dibburo immah benachat velo yihye atzev velo ragzan

Vechen tziuu al haishsha shettihye mechabbedet et balah beoter midday veyihye aleha mora mimmennu vetaase kal maaseha al piv veyihye beeneha kemo sar o melech mehallechet betaavat libbo umarcheket kal ma sheyyisna veze derech benot yisrael uvne yisrael hakkedoshim vehattehorim beziuugan uvidrachim ellu yihye yishshuvan nae umshubbach
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 16: Hannechasim shemmachneset haishsha levalah ben korka ben mittaltelin ben avadim af al pi shehen nichtavin bishtar hakketubba enan nikrain ketubba ella nedunya shemam veim kibbel habbaal acharaut hannedunya alav venaaset birshuto im pachata pachata lo veim hotira hotira lo hare zo nikret nichse tzon barzel veim lo kibbel acharaut hannedunya alav ella hare hi birshut haishsha im pachata pachata lah veim hotira hotira lah hare zo nikret nichse melog

Vechen kal nechasim sheyyesh laishsha shello hichnisa otan levalah velo katvu otan bakketubba ella nisharu leatzmah o naflu lah bayerushsha achar shennitarsa o nittenu lah bemattana hakkol nikrain nichse melog shekkullan birshutah hen veen nikrain ketubba ella ikkar ketubba shehu mea o matayim im hattosefet bilvad

Kevar hodanu shechachamim tikkenu ketubba laishsha vedin hattosefet kedin haikkar velo tikkenu ligbotah kal zeman shettirtze ella hare hi kechov sheyyesh lo zeman veen hakketubba nigbet ella leachar mitat habbaal o im gershah vechen hitkinu sheim hau labbaal sadot tovot veraot uvenoniyyot uvaa haishsha ligbot ketubbatah mimmennu shello tigbe ella min haraa shebbinchasav vehi hannikret zibburit

Vechen hitkinu shekkeshettavo ligbot ketubbatah achar moto lo tigbe ad shettishshava binkitat chefetz shello hinniach etzlah kelum velo machra lo ketubbatah velo machala otah veshamin lah kal ma shealeha ufochatin oto mikketubbatah aval im gershah lirtzono gova belo shevua veen shamin kesut shealeha shehare lekachan lah vezachta bahen vehu rotze lehotziah lo hi

Vechen hitkinu shello tigbe haalmana ketubbatah ella min hakkarka veenah gova mishshevach sheshshavchu nechasim leachar mitat habbaal veen habbanot nizzonot leachar mitat avihen mishshevach sheshshavchu nechasim leachar mitato veenah torefet bichtubbatah beshevach shehishbiach hallokeach af al pi shebbaal chov gove et hashshevach udvarim ellu mikkulle ketubba hem

Vechen mikkulle ketubba shettittol haishsha bichtubbatah min happachut shebbammatbeot ketzad nasa ishsha bemakom echad vegershah bemakom acher im hau meot mekom hannissuin tovim mimmeot mekom haggerushin noten lah mimmeot mekom haggerushin veim hau meot mekom haggerushin tovim mimmeot mekom hannissuin noten lah mimmeot mekom hannissuin bamme devarim amurim beshehaya bichtubbatah maot setam aval im peresh bah matbea yadua ben baikkar ben battosefet hare hi kedin hammalve et chavero matbea yadua shennoten lo kamma shehillevahu kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot halvaa

Tikkenu haggeonim bechal hayeshivot shettihye haishsha gova ketubbatah achare mot balah af min hammittaltelin kederech shehitkinu levaal chov ligbot min hammittaltelin ufashta takkana zo berov yisrael vechen shear tenae ketubba kullan kichtubba hen veyeshnan bemittaltelin kevakkarka chutz mikketubbat benin dichrin shello matzanu minhag yerushshatan pashut bechal hayeshivot lefichach ani omer maamidin otah al din haggemara sheen yorshin ketubbat imman ella min hakkarka

Kevar nahagu bechal hammekomot sheyyadanu vesheshshamanu shiman sheyyichtevu bakketubba ben mimmekarkee ben mimmittaltele vedavar ze tikkun gadol hu vaanashim gedolim unvonim hinhigu davar ze shehare ze tenay shebbemamon venimtza haalmana gova min hammittaltelin bitnay ze lo betakkanat acharonim

Hare shello katav kach bishtar hakketubba ella nasa setam im haya yodea betakkana zo shel geonim gova veim lav o shennistappek lanu haddavar mityashshevin baddavar harbe sheen koach betakkanat haggeonim ladun bah af al pi shello nitparsha kedin tenae ketubba shehem takkanat hassanhedrin haggedola ad shennotzi bah mamon min hayyorshim

Veod tikkenu chachamim sheyyihu kal nichse habbaal achrain vearvain lichtubba afillu ketubbatah mane veyesh lo karka bealpayim zehuvim hakkol tachat shibud hakketubba vechal sheyyimkor achar hannissuin minnechasav af al pi shemmimkaro kayyam veyesh lo limkor kal nechasav im yirtze yesh lah litrof otan bichtubbatah kesheyegarshenna o kesheyyamut im lo timtza nechasim bene chorin uchshettitrof lo titrof ella bishvua binkitat chefetz kedin kal baale chovot vetakkana zo kede shello tihye ketubba kalla beenav

Keshemmashbiin bet din o hayyorshin et haalmana keshettavo ligbot ketubbatah en mashbiin otah ella chutz levet din mippene shebbatte dinin hau nimnain millehashbiah shechoshshin lah shemma lo tedakdek al atzmah bishvua veim ratzu hayetomim lehaddirah noderet lahen kal ma sheyyirtzu umaddirin otah bevet din veachar kach notelet ketubbatah

Meta haalmana kodem shettishshava en yorsheha yorshin mikketubbatah kelum sheen lah ketubba ad shettishshava veim nisset kodem shettishshava hare zo nishbaat achar hannissuin venotelet kal zeman shettirtze aval enah noderet venotelet shemma yafer lah habbaal

Yiched lah karka bichtubbatah ben sheyyiched bearbaat hammetzarim ben bemetzar echad gova et ketubbatah mimmenna belo shevua vechen im katav lah mittaltelin vehen atzman kayyamin notelet otan belo shevua vechen im nimkeru venilkach bahen mittaltelin acherim venoda sheellu hashsheniyyim middeme hammittaltelin harishonim notaltan belo shevua

Happogemet ketubbatah lo tippara ella bishvua ketzad hotzia shetar ketubba sheyyesh bo elef zuz habbaal omer nitkabbalte hakkol vehi omeret lo nitkabbalti ella kach vechach vaafillu yesh aleha edim bammiktzat shennatla vaafillu dikdeka atzmah becheshbon ma shennatla bachatzi peruta lo tittol hashshear ella bishvua
Amar habbaal nitkabbalte hakkol vehi omeret lo nitkabbalti kelum vead echad meid aleha shennitkabbela hakkol o miktzat lo tippara kal hakketubba ella bishvua

Hannifraat shello befanav lo tippara ella bishvua ketzad hare sheggeresh et ishto vehalach lo bet din yordin linchasav achar shettishshava umagbin otah ketubbatah vehu sheyyihye bemakom rachok sheyyesh lahen torach lehodio aval im haya bemakom karov lehodio sholchin lo umodiin oto veim lo yavo tishshava vetittol

Happochetet ketubbatah nifraat shello bishvua ketzad hotzia shetar ketubba beelef zuz hu omer nitkabbalte hakkol vehi omeret lo nitkabbalti kelum veen li ella chamesh meot zuz veze shekkatav li elef amana hayeta beni leveno hare zo nifraat shello bishvua aval im amra en bishtar ketubbati ella chamesh meot enah nifraat bishtar ze sheyyesh bo elef zuz kelum shehare bittela oto uchillu hodet shehu sheker lefichach nishba shevuat hesset veniftar

Kal makom sheamarnu lo tippara ella bishvua omrim lah bet din hishshavi utli umakom sheamarnu tippara shello bishvua omrim labbaal amod veten lah veen atta neeman betaana zo ad shettavi reaya lidvarecha

Amar habbaal meatzmo tishshava li al taanati omrin lah hishshavi utli vetishshava binkitat chefetz hitnet immo shettigbe ketubbatah shello bishvua o shettehe neemenet bechal ma shettiton gova mimmennu belo shevua kelal aval im baa ligbot miyyorshav tishshava veachar kach tittol

Hitnet immo shettigbe ketubbatah miyyorshav belo shevua o shettihye neemenet bechal ma shettiton al yorshav hare zo notelet mehen belo shevua aval im baa litrof minnechasim meshubadim lo titrof ella bishvua veaf al pi sheheeminah habbaal sheen tenay habbaal moil ella alav veal yorshav aval lehafsid mamon acherim eno moil

Almana shehaya shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadah nishbaat vegova ketubbatah leolam afillu achar mea shana ben shehayeta bevet balah ben shehayeta bevet aviha veim en shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadah en lah kelum vaafillu ikkar ketubba vaafillu tava beom mitat balah vechen haggerusha afillu ikkar ketubba en lah ad shettotzi shetar ketubba

Bamme devarim amurim bemakom sheddarkan lichtov ketubba aval bemakom sheen darkan lichtov ketubba ella somchin al tenay bet din hare zo gova ikkar ketubba af al pi sheen beyadah shetar ketubba ben nitgarsha ben nitalmena ben shehayeta bevet balah ben shehayeta bevet aviha aval tosefet en lah bechal makom ella biraya berura

Vead kamma tigbe haalmana haikkar bemakom sheen kotvin ketubba im hayeta bevet balah gova leolam veim hayeta bevet aviha ad esrim vechamesh shana veim baa litboa achar esrim vechamesh shana en lah kelum sheillu lo machala lo shatka kal zeman ze vahare enah im hayyorshim kede shettomar nichlamti milletavan vehen immi babbayit
Lefichach im haya hayyoresh atzmo molich mezonoteha levet aviha umtappel bah yesh lah litboa ketubbatah vaafillu achar shana mippene shezzo sheshshatka velo tava mippene shehi bosha min hayyoresh

Hi omeret betula nisseti veikkar ketubbati matayim vehabbaal o yorshav omrim beula nisset veen lah ella mea im yesh edim sherau sheasu lah hamminhagot shennahagu anshe otah hair laasotan livtula kegon mine simcha o ketarim o malbush yadua o shear devarim sheen osin kach ella livtula hare zo notelet matayim veim en lah edim baze hare zo notelet mane veim haya habbaal kayyam yesh lah lehashbio shevuat hattora shehare hoda bemiktzat hattaana veneeman hakkatan lehaid begadlo velomar zachur ani keshehayiti katan shennaasa liflonit minhag habbetulot vechal haddevarim haellu bemakom sheen kotvin ketubba kemo sheamarnu

Haishsha sheamra levalah gerashtani neemenet sheenah meizza paneha bifne balah lefichach haishsha shehotzia shetar ketubba veen immah get veamra levalah gerashtani veavad gitti ten li ketubbati vehu omer lo gerashtich chayyav litten lah ikkar ketubba aval eno noten lah hattosefet ad shettavi reaya sheggershah o sheyyatza get im hakketubba mittachat yadah

Amar lah habbaal kach haya gerashti venatatti lah kal hakketubba ikkar vetosefet vechatva li shover veavad shovri mittoch sheyyachol lomar lo gerashti velo yitchayyev betosefet neeman umashbiah binkitat chefetz venoten lah et haikkar venishba hu shevuat hesset al hattosefet

Hotzia get veen beyadah shetar ketubba im derech oto makom shello yichtevu ketubba gova ikkar ketubbatah bagget shebbeyadah veim darkan lichtov ketubba afillu ikkar en lah ad shettotzi shetar ketubba kemo shebbearnu venishba habbaal shevuat hesset al taanatah veniftar

Hotzia shette gittin ushte ketubbot gova shette ketubbot hotzia shette ketubbot veget echad enah gova ella ketubba achat vee zo mehen gova im shettehen shaot bittela haacharona et harishona veenah torefet ella mizzeman haacharona veim haya beachat mishshettehen tosefet al chavertah gova beezo mehen shettirtze utvattel hashsheniyya

Hotzia shette gittin uchtubba achat en lah ella ketubba achat shehamgaresh et ishto vehechezirah setam al ketubbatah harishona hechezirah hotzia get uchtubba achar mitat habbaal im get kodem lichtubba gova beget ze ikkar ketubba im en darkan lichtov ketubba vegova kal ma sheyyesh bichtubbatah zo shehare zachta bah bemitato veim ketubba kadma et hagget en lah ella ketubba achat sheal ketubbatah harishona hechezirah

Haishsha neemenet lomar met bali kede shettinnase kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot gerushin umittenae hakketubba sheim tinnase leacher achar moto tittol kal ma shekkatav lah bichtubbatah lefichach im baa levet din veamra met bali hattiruni lehinnase velo hizkira shem ketubba baolam mattirin otah lehinnase umashbiin otah venotnin lah ketubbatah baa veamra met bali tenu li et ketubbati af lehinnase en mattirin otah sheal iske hakketubba baa vahare ze bechezkat shello met veen datah lehinnase ella littol ketubba mechayyim bilvad baa veamra met bali hattiruni lehinnase utnu li et ketubbati mattirin otah lehinnase venotnin lah ketubbatah mippene sheikkar devareha al iske hannissuin baa aval im baa veamra tenu li et ketubbati vehattiruni lehinnase mattirin otah veen notnin lah ketubba veim tafsa en motziin miyyadah
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 17: Mi shehaya nasuy nashim rabbot umet kal shennisset battechilla kodemet littol ketubbatah veen achat mehen notelet ella bishvua veen laacharona ella ma sheshshiyera shellefaneha vegam hi nishbaat venotelet hashshear vechen im haya alav shetar chov im haya hachov kodem gove baal chov techilla veim hakketubba kadma gova haishsha battechilla vehannishar labbaal chov

Bamme devarim amurim keshehayeta hakkarka shebbau ligbot mimmenna kenuya lo bishat nissuim uvshaa shellava hu shehaddin noten shekkal hakkodem bishtar techilla zacha techilla aval im nasa nashim zo achar zo velava ben kodem nissuin ben achar nissuin veachar shennasa velava kana karka kullan cholkin keechad sheshshibud kullan keechad ba shebbeshaa shekkana haya meshubad lakkol veen kan din kedima

Vechen im haya zeman hakketubbot vehashshetarot kullan yom echad o shaa achat bemakom shekkotvim shaot cholkin keechad sheen sham kodem ulolam kal shekkadam vezacha bemittaltelin kede chovo o kede ketubbatah en motziin miyyado sheen din kedima bemittaltelin

Mi sheggeresh et ishto vealav shetar chov uva baal chov vehaishsha ligbot vehau lo maot vekarka kede hachov vehakketubba baal chov notel maot vehaishsha notelet ketubbatah min hakkarka veim en lo ella karka sheen bah kede ligbot shenehem velo haya bah din kedima notnin oto levaal chov veim nishar laishsha kelum tittol veim lav tiddache mippene baal chov shehare baal chov hifsid vehotzi meotav vehaishsha lo chasra davar sheyyoter mishshehaish rotze lissa ishsha rotze lehinnase
Vechen mi shemmet vehinniach ishsha uvaal chov vekarka sheen bah din kedima haishsha nidchet mippene baal chov vehu gove chovo techilla

Vechevan shettikkenu haggeonim shettigbe haishsha uvaal chov min hammittaltelin vehaddavar yadua sheen din kedima bemittaltelin im lo hinniach mittaltelin kede litten lishnehem notnin levaal chov kal chovo techilla veim nishar laishsha ma shettittol bichtubbatah tittol veim lav tiddache

Hau ketuvin bichtubbatah nichse tzon barzel vetaana sheavdu o shellekacham habbaal hare hi benichse tzon barzel shellah kishar baale chovot venishbaat shello lakcha otan velo natna velo machala vecholeket im baale chovot

Mi shemmet o geresh veyesh lo nashim rabbot veen sham din kedima veen lo kede kal hakketubbot ketzad hen cholkot roim im kesheyechalek hammamon al minyan hannashim yegia lappechuta shebbahen kede ketubbatah o pachot cholkot beshave veim haya hammamon yoter al ze cholkim mimmennu kede sheyyaggia lappechuta shebbahen kashshiur ketubbatah vechozrot vecholkot et hammotar ben hannotarot al derech harishon ketzad mi shehaya nasuy arba nashim ketubbatah shel rishona arba meot veshel sheniyya shelosh meot veshel shelishit matayim veshel reviit mea nimtza hakkol elef vegeresh kullan o met im hinniach arba meot o pachot cholkot beshave vechal achat notelet mea o pachot hinniach shemone meot im techalek ben kullan beshave nimtzet harviit notelet matayim vahare en bichtubbatah ella mea ella ketzad osin lokchin arba meot zuz vecholkin otan benehen beshave mea mea nimtzet harviit natla kede ketubbatah vehalcha lah nishar kan arba meot zuz veshalosh nashim shebbeyad kal achat mishshelashtan mea zuz im tachalok haarba meot ben shelashtan beshave nimtza hashshelishit notelet matayim ushloshim veshalosh ushlish vahare en bichtubbatah ella matayim lefichach lokchin mearba hammeot shelosh meot vecholkin ben shelashtan beshave shennimtzet hashshelishit shennatla matayim shellah vehalcha lah nishar kan mea ushte nashim cholkin et hammea beshave ben rishona ushniyya nimtza beyad harishona matayim vachamishshim vechen beyad hashsheniyya venimtza beyad hashshelishit matayim uvyad harviit mea veal derech zo cholkot leolam afillu hen mea

Hearev leishsha bichtubbatah af al pi shekkanu miyyado eno chayyav leshallem shemmitzva asa vahare lo chasra kelum veim arev shel ketubbat beno hu vekanu miyyado chayyav leshallem shehaav biglal beno meshabed atzmo vegomer umakne vekabbelan shel ketubba chayyav leshallem af al pi shello kanu miyyado vee ze hu kabbelan ze sheamar leishsha hinnasi leze vaani noten ketubba zo aval im amar lah hareni arev ketubba zo ani porea ketubba zo ani chayyav bah vechayyotze baze patur ella im ken haya aviv hamgaresh et ishto yaddirenna hanaa veachar kach tippara ketubbatah min hakkabbelan o meaviv im haya arev shemma yachazirenah venimtzeu osin kenunya al nechasav shel ze

Vechen hammakdish nechasav vegeresh et ishto yaddirenna hanaa veachar kach tippara min happode miyyad hahekdesh shemma yaasu kenunya al hahekdesh aval hamgaresh et ishto uvaa litrof min hallakochot en mechayevin oto lehaddirah ella nishbaat vetorefet veim ratzta tachazor levalah shekkevar yadu hallakochot sheyyesh alav ketubbat ishsha vehem hifsidu al atzmam shellakchu nechasim shettachat shibudah

Habbaal shemmachar nechasav veachar kach katva ishto lallokeach din udvarim en li immecha vehiskima lemaasav af al pi shekkanu mimmenna hare zo torefet shello katva lo ella shello tihye benah leven balah ketata veyesh lah lomar nachat ruach asiti levali aval im kanu miyyad haishsha techilla sheen lah shibud al makom ze veachar kach machar oto habbaal enah torefet oto vechen im machar habbaal veamar leishto lichtov lallokeach din udvarim en li immecha velo katva velo hiskima lemaasav venifsad hammecher vechazar habbaal umachar leish acher ben otah sade ben sade acheret veachar shemmachar habbaal hiskima lemaasav vekanu miyyadah sheen lah shibud al sade zo enah yechola litrof sheenah yechola lomar nachat ruach asiti levali shehare barishona keshello ratzta lo halcha birtzon balah

Mi shehau lo shette nashim umachar et sadehu vekanu miyyad harishona sheen lah shibud al sade zo veenah torefet oto min hallokeach vehaya hakkinyan moil sheenah yechola liton bo nachat ruach asiti levali veachar kach met habbaal o geresh shettehen hashsheniyya motzia miyyad hallokeach shehare lo kanu miyyadah lallokeach veharishona motzia miyyad hashsheniyya mippene shehi kadma velo hesira shibudah ella meal hallokeach uchshettachzor hassade larishona chozer hallokeach umotziah miyyadah shehare kanu lo vechozrot chalila ad sheyyaasu peshara benehen

Almana ben min hannissuin ben min haerusin nishbaat umocheret mikkarka balah venifraat ketubbatah ben bevet din mumchin ben bevet din sheenan mumchin vehu sheyyihu hashshelosha haanashim neemanin veodin beshumat hakkarka veacharaut hammecher al nichse yetomim aval haggerusha lo timkor ella bevet din mumchin vechal hammocheret bevet din lo timkor ella behachraza uvhilchot halvaa yitbaer mishpat mechirat bet din heach hi aval hammocheret shello bevet din enah tzericha hachraza veaf al pi chen tzarich shelosha shehem neemanim veodim beshuma

Almana shemmachra karka bichtubbatah benah leven atzmah im machra shave beshave michrah kayyam venishbaat shevuat almana achar shemmachra vehu shemmachra leacher aval im shama leatzmah lo asta kelum vaafillu hichriza

Hayeta ketubbatah matayim umachra sheve mea bematayim o sheve matayim bemea nitkabbela ketubbatah veen lah kelum uvilvad shettishshava shevuat almana hayeta ketubbatah mea umachra sheve mea vedinar bemea michrah batel vaafillu amra ani achazir et haddinar layyorshim
Hayeta ketubbatah arba meot zuz umachra laze bemane velaze bemane shave beshave velaacharon sheve mea vedinar bemea shel acharon batel veshel kullam kayyam
Yesh laishsha limkor ketubbatah o littenah bemattana im met habbaal o gershah yavo halla veyittol veim meta hi bechayye balah o kodem shennishbea en lo kelum

Hare shemmachra miktzat ketubbatah o mishkena miktzat ketubbatah o natna leacher miktzat ketubbatah mocheret mikkarka balah vetigbe hashshear ben bevet din mumchin ben bishlosha neemanim umocheret lichtubbatah afillu peamim rabbot ben bevet din ben bishlosha neemanim veodim shumat hakkarka

Hammocheret ketubbatah ben laacherim ben levalah lo ibbeda shear tenae ketubba veim haya lah ben zachar yoresh keneged hakketubba hazzot shennimkera minnichse aviv yoter al chelko kedin tenay ze aval hammochelet ketubbatah levalah ibbeda kal tenae ketubbatah vaafillu mezonot en lah alav umochelet ketubbatah enah tzericha kinyan velo edim kishar kal hammochalim sheenan tzerichin lo edim velo kinyan ella bidvarim bilvad vehu sheyyihu devarim shehaddaat somechet alehen velo yihu divre sechok vehittul o divre temah ella bedaat nechona
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 18: Almanna nizzonet minnichse yorshin kal zeman almenutah ad shettittol ketubbatah umishshettitba ketubbatah bevet din en lah mezonot vechen im machra ketubbatah kullah o mishkena ketubbatah o asta ketubbatah appotiki leacher vehu shettomar lo po tigbe chovcha ben sheasta devarim ellu bevet din mumchin ben shello bevet din ben sheasta bechayye balah ben sheasta leachar mitat balah en lah mezonot min hayyorshim aval im machra miktzatah yesh lah mezonot umishshettitares haalmana ibbeda mezonoteha

Keshem shennizzonet achar moto minnechasav kach notnin lah kesut uchle tashmish umador o yoshevet bemador shehayeta bo bechayye balah umishtammeshet becharim uchsatot baavadim uvishfachot shennishtammesha bahen bechayye balah nafal hammador en hayyorshin chayyavin livnoto veim amra hanichu li vaani evnennu mishshelli en shomin lah vechen lo techazzek bidko velo titche oto ella teshev bo kema shehu o tetze veyorshin shemmachru medor almana lo asu velo kelum

Nafal habbayit o shello haya levalah bayit ella besachar notnin lah mador lefi kevodah vechen mezonoteha uchsutah lefi kevodah veim haya kevod habbaal gadol mikkevodah notnin lah lefi kevodo mippene sheola immo veenah yoredet afillu leachar mita

Birkat habbayit merubba ketzad chamishsha shehaya mezonot kal echad mehen kav besheyyochal levaddo im hau chamishshettan bevayit echad veochlin beeruv maspik lahen arba kabbin vehu haddin lishar tzarche habbayit lefichach almana sheamra enenni zaza mibbet avi pisku li mezonot utnu li sham yecholin hayyorshin lomar lah im atte etzlenu yesh lach mezonot veim lav en anu notnim lach ella kefi birkat habbayit veim hayeta toenet mippene shehi yalda vehem yeladim notnin lah mezonot hammaspikin lah levaddah vehi bevet aviha umotar mezonot haalmana umotar hakkesut layyorshin

Almana shechalta im tzericha lirfua sheen lah kitzva hare zo kimzonot veorshin chayyavin bah veim hi tzericha refua sheyyesh lah kitzva hare zo mitrappea mikketubbatah nishbet en hayyorshin chayyavin lifdotah afillu hayeta yevama vaafillu nishbet bechayye balah vamet vehi bashshivyah en chayyavin lifdotah minnechasav ella nifdet mishshel atzmah o tittol ketubbatah vetifde atzmah

Meta haalmana yorshe habbaal chayyavin bikvuratah veim nishbea shevuat almana veachar kach meta yorsheha yorshin ketubbatah vehen chayyavin bikvuratah aval lo yorshe habbaal maase yede haalmana layyorshin veoresh sheamar laalmana teli maase yadayich bimzonotayich en shomin lo aval hi sheratzta baze shomin lah
Vechal melachot shehaishsha osa levalah almana osa litomim chutz mimmezigat hakkos vehatztzaat hammitta veharchatzat panav yadav veraglav
Metziat haalmana uferot nechasim shehichnisa labbaal leatzmah veen layyoresh bahem kelum

Vehannechasim atzmam shehem nedunyatah notelet otan belo shevua veen layyorshim bahem din leolam ella im ken hotiru bechayye habbaal vehau nichse tzon barzel shehammotar labbaal veim meta haalmana belo shevua yorsheha yorshim nedunyatah af al pi shehu nichse tzon barzel veim haya bahen motar hammotar leorshe habbaal

Almana shettafsa mittaltelin kede shettizzon mehen ben shettafsa mechayyim ben shettafsa achar moto afillu tafsa kikkar zahav en motziin miyyadah ella kotvin aleha bet din ma shettafsa ufoskin lah mezonot umchashshevin immah vehi nizzonet mimma shebbeyadah ad shettamut o ad shello yihu lah mezonot veyikchu hayyorshin et hashshear

Vechen im tafsa mittaltelin bichtubbatah bechayye balah vamet gova mehen aval im tafsa achar moto lichtubbatah enah gova mehen af al gav shettikkenu haggeonim shettigbe hakketubba utnae hakketubba min hammittaltelin lefichach tizzon haalmana min hammittaltelin af al pi shello tafsa

Veim hinniach balah mittaltelin velo tafsa otan hayyorshim notlin otan vehen maalin lah mezonot veenah yechola leakkev alehen velomar yihu hammittaltelin munnachin bevet din ad sheizzon mehen shemma yovdu velo yihu li mezonot vaafillu hitneta alav beferush shettizzon min hammittaltelin enah meakkevet vechaze danin tamid bechal batte dinin
Aval im hinniach karka yechola hi leakkev alehen shello yimkeru veim machru enah motzia miyyad hallakochot sheen haishsha vehabbanot nizzonot ella minnechasim bene chorin
Hinniach nashim rabbot af al pi shennesaan zo achar zo nizzonot beshave kemo sheen din kedima bemittaltelin

Almana shennafla lifne yavam bishlosha chodashim harishonim nizzonet mishshel baal veim hukkar haubbar vechen im henichah meubberet nizzonet veholechet ad shetteled yalda ben shel kayyama nizzonet veholechet kal yeme almenutah kishar kal hannashim lo nimtzet meubberet achar shelosha chodashim o shehippila enah nizzonet lo mishshel baal velo mishshel yavam ella tovaat yevamah lichnos o lachalotz
Tava yevamah lichnos o lachalotz veamad bevet din uvarach o shechala o shehaya hayyavam bimdinat hayyam hare zo nizzonet mishshel yavam belo shevua kelal
Nafla lifne yavam katan en lah mezonot ad sheyyigdal veyihye kishar hayyavamin

Mi sheyyiched karka leishto bimzonoteha bishat mita veamar yihye makom peloni limzonot hare ribba lah mezonot veim haya secharo pachot mimmezonot haruot lah notelet hashshear mishshear nechasim veim haya secharo yoter min harauy lah notelet hakkol aval im amar lah yihye bemakom peloni bimzonoteha veshatka en lah ella perot oto makom bilvad shehare katzatz lah mezonot

Almana shebbaa levet din litboa mezonot yesh mi shehora shepposkin lah mezonot veen mashbiin otah veen rauy lismoch al horaa zo mippene shennitchallef lo haddavar beishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam verabbotay horu sheen lah mezonot mibbet din ad shettishshava shehare zo baa lehippara minnichse yetomim vechal hannifra minnichse yetomim lo yippara ella bishvua velaze dati nota vechen rauy ladun

Almana shebbaa levet din litboa mezonot mashbiin otah battechilla umochrin belo hachraza venotnin lah mezonot vechen yesh lah limkor limzonot shello bevet din mumchin ella bishlosha anashim neemanim belo hachraza vechen im machra limzonot benah leven atzmah shave beshave michrah kayyam uchsheyyavou hayyorshin lehashbia otah nishbaat

Vechamma mochrin limzonot kede lazun mehem shishsha chodashim lo yoter al ze umochrin al menat sheyyihye hallokeach noten lah mezon sheloshim yom vechozeret umocheret paam sheniyya leshishsha chodashim vechen mocheret veholechet leolam ad sheyyishshaer min hannechasim kede ketubbatah gova ketubbatah min hashshear veholechet lah

Almana sheppasku lah bet din mezonot en mechashshevin immah al maase yadeha ad sheyyavou hayyorshim veyitbeuha im matzu lah maase yadeha notlin oto veim lav holchin ledarkam vaani omer sheim hau hayyorshim ketannim bet din mechashshevin immah ufoskin maase yadeha kederech shepposkin lah mezonot

Almana sheen shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadah en lah mezonot shemma machala ketubbatah o machra o mishkena otah af al pi shello taan yoresh toanin anu lo veomrim lah havii ketubbatech vehishshavi utli mezonotecha ella im en darkam lichtov ketubba

Haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam uvaa veamra met bali ratzta nizzonet kedin kal haalmanot ratzta notelet ketubba amra gershani bali enah neemenet venizzonet minnechasav ad kede ketubbatah mikkal panim sheim adayin hi ishto yesh lah mezonot veim gershah kemo sheamra yesh lah ketubba shehare ketubbatah beyadah lefichach notelet mezonot ad kede ketubbatah veholechet lah
Haishsha shehaya lah sefek gerushin umet balah enah nizzonet minnechasav sheen motziin miyyad hayyoresh missafek aval bechayye balah yesh lah mezonot ad shettitgaresh gerushin gemurin

Almana aniyya sheshshahata shette shanim velo tava mezonot o ashira sheshshahata shalosh shanim velo tava vittera veen lah mezonot bashshanim sheavru ella mishshaa shettava veim shahata pachot mizze afillu beom echad lo vittera ella tovaat venotelet mezon hashshanim sheavru

Almana shettava mezonot min hayyorshim hem omrim natannu vehi omeret lo natalti kal zeman shello nisset al hayetomim lehavi reaya o tishshava shevuat hesset vetittol mishshennisset aleha lehavi reaya o yishshavu hayyorshim shevuat hesset shennatnu lah

Din tosefet ketubba kedin haikkar lefichach almana shettava o machra o machala o mishkena tosefet ketubbatah im haikkar en lah mezonot veim tava miktzat vehinnicha miktzat hare zo kemi shettava miktzat haikkar vehinnicha miktzato vechal hammocheret o hammochelet setam machra umachala hattosefet im haikkar sheshshenehem ketubba shemam bechal makom
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 19: Mittennae hakketubba sheyyihu banim hazzecharim yorshom ketubbat imman undunyatah shehichnisa betorat nichse tzon barzel veachar kach cholkin shear hayerushsha im achehem beshave

Ketzad nasa ishsha ketubbatah undunyatah elef veyalda ben umeta bechayyav veachar kach nasa ishsha acheret ketubbatah undunyatah matayim veyalda ben umeta bechayyav veachar kach met hu vehinniach alpayim beno min harishona yoresh elef shebbichtubbat immo uvno min hashsheniyya yoresh matayim shebbichtubbat immo vehashshear yorshim oto beshave nimtza beyad ben harishona elef vearba meot uvyad ben hashsheniyya shesh meot

Bamme devarim amurim beshehinniach yoter al kede shette ketubbot dinar echad o yoter kede sheyyachleku hashshear beshave aval im lo hinniach yoter dinar cholkim hakkol beshave sheim yirshu ellu ketubbat imman veellu ketubbat imman velo yishshaer dinar echad lachalok oto ben hayyorshim nimtza tenay ze mevattel chilluk yerushsha ben habbanim beshave shehu min hattora

Vehu haddin lemi shennasa nashim rabbot ben bazo achar zo ben bevat achat umetu kullan bechayyav velo mehen banim zecharim im haya sham yoter al kede kal hakketubbot dinar kal echad veechad yoresh ketubbat immo vehashshear cholkin beshave

Amru hayetomim hare anu maalin al nichse avinu yoter dinar kede sheyyittelu ketubbat imman en shomin lahem ella shamin et hannechasim bevet din kamma shehau shavin bishat mitat avihen veaf al pi shennitrabbu o nitmaatu achare mitat avihen kodem sheyyavou lachalok en shamin otan ella kishat mitat avihen
Haya sham yoter al kede kal hakketubbot dinar o yoter af al pi sheyyesh alav shetar chov keneged hayyoter eno memaet ella kal echad mehen yoresh ketubbat immo

Mi shehaya nasuy shette nashim umeta achat mehen bechayyav veachat achar moto velo banim mishshettehen af al pi shello hinniach yeter al shette hakketubbot im nishbea hashsheniyya shevuat almana kodem shettamut baneha kodmim lirushshat ketubbatah mippene sheenan yorshin ketubbat imman bitnay ze ella yerushsha shel tora veachar kach yorshin bene harishona ketubbat imman bitnay ze veim nishar sham kelum cholkin oto beshave veim meta kodem shettishshava bene harishona yorshim ketubbat imman bilvad vehashshear cholkin beshave

Haya nasuy shette nashim vehau lo banim mehen vamet veachar kach metu hannashim im nishbeu veachar kach metu kal echad veechad yoresh ketubbat immo birushsha shel tora velo bitnay ze lefichach en mashgichin im yesh sham motar o en sham veorshe harishona kodmin leorshe hashsheniyya veim lo nishbeu cholkin habbanim hakkol beshave veen sham yerushshat ketubba lefi sheen laalmana ketubba ad shettishshava

Achat nishbea veachat lo nishbea zo shennishbea baneha yorshin ketubbatah techilla vehashshear cholkin oto beshave vechal hayyoresh ketubbat immo shemmeta bechayye aviv eno toref minnechasim meshubadim ella mibbene chorin kechal hayyorshin

Umittenae ketubba shettihyena habbanot nizzonot minnichse avihen achar moto ad sheyyitarsu o ad sheyyivgeru bagra habbat af al pi shello nitarsa o nitarsa af al pi shello bagra en lah mezonot uvat hannizzonet minnichse aviha leachar moto maase yadeha umtziatah leatzmah lo laachim

Poskin labbat mezonot uchsut umador minnichse aviha kederech shepposkin laalmana umochrin limzon habbanot uchsutan belo hachraza kederech shemmochrin limzon haalmana uchsutah ella shehaishsha poskin lah lefi kevodah uchvod habbaal velabbanot poskin lahen davar hammaspik lahen bilvad veen habbanot nishbaot

En habbanim yorshin ketubbat imman velo habbanot nizzonot bitnaim ellu ad sheyyihye shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadam aval im en sham shetar ketubba en lah kelum shemma machala imman ketubbatah veim en darkam lichtov ketubba yesh lahen kefi hattenaim

Mi shetztziva bishat mitato laakor echad mittenae ketubba kegon sheamar el yizzonu benotav minnechasav o al tizzon almanato minnechasav o al yirshu banav ketubbat imman en shomin lo natan kal nechasav bemattana laacherim hoil umattenat shechiv mera enah kona ella leachar mita kemo sheyyitbaer hare hammattana vechiyyuv hannechasim bitnain ellu bain keechad ulfichach almanato uvnotav nizzonot minnechasav uvanav yorshim ketubbat imman shemmeta bechayye balah

Bat hammaenet hare hi kishar habbanot veyesh lah mezonot aval bat hayevama uvat hashsheniyya uvat haarusa uvat haanusa en lahen mezonot achar mitat avihen bitnay ze aval bechayye avihen hu chayyav bimzonotan kedin shear habbanim vehabbanot bechayye avihen

Hamares bat hannizzonet min haachin chayyav bimzonoteha mishsheat haerusin shehare en lah mezonot meacheha ella ad shettitares o ad shettibbager vezo enah bogeret kede shettizzon atzmah ella ketanna o naara veen adam rotze shettitbazze arusato vetelech vetishal al happetachim
Nisset habbat umeana o nitgarsha o nitalmena afillu hi shomeret yavam hoil vechazra levet aviha vaadayin lo bagra hare zo nizzonet minnichse aviha ad shettibbager o ad shettitares

Mi shemmet vehinniach banim uvanot yirshu habbanim kal hannechasim vehem zanin et achotehem ad sheyyivgeru o ad sheyyitarsu bamme devarim amurim beshehinniach nechasim sheefshar sheyyizzonu mehem habbanim vehabbanot keachat ad sheyyivgeru habbanot veellu hen hannikrain nechasim merubbin aval im en bannechasim shehinniach ella pachot mizze motziin mehem mezonot labbanot ad sheyyivgeru venotnin hashshear labbanim veim en sham ella kede mezon habbanot bilvad habbanot nizzonot mehen ad sheyyivgeru o ad sheyyitarsu vehabbanim yishalu al happetachim

Bamme devarim amurim beshehinniach karka aval im lo hinniach ella mittaltelin hoil uvtakkanat haggeonim hu sheyyizzonu habbanot min hammittaltelin hare habbanim vehabbanot nizzonot keechad min hannechasim haellu hammuatin shello tikkenu lahem bemittaltelin ella sheyyihu kevanim vechaze horu haggeonim

Hinniach karka vehau hannechasim merubbin venitmaatu achar ken kevar zachu bahen yorshim hau muatin bishat mita venitrabbu achar kach habbanim yorshin otan vaafillu lo nitrabbu im kadmu habbanim umachru nechasim muatin michran kayyam

Hau hannechasim merubbin veyesh alav chov o shehitna im ishto sheyyazun et bittah en hachov velo mezonot bat ishto memaatin bannechasim ella yirshu habbanim hakkol veyittenu levaal chov chovo veyazunu bat eshet avihen ad zeman sheppasak veyazunu achotehen ad sheyyivgeru o ad sheyyitarsu veyetzu mittachat yedehem

Hinniach almana uvat mimmenna o meishsha acheret veen bannechasim kede sheyyizzonu shettehen haalmana nizzonet vehabbat tishal al happetachim vechen ani omer shemmezonot habbat kodmin lirushshat habben et ketubbat immo shemmeta bechayye aviv veaf al pi sheshshenehem mittenae hakketubba vekal vachomer haddevarim im nidchet yerushsha shel tora mippene mezonot habbat lo tiddache yerushshat hakketubba shehi tenay bet din mippene mezonot habbat
Mi shemmet vehinniach banot gedolot uktannot velo hinniach ben en omrim yizzonu hakketannot ad sheyyivgeru veyachleku shear hannechasim beshave ella kullan cholkot beshave
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 20: Tziuu chachamim sheyyitten adam minnechasav meat levitto kede shettinnase bo veze hu hannikra parnasa hammassi et bitto setam lo yifchot lah mikkesut shepposkin leeshet ani shebbeyisrael kemo shebbearnu bamme devarim amurim beshehaya haav ani aval im haya ashir hare ze rauy litten lah kefi ashro
Peresh al habbaal sheen lah kelum vesheyyachnisenna arumma en lah kelum velo yomar habbaal keshettavo leveti achassenna ella mechassenna vehi bevet aviha

Haav shemmet vehinniach bat omdin dato kamma haya belibbo litten lah lefarnasa venotnin lah uminnayin yodin umdan dato mereav umyuddaav umassao umattano uchvodo vechen im hissi bat bechayyav omdin bah veim lo yadu lo bet din umdan daat notnin lah minnechasav issur lefarnasatah

Hinniach banot rabbot kal shettavo lehinnase notnin lah issur hannechasim veshelleachareha issur ma sheshshiyera rishona veshel achareha issur ma sheshshiyera sheniyya veim bau kullan lehinnase keachat rishona notelet issur vehashsheniyya issur ma sheshshiyera rishona vehashshelishit issur ma sheshshiyera sheniyya vechen afillu hen eser vechozrot vecholkot kal haissurim beshave ushar hannechasim laachim

Issur ze shehu lefarnasa eno mittenae ketubba lefichach afillu lefi takkanat chachamim harishonim veacharonim enah notelet ella min hakkarka veyesh lah ligbot issur ze missechirut hakkarka veim ratzu haachin litten lah maot keneged issur hakkarka notnin

Habbat beissur ze kevaalat chov shel achin hi lefichach notelet oto min habbenonit belo shevua veim metu haachin notelet oto min benehem mizzibburit uvishvua shehare hi nifraat minnichse yetomim vehabba lippara minnichse yetomim lo yippara ella mizzibburit uvishvua kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot halvaa
Vehaachim shemmachru o mishkenu karka avihem habbat torefet min hallakochot parnasatah kederech shettorfim kal baale chovot min hallakochot kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot halvaa
Mi shehissi banot gedolot venisharu ketannot umet belo ben en notlin parnasa liktannot veachar kach cholkot hannechasim ella cholkot kullan beshave

Mi shemmet vehinniach shette banot uven vekadma rishona venatla issur nechasim velo hispika hashsheniyya ligbot ad shemmet habben venaflu kal hannechasim lishtehen en hashsheniyya notelet issur ella cholkot beshave vezachta harishona beissur shellah
Mi shetztziva bishat mita al tefarnesu benotay minnechasay shomim lo sheen ze mittenae ketubba

Mi shemmet vehinniach almana uvat kevar bearnu shemmezonot haalmana kodmin limzonot habbat vechen im nisset habbat enah notelet issur nechasim mippene mezonot haalmana vaafillu meta habbat achar shennisset en habbaal yoresh parnasa haruya lehinnaten lah shehare hannechasim kullan bechezkat haalmana shettehe nizzonet mehen

Ketanna yetoma shehissiatah immah o acheha ledatah venatnu lah mea o chamishshim zuz yechola hi mishshettagdil lehotzi miyyadam parnasa haruya lah o beumdan daat haav o beissur hakkarkaot vaafillu lo hau haachin zanin otah veaf al pi shello machata bishat nissuin mippene shehakketanna enah bat mechaa

Nisset habbat achar sheggadla ben naara ben bogeret velo tava parnasatah ibbeda parnasatah veim michata beet nissueha hare zo motzia et harauy lah kal zeman shettirtze bagra veodah bevet aviha ben shebbagra achar moto ben shehinnichah bogeret im pasku haachin millatet mezonoteha shehare en lah mezonot kemo shebbearnu veshatka velo tava parnasatah ibbeda parnasatah veim michata lo ibbeda parnasatah lo pasku haachim mezonoteha vezanu otah beveger af al pi shello michata lo ibbeda parnasatah kal zeman shehen zanin otah sheyyesh lah liton mippene shehen zanin otah af al pi sheenan chayyavin vehi adayin lo nisset mippene ze lo tava parnasatah

Mi shetztziva latet levitto kach vechach maot lefarnasatah likkach bahen karka ben shehaya shechiv mera ben shehaya bari umet vahare hammaot beyad hashshalish veamra habbat tenu otam levali kal ma sheyyirtze yaase bahen im hayeta gedola venisset harshut beyadah veim adayin meoreset hi yaase shalish ma shehushlash beyado veim adayin ketanna hi afillu nisset en shomin lah ella yaase hashshalish kemo shetztziva haav
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 21: Metziat haishsha umaase yadeha levalah uma hi osa lo hakkol keminhag hammedina makom sheddarkan leerog oreget lirkom rokemet litot tzemer o pishtim tova veim lo haya derech neshe hair laasot kal hammelachot haellu eno kofah ella litot hatztzemer bilvad shehappishtan mazzik et happe veet hassefatayim vehatteviyya hi hammelacha hamyuchedet lenashim shenneemar vechal ishsha chachmat lev beyadeha tau

Dachaka atzmah veasta yoter min harauy lah hammotar labbaal haya lo mamon harbe afillu haya lah kamma shefachot enah yoshevet levattala belo melacha shehabbattala mevia lide zimma aval en kofin otah laasot melacha kal hayyom kullo ella lefi rov hammamon memaetet bimlacha

Hammaddir et ishto shello taase melacha kelal yotzi veyitten ketubba shehabbattala mevia lide zimma vechen kal ishsha rochetzet levalah panav yadav veraglav umozeget lo et hakkos umatztzaat lo et hammitta veomedet umshammeshet bifne balah kegon shettitten lo mayim o keli o tittol millefanav vechayyotze bidvarim ellu aval enah omedet umshammeshet bifne aviv o bifne beno
Umlachot ellu osa otan hi beatzmah vaafillu hau lah kamma shefachot en osin melachot ellu labbaal ella ishto

Yesh melachot acherot shehaishsha osa levalah bizman shehen aniyyim veellu hen ofa happat battannur veezra tikken shettihye ishsha mashkemet veofa kede shettihye happat metzuya laaniyyim umvashshelet et hattavshilin umchabbeset et habbegadim umenika et benah venotenet teven lifne behemto aval lo lifne bekaro umtachenet ketzad metachenet yoshevet barechayim umshammeret hakkemach veenah tochenet o mechammeret achar habbehema kede shello yibbatlu harechayim veim haya darkan litchon berechayim shel yad tochenet

Bamme devarim amurim baaniyyim aval im hichnisa lo shifcha achat o nechasim sherauy liknot mehen shifcha achat o shehayeta lo shifcha achat o shehaya lo mamon kede liknot mimmennu shifcha achat enah metachenet velo ofa velo mechabbeset velo notenet teven lifne behemto hichnisa lo shette shefachot o nechasim haruyin liknot mehen shette shefachot o shehau lo shette shefachot o shehaya rauy liknot shette shefachot enah mevashshelet veenah menika et benah ella notenet oto lashshifcha lehenik

Nimtzeu kal hammelachot shekkal ishsha osa otan levalah chamesh melachot tova verochetzet panav yadav veraglav umozeget et hakkos umatztzaat et hammitta veomedet umshammeshet befanav vehammelachot shemmiktzat hannashim osot otan umiktzatan enan osot shesh melachot metachenet umvashshelet veofa umchabbeset umenika venotenet teven lifne behemto

Kal melachot shehaishsha osa levalah nidda ose levalah chutz mimmezigat hakkos vehatztzaat hammitta veharchatzat panav yadav veraglav gezera mishshum hirhur shemma yavo livol lefichach matztzaat mittato keshehi nidda shello befanav umozeget et hakkos veenah notenet oto beyado kedarkah tamid ella mannachat oto al haaretz o al hakkeli o al hashshulchan vehu notlo

Haishsha sheshshavra kelim beet sheasta melaachoteha betoch betah petura veen ze min haddin ella takkana sheim en atta omer ken en shalom betoch habbayit leolam ella nimtzet nizheret venimnaat merov hammelachot venimtzet ketata benehem

Kal ishsha shettimmana millaasot melacha min hammelachot shehi chayyevet laasotan kofin otah veosa afillu beshot taan hu sheenah osa vehi omeret sheenah nimnaat millaasot moshivin ishsha benehen o shechenim vedavar ze kefi ma sheyyire haddayyan sheefshar baddavar

Haishsha kal zeman shehi menika et benah pochatin lah mimmaase yadeha umosifin lah al mezonoteha yayin udvarim sheyyafin lechalav pasku lah mezonot haruot lah vahare hi mitava leechol yoter o leechol maachalot acherot mippene choli hattaava sheyyesh lah bevitnah hare zo ochelet mishshellah kal ma shettirtze veen habbaal yachol leakkev velomar sheim tochal yoter midday o tochal maachalim raim yamut havalad mippene shetztzaar gufah kodem

Yalda teomim en kofin otah lehenik shenehem ella menika echad vesocher habbaal menika lashsheni hare sheratzta haishsha lehenik ben chavertah im benah habbaal meakkev veeno mannicha ella lehenik beno bilvad

Nadra shello lehenik et benah kofe otah umenikato ad sheyyihye ben chodesh echad hazzachar veechad hannekeva hi omeret ani enik et beni vehu eno rotze shettenik ishto kede shello titnavel af al pi sheyyesh lah kamma shefachot shomin lah shetztzaar hu lah lifrosh mibbenah

Hayeta aniyya shehi chayyevet lehenik et benah vahare hu ashir sherauy lo shello tenik ishto af al pi sheen lo shefachot im lo ratzta lehenik socher menika o kone shifcha mippene shehaishsha ola im balah veenah yoredet
Hi omeret rauy hu liskor o liknot shifcha vehu omer eno rauy aleha lehavi reaya veen kan makom lishvua

Haishsha shennitgarsha en kofin otah lehenik ella im ratzta noten lah secharah umenikato veim lo ratzta notenet lo et beno vehu metappel bo bamme devarim amurim shello henika oto ad shehikkirah aval im hikkirah vaafillu hu suma en mafrishin oto meimmo mippene sakkanat havalad ella kofin otah umenika oto besachar ad chodesh

Haggerusha en lah mezonot af al pi shehi menika et benah aval noten lah yoter al secharah devarim shehakkatan tzarich lahen mikkesut umaachal umashke vesicha vechayyotze baze aval hamebberet en lah kelum shalmu chodashav ugmalattu im ratzta hamgoreshet sheyyihye benah etzlah en mafrishin oto mimmenna ad sheyyihye ben shesh shanim gemurot ella kofin et aviv venoten lo mezonot vehu etzel immo veachar shesh shanim yesh laav lomar im hu etzli etten lo mezonot veim hu etzel immo lo etten lo mezonot vehabbat etzel immah leolam vaafillu leachar shesh

Ketzad haya haav rauy litzdaka motziin mimmennu harauy lo beal karcho vezanin otah vehi etzel immah vaafillu nisset haem leacher bittah etzlah veaviha zan otah mishshum tzedaka ad sheyyamut haav vetizzon minnechasav achar moto bitnae ketubba vehi etzel immah veim lo ratzta haem sheyyihu baneha etzlah achar sheggemalatan echad zecharim veechad nekevot harshut beyadah venotenet otan laavihen o mashlechet otan lakkahal im en lahen av vehen metappelin bahen
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 22: Habbaal kodem lechal adam birushshat ishto umeematay yizke birushshatah mishshettetze mershut haav veaf al pi sheadayin lo nichnesa lachuppa hoil venaaset birshut balah yirashenna

Ketzad haishsha shennitarsa umsarah aviha levalah o lishluche balah o mesaruha sheluche haav levalah o lishluchav umeta badderech kodem shettikkanes lachuppa af al pi shekketubbatah adayin bevet aviha balah yorshah vechen im halach haav o sheluche haav im habbaal venichnas immah balah badderech lechatzer venityached immah sham leshem nissuin umeta hare ze yirashenna balah aval im adayin haav im habbaal leholichah levet balah o shehalchu sheluche haav im sheluche habbaal o im habbaal afillu nichnas habbaal immah lechatzer lalun kederech shellanin ovre derachim befundak echad hoil vehaav o sheluchav immah vaadayin lo nityached immah leshem nissuin im meta yirashenna aviha af al pi shekketubbatah bevet balah
Vechen im hayeta bogeret o yetoma o almana vehalcha hi beatzmah mibbet aviha levet balah veen immah lo balah velo sheluchav umeta badderech en habbaal yoresh otah

Hannose ishsha shehi asura lo hoil veyesh lo bah kiddushin im meta tachtav yirashenna vechen hannose et hakketanna af al pi sheen kiddusheha kiddushin gemurim im meta tachtav yirashenna aval happikkeach shennasa chereshet im meta lo yirashenna vehacheresh shennasa pikkachat umeta yirashenna shehare hi bat daat uldatah nisset vezikketa lo mamonah

Ketanna shennitkaddesha ledaat aviha venisset shello ledaat aviha ben befanav ben shello befanav yachol haav limchot kemo shebbearnu vaafillu shatak haav im meta en habbaal yorshah ella im ken ratza haav benissueha

Horu haggeonim shehaishsha shechalta uvikkesha mibbalah sheyegarshenna vetetze belo ketubba kede shello yirashenna en shomin lah vaafillu amra ani sona oto veeni rotza laamod immo en shomin lah veen danin otah kedin moredet vedin yafe hu ze

Kal nechasim sheyyesh laishsha ben nichse tzon barzel ben nichse melog habbaal ochel kal perotehen bechayyeha veim meta bechayye balah yoresh balah hakkol lefichach im machra haishsha nichse melog achar shennisset af al pi sheotan hannechasim naflu lah kodem shettitares habbaal motzi happerot miyyad hallakochot kal yeme chayyeha aval lo guf hakkarka sheen lo kelum beguf nichse melog ad shettamut meta bechayyav motzi hagguf miyyad hallakochot belo damim veim haddamim shellakcha miyyad hallakochot kayyamin beatzman machaziran lallakochot veeno yachol lomar shemma metzia hen

Bamme devarim amurim binchasim hayeduin labbaal aval im naflu lah nechasim bimdina acheret velo yada bahen habbaal umachra otan michrah kayyam vechen arusa shemmachra kodem hannissuin michrah kayyam sheen labbaal benichse arusato kelum ad sheyyichnos

Haishsha shekkatva kal nechaseha leacher ben karov ben rachok kodem shettinnase af al pi sheim nitgarsha o nitalmena tevuttal hammattana kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot mattana en habbaal ochel perotehen veim meta bechayyav eno yorshan shehare natna otan kodem shettinnase uchshettamut bechayye balah yikne mekabbel hammattana mattenato kinyan gamur velo od ella afillu natna miktzat nechaseha o kullam kodem nissueha vechatva lamkabbel kene mehayyom velichsheertze shehare lo kana kinyan gamur ad shettirtze en habbaal ochel perot otah hammattana veim meta eno yorshah

Shomeret yavam yesh lah limkor velitten bemattana nechasim shennaflu lah keshehi shomeret yavam veen layyavam perot afillu benichse tzon barzel shehichnisa leachiv ad sheyyichnos meta keshehi shomeret yavam yorsheha meaviha yorshin benichse melog shellah vachatzi nichse tzon barzel veorshe habbaal yorshim ketubbatah vachatzi nichse tzon barzel veorshe habbaal chayyavin bikvuratah

Shomeret yavam ketubbatah al kal nichse balah lefichach en hayyavam yachol limkor benichse achiv ben kodem yibbum ben achar yibbum veim machar o natan mattana o chalak im echav benichse hammet ben kodem yibbum ben achar yibbum lo asa kelum shekkevar nitchayevu nechasim ellu laalmana ligbot mehen ketubbatah
Kanas et yevimto vehinniach achiv perot mechubbarin lakkarka yimmachru veyillakach bahen karka vehayyavam ochel perotehen

Hinniach perot telushin min hakkarka vechen im hinniach maot umittaltelin hakkol shel yavam umishtammesh bahen kemo sheyyirtze veenah yechola leakkev shehammittaltelin en hakketubba nigbet mehen ella betakkanat haggeonim veen koach betakkana zo lemano minnichse echav ulasran alav beacharaut zo shello yissa veyitten bahem

Yevama shello hayeta lah ketubba o shemmachala ketubbatah zacha benichse achiv umocher venoten kecheftzo uchsheyyichnos et yevimto yichtov lah ketubba mea veyihu kal nechasav achrain lichtubbatah kishar kal hannashim sheyyesh lahen ketubba

Haishsha shemmachra o shennatna achar shennisset benichse tzon barzel ben levalah ben laacherim lo asta kelum vechen baal shemmachar karka benichse ishto ben nichse tzon barzel ben nichse melog lo asa kelum

Machar mittaltelin shel nichse tzon barzel af al pi sheeno rashshay im machar mimikkaro mimkar machru shenehem benichse melog ben shellakach min haish techilla vechazar velakach min haishsha ben shellakach min haishsha vechazar velakach min haish michran kayyam
Vechen haishsha shemmachra o natna nichse melog levalah mimkarah umattenatah kayyamin veenah yechola lomar benichse melog nachat ruach asiti levali aval bishar nechasim yesh lah lomar

Ketzad haishsha shemmachra o natna levalah minnichse tzon barzel ben karka ben mittaltelin o sade sheyyiched lah bichtubbatah o sade shekkatav lah bichtubbatah o sade shehichnis lah shum mishshello lo kana balah veaf al pi shekkanu miyyad haishsha birtzonah chozeret bechal et shettirtze shello natna velo machra ella mippene shelom betah lefichach en labbaal reaya benichse ishto kelal chutz minnichse melog kemo shebbearnu

Nichse tzon barzel sheavdu o shennignevu umachala haishsha otam levaalah vekanu mimmenna beedim yerae li sheenah yechola lomar nachat ruach asiti levali ha lema ze dome lemi shekkanu miyadah sheen lah acharaut shehechezira nechasim ellu nichse melog shehare en habbaal mevi reaya littol kelum velo lehachazik bannechasim ella lehippater mitteviatah milleshallem aval im natna lo mattana mittaltele tzon barzel hakkayyamin lo kana mippene sheyyesh lah lomar nachat ruach asiti levali
Baal shemmachar karka leferot lo asa kelum mippene shello hitkinu perot laish ella kede leharviach behotzaat habbayit lefichach im machar leferot velakach otan hammaot lischora shomin lo

Hau laishsha kesafim im nichse tzon barzel hen hare ze nose venoten bahen veim nichse melog hen ben shehichnisa otan lo ben shennaflu lah birushsha o nittenu lah bemattana o naflu lah mittaltelin o nittenu lah hare ellu yimmachru veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perotehen
Vechen haishsha shechavlu bah acherim kal hammaot haruot latet lah yillakach bahen karka vehabbaal ochel perotehen kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot chovel

Naflu lah avadim af al pi shehen zekenim lo yimmachru mippene shevach bet aviha naflu lah zetim ugfanim velo haya lah beguf hakkarka shehailanot bah kelum im osin kede tippulan lo yimmachru mippene shevach bet aviha veim lav hare ellu yimmachru leetzim veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot

Naflu lah perot mechubbarin lakkarka hare ellu shel baal telushin min hakkarka shellah veyimmachru veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot aval hamgaresh et ishto vehau lah perot mechubbarin lakkarka bishat gerushin hare ellu shellah veim hau telushin hare ellu shello

Avde nichse melog uvehemat nichse melog habbaal chayyav bimzonot shellahen uvchal tzarchehem vehen osin lo vehu ochel perotehem lefichach velad shifchat melog labbaal velad behemat melog labbaal veim gershah veratzta haishsha litten damim velittol velad hashshifcha mippene shevach bet aviha shomin lah

Hichnisa lo shene kelim o shette shefachot betorat nichse tzon barzel veshamu otan alav beelef zuz vehukru veamdu bealpayim vegershah notelet echad beelef shellah vehashsheni im ratzta shettitten damav vetittol mishshum shevach bet aviha shomin lah

Hannoten mattana leishto ben shennatan lah karka ben shennatan lah maot velakcha bahen karka en labbaal perot bemattana zo vechen hannoten mattana leishsha al menat shello yihye habbaal ochel peroteha ella yihu peroteha laishsha lema shettirtze en habbaal ochel perot mattana zo vechen hammocheret ketubbatah betovat hanaa otan haddamim laishsha veen habbaal ochel perotehen

Velad behemat melog shennignav venimtza haggannav veshillem shenayim hakkefel laishsha sheen ze peri shettikkenu lo chachamim hachovel beishto kal hannezek vehatztzaar vehabboshet shellah veen habbaal ochel perot kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot chovel

Hammocher karka leishto im hau hammaot shellakcha bahen et hakkarka mibbaal geluyin viduin labbaal kanta vehabbaal ochel perot otah hakkarka veim hau maot temunin lo kanta shehabbaal omer lo macharti ella kede leharot hammaot shettamna veotan hammaot shenniru yillakach bahen karka vehabbaal ochel perot

Hare shennimtzeu maot o mittaltelin beyad haishsha hi omeret bemattana nittenu li vehu omer mimmaase yadayich hem shehem shelli hare zo neemenet veyesh lo lehacharim al mi shettoenet davar sheeno chen veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot veim amra al menat ken nittenu li al menat shello yihye levali reshut bahen ella eese bahen kal ma sheertze aleha lehavi reaya shekkal mamon shennimtza beyad haishsha bechezkat habbaal hu sheyyochal perotav ad shettavi reaya
Amra lo atta natatta li bemattana nishbaat shevuat hesset shennatan lah habbaal veeno ochel perotehen

En mekabbelin pikdonot lo min hannashim velo min haavadim velo min hakketannim veim avar vekibbel min haishsha yachazir laishsha meta yachazir levalah kibbel min haeved yachazir laeved veim met yachazir lerabbo kibbel min hakkatan yikne lo bo sefer tora o davar sheochel perotehem vechullam sheamru bishat mitatan pikkadon ze shel peloni hu im hau bechezkat neemanin etzel ze shehappikkadon etzlo yaase kemo shetztziuu veim lav yitten leorshehem

Haishsha shehau lah kesafim haruot labbaal leechol perotehem hu omer kach vechach yillakach bahem vehi omeret eni lokachat bahen ella kach vechach lokchim davar shepperotav merubbim vitziato meuta ben shehaya haddavar kirtzono o shehaya kirtzonah veen lokchin ella davar sheggizo machalif shemma yochal hakkol venimtza hakkeren aved

Haishsha shehichnisa levalah ez lachalavah verachel legizzatah vedekel leferotav af al pi sheen lah ella perot ellu bilvad hare ze ochel veholech ad shettichle hakkeren vechen im hichnisa lo kele tashmish betorat nichse melog hare ze mishtammesh bahen velovesh umatztzia umchasse ad sheyyichle hakkeren uchsheyegaresh eno chayyav leshallem habbelaot shel nichse melog

Horu haggeonim shennichse tzon barzel af al pi sheppechitatan al habbaal im hau habbelaot kayyamin vehau osin meen melachtan notelet keleha kema shehen veim lo hau osin meen melachtan hare hen kemo shennignevu o avdu shehu chayyav leshallem bidmehem sheshshamu otan alav bishat nissuin uminhag pashut hu ze vechal hannose al minhag ze kibbel alav acharaut hannedunya uchshem sheeno meshallem happechat kach eno notel et hashshevach im hotiru demehen lefi minhag ze yesh labbaal lachof miktzat avde ishto veammehoteha sheyyihu meshammeshin oto bevet ishsha acheret shennasa ben shehau avde melog ben shehau avde tzon barzel aval eno yachol leholichan leir acheret shello middaat ishto
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 23: Haisha shehitnet al balah levattel zechut middevarim shezzoche bahen habbaal im katav lah veodah arusa kodem hannissuin eno tzarich liknot miyyado ella kal ma shekkatav lah kayyam veim katav lah achar hannissuin tzarich liknot miyyado

Hitna immah shello yihu lo din udvarim binchaseha im machra venatna michrah umattenatah kayyam aval ochel perotehen kal zeman shehen birshutah veim kanu miyyado keshehi arusa sheen lo din udvarim binchaseha hare sillek atzmo migguf hakkarka veen lo binchaseha perot leolam vaafillu irer al kinyano veamar lo ala bedati sheen li perot mippene kinyan ze ella sheim machra michrah kayyam sheen adam nose ishsha belo nechasim en shomin lo ella kevar sillek atzmo migguf hakkarka
Hitna immah shello yochal perot nechaseha hare ze eno ochel perotehen aval mochrin et happerot velokchin bahen karka vehu ochel peroteha shello sillek atzmo ella mipperot nechasim ellu bilvad

Hitna immah shello yochal perot nechaseha velo pere perotehen lokchin happerot vekonin bahem karka velokchin perot karka zo vekonin bahem karka sheniyya vehu ochel perot ellu shehen pere pere perot vechen haddavar tamid ad sheyyatne immah shello yihu lo lo perot velo pere perotehen ad leolam veachar kach lo yihu lo perot bechayyeha aval im meta yirash hakkol

Hitna immah shello yirashenna hare ze lo yirashenna aval ochel perot bechayyeha vechen im hitna immah sheyyirash miktzat nechasim vechen im hitna immah sheim meta belo banim yachzeru nechasin levet aviha hakkol kayyam

Bamme devarim amurim shehitna immah kodem shettinnase shehannachala habbaa lo laadam shello mimmishpachto matne aleha shello yirashenna kodem shettehe reuya lo aval im hitna immah achar shennisset tenao batel veyirashenna kemo shebbearnu
Hitna immah achar nissuin shello yihu lo din udvarim binchaseha velo befere peroteha ad olam bechayyeha uvmotah hare ze eno ochel perot kelal aval im meta yirashenna kemo shebbearnu

Habbaal shehotzi hotzaot al nichse melog ben shehotzi meat veachal perot harbe ben shehotzi harbe veachal perot meat vaafillu achal gerogeret achat derech kavod o sheachal dinar echad afillu shello derech kavod vaafillu lo lakach bapperot mimma shehotzi ella chavila achat shel zemorot ma shehotzi hotzi uma sheachal achal

Vechen im naflu lah kesafim bemakom rachok vehotzi alehen hotzaot ad shehevian o ad shehotzian miyyad mi shehau etzlo velakach bahen karka veachal peroteha kashshiur ma shehotzi hotzi uma sheachal achal hotzi velo achal o sheachal pachot mikkashshiur shamin kamma shehishbichu veshoalin oto kamma hotzi im hashshevach yeter al hahotzaa yishshava binkitat chefetz kamma hotzi venotel hahotzaa veim hahotzaa yetera al hashshevach en lo min hahotzaa ella keshiur hashshevach uvishvua

Bamme devarim amurim bimgaresh aval haishsha shemmarda al balah afillu achal harbe shamin lo kamma achal ufochet oto mimma sherauy litten lo min hahotzaa achar sheyyishshava venotlo shello hikna lah kede shettittol vetetze meatzmah vechen hammotzi hotzaot al nichse ishto ketanna umeana bo roin kamma achal vechamma hotzi vechamma hishbiach veshamin lo kearis shehare birshut yarad

Minhagot rabbot yesh bindunya yesh mekomot shennahagu sheyyichtevu bakketubbot hannedunya yeter al dameha bishlish o bechomesh o bemechetza kegon shettihye hannedunya mea vechotvim shehichnisa mea vachamishshim kede leharbot bifne haam uchshettavo ligbot lo tigbe ella hammea veyesh mekomot shennahagu lichtov pachot veim paska lehavi lo bemea kelim notenet sheve mea veesrim o mea vachamishshim vechotvin shehichnisa lo mea veyesh mekomot shennahagu lichtov sheve mane bemane veyesh mekomot shennahagu sheyyitten haish maot lefi hannedunya davar katzuv shettitkashshet bo hakkalla vetikne bo besamim vechayyotze bahen veyesh mekomot sheyyachnis haish shum mishshello laishsha veyitztaref lindunyatah lehitnaot bo

Hannose setam kotev venoten keminhag hammedina vechen hi sheppaska lehachnis notenet keminhag hammedina uchshettavo ligbot ketubbatah magbin lah ma shebbichtubbatah keminhag hammedina uvchal haddevarim haellu vechayyotze bahen minhag hammedina ikkar gadol hu veal piv danin vehu sheyyihye oto minhag pashut bechal hammedina

Ish veishsha shehau benehem shidduchin veamar lah kamma et machneset li kach vechach veamra lo vechamma atta noten li o kotev li kach vechach vechen haav sheppasak al yede beno uvitto kamma atta noten levincha kach vechach vechamma atta noten levittecha kach vechach veamdu vekiddeshu kanu otan haddevarim veaf al pi shello haya benehen kinyan veellu hen haddevarim hanniknim baamira

Bamme devarim amurim besheppasak haav levitto ben ketanna uven gedola ufasak haav livno uvnissuin rishonim sheddato shel adam kerova etzel beno umerov simchato bannissuin harishonim gamar umakne lo baamira aval ach sheppasak laachoto o ishsha sheppaska levittah vechen shear kerovim vechen haav sheppasak livno o levitto benissuin sheniyyim lo kanu otan haddevarim ad sheyyiknu mide happosek sheyyitten kach vechach

Haav sheppasak al yad bitto lo kanta habbat otah hammattana ad sheyyichnos otah balah vechen habben lo kana ad sheyyichnos shekkal happosek eno posek ella al menat lichnos lefichach happosek maot lachatano umet kodem sheyyichnos venafla lifne achiv leyibbum yachol haav lomar layyavam leachicha hayiti rotze litten ulcha eni rotze litten vaafillu haya harishon am haaretz vehashsheni chacham veaf al pi shehabbat rotza bo

Happosek maot lachatano vehalach haav limdina acheret yechola hi lomar labbaal ani lo pasakti al atzmi ma ani yechola laasot o kenos belo nedunya o patreni beget aval im paska hi al atzmah velo higgia yadah hare zo yoshevet ad shettimtza ma sheppaska o ad shettamut velamma lo tiftor atzmah bemardut shehammoredet vehi arusa habbaal rotze lechansah vehi enah rotza aval zo en habbaal rotze bah ad shettitten hannedunya sheppaska vehi rotza bo shehare omeret lo o kenos o petor bamme devarim amurim bigdola aval biktanna sheppaska al atzmah kofin oto litten get o yichnos belo nedunya

Hannose ishsha ufaska immo sheyyihye zan et bittah kach vechach shanim chayyav lazun otam shanim shekkibbel al atzmo vehu sheyyatnu al davar ze bishat hakkiddushin aval shello bishat hakkiddushin ad sheyyiknu miyyado o ad sheyyichtov bishtar vechayyotze bo kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot mikkach umimkar nitgarsha betoch hashshanim shekkibbel al atzmo lazun et bittah venisset leacher ufaska gam immo sheyyihye zan otah habbat kach vechach shanim lo yomar rishon im tavo leveti azunah ella molich mezonoteha lammakom shehi sham immah vechen lo yomru shenehem hare anu zanin otah keachat ella echad zanah veechad noten lah deme mezonot

Nisset habbat betoch zeman ze habbaal chayyav bimzonoteha uvaale immah shenehem kal echad veechad noten lah deme mezonot metu ellu sheppasku lazun otah im kanu miyyadan o shechiyyev atzmo bishtar hare zo kevaal chov bishtar vetorefet mezonoteha minnichsehen hamshubadim ad sof hazzeman sheppasku veim pasku bishat hakkiddushin velo haya sham kinyan hare hem devarim shello nittenu likkatev veenah torefet bimzonoteha
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 24: Hannose et haayelonit velo hau lo banim velo ishsha acheret lifrot velirbot mimmenna af al pi shekkofin oto umotzi hare hi kechal hannashim veyesh lah ketubba ushar tenae ketubba vechen zoche habbaal bema shezzacha bishar hannashim

Aval hannose ishsha velo hikkir bah venimtzet ayelonit o mechayyave lavin vechen hannose sheniyya ben hikkir bah ben lo hikkir bah en lah ikkar ketubba velo tenay mittenae ketubba aval tosefet yesh lah veen lah mezonot vaafillu leachar moto uchshekkofin oto umafrishin benehem en motziin min habbaal perot sheachal

Velamma en lahen ikkar veyesh lahen tosefet haikkar shehu takkanat chachamim kede shello tihye kalla beenav lehotziah hoil velo hikkir bah en lah ikkar aval tosefet shehu chiyyev atzmo bah kal zeman shettirtze vetaamod lefanav hare amda battenay shellah vahare hiknet lo hanaatah vahare hi omedet lefanav aval hattora asra otah alav uma hi yechola laasot lefichach yesh lah tosefet sheen maaseha hen haggormin lah leheaser achar hannissuin ella asura hayeta mikkodem

Velamma lo chilleku bashsheniyya ben shehikkir bah ben shello hikkir bah ella amru en lah ikkar ketubba bechal makom mippene shehi middivre sofrim asu bah chizzuk aval im nasa achat mechayyave lavin vehikkir bah o achat mechayyave ase ben hikkir bah ben shello hikkir bah yesh lah ketubba shechayyave lavin shehikkir bah ratza lazun binchasav vechayyave ase issuran kal veyesh lishtehen mezonot leachar moto vechen im laveta veachla chayyav leshallem uchshekkofin otan lehotzi motziin min habbaal kal perot sheachal mikkal nechaseha
Hammaenet en lah ketubba aval tosefet yesh lah veen motziin min habbaal perot sheachal veim laveta keshehayeta tachtav veachla veachar kach meana en motziin otan mezonot min habbaal
Mi shezzinneta tachat balah en lah ketubba lo ikkar velo tosefet velo echad mittenae ketubba shehare maaseha garmu lah leheaser al balah

Veheach din nashim ellu bindunya shellahem kal ishsha shennedunyatah kayyemet afillu zinneta notelet shellah veholechet veim hayeta sheniyya o echad mechayyave ase ben hikkir bah ben shello hikkir bah o shehayeta ayelonit o mechayyave lavin vehikkir bah hare hi bindunyatah kechal hannashim

Nichse tzon barzel chayyav beachrautan venichse melog ma shennignav o sheavad avad lah veeno chayyav leshallem hayeta ayelonit o mechayyave lavin velo hikkir bah kal ma sheavad o nignav o bala o shennishchak minnichse tzon barzel en habbaal chayyav leshallem shehare hi natna lo reshut lihotan etzlo vechal ma sheavad o nignav minnichse melog chayyav leshallem hefech mikkal hannashim mippene sheen sham ishut gemura lo zacha benichse melog
Vehammaenet en lah belaot kelal sheen motziin min habbaal davar mimma sheavad o nignav minnechaseha ben minnichse melog ben minnichse tzon barzel ella notelet hannimtza lah veotza

Mi shezzinneta tachat balah en lah ketubba lo ikkar velo tosefet veen motziin mehabbaal davar mimma sheavad o nignav minnichse tzon barzel shellah veen tzarich lomar nichse melog velo hamzanna bilvad ella af haoveret al dat moshe o al dat yehudit o hayyotzet mishshum shem ra en lah ketubba lo ikkar velo tosefet velo tenay mittenae ketubba vechal achat mehen notelet hannimtza lah minnedunyatah veotza veen habbaal chayyav leshallem kelum lo ma sheppichet velo ma sheavad

Veellu hen haddevarim sheim asta achat mehen avra al dat moshe yotza bashshuk usar roshah galuy o shennoderet o shennishbaat veenah mekayyemet o sheshshimmesha mittatah vehi nidda o sheenah kotza lah challa o sheheechila et balah devarim asurim en tzarich lomar shekatzim urmasim unvelot ella devarim sheenan meussarin veheach yodea davar ze kegon sheamra lo perot ellu peloni kohen tikkenam li veissa zo pelonit hifrisha li challatah ufloni hechacham tiher li et hakketem veachar sheachal o ba aleha shaal oto peloni veamar lo hau devarim meolam vechen im huchzeka nidda bishchenoteha veamra levalah tehora ani uva aleha

Vee zo hi dat yehudit hu minhag hatztzeniut shennahagu benot yisrael veellu hen haddevarim sheim asta achat mehen avra al dat yehudit yotza lashshuk o lemavoy mefullash veroshah parua veen aleha redid kechal hannashim af al pi shessearah mechusse bemitpachat o shehayeta tova bashshuk uvered vechayyotze bo keneged paneha al paddachtah o al lechayeha kederech sheosot haakkum happerutzot o shettova bashshuk umaret zerooteha livne adam o shehayeta mesacheket im habbachurim o shehayeta tovaat hattashmish bekol ram mibbalah ad sheshshechenoteha shomot otah medabberet al iske tashmish o shehayeta mekallelet avi balah bifne balah

Ezra tikken shettihye ishsha chogeret besinnar tamid betoch betah mishshum tzeniut veim lo chagra enah overet al dat moshe velo hifsida ketubbatah vechen im yatzta beroshah parua mechatzer lechatzer betoch hammavoy hoil usarah mechusse bemitpachat enah overet al dat

Haoveret al dat tzericha hatraa veedim veachar kach tafsid ketubbatah avra beno levenah veyada shehi overet al dat vehitra bah belo edim vechazra veavra hu toen veomer achar hatraa avra vehi omeret lo avarti kelal o lo hitra bi im ratza lehotzi hare ze noten ketubba achar shettishshava shello avra sheim tode sheavra achar hatraa zo en lah kelum

Ketzad hi yotza mishshum shem ra kegon shehau sham edim sheasta davar mechoar beoter shehaddevarim marin shehayeta sham avera af al pi sheen sham edut berura biznut ketzad kegon shehayeta bechatzer levaddah verau rochel yotze venichnesu miyyad bishat yetziato umatzu otah omedet meal hammitta vehi loveshet hammichnasayim o chogeret azorah o shemmatzu rok lach lemala min hakkila o shehau yotzim mimmakom afel o maalin ze et ze min habbor vechayyotze bo o sherauhu menashshek al pi chalukah o sherau otan menashshekin ze et ze o megappefin ze et ze o shennichnesu ze achar ze vehegifu delatot vechayyotze bidvarim ellu im ratza habbaal lehotziah tetze belo ketubba veen zo tzericha hatraa

Overet al dat moshe o al dat yehudit vechen zot sheasta davar mechoar en kofin et habbaal lehotzi ella im ratza lo yotzi veaf al pi shello hotzi en lahen ketubba shehakketubba takkanat chachamim hi kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah velo hikpidu ella al benot yisrael hatztzenuot aval ellu happerutzot en lahen takkana zo ella tehe kalla beenav lehotziah

Mi sheraa ishto shezzinneta o sheamra lo achat mikkerovotav o mikkerovoteha shehu maaminam vesomechet dato alehem shezzinneta ishto ben shehaya haomer ish ben shehayeta ishsha hoil vesamcha dato ledavar ze shehu emet hare ze chayyav lehotzi veasur lo lavo aleha veyitten ketubba veim hodet lo shezzinneta tetze belo ketubba lefichach mashbiah binkitat chefetz shello zinneta tachtav im raa otah beatzmo veachar kach tigbe ketubbatah aval bidvar acher eno yachol lehashbiah ella al yede gilgul

Amra lo ishto shezzinneta tachtav birtzonah en mashgichin lidvareha shemma eneha natna beacher aval ibbeda ketubbatah ikkar vetosefet veibbeda habbelaot shehare hodet biznut veim haya maaminah vesomech dato al devareha hare ze chayyav lehotziah veen bet din kofin et haish legaresh et ishto bedavar middevarim ellu ad sheyyavou shene edim veyaidu shezzinneta ishto zot bifnehem birtzonah veachar kach kofin oto lehotzi

Haishsha shezzinneta tachat balah bishgaga o beones hare zo mutteret levalah shenneemar vehi lo nitpasa ha nitpasa mutteret ben sheanasah akkum ben sheanasah yisrael vechal shettechillat biatah beones af al pi shessofah beratzon vaafillu amra hanichu lo sheilmale lo anas oti hayiti socharto hare zo mutteret shehayyetzer levashah umittechilla hayeta beones

Nashim shegganvu otan listim hare hen kishvuyyot shehen anusot umuttarot levalehen veim henichum vehalchu lallistim meatzman hare ellu beratzon vaasurot levalehen vedin hashshogeget vedin hanneeneset echad hu shehashshegaga tzad ones yesh bah
Bamme devarim amurim beshehaya balah yisrael aval eshet kohen sheshshagga o shenneensa asura levalah shehare naaset zona mikkal makom vehu asur bezona kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot issure bia
Echad eshet yisrael o eshet kohen shenneensa ketubbatah kayyemet haikkar vehattosefet velo hifsida mikketubbatah kelum vechofin et hakkohen litten lah ketubbatah ulgarshah

Eshet kohen sheamra levalah neenasti o shagagti venivalti leacher eno choshesh lidvareha shemma eneha natna beacher veim hayeta neemenet lo o sheamar lo adam shehu somech al devarav yotzi veyitten ketubba

Haomer leishto bifne shenayim al tissatri im ish peloni venichnesa immo leseter bifne shene edim veshahata kede tuma hare zo asura al balah ad sheyyashkenna me hammarim kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot sota veim met kodem sheyyashkenna en lah ketubba veaf al pi shello matzu davar mechoar sheen lecha davar yoter mechoar mizze vehayyom sheen sham me sota neesra alav issur olam vetetze belo ketubba lo ikkar velo tosefet shehare maaseha haraim garmu lah leheaser
