Amar lah beno levenah al tissatri im ish peloni veraa otah shennistera immo veshahata kede tuma hare zo asura alav bazzeman hazze sheen sham me sota vechayyav lehotzi veyitten ketubba veim hodet shennistera achar shehitra bah tetze belo ketubba ulfichach mashbiah al ze veachar kach yitten ketubba
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 25: Hannose ishsha setam venimtzeu aleha nedarim tetze belo ketubba lo ikkar velo tosefet beellu nedarim amru shello tochal basar o shello tishte yayin o shello titkashshet bemine tzivonin vehu haddin lishar hamminim shedderech kal neshe hammakom lehitkashshet bahen aval nimtza aleha neder acher chutz meellu lo hifsida kelum

Vechen hakkones ishsha setam venimtza bah mum mimmume hannashim shekkevar bearnum velo yada habbaal bemum ze velo shama bo veratza hare zo tetze belo ketubba lo ikkar velo tosefet ketzad haya merchatz bair vehau lo kerovim eno yachol lomar lo yadati mumin ellu vaafillu mumin shebbasseter mippene shehu bodek bikrovotav vachazaka sheshshama veratza veim en sham merchatz o shello hau lo kerovim toen bemumin shebbasseter venichpa beittim yeduim hare hu mimmume seter aval bemumin shebbegaluy eno yachol liton shehare hakkol roin otan veomrin lo vechezkato sheshshama venitpayyes davar yadua hu sheen din ze ella beotan hammekomot shehaya minhag hannashim sham lehallech bashshuk ufnehen geluot vehakkol yodin otan veomrin zo hi bitto shel peloni vezo hi achoto shel peloni kemo are edom bazzeman hazze aval mekomot sheen derech habbanot sham latzet lashshuk kelal veim tetze habbat lammerchatz banneshef tetze mitnakkera velo yire otah adam chutz mikkerovoteha hare ze toen af bemumin shebbegaluy vehu shello haya sham merchatz veshello hayeta lo kerova livdok bah aval im haya sham merchatz beir zo sheen derech hannashim latzet bah ufnehem megullot im yesh lo kerova eno yachol liton shehare hakkol roin otah arumma bammerchatz veim darkan lehitnakker ulhitchabbe af bammerchatz veshettihye habbat rochetzet ballayela o bevayit katan bammerchatz levaddah ad shello terae velo tivada hare ze toen af bemumin shebbaggaluy vehaddevarim ellu devarim shel taam hem veenam gezerat hakkatuv

Horu miktzat haggeonim shezze sheamru chachamim mippene shehu bodek bikrovotav eno kerovotav bilvad ella afillu meyuddaav vaafillu haya gar beir sheen lo karov kelal im yesh sham merchatz eno yachol liton shei efshar shello yihu lo reim veomer leechad mereav shettivdok lo ishto o achoto al pelonit ulfichach chezkato sheshshama venitpayyes velo yerae li din ze sheen kal adam motzi kal ma sheyyesh belibbo middevarim ellu lakkol ella likrovav veod sheen dato somechet ella ledivre kerovav beoter

Ketzad hi taanat hammumin im hau hammumin shennimtzeu bah mumin shevadday hau bah kodem shettitares kegon etzba yetera vechayyotze bo al haav lehavi reaya sheyyada bahen habbaal veratza o shechezkato sheyyada veim lo hevi reaya tetze belo ketubba kelal hau mumim sheefshar shennoldu bah achar haerusin im nimtzeu bah achar shennichnesa levet habbaal al habbaal lehavi reaya shead shello nitarsa hau bah vehaya mikkacho mikkach taut veim nimtzeu bah vehi bevet aviha al haav lehavi reaya sheachar haerusin noldu venistachafa sadehu
Hevi habbaal reaya shead shello titares hau bah o shehoda lo bechach vehevi haav reaya sheraa veshatak venitpayyes o shechezkato sheyyada bahen venitpayyes hare ze chayyav bichtubba

Ba al ishto veshaha kamma yamim vetaan shemmum ze lo nira li ad atta afillu haya betoch hakkematim o bechaf haregel en shomin lo chazaka sheen adam shote bechos ella im ken bodko yafe vechezkato sheyyada veratza

Hannose ishsha venimtza sheen lah veset kavua leniddatah ella lo targish beatzmah ad shettire dam nidda hare zo lo teshammesh ella bishne edim shebbodeket bahen atzmah echad lifne tashmish veechad leachar tashmish chutz min haed shel ish shemmekanneach bo atzmo kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot issure bia

Veaf al pi shemmum gadol hu ze lo hifsida kelum shehare bodeket atzmah techilla umshammeshet hare shebbadka atzmah venivala uvet shekkinnecha atzmah hi vehu nimtza dam al ed shellah o al ed shello im era ze paam achar paam shalosh peamim semuchot zo lazo hare zo asura leshev im balah vetetze belo ketubba lo ikkar velo tosefet veen lah tenay mittenae ketubba shehare enah reuya letashmish veotzi velo yachazir leolam shemma titrappe venimtza shello gamar legarshah bishat gerushin umutteret lehinnase leacher kemo sheyyitbaer beinyan hannidda

Bamme devarim amurim beshehayeta kach mittechillat nissueha umibbeila rishona raata dam aval im era lah choli ze achar shennisset nistachafa sadehu lefichach im baal paam achat velo nimtza dam veachar kach chazra lihot roa dam bechal et tashmish yotzi veyitten ketubba kullah velo yachazir olamit kemo shebbearnu
Vechen ishsha shennoldu bah mumin achar shennisset afillu naaset mukkat shechin im ratza lekayyem yekayyem veim ratza lehotzi yitten ketubba

Haish shennoldu bo mumin achar shennissa afillu niktea yado o raglo o nismet eno velo ratzta ishto leshev immo en kofin oto lehotzi velitten ketubba ella im ratzta teshev veim lo ratzta tetze belo ketubba kedin kal moredet aval im nolad lo reach happe o reach hachotem o shechazar lilkot tzoat kelavim o lachtzov nechoshet meikkaro o leabbed orot kofin oto lehotzi velitten ketubba veim ratzta teshev im balah

Naasa haish mukke shechin kofin oto lehotzi velitten ketubba veaf al pi shehi rotza leshev en shomin lah ella shemmafrishin otan beal karchan mippene shehi memikatto veim amra eshev immo beedim kede shello yavo aleha shomin lah

Mi shehaya balah baal reach happe o reach hachotem o melakket tzoat kelavim vechayyotze bahen umet venafla lifne achiv veyesh bo oto mum shehaya bevalah yechola hi lomar leachicha hayiti yechola lekabbel ulcha eni yechola lekabbel veyachalotz veyitten ketubba ure vanim levanecha shalom al yisrael
Mishneh Torah, Virgin Maiden 1: Mi sheppitta betula konsin oto mishkal chamishshim selaim shel kesef mezukkak vehu hannikra kenas vechen im anas otah uknas ze mitzvat ase shel tora shenneemar venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara chamishshim kesef

Vee ze hu mefatte vee ze hu ones mefatte lirtzonah ones shebba aleha beal karchah kal hannivelet bassade hare zo bechezkat anusa vedanin otah bedin anusa ad sheyyaidu haedim shebbirtzonah nivala vechal hannivelet bair hare zo bechezkat mefutta mippene shello zaaka ad sheyyaidu haedim shehi anusa kegon sheshshalaf lah cherev veamar lah im tizaki eherog otach

Hamfutta shello ratzta lehinnase lamfatte o shello ratza aviha littenah lo o shello ratza hu lichnos hare ze noten kenas veholech veen kofin oto lichnos veim ratzu uchnasah eno meshallem kenas ella kotev lah ketubba kishar habbetulot aval haanusa shello ratzta hi o aviha lehinnase leones harshut beyadam venoten kenas veholech ratzta hi veaviha velo ratza hu kofin oto vechones venoten kenas shenneemar velo tihye leishsha hare zo mitzvat ase afillu hi chiggeret o suma o metzoraat kofin oto lichnos veeno motzi lirtzono leolam shenneemar lo yuchal leshallechah kal yamav hare zo mitzvat lo taase
Veen lah ketubba shello tikkenu chachamim ketubba leishsha ella kede shello tihye kalla beenav lehotziah veze eno yachol lehotziah

Hayeta anusa zo asura alav afillu mechayyave ase vaafillu sheniyya hare ze lo yissaenna vechen im nimtza bah devar zimma achar shekkanas hare ze yegarshenah shenneemar velo tihye leishsha ishsha haruya lo
Kohen gadol sheanas betula o sheppitta otah hare ze lo yichnos mippene shehu metzuve likkach et habbetula uvshaa sheyyissa zo enah betula veim kanas yotzi beget

Af al pi shenneemar beones lo yuchal leshallechah kevan shekkedamo ase shenneemar velo tihye leishsha hare ze nitteko laase venimtzet zo mitzvat lo taase shennittekah laase sheen lokin aleha ella im lo kiyyem ase shebbah kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot sanhedrin lefichach haones sheavar vegeresh kofin oto lehachazir veeno loke meta gerushato kodem sheyyachzirenna o nitkaddesha leacher o shehaya kohen sheasur bigrusha hare ze loke shehare avar al lo taase veeno yachol lekayyem ase shebbah

En haones o hamfatte chayyav biknas ad sheyyavo aleha kedarkah uvedim veeno tzarich hatraa umeematay yihye labbat kenas meachar shalosh shanim gemurot ad shettivgor nivala betoch shalosh shanim en biatah bia ba aleha mishshebbagra en lah kenas shenneemar naara vetula lo habbogeret

Veachat sheyyesh lah av veachat sheen lah av yesh lah kenas veellu sheen lahen kenas habbogeret vehammaenet vehaayelonit vehashshota vehachereshet umi sheyyatza aleha shem ra beyaldutah uvau shenayim veheidu shettava otan liznot immah vehamgoreshet min hannissuin vaadayin hi naara betula aval hamgoreshet min haerusin im neensa yesh lah kenas uknasah leatzmah veim nitpatteta en lah kenas

Haggiyyoret vehashshevuya vehamshuchreret im nitgayera venifdet venishtachrera vehi bat shalosh shanim o pachot yesh lah kenas veim hayeta bat shalosh shanim veom echad keshennitgayera o keshennifdet o keshennishtachrera en lah kenas hoil uviatan bia hare hen kivulot

Hayeta betula zo asura al haones o hamfatte im hayeta achat mechayyave keretot kegon achoto o dodato vehannidda vechayyotze bahen o shehayeta mechayyave lavin im hitru bo hare ze loke veeno meshallem kenas sheen adam loke umshallem veim lo hayeta sham hatraa hoil veeno chayyav malkot hare ze meshallem kenas
Hayeta mechayyave ase o sheniyya vechayyotze bahen sheasura middivre sofrim ben hitru bo ben lo hitru bo chayyav biknas sheen kan malkot

Hayeta mechayyave mitat bet din kegon bitto veeshet beno vechayyotze bahen ben hitru bo ben lo hitru bo patur min hakkenas shenneemar velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh ha im haya sham ason en sham onesh veaf al pi sheharigat haishsha bishgaga shehare lo nitkavvenu lah shenneemar ki yinnatzu anashim venagfu ishsha ha lamadta shello chillek hakkatuv beason ben shogeg lemezid lefatro min hattashlumin vahare hu omer makke nefesh behema yeshallemenna umakke adam yumat ma makke nefesh behema lo chillek hakkatuv ben shogeg lemezid lechayevo betashlumin af makke nefesh adam lo chillek hakkatuv ben shogeg lemezid lefatro min hattashlumin
Vechen haddin lechal avera sheyyesh bah mitat bet din sheen bah tashlumin
Ba aleha umeta hare ze patur min hakkenas shenneemar venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara lo laavi hammeta vehu shettamut kodem shettaamod baddin
Mishneh Torah, Virgin Maiden 2: Chamishim kesef shel kenas hem deme hanaat shechiva bilvad vechayyav hamfatte litten boshet ufgam yoter al hakkenas hakkatzuv battora yeter alav haones shehu noten et hatztzaar shehannivelet birtzonah en lah tzaar vaanusa yesh lah tzaar vechen hu omer baanusa tachat asher innah
Nimtza hamfatte meshallem shelosha devarim kenas uvoshet ufgam vehaones arbaa kenas uvoshet vetzaar ufgam
Kenas shave bakkol echad habba al bat kohen gadol veechad habba al bat ger o mamzer kenasah chamishshim kesef aval habboshet vehappegam vehatztzaar enan shavin lakkol utzrichin shuma

Ketzad shamin habboshet hakkol lefi hamvayyesh vehammitbayyesh sheeno dome mevayyesh naara chashuva umimmishpacha meyuchasa limvayyesh ketanna aniyya bezuya veeno dome mitbayyesh meadam chashuv vegadol lemitbayyesh meechad mehannevalim vekal min hakkallim
Ulfi ze roin haddayyanin maalato umaalatah veshamin kamma mamon rauy leaviha ulmishpachtah litten velo yeera lahen davar ze meadam ze vechamohu chayyav leshallem

Pegam lefi yafyah roin otah keillu hi shifcha nimkeret bashshuk kamma hi shava beula vechamma hayeta shava betula sheadam rotze liknot shifcha betula littenah leavdo shehu rotze bahanayato vetovato veroin kamma pachata vishallem tzaar lefi katnutah uvinyan gufah ulfi shanav vegufo omdin kamma haav rotze litten velo titztaer zo mizze veyitten

Hamfatte noten boshet ufgam miyyad veeno noten hakkenas ella im ken lo nesaah shenneemar veim maen yemaen aviha letittah lo kesef yishkl aval haones noten arbaa devarim miyyad vechones lefichach keshettirtze lehitgaresh o titalmen en lah kelum

Bau aleha shenayim echad kedarkah veechad shello kedarkah ze shebba aleha shello kedarkah im hu rishon chayyav bevoshet ufgam veim hu acharon chayyav bevoshet bilvad shekkevar nifgema veze shebba aleha kedarkah ben rishon ben acharon chayyav biknas uvishar haddevarim aval en boshet ufgam shel bat shello nivala kelal kevoshet ufgam zo shennivala shello kedarkah

Kevar hodanu habbanot sheen lahen kenas veeser hen habbogeret vehammaenet vehamgoreshet vehaayelonit vehashshota vehachereshet vehaggiyyoret vehashshevuya vehamshuchreret vehayyotze aleha shem ra ushar habbanot yesh lahen kenas

Kal bat sheyyesh lah kenas yesh lah boshet ufgam veim hayeta anusa yesh lah tzaar vechal bat sheen lah kenas kach en lah lo boshet velo pegam im nitpatteta vechen im neensa chutz mibbogeret ummaenet veshota vechereshet
Ketzad haones et habbogeret veet hammaenet af al pi sheen lahen kenas yesh lahen boshet ufgam vetzaar vehaones shota o chereshet meshallem tzaar bilvad aval hamfatte et kullan patur mikkelum

En adam meshallem kenas bechal makom behodaat piv ella al pi edim lefichach haomer anasti o pittiti bitto shel peloni eno meshallem kenas aval meshallem boshet ufgam behodaat piv vechen bat shettava ish baddin veamra lo anasta o pittita oti vehu omer lo hau devarim meolam hare ze nishba shevuat hesset sheillu hoda haya meshallem lah boshet ufgam vetzaar al pi atzmo
Amra lo anasta oti vehu omer lo ki ella pittiti hare ze nishba shevuat hattora al deme hatztzaar umshallem boshet ufgam shehare hoda bemiktzat hattaana kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo
Shelosha devarim shel mefatte vearbaa shel ones hare hen shel av shekkal shevach neurim lo veim en lah av hare hen shel atzmah

Mefutta o anusa shello tava ad shebbagra o ad shennisset o ad shemmet haav haarbaa devarim o hashshelosha shellah amda baddin vetava oto veachar kach bagra o shennisset hare hen shel av veim met haav achar amidatah baddin hare hen shel achin shehen yorshe haav shemmeet sheamda bedin zacha bahen haav
Habbat shennitarsa venitgarsha kenasah levaddo leatzmah neensa o nitpatteta veachar kach nitkaddesha leacher kenasah ushar haddevarim leaviha sheen haerusin motziin mershut av

Ani omer shezze shenneemar battora al techallel et bittecha lehaznotah shello yomar haav hoil velo chiyeva tora mefatte veones ella sheyyitten mamon laav hareni socher bitti habbetula laze lavo aleha bechal mamon sheertze o aniach ze lavo aleha bechinnam sheyyesh lo laadam limchol mamono lechal mi sheyyirtze lechach neemar al techallel et bittecha shezze shechiyeva tora laones velamfatte mamon velo malkot besheera haddavar mikre shello middaat aviha velo hechina atzmah lechach sheddavar ze eno hove tamid veeno matzuy aval im heniach bitto habbetula muchenet lechal mi sheyyavo aleha gorem shettimmale haaretz zimma venimtza haav nose bitto vehaach nose achoto sheim titabber veteled lo yivada ben mi hu vehammechin bitto lechach hare hi kedesha veloke habboel vehannivelet mishshum lo tihye kedesha veen konsin oto shello chiyeva tora kenas ella leones umfatte aval zo shehechina atzmah lechach ben middatah ben middaat aviha hare zo kedesha veissur kedesha echad hu ben bivtula ben bivula lefichach amru chachamim shehayyotze aleha shem ra beyaldutah en lah kenas kemo shebbearnu shehare zo bechezkat shehifkira atzmah ledavar ze birtzonah

Vechen im amar lo metzatiha betula velo amar shezzinneta tachtay o sheamar zinneta tachtay velo hevi edim ella bau mealehem hare ze patur af al pi shehaedim neheragim im huzammu

Mishneh Torah, Woman Suspected of Infide: Kinnuy haamur battora vekinne et ishto hu sheyyomar lah bifne edim al tissatri im ish peloni afillu haya aviha o achiha o akkum o eved o shachuf hu haish sheeno mitkashshe veeno molid

Hassetira haamura battora venistera hu shettissater im oto haish sheamar lah al tissatri immo bifne shene edim im shahata immo kede tuma shehu kede litzlot betza ulgamah hare zo asura al balah ad shettishte me hammarim veyibbadek haddavar uvizman sheen sham me sota teaser alav leolam vetetze belo ketubba
Kinne lah al shenayim keechad veamar lah al tissatri im peloni ufloni venistera im shenehen keechad veshahata kede tuma afillu hem shene acheha o aviha veachiha hare zo asura ad shettishte
Amar lah bifne shenayim al tedabberi im peloni en ze kinnuy veaf al pi shennistera immo beedim veshahata kede tuma lo neesra alav veenah shota bekinnuy ze

Vechen im amar lah al tissatri immo verauha medabberet immo en zo setira velo neesra velo shota vechen im lo kadam kinnuy uvau shenayim veheidu shennistera im ze veshahata kede tuma lo neesra al balah veenah shota

Amar lah lo tissatri im ish peloni vehaya katan pachot mibben tesha shanim veom echad o sheamar lah al tissatri im behema zo en ze kinnuy shenneemar veshachav ish otah perat lekatan velivhema sheen osrin otah alav

Baal shemmachal al kinnuo kodem shettissater kinnuo machul uchillu lo kinne lah meolam aval im machal achar shettissater eno yachol limchol gershah hare ze kemi shemmachal veim hechezirah tzarich lekanneot kinnuy acher

Kinne lah bifne shenayim veraa otah shennistera im ze shekkinne lah alav veshahata kede tuma hare zo asura alav veotzi veyitten ketubba sheeno yachol lehashkotah al pi atzmo vechen im shama haam merannenin achareha achar hakkinnuy vehassetira ad sheshshama mehannashim hattoot leor hallevana nosot venotnot bah shezzinneta im haish shekkinne lah alav hare ze asur lekayemah veotzi veyitten ketubba
Ba ed echad veheid lo shennistera immo achar kinnuy veshahata kede tuma im hu neeman lo vedato somechet alav yotzi veyitten ketubba veim lav hare ishto mutteret lo
Veellu shebbet din mekannin lahen mi shennitcharesh balah o shennishtatta o shehaya bimdina acheret o shehaya chavush bevet haasurin lo lehashkotah ella lefaslah mikketubbatah

Ketzad shamu bet din shehaam merannenin achareha korin otah veomrin lah al tissatri im ish peloni bau edim achar kach shennistera immo veshahata kede tuma bet din osrin otah al balah leolam vekorin ketubbatah uchsheyyavo balah o yavri o yatza mibbet haasurin noten lah get veeno yachol lehashkotah mippene shello kinne lah hu

En hannezakin mishtallemin veen chayyavin bechofer veen habbehema nehereget ella biraya berura uvedim hakkesherim lehaid shello tomar hoil veen metzuyin beurot hassusim uvrefet habbakar vegidrot tzon ella haavadim veharoim vechayyotze bahen im heidu shebbehema zo hizzika et zo shomin lahem veim heidu ketannim o nashim sheadam ze chaval et ze o heidu bishar nezakin somchin alehen en haddavar ken ella en mechayevin leolam mamon al pi edim ad sheyyihu edim hakkesherim lehaid shear eduyyot veyaidu vichayevu bet din hammazzik leshallem

Hayeta happara leechad vehavalad leechad hare pechat hashshumman sheppachat guf happara levaal happara ufchat hannefach cholkin oto baal happara im baal havalad vehannefel shel baal havalad

Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 10: Shor shehemit et haadam bechal makom ben gadol ben katan ben eved ben ben chorin echad tam veechad muad hare ze niskal veim hemit et haakkum patur kedinehem

Vehoil vechal behema chayya veof shehargu et haadam niskalin heach yimmatze muad laharog ad sheyeshallemu bealav et hakkofer kegon sheharag shelosha ovde kochavim veachar kach harag yisrael shehammuad leakkum hare ze muad leyisrael o sheharag shelosha yisrael terefa veachar kach harag shalem o sheharag uvarach uvarvii nitpas sheen habbealim chayyavin bechofer ad sheyyissakel hashshor vechen im sikken shelosha bene adam keechad o sheharag shalosh behemot hare ze muad lahariga uvalim meshallemin et hakkofer vechen im hikkiru edim et baal hashshor velo hikkiru et hashshor befaam rishona ushniyya ushlishit uvarviit rau shoro sheharag velo hau yodin im ze hu hashshor sheharag beshalosh peamim harishonot o acher haya hoil vehuadu habbealim sheyyesh lahem bivkaram shor sheharag shalosh peamim haya lahem lishmor kal behemtam umeachar shello shamru meshallemin et hakkofer

Ze shekkatuv battora vegam bealav yumat mippi hashshemua lamdu shechiyyuv mita zo bide shamayim veim natan kofer hanneherag mitkapper lo veaf al pi shehakkofer kappara memashkenin mi shennitchayyev bechofer beal karcho
Shor shel shene shuttafin sheharag kal echad mehem meshallem kofer shalem shehare kal echad mehen tzarich kappara gemura

En gomrin dino shel shor ella bifne bealav im hau lo bealim aval im lo hau lo bealim kegon shor hammidbar veshor shel hekdesh veshor shel ger shemmet veen lo yorshin im hemit hare ze niskal vegomrin dino af al pi sheen lo bealim vechen shor haishsha veshor hayetomim veshor haappotroppesim shehemitu niskalin veen haappotroppesim meshallemin et hakkofer shehakkofer kappara hu veen hakketannim vehachershim vehashshotim bene chiyyuv kede sheyyihu tzerichin kappara

En habbehema niskelet im hemita ad shennitkavvena lehazzik lemi shehi chayyevet alav sekila aval shor shehaya mitkaven laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam nitkavin leakkum veharag leyisrael nitkaven linfalim veharag ben kayyama patur min hammita veim haya muad habbealim chayyavin bechofer o biknas im hemit eved veaf al pi sheharag belo kavana hoil vehu muad laze

En habbealim meshallemin et hakkofer ad shettamit behemtan chutz mershutan aval im hemit birshut hammazzik af al pi shehu biskila habbealim peturin min hakkofer ketzad hannichnas lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshuto vaafillu nichnas litboa secharo o chovo mimmennu ungacho shoro shel baal habbayit umet hashshor biskila vehabbealim peturin min hakkofer shehare en lo reshut likkanes lirshuto shel ze shello middato
Amad bappetach vekara levaal habbayit veamar lo hen venichnas ungacho shoro shel baal habbayit hare habbealim peturin sheen mashma hen ella amod bimkomcha ad sheadabber immecha

Para meubberet shehemita et haadam vechen kal behema shenneevda bah avera hare ebbarah kamoha hi veebbarah nagcha hi veubbarah nirbea

Nafal letocho shor pesule hammukdashin umet hare ze patur shenneemar vehammet yihye lo mi shehammet shello yatza ze shehu asur bahanaa vedino sheyyikkaver

Vechen shor shel hedot veshel pesule hammukdashin shennagchu keechad im tam hu ze shel hedot meshallem chatzi nezek veim muad nezek shalem shehannizak omer lo kal sheuchal lehotzi mizze otzi vehashshear mimmecha veze hoil vehekdesh hu ufatur atta teshallem li hakkol
Mi shehaya chofer bor birshut harabbim venafal alav shor vaharago baal hashshor patur veim met hashshor notel baal hashshor deme shoro miyyorshe baal habbor
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 13: Kelim shennaflu labbor venishtabberu baal habbor patur shenneemar venafal shamma shor o chamor mippi hashshemua lamdu shor velo adam chamor velo kelim afillu nafal shor bechelav umet hashshor venishtabberu kelav chayyav al habbehema ufatur al hakkelim

Habbor meavot nezikin hu vetoldotav kamohu muadin mittechillatan vechal hammanniach takkala hare zo toledet habbor veim huzzak bah adam o behema meshallem ze shehinniach hattakkala nezek shalem ben hifkir hattakkala ben lo hifkirah veim huzzeku bah kelim patur

Ketzad hammanniach avno o sakkino o tivno o massao vechayyotze bahen birshut harabbim vehuzzeku bahen ben adam ben behema chayyav nezek shalem vechen im hinnichan birshuto vehifkir reshuto velo hifkiran nitkal bakkarka venechbat betakkala zo vehuzzak bah chayyav baal hattakkala veim huzzeku kelim bechal ellu o nittannefu patur
Hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut vehirbitz gelalim venittannefu bahen kelav shel baal habbayit patur shehaggalal ze toledet bor hu velo matzanu bor shechiyyev bo al hakkelim

Hammanniach et hakkad birshut harabbim vehalach hamhallech venitkal bah ushvarah patur lefi sheen derech bene adam lehitbonen badderech keshehen mehallechin veim huzzak bah hare baal hakkad chayyav binzakav vaafillu hifkir hakkad shekkal hammafkir nezakav bemakom sheen lo reshut laasotah mittechilla chayyav keillu lo hifkiran

Hinniach et hakkad bemakom sheyyesh lo reshut lehannichah sham kegon mekom hakkeranot shel gittot vechayyotze bahen venitkal bah ushvarah chayyav veim huzzak bah hamhallech baal hakkad patur mippene shehaya lo lehistakkel veim hayeta afela o shemmille kal hadderech kaddim patur al sheviratah veim nitkal bah hare baal hakkad chayyav vechen kal kayyotze baze

Nishbera kaddo birshut harabbim vehuchlak echad bammayim o shellaka bacharaseha patur middine adam lefi sheanus hu vechayyav bedine shamayim mippene shello sillek hacharasim vahare hacharasim vehammayim kehefker velo hifkir ella achar shenneenas ulfichach patur veim nitkaven lizkot bacharaseha vehuzzak bahen acher chayyav vehu haddin lenafla gemallo velo heemidah vechal kayyotze bah veim huzzeku kelim bechal ellu patur ben hifkir ben lo hifkir kemo shebbearnu

Shene kaddarin shehau mehallechin badderech ze achar ze venitkal harishon venafal venitkal hashsheni barishon im haya larishon laamod velo amad chayyav harishon benizke sheni sheaf al pi shehu anus bishat nefila eno anus bihoto muttal badderech vahare hu yachol laamod veim lo haya lo laamod patur veaf al pi shello hizhir laze shennitkal bo mippene shehu tarud benafsho
Bamme devarim amurim shehu chayyav binzakav shel sheni keshehuzzak gufo shel sheni aval im huzzeku kelav patur sheeno chayyav al hakkelim babbor vechal takkala toledet bor hu kemo shebbearnu

Hakkadarim vehazzaggagim vechayyotze bahen shehau mehallechin ze achar ze venitkal harishon venafal venitkal hashsheni barishon vehashshelishi bashsheni vechal echad mehen yesh lo laamod velo amad harishon chayyav benizke gufo shel sheni ben shehuzzak begufo shel rishon hammuttal baaretz ben shehuzzak bemassao vehashsheni chayyav benizke gufo shel shelishi im huzzak begufo shel sheni aval im huzzak bemassao shel sheni shennafal patur shehare omer lo hashsheni bor ze shehu massai en ani hakkore oto shehare harishon hippil hashsheni im massao veim hizhiru ze et ze kullan peturin
Nafal harishon vehaya muttal lerochav hadderech venitkal echad berosho veechad beraglav veechad bevitno hare hu chayyav benizke kullan hoil vehaya lo laamod velo amad

Hashshofech et hammayim birshut harabbim vehuzzak bahen acher chayyav binzakav veim nittanfu kelav patur kemo shebbearnu nivleu hammayim baaretz venishara haaretz chalaka vehuchlak venafal vehuzzak bakkarka hare ze chayyav binzakav

Kal ellu sheppotkin bivotehen vegorfin mearotehen en lahen reshut lishpoch hammayim birshut harabbim bimot hachamma aval bimot haggeshamim yesh lahen reshut veaf al pi chen im huzzak adam o behema bammayim chayyavin nezek shalem

Lo yotzi adam tivno vekashsho lirshut harabbim kede sheyyadushu veyaasu lo zevel veim hotzi kenasuhu chachamim sheyyihu kehefker vechal hakkodem bahen zacha meet shenniddoshu vehishbichu veim kadam adam vezacha bahen mishsheat hotzaa lirshut harabbim en motziin miyyado veaf al pi shehen kehefker im huzzak bahen adam o behema hare ze hammotzi chayyav leshallem

Yesh lechal adam lehotzi et hazzevel vehaggelalim lirshut harabbim bishat hotzaat zevalim velitzbor otan sham sheloshim yom kede sheyyihye nishshof beragle adam veragle behema veaf al pi chen im hizzik chayyav leshallem vechayyavin al ze haggalal mishshum gezel kevan sheen bo shevach im niddosh lo kansu bo
En shorin tit birshut harabbim veen lovnim levenim aval govlin tit birshut harabbim aval lo levenim
Habbone birshut harabbim hammevi avanim mevi vehabbone bone vechullan shehizziku chayyavin leshallem nezek shalem

Hachotzev shechatzav even umsarah lesattat vehuzzak bah adam o behema hassattat chayyav vesattat shemmasar lechammar hachammar chayyav masar chammar lechattaf hakkattaf chayyav masar kattaf levone habbone chayyav mesarah habbone leze shemmetakken yeshivatah babbinyan hamtakken chayyav veim achar sheheeluha al gabbe haddimos nafla vehizzika vehau osin bekabbelanut kullan chayyavin uvischirut haacharon chayyav vechullan peturin

Hakkotel vehailan shennaflu lirshut harabbim vehizziku patur milleshallem veaf al pi shehifkiran lefi sheenan domim labbor shehare en techillatan lehazzik veim hau reuin bet din kovin lo zeman lakotz et hailan velistor et hakkotel vechamma hazzeman sheloshim yom naflu betoch hazzeman vehizziku patur leachar hazzeman chayyav mippene sheshshiha otan

Hammatznia et hakkotz veet hazzechuchit vehaggoder gedero bekotzim vehifriach lirshut harabbim vehuzzak echad bahen chayyav nezek shalem veim gadar bekotzim betzimtzum betoch reshuto patur lefi sheen derech bene adam lehitchakkech bakketalim

Hammatznia kotzav uzchuchiyyotav betoch katlo shel chavero uva baal hakkotel vesatar et katlo venafal lirshut harabbim vehizzik im kotel raua haya hammatznia chayyav veim kotel bari hu baal hakkotel chayyav

Chasidim harishonim hau matzniin et hakkotzim veet hazzechuchiyyot betoch sedotehem beomek shelosha tefachim baaretz kede shello taalem hammacharesha vaacherim sorfim otan beesh vaacherim mashlichim otan layyam o lannahar kede shello yuzzak bahen adam

Lo yesakkel adam mershuto lirshut harabbim ven osin chalal tachat reshut harabbim velo borot velo shichin velo mearot veaf al pi shehaagala yechola lehallech al gabbehen vehi teuna avanim shemma tippachet millematta shello middato vehachofer bor letzarche rabbim muttar

En motziin zizin ugzuzteraot lirshut harabbim ella im ken hau lemala miggamal verochvo vehu shello yaafil hadderech al bene reshut harabbim veim ratza kones letoch shello umotzio kanas velo hotzi hare ze motzi kal zeman sheyyirtze aval eno yachol lehachzir ketalim limkoman leolam shekkal metzar shehechziku bo rabbim asur lekalkelo
Lakach chatzer uvah zizin ugzuzteraot yotzot lirshut harabbim hare zo bechezkatah veim nafla chozer uvone otah keshehayeta

Ilan shehu note lirshut harabbim kotzetz kede sheyyihye haggamal over berochvo umannichin makom panuy mishshete siftot hannahar kerochav kitfe hammallachim sheyyordin sham umoshchin hassefina vechal ilan hannimtza berochav ze kotztzin oto miyyad veen matrin bivalav shehare meakkev moshche hassefina

Mi shehayeta derech harabbim overet betoch sadehu netalah untanah lahem min hatztzad ma shennatan natan vezachu bo veze shennatal lo zacha bo vechamma rochav derech harabbim en pachot mishshesh esre ammot
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 14: Hammadlik betoch sede chaviro veavra haddeleka vehizzika chayyav leshallem nezek shalem shenneemar ki tetze esh umatza kotzim veneechal gadish o hakkama vego shallem yeshallem hammavir vego vehabbeera meavot nezikin hi

Hidlik betoch reshuto tzarich leharchik missof hammetzar kede shello taavor haddeleka lisde chavero vechamma shiur haharchaka hakkol lefi govah haddeleka veim lo hirchik karauy veavra haesh vehizzika chayyav leshallem nezek shalem hirchik karauy veavra vehizzika patur shezzo makka bide shamayim hi vechen im avra nahar o shelulit sheyyesh bahen mayim verachban shemone ammot patur

Avra gader omdin govah haggader vegovah haddeleka vehaetzim o hakkotzim hammetzuyin sham im enah reuya laavor patur veim reuya laavor chayyav bamme devarim amurim beesh hakkodachat aval im haya lah lahav gadol haole venichpaf miggovah aliyyat hallahav vehau etzim metzuyin sham en lah omed ella afillu avra elef amma chayyav

Nafla deleka bachatzero venafal gader shello mechamat haddeleka veavra haddeleka bechatzer acheret im haya yachol ligdor haggader shennafal velo gedaro chayyav lema haddavar dome leshoro sheyyatza vehizzik shehaya lo leshamro velo shemaro

Hashsholeach et habbeera beyad cheresh shote vekatan patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim bamme devarim amurim shemmasar lahen gachelet velibbuha shedderech haggachelet lehikkavot meeleha kodem shettaavor vetadlik aval im masar lahen shalhevet chayyav shehare maasav garmu
Shalach et habbeera beyad pikkeach ze happikkeach shehivir chayyav leshallem vehashsholeach patur vechen im hinniach shomer lishmor habbeera hashshomer chayyav

Echad hevi et haur veechad hevi et haetzim hammevi et haetzim chayyav echad hevi et haetzim veechad hevi et haur hammevi et haur chayyav ba acher velibbah hamlabbe chayyav libbattu ruach sheenah metzuya tamid hare kullan peturin libba velibbattu haruach chayyav shehare hu garam vechal haggorem lehazzik meshallem nezek shalem min hayyafe shebbannechasim kishar kal hammazzikin

Esh sheyyatza veachla etzim o avanim o afar chayyav leshallem shenneemar umatza kotzim chu o hassade achla gadish vechayyotze bo vehau kelim temunim betoch haggadish im hau kegon morigim uchle bakar vechayyotze bahen middevarim shedderech anshe hassade letamnam baggadish chayyav leshallem hau begadim uchle zechuchit vechayyotze bahen patur al hakkelim

Bamme devarim amurim bemadlik betoch sede chavero aval bemadlik betoch shello veavra lisde chavero patur al kal hakkelim hattemunim baggadish aval meshallem hu shiur mekom hakkelim veroin oto keillu hu male gadish shel chittim o shel seorim

Hammadlik betoch sede chavero veyatza haesh veneechal haggadish vehaya gedi kafut lo veeved samuch lo venisraf immo chayyav shekken derech bene adam laasot begadish haya eved kafut lo ugdi samuch lo venisraf immo patur

Hammashil makom lachavero vehigdish bo vehitmin bo kelim vehidlik hammashil vesaraf haggadish eno meshallem ella deme gadish bilvad hishilo makom lehagdish chittim vehigdish seorim o lehagdish seorim vehigdish chittim o shehigdish chittim vechippam bisorim o shehigdish seorim vechippam bechittim eno meshallem lo ella deme seorim bilvad

Hammadlik et habbira shel chavero meshallem kal ma shebbetochah shekken derech bene adam lehanniach kal kelehem vechal cheftzehem babbattim vechal sheyyiton baal habbayit hare ze nishba binkitat chefetz venotel ushvua zo middivre sofrim kemo sheyyitbaer uvilvad sheyyiton devarim shehu amud bahen o shehu lamud lihot otan haddevarim shettaan pikkadon etzlo

Gamal shehu taun pishtan veover birshut harabbim venichnas pishtano letoch hachanut vedalka benero shel chenvani vehidlik et kal habbira baal haggamal chayyav mippene shehirba bemassooy ben sheamda habbehema ben shello amda hinniach hachenvani nero mibbachutz hachenvani chayyav af bidme pishtan mippene shehinniach nero mibbachutz vaafillu ner chanukka haya lo leshev velishmor

Hakkofef kamato shel chavero lifne haesh ad shettidlak im en haesh maggaat lah ella beruach sheenah metzuya patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim vehattomen kamato shel chavero beafar o beteven veavra haesh veachla otah hare hattomen patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim mippene shehammadlik et haesh patur al hattamun

Esh sheavra vehizzika et haadam vechavla bo hare hammavir chayyav binzakav uvshivto uvrippuo uvtzaaro uvvashto keillu hizziko beyado sheaf al pi sheishsho mamono hu hare hu kemo shehizzika bechitzav aval im hizzika behemto o boro et haadam eno chayyav ella benezek bilvad kemo shebbearnu

Kal toldot haesh hare hen keesh ketzad hinniach even o sakkin o massa berosh gaggo venaflu beruach metzuya vehizziku chayyav leshallem nezek shalem shekkal ellu vechayyotze bahen toldot habbeera hen veim naflu beruach sheenah metzuya vehizziku patur seliku lehu hilchot nizke mamon besad
Mishneh Torah, Murderer and the Preserva: Kal horeg nefesh ben adam over belo taase shenneemar lo tirtzach veim ratzach bezadon bifne edim mitato besayif shenneemar nakom yinnakem mippi hashshemua lamdu shezzo mitat sayif ben sheharag et chavero bevarzel ben shesserafo baesh mitato besayif

Mitzva beyad goel haddam laharog et harotzeach shenneemar goel haddam hu yamit et harotzeach vechal harauy lirushsha hu goel haddam lo ratza goel haddam o shello haya yachol lahamito o sheen lo goel dam bet din memitin et harotzeach besayif

Haav sheharag et beno im haya ben lanneherag hare ze horeg avi aviv mippene shehu goel veim en lo ben en echad min haachin naase goel haddam lehamit et aviv ella bet din memitin oto veechad hazzachar veechad hannekeva bigullat haddam

Umuzharin bet din shello likkach kofer min harotzeach vaafillu natan kal mamon shebbaolam vaafillu ratza goel haddam lefatro sheen nafsho shel ze hanneherag kinyan goel haddam ella kinyan hakkadosh baruch hu shenneemar velo tikchu chofer lenefesh rotzeach veen lecha davar shehikpida tora alav kishfichut damim shenneemar velo tachanifu et haaretz vego ki haddam hu yachanif et haaretz vego

Rotzeach sheharag bezadon en memitin oto haedim velo haroim oto ad sheyyavo levet din vidinuhu lemita shenneemar velo yamut harotzeach ad amdo lifne haeda lammishpat vehu haddin lechal mechuyeve mitot bet din sheavru veasu sheen memitin otan ad sheyyiggamer dinam bevet din

Bamme devarim amurim besheavar veasa heaon shechayyav alav mitat bet din aval harodef achar chavero lehargo afillu haya harodef katan hare kal yisrael metzuvin lehatztzil hannirdaf miyyad harodef vaafillu benafsho shel rodef

Ketzad im hizhiruhu vahare hu rodef acharav af al pi shello kibbel alav hatraa kevan sheadayin hu rodef hare ze neherag veim yecholim lehatztzilo beevar meevre harodef kegon sheyyakku oto bechetz o beeven o besayif veyikteu et yado o yishberu et raglo o yesammu et eno osin veim enan yecholin lechaven ulhatztzilo ella im ken haraguhu larodef hare ellu horgin oto af al pi sheadayin lo harag shenneemar vekatztzota et kappah lo tachos enecha

Echad bimvushav veechad kal davar sheyyesh bo sakkanat nefashot echad haish o haishsha inyan hakkatuv shekkal hachoshev lehakkot chavero hakkaa hammemita oto matztzilin et hannirdaf bechappo shel rodef veim enan yecholin matztzilin oto af benafsho shenneemar lo tachos encha

Af zo mitzvat lo taase shello lachus al nefesh harodef lefichach horu chachamim shehaubbara shehi maksha leled muttar lachtoch haebbar bemeeha ben besam ben beyad mippene shehu kerodef achareha lehargah veim mishshehotzi rosho en nogin bo sheen dochin nefesh mippene nefesh vezehu tivo shel olam

Echad harodef achar chavero lehargo o rodef achar naara meorasa leansah shenneemar ki kaasher yakum ish al reehu urtzacho nefesh ken haddavar hazze vahare hu omer tzaaka hannaara hamorasa veen moshia lah ha yesh lah moshia moshiah bechal davar sheyyachol lehoshia vaafillu baharigat harodef

Vehu haddin lishar kal haaraot chutz min habbehema aval hazzachur matztzilin oto benefesh harodef kishar kal haaraot aval harodef achar habbehema leravah o sheradaf laasot melacha beshabbat o laavod avoda zara af al pi shehashshabbat vaavoda zara ikkere haddat en memitin oto ad sheyyaase viviuhu levet din vidinuhu veyamut

Radaf achar erva utfasah veshachav immah veheera af al pi shello gamar biato en memitin oto ad amdo baddin radaf achar erva vaacherim hau rodfin acharav lehatztzilah veamra lahem hanichuhu kede shello yahargeni en shomin lah ella mavhilin oto umonin oto millivol beevarav veim enan yecholim lemano beevarav afillu benafsho kemo shebbearnu
Kal hayyachol lehatztzil beevar meevarav velo tarach bechach ella hitztzil benafsho shel rodef vaharago hare ze shofech damim vechayyav mita aval en bet din memitin oto

Kal hayyachol lehatztzil velo hitztzil over al lo taamod al dam reecha vechen haroe et chavero tovea bayyam o listim baim alav o chayya raa baa alav veyachol lehatztzilo hu beatzmo o sheyyiskor acherim lehatztzilo velo hitztzil o sheshshama ovde kochavim o mosrim mechashshevim alav raa o tomnin lo pach velo gilla ozen chavero vehodio o sheyyada beakkum o beones shehu ba al chavero veyachol lefayeso biglal chavero lehasir ma shebbelibbo velo piyeso vechal kayyotze bidvarim ellu haose otam over al lo taamod al dam reecha

Haroe rodef achar chavero lehargo o achar erva levaolah veyachol lehatztzil velo hitztzil hare ze bittel mitzvat ase shehi vekatztzota et kappah veavar al shene lavin al lo tachos encha veal lo taamod al dam reecha

Af al pi sheen lokin al lavin ellu mippene sheen maase bahen chamurim hem shekkal hamabbed nefesh achat miyyisrael keillu ibbed kal haolam kullo vechal hamkayyem nefesh achat miyyisrael keillu kiyyem kal haolam kullo
Kal hahoreg chavero beyado kegon shehikkahu besayif o beeven hammemita o shechanako ad shemmet o serafo beesh hoil vaharago mikkal makom hu beatzmo hare ze neherag bevet din

Aval hassocher horeg laharog et chavero o sheshshalach avadav vaharaguhu o shekkefato vehinnicho lifne haari vechayyotze bo vaharagathu chayya vechen hahoreg et atzmo kal echad meellu shofech damim hu vaaon hariga beyado vechayyav mita lashshamayim veen bahen mitat bet din

Uminnayin shekken hu haddin shenneemar shofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech ze hahoreg beatzmo shello al yede shaliach et dimchem lenafshotechem edrsh ze horeg atzmo miyyad kal chayya edreshennu ze hammoser chavero lifne chayya letarfo miyyad haadam miyyad ish achiv edrosh et nefesh haadam ze hassocher acherim laharog et chavero uvferush neemar bishlashtan leshon derisha hare dinam masur lashshamayim

Vechal ellu haratzchanim vechayyotze bahen sheenan mechuyyavin mitat bet din im ratza melech yisrael lehargam bedin hammalchut vetakkanat haolam harshut beyado vechen im rau bet din lehargam behoraat shaa im hayeta hashshaa tzericha lechach yesh lahem reshut kefi ma sheyyiru

Hare shello haragam hammelech velo hayeta hashshaa tzericha lechach lechazzek haddavar hare bet din chayyavin mikkal makom lehakkotam makka rabba hakkerova lemita leasram bematzor uvmatzok shanim rabbot ultzaaran bechal mine tzaar kede lehafchid ulayyem al shear harshaim shello yihye haddavar lahem lefuka ulmichshol veyomar hareni mesabbev laharog oyevay kederech sheasa peloni veeppater

Echad hahoreg et haggadol o et hakkatan ben yomo ben zachar ben nekeva hare ze neherag alav im harag bezadon o gole im harag bishgaga vehu shekkalu lo chodashav aval im nolad lefachot mittisha chodashim hare hu kenefel ad sheyyishhe sheloshim yom vehahorgo betoch sheloshim yom eno neherag alav
Echad hahoreg et habbari o et hachole hannote lamut vaafillu harag et haggoses neherag alav veim haya goses bide adam kegon shehikkuhu ad shennata lamut vahare hu goses hahorgo en bet din memitin oto

Hahoreg et hatterefa af al pi sheochel veshote umhallech bashshuk hare ze patur middine adam vechal adam bechezkat shalem vehahorgo neherag ad sheyyivada bevadday shezze terefa veyomru harofim shemmakka zo en lah teala baadam uvah yamut im lo yemitennu davar acher

Adam terefa sheharag et hannefesh neherag shenneemar uviarta hara mikkirbecha vehu sheyyaharog bifne bet din aval bifne edim patur shemma yazommu veim huzammu enan neheragin shehare lo zammu ella laharog terefa vechal edut sheenah reuya lahazama enah edut bedine nefashot
Echad hahoreg et yisrael o hahoreg eved kenaani hare ze neherag alav veim harag bishgaga gole

Barishona mi sheharag ger toshav eno neherag alav bevet din shenneemar vechi yazid ish al reehu veen tzarich lomar sheeno neherag al haakkum veechad hahoreg et eved acherim o hahoreg avdo hare ze neherag alav shehaeved kibbel alav mitzot venosaf al nachalat Adonai

Ma ben avdo leeved acherim sheavdo yesh lo reshut lehakkoto lefichach im hikkahu hakkaa sheyyesh bah kede lehamit venata lamut veamad esrim vearba shaot veachar kach met lo haya neherag alav af al pi shemmet mechamat hammakka shenneemar lo yukkam ki chaspo hu umahu yom o yomayim yom shehu keomayim shehu meet leet

Af al pi shehachovel beaviv bezadon chayyav mitat bet din kemo hahoreg shear adam im chaval beaviv o beimmo bishgaga eno chayyav galut shello chiyeva tora galut ella lehoreg nefesh adam bishgaga bilvad kemo shebbearnu
Mitzvat ase lehafrish are miklat shenneemar shalosh arim tavdil lach veen are miklat nohagot ella beeretz yisrael
Veshesh arim hau shalosh hivdil moshe rabbenu beever hayyarden veshalosh hivdil yehoshua beeretz kenaan

En achat meare miklat koletet ad sheyyuvdelu kullan shenneemar shesh are miklat tihyena lachem vehodianu moshe rabbenu sheen shalosh shebbeever hayyarden koltot ad sheyyuvdelu shalosh shebbeeretz kenaan velamma hivdilan amar hoil uvaa mitzva leyadi akayemenna

Bime hammelech hammashiach mosifin shalosh acherot al ellu hashshesh shenneemar veyasafta lecha od shalosh arim al hashshalosh haelle vehechan mosifin otan beare hakkeni vehakkenizzi vehakkadmoni shennichrat leavraham avinu berit alehen vaadayin lo nichbeshu vaalehen neemar battora veim yarchiv Adonai elohecha et gevulcha

Vechayyavin bet din lechaven hadderachim leare miklat letakkenam ulharchivan umsirin mehen kal michshol vechal takkala veen mannichin badderech lo tel velo gaye velo nahar ella osin alav gesher kede shello leakkev et habboreach lesham shenneemar tachin lecha hadderech verochav derech are miklat en pachot mishsheloshim ushtayim ammot umiklat miklat haya katuv al parashat derachim kede sheyyakkiru haratzchanim veyifnu lesham

Bachamishsha asar baadar bechal shana bet din motziin sheluchim letakken hadderachim vechal makom shemmetzauhu shennitkalkel metakkenim oto uvet din shennitrashshelu bedavar ze maale alehen hakkatuv keillu shafchu damim
Vechen moshchin ben kal ir veir meare miklat bitchillat hafrashatan ad sheyyihu meshullashot beshave shenneemar tachin lecha hadderech

Are miklat en osin otan lo ayarot gedolot velo kerakkim gedolim velo ketannim ella ayarot benoniyyot veen moshivin otan ella bimkom shevakim uvimkom hammayim veim en sham mayim machnisin letochan mayim veen moshivin otan ella bimkom uchlusin nitmaatu uchlusehen mosifin alehen nitmaatu diyyurehen machnisin letochan kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim veen porsin betochan metzudot veen mafshilin betochan chavalim kede shello yihye regel goel haddam metzuya sham
Kal are halviyyim koltot vechal achat mehen ir miklat hi shenneemar vaalehem tittenu arbaim ushtayim ir kal hearim asher tittenu lalviyyim arbaim ushmone ir hikkishan hakkatuv kullan zo lazo liklot

Uma hefresh yesh ben are miklat shehuvdelu lemiklat uven shear are halviyyim sheare miklat koltot ben ledaat ben shello ledaat hoil venichnas bahen niklat ushar are halviyyim enan koltot ella ledaat verotzeach haddar beare miklat eno noten sechar beto vehaddar bishar are halviyyim noten sachar levaal habbayit

Kal ir hakkoletet techumah kolet kamoha ilan sheomed betoch techum are miklat venofo note chutz lattechum mishsheyyaggia tachat hannof niklat haya omed chutz lattechum venofo note letoch hattechum mishsheyyaggia leikkaro niklat vehahorgo sham neherag alav veaf al pi shehattechum kolet en harotzeach dar bo shenneemar veyashav bah bah velo bitchumah

Harug shennimtza nofel laaretz velo noda mi hikkahu mannichin oto bimkomo veotzin chamishsha zekenim mibbet din haggadol shebbirushalayim shenneemar veyatzu zekenecha veshoftecha umoddin mimmennu el hearim shessevivot hechalal afillu nimtza betzad ir zo shehaddavar yadua bevadday shehi hakkerova mitzva limdod

Achar shemmoddin venoda hair hakkerova kovrin et hanneherag bimkomo vechozrin zikne yerushalayim limkoman uvet din shel otah hair meviin eglat bakar mishshel anshe otah hair umoridin otah el nachal sheshshotef bechazka vezehu etan haamur battora

Veorfin otah sham bekofitz meachareha uvet din shel otah hair im kal zekeneha afillu hem mea kullan rochatzin et yedehen sham bimkom arifatah veomrim sham betoch hannachal bilshon hakkodesh yadenu lo shafchu et haddam hazze veenenu lo rau kelomar shello ba leyadenu hanneherag hazze uftarnuhu belo mezonot velo reinuhu uftarnuhu belo levaya vehakkohanim omrim bilshon hakkodesh kapper leammecha yisrael veholchin lahen vehakkadosh baruch hu mechapper al haddam shenneemar venikkapper lahem haddam

Keshemmoddin min hechalal medakdekin bammidda veen mekadderin bah veen moddin ella leir sheyyesh bah bet din shel esrim ushlosha veen moddin lirushalayim sheyerushalayim en mevia egla arufa lefi shello nitchalleka lishvatim veneemar baadama asher Adonai elohecha noten lecha lerishtah

Nimtza karov lirushalayim o leir sheen bah bet din mannichin otah umoddin el shear haayarot hassemuchot lo nimtza samuch lassefar o leir sheyyesh bah akkum en moddin kal ikkar shehare ze bechezkat sheharaguhu akkum

En hair hakkerova mevia ella bizman shemminyan harov shebbah kemo minyan hair harchoka mimmenna aval im hau ellu shebbarchoka merubbin al anshe hakkerova mimmenna holchin achar harov vehamrubbin meviin haegla
Af al pi sheholchin achar harov min hattora veholchin achar hakkarov harov adif

Nimtza hanneherag mechuvan ben shette ayarot veanshe zo keanshe zo beshave yaviu egla achat beshuttafut veyatnu veyomru im zo hi hakkerova hare hi shellahen veellu yittenu lahem chelkam mattana veim ellu hem hakkerovim hare hu shellahen veellu yittenu lahen chelkam mattana lefi shei efshar letzamtzem vaafillu bide adam
Mehechan moddin mechatmo nimtza gufo bemakom echad verosho bemakom acher molichin hagguf etzel harosh vekovrim oto bimkomo vechen kal met mitzva molichin gufo etzel rosho venikbar bimkomo

Nimtzeu metim rabbim ze betzad ze moddin mechatmo shel kal echad veechad mehen veim hayeta ir achat kerova lechullam mevia egla achat al kullan nimtzeu ze al gabbe ze moddin min haelon kemot shehen munnachin
Neemar ki yimmatze chalal lo chanuk velo mefarper sheen ze nikra chalal baadama lo tamun begal nofel lo taluy beilan bassade lo tzaf al pene hammayim lo noda mi hikkahu ha im noda lo hau orfin
Afillu raa hahoreg ed echad afillu eved o ishsha o pasul leedut baavera lo hau orfin lefichach mishsherabbu haratzchanim begaluy batla egla arufa

Ed echad omer raiti et hahoreg veed echad hichchisho veamar lo lo raita hau orfin bamme devarim amurim keshebbau shenehem keachat aval im amar echad ani raiti et hahoreg hare ze neeman kishnayim leinyan ze veim ba achar kach ed echad vehichchisho veamar lo lo raita en mashgichin al divre haacharon veen orfin

Bau shenayim achar sheheid haechad vehichchishuhu veamru lo lo raita hare hen kishte eduyyot hammachchishot zo et zo veorfin ishsha omeret raiti et hahoreg veishsha acheret machcheshet otah veomeret lo rait hau orfin ben shebbau shettehen keachat ben shebbau zo achar zo shenayim omrim rainu veechad omer lahen lo reitem en orfin echad omer raiti ushnayim omrim lo lo raita hau orfin
Bamme devarim amurim keshehau shelashtan kesherim o pesulim aval im amar ed echad raiti hahoreg ushte nashim o shene pesulim omrim lo lo raita en orfin
Shette nashim o shene pesulim omrim rainu hahoreg veed echad machchisham veomer lo reitem orfim sheafilu mea nashim o mea pesulim veed echad machchish et kullan hare ellu keish echad veed echad
Shalosh nashim o shelosha pesulim omrim rainu hahoreg vearba nashim o arbaa pesulim omrim lo reitem orfin ze hakkelal bifsulin hallech achar rov hamminyan bechal makom
En din egla arufa noheg ella baaretz yisrael vechen beever hayyarden
Egla arufa bat shette shanim o pachot aval im hayeta bat shette shanim veom echad pesula veen hammumin poslin veaf al pi chen im hayeta terefa pesula kappara neemar bah kekadashim

Kal haavodot poslot et haegla kemo shepposlin befara adumma shenneemar asher lo ubbad bah velamma neemar ol achar shenneemar asher lo ubbad bah shehu kolel haol im shear avodot shehaol posel ben bishat melacha ben shello bishat melacha kevan shemmashcha beol tefach nifsela af al pi shello charash bah velo asa bah melacha ushar avodot en poslin ella ad sheat melacha

Kal melacha shehi letzarkah kegon peras tallito aleha mippene hazzevuvim eno poslah vechal shehi shello letzarkah kegon shepperas tallito aleha lenosah pesula vechen kal kayyotze baze kemo shebbearnu behilchot para adumma
En orfin et haegla ella bayyom lefi shenneemar bah kappara kekadashim vechal hayyom kasher laarifatah veen orfin shette eglot keachat sheen osin mitzot chavilot chavilot
Egla arufa asura bahanaa venikberet bimkom arifatah umishshettered lannachal teaser bahanaa af al pi sheadayin lo neerfa veim meta o nishchata achar yeridatah hare zo asura bahanaa vetikkaver

Nimtzeu haedim zommin hare zo mutteret bahanaa ketzad kegon sheamar ed echad ani raiti et hahoreg uvau shenayim vehichchishuhu veamru lo lo raita vehifrishu et haegla vehoriduha lannachal learfah al pihem veachar kach huzammu hashshenayim hare zo mutteret bahanaa

Nimtza hahoreg ad shello tearef haegla tetze vetire baeder nimtza achar shenneerfa tikkaver bimkomah sheal hassafek baa mittechillatah kippera sefekah vehalcha lah veaf al pi shennimtza harotzeach achar arifatah hare ze yehareg shenneemar veatta tevaer haddam hannaki

Hannachal shenneerfa bo haegla asur bizria vaavoda leolam shenneemar asher lo yeaved bo velo yizzarea vechal haoved sham avoda begufah shel karka kegon shecharash o chafar o zara o nata vechayyotze baellu hare ze loke umuttar lisrok sham pishtan ulnakker sham avanim shezze kemi shearag sham beged o tefaro sheenah melacha beguf hakkarka lechach neemar lo yeaved velo yizzarea ma zeria begufah shel karka af kal haavoda shenneesra sham enah ella begufah shel karka
Anshe ir kerova shennitacharu velo heviu egla arufa kofin otan umviin vaafillu leachar kamma shanim shechayyave egla arufa sheavar aleha yom hakkippurim chayyavim lehavi achar yom hakkippurim

Mitzvat ase laasot adam maake legaggo shenneemar veasita maake legaggecha vehu sheyyihye bet dira aval bet haotzarot uvet habbakar vechayyotze bahen eno zakuk lo vechal bayit sheen bo arba ammot al arba ammot patur min hammaake

Bayit shel shene shuttafin chayyavin bemaake shenneemar ki yippol hannofel mimmennu lo tala ella benofel im ken lamma neemar gaggecha lemaet batte kenesiyyot uvatte midrashot lefi sheenan asuyim ledira hayeta reshut harabbim gevoha miggaggo eno zakuk lemaake shenneemar ki yippol hannofel mimmennu velo letocho

Govah hammaake en pachot measara tefachim kede shello yippol mimmennu hannofel vetzarich lihot hamchitztza chazaka kede sheyyishshaen adam aleha velo tippol vechal hammeniach gaggo belo maake bittel mitzvat ase veavar al lo taase shenneemar velo tasim damim bevetecha veen lokin al lav ze mippene sheen bo maase

Echad haggag veechad kal davar sheyyesh bo sakkana verauy sheyyikkashel bah adam veyamut kegon shehayeta lo beer o bor bachatzero ben sheyyesh bo mayim ben sheen bo mayim chayyav laasot chulya gevoha asara tefachim o laasot lah kissuy kede shello yippol bah adam veyamut vechen kal michshol sheyyesh bo sakkanat nefashot mitzvat ase lahasiro ulhishshamer mimmennu ulhizzaher baddavar yafe yafe shenneemar hishshamer lecha ushmor nafshecha veim lo hesir veheniach hammichsholot hammeviin lide sakkana bittel mitzvat ase veavar be lo tasim damim
Harbe devarim asru chachamim mippene sheyyesh bahem sakkanat nefashot vechal haover alehen veomer hareni mesakken beatzmi uma laacherim alay bechach o eni makpid bechach makkin oto makkat mardut

Veellu hen lo yanniach adam piv al hassilon hamkalleach veyishte velo yishte ballayela min hanneharot umin haagammim shemma yivla aluka vehu eno roe velo yishte mayim megullim shemma shata mehen nachash vechayyotze bo mizzochale afar veyamut

Veellu hen hammashkin haasurin mishshum gilluy hammayim vehayyayin vaafillu mazug vaafillu hitchil taamo lehishtannot lechometz vehechalav vehaddevash vehatztzir aval shear kal hammashkin en makpidin al gilluyan sheen baale eres shotin mehen

Hashshum shennitrassek vaavattiach shennechtach venitgalla asur vechen kal kayyotze bahen yayin mevushshal veyayin toses en bahen mishshum gilluy vetoses hu hayyayin mishsheat derichato ad shelosha yamim veyayin o mayim o chalav shehau chammin kal zeman shehahevel ole mehen vechen mashkin shehaya hammashke yored millemala letochan tippa achar tippa vehu sheyyihye tored veored kal ellu en bahen mishshum gilluy shezzochale afar mityarim mibbibua hammashke umin hahevel veen shotin mimmennu

Me kevashin umi shelakot ume turmusin en bahen mishshum gilluy mayim sheshshara bahen kevashin ushlakot veturmusin im nishtanna taman en bahem mishshum gilluy veim en bahem noten taam asurin vechen mayim shehediach bahen perishim vedarmuskin lachole asurin mishshum gilluy
Yayin shennitchabber bo devarim chaddin kefilpelin o devarim marim keafsantin ad shennishtanna taamam en bo mishshum gilluy vehu haddin bishar hammashkin

Kal hammashkin haasurin mishshum gilluy shennitgallu ben bayyom ben ballayela asurin vaafillu haya betziddan adam yashen en emat yashen al hazzochalin vechamma yishhu veyeasru kede sheyyetze harachash mittachat ozen keli veyishte veyachzor limkomo

Shiur hammayim sheyyeasru im nitgallu kede sheyyihye hassam nikkar bahen umazzik aval im hau hammayim merubbin kede shettovad bahen hammara hare ellu muttarin ben bechelim ben bekarkaot vechen haddin bishar hammashkin

Mayan hammoshech kal shehu en bo mishshum gilluy lagin megulle shehinnicho beshidda teva umigdal o battik shello o babbor afillu amok mea amma o bemigdal gavoha mea amma o bitraklin meyuppe umsuyyad hare ze asur badak et hatteva o et hammigdal veachar kach hinnicho hare ze muttar veim haya bahen nekev asur kamma yehe bannekev kede shettikkanes etzba ketanna shel katan

Chavit shennitgalleta af al pi sheshshatu mimmennu tisha velo metu lo yishte asiri maase haya veamru sheshshata asiri umet mippene sheeres hannachash shaka lematta veyesh sam chamat zochale afar sheole vetzaf lemala veyesh sam shehi nitlet beemtza hammashke lefichach hakkol asur vaafillu sinneno bemisnenet vechen avattiach shennitgalla af al pi sheachlu mimmennu tisha velo metu lo yochal asiri

Mayim shennitgallu lo yishpechem lirshut harabbim velo yerabbetz bahem et habbayit velo yegabbel bahen et hattit velo yirchatz bahen panav yadav veraglav velo yashke mehen lo behemto velo behemat chavero aval mashke otan lechatul
Issa shennillosha bemayim megullin afillu hi shel teruma tissaref vaafillu neefet happat asura

Behema chayya o of shenneshachan hannachash vechayyotze bo o sheachlu sam hammemit haadam kodem sheyyishtanne begufan hare ellu asurim mishshum sakkanat nefashot lefichach behema chayya veof shennimtzeu chatuche raglayim af al pi shehen muttarin mishshum terefa hare ellu asurin mishshum sakkana shemma echad mizzochale afar neshachan ad sheyyibbadku ketzad bodkan tzole otan betannur im lo nitchattech habbasar velo nishtanna mishshear hatztzali hare ellu muttarin

Vechen nikkure teenim vaanavim vehakkishshuim vehaddilluin vehaavattichin vehammelaffonot afillu hau gedolim beoter ben telushin ben mechubbarin vaafillu hau betoch hakkeli kal sheyyesh bo lecha venimtza nashuch asur shemma nachash vechayyotze bo neshacho vaafillu raa tzippor o achbar yoshev umnakker hare ellu asurin shemma bimkom nekev nikkav

Teena o enav shennittal haoketz shellahen en bahem mishshum gilluy lefichach ochel adam teenim vaanavim ballayela veeno choshesh teena nekura sheyyavsha venaaset gerogeret utmara nekura sheyyavsha shettehen muttarot
Asur leadam litten maot o dinarim letoch piv shemma yesh alehen rok yavesh shel mukke shechin o metzorain o zea shekkal zeat adam sam hammavet chutz mizzeat happanim

Vechen lo yitten adam pas yado tachat shecho shemma naga beyado bimtzora o besam ra shehayyadayim askaniyyot velo yitten hattavshil tachat hammitta af al pi shehu osek bisuda shemma yippol bo davar hammazzik vehu eno roehu

Vechen lo yinotz hassakkin betoch haetrog o betoch hatztzenon shemma yippol adam al chuddah veyamut vechen asur laadam laavor tachat kir natuy o al gesher raua o likkanes lechurba vechen kal kayyotze beellu mishshear hassakkanot asur laavor bimkoman

Vechen asur lihudi lehityached im haakkum mippene shehen chashudim al shefichut damim velo yitlave immahen badderech paga akkum badderech machziro limino hau olin bemaale o yordim birida lo yihye yisrael lematta veakkum lemala ella yisrael lemala veakkum lematta shemma yippol alav lahamito veal yashoach lefanav shemma yarotz et gulgalto
Im shealo lean atta holech yarchiv lo et hadderech kederech shehirchiv yaakov leesav shenneemar ad asher avo el adoni seira

Asur likkach refua min haakkum ella im ken nityaashu mimmennu sheyyichye veasur lehitrappeot min haeppikoros veaf al pi shennityaashu mimmennu shemma yimmashchu acharav umuttar likkach refua min haakkum livhema o lemakka shebbagguf mibbachutz kegon melugma urtiyya veim hayeta makka shel sakkana asur likkach mimmennu vechal makka shemmechallelin aleha et hashshabbat en mitrappein mehem
Umuttar lishol lerofe akkum veyomar lo sam peloni yafe lecha vechach vechach taase aval lo yikkach mimmennu

Veasur lehistapper mehen birshut hayyachid shemma yahargennu im haya adam chashuv muttar mippene shemmityare lehargo veim dimma leakkum shehu adam chashuv kede sheyefached mimmennu velo yahargennu hare ze muttar lehistapper mimmennu

Asur limkor leakkum kal kele hammilchama veen mashchizin lahem et hazzayin veen mochrin lahen lo sakkin velo kolarin velo kevalim shel barzel velo shalshelaot shel barzel hindua velo dubbim vaaraot velo kal davar sheyyesh bo nezek larabbim aval mochrin lahen terisin sheenan ella lehagen
Uchshem sheasru limkor leakkum kach asru limkor leyisrael shemmocher leakkum umuttar limkor kele zayin lechayil shel bene hammedina mippene shehen meginnin al yisrael

Kal sheasur limkor leakkum asur limkor leyisrael shehu listim mippene shennimtza machazik yede ovre avera umachshilo vechen kal hammachshil iver bedavar vehissio etza sheenah hogenet o shechizzek yede ovre avera shehu iver veeno roe derech haemet mippene taavat libbo hare ze over belo taase shenneemar velifne iver lo titten michshl habba littol mimmecha etza ten lo etza hahogenet lo

Veasur lehassi etza tova leakkum o leeved rasha vaafillu lehassio etza sheyyaase devar mitzva vehu omed berisho asur velo nitnassa daniyyel ella al shehissi etza linvuchadnetztzar litten tzedaka shenneemar lahen malka milki yishpar alach

Mi sheppaga bachavero badderech uvhemto rovetzet tachat massaa ben shehaya aleha massa harauy lah ben shehaya aleha yoter mimmassaah hare ze mitzva lifrok mealeha vezo mitzvat ase shenneemar azov taazov immo

Velo yifrok veyannichennu nivhal veyelech ella yakim immo veyachzor veyiton massao aleha shenneemar hakem takim immo zo mitzvat ase acheret veim hinnicho nivhal velo parak velo taan bittel mitzvat ase veavar al mitzvat lo taase shenneemar lo tire et chamor achicha
Haya kohen vehabbehema rovetzet bevet hakkevarot eno mittamme lah keshem sheeno mittamme leheshshev aveda vechen im haya zaken sheen darko liton velifrok hoil veenah lefi kevodo patur

Ze hakkelal kal sheillu hayeta shello haya toen uforek hare ze chayyav liton velifrok beshel chavero veim haya chasid veose lifnim mishshurat haddin afillu haya hannasi haggadol veraa behemat chavero rovetzet tachat massaa shel teven o kanim vechayyotze bahen porek vetoen immo

Parak vetaan vechazra venafla chayyav liton velifrok paam acheret afillu mea peamim shenneemar azov taazov hakem takim immo lefichach tzarich lehiddaddot immo ad parsa ella im ken omer lo baal hammassa eni tzarich lecha

Meematay yitchayyev lifrok veliton immo mishsheyyirehu reiyya shehi kifgia shehare neemar ki tire veneemar ki tifga vechamma shiaru chachamim mishsheyyihye benehem matayim veshishshim veshesh amma ushne shelishe amma shehu echad mishshiva umechetza bemil haya rachok mimmennu yeter mizze eno zakuk lo
Mitzva min hattora lifrok immo bechinnam aval liton alav hare zo mitzva venotel secharo vechen beshaa shemmedadde immo ad parsa yesh lo sachar

Matza behemat chavero revutza af al pi sheen habbealim immah mitzva lifrok mealeha veliton aleha shenneemar azov taazov hakem takim mikkal makom im ken lamma neemar immo sheim haya baal habbehema sham vehalach veyashav lo veamar laze sheppaga bo hoil vealecha mitzva im ratzita lifrok levaddecha perok hare ze patur shenneemar immo veim haya baal habbehema zaken o chole chayyav liton velifrok levaddo

Ze shenneemar battora kaasher yitten mum baadam ken yinnaten bo eno lachavol baze kemo shechaval bachavero ella shehu rauy lechassero evar o lachavol bo kaasher asa ulfichach meshallem nizko vahare hu omer velo tikchu chofer lenefesh rotzeach lerotzeach bilvad hu sheen bo kofer aval lechesron evarim o lechabbalot yesh bo kofer
Vechen ze shenneemar bechovel bachavero umazziko lo tachos enecha shello tachus betashlumin shemma tomar ani hu ze veshello bechavana chaval bo arachamennu lechach neemar lo tachos enecha

Uminnayin shehu chayyav bevoshet bifne atzmo shehare neemar veshalcha yadah vehechezika bimvushav vekatztzota et kappah bichlal din ze kal hamvayyesh
Hamvayyesh eno chayyav al habboshet ad sheyyihye mitkaven shenneemar veshalcha yadah aval hamvayyesh chavero belo kavana patur lefichach yashen vechayyotze bo shebbiyyesh patur

Adam muad leolam ben shogeg ben mezid ben er ben yashen ben shikkor im chaval bachavero o hizzik mamon chavero meshallem min hayyafe shebbinchasav bamme devarim amurim shehayyashen chayyav leshallem bishnayim sheyyashnu keechad venithappech echad mehen vehizzik et chavero o kara bigdo aval im haya echad yashen uva acher veshachav betziddo ze shebba baacharona hu hammuad veim hizziko hayyashen patur vechen im hinniach keli betzad hayyashen ushvaro patur shezze shehinnicho hu hammuad sheppasha

Mi shennafal min haggag beruach metzuya vehizzik chayyav bearbaa devarim ufatur min habboshet nafal beruach sheenah metzuya chayyav benezek bilvad ufatur mearbaa devarim veim nithappech chayyav bakkol af bevoshet shekkal hammitkaven lehazzik af al pi shello nitkaven levayyesh chayyav bevoshet

Hammitkaven levayyesh et hakkatan uviyyesh et haggadol noten laggadol deme bashto shel katan nitkaven levayyesh haeved uviyyesh et ben chorin noten leven chorin deme bashto shel eved
