Masar shoro lishnayim vetaanu taanat gannav venishbeu vehoda echad mehem vehashsheni bau alav edim shenehen meshallemin et hakkeren veim tafas baal happikkadon et hakkefel en motziin miyyado veze shehu meshallem chomesh kishar hannishbain shevuat happikkadon shehodu meatzman

Baal happikkadon shettava et hashshomer venishba shennignav veachar kach hukkar haggannav vetava hashshomer et haggannav vehoda lo haggannav shegganav vetava baal happikkadon et haggannav vechafar uvau edim shegganav im beemet nishba hashshomer keshettaan shennignav niftar haggannav min hakkefel behodaato lashshomer veim besheker nishba en motziin hakkefel min haggannav veim tafsu habbealim hakkefel en motziin miyyadan tavu habbealim et hashshomer veshillem veachar kach hukkar haggannav utvauhu habbealim vehoda lahen shegganav veachar kach tevao hashshomer vechafar bo uvau edim shegganav en motziin hakkefel min haggannav veim tafas hashshomer et hakkefel en motziin miyyado vechen haddin betashlume arbaa vachamishsha im tavach haggannav o machar

Hattoen taanat gannav befikkadon shel katan af al pi shennatan lo keshehu katan utvao keshehu gadol venishba veachar kach bau edim hare ze patur min hakkefel shenneemar ki yitten ish veen netinat katan kelum vetzarich shettihye netina utvia shavin baggadol

Shomer shegganav mershuto kegon shegganav tale meeder shehufkad etzlo vesela mikkis shehufkad etzlo im yesh alav edim chayyav bechefel veaf al pi shehechzir hassela limkomo vehattale leedro hare ze chayyav beacharautan ad sheyyodia habbealim shehare kalta shemirato uchillu lo hechzir kelum ad sheyyodia bealav aval haggonev sela mikkis chavero o keli mibbeto vehechzir davar hagganuv mibbeto limkomo im yadu habbealim bignevato velo yadu bachazirato adayin haggannav chayyav beacharauto ad sheyyimne et meotav
Mana et kiso umtzao shalem hamminyan patur veim lo yadu habbealim lo bignevato velo bachazirato afillu minyan eno tzarich ella kevan shehecheziro limkomo niftar meacharauto

Bamme devarim amurim bedavar sheen bo ruach chayyim aval haggonev tale meeder chavero veyadu bo habbealim vehecheziro laeder shello middaat habbealim umet o nignav chayyav beacharauto veim manu et hatztzon vehi shelema patur veim lo yadu habbealim lo bignevato velo bachazirato af al pi shemmanu et hatztzon vehi shelema chayyav beacharauto ad sheyyodia et habbealim kede sheyyishmeru et hattale hagganuv shehare limdo derech acheret chutz midderech shear hatztzon shebbeeder ze
Mishneh Torah, Theft 5: Asur liknot min haggannav hachefetz shegganav veaon gadol hu shehare machazik yede ovre avera vegorem lo lignov genevot acherot sheim lo yimtza lokeach eno gonev veal ze neemar cholek im gannav sone nafsho

Haggonev umachar velo nityaashu habbealim veachar kach hukkar haggannav uvau edim shezze hachefetz shemmecharo peloni ze hu genavo befanenu chozer hachefetz livalav vehabbealim notnin lallokeach damim sheshshakal laggannav mippene takkanat hashshuk vehabbealim chozrin veosim din im haggannav veim ganav mefursam hu lo asu bo takkanat hashshuk veen habbealim notnin lallokeach kelum ella chozer hallokeach veose din im haggannav umotzi mimmennu damim sheshshakal lo

Nityaashu habbealim min haggeneva ben shennityaashu veachar kach machar haggannav ben shennityaashu achar shemmachar kana hallokeach beyeush veshinnuy reshut veeno machzir haggeneva atzmah livaleha ella noten lahem haddamim im lakach miggannav mefursam o eno noten kelal lo chefetz velo damim mippene takkanat hashshuk im lo haya ze hammocher gannav mefursam

Bizman shehallokeach ose din im baal habbayit im en edim bechamma lakach hare hattaggar nishba binkitat chefetz bechamma lakach venotel min habbealim vechal hannishba venotel shevuato middivrehem venishba binkitat chefetz kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo

Bizman shehallokeach ose din im haggannav vehu omer bechach vechach lakachti mimmecha vehu omer lo macharti lecha ella befachot mizze hattaggar nishba binkitat chefetz venotel min haggannav sheen haggannav yachol lishshava mippene shehu chashud al hashshevua

Ganav ufara bechovo ganav ufara behekkefo en baze takkanat hashshuk ella habbealim notlim haggeneva belo damim veyishshaer chov ellu al haggannav keshehaya mishken haggeneva ben shemmishkenah beyeter al dameha o befachot middameha habbealim notnin levaal hammashkon vechozrin veosin din im haggannav ella im ken haya haggannav mefursam kemo shebbearnu

Hallokeach miggannav sheeno mefursam ben shellakach mimmennu sheve mea bematayim o sheve matayim bemea hare ze notel haddamim mibbaal habbayit veachar kach machzir haggeneva mippene takkanat hashshuk kemo shebbearnu

Haya noshe begannav mea zuz veganav vehevi levaal chovo venatan lo mea acheret hare haggeneva chozeret livaleha veomrin laze lech utva haggannav bematayim shello natatta lo hammea haacheret mippene hachefetz shehevi lecha bilvad keshem sheheemanto barishona heemanto baacharona

Lakach miggannav sheeno mefursam bemea umachar leacher bemea veesrim vehukkar haggannav baal haggeneva noten leze haacharon mea veesrim venotel genevato vechozer habbaal venotel esrim shel sachar min hammocher venotel hammea min haggannav veim gannav mefursam hu notel hammea veesrim min hattaggar shellakach min haggannav veholech hattaggar vetovea haggannav bemea shel keren vehu haddin im machar hashsheni lishlishi vehashshelishi lirvii afillu mea shehu notel mikkal echad veechad ma shenniskar venotel hakkeren min haggannav vechal haddevarim haellu lifne yeush kemo shebbearnu

Baal habbayit sheeno asuy limkor et kelav veyatza lo shem geneva bair vehikkir kelav usfarav beyad acherim o shehaya asuy limkor vehau kelim ellu shehikkir mikkelim haasuyin lehashil ulhaskir im bau edim shezze kelav shel ze yishshava ze shehen beyado binkitat chefetz bechamma lakach veyittol mibbaal habbayit veyachzir lo kelav

Haya baal habbayit asuy limkor et kelav velo hau middevarim haasuyin lehashil ulhaskir af al pi sheyyatza lo shem geneva bair vehukkeru kelav eno machaziran miyyad hallakochot shemma hu mecharan laacherim aval im bau bene adam velanu betoch beto veamad vezaak ballayela nignevu kelay usfaray uvau bene adam umatzu machteret chatura uvne adam shellanu betoch beto yotzin utzrorot shel kelim al kitfehem vehakkol omrim hallalu kelav usfarav shel peloni hare ze neeman veyishshava ze shehakkelim beyado binkitat chefetz kamma hotzi veyittol mibbaal haggeneva veyachzir lo kelav

Ganav shehuchzak venitparsem shennichnas letoch bet chavero veedim meidim sheyyatza vechelim temunim lo tachat kenafav af al pi shehaya sham baal habbayit vetaan veamar lekuchin hen beyadi uvaal habbayit omer genuvim hem im haya baal habbayit sheen darko limkor et kelav veotam kelim en derech bene adam lehatminan veen derech oto hammuchzak lehatznia kelav tachat kenafav hare baal habbayit neeman veyishshava binkitat chefetz venotel kelav veim en adam ze muchzak bigneva en baal habbayit neeman ella nishba ze shehakkelim beyado shevuat hesset shehakkelim haellu lekuchim beyado veholech
Mishneh Torah, Theft 6: Kal davar shechezkato shehu ganuv asur likkach oto vechen im rov oto haddavar shehu ganuv en lokchin oto lefichach en lokchim min haroim tzemer o chalav o gedayim aval lokchin mehen chalav ugvina bammidbar aval lo bayyishshuv umuttar likkach min haroim arba tzon o arba gizzot shel tzemer meeder katan o chamesh meeder gadol sheen chezkato shehu ganuv bedavar ze
Kelalo shel davar kal sheharoe mochro im haya baal habbayit margish bo muttar lelakcho min haroe veim en baal habbayit margish bo asur lelakcho

En lokchin mishshomre perot etzim o perot ella bizman shehen yoshvin umochrim vehassallim vehappeles lifnehem shehare haddavar galuy veyesh lo kol veen ze geneva velokchin mippetach hagginna aval lo meachore hagginna vechullan sheamru hatmen asur lakachat mehen umuttar lakachat min haaris shehare yesh lo chelek bapperot uvaetzim

En lokchin min hannashim umin haavadim umin hakketannim ella devarim shechezkatan shehen shellahen middaat habbealim kegon nashim shemmachru kele pishtan baggalil o agalim bashsharon vechullan sheamru hatmen asur likkach mehen mippene shehen bechezkat geneva velokchim betzim vetarnegolim bechal makom mikkal adam veim amar hatmen asur
Lokchin min habbaddadin zetim bemidda veshemen bemidda aval lo zetim muatim velo shemen muat shechezkato geneva hem vechen kal kayyotze bahem

Mochin shehakkoves motzi hare ellu shello veshehassorek motzi hare ellu shel baal habbayit hakkoves notel shelosha chutin vehen shello yeter mikken shel baal habbayit im haya shachor al gabbe lavan notel et hakkol vehem shello
Hachayyat sheshshiyyer min hachut kede meshichat machat veshiyyer min habbeged matlit shehi shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot chayyav lehachziran labbealim pachot mikkan shello

Nesoret shehecharash motzi bemaatzad shello bechashshil shel baal habbayit veim haya ose etzel baal habbayit af hannesoret shel baal habbayit vechal haddevarim haellu vechayyotze bahen holchin bahen achar minhag hammedina

Kal umman shemmachar davar min haddevarim sheeno shello kehilchot hammedina kegon mochin shemmecharan hassorek bemakom shennahagu sheyyihu shel baal habbayit asur likkach mimmennu mippene shehen bechezkat geneva aval lokchin mimmennu kar male mochin veim machar haumman devarim shehen shello kehilchot medina lokchin mimmennu veim amar hatmen asur
Mishneh Torah, Theft 7: Hashshokel lachavero mimmishkalot chaserot min hammishkal shehiskimu alav bene otah hammedina o hammoded bemidda chasera min hammidda shehiskimu aleha hare ze over belo taase shenneemar lo taasu avel bammishpat bammidda bammishkal uvammesura
Af al pi shehammoded o hashshokel chaser gonev eno meshallem lo tashlume kefel ella meshallem lo hammidda o hammishkal veen lokin al lav ze mippene shehu chayyav betashlumin

Kal mi shemmashhe beveto o bachanuto midda chasera o mishkal chaser over belo taase shenneemar lo yihye lecha bechischa vego vaafillu laasot hammidda avit shel meme raglayim asur sheaf al pi sheen ze lokeach umocher bah shemma yavo mi sheeno yodea shehi chasera veyimdod bah veen lokin al lav ze shehare en bo maase

Hau hammiddot vehammishkalot shel bene hair chatumot bechotam yadua vezo hammidda o hammishkal hachaserim belo chotam hare ze muttar lashhotam lishar tashmishe habbayit kayyotze baze sela shennifgema min hatztzad lo yaasenna mishkal ben mishkelotav velo yizrekenna ben gerutotav velo yikkavenna veyitlenna betzavar beno shemma yavo acher veyaasenna mishkal ella o yishchok o yachtoch o yakotz o yashlich leyam hammelach

Chasra veamda al mechetza yekayyem amda al pachot mimmechetza o al yeter mimmechetza yakotz ad sheyyaamidenna al mechetza veim lo chasra ella pachot mishshetut yekayyem laset velatet bah aval lo lemishkal shekkal pachot mishshetut rov bene adam mochalin bo bemassa uvmattan
Sela shennifgema baemtza asur lemachrah leharag o lecharam mippene shemmerammin bah et acherim aval nokvah vetole otah betzavar hakkatan

Ose adam middotav sea vachatzi sea verova sea vekav vachatzi kav verova hakkav vachatzi harova ushminit harova aval lo yaase kabbayim shello titchallef berova hassea shehu kav umechetza vechen bemiddot hallach ose hin vachatzi hin ushlishit hahin urviit hahin velog vachatzi log urviit ushminit veechad mishshemona bashsheminit velo asru laasot shelishit hin urviit hin af al pi shemmitchallefin ze baze hoil vehau bammikdash mimot moshe rabbenu

Echad hannose vehannoten im yisrael o im akkum im madad o shakal bechaser over al lo taase vechayyav lehachzir vechen asur lehatot et haakkum becheshbon ella yedakdek immo shenneemar vechishshav im konehu af al pi shehu kavush tachat yadecha kal vachomer leakkum sheeno kavush tachat yadecha vahare hu bichlal ki toavat Adonai elohecha kal osho elle kol osho avel mikkal makom

Vechen bemiddat hakkarka im hita et chavero bimshichat hakkarka over belo taase shenneemar lo taasu avel bammishpat bammidda bammidda zo middat hakkarka vechen hu inyan pasuk ze lo taasu avel bammishpat lo bemishpat hammishkal velo bemishpat hammidda afillu midda ketanna kimsura
Bene chavura hammakpidim ze al ze shehechlifu chelek bechelek o lava mimmennu maachal vehechzir lo ovrin mishshum midda umishshum mishkal umishshum minyan umishshum lovin uforin beom tov

Hammassig gevul reehu vehichnis mittechum chavero betoch techumo afillu melo etzba im bechazka asa hare ze gazlan veim hissig basseter hare ze gannav veim beeretz yisrael hissig haggevul hare ze over bishne lavin belav geneva o belav gezela uvlav lo tassig veen chayyav belav ze ella beeretz yisrael shenneemar benachalatcha asher tinchal

Kashe anshan shel middot yeter meanshan shel araot shezze beno leven hammakom veze beno leven chavero vechal hakkofer bemitzvat middot kechofer bitziat mitzrayim shehi techillat hatztziuuy vechal hamkabbel alav mitzvat middot hare ze mode bitziat mitzrayim shehi garma lechal hatztziuuyin
Mishneh Torah, Theft 8: Mitzvat ase letzaddek hammoznayim vehammishkalot vehammiddot yafe yafe uldakdek becheshbonan bishat asiyyatan shenneemar mozne tzedek vego vechen bemiddat hakkarka tzarich ledakdek becheshbon meshichat hakkarka al pi haikkarim hammitbaarim bechitve haggimatriyya sheafilu melo etzba min hakkarka roin otah keillu hi melea karkom
Arba ammot hassemuchin lecharitz mezalzelin bimshichatan vehassemuchim lisfat hannahar en moshchin otan kelal mippene shehen shel bene reshut harabbim

Vehammoded et hakkarka lo yamod leechad bimot hachamma ulechad bimot haggeshamim mippene shehachevel mitkatztzer bimot hachamma lefichach im madad bekane o beshalshelet shel barzel vechayyotze bahem en bechach kelum

En osin mishkalot lo shel barzel velo shel oferet velo shel shear mine mattachot kaellu mippene shemmaalin chaluda umitchasserin aval osin shel tzechiach sela veshel zechuchit veshel even shoham vechayyotze bahen
En osin et hammachak lo shel delaat mippene shehu mekel velo shel mattechet mippene shehu machbid aval osehu shel zayit veshel egozim veshel shikma veshel eshkeroa vechayyotze bahen
En osin et hammachak tziddo echad katzar vetziddo echad ave velo yimchok meat meat mippene shemmafchito lammocher velo yimchok bevat achat mippene shemmafchito lallokeach

En tomnin et hammishkalot bemelach kede sheyyifchatu velo yartiach bemiddat hallach beet shemmoded vaafillu hayeta hammidda ketanna beoter shehare hattora hikpida al hammiddot bechal shehu shenneemar uvammesura vehi midda achat ketanna mishsheloshim ushlosha belog

Mochre ashashiyyot shel barzel vechayyotze bahen tzarich lihot chute hammoznayim sheochez hashshokel beyado taluy baavir shelosha tefachim ugvohin min haaretz shelosha tefachim veorech kene hammoznayim veorech hachutim shenem asar tefach
Moznayim shel mochre tzemer veshel mochre zechuchit yihye orech hachutim shehen teluyin bo shene tefachim ugvohin min haaretz shene tefachim vehakkane vehachutin arkan tisha tefachim
Moznayim shel chenvani veshel baal habbayit yihye orech hachut shehen teluyim bo tefach ugvohin min haaretz tefach vehakkane vehachutin arkan shishsha tefachim

Hachut shettolin bo happeles vechen chut moznayim shel zahav veshel mochre argaman tov arko shalosh etzbaot ugvohin min haaretz shalosh etzbaot veorech happeles veorech hashshalshelaot shello kefi ma shehu rotze
Minnayin shechayyav hammocher lehachria lallokeach beet sheshshokel lo shenneemar even shelema vatzedek yihye lach amra tora tzaddek mishshellecha veten lo

Vechamma belach echad lemea uvyavesh echad learba meot ketzad machar lo eser litra lach noten lo gerumin echad measara belitra veim machar lo esrim litrin yavesh noten lo gerumav echad meesrim belitra vechen lefi cheshbon ze ben rav ben meat
Bamme devarim amurim bemakom shennahagu limkor ayin beayin aval bemakom shennahagu lehachria chayyav lehachria lo tefach
Haya shokel lo eser litrin lo yomar lo shekol achat achat vehachra ella shokel lo asara bevat achat vehechrea echad lechullan
Makom shennahagu lamod bedakka lo yamod begassa begassa lo yamod bedakka limchok lo yigdosh veosif bedamim vechen im nahagu ligdosh lo yimchok veyifchot min haddamim ella moded keminhag hammedina
Bene medina sheratzu lehosif al hammiddot o al hammishkalot lo yosifu yeter al shetut sheim haya hakkav mechil chamishsha vaasauhu mechil shishsha harshut beyadan yeter al shishsha lo yaasu

Hassiton mekanneach et middotav achat lishloshim yom uvaal habbayit achat lishnem asar chodesh vehachenvani mekannechan paamayim beshabbat ummache mishkelotav paam achat beshabbat umkanneach moznayim al kal mishkal umishkal kede shello yachlidu

Hamvakkesh lishkol shelosha revie litra noten litra bechaf moznayim vehabbasar urvia litra bechaf sheniyya sheim atta omer noten chatzi litra urvia litra bechaf achat shemma yippol revia hallitra veen hallokeach roehu

Chayyavin bet din lehaamid shotrim bechal medina umdina uvchal pelech ufelech sheyyihu mechazzerin al hachanuyyot umtzaddekin et hammoznayim veet hammiddot ufoskin hashshearim vechal mi shennimtza immo mishkal chaser o midda chasera o moznayim mekulkalin yesh lahem reshut lehakkoto kefi kocho ulkanso kefi reot bet din lechazzek haddavar vechal mi shemmafkia et hashshaar umocher beyoker makkin oto vechofin oto umocher keshaar hashshuk
Mishneh Torah, Theft 9: Kal haggonev nefesh adam over belo taase shenneemar lo tignov pasuk ze haamur baaseret haddevarim hi azhara legonev nefashot vechen hammochro over belo taase shezze bichlal lo yimmachru mimkeret aved veen lokin al shene lavin ellu mippene shehu lav shennittan leazharat mitat bet din shenneemar ki yimmatze ish gonev nefesh meechav vego umitato bechenek

En haggannav chayyav mitat chenek ad sheyyignov et hayyisrael veyachnisenu lirshuto veyishtammesh bo veyimkerennu laacherim shenneemar vehitammer bo umcharo vaafillu lo nishtammesh bo ella befachot mishsheve peruta kegon shennishan alav o nismach bo af al pi shehannignav yashen hare ze nishtammesh bo

Genavo venishtammesh bo umcharo vaadayin hagganuv birshut atzmo velo hichniso haggannav lirshuto patur genavo vehotzio lirshuto venishtammesh bo velo mecharo o mecharo kodem shennishtammesh bo o nishtammesh bo umcharo leechad mikkerovav shel ganuv kegon shemmecharo leaviv o leachiv hare ze patur shenneemar gonev nefesh meechav ad sheyyavdilennu meechav umikkerovav bammechira vechen im genavo vehu yashen venishtammesh bo keshehu yashen umcharo vaadayin hu yashen hare ze patur
Vechen im ganav ishsha umcharah leubbareha bilvad kegon shehitna al hallokeach shezzo hashshifcha li veen lecha ella havveladot hare ze patur

Haggonev et beno o et achiv hakkatan vechen haappotroppin shegganvu et hayetomim shehen semuchin etzlam uvaal habbayit shegganav echad mibbene beto hassemuchin al shulchano umlammed tinokot shegganav echad min hakketannim hallomdim etzlo af al pi shennishtammesh bo umcharo patur shenneemar venimtza veyado perat leellu shehen metzuyin beyadam

Echad haggonev et haggadol o haggonev et hakkatan ben yomo shekkalu lo chodashav ben zachar ben nekeva ben shehaya haggannav ish o ishsha hare ellu neheragin shenneemar gonev nefesh mikkal makom veechad haggonev et yisrael o shegganav ger o eved meshuchrar shenneemar nefesh meechav veellu bichlal achenu hen betora uvmitzot aval haggonev et haeved o mi shechetzo eved vechetzo ben chorin patur

Habba bammachteret ben bayyom ben ballayela en lo damim ella im harago baal habbayit o shear haadam peturin urshut yesh lakkol lehargo ben bechol ben beshabbat bechal mita sheyecholin lahamito shenneemar en lo damim

Veechad habba bammachteret o gannav shennimtza betoch gaggo shel adam o betoch chatzero o betoch karpifo ben bayyom ben ballayela velamma neemar machteret lefi shedderech rov haggannavim lavo bammachteret ballayela

Umippene ma hittira tora damo shel ganav af al pi shebba al iske mamon lefi shechezkato sheim amad baal habbayit lefanav umnao yahargenu venimtza ze hannichnas levet chavero lignov kerodef achar chavero lehargo ulfichach yaharog ben shehaya gadol ben shehaya katan ben zachar ben nekeva

Haya haddavar barur levaal habbayit shezze haggannav habba alav eno horgo velo ba ella al iske mamon asur lehargo veim harago hare ze horeg nefesh shenneemar im zarcha hashshemesh alav im barur lecha haddavar kashemesh sheyyesh lo shalom immecha el tahargehu lefichach av habba bammachteret al beno eno neherag shevadday sheeno horgo aval habben habba al aviv neherag

Vechen haggannav shegganav veyatza o shello ganav umtzao yotze min hammachteret hoil ufana oref veeno rodef yesh lo damim vechen im hikkifuhu bene adam o edim af al pi sheadayin hu birshut ze shebba alav eno neherag veen tzarich lomar im ba levet din sheeno neherag

Vketzad osin mochrin otah kullah lemi sheyyakriv otah vedameha chullin chutz middeme oto evar veim haya evar shehanneshama teluya bo pashta kedushsha bechullah

Vechen haomer rosh eved ze o lev chamor ze hekdesh lammizbeach o sheamar roshi hekdesh lammizbeach eno chayyav ella bidme rosho veroin kamma yishve oto evar illu haya nimkar veyavi bedamav karban

Vechal mi shehecherim o hikdish kal nechasav lokchin kal ma sheyyesh lo vaafilu tefillin shebberosho veen tzarich lomar kele ummenuto uvgadav shehakkol hekdesh o cherem
