Hammakdish kal nechasav vehayeta alav ketubbat ishsha o shitre baale chovot en haishsha yechola ligbot ketubbatah min hahekdesh velo baal chov et chovo shehahekdesh mafkia hashshibud shekkadam aval kesheyyimkor hahekdesh hakkarka shello vetetze hassade lechullin yesh levaal chov ulishsha ligbot min happode shehare shibudah omed al karka zo
Ha lema ze dome lishne lakochot shekkatva larishon din udvarim en li immecha umachar lashsheni shehi torefet min hashsheni

Vechetzad podin karka ze mashbiin et haishsha o baal chov techilla kederech kal habba lippara minnechasim meshubadim veachar kach machrizin alehem shishshim yom babboker uvaerev kemo shebbearnu veomdin kamma adam rotze litten bassade al menat litten leishsha ketubbatah ulvaal chov et chovo veachar sheppodin otah velokeach otah hallokeach afillu bedinar kede shello yomru hekdesh yotze belo pidon chozer happode umagbe laishsha ketubbatah o labbaal chov et chovo afillu haya hachov mea vehassade shava tishim al menat kach pode otah harotze lifdotah aval im haya hachov shenayim bidme hassade kegon shehayeta shava mea veyesh alav chov uchtubbat ishsha matayim en podin otah al menat litten hachov o hakketubba ella podin otah setam sheim hitnu litten enah nifdet kelal

Hammakdish kal nechasav veachar kach geresh et ishto vegavta ketubbatah min happode min hahekdesh eno gove ad sheyyaddirenna hanaa shemma kenunya asu al hahekdesh veen omrin illu ratza haya omer betaut hikdashti veyishshael al hekdesho lechacham veyachzor lo

Vechen en neeman lomar achar shehikdish mane lifloni chov alay o keli ze shel peloni hu shemma yaasu kenunya al hahekdesh vaafillu haya shetar beyad baal chov eno gove al pi ze ella kederech sheggovin kal baale chovot kemo shebbearnu

Bamme devarim amurim bevari aval chole shehikdish kal nechasav veamar beshaa shehikdish mane lifloni beyadi neeman sheen adam ose arma al hahekdesh bishat mitato vechote laacherim shehare hu holech lamut lefichach im amar tenu otah lo notel belo shevua veim lo amar tenu en notnin ella im ken haya beyado shetar mekuyyam hare ze notel min hahekdesh mippene hatztzavaa veim achar shehikdish amar tenu en shomin lo ella hare hu kishar baale chovot im nitkayyem shetaro nishba vegove min happode velo min hahekdesh
Mi sheyyatza alav kol shehifkir et nechasav o hikdishan o hecheriman en choshshin lo ad shettihye sham reaya berura

Bachamisha asar baadar bet din nifnin lechappes velivdok al tzarche tzibbur veal inyene hahekdeshot uvodkin alehen vedorshin vechokrin ufodim et hahekdeshot veet hacharamin vegovin et haarachin veet haddamim mikkal hachayyav bahen kede sheyyihye kal haam atid litten terumat hashshekalim lechazzek et bet elohenu

En podin et hahekdeshot ella bishlosha bekiin vechen kesheggovin mittaltelin shemmemashkenin mechayyave arachin shamin otan bishlosha uchshemmaarichin behema vechayyotze bah mishshear mittaltelin shamin otah bishlosha aval keshemmaarichin et hakkarkaot o im huzkeku ligbot erche adam min hakkarka shello en maarichin otan ella baasara veechad mehen kohen shehare kohen katuv bapparasha vechen haomer damay alay o deme peloni alay o deme yadi o ragli alay kesheshshamin oto kamma hu shave o kamma deme yado o raglo shamin baasara veechad mehen kohen

Kesheppodin hahekdeshot miyyad hahekdesh ben shehau karkaot o mittaltelin machrizin alehen bifne kal habbain lifdot amar echad hare hen shelli beeser selaim veamar echad beesrim veamar echad bishloshim veamar echad bearbaim veamar echad bachamishshim chazar bo shel chamishshim levaddo memashkenin minnechasav eser venotnin otan hahekdeshot laze shennatan arbaim venimtza hahekdesh notel chamishshim eser mizze vearbaim mizze chazar bo achare ken shel arbaim memashkenin minnechasav eser venotnin et hahekdesh levaal hashsheloshim vechen ad harishon chazar bo harishon shennatan eser machrizin al hahekdesh paam sheniyya umochrin oto im nifda befachot meeser nifrain mishshel baal haeser et hammotar

Bamme devarim amurim keshechazru ze achar ze aval chazru kullan keechad meshalleshin benehem beshave ketzad amar harishon hare hu shelli beeser veamar hashsheni beesrim veamar hashshelishi bearbaa veesrim vechazar bo hashshelishi vehashsheni keechad notnin oto larishon beeser ummashkenim minnichse hashsheni besheva uminnichse shelishi besheva venimtza hahekdesh gove arba veesrim vechen im chazru shelashtan keachat venimkar hahekdesh beshalosh memashkenin minnichse kal echad mishshelashtan sheva selaim vechen al derech zo leolam

Habbealim kodmin lechal adam mippene shehen mosifin chomesh veen mosifin chomesh al illuyan shel shear happodim ella al ma shennatnu hem techilla ketzad amru habbealim hare ze shellanu beesrim uva acher veamar hare hu shelli beesrim habbealim kodmin mippene shehen mosifin chomesh venotnin chamesh veesrim ba echad veamar hare hu shelli beachat veesrim im shatku habbealim velo hosifu kelum mochrin otah lahem bechamesh veesrim veim hosifu habbealim al esrim veachat afillu peruta achat hare ellu notnin shesh veesrim ufruta achat achat veesrim ufruta shennatnu meatzman vechamesh shehen chayyavin bo mishshum chomesh hammattan shennatnu techilla vechen im ba hashsheni veamar hare hu shelli beesrim ushtayim uva shelishi veamar beesrim veshalosh uva revii veamar beesrim vearba uva hachamishi veamar beesrim vechamesh vehosifu hen al haesrim vechamesh afillu peruta achat kofin otan litten sheloshim ufruta chamesh veesrim ufruta shennatnu meatzman vechamesh mechomesh shehen chayyavin bo lefi sheen habbealim mosifin chomesh al illuo shel ze ella chomesh ma shennatnu techilla mosifin al ma shennatan haacharon im ratzu

Bamme devarim amurim shello shamu hahekdesh shelosha mumchin aval im shamu oto shelosha mumchin veamru shehu shave ma shennatan haacharon vehosifu habbealim al illuo afillu peruta achat hare hen mosifin chomesh al illuo shel acharon venotnin achat ushloshim vedinar ufruta

Hare shello nishshom hahekdesh venatnu habbealim techilla esrim uva acher venatan chamesh veesrim veshatku habbealim velo hosifu kelum habbealim kodmin sheaf hen chayyavin litten chamesh veesrim mippene hachomesh ba acher venatan shesh veesrim hu kodem veim ratzu habbealim vehosifu afillu peruta notnin achat ushloshim ufruta kemo shebbearnu veal derech zo leolam

En makdishin velo maarichin velo machrimin bazzeman hazze sheen sham mikdash bachataenu kede lechazzek et bidko veim hikdish o heerich o hecherim im hayeta behema noel delet befaneha ad shettamut meeleha veim hau perot o kesut o kelim mannichin otan ad sheyyerakvu veim hau maot o kele mattachot yashlichen leyam hammelach o layyam haggadol kede leabbedan
Hikdish o hecherim eved shennichnas lemitzot podehu veyelchu damav leyam hammelach kishar damim vaarachin shel zeman hazze veim haya eved akkum lo maalin velo moridin

Muttar lifdot hahekdeshot bazzeman hazze lechattechilla vaafilu bifruta umashlich otah leyam hammelach vachachamim danu sheyyifde bearbaa zuzim o karov laze kede lefarsem haddavar aval bizman hammikdash lo yifde lechattechilla ella beshaveo kemo shebbearnu

Mi shehechrim bazzeman hazze mittaltelin setam hare ellu notnan lakkohanim hannimtzain beoto makom aval im hecherim sade beeretz yisrael setam o shehecherimah lakkohanim enah cherem sheen sede charamim noheg ella bizman shehayyovel noheg hecherim lakkohanim karka bechutz laaretz vaafillu bazzeman hazze hare hi kemittaltelin baaretz yisrael vetinnaten lakkohanim

Af al pi shehahekdeshot vehacharamin vehaarachin mitzot verauy lo leadam lehanhig atzmo bidvarim ellu kede lachof yitzro velo yihye kilay vikayyem ma shetztziuu neviim kabbed et Adonai mehonecha af al pi chen im lo hikdish velo heerich velo hecherim meolam en bechach kelum hare hattora heida veamra vechi techdal lindor lo yihye vecha chet

Leolam lo yakdish adam velo yacharim kal nechasav vehaose ken over al daat hakkatuv shehare hu omer mikkal asher lo velo kal asher lo kemo shebbearu chachamim veen zo chasidut ella shetut shehare hu meabbed kal mamono veyitztarech labberiyyot veen merachamin alav uvaze vechayyotze bo amru chachamim chasid shote mikkelal mevalle olam ella kal hamfazzer mamono bemitzot al yefazzer yoter mechomesh veyihye kemo shetztziuu neviim mechalkel devarav bemishpat ben bedivre tora ben bedivre olam afillu bekarbanot sheadam chayyav bahen hare chasa tora al hammamon veamra sheyyavi kefi missat yado kal vachomer lidvarim shello nitchayyev bahen ella mechamat nidro shello yindor ella karauy lo shenneemar ish kemattenat yado kevirkat Adonai elohecha asher natan lach
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 1: Hannezirut hu neder mikkelal nidre issar shenneemar ki yiddor neder nazir vego umitzvat ase sheyegaddel sear rosho shenneemar gaddel pera sear rosho veim gilleach bime nizro over belo taase shenneemar taar lo yaavor al rosho vechen asur lehittame lammetim o leechol devarim sheasaran hakkatuv alav miggefen hayyayin kal yeme nizro

Avar vegilleach o nitma o achal miggefen hayyayin hare ze loke shettayim achat mishshum lo yachel devaro shekkolel kal hannedarim veachat mishshum davar sheavar alav middevarim sheasurin issur meyuchad al hannazir

Nadar benazir vekiyyem nidro kemitzvato hare ze ose shalosh mitzot ase haachat kechal hayyotze mippiv yaase vahare asa vehashsheniyya gaddel pera sear rosho vahare giddel vehashshelishit tiglachto im havaat karbenotav shenneemar vegillach hannazir petach ohel moed vego
Haomer lo eppater min haolam ad sheeheye nazir hare ze nazir miyyad shemma yamut atta veim echer neziruto hare ze over beval teacher leshallemo veen lokin al lav ze

En omrin binzirut ad sheyyotzi bisfatav davar shemmashmao etzel kal haam kainyan shebbelibbo ella kevan sheggamar belibbo vehotzi bisfatav devarim sheinyanam sheyyihye nazir af al pi shehen inyanot rechokot veaf al pi sheen bemashmaan leshon nezirut hare hu nazir

Ketzad hare shehaya nazir over lefanav veamar ehye hare ze nazir hoil uvlibbo haya sheyyihye kemo ze veaf al pi shello peresh veamar ehye kemo ze vechen im achaz bisaro veamar ehye nae o ehe mechalkel o aha mesalsel o sheamar hareni mesalsel o hareni mechalkel o hare alay leshalleach pera hare ze nazir vehu sheyyigmor belibbo lehazzir
Amar hare alay tzipporim af al pi shehaya nazir over lefanav veaf al pi shehaya belibbo lehazzir eno nazir vahare ze kemi shello hotzi bisfatav kelum
Kal kinnuye nezirut kinzirut ketzad mekomot haillegim shemmeshannin et haddibbur veamar sham hareni nazik naziach paziach hare ze nazir

Haomer hareni nazir min hachartzannim bilvad o min hazzaggim bilvad o hareni nazir min hattiglachat o hareni nazir min hattuma bilvad hare ze nazir gamur vechal dikduke nezirut alav veaf al pi shello haya belibbo lehazzir ella middavar ze bilvad hoil vedavar shennazar mimmennu asur al hannezirim hare ze nazir gamur
Aval haomer hareni nazir min haggerogarot o min haddevela vechayyotze bahen hare ze asur bahen veeno nazir

Mazgu lo kos shel yayin venatnu lo lishtot veamar hareni nazir mimmennu hare ze nazir gamur veim haya mar nefesh o koes o mitabbel vehau mevakkeshin mimmennu sheyyishte kede leshakkeach amalo veamar hare ze nazir mimmennu hare ze asur beoto hakkos bilvad veeno nazir shello nitkaven ze ella shello yishte kos ze

Vechen shikkor shennatnu lo kos kede lerauoto veamar hare ze nazir mimmennu hare ze asur beoto hakkos bilvad veeno chayyav binzirut shello nitkaven ze ella shello yeshakkeru oto yoter midday veim higgia leshichruto shel lot en devarav kelum veeno chayyav al kal avera sheyyaase shemmishshehiggia leshichruto shel lot eno ben chiyyuv

Haomer hareni nazir al menat sheeheye shote yayin o mittamme lammetim o megalleach seari hare ze nazir veasur bechullam mippene shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora vechal hammatne al hakkatuv battora tenao batel

Nadar benazir veamar lo hayiti yodea shehannazir asur beyayin o betuma o betiglachat veillu hayiti yodea ken lo hayiti noder hare ze nazir vechayyav bechullam shehare hu haya yodea sheasar atzmo beechad mishshelosha minin uchvar bearnu sheafillu lo nadar ella meechad mehem asur bechullan

Amar yodea hayiti shehannazir asur bechal ellu aval haya beddati shemmuttar li lishtot ani hayyayin mippene sheeni yachol lichot belo yayin o mippene sheani kover et hammetim hare ze eno nazir mippene sheellu bichlal nidre shegagot sheenam tzerichin sheela lechacham kemo shebbearnu
Haomer hare yadi nezira hare ragli nezira lo amar kelum hare roshi nazir kevedi nezira hare ze nazir ze hakkelal kal evar sheim yinnatel min hachay yamut im amar hare hu nazir hare ze nazir

Haomer hareni nazir kesheyyihye li ben im nolad lo ben zachar hare ze nazir aval im nolda lo bat o tumtum o anderoginus en ze nazir amar hareni nazir kesheyyihye li valad afillu nolad lo bat o tumtum veanderoginus hare ze nazir hippila ishto eno nazir chazra venitabbera veyalda hare ze nazir
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 2: Hannoder benazir beshogeg o beones o shennadar lezarez chavero o derech havay hare ze patur kishar nedarim umi shennadar benazir venicham al nidro hare ze nishal lechacham umattir lo neziruto kederech shemmattirin shear hannedarim

Mi shennadar benazir vehalach lehavi karbenotav shennazar al daat sheyeviem bimlot yeme nizro metzaan shennignevu o nigneva behema mehen im ad shello nigneva habbehema nazar hare ze nazir veim achar shennigneva o sheavda o shemmeta nazar eno nazir shezze nazar betaut
Hammatpis binzirut hare ze nazir kemo shebbearnu bedin kal hammatpis beneder

Haya nazir over lefanav veamar hareni kaze hare ze nazir nadar chavero benazir veamar hu pi kefiv miyyayin o sheamar seari kisaro millehiggazez hare ze nazir vechen im shama veamar vaani betoch kede dibbur veshama shelishi betoch kede dibbur shel sheni veamar vaani vaafillu hen mea kullan nezirin
Haomer hareni nazir kesheyyihye li ben vachavero amar vaani hare chavero nazir miyyad
Haomer lachavero hareni nazir kesheyyihye lecha ben veshama chavero veamar vaani en ze nazir shello nitkaven ze haacharon ella lomar sheani ohev sheyyihye lecha ben kemo ze shehare hu bosh mimmennu
Haomer hareni nazir kesheyyihye lifloni ben veshama chavero veamar vaani hare ze safek shemma lo nitkaven ella lihot nazir kemoto o lomar sheani ohev oto kemotcha usfek nezirut lehakel

Shenayim shehau mehallechim badderech verau echad ba kenegdan veamar echad min hashshenayim ze haholech kenegdenu shimon hu veamar chavero reuven hu veamar ze hareni nazir im yihye reuven veamar haacher hareni nazir im yihye shimon higgia alehem vahare hu reuven hare ze nazir veim haya shimon hare chavero nazir kemo shennadru vechen kal kayyotze baze lo higgia alehem ella chazar laachorav venelam meenehem velo yadu mi hu en echad mehen nazir
Vechen haomer hareni nazir im yihye bichri ze mea kor vehalach lemoddo umtzao shennignav o sheavad eno nazir vechen kal kayyotze baze shessafek nezirut lehakel

Hau mehallechin badderech verau et hakkevi merachok veamar echad mehem hareni nazir shezze chayya veamar acher hareni nazir shezze behema veamar acher hareni nazir sheen ze chayya veamar acher hareni nazir sheen ze behema veamar acher hareni nazir sheen ze lo chayya velo behema veamar acher hareni nazir shezze behema vechayya hare kullam nezirim mippene shehakkevi yesh bo derachim shave bahen lechayya veyesh bo derachim shave bahen livhema veyesh bo derachim shave lechayya velivhema veyesh bo derachim sheeno shave lo livhema velo lechayya vehu haddin im rau anderoginus venechleku bo im hu ish o ishsha venadru al derech shennadru ellu bichvi hare kullam nezirim shehaanderoginus yesh bo derachim shave bahen leish udrachim shave bahen leishsha udrachim sheeno shave bahen lo leish velo leishsha udrachim shehen shavin leish ulishsha

Vechal hadderachim haellu beinyene hammitzot velo betivo vetoladto vechen darche hakkevi beinyene hammitzot lo betivo vetoladto ketzad damo taun kissuy kechayya vechelbo asur kivhema vahare hu kilayim im habbehema vechen im hachayya keillu enah chayya velo behema vetaun shechita kivhema vechayya veyesh bo derachim acherim vechal echad mehen yitbaer bimkomo vechen anderoginus mittamme beloven kaanashim umittamme beodem kenashim veeno nimkar beeved ivri lo kaanashim velo kenashim vehahorgo neherag alav kaanashim uchnashim veyesh bo dinim acherim vechal echad yikkatev bimkomo

Vechen im rau anashim baim kenegdam mehem pikchim umehem sumim veamar echad hareni nazir sheellu pikchin veamar acher hareni nazir sheen ellu pikchin veamar acher hare ani nazir sheellu sumin veamar acher hareni nazir sheen ellu sumin veamar acher hareni nazir sheellu pikchin vesumin veamar acher hareni nazir sheen ellu lo pikchin velo sumin hare kullam nezirim vechen kal kayyotze baze

Katan shehiggia leonat nedarim venadar benazir hare ze nazir umevi karbenotav veaf al pi sheadayin lo hevi shette searot kishar hannedarim vehaish maddir et beno katan benazir af al pi shello ba leonat nedarim veen haishsha madderet et benah benazir vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala hu veeno noheg bishar nedarim

Ketzad haav sheamar livno hakkatan hare atta nazir o sheamar beni peloni nazir o hare ze nazir veshatak habben hare ze nazir vechayyav haav linhog bo kal dikduke nezirut veim nitma mevi karban tuma uchsheyyashlim neziruto mevi karban tahora kishar hannezirim haggedolim

Lo ratza habben umicha bedavar ze o shemmichu kerovav o sheggilleach searo o sheggillechuhu kerovav shehare naasa maase sheggilla dato shello ratza hu o kerovav binzirut zo hare ze eno nazir vead matay yesh lo lehaddiro ad sheyyagdil veyease ish
Haakkum en lahen nezirut shenneemar dabber el bene yisrael
Nashim vaavadim yesh lahen nezirut vehaav o habbaal mefer nezirut haishsha im ratza kishar hannedarim aval haeved yesh lerabbo lachof oto lishtot ulhittame lammetim veim lo kafa oto noheg nezirut

Nadar haeved shear nedarim sheyyesh bahen innuy nefesh o shemmeakkevin et hammelacha o sheheerich en rabbo tzarich lechuppo mippene sheen nafsho kenuya lo velo yachul alav neder lema haddavar dome leoser perot acherim alehem aval im en sham innuy velo davar shemmeakkev melacha eno yachol lechuppo nadar avdo binzirut veamar lo mufar lecha yatza lecherut vechayyav lehashlim neziruto shehaeved kofin oto veen meferin lo veim hefer yatza lecherut

Eved shennadar binzirut uvarach o shehalach merabbo hare ze asur lishtot yayin kede sheyyitztaer veyachzor lirshut rabbo nazar vehishlim neziruto vegilleach velo yedao rabbo veachar kach yatza lecherut hare ze yatza yede nidro aval im nadar velo gilleach veyatza lecherut lo yatza yede nidro nitma veachar kach yatza lecherut mone mishshaa shennitma
Nezirut noheget bifne habbayit veshello bifne habbayit lefichach mi shennadar benazir bazzeman hazze hare ze nazir leolam sheen lanu bayit kede sheyyavi karbenotav bimlot yeme nizro

En hannezirut noheget ella beeretz yisrael umi shennazar bechutza laaretz konsin oto umchayevin oto laalot leeretz yisrael velihot nazir beeretz yisrael keminyan hayyamim shennazar lefichach mi shennadar bazzeman hazze bechutza laaretz kofin oto laalot leeretz yisrael velihot noheg sham nezirut ad sheyyamut o ad sheyyibbane hammikdash veyavi karbenotav bimlot yeme nizro

Vechal zeman shehu bechutza laaretz hare ze asur lishtot yayin ulhittame lammetim ulgalleach vechal dikduke nezirut alav veaf al pi sheen yamim ellu olin lo veim avar veshata o gilleach o naga bemet vechayyotze bingia loke
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 3: Setam nezirut sheloshim yom ketzad mi sheamar hareni nazir en pachot mishsheloshim yom vaafillu amar hareni nazir nezirut gedola ad meod harbe hare ze nazir sheloshim yom shehare lo peresh zeman

Peresh zeman pachot mishsheloshim kegon sheamar hareni nazir yom echad o asara yamim o esrim yom hare ze nazir sheloshim yom sheen nezirut pechuta mishsheloshim yom vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala
Peresh zeman yoter mishsheloshim yom kegon sheamar echad ushloshim yom o arbaim o mea yom o mea shana hare ze nazir kizman shepperesh lo pachot velo yoter
Haomer hareni nazir shaa achat hare ze nazir sheloshim yom amar hareni nazir sheloshim yom veshaa achat hare ze nazir echad ushloshim yom sheen nozrin shaot

Haomer hareni nazir mikkan ad makom peloni im lo hechezik badderech hare ze nazir sheloshim yom bilvad shello nitkaven ze ella linzirut gedola vahare lo peresh zeman veim hechezik badderech im haya mehallech pachot mishsheloshim yom hare ze nazir sheloshim yom veim haya yoter mishsheloshim yom hare ze nazir nezirut achat keminyan hayyamim

Mi sheamar hareni nazir shette nezirut o shalosh o arba hare ze nazir kamminyan sheamar kal nezirut mehen sheloshim yom uvsof kal sheloshim ushloshim megalleach umevi karbenotav umatchil limnot nezirut sheniyya afillu amar hareni nazir mea elef neziriyyot shei efshar sheyyichye kazzeman hazze hare ze mone achat achar achat ad sheyyamut o ad sheyyashlim minyan nezirutav

Haomer hareni nazir keminyan yemot hashshana mone nezirutav keminyan yemot hashshana im peresh shenat hachamma mone shelosh meot veshishshim vechamesh nezirut kal achat mehen sheloshim yom veim peresh shenat levana mone shelosh meot arba vachamishshim nezirut veim setam mone shelosh meot vearba vachamishshim nezirut shehare bearnu shekkal hannedarim holchin achar leshon bene adam verov shene hachamma shelosh meot vachamishsha veshishshim yom monin lah verov shene hallevana shelosh meot vearba vachamishshim yom monin lah veen korin kal haam shana setam ella lishnat hallevana

Haomer hareni nazir achat umechetza hare ze nazir shette nezirut amar hareni nazir veom echad o sheamar hareni nazir veshaa achat hare ze nazir shette nezirut amar hareni nazir veachat hare ze nazir shettayim hareni nazir veachat veod hare ze nazir shalosh nezirut hareni nazir veachat veod veshuv hare ze nazir arba nezirut hareni nazir sheloshim yom veom echad hare ze nazir nezirut achat shel sheloshim veechad yom
Mi shehau shette kitte edim meidin oto ellu meidin shennazar shettayim veellu meidin shennazar chamesh hare ze nazir shettayim shebbichlal chamesh shettayim vahare kullan meidim bishtayim

Mi shennazar shette nezirut ben shennadar shettehen bevat achat ben shennadar zo achar zo kegon sheamar hareni nazir yom hareni nazir yom umana et harishona vehifrish karban veachar kach nishal al harishona vehittir nidro alta lo rishona bashsheniyya umevi ze hakkarban veniftar vaafillu hevi kapparato vaafillu gilleach searo veachar kach nishal aleha alta lo rishona bashsheniyya shehare en hashsheniyya chala ella leachar harishona veharishona kevan shehittirah keillu enah meikkarah
Mi sheamar hareni nazir leolam o hareni nazir kal yeme chayyay hare ze nazir leolam veim amar hareni nazir elef shana hare ze nazir lizman katzuv veaf al pi shei efshar sheyyichye haadam elef shana

Vma ben nezir olam lenazir lizman katzuv shehannazir lizman asur legalleach ad sof yeme neziro shenneemar kal yeme neder nizro taar lo yaavor al rosho ad melot hayyamim unzir olam im hichbid searo mekel betaar mishshenem asar chodesh ad shenem asar chodesh umevi karbano shalosh behemot kesheyegalleach shenneemar vayehi mikketz yamim layyamim asher yegalleach ki chaved alav vegillecho veavshalom nezir olam haya vedavar ze halacha hi mippi hakkabbala unzir olam shennitma hare ze mevi karban tuma umgalleach tiglachat tuma kemo nazir lizman katzuv

Shimshon lo haya nazir gamur shehare lo nadar benazir ella hammalach hifrisho min hattuma vechetzad haya dino haya asur beyayin veasur betiglachat umuttar lehittame lammetim vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala

Lefichach mi sheamar hareni nazir keshimshon hare ze nazir min hattiglachat umin hayyayin leolam veeno megalleach kal shenem asar chodesh kishar nezire olam umuttar lehittame lammetim veim amar lo nitkavanti ella leish acher sheshshemo shimshon eno nazir umi shennadar nazir keshimshon eno yachol lehishshael al nidro shennezirut shimshon leolam hayeta
Haomer hareni keshimshon keven manoach kevaal delila kemi sheakar daltot azza kemi shennikkeru pelishtim et enav hare ze nazir kinzirut shimshon veaf al pi sheefshar shennaasu maasim ellu leish acher

Shemuel haramati nezir olam haya lefichach haomer hareni kishmuel haramati keven channa keven elkana kemi sheshshissef et agag baggilgal vechayyotze beellu hare ze nezir olam veen omrin shemma leish acher shemmaasav kaelle nitkaven

Haomer hareni nazir melo habbayit o melo hakkuppa bodkin oto im amar lo haya beddati sheeheye nazir kal yamay velo nitkavanti ella lehaarich zeman hannezirut zeman merubbe hare ze nazir sheloshim yom bilvad veim amar setam nadarti roim et hakkuppa keillu hi melea chardal veyihye nazir kal yamav veyesh lo legalleach mishshenem asar chodesh lishnem asar chodesh veyavi karbenotav kishar nezire olam

Haomer hareni nazir kisar roshi o kaafar haaretz o kechol hayyam hare ze kemi sheamar hare nezirut alay keminyan sear roshi o keminyan afar haaretz o keminyan chol hayyam lefichach yegalleach kal sheloshim yom veyatchil limnot nezirut sheniyya sheloshim yom vigalleach vechen ad sheyyamut uvchal tiglachat vetiglachat eno shote yayin velo mittamme lammetim veim shata o nitma afillu beom hattiglachat hare ze loke

Haomer hareni nazir im ochal kikkar zo hareni nazir im ochalenna hareni nazir im ochalenna vaachalah hare ze chayyav binzirut kamminyan sheamar umone achat achar achat kal achat mehen sheloshim umgalleach besof kal sheloshim umevi karbano
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 4: Haomer hareni nazir hare ze megalleach tiglachat tahora yom echad ushloshim veim gilleach beom sheloshim yatza amar hareni nazir sheloshim yom eno megalleach ella beom echad ushloshim

Mi shennazar shette neziruyyot megalleach et harishona beom echad ushloshim veet hashsheniyya beom echad veshishshim veim gilleach et harishona yom sheloshim megalleach et hashsheniyya yom shishshim veim gilleach yom tisha vachamishshim yatza sheyyom sheloshim ole lo af leminyan nezirut sheniyya

Homer hareni nazir venazir kesheyyihye li ben vehitchil nezirut shello veachar kach nolad lo ben mashlim et shello veachar kach mone et shel beno amar hareni nazir kesheyyihye li ben vahareni nazir kach vechach yom vehitchil binzirut shello veachar kach nolad lo ben posek nezirut shello umone et shel beno veachar kach chozer umashlim et shello vahare shettehen kinzirut achat lefichach im nitma betoch nezirut shel beno soter hakkol nitma achar nezirut beno keshehitchil lehashlim neziruto eno soter ella ad nezirut beno uvchamma yamim mashlim et shello im nishar minneziruto keshennolad habben sheloshim o yoter mone nezirut beno umashlim hayyamim shennisharu minneziruto veim nisharu minneziruto pachot mishsheloshim mone sheloshim achar nezirut beno sheen ben tiglachat letiglachat pachot mishsheloshim yom

Ketzad haomer hareni nazir kesheyyihye li ben vahareni nazir mea yom vehitchil binzirut shello venolad lo ben im nishar min hammea shennadar sheloshim yom o yeter keshennolad habben lo hifsid kelum shehare posek nezirut shello umatchil umone shel beno umgalleach umevi karbenotav umashlim hashsheloshim o yeter shennisharu minneziruto umgalleach linziruto veim nishar min hammea pachot mishsheloshim soter ad shivim

Ketzad nolad habben beom shemonim mone shel beno umashlim et shel beno umgalleach umatchil limnot meachar hattiglachat sheloshim yom venimtza mafsid mikkodem havalad asara yamim shehem miyyom shivim ad havalad vechen kal kayyotze baze

Haomer hareni nazir leachar esrim yom vechazar veamar hareni nazir meatta mea yom mone esrim yom ufosek umatchil limnot sheloshim shehi hannezirut shennadar leachar esrim veachar hashsheloshim megalleach tiglachat tahora umevi karbenotav vechozer umone shemonim yom kede lehashlim hammea shennadar bassof umgalleach umevi karbenotav

Amar hareni nazir leachar esrim yom vahareni nazir meatta mone sheloshim yom umgalleach tiglachat tahora vechozer umone sheloshim yom acherim vehi hannezirut shennadar leachar esrim sheim tomar mone esrim ufosek mone sheloshim umgalleach nisharu minnezirut shehitchil bah asara yom bilvad veen ben tiglachat tahora letiglachat tahora leolam pachot mishsheloshim yom
Amar hareni nazir leachar esrim yom vechazar veamar hareni nezir olam meatta lo chala alav nezirut shennadar barishona
Vechen im amar hareni nezir shimshon leachar esrim yom vechazar veamar hareni nazir meatta eno megalleach linzirut zo shennadar baacharona
Mi sheamar hare ani nazir yom echad lifne mitati hare ze asur lishtot yayin ulhittame ulgalleach leolam

Haomer hareni nazir bayyom shebben david ba bo im bechol nadar hare ze asur leolam veim beshabbat o beom tov nadar otah shabbat o oto yom tov muttar mikkan veelach asur leolam shehaddavar safek im yavo beshabbat o beom tov o lo yavo vehoil vehu safek bayyom shennadar lo chala alav nezirut shessefek nezirut lehakel mikkan veelach chala alav nezirut veshabbat habbaa shehi safek enah mafkaat nezirut shechala alav

Nazir sheshshalmu yeme neziruto velo gilleach tiglachat tahora hare ze asur legalleach velishtot yayin ulhittame lemetim keshehaya mikkodem vechal dikduke nezirut alav veim gilleach o shata yayin o nitma loke

Mi shennadar benazir vedimma sheeno neder vehaya noheg hetter benidro veshata yayin ulachar zeman shaal lechacham vehorahu shehu neder veshehu chayyav binzirut hare ze mone mishshaa shennadar umiddivre sofrim sheyyinhog issur kayyamim shennahag bahen hetter

Ketzad hare shennadar sheloshim yom venahag hetter benidro asara yamim venahag issur esrim yom ulachar hashsheloshim shaal lechacham veasar lo hare ze mone asara yamim miyyom sheshshaal keneged haasara shennahag bahen hetter veim shata o gilleach o nitma baaseret yamim haellu makkin oto makkat mardut
Bamme devarim amurim binzirut muetet aval binzirut merubba dayyo sheyyinhog sheloshim yom binzirut af al pi sheavar al neziruto hamrubba kal yamav veim lo nahag issur beatzmo en nizkakin lo kelal
Kal bet din shennizkakin laze vechayyotze bo umodiin leellu shemmezalzelin bindarim sheen chayyavin min hattora o sheyyoru lahen lehakel o sheyyiftechu lahen petach menaddin oto bet din hahedot

Haishsha shennadra binzirut veshalmu yeme hannezirut vehevia karbenoteha venishchata achat min habbehemot venizrak damah veachar kach shama balah af al pi sheadayin lo gillecha eno yachol lehafer veim kodem zerika hare ze yafer bamme devarim amurim betiglachat tahora aval betiglachat tuma yafer af al pi shekkarvu hakkarbanot shel tiglachat tuma mippene shehi adayin tzericha limnot nezirut acheret
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 5: Shelosha minin asurin lenazir hattuma vehattiglachat vehayyotze min haggefen ben peri ben pesolet peri aval hashshechar shel temarim o shel gerogarot vechayyotze bahen muttar lenazir ve shechar ze shenneesar alav battora hu hashshechar shel taarovet hayyayin

Hayyotze min haggefen ketzad nazir sheachal kezayit min happeri shehu anavim lachim o yeveshim o boser o sheachal kezayit mippesolet happeri shehi hazzaggin vehem hakkelippa hachitzona o hachartzannim vehem hazzaggin happenimin shezzorim otan hare ze loke vechen im shata reviit yayin o achal kezayit miyyayin karush shehu happeri o shata reviit chometz shehu pesolet happeri hare ze loke aval healin vehallulavim ume gefanim vehassemadar hare ellu muttarin lenazir sheenan lo peri velo pesolet peri ella min haetz hen nechshavin

Kal issure gefen mitztarfin ze im ze ketzad hare shetztzeref anavim lachim im yeveshim o im boser vechartzan vezag veachal min hattaarovet kezayit loke vechen im achlam ze achar ze ad sheachal min hakkol kezayit loke vechen im shata reviit taarovet yayin vechometz loke

Davar hammuttar eno mitztaref ledavar haasur benazir ketzad yayin shennitarev bidvash af al pi shettaam hakkol taam yayin veshata min hattaarovet vechen hatztzimmukin shedderasan im haggerogarot vetaam hakkol taam tzimmukin veachal min hattaarovet eno loke ad sheyyihye middavar haasur battaarovet kezayit bichde shalosh betzim veachal keshalosh betzim kishar haissurin hashshavim bechal adam kemo shebbearnu behilchot maachalot asurot

Vechen im shara pitto beyayin vehaya harviit yayin bichde peras min happat veachal kede peras shennimtza sheachal reviit yayin hare ze loke veal ze vechayyotze bo neemar battora vechal mishrat anavim leesor davar shennitarev bo hayyayin vetamo ketaam hayyayin vehu sheyyihye taamo umammasho kishar issure maachalot
Nitarev yayin vechayyotze bo bidvash veen sham taam yayin hare ze muttar lenazir lo yihye ze chamur mechelev vedam
Haya bo taam yayin veen sham reviit bichde achilat peras hare ze asur middivre sofrim kemo shebbearnu behilchot maachalot asurot umakkin oto im achal makkat mardut

Nazir sheachal kezayit anavim uchzayit chartzan uchzayit zag uchzayit tzimmukim veshata reviit yayin vaafillu sachat eshkol veshata mimmennu reviit hare ze loke chamesh malkiyyot shekkal echad mehen belav echad hu veloke malkut shishshit mishshum lo yachel devaro shehu shave bechal hannedarim vechen im achal kezayit zag o kezayit anavim loke shettayim achat mishshum zag o mishshum anavim veachat mishshum lo yachel devaro vehu haddin lenazir sheggilleach o nitma shehu loke shettayim achat al haissur hamyuchad bo veachat al haissur hashshave bechal hannedarim shehu lo yachel devaro

Nazir sheshshata reviit yayin urviit chometz eno loke ella achat sheeno chayyav al hayyayin bifne atzmo veal hachometz bifne atzmo sheen katuv yayin lo yishte vechometz lo yishte ella kach chometz yayin vechometz shechar lo yishte kelomar lo yishte yayin velo davar shennitarev bo hayyayin vehu hashshechar vaafillu hechmitzu vehoil velo kafal ella hachometz shehu shem echad eno loke al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo

Nazir shehaya shote beyayin kal hayyom kullo af al pi shehu chayyav lashshamayim al kal reviit urviit eno loke ella achat mishshum yayin veachat de la yachel devaro kemo shebbearnu veim hitru bo al kal reviit urviit veamru lo al tishte al tishte vehu shote chayyav al kal echad veechad middivre sofrim sheasur lenazir laamod bemoshav shote yayin veyitrachek mimmennu harbe shehare michshol lefanav amru chachamim saviv lakkerem lo yikrav

Nazir sheggilleach seara achat loke ben betaar ben bezug vehu shekkitztzetza meikkarah keen taar vechen im telashah beyado loke echad hamgalleach veechad hammitgalleach shenneemar taar lo yaavor al rosho veim hinniach mimmennu kede lachof roshah leikkarah eno loke sheen ze keen taar
Heevir al rosho sam shemmashshir et hassear vehishshir et hassear eno loke ella bittel mitzvat ase shenneemar gaddel pera sear rosho
Nazir sheggilleach kal rosho eno loke mishshum hattiglachat ella achat veim hitru bo al kal sear vesear veamru lo al tegalleach al tegalleach vehu megalleach loke al kal achat veachat

Nazir chofef al searo beyado vechochech betzipparnav veim nafal sear eno choshesh shehare en kavanato lehashshir veefshar shello yashshir aval lo yisrok bemasrek velo yachof baadama mippene shemmashsheret et hassear vadday veim asa chen eno loke
Nazir shennitma lemet tumat shiva ben betumot shehu megalleach alehen kemo sheyyitbaer ben betumot sheeno megalleach alehen hare ze loke
Nitma lemet peamim harbe af al pi shehu chayyav malkot al kal achat veachat lashshamayim en bet din malkin oto ella achat veim hitru bo al kal paam ufaam vehu mittamme loke al kal achat veachat

Bamme devarim amurim beshennitma uferash vechazar venaga o nasa o heehil aval im haya nogea bemet vaadayin hammet beyado venaga bemet acher eno chayyav ella achat af al pi shehitru bo al kal negia ungia shehare mechullal veomed

Nazir shennichnas levayit veshaha sham ad shemmet sham hammet o shennichnas leohel hammet beshidda teva umigdal uva chavero ufara gag hatteva mealav middato hare ze loke shettayim achat mishshum lo yavo veachat mishshum lo yittamma shehare tuma uvia bain keachat aval im nichnas kedarko tumato kodemet leviato shemmeet sheyyachnis chatmo o etzbeot raglav nitma veeno chayyav mishshum bia ad sheyyavo kullo
Nichnas leohel hammet o levet hakkevarot bishgaga veachar shennoda lo hitru bo velo kafatz veyatza ella amad sham hare ze loke vehu sheyyishhe sham kede hishtachavaya kemo tame shennichnas lammikdash

Hamtamme et hannazir im haya hannazir mezid hannazir loke veze shettimmeo over mishshum velifne iver lo titten michshl veim haya hannazir shogeg veze shettimmeo mezid en echad mehem loke velamma lo yilke hamtamme et hannazir lefi shenneemar vetimme et rosh nizro eno loke ad sheyetamme atzmo middato

Nazir tahor shettimme atzmo loke af mishshum lo teacher leshallemo shehare icher nezirut tahora veasa maase vechen im nadar bevet hakkevarot loke af mishshum lo teacher ha lamadta shehannazir shettimme atzmo loke arba malkiyyot mishshum lo yittamma umishshum lo yachel devaro umishshum lo teacher leshallemo umishshum lo yavo im hayeta bia vetuma keachat kemo shebbearnu
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 6: Nazir sheshshata yayin veachal yotze min haggefen afillu yamim rabbim eno soter mime neziruto afillu yom echad vechen im gilleach miut sear rosho ben beshogeg ben bemezid nitgalleach rov rosho ben betaar ben keen taar velo nishar min hassearot kede lachof roshan leikkaran ben bezadon ben bishgaga afillu gillechuhu listim beones hare ze soter sheloshim yom ad sheyyihye lo pera veachar kach matchil limnot

Ketzad nadar nezirut mea yom ulachar esrim yom nitgalleach rov rosho hare ze shohe sheloshim yom ad sheyyirbe sear rosho veachar hashsheloshim yom mone shemonim yom tashlum yeme neziruto vechal otan hashsheloshim yom kal dikduke nezirut alav ella sheen olin lo min hamminyan

Nazir shennitma ben bezadon ben bishgaga vaafillu timmeuhu akkum beones satar hakkol umgalleach tiglachat tuma umevi karbenot tuma umatchil limnot yeme nezirut shenneemar vehayyamim harishonim yippelu vaafillu nitma beom melot yeme nizro besof hayyom satar hakkol

Nitma achar yom melot shehu yom havaat karbenot tahora illu lo nitma soter sheloshim bilvad vechetzad yaase mevi karbenot tuma kesheyyithar umgalleach tiglachat tuma umatchil limnot nezirut sheloshim yom umgalleach tiglachat tahora umevi karbenot tahora veim nitma achar shennizrak alav echad min haddamim eno soter kelum ella yavi shear karbenot tahora shello kesheyyithar
Nitma bayyom shelleacharav shehu yom sherauy legaddel sear illu gilleach achar melot hare ze eno soter kelum af al pi sheadayin lo gilleach shehare shalma hannezirut vechal shennitpal lah

Nitma bayyom shennadar o bashsheni eno soter ella mashlim alehem achar sheyyavi karbano shenneemar vehayyamim harishonim yippelu ad sheyyihu sham shene yamim rishonim lefichach im nitma mishshelishi vahala soter kal hakkodmin

Nadar benazir vehu teme met chala alav nezirut veim nitma paam acheret o shata yayin o gilleach loke veim shaha betumato kamma yamim en olin lo ad sheyyazze shelishi ushvii veyitbol bashshevii veom shevii shello ole lo mimminyan nezirut laze shennadar vehu tame aval nazir tahor shennitma eno matchil limnot ella miyyom hashshemini vahala

Mi shennadar vehu bevet hakkevarot nezirut chala alav vaafillu shaha sham kamma yamim en olin lo veloke al shehiyyato sham veim hitru bo shello yazzir sham eno megalleach searo kesheyyetze mishsham veim nitma sham bevet hakkevarot beachat min hattumot shehannazir megalleach alehen eno megalleach veeno mevi karban tuma
Nichnas lesham beshidda teva umigdal uva chavero ufara alav et hammaaziva venitma af al pi sheshshaha sham eno loke aval makkin oto makkat mardut im shaha

Yatza mibbet hakkevarot veshaha yamim vechazar venichnas en otan hayyamim olin lo yatza vehizza vetaval vetahar umana yamim minneziruto vechazar levet hakkevarot otan hayyamim shemmana olin lo vaafillu nichnas beom shemini shello hare hashshevii shello ole lo min hamminyan veim nitma sham achar shennichnas beachat min hattumot shehannazir megalleach alehen mevi karban tuma vesoter hayyamim hakkodmin umgalleach tiglachat tuma

Tiglachat tuma ketzad hi hannazir shennitma beachat min hattumot shehu megalleach alehen hare ze mazze alav bashshelishi uvashshevii umgalleach sear rosho bashshevii vetovel bashshevii achar hahazzaya kederech kal temee met umaariv shimsho umevi karbenotav bashshemini vehen shette torim o shene bene yona echad leola veechad lechattat vecheves ben shenato leasham vesoter kal hayyamim hakkodmin umatchil limnot neziruto veim gilleach bashshemini mevi karbenotav bo bayyom
Meematay matchil limnot mishsheyyavi chattato aval olato vaashamo en meakkevin oto millimnot

Hare shehizza bashshelishi uvashshevii velo taval venitacher kamma yamim kesheyyitbol yaariv shimsho veyavi karbenotav lemachar taval veheeriv shimsho veicher karbenotav eno matchil limnot ad sheyyavi chattato aval olato vaashamo en meakkevin oto kemo shebbearnu

Keshemmegalleach hannazir tiglachat tuma eno tzarich legalleach al petach hammikdash velo lehashlich searo al haesh uven sheggilleach bammedina o bammikdash searo asur bahanaa vetaun kevura veefro asur keefer kal hannikbarim vehamgalleach bammikdash im hishlichan tachat dud haasham yatza

Nazir shennitma tumot harbe ben shehitru bo al kal achat veachat uven shello hitru bo al kal achat veachat eno mevi al tumotav ella karban echad bamme devarim amurim shennitma paam sheniyya kodem sheyyavi karbenot tuma harishona veaf al pi shennitacher kamma yamim achar tahorato kodem havaat chattato venitma beotan hayyamim eno mevi ella karban echad aval im nitma vetahar vehevi chattato venitma paam sheniyya achar shehevi chattato af al pi sheadayin lo hevi ashamo veolato chayyav bekarbanot acherot

Nazir sheggilleach tiglachat tahora veachar kach noda shettame haya betoch yeme nizro im betuma yedua nitma satar hakkol umevi karbenot tuma umgalleach tiglachat tuma umone nezirut acheret umevi karbenot tahora veim betumat hattehom nitma eno soter vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala

Veim ad shello nizrak alav echad min haddamim noda shehu tame ben betuma yedua ben betumat hattehom soter hakkol noda lo achar shennizrak echad min haddamim af al pi shello gilleach hoil vetuma sheenah yedua hi eno soter
E zo hi tumat hattehom kal sheen adam makkirah afillu besof haolam velo amru tumat hattehom ella lemet bilvad aval harug lo shehare yodea bo ze sheharago

Nimtza hammet galuy en ze tumat hattehom nimtza mushka bekarkait meara vehammayim al gabbav hare ze tumat hattehom sheenah yedua haya tamun beteven o bitzrorot hare zo tumat hattehom bemayim baafela uvinkike hasselaim enah tumat hattehom

Nazir shennitma bemet veyarad vetaval bammeara vehevi karbenot tuma umana nezirut vegilleach tiglachat tahora veachar kach noda shemmet haya mushka bekarkait hammeara kesheyyarad litbol af al pi shehi tuma sheenah yedua satar hakkol mippene shehuchzak letuma vechezkat hattame tame ad sheyyithar vadday yarad lehaker hare ze tahor ad sheyyeda shennaga nimtza hammet tzaf al pene hammayim hare ze bechezkat tame shechezkato shennaga baze shehu tzaf
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 7: Yesh tumot min hammet sheen hannazir megalleach alehen velo soter et hakkodmin veaf al pi shennitma bahen tumat shiva lefi shello neemar bo vechi yittamma lenefesh ella vechi yamut met alav ad sheyyittame mittumot shehen meatzmo shel met veachar kach yavi karbenot tuma vigalleach tiglachat tuma veyippelu kal hayyamim harishonim

Veellu tumot min hammet shehannazir megalleach alehen al hannefel vaafillu lo nitkashsheru evarav begidin veal kezayit mibbesar hammet veal kezayit netzel veal atzamot shehen rov minyan haatzamot af al pi sheen bahen rova hakkav veal atzamot shehen rov binyano shel met veaf al pi sheen bahen rova hakkav veal chatzi kav atzamot af al pi sheen bahen lo rov binyano velo rov minyano vechal haatzamot yihu mishshel met echad velo mishshene metim veal hashshidra habbaa mimmet echad veal haggulgolet shel met echad veal evar min hammet habba mimmet echad veal evar min hachay meadam echad sheyyesh alehen basar sherauy laalot bo arucha bechay veal chatzi log dam habba mimmet echad veal melo chafnayim rekev hammet e zehu netzel ze besar hammet shennimmoach venaasa lecha serucha

Veen rekev hammet metamme ad sheyyikkaver erom bearon shel shayish veyihye kullo shalem chaser mimmennu evar o shennikbar bichsuto o bearon shel etz o beshel mattechet en lo rekev velo amru rekev ella lemet bilvad lehotzi harug shehare chaser damo

Kavru shene metim keechad o sheggazzu searo o tzipparnav ukvarum immo o ishsha ubbara shemmeta venikbera veubbarah bemeeha en harekev shellahem metamme vechen im tachan hammet ad shennaasa rekev eno metamme ad sheyyarkiv meelav tachan et hammet vehinniach afaro ad shehirkiv kullo o shehirkiv miktzato keshehu chay umet vehirkiv hakkol hare ze safek veim nitma lerekev ze hare ze sefek tame vechen im nitma berova atzamot habbain mehashshidra o min haggulgolet beaholan hare ze sefek tame

Kal ellu hashshettem esre tumot shemmaninu im naga nazir beachat mehen o nesaah o heehil hannazir aleha o heehil hattuma al hannazir o haya hannazir veachat mittumot ellu beohel echad hare ze megalleach tiglachat tuma umevi karban tuma vesoter et hakkol chutz min harekev sheeno metamme bemagga shei efshar sheyyigga bechullo shehare eno guf echad aval im nesao o nitma beaholo megalleach

Vechen nazir shennaga beetzem hammet afillu etzem kisora o nesao hare ze megalleach alav umevi karbenot tuma vesoter et hakkodmim veen etzem kisora metamme beohel aval nitma beachat mishshenem asar devarim hallalu begush eretz haakkum o besade shennechrash kever betochah shehen metammein bemagga uvmassa o sheheehil alav veal hassarigim hayyotzim min hailanot o happeraot hayyotzot min haggader o mitta o gamal vechayyotze bo o shennitma beohel rova atzamot sheen bahen lo rov binyan velo rov minyan o shennitma birviit dam min hammet shehi metamme bemagga uvmassa uvohel o shennitma begolel o bedofek shehen metammein bemagga uvohel o shennitma beevar min hachay o beevar min hammet sheen alehen basar karauy hare ze eno soter

Af al pi shebbechal ellu hu tame tumat shiva umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii eno megalleach tiglachat tuma velo mevi karbanot velo soter et hakkodmin aval kal yeme hattuma en olin lo mimminyan yeme neziruto

Naga beohel hammet o bechelim hannogim bemet eno mazze bashshelishi uvashshevii veyerae li sheddin ze meyuchad benazir aval kal adam shennitma bichli tumat shiva yazze bashshelishi uvashshevii kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot tumat met vechen yerae li shezze sheeno mazze bashshelishi uvashshevii im naga bechelim kede sheyyaalu lo yeme tumato bechelim mimminyan yeme neziruto

Nazir shennitztarea vehuchlat kal yeme chilluto veshivat yeme sefiro shessofer achar sheyyithar letzarato ben tiglachat rishona lishniyya en olin lo mime neziruto aval yeme hesger olin lo vechen im zav besaro ben ish ben ishsha kal yeme zivatan olin lahen af al pi shehen temein vedavar ze halacha lemoshe missinay hu
En tzarich lomar sheim nitma hannazir bishar tumot sheyeme tumato olin lo veeno soter kelum nitma bemet betoch yeme tzarato soter et kal hakkodmin shehare binziruto omed veaf al pi shehu tame

Hannazir muttar betumat met mitzva uvtiglachat mitzva veasur beyen hammitzva keyen harshut ketzad mi shennishba sheyyishte hayyom yayin shehare mitzva alav lishtot veachar kach nadar benazir chala nezirut al hashshevua veasur beyayin veen tzarich lomar shehu asur beyen kiddush vehavdala sheeno ella middivre sofrim
Vechetzad hu muttar betumat met mitzva haya mehallech badderech ufaga bemet sheen sham mi sheyyikberennu hare ze mittamme lo vekovro udvarim ellu divre kabbala hen

Nazir vechohen sheppagu bemet mitzva yittamme nazir af al pi shehu soter hayyamim harishonim umevi karban tuma veal yittamme kohen shezze kedushshato kedushshat shaa vaafillu haya nezir olam vehakkohen kedushshato kedushshat olam

Pagu bo shene nezirim echad nazir sheloshim yom veechad nazir mea yom yittamme nezir sheloshim haya echad nazir lizman katzuv vehashsheni nezir olam yittamme hannazir lizman katzuv shennezirut olam kedushshato chamura mizze

Vechetzad hu muttar betiglachat mitzva nazir shennitztarea venirpa mitztzarato betoch yeme nezirut hare ze megalleach kal searo shehare tiglachto mitzvat ase shenneemar bimtzora vegillach et kal searo vego vechal makom sheatta motze mitzvat ase velo taase im yachol atta lekayyem et shenehem mutav veim lav yavo ase veyidche et lo taase vahalo nazir sheggilleach bime nizro avar al lo taase vaase shenneemar kadsh yihye gaddel pera sear rosho uvchal makom en ase docha lo taase vaase velamma doche ase shel tiglachat hannega linzirut mippene shekkevar nitma hannazir betzaraat vime chilluto en olin lo kemo shebbearnu vahare eno kadosh bahen uvatal haase meelav velo nishar ella lo taase shehu taar lo yaavor al rosho ulfichach ba ase shel tiglachat hatztzaraat vedacha oto
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 8: Tiglachat hattahora ketzad hi kesheyyigmor hannazir yeme neziruto mevi shalosh behemot keves leola vechavsa lechattat veayil lishlamim hevi shelashtan velo peresh haruya lechattat tikrav chattat veharuya lishlamim shelamim veharuya leola ola umevi im el hashshelamim shishsha esronot ushne shelishe issaron solet ofe mehen esrim challa eser challot matztzot vaasara rekike matztzot umosheach haesrim birviit shemen veshiur ze halacha lemoshe missinay umevi haesrim bichli echad

Veshochet hachattat techilla veachar kach haola veachar kach shelamim veachar kach megalleach veim gilleach achar sheshshachat hachattat o haola yatza umvashshel hashshelamim o sholkan velokeach min harotev shel zivche hashshelamim venoten al hassear veachar kach mashlicho laesh tachat dud hashshelamim veim hishlicho tachat hachattat yatza

Vehechan megalleach searo beezrat hannashim belishkat hannezirim shehayeta sham bekeren mizrachit deromit veshem mevashshelin et shelamehen umashlichin searan laesh veim gilleach bammedina yatza uven sheggilleach bammedina uven sheggilleach bammikdash tachat haddud hu mashlich searo veeno megalleach ad sheyyihye petach haazara patuach shenneemar petach ohel moed lo sheyegallach keneged happetach shezze bizon mikdash hu

Veachar kach notel hakkohen et hazzeroa beshela min haayil vechallat matztza achat min hassal verakik echad venotnan al kappe hannazir o hannezira umnifan veachar kach huttar hannazir lishtot yayin ulhittamme lemetim

Nazir memorat eno tzarich lehaavir taar veaf al pi sheen lo sear o sheen lo kappayim hare ze makriv karbenotav veyishte veyittamme veim hevi karbenotav velo gilleach rosho en hattiglachat meakkevet ella shote umittamme laerev shemmishsheyyizzarek alav echad min haddamim huttar af al pi shello natan al kappav velo henif shekkal devarim ellu lemitzva velo leakkev

Af al pi sheen hattiglachat meakkev alav mitzva legalleach afillu leachar zeman merubbe venazir sheggilleach belo taar o sheggilleach veshiyyer shette searot lo asa kelum velo kiyyem mitzvat gilluach ben nazir tahor ben nazir tame

Gilleach vehinniach shette searot vetzimmeach rosho kullo vechazar vegillecho im otan shette hassearot o sheggilleach achat venashra achat hare ze kiyyem mitzvat gilluach nashra achat vegilleach achat en kan mitzvat gilluach

Gilleach al hashshelamim venimtza pasul tiglachto pesula uzvachav lo alu lo gilleach al hachattat venimtzet shello nishchata leshem chattat veachar kach hevi hashshelamim vehaola vehikrivan kemitzvatan tiglachto pesula uzvachav lo alu lo
Gilleach al haola veal hashshelamim venishchatu shello lishman veachar kach hevi karbanot acherot lehakrivan lishman tiglachto pesula uzvachav lo alu lo
Gilleach al shelashtan venimtza echad mehem kasher tiglachto keshera veyavi shear hazzevachim veyikkarvu kehilchatan

Kal makom sheamarnu tiglachto pesula hare hu kemi shennitgalleach betoch yeme neziruto shehu soter sheloshim yom kemo shebbearnu venimtza mone sheloshim yom achar hattiglachat happesula veyavi karbenotav
Shalme nazir sheshshechatan shello kemitzvatan kesherim veen olim labbealim leshem chova veneechalin leom echad veen teunin lechem velo mattanot velo zeroa
Shalosh behemot ellu vehallechem habba immahem hakkol min hachullin kishar nidre hekdesh kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo
Haomer hareni nazir al menat sheagalleach mimmeot maaser sheni hare ze nazir veeno mevi karbenotav min hammaaser ella min hachullin

Haish shennadar benazir yesh lo lehavi karbenot aviv leatzmo umgalleach alehem veen haishsha megallachat al karbenot aviha vedavar ze halacha mippi hakkabbala hu ketzad mi shehaya aviv nazir vehifrish maot liknot bahen karbenotav umet vehinniach hammaot setumin veamar achare mot aviv hareni nazir al menat sheavi karbenotay mimmaot shehifrish bahen avi lekarbenotav hare ze mevi mehen karbenotav vechen im haya hu veaviv nezirim vehifrish aviv maot setumin umet haav veamar habben achar mot aviv hareni megalleach al meot avi hare ze mevi karbenotav mehen aval im lo amar yippelu hammaot lindava met haav vehinniach banim rabbim cholkim hammaot hassetumim mippene shehi yerushsha lahen veyesh lechal echad mehen legalleach al chelko vehabbechor notel bahen pi shenayim
Ben shehaya haav nezir olam vehabben nazir zeman katzuv ben shehaya haav nazir zeman katzuv vehabben nezir olam hare ze megalleach umevi karbenotav mimmeot nezirut aviv

Hifrish haav maot lehavi bahen karbenot tuma umet en habben mevi bahen karbenot tahora vechen im hifrishan haav lekarban tahora en habben megalleach alehen tiglachat tuma sheddevarim ellu hen safek veim hevi zevachav lo alu lo

Haomer hare alay legalleach nazir chayyav lehavi karbenot tiglachat tahora umakrivan al yad eze nazir sheyyirtze amar hare alay chatzi karbenot nazir o im amar hare alay legalleach chatzi nazir hare ze mevi chatzi hakkarbanot leeze nazir sheyyirtze veoto nazir mashlim karbenotav mishshello aval im amar hare alay karbenot chatzi nazir hare ze mevi karbenot nazir shalem sheen lanu chatzi nezirut

Haomer hareni nazir vealay legalleach nazir veshama chavero veamar vaani hare chavero nazir veeno chayyav legalleach nazir acher shehare lo hitpis atzmo ella binzirut veim amar vaani vealay legalleach nazir hare ze chayyav veim hau pikchin mevi kal echad mehen karbanot al yede chavero veim lo asu chen chayyavim legalleach nezirut acherim

Haomer hare alay legalleach chatzi nazir veshama chavero veamar vaani vealay legalleach chatzi nazir ze mevi chatzi karbenotav shel ze veze mevi chatzi karbenotav shel ze vechal echad mehen mashlim karbenotav im hau pikchin veim lav ze mevi chatzi karbanot meeze nazir sheyyirtze veze mevi chatzi karbanot meeze nazir sheyyirtze
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 9: Hammafrish maot sheyyakriv mehen karbenot nezirim vehikriv mehen vehotiru yaviu bemotaran karbenot nezirim acherim shemmotar nezirim linzirim hifrish maot setumin linziruto vehotiru yippelu hammotarot lindava
Hammafrish maot meforashin linziruto vehotiru motar meot haola yavou ola umotar hachattat yolichem leyam hammelach umotar deme hashshelamim yavou shelamim veen teunin lechem veneechalin leom echad

Hammafrish maot linziruto umet im hau setumin yippelu lindava hau meforashin deme ola yavou ola deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach deme shelamim yavou shelamim veneechalin leom echad veen teunin lechem

Ketzad hem hammaot hassetumin kegon shehifrish maot lehavi mehen karbenotav velo amar kelum aval im amar ellu lechovati hare ellu kimforashin veen tzarich lomar im amar ellu leolati ulchattati velishlamay shehen kimforashin
Hammafrish behema baalat mum hare hi kemaot setumin vechen hammafrish lashon shel kesef veshel zahav o keli af al pi sheamar ze lechattati ulolati velishlamay hare hu kemaot setumin
Haomer ellu lechattati vehashshear linziruti umet o shehayeta ishsha vehefer lah balah deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach vehashshear yavou bechetzyan ola uvchetzyan shelamim
Amar ellu leolati vehashshear linziruti deme ola yavou ola vehashshear yippelu lindava

Mi sheddimma shehu chayyav binzirut vehifrish karbenotav veachar kach shaal lechacham vehorahu sheen ze neder veeno chayyav binzirut ma yaase bakkarbanot shehifrish yetzu veyiru baeder shezze hekdesh taut sheeno hekdesh kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo

Haishsha shennadra benazir vehifrisha karbenoteha veachar kach hefer lah balah im shello hayeta habbehema tetze vetire baeder sheen adam makdish davar sheeno shello veim hau hakkarbanot mishshellah veen levalah bahen kelum kegon shennatnu lah bemattana al menat shello yihye labbaal bahen reshut ella ma shettirtze taase bahen hachattat tamut vehaola tikkarev ola vehashshelamim yikkarvu shelamim veneechalin leom echad veenan teunin lechem
Hifrisha maot setumin lekarbenoteha yippelu lindava hau meforashin deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach udme ola yavou ola udme shelamim yavou shelamim veneechalin leom echad veenan teunin lechem
Haishsha shennadra benazir venitmet betoch yeme nezirut veachar kach shama balah vehefer lah hare zo mevia karban tuma

Haish shehiddir et beno benazir vehifrish alav karbenotav velo ratza habben binzirut zo umacha hu o kerovav o sheggilleach hu o sheggillechuhu kerovav hachattat tamut vehaola tikkarev ola vehashshelamim yikkarvu shelamim veneechalin leom echad veenan teunin lechem hifrish lo maot setumim hare ellu yippelu lindava hau maot meforashin deme chattat yelchu leyam hammelach deme ola yavou ola deme shelamim yavou shelamim veenan teunin lechem veneechalin leom echad
Haomer hareni nazir kesheyyihye li ben vehifrish karban vehippila ishto vechazra veyalda hare hakkarbanot safek vaasurin begizza uvaavoda

Shene nezirim shennitma echad mehem veen yadua mi hu ketzad meviin karbenotehen meviin karban tuma vekarban tahora bimlot yeme nezirutam veomer echad mehem im ani hu hattame karban tuma shelli vekarban tahora shellecha veim ani hu hattahor karban tahora shelli vekarban tuma shellecha vesofrim yeme nezirut acheret gemura meachar karbanot ellu vechozrin umviin karban tahora veomer echad mehen im ani hu shehayiti tame karban tuma shelli vekarban tahora shellecha veze karban tahorati im ani hu hattahor karban tahora shelli vekarban tuma shellecha veze karban tahoratcha nimtzeu shello hifsidu bekarbenotehen kelum

Met echad mehen hare ze mevi chattat haof veolat behema veyomar im tame hayiti hachattat mechovati vehaola nedava veim tahor hayiti haola mechovati vechattat haof safek vesofer yeme nezirut acheret umevi karban tahora veomer im tame hayiti haola harishona nedava vezo chova veim tahor hayiti haola harishona chova vezo nedava veze shear karbani veen echad mishshenehem megalleach tiglachat tuma ella im ken hau ketannim o nashim sheen ellu makkifin peat rosham missafek

Vechetzad yivaled lahem safek ze betuma kegon shehau shene hannezirin omdin birshut hayyachid shessefek tuma sham tame vehaya echad mibbachutz roe otan veamar raiti echad mikkem shennitma veeni yodea mi hu aval im haya ed ze immahen bechatzer hare shenehen tehorin kevan shehem shelosha hare hen rabbim verabbim birshut hayyachid sefekan tahor kisfek tuma birshut harabbim shehu tahor kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo

Bamme devarim amurim kesheshshatku hannezirim shenehem o nistappek lahen haddavar aval im amar echad mehen ani lo nitmeti afillu shene edim meidim alav shennitma eno mevi karban al pihem shezze sheamar lo nitmeti keomer eni mevi betuma shekkevar nishalti al neziruti venimtza sheeno machchish et haedim veadam neeman al yede atzmo aval im shatak o nistappek lo hare ze mevi karban afillu al pi ed echad kemo shebbearnu vechen ed sheamar leechad befanay nadarta binzirut im hichchisho eno chayyav kelum veim lo hichchisho noheg nezirut al piv afillu amar lishnayim raiti echad mikkem shennazar veeni yodea mi hu hoil veen machchishin oto nohagin nezirut al piv nahag nezirut al pi ed echad veshata yayin o nitma vehitru bo shenayim loke af al pi sheikkar hannezirut beed echad
Met shehaya mushkav lerochav hadderech af al pi sheen sham makom laavor ella alav o nogea betziddo veaf al pi shehi tuma yedua veavar sham nazir hare ze tahor hoil vesafek birshut harabbim tahor

Bamme devarim amurim bimhallech beraglav aval im haya rochev o taun massa hare ze tame shehammehallech beraglav efshar shello yigga o shello yaahil o shello yasit aval taun o rochev i efshar shello yigga veshello yaahil o shello yasit shehare hammet lerochav hadderech
Mishneh Torah, Nazariteship 10: En adam megalleach tiglachat achat veola lo lenizro ultzarato vetiglachat hatztzaraat bizman shehu sefek metzora eno doche et hannezirut lefichach mi shennazar shana achat vehaya bechal hashshana hazzot sefek metzora usfek teme met o shehaya bah sefek metzora uvsof hashshana nitma besafek hare ze mone shiva yamim umazze bashshelishi ushvii veeno megalleach bashshevii veeno yachol lishtot beyayin ulhittamme lemet ella leachar arba shanim veochel bekadashim leachar shette shanim mippene shehu tzarich legalleach arba tiglachiyyot tiglachat tahora vetiglachat tuma missafek ushte tiglachiyyot shemmegalleach hamtzora shehare hu sefek metzora

Tiglachat rishona megalleach otah achar shana rishona umgalleach bah rosho uzkano vegabbot enav umittaher beetz erez veezov vetzipporim kishar metzoraim im eno teme met velo metzora hare hi tiglachat tahora shel neziruto veim hu metzora vadday beshana rishona hare hi tiglachat rishona shel metzora veshohe shana acheret keminyan yeme hannezirut veachar kach megalleach tiglachat sheniyya shel metzora sheeno yachol legalleach achar shiva kishar metzorain shemma eno metzora ella teme met vadday haya veshana sheniyya zo hare hu bah nazir sheasur legalleach umeachar sheggilleach shette tiglachiyyot ellu shalma tahorat hatztzaraat umuttar leechol bekadashim veshohe shana shelishit veachar kach megalleach tiglachat shelishit shemma metzora vadday haya beshana rishona velo haya teme met veshana rishona lo alta lo mippene shehi yeme chilluto veshana sheniyya lo alta lo mippene shehi yeme sefiro shel metzora shebben tiglachat rishona ushniyya lefichach tzarich lishhot shana shelishit binziruto umgalleach tiglachat shelishit linziruto vehi tiglachat tahora o shemma teme met vadday haya umtzora vadday veen tiglachat achat ola linziruto ultzarato venimtzet tiglachat rishona ushniyya tiglachat tzaraat vetiglachat shelishit tiglachat tuma veen achat mishshalosh shanim ola shehare hashshelishit tiglachat tuma lefichach tzarich lishhot shana reviit binzirut umgalleach tiglachat reviit usaro bechal tiglachat safek asur bahanaya missafek shessear nazir shennitztarea muttar bahanaya

Vechen im nadar eser shanim nezirut vehaya bahen sefek metzora venolad lo sefek tuma besofan hare ze eno shote beyayin ad arbaim shana umgalleach arba tiglachot achat besof kal eser shaniyim tiglachat rishona lisfek yeme tzarato sheniyya lisfek yeme sefiro shel metzora shelishit lisfek tumato reviit tiglachat tahora

Vechetzad mevi ze karbenotav im haya ashir kotev nechasav laacherim shemmetzora ashir shehevi karban ani lo yatza veachar kach mevi chattat haof veolat behema betiglachat rishona ushniyya ushlishit vechal chattat of mehen lo teachel mippene shehi safek umevi betiglachat reviit karban nazir tahor shehu shalosh behemot kemo shebbearnu

Shalosh chatteot haof shemmevi bishlosh hattiglachot chattat rishona lisfek tumato sheniyya lisfek tzarato sheen hamtzora mevi karbano ella leachar tiglachat sheniyya vechen chattat shelishit lisfek tumato sheen tiglachat achat ola lenizro ultzarato veshemma metzora vadday utme met vadday haya shehattiglachat harishona vehashsheniyya letzarato kemo shebbearnu vetiglachat shelishit tiglachat tuma ulfichach tzarich lehavi karban tuma bashshelishit
Shalosh olot behema shemmevi immahen al harishona hu matne veomer im tahor ani zo mechovati veim tame ani hare hi nedava vechen hu omer bashsheniyya uvashshelishit

Umevi karban tahora betiglachat reviit veomer umatne im tame hayiti ola rishona nedava vezo chova veim muchlat hayiti rishona chovat metzora vezo chovat nezirut ushtayim haemtzaiyyot nedava veim tahor mittumat met hayiti umtzora ola harishona chova vechen hashsheniyya achat lechovat metzora veachat lechovat nezirut ushlishit urviit nedava vehashshear karban tahorati veim tame hayiti umtzora ola rishona chovat tzaraat ushniyya ushlishit nedava veze karban tiglachat tahora

Aval haasham vehaola enan meakkevin lo betiglachat tuma velo betzaraat nimtzeta omer im hu metzora vadday velo nitma bemet hare tahar betzipporin vechattat haof hi chattato velo teachel mippene shehu safek veolat behema sheimmah mikkarban tiglachat tahora kede sheyegalleach al habbehema veim teme met hu hare olat behema nedava veim eno metzora utme met hu chattat haof karban nazir shennitma veolat behema nedava vahare hevi karban tahora baacharona veim eno teme met velo metzora olat behema shehevi battiglachat harishona hi mechovat tiglachat vechattat haof baa al safek vahare lo neechelet

Bamme devarim amurim shehu megalleach arba tiglachot keshehaya katan o ishsha aval haish eno megalleach missafek lo tiglachat tuma velo tiglachat tzaraat shemma tahor hu venimtza makkif peat rosho shello bimkom mitzva lefichach eno megalleach ella tiglachat tahora bilvad sheen arba tiglachot ellu leakkev ella lemitzva

Nazir shennitztarea vadday venitma besafek ketzad hu ose achar sheyyithar mitztzarato mazze bashshelishi uvashshevii umgalleach tiglachat tuma umatchil limnot neziruto kullah shehare naflu hayyamim harishonim bisfek tuma shennitma umevi karban tahora veshote beyayin umeachar sheyyavi karban tzaraat ochel bekadashim

Nitma vadday vehaya metzora besafek vetahar missefek tzarato mone yeme neziruto shelema veachar kach megalleach tiglachat hannega sheen tiglachat sefek nigo docha nezirut veachar kach mone shivat yamim shebben tiglachat metzora harishona letiglachat sheniyya umgalleach umevi karbenotav veochel bekadashim umazze bishlishi ushvii veachar kach mone shiva acherim letumat met umgalleach tiglachat tuma veachar kach mone neziruto kullah

Vechen im haya tame umtzora bevadday leachar sheyyithar mitztzarato megalleach tiglachat tzaraat harishona umazze bashshelishi uvashshevii umgalleach rosho uzkano bashshevii vehi tiglachat sheniyya shel tzaraat umevi karbenotav bashshemini veochel bekadashim vesofer shiva umgalleach tiglachat tuma veachar kach sofer yeme nezirut shelema umevi karban tahora veshote beyayin
Lamma sofer shiva sheen shivat yeme hattuma olin beshivat yeme sefira shebben tiglachat vetiglachat shel metzora

Haomer hareni nazir im eese kach vechach o im lo eese vechayyotze baze hare ze rasha unzirut kazo minnezirut reshaim hu aval hannoder la derech kedushsha hare ze nae umshubbach veal ze neemar nezer elohav al rosho kadsh hu la ushkalo hakkatuv kenavi shenneemar vaakim mibbenechem linviim umibbachurechem linzirim seliku lehu hilchot nezirut besiyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 1: Arbaa mine shevuot hen shevuat bittuy ushvuat shave ushvuat happikkadon ushvuat haedut shevuat bittuy hu shenneemar battora o nefesh ki tishshava levatte visfatayim lehara o lehetiv vehi nechleket learbaa chalakim shettayim lehabba ushtayim lesheavar kegon shennishba al davar sheavar shennaasa o shello naasa veal davar sheatid lihot sheyyease veshello yease

Veen shevuat bittuy noheget ella bidvarim sheefshar lo laasotan ben lehabba ben lesheavar ketzad lesheavar sheachalti o shezzarakti even layyam o sheddibber peloni im peloni o shello achalti o shello zarak even layyam o shello dibber peloni im peloni ketzad lehabba sheochal o shello ochal o sheezrok o shello ezrok even layyam hare ellu shettayim lesheavar ushtayim lehabba

Nishba achat mearba machalokot ellu vehechlif kegon shennishba shello yochal veachal o sheyyochal velo achal o sheachalti vehu lo achal shello achalti veachal hare zo shevuat sheker veal ze vechayyotze bo neemar lo tishshavu vishmi lashshaker veim nishba lashsheker bemezid loke beshogeg mevi karban ole veored shenneemar venelam mimmennu vehu yada veashem vego

Shevuat shave nechleket learba machalokot haachat shennishba al davar hayyadua sheen ken ketzad kegon shennishba al haish shehu ishsha veal haishsha shehu ish veal ammud shel shayish shehu shel zahav vechen kal kayyotze baze

Hashsheniyya shennishba al davar yadua sheen bo safek leadam shehu ken kegon shennishba al hashshamayim shehu shamayim veal haeven zo shehi even veal hashshenayim shehem shenayim vechen kal kayyotze baze shezze haddavar en bo safek leadam shalem kede letzaddek haddavar bishvua

Shelishit shennishba levattel et hammitzva ketzad kegon shennishba shello yitattef betzitzit shello yilbash tefillin veshello yeshev bassukka bechag hassukkot velo yochal matztza belele happesach o sheyyitanne beshabbatot uvyamim tovim vechen kal kayyotze baze

Reviit shennishba al davar sheen koach bo laasot ketzad kegon shennishba shello yishan shelosha yamim layela vaom retzufim o shello yitom kelum shiva yamim retzufim vechen kal kayyotze baze kal hannishba shevuat shave mearba shevuot ellu over belo taase shenneemar lo tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshave veim haya mezid loke veim haya shogeg patur mikkelum

Shevuat happikkadon ketzad kal mi sheyyesh mamon chavero beyado ben pikkadon ben milve o sheggezalo o ashako o matza lo aveda velo hechezirah vechayyotze baze vetava mimmennu mamon sheyyesh lo beyado vechafar bo hare ze over belo taase shenneemar lo techachashu zo azhara lichfirat mamon veen lokin al lav ze veim nishba lo al sheker al mamon shekkafar bo hare ze over belav acher veal ze neemar lo teshakkeru ish baamito zo azhara lenishba al kefirat mamon ushvua zo hi hannikret shevuat happikkadon

Uma hu chayyav al shevuat happikkadon sheshshikker bah meshallem et hakkeren shekkafar bo im tosefet chomesh umakriv asham vadday ben shehaya mezid ben shehaya shogeg shenneemar vechichesh baamito befikkadon o vitsumet yad o vegazel vego vehaya ki yecheta veashem velo neemar bo venelam mimmennu lechayyev mezid keshogeg

Vehu sheyyazid befikkadon o bemamon shennitchayyev bo veyada bo bishat shevua aval im shagag veshachach sheyyesh lo etzlo mamon vechafar venishba veachar kach yada hare ze anus ufatur mikkelum vechen im lo yada sheasur lishshava lashsheker al kefirat mamon hare ze anus ufatur

Im ken heach hi shiggat shevuat happikkadon kegon shenneelam mimmennu im chayyavin aleha karban im lav veyada shehi asura vesheyyesh lo etzlo mamon zo hi shiggatah uzdonah sheyyada shechayyavin aleha karban

Shevuat haedut ketzad haedim sheyyadu edut mamon utvaam baal haedut lehaid lo vechafru beedutan velo heidu venishbeu sheenan yodin lo edut zo hi nikret shevuat haedut vechayyavin al shevua zo karban ole veored ben shehau mezidin ben shehau shoggim shenneemar nefesh ki techeta veshama kol ala vehu ed velo neemar bah venelam lechayyev al hazzadon kishgaga

Ketzad shiggat shevuat haedut kegon shenneelam mimmennu shechayyavin aleha karban veyada sheshshevua zo asura veshehi sheker uzdonah sheyyada shechayyavin aleha karban aval im lo yada shehi asura o sheshshachchu haedut venishbeu veachar kach noda lahem shehen yodin lo edut veshennishbeu al sheker hare ellu anusin ufturin af min hakkarban
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 2: Echad hannishba echad mearbaa mine shevuot ellu mippi atzmo veechad hammushba mippi acherim veana amen afillu hishbio akkum o katan veana amen chayyav shekkal haone amen achar shevua kemotzi shevua mippiv veechad haone amen o haomer davar sheinyano keinyan amen kegon sheamar hen o mechuyyav ani bishvua zo kibbalti alay shevua zo vechal kayyotze baze bechal lashon hare ze kenishba lechal davar ben lechayevo malkot ben lechayevo karban

Echad hannishba o shehishbio acher bashshem hamyuchad o beechad min hakkinnuyin kegon shennishba bemi sheshshemo channun uvmi sheshshemo rachum uvmi sheshshemo erech appayim vechayyotze bahen bechal lashon hare zo shevua gemura vechen ala vearur hare hen shevua vehu sheyyazkir shem min hashshemot o kinnuy min hakkinnuyin ketzad kegon sheamar beala o arur la o lemi sheshshemo channun o lemi sheshshemo rachum mi sheyyochal davar peloni vaachalo hare ze nishba lashsheker vechen bishar mine shevuot
Vechen haomer shevua ba o bemi sheshshemo channun shello ochal veachal shezzo ishsha vehu ish sheen lecha beyadi kelum veyesh lo sheeni yodea lecha edut vehu yodea hare ze chayyav

Amar ala o arur o shevua velo hizkir shem velo kinnuy hare ze asur baddavar shennishba alav aval eno loke velo mevi karban im avar al shevuato ad sheyyihye bah shem min hashshemot hammeyuchadim o kinnuy min hakkinnuyin kemo shebbearnu

Velo hashshevua bilvad ella kal kinnuye shevua kishvua kegon shehau anshe oto makom illegim vehau korim lishvua shevutah o shekuka o shehau arammiyyim shelleshon shevua bilshonam momta vehaillegim mechannin otah veomrim moha kevan sheamar lashon shemmashmao veinyano shevua hare ze chayyav kemi shehotzi leshon shevua

Vechen haomer lav lav shette peamim derech shevua o hen hen vehizkir shem o kinnuy hare ze kenishba vechen yamin shevua usmol shevua shenneemar nishba Adonai bimino uvizroa uzzo vechen haomer mivta shello eese kach vechach vehizkir shem o kinnuy hare zo shevua
Amar issar la o lemi sheshshemo channun sheeese o shello eese hoil vehotzio bilshon shevua hare hi kishvua
Shama chavero nishba veamar vaani kemotcha hoil velo hotzi shevua mippiv velo hishbio chavero hare ze patur vezehu matpis bishvua shehu patur

Vechen im nishba shello ochal basar ze vechazar veamar vahare happat zo kabbasar hazze hare hu patur al happat shehare lo hotzi shevua mippiv aleha ella hitpisah veaf al pi shehu patur min hammalkot o min hakkarban asur lo leechol otah happat shehitpis bishvua

Mi shennitkaven lishvua vegamar belibbo shello yochal hayyom o shello yishte vesheddavar ze asur alav bishvua velo hotzi visfatav hare ze muttar shenneemar levatte bisfatayim en hannishba chayyav ad sheyyotzi inyan shevua bisfatav

Vechen im gamar belibbo lehishshava vetaa vehotzi bisfatav davar shello haya belibbo hare ze muttar ketzad hammitkavin lehishshava shello yochal etzel reuven uchshebba lehotzi shevua nishba shello yochal etzel shimon hare ze muttar leechol im reuven shehare lo hotzio bisfatav veim shimon shehare lo haya shimon belibbo

Vechen shear mine shevuot eno chayyav ad sheyyihye piv velibbo shavin lefichach im nishba echad befanenu shello yochal hayyom veachal vehitru bo veamar ani lo haya belibbi ella shello etze hayyom vetaa leshoni vehotzi achila shello hayeta belibbi hare ze eno loke ad sheyyode bifne edim kodem sheyyochal sheal achila nishba o shekkibbel alav hatraa velo taan shettaa beet hatraa af al pi shettaan achar kach en shomin lo vechen im hitru bo veamar meolam lo nishbati o lo nadarti ella al davar ze veachar sheheidu alav shennishba o nadar amar ken haya aval lo haya pi velibbi shavin o tenay haya belibbi al hanneder en shomin lo veloke
Kayyotze bo amru lo ishtecha nadra veamar belibbi haya lehafer lah vehefarti shomin lo amru lo nadra vehu omer lo nadra vechevan sheraa otam heidu alav amar belibbi haya lehafer en shomin lo
Gamar belibbo shello leechol pat chittin venishba shello yochal pat setam asur befat chittim sheppat chittim pat shemah

Mi shennishba veamar shevua shello ochal hayyom veal datechem ani nishba en ze yachol lomar kach vechach haya belibbi shello nishba ze al dato ella al daat acherim vechevan shehaya piv velibbam shel acherim shennishba al datam shavim chayyav mippene shellibbam shel ellu bimkom libbo kam vechen bishar mine shevuot
Lefichach keshemmashbiin haddayyanin et hannishba omrim lo lo al datecha anu mashbiim otcha ella al datenu

Mi shennishba vehaya piv velibbo shavin bishvua veachar shenneesar chazar bo miyyad betoch kede dibbur vehu kede sheyyomar talmid lerav shalom alecha rabbi veamar en zo shevua o nichamti o chazarti bi vechayyotze bidvarim ellu sheinyanam shehittir ma sheasar hare ze muttar veneekra hashshevua shezze dome letoe

Vechen im amru lo acherim chazor becha o muttar lecha vechayyotze bidvarim ellu vekibbel mehen betoch kede dibbur veamar hen o chazarti bi vechayyotze baze hare ze muttar veim achar kede dibbur eno yachol lachzor bo

Nishba vechazar bo betoch kede dibbur belibbo en ze kelum vechen im amru lo acherim chazor becha o muttar lecha o machul lecha vekibbel divrehem belibbo betoch kede dibbur en ze kelum ad sheyyotzi hachazara befiv kemo hashshevua
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 3: Kal hannishba shevua mearba mine shevuot ellu beones hare ze patur mikkelum veechad hannishba mittechillato beones kemo shebbearnu o shennishba veneenas velo hinnichuhu lekayyem shevuato o shehishbio annas lefichach nishbain lacharamin ulhorgin ulmochsin
Bee ze moches amru bemoches haomed meelav shellokeach mamon shello birshut melech hammedina o shellokeach birshut hammelech aval mosif leatzmo al haddavar hakkatzuv kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot gezela

Vetzarich hannishba beones lihot kavanato belibbo beet hashshevua ledavar happotro veaf al pi shehaddevarim ellu shebballev enan devarim hoil veeno yachol lehotzi bisfatav mippene haones hare ze somech al devarim shebbelibbo
Ketzad kegon shennishba leannas shello yochal basar setam uvlibbo shello yochal hayyom o shello yochal besar chazir hare ze muttar vechen kal kayyotze baze

Vechen shevuat havay veshel shegagot patur alehen shevuat shel havay ketzad kegon sheraa chelot gedolot vechoma gevoha venishba sheraiti chel peloni hammelech vehem keotze mitzrayim vesheraiti chomat ir pelonit gevoha ad larakia vechayyotze bidvarim ellu shezze lo gamar belibbo shehaddavar kach belo pachot velo yoter velo nitkaven ella lesapper et govah hachoma o rov haam

Shevua shel shegagot ketzad im shevuat haedut o happikkadon hi kegon sheshshagag befikkadon uvedut shehu patur mikkelum kemo shebbearnu veim shevuat shave hi kegon shennishba shello yilbash tefillin velo yada shehattefillin mitzva veim shevuat sheker hi kegon shennishba shello achal venizkar sheachal o shennishba shello yochal veshachach veachal o shello tehane ishto lo mippene shegganva kiso o shehikketa et beno venoda shello ganva veshello hikketa vechen kal kayyotze baze

Im ken e zehu shiggat shevuat bittuy shechayyavin aleha karban ole veored lesheavar kegon shennishba shello achal vehu yodea sheachal vesheshshevuat sheker zo shennishba asura aval lo yada shechayyavin aleha karban zo hi hashshegaga shechayyavin aleha karban ole veored bishvuat bittuy lesheavar

Vechetzad hi hashshegaga shechayyavin aleha karban lehabba kegon shennishba shello yochal pat chittim veshagag vedimma shennishba sheyyochal pat chittim vaachalah shezze neelma mimmennu hashshevua heach hayeta vahare hu zocher et hachefetz shennishba alav zo hi shiggat shevuat bittuy lehabba shechayyavin aleha karban
Aval im nishba shello yochal pat chittim veachal pat chittim al daat shehu pat seorim hare ze anus ufatur shehare lo neelma mimmennu shevua velo nelam mimmennu ella chefetz shennishba alav

Neelma mimmennu shevua heach hayeta venelam mimmennu chefetz shennishba alav hare ze patur min hakkarban ketzad kegon shennishba shello leechol pat chittim vedimma shennishba sheyyochal pat chittim veachal pat chittim al daat shehu pat seorim shehare helem shevua vechefetz beyado hare ze keanus ufatur

Nishba al kikkar shello yochlennu venitztaer alav vaachalo mippene hatztzaar vehu shogeg shehare dimma shemmuttar lo leachlo mippene hatztzaar hare ze patur min hakkarban lefi sheeno shav midiato ella yada sheasura hi vaachalah betaut
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 4: Mi shennishba shello yochal hayyom kelum veachal pachot mikkezayit patur sheen achila pechuta mikkezayit vahare hu keochel chatzi shiur minnevelot utrefot vechayyotze bahen veim amar shevua shello ochal davar ze vaachalo chayyav vaafillu haya haddavar shennishba alav zera chardal echad o pachot mimmennu
Nishba shello yitom kelum veachal kal shehu chayyav
Mi shennishba shello yochal hayyom veshata chayyav shehashshetiyya bichlal achila lefichach im achal veshata eno chayyav ella malkot achat im haya mezid o chattat achat im haya shogeg
Nishba shello yishte hayyom hare ze muttar leechol sheen achila bichlal shetiyya vechamma yishte vihe chayyav nire li sheeno chayyav ad sheyyishte reviit kishar haissurin

Shevua shello ochal hayyom veachal minin harbe o shevua shello eshte hayyom veshata mine mashkin harbe eno chayyav ella achat vaafillu amar shevua shello ochal hayyom basar ufat vekitnit veachal hakkol eno chayyav ella achat vechullan mitztarfin lichzayit

Shevua shello ochal veshello eshte veachal veshata chayyav shettayim shehashshetiyya bichlal achila vehoil uferet veamar veshello eshte gilla dato shello kalal hashshetiyya bichlal haachila venimtza kenishba al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo ulfichach chayyav shettayim
Vechen haomer shevua shello ochal pat chittin ufat seorin ufat kussemin vaachalan chayyav al kal achat veachat shello amar pat ufat ufat ella lechallek ulchayyev al kal achat
