Mi shehaya chayyav mamon lishne shuttafin utvao echad mehen vechafar bo venishba chayyav bishvuat happikkadon shehare kafar mamon tevauhu shenehem vehoda bakkol leechad mehem veamar lo laviti ella mizze levaddo venishba patur mishshevuat happikkadon shehare lo patar atzmo mikkelum aval chayyav bishvuat bittuy

Vechen mi shehayeta alav milve bishtar vechafar bah venishba patur mishshevuat happikkadon shehare bishtar nishtabed hakkarka venimtza ze kechofer bekarka uchvar bearnu shehakkofer bekarka patur mishshevuat happikkadon vechayyav bishvuat bittuy shehare nishba al sheker

Hayeta alav milve beedim bilvad vechafar venishba chayyav bishvuat happikkadon shehare patar atzmo bichfirato milleshallem atta veaf al pi shekkesheyyavou haedim yitchayyev leshallem venimtza shello hoila lo kefirato hare hoila beittah veshemma lo yavou haedim o yavou velo titkayyem edutan o yippaslu ulfichach chayyav
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 9: Hattovea edav lehaid lo edut sheyyitchayyev hannitba beedutan levaddah litten letovea ze mamon hammittaltel vechafru beedutan venishbeu ben shennishbeu bevet din ben shennishbeu chutz levet din hare ellu chayyavin mishshum shevuat haedut shehare hifsiduhu mamon bichfiratam vechen im hishbiam hattovea vechafru bo af al pi shello nishbeu hen velo anu amen achar shevuato kevan shekkafru hare ellu chayyavin vehu sheyyashbiem bevet din

En haedim chayyavin bishvuat haedut ad sheyyichperu beedutan bevet din ben shennishbeu o hishbian bevet din ben shennishbeu o hishbian chutz levet din vehakkefira bevet din bilvad shenneemar im lo yaggid venasa aono makom sheyyaggid veoil hu sheim lo yaggid sham yitchayyev

Tevaan beedut sheenah mechayyevet mamon o beedut karkaot o avadim o shetarot vechafru venishbeu peturin mishshevuat haedut sheen chayyavin ella al kefirat edut mamon sheddoma lefikkadon utsumet yad vegezel vaaveda sheppertan hakkatuv bapparasha shehen mittaltelin sheggufan mamon uchsheyyaidu laze yitten ze

Vechen hammashbia ede kenas vechafru peturin mishshevuat haedut mippene sheim kadam hannitba vehoda biknas yippater milleshallem veaf al pi shebbau haedim achar ken veheidu nimtzeu haedim lo chiyevu ze beedutan levaddah ella edutan im kefirat hannitba hi hamchayyevet otan vehoil veim hoda lo toil edutan im kafru bah venishbeu peturin

Mashbiachem ani shettavou vetaidu li sheyyesh li beyad peloni tashlume kefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha vechafru chayyavin bishvuat haedut mippene hakkeren shehu mamon lo mippene hakkefel shehu kenas vechen im hishbiam sheyyaidu lo sheanas peloni o pitta bitto vechafru chayyavin bishvuat haedut mippene habboshet vehappegam sheim hoda bahem hannitba meshallem lo mippene hakkenas vechen kal kayyotze baze
En haedim chayyavin bishvuat haedut ad sheyyichperu veyishshavu achar teviat baal din atzmo o shelucho aval im kadmu venishbeu kodem sheyyitbaem peturin mishshevuat haedut

Ketzad mashbia ani alechem keshettedu li edut shettavou utiduni veamru amen veyadu lo edut achar ken utvaam lehaid vechafru bo hare ellu peturin mishshevuat haedut

Veasur lehishshava bedavar acher im shemo vechal hamshattef davar acher im shem hakkadosh baruch hu bishvua neekar min haolam sheen sham mi sherauy lachlok lo chavod shennishbain bishmo ella haechad baruch hu
Umuttar leadam lehishshava al hammitzva laasotah kede lezarez et atzmo veaf al pi shehu mushba aleha mehar sinay shenneemar nishbati vaakayyema lishmor mishpete tzidkecha
Shevua zo shemmashbiin haddayyanim lemi shennitchayyev shevua hi hannikret shevuat haddayyanin ben shehaya chayyav bishvua zo min hattora ben shehaya chayyav bah middivre sofrim
