Talmid chacham lechattechilla mashbiin oto meyushshav utfillin beyado veeno tzarich littol sefer tora ella tefillin bechappo chefetz hu venishba bilshon hakkodesh kemo shebbearnu

En ben shevuat hesset lishvuat haddayyanin ella nekitat chefetz sheen hannishba shevuat hesset ochez sefer tora ella mashbiin oto beshem o bechinnuy bishvua o beala mippiv o mippi bet din kemo shevuat haddayyanin uchvar nahagu hakkol lihot sefer tora beyad chazzan hakkeneset o shear haam beet shemmashbiin shevuat hesset kede leayyem alav

Haddayyanin shehishbiu et hannishba bechal lashon shehu makkir hare zo kemitzvatah vechen horu haggeonim aval rabbotenu horu sheen mashbiim ella bilshon hakkodesh veen rauy lismoch al horaa zo veaf al pi shennahagu bechal batte dinin lehishshava bilshon hakkodesh tzarich lehodia et hannishba ad sheyehe makkir leshon hashshevua sheshshevuat haddayyanin hi shevuat happikkadon beatzmah veaf shevuat hesset nahagu kal haam lehashbia otah bilshon hakkodesh

Kal mi sheyyitchayyev shevuat haddayyanin shehi al yede taanat vadday uchfira ben shehayeta middivre tora ben shehayeta middivrehem meayemin alav kemo sheyyitbaer vechal mi sheyyitchayyev bah betaanat safek ben min hattora ben middivrehem eno tzarich iyyum

Vechetzad meayemin al hannishba omrin lo heve yodea shekkal haolam kullo nizdaazea beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe lo tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshave vechal averot shebbattora neemar bahen venakke vechan neemar lo yenakke kal averot shebbattora nifrain mimmennu vechan mimmennu umimmishpachto shemmechappin al ze velo od ella gorem lehippara missonehem shel yisrael shekkal yisrael arevin ze baze shenneemar alo vechachesh veratzoach vego vechatuv acharav al ken teeval haaretz veumlal kal yoshev bah kal averot shebbattora tolin lo shenayim ushlosha dorot im yesh lo zechut vechan nifrain miyyad shenneemar hotzetiha neum Adonai tzevaot uvaa el bet haggannav veel bet hannishba bishmi lashshaker hotzetiha miyyad uvaa el bet haggannav ze haggonev daat habberiyyot veen lo mamon al chavero vetoano bechinnam umashbio el bet hannishba bishmi lashsheker kemashmao vechillattu veet etzav veet avanav devarim sheen esh umayim mechallin otan shevuat sheker mechalla otan

Veinyan haiyyum hazze kullo belashon shehen makkirin omrim lahem kede sheyyavinu baddevarim veyachzor hachote lemutav amar eni nishba potrin oto venoten ma shettaano chavero vechen im amar hattoen eni mashbio uftaro holchin lahen
Amar hareni nishba vachavero tovea haomdim sham omrim ze laze suru na meal ahole haanashim harshaim vego veomrin lo lo al datecha anu mashbiin otcha ella al datenu veal daat bet din
Af al pi sheen meayemin iyyum ze bishvuat taanat safek kemo shebbearnu velo bishvuat hesset tzerichin haddayyanin liftzor bevaale dinin ulay yachzeru bahen ad shello tihye sham shevua kelal

Davar barur vegaluy shekkal hannishba shevuat haddayyanin o shevuat hesset besheker sheyehe chayyav mishshum shevuat happikkadon shekkevar nitbaaru mishpateha veeno loke veaf al pi shehu mezid venitchayyev leshallem ma shennishba alav betosefet chomesh shehu revia hakkeren ad sheyyihye hu vechumsho chamishsha umevi karban asham im yesh sham bet din kemo shebbearnu
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 12: Af al pi shelloke hannishibba lashshave o lashsheker vechen hannishba shevuat haedut o shevuat happikkadon mevi karban en mitkapper lahen aon hashshevua kullo shenneemar lo yenakke Adonai en laze nikkaon middin shamayim ad sheyyitpara mimmennu al hashshem haggadol shechillel shenneemar vechillalta et shem Adonai elohecha ani Adonai lefichach tzarich adam lehizzaher meaon ze yoter mikkal haaverot
Aon ze min hachamurot hu kemo shebbearnu behilchot teshuva af al pi sheen bo lo karet velo mitat bet din yesh bo chillul hashshem hamkuddash shehu gadol mikkal haaonot

Mi shennishba bashshamayim uvaaretz uvashshemesh vechayyotze bahen af al pi sheen kavanato ella lemi shebberaam en zo shevua vechen hannishba benavi min hanneviim o bichtav mikkitve hakkodesh af al pi sheen kavanato ella lemi sheshshalach navi ze o lemi shetztziva bichtav ze en zo shevua veaf al pi sheen ellu shevuot meayemin alehen umlammedin et haam shello yinhagu kallut rosh bechach umarin beenehem shezzo shevua ufotchin lahem petach umattirin lahem

Bamme devarim amurim bishar kitve hakkodesh aval hannishba battora im nishba bema shekkatuv bah dato al hahazkarot veim nishba bah setam dato al haggevil veen kan shevua netalah beyado venishba bah hare ze kemi shennishba bema shekkatuv bah veasur
Vehannishba battora setam im talmid chacham hu eno tzarich sheela lechacham veim am haaretz hu tzarich sheela lechacham kede shello yinhag kallut rosh bishvuot

Eved shennishba en rabbo tzarich lichpoto vahare hu achar shennishba kekodem shennishba lefi sheen gufo kanuy lo kede shettachul alav shevuato veneemar bishvuot lesor issar al nafsho mi shennafsho birshuto yatza eved shehu birshut acherim venimtza ze kemo shennishba al nichse acher

Ketannim shennishbeu vehen yodin taam hashshevua af al pi sheenan chayyavin kofin otan laamod bedivrehen kede lechannechan ulayyem alehem kede shello yinhagu kallut rosh bishvuot veim haya haddavar shennishbeu alav davar sheen hakkatan yachol laamod bo ella im ken nizzak kegon shennishba sheyyatzum o shello yochal basar zeman merubbe makke oto aviv o rabbo vegoer bo umarin lo shehuttera shevuato kede shello yihye ragil lehakel rosh bishvuot
Tzarich lehizzaher bakketannim harbe ullammed leshonam divre emet belo shevua kede shello yihu regilim lehishshava tamid keakkum veze haddavar kemo chova al avotehem veal melammede tinokot

Hashshomea hazkarat hashshem mippi chavero lashshave o shennishba lefanav lashsheker o shebberech beracha sheenah tzericha shehu over mishshum nose shem Adonai lashshave kemo shebbearnu behilchot berachot hare ze chayyav lenaddoto veim lo niddahu hu beatzmo yehe benidduy vetzarich lehattir oto miyyad kede shello yehe michshol laacherim shehare eno yodea shennidduhu veim tomar yodio nimtzeu kal haolam benidduy shehare limdu leshonam haave ushvua tamid

Bamme devarim amurim beshehaya hannishba hazze o hamvarech levattala mezid aval im haya shogeg velo yada shezze asur eno chayyav lenaddoto vaani omer sheasur lenaddoto shello anash hakkatuv shogeg ella mazhiro umatre bo shello yachzor

Velo shevua lashshave bilvad hi sheasura ella afillu lehazkir shem min hashshemot hamyuchadin levattala asur veaf al pi shello nishba shehare hakkatuv metzave veomer leyira et hashshem hannichbad vehannora uvichlal yirato shello yazkiro levattala lefichach im taa hallashon vehotzi shem levattala yemaher miyyad vishabbeach vifaer vihadder lo kede shello yizzacher levattala ketzad amar Adonai omer baruch hu leolam vaed o gadol hu umhullal meod vechayyotze baze kede shello yehe levattala

Af al pi shemmuttar lehishshael al hashshevua kemo shebbearnu veen baze dofi umi shellibbo nokfo bedavar ze eno ella shemetz minut af al pi chen rauy lehizzaher bedavar ze veen nizkakin lehattir ella mippene devar mitzva o mippene tzorech gadol vetova gedola hi leadam shello yishshava kelal veim avar venishba sheyyitztaer vayyaamod bishvuato shenneemar nishba lehara velo yamir vechatuv acharav ose elle lo yimmot leolam seliku lehu hilchot shevuot besiyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Vows 1: Hanneder nechlak lishte machalokot hachelek harishon hu sheyyeesor al atzmo devarim hammuttarim lo kegon sheyyomar perot medina pelonit asurin alay kal sheloshim yom o leolam o min peloni mipperot haolam o perot ellu asurin alay bechal lashon sheyyeesor hare ze neesar bahen veaf al pi sheen sham shevua kelal velo hazkarat shem velo kinnuy veal ze neemar battora lesor issar al nafsho sheyyeesor al atzmo devarim hammuttarim vechen im amar hare hen alay issar hare ellu asurin vechelek ze hu sheani kore oto nidre issar

Vehachelek hashsheni hu sheyechayyev atzmo bekarban sheeno chayyav bo kegon sheyyomar hare alay lehavi ola o hare alay lehavi shelamim o mincha hare behema zo ola o shelamim vehaomer hare alay hu hannikra neder vehaomer hare zo hu hannikra nedava vehannedava vehanneder mimmin echad hu ella shehannedarim chayyavin beacharautan undavot en chayyavin beacharautan veal ze neemar battora undarecha asher tiddor venidvotecha vego vechelek ze hu sheani kore oto nidre hekdesh
Vedine hachelek harishon veinyano hem sheanu mevaarim bahalachot ellu aval dine nidre hekdesh umishpetehem kullam yitbaaru bimkomam behilchot maase hakkarbanot

Mitzvat ase shel tora sheyekayyem adam shevuato o nidro ben shehaya minnidre issar ben shehaya minnidre hekdesh shenneemar motza sefatecha tishmor veasita kaasher nadarta veneemar kechal hayyotze mippiv yaase

Haoser al atzmo min mimmine maachal kegon sheamar teenim asurin alay o teenim shel medina pelonit asurim alay o teenim ellu asurin alay vechayyotze beellu veachal mehen kal shehu loke min hattora shenneemar lo yachel devaro sheen lindarim shiur shekkal hannoder middavar hare ze kimfaresh kal shehu amar achila mipperot medina pelonit asurin alay o achila mipperot ellu eno loke ad sheyyochal kezayit
Asar al atzmo achila min hatteenim vaachila min haanavim ben beneder echad ben bishne nedarim hare ellu mitztarfin lichzayit vechen kal kayyotze baze

Haomer perot ellu alay karban o sheamar hare hem kekarban o sheamar lachavero kal ma sheochal immecha alay karban o kekarban o hare hen alay karban hare ellu asurin alav mippene sheefshar sheyyiddor adam karban veyaase behema shehayeta chol karban veteaser

Aval haomer perot ellu alay o min peloni alay o ma sheochal im peloni alay kivsar chazir o keakkum o kinvelot utrefot vechayyotze beellu hare ellu muttarin veen kan neder shei efshar sheyyaase davar sheeno besar chazir kivsar chazir
Ze hakkelal kal hammesim devarim hammuttarim kaddevarim haasurim im oto davar haasur yachol laasoto beneder hare ellu asurim veim eno yachol laasoto beneder hare ellu muttarin

Hachattat vehaasham af al pi sheenan bain beneder undava kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo efshar lannoder lehavi otam mechamat nidro shehannoder benazir mevi chattat veim nitma mevi asham kemo sheyyitbaer lefichach haomer perot ellu alay kechattat o keasham o sheamar hare hen chattat o hare hen asham hare ellu asurin veen tzarich lomar beomer hare hen ola o shelamim o mincha o toda shehen asurin shekkal ellu bain beneder undava
Aval haomer perot ellu alay kechallat aharon o kitrumato hare ellu muttarin sheen sham derech lehavi ellu beneder undava
Haomer hare happerot haellu alay kenotar kefiggul kevasar tame shel kadashim hare ellu asurin shehare asaan kivsar karban mikkal makom

Haomer hare hen alay kemaasar behema hare ellu asurin hoil ukdushshato bide adam hare hen alay kivchor hare ellu muttarin sheen kedushshato bide adam veeno yachol lehatpiso beneder shenneemar lo yakdish ish oto

Amar hare hen alay kecherme shamayim hare ellu asurin shecherme shamayim levedek habbayit hare hen alay kitrumat hallishka kitmidim kedirim keetzim keishshim kemizbeach o keachad mimmeshammeshe hammizbeach kegon sheamar hare hen alay keyaim kemizrakot kemizlagot vechayyotze bahen vechen haomer hare hen alay kehechal kirushalayim hare ellu asurin veaf al pi shello hazkir shem karban shekkal devarim ellu inyanam keomer hare hen alay karban

Haya lefanav besar kodesh afillu haya besar shelamim achar zerikat damim shehu muttar lazzarim veamar hare hen alay kevasar ze hare ellu asurin shello hitpis ella beikkaro shehaya asur aval im haya besar bechor im lifne zerikat damim hare ze asur veim leachor zerikat damim hare ze muttar

Yesh mekomot sheanshehem illegim umafsidin et hallashon umchannin al davar bedavar acher holchin sham achar hakkinnuy ketzad kal kinnuye karban kekarban haomer hare hen alay konam konach konaz hare ellu kinnuyin lekarban cherek cheref cherech hare ellu kinnuyin lecherem vechen kal kayyotze baze holchin achar leshon kelal haam beoto makom uvoto zeman
Uchshem sheoser atzmo bechinnuyin kach im hikdish bechinnuyin hare ze hekdesh vechinnuye hakkinnuyin muttarin ben benidre issar ben benidre hekdesh

Haomer lachavero ma sheochal immecha lo yehe chullin o lo yehe kasher o lo yehe dechi o lo yehe tahor hare ze kemi sheamar lo kal ma sheochal immecha yehe karban shehu asur vechen im amar lo kal ma sheochal immecha tame o notar o piggul hare ze asur

Haomer lachavero lo chullin lo ochal lecha hare ze kemi sheamar lo ma sheochal lecha lo yehe chullin ella karban vechen im amar hakarban sheochal lecha karban sheochal lecha kekarban sheochal lecha hare ze asur aval haomer hakkarban lo ochal lecha o kekarban lo ochal lecha o lekarban lo ochal lecha o karban lo ochal lecha o lo karban lo ochal lecha kal ellu muttarim sheen mashma devarim ellu ella shennishba bekarban shello yochal laze vehannishba bekarban eno kelum o shennadar shello yochal lo karban
Chullin sheochal lecha hachullin sheochal lecha kechullin sheochal lecha chullin shello ochal lecha hachullin shello ochal lecha kechullin shello ochal lecha hare ze muttar
Aval haomer lo tame sheochal lecha lo notar sheochal lecha lo piggul sheochal lecha asur shemmashmao shel davar davar sheochal hu sheyyihye piggul o tame lefichach lo ochal lecha

Bahechal sheochal lecha hechal sheochal lecha lo hechal sheochal lecha asur hechal shello ochal lecha kehechal shello ochal lecha lo hechal shello ochal lecha muttar shezze kemi shennishba bahechal shello yochal vechen kal kayyotze baze

Haomer lachavero muddar ani mimmecha mashma davar ze shello yedabber immo mufrash ani mimmecha mashmao shello yissa veyitten immo meruchak ani mimmecha mashmao shello yeshev bearba ammotav vechen im amar lo menudde ani lecha o meshammatna mimmecha aval im amar lo muddar ani mimmecha shello ochal lecha o mufrash ani mimmecha shello ochal lecha o meruchak ani mimmecha shello ochal lecha hare ze asur leechol veim achal kezayit mikkal nechasav loke mishshum lo yachel devaro
Amar lo menudde ani lecha shello ochal lecha eno ochel lo veim achal eno loke amar lo nadina mimmecha hare ze asur lehanot

Haomer lachavero hare alay kenidre reshaim im ochal lecha shemminnidrehem nazir vekarban ushvua veachal chayyav bechullan vechen haomer hare alay kindavot kesherim shemminnidvotam nazir vekarban hare ze chayyav

Amar hare alay kenidre reshaim o kindavot kesherim sheochal lecha o im ochal lecha hare ze asur af al pi shello peresh amar kenidre kesherim lo nitchayyev bichlum sheen hakkesherim nodrim bederech issur vachaas amar kenidre reshaim hareni vehaya nazir over lefanav chayyav binzirut kenidre reshaim alay chayyav karban kenidre reshaim shello ochal mimmennu chayyav bishvua
Hannoder battora kegon sheamar perot ellu alay kazo lo amar kelum veeno tzarich sheela lechacham ella im ken haya am haaretz kede shello yinhagu kallut rosh bindarim
Nadar bema shekkatuv bah hare ze asur shehare katuv bah issar veneder netalah beyado venadar bah hare ze kemi shennadar bema shekkatuv bah
Haomer lachavero nashkim venishne perek alav lehashkim velikrot shezze kemo neder hu veaf al pi shello hotzio bilshon neder

Haomer leishto hare atte alay keimmi o kaachoti o kearla o kechile hakkerem hare ze keomer al happerot hare ellu kivsar chazir keshem shehu muttar leachlan kemo shebbearnu kach muttar beishto aval im amar lah hareni muddar mimech hanaya o hanaat tashmishech asura alay hare zo asura alav kemo sheyyitbaer
Mishneh Torah, Vows 2: Echad hannoder mippi atzmo o shehiddiro chavero veamar amen o davar sheinyano keinyan amen shehu kabbalat devarim

Veen hannoder neesar bedavar sheasar al atzmo ad sheyyotzi bisfatav veyihye piv velibbo shavin kemo shebbearnu bishvuot aval hammitkaven lindor benazir venadar bekarban bekarban venadar benazir bishvua venadar o shennitkaven lindor venishba o shennitkaven lomar teenim veamar anavim hare ze muttar bishnehem veen kan neder

Hannoder al daat acherim hare ze kenishba al daat acherim vechen hannoder vechazar bo betoch kede dibbur o shemmichu bo betoch kede dibbur vekibbel hare ze muttar vedin kal ellu haddevarim bindarim kedinan bishvuot

Mi shehitna kodem sheyyiddor veamar kal neder sheeddor mikkan vead eser shanim hareni chozer bahen o hare hen betelim vechayyotze baddevarim ellu veachar kach nadar im haya zocher hattenay beshaa shennadar hare nidro kayyam shehare bittel hattenay beneder ze veim lo zachar hattenay ella achar shennadar af al pi shekkibbel hattenay belibbo vekiyemo hare hanneder batel veaf al pi shello hotzi atta hachazara befiv kevar hikdim hachazara lanneder vehotziah befiv mikkodem veyesh shemmore lehachmir veomer vehu sheyyizkor hattenay achar shennadar betoch kede dibbur

Mi shehikdim et hattenay leshana o leeser veachar kach nadar venizkar beshaa shennadar sheyyesh lo tenay veshachach al e ze davar hitna vechetzad haya hattenay im amar al daat rishona ani ose en nidro neder shehare bittelo veim lo amar al daat rishona ani ose kevar bittel hattenay vekiyyem hanneder shehare zachar bishat hanneder sheyyesh sham tenay veaf al pi chen nadar

Yesh mehaggeonim sheomrim en kal ellu haddevarim nohagin ella bindarim bilvad lo bishvuot veyesh mi shemmore sheddin hannedarim vehashshevuot beinyanot ellu echad hem vechi yesh lo lehakdim tenay lishvuato kederech sheamru bindarim

Setam nedarim lehachmir uferushan yesh bo lehakel ulhachmir ketzad haomer hare happerot haellu alay kevasar maliach uchyen nesech omrin lo ume haya belibbecha im peresh veamar kevasar maliach shel karban uchyayin shennitnassech al hammizbeach haya belibbi hare ze asur veim amar lo haya belibbi ella tikrovet akkum veyayin shennitnassech lah hare ze muttar veim nadar setam hare ze asur
Vechen haomer hare happerot haellu alay cherem im kecherem shel bedek habbayit asur veim kecherme hakkohanim muttar mippene shehen mamon shellahem veen bah issur veim setam asur
Hare hen alay kemaaser im kemaasar behema asur mippene shehu karban shehikdisho beyado kemo shebbearnu veim kemaasar dagan muttar veim setam asur
Hare hen alay kitruma im litrumat hallishka nitkaven hare ze asur veim litrumat haggoren nitkaven muttar veim setam asur vechen kal kayyotze baze

Bamme devarim amurim bemakom shemmashma kal echad meellu sham shene inyanot aval makom sheddarkan sheen korim cherem setam ella lecherme bedek habbayit bilvad veamar sham hare hen alay cherem hare ze asur vechen im haya darkan sheen korim cherem setam ella lecherme kohanim hare ze muttar vechen kal kayyotze baze sheen holchin bindarim ella achar leshon anshe oto makom beoto zeman

Hannoder becherem veamar lo haya belibbi ella chermo shel yam shehi hammichmoret nadar bekarban veamar lo haya belibbi ella bekarbenot melachim amar lachavero hare atzmi alecha karban veamar lo haya belibbi ella leasro beetzem shehinnachti li lihot noder bo derech sechok nadar shello tehane lo ishto veamar lo haya belibbi ella ishti rishona sheggerashtiha vechen kal kayyotze beellu haddevarim shemmashmaan lechal haam issur vehu omer lo nitkavanti ella lechach ulchach im haya hannoder talmid chacham hare ze muttar veen tzarich sheela lechacham veim haya am haaretz marin beenav shezze neder veshehu asur ufotchim lo petach mimmakom acher umattirin lo uven shehaya talmid chacham o am haaretz goarin bahen umlammedin otan shello yinhagu minhag ze bindarim velo yihu nodrin derech sechok vehittul

Vechen haomer leishto hare atte alay keimmi o haomer perot ellu alay kivsar chazir sheen kan neder kemo shebbearnu im haya haomer talmid chacham eno tzarich sheela lechacham veim haya am haaretz tzarich sheela lechacham umarin beenav sheishto asura vesheotan happerot asurin ufotchin lo petach mimmakom acher umattirin lo nidro kede shello yinhagu kallut rosh bindarim

Hahefker af al pi sheeno neder hare hu kemo neder sheasur lo lachzor bo uma hu hahefker hu sheyyomar adam nechasim ellu hefker lakkol ben bemittaltelin ben bekarkaot vechetzad din hahefker kal hakkodem vezacha bo kanahu leatzmo venaasa shello vaafillu ze shehifkir dino bo kedin kal adam im kadam vezacha bo kanahu
Hammafkir laaniyyim aval lo laashirim eno hefker ad sheyyafkir lakkol kishmitta vhammafkir avadav haggedolim kanu atzman vehakketannim kal hakkodem vehechezik bahen zacha kishar hammittaltelin

Hammafkir et hakkarka kal hakkodem vehechezik bah zacha din tora afillu hifkir bifne echad hare ze hefker veniftar min hammaasrot kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo aval middivre sofrim eno hefker ad sheyyafkir bifne shelosha kede sheyyihye echad zoche im ratza vehashshenayim meidim vehaomer hare ze hefker veze hare hashsheni sefek hefker veim amar veze kemo ze o sheamar vegam ze hare hitpis hashsheni veyihye hefker vadday
Hammafkir et sadehu velo zacha bah adam kal shelosha yamim yachol lachzor bo achar shelosha yamim eno yachol lachzor bo ella im ken kadam vezacha bah hare hu kezoche min hahefker ben hu ben acher

Haomer sade zo mufkeret leom echad leshabbat achat lechodesh echad leshana achat leshavua echad ad shello zacha bah hu o acher yachol lachzor bo umishshezzacha bah ben hu ben acher eno yachol lachzor bo umippene ma yesh lo lachzor kan ad sheyyizku bah mippene shezze davar sheeno matzuy hu sheen adam mafkir lizman katzuv
Davar hammufkar shebba echad ushmaro vehaya mabbit bo shello yittelennu adam lo kanahu behabbata ella ad sheyyagbiho im haya mittaltelin o yachazik bakkarka kederech shekkonin hallakochot
Mishneh Torah, Vows 3: Arbaa devarim yesh ben nedarim lishvuat bittuy shebbishvuat bittuy en shevua chala al shevua uvindarim yachul neder al neder hammatpis bishvua patur uvindarim chayyav en shevuat bittuy chala ella al divre harshut undarim chalot al divre mitzva kedivre harshut shevuat bittuy chala al davar sheyyesh bo mammash veal davar sheen bo mammash undarim enan chalin ella al davar sheyyesh bo mammash
Ketzad yachul neder al neder haomer hare alay karban im achalti kikkar zo hare alay karban im ochalenna vaachalah chayyav al kal achat veachat vechen kal kayyotze baze

Ketzad hammatpis bindarim chayyav shama chavero shennadar veamar vaani kemotcha betoch kede dibbur hare ze asur bema shenneesar bo chavero shama hashshelishi ze sheamar vaani veamar vaani afillu hau mea vechal echad mehen omer vaani betoch kede dibburo shel chavero hare kullan asurin

Vechen haomer habbasar hazze alay asur vechazar veamar afillu achar kamma yamim vehappat hazzot kabbasar hazze hare happat nitpesa veneesra chazar veamar udvash ze kappat hazzot veyayin ze kidvash ze afillu hen mea kullan asurin

Hare shemmet aviv o rabbo hayyom venadar sheyyatzum oto hayyom vetzam ulachar shanim amar hare yom ze alav keom shemmet bo aviv o rabbo hare ze asur leechol bo kelum shehare hitpis yom ze vaasaro kayyom haasur lo vechen kal kayyotze beellu

Ketzad chalim hannedarim al divre mitzva kedivre harshut haomer hare hammatztza belele happesach asura alav hare yeshivat hassukka bechag hassukkot asura alav vahare hattefillin asurot bintila alav hare ellu asurin alav veim achal o yashav o natal loke vechen kal kayyotze baze veen tzarich lomar bemi sheamar hare alay karban im ochal matztza belele happesach shehu chayyav bekarban vechen kal kayyotze baze

Umippene ma nedarim chalim al divre mitzva ushvuot en chalot al divre mitzva shehannishba oser atzmo al davar shennishba alav vehannoder oser haddavar hannadur al atzmo nimtza hannishba levattel mitzva oser atzmo uchvar atzmo mushba mehar sinay veen shevua chala al shevua vehaoser davar ze beneder ze haddavar hu shenneesar veoto haddavar eno mushba mehar sinay

Kesheatta mitbonen bakkatuv timtza shehaddevarim marin ken kemo shekkibbelu chachamim mippi hashshemua shehare omer bishvuat bittuy lehara o lehetiv bedivre harshut kemo shebbearnu sheyyochal veyishte hayyom o sheyyatzum vechayyotze bahen uvindarim hu omer kechal hayyotze mippiv yaase velo chillek ben divre mitzva ledivre harshut

Hannoder sheyyatzum beshabbat o beom tov chayyav latzum shehannedarim chalim al divre mitzva kemo shebbearnu vechen hannoder sheyyatzum yom rishon o yom shelishi kal yamav ufaga bo yom ze vahare hu yom tov o erev yom hakkippurim hare ze chayyav latzum veen tzarich lomar rosh chodesh paga bo chanukka ufurim yiddache nidro mippene hayyamim haellu hoil veissur hatztzom bahem middivre sofrim hare hen tzerichin chizzuk veyiddache nidro mippene gezerat chachamim

Ketzad en hannedarim chalim ella al davar sheyyesh bo mammash haomer dibburi alecha karban eno asur milledabber immo shehaddibbur en bo mammash vechen im amar lo dibburi asur alecha en ze keomer perotay asurin alecha o perotay karban alecha shehen asurin alav lefichach haomer lachavero karban sheeni medabber immecha o sheeni ose immecha o sheeni mehallech immecha o sheamar karban sheeni yashen sheeni medabber sheeni mehallech o sheamar leishto karban sheeni meshammeshech en hanneder chal bechal ellu vahare ze keomer dibburi vehilluchi vaasiyyati veshimmushi karban shehen devarim sheen bahen mammash

Aval haomer yeaser pi ledibburo veyaday lemaasehen veraglay lehilluchan veenay lishnatan hare hanneder chal alehen lefichach haomer lachavero karban pi milledabber immecha veyaday millaasot immecha veraglay millehallech immecha hare ze asur vechen haomer hare alay karban im adabber im peloni o im lo adabber immo veavar al devaro chayyav bekarban vechen im nadar dibbarti velo dibbarti vechayyotze bahen sheen ellu nidre issar sheanu mevaarin mishpetehem ella nidre hekdesh

Hannoder bidvarim sheen bahem mammash vaasaran af al pi sheen hanneder chal alehem en morim lo sheyyinhog bahen hetter hoil veasar atzmo bahen uvdato shehanneder chal alehen ella potchin lo petach mimmakom acher umattirin lo nidro af al pi shello neesar kede shello yinhagu kallut rosh bindarim
Mishneh Torah, Vows 4: Nidre onasin venidre shegagot venidre havay hare ellu muttarim kederech shebbearnu bishvuot hare shehiddiruhu haannasin vehammochsin veamru lo nedor lanu shehabbasar asur alecha im yesh immecha davar shechayyav bemeches venadar veamar hare happat vehabbasar vehayyayin asurin alay hare ze muttar bakkol veaf al pi shehosif al ma shebbikkeshu mimmennu vechen im bikkeshu mimmennu sheyyiddor shello tehane ishto lo venadar shello tehane lo ishto uvanav veechav kullan muttarin vechen kal kayyotze baze

Uvchal hannedarim haellu tzarich sheyyitkaven belibbo ledavar hammuttar kegon sheyyasim belibbo sheyyihu asurin alav oto hayyom bilvad o otah shaa vechen kayyotze baze vesomech al devarim shebbelibbo hoil vehu anus veeno yachol lehotzi bisfatav venimtza beshaa sheyyiddor lahen en piv velibbo shavin kemo shebbearnu bishvuot

Vechen nidre zeruzin muttarin ketzad kegon shehiddir chavero sheyyochal etzlo venadar ze shello yochal mippene sheeno rotze lehatriach alav ben achal ben lo achal shenehen peturin vechen hammocher shennadar shello yimkor chefetz ze ella besela vehallokeach nadar shello yikkachennu ella beshekel veratzu bishlosha dinarin shenehen peturin vechen kal kayyotze baze lefi shekkal echad mehem lo gamar belibbo velo nadar ella kede lezarez et chavero velo gamar belibbo
Uminnayin sheafilu arbaa mine nedarim ellu shehen muttarim sheasur lo leadam lihot noder bahen al menat levattelan talmud lomar lo yachel devaro lo yaase devarav chullin

Mi shennadar venicham al nidro hare ze nishal lechacham umattiro vedin hetter nedarim kedin hetter shevuot sheen mattir ella chacham muvhak o shelosha hedotot bemakom sheen chacham uvlashon shemmattirin hashshevua mattirin hanneder vechen shear hainyanot shepperashnu bishvuot kullan bindarim kederech shehen bishvuot
Veen mattirin hanneder ad sheyyachul kishvua
Uchshem shennishalim al nidre haissar umattirin oto kach nishalim al nidre hekdesh umattirin oto ben nidre kadshe bedek habbayit ben kadshe mizbeach veen nishalin al hattemura
Uchshem shehaav o habbaal mefer nidre issar kach mefer nidre hekdeshot haddomin lenidre haissar

Mi shennadar veshama chavero veamar vaani veshama shelishi veamar vaani venishal harishon al nidro vehuttar hutteru kullan nishal haacharon vehuttar haacharon muttar vechullan asurin nishal hashsheni vehuttar hashsheni veshel acharav muttarin veharishon asur
Vechen hammatpis devarim harbe beneder kegon shennadar al happat vehitpis habbasar venishal al happat vehuttar bah huttar habbasar nishal al habbasar vehuttar bo lo huttar happat

Hannishba o hannoder sheeni nehene lechullechem venishal al nidro o al shevuato al echad mehem vehittiro hutteru kullam shehanneder shehuttar mikkelalo huttar kullo amar sheeni nehene laze velaze velaze huttar harishon hutteru kullan huttar acharon haacharon muttar vechullan asurin sheeni nehene laze laze laze tzerichin petach lechal echad veechad vechen kal kayyotze baze
Nadar benazir uvkarban uvishvua o shennadar veen yadua bee ze mehen nadar petach echad lechullan
Hannoder meanshe hair venishal lechacham shebbair o shennadar miyyisrael vahare hu nishal lechacham shebbeyisrael hare nidro muttar

Haomer perot ellu asurin alay hayyom im elech lemachar lemakom peloni hare ze asur leachlam hayyom gezera shemma yelech lemachar leoto makom veim avar vaachalan hayyom vehalach lemachar loke veim lo halach eno loke

Amar hare hen asurin lemachar im elech hayyom lemakom peloni hare ze muttar lelech hayyom leoto hammakom veyeasru alav otan happerot lemachar vechen kal kayyotze baze mippene sheadam zahir bedavar haasur shello laasoto veeno zahir bitnay sheggorem leesor davar hammuttar

Hannoder latzum asara yamim bee ze yom sheyyirtze vehaya mitanne beom echad mehem vehutzrach lidvar mitzva o mippene kevod adam gadol hare ze ochel uforea yom acher shehare lo kava hayyamim bitchillat hanneder nadar sheyyatzum hayyom veshachach veachal mashlim latzum nadar sheyyatzum yom echad o shenayim uchshehitchil latzum shachach veachal ibbed taanito vechayyav latzum yom acher
Mishneh Torah, Vows 5: Reuven sheamar leshimon hareni alecha cherem o hare atta asur bahanayati neesar al shimon sheyyehane biruven veim avar venehena eno loke shehare lo amar shimon kelum umuttar liruven lehanot beshimon shehare lo asar atzmo bahanayato

Amar leshimon hare atta alay cherem o hareni asur bahanayatcha hare neesar reuven millehanot beshimon veim nehena loke shehare chillel devaro veshimon muttar bahanayat reuven amar lo hareni alecha cherem veatta alay o hareni asur bahanayatcha veatta asur bahanayati shenehem asurin ze baze vechen kal kayyotze baze
Reuven sheamar leshimon hare perot peloni asurin alecha o hare atta asur bahanayat peloni en ze kelum sheen adam oser chavero bedavar sheeno shello ella im ken ana shimon amen kemo shebbearnu

Haomer lachavero kikkari zo asura alecha af al pi shennetanah lo bemattana hare zo asura alav met venafla lo birushsha o shennetanah lo acher bemattana hare zo mutteret shello amar lo ella kikkari vahare enah atta shello

Amar lo perot ellu asurin alecha velo amar lo perotay af al pi shemmecharan o shemmet venaflu leacher hare ellu asurin alav shehaoser davar shehu shello al chavero af al pi sheyyatza mershuto hare hu beissuro omed ella im ken amar nechasay o beti o perotay vechayyotze bilshonot ellu shehare lo asaran ella kal zeman shehen birshuto

Haomer livno hare atte asur bahanayati o shennishba shello yehane bo im met yirashennu shezze keomer nechasay alecha asurin asar alav hanayato uferesh ben bechayyay ben bemoti im met lo yirashennu shezze kemi sheamar lo nechasim ellu asurin alecha

Asar beno bahanayato veamar im yihye ben beni ze talmid chacham yikne beni ze nechasay kede lehaknotan livno hare ze muttar veyihye habben asur benichse haav uven habben muttar bahen im yihye talmid chacham kemo shehitna

Ze habben haasur birushshat aviv im natan yerushshat aviv leechav o levanav hare ze muttar vechen im peraam bechovo o bichtubbat ishto vetzarich lehodian sheellu nichse avi sheasaran alay shehannishba shello yehane bo chavero muttar lo lifroa et chovo kemo sheyyitbaer

Mi shenneesar alav min mimmine maachal ben beneder ben bishvua venitbashshel im minim acherim o nitarev immahen hare ze muttar bamminim hammuttarim af al pi sheyyesh bahen taam hammin haasur veim neesar beferot ellu venitarvu baacherim im yesh bahen taam davar haasur asurin veim lav muttarin

Ketzad neesar bevasar o beyayin hare ze muttar leechol marak virakot shennitbashshelu im habbasar veim hayyayin af al pi sheyyesh bahen taam habbasar o taam hayyayin veeno asur ella baachilat basar bifne atzmo o lishtot yayin bifne atzmo

Neesar bevasar ze o beyayin ze venitbashshel im hayyarak im yesh bayerakot taam basar o taam hayyayin asurin veim lav muttarin shezze habbasar veze hayyayin naasa kemo besar nevelot ushkatzim vechayyotze bahen vechen kal kayyotze baze lefichach haomer basar ze asur alay hare ze asur bo uvammarak shebbo uvattavlin shebbo

Nitarev yayin ze sheasaro al atzmo beyayin acher afillu tippa bechavit neesar hakkol mippene sheyyesh lo lehishshael al nidro naasa kedavar sheyyesh lo mattirin sheeno batel bemino kemo shebbearnu behilchot maachalot asurot
Haomer perot haellu karban alay o karban hen lefi o karban hen al pi hare ze asur bechillufehen uvgiddulehem veen tzarich lomar bammashkin hayyotzin mehen

Nadar o nishba sheeni ochel otam o sheeni toem otam im haya davar shezzaro kale kesheyyizzara kegon chitta usora hare ze muttar bechillufehen uvgiddulehen veim haya haddavar sheen zaro kale baaretz kesheyyizzara kegon betzalim veshumin afillu giddule giddulin asurin uven kach uven kach mashkin hayyotzin mehen safek lefichach im shata mehen eno loke

Vechen haomer leishto maase yadayich alay karban o karban hen lefi o karban hen al pi asur bechillufehen uvgiddulehen sheeni toem sheeni ochel im hau perot maase yadeha davar shezzaro kale muttar bechillufehen uvgiddulehen veim haya davar sheen zaro kale afillu giddule giddulin asurin velamma lo yibbatel haikkar haasur baggiddulin sherabbu alav shehare hen davar sheyyesh lo mattirin sheeno batel berov kemo shebbearnu
Haoser perotav al chavero ben beneder ben bishvua hare giddulehen vechillufehen safek lefichach chavero asur begiddule perot ellu uvchillufehen veim avar venehena nehena
Mishneh Torah, Vows 6: Haomer lachavero hanaa hammevia lide maachalcha asura alay o hanaa hammevia lide maachali asura alecha hare ze hanneesar lo yishal min haasur lo nafa uchvara verechayim vetannur vechal davar sheosin bahen ochel nefesh aval mashilo nezamim vetabbaot vechelim sheen osin bahen ochel nefesh veasur lishl mimmennu sak lehavi bo perot vachamor lehavi alav perot

Makom sheddarkan sheen mashilin kelim ella besachar asur lishl mimmennu af kelim sheen osin bahen ochel nefesh hare shehau bemakom sheen notlin sachar veshaal mimmennu kelim sheen osin bahen ochel nefesh kede leheraot bahen bifne acherim ad sheyyehane mehem o shebbikkesh laavor beartzo kede sheyyelech bemakom sheyyehane bo hare ze asur missafek lefichach im avar eno loke
En ben muddar hanaa mechavero lemuddar mimmennu hanayat maachal ella derisat haregel vechelim sheen osin bahen ochel nefesh bemakom shemmashilin otam sham bechinnam

Reuven shenneesra alav hanayat shimon ben beneder ben bishvua muttar lo sheyyitten shimon al yado machatzit hashshekel sheruven chayyav bah vechen porea chov shealav shehare lo higgia leyad reuven kelum ella mana mimmennu hattevia umniat hattevia enah bichlal issur hanaya lefichach muttar lo lazun et ishto veet banav vaavadav afillu hakkenaanim af al pi shehu chayyav bimzonotam aval lo yazun et behemto ben temea ben tehora shekkal shemmosif bivsarah hi hanaya shehiggia leyad reuven

Haya shimon kohen hare hu muttar lehakriv karbenot reuven shehakkohanim sheluche shamayim hem veenam sheluche baal hakkarban umassi shimon bitto habbogeret liruven middatah aval im hayeta naara shehare adayin hi birshuto asur shezze kemoser lo shifcha leshammesho

Vetorem shimon terumat reuven umafrish lo maasrotav middato ketzad middato kegon sheamar reuven kal harotze litrom yavo veyitrom aval lo yomar leshimon litrom lo shehare ose oto shaliach veze hanaya lo

Umlammedo tora shebbeal pe shehare asur littol aleha sachar aval lo tora shebbichtav shennotlin aleha sachar veim en darkan sham littol sachar al tora shebbichtav hare ze muttar uven kach uven kach muttar lelammed et beno
Chala reuven nichnas shimon levakkero uvmakom shennotel sachar mi sheyyashav im hachole letzevet lo lo yeshev shimon ella mevakkero veomed umuttar lo lerappeoto beyado shezzo mitzva hi

Chalta behemat reuven lo yerappe otah shimon aval omer lo ase lah kach vechach verochetz immo beambeti gedola aval lo biktanna mippene shemmehannehu beshaa shemmagbiha alav hammayim veyashen immo bammitta bimot hachamma aval lo bimot haggeshamim mippene shemmechammemo umesev immo al hammitta veochlin al shulchan echad aval lo mikkeara achat velo meevus shellifne happoalim shemma yanniach shimon chaticha achat tova velo yochal otah kede sheyyochal otah reuven o yekarev otah lefanav venimtza mehannehu vechen beferot shebbaevus aval im achal shimon mikkeara shehu yodea shekkesheyyachazirenna levaal habbayit yachzor baal habbayit veyannichenna lifne reuven hare ze muttar veen choshshin shemma hinniach netach tov bishvilo
Umuttar reuven lishtot kos shel tanchumin miyyado shel shimon mishshel reuven vechen kos shel bet hammerchatz sheen baze hanaya
Veasur reuven begachalto shel shimon umuttar beshalhevet shello

Haya leshimon merchatz o bet habbad muskarim bair im haya leshimon bahen tefisat yad kegon shehinniach mehen kal shehu leatzmo velo secharo afillu hinniach bammerchatz ambeti achat uvvet habbad akkal echad asur liruven lehikkanes leotah merchatz velidroch baggat veim lo hinniach leatzmo kelum ella sachar hakkol hare ze muttar

Veasur liruven leechol mipperot sede shimon vaafillu bashsheviit shehakkol hefker shehare lifne sheviit nadar aval im nadar bashsheviit ochel min happerot hannotot chutz lassade aval lo yikkanes lassade af al pi shehakkarka hefker gezera shemma yishhe sham achar sheyyochal velo hifkira otah tora ella kal zeman shehapperot betochah

Bamme devarim amurim kesheamar lo hanayat hannechasim haellu asurin alecha aval im amar lo hanayat nechasay asurin alecha o shennishba reuven o shennadar minnichse shimon kevan shehiggia sheviit ochel mipperot sadehu shehare yatzu mershut shimon aval lo yikkanes lesadehu min hattaam shebbearnu

Neesra al reuven hanayat maachal shimon bilvad im lifne sheviit neesra ben beneder ben bishvua hare ze yored letoch sadehu aval eno ochel mipperotav veim bishviit neesra yored veochel mipperotav sheen perot ellu shel shimon ella shel hefker hen
Veasur liruven lehashil leshimon gezera shemma yishal mimmennu vahare hu asur bahanaato vechen asur lehaloto gezera shemma yilve mimmennu velo yimkor lo gezera shemma yikkach mimmennu

Nizdammena lo melacha immo kegon shehau kotzrim keechad ose berachok mimmennu gezera shemma yesayeennu hammaddir et beno mippene sheeno osek battora veneesar bahanayat aviv hare haav muttar lemalleot lo chavit shel mayim ulhadlik lo et hanner velitzlot lo dag katan sheen kavanato ella lahanaa gedola udvarim ellu legabbe habben enan chashuvin
Mi shennishba o nadar shello yedabber im chavero hare ze muttar lo lichtov bichtav uldabber im acher vehu shomea hainyan sheyyirtze lehashmio vechaze horu haggeonim
Mishneh Torah, Vows 7: Shennayim shenneesra hanaat kal echad mehen al chavero ben beneder ben bishvua hare ellu muttarin lehachzir aveda ze laze mippene shehu mitzva uvmakom sheddarkan shennotel sachar hammachazir et haaveda yippol hassachar lahekdesh sheim yittol sachar nimtza nehene veim lo yittol nimtza mehanne

Umuttarin bidvarim shehem beshuttafut kal yisrael kegon har habbayit vehalleshachot vehaazarot vehabbeer shebbeemtza hadderech vaasurin bidvarim shehem beshuttafut kal anshe hair kegon harchava shebbair vehammerchatz uvet hakkeneset vehatteva vehassefarim

Vechetzad yaasu kede sheyyihu muttarin bidvarim ellu kal echad veechad mishshenehem kotev chelko lannasi o leechad mishshear haam umzakke lo bechelko al yede acher venimtza kal echad mehem kesheyyikkanes lammerchatz shehu lechal anshe hair o levet hakkeneset eno nichnas lirshut chavero ella lirshut acherim shehare kal echad mehem nistallek mechelko shebbemakom ze untano bemattana

Hau shenehem shuttafin bechatzer im yesh bah din chaluka hare ellu asurin lehikkanes lah ad sheyyachaloku veyikkanes kal echad lechelko veim en bah din chaluka kal echad veechad nichnas leveto vehu omer betoch shelli ani nichnas uven kach uven kach shenehem asurim lehaamid rechayim vetannur ulgaddel tarnegolin bechatzer zo

Shenayim shehau shuttafin bechatzer venadar echad mehen shello yehanne bo hashsheni kofin et hannoder limkor chelko nadar shello yehane hu bashsheni hare ze muttar lehikkanes leveto mippene shebbirshuto hu nichnas aval eno yachol lehishtammesh bachatzer kemo shebbearnu
Haya echad min hashshuk asur bahanaat echad mishshenehem hare ze muttar lehikkanes lechatzer mippene shehu omer lo letoch shel chavercha ani nichnas eni nichnas letoch shellecha

Mi sheasar hanayat umma min haummot al atzmo hare ze muttar likkach mehen beoter velimkor lahen befachot asar hanayato alehem im shomin lo sheyyikkach mehen befachot veyimkor beoter muttar veen gozrin kan shello yimkor gezera shemma yikkach shehare lo nadar meish echad kede shennigzor alav ella meumma kullah sheim i efshar lo lissa velitten im ze yissa veyitten im acher lefichach im asar hanayatan alav hare ze mashilan umalve otan aval lo yishal mehem velo yilve mehen
Asar hanayato alehen vahanayatan alav lo yissa veyitten immahem vechen lo yisseu hen veyittenu immo velo yashil lahen velo yilve mehem velo yalve otan
Asar al atzmo hanayat bene hair asur lehishshael al nidro lechacham mibbene otah hair hahi veim nishal vehittir lo hare nidro muttar kemo shebbearnu
Mi sheasar hanayat habberiyyot alav hare ze muttar lehanot beleket shichcha ufea umaasar ani hammitchallek bagoranot aval lo betoch habbayit

Mi sheasar hanayato al hakkohanim veal halviyyim hare ellu bain venotlin mattenotehem al karcho veim amar kohanim ellu ulviyyim ellu hare ellu asurin veyitten terumotav umaasrotav lechohanim ulviyyim acherim vehu haddin bemattenot aniyyim im haaniyyim

Mi shehayeta hanayato asura al chavero veen lachavero ma yochal holech etzel hachenvani veomer ish peloni asur bahanayati veeni yodea ma eese im halach hachenvani venatan lo uva venatal mizze hare ze muttar

Haya beto livnot gedero ligdor sadehu liktzor vehalach etzel poalim veamar ish peloni asur bahanayati veeni yodea ma eese vehalchu hen veasu immo uvau laze venatan lahen secharan hare ze muttar shennimtza ze sheppara lo chovo uchvar bearnu shezze muttar lifroa lo chovo

Hau mehallechin badderech veen lo ma yochal noten leacher mishshum mattana vehalla muttar bah veim en immahem acher manniach al hassela veomer hare hen mufkarin lechal mi sheyyachpotz vehalla notel veochel

Natan leechad mattana veamar lo hare seudda zo netuna lecha mattana veyavo peloni shehu asur bahanayati veyochal immanu hare ze asur velo od ella afillu im natan lo setam vechazar veamar lo retzoncha sheyyavo peloni veyochal immanu im hochiach sofo al techillato shello natan lo ella al menat sheyyavo peloni veyochal asur kegon shehayeta seudda gedola vehu rotze sheyyavo aviv o rabbo vechayyotze bahen leechol misseudato shehare seudato mochachat alav shello gamar lehaknot lo vechen kal kayyotze baze

Kal mattana sheim hikdishah lo tihye mukdeshet enah mattana vechal hannoten laze mattana al menat lehaknotah leacher hare ze haacher kana beet sheyyakne lo harishon veim lo hikna lo harishon leoto acher lo kana lo harishon velo hashsheni

Mi shenneesra hanayato al baal bitto vehu rotze latet levitto maot kede shettihye nehenet bahen umotzia otan bachafatzeha hare ze noten lah veomer lah hare hammaot haellu netunin lach bemattana uvilvad shello yehe levaalich reshut bahen ella yihu lema sheatte notenet lefich o lema shettilbeshi vechayyotze baze vaafillu amar lah al menat sheen levaalich reshut bahen ella ma shettirtzi asi bahen lo kana habbaal uma shettirtze taase bahen aval im natan lah mattana veamar lah al menat sheen levaalich reshut bahen velo peresh shettihye hammattana hazzot lechach ulchach o lema shettirtze taase bahen hare kana otah habbaal leechol peroteha vedavar ze asur shehare hu asur bahanayat chotno
Mishneh Torah, Vows 8: Mi shennadar o nishba uferesh bishat nidro davar shennadar o nishba biglalo hare ze kemi shettala nidro o shevuato beoto davar veim lo nitkayyem oto davar shennishba biglalo hare ze muttar

Ketzad nadar o nishba sheeni nose ishsha pelonit sheaviha ra sheeni nichnas levayit ze shekkelev ra betocho metu o sheasa haav teshuva hare ze muttar shezze kemi shennadar o nishba veamar shello essa pelonit velo ekkanes levayit ze ella im nistallek hahezzek vechen kal kayyotze baze

Aval hannoder o hannishba sheeni nose pelonit hakkeura venimtzet naa shechora venimtzet levana ketzara venimtzet arukka konam sheen ishti nehenet li shegganva et kisi veshehikketa et beni venoda shello ganva veshello hikketa hare ze muttar mippene shehu neder taut vehu bichlal nidre shegagot shehen muttarin veen ze ketole nidro bedavar velo nitkayyem haddavar shehare hassibba shebbiglalah nadar lo hayeta metzuya vetaut haya

Velo od ella mi sheraa anashim merachok ochlim teenim shello veamar lahen hare hen alechem karban kevan shekkarav alehem vehibbit vahare hen aviv veachiv hare ellu muttarin af al pi shello peresh hassibba shehiddiran biglalah hare ze kemo shepperesh shehaddavar mochiach shello asar alehem ella shehaya bedato shehen zarim vechen kal kayyotze baze

Mi shennadar o nishba venolad lo davar shello haya belibbo bishat hashshevua o bishat hanneder hare ze asur ad sheyyishal lechacham veyattir et nidro ketzad asar et atzmo bahanayat peloni o shello yikkanes lemakom peloni venaasa oto haish sofer veoto makom bet hakkeneset af al pi shehu omer illu hayiti yodea shezze naasa sofer uvmakom ze yease bet hakkeneset lo hayiti noder o nishba hare ze asur lehanot ulhikkanes ad sheyyattir nidro kemo shebbearnu vechen kal kayyotze baze

Kal neder shehuttar miktzato huttar kullo vehu haddin bishvua ketzad raa anashim merachok ochlin perotav veamar hare hen alechem karban uchshehiggia alehem vehinne hem aviv vaanashim zarim hoil veaviv muttar kullan muttarin vaafillu amar illu hayiti yodea ken hayiti omer peloni ufloni asurin veavi muttar hare kullan muttarin aval im omer keshehiggia alehen illu hayiti yodea sheavi benechem hayiti omer kullechem asurin chutz meavi hare kullan asurin chutz meaviv shehare gilla dato shello hittir miktzat hanneder ella kemo shennadar haya noder umatne al aviv

Vechen haomer hayyayin karban alay mippene shehayyayin ra livne meayim veamru lo hare hamyushshan yafe livne meayim im amar illu hayiti yodea lo hayiti noder vaafillu amar illu hayiti yodea hayiti omer hechadash asur vehayyashan muttar muttar bayyashan uvechadash aval im amar illu hayiti yodea hayiti omer kal hayyenot asurin alay chutz min hamyushshan hare ze muttar bamyushshan bilvad vechen kal kayyotze baze

Kal hannoder o nishba roin devarim shebbiglalan nishba o nadar ulmedin mehen lee ze nitkaven veholchin achar hainyan lo achar kal mashma haddibbur ketzad haya taun massa shel tzemer o shel pishtim vehizzia vehaya recho kashe venishba o nadar shello yaale alav tzemer o pishtim leolam hare ze muttar lilbosh bigde tzemer o pishtim ulchassotan veeno asur ella lehafshilan laachorav haya lavush bigde tzemer venitztaer bilvishatan venishba o nadar shello yaale alav tzemer leolam asur lilbosh umuttar liton alav umuttar lehitkassot begizze tzemer shello nitkaven ze ella leveged tzemer vechen kal kayyotze baze

Hau mevakkeshin mimmennu sheyyissa kerovato vehu memaen ufatzru bo venadar o nishba shello tehene bo leolam vechen hamgaresh et ishto venishba o nadar shello tehene bo leolam hare ellu muttarot lehanot lo sheen kavanato ella leshem ishut

Vechen hakkore lachavero sheyyisod etzlo umeen venishba o nadar shello yikkanes leveto velo yishte lo tippat tzonen hare ze muttar lehikkanes leveto velishtot lo tzonen shello nitkaven ze ella shello yochal veyishte immo bisudda zo vechen kal kayyotze baze

Haomer lachavero konam levetcha ani nichnas vesadcha ani lokeach ben beneder ben bishvua umet o mecharan leacher hare ze muttar lehikkanes labbayit velikkach hassade min hayyoresh o min hallokeach shello nitkaven ze ella kal zeman shehen birshuto aval im amar labbayit hazze eni nichnas vesade ze eni lokeach umet o mecharan leacher hare ze asur

Haomer lachavero hashileni paratcha amar lo enah penuya nishba o nadar veamar konam sadi eni choresh bah leolam im haya darko lachrosh beyado hu asur vechal adam muttarin lachrosh lo bah veim en darko lachrosh beyado hu vechal adam asurin vechen kal kayyotze bidvarim ellu

Mi shennishba o nadar sheyyissa ishsha o sheyyikne bayit o sheyyetze beshayyara o yifrosh bayyam en mechayevin oto lissa ishsha o liknot o letzet miyyad ella ad sheyyimmatze davar hehagun lo maase beishsha shennadra shekkal mi sheyyitba otah tinnase lo vekaftzu aleha bene adam sheenan hagunin lah veamru chachamim lo nitkavvena zo ella lechal mi sheyyitba otah min hahagunin lah vechen kal kayyotze baze

Hammaddir et chavero o shennishba veamar lo shettavo vetittol levanecha kor echad chittim o shette chaviyyot shel yayin hare ze yachol lehattir nidro belo sheela lechacham veyomar lo kelum nitkavanta ella lechabbedeni kevodi shello ettol uchvar higgia elay kavod shennadarta bishvili vechen hannoder o hannishba sheen atta nehene li im en atta noten livni kor shel chittim ushte chaviyyot shel yayin hare ze yachol lehattir nidro shello bishelat chacham veyomar hareni keillu nitkabbalti vehiggiu leyadi vechen kal kayyotze baze
Mishneh Torah, Vows 9: Binnedarim hallech achar leshon bene adam beoto makom uvoto lashon uvoto zeman shennadar o nishba bo ketzad nadar o nishba min hamvushshal im derech oto makom beoto lashon beoto zeman shekkorin mevushshal afillu letzali ulshaluk hare ze asur bakkol veim en darkam likrot mevushshal ella levasar shennitbashshel bemayim uvtavlin hare ze muttar betzali uvshaluk vechen hamushshan vehamvushshal bechamme teverya vechayyotze bahen holchin bo achar hallashon shel bene hair
Nadar o nishba min hammaliach im darkam likrot maliach lechal hammeluchin hare ze asur bechal hammeluchin veim en darkam likrot maliach ella ledag maliach bilvad eno asur ella bedag maliach

Nadar o nishba min hakkavush im darkam likrot kavush lechal hakkevushim hare ze asur bakkol veim en darkam likrot kavush ella leyarak kavush bilvad eno asur ella bechavush shel yarak vechen kal kayyotze baze
Hau miktzat bene hammakom korin lo kach umiktzatam en korin en holchin achar harov ella hare ze sefek nedarim vechal sefek nedarim lehachmir veim avar eno loke

Ketzad nadar min hashshemen bemakom shemmistappekin beshemen zayit uvshemen shumshemin verov anshe hammakom en korin shemen setam ella leshemen zayit vekorin leshemen shumshemin shemen shumshemin umiutam korin af leshemen shumshemin shemen setam hare ze asur bishnehem veeno loke al shemen shumshemin vechen kal kayyotze baze

Kal davar shedderech shaliach beoto makom lehimmalech alav hare hu bichlal hammin shenneemar leshaliach setam ketzad makom sheddarkan im yishlach adam shaliach liknot lo basar setam amar lo lo matzati ella dagim im nishba o nadar bemakom ze min habbasar neesar af bivsar dagim vechen kal kayyotze baze uvchal makom hannoder min habbasar asur bivsar ofot uvikravayim umuttar bachagavim veim marin haddevarim beet shennadar shello nitkaven ella bivsar behema bilvad o livsar of uvhema bilvad hare ze muttar bivsar dagim vaafillu bemakom shehashshaliach nimlach alehen

Hannoder min hamvushshal muttar bevetza shello nitbashshela ad shekkafta ella nitgalgela bilvad hannoder mimmaase kedera eno asur ella middevarim shemmartichin otan bikdera kegon rifot ulvivot vechayyotze bahen asar atzmo mikkal hayyored likdera hare ze asur bechal hammitbashshelin bikdera

Hannoder min haddagim muttar betzir uvmuryas shel dagim hannoder min hechalav muttar bakkom vehu hammayim hammuvdalin min hechalav nadar min hakkom muttar bechalav nadar min haggevina asur bah ben melucha ben tefela

Hannoder min hachittim asur bahen ben chayyin ben mevushshalin chitta chittim sheani toem asur bahen ben kemach ben pat chitta sheani toem asur beafuy umuttar lachos chittim sheani toem muttar beafuy veasur lachos chitta chittim sheani toem asur ben beafuy ben lachos vehannoder min haddagan o min hattevua eno asur ella bachameshet hamminin

Hannoder min hayyarak muttar bidluin hannoder bichreshin muttar bekaflotot hannoder min hakkeruv asur bemayim shennitbashshel bo hakkeruv shehare me shelakot kishlakot nadar mimme hashshelakot muttar bashshelakot atzman hannoder min harotev muttar battavlin shebbo min hattavlin muttar barotev hannoder min haggerisin asur bammikpa shel gerisin

Hannoder min perot haaretz asur bechal perot haaretz umuttar bichmehin ufitriyyot veim amar kal giddule karka alay asur af bichmehin ufitriyyot af al pi sheenan yonkin min hakkarka gedelin hen bakkarka

Hannoder mipperot hashshana asur bechal perot hashshana umuttar bigdayim uvitlaim uvchalav uvvetzim uvgozalot veim amar kal giddule shana alay asur bechullam hannoder mipperot hakkayitz en asur ella bitenim

Uvchal haddevarim haellu vechayyotze bahen hizzaher beikkar haggadol shehu bindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam shebbeoto makom beoto lashon uvoto zeman veal pi ikkar ze tore vetomar ze hannoder asur bedavar peloni umuttar bedavar peloni

Hannoder min haanavim muttar beyayin vaafillu hechadash min hazzetim muttar beshemen min hattemarim muttar bidvash temarim min hassitvaniyyot muttar bechometz sitvaniyyot min hayyayin muttar beyen tappuchim min hashshemen muttar beshemen shumshemin min haddevash muttar bidvash temarim min hachometz muttar bechometz sitvaniyyot min hayyarak muttar beyarkot sade mippene shekkal ellu shem levay hem vehu lo nadar ella mishshem sheeno levay beoto makom vechen kal kayyotze baze

Hannoder min hakkesut muttar besak uviria uvachamila min habbayit asur baaliyya shehaaliyya bichlal habbayit nadar min haaliyya muttar babbayit min haddargash muttar bammitta min hammitta asur baddargash shehu kemo mitta ketanna
Hannoder shello yikkanes levayit ze hare ze asur min haagaf velifnim nadar shello yikkanes leir zo muttar lehikkanes litchumah veasur lehikkanes leibburah

Hannoder hanaya mibbene hair uva adam venishtaha sham shenem asar chodesh hare ze asur lehanot mimmennu pachot mikkan muttar nadar miyyoshve hair kal sheshshaha sham sheloshim yom asur lehanot mimmennu pachot mikken muttar

Hannoder min hammayim hannimshachin mimmayan peloni asur bechal hanneharot hayyonkot mimmennu veen tzarich lomar hannimshachot af al pi shennishtanna shemam veen korin otan ella nahar peloni uver peloni veen melavin otan leshem hammayan hannadur hoil vehu ikkaran asur bakkol aval im nadar minnahar peloni o mimmayan peloni en asur ella bechal hanneharot hannikraot al shemo

Hannoder miyyorde hayyam muttar beoshve hayyabbasha miyyoshve hayyabbasha asur beorde hayyam af al pi shehen mefarshim beemtza hayyam haggadol sheyyorde hayyam bichlal yoshve hayyabbasha nadar meroe chamma asur besumin shello nitkaven ze ella mimmi shehachamma roa oto nadar mishshechore harosh asur bekerchim uvaale sevot umuttar benashim uviktannim veim darkan likrot shechore harosh lakkol asur bakkol

Nadar mishshovte shabbat asur beyisrael uvchutim nadar meole yerushalayim asur beyisrael umuttar bechutim shello nitkaven ze ella lemi shemmitzva alav laalot lirushalayim vehannoder mibbene noach muttar beyisrael sheen nikraim bene noach ella shear haummot
Nadar mizzera avraham muttar bivne yishmael uvne esav veeno asur ella beyisrael shenneemar ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara vahare yitzchak amar leyaakov veyitten lecha et birkat avraham

Nadar min haarelim asur bemule akkum umuttar baarele yisrael nadar min hammulim asur bearle yisrael umuttar bemule akkum sheen haarla keruya ella leshem akkum shenneemar ki chal haggoyim arelim veen kavanato shel ze ella lemi shehu metzuve al hammila velo lemi sheeno metzuve aleha

Hannoder miyyisrael asur begerim min haggerim muttar beyisrael hannoder miyyisrael asur bechohanim ulviyyim min hakkohanim umin halviyyim muttar beyisrael hannoder min hakkohanim muttar bilviyyim mehalviyyim muttar bechohanim hannoder mibbanav muttar bivne banav uvchal haddevarim haellu vechayyotze bahen din hannoder vehannishba echad hu
Mishneh Torah, Vows 10: Hannoder o hannishba sheeni toem hayyom eno asur ella ad shettecheshach sheeni toem yom echad asur meet leet mishsheat nidro lefichach hannoder sheani toem hayyom af al pi shehu muttar mishshettechshach lo yochal mishshettechshach ad sheyyishal lechacham gezera shemma yishshava paam acheret yom echad veyochal mishshettechshach shehare en kal haam yodim hefresh shebben ze laze

Nadar sheani toem yom hare ze safek veasur meet leet keomer yom echad veim achal achar shechashecha eno loke sheani toem shabbat zo hare ze asur bishar yeme hashshabbat uvom hashshabbat vahare hu muttar meechad beshabbat sheani toem shabbat achat hare ze asur shiva yamim meet leet amar shabbat setam velo peresh lo achat velo zo hare safek veasur shiva yamim meet leet veim achal achar shabbat eno loke kemo shebbearnu

Sheani shote chodesh ze asur bishar yeme hachodesh aval beom rosh chodesh yihye muttar af al pi shehaya chodesh chaser sheani toem chodesh echad asur sheloshim yom gemurim meet leet nadar chodesh setam asur sheloshim yom meet leet missafek

Sheani ochel basar shana zo afillu lo nishar min hashshana ella yom echad en asur ella oto hayyom uvom rosh hashshana muttar verosh hashshana lindarim hu yom rosh chodesh tishre sheani ochel shana achat hare ze asur shana temima miyyom leom veim nitabbera hashshana asur bah uvibburah sheani ochel shana hare ze asur shana temima miyyom leom missafek kemo shebbearnu

Sheani shote yayin shavua ze asur bishar shene hashshavua uvishnat hashshemitta veeno muttar ella merosh hashshana shel motzae sheviit sheani shote yayin shavua echad asur sheva shanim gemurot miyyom leom amar yovel ze asur bishar shene hayyovel uvishnat chamishshim atzmah

Sheani shote yayin ad rosh adar im hayeta shana meubberet velo yada shehi meubberet keshennadar eno asur ella ad rosh chodesh adar rishon veim nadar ad sof adar hare ze asur ad sof adar sheni veim yada shehashshana meubberet venadar ad rosh adar asur ad rosh adar sheni

Haoser atzmo bedavar ad happesach ben sheamar ad pene happesach ben sheamar ad happesach eno asur ella ad sheyyaggia bilvad veim amar ad sheyyihye happesach hare asur ad sheyyetze happesach amar ad hakkatzir o ad habbatzir o sheamar ad sheyyihye habbatzir o hakkatzir eno asur ella ad sheyyaggia

Ze hakkelal kal shezzemanno kavua venadar adav en asur ella ad sheyyaggia veim nadar ad sheyyihye hare ze asur ad sheyyetze vechal sheen lo zeman kavua kegon zeman hakkatzir vehabbatzir ben shennadar adav ben shennadar ad sheyyihye eno asur ella ad sheyyaggia

Haoser atzmo bedavar ad hakkayitz hare asur ad sheyyatchilu anshe hammakom shennadar bo lehachnis kalkalot teenim ad hakkatzir ad sheyyatchilu haam liktzor ketzir chittim aval lo ketzir seorim peresh veamar ad sheyyaavor hakkayitz hare ze asur ad sheyyichpelu haam rov hammachtzelaot shebbammuktze shemmeyabbeshin alehem teenim vaanavim laasotam gerogarot vetzimmukim hakkol lefi mekom nidro shel noder

Ketzad hare shennadar bevika veasar atzmo baddavar ad hakkayitz veala lahar eno mistakkel bakkayitz shel makom shehu bo atta im higgia im lo higgia ella bakkayitz shel makom shennadar bo vealav hu somech vechen kal kayyotze baze

Haoser atzmo bedavar ad haggeshem hare ze asur ad zeman haggeshamim shehu beeretz yisrael rosh chodesh kislev higgia zeman haggeshamim hare ze muttar ben yardu geshamim ben lo yardu veim yardu geshamim mishshiva asar bemarcheshvan hare ze muttar veim amar ad haggeshamim hare ze asur ad sheyyerdu haggeshamim vehu sheyyardu mizzeman revia sheniyya shehu beeretz yisrael umkomot hassemuchin lah michg bemarcheshvan veelach veim peresh veamar ad sheyyippasku haggeshamim hare ze asur ad sheyyaavor happesach beeretz yisrael uvimkomot shehem kemotah

Mi shehiddir et ishto bemarcheshvan veamar lah sheen atte nehenet li mikkan vead happesach im telchi levet avicha mehayyom vead sukkot hare zo asura lehanot lo miyyad gezera shemma telech veim halcha lifne happesach vahare hu mehanne otah lifne happesach hare ze loke avar happesach af al pi shehalach hattenay hare ze asur linhog chullin benidro ulhannichah shettelech vetehene ella noheg bah issur ad hechag kemo shennadar veaf al pi shettala hanneder beissur zeman sheavar vechen kal kayyotze baze veim halcha achar happesach enah asura millehanot lo

Amar lah sheen atte nehenet li ad hechag im telchi levet avicha ad happesach asura lehanot miyyad veim halcha lifne happesach venimtza mehanne otah hare ze loke vaasura bahanayato ad hechag umutteret lelech levet aviha mishshehiggia happesach
Mishneh Torah, Vows 11: Katan ben shettem esre shana veom echad uktanna bat achat esre shana veom echad shennishbeu o nadru ben nidre issar ben nidre hekdesh bodkin otan veshoalin otan im yodin leshem mi nadru ulshem mi hikdishu venishbeu nidrehen kayyamim vehekdeshan hekdesh veim lo yadu en benidrehem uvdivrehem kelum utzrichin bedika kal hashshana kullah shehi shenat liktanna ushnat lekatan

Ketzad hare shennadru o hikdishu bitchillat shana zo veshaalu otan venimtzeu yodin venitkayyem nidran venadru neder acher afillu besof shana zo tzerichin bedika veachar kach yitkayyem veen omrin hoil venimtzeu yodin bitchillat hashshana en tzerichin bedika ella bodkin otan et kal hashshana hazzo kullah

Kodem hazzeman hazze af al pi sheamru yodin anu leshem mi nadarnu ulshem mi hikdashnu en nidrehen neder veen hekdeshan hekdesh veachar hazzeman hazze shennimtza habben ben shana veom echad vehabbat bat shana veom echad af al pi sheamru en anu yodin leshem mi nadarnu ulshem mi hikdashnu divrehen kayyamin vehekdeshan hekdesh venidrehen nedarim veaf al pi shello heviu shette searot vezo hi onat nedarim haamura bechal makom

Hoil vehiggiu lishne haggedolim nidrehen kayyamin af al pi shello heviu simanin vaadayin lo naasu gedolim lechal davar vedavar ze middivre tora shehammufla hassamuch leish hekdesho venidro neder af al pi shennidrehen kayyamin im chillelu nidran o nishbeu vehechlifu enan lokin ad sheyyagdilu veyaviu shette searot
Hikdishu uva haggadol venehena min hahekdesh shehikdishu loke mishshum shennidrehem nedarim min hattora kemo shebbearnu

Bamme devarim amurim shebbat shana veom echad nedareha kayyamin beshello hayeta birshut haav o birshut habbaal aval im hayeta birshut haav afillu higdila vahare hi naara aviha mefer kal nedareha vechal shevuot shettishshava beom shamo shenneemar kal nedareha veesareha vego ki heni aviha otah vego
Vead matay aviha mefer ad shettivgar bagra eno mefer lah vahare kal nedareha ushvuoteha keneder almana ugrusha shenneemar bahen kl asher asra al nafshah vego

Umeematay mefer habbaal nidre ishto ushvuoteha mishshettikkanes lachuppa vehu mefer leolam ad sheyegarshenna veyaggia hagget leyadah hayeta megoreshet missafek lo yafer lah natan lah get al tenay o leachar zeman lo yafer bayyamim shebbentayim vechen mi sheshshama shemmet balah venisset vahare balah kayyam vechayyotze bah en habbaal harishon velo haacharon meferin nedareha hayeta mechayyave lavin veen tzarich lomar mechayyave ase vehefer nedareha hare ellu mufarin
Naara meorasa en mefer nedareha ella haav im habbaal keachad veim hefer haechad levaddo eno mufar hefer habbaal levaddo veavra al nidrah kodem sheyyafer haav enah loka

Met haarus chazra lirshut aviha vechal shettiddor haav mefer keshehaya kodem shettitares met haav achar shennitarsa venadra achar moto en habbaal mefer sheen habbaal mefer nidre ishto ad shettikkanes lachuppa

Naara arusa shennadra veshama aviha velo shama arusah venitgarsha bo bayyom venitarsa leacher bo bayyom afillu lemea aviha uvalah haacharon meferin nedareha shennadra bifne arus rishon mippene shello yatzata lirshut atzmah shaa achat sheadayin hi birshut haav mippene shehi naara

Aval haishsha hannesua shennadra velo hefer lah balah vegershah bo bayyom vehechezirah bo bayyom eno yachol lehafer shehare yatzata lirshut atzmah achar shennadra af al pi shennadra birshuto vehi atta birshuto hoil veyatzta birshut atzmah bentayim nitkayemu nedareha

Naara meorasa shennadra velo shama aviha velo balah venitgarsha venitarsa laacherim afillu leachar kamma yamim kesheyyishma haav vehabbaal haacharon meferin nedareha shennadra bifne arus harishon hoil velo shama otam haarus harishon

Naara meorasa shennadra veshama aviha levaddo vehefer lah umet haarus kodem sheyyishma venitarsa bo bayyom afillu lemea aviha vaarusah haacharon meferin nedareha shennadra bifne arus rishon shemmet kodem sheyyishma
Shama arus rishon vehefer umet veachar kach shama haav venitarsa leacher bo bayyom aviha im haarus haacharon meferin nedareha

Shama aviha velo shama haarus umet bo bayyom haarus o sheshshama gam haarus vehefer o sheshshatak umet bo bayyom nitrokna reshut laav vehaav yachol lehafer shama haarus vekiyyem umet bo bayyom o sheshshama veshatak umet bayyom shelleacharav en haav yachol lehafer
Gershah haarus achar sheshshama hare ze safek im haggerushin kishtika veyafer haav im habbaal haacharon sheyeares bo bayyom o haggerushin kemo shekkiyyem arus rishon shekkevar nitkayemu hannedarim

Shama haav vehefer lah umet haav veachar kach shama habbaal afillu shama habbaal kodem sheyyamut haav lo nitrokna reshut labbaal veeno yachol lehafer leolam achar mot haav sheen haarus mefer ella beshuttafut

Shama arus vehefer lah umet veachar kach shama haav o sheshshama haav vehefer lah umet habbaal kodem sheyyishma en haav levaddo yachol lehafer nedarim ellu shenniru learus rishon ella beshuttafut arus haacharon im nitarsa bo bayyom kemo shebbearnu

Nadra vehefer lah aviha levaddo velo shama haarus ad shennichnesa lirshuto eno yachol lehafer sheen habbaal mefer nidre arusato achar shennisset ella kodem shettikkanes lirshuto hu shemmefer beshuttafut haav lefichach haya derech talmide chachamim ad shello tetze bitto mershuto omer lah kal nedarim shennadarte betoch beti hare hen mufarin
Vechen habbaal ad shello tikkanes lirshuto omer lah kal nedarim shennadarte mishsheerastich ad shello tikkansi betoch beti hare hen mufarin shehabbaal mefer nidre ishto af al pi shello shama otam

Halach haav im sheluche habbaal o shehalchu sheluche haav im sheluche habbaal adayin aviha uvalah meferin nedareha masar haav lishluche habbaal o shemmasru sheluche haav lishluche habbaal en haav yachol lehafer shehare yatzat mershuto velo habbaal yachol lehafer sheen habbaal mefer bekodmin kemo shebbearnu
Shomeret yavam afillu asa bah yevamah maamar vaafillu yavam echad livama achat eno mefer nidre yevimto ad sheyyavo aleha

Hayeta yevimto naara meorasa leachiv veaviha kayyam en hayyavam veaviha meferim nedareha keachat ella haav levaddo hu shemmefer kal shettiddor vaafillu asa bah hayyavam maamar enah kenaara meorasa sheen hammaamar kone bivama kinyan gamur kemo shebbearnu
Naara shehissiah aviha venitalmena o nitgarsha min hannissuin hare zo kitoma bechayye haav veen aviha mefer nedareha veaf al pi sheadayin hi naara

Naara meorasa shennadra velo shamu nedareha aviha uvalah ad shebbagra o ad shennaaset yetoma bechayye haav hare nedareha kayyamim veen habbaal yachol lehafer shehare yatzat mershut aviha shehu mefer immo beshuttafut vaadayin lo nichnesa lirshut habbaal
Mishneh Torah, Vows 12: Kal hannedarim vehashshevuot haav mefer beom shamo shenneemar kal nedareha veesareha aval habbaal eno yachol lehafer ella kal nedarim ushvuot sheyyesh bahen innuy nefesh o shehen bidvarim shebbeno levenah kegon shennishbea o nadra shello tichchol o shello titkashshet shenneemar ben ish leishto
Uma ben nedarim sheyyesh bahen innuy nefesh lidvarim shebbeno levenah shehannedarim sheyyesh bahen innuy nefesh mefer el atzmo veel acherim veshebbeno levenah leatzmo mefer velaacherim eno mefer

Ketzad nadra shello leechol basar mefer lah vetihye mutteret leechol im kal adam leolam asra aleha tashmish kal adam shebbaolam yafer chelko vetihye meshammashto uchsheyyamut o yegarshenna hare hi asura betashmish kal adam vechen kal kayyotze baze
Echad innuy gadol veechad innuy katan veechad innuy shehu lizman merubbe o lefi shaa hakkol mefer habbaal

Ketzad nadra o nishbea shello tirchatz hayyom o shello tishte yayin hayyom o shello tochal hayyom devash vechen im nadra shello tichchol hayyom o shello tilbash rikma hayyom mefer vechen kal kayyotze baze afillu nadra mimmaachal ra o mimmin shello taama oto miyyameha hare ze yafer
Nadra mishshete kikkarot beachat yesh lah innuy uvachat en lah innuy mefer lezo shemmitanna bah veeno mefer lezo sheen lah innuy

Nadra shello tochal teenim shel medina zo yafer mishshum devarim shebbeno levenah sheesek gadol hu lo lehittafel ulhavi lah mimmedina acheret lefichach im met o gershah o shehevi lah ish acher mipperot otah medina hare ellu asurin aleha sheeno mefer laacherim bidvarim shebbeno levenah

Vechen im nadra shello lehannot labberiyyot af al pi sheen habbaal bakkelal yesh lo lehafer mishshum devarim shebbeno levenah shello yihye zakuk lehaachilah mishshello bilvad vechen im asra hanaatah al umma kullah kegon kal hayehudim o kal hayyishmeelim hare ze yafer

Haishsha sheamarah levalah hanaat tashmishi asura alecha eno tzarich lehafer ha lema ze dome leoser perot chavero al baal happerot vechen hu sheomer lah hanaat tashmishi asura alayich lo amar kelum mippene shehu meshubad lah bisher kesut veona kemo shebbearnu behilchot ishut aval im amra lo hanaat tashmishcha asura alay tzarich lehafer veim lo hefer hare ze asur leshammeshah sheen maachilin et haadam davar haasur lo

Amra yikdeshu yaday leosehen o shennadra shello yehane bemaase yadeha eno neesar bemaase yadeha mippene sheyyadeha meshubadin lo sheaf al pi sheamru hashshichrur vehechametz vehahekdesh mafkiin hashshibud chachamim asu chizzuk leshibud habbaal sheenah yechola lehafkio mippene shehu middivrehem aval tzarich hu lehafer shemma yegarshenna vetihye asura lachzor lo

Nishbea o nadra shello yehene bah lo avi balah velo echav ushar kerovav eno yachol lehafer vechen im nadra shello etten mayim lifne behemtecha veteven lifne bekarcha vechayyotze bidvarim ellu sheen bahen innuy nefesh veenam middevarim shebbeno levenah veenah mimmelachot shehi chayyevet bahen hare ze eno yachol lehafer

Yesh labbaal velaav lehafer nedarim sheadayin lo chalu velo neesra bahen ketzad kegon sheamra hayyayin asur alay im elech lemakom peloni hare ze mefer af al pi sheadayin lo halcha velo neesra vechen kal kayyotze baze
Haav o habbaal sheen shomin enam meferin af al pi shehabbaal mefer nedarim shello shemaan harauy lishmoa en hashshemua meakkevet bo
Hashshote eno mefer ben av ben baal hakkatan en lo ishut lefichach eno mefer vehabbaal mefer nidre shette nashav keachat vechen haav mefer nidre shette benotav keachat

Hafarat nedarim kal hayyom veenah meet leet ketzad nadra bitchillat lel sheni hare mefer kal oto hallayela vechal yom sheni nadra beom sheni bitchillat hayyom mefer kal oto hayyom nadra besof hayyom im chashecha im hefer lah ad shello techshach mufar veim lo hefer lah ad shechashecha eno yachol lehafer

Umahu ze shekkatuv battora miyyom el yom melammed shemmefer ballayela im nadra ballayela vechen mefer kal hayyom kemo shebbearnu nadra veshahata kamma yamim veachar kach shama haav o habbaal hare ze mefer beom shamo uchillu nadra beet sheshshemaah shenneemar beom shamo lo beom nidrah bilvad

Naara meorasa shennadra veshama aviha vehefer ulachar yamim shama haarus vehefer beom shamo en ze mufar shenneemar veim heni aviha otah beom shamo vego veim hao tihye leish undareha aleha veshama ishah beom shamo vego ha lamadta sheachar shehefer haav veshama haarus hare ze mefer beom shemoa haav vehu haddin im shama arus vehefer veachar kamma yamim shama haav vehefer beom shamo sheeno mufar uminnayin shebbenaara meorasa hakkatuv medabber shehare hu omer lematta veim bet ishah nadara vego veshama ishah vehecherish lah vego mikkelal sheishah haamur lemala arus kemo shebbearnu

Shama haav o habbaal veshatak kede letzaarah af al pi shello haya belibbo lekayyem nidrah hoil veavar hayyom velo hefer velo bittel nitkayemu nedareha nadra vehefer lah haav o habbaal vehi lo yada shehefer veavra al nidrah o al shevuatah bezadon hare zo petura veaf al pi shennitkavvena leissur hoil venaasa hahetter petura veal ze neemar va yislach lah ki heni aviha otah umakkin otah makkat mardut mippene shennitkavvena leissur
Nadra veavra al nidrah kodem sheyyafer lah aviha o balah af al pi sheshshama bo bayyom vehefer lah hare zo chayyevet al davar sheavra bo im malkot malkot veim karban karban

Shama nidrah veshatak mippene shello haya yodea sheyyesh laav o labbaal lehafer o sheyyada sheyyesh lahem lehafer aval lo yada shenneder ze tzarich hafara ulachar zeman yada hare ze yafer ushat yediato keillu hi sheat hanneder o sheat shemuato veyafer kal hayyom

Nadra ishto vesavur shehi bitto vehefer lah al daat shehi bitto vechen im nadra benazir vesavur shennadra bekarban vehefer lah al daat shennadra karban asra atzmah bitenim vesavur sheasra atzmah baanavim vehefer lah al daat shennadra leesor atzmah baanavim tzarich lachzor ulhafer kesheyyeda hanneder vehannoderet leshem hannoderet hazzot ulshem hanneder hazze shenneemar lo heni aviha otah lenoderet atzmah veomer veshama aviha et nidrah ad sheyyeda e ze neder nadra veyesh lo lehafer oto kal yom hayedia
Mishneh Torah, Vows 13: Mefer adam o mekayyem divre ishto o bitto bichal lashon veaf al pi sheenah makkeret sheen haishsha tzericha lishmoa hahafara o hakkiyyum

Vechetzad mefer omer mufar o batel o en neder ze kelum vechayyotze bidvarim sheinyanam akirat hanneder meikkaro ben befaneha ben shello befaneha aval im amar lah i efshi shettiddori o en kan neder hare ze lo hefer vechen haomer leishto o levitto machul lich o muttar lich o sharuy lich vechal kayyotze beinyan ze lo amar kelum sheen haav vehabbaal mattir kemo hechacham ella oker hanneder mittechillato umfero
Vechetzad mekayyem kegon sheyyomar lah kayyam lechi o yafe nadarte o en kemotech o illu lo nadarte hayiti maddirech vechal kayyotze bidvarim shemmashmaan sheratza beneder ze
Hamvattel nidre ishto o bitto eno tzarich lomar kelum venitbattelu kal hannedarim
Umahu habbittul sheyyachof otah laasot davar sheasra oto aval hahafara eno kofe otah ella mefer lah umnichah im ratzta osa veim ratzta enah osa

Ketzad nadra o nishbea shello tochal o shello tishte veamar lah mufar lach hare ze hefer umutteret leechol velishtot natal venatan lah veamar lah teli veichli teli ushti hare zo ochelet veshotat vehanneder batel meelav

Hammefer nidre bitto o ishto tzarich lehotzi bisfatav veim hefer belibbo eno mufar aval hamvattel eno tzarich lehotzi bisfatav ella mevattel belibbo bilvad vechofe otah laasot ben asta ben lo asta batel hanneder

Meferin nedarim beshabbat ben letzorech hashshabbat ben shello letzorech hashshabbat velo yomar lah beshabbat mufar lich kederech sheomer bechol ella mevattel belibbo veomer lah teli ichli teli ushti vechayyotze baze

Haomer leishto o levitto kal hannedarim shettiddori mikkan vead sheavo mimmakom peloni hare hen kayyamin o hare hen mufarin lo amar kelum asa shaliach lehafer lah o lekayyem lah eno kelum shenneemar ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu vechen haav beatzmo velo bishlucho

Asra atzmah bitenim vaanavim ben beneder ben bishvua ben sheasra atzmah bechal hammin ben sheamra teenim vaanavim ellu vekiyyem litenim vehefer laanavim o shekkiyyem laanavim vehefer litenim ma shekkiyyem kayyam uma shehefer mufar vechen kal kayyotze baze veen omrin bahafara neder shehufar miktzato hufar kullo kederech sheomrin behattara
Mi shennadra ishto veshama vehitpis atzmo benidrah eno yachol lehafer shehare kiyyem lah nadar hu vehitpisa atzmah benidro mefer et shellah veshello kayyam
Ketzad shama ishto o bitto omrin hareni nezira veamar vaani eno yachol lehafer ushnehem nezirim amar hu hareni nazir veshama hi veamra vaani mefer lah veshello kayyam vechen kal kayyotze baze

Nadar leatzmo vehiddirah kemoto vegamar belibbo lehaddirah veamra amen hare ze eno yachol lehafer veim nadar vehiddirah derech sheela leda ma belibbah kemo sheamar lah hatirtzi beneder ze lihot kemoti o lo veamra amen hare ze mefer lah

Ketzad amar lah hareni nazir veatte kelomar veatte nezira kemoti veamra amen eno yachol lehafer amar lah hareni nazir uma tomri haatte nezira kemoti veamra amen hare ze yafer veim hefer lah shello batel shezze kemi shettala nidro benidrah amra lo hareni nezira veatta veamar amen eno yachol lehafer vechen kal kayyotze baze
Haishsha shennadra veshama acher vehitpis atzmo benidrah veamar vaani veshama aviha o balah vehefer lah shellah mufar veze shehitpis atzmo chayyav

Haishsha sheen lah baal veenah birshut av veamra hare habbasar asur alay leachar sheloshim yom venisset betoch sheloshim yom af al pi shebbeshaa shechal hanneder hare hi birshut habbaal eno yachol lehafer shebbishat hanneder lo hayeta birshuto veal ze neemar veneder almana ugrusha vego vaafillu hayeta meoreset lo bishat hanneder sheen habbaal mefer bekodmin kemo shebbearnu

Nadra tachat balah sheyyihye habbasar asur aleha leachar sheloshim yom o shettihye nezira leachar sheloshim yom vehefer lah balah umet o gershah betoch sheloshim yom af al pi shebbeshaa shehaya lanneder lachul hare hi gerusha o almana hare zo mutteret shekkevar hefer lah neder ze

Almana o gerusha sheamra hareni asura beyayin kesheennase venisset en habbaal yachol lehafer amra vehi tachat balah hareni asura bevasar kesheetgaresh hare habbaal mefer uchshettitgaresh tihye mutteret

Hamkayyem belibbo hare ze kayyam vehammefer belibbo eno mufar kemo shebbearnu lefichach im hefer belibbo hare ze yachol lachzor ulkayyem veim kiyyem belibbo eno yachol lachzor ulhafer ella im chazar betoch kede dibbur kede shello yihye koach devarim shebbelibbo gadol mikkoach hammotzi bisfatav

Hamkayyem nidre bitto o ishto venicham hare ze nishal lechacham umattir lo hakamato vechozer umefer lah bo bayyom aval im hefer lah venicham eno yachol lehishshael lechacham kede sheyyachazor vikayyem

Naara meorasa shennadra vekiyyem lah aviha levaddo o balah levaddo vehefer lah haacher af al pi shennishal lechacham vehittir lo hakamato eno chozer umefer lah im haacher shekkevar hefer lah sheen lahem lehafer ella shenehem keechad

Amar levitto o leishto kayyam lich kayyam lich venishal al hakama harishona hare hashsheniyya chala alav amar lah kayyam lich umufar lich velo tachul hakama ella im ken chala hafara hare ze mufar sheen hahakama moil achar hahafara amar lah kayyam umufar lich bevat achat hare ze kayyam amar lah kayyam lich hayyom hare ze kayyam leolam amar lah mufar lich lemachar eno mufar shehare kiyemo hayyom ulmachar eno yachol lehafer amar lah kayyam lich shaa achat veavar hayyom velo hefer hare ze kayyam veen omrin shezze kemi sheamar lah hare mufar lich leachar shaa shehare lo hotzi hafara mippiv amar lah kayyam lechi shaa achat uchsheavra hashshaa amar lah mufar lich hare ze safek ulfichach asura benidrah veim avra al nidrah enah loka

Mi shennadar nedarim kede lechonen deotav ultakken maasav hare ze zariz umshubbach ketzad kegon mi shehaya zolel veasar alav habbasar shana o shettayim o mi shehaya shoge bayyayin veasar hayyayin al atzmo zeman merubbe o asar hashshichrut leolam vechen mi shehaya rodef shalmonim venivhal lehon veasar al atzmo hammattanot o hanayat anshe medina zo vechen mi shehaya mitgae beyafo venadar benazir vechayyotze bindarim ellu kullan derech avoda lashshem hem uvindarim ellu vechayyotze bahen amru chachamim nedarim seyag lifrishut
Veaf al pi shehen avoda lashshem lo yarbe adam benidre issur velo yargil atzmo bahem ella yifrosh middevarim sherauy lifrosh mehen belo neder

Amru chachamim kal hannoder keillu bana bama veim avar venadar mitzva lehishshael al nidro kede shello yehe michshol lefanav bamme devarim amurim benidre issar aval nidre hekdesh mitzva lekayeman velo yishshael alehen ella middochak shenneemar nedaray la ashallem seliku lehu hilchot nedarim besiyata dishmayya
